stays.name: 成龍山莊
stays.description: 一個擁有安全、乾淨、溫馨的家及庭院造景的好地方，位於中台禪寺附近，是一個屬於旅遊的中心點。從設計到施工，全都由莊主父親一手包辦，藉由20多年的建築經驗，精心打造這與眾不同的渡假仙境。成龍山莊位於南投縣埔里鎮，是旅遊中心休憩最佳住宿地點。山莊擁有得天獨厚的四季氣候與甜美的山泉水質。是一棟歐式開放空間別墅，一、二樓有7米高挑空大廳，讓您瞬間釋放都市叢林裡的壓迫感。坐臥埔里郊區，綿綿山脈環繞，空氣、陽光、美景。在山居裡享受天然山泉泡澡或泡一壺茶、一杯咖啡之愜意。山莊夜色夜裡，聽著蛙嗚鳥叫聲以及山林裡交奏的聲音，還有三五好友爽朗的笑聲，早就忘卻了時間與空間的存在，剩下的是滿懷溫暖實在的感覺，伴著您進入夢鄉。此外，還有一座自己的農村酒莊-正龍酒莊，以埔里的紅甘蔗和清境地區的水蜜桃製酒，取名為甘願和桃喜，住宿可以免費品酒，還有一個溫室的番茄園，種植玉女小番茄，提供房客採果。(未成年請勿飲酒)記得來嘗嘗主人所烤的紅甘蔗，體驗埔里人的盛情，並以在地人的角度，讓您領略埔里這山城的美好哦!
stays.descriptionEn: A good place that has a safe, clean, warm home and garden landscaping, located near the Chung Tai Chan Monastery, and is a part of the tourism center. The father of the host constructed the house single-handedly, from design to construction, and with 20 years of construction experience, he carefully built this unique holiday wonderland. Cheng Long House is located in Puli Township, Nantou County, is the best place to stay in tourist centers. Cheng Long House is blessed with weather of four seasons and of sweet spring water. It is an open space villa with a European-style. The first and second floors have a seven-meter high-ceiling hall each, allowing you to instantly release the pressure in the urban jungle. The villa sits in the suburbs of Puli surrounded by mountains, air, sunlight, beautiful scenery. In Cheng Long House, you can enjoy the pleasure of taking a natural spring bath or enjoy the coziness of sipping a pot of tea, or a cup of coffee. At night, in the villa, you can listen to the birds singing and frogs wooing and the voice of the mountains played, as well as a few friends' hearty laughters, and you have long forgotten the existence of time and space. And, the rest is full of the feeling of warmth, accompanying your sleep. In addition, we have an own rural winery - Zhenglong Wineries. We use red cane of Puli and peace of Chingjing region in making wines, named Ganyuan and Taoxi, for a free wine-tasting of staying guests, as well as a greenhouse tomato garden, planting cherry tomatoes, offering guests fruit picking. (Minors do not drink) Remember to taste the roasted red cane offered by the host and experience the hospitality Puli. And with the local people's point of view, let you enjoy the beautiful mountain town of Puli.

stays.descriptionEn: Taomi Farm House B&B is located in Taomi Eco-Village (the vision developed after the 921 earthquake), has a quiet and serene environment. In front of the B&B, there stands a large camphor tree, you can sit under the tree by the stone table, drinking tea, chatting, enjoying the cool evening embrace of nature, it is quite an experience.

stays.name: 景上景休閒體驗農莊
stays.description: 景上景是一處讓你緩慢撥動日光、停留駐足觀星的渡假民宿。位於日月潭國家風景區桃米生態村、暨南國際大學後山，就在好山景、好水質、好生態的草湳濕地旁。海拔６５０公尺，視野廣闊，北望合歡山奇萊南峰雪景，南觀日月潭水社大山。景是到此住宿的客人長留腦海的記憶；生態是體驗大自然２４小時協奏不息的共鳴者。景上景農莊的主人用自然的農法種出四季的蔬果，依時令讓客人採摘、品嘗無毒的甜蜜果實。住宿房間每間皆有陽台，依面向觀景都會讓住宿者驚喜，芬多精迷漫整個周圍，晚上貓頭鷹的低嗚聲伴隨入眠。清晨時東面三千多公尺高山拱擁日出，伴著大家享用中西式早餐，給大家滿滿的活力能量。
stays.descriptionEn: Jingshangjing is vacation bed and breakfast where you can slowly stir the sunlight and stop to watch the stars. It is located in the Taomi Ecological Village of Sun Moon Lake on the mountain behind National Chi Nan University, next to Caonan Wetlands, a place of wonderful scenery and ecology. At an elevation of 650 meters, it features expansive views of the snow on Qilai Southern Peak in Hehuanshan in the north, and Shuishe Dashan by Sun Moon Lake in the south. The scenery is what creates the most unforgettable memories, and the ecology is a harmonious way to experience nature at any time of the day. The owner uses natural agricultural methods to grow different seasonal fruits and vegetables, which visitors are allowed to pick, tasting sweet fruit free of pesticides. Rooms come with balconies and amazing scenic views, the air is filled with phytoncides, and guests are lulled to sleep by the low cries of owls. In the morning, the sunrise is embraced by a 3,000 meter mountain while visitors enjoy a Western or Chinese breakfast, providing energy for the day to come.

stays.searchText: 景上景休閒體驗農莊 景上景休閒體驗農莊 南投縣民宿480號 南投縣 埔里鎮 桃米里10鄰種瓜路45-3號 景上景是一處讓你緩慢撥動日光、停留駐足觀星的渡假民宿。位於日月潭國家風景區桃米生態村、暨南國際大學後山，就在好山景、好水質、好生態的草湳濕地旁。海拔６５０公尺，視野廣闊，北望合歡山奇萊南峰雪景，南觀日月潭水社大山。景是到此住宿的客人長留腦海的記憶；生態是體驗大自然２４小時協奏不息的共鳴者。景上景農莊的主人用自然的農法種出四季的蔬果，依時令讓客人採摘、品嘗無毒的甜蜜果實。住宿房間每間皆有陽台，依面向觀景都會讓住宿者驚喜，芬多精迷漫整個周圍，晚上貓頭鷹的低嗚聲伴隨入眠。清晨時東面三千多公尺高山拱擁日出，伴著大家享用中西式早餐，給大家滿滿的活力能量。

stays.description: 松風民宿位於埔里市區有庭園景觀及鄉村寧靜空間，訊且鄰近週五、週六埔里大夜市(享受寧靜的田園步調還有熱鬧的鄉村夜市)，白天體會埔里熱情的民風，品嚐埔里酒廠之佳釀，舉凡紹興宴、當地風味餐，地理中心碑、台一生態教育農場、觀音瀑布，都是在本民宿約3～15分鐘車程，週五、週六又有埔里大夜市可以品嘗美食小吃。松風位在花卉特產中心旁，距國道6號交流道只有3分鐘車程且附近麥當勞、亞卓餐廳（客家料理），吃飯相當方便，且距離埔里酒廠走路只需5 ～ 10分鐘、開車至地理中心碑、廣興紙寮都只要約10分鐘、牛耳藝術渡假村約10分鐘、九族文化村約25分鐘、日月潭20分鐘、清境農場40分鐘，不論去任何景點都相當方便。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Puli City, Songfeng Recreation Farm features outdoor scenery and countryside peace and quiet, and is close to the Puli Night Market, open on Fridays and Saturdays (enjoy the serenity of the countryside living as well as the liveliness of the night market). During the day, enjoy Puli’s friendly atmosphere and try out the great brewery products. Locations within a 3-15 minute drive include Shaoxing Banquet, local flavor restaurants, the Geographic Center of Taiwan Tablet, Taiyi Ecological Leisure Farm, and Guanyin Waterfall. Delicious foods and snacks are available to try at the Puli Night Market on Fridays and Saturdays. Songfeng is located next to the Puli Multi-Function Flower Center and a 3 minute drive from National Highway No. 6, near Mcdonald’s and Ya Zhuo Restaurant (Hakka cuisine), making finding a place to eat convenient. It’s a 5-10 minute walk from Puli Brewery, 10 minute drive to the Geographic Center of Taiwan Tablet, Taiwanpaper, and New Era Art Resort and Spa, 25 minutes to the Formosa Aboriginal Culture Village, 20 minutes to Sun Moon Lake, and 40 minutes to Cing Jing (Qing Jing) Farm, making travel to any of these places convenient.

stays.description: 「桃源山莊‧埔里桃米民宿」位於南投埔里桃米社區，坐擁青山綠水的宜人美景，周邊鄰近紙教堂、月老教堂、桃米村、元首館、虎頭山、鯉魚潭、廣興紙寮、18度C巧克力工坊、地理中心碑等必訪景點，前往日月潭、九族文化村更是輕鬆可到，是您來到南投旅行的最佳住宿選擇！「桃源山莊‧埔里桃米民宿」占地遼闊，擁有寬敞的草皮庭園、小池塘與戶外觀景區等讓大小朋友都能與大自然近距離接觸，山莊內不僅戶外規劃完善，室內更是豐富多變，除了窗明几淨的客廳外，亦有廚房、棋牌室等讓旅人自由應用，盡情地在此渡過歡樂時光。「桃源山莊‧埔里桃米民宿」內備有二至五人套雅房，不論是情侶、親子或團體出遊都能擁有最舒適的住宿感受，房間內優雅別緻，部分房內有著對外觀景窗，張眼即是綠意盎然的療癒景色！除此之外，山莊也貼心地準備有五人房中房、多人單床房等，讓您能夠在與旅伴共享旅程的同時又保有私人空間，彼此都能盡情地放鬆身心，留下美好的旅行回憶。倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【0965-353149】桃源山莊‧埔里桃米民宿
stays.descriptionEn: Taoyuan Villa ‧ Puli Taomi B&BTaoyuan Villa ‧ Puli Taomi B&B is located in the Taomi community of Puli, Nantou, surrounded by picturesque mountains and rivers. The B&B is near must-visit attractions such as the Paper Dome, Cupid’s Church, Taomi Village, King Garden, Hutoushan, Liyu Lake, Guangxing Paper Mill, 18°C Chocolate Factory, and the Geographic Center of Taiwan Monument. It’s also just a short and easy drive to Sun Moon Lake and Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village — the perfect accommodation for your Nantou trip!

stays.name: 桃米松民宿
stays.description: 「埔里桃米松民宿」位於令人心曠神怡的南投埔里山城，位置座落在一片自然山林、鄉野景色之間。民宿正對面的青翠群山清晰可見，遠處的中央山脈更是清晰可見，擁攬晨曦、山嵐等半山腰的悠然美景，山巒、雲嵐、日出、星星、造型各異的竹(樹)形的不同變化輕鬆即可領略。歡迎您用雙手感受泥土的溫度，用雙耳聆賞大自然的鳥叫蟲鳴，以雙目欣賞青蛙、蜻蜓、蝴蝶、夏日螢火蟲、五月桐花雪等多元的豐富生態。您也可選擇悠閒地漫步林邊步道，來場森林浴生態之旅，讓身心深層放鬆。 「埔里桃米松民宿」擁有寬廣的活動空間，更備有露天休閒桌椅和觀景平台，提供一處可以舉辦活動、泡茶、烤肉的開闊空間，更提供代洽社區賞蛙、夏日螢火蟲參訪、農村體驗營等特色活動報名服務。想要深入鄉野，享受山林間的清涼宜人，感受樸實的友善人情味~來這裡就對了！
stays.descriptionEn: "TaoMiSong B&B in Puli" sits in Shan Cheng, Puli, Nantou where there are soothing and relaxing mountains and forests with rural sceneries. The green mountains opposite to the B&B is clearly visible with the Central Mountain Range in the distance. It has a beautiful view of sunrise and clouds and mists in the halfway up a hills. You may easily watch mountains, clouds, sunset, stars, and trees as well as bamboos with different shapes. Welcome you to feel the temperature of the earth with your hands and hear the ambinet sound of birds and insects in the nature. You may also watch frogs, dragonflies, butterflies, summer fireflies, and tung blossoms in May. You may also choose to stroll forest trails slowly for a forest ecoloical trip to deeply relax your mind and body. "TaoMiSong B&B in Puli" has a vast space for activities and outdoor tables and chairs with the viewing platform where you may organize events, brew tea, or Barbecue. We can also help you book the activities, such as frog and firefly watching, or farm fun camp. If you want to travel in the countryside and enjoy the coolness in the mountains and forests, or feel the pure hospitality, come here!

stays.name: 櫻花民宿
stays.description: 櫻花村汽車旅館位於南投縣埔里鎮，是一間結合休閒、旅遊與住宿功能的汽車旅館。旅館地處交通便利的位置，四周群山環繞、環境清幽，是前往南投各大景點旅遊時理想的休憩與住宿地點。附近景點包含埔里酒廠、鯉魚潭、中台禪寺、桃米生態村，以及通往日月潭、清境農場等熱門觀光區的交通樞紐。 館內設有多種不同風格的房型，例如商務套房、時尚套房與浪漫蜜月套房，滿足不同旅客的需求。客房設備完善，提供寬敞舒適的住宿空間，並配備液晶電視、KING SIZE雙人床、按摩浴缸、蒸氣室及免費無線網路等設施，讓旅客在旅途中也能享受放鬆與便利。 此外，旅館也提供多項貼心服務，例如24小時櫃檯服務、免費停車、旅遊諮詢與客房清潔等，無論是商務出差、情侶度假或家庭旅遊，都能獲得舒適且便利的住宿體驗。整體而言，櫻花村汽車旅館以舒適的環境、齊全的設備與便利的地理位置，成為許多旅客造訪埔里時的住宿選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: Sakura Village Motel, located in Puli Township, Nantou County, is a motel combining leisure, tourism, and accommodation. Conveniently situated amidst mountains and a tranquil environment, it& #39;s an ideal place to rest and stay when visiting Nantou& #39;s various attractions. Nearby attractions include Puli Winery, Carp Lake, Chung Tai Chan Monastery, Taomi Eco-Village, and it serves as a transportation hub for popular tourist areas such as Sun Moon Lake and Cingjing Farm.The motel offers a variety of room types, including business suites, stylish suites, and romantic honeymoon suites, catering to different travelers& #39; needs. The well-equipped rooms provide spacious and comfortable accommodations, featuring amenities such as LCD TVs, king-size beds, jacuzzi bathtubs, steam rooms, and free Wi-Fi, allowing guests to relax and enjoy convenience during their trip.Furthermore, the motel offers a number of thoughtful services, such as 24-hour front desk service, free parking, tourist information, and housekeeping, ensuring a comfortable and convenient stay for business travelers, couples, or families. Overall, Sakura Village Motel has become a popular accommodation choice for many travelers visiting Puli due to its comfortable environment, complete facilities, and convenient location.

stays.name: 水泥角生態民宿
stays.description: 水泥角生態民宿 位於南投埔里桃米生態村，是一間以「生態共生、親近自然」為理念的特色民宿。環境被森林與溪流包圍，擁有豐富的蛙類與昆蟲生態，適合親子與喜愛慢活、自然體驗的旅人。民宿結合簡約設計與舒適空間，提供生態導覽、在地早餐與包棟服務，讓旅人放慢步調，感受埔里的自然日常。
stays.descriptionEn: The Nearest Nook B&B is located in Taomi Ecological Village, Puli, Nantou. Surrounded by forests and streams, it offers a nature-focused stay with rich frog and insect ecology. With a simple, comfortable design, the guesthouse is ideal for families and travelers seeking a slow, eco-friendly experience, featuring local breakfasts, eco tours, and whole-house rentals.

stays.name: 永樂園旅社
stays.description: 永樂園旅社位於南投縣埔里鎮近埔里車站的旅館, 日據時代阿嬤就開始經營, 當時是仁愛鄉原著民要到平地買賣物品,採購首選歇腳處! (當時稱之為番仔間)我們仍保留當時部分建築, 大廳地板也是50年代磨石裝飾, 在永樂園可以感受時空年代穿越, 我們有的是人與人之間的和善及人情味傳遞房型有背包客房(4-6人一間),雙人房,三人房,家庭房,房間溫馨乾淨平價, 永樂園是您出外住宿好選擇.
stays.descriptionEn: Forever Happiness Hotel located near Puli Station in Puli Township, Nantou County.Grandma started operating during the Japanese occupation period. At that time, the aboriginals of Renai Township wanted to buy and sell goods on the flat land, and the preferred resting place for purchase!We still retain some of the buildings at that time. The floor of the hall is also decorated with millstones in the 50s. In Forever Happiness Hotel , you can experience the passage of time and space. What we have is the transfer of kindness and humanity between peopleThere are backpack rooms (a room for 4-6 people), double rooms, triple rooms, and family rooms. The rooms are warm, clean and affordable.we are your good choice for stay.

stays.name: 滿一民宿
stays.description: 這是一間座落在青山綠野中的民宿，新鮮空氣，山巒美景，綠葉環繞四周，遼闊的庭院與藍天陽光相互輝映，令人暫時忘卻都市喧擾塵囂，來南投埔里享受悠閒時刻，盡情遊走微風山谷，尋幽走訪綠野山水，品嘗悠閒寂靜的花草芬芳，清新悅耳蟲鳴鳥叫聲與您相互歌唱，給您一趟接近大自然的旅程，享受大自然迂迴的美。藍天綠野自然風光，夜晚滿天星斗，提供給每位友人享有更休閒、更優質的住宿環境與空間，忘卻俗世的紛紛擾擾，拋憂忘愁，讓您疲憊的心靈沉澱一下，感受另類的、特別的當地住宿風格。

stays.description: 漫漫耕恬民宿位於投64縣道約8.5公里處，從台21線51公里處進入距離約2公里，位置處於南投縣埔里鎮與日月潭風景區的中間，離國道6號愛蘭交流道6公里，交通便利。*GPS定位:E東經120度54分31秒，N北緯23度56分1秒漫漫耕恬民宿海拔約750公尺，全日照向陽面的山景優美，可以遠眺日月潭，民宿園區是MOA認證的法瑪斯特有機農場，園區自然天成，有機栽培多樣的果樹與蔬菜，遊客可以預約體驗農耕生活或生態導覽。民宿建築以綠建築概念，內部多以原實木裝潢，簡單溫馨，健康環保。貴客早餐我們提供親手現做的有機食材與手工自製的窯烤麵包。漫漫耕耘心靈的香恬，漫漫栽種幸福的滋味...我們在山上過半農半 X 的生活，這裡記錄著我们開山闢壤，建設過程的點點滴滴，歡迎一起來與我們分享生活故事以及體驗山上豐富的生態。
stays.descriptionEn: Beyond Hill Cottage is located at the 8.5 kilometer mark on Provincial Highway 64, about 2 kilometers from the Provincial Highway 21 51 kilometer mark, between Puli and Sun Moon Lake, about 6 kilometers from National Highway No. 6 Ailan Interchange, making it convenient for transportation. *GPS coordinates: East Longitude 120 degrees, 54 minutes, 31 seconds and North Latitude 23 degrees, 56 minutes, 1 second. Elevation: 750 meters. It faces the mountains, features views of Sun Moon Lake, and is an MOA-certified Fa Ma Si Te organic farm with a natural garden growing a variety of organic fruit trees and vegetables. Visitors may make reservations for the agricultural life or ecological tour. The structure features green architecture and wooden interior decorations, providing a simple, warm, healthy, and environmentally-friendly atmosphere. Breakfast is handmade using organic ingredients and includes oven-baked bread. Gently cultivate your spirit and sow the seeds of happiness. This place records the details of our pioneering spirit and construction process. Come share our life story and experience the rich mountain ecology.

stays.name: 漾之谷溫泉民宿
stays.nameEn: The Rippling Vale,Mansion Of Hot Spring
stays.description: 漾之谷位於有小洛陽的埔里鎮小山谷水漾曲折青山澗 幽徑直指桃花源覓得玉泉洗凝脂 挽來貴妃作一回 夜入回燈留客宿 明日醒來各自還 莫問王孫何處去 道盡山城小洛陽漾之谷的溫泉色清無臭，洗後光滑柔細不黏膩，屬於弱鹼性性溫泉，由於富含礦物質，因此不論是浸泡、沐浴或經處理後成為礦泉水飲用，都對身體健康極有幫助，在忙碌的都市生活裡，是不是很久沒好好的睡飽了呢？漾之谷沒有飯店華麗裝潢，簡約、自然、樸誠，享受閒逸涼風徐徐度，提供原木的家具，好睡的床，裝潢就是原始無加工的山林美景，想體驗山上隱居慢活生活，或是玩膩了每次旅遊總是在趕行程讓自己回去覺得更累呢? 那你一定要來漾之谷住住，泡著舒服放鬆的溫泉後，好好讓自己睡一覺，早晨起來享受置身林中的芬多精，享用我們準備的溫泉早餐，慢慢體驗埔里小鎮的好山好水好風光。
stays.descriptionEn: Known as “Little Loyang,” The Rippling Vale, Mansion Of Hot Spring is located in Xiaoshan Valley (Puli Township). Its hot springs are clear and odorless, leave the skin feeling soft, smooth, and refreshed, and are mildly alkaline. Minerals in the water make it healthy for soaking, bathing, or drinking (after treatment). In your busy city life, how long has it been since you had a good rest? Instead of luxurious hotel decorations, we offer simplicity, natural elements, honesty, and enjoying the cool breeze, providing wooden furniture and good sleeping beds. The scenery of the mountains serves as the most natural decoration. Would you like to experience the relaxation and seclusion of mountain life, or are you tired of going on vacation and rushing from one place to the next, leaving you even more tired when you return? Then you must pay us a visit, soaking in the comfortable, relaxing springs, taking a deep rest, enjoying phytoncides in the morning, trying out our specially-prepared breakfast, and deliberately experiencing the scenic of beauty of Puli.

stays.description: 南投｜熊麋鹿了幸福手作民宿．無敵可愛的日雜風民宿這一次真的迷路了！桃米里路旁站著各家民宿指標，卻怎麼樣都找不著那個傳說中超級可愛的目的地。我們在鄉間小路上轉呀轉，終於轉進了這棟刻意連指標都沒有的──熊糜鹿了！從漫畫裡走出來的夢幻主人走進這棟漆成粉紅色的幸福手作民宿，寬敞的空間溫暖又明亮，甜甜的日系鄉村風伴隨著肉桂香飄來，淺色的木製書櫃上擺著各式各樣可愛的小雜貨，而這間旅宿的主角──熊和麋鹿，就躲在各個角落！不管是正在比腕力的麋鹿和黑熊，或是主人設計有著麋鹿角的小白熊，每隻都笑得燦爛迎接你們！但你絕對想不到，這麼可愛夢幻的童話民宿，竟然是來自兩個大男孩手裡──Jerry和Ethan！Jerry又被暱稱為「兔兔哥」，就是庫洛魔法使裡的兔兔哥，兩個人就像從少女漫畫裡走出來一樣，白白淨淨，彎月般的眼睛、嘴角是靦腆的微笑。由他們準備好的下午茶早已等著你們，更驚喜的是，你們還可以自己選擇繽紛的馬克杯喝茶！這裡的茶和手工餅乾是24小時供應的，甚至可以預約報名Jerry 和Ethan的甜點DIY工作坊，一起穿上可愛的圍裙在可愛的房子裡做香甜的餅乾！少女們的甜美豪宅熊麋鹿了絕對是少女們的豪宅，不是金碧輝煌的那種豪華，而是無處不甜美可口、少女們的夢幻華麗！一樓的公共空間，有著薰衣草色的花布沙發，一隻跟真人一般高的鬆軟大熊就在沙發裡等著跟妳擁抱，就連天花板的樹也是一層雲、一層蝴蝶、一層愛心的形狀！每間房都刷上各種粉嫩的顏色，最受歡迎的就是三樓Tiffany blue的房間，天花板裁成鑽石的線條，掛著華麗的水晶燈；還有一樓的拉拉熊房，門口大大的熊頭和熊掌，還沒進門就先跟你Give me five！不只如此，每間房間與浴室都提供暖氣，更選用與全球希爾頓飯店集團同等級的床，讓每個旅人都能香甜入夢！
stays.descriptionEn: Nantou｜Bear Meets MooseThe unparalleled cuteness of a Japanese zakka-style guesthouseWe’re really lost this time! Various guesthouse signs stand along either side of the road in Taomi Village, yet our fabled super-cute destination is nowhere to be found. Turning this way and that on the country lanes, we finally arrive at the Bear Meets Moose guesthouse. No wonder we got lost. They purposely have no sign!Dreamlike hosts straight out of Japanese mangaYou enter the pink building of the Bear Meets Moose guesthouse. Spacious, warm and bright, the style is rustic Japanese and there is a smell of cinnamon in the air. Light-colored wooden bookshelves hold all kinds of cute miscellaneous goods. Of course, the leading characters of this guesthouse - bear and moose - are hiding in every corner! No matter if it’s armwrestling moose and black bear, or white bears with moose antlers designed by the guesthouse owner, each wears a welcoming smile just for you!The most unexpected thing is that this cute, dreamlike, fairytale guesthouse is actually the creation of two grown boys, Jerry and Ethan. Jerry’s nickname is Tu-Tu-Ge (or Rabbit Brother), a reference to Tukisiro Yukito from the Japanese manga Cardcaptor Sakura. Both Jerry and Ethan appear as if they have just emerged from the kind of manga adored by young girls, with their fair, clear skin, eyes like crescent moons, and mouths always turned up at the corners in a smile.Afternoon tea prepared by the hosts is ready and waiting for you, but the best thing is that you get to choose your preferred mug from their rich and varied collections. Tea and handmade cookies are available around the clock here. You can even sign up for Jerry and Ethan’s own DIY dessert workshop, donning a cute apron in this cute house to make cute aromatic cookies together!A mansion fit for young ladiesBear Meets Moose is absolutely a mansion fit for young ladies; not a gold-and-jade kind of luxuriousness, but rather the kind of sweet and gorgeous environment that young girls dream of. A lavender-colored calico sofa furnishes the first floor common space, and a life-sized stuffed bear sits there awaiting your embrace. Even the wooden tree adorning the wall and ceiling spreads out overhead in layered shapes resembling a cloud, a butterfly and a heart!Each room is painted in tender colors, the favorite being the Tiffany blue room on the third floor where the ceiling is cut into diamond-shaped lines and adorned with a crystal light fixture. There is also the Rilakkuma room on the first floor where the doors are decorated with a big bear’s head and paws asking you to “give me five” before you enter. Furthermore, room and bathroom are furnished with a heater and a bed of the same quality as the Hilton hotel chain. Each and every guest is guaranteed a sweet night’s sleep.Joy fills the space inside and outYou wake up in the morning and push open the balcony doors. The sight of blue sky and green grass raises your spirits. Next, you go down stairs and find Jerry and Ethan working together to make the breakfast of your choice: a savory American-style meal, sweet banana and chocolate waffles, or toast and homemade jam. Breakfast is served with hot tea or coffee, giving the day a sumptuous and delightful start. After breakfast, walk out into the vast outdoor park area and discover even more pleasant surprises. Apart from the ecological pond and the four-seasons pathway, there is even a pool shaped like a cupid’s heart. Near the pool is a spacious barbecue area with the option to order barbecued suckling pig. Time flies in such a place, but each moment leaves a cheerful memory.

stays.name: 石上清泉
stays.description: 石上清泉度假民宿空山新雨後，天氣晚來秋。明月松間照，清泉石上流。竹喧歸浣女，蓮動下漁舟。隨意春芳歇，王孫自可留。 ～王維 山居秋暝因喜歡詩中的意境，所以將民宿命名「石上清泉」。這裡位於埔里桃米社區，一棟日式的建築，銀灰色屋頂、潔白的外牆，這裡被四周的青山所環繞，擁有著純淨的山泉、清新的空氣、藍天白雲的寬闊景緻和美麗的田園風情。午後在庭園中靜靜的享受著美麗的景色，彷彿一切的時間都慢了下來，到了晚上，走到湯屋好好洗滌一下沈睡已久的心靈，之後再到居酒屋與三五好友小酌一番，放鬆心情。早上醒來，沐浴在溫暖的陽光中，坐在庭園中享受美味的早點，看著陽光變化的光影，聽著風吹拂樹葉的聲音，放眼看去全是草木的溫潤色澤，遠離都市塵囂享受寧靜貼近自然……………經營民宿已經邁入第十個年頭，我們希望每一位來到這裡的旅客都能享受溫馨舒適、遠離塵囂的片刻寧靜，得到真正的身心放鬆，完全度假的感受。
stays.descriptionEn: Rock Springs B&B After the rain, the mountains are empty / After the evening, the weather turns cold. / Moonlight penetrates the pine trees, / water flow over rocks. / When bamboos make noise, it is the sign of washerwomen returning home. / Lotus waves, we know someone is going down the boat. / Spring is leaving, leisurely, I am contented, and here I stay. / ~ Mountain Autumn Evening by Wang Wei. Because we like the artistic mood of the poem, so the B&B named Rock Springs B&B (Shí Shàng Qīng Quán). It is located in Taumi, Puli, a Japanese-style building with silver roof and clear white walls, surrounded by green mountains. Here has pure spring, fresh air, blue sky, and beautiful wide views of idyllic. Quietly enjoying the beautiful scenery in the garden in the afternoon, as if everything& #39;s time is slowing down. At night, go to the bathing house to take a good bath washing slumbering mind. After that have a drink at the pub or izakaya with a few friends to relax. Woke up in the morning, bathed in the warm sunshine, sit in the garden and enjoy a delicious breakfast. Watch the sun changes in light and shadow, listen to the sound of the wind blowing leaves, look around all vegetation are all in warm color, and we enjoy the tranquility, being away from the city hubbub but close to nature.... The B&B has been in business for nearly 10 years, we hope that every guest comes here can enjoy a cozy, quiet moment away from the hubbub and get really relaxed, complete vacation experience.

stays.name: 紅瓦厝山居民宿
stays.description: 尋找近代文明欠缺綠生活環境在桃米生態村紅瓦厝民宿，最快速的方法就是到當地體驗看看。埔里民宿～紅瓦厝山居民宿」利用環境優勢並結合在地景色，在所屬範圍內規劃出客房、餐廳、視廳會議室及賞景台，每個環境區域都散風著一股懷舊的古早氣息，藉由原木、紅磚等自然元素之建材，為遊客打造出最樸實單純的休憩領域。除了懷舊風的景致之外，「紅瓦厝山居民宿」也規劃了擁有復古與現代感的新館住所，讓您能透過不同的氛圍環境，去感受不同的住宿樂趣。
stays.descriptionEn: Looking for green living environment that modern civilization lacks? Come Red Tile House Bed and Breakfast in Taumi ecological village. "Puli B&B ~ Red Tile House" took advantage of environmental advantages and combined with local scenery, within the scope planned their rooms, restaurant, conference rooms, and viewing terrace. Each environmental area emits an ancient nostalgic atmosphere through the natural elements of the building materials such as timber, red brick, and others, to create the most pure and simple leisure fields for travelers. Besides the nostalgic scenery, "Red Tile House" is also planning a new house featuring the senses of both retro and modern to allow you to experience different accommodation fun through different atmosphere environment.

stays.name: 綠堡休閒民宿
stays.description: 「埔里‧綠堡休閒民宿」綠色鄉村風十足的外觀就像童話故事內的城堡般讓人驚艷，戶外庭園遼闊寬敞，有草皮與休憩區讓旅人應用，不論是散客住宿或是團體出遊包棟都十分適合，民宿大廳空間窗明几淨，設置了多組休憩桌椅讓您可與旅伴在此聊天，分享旅行中的點滴；民宿除了接待散客和小家庭，亦歡迎團體入住，但為了維護住宿品質及環境安寧，期許所有住客能於晚間10點結束團聚活動並降低音量，以共同維護旅居品質，我們希望每組旅客都能在這裡獲得最舒服的住宿體驗民宿內提供二至六人房型，房間以繽紛色彩營造出各種風格，簡約的擺設散發著自在的氛圍，更規劃有觀景窗讓您欣賞戶外景色，而房內也準備了齊全備品與柔軟床褥和乾濕分離衛浴等呵護旅人，讓每個來到「埔里‧綠堡休閒民宿」的旅人都能夠有賓至如歸的感受，盡情地享受難得的旅行時光！

stays.name: 綠湖別莊民宿
stays.description: 綠湖別莊民宿-十年前, 別莊主人返回鄉里, 打造一間自己的渡假屋! 今日, 這間渡假屋敞開大門, 歡迎您的光臨.... 在這裡, 桃花源般的閒適, 一次表現到底, 外界的紛紛擾擾, 都與此處無關! 滿眼的柔綠鋪著地, 迎接著 您的目光與腳步! 沒有車馬嘶鳴, 沒有水泥叢林, 自在與悠閒, 是這裡的基本氣氛! 歡樂與笑聲, 是這裡的共同語言! 在這裡, 手工訂製傢俱 古董字畫 已陸續進場, 傢俱的標準材質, 是台灣檜木, 風格 是極簡與細緻! 品味 是精緻與高雅! 水墨的氣韻 水彩的高雅 油畫的深度 膠彩的細膩 別莊主人, 再度為自己的渡假屋, 做全面性的品質呈現! 這次 是專程為您, 打造這一份渡假賀禮... 綠湖別莊 庭園渡假民宿 藝術展現
stays.descriptionEn: "Lu Hu Bie Zhuang Homestay" was built ten years ago by the host who returned to his old homeland to build his vacation dreams, It is now open to offer a carefree atmosphere to all visitors and make everyone enjoy with contentment and satisfaction! The soft tuft is always welcoming, you will see no more busy traffic, excessive concrete buildings; instead, everything is relaxing and soothing, and the talks are filled with happiness and laughter! Don& #39;t get stunned by the host& #39;s collection of handmade cypress furniture, antiques, calligraphy and painting, it& #39;s typical for amateurs of art to pursue a simplistic yet delicate life of elegance! Artworks of ink, gouache, oil and acrylic paints fill the space with diversity and are always there, ready to catch your eyes. Make sure you visit "Lu Hu Bie Zhuang" for a feast of artistic concepts in a restful atmosphere!

stays.name: 草本生活家民宿
stays.description: 「埔里桃米民宿～草本生活家」擁有豐富的自然生態圈，四季皆有不同變化的動植物群，還有後山森林步道，在這能聆聽蛙嗚、蟲叫、鳥啼所共同譜出的自然樂章；彷彿與大自然融為一體；盡情得徜徉在大自然中悠然、自得～初夏的螢火蟲及滿天的星斗相互呼應；都將帶給您最驚豔的視覺饗宴。盛夏時期可到一旁清澈溪流邊玩玩沁涼的溪水，坐在樹蔭下吹著徐徐的微風享受這別具悠閒的渡假時光。
stays.descriptionEn: "Puli Taomi Homestay～Cao Ben Shenghuo Jia Homestay" has a rich natural ecosystem with different flora and fauna as well as forest trails. You can hear the ambient sound of frogs, insects, and birds; You may feel at one with nature; You can indulge in the nature～the fireflies in the early summer echo the starry sky; all of these will give you the most amazingly visual impact. In the summer, you can play at the riverside or sit under a tree and feel the breeze on your body to enjoy this leisure and vacation time.

stays.description: 位於南投縣埔里鎮市中心的民宿,商務旅遊~最佳的中繼站~開車至日月潭遊湖,坐船35分鐘~武界看日出開車45分鐘~清境觀山景開車55分鐘~合觀山賞雪開車90分鐘~若是在市中心可在一早至步行13分鐘到傳統市場第三市場吃著~老字號的豆花粉圓~老店羹麵~老店好吃的素食早餐~老店古早味蘿蔔糕~還有很多,好吃,攤位琳琅滿目的物品看看,逛完接著再來去埔里響亮的18度C巧克力工坊開車4分鐘到~附近就可再去埔里有名的廟宇地母廟(每年的誕辰祝壽是埔里一大特色)走走,是個讓人非常舒服地方~中午要讓肚子填飽有距離民宿開車4分鐘到娜娜泰式時尚料理很有特色的一家店食物好吃到不行~或者也可開車約4分鐘埔里酒廠對面一家振松記米粉店舖吃料理,飯後當然就是到對面埔里酒廠看看吃有名的紹興香腸~品嚐裏頭的酒香,還有很多有特色的攤位讓您流連忘返哦!如果還是沒過癮接著開車約12分鐘到有童話風城堡的景點元首館走走會讓您拍照拍個停不下來了.

stays.name: 西站行旅
stays.description: 過去曾經是埔里西站公車轉運站，經九二一摧毀等閒置17年已久，歷時兩年完工，2014年正式營運的埔里西站行旅，以『雅緻新普普藝術主義』建築風格為主，外牆大膽用色，屹立在主要中繼站的埔里市中心。是西站商旅希望為旅客來此停留時放鬆心情充電，再繼續走往下一個旅途。台灣廚師/節目主持人詹姆士 ; 台灣女藝人蝴蝶姊姊 ; 三立、八大、東森、公共、mom、大愛電視台等知名電視台後製錄影團隊都曾入住過。也因為位於埔里中繼站，有者寬闊的室內外停車場，許多重機團環島經中部入住、武嶺單車比賽包棟、家庭旅遊、商務出差等方便停車且生活機能便利，為主要首選之地呢！館外生活機能非常方便，原西站轉運站在門口即有公車站牌上下車，可搭車來回前往台中高鐵、台中火車站、草屯、豐原等，大眾運輸便利；公車站對面即是綠意公園『仁愛公園』、緊臨『打鐵街』、『媽祖廟』、『孔子廟』『埔里酒廠』、『龍南漆藝博物館』，步行只要五分鐘以內美食商家有著以『 五頓街 』謂之；提供寬闊16個室外停車位及20個地下室停車位。館內40間舒適客房、採簡潔設計風格，極簡純白搭配沉穩純木，空間寬敞而舒適典雅；高標準級客房規格，每房皆有對外窗景、乾溼分離獨立衛浴及寬頻上網，帶給您住在山城中的自在悠閒。

stays.name: 錯喜歡旅棧
stays.description: 人生就像品茶，看似平淡，卻都需要經過沸水一燙，才能沏出綿綿韻味。好茶久浸亦不苦。​同在台北長大，幾乎是道地的台北人，不知道為何我們卻流著農村的血液，喜歡騎車吹山風，多過坐車吹冷氣。從居住了30多年的繁華都市來到鄉下，才發現原來我們累了，一時間疲憊傾洩而出，原來只有在寧靜的山裡，才有真正的放鬆。 在都市，我們不被允許說累，但是在「慢還可以再慢」的埔里，慢步是被鼓勵的，再也不用分身乏術。這一刻，請你慢慢喝茶，慢慢體會。
stays.descriptionEn: Our private guest house is perfect for up to 16 adults.Located in the heart of Taiwan, we are only 20 minutes from Sun Moon Lake, and 10 minutes from downtown.Live like a "local" and experience authentic mountain view. Our private Guest House is fully furnished, offers everything you need for a dream stay, including local food breakfast. Also you can have your own outdoor balcony, simply relaxing and enjoying the nearby country breeze.Guests are provided privacy in our guest house. We live in the same house on the first floor.

stays.name: 闕麒景觀民宿
stays.description: 我們一家人的圓夢道路，從整地開始；一草一木，一磚一瓦在這塊土地上陸續耕耘才有了現在的「闕麒」，戶外千坪的空間一路細心規劃優雅舒適的庭園環境，也期盼邀您一同品味溫馨、浪漫、悠閒的美麗假期，讓您的身心靈遠離塵囂，徜徉在大自然的原始饗宴 。「闕麒」每間住房的設計，都貼心地為嘉賓以8mm的強化玻璃訂製如電影螢幕般的景觀大視窗，讓您即使在房內休憩，亦能悠閒地享受麒麟山黎明的晨曦和埔里的黃昏時美麗的晚霞落日，一幅幅大自然如畫的景緻盡覽無遺；讓您的心情隨著四季更迭，寧靜中咀嚼那份恬適的感動～心思細膩的女主人始終堅持選用真材實料的原木地板、衣櫥、梳妝台作為房內簡潔清爽的佈置，當然也顧及現代人與科技密不可分的關係，備有高級液晶電視、免費上網的視聽服務，讓您在度假感受田園親切淳樸的感覺時，也能隨心瀏覽網域，掌握時事的脈動！每間房的浴室皆是當下最舒適的乾濕分離式的衛浴設備以及ＨＣＧ頂級的蓮花式洗手盆；並不惜成本附送知名品牌依必朗的香皂、牙膏、洗髮精、沐浴乳˙˙等個人清潔用品，另外吹風機、刮鬍刀、髮梳、浴帽、拖鞋也一應俱全，平實的消費，卻擁有飯店般的優越品質喔！
stays.descriptionEn: The journey toward realizing our dream started with preparing the land, one plant, tree, brick, and tile at a time, to create the bed and breakfast we have today. The outdoor area of 3,300 square meters has been carefully designed into an elegant and comfortable environment, and we invite you to experience a warm, romantic, leisurely and beautiful vacation, where your body, mind, and spirit can leave behind the hubub of the city and wander through the delights of nature. Room designs feature 8mm thick strengthened glass, thoughtfully utilized as theater-like viewing windows, giving guests the opportunity to casually enjoy the sunrise of Qilin Mountain and the evening sunset of Puli from the comfort of their rooms. Beautiful as a painting, the landscape is laid out before your eyes as your mood changes with the seasons, savoring that sweet feeling of quietude. The thoughtful owner has equipped rooms with real wood floors, closets, and dressing tables for a simple and refreshing layout, and of course he has taken into consideration the necessity for technology in modern life, including high quality plasma TVs and wireless Internet service so that guests can experience the simplicity and honesty of the countryside as well as surfing the Internet and staying connected with the times! Bathrooms come equipped with the most comfortable separate shower facilities and top-quality HCG lotus-shaped sinks. We’ve spared no expense to bring you name-brand toiletries, such as soap, toothpaste, shampoo, and body wash, in addition to providing blow dryers, razor blades, combs, shower caps, and slippers. Experience outstanding hotel quality at affordable prices!

stays.searchText: 闕麒景觀民宿 闕麒景觀民宿 南投縣民宿481號 南投縣 埔里鎮 水頭里東潤路31號 我們一家人的圓夢道路，從整地開始；一草一木，一磚一瓦在這塊土地上陸續耕耘才有了現在的「闕麒」，戶外千坪的空間一路細心規劃優雅舒適的庭園環境，也期盼邀您一同品味溫馨、浪漫、悠閒的美麗假期，讓您的身心靈遠離塵囂，徜徉在大自然的原始饗宴 。「闕麒」每間住房的設計，都貼心地為嘉賓以8mm的強化玻璃訂製如電影螢幕般的景觀大視窗，讓您即使在房內休憩，亦能悠閒地享受麒麟山黎明的晨曦和埔里的黃昏時美麗的晚霞落日，一幅幅大自然如畫的景緻盡覽無遺；讓您的心情隨著四季更迭，寧靜中咀嚼那份恬適的感動～心思細膩的女主人始終堅持選用真材實料的原木地板、衣櫥、梳妝台作為房內簡潔清爽的佈置，當然也顧及現代人與科技密不可分的關係，備有高級液晶電視、免費上網的視聽服務，讓您在度假感受田園親切淳樸的感覺時，也能隨心瀏覽網域，掌握時事的脈動！每間房的浴室皆是當下最舒適的乾濕分離式的衛浴設備以及ＨＣＧ頂級的蓮花式洗手盆；並不惜成本附送知名品牌依必朗的香皂、牙膏、洗髮精、沐浴乳˙˙等個人清潔用品，另外吹風機、刮鬍刀、髮梳、浴帽、拖鞋也一應俱全，平實的消費，卻擁有飯店般的優越品質喔！

stays.name: 隱月行旅民宿
stays.description: 位於風景秀麗南投縣埔里鎮全新落成民宿，以健康、潔淨、永續為目標我們堅持整棟民宿採用天然未上漆柚木家俱及原石材裝潢，不使用劣質的甲醛裝潢板材採五星級等級寢具，無矽靈精油洗髮、沐浴用品，給您最舒適的住宿體驗您所親近肌膚的寢具，皆比照五星級酒店，進入專業洗衣部門，使用40度以上熱水及100 PPM漂白水消毒漂洗過後，再進入80度以上烘乾消毒，絕不是自行單純使用家用洗衣機清洗，確保提供最潔淨與舒適的住宿品質。備有烤肉區、廚房、卡拉OK、Netflix頻道及75吋大屏幕電視、2個停車位(附近白線內皆可停車)廚具採用兒童安全保護IH爐，取代傳統瓦斯爐，備有移動式電磁爐、平底鍋、火鍋鍋具、基本調味料…等，方便家人朋友歡聚小酌民宿位置生活機能方便，車程2-3分鐘內有全家、7-11便利商店、寶雅、全聯、家樂福、郵局，臨時缺少用品皆可便利採購本民宿提供：✔️廚房可烹飪並提供簡易餐具（冰箱、lH爐、電磁爐、抽油煙機、烘碗機、碗筷杯具）✔️獨棟精緻別墅✔️現代感的精緻裝潢✔️民宿專屬車位2+2(其中有2個車位，因本民宿位於重劃區內，白線內可尋找臨停車位，無拖吊車)✔️TOTO衛浴設備✔️包棟KTV歡唱(可無限歌唱/夜間10:00後須放低音量)✔️電動麻將✔️桌遊✔️ 可火鍋及及提供廚房可簡易烹飪✔️烤肉✔️三溫飲水機✔️提供第四台 & Neflix & 500m Wifi網路 & 小愛音箱 & 安博✔️五星級高磅數羽絨枕被✔️個人專屬高級備品（洗髮精、沐浴乳、浴帽、大小浴毛巾、牙刷牙膏、刮鬍刀）✔️頂級原木柚木傢俱✔️丹麥mininor嬰幼兒澡盆及PUKU奶瓶消毒鍋✔️可加床，每加1人床架組1,000元；內含1人份備品；現場目前至多可加4人床架組（加床為飯店等級舒適折疊床組，並提供專屬五星級高磅數羽絨枕被一套）。✔️定期進行全館清潔及消毒

stays.description: 我家門前有小河後面有山坡，依山傍水，處處蟲鳴鳥叫、花香撲鼻，沒有都市的塵囂，只有青山綠水瀰漫著大自然的芳香，耳中充滿了天籟的呼喚。在這裡，可以大口的呼吸，讓疲憊的身心得到舒緩，這裡是旅人們溫馨的家。 埔里的桃米社區是一處看似荒蕪沼澤、溪澗的大凹地，卻擁有全台灣種類最多的青蛙、蜻蛉和數量最多的螢火蟲，青蛙ㄚ婆－王惠美就這麼一頭栽入蛙蛙世界。 「青蛙ㄚ婆ㄟ家民宿」主人夫婦在為一生事業而勞頓之後，看上桃米的環境，選擇在此退休。原在台中從事插花教學和會場佈置的王惠美，有著獨特的美感與自信，一手主導了民宿的規劃和房間的設計，卻也意外的臣服在青蛙、鳥兒等小動物的純真之下。 褪去了以往在都會的粉抹和盛裝，徒手在池塘挖土，化身為青蛙ㄚ婆，王惠美無怨無悔。說是ㄚ婆，其實一點都不老，那是孩童稱呼而來的，但對於青蛙的認識和投入，卻是她人生中最真切的感動與喜悅。和女兒雙雙取得了解說員的證書，對於青蛙的叫聲、特徵和特性等，瞭若指掌，談起了青蛙，主人們如數家珍，眉開眼笑。親自跟著她們帶領觀察青蛙，將是住宿於此，最難忘的回憶！ 青蛙ㄚ婆ㄟ家，這裡的點點滴滴都是可愛動人的小故事，或許您以後會忘記埔里桃米有個青蛙ㄚ婆，但是我相信您以後一定不會忘記，這裡的生態…以及我們的故事…給您一輩子回憶的感覺～
stays.descriptionEn: Creek is in front of my house, behind the house the hills, mountains on one side and water on the other. Insects buzz and birds chirp and they are everywhere. Floral aromas emit. No hubbub of the city, only mountains and waters, and filled with the fragrance of nature, and ears filled with the sounds of nature& #39;s call. Here, take a deep breath to relieve your physical and mental fatigue, here is the travelers& #39; warm home on their journey. Taumi Community in Puli is seemingly a barren marsh, a large depression of streams, but it has the largest frog species in Taiwan, damselflies and the largest number of fireflies, Grandma Frog--Wang Hui Mei was so plunge into the frog world. The host couple of "Grandma Frog Farm House" after working for a lifetime career and fatigued, they settled the fancy Taumi environment and choose to retire here. Wang Hui Mei originally engaged in teaching flower arrangement and site layout in Taichung, she has a unique sense of beauty and self-confidence, single-handedly led the B&B Planning and design of the room, but also unexpectedly surrender to frogs, birds and other small animals under innocence. Wiped off the makeup and took off costumes, dig in the pond bare-handed, and become Grandma Frog, Wang Hui Mei has no regret. Although called her Grandma Frog, she really is not old. It is the children call comes. But for understanding frogs and committed to it, that is her most vivid impression and joy of life .Both she and her daughter made a certificate for the narrator. She understands fully the voice of frogs, features, and characteristics. When talking about the fogs, she can speak on a subject with great familiarity, and a grin. Following their lead to observe frogs will be the most unforgettable memories of the stay. Grandma Frog Farm House, every lovely bits and pieces are all touching little stories. Perhaps you later will forget Grandma Frog of Puli Taumi, but I& #39;m sure you will not forget. The eco here ... and our story ... will give you a feeling of lifetime of memories ~

stays.description: 民宿座落於日月潭東南方水里鄉上安社區，距週邊景點日月潭、集集小鎮、水里蛇窯、車埕，信義梅子夢工場車程都在20分鐘內。為鼓勵遊客朋友走向戶外，享受大自然美景的洗禮，所以住宿沒有電視可看，我們特地安排夜間活動，提古仔燈夜遊鵲橋（南投縣單跨距離最長的吊橋），話上安說茶經、品茶、賞茶，並結合呆呆休閒農業區安排各項的農業體驗如：茶葉、梅子、葡萄、香菇………等的農業體驗行程。
stays.descriptionEn: The B&B is located in the Shang'an community, Shuili Township, to the southeast of Sun Moon Lake, a 20 minutes' drive from the surrounding attractions, including Sun Moon Lake, Jiji, Shuili Snake Kiln, Checheng, and Xinyi Dream Works of the Mei (plum). To encourage visitors to go outdoors and enjoy the baptism of natural beauty, we offer no TV to watch, but we have specially designed evening activities, including a night trip to Magpie Bridge (the longest single-span suspension bridge in Nantou) carrying an ancient lantern, Talking about Shang'an and tea, tea sipping, watching tea, and combining the trip with Daidai Leisure Farm's programs to have agriculture experience, such as, tea, plums, grapes, mushrooms, etc.

stays.description: 照片提供:日向科技-玩全台灣旅遊網來一趟純樸、清新的水鄉之旅讓自已回歸自然寧靜的單純心境「水里民宿～水里二坪山莊民宿」位於水里鄉二坪山上，所在位置視野遼闊優美，可遠眺整個水里市區，民宿除了位處當地知名的二坪枝仔冰旁，更鄰近水里蛇窯、車埕老街、明潭水庫等景點，若欲前往集集、日月潭也都相當快速方便。來到「水里民宿～水里二坪山莊民宿」所見的景物與環境，皆是自然度滿分的舒適畫面，是一處相當適合闔家前往的散心之地。在客房的部份，「水里民宿～水里二坪山莊民宿」規劃有二人、四人及六人之房型，若同行人數較多，亦有開放整棟包租的服務；客房擺設皆是以強調出舒適感為原則，俐落大方的房內佈置，再加上空間十足的寬敞感，讓每一位入住旅客，都能在此享受到最舒適、放鬆的悠閒假期。另外，「水里民宿～水里二坪山莊民宿」亦有提供合菜訂桌的用餐服務，透過女主人的精湛廚藝，讓您品嚐到獨具風味的美味料理；如有需要預約用餐的朋友，請務必提前告知，以方便為您準備新鮮食材。倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【049-2770936或0953-909995】水里民宿～水里二坪山莊民宿。
stays.descriptionEn: Take a trip to simple, clean rivers and lakes. Make yourself return to simple and pure state of nature peaceful tranquility. "Shuili Er Ping B&B--B&B in Shuili" is located in Erping Mountain, Shuili Township, with a vast and beautiful horizon overlooking the entire Shuili urban. The B&B is next to the local well-known Erping popsicle, and close to Shuili Snake Kiln, Checheng Street, Mingtan Reservoirs and other attractions. It has easy access to Chichi and Sun Moon Lake if you want to pay a visit. Staying in "Er Ping B&B," the scenery and the environment you have seen are comfortable views of 100ï¼ natural degrees, and it is a quite suitable for the whole family outings." Er Ping B&B" offers two-person, four-person and six-person types of rooms, and if the size of the party is relatively large, then a whole building package is available. Rooms are all furnished to emphasize the principle of comfort. Neat and generous room layout, coupled with a spacious sense of space to make every traveler be able to enjoy the most comfortable, relaxed, leisurely holiday. In addition, Er Ping B&B" also provides a set menu and dining table scheduling services and offers you delicious dishes with unique flavors skillfully prepared by the hostess. If you need to make a reservation for dining, please inform us in advance, in order to prepare fresh ingredients. If you have any questions about the journey or trip, please call directly【049-2770936 or 0953-909995】 Shuili Er Ping B&B--B&B in Shuili.

Have you ever strolled through the beautiful Shuili Township? Are you here to rush to rush? As long as you are willing to come to this guesthouse to communicate, I will take you to experience the most beautiful paradise at the foot of Yushan Mountain, the watery creek that does not dry all the year round, and the night view that runs through the watery village. The cool breeze is oncoming and touching, don't you say you are not intoxicated? There are also many hidden versions of secret stories, waiting for you to find and explore

stays.name: 松之園
stays.description: 禪與松休閒養生會館(合法民宿) 位於南投縣水里鄉，在往日月潭風景區的路上；鄰近有日月潭、集集、車埕、水里蛇窯、東埔溫泉……等旅遊景點。本館占地7500坪，前身為50~60年代水里地區第二大的木材集散場與製材所。直到 921 地震後由本地頗負盛名的楊醫師所購買，加以整修並大量移植「台灣五葉松樹」，在多年後才有今日美麗的風貌。「禪與松」園區包含「禪之園民宿」及「松之園民宿」，領有「松之園民宿」第 260 號及「禪之園民宿」第 279 號兩張合法執照。目前由經營團隊採取聯合經營，即為「禪與松」休閒養生會館。「禪之園」為紅瓦白牆的日式建築，也是本會館的接待大廳。而「松之園」為台灣紅檜興建的木屋，搭配六角紅色地磚，具有濃濃的日式懷舊風。在這裡，你可以放慢腳步，處於五葉松林以及綠油油的大片草地中，感受此地涼風吹拂、松林微動以及鳥語蟲鳴。本館附近有多處有名觀光景點，如距離只要15分鐘的車程的「南投集集」，「日月潭」也只需30分鐘車程，而與「水里蛇窯」只有一牆之隔，步行只需10分鐘。另外，距離台中清泉崗機場及台中高鐵站均僅需1小時的車程。若要到車埕休閒農業區、日月潭國家風景區與信義鄉梅子夢工場等景點都很方便。禪與松休閒養生會館擁有寧靜和優美環境以及養生的健康料理，並提供多種舒適溫馨的房型及完善的服務，我們非常歡迎您的入住！
stays.descriptionEn: The "Dhyana and Pine Recreational Homestay" is located in Shuili Township, Nantou County, and right on the way to Sun Moon Lake Scenic Area, the destinations nearby include Sun Moon Lake, Jiji, Checheng, Shuili Snakekiln, Dongpu Hot Spring and more. This hostel occupies 25000 sqm of land and the location was Shuili's second largest log stockpile and lumbermill in 1950s to 1960s. The land was later purchased by Dr. Yang who is well-known locally after the "921" earthquake of 1999. With his massive planting of "Taiwan pines", this place booms years later. This pine garden is built with two hostels: "Dhyana Homestay" and "Song Zhi Yuan Homestay", both are registered with No. 260 and 279 licenses, respectively. These two homestays are managed by one single management group. The "Dhayana Homestay", a Japanese-style building with red roof tiles and white wall serves as the lobby of both homestays, while "Song Zhi Yuan" presents the cabins built with Taiwan red cypress timber and red honeycomb cell-shaped floor tiles, which resembles the old-school Japanese style. Relax in the Taiwan pine forest and pasture to talk to the breeze, pine forest and chirping birds and insects. There are several famous destinations, including Jiji (15 minutes driving), Sun Moon Lake (30 minutes driving), and Shuili Snakekiln (10 minutes of walking). Also, Taichung International Airport and HSR Taichung Station takes only about an hour of driving, and it's convenient to reach Checheng Recreational Agriculture Area, Sun Moon Lake National Scenic Area and Dream Works of the Mei in Xinyi Township. Featured with tranquility, healthy cuisine, various accommodation options and guest-oriented service, "Dhyana and Pine" welcomes your visit!

stays.name: 禪之園民宿
stays.description: 禪之園民宿位於南投縣水里鄉，在往日月潭風景區的路上；鄰近有日月潭、集集、車埕、水里蛇窯、東埔溫泉……等旅遊景點。本館占地7500坪，前身為50~60年代水里地區第二大的木材集散場與製材所。直到 921 地震後由本地頗負盛名的楊醫師所購買，加以整修並大量移植「台灣五葉松樹」，在多年後才有今日美麗的風貌。
stays.descriptionEn: Zen Garden B&B is located in Shuili Township, Nantou County, on the way to Sun Moon Lake Scenic Area; it is close to tourist attractions such as Sun Moon Lake, Jiji, Checheng, Shuili Snake Kiln, Dongpu Hot Spring, etc. The museum covers an area of ​​7,500 pings and was formerly the second largest timber distribution center and lumber processing plant in the Shuili area in the 1950s and 1960s. It was not until after the 921 earthquake that the famous local doctor Yang purchased it, renovated it and transplanted a large number of "Taiwan five-needle pine trees". Many years later, it has the beautiful appearance it has today.

stays.name: 老五民宿
stays.description: 倚著玉山山脈，隔陳有蘭溪對望溪頭，位於南投水里的上安村，樸實靜默的守著青山綠意。短暫數年的都會生活，讓我們早早體會自然環境的可貴，根植於土地的深切情感，回到最愛的上安村，在河畔的平原上的築起唐風民居，引溪澗入水塘、植青松水柳，佈置自然庭園，重拾自然恬靜的山居生活。生活若是一種學習的進程，那麼院子裡的蓊鬱植栽就是我們的學習成果，幫自然挪出一個空間，大自然便給予滿滿豐盛回應。水楊的樹幹年年加粗，五葉松恣意的伸展姿態，螢火蟲不請自來、溪魚滿水塘，紅冠水雞也來此安居。照顧一畦有機野菜田，剩菜做堆肥，生態污水淨化池裡荷花盛開，自然循環的生活方式在這裡得到自在的實踐，我們樂在其中。在舒緩的園中小憩、品味放空的悠閒，聽鳥語輕碎，枝芽光燦閃耀，當山嵐輕送飄過眼前，不管是慢活還是樂活，在這裡都已忘言。分享自然生活的過程，讓我們更感富足，歡迎您的到訪親臨，與我們呼吸大地的生命氣息，同享山居的悠然時光。
stays.descriptionEn: With back to Yushan Mountain, across Chenyoulan River, opposite Xitou, located in Shang& #39;an Village, Shuili, Nantou, silently guarding the green mountains. Having been living in the city for a few years makes us realize the value of early experiencing the natural environment. Emotionally being deeply rooted in the land, we returned to favorite Shang& #39;an Village. On the river plains we built a folk house in Tang style. We introduced stream water into the pond and planted water willows and pine trees, and arranged it into a natural garden to regain natural tranquility of a mountain life. If life is a learning process, then the lush plantings in the courtyard is our learning outcomes, to set aside a space for nature, and nature will return full hearty responses. The Bigcatkin willow trunk becomes wider and wider, Japanese strobus pine& #39;s stretch without restrain, the fireflies come uninvited, river fish are full of ponds, and common Moorhens settle down here. Take care a plot of organic vegetable fields, leftovers make compost, lotus blossom in the ecological wastewater treatment pond, natural cycle of life here has been practiced freely, and we enjoy it. Rest in a soothing garden, taste the leisure of venting, listen to the birds chirping, branches and buds are flickering, when mountain mist floating by, or whether it is slow living or LOHAS, here words have been forgotten. Sharing this natural life process makes us feel more affluent. Welcome your visit, and together with our breath of life to share the mountain leisurely time.

stays.searchText: 老五民宿 老五民宿 南投縣民宿042號 南投縣 水里鄉 上安村福田路29號 倚著玉山山脈，隔陳有蘭溪對望溪頭，位於南投水里的上安村，樸實靜默的守著青山綠意。短暫數年的都會生活，讓我們早早體會自然環境的可貴，根植於土地的深切情感，回到最愛的上安村，在河畔的平原上的築起唐風民居，引溪澗入水塘、植青松水柳，佈置自然庭園，重拾自然恬靜的山居生活。生活若是一種學習的進程，那麼院子裡的蓊鬱植栽就是我們的學習成果，幫自然挪出一個空間，大自然便給予滿滿豐盛回應。水楊的樹幹年年加粗，五葉松恣意的伸展姿態，螢火蟲不請自來、溪魚滿水塘，紅冠水雞也來此安居。照顧一畦有機野菜田，剩菜做堆肥，生態污水淨化池裡荷花盛開，自然循環的生活方式在這裡得到自在的實踐，我們樂在其中。在舒緩的園中小憩、品味放空的悠閒，聽鳥語輕碎，枝芽光燦閃耀，當山嵐輕送飄過眼前，不管是慢活還是樂活，在這裡都已忘言。分享自然生活的過程，讓我們更感富足，歡迎您的到訪親臨，與我們呼吸大地的生命氣息，同享山居的悠然時光。

Checheng is very old and traditional village, and is called frontier arbor which has abundant logging, biological resource, and the amazing hydropower plant. Checheng has various attractive sights, including Checheng Wood Musium, Mightan Reservoir, Agricultural Leisure Area, historical town, visitor center, beautiful lake, old tunnel, amongst others.

stays.name: 里山城居民宿
stays.description: 70年代山區台式建築老屋，山城水里小鎭中，体驗不同的旅行住宿，在水里溪旁玉山腳下的水里，可端看因木業興盛曾風華ㄧ時素有小台北之稱的歷史小鎮水里 房屋經過翻修後保留部分原來老時光韻味，花磚、鐵窗 、木造，等..是水里第一期的山區別墅，房子位於水里車站步行5分鐘距離，提供舒適獨立房間4房間，最多12位入住，最適合包棟家庭和好朋入住，備設齊全有開放廚房、電鍋、瓦斯爐等⋯ 客廳公共空間，網路MOD，像在家一樣方便，水里交通便利有台鐵火車/總達客運/小巴士/共乘車可到南投各熱門風景區，適合從水里為據點，花個數天漫遊整個南投縣，提供乾浄、平價的優質選擇，山區難免有小昆蟲，請勿見怪； 另衛浴是共用型淋浴間1間、廁所1套分別獨立使用，如開車旅客可停放在附近附近空地需步行約50公尺

stays.name: 他里溫
stays.description: 他里溫民宿外觀有著休閒放鬆風格特色，從大廳、客房，甚至是衛浴區域，您都能看見使人倍感親切的舒適佈局，從小細節到大環境，每個地方都有值得回味的巧思設計。尤其是房間的床組是我們親自到百忍木匠工訪手工打造的實木家具。他里溫民宿擁有簡約的風景，距離溪頭森林遊樂區大約40分鐘的車程，提供覆蓋公共區的免費Wi-Fi。他里溫民宿距離竹山紫南宮大約7分鐘車程。民宿規劃有2人至6人之房型，透過簡約的風格設計，讓每間客房都呈現簡易的空間面貌，同時兼具舒適與設計感的休憩環境，客房除了依照房型人數入住之外，在許可範圍內亦可提供加床服務。客房內均裝有空調，並設有大窗戶，提供帶有免費頻道的液晶電視以及配有淋浴設施和吹風機的浴室。客人可以尋求協助安排旅遊行程、以及免費私人停車服務。
stays.descriptionEn: The interior of the hotel has a casual and relaxing style. From the lobby, guest rooms and even the bathroom area, you can see the comfort and layout that makes you feel at home. From small details to big environment, every place has a reminiscent of ingenuity. design. Especially the bed set of the room is the solid wood furniture that we personally went to hand-built by the carpenter. Featuring a minimalist view, Heliwen Homestay is a 40-minute drive from Xitou Forest Recreation Area. Free Wi-Fi is available in public areas. He Liwen Homestay is a 7-minute drive from Zhunan Zinan Palace. The B&B is planned to have a room size of 2 to 6 people. With a simple style design, each room has a simple space and a comfortable and design environment. In addition to the number of people staying in the room, the room is licensed. Extra beds are also available in the range. Rooms are air conditioned and feature large windows, an LCD TV with free channels and a bathroom with shower and hairdryer. Guests can ask for assistance with travel arrangements and free private parking.

stays.name: 山林別苑旅店
stays.description: 位於南投大鞍山的山林別苑旅店，坐落在壯麗的自然環境中，是一個理想的度假場所。這裡擁有迷人的山景與清新的空氣，讓每位旅客都能在此找到內心的寧靜。 在山林別苑旅店，您可以逃離都市的喧囂，享受山林的靜謐。無論是家庭旅遊、情侶度假，或是好友相聚，我們都期待為您提供難忘的住宿體驗，讓您的每一刻都充滿美好回憶。旅店內舒適的客房和精緻的餐飲選擇，將使您的旅程更加愉快。 我們熱誠歡迎您親臨山林別苑旅店，感受自然之美，享受靜謐時光，創造屬於您的美好回憶！
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the stunning natural environment of Daan Mountain in Nantou, Shanlin Bieyuan Inn is an ideal retreat. With its captivating mountain views and fresh air, every traveler can find inner peace here. At Shanlin Bieyuan Inn, you can escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy the tranquility of the mountains. Whether you’re on a family trip, a romantic getaway, or a gathering with friends, we look forward to providing you with an unforgettable accommodation experience that fills every moment with beautiful memories. stays.name: 有竹居
stays.description: 有竹居，一座位於竹山大鞍、超過一甲子歷史的古厝，由於屋主轉往都市發展，閒置了很長一段時間，幾年前，長年旅居在外的林文山，毅然決然地回鄉修復這個充滿成長回憶的舊居，好讓更多人可以體驗這置身雲端的雅緻文化及竹林美景。在整修的過程中，堅持遵循古法修復古厝，除了建築的竹編牆、檜木樑柱及清水磚等，室內也不馬虎地安裝地熱設備，讓室內保持恆溫並達到除溼的效果，提供入住旅客舒適的留宿環境。另外，有竹居裡處處可見林太太--陳淑鈴老師的柴燒陶刻作品，為此傳統閩南建築增添一分人文氣息；偶爾也能見到陳老師創作的身影。
stays.descriptionEn: Bamboo House is a traditional southern Chinese courtyard house hidden in bamboo forests at Zhushan, Nantou. With more than half of a century long history, the building was out of shape until recent years. Winston Lin, after years of working around the world, returned to his home village and renovated the house he grew up in. After careful repairing and construction, the house presents itself with traditional bamboo columns, hinoke beams, white stucco, and red bricks as well as modern floor heating, skylights and bathrooms.On the hill behind the main house sit a wood burning kiln where visitors can learn pottery making. further up at the highest in the property, Tea Pavilion is the most tranquil corner where visitor can enjoy local tea and organic coffee with amazing views.

stays.name: 水車閣
stays.description: 水車閣 介紹"緣起~ 老闆娘出生於竹山鎮旁稱作水車的小地方， 由於老闆娘在未上小學前就離開這裡去台中生活， 經歷了工作成家到兒女成群。 退休後，心心念念想回到出生地蓋個房子。 供分散在台灣北中南城市裡生活的兒女家庭， 可以有個依歸以及聚會的場所， 因緣際會下，回到故鄉竹山水車買了這塊地，開始實踐夢想中的房子。 年輕時，老闆娘去過歐洲旅行並深深喜愛歐式建築的房子風格， 所以房子的主體，帶有歐式建築的氣息，挑超高的主大廳，彩繪玻璃等設計， 完全是由老闆娘以及念土木建築的大兒子一同討論設計的， 並在房子後方設計成五間套房，是家庭聚會時大家回來休憩住宿的場所， 而平時可供民宿使用，故起名為水車閣。 起建整地時發現的大石，就擺設在大門側並刻上文字，作為民宿之標記， 戶外鋪滿翠綠舒適的台北草草皮，兩側則是老闆娘親手種滿的松、柏、櫻花、楓、銀杏等， 而庭院的後方草坪，建了一個小時候的手壓泵浦，童趣滿點， 在民宿入口的左側，是一個竹水車，取意自竹山水車里這個地名，水車下有小池塘，養滿了活潑好 動的錦鯉與如意， 經歷了兩年的辛苦，房子從無到有建立起來， 完成了夢想中的房子。

stays.searchText: 水車閣 水車閣 南投縣民宿899號 南投縣 竹山鎮 中央里北勢巷20-8號 水車閣 介紹"緣起~ 老闆娘出生於竹山鎮旁稱作水車的小地方， 由於老闆娘在未上小學前就離開這裡去台中生活， 經歷了工作成家到兒女成群。 退休後，心心念念想回到出生地蓋個房子。 供分散在台灣北中南城市裡生活的兒女家庭， 可以有個依歸以及聚會的場所， 因緣際會下，回到故鄉竹山水車買了這塊地，開始實踐夢想中的房子。 年輕時，老闆娘去過歐洲旅行並深深喜愛歐式建築的房子風格， 所以房子的主體，帶有歐式建築的氣息，挑超高的主大廳，彩繪玻璃等設計， 完全是由老闆娘以及念土木建築的大兒子一同討論設計的， 並在房子後方設計成五間套房，是家庭聚會時大家回來休憩住宿的場所， 而平時可供民宿使用，故起名為水車閣。 起建整地時發現的大石，就擺設在大門側並刻上文字，作為民宿之標記， 戶外鋪滿翠綠舒適的台北草草皮，兩側則是老闆娘親手種滿的松、柏、櫻花、楓、銀杏等， 而庭院的後方草坪，建了一個小時候的手壓泵浦，童趣滿點， 在民宿入口的左側，是一個竹水車，取意自竹山水車里這個地名，水車下有小池塘，養滿了活潑好 動的錦鯉與如意， 經歷了兩年的辛苦，房子從無到有建立起來， 完成了夢想中的房子。

stays.name: 貓頭鷹森林民宿
stays.description: 隱身於南投縣竹山鎮社寮地區，「紫南宮」ㄟ好厝邊。老闆娘歷經921大地震試煉，浴火重生建了這方樂土，環境清幽、生態豐富，歡迎大家相揪來作客，呷茶、交朋友。CP值高 房間非常乾淨 環境非常優美寬敞 整座山都 可以享受 夜景非常優美 早餐好 有自己家的感覺 老闆娘把來的客人都當自己的家人對待還有從澳萬大源頭流出海的台灣第一長的濁水溪之美，在這山頭可以一攬無餘忘掉所有煩惱得到心靈舒壓最好的去處，萬家燈火在你的腳下非常忘我非常放空放鬆，坐著看夕陽之美從二水下海，晚上雲林林內小鎮的燈光和彰化二水小鎮的燈火還有南投照境山二高山崇社區紫南宮全台最大的消防署最大的訓練中心構成的一副動畫還有很多歷吏文化自然景觀生態環境一時說不完等待你的親自體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Nestled in the Sheliao area of ​​Zhushan Township, Nantou County, "Zinan Temple" is a wonderful neighbor.The proprietress survived the devastating 921 earthquake and rose from the ashes to build this haven. The environment is tranquil and the ecosystem is rich; everyone is welcome to come and visit, enjoy tea, and make friends.High cost-performance ratio, very clean rooms, beautiful and spacious environment, enjoy the entire mountain, beautiful night view, good breakfast, feel at home, the owner treats all guests like family, and the beauty of the Zhuoshui River, the longest river in Taiwan, flowing from the source of Aowanda into the sea, can be seen from this mountain, forget all your troubles and find the best place to relax. The lights of thousands of homes are under your feet, you can be very absorbed and relaxed, sit and watch the beautiful sunset, go down to the sea from Ershui, the lights of Linnei Town in Yunlin and Ershui Town in Changhua, and the lights of Zhaojingshan, Ergaoshan Chong Community, Zinan Temple, the largest fire station and the largest training center in Taiwan in Nantou form an animation. There are also many historical and cultural landscapes, natural landscapes and ecological environment that cannot be described at once, waiting for you to experience it for yourself.

stays.description: 「Le Chateau」是「麗堡休閒精品汽車旅館」的英文名稱，也是法文的城堡之意，本館外觀具有米白色的城堡設計，戶外庭園充滿著濃厚的歐洲田園氣息，套房內擁有高貴典雅的裝潢，並設有37吋液晶電視、雙人按摩浴缸、SPA氣泡池等設施，給您最舒適的休憩園地，享受有如法國貴族般頂級的奢華饗宴～ 「麗堡休閒精品汽車旅館」除了提供適合情侶、小夫妻入住的房型外，更貼心的為帶著孩子們出遊的家庭設置了家庭式的溫馨套房，充分滿足房客觀光、商務及休息等多元需求～ 「麗堡休閒精品汽車旅館」為安全的合法旅館，位在南投竹山鎮市區內，下竹山交流道僅三分鐘車程即可抵達，並鄰鹿谷.溪頭，杉林溪，紫南宮，集集綠色隧道，竹山大鞍天梯等觀光優質景點。講求最新，服務最貼心，注重客房衛生及清潔，使您在疲勞的旅途中，能像家中般的溫馨。

stays.description: ? 猴ＴＥＬ・草屯三層巷隱身於草屯巷弄裡的一棟獨棟小屋，四間舒適客房，將工業風與溫馨感巧妙融合。無論是三五好友出遊，還是家庭旅宿，都能在這裡找到自在愜意的氛圍。?‍♂️ 周邊玩樂超便利：九九峰動物樂園：與小動物們近距離互動，親子必訪。九九峰登山步道：輕裝健行，享受群山環抱的自然療癒。草屯工藝博物館：探索在地工藝與人文之美。開車約半小時即可抵達 埔里小鎮 與 日月潭，山城與湖光一次收集。✨ 在猴ＴＥＬ，白天可以奔向山林與湖泊，晚上回到工業溫馨風的空間裡，喝杯茶、聊聊天，把旅程的美好收進記憶。
stays.descriptionEn: ? Monkey TEL・Caotun San Ceng AlleyTucked away in a quiet alley of Caotun, this private house with four cozy rooms blends an industrial style with a warm, homey vibe. Perfect for families, friends, or anyone seeking a comfortable retreat.?‍♂️ Nearby attractions:Jioujioufeng Zoo – Meet adorable animals up close, a must for family trips.Jioujioufeng Hiking Trail – Light trekking with breathtaking mountain views.Caotun Crafts Museum – Discover the beauty of local craftsmanship and culture.A short drive takes you to Puli town and the stunning Sun Moon Lake for the best of both mountain and lake scenery.✨ At Monkey TEL, spend the day exploring nature and culture, then return at night to a cozy industrial-style space where you can relax, sip tea, and share stories.

stays.name: 福美大飯店
stays.description: 福美大飯店由母公司洪達自動化所投資，近幾年在台灣、中國大陸兩地的自動化噴塗設備事業穩定後，決跨足商務觀光飯店，返鄉投資創造就業機會，為家鄉盡一份心力。福美飯店取其幸福美滿之意, 149間精緻設計客房，八層樓高中庭陽光天井環繞設計，本著堅持品味，誠摯服務來感動每位遠道而來的旅客。選擇坐落在碧山路的繁華舊址重新整頓，則有著振興歷史傳承的精神，帶著決心要創造出南投最幸福的飯店自許，結合在地文化與特色，以幸福美滿、精緻品味、傳統創新為經營指標，期盼帶給旅客最佳住宿餐飲的感新服務。
stays.descriptionEn: Hotel Formosa is an investment of parent company Hongdart Automation. As Hongdart’s painting equipment business has stabilized in Taiwan and Mainland China in recent years, Hongdart decided to cross over into the operation of a business and tourism hotel. Hongdart returned to its hometown and do its part in investing and creating employment opportunities. The name Hotel Formosa symbolizes happiness and joy. The hotel is 8 stories tall, with 149 exquisitely designed rooms and open air courtyard. The hotel aims to provide highest taste and most sincere service to touch the hearts of each traveler, which was why a formerly prosperous location on Bishan Rd was selected for renovation. Happiness, joy, exquisite taste, and traditional innovation are our business philosophies in hopes to bring the best accommodation, hospitality, and moving service to visitors.

stays.name: 耕雲齋
stays.description: 九九峰下藝術家的家:耕雲齋民宿位於南投縣草屯鎮平林里的九九峰，又稱「九九尖山」，遠遠望去像是跳耀的火焰而得名，特殊的地質景觀成為草屯第一名景。耕雲齋民宿即坐落於此，這裡依山傍水，前有烏溪環繞，後有九九峰聳立，居高臨下視野遼闊。無一處方正格局的建築特別引人注目，這兒原是柯耀東、郭皆貴藝術家夫妻的故居，兩人於1999年委請趙力行建築師進行設計，建築約有330坪，外觀像是開展的有機物，入內後挑高的空間營造開闊的視覺感受，並利用階梯高度差製造樓層的錯落，房子的動線流暢、光線充足，他們花了下半輩子的時間慢慢經營，在這裡生活與創作，晨間禽語相迎，白日晴空萬里，傍晚滿天彩霞盡收眼底。室內更陳列了兩位藝術家許多平面與立體作品，宛如小型美術館，目光所及無處不藝術。2021年他們的兒子柯適中教授將此處重新整理，希望透過旅宿能更貼近藝術，在民宿旁有其工作室「白屋工坊」，也能為旅人安排手作課程，豐富行程。附近有多肉植物園可體驗多肉盆組且鄰近毓繡美術館亦可預約參觀。備註:1.惟因立體陶瓷藝術作品眾多，無法接待12歲以下兒童及寵物。2.採包棟出租，每次只接待1組客人(5人以上成行)3.為顧及安全，廚房不開放使用，且全區(含室內及庭院)不提供烤肉及使用明火，請務必配合。

stays.name: 兩腳詩集･概念旅館
stays.description: 【 兩腳詩集綠活學旅 】所在地為台灣的南投縣集集鎮，小鎮有著300年的開墾歷史以及921地震後復甦的樣貌，以農家樸實農產、豐富人文古蹟、親切純樸居民、悠閒小鎮風貌聞名，兩腳詩集所販售的不僅僅是房間的內容，更包含我們彼此良好互動下的在地生活守護。2018年成為台灣第一家【Control Union - GSTC 國際永續飯店認證】旅館，2021年取得台灣銀級環保旅館，提供的住宿產品在服務優化中盡力減少對環境造成衝擊，而推薦與所辦理的地方餐飲、旅遊活動以及觀光景點導覽等，都經過審慎的參與與判斷，讓旅人透過優良的消費選擇，支持著地方良好傳統的守護!兩腳詩集不僅僅是旅行中的美好空間，也是實踐永續的練習場，放下那些旅館就該如何如何的想法，這是我們的百態生活，我們的生命歷程，放鬆心情，帶根牙刷來集集走走找找我們吧!我們的資訊總是詳盡誠實的說明，盡力不讓認知落差產生的不愉快發生，因此訂房前請詳閱住宿須知，期待您與我們一同認同這樣的彼此相處方式，讓每間旅館都能保有著自己的個性，美好旅人假期的每個獨特旅行!

stays.name: 嘟嘟鳥民宿
stays.description: 集集小鎮，沒有太多的裝飾，保留著舊有的火車站，這是許多人旅行集集的第一站，騎著輕快的腳踏車，進入陰涼的綠色隧道，兩旁茂盛的老樟樹，讓人情不自禁多拍幾張照片，緩緩駛來的舊火車，更是大家抓拍的對象，來到了集集，腳步放慢了，心情輕鬆了，綠色隧道的入口處，有一間優雅又亮麗的建築物，嫩芽綠的外觀和城堡的造型，讓經過的人都為之驚艷，簡單的線條，明亮的開窗，有些歐式鄉村的風格，又有些現代建築整齊的影子，一眼看去，就知道它是一間民宿，火車延著山腳由遠而近，緩緩的經過這間民宿面前，這間民宿的名字叫“嘟嘟鳥”，庭院的植栽與四周的景觀相諧調，建築物二樓以下的外牆，刻意漆成鮮綠色，希望能與環境結合，走入大廳，明亮的大窗，吸引人聚焦在窗外景色，嘟嘟鳥的設計，就是藉由大自然的體驗，撫平煩瑣的思緒，讓人的心情恢復淡然，每個房間都有私人陽台，是一個觀景發呆和放空的空間，“嘟嘟鳥”四周都是鳥鳴聲，也是一個賞鳥的好地方，因為栽種不使用農藥，所以生態自然豐富，“嘟嘟鳥”以結識新朋友的心情，歡迎您的到來。 訂房電話：0905860760 李小姐

stays.name: 大自然休閒民宿
stays.description: 每個旅人行腳落腳處總希望是個乾淨舒適的空間，讓身心靈徹底放鬆，大自然集集休閒會舘提供不同風格的住宿體驗，花朵意象的紅色約定、黃金國度；徜徉異國渡假的季節雨、峇里風情、藍色狂想；喜愛森林芬多精的綠森林、綠菩提…等，夢想在寧靜純樸的小鎮，讓旅人們享受優質浪漫的住宿。 熱心好客的主人，除了提供優質住宿及溫馨的開放空間外，把每位住宿的客人當作自己家人朋友般禮遇，特地採用當地農特產用心烹煮美味又健康的早餐，讓每位迎接晨曦的客人有著家的幸福感覺，留下難忘的南投之旅，再向下一個旅程出發。 距離集集火車站約500公尺的大自然集集休閒舘，走路只要7分鐘，日月潭、九族文化村、溪頭、等國際知名風景名勝也只要約40分鐘車程；猴探井遊憩區(星月天空)、信義鄉風櫃斗、埔里紙教堂、車埕…等熱門景點近在咫尺，交通十分便利。不論是冬梅、春櫻、夏螢、秋楓，體驗不同的四季自然風情，非常適合三五好友或是家族同遊，享受慢活的歡樂時光。 旅行的意義是為自己曾經踏過足跡做最感動的記錄，也許是美麗的風景，也可能是所接觸的風土民情，不論您旅行的動機為何，大自然集集休閒會館希望每個到訪的旅人，行囊中載滿幸福的回憶！
stays.descriptionEn: Every traveler hopes to stay in a clean and comfortable space, to allow body and spirit to relax completely. Da Ziran Xiuxian Homestay provides different styles of accommodation experience, including Red Promise in floral images, Golden Kingdom, exotic Season Rain, Bali Sentiment, Blue Rhapsody, Green Forest and Green Bodhi which love the forest phytoncides. Dream allows travelers to enjoy quality and romantic accommodation in the peaceful and simple town. Besides providing quality accommodation and cozy public spaces, the hospitable owner treats every guest as his own family and friend, offering delicious and healthy breakfast prepared using local agricultural products, allowing every guest to feel like being at home and have a memorable journey to Nantou before heading towards the next journey. Da Ziran Xiuxian Homestay is at about 500 meters and a 7-minute walk from the train station, it only takes about 40-minute drive to famous international tourist attractions such as Sun Moon Lake, Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village and Xitou; popular sites such as Houtanching Recreational Area (Sky of Star Month), Fongguiedou in Sinyi Township, Paper Dome in Puli, and Checheng are all within the vicinity as well with convenient traffic connections. It is suitable for friends or family outings to experience the different seasonal natural sentiments, including plum blossom in winter, cherry blossom in spring, fireflies in summer and maple leaves in fall, to enjoy the fun time of the Slow Life. The meaning of traveling is to make the most heart-moving documentation of places you have been to, it may be magnificent sceneries, or may be folk customs you came in contact with; regardless of your intention for traveling, Da Ziran Xiuxian Homestay hopes that every traveler visiting here may return fully packed with happy memories!

stays.description: 「 集集 山魚水 南投縣旅館編號095，歡迎使用「國民旅遊卡」，為鎮上唯一合法優質旅館、設備新穎、集集唯一的星級飯店，全棟每一間房間內都有WIFI無線免費上網（請自備連網設備）。 「集集山魚水渡假飯店」，位於集集鎮成功路，集集國中正對面，離集集火車站僅約600公尺，車程2分鐘即可抵達集集古街，步行也只需8分鐘，無論是交通或停車都極為方便。前有九二一震後慈濟悲心建造之集集國中，校舍環境平靜優美。山景涵蓋集集大山、獅頭山、周邊綠意盎然，空氣清新，鄰近和平社區的快樂田園，種滿了向日葵及波斯菊花海。 頂樓客房拉開窗簾甚可直接欣賞「集鹿大橋」全長240公尺的斜張橋。橫跨集集、鹿谷兩鄉鎮間的集鹿大橋，是集集攔河堰附帶工程，耗資8億5000萬元， 也是南投縣第一座斜張橋造型橋樑，是水里、集集與鹿谷、南投之重要交通網路！ 「集集山魚水渡假飯店」的客房空間，其高達26幾間的客房數，在集集地區無人可及，無論是客房裝潢設計或是可容納高達100人的會議場地之提供，完全滿足公司行號團體至集集旅遊開會的唯一選擇！「集集山魚水渡假飯店」旁邊緊鄰集集鎮立游泳池，鎮立游泳池自集集大山引進之天然山泉水，所規劃而成的千坪游泳池，可真是再次吸引了眾人眼光，另外亦有玻璃屋SPA區、按摩池、設有滑水道的寶貝專屬兒童池，以及具時尚感的餐廳區域，種種嶄新又貼心的休閒設置。ps:鎮立游泳池冬天不開放，夏季開放期間也有保養修館日，訂房前請提前詢問櫃檯喔！置身於單純的小鎮之中，也能在樸實的氛圍環境裡，去感受屬於城市的奢華與享受．．． 倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【049-2761000】集集山魚水渡假飯店。
stays.descriptionEn: "Jiji& #39;s Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel (registered hotel number 095 under the Nantou County) is the only legally registered hotel in town. We accept the Taiwan Traveler Card. Boasting the latest facilities and an environment comparable to star-rated hotels, we provide free Wifi networks at all of our rooms. (You& #39;ll need your own phone, tablet or laptop to access the Internet) "Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel (formerly Jiji Resorts) is located on the Chenggong Rd., Jiji Township and right across Jiji Junior High School. The hotel is only 600 m from Jiji Railway Station and a 2-minute ride or 8-minute walk away from Jiji Old Street, highly convenient whether by public or private transport. In the front of the hotel stands Jiji Junior High School kindly built by Buddhist Compassion Relief Tzu Chi Foundation after the 921 earthquake of 1999. The campus is peaceful and beautiful. Our mountain view covers Big Jiji Mountain and Lion& #39;s Head Mountain surrounding by the vast greenness and bathed in fresh air. The nearby fields of the Ho Ping community are planted with a wide area of sunflower and cosmos. The loft suite offers a direct view of Ji-Lu Bridge, a cable-stayed bridge spanning 240 m wide. The bridge spanning connecting the two townships of Jiji and Lugu is the complementary work of the Jiji Dam, costing TWD 850 million . It& #39;s also the first cable-stayed bridge in Nantou County that connects the vital transportation network between Shuili, Jiji and Lugu! "Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel" is far better than its competitors by offering more than 20 rooms. With the advantages of room interior design and conference venue capable of accommodating up to 100 people, we are the only option in Jiji when it comes to company or group tours and meetings! "Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel (formerly Jiji Resorts) is located closely to the Jiji Township Swimming Pool. The pool is an eye-catching attraction with itsnatural spring water coming straight from Big Jiji Mountain and its area of 3,300 sqm. In addition, brand-new recreational facilities including glass SPA house, massage pool, children pool with a water slide and fashionable dining area have been set up for your convenience and enjoyment. P.S. the pool is closed in winter and during maintenance days in summer. Remember to consult the front desk before booking! The simple atmosphere of a humble country town coexist with the luxury and hospitality of an urban environment... If you have any queries for your trip, please contact us at 049-2761000.

stays.name: 蘋果的家渡假別墅民宿
stays.nameEn: Pingguo De Jia Du Jia Homestay
stays.description: 蘋果的家民宿座落於集集小鎮上，自民宿漫步至集集火車站數分鐘可達，而周邊更有明新書院、綠色隧道、特有生物保育中心、武昌宮…等旅遊景點，交通十分便捷。本民宿為四層樓的SRC鋼骨建築，外觀極為氣派，是集集地區唯一有電梯設備貼心服務的民宿。別墅四周綠意盎然一片，套房空間寬敞，有陽台及落地窗，在夜裡有星星及涼風吹來很有氣氛，但須注意保暖，夜裡的涼風至早上太陽升起便會停止，此現象是高山與平地冷熱對流的新鮮空氣，夜裡窗戶微開，芬多精進入房間是最佳獨立建物所享有的特質。
stays.descriptionEn: Apple Home Bed and Breakfast is located in Jiji Township, a short walk from the Jiji train station. Conveniently situated, it is close to Mingxin Academy, Green Tunnel, the Endemic Species Research Institute, and Wuchang Temple. The building is an imposing 4-story building made of steel-reinforced concrete, the only bed and breakfast in Jiji with elevator service. The villa is surrounded by greenery, and the spacious suite rooms feature balconies and French windows. At night, the stars and gentle breeze add to the atmosphere, but guests should take care to stay warm. The breeze, bringing fresh air, stops the next morning when the sun rises, as it is a phenomenon caused by the convergence of hot and cold air from the mountains and plains. One of the best features of this independent structure is phytoncides, which blow in during the evening if the windows are left slightly open.

stays.name: 阿都民宿
stays.description: A Du民宿距離集集火車站只有約900公尺，徒步只需要七分鐘。新館設計為庭園平房式，每一間房間都是獨立，且都在一樓。民宿裡頭種滿許多植物、花，提供您最自然的環境，房間相當乾淨舒適。我們提供停車場、集集火車站至本民宿免費接送、中西式早餐、冷氣、冰箱、茶水機、免費wifi。除此之外，國外旅客不需要先事先付款，入住當天付款就可以，且提供國外旅客優惠價格。如果有機會，非常歡迎來到集集遊玩。若有任何疑問，可以以英文書寫方式聯絡我們。
stays.descriptionEn: A Du B & B from Chichi railway station is only about 900 meters, it takes only just seven minutes on foot. The design for the new A DO B&B is garden style, each room is independent and is on the first floor. There are so many plants, flowers. Because we want to offer you the most simple, natural environment. Our rooms are quiet clean, comfortable and with good ventilation, light. We offer parking, Jiji railway station shuffle, Western-style breakfast or Chinese-style breakfast, big screen TV, air conditioning, refrigerator, tea machine, wifi. In addition, foreign visitors do not need to pay in advance, means that pay when you check in.(notice: we accept NT cash only). If you have a chance, welcome to Jiji, I believe that you will have really nice trip memories. If you have any questions, don’t hesitate. Please contact us with email in English writing (email: m763531@yahoo.com.tw)

stays.name: 集集八張民宿
stays.description: 集集八張民宿位於集集鎮八張街與民生路的交叉口。民宿主人林先生從事林造業已有20餘年，此棟民宿也是自地自建，所以硬體結構不但新穎，而且堅固安全。八張民宿距離集集火車站僅800公尺，交通便利，要到集集每一個景點都很方便。因為距市中心近，所以晚上可以逛逛集集形像商圈、或購物、或品嘗當地美食;春節期間可以欣賞元宵燈會，喝杯鎮長咖啡....來旅遊選擇集集八張民宿，在體驗小鎮的純樸風光之餘，也給你"有點鄉下又不會太鄉下"的感覺，因為一切都是那麼的便利。
stays.descriptionEn: Jiji Bazhang B&B is located at the intersection of Minsheng Road and Bazhang Street, Jiji Township. Mr. Lin, the host, has been engaged in the forestry industry for more than 20 years. This B & B are also self-built building; therefore the hardware structure is not only novel, but strong and safe. Bazhang B&B is just 800 meters from Jiji Station, has convenient transportation to go to every attraction in Jiji. Because it is close to the city center, at night, you can stroll Jiji image circle, or shopping, or sample the local cuisine. During the Spring Festival, you can enjoy a cup of coffee on Mayor. If you travel to Jiji, please choose to stay in Jiji Bazhang B&B to experience the simplicity of this small Town, and it will give you a feeling of "a small country but not too small," because everything is so convenient.

stays.name: 集集水園休閒民宿
stays.nameEn: Ji Ji Shui Yuan Xiuxian Homestay
stays.description: 「集集民宿‧集集水園休閒民宿」，位於集集火車站後方，享有極佳的地理位置，不僅正好避免集集大街的喧囂，保有獨立而寧靜的休閒空間，卻能享有便捷的交通路線，距離大街更是步行可抵。 我們的民宿立於田野間，擁有空曠寬敞的絕佳視野，周邊無遮蔽物掩蔽，集集大山及鹿谷的群山舉目可見，巍巍大山搭配蔚藍的天空及綠蔭田野交織成一幅美景，令人心曠神怡。 民宿中供有二人及四人家庭房型。明亮舒適的住屋空間，搭配簡潔現代的室內佈置，使得房內呈現親切的居家氛圍，更顯協調溫馨。民宿擁有廣大寬敞的空間並設有烤肉區，旅人們還可以在園內享受田野樂趣，早餐還可享用園內所栽植的有機水果，感受新鮮自然的好滋味～園內寬敞美麗的遊憩空間，不論是親子、朋友或情侶共逰都相當適宜，您可與孩童一同探索生態，共享天倫之樂；也可緩緩牽起老伴的手漫步田園，來場浪漫之旅。
stays.descriptionEn: Jiji Shuiyuan B&B is located behind the Jiji Station. Being in the back of the train station has a lot of advantages. It avoids the noise coming from the busy Jiji Road, and the rooms are quiet. Transportation is very convenient as Jiji Road is within walking distance from the B&B. Jiji Shuiyuan B&B is situated among farmlands with an unobstructed broad open view. Mt. Jiji and the Lugu Mountain Range can be seen in the distance. The towering mountains contrasting against the blue sky and lush green farmland is delightful and picturesque. The B&B has rooms for couples and for a family of four. The bright and comfortable guestrooms are furnished with simple and modern furnitures and decorations. The furnishings are nicely coordinated, making the rooms warm and inviting. There is also a large open space equipped with a barbeque area available for guests to enjoy the country lifestyle. The spacious and beautiful outdoor space is perfect for families, friends and couples to hang out. Fresh organic fruits grown in the garden are also served for breakfast. You can explore the ecology in the area with your kids or take your loved ones for a stroll in the farmland. It& #39;s quite romantic.

stays.name: 集集農場民宿
stays.description: 集集農場是一個結合：住宿、休閒、有機的小型山坡農場我們的經營理念是：尊重大自然、盡量保留山坡原始地貌在這裡您可以住宿在我們的獨棟休閒小木屋，三五好友盡情享受山中無甲子的生活，所有的農作物您都不用擔心化學的危害，全有機栽培是我們的堅持，集集農場是一個可以讓您找到深藏心中原始感動的好所在。
stays.descriptionEn: Jiji Farm is a small hillside farm that combines accommodation, leisure and organic farming. Our business philosophy is to respect nature and preserve the original landforms of the hillside as much as possible. Here you can stay in our single-family leisure cabin and enjoy the life in the mountains with a few friends. You don’t have to worry about chemical hazards for all crops. We insist on full organic cultivation. Jiji Farm is a good place for you to find the original touch hidden in your heart.

stays.name: 集集鐵道行旅-寶藝村
stays.description: 位於南寶藝村休閒旅遊事業全新品牌「集集鐵道行旅」，以融合在地文化特色，客製化打造專業飯店為核心為理念。「集集鐵道行旅」距離知名景點「集集火車站」300公尺，為一間融合精緻設計與親子漫遊的旅館品牌，經典灰色的外觀，帶有些許歐式風格的建築，宛如充滿歷史與故事，與百年歷史的「集集火車站」相互輝映。簡約的設計風格中，不忘透過互補、對比及低彩度色調展現舒適輕雅的氛圍，並且結合集集當地的意象：鐵道、山嵐、農村…等自然素材，透過設計師的巧手，打造出具有巧思的公共空間與客房。「集集鐵道行旅」給予我們不只是旅店，而是提供每位旅人充滿回憶的處所，舒適的沈浸在旅店的空間，輕鬆的體驗集集小鎮的漫遊，忘卻平日的辛勞與煩憂，藉由探索集集小鎮，讓旅人在過程中產生共鳴與文化的交流，也透過鐵道文化結合具有童趣記憶的空間，期待能讓親子及旅人們有一段難忘的美麗回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Nan Baoyi Village, the new brand of leisure tourism "Jiji Railway Travel" is based on the core concept of integrating local cultural characteristics and customizing the creation of professional hotels. "Jiji Railway Travel" is 300 meters away from the famous scenic spot "Jiji Railway Station". It is a hotel brand that combines exquisite design with parent-child travel. It has a classic gray appearance and a slightly European-style building, which seems to be full of history and stories. , complementing each other with the century-old "Jiji Railway Station". In the simple design style, we do not forget to show a comfortable and elegant atmosphere through complementary, contrasting and low-color tones, and combine it with local imagery: railways, mountains, countryside... and other natural materials, through the designer's skillful hand , creating ingenious public spaces and guest rooms. "Jiji Railway Travel" not only provides us with a hotel, but also provides every traveler with a place full of memories. You can immerse yourself comfortably in the hotel space and experience roaming in Jiji town with ease, forgetting the daily hard work and worries. Exploring Jiji Town allows travelers to have resonance and cultural exchanges in the process. It also combines the railway culture with a space of childlike memories, hoping that parents, children and travelers can have an unforgettable and beautiful memory.

stays.searchText: 集集鐵道行旅-寶藝村 寶藝村股份有限公司 南投縣旅館115號 南投縣 集集鎮 市前街23號 位於南寶藝村休閒旅遊事業全新品牌「集集鐵道行旅」，以融合在地文化特色，客製化打造專業飯店為核心為理念。「集集鐵道行旅」距離知名景點「集集火車站」300公尺，為一間融合精緻設計與親子漫遊的旅館品牌，經典灰色的外觀，帶有些許歐式風格的建築，宛如充滿歷史與故事，與百年歷史的「集集火車站」相互輝映。簡約的設計風格中，不忘透過互補、對比及低彩度色調展現舒適輕雅的氛圍，並且結合集集當地的意象：鐵道、山嵐、農村…等自然素材，透過設計師的巧手，打造出具有巧思的公共空間與客房。「集集鐵道行旅」給予我們不只是旅店，而是提供每位旅人充滿回憶的處所，舒適的沈浸在旅店的空間，輕鬆的體驗集集小鎮的漫遊，忘卻平日的辛勞與煩憂，藉由探索集集小鎮，讓旅人在過程中產生共鳴與文化的交流，也透過鐵道文化結合具有童趣記憶的空間，期待能讓親子及旅人們有一段難忘的美麗回憶。

stays.descriptionEn: Yi Dou Meng is a cozy retreat located along a peaceful path next to Kongming Temple in Yuchi Township, Nantou. Recently given a full makeover, the estate now features freshly redone wooden floors and ceilings, brand-new pillows, duvets, mattresses, TVs, and more. Thoughtful landscaping and greenery bring a soothing vibe, inviting guests to unwind and enjoy the peaceful embrace of nature.Picture waking up to the soft chirping of birds and golden morning sunlight pouring in through the windows. In winter, plum blossoms bloom just outside, creating a hidden seasonal view. Ideal for family trips or friend gatherings — with a private space, BBQ area, and mahjong table all to yourselves.Just a 3-minute drive to Sun Moon Lake and 10 minutes to the Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village.

stays.name: 力麗哲園-日潭館
stays.nameEn: Lealea Garden Hotels Sun Moon lake-Sun
stays.description: 心靈與美景的融合哲學在精品旅館蔚為風潮的今天，於2014年夏季全新登場的「力麗哲園-日潭館」，小巧、精緻的風格，不僅符合趨勢潮流，巧妙的建築設計，讓40間房的規模，有多達25間是湖景客房，並創新規劃半露天式的迎賓大廳，結合咖啡雅座，讓旅客還未入住前就能感受到濃濃的休閒風。大自然親近的渡假城【帶您貼近天然原始的原木韻味，擁有寧靜的時光 】從半開放式的Check In空間往館內延伸，處處可見設計者的用心。貼近天然原始風貌的元素架構，充分運用與大自然親近的原木韻味，創造出一種溫馨如家的感覺；值得一提的，力麗哲園以「渡假城」的概念在日月潭拓點。本館經星級旅館評鑑為「三星級」旅館
stays.descriptionEn: WELCOME TO LEALEA GARDEN HOTEL-SUNIn the trend of boutique hotels, the Sun Moon Lake- Sun, newly opened on August 2014, is small and neat in style. It is not only trendy but also exquisite in its architecture. Marvelously designed, out of 40 rooms, 25 of them offer the guests a magnificent view of the lake. In addition, the newly planned semi-outdoor lobby, in which there is a nice café, welcomes the guests with a leisurely atmosphere shortly before they check in.Following the semi-outdoor check in space, we arrive in the premises, feeling the neat design of the architect. Saturated with almost natural elements, it creates a primitive atmosphere. Of course, Sun Moon Lake -Sun was launched into operation earlier in the same area with the concept of “resort city.” Naturally, the lodgers in the Sun Moon Lake-Sun are welcome to use the facilities and restaurants of the flag ship hotel and the Sun Moon Lake. Living in the Lealea Garden Hotel, visitors can enjoy the simplicity and tranquility of a small hotel but with the facilities of a grand hotel. Visitors can enjoy all the merits of Lealea.

stays.name: 力麗哲園-月潭館
stays.description: 繼力麗哲園會館-日月潭之後再度斥資打造力麗哲園-月潭館。建築風格以原創風味搭配伊達邵少數民族特有圖騰特色,塑造會館本身特有的建物格調！以仿木鋁包板飾條建材，相互交叉為外觀綴飾主軸,搭配編織概念融入於內的編織磚，展現濃厚的原住民文化特色；接待大廳更注入峇里島設計風，讓旅人盡享輕鬆自在又浪漫的度假氛圍。佇立於纜車站親水步道旁，臨窗遠眺日月潭湖景風貌及盡攬潭水四季的萬變風光。旅宿於此，旅人滿載悠然自得的休閒風情。
stays.descriptionEn: Following the LEALEA GARDEN HOTEL in Sun Moon Lake, we now offer you the glamorous new Moon Lake branch.The architecture is original with unique totems of the Itathao Tribe, giving the hotel its own special style.The inter-crossing wood-like aluminum sheathing is the main frame of decoration, and the concept of weaving integrated in the bricks present rich aboriginal feature. The lobby follows a Bali design, bringing travelers a relaxing and romantic holiday atmosphere.Standing next to the lakeside trail of the cable car station, you can admire the beauty of Sun Moon Lake and its ever changing wonders all year round. Travelers staying with us are at all times carefree and content.

stays.name: 原宿民宿
stays.description: 「到得人家盡處，依然水接天涯」，這句詞可為伊達邵最好的寫照。日月潭景緻幽美，昔日邵族人繞嶼以居，湖光山色，艋甲往來，杵音歌聲，繞揚在雲水飛動裏，乃有別一洞天的稱譽。 一間真正由邵族族人築起的民宿，以原住民風格為主要設計，並以貓頭鷹為主要吉祥物，從招牌設計、大廳壁畫都可清楚瞧見貓頭鷹的蹤跡，搭配象徵自然的木頭元素和原住民的傳統繽紛圖騰，展現自然的清新氣息。 客房以原住民傳統的古語為房間命名，整面的落地玻璃如畫一般完全展示出戶外景緻，依照時序、光線變化而有著不同的迷人景象，令人目不轉睛，也讓下榻於此的旅人們都能享受到真正沉靜溫馨的舒適氣息。

stays.description: WELCOME TO OUR TENNIS HOMESTAY(B&B)全台第一家專業的網球民宿，在日月潭出現了！民宿主人蕭老師(台灣黑熊)的夢想！結合網球與民宿的網球民宿，歡迎指教！會打網球的朋友一定要來感受這種氛圍，沒有接觸過網球的朋友，更要來體驗看看這個熱情的網球世界！在旅遊與打球方面都能兼得，白天可以享受日月潭的美景，吸取大自然的芬多精，晚上天空中的星海更是迷人！除此之外，我們擁有國際標準規格的「紅土網球場」，以及有著「專業重訓器材的健身房」，絕對是網球人的天堂！不僅如此，擁有國家級網球教練資格的民宿主人蕭老師(台灣黑熊)，未來也會在這邊安排各種專業課程，歡迎一起來打球！一起來享受美好的假期！

stays.name: 四季時光
stays.description: 日月潭四季時光民宿位於魚池鄉，供應免費早餐、迎客小點心、小飲品。每間房間皆備有沙發、起居空間及高級舒適床墊，乾淨寬敞讓您享有最美好的住宿體驗。一樓客房設有陽露臺與花園為鄰，4-5月可近距離賞螢。頂樓寬敞露臺可欣賞星空與山谷原野之美。整棟設有電梯、無障礙出入空間。住宿遠離塵囂，廣闊庭園方便停車及休閒。全棟提供免費wifi，客房均設有淋浴區及獨立式浴缸、暖風機等乾溼分離衛浴設備，並備有大小毛巾、擦手巾、牙膏、牙刷、沐浴乳、洗髮精、吹風機、空調、冰箱及電視。民宿緊鄰幽靜的頭社國小，距離日月潭月牙灣及頭社水庫生態步道皆約500公尺，適宜有氧散步。距離日月潭國家風景區管理處暨向山遊客中心2.5公里、後尖山步道3公里、日月潭水社碼頭6公里、水里火車站12公里、台中國際機場93公里。

stays.name: 四蒔
stays.description: 曰春夏，曰秋冬，此四時，運不窮。四季變換，時光流轉，這句話道出了自然界無窮的循環與變化，也映照了每個人在人生旅途中的起伏和變遷。就如同春夏秋冬四季的更替，我們每個人都在不同的時期經歷著不同的挑戰與成長。無論是陽光燦爛的春日，還是寒冷凜冽的冬季，每一個季節都有它獨特的風景與意義。而四蒔旅宿正是為了成為您旅途中的一個避風港，無論您走得多遠，四蒔都願意成為您休憩的地方。四蒔旅宿取名自四季，每一個季節都象徵著生活中的不同階段與情感。我們希望每位來到這裡的客人，都能感受到這片土地上的溫暖和包容，像是回到家一般的安心與舒適。在這裡，您可以暫時放下旅途的疲憊，享受片刻的寧靜。無論您是遠道而來的遊客，還是生活中的匆匆過客，我們都希望能為您提供一個愉快而放鬆的住宿體驗。我們相信，旅行不僅是身體的移動，更是心靈的沉澱。在四蒔旅宿，我們不僅提供舒適的住宿空間，更希望您能在這裡找回內心的平靜與愉悅。每一間客房，每一個細節，都蘊含著我們對待客人如家人般的用心。我們的設計簡約而溫馨，讓您無論在春日的微風中，還是冬季的溫暖光線下，都能感受到家的溫暖。在這片土地上，四季如歌，歲月如梭。我們深知，每個人都有屬於自己的旅程，而這些旅程中總會有不同的高低起伏，無論是順境還是逆境，總會有終結的時刻。而四蒔旅宿，正是為了讓您在這個過程中，有一個地方可以停留、喘息，並以最佳的狀態繼續前行。我們感謝每一位選擇四蒔旅宿的客人，您的到來是我們最大的榮幸。我們願在您的旅途中，為您提供最真摯的服務，讓每一次停留都成為一段美好的回憶。無論春夏秋冬，四蒔旅宿將永遠是您旅途中的一個堅實的依靠。謝謝您選擇我們，願您的每一程都平安順利，心情愉快。
stays.descriptionEn: It is called spring and summer, and it is called autumn and winter. These four seasons bring endless luck. The seasons change and time passes. This sentence expresses the endless cycles and changes in nature, and also reflects the ups and downs and changes in everyone's life journey. Just like the change of the four seasons of spring, summer, autumn and winter, each of us experiences different challenges and growth at different times. Whether it's a sunny spring or a cold winter, every season has its own unique scenery and meaning. The purpose of Sishi Hotel is to be a haven during your journey. No matter how far you go, Sishi is willing to be your place to rest.

stays.name: 大漢居
stays.description: 靜享遠離喧囂的湖光山色體驗山巒環抱的山水風情湖光山色的絕美風情、令人忘卻喧囂的寧靜，是吸引許多旅人不斷重遊日月潭的主要因素，此外，濃厚的在地人文風情、豐富的自然資源、水陸空多種玩法的旅遊資源，更是令人暢玩不膩、隨時都想在日月潭盡情玩樂～來到日月潭,想找個交通便利又平價的住宿,那您一定要來拜訪～大漢居民宿～● 交通便利座落於日月潭的～大漢居民宿～，斜對面即是水社遊客中心、客運總站的交通樞扭，各路線巴士在此匯集。要往返埔里,台中,台北,水里,車埕,溪頭,東埔,阿里山..等,皆有巴士可直接抵達,相當方便。對自由行旅客而言,根本不用擔心接送及搬運行李的問題。因為下車處再步行100公尺就可抵達本民宿。從民宿步行500公尺即可抵達水社碼頭,搭乘遊艇暢遊日月潭。或從民宿旁租腳踏車,悠遊最美的日月潭自行車道。民宿緊鄰熱鬧的水社商圈商店街，只需步行即可享用各式中西式早餐及輕鬆品嚐日月潭在地美食、採買紀念品。若要停車,對面即是大型的停車場，不需煩惱停車問題。● 平價住宿民宿設有雙人、三人與四人套房，走進由民宿主人佈置得溫馨典雅、明亮寬敞的套房，令人彷彿就像回到自家般的親切與自在，還可在部份房型內即可欣賞戶外美景，非常適合情侶、三五好友、家庭共同出遊住宿,更歡迎團體包棟住宿。● 搭配套裝行程,省時又省錢為服務旅客,民宿規劃了各式套裝行程,如遊湖腳踏車套裝,日月潭纜車套裝,九族文化村套裝..等。讓遊客不用為了如何玩日月潭而傷透腦筋。如果您希望有專屬自己的行程規劃,我們也提供專業的諮詢與規劃,讓您好好暢遊日月潭。詳細的套裝行程及優惠票券,可參考優惠情報或抵達後再詳細為您說明。倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【049-2855245、0937-892677】日月潭民宿～大漢居。

stays.name: 天月水色
stays.description: 座落於如此美景下的「南投民宿～日月潭天月水色精品民宿」，不僅方便到達文武廟、環潭步道等熱門景點，鄰近伊達邵碼頭、德化社商圈，更是成為您不論是漫步湖畔享受悠閒的氛圍，或是飽嘗各項原民美食、在地佳餚等，都是不二選的地點哦！步行到日月潭纜車乘車處也只需要約15分鐘的時間，細細品味沁涼微風的吹徐、光影綠蔭的迷人，體會不同以往的日月潭之旅！
stays.descriptionEn: Skylight B&B is located at one of the main piers of Sun Moon Lake, Ita Thao, an aboriginal village. The B&B is located in the middle of a shopping street with many food stalls and restaurants, just a 3-minute walk from Ita Thao Pier.Skylight B&B has easy access to all attractions: a 15-minute walk to the ropeway station, a 15-minute drive to Shuishe bus stop, and an 80-minute drive to Taichung HSR station. Sun Moon Lake has many unique and interesting attractions such as Ci'en Pagoda, Xuanzang Temple, Shiwatou Trail, Dazhu Lake Trail, Wenwu Temple, Longfeng Temple and so on. Skylight Bed & Breakfast is 1 hour and 20 minutes from Taichung Airport.Designed for modern comfort, the room is equipped with a large comfortable bed, free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, heating facilities, a flat-screen TV, a refrigerator, an electric kettle and free toiletries. Each bathroom has an overhead shower and a huge stone bathtub for you to wave goodbye to after a long day.The homestay provides guests with fresh and delicious breakfast. They can relax and enjoy the sun terrace of our outdoor restaurant. There are many restaurants within a 5-minute walk of Skylight B&B. Staff will be happy to help arrange tours.

stays.name: 山中城宝渡假民宿
stays.description: 與大自然共生共存，才能深入感受無窮的奧妙體驗～進入群山環繞的魚池、深入靜幽絕美的日月潭，原本煩亂的心境卻因眼前的山林景致隨之飄散，座落其中的「日月潭民宿～山中城宝渡假民宿」，純白的外觀建築、點綴其中的木質屋頂、窗架、就好似一棟從大自然中升出的歐式別墅，採用環保的綠色建材興建、取自自然的太陽能光電等設施，創造出一個取之於自然、回饋於生態的綠色建築，親近自然的舒適氛圍，讓人完全沉浸於山城風光的寧靜悠閒。佔地廣闊的「日月潭民宿～山中城宝渡假民宿」，設有庭園、烤肉區域、觀景平台…等休閒設施，於庭園中悠閒的泡茶聊天、歡樂的遊玩烤肉；走進設計別致優雅的民宿內，處處流露主人的巧思與用心，歐式風格的擺飾裝潢，顯得格外氣派但不失溫馨，採光良好的套房空間，明亮寬敞、典雅樸實的氛圍，令人倍感舒適、自在。重視生態保育、環境維護的「日月潭民宿～山中城宝渡假民宿」，除了庭園中的綠意茵茵，不時還有少見的昆蟲動物帶給您不同的旅程驚喜，走吧～安排假期一同來享受山城中的舒適靜謐，輕鬆渡過一個環保的舒適假期吧！倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【049-2897597 049-2897597 免費 、0936-316048 0936-316048 免費 】日月潭民宿～山中城宝渡假民宿。
stays.descriptionEn: Coexisting with nature is the way to gain an experience of limitless wonder. Come to Yuchic (Yuchi), a place surrounded by mountains, and Sun Moon Lake, a place of quiet, unrivalled beauty that will sweep away all your cares and worries. Nunu Haus Guest House, located in this area, features an all-white building adorned with a wooden roof and window frame, resembling a European villa that sprung out of nature itself. Built with environmentally-friendly materials and solar powered, it is a green building that was created from and gives back to nature, providing a comfortable, all-natural atmosphere where people can lose themselves in the quiet ease of the scenery. Covering a large area, Nunu Haus Guest House features recreational facilities such as an outdoor area, BBQ area, and scenic observation deck. Brew a pot of tea and have a casual chat with friends in the outdoor area, or have a good time at the BBQ area. Enter the unique, elegantly designed building, where the owner’s care and thoughtfulness is apparent in every corner. The European decoration displays extraordinary class without losing its warm touch, and the suite rooms are brightly-lit, spacious, and possess an elegant, sincere atmosphere, making guests feel comfortable and at home. Emphasizing ecological preservation and environmental maintenance, Nunu Haus Guest House features not only a lush green outdoor area but glimpses of rare insects and animals, bringing new surprises to your travels. Don’t wait –plan a vacation to come enjoy the comfort and seclusion of a place surrounded by mountains, where you can relax and enjoy a comfortable break! Please call our toll-free line at 049-2897597, 049-2897597, 0936-316048, or 0936-316048 for any questions regarding your trip or itinerary.

stays.searchText: 山中城宝渡假民宿 山中城宝渡假民宿 南投縣民宿494號 南投縣 魚池鄉 中明村有水巷35-3號 與大自然共生共存，才能深入感受無窮的奧妙體驗～進入群山環繞的魚池、深入靜幽絕美的日月潭，原本煩亂的心境卻因眼前的山林景致隨之飄散，座落其中的「日月潭民宿～山中城宝渡假民宿」，純白的外觀建築、點綴其中的木質屋頂、窗架、就好似一棟從大自然中升出的歐式別墅，採用環保的綠色建材興建、取自自然的太陽能光電等設施，創造出一個取之於自然、回饋於生態的綠色建築，親近自然的舒適氛圍，讓人完全沉浸於山城風光的寧靜悠閒。佔地廣闊的「日月潭民宿～山中城宝渡假民宿」，設有庭園、烤肉區域、觀景平台…等休閒設施，於庭園中悠閒的泡茶聊天、歡樂的遊玩烤肉；走進設計別致優雅的民宿內，處處流露主人的巧思與用心，歐式風格的擺飾裝潢，顯得格外氣派但不失溫馨，採光良好的套房空間，明亮寬敞、典雅樸實的氛圍，令人倍感舒適、自在。重視生態保育、環境維護的「日月潭民宿～山中城宝渡假民宿」，除了庭園中的綠意茵茵，不時還有少見的昆蟲動物帶給您不同的旅程驚喜，走吧～安排假期一同來享受山城中的舒適靜謐，輕鬆渡過一個環保的舒適假期吧！倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【049-2897597 049-2897597 免費 、0936-316048 0936-316048 免費 】日月潭民宿～山中城宝渡假民宿。

stays.description: 「日月潭．山明水秀．民宿」位於熱鬧的伊達邵商圈，方便旅人可恣意漫遊伊達邵熱鬧的商圈街道，遍嚐邵族傳統風味美食及在地特色小吃。您也可於飯後步行至伊達邵碼頭欣賞優美的湖光山景。日月潭的藍色湖泊搭配綠意山景，在藍天白雲的照映下，更顯閃閃動人。「日月潭．山明水秀．民宿」鄰近伊達邵、文武廟、日月潭纜車站、水社碼頭、朝霧碼頭…等知名景點。自民宿出發漫步到日月潭湖畔也僅需約2~3分鐘的腳程距離。您隨時皆可放空身心靈‧讓自己沉浸在一片風光明媚之中；也可靜靜坐在湖畔之濱，獨享靜謐之境。「日月潭．山明水秀．民宿」提供多間潔淨溫馨的舒適房型，屋內明亮的燈光照明及低調奢華的裝潢設計，搭配窗外山明水秀的湖光水色及明媚風光，呈現高雅、靜謐的舒活氣息，讓人隨之心曠神怡。

stays.searchText: 山明水秀民宿 山明水秀民宿 南投縣民宿560號 南投縣 魚池鄉 日月村光華街48號 「日月潭．山明水秀．民宿」位於熱鬧的伊達邵商圈，方便旅人可恣意漫遊伊達邵熱鬧的商圈街道，遍嚐邵族傳統風味美食及在地特色小吃。您也可於飯後步行至伊達邵碼頭欣賞優美的湖光山景。日月潭的藍色湖泊搭配綠意山景，在藍天白雲的照映下，更顯閃閃動人。「日月潭．山明水秀．民宿」鄰近伊達邵、文武廟、日月潭纜車站、水社碼頭、朝霧碼頭…等知名景點。自民宿出發漫步到日月潭湖畔也僅需約2~3分鐘的腳程距離。您隨時皆可放空身心靈‧讓自己沉浸在一片風光明媚之中；也可靜靜坐在湖畔之濱，獨享靜謐之境。「日月潭．山明水秀．民宿」提供多間潔淨溫馨的舒適房型，屋內明亮的燈光照明及低調奢華的裝潢設計，搭配窗外山明水秀的湖光水色及明媚風光，呈現高雅、靜謐的舒活氣息，讓人隨之心曠神怡。

stays.name: 山水田雅舍
stays.description: 經過熱鬧喧嘩的商圈人潮，欣賞過日月潭的特有氣質景致，該是前往今夜落腳處了。來到了「日月潭山水田雅舍民宿」，一幕鄉村味十足的畫面，頓時令我感動了起來，這不就是小時候曾經幻想過的「家」嗎？...只不過眼前所見的「家」多了些包裝設計，將我心中的夢築的更完美了，讓人更想尋找它的特別。以最簡單的陳設營造出最溫馨的氣氛，木質地板也凸顯出更自在的悠閒感，但恰到好處的活動空間，並不會讓人有置身閣樓的壓迫感，讓人莫名奇妙待上好一陣子捨不得出來。 喜愛自然物的主人，依夢築出「日月潭山水田雅舍民宿」，正好與我小時幻想的片段契合．．．您願意前來，也與它再做另一個夢嗎？
stays.descriptionEn: After a busy day of shopping and enjoying the beautiful Sun Moon Lake, it's time to look for a place to spend the night. The rustic Sun Moon Lake Shanshuitian B&B is warm and homey, like the perfect home that appeared in our childhood dreams. The only difference is this home is now more carefully decorated and more perfect looking. You can't help but go inside to take a closer look.The living space is simply decorated but very warm and welcoming. The perfectly sized living space has a comfortable wooden floor, unlike other confined places with low ceilings. You will be so relaxed here that you wouldn't want to leave. The owner loves natural materials and uses furnitures and accessories made with natural materials to decorate Sun Moon Lake Shanshuitian B&B. The decor in each room happens to match the rooms in the house I dreamed of when I was little. Would you like to come here to see if this is the house from your childhood dream?
