stays.name: 愛黏在一起民宿
stays.description: 關於愛黏在一起好幾次在大自然中感受風吹，日照，氣味。這些是大自然治癒我們的方式。心被洗淨般的舒爽而那自由的空間不就是心中那處會呼吸的家嗎？外觀簡潔白牆呼應水泥清水模，挑高７米引進自然光。陽光穿透著建築裡和外，我們從室內窺探著今天雲朵的心情，花園廣場滿滿的鹿角蕨，各式各樣的植栽，也由外至內綠化了整個家。如果滿佈陽光綠意是生活那麼這些就是找回真正自我的夢想實踐我以誠摯的心，熱情的款待邀請至「愛黏在一起設計師民宿」做體驗旅行，希望每位旅人都能探索自我心靈國度，徜徉大自然風光，重新點燃對生命的熱誠。

stays.name: 文山民宿
stays.description: 輪番上陣的經典四季湖光山色的最佳代表挑逗視覺感的自然美景色的極致舞台～日月潭 這裡沒有城市裡充滿壓力的高樓林立，只有新鮮空氣和無拘無束的寬闊好環境；「日月潭文山民宿」為登記合法之日月潭民宿，編號529，就是座落在這麼一處好山好水的日月潭風景區內，除了鄰近九族文化村多處旅遊景點，遊玩路線及行程規劃相當容易之外，在交通往來上也是十分便利，坐公車也可直接抵達，民宿也特別安排了一些超值優惠套裝行程,讓房客能省荷包之外也能不必為行程而煩惱,不論您是散心渡假或放鬆舒壓，「日月潭文山民宿」都絕對會是您的最佳選擇。 您可在視線所及的範圍內，看見環繞的青山景色、悠閒自在的休憩庭園以及寬敞開放的活動空間。透過潔白的清爽色調所打造出的閒逸環境；民宿提供有二人、四人、六人及八人等套房及和式通舖式房型，以素雅的傢俱陳設及簡單俐落的擺設方式，呈現出質樸實在的舒適空間，而整個環境所散發的溫馨氛圍，更是讓您有著如同在家的自在心情。 ◎廣大庭園腹地，要烤肉辦活動都ok ◎位於日月潭與九族文化村的必經要道◎鄰近魚池鄉商圈，用餐、購物都很方便 ◎民宿內有免費安全私人停車埸，寶貝您的愛車免煩惱，且不必托行李走很遠◎民宿外有公車站牌要往哪裡都很方便，不用為交通問題而煩惱～觀賞雲海看日出好去處～ 想觀雲海看日出的朋友們，不必舟車勞頓跑到阿里山了！「清晨到文山民宿附近南投縣魚池鄉槌仔寮金龍山俯瞰魚池盆地，就可以觀賞低空雲海日出。」～觀賞螢火蟲好去處～ 想觀賞螢火蟲的朋友們，不必舟車勞頓跑到很遠的山上,鄉間路小又怕找不到停車位了！「4月中~5月底螢火蟲季節，文山民宿附近(約600公尺)在夏夜裡便可觀賞到一大片如星光般的螢火蟲飛舞。」放鬆心情，同時也放慢您的腳步，並用心去體會生活中最簡單的那個部份～

stays.name: 日月潭大統民宿
stays.description: 走遍各地旅遊景點，卻唯獨對日月潭念念不忘，天地之中的自然之美，就如同一位神奇魔法師，特別為這的四季皆添入不同風情，小施個魔法，就令人無法招架，忘不了如詩畫的那一幕，只好再度重遊．．． 「日月潭大統飯店」位在日月潭環潭公路旁，鄰近文武廟、孔雀園、玄奘式、玄光式、慈恩塔及貓蘭山、水社大山、涵碧、大竹湖、水蛙頭、松柏崙、慈恩塔、土亭仔等八條自然步道，多處美麗景點，當然一天是玩不完的，若您不想浪費時間，又想在短時間內玩到重點，請別客氣，詢問咱們的民宿主人，他會大方的以專業的在地身份，給您最適當的行程建議。 為提升整體質感，採用柚木材質做為房內地板的選擇，不僅增加室內明亮度，寬度也跟著加大，其內部陳設，如液晶電視、床俱、羽絨被枕、......等，也都堅持高度品質；大部份房型，皆設有大片景觀窗，不管是湖景或山景房，想要有個陽光充沛的休閒時光，只要拉開窗簾，溫暖光線就會馬上進入。另外，民宿還設有開放式觀景陽台，請開啟您的超廣角視野，可千萬別錯過每一處完美景色。 為了讓家有行動不便或年長者的旅客也能安心入住，大統飯店特別貼心設置了無障礙設施「電梯」，此周全貼心的設備，所以「旅客的滿意度，是大統飯店的責任」。
stays.descriptionEn: I traveled all over the tourist attractions, but only remembered Sun Moon Lake. The beauty of nature in heaven and earth is like a magical magician. He especially added different flavors to the four seasons here. A little magic is irresistible. Can& #39;t forget that scene like poetry and pictures, so I had to revisit it again. ． ．​​"Sun Moon Lake Datong Hotel" is located beside the Sun Moon Lake Huantan Highway, adjacent to Wenwu Temple, Peacock Garden, Xuanzang Style, Xuanguang Style, Ci& #39;en Pagoda and Maolan Mountain, Shuishe Mountain, Hanbi, Dazhu Lake, Shuiwatou, Songbolun , Ci& #39;en Tower, Tutingzai and other eight natural trails, many beautiful scenic spots, of course, you can& #39;t finish it in one day. If you don& #39;t want to waste time and want to play the key points in a short time, please feel free to ask our homestay The host, he will generously give you the most appropriate itinerary advice as a professional local.​​In order to improve the overall texture, teak wood material is used as the choice of the floor in the room, which not only increases the brightness of the room, but also increases the width. , also insist on high quality; most of the room types are equipped with large landscape windows, whether it is a lake view or a mountain view room, if you want to have a sunny leisure time, just open the curtains, and the warm light will enter immediately. In addition, the homestay also has an open viewing balcony, please open your ultra-wide-angle view, but don& #39;t miss every perfect view.​​In order to allow travelers with mobility problems or elderly people to stay at ease, Datong Hotel has specially set up a barrier-free facility "elevator". This comprehensive and thoughtful equipment, so "the satisfaction of passengers is the responsibility of Datong Hotel." .

stays.name: 日月潭大飯店
stays.description: 日月潭大飯店位於日月潭南半月湖岸旁，以日月潭為名，106 間的客房每間以湖水、雲影、陽光堆砌獨立寬敞空間，素雅簡鍊流線的外觀下，隱約地帶出精巧的心，寧靜中，悠然呈現幾許華麗情調，讓您在無時無刻的享受屬於您嚮往已久的悠閒恬靜。飯店直接連結 CNN 票選全球十大最美環湖步道，也是日月潭唯一設有單車碼頭戶外庭園飯店，不論白天與夜晚，可悠緩慢步或輕踩鐵馬於湖潭小徑，欣賞沿途迎著酣美晨光，雲嵐飄漾任風吹，心靈像風箏般地自由；當暗夜降臨，姣潔月色倒映潭心，懾人的鏡面水湖，映照月光閃爍，彷似一條波光粼粼鯉魚如此夢幻絢麗，令人讚嘆。欣賞日月潭的美，需要時間細細品味；清晨雲霧飄邈，詩情畫意，白天潭水湛藍，風光明媚；傍晚夕陽餘暉，水波蕩漾，各有千萬姿色，令人時在波上、時在雲間，幸福至極，讓人忘記時間的存在。
stays.descriptionEn: Named after the Sun Moon Lake, the Hotel is settled alongside the South Half Moon Bay.The scenery of light and shade, down between clouds, is embraced by waves. 106 rooms are finely crafted, in pure, grace and elegance. Tranquility around and glamour amid, you may bathe in leisure and serenity.On the CNN top ten routes, and in the only garden hotel with bicycle parking and lakeshore pier, you may go cycling down the way whether in night or in day. Enjoy the morning light along the path, feel the breeze on the track. While the air flows through chin, own the freedom as the wind.The moonlight shimmering after dark, water light up mirror arc. Splendid like a fantasy, brilliance may take your breath. All landscapes by Sun Moon Lake, you can never thorough taste. Filled in the haze and the mist, sunrise could be such a poem; Lake painted in deep blue gray, as a sapphire during the day; Wave is rendered in golden color, after the glow of sunset. Being here among the clouds and the waves, the only presence would be happiness.

stays.searchText: 日月潭大飯店 日月潭大飯店股份有限公司 南投縣旅館088號 南投縣 魚池鄉 水社村中山路419號 日月潭大飯店位於日月潭南半月湖岸旁，以日月潭為名，106 間的客房每間以湖水、雲影、陽光堆砌獨立寬敞空間，素雅簡鍊流線的外觀下，隱約地帶出精巧的心，寧靜中，悠然呈現幾許華麗情調，讓您在無時無刻的享受屬於您嚮往已久的悠閒恬靜。飯店直接連結 CNN 票選全球十大最美環湖步道，也是日月潭唯一設有單車碼頭戶外庭園飯店，不論白天與夜晚，可悠緩慢步或輕踩鐵馬於湖潭小徑，欣賞沿途迎著酣美晨光，雲嵐飄漾任風吹，心靈像風箏般地自由；當暗夜降臨，姣潔月色倒映潭心，懾人的鏡面水湖，映照月光閃爍，彷似一條波光粼粼鯉魚如此夢幻絢麗，令人讚嘆。欣賞日月潭的美，需要時間細細品味；清晨雲霧飄邈，詩情畫意，白天潭水湛藍，風光明媚；傍晚夕陽餘暉，水波蕩漾，各有千萬姿色，令人時在波上、時在雲間，幸福至極，讓人忘記時間的存在。

stays.nameEn: Sun Moon Lake Full House Resort
stays.description: 一處坐落於日月潭依達邵廿餘載的別墅，之所以能屹立迄今，是因為口耳相傳，因為光臨的人願意分享這般真的經營。不是天生注定，一切只是偶然。意料之外的落腳，一瞥的念頭，一座民宿嫣然誕生。第一間日月潭合法的特色民宿，委實名符其實。花園圍繞的木屋所營造的氛圍，就是一個孩童在裡頭哼彈簡單音階這樣的景、音，清麗而感人。
stays.descriptionEn: A villa sits at Ita Thao at Sun Moon Lake for over 20 years. It has been able to survive by word of mouth because guests are more than willing to share their experiences. Such was not destined, everything was just coincidence. Unexpectedly settled, a glimpse of an idea, and a Bed and Breakfast was beautifully born. The first legitimate specialty B&B in the Sun Moon Lake area. A reality that corresponds with the name. Huts surrounded by gardens create an ambience, a child playing inside and humming a simple scale—such a scene and sound, elegant and touching.

stays.name: 日月潭漁村民宿
stays.nameEn: Sun Moon Lake Fishing Village B&B
stays.description: 「日月潭民宿-漁村民宿」位於日月潭德化社邵族人的聚集地，不僅是擁有地理上少見的山水風景，還蘊藏了繽紛豐富的邵族文化。從面山背水的漁村民宿窗外望去盡是環山繞水的青翠美景，與別館中復古的風格相輝映，造就了一種與世無爭的感受。一進到漁村民宿就會被那樸實的環境所吸引，懸掛在大廳裡的一幅大大的日月潭美景啟動了心中想要深入探索日月潭的按鈕。而民宿中所有的家具設備都是深色的木頭材質，讓人有種掉入時光隧道回到了過去那個純真的年代。
stays.descriptionEn: "Fisherman Homestay" is located in the gathering place of the Thao people in Dehua Village, Sun Moon Lake. It not only boasts a rare geographical landscape of mountains and water but also embodies the vibrant and rich Thao culture. From the windows of Fisherman Homestay, which faces the mountains and backs onto the water, one can see the lush greenery of surrounding hills and winding waters, harmonizing with the retro style of the annex, creating a sense of being detached from worldly concerns.Upon entering Fisherman Homestay, one is immediately captivated by its unpretentious environment. A large painting of the beautiful Sun Moon Lake scenery hanging in the lobby ignites a desire to explore Sun Moon Lake more deeply. All the furniture and fixtures in the homestay are made of dark wood evoke a sense of stepping into a time tunnel, returning to the innocent days of the past.

stays.name: 明軒曉居民宿
stays.description: 擁有生態池、露天休閒桌椅及烤肉場地等設施的「日月潭民宿．明軒曉居」，讓來此住宿的旅人就算哪兒也不去，也能賞花觀景、玩沙烤肉，慵懶一整天。若是要驅車前往埔里, 金龍山, 車埕 ,日月潭國家風景區、九族文化村、文武廟、三育基督教學院、慈恩塔, 蓮華池生態區等景點車程也在10~20分鐘內，是一處遠離塵囂卻又交通便利的世外桃源。 隨風搖曳的綠葉與紅艷艷的花朵歡欣鼓舞地迎接到來旅客，「日月潭民宿．明軒曉居」整棟建築物、住宿房間及庭園景觀皆是由民宿主人鄭大哥一手打造 , 鄭大哥原先就是從事園藝景觀的工作，因此對庭園造景還有植物非常了解，也可以說是這方面的專家。由於之前都在外地打拼，幾年前才開始真正回家鄉，打造出一座屬於自己的私人後花園，並取名芸園，芸來自自己的太太，可看出鄭大哥有多愛老婆。鄭大哥的兒子跟媳婦也很用心的幫忙管理這個地方，早餐是由兒子夫妻一起親手做的唷!，山水相連的美好空間讓人流連忘返。民宿除了有景觀雙人套房可以遠眺山嵐之外，另有木屋房型適合大家庭及朋友聚會，溫馨敦實的氛圍別有一番風味，若是有小家庭來此，可以選擇親子四人房讓小朋友們有個快樂的周末假期～

stays.name: 月潭小棧民宿
stays.description: 歡迎光臨月潭小棧(日月潭住宿~歡迎包棟) ★民宿距離日月潭纜車站步行約7-10分鐘，老街及碼頭步行約3-5分鐘～ 那年的記憶依然深刻．．彷彿昨日如今，我再度來到這裡順著階梯而下的，是另一個回憶的開始 位在美麗日月潭德化社內的「日月潭民宿-月潭小棧」，在這裡不必擔心景點距離有多遠、更不需為了到哪逛街而煩惱，因為德化碼頭和熱鬧商圈都近在咫尺，步行不用一分鐘唷。頗具日式簡約味道的民宿外觀設計，沒有多餘的裝飾，採光佳的大片玻璃門，飽和了屋內光線，更瞬間加大視覺空間，看似小空間，卻因琳瑯滿目的豐富擺設及邵族特色裝飾的點綴，讓整個大廳大了起來。 民宿提供雙人、四人房型供遊客選擇，潔靜雅致的住宿環境，如同高級飯店的高品質寢具及設備搭配，利用木質地板提升空間的明亮度，也強調出整體所要呈現的質感。依房型的不同，您還有機會欣賞到日月潭湖景。日月潭的夜有著不同於白天的魅力，民宿旁的景觀階梯，到了晚上就成了浪漫的地盤，建議您，趁著入睡前，到外頭走走，沉浸在這安靜沒有喧鬧的街，您會發現自已好幸福。 被擁在溫暖柔和的光線裡，心裡頭的那股溫馨，彷彿回到了「家」。倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【049-2850387】或【0921-001937】日月潭-月潭小棧民宿。
stays.descriptionEn: The closest bed and breakfast to Sun Moon Lake, Moon Lake Bed and Breakfast is 400 meters from the ropeway station. A 5-10 minute stroll along the Ita Thao Lakeside Trail, where you can enjoy views of the lake, will bring you to the station. Bring your whole family to ride the ropeway and stay at our bed and breakfast! It’s located in the Dehuashe Area, about 200 meters from Dehuashe Wharf and the commercial street. Whether you’re here to enjoy the lake by boat, walk the surrounding trails, take in the scenery, or go shopping at the commercial street, Moon Lake Bed and Breakfast is your most convenient choice!

stays.description: 座落於日月潭風景區中的「有水巷渡假民宿」設有二人與四人的房型空間，白色木屋建築就好像森林中的童話小屋，以簡約俐落的陳列擺設，打造出寬敞明亮、乾淨清爽的休憩空間，每個房間都設有大面窗形，讓早晨的陽光將您喚醒，夜晚隨著蟲嗚入睡，體驗大自然生活中的悠哉舒適；擁有廣大的戶外庭園,座落山林中靜幽寧靜的環境中，早晨再品嚐主人家自種美味蔬果早餐，給您一早健康無負擔的充足活動。
stays.descriptionEn: Do you feel rushed and out of breath from your rushed pace of life? Why not come to Sun Moon Lake – Youshuixiang Vacation Bed and Breakfast, where you can experience a more relaxing way of living? Sun Moon Lake is like a scenic painting of great depth and variety; whether you’re here to stroll the pathways and feel the breeze on your face, absorb the fragrance of a tea garden, or wander through the changing scenery by day or night, you can’t escape the beauty of this place. Located in the Sun Moon Lake Scenic Area, Youshuixiang Vacation Home is near tourist sties such as Yuchic (Yuchi) and Puli. It’s a legally-certified establishment, and the all-new white wood building looks straight out of a fairy tale forest, featuring a large outdoor area and surrounded by dense woods. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere of recreation amidst nature. Sun Moon Lake Youshuixiang Vacation Bed and Breakfast offers double and 4 person rooms featuring simple, clean layout, as well as being bright, spacious, clean, and refreshing, with large windows. Wake up to the morning sunlight and fall asleep to the sounds of birds and insects in the evening, experiencing the comfortable and carefree feeling of nature. Situated in a quiet secluded environment within the forest, you can enjoy a breakfast of delicious produce grown by the owner himself, providing health and energy for the day to come. Breakfast is free of charge. Other services include: 1. Meal ordering or BBQ ingredients. 2. Ticket purchase for the Formosa Aborigine Cultural Village or Sun Moon Lake boat tour. 3. Free samples of our homegrown Ruby Black Tea. 4. Activities – Sun Moon Lake Tour (along the bike trail). 5. Agricultural products: black tea, mushrooms, orchids. 6. Pickup service – provided by the owner. 7. Ecological features: Fireflies, flowers, beetles, butterflies.

stays.name: 桂月村
stays.description: 我們位於日月潭精華地帶，水社碼頭的街道上，鬧中取靜，舉凡觀賞高山湖泊美景、購物、飲食、住宿、交通、免費旅遊資源與旅遊景點等，皆在步行1～3分鐘以內可達。我們倡導不違背自然原則的生活態度，提供遊客能享有自然、健康、舒適的膳食與住宿環境。此外，我們更重視與客人之間的良性互動與尊重，歡迎客人卸下都市生活中的緊張以及對他人的不安全感，與我們和樂相處；在這裡重新定義人與人之間原本就該有的單純而和諧關係。
stays.descriptionEn: Laurel Villa sits along the Shueishe pier which is the most prominent area in Sun Moon Lake. This area provides the best panoramic view of the lake and the surrounding mountains, Shopping, food, accommodation, transport, and some of the attractions at Sun Moon Lake are within walking distance from Laurel Villa. We strive to live in harmony with nature and hope our guest can experience it by providing the most natural and comfortable living environment along with fresh and healthy meals. Take a break from your busy schedule, visit us on your next trip to Sun Moon Lake and allow us to be part of your experience. We hope you’ll be able to find peace and tranquil during your stay with us.

stays.descriptionEn: Hi~ Welcome home~ Yuanju is located within the Sun Moon Lake National Scenic Area, near Shuishe Pier, the most beautiful cycling trails, and the romantic Hanbi Trail. Our home is simple and comfortable, without excessive decoration, hoping that every traveler will feel as relaxed and unrestrained as if they were at home. At Sun Moon Lake, we hope that travelers will not only stay in their rooms, but also go outdoors to enjoy the beauty of nature. We also offer a variety of experiences such as SUP (Stand Up Paddleboarding), cycling around the lake, and hiking trails. Let travelers eat authentic local food, play local games, and fully enjoy their wonderful holiday.

stays.name: 浪漫滿屋民宿
stays.description: 透過琉璃盒建築與水對話位於國度中心的日月潭畔，浪漫滿屋民宿的設計概念，引進日月潭的「色韻」意象，以水的環繞、光影變化的基調，將「一個玻璃盒子，浮在水面上」的空間詩學概念，融以愛戀情感元素與自然，並藉由鋼構、玻璃與石材等，勾勒出現代浪漫的建築氛圍，脫離一般民宿的傳統與包袱，跳Tone的設計思考模式，不一味地抄襲、拷貝，令人眼睛為之一亮。這棟風格獨具的3層樓建築，隨者四季更迭，在山巒環抱下展現多樣琉璃幻化的情境，讓每位造訪的遊客深深著迷，浸心沈潛浪漫情懷悠然而升。新浪漫美學的情境家屋5種不同風格的特色房型，有著命中註定、海角七號、深情蜜碼、心心相印、琉璃情海等浪漫命名，空間更用心鋪陳出偶像劇的夢幻情境，置身之中，可以感受到浪漫的喜悅、體驗浪漫的想法，分分秒秒都有戀愛般的好心情。浪漫滿屋也針對住客量身打造夢想企劃，從生日派對到求婚驚喜、婚紗拍攝，完成每一位訪客對於浪漫的憧憬，一段又一段的幸福故事就此展開。

stays.searchText: 浪漫滿屋民宿 浪漫滿屋民宿 南投縣民宿485號 南投縣 魚池鄉 新城村通文巷3-10號 透過琉璃盒建築與水對話位於國度中心的日月潭畔，浪漫滿屋民宿的設計概念，引進日月潭的「色韻」意象，以水的環繞、光影變化的基調，將「一個玻璃盒子，浮在水面上」的空間詩學概念，融以愛戀情感元素與自然，並藉由鋼構、玻璃與石材等，勾勒出現代浪漫的建築氛圍，脫離一般民宿的傳統與包袱，跳Tone的設計思考模式，不一味地抄襲、拷貝，令人眼睛為之一亮。這棟風格獨具的3層樓建築，隨者四季更迭，在山巒環抱下展現多樣琉璃幻化的情境，讓每位造訪的遊客深深著迷，浸心沈潛浪漫情懷悠然而升。新浪漫美學的情境家屋5種不同風格的特色房型，有著命中註定、海角七號、深情蜜碼、心心相印、琉璃情海等浪漫命名，空間更用心鋪陳出偶像劇的夢幻情境，置身之中，可以感受到浪漫的喜悅、體驗浪漫的想法，分分秒秒都有戀愛般的好心情。浪漫滿屋也針對住客量身打造夢想企劃，從生日派對到求婚驚喜、婚紗拍攝，完成每一位訪客對於浪漫的憧憬，一段又一段的幸福故事就此展開。

stays.description: 若一個名字能在你我心中有份量儘管一字要價一億也不足為惜~百年來，進出涵碧樓者盡為帝王將相，嚴密的管制措施，讓這幢風雲名樓始終蒙上一層神秘的面紗。但究竟涵碧樓一名如何而來?將時光倒回廿世紀初， 正值日人積極日月潭的水力發電開發，日本人伊藤在現在的涵碧半島上建了一幢木屋，作為渡假，並命名為「涵碧樓」那時是1901年。 1923年日本皇太子裕仁來台視察，指定涵碧樓為駐蹕所，並擴建為二層樓的建築，增加八間貴賓房，包含東、西廂房、餐廳、會議室等設施，從此涵碧樓由一幢富豪人家的渡假別墅，一躍而為官方招待所。1949年國民政府遷台，涵碧樓成了先總統蔣公的行館，作為渡假、接待來台訪問的外國元首。1998年鄉林集團董事長賴正鎰接了一通電話，內心是萬分的激動與存疑，因為三十幾年來，賴董心中一直夢想有一天能夠在日月潭湖畔建一幢世界級的酒店，而來電的人正表示涵碧樓有意出售。當然，要買下這幢風雲名樓，並非易事，因為賣方開價2.7億元，而且不肯降價，一毛錢也不能少，否則免談，經過一年多的折衝，無數回合的談判，最後還是以「不二價」成交。 事後賴董回憶說，還有什麼名字可以不需要做任何廣告，就可以讓所有人朗朗上口呢？而且這個名字在大家心目中的地位與份量，不是花錢就做得到的，因此涵碧樓三個字，每一個字值一億元，算起來是便宜的。歷時五年餘，總投資額新台幣18.6億元，以「極簡」、「禪風」為建築設計核心，將原有宮殿式的六層樓建築，僅留下樑、柱、樓板，其餘皆拆除改裝，並依用途分A.B.C三館: A館為客房大樓；B館包含SPA、健身房、三溫暖、會員俱樂部等休閒設施；C館包含別墅區、會議室、圖書館、停車場等空間。於2002年3月3日以全新的面貌與渡假型態重現國人眼前。
stays.descriptionEn: If there is a name that can stir your emotions, it is The Lalu(Han Bi Lo in Chinese), even if each word in the name costs a hundred million dollars. In 1901, Mr. Ito built a small wooden cabin on the Lalu Peninsula for vacation use and called it “TheFor hundreds of years, with strict entrance control, only senior governmental official, generals, prime ministers, and emperors are allowed into The Lalu. Therefore, a myth is created to this building. However, how did The Lalu come about?In 1923, the Japanese Crown Prince Hirohito visited Taiwan and appointed The Lalu to be his official residence. He rebuilt the small wooden cabin into a two-story building and added eight guest rooms, including the east and the west wings, dining room, conference room and more. From this time on, The Lalu turned itself from a luxury vacation home into an official government guest house.In 1949, when the Chinese Nationalist Government retreated to Taiwan, The Lalu became President Chiang Kai-Shek’s hostel, used primarily for vacation use and to entertain foreign head of states.In 1998, Mr. Cheng-Yi Lai, chairman of the Shining Group, received a phone call that filled his heart with tremendous excitement and doubt. For the past 30 years, his dream was to build a world class hotel along the shores of Sun Moon Lake. The man that made the phone call indicated to him that The Lalu was for sale.However, buying this historical building was not going to be a simple task. The seller was asking for a sum of NT$ 270 million and made it clear that it was not negotiable. It took over a year of hard work and negotiation, with the end result closing at the firm asking price of NT$ 270 million. Mr. Lai recalled and said, “Which name is always on people’s mind without ever needing any advertisement? This name has its place and historical value in public’s mind so the name itself is priceless. Even with millions that we spent on it, I think it’s still a bargain.”After 5 years and an investment of NT$ 1.86 billion, using the theory of utmost simplification of Zen style as the architectural design core from our award winning international design team, the renovation of this historical hotel began. It was rebuilt from the original palace style 6 story building, saving only its beams, columns and floor and replacing everything else. The new design divides the building into three separate building (building A, B and C) for different purposes. Building A is the main guest house. Building B is the structure that houses entertainment facilities such as the Spa, gym, Jacuzzi and Members Clubhouse. Building C includes the Villa area, conference facility, Library and parking lot. On March 3, 2002, The Lalu reopened to the public with its new design and resort style .

stays.name: 清平樂村居
stays.description: 日月潭民宿--清平樂村居 座落於魚池鄉澀水社區 是一棟亮眼的黃色小屋在依山傍水的天然環境擁抱下襯托出清平樂得天獨厚下的不平凡。清平樂旁有自然生態池，伴隨四季的變化，有魚、蜻蜓、青蛙、蝌蚪等生物生活於其中，當然還有荷花、蓮花等植物浮游其上。四週有茶園、農田、果樹等鄉村淳樸風景圍繞；清晨時，可繞著環村步道拜訪澀水社區，享受著微風吹拂下的清新氣息，耳聽山林鳥語，也可以到陶藝教室去製作陶器，藉由手指的觸感來感受土壤的溫暖，讓心與自然更加貼近，亦或是走遠點，到瀑布去享受冰涼、飛濺的水花點點。當然啦！你也可以驅車前往日月潭、九族文化村等，都是位於附近的著名景點，路程不遠立即可到達的地方。晚上住在清平樂，，在滿天星的陪伴下，與同行好友喝茶聊天,寧靜的村居可以讓您身心靈沉澱,蟲鳴鳥叫自然的樂音伴您入夢鄉.
stays.descriptionEn: Sun Moon Lake Homestay – CHIN-PIN LO B&B is located at Seshui Community in Yuchi Township. The B&B is a conspicuous yellow building intimately hugged by the surrounding mountains and rivers, helping to create a unique sanctuary and paradise. CHIN PIN-LO B&B is graced with a natural ecology pond that adapts to the seasons. Fish, dragonflies, frogs, and tadpoles as well as plants such as waterlilies and lotuses call this place their home. Tea plantations, farms, orchards, and other simple, rustic elements surround CHIN PIN-LO B&B. Guests could take a walk along the footpath that circles the village or visit Seshui Community in the morning while enjoying the refreshing air provided by the gentle wind while enjoying the hums and chirps of birds and other natural wildlife in the mountains. Visitors are also welcome to the pottery classroom to make their own porcelain and pottery, or go even further to the waterfall to enjoy its refreshing, misty splashes. Of course, you can also drive to nearby attractions such as Sun Moon Lake and Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village. It does not take long to drive to these places. Night time at CHIN-PIN LO features starry skies, a perfect time to enjoy tea with your friends while sharing a delightful conversation. The quiet countryside will help relax your soul, with the natural chirping of critters and birds keeping you company as you settle down for a most relaxing sleep.

stays.name: 湖悅民宿
stays.nameEn: HU YUE LAKE VIEW HOME STAY
stays.description: 在湖悅，您將會感受到一種前所未有的寧靜與滿足。清晨的微光穿透窗簾，輕輕灑在您的臉上，帶來一天的清新與希望。當您推開窗戶，湖水的清香迎面而來，彷彿是大自然親切的擁抱，溫暖著您的心房。傍晚時分，夕陽悄然西下，將餘暉灑在湖面上，波光粼粼。您與摯愛漫步湖畔，每一步都如詩如畫，充滿了甜蜜與溫馨的回憶。這一刻，時間仿佛停滯，只為了讓您享受這份寧靜與愉悅。夜晚降臨，月光如水，瀲灩在湖面上，映襯著天際的星光。這片湖畔，靜謐而祥和，讓您的心靈得以舒展，彷彿與自然融為一體。來到湖悅，您將與大自然真摯相會，放下繁囂的生活，重新找回內心深處的平靜與和諧。讓我們共同創造屬於您的永恆記憶，在這片湖畔的美麗山水間，感受到最真摯、最深刻的感動和滿足。
stays.descriptionEn: At Hu Yue, you will feel an unprecedented tranquility and satisfaction.The morning light penetrates the curtains and gently falls on your face, bringing freshness and hope for the day. When you open the window, the fragrance of the lake comes towards you, like a warm embrace from nature, warming your heart.In the evening, the setting sun quietly sets, casting its afterglow on the lake, making the waves sparkle. You and your loved one stroll along the lakeside, and every step is picturesque and filled with sweet and warm memories. At this moment, time seems to have stopped, just for you to enjoy this tranquility and pleasure.As night falls, the moonlight shimmers on the lake like water, reflecting the stars in the sky. This lakeside is quiet and peaceful, allowing your mind to relax and feel as if you are one with nature.When you come to Hu Yue, you will have a sincere encounter with nature, let go of the hustle and bustle of life, and rediscover the peace and harmony deep in your heart.Let us create your eternal memory together, and feel the most sincere and profound touch and satisfaction among the beautiful mountains and waters by the lake.

stays.searchText: 湖悅民宿 湖悅民宿 南投縣民宿502號 南投縣 魚池鄉 日月村義勇街113號 在湖悅，您將會感受到一種前所未有的寧靜與滿足。清晨的微光穿透窗簾，輕輕灑在您的臉上，帶來一天的清新與希望。當您推開窗戶，湖水的清香迎面而來，彷彿是大自然親切的擁抱，溫暖著您的心房。傍晚時分，夕陽悄然西下，將餘暉灑在湖面上，波光粼粼。您與摯愛漫步湖畔，每一步都如詩如畫，充滿了甜蜜與溫馨的回憶。這一刻，時間仿佛停滯，只為了讓您享受這份寧靜與愉悅。夜晚降臨，月光如水，瀲灩在湖面上，映襯著天際的星光。這片湖畔，靜謐而祥和，讓您的心靈得以舒展，彷彿與自然融為一體。來到湖悅，您將與大自然真摯相會，放下繁囂的生活，重新找回內心深處的平靜與和諧。讓我們共同創造屬於您的永恆記憶，在這片湖畔的美麗山水間，感受到最真摯、最深刻的感動和滿足。

stays.name: 漢來日月行館
stays.description: 漢來日月行館坐落於涵碧半島制高點隱密湖畔，可一覽日月雙潭環繞270度最美景觀，由全球知名LWMA李瑋珉設計師操刀設計，全面改造地上12層、地下3層的飯店動線與空間設計，重新翻轉飯店大門入口，打造幽靜優雅的旅居動線，全館擁有93間湖景客房及套房，客房面積自15坪至108坪不等，在飯店空間中融入日月潭的天光、湖水、山景與森林元素，讓在漢來日月行館的每一刻都如同置身宛如仙境的日月山水間，重新定義頂級奢華的度假體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Grand Hilai Sun Moon Lake is located at a high point on the serene banks of Sun Moon Lake, offering a stunning 270-degree view of the lush surroundings. Designed by the globally renowned designer LWMA Li Wei-Min, the hotel features a complete transformation of its 12 above-ground floors and 3 basement levels, with a reimagined entrance that creates a tranquil and elegant pathway for guests. The resort boasts 93 lakeview guest rooms and suites, with sizes ranging from 50 to 357 square meters. The design incorporates elements of sunlight, lake waters, mountain views, and forest surroundings unique to Sun Moon Lake, ensuring that every moment spent at Grand Hilai Sun Moon Lake feels like a dream in a fairy-tale landscape, redefining the ultimate luxury vacation experience.

images.description: ● 標準雙人入住，房內附有等同單人床大小之訂製沙發床，可加一人不另加床，每人加收1000元。 ● 很受歡迎的房型，雙面大落地窗，走出房門外為日出大平台(房內無陽台)，浴廁為開放式，最適合情侶及夫妻。 ● 以戶外梯串接房間，進出完全不受限制，旅行本該如此自由與自在。 ● 客房內之降板浴缸如常提供泡澡使用。 **************************************** 我推開窗門 迎向風中的一個早晨 我靜靜地等待 等待著你柔情的眼神 **************************************** 微微燈光，流洩的音樂，褪下外衣，擁抱時空轉換的愜意….. 以清水混凝土為空間基底的穿透式規劃，俐落幾何語彙貫穿空間呈現本質的存在，大面落地窗與特別設計之白紗及麂皮絨，提供不同的視界與光影游移變化。休憩區與浴室全開放，附有乾濕淋浴空間。嘗試一種人與人、人與空間不同對話方式的新體驗。

images.name: 鄉間小路
images.description: ● 標準為兩人入住，每加一人入住加1000元，五人以內入住均不提供加床，以客房內之沙發床為臥舖。(與床墊同材質、同等級) ● 鄉間小路為最受歡迎的特殊房型，兩個樓層可供使用坪數約26坪。為三面大落地窗，附有雙面日出大陽台，上下樓層各附有衛浴及電視冰箱。 ● 以戶外梯串接房間，進出完全不受限制，旅行本該如此自由與自在。 ● 客房內之降板浴缸如常提供泡澡使用。 **************************************** 笑意寫在臉上 哼一曲鄉居小唱 任思緒在晚風中飛揚 多少落莫惆悵 都隨著晚風飄散 遺忘在鄉間的小路上 **************************************** 鄉間小路是整棟建築最特別的空間，L型的薄型折板鋼構梯，巧妙地串接了兩層樓的空間。下層是開闊的起居空間，附有一座大型的L沙發，或臥、或躺隨心所欲，並可依需求調整成雙人床鋪使用。上層是開闊的臥區空間，還有一個發呆、發懶的心靈角落。走出陽台可以恣意的閒踱晃蕩，也可坐在鞦韆上迎風擺盪。上下層三面落地玻璃提供了絕佳的視覺饗宴，讓日月星辰與您愜意為伍。 藍天配朵夕陽在胸膛，繽紛的雲彩是晚霞的衣裳，多少落莫惆悵，都隨著晚風飄散，遺忘在鄉間的小路上!正是這個空間的最佳心情寫照....

stays.name: 秘密花園設計villa
stays.description: 尋找有大自然與漫活的民宿麼!?落腳在三育基督神學院旁不起眼的花草小路通往著秘境民宿~秘密花園【到日月潭找吳爸爸】若非口耳相傳或不經意上網發現，也許就很難遇見如此美麗的秘密之地。吳爸爸，過去一家人曾到巴西住過8年的時間，但後來在種種考量下決定回台灣；大家口中的「吳爸爸」，是一位帶著滿懷熱情與堅定夢想的熟齡男子，非建築科班出身的他，卻以無師自通的巧手及慎密的思緒，一手打造出自己的家園。【獨派建築創意．藏不住的秘密】不假他人之手，從草圖、施工到完成，甚至是民宿區內園區裡的整頓規劃，全都是由吳爸爸一手完成，可說是完成了人生中最具意義的不可能任務，巧妙的結合了自然景觀及建築藝術的可能性，大量的採用玻璃建材，利用其所呈現之透視性來引發更多的視覺奇蹟，獨具創意的規劃設計，也讓「日月潭秘密花園民宿」的裡裡外外及每個角落，隨處都隱藏著驚喜。一個充滿熱情與理想的「日月潭秘密花園民宿」，期待有緣的您前來遇見幸福未來～
stays.descriptionEn: Looking for a relaxed, all-natural bed and breakfast? Next to the Taiwan Adventist College is a small, inconspicuous flower path that leads to a secret place – Secret Garden Bed and Breakfast. “Look for Mr. Wu when you come to Sun Moon Lake.” Unless you heard about this place by word of mouth or the Internet, it might be difficult to find such a beautiful, secret place. Mr. Wu and his family lived in Brazil for 8 years before deciding to return to Taiwan due to several considerations. A middle-aged man, he enjoys a reputation for being friendly and steadfastly pursuing his dreams. Without an architectural background, he nonetheless created his home through careful planning and skillful, self-taught methods. “Unique architectural creativity, unconcealable secrets.” Mr. Wu was singularly responsible for the blueprints, construction, and overall planning, completing this impossible mission that became his life’s most meaningful project. Thoughtfully integrating natural scenery and architectural art, it used a large amount of glass, whose transparency enhanced the visual appeal. The independent, creative design also fills every corner, inside and out, with surprises. We welcome you to Sun Moon Lake Secret Garden Bed and Breakfast, a place of friendliness and ideals that fate will hopefully lead you to!

stays.description: 距離伊達邵碼頭步行僅需三分鐘，「日月潭住宿．日月潭米樂民宿」座落於熱鬧的伊達邵商圈內，幾步之遙便可以享受道地邵族精心準備的原住民風味餐、山豬肉小吃、日月潭紅茶，以及欣賞青山綠水的遼闊湖景，附近則有日月潭纜車站、孔雀園、文武廟、玄奘寺、慈恩塔、玄光寺與各式的環湖步道等景點，等待您去遊歷與發掘。 「日月潭住宿．日月潭米樂民宿」備有超大中央廚房，提供衛生又安全的營養早餐，給每個住宿旅客一早滿滿的元氣。民宿房間設計走典雅細緻的歐美鄉村風格，棕色的木地板與溫馨別致的復古家具營造出溫馨氛圍，再加上碎花元素的布幔或是牆上畫作點綴其中，舒適而自在的悠閒空間，讓您享受無憂無慮的美麗假期。 倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【049-2850625】。

stays.name: 紅茶工房
stays.description: 一個紅茶樹下長大的孩子，為了讓晟養自己長大的紅茶園能夠永續耕作，選擇退出職場，回到山巒疊嶂幽靜美好的山水田園和紅茶生活在一起，回歸心靈和生命純真 的故鄉。當兩個孩子放下工作，決定幫著父母親一起打拼的時候，紅茶工房於是誕生了！一家人手牽手，心連心，一步一腳印的走進紅茶的世界裡。為了實現心目中想要的房子，紅茶工房從設計開始，就在一家人不斷的討論中，選定了英國都鐸式的建築。自然簡約、質樸典雅的風格。為 了滿足喜歡格子窗，又能攬進陽光和綠意的明亮視野，一家人在紙上畫起一張張與想像中窗戶同等大小尺寸的圖紙。然後裁剪黏貼、核對比較，確定四比三長方形是 最佳比例，將都鐸式窄而深的窗戶，改變成大和寬的格局。同時，基於房子外觀顏色的搭配，從屋瓦樣式、顏色，一片片磁磚、木地板的選擇，除了勤於上網多方搜 尋資訊，也跑遍了大台中地區製造廠商，實地比較，直到找到想要的質地和樣式。紅茶工房民宿的房間名字，分別命名為與紅茶相關的紅茶籽、紅茶芢、工房老茶、台茶18號等。在不同的房間裡分別有各自主題的闡述。而這些文字或是圖畫，都是工房家族所寫，和拍攝的照片沖洗，再經特殊油壓處理，可以說是別出心裁、風格獨具。紅茶工房家族為了給民宿客人家人般的感受，特別提供滿室暗香的浮動的紅茶枕頭。它是工房家族三代人從製茶到縫製枕頭，親力親為所製造出來的除了陣陣從床頭傳來的紅茶香之外，在房間的走道上，我們也用圖片來細說，紅茶工房家族製造這些紅茶枕頭的辛苦過程。為 了紅茶為主題的氛圍，房子裡外的燈具，都是以紅茶葉設計製作。柔和的光暈襯托下，枝葉伸展出的律動，讓紅茶工房的風格獨具。室內外寬敞明亮的空間、優雅簡 約的佈置、空氣中浮動的紅茶香，都是紅茶工房家族以最真誠的心意，希望提供給遠方到來的貴客，最大的舒適和最好的氛圍。紅 茶工房的興建，最大的目的，就在於工房老茶園的永續經營。所以工房的老茶樹自然才是主角。因此，我們在民國99年春節前，最適合紅茶移植的深冬，把這些老 茶樹從茶園移植到家裡來照顧，如今，我們把他們種在紅茶工房的庭院裡，日日以它們為伴。就像從前天天在紅茶樹下翻滾的日子，即使不到茶園的日子裡，也能感 受到它們就在自己的身邊。如果您來到紅茶工房，請您仔細看看他們，這就是晟養我們一家人的紅茶樹，立於天地之間，經過風霜雨水洗禮，超過一甲子了呢！紅茶工房裡，還有工房家族自己研發以老茶園的紅茶為食材，加上當地蔬果所做出的特色料理。堪稱紅茶工房強檔的招牌奶茶，茶香與奶味交融，爽口不甜膩，搭配自製的手工餅乾、紅茶乳酪蛋糕，幸福的感覺，美好的時光，都在紅茶工房哦！這就是紅茶工房！一個小小的、溫暖的、悠閒的、美好的地方！
stays.descriptionEn: One day, a child raised beneath the black tea tree decided to leave the workplace behind and return to a place of serene mountains and the scenic countryside, his pure spiritual and life hometown, in order to live with the black tea plants and help the garden that raised him continue to grow sustainably. When the two children put aside their work and decide to help their parents, Black Tea Workshop was born! United in heart and mind, the family entered the world of black tea one step at a time. In order to realize their dream, they started with the designs, and following much debate, decided on a Tudor architectural style – simple, natural, refined, and down-to-earth. They drew up several designs matching the scale of their ideas for lattice windows which let in sunlight and greenery while providing great views. After cutting, pasting, and comparing, they decided on an ideal rectangular 4:3 ratio, changing the deep, narrow Tudor windows into a larger, wider design. For the color coordination of the building’s exterior, they not only diligently searched the Internet to select roof tiles, colors, magnets, tiles, and wood floors, but also visited manufacturers around Taichung to compare and contrast until they found the right texture and patterns. The bed and breakfast’s rooms are named based on the theme of black tea, such as Black Tea Seed, Black Tea Ren, Workshop Aged Tea, and Taiwanese Tea No. 18. The rooms also feature different-themed decoration, with the characters or pictures created by the workshop family or photographs subjected to a special pressure proces, giving them a unique, original style. In order to help guests feel at home, black tea pillows are provided, filling the room with a faint fragrance. The pillows are made by the three generations of family members who run the business and have been personally involved in everything from producing tea to sewing pillows. In addition to the fragrance of the pillows, the room walkways feature pictures detailing the process of hard work that goes into making pillows. In keeping with the black tea theme, room lights are designed with black tea leaves, and under the contrast of the soft light, the leaves spread out, contributing to Black Tea Workshop’s unique style. Rooms are spacious and well-lit inside and out, simple and refined in layout, and faintly fragrant of black tea – features provided by the Black Tea Workshop family in order to provide honored guests with the best and most comfortable atmosphere. The main goal of the workshop is sustainable management of the old tea garden, which naturally makes the old trees the point of focus. So before the 2010 Chinese New Year, in the dead of winter which is the best time for transplanting, the old trees are moved from the garden inside the house to be taken care of. We currently grow them in the Black Tea Workshop courtyard, where they accompany us each day. The days pass just as they once did amidst the tea trees; even when we don’t go to the garden anymore, we feel their presence. When you come to Black Tea Workshop, please take a close look at them. These are the trees that raised our family, standing strong and tall, braving winds and rain for over sixty years! Black Tea Workshop also features cuisine made from old tea garden black tea and seasonal fruits and vegetables. Our specialty milk tea blends the fragrance of milk and tea, refreshing without being overly sweet, and goes well with our handmade cookies and black tea cheesecake. Black Tea Workshop is a place that will leave wonderful memories! This is Black Tea Workshop! A small, warm, beautiful, carefree place!

stays.description: 日月潭澀水社區是主人從小成長的地方，因為熱愛這片土地園林，所以在此地建構出了有如童話般的歐風木屋，木造的房子結合著綠色的大地更增添了幾分宜人的自然氣息。微微的清風、淡淡的木頭香、鄉民的熱情、地方的樸實、清爽的自然景色加上擁抱在檳榔樹間的溫馨小屋是絕妙的搭配，值得與您一起分享--日月潭住宿-綠野鄉居。
stays.descriptionEn: The host grew up in the Seshui community in Sun Moon Lake area, because he loves this land and garden, he constructed a fairytale-like huts with European style on the land. The wooden houses combined with the green earth added a bit more pleasant natural atmosphere. Slight breeze, faint woodsy smell, warm villagers, local simplicity, fresh and natural scenery coupled with the warm little house embraced amid the Areca catechu trees is a wonderful match, and is worthy to share with you -- Sun Moon Lake Accommodation - Lu Ye Xiang Ju B&B.

stays.name: 花鳥新村渡假民宿
stays.description: 走入日月潭，無不被它的潭水及山嵐景致所吸引，我帶著空杯的心，要接收這裡所有的清新、自然、美與浪漫，謄入我的旅遊札記中，時時回味、細細品嚐。驅車前往日月潭花鳥新村民宿，眼前那棟獨自佇立的高雅別墅，四週無拘無束的自然空間，民宿庭院前的兩排小矮樹，像迎賓小兵般的列隊歡迎著，草坪中隨意擺上的傘花，隨風搖擺的搖椅...在偌大的土地上，我正享受令人神輕氣爽的一切，就在離你不遠處，我在．．．花鳥新村。日月潭花鳥新村民宿客廳的挑高設計營造出貴族的氣派，直達二樓的超大視野以及那面加大的造型落地窗，讓你帶著廣角的視線，覽盡室內外所有美景，古典燈飾所營造的貴氣，柔白紗質窗簾所帶出的唯美氣質，精心所選的傢俱，與高闊空間感的完美搭配，表現出的不僅是主人的獨特構思，更輕易的將遠到的旅客，帶往更高品質的旅居品味。你的舒適和自在，是我們所追求的滿意程度，為了打造符合你的休憩空間，選擇柔和色系的寢飾，搭配著簡單俐落的內部陳設，如此恰到好處的佈置，順勢將整體舒適度提昇。
stays.descriptionEn: Entering Sun Moon Lake, I find it hard not to be attracted by the lake water and the mountain scenery; I am here with an empty mood to accept all freshness, nature, beauty and romance here, where I will record into my travel log for memory in the future. Driving towards Flora Villa-Rexort at Sun Moon Lake, the standalone elegant villa is surrounded by carefree natural space; the two rows of hedges in the courtyard resemble guest-welcoming soldiers in a parade, the parasols randomly placed on the lawn sway with the wind. I am enjoying everything that is refreshing on this vast land, which is not very far away, I am at… Flora Villa-Rexort. Flora Villa-Rexort at Sun Moon Lake has an elevated design for the lounge to create an aristocratic manner, the super large field of vision straight to the second floor and the enlarged stylish French window allows you to embrace all scenery indoor and outdoor with a broad sight; the perfect combination between the majestic ambience created by the elegant decorative lighting, the beautiful temperament introduced by the white gauze curtains, the meticulously selected furniture and spacious space not only demonstrates the owner’s unique ideas, but further easily brings the travelers coming from afar to a better quality hotel taste. Your comfort and ease is the degree of satisfaction that we pursue, in order to create a resting space that suits you, gentle colored beddings are selected to go with simple and well-executed interior displays, such appropriate decorations stimulate the enhancement of the overall degree of comfort.

stays.description: 「日月潭住宿．蔓條絲裡～浮田小屋」座落於離日月潭不遠處的頭社盆地，擁有遠離喧囂的鄉野風光、大自然中豐富的人文景觀，還有那純樸自適的農村生活，此外您更不可錯過全台僅有的特殊地質環境－泥炭土活盆地，享受涼爽舒適、清幽宜人的放鬆環境，還有著相當優質的休憩環境。簡約典雅的民宿外觀，讓「日月潭住宿．蔓條絲裡～浮田小屋」處處彌漫著淡淡的悠閒氣息，規劃出許多間套房，內陪環境強調舒適性與溫馨感，透過乾淨俐落的空間佈局，讓每一個所到之處，都呈現出舒適性十足的溫暖面貌。另外，針對出遊人數較多的玩家，「日月潭住宿．蔓條絲裡～浮田小屋」亦有開放包棟服務。歡迎邀約您的三五好友，共同前來歡渡美好的週末假期
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the Toushe Basin and not too far from Sun Moon Lake, Slow Motion B&B is tucked in the charming countryside and far away from the busy city. The rich diverse landscape includes the simple rural lifestyle and the must-not-miss Peat Live Basin, the only such unique geological terrain in Taiwan. The relaxing atmosphere and cool comfortable weather make this an enjoyable vacation spot. The simple and elegant exterior of Slow Motion B&B evoke a sense of laid-back atmosphere. All the rooms here are carefully decorated to create an inviting and comfortable ambiance. The clean and simple decoration further add to the warmth in each room. Visitors with a big group can reserve the entire house. We welcome you to bring a few of your best friends and spend a happy weekend with us.

stays.name: 讀好 聚
stays.description: **「讀好·聚」**是「讀好民宿」品牌的全新據點，以 包棟住宿 為核心，專為同學會、家庭旅行、好友小聚設計。我們相信，現代人能夠真正空出時間與朋友、家人相聚，是一件珍貴且難得的事。因此，「讀好·聚」希望成為那個承載笑聲、對話與回憶的空間——就像多一個家。空間特色 • 舒適寬敞：全棟設計貼近家的氛圍，適合 6–12 人入住。 • 樂齡友善：無障礙空間，桌椅堅固好支撐，貼心設施，銀髮長輩也能輕鬆入住。 • 溫暖氛圍：延續「讀好」品牌一貫的友善與溫度，沒有複雜的娛樂設備，而是專注於對話、陪伴與自在。位置便利位於魚池鄉近日月潭，離全聯僅步行3分鐘就可以到達，台灣好行魚池站步行三分鐘。品牌精神「讀好·聚」不是複製，而是延伸。每一個讀好據點都有獨特的故事與風格，但核心精神始終如一：友善、溫度、與人連結。在這裡，沒有趕場的壓力，只有一次久違的聚會，一段值得慢慢收藏的時光。
stays.descriptionEn: Read Nice · Gather is the latest addition to the Read Nice B&B brand, designed as a whole-house rental for class reunions, family trips, and gatherings with friends.We believe that finding time to truly connect with friends and family has become rare and precious. That’s why Read Nice · Gather was created—to be a space that carries laughter, conversations, and memories, just like a second home.Space Features • Comfortable & Spacious: A homelike design perfect for 6–12 guests. • Senior-Friendly: Accessible facilities, sturdy furniture, and thoughtful details that make it easy and safe for elder family members to enjoy their stay. • Warm Ambience: Continuing the Read Nice spirit of friendliness and warmth, with no complicated entertainment facilities—just a focus on conversation, companionship, and ease.Convenient LocationLocated in Yuchi Township, near Sun Moon Lake. Just a 3-minute walk to PX Mart supermarket and 3 minutes to the Taiwan Tourist Shuttle (Yuchi Stop).Brand SpiritRead Nice · Gather is not a copy, but an extension. Each Read Nice location has its own story and style, yet the core values remain the same: friendliness, warmth, and human connection.Here, there is no rush—only the joy of a long-awaited reunion and moments worth treasuring.

stays.name: 雲品溫泉酒店日月潭
stays.description: 雲品溫泉酒店日月潭是日月潭畔五星級溫泉渡假飯店，全館皆以大型落地窗帷幕，直接引進天然美景，提供旅客最大的視覺空間映像，全天候均可愉悅的擁抱大自然，享受豐富多變的景觀與風貌。 全館共有207間客房皆精心擘劃落地窗及觀景陽台，並設有獨立的大理石浴池可以泡湯，讓旅客在無人打擾的私密空間中，享受最純淨自然的放鬆與感動。 多樣化的餐飲服務，包括大廳酒吧、雲月坊、丹彤自助餐廳、KEN CAN by Ken Chan及彩雲軒鐵板燒餐廳，提供中、西式等餐飲服務。國際宴會廳有雲翰廳與雲揚廳，高貴典雅，可容納超過會議500位、或設宴40桌，適合舉辦公司會議、結婚喜慶、尾牙春酒、主題派對、產品發表會等。雲品溫泉酒店擁有超過千坪的休閒設施，包括戶外的名人坡、圓形廣場、花園步道，室內的湖景健身房、親水主題館的水療區、游泳池、煙嵐風呂及雲遊森林兒童遊戲區，以及VALMONT在台灣的首家飯店直營SPA服務的VALMONT SPA等，提供旅客多樣化的遊樂與休閒選擇。雲品溫泉泉質為PH值8.6，無色無味的碳酸氫鹽泉。在冷熱溫泉交替的瀰漫中，放鬆全身的緊繃感，從心靈到身體的完整洗禮，彷彿徜徉於大自然的輕撫呵護中，輕盈自在，適合全家旅行。
stays.descriptionEn: Fleur de Chine Hotel is a five-star spa resort hotel on the shores of Sun Moon Lake. The hotel offers 207 rooms in total, all with elaborately designed French windows, balconies and in-room hot spring marble bathtubs, directly introducing the beauty of nature and offering travelers a broad visual horizon where you can pleasantly embrace nature all day and enjoy rich and varied views of the landscape. A variety of food and beverage services are on offer, including the Lobby Lounge, Sky Lounge, Crimson, KEN CAN by Ken Chan and Rainbow Cloud Teppanyaki restaurants with Chinese and Western and other catering services. The International Ballroom, including the elegant Cosmos Cloud and Soaring Cloud, can accommodate conferences of more than 500 people or a banquet of 40 tables, both suitable for corporate meetings, wedding celebrations, year-end party, theme parties, product launches and so on. Fleur de Chine Hotel has leisure facilities of more than one thousand square meters, including an outdoor Noble Hill, Circular Concourse, garden trails, indoor lake view gym, hydrophilic pavilion spa area, swimming pool, Mountain Mist Spring, children's playground, as well as the VALMONT SPA service in the hotel offering travelers a variety of recreational and leisure options. Fleur de Chine Hotel's spring is an alkaline HCO₃, ph 8.6, and is colorless and odorless hydrogen carbonate spring. The alternating of hot and cold spring relaxes you both mentally and physically. Suitable for a family outing.

stays.description: 日月潭民宿-【靜心園鄉居】位於南投縣魚池鄉日月潭周邊的澀水社區，在台21線--中潭公路過了『大雁隧道』之後，隨即右轉進入即達，不但交通便利，且鄰近日月潭國家風景區、九族文化村、三育基督教學院、蓮華池、水里車埕、埔里……等風景點，是您利用週休或連續假期，規劃到南投旅遊渡假的理想住宿點！澀水社區貌似蓮花座山谷地形中，環境幽美、景色宜人，擁有豐富的特產及生態資源，社區居民努力之下，成功經營成一座非常具有特色的生態村，96年更當選「十大經典農村」。村裡有兩大特色特產，一是「澀水陶」得天獨厚的白仙優質黏土，讓澀水出產的陶器由於不需上釉，直接利用木柴燃燼後所產生的氧化灰燼，將陶器燒成千變萬化的外表，因此每個成品都是獨一無二，非常有特色。另一種特產是台灣頂級紅茶「澀水皇茶」，所以將之命名為皇茶，一方面是因為他原本是日本天皇御用的茶品，另一方面也有奉茶的意思。這裡生產的紅茶都是有機種植，一心兩葉的手摘茶葉，不使用化學肥料和噴灑農藥，因為品質優良才能在阿薩姆文化復興佔有一席之地。更誠摯的邀請你們，到這裡品嚐看看特別的「日本天皇御用茶」。
stays.descriptionEn: Sun Moon Lake’s Jing Xin Yuan Rural Bed and Breakfast is located in Seshui Community near Sun Moon Lake (Yuchih (Yuchi) Township, Nantou County). On Provincial Highway 21, on Zhongtan Road after passing Dayan Tunnel, take a right and enter. Conveniently located, with nearby tourist sites including Sun Moon Lake, Formosa Aboriginal Culture Village, Taiwan Adventist College, Lienhuachih, Shueili (Shuili) Checheng, and Puli, this is the ideal place to stay on weekends or vacations when planning your trip to Nantou. Seshui Community resembles a lotus blossom in a valley, featuring a beautiful environment, great scenery, and rich produce and ecological resources. Community resides worked together to build a very special ecological village which was selected as one of the Top 10 Classic Villages in 2007. It produces two specialty products, the first of which is Seshui Pottery, made from top-quality Baixian clay, which does not require the use of glaze. The oxidized ashes given off by the wood-fired baking process gives the finished pottery a varied appearance, making each piece a special, unique product. The other speicalty product is Seshui Royal Tea, which derives its name from being one of Taiwan’s top quality black teas. It was once the tea of choice for Japanese emperors; the name also refers to serving tea. All tea leaves are organic, handpicked with one bud and two leaves, and free of fertilizers or pesticides. Excellent quality guaranteed their place in the Assam cultural revival. We welcome you to try out this special “Japanese imperial tea.”

stays.name: 馥麗溫泉大飯店
stays.description: 馥麗溫泉大飯店，以「馥．麗」兩字為名。引自《易經˙離卦》全館客房包括總裁套房、皇家套房、阿薩姆和洋套房、豪華家庭房、豪華日月房、經典湯語房，每間客房皆附碳酸氫鈉溫泉湯池及獨立陽台，擁抱盎然的山林綠意、與昭和時期古樸的檜木官舍闢鄰而居。寬敞的空間，邀您享受皇室貴族般禮遇，將優雅與完美融於渡假之中。中餐廳璽悅廳提供日月潭地區少見寬敞優雅的多功能宴會場地，配備8間9-15坪獨立箱房，可滿足賓客隔間或全區開放的需求。御品百匯廳主廚精選南投在地盛產食材，隨四時節氣提供健康且創意的跨國界百匯美食。雲瞻國際會議廳:可容納300人會議的絕佳場地，簡雅明亮的設計風格，居高臨下的地理優勢，讓您在湖光山色環繞中享有優雅恬靜的會議環境。嵐亭輕食館提供輕食與各式酒精性及非酒精性飲料，品銘酒佳釀，三五知已杯幌交錯，或獨自抿嘴品味，都能釋放你心裡的靈魂渴望。四季開放的露天兒童親水區、溫泉按摩池、戲水池，舉目盡是猫囒山的沁人綠意，及瀰漫清新草香的戲水空間，邀您與陽光和芬多精熱情相擁。室內休閒中心提供的精彩童玩小舖 DIY 、X-BOX、撞球桌、乒乓球桌、手足檯、棋藝室、KTV、悅書室、頂級的芳療SPA與珍稀北投岩盤浴等服務設施，都將讓您的假期更為悠閒歡樂。
stays.descriptionEn: The brand image of the Fuli Hot Spring Resort is based on the two Chinese characters that make up its name, “Fu” and “Li”. With room type : CEO Suit, Royal Suite, Assam Suite with Japanese Living Room, Family Suite, Superior Double Twin, Superior Room, all the room carries a minimalist design that accentuates the natural scenery outside its balcony. For a resident with taste and an inclination toward lifestyles of health and sustainability, this room of humanistic culture is for you. Moreover, as you indulge yourself in a nourishing beauty soak, you also receive a beauty treatment that frees your body, mind and soul.Open to Fuli guests year round, our outdoor water facilities include a water amusement area for children, a wading pool, and a hot spring Jacuzzi. Surrounded by the verdancy of Moalan Mountain and fragrance of the green, this is a great spot to enjoy a sun bath and soak up refreshing phytoncides. Our indoor facilities include handcraft activities, chldren’s play room, x-box play room, snooker pool tables, table tennis, table soccer, chess room, KTV, gym, reading room, aroma therapy spa, stone spa, that all make your vacation more exiting.Cheers Banquet Hall: This spacious multi-functional banquet hall is a rarity around Sun Moon Lake area. There are eight private rooms inside the hall with footage between 30 to 50 square meters, and the hall can be partially compartmented or fully open. Imperial Kitchen: Using chef-selected Nantou specials that have come into season, we serve an array of delicacies and creative cross-national cuisines that accord with the 24 solar terms for maximum health benefits. Supreme Room: Simply elegant and well-lit, this conference room can accommodate up to 300 participants. Its height allows a vista of Sun Moon Lake and the surrounding sceneries make this conference hall a luxury. Lunchtea delicatessen: There is provided light meal and all kind of spirituous beverages and soft drinks. stays.description: 『人生只有一次，不要停止你的精采人生』【魚樂魚池】是一對愛戶外運動夫妻經營的運動背包客棧。 帶運動社團的朋友們玩遍台灣後，回到自己的故鄉位於南投魚池鄉開了一間屬於自己的背包客棧，發掘日月潭的運動旅遊體驗。住宿介紹：【男女多人共住房】上下舖床型 12床600元／床【女生房】上下舖床型 12床600元／床男女分層住宿日月潭如此醉人的湖光山色，就像是老天爺送的寶石般鑲嵌於台灣的正中心，它除了是台灣最大的高山湖泊令其成為國際知名的旅遊景點外，擁有豐富的自然資源以及人文地景。​除了觀光客熟知的渡輪及纜車外，日月潭有各式各樣有趣的玩法，舉凡手作DIY、極限運動、自然環境導覽......等等，就讓我們一起用運動來體驗不一樣的日月潭吧~!!

stays.name: 來來休閒民宿
stays.description: 小半天來來休閒民宿位於南投縣鹿谷鄉『小半天』地區，民宿園區佔地約二千坪，設有多功能休閒(活動)中心，花卉種苗區、烏龍茶苗區、休閒品茗區、烤肉區、DIY烹飪區、沙坑遊戲區及觀星活動草坪、是一處僻靜、優閒的休憩新天地。園區鄰近溪頭、妖怪村、鳳凰谷鳥園及杉林溪，離天梯、紫南宮、集集小鎮、水里車埕及日月潭等風景區也只需約40-50分鐘的車程，是您週休度假，來溪頭杉林溪享受森林浴與芬多精的最佳住宿選擇！客房分為:甜蜜精緻雙人房、溫馨家庭4人房、尊爵豪華雙人房及歡樂團體6人房，設施新穎舒適、陳設乾淨素雅，不論您是情侶、親子、家族旅遊，一定可以讓您歡樂滿行囊！
stays.descriptionEn: Xiaobantian Lailai Xiuxian Homestay is located in the Xiaobantian area of Lugu Township in Nantou County. The B&B and its gardens occupy an area of about 6600 square meters, offering a secluded and relaxing sanctuary that is furnished with multi-functional recreational (activity) centers, floricultural nurseries, oolong tea nurseries, relaxing tea appreciation areas, BBQ areas, DIY cooking areas, sandbox and playgrounds, and stargazing lawns. The Park is close to Xitou, Monster Village, National Fenghuanggu Bird Park, and Sunlin River. Other destinations such as Sky Ladder, Zinangong (Zinan Temple), Downtown Jiji, and Sun Moon Lake are only a 40 to 50-minute drive away. This is the perfect destination for a weekend getaway for those who dream of basking in forests and wholesome phytoncides of Xitou Sunlin River. Guest rooms are divided into: Cozy Room (for 2), Warm Family Room (for 4), Luxurious Room (for 2), and Joyful Group Cabin (for 6). Furnishings are brand-new and designed for comfort and provide a clean and elegant atmosphere. Couples, parents and children, and entire families will experience great fun with us!

stays.name: 吉野渡假山莊
stays.description: 吉野主人是一對喜歡大自然的夫妻。女主人自鹿谷遠嫁台北，每逢假日必全家返鄉，享受恬靜、溫馨的田野生活。男主人也被宜人氣候、寧靜自然環境吸引，樂於攜家帶眷回娘家！幾年前夫妻倆有個共同的夢想『在鄉下蓋一間屬於自己房子』，栽植花木、灑掃庭園，退休後可隱居山林，享受當閒雲野鶴的樂趣。於是在親友鼓勵及支持下，委由郁專空間建築設計師巧妙規劃及聚益營造公司負責監造，今美夢成真、如願以償，【吉野】便在分享的心情裡，誕生！溪頭的後花園—和雅村-吉野渡假山莊，是我從小生長的地方，我熱愛這裡的一切。如今我和先生實現我們的夢想，吉野現在是我們養生的地方，將來是我倆養老的所在。我們把夢想與美的感覺，與所有喜歡大自然的朋友分享！歡迎有緣的朋友們來吉野享受山間生活！一起養生！【吉野】得天獨厚的美麗風景，寧靜自然的環境，寬廣視野的景觀，嶄新舒適的住宿設備，更有包括溪頭、杉林溪、大崙銀杏森林步道等等多處景點，提供給您一日或是二日遊的好去處，當您遊遍好山好水後，在【吉野】沏一壺花茶，輕啜一杯香純咖啡，徹底享受一下自然與悠閒。【吉野】願與所有喜愛大自然的朋友們，一同分享美好感覺。

stays.searchText: 吉野渡假山莊 吉野渡假山莊 南投縣民宿285號 南投縣 鹿谷鄉 和雅村林尾巷13-5號 吉野主人是一對喜歡大自然的夫妻。女主人自鹿谷遠嫁台北，每逢假日必全家返鄉，享受恬靜、溫馨的田野生活。男主人也被宜人氣候、寧靜自然環境吸引，樂於攜家帶眷回娘家！幾年前夫妻倆有個共同的夢想『在鄉下蓋一間屬於自己房子』，栽植花木、灑掃庭園，退休後可隱居山林，享受當閒雲野鶴的樂趣。於是在親友鼓勵及支持下，委由郁專空間建築設計師巧妙規劃及聚益營造公司負責監造，今美夢成真、如願以償，【吉野】便在分享的心情裡，誕生！溪頭的後花園—和雅村-吉野渡假山莊，是我從小生長的地方，我熱愛這裡的一切。如今我和先生實現我們的夢想，吉野現在是我們養生的地方，將來是我倆養老的所在。我們把夢想與美的感覺，與所有喜歡大自然的朋友分享！歡迎有緣的朋友們來吉野享受山間生活！一起養生！【吉野】得天獨厚的美麗風景，寧靜自然的環境，寬廣視野的景觀，嶄新舒適的住宿設備，更有包括溪頭、杉林溪、大崙銀杏森林步道等等多處景點，提供給您一日或是二日遊的好去處，當您遊遍好山好水後，在【吉野】沏一壺花茶，輕啜一杯香純咖啡，徹底享受一下自然與悠閒。【吉野】願與所有喜愛大自然的朋友們，一同分享美好感覺。

stays.description: 歡迎來到『和愉的家』您好，我是小闆娘！『和愉的家』是合法旅宿，南投民宿編號：NO.531，並榮獲好客民宿認證（NO.532）及南投好食民宿認證。我們有五間溫馨的客房，其中四間為雙人房（其中一間為兩床雙人房），還有一間四人房。由於我們全家與您同住於此，並不提供「包整棟」服務。不過，您可以預訂我們的所有房間，與親友共度愉快假期。雖然不提供外借廚房烹飪服務，但所有公共空間皆可自由使用。我們是一家普通的家庭民宿，家中還有兩位小孩，因此特別歡迎有小朋友的家庭來入住。如果您需要幫助，我們會竭誠為您提供協助，但由於規模與大飯店不同，我們並不提供如飯店般的各式設施與24小時客房服務。若您有任何需求，隨時都可以聯絡我們，我們會盡力提供幫助。在此，也請您愛護與尊重我們的家，讓每一位旅客都能感受到溫馨和舒適。謝謝您！關於『和愉的家』民宿我們的民宿位於南投鹿谷小半天，周圍環繞著翠綠的茶苗園，環境純樸寧靜。夜晚沒有喧囂，只有蟲鳴鳥叫，和清新的空氣陪伴您入睡。這裡沒有豪華的裝潢，也沒有各式各樣的娛樂設施，卻有繁星點點和滿滿的自然美景，是您放鬆心情、遠離塵囂的理想場所。我們堅持為每位旅客提供：一口清新的空氣一份安心的餐點一個寧靜的夜晚一床陽光味的棉被一宿好眠這些，正是我們的價值與堅持。

You will definetely enjoy the wonderful night with the peaceful environment .Also,the delicious breakfast cooked by the male host, so that you have a happy and relaxing holiday.Hoyu B&B is your best choice ever!

stays.name: 孟宗山莊大飯店
stays.description: 中二高(三號國道) 243公里處，下竹山交流道，右轉往鹿谷溪頭方向(151縣道)，經"初鄉橋"。漸上山路，過鹿谷鄉–茶鄉，沿路有上百家茶莊，可進莊品茶，聽茶事。(13公里處)內湖國小，校舍木造，極稀有，值得參觀。到此地，很容易感受到自然的涼意，是廣大森林的造化。前進至(18公里處)，經"孟宗竹林公路"，溪頭到了，溪頭的美在霧靄煙嵐，涼爽宜人。溪頭園區大門門口處 "孟宗大道"，路邊一系"詩文走廊"。"巨竹"高6層樓是世界上最高大的印度麻竹。接到"銀杏林茶花園"，內面"孟宗山莊"。溪頭亦為孟宗竹的專區，取"孟宗"為山莊之名，孟宗為二十四孝子之一，為取歷史典故，每層設計24間客房，三層合計72間，與"24孝 72賢"的故事相輝映。孟宗山莊以"雅緻 親切 用心"的經營理念，創塑最友善環境，正是"此地有翠嶺青溪鳳山鹿谷，遊人似七賢六逸九老八仙"也。孟宗山莊努力保持三星優質榮譽。溪頭海拔高1000至1650公尺，朝暉夕陰、氣象萬千，從神木林道下望鳳凰山麓“修篁鬱鬱白雲封 一角山樓號孟宗”。孟宗空中屋頂看透溪頭全景，客房特以獨製孟宗竹材裝潢，備長炭淨化空氣，竹炭用品等，得到滿意高評。40年來孟宗已服務超越百萬旅客，文人雅房，特以在地詩聖 張達修先生之溪頭好詩，特聘在地書法達人 陳連忠先生使用古檜木落墨共築詩書文創傑作分享來住嘉賓。經921地震重建，每樓設18間，四層客房計72間。保留在地餐飲風味，支持健康養生觀念，勤奮維持星級品質，推新服務。銀杏咖啡、沏茶趣，聆聽溪頭故事。"竹香烤飯"、"筍干快餐"推陳出新。溪頭四季皆適合渡假 健身 養心 暫留 享受輕鬆。孟宗同仁加強深度解說之服務，帶您伴您漫遊溪頭森林之唐奧，讓你優雅體驗溪頭的美，孟宗的好。
stays.descriptionEn: At 243 km of Taichung Highway No. 2 (National Freeway No. 3), exit at Jhushan (Zhushan) interchange and turn right towards the direction of Xitou, Lugu (Nantou Highway 151), pass "Chuxiang Bridge," along the mountain road, pass Lugu Towansjip--the home of tea. Along the way you will find there are over one hundred tea houses, and you may pick a tea house to enjoy tea or chat with people there about tea. (At 13 km) there lies a Neihu Elementary School, it has wooden school buildings, which are very rare and worth a visit. Arriving here, it is easy to feel the natural coolness, which is the result of the vast forests. Proceed to (18 km), pass "Moso Bamboo Highway," then you have arrived Xitou. The beauty of Xitou is in the mist, which is cool and pleasant. At the entrance of Xitou Nature Education Park, there is an "Moso Avenue", beside the avenue a "poetry corridor." A "Gigantic Bamboo" of 6 floors high is the world's tallest Dendrocalamus giganteus Munro. Next, go to "Ginkgo Tea Garden,", in the garden you find "Ginkgo Hotel." Xitou is also a special zone for Moso bamboos, Ginkgo Hotel in Chinese is named "Meng Zong", the name after one of 24 filial sons in Chinese history. The Hotel used to be a three-story building, each story is designed for having 24 rooms; therefore a total of 72 rooms. The number of 72 rooms sounds matching the stories of"24 sons of Filial Piety and 72 Virtuous," to shine on the historic events. The business philosophy of Ginkgo Hotel focuses on implementing of "elegant, cordial, and attentive" qualities for creating the most friendly ambience. Ginkgo Hotel is endeavored to keeping 3-star rating quality honor. Xitou is about 1000-1650 meters in elevation and enjoys spectacular views of multitudinous morning sunshine and multifarious evening overcasts. From the sky roof of Ginkgo Hotel, you can overlook Xitou's panoramic view. Guest rooms are decorated with specially produced Moso bamboos providing charcoal air purification, and other charcoal supplies, which obtain a high satisfaction rating. For 40 years, Ginkgo Hotel has served over one million visitors, scholars Yafang specially selected Mr. Zhang Daxiu's poems of Xitou, hired calligraphers Mr. Chen Lianzhong to write the poems on ancient cypress boards for exhibitions, sharing the masterpieces of cultural and creative productions with staying tourists. After the 921 earthquake reconstruction, each floor is designed to have 18 rooms, and the building has 4 stories; therefore, it has a total of 72 rooms. We prepare foods with local flavors and support the concepts of maintaining good health, diligently keeping our star-rated quality, and launching new services. Ginkgo coffee, fun of making tea, listening Xitou story. "Bamboo grilled rice" and "rice with dried bamboo shoots fast food" are innovative. Xitou is a suitable place for enjoying your vacation, fitness activities, nourishing the mind and body, temporary stay, and relaxing life. stays.searchText: 孟宗山莊大飯店 孟宗山莊股份有限公司 南投縣旅館003號 南投縣 鹿谷鄉 內湖村興產路3號 中二高(三號國道) 243公里處，下竹山交流道，右轉往鹿谷溪頭方向(151縣道)，經"初鄉橋"。漸上山路，過鹿谷鄉–茶鄉，沿路有上百家茶莊，可進莊品茶，聽茶事。(13公里處)內湖國小，校舍木造，極稀有，值得參觀。到此地，很容易感受到自然的涼意，是廣大森林的造化。前進至(18公里處)，經"孟宗竹林公路"，溪頭到了，溪頭的美在霧靄煙嵐，涼爽宜人。溪頭園區大門門口處 "孟宗大道"，路邊一系"詩文走廊"。"巨竹"高6層樓是世界上最高大的印度麻竹。接到"銀杏林茶花園"，內面"孟宗山莊"。溪頭亦為孟宗竹的專區，取"孟宗"為山莊之名，孟宗為二十四孝子之一，為取歷史典故，每層設計24間客房，三層合計72間，與"24孝 72賢"的故事相輝映。孟宗山莊以"雅緻 親切 用心"的經營理念，創塑最友善環境，正是"此地有翠嶺青溪鳳山鹿谷，遊人似七賢六逸九老八仙"也。孟宗山莊努力保持三星優質榮譽。溪頭海拔高1000至1650公尺，朝暉夕陰、氣象萬千，從神木林道下望鳳凰山麓“修篁鬱鬱白雲封 一角山樓號孟宗”。孟宗空中屋頂看透溪頭全景，客房特以獨製孟宗竹材裝潢，備長炭淨化空氣，竹炭用品等，得到滿意高評。40年來孟宗已服務超越百萬旅客，文人雅房，特以在地詩聖 張達修先生之溪頭好詩，特聘在地書法達人 陳連忠先生使用古檜木落墨共築詩書文創傑作分享來住嘉賓。經921地震重建，每樓設18間，四層客房計72間。保留在地餐飲風味，支持健康養生觀念，勤奮維持星級品質，推新服務。銀杏咖啡、沏茶趣，聆聽溪頭故事。"竹香烤飯"、"筍干快餐"推陳出新。溪頭四季皆適合渡假 健身 養心 暫留 享受輕鬆。孟宗同仁加強深度解說之服務，帶您伴您漫遊溪頭森林之唐奧，讓你優雅體驗溪頭的美，孟宗的好。

stays.name: 掬月居
stays.description: 「溪頭‧麒麟潭－掬月居民宿」座落於南投鹿谷鄉溪頭風景區，鄰近麒麟潭的地理位置讓旅人能夠輕鬆自在的前往麒麟潭散步，欣賞天使落下凡間的那滴眼淚，剔透晶瑩的水面被微風吹拂過而激起陣陣漣漪，盪漾的潭面令人捨不得移開目光。「溪頭‧麒麟潭－掬月居民宿」為獨棟型別墅，庭園整片綠油油的草皮與植栽令人心情舒暢，大廳內沉穩的原木桌椅有著尊貴的氣息，在這裡休息品茗更是別有一番風味。「溪頭‧麒麟潭－掬月居民宿」提供二到四人套房，房間內清新雅致，採光明亮讓空間充滿陽光的蹤影，「溪頭‧麒麟潭－掬月居民宿」內每間房型的床鋪皆採用斯林百蘭進口名床，讓旅人能夠舒適地進入甜蜜的夢鄉。浴室空間以乾濕分離的方式，使空間乾爽潔淨，更貼心地設置免治沖洗馬桶，讓人毫無負擔的放鬆身心。「溪頭住宿‧掬月居民宿」也提供包棟服務，不論是好友、情侶、家庭旅遊或是員工旅行，都能在此找到最適合的房型，渡過完美假期。倘若您要訂房，請直接電洽【0972-226310、049-2750738】加Line訂房更方便ID-0972226310。

stays.name: 新來來民宿
stays.description: 小半天來來休閒民宿位於南投縣鹿谷鄉『小半天』地區，民宿園區佔地約二千坪，設有多功能休閒(活動)中心，花卉種苗區、烏龍茶苗區、休閒品茗區、烤肉區、DIY烹飪區、沙坑遊戲區及觀星活動草坪、是一處僻靜、優閒的休憩新天地。園區鄰近溪頭、妖怪村、鳳凰谷鳥園及杉林溪，離天梯、紫南宮、集集小鎮、水里車埕及日月潭等風景區也只需約40-50分鐘的車程，是您週休度假，來溪頭杉林溪享受森林浴與芬多精的最佳住宿選擇！客房分為:甜蜜精緻雙人房、溫馨家庭4人房、尊爵豪華雙人房及歡樂團體6人房，設施新穎舒適、陳設乾淨素雅，不論您是情侶、親子、家族旅遊，一定可以讓您歡樂滿行囊！英文
stays.descriptionEn: Xiaobantian Lailai Xiuxian Homestay is located in the Xiaobantian area of Lugu Township in Nantou County. The Residence and its gardens occupy an area of about 6500 square meters, offering a secluded and relaxing sanctuary that is furnished with multi-functional recreational (activity) centers, floricultural nurseries, oolong tea nurseries, leisurely tea appreciation area, BBQ area, DIY cooking areas, sandbox and play areas, and stargazing lawns. The Park is close to Xitou, Monster Village, National Fenghuanggu Bird Park, and Sunlin River. Other destinations such as Sky Ladder, Zinangong (Zinan Temple), Downtown Jiji, and Sun Moon Lake are only a 40 to 50-minute drive away. This is the perfect destination for a weekend getaway for those who dream of basking in forests and phytoncides of Xitou Sunlin River. Guest rooms are divided into: Cozy Room (for 2), Warm Family Room (for 4), Luxurious Room (for 2), and Joyful Group Cabin (for 6). Furnishings are brand new and designed for comfort and provide a clean and elegant atmosphere. Couples, parents and children, and entire families will experience great fun with us! English

stays.name: 明山森林會舘
stays.description: 關於明山森林會舘-The M Village明山森林會舘位於南投的溪頭自然教育園區旁。（原名：明山大飯店、明山別舘）四周環繞台大實驗林的高聳杉林及特色動植物。提供旅遊住宿、觀光體驗、商圈市集等服務。大樓區客房依館別分為一館、二館、三館及百老匯館。提供舒適的住宿空間，及房客活動。並有限量的密室逃脫房及秘寶房，可以體驗擔任小偵探、破解線索解答謎團。除了大樓區外，更擁有二十棟不同風格的森林木屋。一棟棟的獨立木屋被杉木森林所圍繞，充滿滿滿的芬多精，與森林相融、與大地為伍，美不勝收。關於松林町商圈松林町商圈為附屬於明山森林會舘的商店街。有二十多間不同的商家進駐，於廣場還有駐村藝人表演。於2009年建立，以日式建築為主題，並命名為 「松林町」。用以紀念創辦人松林勝一（松林勝一為日據時代名字，本名林贍）因為部落客網紅的介紹在網路上廣為流傳，松林町成為溪頭熱門景點。町內街道與造景陳設了大紅鳥居、日式建築、大紅燈籠，讓來到溪頭夜宿的旅人，能在大紅燈籠下體驗特殊的神秘氛圍。商店街中【老松林餅舖】主廚創作了許多特色伴手禮，如溪頭餅、銀杏酥。著名的【久保田烘焙坊】則是紀念松林勝一與日籍友人久保田珍貴的異國友誼。其中招牌商品「咬人貓麵包」屢屢造成排隊熱銷的風潮。松林町正式在溪頭掛牌後，更定期舉辦一連串的假日及節慶活動。在俗稱鬼月的七月，舉辦了魔神慶典、魔神祭，萬聖節期間舉辦萬聖嘉年華、邀請大家一同搞怪、撒糖，在新春期間為了歡慶豐收及表達對大自然的崇敬，舉辦了山神祭，祈求賜予來到這片土地的人們～平安、幸福！各種豐富的活動與體驗、成功的吸引社會大眾到松林町來遊玩。夢想、建設一直持續進行著，歡迎您來到這裡，邀您一起與我們共度。
stays.descriptionEn: About Mingshan Forest Resort - The M VillageMingshan Forest Resort is located next to the Xitou Nature Education Area in Nantou.(Original name: Mingshan Hotel, Mingshan Villa)It is surrounded by the towering fir forest and unique flora and fauna of the National Taiwan University Experimental Forest.Provide tourist accommodation, sightseeing experience, business district market and other services.The guest rooms in the building area are divided into Building 1, Building 2, Building 3 and Broadway Building.Provide comfortable accommodation space and guest activities.There are also a limited number of escape rooms and secret treasure rooms where you can experience being a little detective and crack clues to solve mysteries.In addition to the building area, there are also twenty forest cabins of different styles.The independent wooden houses are surrounded by fir forests, full of phytoncides.Blending with the forest and being one with the earth, it is so beautiful.About the Matsubayashi shopping districtThe Songlin-cho shopping district is a shopping street affiliated with the Mingshan Forest Hall.There are more than 20 different businesses settled in the square, and there are also resident artists performing in the square.It was established in 2009 with the theme of Japanese architecture and was named "Matsubayashi Town".To commemorate the founder, Songlin Shengyi (Songlin Shengyi was a name during the Japanese occupation period, his real name was Lin Shan)Thanks to the widespread introduction of bloggers and influencers on the Internet, Songlin Town has become a popular tourist attraction in Xitou.The streets and landscapes of the town are decorated with big red torii gates, Japanese-style buildings, and big red lanterns.Travelers who come to Xitou to stay overnight can experience the special mysterious atmosphere under the big red lanterns.The chef of [Laosonglin Cake Shop] in the shopping street has created many special souvenirs, such as Xitou Cake and Ginkgo Cake.The famous Kubota Bakery commemorates the precious foreign friendship between Katsuichi Matsubayashi and his Japanese friend Kubota.Among them, the signature product "Bite the Cat Bread" has repeatedly caused queues and is a hot seller.After Songlin Town was officially established in Xitou, it has been holding a series of holiday and festival activities on a regular basis.In July, commonly known as the Ghost Month, the Demon Festival and Demon Festival are held.During Halloween, we will hold a Halloween Carnival and invite everyone to join us in making fun of others and spreading candy.During the Chinese New Year, a mountain god festival was held to celebrate the harvest and express respect for nature.Pray for peace and happiness to those who come to this land!A variety of rich activities and experiences have successfully attracted the general public to visit Matsubayashi.Dreams and construction are ongoing. We welcome you to come here and spend time with us.

stays.searchText: 明山森林會舘 明山別舘股份有限公司 南投縣旅館029號 南投縣 鹿谷鄉 內湖村興產路2-3號 關於明山森林會舘-The M Village明山森林會舘位於南投的溪頭自然教育園區旁。（原名：明山大飯店、明山別舘）四周環繞台大實驗林的高聳杉林及特色動植物。提供旅遊住宿、觀光體驗、商圈市集等服務。大樓區客房依館別分為一館、二館、三館及百老匯館。提供舒適的住宿空間，及房客活動。並有限量的密室逃脫房及秘寶房，可以體驗擔任小偵探、破解線索解答謎團。除了大樓區外，更擁有二十棟不同風格的森林木屋。一棟棟的獨立木屋被杉木森林所圍繞，充滿滿滿的芬多精，與森林相融、與大地為伍，美不勝收。關於松林町商圈松林町商圈為附屬於明山森林會舘的商店街。有二十多間不同的商家進駐，於廣場還有駐村藝人表演。於2009年建立，以日式建築為主題，並命名為 「松林町」。用以紀念創辦人松林勝一（松林勝一為日據時代名字，本名林贍）因為部落客網紅的介紹在網路上廣為流傳，松林町成為溪頭熱門景點。町內街道與造景陳設了大紅鳥居、日式建築、大紅燈籠，讓來到溪頭夜宿的旅人，能在大紅燈籠下體驗特殊的神秘氛圍。商店街中【老松林餅舖】主廚創作了許多特色伴手禮，如溪頭餅、銀杏酥。著名的【久保田烘焙坊】則是紀念松林勝一與日籍友人久保田珍貴的異國友誼。其中招牌商品「咬人貓麵包」屢屢造成排隊熱銷的風潮。松林町正式在溪頭掛牌後，更定期舉辦一連串的假日及節慶活動。在俗稱鬼月的七月，舉辦了魔神慶典、魔神祭，萬聖節期間舉辦萬聖嘉年華、邀請大家一同搞怪、撒糖，在新春期間為了歡慶豐收及表達對大自然的崇敬，舉辦了山神祭，祈求賜予來到這片土地的人們～平安、幸福！各種豐富的活動與體驗、成功的吸引社會大眾到松林町來遊玩。夢想、建設一直持續進行著，歡迎您來到這裡，邀您一起與我們共度。

stays.name: 星月谷民宿
stays.description: 在這裡 您可以遠眺山巒流雲 沉醉山城夜景在這裡 您可以小旅慢行 細細品味凍頂茶香本民宿為歐式木屋Villa，座落在鹿谷鄉凍頂山半山腰，可俯瞰絕美夕陽、雲海、琉璃光夜景等，全棟以加拿大香杉原木裝璜，並搭配鄉村田園風格的傢俱燈飾，使各式客房呈現樸素溫暖的典雅質感，加上每間客房備有獨立衛浴間佐以嚴選備品，與秉持貼心親切的服務初衷，我們希望這裡不僅是個讓旅人放鬆度假好去處，也是一個能承載美好記憶的起點。
stays.descriptionEn: Accompanied by the golden sunset and charming night scenes, the hostel “StarMoonValley” is well- known for its impressive wide-open view of Tung-ting Mountain, especially the view goes with bright shining among the valley whenever lamps are lighting at night. What’s more, you can watch the fantastic magic show of cloud-sea just in front of the hostel, especially in the summer raining days, the constantly changing cloud sea covers up the hill where bamboos and green teas living in, making the landscapes even more attractive to people.When you’re away from the city and stop by “StarMonnValley” hostel at night , you can enjoy this very moment with peaceful tranquility that the noises of city becomes a far-off murmur while the only sound echoes in the hill is the whisper of gentle wind responding to the fascinating Moonrise. Whenever you walk down to the hillside, you can easily catch up with the charming night-scene and overlooking the entire panorama view of Lugu Township. “Memory is the treasure of mind”, that’s what the host of hostel believing in and looking forward to sharing good things in life with whoever comes here. In this case, to offer great life experience in tasting every subtle of happiness that we made for every privileged you here in “StarMoonValley”, is always, and will be our primary pursuit and persistence for good in the future.Come to us and take a closer look, you’ll find another way home here!

stays.description: 【小半天林家莊民宿】位於溪頭風景線(溪頭民宿)的小半天支線上(小半天民宿)，距離溪頭森林遊樂區(妖怪村民宿)約 15 分鐘的車程，到杉林溪也只需 50 分鐘(杉林溪民宿)。 在忙碌的都市生活中，您是否覺得疲憊不堪，趁著週休二日的時間可以消除你一個禮拜的疲勞，忘掉城市生活中煩躁的生活。【小半天林家莊民宿】的渡假生活，可以讓你彷彿置身世外的感覺，讓您留連忘返。在夏日生態活絡時，更是體驗昆蟲世界的好時機唷，自然體驗不用遠求，【小半天林家莊民宿】享受一趟自然體驗不用遠求，【小半天林家莊民宿】享受一趟自然饗宴！常年豐富的生態環境就在門前，設有景觀休憩區和寬敞的草皮休憩庭園，眼睛所及都是美麗山色及四時應景的植物，讓您目不暇及；還能讓您的小朋友有歡樂難忘的假期。而當夜晚降臨，星光點點、涼爽晚風與主人泡茶話家常，將更是您記憶深刻的印象。『回家』是洋溢著歡樂與溫馨的回憶，位於南投縣的【小半天林家莊民宿】，要讓每一位有緣千里來相聚的大小朋友，感覺就像回到家感覺。
stays.descriptionEn: “Xiao Bang Tien Lin House HomeStay” is located at theXiao Bang Tien Branch (Xiao Bang Tien Homestay) of Xitou Scenic Line (Xitou Homestay). It is only 15 minutes of driving distance to Xitou Forestry Park (The Monster Village Homestay) and 50 minutes to Shan Lin Xi Forestry Park. Feeling drained by the busy city life? Make use of the weekend to come here and hsake off the fatigue accumulated over the week. Take a vacation at “Xiao Bang Tien Lin House HomeStay”. It offers a Shangri-la like life and will make you want to stay. It is a good timing to experience the insect world when the eco-system is thriving during the summer time and it is far to experience natural life. Come to “Xiao Bang Tien Lin House HomeStay” to experience a natural life just around you. The “Xiao Bang Tien Lin House HomeStay” offers you a natural experience. The constantly splendid eco-system is just right at the front door. It is equipped with landscape leisure area and broad meadow leisure courtyard. Stunning mountain views and all-season plants are right under your eyes, and provide your children a joyous and unforgettable vacation. When nights falls, twinkling stars begin the curtain show one after another. Have a cup of tea and pleasant chat with the owner under the cooling night breeze, it imprints deeper in your memory. “Returning home” is the memory full of joy and warmth. Located in Nantou County, the “Xiao Bang Tien Lin House HomeStay” is devoted to making all visitors, old and young, just feel right at home during their stay.

stays.searchText: 林家莊民宿 林家莊民宿 南投縣民宿129號 南投縣 鹿谷鄉 竹林村田頭巷8-5號 【小半天林家莊民宿】位於溪頭風景線(溪頭民宿)的小半天支線上(小半天民宿)，距離溪頭森林遊樂區(妖怪村民宿)約 15 分鐘的車程，到杉林溪也只需 50 分鐘(杉林溪民宿)。 在忙碌的都市生活中，您是否覺得疲憊不堪，趁著週休二日的時間可以消除你一個禮拜的疲勞，忘掉城市生活中煩躁的生活。【小半天林家莊民宿】的渡假生活，可以讓你彷彿置身世外的感覺，讓您留連忘返。在夏日生態活絡時，更是體驗昆蟲世界的好時機唷，自然體驗不用遠求，【小半天林家莊民宿】享受一趟自然體驗不用遠求，【小半天林家莊民宿】享受一趟自然饗宴！常年豐富的生態環境就在門前，設有景觀休憩區和寬敞的草皮休憩庭園，眼睛所及都是美麗山色及四時應景的植物，讓您目不暇及；還能讓您的小朋友有歡樂難忘的假期。而當夜晚降臨，星光點點、涼爽晚風與主人泡茶話家常，將更是您記憶深刻的印象。『回家』是洋溢著歡樂與溫馨的回憶，位於南投縣的【小半天林家莊民宿】，要讓每一位有緣千里來相聚的大小朋友，感覺就像回到家感覺。

stays.nameEn: Pu Su Garden Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: 樸宿~即是由樸實的主人，提供簡潔舒適、樸素不奢華的住宿環境，真真實實的農家副業經營，雖然簡單，但是大方，雖然樸素，但是舒適。樸宿位於鳳凰谷風景特定區內，近鳳凰谷鳥園、台大茶園、萬年亨衢石碑古蹟、麒麟潭等景點，除此之外若行程安排去溪頭森林遊樂區，開車也只需 30 分鐘的時間。早餐提供家常菜色3-4道，當季水果1樣及女主人的手做麵包，以及加了糙米的地瓜稀飯，值得旅客親臨住宿體會。
stays.descriptionEn: Reasonably priced accommodation in B&B is hard to find, but Pusu Garden Bed and Breakfast provides surprisingly good value with a clean, simple and comfortable accommodation for guests to enjoy and experience the countryside living. Pusu is a perfect getaway for a short break from bustling city. Conscientious selection of domestic cooking ingredients for breakfast is our preference. Pusu serves traditional Taiwanese-style breakfast with seasonal vegetables and fruits. To provide a healthy, local and seasonal food is our goal and fulfillment. Such as rice porridge with sweet potato, its simple, yet distinctly homey flavor fascinates every customer. Moreover, Pusu provides homemade CIABATTA sandwiches, fresh blended sugar-free drinks and seasonal fruits for breakfast during vegetables low season.We plant small amount of large-leafed black tea and coffee by nature farming. They are growing in rough open field without any chemical fertilizer and herbicide. Farming is a painstaking job, yet we enjoy it and will persist. By farming we touch the soil, perceive the blessing and the harvest from the Mother Nature that reminds us to be modest and always cherish all we have. During your stay we will share our nature farming black tea and coffee with you and they are also available for our guests to purchase as featured local farm gifts.

stays.name: 櫻花嶺渡假山莊
stays.description: 櫻花嶺以最親切的笑容、最放鬆的環境歡迎您的到來，坐落於寧靜悠閒的小半天社區，特別聘請專業木屋、景觀等設計師，按環境作全方位之精緻開發，打造自在、安全溫馨放鬆的純木屋住宿環境。遊機能方便，鄰近溪頭、妖怪村、杉林溪等熱門景點，讓您可以擁有更好更貼近您心的住宿選擇。 在這樣充滿鄉土人情味的鄉村，體驗漫步調的優閒生活。欣賞湛藍的天、蒼翠的山林、豐富的生態及設計師用心打造的庭院，與那一份對都市人來說，是奢侈而不可多得的悠閒，放鬆心情、舒解壓力，與親切的莊主享受著清香甘甜的凍頂烏龍茶或與三五好友把酒言歡、談笑風生；或放空思緒看著莊裡優遊自在地游來游去的魚兒、抬頭望滿天星星的夜空，唯一你需要做的事只有享受放鬆。
stays.descriptionEn: Sakura Villa welcomes you with the warmest smile and most relaxing environment. Located in the quiet, leisurely Xiaobantian Community, the building was carefully and holistically designed and constructed by professional woodwork and landscape designers based on the surrounding environment, creating a comfortable, secure, warm, and relaxing wooden building accommodation. Convenient for tourism, it is located near tourist spots such as Xitou, Monster Village, and Sun Link Sea, being your best choice for quality and service. In this place of countryside friendliness, visitors can experience a relaxing, leisurely pace of life. Appreciate the azure sky, verdant forest, rich ecology, carefully designed courtyard, and rare moment of leisure. Relax, let go of stress, and enjoy a cup of sweet, refreshing Oolong tea with the friendly owner. Or gather with a few friends for drinking, chatting, and laughter. Daydream as you watch the carefree fish swimming by, or gaze up at a sky full of stars…all you need to do is relax and enjoy.

stays.name: 碧雪杉林
stays.description: 溪頭位在有台灣心臟之稱的南投縣，以綠意盎然的生態聞名全台，園區內全年均溫16度，是夏天避暑的好去處，而「南投溪頭碧雪杉林民宿」便位於距離溪頭僅十分鐘車程處，是來到溪頭旅行的最佳住宿選擇！不僅如此，周邊與忘憂森林、妖怪村、銀杏森林、麒麟潭、三生緣區、小半天等皆短短車程可到，讓您在規劃行程上毫無負擔，輕鬆完成一趟難忘的生態忘憂之旅！外觀以黑白灰色系打造而成，大方的設計加上寬敞的前庭，在這綠林之中更顯空靈與優雅；推門進入大廳，可見空間內窗明几淨，活潑的壁面俏皮地歡迎著旅人到來，巧妙地利用景窗造景讓綠意延伸至室內，帶來清新氣息，彷彿芬多精隨時游移在旅人身邊般地令人放鬆。備有多間套房讓旅人選擇，房內規劃雅緻簡約，景觀窗戶讓您可在房內眺望戶外山林景緻，並貼心地提供基本備品，更準備了闢美星級飯店的高級柔軟床鋪與潔淨的衛浴空間讓您在此解放身心疲憊，享受慵懶自在的美好假期！厭倦了庸庸碌碌的繁忙生活了嗎？那就快來趟南投，讓「南投溪頭碧雪杉林民宿」為您帶來忘卻煩憂的幸福時光！

stays.name: 維多麗亞玫瑰莊園
stays.description: 「維多麗亞玫瑰莊園」白色外牆玫瑰印記，金色大門寬敞庭園，仿若置身歐洲莊園；白牆灰瓦、藍天綠地，清新優雅；走進大廳，每個空間、每個角落，處處驚喜！ 千古山巒環繞，森林雲海相隨，每當薄霧籠罩，莊園猶如披上白紗的貴婦，矗立於山林間。靜靜地欣賞著自然美景，坐在庭園小憩，讓人流連忘返，自然山林，清新和諧。聆聽蟲鳴鳥叫，與自然山林為伍，山嵐晨旭，忘掉一切煩憂，遠離塵囂，過著山居無歲月的生活，這是奢侈的享受；漫步屋內，歐洲宮廷的金碧輝煌，彷彿置身巴黎羅浮宮，處處看到用心、巧思與品味。
stays.descriptionEn: "VICTORIA MANOR" has a white wall with rose marks. With the golden gate and spacious courtyard, you may feel as if you were in an European manor. The white wall and gray tiles with the blue sky and green land are fresh and elegant. When you walk into the lobby, every corner will surprise you! The Manor is surrounded by mountains and forests with a sea of clouds. When it is shrouded with mists, it looks like a lady with white silks standing in forests. You may quietly watch natural beautiful sceneries and sit in the courtyard. You may enjoy yourself so much as to forget to go home in the mountains and forests. Hear the ambient sound of birds and insects and travel in the mountains and forests. With clouds and mists in the mountains and sunrise, you may forget all worries. You are far away from cities and live in mountains. This is a luxurious experience. When you in the Manor, the gorgeous European palace style makes you feel as if you were at Musée du Louvre in Paris. You can see the Ingenuity and taste.

stays.description: 山莊位於溪頭森林遊樂區前三公里處，只要五分鐘的車程。環境得天獨厚，山林美景盡入眼簾。又臨溪頭主流北勢溪，潺潺流水不絕於耳，故名『聽濤園』。宛如人間仙境，世外桃源，是您週休渡假，來溪頭和杉林溪享受森林浴與芬多精的最佳去處。聽濤園渡假山莊除住宿外，也有餐廳部(最多可容納200人)，特聘請資深師傅掌廚，精心為您調配山產野菜料理，口味絕佳，足夠的鄉土原味令您讚不絕口！竹筍飯、竹筍爌肉、竹筍排骨湯......新鮮在地野菜，特製甜湯...等多樣聽濤園名菜等您來品嚐喔！可以為您明日的行程儲備最佳的體力！！
stays.descriptionEn: Our villa is located 3 kilometers from the front of the Xitou Forest Recreation Park, a 5 minute drive by car. Featuring an excellent natural environment of mountains and forest, it borders Beishi Stream, the main one in Xitou, with the name “Tingtau” being derived from the babbling sound of the water. During your holidays and weekends, come to this otherworldly paradise and enjoy the forest bath and phytoncides of Xitou and Sun Link Sea. In addition to providing accomodation, Tingtau Villa includes a restaurant (capable of holding 200 people), featuring experienced chefs who carefully prepare delicious cuisine using mountain produce and wild vegetables – an original flavor of home that never fails to win the praise of customers! Come sample famous dishes such as our rice with bamboo shoots, rice with bamboo shoots and braised pork, freshly-caught trout, fresh local vegetables, and rich coconut milk, providing energy for the next day’s journey!

stays.name: 農村老爺民宿
stays.description: 南投｜農村老爺，讓時光暫停的農家大院過了集鹿大橋，越過田野、眺望山丘，心中雜念消失。瞬間如同穿越時空，回到復古的年代，遇見一座有著五零年代台灣風情的農家大院。彷彿走入古代田園詩人所寫的畫面中，農村老爺裡有著陽光綠意、山居屋院，和主人劉大哥對土地的愛。心底的兒時記憶雙腳落在柔軟的草皮，你們幾位「老爺」下車，陽光透過絲瓜棚撒下，走近木造大門，牆上紅磚有時光的痕跡，門邊的春聯令人感到親切，「快進來坐吧！」劉大哥熱情的招呼聲傳來，一隻小黃犬跑過來──卡奇多，這名字取自一曲西班牙民謠，意指「天上掉下來的禮物」。寬闊的現代三合大院，充滿層次，透過佈滿空間的大片木窗，前庭後院的空氣、天光得以穿透在屋裡，並在窗紗留下一幅幅美好剪影。偌大的主屋由隔板、門牆分割，並在兩側由檜木長廊延伸出側屋及後院的綠意，要你慢下腳步隨意遊逛。五零年代真情放映走進屋子，由木質與原石堆砌的建築，不論是屋內的屋樑，或者院子上石砌的矮牆與水井，處處都是劉大哥和劉大姊童年的回憶。劉大哥說，「木頭與石頭是農村老爺重要的元素，因其兩者的紋理內外相同，而人心也該如此。」劉大哥期待，每位旅人來此都能感受空間傳遞的誠心。推開紅木紗門，通往二樓的房，踩在木板上發出的聲響，讓人想起小時與手足們在樓梯間追逐的時光。走進農村老爺的三款復古房型。台灣杉鄉村風房，由台灣杉木打造的牆板與地板，散發美好香氣；而日式榻榻米房也十分溫馨；最浪漫的莫過於古典紅眠床房，劉大哥用心尋找的古早紅眠床鋪，一旁裝飾雕花、紅枕、喇叭花音響，讓你與戀人一同走入浪漫的夢裡。
stays.descriptionEn: Natou｜Jiji Village B&BA traditional courtyard farmhouse where time temporarily stands stillAs you pass over the Jilu Bridge, cross farmers’ fields, and survey the rolling hills, the distracting thoughts in your mind all dissipate. In a moment, you seem to transcend space and time, returning to olden days where you encounter a traditional courtyard farmhouse, majestic in its old age and exuding the genuine ambiance of 1950s Taiwan. You feel as though you’ve walked into the type of picturesque pastoral landscape described in ancient Chinese poetry. Jiji Village B&B possesses a sunny verdancy, the courtyard of a mountain getaway, and host Mr. Liu’s love of the land.Deeply felt memories of childhoodYou and your friends disembark and put both feet on the soft, grassy ground as sunlight shines through lattice covered with loofah gourd vines. You pass through the wooden front doors surrounded by spring couplets, and admire the red brick walls which bear the traces of passing time. “Come right in and have a seat!” You hear Mr. Liu’s friendly welcome as a small, yellow dog named Cachito greets you. The name Cachito originates from a Spanish folktale, and Mr. Liu regards Cachito as a gift from heaven.This spacious, modern three-building courtyard is full of layers. The sunlight and air from the front vestibule and rear courtyard are able to penetrate inside through large, wooden-framed windows, imprinting the window screens with numerous beautiful silhouettes. The huge space is divided by wooden panels and doors, and to both sides, the refreshing greenery of potted plants is seen along the hinoki promenades of the left and right buildings. The entire space encourages you to slow your pace and wander leisurely around, taking in the scenery.A true reflection of the 1950sFrom the roof beams inside to the steps in the courtyard, from the low stone walls to the courtyard well, entering this house of wood and stone is like stepping into the childhood memories of Mr. and Mrs. Liu. According to Mr. Liu, “Wood and stone are two key elements here at Jiji Village B&B, because the veins in the stone and the grain of the wood are respectively identical inside and outside. So, too, should be the mind of man and woman.” Mr. Liu hopes that all travelers who visit here can perceive the sincerity which this building emits. Pushing open the rosewood screen doors and heading to the second-floor rooms, the floorboards creaking underfoot are reminiscent of childhood days chasing siblings up and down the halls and stairs. Jiji Village offers three guest rooms in old fashioned styles. The walls of the Taiwan Fir Tree Country-Style Room are constructed from Chinese fir, and the woody aroma permeates the room. The Japanese Tatami Room is exceedingly comfortable. Yet the most romantic of all is the Classic Chinese Canopy Bed Room. Mr. Liu searched far and wide to find this traditional bed. The room is also furnished with an ornately carved dresser, embroidered red pillows, and an antique gramophone phonograph player, creating a romantic dreamland for you and your lover.A traditional farmhouse infused with modernityBeneath a single yellow light bulb, Mr. and Mrs. Liu prepare dinner beside the traditional wood burning kitchen hearth. Mr. Liu cheerfully carries out plate after plate of authentic vegetable and meat dishes; juicy bamboo shoot with meat, organic loofah gourd fresh from the garden, braised bean and pork, and healthy burdock consommé, all made with love. After the meal, you chat over the tea table off to one side of the dining room, admiring the traditional Taiwanese tea spread and delicate ceramic teaware. Mr. Liu also has a traditional Japanese tea spread with tatami seating. Hollows in the floor allow you to extend your legs comfortably as the moon shines through the windows and reflects off the tea in your cup. You walk out into the courtyard to appreciate the tranquil evening and the cool, countryside air. The summer sun, just like a farmer, rises early, illuminating the bright green lawn in the courtyard. Waking to the shadows dancing in the passion fruit orchard outside your window, you walk spritely downstairs to find that Mrs. Liu has prepared a sumptuous breakfast of refreshing salad and rice milk, reminding you of the happiness to be found in simple things.After retiring from the air force, Mr. Liu felt homesick and so decided to return to his childhood home in Nantou and start a guesthouse business. He could not have anticipated that he would encounter the devastating Jiji earthquake which rocked Taiwan on the 21st of September, 1999. That traumatic event did not dishearten Mr. Liu, instead inspiring him to begin the activity of “Orally Recounting History” where he did relief work to aid those affected by the disaster. He and Mrs. Liu set up a vendor’s stall selling Job’s tear milk on the street, using their love of their homeland to get back on their feet. First, they opened a restaurant based on all of the old, traditional recipes they could find by interviewing the local elders, inviting travelers to taste the local flavors of Jiji. Yet they never forgot their original intention to open a guesthouse. Thus, after opening their restaurant and winery, they devoted themselves wholeheartedly to the operation of their guesthouse, a road that they have walked together, supporting one another all the way, using past frustrations to nurture their aspirations. They based their blueprints upon childhood memories, inviting travelers into their traditional courtyard farmhouse, to enjoy tranquility, happiness, and contentment.

stays.searchText: 農村老爺民宿 農村老爺民宿 南投縣民宿351號 南投縣 鹿谷鄉 瑞田村瑞田巷9-11號 南投｜農村老爺，讓時光暫停的農家大院過了集鹿大橋，越過田野、眺望山丘，心中雜念消失。瞬間如同穿越時空，回到復古的年代，遇見一座有著五零年代台灣風情的農家大院。彷彿走入古代田園詩人所寫的畫面中，農村老爺裡有著陽光綠意、山居屋院，和主人劉大哥對土地的愛。心底的兒時記憶雙腳落在柔軟的草皮，你們幾位「老爺」下車，陽光透過絲瓜棚撒下，走近木造大門，牆上紅磚有時光的痕跡，門邊的春聯令人感到親切，「快進來坐吧！」劉大哥熱情的招呼聲傳來，一隻小黃犬跑過來──卡奇多，這名字取自一曲西班牙民謠，意指「天上掉下來的禮物」。寬闊的現代三合大院，充滿層次，透過佈滿空間的大片木窗，前庭後院的空氣、天光得以穿透在屋裡，並在窗紗留下一幅幅美好剪影。偌大的主屋由隔板、門牆分割，並在兩側由檜木長廊延伸出側屋及後院的綠意，要你慢下腳步隨意遊逛。五零年代真情放映走進屋子，由木質與原石堆砌的建築，不論是屋內的屋樑，或者院子上石砌的矮牆與水井，處處都是劉大哥和劉大姊童年的回憶。劉大哥說，「木頭與石頭是農村老爺重要的元素，因其兩者的紋理內外相同，而人心也該如此。」劉大哥期待，每位旅人來此都能感受空間傳遞的誠心。推開紅木紗門，通往二樓的房，踩在木板上發出的聲響，讓人想起小時與手足們在樓梯間追逐的時光。走進農村老爺的三款復古房型。台灣杉鄉村風房，由台灣杉木打造的牆板與地板，散發美好香氣；而日式榻榻米房也十分溫馨；最浪漫的莫過於古典紅眠床房，劉大哥用心尋找的古早紅眠床鋪，一旁裝飾雕花、紅枕、喇叭花音響，讓你與戀人一同走入浪漫的夢裡。

stays.name: 逍遙居民宿
stays.description: 「溪頭住宿-逍遙居」為南投合法溪頭民宿，座落於溪頭風景區、溪頭森林遊樂區、麒麟潭、溪頭妖怪村、杉林溪森林遊樂區等知名旅遊景點，交通十分便捷，由於民宿的房內檜木香氣四溢，因此成為網友極為推薦的香氛民宿。「溪頭住宿-逍遙居」，園內規劃有大型停車場、中庭景觀花園、烤肉區及檜木住宿區，寬敞花園裡綠意盎然，每一個角落，全是主人家巧思下的創作，讓您家中的小寶貝一同渡個好假，走著走著，倘若您巧遇小白兔妹妹，正愜意的在草皮裡獨自玩耍著，可別驚嚇到牠喔！偷偷和牠拍張照吧！來到「溪頭住宿-逍遙居」，您可以很輕易的發現白色偌大的檜木屋住宿區就屹立在眼前，輕輕打開房門，陣陣的檜木香氣撲滿鼻，房內精緻的程度肯定讓您驚訝，客房內不僅採光相當明亮，主人也貼心為房客準備king size的大床，讓您一夜好眠，此外，房內備品、乾濕分離衛浴、冷氣等設施一應俱全，倘若您是家族旅遊或小團體出遊，「溪頭民宿～逍遙居」也備有檜木四人房、挑高的檜木樓中樓八人房等多款房型，滿足您的住宿需求。☆本民宿為交通部觀光局核准之國民旅遊卡特約店☆本民宿為經南投縣政府核准合法民宿編號369號

stays.name: 野菜園民宿
stays.description: 溪頭民宿 : 野菜園民宿位於小半天風景線上，為南投合法民宿編號214號，民宿四周連綿青山，園內花草扶疏，綠意盎然一片，順著鋪石的走道漫步園區，您會發現蝴蝶姑娘隨著鳥語蟲鳴翩翩起舞，濃濃的鄉村式假期，即將登場……溪頭民宿 : 野菜園民宿是當地別具特色的熱門民宿，主人夫婦皆為農家經營，以專業的素養，打造精緻、無污染的有機溫室農園，園內近百種的有機蔬果，全都不用農藥及化學肥料，為了提供遊客更優質的住宿環境，野菜園民宿內設有寬敞的庭園綠地及兒童遊憩區、卡拉OK、田園菜圃區、池塘等設施。溪頭民宿 : 野菜園民宿的一樓為挑高明亮的接待大廳，二樓以上則為住宿區，提供多款溫馨舒適的套房，在住宿套房方面，更以溫潤的檜木做為建材，讓您無時刻的沉浸在芬多精的情境下，且間間設施備品一應俱全，依房型的不同，配有觀景露台。倘若您想來趟芬多精森林之旅，或對溪頭風景線上的行程及旅途有任何疑問，請直接來電洽詢，溪頭野菜園民宿歡迎您的蒞臨。
stays.descriptionEn: Xitou B&B: Wild Vegetable Garden B&B is located on the Xiaobantian Scenic Route, and is the 214th legal B&B in Nantou. Surrounded by rolling green hills, the B&B& #39;s grounds are lush with flowers and verdant greenery. Strolling along the paved paths, you& #39;ll find butterflies fluttering to the sounds of birds and insects—a truly immersive rural holiday awaits…Xitou B&B: Wild Vegetable Garden B&B is a unique and popular local B&B. The owners, a husband and wife family, are farmers who have professionally created a refined, pollution-free organic greenhouse farm. The farm boasts nearly a hundred varieties of organic fruits and vegetables, all grown without pesticides or chemical fertilizers. To provide guests with a superior accommodation experience, Wild Vegetable Garden B&B features a spacious garden, a children& #39;s play area, karaoke, a vegetable garden, a pond, and other facilities.Xitou B&B: The ground floor of Wild Vegetable Garden B&B features a bright, high-ceilinged reception hall, while the upper floors house the accommodation area, offering a variety of cozy and comfortable suites. These suites are constructed with warm cypress wood, allowing you to immerse yourself in a phytoncide-filled atmosphere at all times. Each room is fully equipped with amenities, and depending on the room type, it includes a viewing terrace.If you are interested in a phytoncide forest adventure, or have any questions about itineraries or travel along the Xitou scenic route, please feel free to contact us. Wild Vegetable Garden B&B welcomes you.

stays.description: 民宿位於全國最美麗的社區之一南投縣鹿谷鄉小半天的「鋐洋民宿」，鄰近溪頭大學池、大崙山銀杏林、杉林溪森林遊樂區、德興瀑布、鳳凰谷鳥園等旅遊景點。提供遊客舒適乾淨的住宿環境、休憩泡茶的聊天大廳、休閒庭園以及烤肉區..等，擁有約千坪的廣大草坪地，草木扶疏加上紅花隨意的點綴，如此溫和的視覺享受，為您此趟休閒之旅再加分。親切的人文、純樸的鄉村、最貼近彼此的美麗園地，鋐洋民宿歡迎您的蒞臨。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Xiaobantian (Lugu Township, Nantou County), one of the most beautiful communities in Taiwan, HoYa Home Stay is near tourist sites such as Xitou- University Pond, Dalun Mountain Gingko Forest, Sun Link Sea, Forest Recreation Area, Dexing Waterfall, and Fonghuanggu Bird and Ecology Park. It provides visitors with clean, comfortable accommodation, a large hall for resting, drinking tea, and chatting, a recreational flower garden, and BBQ area. The large, 3300 square meter lawn is covered with luxuriant plants and adorned with red flowers, a gentle visual sensation that adds to your travel experience. With a friendly culture, honest countryside, and the most intimate, beautiful garden, we welcome you to HoYa Home Stay!

stays.name: 雲瀑春日民宿
stays.description: 在通往溪頭與杉林溪的路旁,與益品美術館相庇鄰, 一棟融合純淨典雅與現代建築風格的「雲瀑春日」, 藍天白雲相伴，矗立在幽靜山谷中， 宛如世外桃源般，讓所有造訪旅客，有心靈與大自然相遇的全新體驗。在此，有一望無際讓人舒心自在的寬廣草地,還有白雲環繞與群山交錯的絕佳美景。更特別的是,房內所展示一幅幅繽紛的畫作,皆是王品集團創辦人戴勝益的創作，踏入此處，彷彿是進入多采多姿的藝術世界,讓美學營造出生活的愉悅與愜意。來到這裡的人，除遠離都市塵囂,更能享受與大自然對話的寧靜與悠閒，絕對是想走出都市，尋找生活品質的最佳地點!

stays.name: 騰芳居民宿
stays.description: 都市的喧囂與擁擠，讓人忍不住想要尋訪一處靜謐渡假勝地……，循著一簾幽夢步道，映入眼簾的是一片綠景庭園與極富現代感的美式鄉村建築，這兒就是【溪頭騰芳居‧禪之民宿】。【溪頭騰芳居‧禪之民宿】座落於鹿谷鄉麒麟潭風景區內，鄰近鳳凰谷鳥園、小半天德興瀑布、溪頭森林遊樂區、杉林溪等旅遊景點，民宿前方是一大片的景觀庭園，旁邊座張的朵朵的傘花，午后，您可以漫步園區，夜間仰首觀星，第二天清晨起個大早，再前往溪頭森林遊樂區或杉林溪森林遊樂區健行去。【溪頭騰芳居‧禪之民宿】全館皆為無毒健康的民宿，自磁磚、原木材、奈米天然油漆到裝潢，就是要讓您渡假無負擔，民宿內分別提供房間內不但使用自製天然沐浴品，頂級的寢具，不經意的腳落，更能看出主人夫婦對於民宿的用心及細膩。您想要遠都市塵囂，污染的空氣，想要洗滌疲憊的身心靈，這裡適合您~歡迎來體驗騰芳居之美!

stays.name: 小木寓所
stays.description: 小木寓所以實踐「嘉義人的生活」為目標，我們試圖分享給大家一個在地的生活節奏，以及喜愛且珍惜木造房屋的心。這是一棟1964年所建造的台灣檜木家屋，有很多跟阿里山連結的故事及背景。 我依舊天真的相信，這棟屋子會有下一個100年。若是我們有緣在這棟屋子相遇，你可以溫柔的摸摸屋內的檜木，並且試著放緩自己的呼吸，感受一下這棟屋子的千年阿里山檜木所要給你的力量。
stays.descriptionEn: At Xiaomu Inn, our goal is to embody “the life of Chiayi people.” We hope to share with everyone the local rhythm of life and our deep love and appreciation for wooden houses. This home, built in 1964, is made of Taiwanese hinoki (cypress) and carries many stories and memories connected to Alishan. I still naively believe that this house will see another hundred years. If fate brings you here, gently touch the hinoki wood inside and try to slow your breathing. Feel the strength and calm that this thousand-year-old Alishan cypress is ready to offer you.

stays.name: 新悦花園酒店
stays.description: 2018年夏天，一隻鮮黃色的熊爸爸爬上了新悦的屋頂，成為嘉義的新地標，守護著嘉義這純淨的自然園地，以城市森林為主題，融入台灣黑熊、梅花鹿、阿里山神木、雲海、飛鳥…等自然元素，為旅客打造一趟有「森」度的文化之旅。 全館設有175間風格烱異的時尚客房，滿足各種不同的旅宿需求，館內設有親子遊戲室，以色彩繽紛的拼貼還有蟻窩作為設計概念，激發親子之間的無限創造力及活力。另外針對寵物也提供「磨鼻子寵物旅館」的友善服務，讓旅客可以安心與毛小孩一同享受旅遊的樂趣。 新悦花園酒店結合人文客房、時尚餐飲、潮流宴會、專業會議等環境高雅的場地，給顧客各項尊榮滿意的至高服務，深信愉快的旅行值得人人擁有，也以提供實惠舒心的住宿體驗，讓住客始終溫暖貼心而自豪。我們傑出的殷勤服務和始終不渝的鋭意創新，與時俱進地為所有旅客提供著無法複製的精采體驗和終生難忘的美好回憶。 新悦花園酒店將酒店設計融合當地的風土與人情文化，以具有當地特色的建築設計到美食講就-新派粵菜，新悦花園酒店品牌致力為每一位貴賓打造難忘的旅遊體驗。
