stays.descriptionEn: Dongshan River Farm is adjacent to the side gate of the Water Park and only a three-minute drive from the Cultural Arts Center. You can also take an electric boat to cruise the river. The farm has meeting rooms, bicycle rentals and cabins that provide vacations, tea tasting, coffee, business meetings, BBQs, local meals, fishing, water play, broadband wireless Internet access, etc. There are also tandem vehicles for cruising the Dongshan River and enjoying the idyllic scenery of birds flying and fish leaping. Eat, drink and have fun at Dongshan River Farm.

stays.name: 向日葵の民宿
stays.description: 提供一個舒適如家的居住空間是向日葵民宿經營的宗旨，不論是室內佈置、服務，都由這個目標出發。清晨在田間小路上騎車與陽光打招呼，午後在河畔旁的樹蔭下享受輕風。拋開束縛在羅東夜市大快朵頤，沉浸在礁溪溫泉柔暖的懷抱裡。驚險刺激又安全的龜山島賞鯨，傳藝中心打開時光隧道的入口。太平山上飄動的楓紅清新可人，驚艷蘇澳冷泉放肆南方澳漁港。從旅行‧發現台灣的美麗不論是定點旅遊或是行程規劃，向日葵民宿位居蘭陽最精華的地區，是住宿最佳選擇。不管您想從任何角度親近宜蘭，或山、或海、或河、或動感、或靜態。冬山河畔旁的向日葵民宿位居蘭陽最精華的地區，期望能滿足您對住宿的需求。
stays.descriptionEn: The mission of Sunflower Bed and Breakfast is to provide a living space that feels as comfortable as home, whether it’s the interior decoration or attentive service. Go for a bike ride down countryside paths and greet the morning sun, or enjoy the gentle breeze in the shade by the riverbank during the afternoon. Let yourself go and enjoy the feast of treats at Luodong Night Market, and soak in the soft embrace of the Jiaoxi Hot Springs. Go whale-watching at Guishan Island, a secure yet exciting and adventurous place, or take a journey through time at the National Center for Traditional Arts. The red maples on Taiping Mountain are refreshing and alluring; experience the amazing Su’ao Cold Springs and let yourself free at Nanfang’ao Fishing Port. Discover the beauty of Taiwan through travel. Whether you’ve got a fixed destination or are planning your trip, Sunflower Bed and Breakfast is located in the busiest part of Lanyang, making it your best choice of accommodation, regardless of what part of Yilan you’re interested in experiencing, whether it’s the mountains, ocean, river, or active/passive activities. Sunflower Bed and Breakfast, on the bank of Dongshan River, is located in the busiest part of Lanyang, and we hope to fulfill all your accommodation needs.

stays.descriptionEn: The "Yihepan" B&B combines the field style with a natural and relaxed atmosphere. The owner of the Yihe River B&B warmly welcomes you, visits the famous attractions of Yilan in a quiet afternoon, and enjoys a relaxing holiday with family and friends. You can have a meal at Luodong’s famous night market, and then return to the cozy and comfortable Yi River B&B. Although the fatigue caused by the journey makes the body relax, but Yi River provides you with the most comfortable accommodation environment to keep you full of spirit To continue the beautiful holiday the next day, "Yihepan" B&B is your choice.

stays.descriptionEn: Yilan Greenbird of Happiness B&B is located in Wujie Township, Yilan County surrounded by rice fields in a graceful and comfortable environment, whereas the elegant European-style space features decoupage works meticulously decorated by the female owner, and each piece of furniture, decorative lighting and curtain is carefully selected by the owner as well! Persisting in bringing loads of happiness to the travelers, delicious guest-welcoming afternoon tea, hot lavender scented tea, reading room, stress-relieving music, energy-boosting Chinese and Western breakfast are specially prepared; each room has a balcony to admire the sky and rice fields in the day, and enjoy the stars at night while enjoying a cup of coffee, as well as light food, afternoon tea and snacks; the owner further provides interesting books for sharing with everyone. Everyone is welcome to Yilan Greenbird of Happiness B&B in search of happiness~^^~ Room reservation: 0939-241-070 Ms. Hsu URL: greenbird.yibnb.net

stays.name: 小魚的家民宿
stays.description: 「宜蘭包棟民宿・小魚的家民宿」鄰近於冬山河親水公園、傳統藝術中心、利澤老街、羅東夜市、羅東文化工場、蜡藝彩繪館、羅東林業文化園區等景點，車程約在10-15 分鐘內，是到宜蘭旅遊的絕佳住所！ 走簡單的居家風格、溫馨的人情味路線，「宜蘭包棟民宿・小魚的家民宿」是民宿主人一手打造，運用繽紛壁貼、可愛的布偶營造出活潑溫馨的民宿空間，主人秉持著「要讓每個旅客像回到家一樣溫暖」的理念，除了提供電視、冷氣、沙發等家具，乾濕分離的獨立衛浴之外，更貼心備有自行車供旅客借用，讓每個來此住宿的旅客都能徹底放鬆、讚不絕口！

stays.description: 宜蘭五結鄉濃厚主題民宿「幸福8號」，穿梭在四季時五彩繽紛的田園之中，到了幸福的大門，下車時深深的吸一口氣，會感受到在都市裡無法體會的大自然空氣，庭院裡滿滿的五彩小花田，在此騎著單車是種閒暇時光，騎累了回到了幸福大門吃吃家人所烤的美食簡直是一大享受。進入了大門內，可以看見濃濃的美式風格超大客廳，「幸福8號」擁有的幸福指數還不止這樣。➡️幸福第一門「微電影房」超大私人電影包廂（超大電影螢幕、DVD投影機、各大強檔電影正版DVD）➡️幸福第二門「夏日小熊房」超可愛熊熊陪你一起度過幸福的夜晚。（超可愛熊熊布偶、復古立體書牆、舒適沙發）➡️幸福第三門「星際太空房」滿滿的星際造景，貼心又安全的寶貝滑梯，晚上關燈時張開眼睛更是看見美麗的星空。（寶貝玩具區、手工彩繪夜星空、太空座椅、太空矮桌）➡️幸福第四門「英倫公主房」幸福的少女心❤️熱愛粉紅色的女孩兒們還在等什麼呢？（紅唇沙發、公主搖椅）➡️幸福第五門「景觀房」你和她最美的氣氛，就需要最獨特的魅力！（觀望星空浴缸、最美的稻田景色、最有幸福美感的夜晚）

stays.name: 心逸民宿
stays.description: 心逸Xin yi 2022/7月全新開幕的合法民宿，登記宜蘭縣民宿2264號，位於宜蘭縣五結鄉，近國道五號(羅東/五結)交流道，鄰近冬山河親水公園、傳藝中心、羅東夜市等，交通位置便利性高，也是鬧中取靜的好所在。 我們用最自然又簡單又單純的方式呈現舒適和生活的期待。客廳寬闊打造具放鬆感的感覺、還有好幾扇偌大的落地窗與大窗框，讓自然陽光灑入，每一窗都是一符自然的風景畫，為每個空間增添了一抹綠意。往餐廳延伸，是一個用餐的好空間，簡約寬敞的環境，希望帶給您一個舒服自然、放鬆休憩的空間。 在這裡很適合發呆、放空、讓人忘了時間正在流動。您可以在這喝杯咖啡喝杯茶，在流動的空間裡，開心說笑或是漫遊在田間小路的過一天，像是注入了能量、一種生活的享受，漫活您的假期。這就是我們想要給您的舒適又放鬆的地方。來趟心逸Xin yi ～感受一下吧！ 春天，田野是綠的，然而又綠得不一樣：墨綠、油綠、嫩綠，被整齊地分成一小塊一小塊。 夏天，低處的田野裡，稻穀熟了，金黃金黃的好像是誰在地裡鋪上一層厚厚的金子。秋波搖晃著稻穀，使沉甸甸的稻穗有節奏地波動著，好像金山在滑坡。風聲稻浪，如似一曲動人的樂章。 秋與冬天，田裡就像一面面的鏡子,映出了天空與美景 遇見了。看到了就是有緣人~
stays.descriptionEn: Xinyi Xinyi is a newly opened homestay in 2022/July. It is located in Wujie Township, Yilan County, near the Interchange of National Highway No. 5 (Luodong/Wujie), near Dongshan River Water Park, Chuanyi Center, Luodong Night Market, etc. The transportation location is convenient. Sex is high, and it is also a good place to be quiet in the midst of trouble. We present comfort and expectation of life in the most natural, simple and pure way. The living room is spacious to create a feeling of relaxation, and there are several large floor-to-ceiling windows and large window frames, allowing natural sunlight to flow in. Each window is a natural landscape painting, adding a touch of greenery to each space. Extending to the restaurant, it is a good space for dining. The simple and spacious environment hopes to bring you a comfortable, natural and relaxing space. It's a good place to be in a daze, to be empty, and to forget that time is flowing. You can have a cup of coffee and a cup of tea here, in the flowing space, laughing happily or roaming the field road for a day, it seems to inject energy, a kind of enjoyment of life, and live your vacation. This is where we want to give you comfort and relaxation. Come to Xinyi ~ feel it! In spring, the fields are green, but the green is different: dark green, oily green, tender green, neatly divided into small pieces. In summer, in the low fields, the rice is ripe, and the golden ones seem to be covered with a thick layer of gold. The autumn waves swayed the rice, causing the heavy ears of rice to fluctuate rhythmically, as if the golden mountain was on a landslide. The sound of wind and rice waves is like a moving piece of music. In autumn and winter, the fields are like mirrors, reflecting the sky and beautiful scenery. Seeing it is fate~

stays.searchText: 心逸民宿 心逸民宿 宜蘭縣民宿2264號 宜蘭縣 五結鄉 傳藝路一段456巷18號 心逸Xin yi 2022/7月全新開幕的合法民宿，登記宜蘭縣民宿2264號，位於宜蘭縣五結鄉，近國道五號(羅東/五結)交流道，鄰近冬山河親水公園、傳藝中心、羅東夜市等，交通位置便利性高，也是鬧中取靜的好所在。 我們用最自然又簡單又單純的方式呈現舒適和生活的期待。客廳寬闊打造具放鬆感的感覺、還有好幾扇偌大的落地窗與大窗框，讓自然陽光灑入，每一窗都是一符自然的風景畫，為每個空間增添了一抹綠意。往餐廳延伸，是一個用餐的好空間，簡約寬敞的環境，希望帶給您一個舒服自然、放鬆休憩的空間。 在這裡很適合發呆、放空、讓人忘了時間正在流動。您可以在這喝杯咖啡喝杯茶，在流動的空間裡，開心說笑或是漫遊在田間小路的過一天，像是注入了能量、一種生活的享受，漫活您的假期。這就是我們想要給您的舒適又放鬆的地方。來趟心逸Xin yi ～感受一下吧！ 春天，田野是綠的，然而又綠得不一樣：墨綠、油綠、嫩綠，被整齊地分成一小塊一小塊。 夏天，低處的田野裡，稻穀熟了，金黃金黃的好像是誰在地裡鋪上一層厚厚的金子。秋波搖晃著稻穀，使沉甸甸的稻穗有節奏地波動著，好像金山在滑坡。風聲稻浪，如似一曲動人的樂章。 秋與冬天，田裡就像一面面的鏡子,映出了天空與美景 遇見了。看到了就是有緣人~

stays.description: Welcome to you！宜蘭五結鄉全新包棟民宿，時空心靈客棧可容納5~12人包棟民宿，你我皆是這宇宙間的時空旅人，穿越過去與未來時空，彼此於冥冥中宇宙安排在此相聚，我們以一顆誠摯的心歡迎您來此「時空心靈客棧」民宿，讓彼此共結這宇宙心靈間殊勝的好緣，將宇宙間強大的能量磁場帶動心靈，令來此每位貴賓皆能擁有健康幸福與智慧的正能量。未來在此住宿的時空心靈旅人，我們會安排不定期課程「心靈冥想療癒課程」、「心靈紓壓課程」、「開啟心想事成」等一系列心靈課程，歡迎有興趣的旅人於「線上詢房」報名參加。
stays.descriptionEn: Nestled in the tranquil countryside of Wujie Township, Yilan County, this accommodation is near the National Center for Traditional Arts and Zhuangwei Sand Dunes.It features warm wood tones and soft lighting, creating a space where you can "slow down" and relax.You can book the entire building for yourself, enjoying a private living room and kitchen. In the morning, you can drive to Turtle Island to watch the sunrise and experience the healing atmosphere of Yilan.

stays.name: 晴天民宿
stays.description: 位於宜蘭五結的「啾吉民宿晴天館」是一棟四層樓的宜蘭包棟民宿，鄰近羅東夜市、傳統藝術中心與利澤簡老街，鬧中取靜，開車即可輕鬆抵達宜蘭各大景點，周邊亦備有免費停車位，是家庭旅遊與團體出遊的絕佳選擇。晴天館採全棟包棟入住，最多可容納20人以上（基本人數為8人），提供三間雙人套房與兩間四人套房(另可依人數、需求將麻將房改裝為雅房)，寬敞明亮空間舒適。房價方面，平日包棟每晚只需 $6,000 起（4人），假日則為 $16,000 起（10人），可開收據，適合親友聚會、同學會或企業小團體。民宿設備齊全，包含：KTV歡唱空間、電動麻將桌、烤肉區、公共廚房與咖啡機、Wi-Fi，同時開放寵物入住(需收清潔費$500/隻)，是宜蘭寵物友善民宿包棟的首選
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Wujie, Yilan, 9G Sunny Villa is a four-story private guesthouse available exclusively for full-house rentals. It’s conveniently close to top attractions like Luodong Night Market, the National Center for Traditional Arts, and Lizejian Old Street—offering the perfect blend of liveliness and tranquility. With free roadside parking and easy access by car, it’s an ideal choice for family trips and group getaways.The villa is designed for private bookings only, and can comfortably accommodate more than 20 guests (minimum booking for 8 people). It includes three double suites and two family suites, and the mahjong room can be converted into a standard guest room depending on group size and needs. The spacious, well-lit rooms provide a relaxing and cozy stay.Rates start at NT$6,000 per night on weekdays (for 4 guests) and NT$16,000 per night on weekends (for 10 guests). Official receipts can be issued, making it suitable for gatherings, reunions, or small corporate retreats.The villa comes fully equipped with a karaoke lounge, automatic mahjong table, BBQ area, shared kitchen, coffee machine, and Wi-Fi. It’s also a pet-friendly accommodation, welcoming furry companions for a cleaning fee of NT$500 per pet—making it one of the top choices for private pet-friendly stays in Yilan.

stays.name: 松風飯店
stays.description: 「人與人相處的真誠與溫度」，是松風文旅用心款待旅人之心。創辦人以生產瓦楞紙箱的地健企業起家，因緣際會下跨足以健康休閒為主的飯店業。本著對「好好做事，不忘本」的堅持，將紙文化元素注入松風文旅，以瓦楞紙藝增添趣味又文藝的氛圍，期望溫暖樸實的瓦楞藝術能夠帶給旅人新穎的住宿體驗松風文旅全館共有六種房型，總數82間房。11至22.5坪的舒適空間，全房型皆挑高設計，以木質色系搭配呈現溫暖開闊風格。坐落於大二結文化區，鄰近羅東及宜蘭，車程僅需十餘分鐘，於鬧中取靜，希望旅人們在這個安靜細膩的空間，能夠充分舒暢疲憊的身心。讓宜蘭的純樸民風及好客之情，緩慢您的步調，讓您單純地、真誠地歡笑。

stays.name: 河風精緻の民宿
stays.description: 提供一個舒適如家的居住空間是河風精緻民宿經營的宗旨，不論是室內佈置、服務，都由這個目標出發。清晨在田間小路上騎車與陽光打招呼，午後在河畔旁的樹蔭下享受輕風。拋開束縛在羅東夜市大快朵頤，沉浸在礁溪溫泉柔暖的懷抱裡。驚險刺激又安全的龜山島賞鯨，傳藝中心打開時光隧道的入口。太平山上飄動的楓紅清新可人，驚艷蘇澳冷泉放肆南方澳漁港。從旅行‧發現台灣的美麗不論是定點旅遊或是行程規劃，河風位居蘭陽最精華的地區，是住宿最佳選擇。不管您想從任何角度親近宜蘭，或山、或海、或河、或動感、或靜態。冬山河畔旁的河風精緻民宿位居蘭陽最精華的地區，期望能滿足您對住宿的需求。
stays.descriptionEn: The mission of Riverbank Cottage is to provide a living space that feels as comfortable as home, whether it’s the interior decoration or attentive service. Go for a bike ride down countryside paths and greet the morning sun, and enjoy the gentle breeze in the shade by the riverbank during the afternoon. Let yourself go and enjoy a feast of treats at Luodong Night Market, and soak in the soft embrace of the Jiaoxi Hot Springs. Go whale-watching at Guishan Island, a secure yet exciting and adventurous place, or take a journey through time at the National Center for Traditional Arts. The red maples on Taiping Mountain are refreshing and alluring; experience the amazing Su’ao Cold Springs and let yourself free at Nanfang’ao Fishing Port. Discover the beauty of Taiwan through travel. Whether you’ve got a fixed destination or are planning your trip, Riverbank Cottage is located in the busiest part of Lanyang, making it your best choice of accommodation, regardless of what part of Yilan you’re interested in experiencing, whether it’s the mountains, ocean, river, or active or passive activities. Riverbank Cottage, on the bank of Dongshan River, is located in the busiest part of Lanyang, and we hope to fulfill all your accommodation needs.

stays.name: 煙波花時間 宜蘭傳藝
stays.description: 夜宿蘭陽藝城 漫遊古味巷陌「煙波花時間 – 宜蘭傳藝」坐落於國立傳統藝術中心-宜蘭傳藝園區。以「夜宿蘭陽藝城 漫遊古味巷陌」為概念，讓旅客住得自在、玩得自由、歡聚在傳藝中心，發掘藏在日常裡的文化藝術軌跡，深度感受、傳揚台灣傳統藝術。全區客房建築出自黃聲遠建築師事務所設計，懷舊磨石地、迴廊池塘、涼亭木椅，自由穿梭濃厚閩南式建築中，彷彿穿越到舊時台灣，留下充滿濃厚文化氣息的片刻回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: Gather happily at NCFTA and to explore the cultural traces in everyday life, to experience Taiwan’s traditional arts in depth.The Moment Hotel Yilan by Lakeshore based on the concept of “Spending a night in the ancient city” is located by the Yilan Park of NCFTA (National Center for Traditional Arts), allowing travelers to sleep well and play freely, to gather happily at NCFTA and to explore the cultural traces in everyday life, to experience Taiwan’s traditional arts in depth. The guest room buildings in the park were designed by Huang Sheng-Yuan Architects, where the lattice windows with terrazzo flooring, the hallway with the fish pond, the pavilion with wooden chairs sum up to provide a strong Taiwanese-style ancient city, such that one feels as if going back to Taiwan in the old days while strolling around freely during the accommodation period, thereby creating memories filled with strong cultural ambience for the travelers.

stays.description: "神雕雅築民宿"在宜蘭縣五結鄉福和二路118巷62號,五結鄉剛好位於宜蘭地理位置的正中央,想要去宜蘭的景點饗用宜蘭的美食,住在宜蘭五結鄉神雕雅築民宿是最佳的選擇.家庭聚會或相約好友們一起出遊 也可以三個家庭一起出遊或是 三代同堂想有擁私人餐廳者、甚或一大家族包一部遊覽車的， 都可以同時入住。 大人加小孩不過十幾個人就可以玩得超開心. 包棟 8-12人,平日13,000 假日 15,000 定價 25,000 包棟 14-18人,平日18,000 假日 20,000 定價 30,000 十幾個人就可以包下一整棟民宿 包棟的住客，若是不想把時間浪費在車上， 只想好好享受鄉居歲月，民宿有一個很棒的服務， 可提供烤肉或外燴，在訂房前先預約。 不僅晚上有在地超豐盛美食大餐可以吃~還有卡拉OK可以歡唱~實在是太好玩啦.
stays.descriptionEn: Shendiao Yazhu is at No.62, Ln. 118, Fuhe 2nd Rd., Wujie Township, Yilan County. Wujie Township is at the center of Yilan county. If you wish to travel around Yilan, Shendiao Yazhu is your best choice. It is suitable for a trip with family and friends. It is appropriate for multiple families and multiple generations for we have a private restaurant. Groups up to 40 people are welcomed too. You can have lots of fun here with your families. The whole building is 13,000 NTD a night on weekdays and 15,000 NTD on weekends for 8-12 people. For 14-18 people it is 18,000 NTD on weekdays and 20,000 NTD on weekends. You only need about 10 people to rent the whole building. We also provide barbecue or catering service. Please make a reservation when booking. Karaoke service is also available. You can have lots of fun singing and feasting.

stays.name: 純真童心
stays.description: 純真童心溜滑梯親子民宿位於五農米產地-宜蘭五結鄉，早期居民都是種稻維生，直到今日純真童心民宿附近都還是一片片綠色稻田，保有未被人為破壞的自然景觀，距離羅東交流道5分鐘即可到達，位於郊區和市區之間。鄰近：羅東夜市、傳藝中心、冬山河親水公園、生態綠舟等著名景點。其中鄰近的冬山河親水公園是每年夏天國際童玩藝術節的舉辦場地，是您到宜蘭童玩節住宿的最佳選擇。「用父母為孩子準備一個家的心，迎接遠道而來的您。」是我們的初衷，我們在去年迎接了家中的第一個小寶貝，開始了解為人父母對孩子殷殷期盼，「希望你可以平安、快樂、健康的長大」是每個父母心中最大願望。因此，帶著這樣的心情，打造出適合孩子遊戲的空間，我們有溜滑梯、球池及攀岩場，運用繽紛活潑的色調，呼應孩子們最純真可愛的童心；每個房間以不同的主題呈現，將孩子最愛的溜滑梯搬到房間裡，安全的空間不僅大人放心，小孩也玩得開心，孩子的笑容，就是讓父母前進的動力。希望來到這裡的孩子與父母，都能帶走滿滿的笑容及回憶。

stays.name: 綠也民宿
stays.description: 位於冬山河休閒農業區內，座落於一片風光絕倫的田野景致中 鄰近全國知名風景區南邊為國際童玩藝術節冬山河親水公園，北邊為國立傳統藝術中心，東邊為國道五號聯絡道-傳藝路直達羅東後火車站及馳名的羅東觀光夜市。民宿距離羅東運動公園開車僅須15分鐘，前往羅東夜市也僅需10分鐘路程即抵，便利的交通，方便旅人前往各地尋幽訪古。民宿外觀為一幢具有設計感強烈的時尚建築，富麗高雅的大廳提供旅人歇腳、談趣的最佳空間；主題式溫馨明亮的客房則提供了旅人靜心休息的寧靜氛圍，潔淨而溫馨的空間搭配舒適的寢具和繽紛的壁貼，展現雅緻舒眠的溫暖氣息，停駐了旅人的匆忙腳步
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the Dongshan River Leisure Agriculture Area, it is located in a beautiful field sceneryIt is close to the nationally renowned scenic spots. To the south is the International Children's Play Art Festival Dongshan River Water Park, to the north is the National Center for Traditional Arts, and to the east is the National Highway No. 5 connecting road - Chuanyi Road, which directly leads to Luodong Hou Railway Station and the famous Luodong Tourist Night Market. The B&B is only a 15-minute drive from Luodong Sports Park and a 10-minute drive from Luodong Night Market. The convenient transportation makes it easy for travelers to visit various places to explore ancient sites.The exterior of the B&B is a stylish building with a strong sense of design. The magnificent and elegant lobby provides the best space for travelers to rest and chat. The themed warm and bright guest rooms provide a peaceful atmosphere for travelers to rest. The clean and warm space is matched with comfortable bedding and colorful wall stickers, showing the warm atmosphere of elegant sleep and stopping the hurried steps of travelers.

stays.name: 羅東棧
stays.description: 位於宜蘭於冬山河休閒農業區內，座落於一片風光絕倫的田野景致中 鄰近全國知名風景區南邊為國際童玩藝術節冬山河親水公園，北邊為國立傳統藝術中心，東邊為國道五號聯絡道-傳藝路直達羅東後火車站及馳名的羅東觀光夜市。民宿距離羅東運動公園開車僅須15分鐘，前往羅東夜市也僅需10分鐘路程即抵，便利的交通，方便旅人前往各地尋幽訪古。民宿外觀為一幢具有設計感強烈的時尚建築，富麗高雅的大廳提供旅人歇腳、談趣的最佳空間；主題式溫馨明亮的客房則提供了旅人靜心休息的寧靜氛圍，潔淨而溫馨的空間搭配舒適的寢具和繽紛的壁貼，展現雅緻舒眠的溫暖氣息，停駐了旅人的匆忙腳步縣的民宿
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the Dongshan River Leisure Agriculture Area, it is located in a beautiful field sceneryIt is close to the nationally renowned scenic spots. To the south is the International Children's Play Art Festival Dongshan River Water Park, to the north is the National Center for Traditional Arts, and to the east is the National Highway No. 5 connecting road - Chuanyi Road, which directly leads to Luodong Hou Railway Station and the famous Luodong Tourist Night Market. The B&B is only a 15-minute drive from Luodong Sports Park and a 10-minute drive from Luodong Night Market. The convenient transportation makes it easy for travelers to visit various places to explore ancient sites.The exterior of the B&B is a stylish building with a strong sense of design. The magnificent and elegant lobby provides the best space for travelers to rest and chat. The themed warm and bright guest rooms provide a peaceful atmosphere for travelers to rest. The clean and warm space is matched with comfortable bedding and colorful wall stickers, showing the warm atmosphere of elegant sleep and stopping the hurried steps of travelers.

stays.name: 美村民宿
stays.description: 「美村民宿」是台灣少見富含生態元素的「渡假農場」型親子民宿! 位於有台北後花園雅稱的台灣東北角「宜蘭」開車出雪隧後從「羅東」下交流道約10分鐘車程即可抵達,鄰近冬山河親水公園和國立傳統藝術中心,交通相當便利! 任何一間客房皆可遠眺宜蘭鎮縣之寶{龜山島}, 落羽松林蔭步道總令人驚羨, 小橋流水、蛙鳴鳥叫、鳥語花香令人流連忘返,9個階梯式自然生態池更使親子戶外教育有口皆碑! 賞荷、戲水、烤肉、歡唱…… 咖啡、品茗、閱讀、寫作、彈琴…… 動靜皆宜,渡假首選! 渡假來宜蘭! 渡假來美村!
stays.descriptionEn: MEI-CUN HOMESTAY is a rare "Holiday Farm" type homestay in Taiwan that is rich in ecological elements! Located in the northeast corner of Taiwan - Yilan County, which is known as the Back Garden of Taipei. We’re about a 10-minute drive from the Luodong Interchange after driving out of the Hsuehshan Tunnel on the National Freeway 5, and is close to Dongshan River Water Park and National Center for Traditional Arts, so the transportation is quite convenient! All our rooms overlook the scenic view of the treasure of Yilan County - Gueishan Island (Turtle Island) which sits in the Northeast of the Pacific Ocean. A stroll along the Bald Cypress Trees-lined trail will be an unforgettable experience. The flowing water along the small bridges, the sound of frogs and birds, coupled with the fragrance of flowers will truly be memorable. Our 9 stepped natural ecological pool is a well-known parent-child outdoor education venue! Enjoy lotus viewing, water playing, barbecuing, singing... Coffee or tea tasting, reading, writing, playing the piano... Your FIRST CHOICE Country Retreat! A Great Holiday Resort in Yilan! Come and stay with us at BEAUTIFUL VILLAGE HOMESTAY!

stays.searchText: 耘心田民宿 耘心田民宿 宜蘭縣民宿1257號 宜蘭縣 五結鄉 公園三路111號 「耘心田」因有童玩親水公園、傳統藝術中心、冬山河畔、五十二甲溼地、羅東夜市…等豐富觀光資源與特色，加上雪隧國道之便，已成宜蘭旅遊的停留首選，更是台北人的休閒旅遊勝地。現在就出發吧！不管是一日輕旅行、溫馨二日遊，或者深度體驗的LONGSTAY，查踏尋訪小城人文故事、闔家聯絡親子感情、沒有目的性的放鬆漫遊、靜享無菜單美食…這兒都是在都會區裡無法獲得、最舒展身心、享受人生的最佳選擇。

stays.description: 『親水89饗樂民宿』位於宜蘭五結鄉，是一座占地為2500平方公尺的小型莊園。 民宿位置鄰近冬山河親水公園旁，除提供舒適的住宿環境外，民宿內還有座令人心曠神怡的美麗花園。民宿內提供腳踏車，供旅人們愜意的邊騎邊享受著大自然的洗禮，沿著自行車道也可以到達每年夏季都會舉辦童玩節的親水公園。 夜晚如果想嚐嚐宜蘭的在地小吃，可以驅車前往羅東夜市，好好的大快朵頤一番。 民宿的內部走的是簡約的舒適風格，每間客房都擁有大坪數的寬敞空間，花園內有遊戲區，還有可以親近小動物的動物區，及觀賞魚兒的生態池，小朋友可以在花園裡度過精采的戶外時光，因此在這樣寬敞的空間裡，可以毫無拘束的盡情放鬆、療癒身心。

stays.description: 回首看看成立民宿的軌跡超平價渡假民宿「一步一腳印」的默默耕耘…經營到現在已經結交到許多來自全世界的朋友，每次看見各位支持超平價渡假民宿粉絲們的一頻一笑，就是讓我們繼續努力揚起微笑的船帆，向新的旅程出發的原動力！超平價渡假民宿會有另一個重要的成長改變^_^超平價風格館即將加入這個營運的行列...2館的接棒加入....令人期待全新的風格館能創造更加豐富的可能，提供嶄新的民宿風貌透過藝術創作者的創意，把原創的彩繪元素翻譯成每個精彩的畫面很歡迎大家來這邊體驗這種創意無限的視覺饗宴。

stays.name: 逗點休閒民宿
stays.description: 踏在鋪滿石片的步道上，讓我們一起走進寧靜優雅的巷弄中，來到位於五結鄉的逗點休閒民宿，逗點，一間充滿溫馨氣息的休閒民宿，在這兒有著女主人親手打造的舒適環境，如優雅的前庭，正是您享受微風品嚐香濃咖啡的的地方，而簡潔明亮的客廳是您談天說地的好場所，溫馨雅緻的客房更是您舒解疲憊一夜好眠好所在。經過一夜甜美好夢，望向窗外，迎接您的正是鳥聲四啼的清晰早晨，空氣中還瀰漫著淡淡的花香、草香，騎著鐵馬正好來趟探索田園的旅程，暢遊在田園小徑間，宜蘭的鄉村美景盡收眼底，讓您感受到大自然的美妙 ，而緊鄰的冬山河畔更是您不可錯的休憩選擇，一間用心經營值得您到訪的民宿 -- 逗點，讓您真正獲得充分休憩的優質民宿。
stays.descriptionEn: Walking along the stone-paved pathway brings us into the tranquil, graceful alley of Wujie Township, where Dot Bed and Breakfast is located. We’re a recreational bed and breakfast full of a warm atmosphere, with a comfortable environment created by the owner herself. The elegant front hall is where guests can enjoy a soft breeze while sipping a rich cup of coffee, the simple, bright living room is a good place to chat with friends, and the warm, elegant rooms provide the opportunity to rest from your fatigue and get a good night of sleep. After awaking from pleasant dreams, look outside the window and be welcomed by the refreshing morning and sound of chirping birds. The air is filled with the faint fragrance of plants and flowers, making this a great time to explore the countryside by bicycle, leisurely winding along the little paths through the fields. The beauty of Yilan’s countryside is everywhere you look, letting you experience the beauty of nature, while the nearby Dongshan River is a rest stop you won’t want to miss. Dot Bed and Breakfast - a bed and breakfast worth the trip, a bed and breakfast where you can fully rest and relax.

stays.name: 金洙椏休閒民宿
stays.description: 金洙椏民宿位於冬山河旁，靠近傳藝路與高速公路的交叉口，離交流道也只有幾百公尺，從桃園中正國際機場開車至此只需八十分鐘，經由全亞洲最長的雪山隧道至台北101大樓也只需五十分鐘，南來北往相當便利。我們有獨立的庭園及停車場，共有兩間雙人房、兩間四人房及一間和室四人房，並設有電梯無障礙坡道等方便有年長者及小孩的家庭一起入住，並且提供交誼廳可讓旅客與家人朋友一起聊天休憩享用我們提供的茶與點心。夜晚可前往名聞遐邇的羅東夜市逛逛，回到民宿後可以全家一起玩玩XBOX運動一下，享受溫馨的家庭時光。一夜好眠後可在陽光沐浴中的餐廳享用老闆娘精心準備，使用宜蘭在地食材的中式早餐，用完早餐後可以騎著金洙椏民宿提供的腳踏車至附近的冬山河腳踏車騎車，延著河岸可欣賞蘭陽田野風光及河景，遠離塵囂，放慢腳步體驗樂活旅遊。
stays.descriptionEn: Jinzhuya Homestay is located on the riverbank of Dongshan River, close to the Chuanyi Road and freeway intersections, a few hundred meters from the Interchanges, an 80 minutes' drive from Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport, and just 50 minutes' drive from Taipei 101 if you take the route through Asia's longest mountain tunnel, Hsuehshan Tunnel. We have quite convenient transportation to all directions. We offer separate gardens and parking lots, two double rooms, two four-person rooms and a Japanese four-person room, in addition to an elevator, accessible ramps, and other facilities to make the stay of elderly and families with children more convenient, as well as a saloon for visitors to chat with friends and family leisurely and enjoy our offer of tea and snacks. In the night, you may stroll to the famous Luodong Night Market, and after your return play XBOX with the whole family together, or exercise, enjoying the warmth of family time. After a good night's sleep, you can enjoy a Chinese breakfast with local food ingredients carefully prepared by the proprietress in the restaurant under the sunshine. After breakfast, you can ride a bicycle provided by the Jinzhuya Homestay to the nearby Dongshan River. Along the riverbank, you enjoy the scenery and river views of the Long Yang countryside, slowing down to experience the Lohas tour, away from the hubbub.

stays.searchText: 金洙椏休閒民宿 金洙椏休閒民宿 宜蘭縣民宿655號 宜蘭縣 五結鄉 協和村1鄰協和中路17-27號 金洙椏民宿位於冬山河旁，靠近傳藝路與高速公路的交叉口，離交流道也只有幾百公尺，從桃園中正國際機場開車至此只需八十分鐘，經由全亞洲最長的雪山隧道至台北101大樓也只需五十分鐘，南來北往相當便利。我們有獨立的庭園及停車場，共有兩間雙人房、兩間四人房及一間和室四人房，並設有電梯無障礙坡道等方便有年長者及小孩的家庭一起入住，並且提供交誼廳可讓旅客與家人朋友一起聊天休憩享用我們提供的茶與點心。夜晚可前往名聞遐邇的羅東夜市逛逛，回到民宿後可以全家一起玩玩XBOX運動一下，享受溫馨的家庭時光。一夜好眠後可在陽光沐浴中的餐廳享用老闆娘精心準備，使用宜蘭在地食材的中式早餐，用完早餐後可以騎著金洙椏民宿提供的腳踏車至附近的冬山河腳踏車騎車，延著河岸可欣賞蘭陽田野風光及河景，遠離塵囂，放慢腳步體驗樂活旅遊。

stays.name: 香格里拉冬山河旅館
stays.description: 白牆紅瓦地中海式建築，坐落於幽靜的蘭陽平原、冬山河畔上，提供旅人盡享慵懶與心靈解放的優質享受。飯店秉持讓旅客體驗休閒渡假與自然生態樂趣的精神，結合宜蘭各式文化活動與節慶，讓專屬於冬山河地區的知性與感性，徹底瀰漫在每位入住飯店裡的客人身上。籌備七年精心打造而成的地中海風情建築，目前佔地約六萬平方公尺，備有72間雅致田園景觀客房、4間中式餐廳、1間西式餐廳，每間客房內皆引進47度c碳酸氫鈉溫泉，讓您在客房內便可充分享受泡湯樂趣！

stays.description: 民宿位置鄰近冬山河親水公園旁，除提供舒適的住宿環境外，民宿內還有座令人心曠神怡的美麗花園。民宿內提供腳踏車，供旅人們愜意的邊騎邊享受著大自然的洗禮，沿著自行車道也可以到達每年夏季都會舉辦童玩節的親水公園。夜晚如果想嚐嚐宜蘭的在地小吃，可以驅車前往羅東夜市，好好的大快朵頤一番。民宿的內部走的是簡約的舒適風格，每間客房都擁有大坪數的寬敞空間，花園內有遊戲區，還有可以親近小動物的動物區，及觀賞魚兒的生態池，小朋友可以在花園裡度過精采的戶外時光，因此在這樣寬敞的空間裡，可以毫無拘束的盡情放鬆、療癒身心。

stays.description: 鸚鵡名宿位在宜蘭縣的五結鄉，靠近冬山河親水公園和國立傳統藝術中心，提供 WiFi（免費）和免費私人停車位。鸚鵡名宿設有附淋浴設施的私人衛浴，並提供平面電視、拖鞋和吹風機。這間住宿提供單點式外帶早餐。鸚鵡名宿提供共用休息室。鸚鵡名宿距離 7-11 1.5公里，距離全家 1.7 公里， 距離全家 1.9公里距離羅東夜市 4.7 公里，距離國立傳統藝術中心 2.5公里，距離清水海邊 3.4 公里。最近的機場是台北松山機場，距離這間住宿 50 公里。鸚鵡名宿自 2021 年 12 月 19 日開始接待 Booking.com 的旅客入住。

It provides WiFi (free) and free private parking spaces. Parrot Guest House has a private bathroom with shower, flat-screen TV, slippers and hairdryer. This accommodation offers a à la carte grab-and-go breakfast. Parrot Guest House offers a shared lounge. Parrot Guest House is 1.5 km from 7-11, 1.7 km from the family, 1.9 km from the family It is 4.7 km from Luodong Night Market, 2.5 km from National Center for Traditional Arts and 3.4 km from Qingshui Seaside. The nearest airport is Taipei Songshan Airport, 50 km from the accommodation.

stays.name: ４３會館
stays.description: 《43會館以南洋島嶼元素打造慵懶的抒壓空間，唱無聲的歌，跳輕盈的舞，任妳的心情自由飛翔，去一個想去的地方，無重力的旅行。後現代極簡風格恰好與VILLA設計衝撞出夢幻至極的寧靜美感。讓旅客不用出國就能享受身心靈的徹底洗禮。精緻的小陽台把陽光牽了進來，在早晨、在傍晚，躺在妳身上撒嬌、磨蹭。》男主人喜歡峇里島Villa不受外人打擾的度假悠閒感，索性將峇里島的Villa全套搬回宜蘭。規劃有私人泳池的花園裡，雞蛋花等花木扶疏，善惡門、石雕、木雕推門、藤編家具、發呆亭，甚至連建築的茅草屋頂，都由峇里島進口。採包棟的會館有套房，衛浴，大型泡澡缸上方規劃了天窗；還有設於庭園的廚房、自然風客廳，另有籃球場、烤肉區、生態釣魚池、開放式廚房及一間視廳室。

stays.description: fishforcats 位於宜蘭縣五結鄉在冬山河親水公園的左側亦是冬山河的左岸。 3分鐘可步行至河岸 (冬山河自行車道）, 是絕佳享受晨間、黃昏散步慢跑的好地方。15分鐘車程到羅東夜市, 5分鐘至傳藝中心。附近有便利商店、超市、傳統市場、小吃店、餐廳。利澤老街也在走路可到的距離內。
stays.descriptionEn: Fishforcats is in Wujie, Yilan County,Taiwan, close to Dongshan River Water Park. The 10 km long Dongshan River cycling path along the river bank (an excellent place for cycling, jogging or a stroll any time of the day, especially in the morning or evening) is just 3 minutes’ walk from our home. The popular Luodong night market is around 15 minutes’ drive from our place whereas the National Centre for Traditional Arts is within 5 minutes’ drive. There are convenient stores, supermarkets, traditional markets, local food stalls and restaurants nearby. The Lize Old Street is also within walking distance.

stays.name: 上河圖渡假會館
stays.description: 本會館以中國風打造， 每個房間都設計中國式的圖騰，為故事背景，宮廷式的建築、裝潢、營造出濃濃的中國風味，房間內以木質窗花作為隔間，擺設紅木家具搭配整體景觀，感覺到溫馨的溫度，大樓以RC結構為本體，房間的佈置皆為防火木質材質，全館的佈置，皆以中國式的隔間為主，打造中國 古典 宮廷 的風味。房間分配，古典雙人房，典雅四人房，宮廷四人房，美房間皆是套房規劃，每個房間都有獨立之陽台，面對冬山河河景， 可以目視整個蘭陽平原，風景幽雅、寧靜。主體外觀全新的 喜樂 知足 休閒會館，獨立整體的外型 從很遠的地方就感受到她亮麗顯眼，矗立在冬山河畔 潔白的庭園設計感受到濃濃的中國風。大廳進入大廳 中國式的雕樑畫棟馬上呈現在眼前 雞絲紅木家具的擺設，更突顯出大廳的高貴與氣質，以原木為設計主體，讓人感受到暖暖的溫度，華麗與高貴，體驗木質原始風貌及溫度。庭院景觀用竹子及碎石 還有咕咾石設計出來的 庭院 潔白亮麗 讓到訪的朋友都能體驗到 中國風之美
stays.descriptionEn: The hall is built in Chinese style. Each room is designed with a Chinese-style totem. As the background of the story, the palace-style architecture and decoration create a strong Chinese flavor. The wooden window grilles are used as compartments and mahogany furniture is arranged as a whole. The landscape feels the warm temperature. The building is based on the RC structure. The rooms are all decorated with fireproof wood. The layout of the whole building is mainly based on Chinese-style compartments, creating the flavor of a Chinese classical palace.Room allocation, classical double room, elegant quadruple room, palace quadruple room, beautiful rooms are all suite planning, each room has its own balcony, facing the Dongshan River, you can see the entire Lanyang Plain, the scenery is elegant, peaceful.Main appearanceThe brand-new joy and contentment leisure club, independent and overall appearance can be felt from a long distance, she is bright and conspicuous, standing on the banks of the Dongshan River, the white garden design feels a strong Chinese style.hallEntering the hall, the Chinese-style carved beams and paintings will immediately show up in front of you with the furnishings of chicken silk mahogany furniture, which highlights the nobility and temperament of the hall. The log is the main design, making people feel the warm temperature, gorgeous and noble, and experience the original wooden style and appearance. temperature.Courtyard landscapeThe courtyard is designed with bamboo, gravel, and guzhu stone, so white and beautiful, so that friends who visit can experience the beauty of Chinese style

stays.description: 《丟丟噹親子民宿》位於宜蘭縣冬山鄉的民宿 ( 附免費停車場 ) 佔地千坪。民宿位置鄰近羅東運動公園，距離羅東夜市8分鐘，是孩子的夢想天堂，不但有蓄水池夏天可戲水、冬天可划船、琉璃沙坑、室內兒童遊戲區...等小朋友最愛的遊戲設施，還有廣大的室內、室外空間．就算一整個天都在樂園裡面玩耍也都不會膩!!!，河堤邊有自行車步道，可以騎自行車或散散步享受大自然的風光，6-8月可以帶小朋友去看成群的獨角仙們。
stays.descriptionEn: "Diao Diu Dang Family Homestay" is a homestay (with free parking) located in Dongshan Township, Yilan County, covering an area of ​​1,000 square meters. The location of the B&B is close to Luodong Sports Park and 8 minutes from Luodong Night Market. It is a dream paradise for children. There are not only cisterns for swimming in summer, boating in winter, glazed sandpits, indoor children's play area...etc. Game facilities, as well as vast indoor and outdoor spaces. Even if you play in the homestay all day, you will not get tired!!! There are bicycle trails by the river embankment, you can ride a bicycle or take a walk to enjoy the scenery of nature. From June to August, you can take children to see groups of beetles.

stays.name: 伊彩園民宿
stays.description: 伊彩園民宿位於冬山河畔距森林公園150公尺，位於珍珠社區旁，從屋外嘹望,看到遼闊的視野，綠油油稻田環抱著伊彩園那種自然美景非常幽美,從大門踏出去就可看到美麗冬山火車站，好像身至國外有歐洲的感覺，美麗的櫻花隧道，能夠讓您感受櫻落繽紛的景致；田園的魅力，令人心曠神怡盡在其中。伊彩園四周環境非常幽美，騎著單車在田埂中漫遊，處處傳來陣陣的稻草香,讓您充分的感受，自然溫馨的記憶…您可漫步其中，細細品味浪漫的冬山河畔，有眾多自然生態 ，以美景亦可享受到幽靜輕鬆休閒與寧靜，美麗的冬山河畔景致如畫，滿足達到精神上休憩的最佳方式 。 還有李姐喜傳統戲曲歌仔戲，最古老的椰子殼做的絃，可以拉幾手歌喔！也可以唱幾首跟你們分享唱歌仔戲的樂趣。家裡有寬敞的客廳，並有小舞台另有免費戲服試穿， 體驗一下歌仔戲生活話化。
stays.descriptionEn: Yi Tsai Yuan Homestay is located next to Dongshan River, 150 meters from the forest park, and close to Zhenzhu Community, with a great scenic view of the surrounding areas. Yi Tsai Yuan is embraced by the lush green rice frields, a scene of great natural beauty, and right from the front door you can see the beautiful Dongshan Train Station. You’ll feel as if you’ve been transported to Europe, and can experience the colorful scenery of falling cherry blossoms at the beautiful cherry blossom tunnel. Here, the charm of the countryside fields will lift your spirits and put your mind at ease. Yi Tsai Yuan is surrounded by incredibly beautiful and secluded scenery. Go for a relaxing bike ride between the countryside fields, where you can smell the fragrance of the straw and fully experience the memory of warm nautre. Take a stroll through the area, thoroughly appreciating the romantic atmosphere of the Dongshan River bank, home to several natural ecological areas, where peacefulness, relaxation, leisure, and tranquility may also be experienced through the landscape. Beautiful as a painting, Dongshan River bank is an experience that provides an excellent way to fulfill your need for mental and spiritual relaxation. Also, Ms. Li enjoys traditional Taiwanese opera, playing a few tunes on strings made from coconut shells or singing a few songs, sharing the fun of this art form with guests. The bed and breakfast features a spacious living room with a small stage and costumes that guests can try out free of charge, experiencing the life of traditional Taiwanese opera.

stays.name: 光腳ㄚ民宿
stays.description: 光腳丫民宿是由社團法人宜蘭縣得安家庭關懷協會成立的休閒民宿社會企業，做為青少年就業職能培訓的職場，所雇用的工作人員均為就業職能待加強的青少年，提供青少年餐旅住宿技能培訓。您的每次消費，將幫助這些青少年，就業學習的機會。竭誠歡迎您的蒞臨，體驗親近土地接近自然，光腳丫的樂趣！光腳丫民宿臨近梅花湖風景區、仁山植物園依偎著青山的懷抱，好山、好水,是一處絕佳地休閒的好所在。佔地五百多坪的戶外生態庭園，有民宿主人精心打造的庭園景觀。屋前的蒲葵樹垂直挺拔的樹幹優美的樹姿， 屋後的落羽松，在夏日滿樹蒼翠濃綠令人賞心悅目。在光腳丫民宿你可以騎著腳踏車，悠遊於綠意盎然的田野間，欣賞湖光山色的梅花湖美景，享受休閒輕鬆的快樂時光！你可以體驗古早生活，控窯的童趣！
stays.descriptionEn: Barefoot Springs B&B is a social enterprise and founded by Yilan County DER AN Family Care Association. As a vocational competence training workplace for teenagers, we employ teenagers who need to improve the vocational competence and we offer them training for hotel and catering. Your every visit will offer these teenagers a chance to learn how to work. We are looking forward to your visit. Enjoy the fun of earth and nature with barefoot! We are near the Plum Blossom Designated Scenic Area and Renshan Botanical Garden, natural and the suitable place for leisure activities. With an outdoor lawn over 1650 square meters, we provide you a beautiful and fantastic lawn scenery. There are tall and straight fan palms in front of the house and verdant and lush bald cypresses in the back in summertime, which are adorable and pleasing. In Barefoot Springs B&B, you can ride a bicycle through the fields, enjoy the landscape of Plum Blossom Lake and have a happy time with your friends and family! You can experience the fun of earth oven cooking!

stays.searchText: 光腳ㄚ民宿 光腳ㄚ民宿 宜蘭縣民宿998號 宜蘭縣 冬山鄉 得安村下湖路11巷131弄112號 光腳丫民宿是由社團法人宜蘭縣得安家庭關懷協會成立的休閒民宿社會企業，做為青少年就業職能培訓的職場，所雇用的工作人員均為就業職能待加強的青少年，提供青少年餐旅住宿技能培訓。您的每次消費，將幫助這些青少年，就業學習的機會。竭誠歡迎您的蒞臨，體驗親近土地接近自然，光腳丫的樂趣！光腳丫民宿臨近梅花湖風景區、仁山植物園依偎著青山的懷抱，好山、好水,是一處絕佳地休閒的好所在。佔地五百多坪的戶外生態庭園，有民宿主人精心打造的庭園景觀。屋前的蒲葵樹垂直挺拔的樹幹優美的樹姿， 屋後的落羽松，在夏日滿樹蒼翠濃綠令人賞心悅目。在光腳丫民宿你可以騎著腳踏車，悠遊於綠意盎然的田野間，欣賞湖光山色的梅花湖美景，享受休閒輕鬆的快樂時光！你可以體驗古早生活，控窯的童趣！

stays.description: 冬山康莊民宿｜宜蘭冬山｜親子友善・包棟首選 坐落於宜蘭冬山鄉田野之間的冬山康莊民宿，是一間溫馨舒適的獨棟包棟民宿，擁有寬敞空間與綠意環繞的自然環境，適合親子出遊、朋友聚會或家庭包棟旅宿。 民宿內部設計溫馨明亮，備有齊全的生活設備，讓旅客如同回到家一般自在。戶外空間更有草地可供孩子奔跑遊玩，是親子旅遊的絕佳選擇。 從康莊民宿出發，無論是前往冬山河親水公園、羅東夜市、傳統藝術中心或梅花湖風景區都十分便利，是您深入體驗宜蘭在地風情的理想據點。 來冬山康莊民宿，享受自然、放慢腳步，打造屬於您的療癒假期。
stays.descriptionEn: Kangzhuang Guesthouse｜Dongshan, Yilan｜Family-Friendly Private Villa Stay Nestled in the peaceful countryside of Dongshan Township in Yilan, Kangzhuang Guesthouse is a cozy, private villa perfect for family vacations, friend gatherings, or exclusive stays. Surrounded by lush greenery and open space, it offers a warm and relaxing retreat for guests of all ages. Inside, the guesthouse is bright and welcoming, thoughtfully equipped with all essential amenities to make you feel right at home. The spacious outdoor lawn is ideal for children to play freely, making it an excellent choice for family-friendly travel. Conveniently located near popular attractions like Dongshan River Water Park, Luodong Night Market, the National Center for Traditional Arts, and Meihua Lake, Kangzhuang Guesthouse is the perfect base for exploring the local charm of Yilan. Slow down, reconnect with nature, and enjoy a truly rejuvenating getaway at Kangzhuang Guesthouse.

stays.name: 啓瓦居會館
stays.description: 「宜蘭」是旅人們落腳的必選「啓瓦居」是旅人們放鬆沈澱心靈最佳選擇青山環抱、雲霧繚繞，宛如仙境離開城市的喧囂讓大自然的蟲鳴鳥叫陪伴著輕快的叫著最美妙的旋律本館地於冬山鄉中山休閒農業區內，在地主產素馨茶及柚子為主要農特產品，臨近梅花湖約5分鐘車程，及仁山植物園、新/舊寮瀑布，生態豐富，每年四~五月有油桐花、及螢火蟲，距離冬山火車站車程約8分鐘，為宜蘭最美麗的火車站，周圍更有生態綠舟風景區，是最臨近市區的世外莊園，歡迎大家一起享受這悠閒慢活的美麗時光。
stays.descriptionEn: Yilan is a must-visit place for travelers"Qiwaju" is the best choice for travelers to relax and calm their mindsSurrounded by green mountains and shrouded in clouds and mist, it is like a fairylandGet away from the hustle and bustle of the cityLet the chirping of insects and birds accompany youSinging the most beautiful melodyThe museum is located in the Zhongshan Leisure Agriculture Area of ​​Dongshan Township. The main agricultural products are jasmine tea and pomelo. It is about a 5-minute drive from Meihua Lake, Renshan Botanical Garden, and Xin/Jiuliao Waterfalls. The ecology is rich, and there are tung flowers and fireflies from April to May every year. It is about an 8-minute drive from Dongshan Railway Station. It is the most beautiful railway station in Yilan. There is also the Ecological Green Boat Scenic Area around it. It is the closest secluded manor to the city. Everyone is welcome to enjoy this beautiful time of leisure and slow living.

stays.name: 喆園民宿
stays.description: 喆園歐風宜蘭民宿位於羅東交流道附近，距離羅東夜市10分鐘，國立傳統藝術中心8分鐘，冬山河親水公園徒步可達。南向可見冬山河希臘式的拱形陣列橋，西側面對迷濛的雪山山脈。美麗的外在景緻，搭配金黃色的緬甸實木柚木與義大利帝諾米黃化石所組成的地板、燒木頭的加拿大壁爐、九到十六坪的大套房、二十餘坪景觀極佳的鐵木露台，整體的內在環境，給您舒適放鬆的渡假感覺！女主人早年陪同先生赴美留學，旅居紐約多年，加上經營喆園台中西餐廳十年的經驗，早餐以西式手法為基礎，調和中式口味，提供好看又好吃的餐廳級飲食，給您物超所值的驚喜。
stays.descriptionEn: Philgarden Yilan B&B is located near Luodong Interchange, 10 minutes from Luodong Night Market, 8 minutes from the National Center for Traditional Arts, and within walking distance of Dongshan River Water Park. To the south, you can see the Greek arched array bridge over the Dongshan River, and to the west you face the misty mountains. Besides the beautiful exterior scenery, the floor is made of golden Burmese solid teak and Italian dino beige fossil, the Canadian wood-burning fireplace, the large suites of 9 to 16 square meters, and the ironwood terrace of more than 20 square meters with excellent views, the overall internal environment will give you a comfortable and relaxing holiday feeling!Based on the experience of managing a steakhouse for ten years and living abroad for years, the hostess offers a mixed free breakfast of eastern and western flavors。The menu is altered by seasons, and the quality beyonds its price.

stays.name: 天然居民宿
stays.description: 天然居民宿位於宜蘭縣冬山鄉復興路168號，羅東運動公園旁，為挑高獨棟三層樓建築。全棟開設53扇大窗，通風採光極佳，庭園500坪，有前中後三座庭院，種植百餘種珍貴花木，放眼一片翠綠，陣陣芳香撲鼻。庭院中有逾十噸重巨石，及達三層樓高之五葉松、楓、樟等大樹，尤其中院鋪設細粒黃金砂石，可供赤腳健康按摩，及孩童堆砌玩樂。庭園四周以綠籬為牆，以各式砂石為步道，環保有機又天然，休閒其間，清新自然，令人心曠神怡。如果您也喜歡貼近自然，欣賞樹石，歡迎光臨天然居，來體驗一下客上天然居，居然天上客的感覺吧!
stays.descriptionEn: Nature House Homestay is located at No. 168 Fuxing Road, Dongshan Township, Yilan County, next to Luodong Sports Park, a raised stand-alone 3-story building with 53 large windows providing great ventilation and lighting, grounds covering 1650 square meter grounds, three courtyards – front, middle, and rear, over one hundred types of precious trees and flowers, greenery as far as the eye can see, and a fragrant atmosphere. The courtyard contains a huge stone weighing over 10 tons and big Taiwanese pine, maple, and camphor trees reaching 3 stories in height. The middle courtyard is paved with fine golden gravel, fun for kids to play with or providing healthy therapeutic effect if walked on barefoot. The courtyard is surrounded by a green fence and includes a trail paved with a variety of gravel – environmentally-friendly, organic, and natural. Relax in this refreshing, natural, pleasant environment. If you enjoy being close to nature and appreciating trees and stones, we welcome you to Nature House Homestay, a heavenly experience!

stays.name: 富農民宿
stays.description: 「富農民宿」位於冬山珍珠社區， 鄰近各著名景點，如冬山火車站空中花園、森林公園、冬山河、蘇澳冷泉，武荖坑、羅東運動公園、親水公園等…風景遊樂區， 交通網絡十分的便利。房舍是二樓雙併建築，四週圍繞著綠色植物編織而成的圍籬，悠悠的散發著自然芬多精，外面連接著一片綠油油的稻田，能讓您感受生命舞動與清新；秋收時節，金黃色稻穗，隨風搖曳，更能讓您體會豐收的喜悅！ 「富農民宿」房舍週圍的菜園，隨著季節，種植多種蔬菜或水果，讓住宿遊客可自行採煮，享受這農村生活；另房舍庭園內，有二百多坪廣場可供遊客停車及舉行各種活動，如烤肉、放煙火、放天燈。並備有自行車讓您騎乘悠遊冬山河畔，假若您還為您的旅程規畫行程「富農民宿」一定是您最佳的選擇，歡迎您的光臨。

stays.descriptionEn: The language of orchids – pure beauty. Orchids convey a feeling of nobility and elegance, and the owner of Peaceful Homestay has named the guest rooms after his favorite flower, hoping that every guest, like the flower language of Cattleya, enjoys the friendly hospitality of the people of Yilan, experiencing their frugal work ethic and results of their efforts. During your journey, witness the way these people love their hometown, making every visitor fall in love with this pure, beautiful town. Peaceful Homestay is located in Dongshan Township, Yilan County, close to Luodong Sports Park, Luodong Night Market, Dajin Recreation Park, Meihua Lake Recreation Park, Jhong Shan Recreation Park, Xinliao Waterfall, Wulaokeng Scenic Area, Dongshan River Water Park, and the National Center for Traditional Arts, featuring convenient transportation that makes it your best choice of accommodation.

stays.name: 悠閑渡假民宿
stays.description: 「宜蘭民宿‧悠閑渡假民宿」位於宜蘭縣冬山鄉，為合法宜蘭民宿，鄰近羅東運動公園、梅花湖、羅東夜市、羅東文化工場、羅東林場…等非玩不可的熱門景點。前往上述景點皆僅需約10分鐘路程即可抵達。 「宜蘭民宿‧悠閑渡假民宿」空間寬敞，佔地近850坪，周邊景色清幽宜人，被阡陌農田和翁鬱林木團團環繞的優質環境，搭配廣大的戶外庭園和生態豐富的景觀池，更顯淡雅而悠閑。寬敞潔淨的房型，以簡潔明亮為主要設計基礎，搭配清新淡然的馬卡龍色系和活潑清甜的普普藝術風格，展露簡單大方、溫暖舒適的雅緻氣息，誠摯歡迎旅人的到來～

stays.name: 晨露庄
stays.description: 原汁原味正統民宿，始終維持民宿的核心，非商業化的民宿。我們沒有制式化的服務與招呼!每位到訪的貴賓，猶如我們的家人與朋友，始終秉持著提供旅人一個在宜蘭的""家""的信念，用真心與熱忱接待每一位訪的朋友們，對我們而言，民宿不是生意，民宿是我們與您分享生活的樂趣!坐落在田野間的晨露庄，提供的是民宿分享生活的一種精神，我們不是飯店也不是旅店，我們是您在宜蘭的家!被蟲鳴鳥叫喚醒，代替了機械式的鬧鈴聲，梳洗後，騎著鐵馬...不到五分鐘的時間，一不留神，就遇見美麗的冬山河，沿著河畔享受宜蘭好山好水的洗禮。回到家裡，庄媽早已準備好一桌道地、豐盛的中西式早點，等著您用餐!一家人熱情地招呼與接待每位到訪的貴賓，您絕對可以相信，人與人的距離是可以如此地貼近，縱使素昧平生，卻如同久未謀面的朋友、家人!準備簡單的行李，或是一個人、或是呼朋引伴，暫時脫離現實的生活，到宜蘭來喘口氣，發呆、看書、聽音樂甚至來個深度之旅，讓自己放縱一下，給自己一個寵愛自己的機會!
stays.descriptionEn: A real, authentic bed and breakfast upholding the principles of the trade instead of being over-commercialized. You’ll never be met by standardized or automatic greeting or service here! We treat every guest as a family member or friend and are committed to providing a home for everyone who comes to visit Yilan, hosting each one with sincerity and friendliness. For us, running a bed and breakfast isn’t about money, it’s about sharing the fun of life with you. Located in the countryside, The Dew offers a spirit of sharing in the bed and breakfast life. This isn’t a hotel or motel, it’s your home in Yilan! Wake up to the sound of birds and insects instead of a machine, an alarm clock. After getting washed and dressed, take a 5 minute bike ride and before you know it come into view of the beautiful Dongshan River. Bathe in Yilan’s beautiful scenery along the river, and by the time you return, the owner’s wife will have a rich, authentic Chinese or Western-style breakfast waiting for you! Our family warmly greets and hosts every guest, and you can be sure never to feel like a stranger here. Though we’ve never met, we’re like long-separated family or friends! Pack your bags and come by yourself or with a group of friends, taking a temporary break from life to come to Yilan and take a deep breath, daydream, read, listen to music, or take an in-depth trip. Relax and give yourself the opportunity to be pampered!

stays.name: 楊春旺建築師行館
stays.description: 側鄰宜蘭縣羅東之運動公園，湧泉豐沛，環境幽美。​​​行館空間機能規劃以會議、辦公、住宿、餐飲需求為主軸，其次以綠化停車、斜坡棧道、水簾瀑布、空中花園、景觀透明電梯、藝術廊道、奇木異石、園藝植栽、鋼版藝術及照明燈光設計...等建築元素為輔。​完整建構一棟以工業風格為導向之鋼構玻璃複合式現代建築。​樂曲高妙、高山流水.逢迎佳賓、活水山莊!
stays.descriptionEn: Located adjacent to Luodong Sports Park in Yilan County, the resort boasts abundant springs and a beautiful setting.The resort& #39;s functional space is primarily designed to accommodate conferences, offices, accommodation, and dining, supplemented by architectural elements such as green parking, a ramped boardwalk, a waterfall, a sky garden, a landscaped elevator, an art gallery, unique trees and rocks, horticultural plantings, steel plate art, and lighting design.The resort is a modern, industrial-inspired steel and glass complex.Splendid music, flowing water in the mountains.Welcome guests to the Living Water Villa!

stays.description: 《走進樹說，生活放鬆》生活匆忙想放鬆就到樹說會呼吸的房子_樹說生活Villa樹說生活villa鄰近冬山伯朗大道(三奇美徑)與52甲水鳥濕地 ，映入眼簾是一棟由經典設計師所復育出酷似水泥帳篷的清水模美學空間，以永續環境為主，注重生態環境的完整並保留原有簡約自然建築風格，沒有過多奢華的裝修，構架出內斂沉穩與不凡的氣度， 更像是一間會呼吸的房子。門前抬頭仰望的大樹，和煦的陽光與藍天相映，霎時為大自然天成的美景!樹說生活villa擁有戶外絕美田園景致，讓旅行者放慢腳步隨性走走看看，體驗及造訪冬山鄉村田野遼闊景色的新生活，在都市和自然的轉換中享受不同的休閒野營樂趣，獲得深刻的旅行經驗。無論是家庭旅遊，或是團體住宿，都是您來宜蘭首選的優質民宿!

stays.descriptionEn: "Water Drift Parent-child Homestay" is a homestay (with free parking) located in Dongshan Township, Yilan County, covering an area of ​​1,000 square meters. The location of the B&B is close to Luodong Sports Park and 8 minutes from Luodong Night Market. It is a dream paradise for children. There are not only cisterns for swimming in summer, boating in winter, glazed sandpits, indoor children's play area...etc. Game facilities, as well as vast indoor and outdoor spaces. Even if you play in the homestay all day, you will not get tired!!! There are bicycle trails by the river embankment, you can ride a bicycle or take a walk to enjoy the scenery of nature. From June to August, you can take children to see groups of beetles.

stays.name: 水筠間民宿
stays.description: 水筠間~獨棟庭院Villa套房專屬個人庭院，擁有獨立式度假套房及寬闊的草坪綠地，每間獨立式套房都擁有40坪的私人專屬空間，包含前庭院、獨棟套房、後陽台，可供我們的住客放鬆休閒、供小孩玩耍，院子裡種植各種花草果樹，並闢有全台唯一有機認證之蝶豆花農園及以蝶豆花為主題，占地300坪的蝶豆體驗花園。民宿內有100坪寬敞的停車空間，我們的住客完全不需要擔心停車問題！ 民宿內更是設施豐富多樣，有水生植物生態池、休閒步道、戲水池、發呆亭、籃球場、腳踏車、羽球拍提供客人遊樂與美景拍照！民宿位於羅東與冬山交界，距離各個景點都非常近，如羅東運動公園、羅東夜市、林業文化園區、梅花湖、宜農牧羊場等等，都是騎腳踏車就可以抵達的距離哦！來宜蘭住宿的完美選擇～水筠間民宿！歡迎您的到來^^ *風格套房*天然湧泉戲水池*水生植物生態池*籃球場

stays.descriptionEn: There is an acre of land in everyone’s heart…What do you plant it with? This place used to be a piece of golden rice field, now we have planted love, hope and dream here… Hope you can cast aside the urban noises and escape from the maddening crowd to enjoy tranquility and the Slow Life. How long have you not listened to your own voice? Listen to the bug buzzes and bird chirps, to experience the baptism of nature. The warm breeze and the fragrant rice fields, this is an ideal place to calm one’s spirit, let us soar in this rich rice field and pursue your dream…

stays.name: 涵暄精品民宿
stays.description: 涵暄位於冬山河親水公園(2012國際童玩節會場)與水鳥保護區間，置身其中，幽靜遼闊的美景綻然眼前，一場大自然的盛大饗宴就此上演──映入眼簾的是成千上萬的白鷺鷥，蜻蜓、蝴蝶翩翩起舞，而閒適自得的水鳥環繞其中。 旅人們就在此與大自然寒喧、交流，洗滌流浪已久的心，也濾淨塵世中的喧囂擾嚷。 在這美麗的宜蘭民宿裡，沏上一壺茶，與三五好友一同寒喧，人的情感就像茶味一樣，先苦後甘，與最愛的人一同品味人生、體會人生、享受人生，最美的旅程，莫過於此。給自己一個機會，享受身、心、靈的震撼體驗，來此一起在時光裡揮寫最雋永回憶。在蒼穹畫布下行走，勾勒自己的人生旅途──我們的自畫像。旅人與大自然為伍，大自然就是他們的家，也是他們的被與枕。不自覺想往那隱形的牆面穿透而去，涵暄是陽光與影的社交場合，我們舞動，我們恣意的翱翔，似乎沒有一絲的傾斜，宜蘭民宿「涵暄」成了旅人心中最佳的桃花源，旅人們也找到屬於自己的家園～涵暄。玻璃牆面向外傾斜的15°，完美地平衡了雙眼，涵暄是一棟會呼吸的建築物，流動的視野感官，每一處角落的投射，都是一個嶄新世界。大量極簡的黑與白，時尚元素演出地十分盡興，檜木與柚木的溫潤色輕灑四周，巧妙的調和了極簡時尚的冷調溫度。我們的宜蘭民宿剛中帶柔，浪漫與理性的氛圍兼具，穿透了人與自然的空間藩籬，歡迎各位貴賓到此～
stays.descriptionEn: The Han Shian Boutique is located between Dong Shan River Park (the site of 2012 Yilan International Children's Folklore and Folk Game Festival) and Lanyang Estuary Waterbird Refuge, at here, the secluded vast natural beauty is blossoming in front you, a nature's grand feast is staging ─ ─ you are greeted by thousands dancing white egrets, dragonflies, butterflies, and quiet contented waterfowl surround them. Travellers chat with nature communicating and washing their long wandering heart, but also filter completely the hustle bustle in this world. In this beautiful B&B in Yilan, brew a pot of tea, chat with a few friends together. People's emotions like the flavor of tea, sweet after the first bitter. The most beautiful journey is no more than sharing life with favorite people, experiencing and enjoying life together. Offer yourself a chance to enjoy a shocking experience of your body, mind, and spirit. Come here we write the most meaningful memories in time spent together. Walk under canvas in the sky, and sketch our own life journey ─ ─ our self-portrait. Travelers get together with nature, and nature is their home, their cover and pillow. Unconsciously, want to penetrate the invisible wall. Han Shian Boutique is a social occasion of light and shadow, we dance, we fly unbridled, and it seems that there is no trace of tilting, "Han Shian Boutique" in Yilan has become a Utopia in the minds of travelers and they also find their own home--Han Shian Boutique. Glass walls are outwardly inclined 15°, a perfect balance to eyes, Han Shian Boutique is a building that can breathe, with the flow of vision senses, every corner's projection is a new world. Lots of minimalist black and white, fashion elements enjoy themselves to the full. The warm colors of cypress and teak wood sprinkle around lightly, having cleverly harmonized the cool temperatures of minimalist fashion. Our B&B has both soft and strong natures, romantic atmosphere blend with rational ambience, penetrating the barriers between man and natural space. Welcome to Han Shian Boutique.

stays.name: 珍珠壹伍零民宿
stays.description: 高CP值宜蘭民宿推薦/宜蘭親子民宿推薦/宜蘭包棟民宿驀然之間，心裡就會浮出這樣的念頭：是時候，來一段簡簡單單的旅行沒有期限，沒有束縛放慢腳步，帶上背包一段旅程，一種心情一趟微雨之城的輕旅行走過 漫無邊際的田野欣賞 鄉野的自然風貌感受 質樸的休閒氛圍位於冬山鄉正中心，置於黃金大海中四周圍繞著阡陌交錯的田園景觀，官帽般的建築，就是民宿─珍珠壹伍零晨，光芒四射，喚醒萬物，充滿朝氣夜，繁星點點，燭光迷離，微醺迷人春 如畫般秧苗倒影夏 纍纍結實金黃稻浪秋 颯颯秋風另有滋味冬 暖陽乍現沃野千里遇見美食 邂逅美景 認識新朋友寂靜歡喜，安然於心，愜意自在 我想這就是旅行的目的珍珠壹伍零最適合全家大小、親朋好友相揪包棟住宿，無論是體驗親子活動、泳池戲水，歡唱或牌聚，珍珠壹伍零早已為您備妥，就等待您親自入住，感受宜蘭田野間的閒適恬靜。
stays.descriptionEn: High CP value Yilan homestay recommendation / Yilan family homestay recommendation / Yilan Baodong homestaySuddenly, the thought will come to mind: it is time to come to a simple tripNo deadlines, no constraintsSlow down and bring your backpackA journey, a moodA light trip to the city of light rainWalk through the endless fieldsAdmire the natural beauty of the countrysideFeel the rustic casual atmosphereLocated in the very center of Dongshan Township, placed in the golden seaSurrounded by an idyllic landscape of strange and strange people,The official hat-like building is a homestay - pearl one wu zeroMorning, radiant, awakens all things, full of vitalityNight, starry, candlelight confused, slightly drunk charmingSpring is reflected in a picturesque seedlingSummer strands are fruity with golden rice wavesAutumn breeze has another tasteThe warm winter sun suddenly appears fertile for thousands of milesMeet the food Meet the scenery Meet the new peopleSilence rejoices, peace of mind, ease I guess that's the purpose of the tripPearl OneWood Zero is most suitable for the whole family, relatives and friends to fight each other to stay in the house, whether it is to experience parent-child activities, pool play, singing or card gathering, Pearl OneWood Zero has long been prepared for you, waiting for you to personally check in, feel the leisure and tranquility between the fields of Yilan.

stays.description: 生態綠舟民宿建於 2017 年，民宿位在冬山鄉，並提供舒適的住宿空間。館內舖有硬木地板，室內裝飾簡潔。民宿創立宗旨為提供房客悠閒自在的生活空間。全館提供免費 WiFi。民宿距離冬山河親水公園有 1.4 公里，距離冬山火車站則有 2 公里。距離最近的機場為台北松山機場，距離 52 公里。每間客房均配有平面電視。部分房型則設有露台或陽台。私人衛浴內配有淋浴設備，並備有USB充電座及拖鞋及吹風機等。公共區域內設有共用大型餐桌，客人可於此享用美味餐點。
stays.descriptionEn: Ecology River is located in Dongshan, just 11.3 km from Yilan City.Every room at this family stay is air conditioned and features a flat-screen TV with cable channels. A terrace or balcony are featured in certain rooms. Each room has a private bathroom equipped with a shower. For your comfort, you will find slippers, free toiletries and a hairdryer.There is a shared kitchen at the property.Jiaoxi is 19.3 km from Ecology River, and Wulai is 33.8 km from the property. The nearest airport is Taipei Songshan Airport, 51.5 km from Ecology River.

stays.name: 神仙灣休閒別館
stays.description: 神仙灣休閒別館位於羅東市區和郊區的交接處，於是不但能體驗田園鄉村風光，距離市區也僅需10分鐘車程，鄰近羅東運動公園，不妨到此活動筋骨還可領略大自然之美。您可抬頭欣賞眼前的花園景觀，此時此刻，您享有的不只是人生的浪漫，還有王公貴族般的尊貴與殊榮。 神仙灣是由屋主一手精心策劃設計，室內呈現古典風華的裝潢更可媲美五星級， 周圍擁有綠色植物及天然岩石造景水池，神仙灣備有多間典雅精緻的大套房，每間客房皆以精雕細琢為發想，營造出一種歷久彌新、古色古香的氣氛，少了些商業化，多了點藝術感，塑造出極具內涵的風格，給予的不僅僅是房間，而是集結貼心與感性，將您的渡假停留在這最美的住宿環境中。
stays.descriptionEn: Celestial Bed and Breakfast is located between the outskirts and center of Luodong, providing guests the opportunity to experience countryside scenery as well as being only a 10 minute drive from the city center. We’re near Luodong Sports Park, where you can stretch out your muscles and appreciate the beauty of nature. Look up and appreciate the flower garden before you, and realize you’re experiencing not just the romance of life but the honor and nobility of royalty. Celestial Bed and Breakfast was planned and designed by the owner himself, with classical-style interior decoration rivaling 5-star hotels, while the area is surrounded by green plants and a natural stone landscape pond. We offer several large, exquisite, elegant suite rooms, and each room features concepts of fine carving craftsmanship, creating a lasting antique atmosphere with an artistic rather than commercial feel, establishing a highly interesting and tasteful style that exhibits not just rooms but attentive service and acute perception. Let your vacation linger at this most beautiful living environment.

stays.name: 稻哪趣
stays.description: 寬敞的庭園綠草如茵，兩旁的小樹盡情生長，長長的碎石子路延伸至底端，映入眼簾的是一棟溫馨簡單的小木屋建築，一踏進門，溫暖柔和的客廳擁抱了入門的旅客，疲倦的身驅逐漸獲得紓解。「稻哪趣包棟民宿The Paddy Hostel」座落在宜蘭冬山河旁，鄰近珍珠社區稻草工藝館、冬山河森林公園、冬山河親水公園，是一個想要親近山水自然的好住所。「稻哪趣包棟民宿The Paddy Hostel」座落於一畦畦的水稻中，以峇厘島風格為設計主軸，且採用預約包棟的方式營運，為旅客提供一個完整而獨立、溫馨且悠閒自在的住宿空間，設施包含了客廳、餐廳、廚房、衛浴設備及臥房，旅客可以自行運用，最適合三五好友或是大家庭來此住宿，不管是要通霄打牌或是享受狂歡派對都不怕被打擾。
stays.descriptionEn: Before entering "Paddy Hostel", you can find a large garden with randomly trimmed trees and gravel path leading to a simple but cozy cabin. Here you can fully restore from fatigue. The "Paddy Hostel" , on the west bank of Dongshan River, provides fast access to Pearl Community Straw and Technology Museum, Dongshan River Forest Park and Dongshan River Water Park, and it's apparently the paradise for nature lovers! Surrounded by rice fields and taking the atmosphere of Bali, the "Paddy Hostel" is available for whole building reservation, where the visitors enjoy an autonomic vacation by renting a rural house fully equipped with living room, dining room, kitchen, washing room and beds for a day. This is ideal for traveling with your friends or family and you won't feel sorry for staying up all night playing or holding parties.

stays.searchText: 稻哪趣 稻哪趣 宜蘭縣民宿1223號 宜蘭縣 冬山鄉 珍珠一路392號 寬敞的庭園綠草如茵，兩旁的小樹盡情生長，長長的碎石子路延伸至底端，映入眼簾的是一棟溫馨簡單的小木屋建築，一踏進門，溫暖柔和的客廳擁抱了入門的旅客，疲倦的身驅逐漸獲得紓解。「稻哪趣包棟民宿The Paddy Hostel」座落在宜蘭冬山河旁，鄰近珍珠社區稻草工藝館、冬山河森林公園、冬山河親水公園，是一個想要親近山水自然的好住所。「稻哪趣包棟民宿The Paddy Hostel」座落於一畦畦的水稻中，以峇厘島風格為設計主軸，且採用預約包棟的方式營運，為旅客提供一個完整而獨立、溫馨且悠閒自在的住宿空間，設施包含了客廳、餐廳、廚房、衛浴設備及臥房，旅客可以自行運用，最適合三五好友或是大家庭來此住宿，不管是要通霄打牌或是享受狂歡派對都不怕被打擾。

stays.descriptionEn: Yilan B&B Fairy Tale Village Ecological Farm B&B has been awarded the Top 100 Hospitality B&Bs by the Bureau of Tourism, the Council of Agriculture& #39;s Special Field Certification, and Yilan County& #39;s Accommodation, Catering, and Experience Service Quality Certification. Located next to Luodong Night Market, Children& #39;s Play Festival, Dongshan River Ecological Oasis-Green Expo, and Meihua LakeIf you don& #39;t want to drive around, you can also stay + day trip. There are many attractions nearby and many people stay for 2-3 nights. Friends who don& #39;t want to just stay can also purchase Fairy Tale Village to find rice happiness-Four Seasons Happy Farm Experience Fun, 1680 yuan per person, 1280 yuan per person for 10 people: Included: Flower and fruit tea or freshly ground coffee + feeding fish to drink + touching clams to catch big-bellied fish & black shells + letting big-bellied fish do foot massage + plane maze game + taking photos with dwarfs and seasonal experience DIY activities: January-December: pulling onions, planting onions (Cong), washing onions, making scallion pancakes DIY; picking silkworms and mulberries at the end of March and the beginning of May (creative competition- Tree Doctor Experience), firefly viewing from March to June, rhinoceros beetle season from May to July, rice harvesting, rice rubbing, rice milling experience, and dressing the rice in the king& #39;s new clothes to take home to enjoy, picking roselle from September to November to make roselle enzyme DIY, picking jujubes from December to February to make golden jujube enzyme DIY or cutting winter plums to make plum vinegar DIY and enjoy the rich sea and land hotpot from the friendly farming in the fairy tale village to the good farming garden directly to the table~ Tour the natural ecology of Meihua Lake and eat all the special snacks in Yilan, which will surprise you everywhere~ look forward to your arrival~ and go home with full of memories, booking fun line:@drz9142s, wechat: m0932090003, WhatsApp: +886932090003

stays.description: 位於宜蘭縣的民宿,有多久 沒讓生活步調慢下來又多久 沒讓心靈沉澱下來又有多久 沒讓身心保持愉快傾聽 大自然的聲音遠離繁忙的都市叢林，留下繁忙的步伐踩著愉悅的腳步前往純樸的鄉村生活來個美麗的竹跡之旅吧!竹跡取其諧音「足跡」希望每個旅客，在歡樂的氣氛中度過愉快的假日，在放鬆心情、充電後能取竹子屹立不搖、不畏艱難的生長精神，內心充滿愉悅得去面對美好的未來，並期待下一個假日的到來。
stays.descriptionEn: Bed and Breakfast in Yilan County,How long did it take to slow down the pace of life, how long did it take for the soul to settle down, how long did it take to keep the body and mind happy, listen to the voice of nature, stay away from the busy urban jungle, leave the busy pace and go to the simple rural life with pleasant steps Let’s have a beautiful trip to bamboo trails! Bamboo trails are homonyms for “footprints”. We hope that every traveler will spend a happy holiday in a happy atmosphere. After relaxing and recharging, you can take bamboo to stand firm and grow without fear of difficulties. Spirited and filled with joy to face the bright future and look forward to the next holiday.

stays.description: 宜蘭｜米修B&B．童話般的木作之家白色的雲飄在宜蘭冬山的晴空，你哼著歌，走在鄉間小徑，突然，聽見小狗的活力叫聲，一隻黑白相間的吉娃娃，用閃閃發亮的大眼睛盯著你，背後一棟用米白、咖啡色堆疊成的三層樓房映入雙眼，歡迎來到米修B&B！ 鄉間的木頭奇遇記推開低矮的木柵門，院子裡的花草正盎然地生長著，紅蜻蜓一路伴你沿著碎石子小徑走到門口，門廊上放著一座穩固的木作鞋櫃，上頭一張黑板被彩色粉筆繽紛寫上：「米修B&B，宿、木工、玩生活」。推開門，一整間色彩豐富的木作家具，讓室內彷彿也成了小森林，抬頭，還有一整窗的藍天綠意，就像童話裡小精靈的家！這一個童話般的家，是主人用心打造的作品，門口的狗屋，就是女主人米修第一個木工作品，為了給自己的狗寶貝Bogi打造一個溫暖的窩，從此變身帥氣女木工！她拉了喜歡DIY的阿鐵一起，身為米修的第一助手，阿鐵對木工的熱愛則是源自於本性的「手賤」，過去甚至還幫SGS檢驗工作！最後他們在屋後搭了一間小小的木工房，親手實踐了他們夢想中的家。有溫度的木工手作房，三段不同顏色的迷你童話走上樓，米修的三間房用大自然的三光色發揮創意：紅色、藍色、綠色，每間房彷彿都是一段段迷你童話。第一頁是小向日葵在紅花圃成長的故事。「瑞德溫房」，是為你與心愛的毛小孩準備的天堂；彩色的枕頭，各種粉嫩色彩的牆壁，組合成一段愉悅的睡前時光。第二頁是小精靈在綠森林裡的奇幻冒險。「格林森房」，是唯一的四人房，適合你與朋友分享假期的祕密基地，天花板邊，一隻紅色恐龍被汽球拉上了天空，肚子上的時鐘喀啦喀啦走，彷彿在暗示，通往歡樂的冒險就在此刻！上了三樓，打開第三頁，人魚公主分享著她在藍色海底世界的故事。「布魯水瀾房」，架高的木頭地板上是一排打高的藍色浪花做床頭板，唯一可以泡澡的浴室，是夢幻的粉色，也是人魚公主給你們的浪漫祝福。
stays.descriptionEn: Yilan｜Meishiou B&B A Fairytale-Like Carpenter’s HouseWhite clouds drift through the clear, blue Yilan skies as you sing a song and stroll along the country lanes. Suddenly, you hear the energetic barking of a little dog. A little black and white Chihuahua stares at you with its sparkling big eyes. Behind it, a three-level building painted in off-white and brown comes into view. Welcome to Meishiou B&B!Countryside memoirs of a happy encounter with woodPushing open the low, wooden gate, you enter a garden filled with lush and vibrant flowers and plants. Red dragonflies accompany you down the crushed stone pathway right up to the front door. On the veranda, you find a sturdy wooden shoe cabinet above which a blackboard has been colorfully decorated with the words “Meishiou B&B: lodging, woodworking, playful life.” You open the door to a room full of richly colored wooden furniture, giving the interior the feeling of a small forest. Lifting your head, you see a beautiful scene of blue sky and green trees out the window, and you feel as if you’ve entered the home of a fairytale elf!This fairytale-like home and all the beautiful furniture within is a product of the hard work of your hosts. The doghouse in the entrance is your hostess Meishiou’s first woodworking project, to create a warm little corner for her beloved dog, Bogi. She has since transformed herself into a stylish female carpenter! She dragged Piety, who loves DIY projects, into her plan, to become her number-one helper. Piety’s passion for carpentry, however, originates from his inherent desire to get his hands on everything around him. He once even helped SGS to do inspection work! Eventually, they built a tiny woodworking shop behind their house, helping to establish their dream home. A cozy, warm woodworking shop, a miniature tri-color fairytaleGoing up stairs, you see Meishiou’s creativity in the natural tri-color decor: red, blue, and green. Each room seems to embody its own miniature fairytale. The first page of the tale tells the story of a sunflower growing up in a safflower garden. With multi-colored pillows and tender-colored walls, the “Red Warmth Room” is a little paradise just for you and your furry friend, set up to give you the most delightful experience before settling in for bed.The second page of the tale tells of an elf’s fantasy adventure in the green forest. The “Green Forest Room” is the only four-person room at Meishiou B&B, serving as the perfect secret base for you and your friends to share a vacation together. A red dinosaur dangling from a floating balloon drifts up near the ceiling, the clock on his belly tick-tocking away as if to suggest that this is the moment for a joyous adventure to begin!On the third floor, you open the third page of the tale, where a mermaid princess shares her story about the world beneath the sea. The “Blue Waters Room” has an elevated wooden floor with a row of tall blue waves for bed headboards. This room has the only bathtub, and it’s pink, like a romantic blessing from the mermaid princess.A fairytale home converging with real lifeIn the morning, you walk out onto the balcony, take a deep breath of that fresh, clean Yilan air, and catch a whiff of a delicious breakfast cooking! Soy milk, a fresh fruit and vegetable salad, mashed potato balls, soft-boiled eggs, and perfectly toasted bread combine for a simple yet perfectly energizing breakfast. If you’re intrigued by Meishiou and Piety’s woodworking life, you can book a seat in Friday’s woodworking course for a chance to hammer around with Meishiou in the workshop! Different than your standard carpentry course, Meishiou enjoys using love to create woodcrafts with her guests. Piety humorously refers to their workshop as their “delivery room” where you can experience with your own hands the satisfaction of creating things from wood.The warm feeling inside the house is just like the interaction between Meishiou and Piety – comfortable and cozy. When they met each other, one had just completed a job, while the other had fallen in love with hiking as a way of coping with a break up. They began hiking, fishing, and bicycle-riding together - they’ve even conquered half of the hundred highest peaks in Taiwan. Having an unspoken understanding of one another, they began to construct their guesthouse together. They’ve been through a lot in their countryside life; even though Piety recently fell seriously ill, the illness was unable to defeat them as they faced it with unyielding optimism. This fairytale-like home is not simply a physical building. Even more so, Meishiou B&B is a product of the charisma of its hosts.

stays.description: 「索菲亞」座落於鄉野田園間，清晨可觀賞日出的燦爛，而夜晚星光與燈光交織出的美麗景緻，更是閃閃動人。 推開大門，歐式豪華的公共空間，一排排俄羅斯娃娃正迎接著您。舒適典雅的房間，寧靜的居家環境，只聽到窗外可愛的鳥兒正在輕快的唱著歌，站在陽台前，遠眺一望無的田園景觀，每到夏天一畝畝綠油油的稻田隨風搖拽，秋天來臨時，綠油油的稻田轉為一串串飽滿的稻穗，冬天則變成一畦畦的小水池，映著藍色的天空。 索菲亞一年四季都有不同的景觀變化，等著您來體會。

stays.searchText: 索菲亞民宿 索菲亞民宿 宜蘭縣民宿1347號 宜蘭縣 冬山鄉 安農六路12號 「索菲亞」座落於鄉野田園間，清晨可觀賞日出的燦爛，而夜晚星光與燈光交織出的美麗景緻，更是閃閃動人。 推開大門，歐式豪華的公共空間，一排排俄羅斯娃娃正迎接著您。舒適典雅的房間，寧靜的居家環境，只聽到窗外可愛的鳥兒正在輕快的唱著歌，站在陽台前，遠眺一望無的田園景觀，每到夏天一畝畝綠油油的稻田隨風搖拽，秋天來臨時，綠油油的稻田轉為一串串飽滿的稻穗，冬天則變成一畦畦的小水池，映著藍色的天空。 索菲亞一年四季都有不同的景觀變化，等著您來體會。

stays.name: 美好生活
stays.description: 在宜蘭冬山藏了個值得推薦的鄉村風味濃厚的民宿，它的名字就像它希望帶給住宿旅客們的感受一樣，它就叫做『美好生活』。來到冬山『美好生活』您可以完全的放鬆，每個小細節都是老闆的用心，這裡的所有裝飾都能讓您宛如身在歐洲一般，您能感覺到普羅旺斯紫色的浪漫，也能感覺到莫內花園藝術的氣息，您可以坐在擁有法國鄉村風的吧台上喝一口濃濃的咖啡或著來杯花茶慢慢的品嚐…，您也可以帶本您最喜愛的書，坐在滿是溫馨的客廳裡渡過愉快的一天…。訂房可以加Line:8f3188
stays.descriptionEn: There is a charming countryside B&B hidden in Yilan's Mt. Dongshan that we highly recommend. Its name evokes a feeling that visitors look for when they are away from home - Beautiful Life B&B.When you come to Mt. Dongshan's Beautiful Life B&B, you will feel complete relaxation because the owner takes care of every little detail. The decor and furnishings evoke the European sensibility. You will be touched by the Provence-inspired romantic purple room, and Monet's garden art-inspired room. You can enjoy a cup of perfectly brewed coffee or sip a cup of floral scented tea at the French country style bar. Maybe you can lounge in the warm and inviting living room and read your favorite book, and spend a perfectly relaxing day.bookings can be added Line:8f3188

stays.description: 老公老婆既是親密愛人，亦是知心好友的暱稱，這就是我們的命名宗旨!以老公疼惜老婆的心，我們想把不添加化學成分的純淨飲食及友善健康的民宿分享給大家! 老公老婆友善民宿以友善&健康為經營理念，致力於提供健康無毒的住宿環境。友善指不使用農藥及化肥、除草劑的耕作方式，民宿主人是縣府輔導之友善小農。室外農園大量植樹，建構香水蓮生態池，堅持使用天然低毒性之清潔劑&洗劑，力行對環境友善。室內布置雅致，以原木家具為主，輕裝潢低汙染，設置無障礙設施，以減少化學物質吸入，力行對人友善。主人具備食品專業及中餐&烘焙乙丙級證照，深知化學添加物之過患，並特別選用天然食材，為房客開設農園體驗&純淨飲食DIY體驗課程。 老公老婆友善民宿位於宜蘭縣冬山鄉柯林村，近羅東運動公園、夜市、梅花湖、柯林湧泉、安農溪、宜農牧場等知名景點。民宿面對羅東溪左岸，視野遼闊氣象萬千，朝迎旭日暮送彩霞夜觀星月，左眺龜山島右望三清宮，景觀優美怡人心神，是到宜蘭度假者的優質民宿。
stays.descriptionEn: Sometimes you call your lover or best friend "My sweetie," and that is exactly why we name our B&B as "my sweetie homestay"! Just imagining how a husband would treat his beloved wife, we have the same feeling to share the pure food and friendly people with you. Taking friendliness and health as the business theories,"my sweetie homestay" is committed to providing the tourists a healthy and non-toxic accommodation. "Friendliness" means being friendly to the earth, which means cultivating and tilling without using insecticides, chemical fertilizer or herbicides. The host is an eco-friendly farmer supported by the County Government. In the plantation, we planted lots of trees, constructed a water lily ecological pond and only use natural detergents and cleaning solutions. We try our best to be friendly to the Earth. Inside the house, we put the furniture made of logs, and set up the barrier-free facilities. There is less decoration in the house; thus, we make low pollution and reduce the chance for people breathing in the chemical substance. We try our best to be friendly towards people. The host is a food expert and has the certificates of Level B and C technician for Chinese culinary and for baking food. He knows well that chemical additives are harmful, so he selects the best natural food ingredients for you. You can experience the plantation life and cook with clean ingredients. My sweetie homestay is located in Kelin Village, Dongshan Township, Yilan County, and is close to resorts like Luodong Sports Park, night market, Plum Blossom Lake, Kelin Fountain, Annong River and E-long goat farm. The B&B is near Luodong River, and you would have an extensive view - the sunrise in the morning, the sunset in the evening, and stars and moon at night. Besides, you would see Guishan Island on your left and San-Ching-Kung on the right. The scenic beauty will definitely refresh your mind. Welcome to the best B&B of Yilan!

stays.name: 聽湖
stays.description: 聽湖民宿，一幢座落於宜蘭冬山梅花湖風景區的優雅建築，俐落的白底黑框，大片的玻璃、通透的採光，搭配現代簡約木質、石紋風格，寬敞舒適的公共空間，梨樹、柚樹、桔樹與落羽松相互唱和的綠意庭院，莊園級的恬靜享受。聽湖民宿位於宜蘭縣冬山鄉梅花湖休閒農業區，地理位置連接二鎮（羅東鎮、蘇澳鎮）與四鄉（三星鄉、大同鄉、南澳鄉、五結鄉），在此可以包覽特色湖泊、群樹山林、農田稻浪、果樹結實纍纍的自然田園風光。我們距離梅花湖僅500公尺，雖寧靜卻不偏僻，只要10分鐘車程即可抵熱鬧的羅東市區，並且鄰近仁山植物園、新寮瀑布、道教達總廟三清宮、冬山河生態綠舟、羅東運動公園、羅東夜市等知名遊憩景點。來到聽湖民宿，我們有雙人房、三人房、四人房、歡聚包棟等房型供您挑選。除了寬敞舒適的公共空間、綠意深深的群樹庭院，聽湖民宿的咖啡廳也期待您的來訪，輕啜一口午後的溫潤與醇厚，美好的假期等您來細細品味。

stays.name: 芯園民宿
stays.description: 當你步入『芯園』的大廳，廳內門口旁，掛著兩塊造型典雅的匾，寫著：「無論你來自何方，此刻我只在乎你。」另一塊寫著：「我如此用心，只想博得你的感動。」這就是芯園之美…我們提供每座城堡獨享的英國式浪漫早餐，晚上還有微醺調酒，房間裡有自動現磨咖啡機及有機花茶，記得帶相機留下美美的回憶，期待讓您從進到芯園後所有的氛圍都是美的。打開房門的剎那間，感動了每雙眼睛，簡直就是童話中公主與王子住的那種夢幻城堡。芯園曾在2000年獲得宜蘭縣最美麗花園殊榮。園區裡栽種各式各樣的花卉，吸引著許多新人來此拍攝婚紗照，電視劇組紛紛來此取景，日本的電視台也來採訪，因此得了『比英國還要英國的美稱。』常有人問我們，當一個民宿主人最快樂的是甚麼？就是當朋友們對我揮手道再見時對我說〝只要有空，我一定要再回到這裡〞！芯園是一個擁抱幸福的驛站，讓客人帶著溫暖與幸福離開，並且經常懷念這裡的美好。
stays.descriptionEn: As you enter the main hall of Xin Yuan House, you’ll notice two elegantly-shaped inscribed boards next to the door, bearing the words “I only care about you, no matter where you’re from” and “I hope my effort can win your heart.” This is the beauty of Xin Yuan House. We provide each castle with its own romantic English-style breakfast in the morning and mild-strength cocktails in the evening. Rooms come with automatic coffee machines and organic flower tea. Don’t forget to bring your camera and leave behind beautiful memories. We hope you enjoy a wonderful atmosphere from the moment you enter Xin Yuan House. Every guest is instantly impressed the moment he or she enters the room – it’s a castle for princes and princesses, straight out of a fairy tale. In 2000, we were honored as the Most Beautiful Garden Bed and Breakfast by Yilan County. The garden is full of a variety of flowers, attracting a number of newlyweds to take wedding photographs here. We’ve also been the setting for several television shows as well as being interviewed by Japanese TV and thereby earning the reputation of having “more authentic style than England itself.” People often ask, “What’s the best part of being a bed and breakfast owner?” When friends wave goodbye and say, “When I have time, I’m definitely coming back!” Xin Yuan House is a rest stop embracing happiness, leaving guests with a feeling of warmth and happiness as they depart and knowing the wonder of this place will always be a part of their memories.

stays.searchText: 芯園民宿 芯園民宿 宜蘭縣民宿020號 宜蘭縣 冬山鄉 珍珠村富農路一段312巷120號 當你步入『芯園』的大廳，廳內門口旁，掛著兩塊造型典雅的匾，寫著：「無論你來自何方，此刻我只在乎你。」另一塊寫著：「我如此用心，只想博得你的感動。」這就是芯園之美…我們提供每座城堡獨享的英國式浪漫早餐，晚上還有微醺調酒，房間裡有自動現磨咖啡機及有機花茶，記得帶相機留下美美的回憶，期待讓您從進到芯園後所有的氛圍都是美的。打開房門的剎那間，感動了每雙眼睛，簡直就是童話中公主與王子住的那種夢幻城堡。芯園曾在2000年獲得宜蘭縣最美麗花園殊榮。園區裡栽種各式各樣的花卉，吸引著許多新人來此拍攝婚紗照，電視劇組紛紛來此取景，日本的電視台也來採訪，因此得了『比英國還要英國的美稱。』常有人問我們，當一個民宿主人最快樂的是甚麼？就是當朋友們對我揮手道再見時對我說〝只要有空，我一定要再回到這裡〞！芯園是一個擁抱幸福的驛站，讓客人帶著溫暖與幸福離開，並且經常懷念這裡的美好。

stays.description: 「宜蘭民宿．蘭陽四季會館」，位於冬山河上游，河畔兩側有冬山河自行車道，也鄰近冬山河生態綠舟、冬山火車站、梅花湖、武荖坑、仁山植物園、羅東林業文化園區，車程半小時內也可到達親水公園、傳統藝術中心、羅東運動公園、南方澳內埤情人灣。「宜蘭民宿．蘭陽四季會館」，是一結合現代與摩登設計感的合法宜蘭民宿，走進寬敞明亮的大廳，在親切熱情的民宿主人接待下，就像回家般的自在，空間中運用巧妙的飾品與燈光，展現無壓迫感的舒適空間，客房大片落地窗的設計，讓您隨時都可欣賞室外四季不同變化的景致，讓遼闊的視野洗滌身心靈的疲憊，更能細細體會到這悠閒的自然風光所帶來的愉悅。「宜蘭民宿．蘭陽四季會館」，提供二人、家庭與包棟的住宿服務方式，貴族系列套房，您可以在戶外的小院子放鬆心情的躺在躺椅上，早上可享受日出時陽光的灑落，與入夜的鄉野蟲嗚蛙叫；尊爵系列套房，可於戶外座椅上，欣賞著夕陽下山的景致、黃昏的澄黃浪漫，與入夜後鄉野的蟲嗚蛙叫。輕鬆渡過一個悠閒、自在的假期。
stays.descriptionEn: Yilan B&B · Lanyang Four Seasons Pavilion is located in the upper reaches of the Dongshan River. Bicycle paths run along both sides of the river, and it is close to Dongshan River Ecoark, Dongshan Train Station, Meihua Lake, Wulaokeng Scenic Area, Renshan Botanical Garden, and Luodong Forestry Culture Park. Within a 30-minute drive, you can also reach the Water Park, National Center for Traditional Arts, Luodong Sports Park, and Neipi Lovers Bay in Nanfang’ao.Yilan B&B · Lanyang Four Seasons Pavilion is a legal and stylishly designed B&B that combines modern and contemporary aesthetics. Upon entering the spacious and bright lobby, you are warmly welcomed by the friendly hosts, making you feel right at home. The interior features clever decorations and lighting, creating a comfortable, pressure-free space. The large floor-to-ceiling windows in the rooms allow you to enjoy the ever-changing scenery of the four seasons, refreshing both body and mind while immersing you in the relaxing beauty of nature.Yilan B&B · Lanyang Four Seasons Pavilion offers accommodations for couples, families, and full-house rentals. In the Noble Suite Series, you can relax on a lounge chair in the outdoor garden, basking in the morning sunshine or listening to the night-time chorus of insects and frogs. In the Prestige Suite Series, you can enjoy the view of the sunset and golden dusk while seated outdoors, along with the calming rural night sounds. Experience a relaxing and leisurely vacation here.

stays.name: 貝多芬田園渡假別墅
stays.description: 宜蘭包棟民宿|貝多芬田園度假別墅：可烤肉打籃球，距離羅東市區開車僅八分鐘的平價包棟民宿。室外可烤肉、有籃球場、綠地草坪，民宿提供了幾台自行車，讓住宿客人可以輕騎馳騁在蘭陽平原的田園小徑。室內有開放廚房並為客人備有一套鍋碗盤，客廳的音響擴大器、DVD播放器、投影機、適合看電影，民宿為獨棟建築想打麻將下棋、也不用怕打擾鄰居，一樓客廳與二樓房間都有個藏書閣，讓客人閒暇可以徜徉在書香裡。喜愛彈鋼琴的住宿客人，也能使用客廳的平台鋼琴，彈奏給親朋好友聆聽、自娛娛人。民宿房型是二樓有三間套房、分別是二間四人房、一間兩人房，一樓有一間四人雅房。早餐是民宿最主要特色，自助式中西式Buffet是我們當天早上現煮多樣菜餚，與多樣小菜，南瓜濃湯、水果、果汁，早上用餐時會有民宿女主人現場鋼琴演奏給住客聆聽。在客人check-out前，我們會幫客人拍照，再利用好多時間挑選及整理美化照片，最後再把照片上傳給客人及貝多芬田園度假別墅粉絲團：https://www.facebook.com/beethovenbnb，讓每次住宿客人包棟後都能留下滿滿笑容的回憶照片。

stays.name: 雅第三合院民宿
stays.description: 訂房專線：03-954-6377「開荒南野際 手拙歸田園；戶庭無塵雜 虛室有餘閒」-陶淵明的歸園田居，多麼令人嚮往的田園詩境，現在想要身歷古人田園情境，不再只能是夢裡尋覓的夢境或是發呆想像的畫面，只要從台北市花40分鐘來一趟宜蘭『雅第三合院民宿』，就能深刻體驗詩中田園風光和農家與世無爭生活。『雅第三合院民宿』擁有挑高寬敞的室內空間，現代化歐式廚房設備，溫暖舒適的客房環境，另外室外450坪的音樂花園，結合了BBQ烤肉區、有機開心農園、天然湧泉垂釣區、天然湧泉戲水池等，在『雅第三合院民宿』，讓人不自覺地抖掉一身都市裡的煩心塵埃，褪去疲憊與煩憂、放鬆心情聆聽大自然的聲音，品嘗一杯香醇咖啡、觀賞著天空不時來訪的候鳥，也讓生活在都市叢林的小朋友在『雅第三合院民宿』盡情自由奔跑嬉戲，享受親子間共同垂釣與烤肉的樂趣!隨著夜幕低垂...滿天的星斗降臨，更點綴著『雅第三合院民宿』的浪漫寧靜與優閒!!!
stays.descriptionEn: Reservation Hotline: 03-954-6377 "Reclaiming the southern land, / dull, I was, to settle into life in a rustic home. / Empty house, clean courtyard, / contented, I am." -- Return to a Rustic Life by Tao Yuanming. How desirable is the world of pastoral poetry. Nowadays, to immerse in a pastoral landscape, you are no longer looking for it in your dream, or imagining. Take a 40 minutes’ drive from Taipei to Ya Di San He Yuan in Yilan, and you can immerse in experiencing the scenery of a bucolic farm and the life without contention only in a poetic world. "Ya Di San He Yuan" has high ceiling spacious interiors, modern kitchen equipment of European style, warm and comfortable rooms, in addition to a 450 square-meter outdoor music garden, which includes a BBQ area, happy organic farm, a fishing area with natural springs, a paddling pool with natural springs, etc. Staying at Ya Di San He Yuan, you will drop unconsciously the bother of dusts, fatigue, and worries of a city life, and relax yourself to listen to the sounds of nature, to sip a cup of coffee, to watch the visiting migratory birds flying pass in the sky. Also, the children living in the urban jungle stay here they can run and play free, and enjoy the fun of fishing and barbecue with parents together. As night falls, the stars are coming in all over the sky, embellishing Ya Di San He Yuan with romantic, quiet leisure.

stays.name: 雲遊仙境
stays.description: 浪漫鄉村套房~浪漫的氣息籠上了整座鄉村，白色的四柱公主床，迷人的粉紅玫瑰燈，充滿詩意的吊籃遊盪其間，如夢幻般仙境，令人嚮往，神遊其中。絕代風華套房~華麗中不失典雅，金色華麗水晶燈照映下，絕代風雅的床，搭配婀娜飄逸的睡簾，坐擁尊貴的雙人椅，有如貴賓級的格調享受。愛戀天使套房~朵朵蒂芬妮燈從藍白色的天際間照耀美景，雲遊四方的天使愛戀上人間仙境，歡迎您至此駐足休憩，放鬆身心靈。童話彼得四人套房~童話世界是孩子的夢想地，綠意盎然，溫馨甜蜜，來此遇見彼得兔幸福的故鄉，圓了孩子的夢，喜悅無限，將是家庭渡假的首選最愛。

stays.name: 飛。旅宿
stays.description: 坐落於綠油油的稻田中央，一種慵懶卻又充滿氣質的氛圍，從建築的外觀，即可深深感受。推開猶如童話城堡中的厚實大門，瞬間被眼前的風景給震攝住了!充滿設計感卻又不失溫馨的家，這裡絕對是尚未曝光的網美民宿。帶點鄉村、又帶點工業、甚至還帶點夢幻，民宿主人說，他們不愛跟著流行走，設計這個家，完全只靠著自己的感覺。將自己愛的元素，全部巧妙地設計在這個空間中，很難用一種風格就可以概括形容。準備簡單的行李、帶雙好走的鞋、訂好機(車)票，就可以出發啦!住在Fly Inn玩宜蘭，真的很簡單!
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the middle of the green rice fields, a lazy yet elegant atmosphere can be deeply felt from the appearance of the building. Pushing open the thick door that looks like a fairy tale castle, you will be instantly stunned by the scenery in front of you! This home is full of design sense yet warm, and it is definitely a popular B&B that has not yet been exposed. The style is a bit rural, a bit industrial, and even a bit dreamy. The owners of the B&B said that they don't like to follow the trend and designed this home based entirely on their own feelings. All the elements that I love are cleverly designed in this space. It is difficult to describe it in one style.Just prepare some simple luggage, bring a pair of comfortable walking shoes, book your flight (train) tickets, and you are ready to go! Staying at Fly Inn and having fun in Yilan is really simple!

stays.name: 香草森林
stays.description: 香草森林位於宜蘭縣冬山鄉，鄰近梅花湖風景區，讓您可以在這自在地騎著單車，悠閒愜意的讓微風輕拂臉龐，多久沒有體會這樣的生活了？香草森林的由來，是以主打房型的特色來命名的，若您想好好體驗被天然芬多精包圍的森林房型，請您提早詢問入住唷！而其他房型也以花草及房間的特色來給予命名，房間裡都有可愛的小植栽，最天然的芬芳氣息，不讓您錯過。這裡沒有華麗的外觀，沒有喧囂的城市，但我們提供最好的服務品質及舒適的家具，能讓您驚豔的不只是你我及花草的生命氣息，還有整片前所未有的大自然景觀。來到這，請慢慢地深一呼吸，在這與小植栽的心靈對話，宣洩平日壓抑的情緒，告訴自己，我很好，我在這裡，我在香草森林享受渡假中...
stays.descriptionEn: Vanilla Forest is in Dongshan township, Yilan county. It is near Meihua Lake where you can ride a bicycle and feel the breeze. When was the last time you felt so free? The name, Vanilla Forest, is named after our special room. If you want to experience our forest room, please contact us and make a booking. The rest of the rooms are named after plants and their features as well. Every room has lovely potted plants to bring you a sense of nature. There is no luxurious design. There is no hustle and bustle of the city. We provide the best services and a comfy environment. You will be amazed by our lively plants and the magnificent nature. When you come here, please take a deep breath slowly. Let out the emotions that have long been suppressed and say to yourself, "I am fine. I am here. I am enjoying my vacation in Vanilla Forest."

stays.name: 鴝花甜點民宿
stays.description: 我們是一間以西式甜點為主題的溫馨優質民宿，除了舒適的住宿環境且提供美味早餐之外，住客貴賓還可以選擇品嚐浪漫悠閒超好吃的下午茶(經常推出優惠方案)，未來也會適時推出甜點DIY課程！服務團隊是由女兒帶領著爸媽組成！我們喜歡和來自世界各地的人們互動、分享生活經驗，藉由這個精心經營的民宿平台，讓女兒擁有一個得以發展甜點事業的場域！遠眺山脈、近賞田園與河流的幽靜環境，甜點民宿坐落於羅東櫻花步道尾段附近、市區和國五高速公路交流道中間位置，前往羅東市區和往返其他景點，甚至是返回台北都十分便利!!!
stays.descriptionEn: We are a warm and high-quality homestay with a western-style dessert theme. In addition to a comfortable accommodation environment and delicious breakfast, our guests can also choose to enjoy a romantic, leisurely and delicious afternoon tea (discounts are often offered). In the future, we will also launch dessert DIY courses!The service team is led by the daughter and her parents! We love interacting with people from all over the world and sharing life experiences. Through this carefully managed homestay platform, our daughter has a place to develop her dessert business!Overlooking the mountains, enjoying the quiet environment of the countryside and the river, the dessert bed and breakfast is located near the end of the Luodong Cherry Blossom Trail, between the city and the National Five Expressway Interchange. It is very convenient to go to Luodong City and other attractions, and even return to Taipei!!!

stays.name: ５１２木屋
stays.description: 512木屋緣由於其地址，宜蘭縣冬山鄉梅花路500巷100弄12號而來；至於木屋更是由於內部存有一棟建築於1979年，占地百坪之大木屋而來。我之所以會在退休之後，又來經營民宿，主要是因為在社會工作多年後，渴望能接近大自然，擁有一大片草原，內有花園、小菜圃，能供我活動筋骨；目前社會因工作忙碌，很難達到親近大自然，更難於與親朋好友促膝長談。因此、我希望能將這樣好的環境介紹給同好者，才興起經營民宿念頭，它又可讓我接觸到社會各種人，它與工作時所碰到的完全不一樣，它沒有利害關係，它純粹是因興趣相同而結合，我們可以瞭東、瞭西，不受任何人影響。民宿經營一年多以後，發覺我可將這片優美的環境介紹給更多喜好的人來體驗，因此、我們又在今年開始了下午茶的營運，三五好友齊聚一堂，一面閒話家常，一面欣賞周遭環境，喝一口濃郁香醇之咖啡，嘗一口又香又酥之麵包、蛋糕等；在炎熱夏天裡，更能遠離冷氣房，清風陣陣徐徐吹來，夾帶陣陣花香，這是多麼棒的享受啊！園區裡任何硬體設備，無論多豪華，總會讓人看膩，唯有大自然風景，隨者一年四季天氣變化，絕不會單調的。歡迎您們的光臨。

Three or five friends gathered together and wentssip. How much is this? Great enjoyment! Any hardware equipment in the park, no matter how luxurious, will always make people look tired. Only the natural scenery, with the weather changes throughout the year, will never be monotonous. Welcome to visit us.

stays.searchText: ５１２木屋 ５１２木屋 宜蘭縣民宿1075號 宜蘭縣 冬山鄉 廣興村梅花路500巷100弄12號 512木屋緣由於其地址，宜蘭縣冬山鄉梅花路500巷100弄12號而來；至於木屋更是由於內部存有一棟建築於1979年，占地百坪之大木屋而來。我之所以會在退休之後，又來經營民宿，主要是因為在社會工作多年後，渴望能接近大自然，擁有一大片草原，內有花園、小菜圃，能供我活動筋骨；目前社會因工作忙碌，很難達到親近大自然，更難於與親朋好友促膝長談。因此、我希望能將這樣好的環境介紹給同好者，才興起經營民宿念頭，它又可讓我接觸到社會各種人，它與工作時所碰到的完全不一樣，它沒有利害關係，它純粹是因興趣相同而結合，我們可以瞭東、瞭西，不受任何人影響。民宿經營一年多以後，發覺我可將這片優美的環境介紹給更多喜好的人來體驗，因此、我們又在今年開始了下午茶的營運，三五好友齊聚一堂，一面閒話家常，一面欣賞周遭環境，喝一口濃郁香醇之咖啡，嘗一口又香又酥之麵包、蛋糕等；在炎熱夏天裡，更能遠離冷氣房，清風陣陣徐徐吹來，夾帶陣陣花香，這是多麼棒的享受啊！園區裡任何硬體設備，無論多豪華，總會讓人看膩，唯有大自然風景，隨者一年四季天氣變化，絕不會單調的。歡迎您們的光臨。

stays.name: 優勝美地音樂渡假民宿
stays.description: 風吹過的稻田，搖曳擺盪。蛙鳴聲的樂音，搭配桂花、茉莉花的清香，在星空下的夏夜-享受。「優勝美地」名稱的由來，除了是取自主人名字外，也以造就與美國國家公園相同美景為自許，希望能營造一處悠閒雅致的度假勝地。硬體上她不講究豪華氣派，而是以潔淨及融入木質元素，營造溫馨與寬廣舒適的環境；軟體裡注入我們藝術的氛圍和熱情款待朋友的心情，希望來到這裡的朋友，都能夠把這裡當成「家」一樣的享受她、愛惜她。期許這裡是一個令人念念不忘的旅遊驛站，我們盼望來此停留的朋友都能得到身心的紓壓，記得緩慢您的腳步，好好享受臺灣宜蘭迷人的山水與人情……。
stays.descriptionEn: Fields of rice gently blow in the wind as guests enjoy the chorus of frogs, fragrange of osmanthus and jasmine, and summer nights under a starry sky. “Yosemite” derived its name from the owner as well as the hope that it could equal the beauty of the famous American national park, and we hope to create an elegant, recreational vacation retreat. The hardware facilities are not particularly grand or luxurious, but rather make use of simplicity and wood elements to create a warm, spacious, and comfortable environment, while the software facilities are infused with our artistic atmosphere and friendly hospitality toward friends. We hope every guest who comes here will enjoy and treasure this place as if it were their own home, that this rest stop will be unforgettable to everyone who visits, and that every guest will feel physically and mentally relaxed. Remember to slow down and enjoy the charming scenery and friendliness of Yilan.

stays.descriptionEn: A home with natural ecological countryside style, Light and Shadow Spa Bed and Breakfast was designed and built one brick and tile at a time by the owner himself, with interior decoration featuring Decoupage artwork created by the owner’s wife. We also provide spa and beauty services. Light and Shadow Spa Bed and Breakfast offers natural ecology, water fountains, a flower and herb garden, Indian oil massage, hot stone spa, Decoupage collage, clay, and wooden coloring DIY learning. The natural ecology offers views of Taiwanese fireflies in the spring, beetles, stag beetles, dragonflies emerging from cocoons, and blue tiger butterflies in the summer, and the opportunity to catch clams and shrimp.
