stays.name: 合群農莊民宿
stays.description: 結合旅遊、休閒、文化美食，農村生活體驗之民宿。優質民宿，抉擇很難！網路查尋霧裡看花，又怕受騙，在此，推薦您，『合群農莊』民宿，可以試試，曾住過客人，都說讚，有客人留言可參閱。它，崇尚自然，有安全、乾淨、舒適的環境，服務親切，客人有賓至如歸感受。它沒有過多人工化造景，惟放眼週遭，綠野田疇，青山綠水，處處大自然美景，躺仰，悠悠白雲，清風徐徐，小鳥、蝴蝶飛舞，偷得浮生半日閒。遊樂設施，免費自行車，盪搖椅，吊床，社區生態湧泉水池，莊前可撈魚蝦。
stays.descriptionEn: Hequn Nongzhuang Bed and Breakfast combines travel, recreation, culture, delicious food, and an experience of farm life. When trying to find outstanding bed and breakfasts, it’s tough to make a choice! An Internet search yields numerous destinations, many of which may not be reliable, so we recommend you stay at Hequn Nongzhuang, and give us a try. Past visitors have all praised us highly, and you can check out their testimonies for yourself. We feature a wonderfully natural, secure, clean, and comfortable environment and friendly service that makes guests feel at home. Instead of artificial scenery, we’re surrounded by green farmland, mountains, water, and beautiful landscapes everywhere you look. Lie back and enjoy a moment of idle leisure as the white clouds lazily drift by, the wind gently blows, and birds fly and butterflies dance through the air. Recreational facilities include: free bikes, swing chairs, hammock beds, a community ecological fountain pond, and fish and shrimp catching in the area in front of the building.

stays.name: 宜蘭力麗威斯汀度假酒店
stays.description: 宜蘭力麗威斯汀度假酒店位於水的故鄉 – 員山，擁有著名的溫泉和壯麗的自然風光，沿著廣闊的海岸線從台北到宜蘭僅40分鐘車程。酒店距離宜蘭市中心僅4公里，至宜蘭火車站僅5.5公里。從台灣桃園國際機場（TPE）到酒店的行車時間約為100分鐘。酒店共有85間舒適宜人的客房、套房及6間獨棟別墅，每間客房均配備享有盛譽的威斯汀天夢之床(Heavenly® Bed)及白茶蘆薈系列沐浴用品天夢之浴(Heavenly® Bath)，以精緻的設施和貼心的服務為您打造卓越非凡的酣眠體驗。客房內設有50吋LED液晶電視、迷你吧、免費高速無線網路及膠囊式咖啡機等。綠色植物和原木裝飾營造出大自然的氛圍。客房更設有富含礦物質的碳酸氫鈉個人溫泉湯池，提供您愉悅健康的休憩環境。全天候供應的「知味西餐廳」提供美味和健康的宜蘭在地及國際美食料理，您可以享用我們色香味俱全的創意自助餐料理或單點美食。獨具特色的「舞 日本料理」是您絕對不可錯過的餐飲體驗，品嚐主廚精心準備的精緻料理，享用一場美食與藝術交織的饗宴。您更可在「大廳酒吧」感受輕音樂的環繞，綴飲一杯特調雞尾酒、鮮榨有機果汁或現煮咖啡，盡情讓身心靈放鬆昇華。宜蘭力麗

stays.name: 幸福方舟
stays.description: 員山鄉是一個青山綠水的世外桃源，是水的故鄉，如洞天福地，這裡沒有城市的喧囂.屋主為土生土長的宜蘭人，為了響應環保每逢假日均做環保志工，幫忙撿拾居家附近垃圾，維護鄰里環境，更呼應”要活就要動”的名言，並特請知名設計師規劃建築住家及保持四周環境的生態，精心造就”幸福方舟” 生態池、池中亭，偌大的綠地庭院處處充滿家的溫馨與幸福。
stays.descriptionEn: Yuanshan township is a wonderland surrounded by nature. There is no hustle and bustle of the city. The owner of Happy Ark Villa Homestay was born and raised in Yilan County. He does voluntary service every weekend and helps keep the neighborhood clean. He also encourages other people to stay healthy and exercise. The homestay is professionally designed and has an eco-pond with a pavilion. There is also a spacious garden to make you feel at home.

stays.name: 悅綠墅
stays.description: 2014年5月新開幕的悅綠墅Aleex Villa位於風景秀麗的員山鄉， 奢華典雅的宮廷外觀， 歐式風情的設計，是由熱愛歐式建築與裝潢的男主人一手設計建造的， 從設計到落成，費時2年的時間，民宿房間內與餐廳區亦可見女主人的油畫作品，唯有細細體會才能明白悅綠墅的獨特之處。 溫馨舒適、寧靜不受打擾的氛圍，緊鄰數公里長的腳踏車道，騎乘民宿的免費自行車，方便前往臨近的員山鄉各景點，提供旅人徜徉在藍天與綠意之中行『光合作用』的住宿新選擇。 悅綠墅的每間客房皆有大片景觀窗戶，擁有遼闊的田園景色並可遠眺龜山島，欣賞朝日時分的瞬息萬變。 悅綠墅設有花園和露台及桌椅供房客迎風賞景，一樓公共空間備有桌遊，民宿亦提供旅遊諮詢服務以及免費私人停車場。臨近的著名景點有: 金車威士忌酒廠 5分鐘車程 八甲漁場 5分鐘車程 勝洋水草博物館 5分鐘車程 羅東運動公園 8分鐘車程【貼心服務】公共設施兒童戲水池、觀景露台贈送宜蘭名產小禮盒免費自行車租賃服務免費旅遊諮詢免費私人停車場
stays.descriptionEn: Aleex Villa, which opened in May 2014, is located in the scenic Yuanshan Township. It has a luxurious and elegant palace appearance and European-style design. It was designed and built by the male owner who loves European architecture and decoration. It took 2 years from design to completion. The hostess's oil paintings can also be seen in the B&B rooms and restaurant area. Only by experiencing it carefully you can understand the uniqueness of Aleex Villa.The cozy, comfortable, and undisturbed atmosphere is adjacent to a bicycle path that is several kilometers long. Riding the free bicycles, you can easily go to various nearby attractions in Yuanshan Township, providing travelers with a new accommodation option to wander among the blue sky and greenery and perform "photosynthesis".Each room at Aleex Villa has large landscape windows, offering vast pastoral views and a distant view of Guishan Island (Turtle Island, allowing you to enjoy the ever-changing scenery at sunrise. Aleex Villa has a garden and terrace with tables and chairs for guests to enjoy the scenery. The public space on the first floor is equipped with tabletop games. The B&B also provides tourism consulting services and free private parking.Famous attractions nearby include:Kavalan Whisky Distillery 5 minutes driveBajia Fishery 5 minutes by carShengyang Aquatic Plant Museum 5 minutes driveLuodong Sports Park 8 minutes by car【Intimate Service】Public facilities: children's swimming pool, viewing terraceFree Yilan specialty productsFree bicycle rental serviceFree travel consultationFree private parking

stays.name: 惠好小農舍
stays.description: 位於宜蘭縣的民宿，獨棟農舍小屋，鄉居恬靜的家，獨棟簡約建築，靜謐私旅行。建築師設計姐妹親手打造的農舍度假自宅，設計風格化，溫馨且舒適。一次僅接待一組客人（4-6位房客），適合全家體驗鄉居享受悠閒時光。餐廳與廚房合一設計，團聚餐桌上最美好的時光，大片落地玻璃，視野清朗，田園美景盡收眼底。庭院綠意盎然，生態幽靜美麗，木棧板露台吊椅，想休憩放鬆，來一趟宜蘭靜謐輕旅行。溫馨提醒：1. 入住時間：下午4：00後退房時間：中午12：00前2. 提供4-6人床位及備品(2張雙人床+1張沙發床)，訂房時請告知入住人數。3. 農舍無電視，亦不提供餐點，但廚房備有冰箱、瓦斯爐、微波爐、電熱水壺、小烤箱、電鍋、餐碗鍋具及簡單調味料可使用。農舍對面有7-11。4. 不開放烤肉及寵物入住，室內禁止吸菸。嚴禁吸毒、開趴。5. 鄉下自然環境，請備防蚊用品。
stays.descriptionEn: Countryside Retreat in Yilan, TaiwanNestled in the rural landscape of Yilan County in northeastern Taiwan, this private vacation cottage offers a serene escape surrounded by lush greenery. The standalone modern-minimalist home features an open-concept kitchen, allowing guests to cook and dine while enjoying the picturesque countryside views. Experience the tranquility of Taiwan’s rural lifestyle in this thoughtfully designed farmhouse retreat.Designed and planned by three sisters—a renowned architect, an interior designer, and a travel journalist—this cozy yet stylish homestay embodies warmth and comfort. To ensure an intimate and exclusive experience, we host only one group at a time, accommodating 4 to 6 guests. Ideal for friends and families, it’s the perfect place to unwind and savor the charm of country living.The integrated kitchen and dining area create a welcoming space for shared meals and gatherings. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide unobstructed views of the surrounding farmlands, while the verdant garden and wooden deck with a hanging chair offer a peaceful retreat. Whether you seek relaxation or a quiet getaway, a stay in Yilan promises a rejuvenating rural escape.Important InformationCheck-in: After 4:00 PMCheck-out: Before 12:00 PMAccommodation: 4–6 guests (2 double beds + 1 sofa bed). Please inform us of the number of guests when booking.Amenities: The farmhouse does not have a TV or provide meals. However, the kitchen is fully equipped with a refrigerator, gas stove, microwave, electric kettle, small oven, rice cooker, tableware, cookware, and basic condiments. A 7-Eleven is conveniently located across the street.House Rules:No barbecues or pets allowed.Smoking indoors is strictly prohibited.Absolutely no drug use or parties.Nature & Environment: As this is a rural area, we recommend bringing mosquito repellent.Enjoy a peaceful countryside retreat in Yilan!

stays.searchText: 惠好小農舍 惠好小農舍 宜蘭縣民宿2068號 宜蘭縣 員山鄉 惠民路202號 位於宜蘭縣的民宿，獨棟農舍小屋，鄉居恬靜的家，獨棟簡約建築，靜謐私旅行。建築師設計姐妹親手打造的農舍度假自宅，設計風格化，溫馨且舒適。一次僅接待一組客人（4-6位房客），適合全家體驗鄉居享受悠閒時光。餐廳與廚房合一設計，團聚餐桌上最美好的時光，大片落地玻璃，視野清朗，田園美景盡收眼底。庭院綠意盎然，生態幽靜美麗，木棧板露台吊椅，想休憩放鬆，來一趟宜蘭靜謐輕旅行。溫馨提醒：1. 入住時間：下午4：00後退房時間：中午12：00前2. 提供4-6人床位及備品(2張雙人床+1張沙發床)，訂房時請告知入住人數。3. 農舍無電視，亦不提供餐點，但廚房備有冰箱、瓦斯爐、微波爐、電熱水壺、小烤箱、電鍋、餐碗鍋具及簡單調味料可使用。農舍對面有7-11。4. 不開放烤肉及寵物入住，室內禁止吸菸。嚴禁吸毒、開趴。5. 鄉下自然環境，請備防蚊用品。

stays.name: 日光之丘
stays.description: 位於蘭陽平原西岸的長型基地，使我們興奮的想像建造出來的建築空間能遠眺遼闊的蘭陽平原，及湖邊的山景，於是房子座落在基地的面向和自然的關係變成為不可分割的關聯。日光、天空、山與水是我們這棟建築創作的動力，並不斷試圖讓這些自然的元素與建築空間的設計能激盪交織出美麗的和諧，每個面向的開窗使光線能在不同的空間中流動，並藉由天窗的設計讓光可以恣意的灑下，不管是白天觀看藍藍的天空、隨風飄動的白雲、亦或是夜晚仰望黑夜中的明星、雨天聽那滴滴答答的聲音等….期盼讓人在這建築空間裡仍能與自然不斷的對話。建築外觀如同船型設計，結合了在地的湖畔”有船入大湖、有山做屏障”的設計概念，粗獷的石版、頁岩與白色外牆、延伸至室內挑高的客廳，實木扶手與踏階，公共區域地坪舖設深灰色澤的磁磚及清水模與文化石牆面，讓人有著神秘與寧靜的感覺，期盼在整個建築空間裡或走動、或觸摸都能感受到那份來自大自然的禮物，領受如同在大自然裡的舒適與自在。站在窗邊放眼過去，隨著季節不斷變化的稻田、隨風搖曳的樹木、湖邊山嵐的變化，坐在臥榻上發呆看著書，聽著音樂、聽那不時傳來的蟲鳴鳥叫聲，夜晚的螢火蟲，都讓你的心能在這建築空間中享受片刻的安寧與放鬆。讓人居住在這建築空間中卻能像是居住在丘陵叢林般，時時刻刻浸沐在日光、天空、山、水的大自然對話裡是我們創作的由哀期盼，於是”日光之丘”建築空間就此展現了。

stays.name: 棲閑民宿
stays.description: -棲閑，坐落於七賢村田野之間， 平時提供旅人舒適的下榻空間， 同時提供精緻美味的手作餐點。棲閑由兩位熱愛宜蘭的室內設計夫婦攜手打造，每個角落都充滿堅持與用心。除了周邊清澈的溪水及大片稻田，棲閑更擁百坪日式庭園，乾淨無污染的環境，生態豐富。夏日夜間有機會可以看到螢火蟲或徐飛於民宿邊，或棲身於花園中；平常白天亦偶有都市少見的白腹秧雞出沒在花園裡。我們期許每位旅人都能感受到像回家一般愜意溫暖，在有限的空間裡留下雋永回憶。

stays.descriptionEn: The Pond B&B provides you with a comfortable, simple and relaxed accommodation environment, with a hundred-ping garden green space, spacious parking space and a lively pond.The crabs are bubbling in the natural spring next to the B&B, with small shrimps, small fish and water plants. The rich pond ecology allows children to play in the water and experience the fun of fishing!Wandering in the green of the fields and bald cypress, you can enjoy the rural life with the morning sun shining and the stars twinkling at night, and enjoy traveling in life and living in travel.

stays.description: 美麗的宜蘭, 清新的空氣, 田野的風光, 濃厚的人情味, 無拘無束的自在氛圍, 與世隔絕的世外桃源, 歡迎光臨涵舍度假民宿. 溜滑梯房型 樓中樓的獨特設計, 別有洞天極具古典風的小檯燈, 微微透出橘色光藝, 充滿了浪漫的氣息. 抬頭一看, 美麗的玻璃吊燈點亮了這個屬於您的小天地, 從室外的陽台眺望景色藍天白雲, 美景盡收眼底，不只住宿，讓孩子的笑聲填滿每位旅客的回憶
stays.descriptionEn: Yilan is a beautiful countryside with fresh air and warm hospitality. The carefree and comfortable lifestyle evokes a secluded paradise. We welcome you to Hanshe B&B. The unique loft layout reveals another level under the lace curtains. The classic table lamp emits orange lights full of romantic flare. The glass chandelier hanging over the ceiling brightens your little world. Outside the balcony is a picturesque view of blue sky and fluffy white clouds.

At night, with pots of tea, watch the night sky with shining, little star and the reflections of the mountains, light, and clouds from the surface of the lake. Or, stroll in the green garden, while let your mood lifts." "Zhu Yuan Ju Homestay" garden B&B is a good place to rest your mind.

stays.name: 荷風民宿
stays.description: 生活不是賽跑，它是每一步都應該细细品味的旅程。荷風自然民宿帶您體驗不一樣的宜蘭之旅！木質打造寬敞舒適空間，浸膩在清心清靜的氛圍。此外還提供自然新鮮的食材，讓平時庸碌的旅人品嘗鄉村新鮮悠閒的滋味。自然樸實的民宿主人，以樂會友的態度，讓荷風自然充滿著獨樹一格的特色，也讓宜蘭變得更溫柔可親了。
stays.descriptionEn: Don't treat life as a race. Life is a journey to be tasted. Weathering and Breakfast will take you to experience a fantastic trip in Yilan! We build up a spacious and comfortable place with wood, and keep you away from the hustle and bustle. Besides, we provide country food prepared from natural and fresh ingredients . The honest host makes friends with music, a great and unique feature of Weathering and Breakfast, making Yilan more adorable.

stays.name: 蘭庭民宿
stays.description: 本民宿秉持著'在地''有機''悠遊''慢活',位於宜蘭縣員山鄉 ,環境優,有大片草坪庭園,裝潢典雅大器,一樓設有專業咖啡吧台.餐廳.交誼廳.烤肉區,專屬停車場,附近有枕山休閒農業區.福山植物園.快樂谷.大湖風景區.雙連埤.大樹公.太陽埤.望龍埤....都是員山鄉才有的自然特色,交通方便,國道五號下交流道約10~15分即可到達
stays.descriptionEn: Local, organic food, easy life and downshifting are our spirit. We are located in Yuanshan Township, Yilan County, with an excellent environment and a large lawn. We have the elegant decoration, and there is a professional coffee bar in first floor. We are not far away from tourist spots such as Zhentoushan Agricultural Leisure Area, Fushan Botanical Garden,Kuailegu, Dahu Scenic Area, Shuanglianpi, Big Deified Tree, Taiyangpi, Wanglongpi, which are all the unique natural spots of Yuanshan Township. It only takes 10 to 15 minutes from the exit of National Highway No. 5 to arrive at the B&B.

stays.name: 鳳凰宿甲蟲生態民宿
stays.description: 網址:http://138.8168.org.tw位於宜蘭太平山，福山植物園必經之道，鳳凰宿就佇立在這樣一個如詩如畫的地方，如蓮花一般盛開，在鳳凰宿你可以欣賞這裡的獨特自然生態，各種各樣的花草蟲鳥，在詳盡的解說之下，彷彿拉近了彼此間的距離，你可以在這裡享用一杯香醇的咖啡，或者參觀鳳凰宿甲蟲生態教育館，也可以在鳳凰宿裡渡過溫馨的一夜，參加晚上的夜間觀察探險隊~和星辰與蟲鳴蛙叫為伴，一起 迎接明日的朝陽。
stays.descriptionEn: Website: http://www.phoenixhouse.com.twLocated in Taiping Shan, Yilan, on the way to Fushan Botanical Garden, Phoenix House proudly stands in this picturesque place, blossoming like a lotus flower. Here, you can enjoy our unique natural ecology and a variety of flower, plants, insects, and birds, while the owner provides a detailed tour that brings us all closer together. Or enjoy a rich cup of coffee and visit the Beetle Ecology Education Center. Spend a warm, comfortable night in our wooden cabins and participate in the nighttime exploration team, accompanied by the stars and sounds of frogs and insects, welcoming the dawn of a new day together.

stays.name: CH會館民宿
stays.description: 屋主是一對環遊世界的年輕夫妻，因為共同喜好，走遍世界很多美麗的國家最後發現國外再美，心裡始終最愛是我們的土地!在美麗的東台灣尋尋覓覓建立了這一間用心打造的民宿因為在國外住過很多民宿，學習了很多國外的美學觀念，也了解要努力發揚在地文化最後在宜蘭找到了這塊夢想中的土地。我們是一間在宜蘭美麗田園上的民宿，一張開眼都是滿滿的稻田，遠處是山 是海在陽台能夠清楚看到龜山島，每一扇窗 都是風景畫!我們遠離塵囂，在民宿 聽不到車聲 喇叭聲，我們只有蟲鳴鳥叫四季荏苒，可以看到稻米由綠轉黃好想跟你們分享這一切，好想告訴你們頂樓露臺的星星有多美我們歡迎您的到來，與我們體驗最美的宜蘭

stays.name: 上萊茵莊園
stays.description: 莊園建築採古典巴洛克風格，從入口玄關至屋內佈置精緻進口水晶吊燈，寬敞大客廳陳列古典油畫、復古式壁爐及經典藝術品。花園種植隨四季更迭的落羽松林，石階步道散佈，自然生態湖畔，歐風花叢錦簇，猶如置身小歐洲。莊園住宿提供法國優質沫浴用品，供旅人洗去疲憊心靈，每日現做歐式早餐，補充一天精神能量。午後悠閒時光可沉浸在歐風客廳，亦或漫步落雨松林下，眺望田畝綠野，舒適地享受歐式寧靜莊園。

stays.searchText: 上萊茵莊園 上萊茵莊園 宜蘭縣民宿978號 宜蘭縣 壯圍鄉 美城村美城三路151號 莊園建築採古典巴洛克風格，從入口玄關至屋內佈置精緻進口水晶吊燈，寬敞大客廳陳列古典油畫、復古式壁爐及經典藝術品。花園種植隨四季更迭的落羽松林，石階步道散佈，自然生態湖畔，歐風花叢錦簇，猶如置身小歐洲。莊園住宿提供法國優質沫浴用品，供旅人洗去疲憊心靈，每日現做歐式早餐，補充一天精神能量。午後悠閒時光可沉浸在歐風客廳，亦或漫步落雨松林下，眺望田畝綠野，舒適地享受歐式寧靜莊園。

stays.description: 宜蘭｜壯圍張宅・與大自然一起呼吸的居所沿著筆直的鄉間小路，駛進一片金黃色的稻田，稻田中農家錯落，你搖下車窗探著頭，欣賞宜蘭的田野風光，兩旁的稻穗，飽滿地在風裡搖擺，迎接旅人的到來；朝著路標前進，與大自然融為一體的壯圍張宅，就座落在稻香的氣息裡。在經典宜蘭厝裡品嚐道地茶點壯圍張宅的主人張大哥，面帶溫暖笑容、穿著木屐，走出來迎接我們，帶我們沿著石板小路穿過後院。推開紗門，風與光一起跳舞，張大哥又與管家親自為你準備有別於一般甜點的傳統茶點，把在地的宜蘭味端上桌，講究的擺盤和道地的食材，嚐一口金棗，享受酸甜滋味；梅子口味的李鹹糕，裡頭參著蜜餞，越嚼越香；飽含香氣的麵茶撒上口感酥脆的椪餅，是最經典的古早味組合；最後再喝一口溫熱的水蜜桃紅茶，讓胃跟心都溫暖了起來。由知名的黃聲遠建築師設計的壯圍張宅是最具代表的宜蘭厝。一層樓的高度，讓田野風光和如水墨畫的山景，在壯圍張宅裡都能欣賞。放慢腳步感受宅院與自然的律動，即使在正午太陽下，坐在室內仍能感受風在流動；大片的落地窗讓陽光灑落，溫暖明亮。方正的格局、屋內口字型的庭院，一株桃紅色的雞蛋花，點亮四季都美好的家。以人為本、相容於自然的家蓋了八年的壯圍張宅是一幢以人為本、相容於自然、又和在地文化融合的家，「我們家的設計，從上面看下來，就是回家的『回』，依家的概念蓋，這就是我要的。」為了實現這樣的理念，張大哥等待八年時間設計、建造，用信任與等待換來了最愛。 高中畢業後便開始從事美髮工作的張大哥，為了家計踏入社會開始工作，就從家鄉宜蘭獨自闖進了台北。也在這條路上，遇見了他人生中最重要的人——藍姊，存了些錢，兩人決定回到宜蘭一同築起屬於他們的家。但是一次意外，藍姊悄然離逝，只是她溫暖的精神早已深深影響壯圍張宅，張大哥說，那塊地當初是藍姊買下的，所以不管怎樣，他一定要繼續藍姊的夢想、實現她期待的夢土。
stays.descriptionEn: Yilan｜Chang HouseA Dwelling That Breathes Along with NatureFollowing the perfectly straight country road, you drive into a golden rice paddy with farm houses scattered throughout. Rolling down the window, you stretch your head out to admire Yilan’s pastoral landscape, the rice stalks by the roadside laiden with grain sway in the gentle breeze to welcome travelers. Following the road signs onwards, you approach your destination: Chang House, in perfect harmony with the natural world, and enveloped in the breeze rich with the aroma of rice.Tasting local refreshments in a classic Yilan residenceHanson is the owner of Chang House. Wearing a warm smile and wooden clogs, he walks out to greet you, leading you along the slate pathway into the back yard. Pushing open the screen door, the wind and sunlight dance together as you see the unique desserts and traditional refreshments that Chang and the housekeepers have prepared for you. As they place the local flavors of Yilan upon the table, you admire the plate arrangement and local ingredients. Taste a bite of kumkuat, enjoying the sweet & sour flavor; salted plum cakes, a local delicacy, stuffed with dehydrated fruit, get sweeter the longer they are chewed; roasted wheat flour tea with a sprinkle of crispy bun cake combines the most classic traditional flavors; wash it all down with a cup of warm honey peach black tea to warm the stomach and the heart.Designed by famous architect Huang Sheng-yuan, Chang House is the most representative residential building in Yilan. The height of the ground floor allows one to appreciate both the view of the fields and the painting-like mountain scenery. Slow down your pace and appreciate the rhythmic interaction between the courtyard and the surrounding natural environment. Even when sitting indoors under the midday sun, you can sense the movement of the wind. The sun floods indoors through large floor-to-ceiling windows, bright and warm. The cubic structure, the square-shaped courtyard, the single pink plumeria tree highlight the year-round beauty of Chang House.A home accordant with nature and founded on peopleEight years in construction, Chang House is founded upon people, accordant with nature, and fused with the local culture. “Looking down at the design of our house from above, you can see the square-within-a-square shape of the Chinese character for return. It is built upon the concept of home, which is precisely what I wanted.” In order to implement this ideal, Hanson waited eight years for the design and construction to be completed. He used patience and trust to exchange for what he loved most.Moving alone from Yilan to Taipei, Hanson got a job as a hairdresser after graduating from high school in order to help ease his family’s economic pressure. Along the way, he met the most important person in his life - Sister Lan. After saving a bit of money, they decided to move together to Yilan and build a home they could call their own. Even though an accident quietly took Sister Lan from this world, her warm spirit had already had a profound influence on Chang House. Hanson says that the property upon which Chang House is built was bought by Sister Lan, so no matter what, he must continue her dream of making her dreamland a reality.The greatest luxury is in fact very simpleChang House’s five suites have all been named after the rooms formerly inhabited by members of Hanson’s family: the Master Bedroom, the Mother Room, the Eldest Daughter Room, the Little Daughter Room, and the Guest Room. All rooms are simple and elegant, while retaining a cozy warmth. Hanson lived with his family in this home for ten years before deciding to share it with the outside world, allowing even more people to stay in a local Yilan residence. His hope was that travelers could also share in their experience of life in this special living room and in this courtyard.In the morning, you enjoy a delicious Chinese-style home cooked meal made entirely of seasonal vegetables and fruit grown in their own garden. Afterwards, you lie in the spacious front yard enjoying the aroma of the rice paddies. In the afternoon, you curl up in a corner of the courtyard with a book. The evening is the most important time of day at Chang House - you climb to the rooftop from where you can enjoy the expansive natural scenery. This is the most magical moment of all, when the golden sun setting beneath orange clouds creates a splendid play of light and shadow across the open fields. It has been said that human beings require sunlight, air, water, and trees. After coming to Chang House, you realize that all you need to do is open your eyes and relax your mind, and all at once, all of these wonderful elements are yours!

stays.name: 愛情海民宿
stays.description: 坐落於宜蘭壯圍鄉海邊的啾吉民宿‧愛情海館，距離蘭陽動植物王國、壯圍沙丘遊客中心、宜騎緣馬場、壯圍海灘盪鞦韆、永鎮海濱公園皆不到1公里，同時開車約16分鐘即可到達宜蘭縣羅東夜市，交通十分便利，同時，門前有停車場可供免費停放遊覽車、4-9台汽車以即可開立收據，非常適合家庭或學生、公司團體自駕或搭客運出遊。愛情海館以整棟包棟出租為主，建築物雖然分為愛情海主館與風車館，但兩棟會一起待客、一次只皆一組來賓喲！愛情海館共有17個房間，包含：單人雅房1間、雙人雅房1間、雙人套房9間、四人套房6間，啾吉民宿會視人數為來賓提供剛好的房型(其他未使用房間則將上鎖、不接客)。愛情海民宿的基礎入住人數為28人，最多可以加床方式入住65人，超大的住宿人數搭配「戶外25坪獨立烤肉區(有遮陽、廁所)、廚房與KTV歡唱設備、電動麻將桌、免費Wi‑Fi及嬰兒澡盆、奶瓶消毒鍋、床圍等設備，加上鄰近沙灘與多元景點，因此非常推薦做您宜蘭親子包棟住宿、寵物友善住宿的首選！房價方面，愛情海民宿平日包棟價格為新台幣22,000元起（此價格最多可住28人），假日則為 28,000元起（此價格最多可住28人），皆可開立收據，特別適合親友聚會、同學會、企業旅遊等大團體使用。
stays.descriptionEn: Nestled along the coast of Zhuangwei Township in Yilan, 9G Love Ocean Villa is conveniently located less than 1 kilometer from several top attractions, including Lanyang Animal and Botanical Kingdom, Zhuangwei Sand Dunes Visitor Center, Yi Qi Yuan Ranch, Zhuangwei Beach Swings, and Yongzhen Seaside Park. It’s also just a 16-minute drive to the popular Luodong Night Market. The villa offers free parking in front of the property, suitable for tour buses or 4–9 cars, and receipts are available—making it ideal for families, student groups, or corporate outings, whether arriving by car or bus.Although the villa consists of two separate buildings—the Main House and Windmill House—they are rented together as one exclusive booking, with only one group hosted at a time, ensuring privacy and a relaxed experience.There are 17 rooms in total, including: 1 single room (shared bathroom), 1 double room (shared bathroom), 9 double suites, and 6 quadruple suites. Rooms are allocated based on the group size, and unused rooms are securely locked.The base occupancy is 28 people, but the villa can accommodate up to 65 guests with extra beds. Facilities include a spacious 25-ping (approx. 82 sqm) outdoor BBQ area with sunshade and restrooms, a kitchen, KTV karaoke system, electric mahjong table, free Wi‑Fi, as well as baby-friendly items like a bathtub, bottle sterilizer, and bed rails. With its proximity to the beach and multiple attractions, Love Ocean Villa is a perfect choice for family-friendly and pet-friendly group stays in Yilan.Rates start at NT$22,000 per night on weekdays (up to 28 guests) and NT$28,000 on weekends (up to 28 guests). Official receipts are available. This villa is highly recommended for family reunions, class gatherings, and company retreats looking for a spacious and private getaway.shared kitchen, coffee machine, and Wi-Fi. It’s also a pet-friendly accommodation, welcoming furry companions for a cleaning fee of NT$1,000 per pet—making it one of the top choices for private pet-friendly stays in Yilan.

stays.name: 無待民宿
stays.description: 無待民宿 位於蘭陽溪河岸景觀第一排，是我們自己蓋的房子!由得過建築新銳獎劉崇聖建築師建築設計，以農業地景跳望北側蘭陽溪及南側稻浪的漂浮盒子，感受光線順著縫隙及天井灑下，如同小王子的望遠鏡一般，靜靜觀察著基地的田野、水鳥及雨水。我們秉持”建築和人一樣，要真誠、要真實、然後還要盡量做到親切和讓人喜歡” 的理念，以逍遙是無法等待、身心合一療癒旅人的心，歡迎您的到來。 無待民宿是可以讓人安心的舒適環境，遠離塵囂、沉澱思考，精緻的設計風是您調整生活步調的好所在。如果在自然中甦醒、身心療癒、悠閒時光、慢活旅程是理想生活的憧憬，那您絕對不能錯過 無待民宿! 樸拙淡雅的空間，享受時光的流動，體感自然界變化規律，遨遊於無窮境界!!誠摯敬意 歡迎您來 #無待民宿 擁有專屬於您的美好時光

stays.name: 璞園民宿
stays.description: 民宿主人為了圓年輕時的夢想~就是擁有一座農場，在尋尋覓覓中終於找到屬於心中的淨土，打造自己的夢想田園，然後分享自己所擁有的環境和生活。建築外觀完全由屋主一手打造設計是一棟優雅帶有日式風格的建築大廳呈現出舒適現代風的氛圍，臥室佈置出渡假悠閒風，屋後則有300坪寬闊的有機蔬菜園在閒暇之餘，滿足了農園樂趣並也提供有蔬菜給住宿的旅客栽取，多餘的客房自然就成了民宿的房間，雖然沒有旅館的大規模與豪華，但有的是朋友般的熱情和家的溫馨。 民宿主人喜愛手作物品就連民宿招牌都是手工雕刻，客房裡的書桌櫃子也是他的傑作。若是願意停下腳步就可以用閒情逸致的心，慢活的心態去欣賞鄉間自然風景及蟲鳴鳥叫聲...........民宿主人就是你的朋友，歡迎來體驗鄉間生活和鄉村深度旅遊的樂趣 !
stays.descriptionEn: Bed and Breakfast in Yilan County.In order to fulfill his dream when he was young, which was to own a farm, the owner of the B&B finally found the pure land in his heart after searching for a long time. He built his own dream farm and then shared his environment and life. The exterior of the building was designed entirely by the owner. It is an elegant Japanese-style building. The lobby presents a comfortable and modern atmosphere. The bedrooms are decorated in a holiday and leisure style. There is a 300-ping wide organic vegetable garden behind the house. In leisure time, it satisfies the farm fun and also provides vegetables for the guests to grow. The extra guest rooms naturally become B&B rooms. Although they are not as large and luxurious as a hotel, they are warm and friendly like home.

stays.searchText: 璞園民宿 璞園民宿 宜蘭縣民宿856號 宜蘭縣 壯圍鄉 古亭村14鄰永美路二段61巷120號 民宿主人為了圓年輕時的夢想~就是擁有一座農場，在尋尋覓覓中終於找到屬於心中的淨土，打造自己的夢想田園，然後分享自己所擁有的環境和生活。建築外觀完全由屋主一手打造設計是一棟優雅帶有日式風格的建築大廳呈現出舒適現代風的氛圍，臥室佈置出渡假悠閒風，屋後則有300坪寬闊的有機蔬菜園在閒暇之餘，滿足了農園樂趣並也提供有蔬菜給住宿的旅客栽取，多餘的客房自然就成了民宿的房間，雖然沒有旅館的大規模與豪華，但有的是朋友般的熱情和家的溫馨。 民宿主人喜愛手作物品就連民宿招牌都是手工雕刻，客房裡的書桌櫃子也是他的傑作。若是願意停下腳步就可以用閒情逸致的心，慢活的心態去欣賞鄉間自然風景及蟲鳴鳥叫聲...........民宿主人就是你的朋友，歡迎來體驗鄉間生活和鄉村深度旅遊的樂趣 !

stays.name: 竹苑
stays.description: 我們是道地的宜蘭人，記憶中的宜蘭是一片又一片的稻田，而稻田中又藏著一片竹林，沿著稻田中的蜿蜒小路走下去，就會發現竹林裡包圍著的是紅磚砌成的四合院，這是我記憶中的宜蘭。小時候清晨上學前，在必經的鄉間小路旁，一片片稻田的畫面，還清楚的烙印在記憶中，稻田裡白鷺鷥、農夫們清早辛勤的耕作，現在才明白，原來這就是平凡的幸福！而我們想找回的，正是這一片土地曾帶給我們心靈上的平靜，”竹苑” 是用現代的方式去表達，找回那份孩提時的記憶，一切結合大自然的元素，只有稻田、原木、紅磚，還有空間裡和陽光的對話，屋外有竹子與水的對話，希望你們也能來到這裡，感受這片土地的美麗與寧靜！有些人、事物、環境不斷的在改變，但是，我們唯一能做的是改變中依然保有它原來的本質與特色，這是我們想做的！府旅觀字第1050098761號http://www.dandl.com.tw/about.php#head

stays.description: 位於宜蘭壯圍鄉的啾吉民宿「河畔館」(又稱：蘭陽河畔居)緊鄰蘭陽溪畔，距離宜蘭著名的羅東夜市及位於宜蘭市的東門夜市僅約12分鐘車程，地理位置優越、交通便利，且社區外設有免費路邊停車空間，非常適合家庭與團體自駕旅遊使用。河畔館為整棟包棟出租空間(一次只接待一組客人)，分為二館(門牌1號)與三館(門牌三號)，每棟基本入住人數為8至16人，若合租則最多可接待32人，附設兩間雙人陽光套房與兩間四人家庭套房，皆有衛浴設備、露臺、冷氣、電視節目，並採全館禁菸政策，提供寬敞明亮、舒適自在的住宿體驗。房價方面，平日包棟每晚只需新台幣12,000元起（12人），假日則為16,000元起（12人），皆可開立收據，十分適合親友聚會、同學會或公司小團體使用。民宿設施相當豐富，從廚房、KTV歡唱設備、免費Wi‑Fi、電動麻將桌到嬰兒澡盆、嬰兒床圍、嬰兒奶瓶消毒鍋等，一應俱全 。河畔館社區門前連接著宜蘭縣最大的溪流「蘭陽溪」的河畔草坪，可以直接走上河堤步道，與幼兒、貓咪或狗狗一起散步，是一處結合自然景緻與舒適住宿的理想空間！
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Zhuangwei Township, Yilan, 9G Riverside House (also known as Lanyang Riverside Stay) sits right beside the scenic Lanyang River. It’s just a 12-minute drive from the famous Luodong Night Market and Dongmen Night Market in Yilan City. With free roadside parking right outside the community, it’s the perfect stay for families or groups traveling by car.The house is available as a full-unit rental, with only one group hosted at a time, ensuring privacy and comfort. It includes two buildings—House 2 (No.1) and House 3 (No.3). Each building accommodates 8 to 16 guests, and both together can host up to 32 guests. Inside, you’ll find two double suites and two family suites, each equipped with a private bathroom, balcony, air conditioning, and TV channels. The entire property is non-smoking, and the space is bright, spacious, and designed for a relaxing stay.Rates start at NT$12,000 per night on weekdays (for 12 guests) and NT$16,000 on weekends (for 12 guests). Official receipts can be issued, making it ideal for family gatherings, reunions, or small corporate groups. The house is fully equipped with a kitchen, KTV sound system, automatic mahjong table, free Wi‑Fi, and family-friendly items like a baby bathtub, bed rail, and bottle sterilizer.Just steps from the entrance, a riverside lawn connects directly to the banks of Lanyang River, the largest river in Yilan. Guests can enjoy peaceful walks along the dike path with children, cats, or dogs—a perfect blend of nature and comfort in one ideal riverside retreat.

stays.name: 靚自然民宿
stays.description: ~~2017年3月全新開幕~~ 「靚自然」民宿雖沒有豪華氣派的外觀、裝潢，卻擁有一種樸實的溫度和經歲月洗鍊後留下的氣韻與質感；乾淨簡單的展示空間裡，放置許多排列整齊的懷舊擺飾，這些皆為民宿主人用心收藏民國初期時的器具與工藝， 像是阿公阿嬤當時使用的碗盤、桌椅、腳踏車、秤、縫紉機…等等，其中也會不定期的更換展示區的擺設喔！ 而民宿內的客房明亮整潔，讓旅人在遠離家園時，也有一處安心的歸屬；另外從民宿步行至大福海濱公園只需10分鐘喔！海灘緊臨宜蘭唯一的海岸線自行車專用道，民宿也貼心提供腳踏車，供來玩的旅人們隨著海風吹拂自在騎乘，享受悠閒漫活的午后。

stays.name: 風車館民宿
stays.description: 坐落於宜蘭壯圍鄉海邊的啾吉民宿‧愛情海館，距離蘭陽動植物王國、壯圍沙丘遊客中心、宜騎緣馬場、壯圍海灘盪鞦韆、永鎮海濱公園皆不到1公里，同時開車約16分鐘即可到達宜蘭縣羅東夜市，交通十分便利，同時，門前有停車場可供免費停放遊覽車、4-9台汽車以即可開立收據，非常適合家庭或學生、公司團體自駕或搭客運出遊。愛情海館以整棟包棟出租為主，建築物雖然分為愛情海主館與風車館，但兩棟會一起待客、一次只皆一組來賓喲！愛情海館共有17個房間，包含：單人雅房1間、雙人雅房1間、雙人套房9間、四人套房6間，啾吉民宿會視人數為來賓提供剛好的房型(其他未使用房間則將上鎖、不接客)。愛情海民宿的基礎入住人數為28人，最多可以加床方式入住65人，超大的住宿人數搭配「戶外25坪獨立烤肉區(有遮陽、廁所)、廚房與KTV歡唱設備、電動麻將桌、免費Wi‑Fi及嬰兒澡盆、奶瓶消毒鍋、床圍等設備，加上鄰近沙灘與多元景點，因此非常推薦做您宜蘭親子包棟住宿、寵物友善住宿的首選！房價方面，愛情海民宿平日包棟價格為新台幣22,000元起（此價格最多可住28人），假日則為 28,000元起（此價格最多可住28人），皆可開立收據，特別適合親友聚會、同學會、企業旅遊等大團體使用。
stays.descriptionEn: Nestled along the coast of Zhuangwei Township in Yilan, 9G Love Ocean Villa is conveniently located less than 1 kilometer from several top attractions, including Lanyang Animal and Botanical Kingdom, Zhuangwei Sand Dunes Visitor Center, Yi Qi Yuan Ranch, Zhuangwei Beach Swings, and Yongzhen Seaside Park. It’s also just a 16-minute drive to the popular Luodong Night Market. The villa offers free parking in front of the property, suitable for tour buses or 4–9 cars, and receipts are available—making it ideal for families, student groups, or corporate outings, whether arriving by car or bus.Although the villa consists of two separate buildings—the Main House and Windmill House—they are rented together as one exclusive booking, with only one group hosted at a time, ensuring privacy and a relaxed experience.There are 17 rooms in total, including: 1 single room (shared bathroom), 1 double room (shared bathroom), 9 double suites, and 6 quadruple suites. Rooms are allocated based on the group size, and unused rooms are securely locked.The base occupancy is 28 people, but the villa can accommodate up to 65 guests with extra beds. Facilities include a spacious 25-ping (approx. 82 sqm) outdoor BBQ area with sunshade and restrooms, a kitchen, KTV karaoke system, electric mahjong table, free Wi‑Fi, as well as baby-friendly items like a bathtub, bottle sterilizer, and bed rails. With its proximity to the beach and multiple attractions, Love Ocean Villa is a perfect choice for family-friendly and pet-friendly group stays in Yilan.Rates start at NT$22,000 per night on weekdays (up to 28 guests) and NT$28,000 on weekends (up to 28 guests). Official receipts are available. This villa is highly recommended for family reunions, class gatherings, and company retreats looking for a spacious and private getaway.shared kitchen, coffee machine, and Wi-Fi. It’s also a pet-friendly accommodation, welcoming furry companions for a cleaning fee of NT$1,000 per pet—making it one of the top choices for private pet-friendly stays in Yilan.

stays.name: 亮院子旅墅
stays.description: 亮院子的位置能將蘭陽平原的美景盡收眼底，遼闊的視野、寧靜優美的環境，四季皆有不同美景。你可以看到綠油油的茶園，近距離觀察到茶葉的生長環境；還能看到連綿的山脈、壯麗的夜景。旅墅內房間寬敞明亮，採光佳，讓旅人們可以舒適地休息，放鬆身心。還提供了各種便利設施，如網路、電視、冷氣...等，讓旅人們在住宿期間享受到家的舒適感。如果您正在計劃旅行，且想要體驗舒適、寧靜且充滿自然氣息的住宿環境，不妨來趟亮院子，一定會讓你有一個難忘的旅程。
stays.descriptionEn: The location of the bright courtyard allows you to have a panoramic view of the beautiful scenery of the Lanyang Plain, with a wide field of vision, a quiet and beautiful environment, and different scenery in four seasons.You can see the green tea gardens and observe the growing environment of tea leaves at close range; you can also see the rolling mountains and the magnificent night view.The rooms in the villa are spacious and bright, with good lighting, allowing travelers to rest comfortably and relax. It also provides a variety of convenient facilities, such as Internet, TV, air-conditioning, etc., so that travelers can enjoy the comfort of home during their stay.If you are planning a trip and want to experience a comfortable, quiet and natural accommodation environment, you might as well come to Liangyuan, which will definitely make you have an unforgettable journey.

stays.name: 微丹民宿
stays.description: 我們愛宜蘭平原 那綠意盎然的田野但我們更加喜愛樹林環繞 那無價的美景清新的空氣 天然的芬多精 樹林間的幽靜遠離城市的喧囂 使這片土地更加樸實、清幽微丹 環山圍繞在玉蘭的一角沒有奢華的裝潢擺設 只有自然的原木建造除了新鮮的空氣外 這裡還瀰漫著淡淡的原木香氣屋內大量的使用落地窗 使採光及視野達到最佳讓我們無時無刻都與這片大自然 零距離
stays.descriptionEn: We love Yilan plain with the lush green fields, but we love being surrounded by woods even more, with their priceless scenery, the refreshing air, the natural phytoncides, the tranquility amongst the woods which is far away from the urban maddening crowd, allowing this piece of land to become even more simple and peaceful. Wei Dan is located in a corner of Yulan surrounded by mountains, without luxurious decorations, and is constructed using only natural logs. Other than the fresh air, this place is also filled with a faint log fragrance; the massive use of French windows in the rooms allow lighting and views to accomplish the ideal state, so that we are right next to the nature at all times.

stays.name: 牡庫．夏民宿
stays.description: 牡庫‧夏民宿位於大同鄉公所前往崙埤部落較高處，遠眺蘭陽溪流湍經泰雅大橋，俯瞰部落全貌，聳立的泰雅生活館，特別突兀，加上清澈見底的野溪，置身其間，不失有如夢幻之境。牡庫夏民宿就在這樣一個特別的地方，山水環繞，視野瞭闊，寧靜淳樸，與大自然接近，享受大自然的禮物，讓都市的朋友忍不住想做個深深的呼吸。而民宿主人竭誠歡迎各位朋友來訪，希望大家來感受不同的生活文化、感受不一樣的生活體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Muku Xia Bed and Breakfast is located at the highest point of Lunpi Tribe on the way to the Datong Township Office, gazing off at Lanyang Stream rushing past Taiya Bridge and looking out over the entire tribe. The towering Atayal Museum is particularly prominent, and standing between it and the clear stream, you feel transported to a place of fantasy. Muku Xia Bed and Breakfast is located in this special place, surrounded by mountains and water, with an expansive view and pure, tranquil atmosphere. Approaching nature, and enjoying its gifts, make every city dweller want to take a deep breath of fresh air. The owner sincerely welcomes all visitors, hoping they experience this unique living culture and experience.

stays.name: 逢春園渡假別墅（ＳＰＲＩＮＧ ＶＩＬＬＡ）
stays.description: 宜蘭｜逢春園．四季靜好的山中憩所細雨落在葉上，一點一點滑落至池畔，你起身往前一望，茵茵綠草透著水珠閃爍， 漫展開來的是眼前一片開闊的景致——深綠、淺綠交疊的山峰下，畫過一痕淺藍的溪水，隨著雲霧逐漸飄散，緩緩露出容顏。晴也好，雨也佳，這裡是四季皆靜好的山中憩所——逢春園。隱身山中的靜謐居所沿著彎曲的小道往山上去，停好車，鼻間是山間沁涼的空氣，一旁大門為你敞開，走進隱密的逢春園，坡道旁是綠意盎然的草坪，幾座歐風雕塑、戶外座椅置放其中。再往內走去，主人許姊熱情地前來迎接，來到半開放的觀景空間，豐盛的迎賓茶點早已為你準備好，喝著來自鄰近茶園的有機蜜香紅茶、嚐口逢春園自種的火龍果與綠豆糕，望向眼前廣闊的景致，心底的煩憂也隨著微風輕吹飄散。逢春園建於1989年，原是許姊結束原先事業而買下的渡假園地，近五千坪的土地全靠著一家人整地打造，沒想到遠離喧囂的山居生活，吸引了親朋好友的來訪，於是築起了新的白色歐式建築作為旅宿，以祖先林阿枝的筆名「逢春」而命名，延續祖先成立的逢春商行的回憶，用同樣的熱忱分享生活。貼近自我的療癒時光踏入房中，聞著寮國香杉的淡淡香氣，心也跟著沈靜下來，以當地的鳥類命名房間，逢春園共有多種房型，以供旅人不同需求。脫下鞋，偌大的窗滿盈綠意，坐臥窗台邊或走進陽台，讓黃橙的夕色淡淡灑落身上，為自己沖一杯溫熱的茶，就這樣看著時光流逝，將悠然的午後留給自己，讓恬靜的景致洗滌疲倦的思緒。在逢春園，除了房內獨享的寬敞空間外，你還能預約嵩屋的紅外線足浴、三溫暖或是能量空間體驗，夜晚，跟著逢春園一泊二食，豐盛的山中美食滿足味蕾，給自己身心全然地放鬆。
stays.descriptionEn: Yilan｜Fengchun VillaA Mountain Retreat that is Peaceful Year RoundA fine drizzle falls upon the leaves, sliding off into the pool below one drop at a time. You stand and look into the distance, and beyond the water droplets sparkling on the soft lawn, an immense scene unfolds before your eyes: layers of dark and light green leading up to mountain peaks, with a light blue stream tracing a path across it all. The clouds and mist slowly disperse, little by little revealing the mountain’s complexion. Rain or shine, this mountain retreat is peaceful year round - Fengchun Villa.A tranquil residence concealed within the mountainsAfter following a winding little road up into the mountains, you park your car and let the refreshing air encircle your nose. To one side, the main doors have been left open for you, so you stroll into the hidden territory which is Fengchun Villa. You admire the lush lawn beside the sloping road, decorated with a few European statues and wooden lawn chairs. You walk deeper into the gardens and Lilysan comes forward extending a warm greeting. Arriving at the semi-open scenic lookout space, you enjoy the tea and snacks that have been prepared for you: organic honey fragrance black tea from a nearby tea farm, dragon fruit from Fengchun Villa’s own gardens, and green bean cakes. You look out over the vast scenery before you as any worries that were hiding deep in your heart are carried away on the gentle mountain breeze.Fengchun Villa was established in 1989 when Lilysan finished her previous business and bought this vacation garden property. Nearly four acres in size, Lilysan and her family prepared and constructed it all themselves. They didn’t expect that this quiet mountain lifestyle, away from the bustle of the city, would attract many family and friends to visit. This inspired the family to construct a white, European style building to serve as a guesthouse, choosing to name it Fengchun after the pen name of an ancestor. As a way to allow the name of their ancestors’ Fengchun Trading Company to live on, they used the same enthusiasm to operate Fengchun Villa as their ancestors did their trading company.An intimate time for self-healingStepping into the house, you smell the mild fragrance of cunninghamia, a type of cypress wood imported from Laos, and it puts your mind at ease. The various guest rooms are named after local birds and are available in many different layouts to meet the different needs of travelers. Taking off your shoes, you admire the abundant greenery outside the massive windows. Reclining beside a window or walking out onto the balcony, the gentle golden light of sunset caresses your body. You pour yourself a hot cup of tea and in this way, feel the slow passage of time. You reserve the afternoon just for yourself, allowing the peaceful view to wash the exhaustion from your train of thoughts. In Fengchun Villa, besides the enjoyment of spacious interior accommodations, you can also make reservations for an infrared foot bath, sauna, or energy space experience. In the evening, the Fengchun Villa menu of rich and sumptuous mountain cuisine is sure to satisfy your taste buds and completely relax both your body and mind.Relaxed and restful mountain lifeThe gentle morning sun signals the start of a new day, urging you toward the table to enjoy a lavish breakfast. You admire the elaborate oil paintings of your host as the mountain air fills you with energy. As a part of your spontaneous vacation, you might set off with your hosts on a scavenger hunt into the mountains, or make reservations for a Chinese tea ceremony. Either of these may help you regain a healthy rhythm for your life, allowing you to experience true comfort from the bottom of your heart, and enjoy the carefree passage of time in the mountains!

stays.description: 在宜蘭太平山下，景觀優美的玉蘭茶樹至高點上，遠眺南湖山脈，重巒疊翠，絲水環繞，景色幻化無窮，2-3月間，庭園周邊八重櫻盛開，鳥語花香，美不勝收。在寧靜、祥和的大自然中，讓您的煩惱與憂愁在此消失殆盡，面對蘭陽溪流域，雅廬景觀度假別墅，精緻典雅的歐式風格裝飾與溫馨親切的賓客接待方式，融合成一股愜意怡然的美好氣氛。
stays.descriptionEn: Beneath Yilan’s Taiping Shan, at the highest point of the scenically beautiful Yulan tea trees, gaze out at the Nanhu Mountain Ridge, with layers of green mountains, surrounding streams, and an ever-changing landscape. From February to March, cherry trees around the courtyard blossom, and the birds sing and the flowers are fragrant, creating an beautiful atmosphere. The tranquility and peacefulness of nature will completely eliminate your worries and cares. Facing Lanyang Stream, Yalu Scenic Vacation Villa features exquisite, elegant European decoration and warm, friendly hospitality, combining to create a pleasant, unrestrained, beautiful atmosphere.

stays.name: 雅韻民宿
stays.description: 徜徉於芬香的環抱之中，伴隨幽靜清雅的嵐；循著流淌的涓涓細流聲，巧遇山間林韻的美。踏踏聲遍佈在蜿蜒的坂道上，驀然回首，慶幸著在眺望遠方的同時，未曾忽略身邊的點滴。緩緩升起的簾幕，帶走了陣陣塵囂，窗邊的雲霧安撫著躁動的心。我矗立在高崗上，期待著與您的相遇。
stays.descriptionEn: Immerse yourself in the fragrance and the mist of mountains. Listen to the sound of the streams and see the beauty of the forest. Walking down the winding paths, don't forget enjoy everything around you when you look in the distance. Leave the mundane life behind and let view outside the window calm your restless heart. I look forward to meeting you here on the hill.

stays.name: 伯斯飯店
stays.description: 伯斯飯店聳立於宜蘭繁華的宜興路旁，位居宜蘭都會中心區，巴洛克時期古堡造型的外觀設計，宏偉非凡，品味卓絕。文藝復興風格的彩繪壁畫、仿古歐洲情懷的燈飾及桌椅、迴旋而上的弧形階梯、撩人遐思的法國香頌。為滿足旅客高品質的完美要求，伯斯飯店精緻而典雅的內部規劃及硬體設施，展現溫馨舒適的氣氛，不僅周到而且貼心，舒適宜人的款待，更讓旅客得以擁有寧靜、溫馨的休憩環境，體貼貴賓的心不言而喻。距離宜蘭火車站僅3分鐘路程，宜蘭轉運站5分鐘路程，東門觀光夜市正對面，商店及麥當勞等美食小吃，環繞四週，飯店附設茶水巴黎西餐廳，並備有免費平面式停車場及全館WIFI免費使用、免費自行車租借悠遊宜蘭自由行、撞球及健身房等設施免費使用。
stays.descriptionEn: Grand Boss Hotel stands beside the prosperous Yixing Road in Yilan, located in the central area of ​​Yilan City. Its Baroque castle-style exterior design is magnificent and of outstanding taste.Renaissance-style painted murals, lamps and tables and chairs with antique European style, spiraling curved stairs, and alluring French chanson. In order to meet the high-quality and perfect requirements of travelers, the exquisite and elegant interior planning and hardware facilities of the Grand Boss Hotel show a warm and comfortable atmosphere. It is not only thoughtful but also considerate. The comfortable and pleasant hospitality allows travelers to have a quiet and warm resting environment. The considerate heart for Valued Guests is self-evident.It is only 3 minutes away from Yilan Railway Station and 5 minutes away from Yilan Transfer Station. It is directly opposite the Dongmen Tourist Night Market and surrounded by shops and McDonald's. The hotel has a Tea Paris Restaurant, free parking and free WIFI throughout the hotel, free bicycle rental for you to travel in Yilan, billiards and gym facilities.

stays.description: 友愛飯店座落於交通便利市中心友愛百貨之樓上，為集結享樂、美食購物於一處之飯店。至宜蘭車站步行約六分鐘，且緊鄰宜蘭東門夜市，臨近福山植物園、傳藝中心等知名景點。客房設計以時尚新潮為裝潢主軸，溫馨適意。每間皆有wi-fi服務，中庭採挑高設計，氣派非凡。白天遠眺窗外之蘭陽平原、龜山朝日、雪山山脈之群峰巒疊等景致。夜晚俯瞰萬家燈火，蘭陽風貌盡收眼底。
stays.descriptionEn: Yoai Hotel is conveniently located in downtown Yilan, on top of Hoai Department Store. It& #39;s a hotel that has pleasure and fine cuisine all under one roof. It& #39;s about a 6-minute walk from the Yilan Station and it& #39;s close to a number of famous tourist attractions: Yilan& #39;s Dongmen Night Market, Fushan Botanical Garden and National Center for Traditional Arts. The guestrooms are modern, trendy, warm and comfortable. Every room has wifi connection. The atrium& #39;s high ceiling is extraordinary. stays.name: 和睦二十六旅店
stays.description: 「和睦26旅店」由三位曾經共同參與台北五星級飯店興建籌設的夥伴所創立，他們有五星級飯店管理的專業與堅持、體貼的設計與設備、具環保概念的綠化配置，他們共同的夢想是要讓旅客以合理的價格，享受五星級飯店的服務品質！選擇距離宜蘭火車站只有5分鐘路程、鄰近宜蘭著名「東門夜市」，就是要讓旅客到了宜蘭，不用再轉車，晚上也有逛街的地方，睡飽精神好，對旅人而言；是種奢求。隔日可在旅店1樓享用早餐，優哉品嚐咖啡後；去探索宜蘭著名景點如幾米廣場、蘭陽博物館、冬山河、傳藝中心、羅東林場、太平山等好玩的地方，「和睦26旅店」就是這樣為處處為出門在外的旅人著想！旅行可以使人放鬆，從不同角度看世界，那種優閒，是一種享受，旅行大多要住宿，人的一生有多少次在外住宿的機會，多數人希望住宿的環境有家溫馨的感覺，有乾淨、明亮的空間，有受尊重及便利的服務，這是一個旅行者最普世的要求，也是「和睦26旅店」努力的目標。無論是過路客，或是專程來小歇一番，和睦26旅店都能讓您流連忘返，給您一個家的感覺～一、平價享受五星級飯店設備二、3 分鐘可到達幾米廣場、東門夜市三、享用咖啡廳早餐套餐四、近交通要點，搭乘火車、客運下車步行即可到達五、單人床/雙人床提供背包客、學生、商務、家庭出遊最豐富的選擇

stays.description: 悅川用心/款待入心悅川酒店致力於表達深度內涵的人文情懷，提供賓客溫款細膩的待客之道。從訂房時刻開始，我們便像等待家人一樣的歡迎您，超越文化語言的隔閡，與旅客建立深刻自然的默契，期待這安靜而毫不喧譁的親切，能讓悅川沁涼您擾嚷之心。旅人生命中的瓦爾登湖在美國哲學作家梭羅的「湖濱散記」中所呈現的寂靜，自在、美麗，正是悅川THE WALDEN 期待帶給旅人的獨特體驗。無論是夾著一支鉛筆與素描本，安靜地完成旅行紀錄，還是戴上相機與自行車，姿意捕捉葛瑪蘭原鄉的大美，抑或與親人好友遠離喧囂和樂相聚，在悅川的時光，必是您生命中美好的春光。悅川用心/打造美好的蘭陽之旅美麗的蘭陽平原，動靜宜賞，這土地孕育出的勝景人文，更值得您細品壯遊。悅川酒店備有旅遊行程規劃及專人為您安排充實的旅遊內涵。另提供禮車接送、商務會議、健身房、藝術品收藏區等精緻服務與設施，充分滿足旅客需求，竭力為您打造一段「蘭陽的美好生活」。
stays.descriptionEn: The Walden is here to provide a warm and hospitable accommodation service.With the expression of in-depth humanistic culture, The Walden is here to provide our honored guests with a warm and hospitable accommodation service.From the beginning of your room reservation, we will welcome you like our own family member.Beyond the cultural and language barrier, our honored guests could immerse themselves in a peaceful and wonderful natural atmosphere,completely away from the hustle and bustle of the modern city.Walden LakeThe quiet, free, beautiful lake sceneries depicted in the "Life in the Woods" as written by noted transcendentalist Henry David Thoreau is the exact unique experienceThe Walden wishes to provide its visitors.Whether you want to spend some time with your family and friends away from the city or capture the beautiful sceneries ofKAMALAN hometown with a pencil,sketch board, camera or a bicycle ride, the Walden has everything for everyone.The Walden is here to create a wonderful Lanyang journey for all our visitors.Being the birthplace to both beautiful sceneries and humanistic culture, the beautiful Lanyang Plain is a place for you to spend your vacation with family and friends.Here at the Walden, travel itinerary planning and tour consultation service are provided to enrich your personal journey. In addition, the hotel also offers a varietyof services such as limousine transportation, business conference room, gymnasium, art collection area and other facilities to meet the needs of all travelers.

stays.name: 杜拜時尚戀館
stays.description: 時尚中的時尚杜拜巧思設計，構築宮廷般奢華時尚，精雕細琢峇里島南國情調、地中海浪漫風情、紐約極簡主義，突破典型商業空間設計，揉合品味內涵、創意美感、機能需求，創造出全新空間體驗。奢華中的奢華杜拜為您精心規畫所有細節，衛浴設備採用與阿拉伯杜拜相同之七星級產品，德國進口GROHE蓮蓬頭花灑、德國進口Villeroy & Boch衛浴、精心規劃俯瞰宜蘭市全景之景觀餐廳、精心打造峇里島風情專屬戲水池、超微氣泡牛奶浴、特製原木烤箱、豪華湧泉按摩浴缸、花灑黃金雨、法式維琪浴、蒸氣室、原木地板、大型液晶電視、立體環繞音響等極致奢華設備。尊寵中的尊寵杜拜秉持以客為尊的信念，所有服務人員均經專業訓練，以提供殷勤備至、細膩溫心的服務；客房寢具與所有用品清潔，均經消毒及嚴格把關，以提供潔淨舒適的休憩環境；採用合法防火建材。【宜蘭唯一迴旋車道直達房間維護最佳隱私並設有反偷拍偵防系統，以提供安全清靜的休閒時光。】【６樓景觀餐廳中西自助早餐，一覽宜蘭市風光，給貴賓您味覺與視覺享受】Tesla超級充電站杜拜為您提供最極致的服務，不管是住宿或是休息，房內提供特斯拉充電站，供顧客使用，需要時請先來電為您預留房型，謝謝。

stays.name: 東旅宜蘭館
stays.description: 坐落於宜蘭是的設計旅店。盡享鄉村之息的美好時光低調日式侘寂與清水模風格，呼應著宜蘭舊城所散發的懷舊魅力。在這裡，時間的流逝都更加悠然。步入宜蘭東旅，彷彿進入時光迴廊。尋求寧靜者在此尋得心靈淨土，旅行者則開啟探索之旅。周遭古街古巷中，懷舊風光仿佛永恆、呼吸間彌漫著清新空氣，時間也在此放慢了腳步。
stays.descriptionEn: Hotel in Ilan - Hotel East Yilan , we provide not only accommodation and catering service of a professional level, more importantly, the unique style formulated from our sophisticated culture! We sincerely hope all of our guests can feel the infinite sensation in it. Whether you are on business or vacation, you will be able to get rid off your pressure with ease during your stay at the atmosphere of elegance and quietness here in Hotel East Yilan. To show our appreciation towards your visit, we have applied for an travel accident insurance for every check-in guest and provide other heartening services, including free breakfast and shuttle reservation. We have also set up a private parking area exclusively for guests to highlight our hospitality. With these consistent and caring service, Hotel East Yilan in Ilan guarantees you a heartwarming and satisfying trip!

stays.name: 葳格行旅
stays.description: Wogo Hotel酒飯店在宜蘭提供帶免費無線網絡連接的空調客房。設有24小時前台和旅遊諮詢台。酒店內設有免費停車場。Wogo Hotel酒店距離宜蘭火車站或夜市有15分鐘的步行路程。宜蘭體育公園距離酒店有10分鐘的車程。距離台北市有1小時的車程，距離桃園國際機場有1.5小時車程。距離太平山有2小時的車程。這些客房均設有隔音設施，電視，冰箱和帶浴缸和淋浴設施的連接浴室。部分客房還設有spa浴缸。Wogo Hotel酒店設有一個花園。汽車旅館還提供行李寄存服務。宜蘭火車站或宜蘭客運碼頭提供免費接送服務，需提前3天提前預約。
stays.descriptionEn: Wogo Hotel offers air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi in Yilan. It features a 24-hour front desk and a tour desk. Free parking is possible on site. Wogo Hotel is a 15-minute walk from Yilan Railway Station or Night Market. It takes 10 minutes by car from Yilan Sports Park to the property. Taipei City is 1 hour's drive away while Taoyuan International Airport is a 1.5-hour car journey away. Taiping Mountain can be reached in 2 hours' drive. Rooms here are all soundproofing, and includes a TV, a fridge and en suite bathroom with a bathtub and shower facilities. Some units also feature a spa bathtub. At Wogo Hotel you will find a garden. The motel also offers luggage storage. Free pick-up service is provided from Yilan Railway Station or Yilan Coach Terminal with reservation at least 3 days in advance needed.

stays.name: 蘭城晶英酒店
stays.description: 晶華國際酒店集團進駐宜蘭市政商中心，創建優質服務的國際會議渡假酒店，連結傳統蘭陽與現代生活美學的品味，距台北南港、信義計畫區不到一小時車程。193間寬敞客房、千坪戶外空中花園、挑高八米無柱式千人宴會廳、中西式美饌餐廳、豐華會健康俱樂部、沐蘭Spa，結合東部最大購物商城蘭城新月廣場，打造一座新概念的度假勝地One-Stop Destination，滿足完美假期的所有想像，體驗蘭陽文化深度、美食娛樂、豐富樂活、物超所值的慢活假期。
stays.descriptionEn: Formosa International Hotels Group, stationed in the Yilan municipal business center, has established the international conference resort hotel to offer quality services. It connects the tastes of traditional Lanyang and modern life aesthetic. Less than one hour's drive from Nangang and Xinyi District of Taipei. The Hotel features 193 spacious rooms, outdoor sky gardens with an area of 3,300 square meters, eight-meter high-ceilinged pillarless ballroom able to accommodate up to one thousand people, Chinese and Western restaurants, Fenghua Club Health Club, and Wellspring Spa. Combines the largest shopping mall in Eastern Taiwn, LUNA Plaza, to create a new concept resort One-Stop Destination to satisfy all the imagination of a perfect holiday and experience Lanyang cultural depth, gourmets and entertainment, rich LOHAS, and slow living holiday of value for money.

stays.description: 『蘭天民宿』坐落在宜蘭旅遊中心點，交通便捷，是您旅遊宜蘭最好的住所。蘭天主人在年輕時為生活離鄉背井前往都市，大半輩子都疲於工作，為了離開都市的喧鬧紛擾，在２００７年回來故鄉築夢，實現嚮往已久的田野生活。湛藍的天空，徐徐的微風，恬靜的田野，一切都是那麼自然。『蘭天民宿』邀您一同體驗鄉村之美，另還有免費提供種菜園地，讓您體驗農村樂趣。
stays.descriptionEn: “Lan-tian Homestay” is located at the touring center of I-Lan. Being convenient for traffic, it is the best location to stay when making tour around I-Lan. When he was young, the owner of Lan-tian Homestay left I-Lan to start his career in big city and he was fully occupied by the work during most of his time. To escape the hubbub life of city, he returned to the hometown to build his dream in 2007 to realize the countryside life that he had been longing for. Bluish sky, gentle breeze, quiet country. Everything is so natural! “Lan-tian Homestay” cordially invites you to experience the beauty of countryside in I-Lan and provides free vegetable gardening land for you to enjoy a fun time on the farm fields.

stays.name: 雲海軒
stays.description: 一對退休的夫妻，在奉獻志業大半輩子後，開始雲遊四海到各處去旅行，閱覽世界各地的壯闊景觀及風土民情來豐富自己的人生與視野…‥。在這段雲遊期間，受到許多旅店主人的接待與服務，讓他們備感溫馨與感念…‥。基於回饋的心，興起了籌辦一間質量高、服務熱忱且讓人倍感溫馨的民宿，也使來自世界各地的旅人有讓他們服務與接待的機會…‥。經過三年的發想與籌劃，在宜蘭市郊靠近員山鄉交界處…‥「雲海軒」民宿誕生了。「雲」與「海」兩字各取自兩夫妻姓名其中一字，有著歡迎「雲遊四海」的旅人之意，「軒」字面之義則為恬淡優雅的小屋，希望讓旅人們感受到回家的溫馨.....

stays.name: 79號角落
stays.description: -在79號角落，找到你的專屬小宇宙！想逃離城市的喧囂，來點療癒系的微旅行嗎？#79號角落民宿Villa 等你來躺平！距離礁溪市區只要10分鐘，鬧中取靜剛剛好～走出門就是水鳥保護區，大自然環繞，每一口空氣都像洗了肺！無論你是想和親愛的一起放空、帶孩子來放電，還是跟朋友來一場說走就走的小旅行，這裡都有你需要的 chill 感、放鬆 vibe 和滿滿好拍的角落！房間寬敞舒適，拍照直接美成一片 IG 牆，躺在床上看夕陽發呆、聽水鳥唱歌，根本不想退房！快來 #79號角落民宿Villa，一起打卡生活裡最可愛的角落吧！
stays.descriptionEn: -Find your own little universe at corner 79!Want to escape from the hustle and bustle of the city and take a healing micro trip?#79 Corner B&B Villa is waiting for you to lie down!It is only 10 minutes away from Jiaoxi city, and it is just the right place for a quiet place in the bustling city.Just outside the door is the water bird sanctuary, surrounded by nature, and every breath of air feels like cleansing your lungs!Whether you want to relax with your loved ones, take your children to relax, or go on a spontaneous trip with friends,Here you will find all the chill, relaxing vibes and plenty of great photo spots you need!The room is spacious and comfortable, and the photos are so beautiful that they can be easily taken on Instagram.I lay in bed, staring at the sunset and listening to the water birds singing. I didn’t want to check out at all!

stays.name: 中冠礁溪大飯店
stays.description: 我們相信，正面的生活觀可以啟動健康，感受溫泉溫暖是最好的紓壓方式。我們相信，以中冠為根莖樹幹，攜手的夥伴形成肢體，一起經營出顧客的幸福溫泉。我們相信，對礁溪溫泉的熱愛可以成為事業，延展出一片天。這樣的信念從得知礁溪始祖級的溫泉飯店之一「礁溪大飯店」要結束經營時，百般不捨，現任老闆認為身為礁溪人，理當肩負起延續礁溪溫泉的發展，決定接手撥下希望種籽。特別聘請了名師精心設計，既保留礁溪特有的泡湯風情，以東方養生智慧的生活型態與身心休憩調養需求計畫，跟隨著大自然的季節性變化，以春夏養陽、秋冬養陰的原理，並融合高科技SPA設備，完美結合礁溪天然資源，富含礦物質，泉水滑洗凝脂的潤澤特性，彷彿身心踏入遠離塵囂的自然祕境；讓旅客能抽離日常煩囂壓力，讓身心輕鬆滿足“即時放鬆”需求所在。訂房專線：+886-3-9882011~5

images.description: 淡雅和風的色系搭配構成東西合併的異國情調。在12坪的自在空間往外探索，無一處不是翠綠的自然景觀，可以在這裡感受到城市中少有的輕鬆悠閒的渡假氛圍，擁有12坪獨立空中花園與戶外的泡湯池，可於晨曦時觀賞鄉野日出、夜空星座美景是此房型最迷人之處

stays.name: 友愛礁溪溫泉飯店
stays.description: HOTELj礁溪館位於礁溪最繁華地段，交通便利可通往各宜蘭景點，提供舒適如家的溫馨環境。緊鄰商店區、小吃街、遊客可以逛街購物，品嚐礁溪溫泉道地美食。HOTELj礁溪館位於台九線公路上，交通便利，離火車站、客運站步行皆5分鐘。國道五號高速公路經頭城交流道下來車程約5-8分鐘即可抵達。飯店為獨棟5層樓建築，擁有31間客房，迎賓大廳、餐廳及每間客房都具有蘭陽特色風格。配有泡湯浴池、冷氣、衛星頻道/有線電視、無線上網(免費)等頂級設備；礁溪溫泉泉質為獨特的平原碳酸氫鈉泉，無色無味全台獨一無二的美人湯。館內各房型均配有泡湯浴池，和室房乾濕分離，讓您在客房即可享受礁溪特有的美人湯。都會時尚設計風格及活潑彩繪壁畫空間，提供旅人多元舒適的居住空間。「j」就是「家」，Hotelj以家的品牌形象為主要訴求，讓您享受回家的幸福小時光。飯店提供中西式自助式早餐，讓您在下榻休憩之餘享受道地的蘭陽風味。
stays.descriptionEn: HOTEL j Jiaoxi is located in the most bustling part of Jiaoxi, a location from which it is convenient to get to any attraction in Yilan. Better yet, we provide a warm and comfortable environment to make you feel at home.We are right next to the shops and food streets. Visitors may shop and taste the authentic delicacies of the Jiaoxi hot spring. HOTEL j Jiaoxi is located on Provincial Highway Number 9. Transportation is convenient as we are within a 5-minute walking distance from both the train station as well as the bus station. We are within 5-8 minutes driving distance after getting off State Highway Number 5 via Toucheng Interchange. The hotel itself is a single 5-story building equipped with 31 guest rooms. The reception lobby, restaurant and each room are all designed with the unique Lanyang style. We are also equipped with the best facilities such as hot spring pools, air conditioning, satellite/cable TV and free Wi-Fi. The hot springs in Jiaoxi also known as the springs of beauty, are unique plain sodium bicarbonate springs. It is colorless, odorless and the only one in Taiwan. All room types in the hotel are outfitted with a spring pool, Japanese style room separation of dry and wet,allowing you to enjoy the spring of beauty unique to Jiaoxi right in your room. Guest rooms are designed in the metropolitan fashion style and painted in a colorful manner, providing travelers with a diverse and comfortable living area. "j" means "Home." HOTEL j's main appeal is our brand image of homeliness, allowing you to enjoy the sweet times of being at home. HOTEL j offers buffet-style breakfast in Chinese and Western styles, allowing you to enjoy the authentic Lanyang taste during your stay.We uphold the spirits of passion, care and thoughtfulness as we serve our guests. Your trip will transcend simple tourism and become an enjoyable experience of relaxation for mind and body.

stays.description: 本館提供31間的客房，用最簡約時尚的風格，搭配天然岩片大浴池，讓您盡情享受PH質在7.0~7.4之間的碳酸氫鈉泉，也就是俗稱的「美人湯」。我們希望每位賓客入住在旅店裡，能夠以攝氏50度C最原粹的溫泉，讓您解放惱人的焦慮並且讓您恢復活力與精神。「溫暖人心的旅店」是園仔湯的經營理念，希望讓每位賓客細細品味，宜蘭的好山好水好風景，隨時都讓您感動，讓我們用最純樸的心，開始體驗旅遊饗宴。
stays.descriptionEn: If what you're looking for is a conveniently located hotel in Yilan, look no further than Garden Hot-Spring. Only 90 KM away, this 3-star hotel can be easily accessed from the airport. With its convenient location, the hotel offers easy access to the city's must-see destinations.Take advantage of a wealth of unrivaled services and amenities at this Yilan hotel. The hotel provides free Wi-Fi in all rooms, fax machine, taxi service, photocopying, daily housekeeping to ensure our guests the greatest comfort. 31 rooms spread over 5 floors provide a warm and pleasant home away from home. Modern comforts such as internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, air conditioning, wake-up service can be found in selected rooms. The complete list of recreational facilities is available at the hotel, including hot spring bath. Garden Hot-Spring is an ideal place of stay for travelers seeking charm, comfort and convenience in Yilan.

stays.name: 大漁日和
stays.description: 宜蘭｜大漁日和．豐收！老饕心中最鮮美的和風饗宴經過雪山隧道，下了交流道轉進小路，空氣中飄散稻野的香氣，迷人的宜蘭，說是台北的後花園似乎太委屈，這兒，是每個旅人心中的桃花源；而大漁日和，就是每個老饕心中最鮮美的香格里拉。感受日式家庭的細膩大漁日和如同每一個位在宜蘭的民宿，躲在田間路邊，也藏在人情味裡。即使如此卻很難錯過它，淺灰石板上嵌著木門，一旁放著幾台腳踏車和植栽，和四周水泥建築相比，多了些溫暖。推開門還沒進屋，在玄關就能聞到濃濃的木頭香，木製長桌上的自在鉤，小炭爐上懸掛著茶壺，而玄關上那彩色熱鬧的大漁旗，在日本就是象徵漁獲豐收之意，看著紅色的鯛魚躍於陽光下、富士山與大浪間，彷彿也傳遞著大漁日和期許自己帶給旅人豐收鮮美的滿足與感動。女主人小珊輕聲細語地上前接待我們，真誠的笑容讓每個旅人像是拜訪了一戶傳統的日本家庭，體驗他們在生活上的細緻堅持。 「我們的初心，就是讓大家來宜蘭度假、吃宜蘭的魚，發現台灣的魚這麼好吃！」因為有妻子小珊的支持，眼光精準的男主人游大哥，看準當時民宿沒人結合宜蘭在地新鮮海產、礁溪泡湯的住宿空間，率先推出一泊二食，竟從此打響名聲、躍為一房難求的美味旅宿指標。體驗慢活的溫度來到以原木打造的大漁日和，沿著樓梯爬上二樓，左右對稱的兩間房裡都有舒適的兩層空間。臥室有鬆軟的床和一整片面對開闊田野的大窗，泡完湯換上輕柔的浴衣坐在和室，捧著熱茶聊天下棋，一轉頭就能見到窗外鮮綠的稻田，在候鳥的季節，還會有高腳鴴漫步其間。樓上則是一整層屬於你的私人湯屋，面積不大卻風情萬種。寬敞的泉池和三四個好友一起泡湯也不覺擁擠，沐浴在礁溪溫潤的泉水，再來杯冰涼的清酒一飲而盡，看著落地窗外一院整理得極佳的枯山水，這就是屬於你的快意時光，溫暖卻又滿足。
stays.descriptionEn: Yilan｜TaioriPlentiful Harvest! The Gourmand’s Ideal Japanese FeastPassing through the Snow Mountain Tunnel and exiting the highway interchange, you turn down a small road into a rural atmosphere rich with the scent of rice paddies. To say that the enchanting county of Yilan is akin to Taipei’s backyard garden simply doesn’t do it justice. This place could more rightly be described as every traveler’s ideal paradise. In the same way, Taiori is every Japanese cuisine-loving gourmand’s Shangri-la.Experience the exquisite character of a Japanese-style homeAs with every other bed and breakfast in Yilan county, Taiori is tucked away beside farmers’ fields, and exudes a generous and friendly ambiance. Even though this is so, it’s difficult to miss the sight of it, with its light gray slate wall and wooden door. To one side of the door sit several bicycles and potted plants. Compared to the other cement buildings in the area, Taiori radiates a different kind of warmth.Opening the doors and stepping forward, you immediately smell the rich aroma of solid wood. Above a long wooden table, a Japanese-style water kettle hangs peacefully from a hook over a charcoal burner. A colorful Japanese-style flag bearing the name of the bed and breakfast hangs on the wall in the entrance. Symbolic in Japan of a plentiful fishing harvest, the colorful red fish leaping into the sunshine between Mount Fuji and a magnificent sea wave seem to represent the feelings of satisfaction and abundance that Taiori hopes to give to every guest. Your hostess, Shan, approaches and greets you in her delicate voice. Her genuine smile gives every traveler the feeling that they have arrived at a traditional Japanese household, and are about to experience the meticulous attention to detail characteristic of the Japanese. “Our original motivation was to allow people to travel to Yilan for a vacation, to eat local fish, and discover the deliciousness of Taiwanese fish!” With his wife Shan’s support, Wesley exacting tastes realized that no other bed and breakfast had yet combined the local seafood of Yilan with the hot springs for which Jiaoxi is famous into a single space. So they took the initiative and constructed just such a landmark restaurant guesthouse which is now in high demand.Experience the warmth of slow livingWhen you arrive at Taiori with its solid wood construction and head upstairs to the second floor, the symmetrical rooms left and right both consist of comfortable two-level spaces. The bedrooms contain soft beds and a full wall of windows overlooking the vast fields beyond. After soaking in the hot spring bathtub, you don a supple bathrobe and sit in the Japanese-style space sipping hot tea and playing Chinese chess. Turning your head, you admire the bright green rice paddies outside the windows. During migratory bird season, black-winged stilts with their long, slender legs can be seen wading slowly through the fields.The upper level of each room consists of your very own private hot spring spa which, however small, is brimming with character. The spacious hot spring bathtub is large enough for three or four friends to enjoy without feeling crowded. Bathing in the gentle hot spring water of Jiaoxi, while sipping a glass of ice-cold sake wine and marveling at the meticulously manicured Japanese garden outside the floor-to-ceiling windows, you feel elated and content.Collect for safe keeping all the delicious memoriesFor the gourmand traveler, the most fascinating element of Taiori B&B is obviously the sumptuous evening meal. When he was a boy, Wesley fell in love with eating and enjoyed helping his mother in the kitchen. Stationed in Shitiping, he often joined the fishermen at sea, experiencing firsthand how to eat freshly caught fish raw and straight from the sea. Seizing the opportunity to open a restaurant beside the Shitiping Harbor, he learned the ropes for cooking seafood while consulting his indigenous chef friends. To this day, Wesley still makes daily trips to the harbor to select the freshest fish, always striving to prepare a unique seasonal menu just for you.Appetizers consist of Yilan’s famous smoked duck and handpicked seaweed. Japanese Jack mackerel, Oriental tuna, and sweet prawns caught fresh that evening are prepared into sashimi, allowing you to savor their most authentic flavor. Precious harlequin shrimp and red big-eyed fish are served lightly salted and broiled to perfection to preserve the delicate freshness of the meat. The seasonal main dish is fried on a pottery skillet: anglerfish liver, testes, and maw served with a rich variety of vegetables and mushrooms, paired with a clear soup and light brown Japanese soy sauce. The sweetness of the veggies perfectly complements the savory fish in mildly salty sauce to produce an indescribable array of flavors. The meal is followed at last by a bowl of miso soup and a kumquat slushie. Using the authentic flavors of the best unadorned ingredients, tonight’s meal leaves you with an unforgettable dining experience.In operation for nearly nine years, Wesley and Shan have not lost their passion for life. Through the hot springs of Jiaoxi and their deliciously sincere intention, they take care of the heart of every traveler. Between blue sky and green fields, they have created a happy safe harbor, providing you with relaxation and peace of mind.

stays.name: 天隆大飯店
stays.description: 想要盡情體驗宜蘭縣的精彩， 礁溪天隆大飯店絕對是您的最佳旅伴。 在這裡，旅客們可輕鬆前往市區內各大旅遊、購物、餐飲地點。天隆大飯店距離火車站、轉運站及礁溪溫泉公園等景點都只要步行5-7分鐘就能抵達。【天隆大飯店觀光局評鑑三星級旅店】天隆大飯店雖然只有33間房,全館採用五星級名牌衛浴設備（美國Kohler，義大利Perla按摩浴池），觀音石沏湯池，傳達我們為泡湯特質量身訂做的初衷！走進房內感性的湯屋，浸浴中樂音飄香，潺潺湧泉，用心與永續經營就是天隆的最佳特色!旅客對早餐絕大多數都給予高分讚許!房內的床多屬獨立套筒並採用高比例羽絨被,讓你睡得舒服,使您的煩憂隨之蒸融；與溫泉好好的談一場戀愛！天隆擁有多項ＳＰＡ功能的半露天景觀水療湯池，能讓您在微風拂面，清音漫妙中眺望蘭陽夜景，是舒緩一天疲憊的良藥。
stays.descriptionEn: If you want to experience Yilan County to the fullest, Tian Long Hotel will absolutely be your best partner. Here, you can go to many tourist, shopping and dining spots at ease. Only a 5-7 minute walk from Tian Long Hotel can take you to numerous spots, such as train station, transfer station and Jiaoxi Hot Spring Park. ""Tourism Bureau grants three star rating – Tian Long Hotel"" Although we have only 33 rooms, the bathroom equipment we have is all from 5-star brand like Kohler (the U.S.) and Perla whirlpool tub (Italy). The hot spring bath built with Kuan Yin stones perfectly conveys our concept of enjoying hot springs! As you walk into the bath, the beautiful music will help you relax in the warm spring. Servicing with all heart and sustainable operation are what Tian Long care about! The breakfast is quite popular among our guests! Our rooms are mostly equipped with independent cylinder and down comforter to make it possible for you to leave all of your worries behind and have a sweet dream. Let’s fall in love with hot spring! Tian Long Hotel has several semi-outdoor scenery hot spring pools which can act as SPAs. You can appreciate the night scenes of the Lanyang Plain and enjoy the soft breeze and music, while easing the fatigue throughout the day.

stays.name: 太子行旅
stays.description: 太子行旅位於礁溪溫泉中心地段，台九省道旁，擁有各式溫泉套房，房內２４小時供應碳酸氫納質溫泉。太子行旅有寧靜的空間、溫馨的擺設，讓閣下在踏入飯店的同時，即可感受到一股休閒與自在的氣圍，精緻典雅的溫泉套房，更讓您平日忙碌的生活步調，在此獲得舒緩，旅途的疲憊身心，也在這樣的環境下充分得到紓解，邀您共同前來體驗，這難得的閑情雅致生活。從踏入飯店這一刻起，溫暖的氣氛，譜成一頁美麗的日記。
stays.descriptionEn: The Prince Hotel is located at the heart of Jiaoxi hot spring, next to Provincial Highway No. 9. With different hot spring suites, sodium bicarbonate hot spring is provided within the rooms for 24 hrs. The Prince Hotel provides a tranquil space with cozy furnishings. At the moment you step into the hotel, you can immediately feel the comfy and leisure atmosphere. The elegant and exquisite hot spring suites allow you to soothe your busy daily rhythm and release all the fatigue from the journey. Within this environment, you’ll be fully relaxed! You are welcome to experience such memorable graceful life style.

stays.name: 宅楠villa會館
stays.description: 宅楠選用了大量的木頭裝飾，木質家具、木質天花板，竹編燈飾等等。我認為木材是最溫暖、最具有生命力的材料，能夠帶給人們舒適、溫馨的感覺，也能讓人們感受到大自然的氣息。 為了實現我們的理念，在設計民宿時考慮了每個細節，為客人提供了舒適、寧靜、放鬆的環境。在每個客房中都設置了大片的落地窗，讓客人可以欣賞到外面的田野美景，同時也為房間帶來了自然光線，讓客房更加通透明亮 讓您享受生活
stays.descriptionEn: Zhai Nan uses a lot of wood decoration, wooden furniture, wooden ceilings, bamboo lighting and so on. I think wood is the warmest and most vital material, which can bring people a comfortable and warm feeling, and can also make people feel the breath of nature. In order to realize our concept, every detail was considered when designing the B&B to provide guests with a comfortable, tranquil and relaxing environment. Large floor-to-ceiling windows are set up in each guest room, allowing guests to enjoy the beautiful scenery of the fields outside. It also brings natural light to the room, making the room more transparent and brighter, allowing you to enjoy life.

stays.name: 小萵旅店
stays.description: 小萵旅店-宜蘭縣旅館074號小窩旅店延續經營理念「慢生活。漫回想。再出發」這次我們在礁溪溫泉鄉，擁有自己的一棟小天地，穿上自己喜歡的顏色，戴著自己挑選的花朵，用恰到好處的空間，全新裝修小窩獨有的風格，漫遊在像太陽般溫暖的溫泉水，感受水霧裊裊輕輕按撫著我們，讓我們與慢生活距離更近了，擁抱這趟旅程美好回憶，明天醒來整裝再出發。初識礁溪小窩，最先映入眼簾的繽紛色彩，慢漫的將心情染成彩色，緊接著推開不想沾染商業氣息的大門，進門後，是被彩色浪潮包圍的花海，浪潮拍打著花海，激起了被遺忘的好心情，真的是很棒的感受。整間旅店的裝潢及擺飾都是我們親手設計佈置，每間浴室的地壁磚是台北宜蘭二地挑選，每個房間的傢俱也是台北台中二地物色，就是要小窩風格，包含局部油漆及Logo等店內視覺識別，可都是由小窩動手設計施工呢。礁溪小窩位於礁溪湯圍溝溫泉公園對面，推薦窩友們來礁溪爬爬山／泡溫泉／賞夜景／吃美食。天矇矇亮出發抹茶山，看看山巒美景，或是天亮了到林美石磐步道/跑馬古道走走，瞧瞧樹林成蔭，潺潺流水，近在呎尺的湯圍溝溫泉公園也要去體驗體驗，太陽下山後安排個浪漫夜景，老街美食轉一圈，大塊朵頤一番後，回到礁溪小窩，溫泉熱氣裊裊升起，慵懶的享受慢舒眠，完整了漫活的一天。我們與小萵旅店的距離～湯圍溝溫泉公園50公尺中山路老街450公尺跑馬古道1公里抹茶山3公里林美石盤步道6公里Learn moreStay a moment and Keep going!*旅店全面禁菸*為提供旅客一個舒適的住宿環境，小窩旅店全面禁菸，旅客在入住前一天，需線上簽署住宿守則，表示同意禁菸規定，若經發現違反禁菸規定者，本旅店有權要求支付三天房價做為清潔費，以進行房間除味淨化工程。

stays.name: 山形閣
stays.description: 日本山形，擁有許多天然壯闊的風景與充滿神祕的山寺，境內連綿著藏王連峰，絕美的白靄樹冰與夕照斜陽，冰雪的山路與氤氳的溫泉，傳達出大自然的奧妙景緻之姿。隨著仙台線的延伸，橫亙於山嶽上的山寺，是修行者的一大靈地。漫步在清幽的步道上，過往的景色事物總帶著幾分神秘色彩，讓人忘卻了世俗羈絆，平靜地休憩在這神聖境地中。關於山形 ‧ 與噶瑪蘭有「平原民族」之稱的宜蘭原住民-葛瑪蘭族，孕育灌溉了這片土地，並與山林有著密不可分的共生關係。山形閣以當地獨特的風俗文化為靈感，外觀設計採用原住民家園生活的山嶽地形及雄偉垂直的峭壁為主題，裝潢設備融入古老的傳統歷史，與地區性的歸屬認同感，使人感受自然平靜的親和力。客房內搭配細膩柔和的色彩，天然石材與木質的溫暖色調相互結合，更能顯現出自在溫馨的氛圍，彷彿讓您置身在森林原野之中。山形閣位於礁溪最佳的地理位置，提供了現代人輕鬆、自由、舒適、恬靜的度假休憩場所。秉持自然主義的概念與禪修冥想的意境，傾聽自己內心的聲音，細細品嘗這片土地的點滴故事。浸身於隱居地中修練的內心世界，遠離塵囂與案牘勞形，人類、自然環境、社會、歷史等等串連出的空間，在這隱居地裡修行，體驗與冥想，讓您的 身 心 靈回歸到最初最原始的狀態。秉持日本茶道「一期一會」的精神希冀與期許您的光臨，靜候與等待您的體驗
stays.descriptionEn: Yamagata Prefecture in Japan contains many majestic natural sights and mysterious temples hidden in mountains; intertwined with Mount Zaō, the elegance of nature is conveyed through the light of dusk reflected off frosted tree branches, icy mountain paths, and emanating mists from hot springs.Extending along the Sendai line, the mountain’s temples are major spiritual grounds for religious practitioners. Walking along the serene paths, events and scenes from the past carry a color of mystery but one breaks free from mundane fetters for tranquil relaxation in sacred grounds.The Kavalan, an indigenous people of Yilan are known as “people of the plains”; their nurturing of these lands has established their symbiotic relationship with the mountains and forests.Yamagata Kaku was inspired by traditional local culture with an exterior design based on the mountainous terrain and soaring cliffs that the indigenous people call home.Décor and furnishings are infused with ancient history and an acknowledgment of this region for an aura that exudes the affinity of nature and tranquility.Soft and gentle colors fill each guest room through the use of natural stone and wood materials, an alternating warm palette that combines to paint a welcoming atmosphere, as if our guests stood amid the forests and plains.Yamagata Kaku can be found in the optimal location of Jiaoxi, providing today’s guests with a recreational resort that is relaxing, free, comfortable, and serene.Listen to the voice of your heart and delicately enjoy the stories of this land through the philosophy of naturalism and Zen meditation.Mountain Temple,It represents the devotion of one’s body in exile to train the spiritescape from the grime and stressthe aspects of mankind, nature, society, and history establish the spacepractice in this hidden land.Experience and meditate,allow your mind, body, and soulto return to their most primitive state.Upholding the Japanese tea ceremony spirit of “one chance in a lifetime”We look forward to your visit and await your experience here

stays.descriptionEn: Sun Spring Resort is a leisure resort hotel located in Jiaoxi (Jiaosi), Yilan. All safety measures and facilities adhere to the strictest standards mandated by the government. Sun Spring Resort is located eight-minute-walk away from the Jiaoxi train station. The hotel is facing mountains with its back facing Lanyang Plain. The hotel is conveniently located among a number of popular attraction points including Jiaoxi Park, Jiaoxi swimming pool, hiking trails, and so on. The hotel's back is facing Turtle Island with a magnificent view.Every room in Sun Spring Resort has hot springs. The hotel has a public hot spring spa pool, two outdoor naked hot spring pools, two indoor naked hot spring pools, free Chinese Western breakfast buffet for guests, delicious and healthy combination meals, free bicycle rental, free binocular rental, free parking, free transportation from and to the Jiaoxi train station for guests.At the top floor you can overlook the magnificent view of Jiaoxi, Yilan. The restaurants can double as conference rooms and places to host various activities such as a birthday party and a business dinner. The hotel has a game room for rent and full body massage with oil for purchase. You can access WiFi anywhere in the hotel.

stays.description: 礁溪～溫泉鄉的美麗色彩，是人們對她的第一印象。弱鹼性的碳酸氫鈉泉─美人湯的呼喚，讓許多重視性靈養生的人們趨之若鶩。礁 溪的美，等著您來體驗！礁溪的溫泉蔬果，等著您來嘗鮮！今日的礁溪，展現 不同的風華面貌！帥王的真情款待，讓您紮實感受在地人的樸實熱情！距離礁溪火車站，步行約莫5分鐘。彎進公園路，彷彿走入另一個世外桃源。右 手邊是群樹環繞的旅遊服務中心，靜謐的步道，不時耳盼傳來的鳥叫蟲鳴，是 您散步冥想的好去處；而左邊簡約時尚的建築物～帥王即鮮活地映入眼簾，步入大廳，親切的招呼聲是我們給您的第一問候！
stays.descriptionEn: Jiaosi~ People''s first impression of Jiaosi is its beauty as the "Hometown of Hot Springs".The calling of "beautiful hot springs", weak alkaline sodium bicarbonate springs, attracts a great number of people who pay close attention to their wellness to visit Jiaosi. Jiaosi has hot springs, fresh fruits and vegetables and beautiful scenery, all just waiting for you to visit. The hearty hospitality of the Baron''s Hotel will help you feel the local sincerity and passion!Just about a 5-minute walk to the hotel from the Jiaosi Train Station, stepping onto Gongyuan Road is like stepping into paradise. On the right side is the Tourist Service Center surrounded by trees. This is a good place to take a walk and meditate along the quiet trails, on which you can hear birds and insects chirping from time to time. Located on the left side is a sophisticated and stylish building standing brilliantly, and that is the Baron''s Hotel. When you walk into the lobby, our cordial reception will be the first greeting to welcome you to the Baron''s Hotel!

stays.name: 德陽暮沐國際旅館
stays.description: 穿越北宜後沿著台九省道前進到礁溪，「川湯春天溫泉飯店」佇足在礁溪溫泉區裡，走入大廳映入眼簾是親切的笑容、貼心服務，全館設備完善，快意享受礁溪溫泉鄉的浪漫風情。備有121間客房，每個房間獨特高雅，至少15坪以上的大小住房選擇，氣派高雅的住房設備，館裡另備有各式溫泉spa設備、精緻湯屋、戶外養生湯池，其五行湯及六福湯提供另類的泡湯方式，完整舒適的休閒設施，享受礁溪湯泉情懷，接著再品嚐飯店精緻餐飲，專業級的管理、國際級的貼心服務、精心設計的住房選擇、定會讓您流連忘返，暖湯熱泉之旅。
stays.descriptionEn: Passing Taipei Yilan Highway and heading for Jiaoxi along Provincial Highway 9, Chuang-Tang Spring Spa Hotel is located in the hot spring area. Walking into the lobby and you will be greeted with friendly smiles. With intimate services and fully equipped facilities in the Hotel, you can relax and enjoy the romantic ambience of the home of hot spring.Total 121 guest rooms available. Each room is unique and elegant. Choices of room sizes at least 50 square meters. Luxurious and elegant amenities. The Hotel also offers hot spring and spa facilities of different styles, exquisite hot spring parlor, and outdoor hot spring bathing pool. In particular, the Wuxin and Liu-foo Hot Spring pools offer alternative bathing styles with complete and comfortable leisure facilities for you to indulge Jiaoxi’s hot spring atmosphere. Next, savor the Hotel’s fine dining, professional management, international class intimate service, carefully designed room types for you to choose from. You will have a warm hot spring journey that you wish to stay for longer time.

stays.name: 慢漫窩溫泉旅宿
stays.description: 慢漫窩溫泉旅宿-宜蘭縣旅館164號慢生活。漫回想。再出發。Stay a moment and Keep going!慢漫窩溫泉旅宿位於礁溪鄉五峰路口，前往五峰旗瀑布的路上，會先看到慢漫窩以及大片的綠樹喔。慢漫窩旁邊有山有樹有街道，也擁有熱騰騰碳酸氫鈉溫泉，小旅行來這泡湯一下，享受慢漫湯的慵懶時光。除了住宿的空間外，我們也很幸運在1F能提供慢友們一些公共區域，我們在1F茶水間提供了公用飲水機、保溫壺、免費茶包、咖啡機；在慢半拍超巿這兒佈置了小朋友及大朋友可以一起遊玩的環境，也放了桌椅讓家長們陪伴更輕鬆，當然在小朋友的創意之下，家長們也能變身玩伴。在這兒小朋友可以扮演老闆、顧客或是更多，讓小朋友玩的開心，開心的知道一些生活常識、金錢觀念、分享、禮讓，或許也能交到一日朋友或是好朋友，記得來玩喔~啊！說太多囉！留些給一起來慢漫窩的慢友們說囉^.*~

stays.name: 懷鄉園渡假別墅
stays.description: 典雅的建築 融入大自然的景色中清脆鳥鳴 是這裡最悅耳的交響曲 在和風輕撫的庭園中 來一杯咖啡悠閒且淘醉的感覺 充斥在 [ 懷香園 ]白天，您在陽台就能夠清楚的看到龜山島的壯麗模樣；晚上，您可以坐擁整個蘭陽夜景。在這裡，鄉村的原始面貌及稻浪景觀會是您見過最美麗的一幅畫；夜間四周的蟲鳴鳥叫將是您聽過最特別的交響協奏曲。自然．純樸．閒靜，這就是「懷鄉園」。民宿就位於著名的二龍競渡龍舟的村落。新建而成的二龍河濱堤防，是散步、慢跑、騎自行車的好地方。宜蘭縣旅遊服務中心，提供您蘭陽地區的旅遊資訊。還有著名的五峰旗瀑布；可觀看夜景的林美高爾夫球場；及百年歷史的協天廟，都是值得一遊的觀光景點。
stays.descriptionEn: The elegant structure of Campestral Garden merges with the natural scenery, and the clear call of birds is the most pleasing symphony of this place. Feel the gentle breeze and enjoy a cup of coffee in the courtyard, experiencing a sensation of intoxicating leisure that fills Campestral Garden. During the day, you can clearly see the magnificent outline of Guishan Island; in the evening, you’re surrounded by Lanyang’s night scenery. Here, the untouched countryside and waves of rice compose the most beautiful painting you’ve seen, the night birds and insects the most special symphony you’ve heard. Campestral Garden is a place of nature, simplicity, and serenity. We’re located in the famous Erlong Dragon Boat Racing Community, and the newly-completed Erlong River embankment is a great place to take a walk, jog, or go bike riding. The Yilan Visitor Information Center provides information regarding the Lanyang area. The famous Wufengqi Waterfall is also nearby, as well as the night scenery of Lin Mei Golf Course and the century-old Xietian Temple, all being worthy tourist attractions.

stays.searchText: 懷鄉園渡假別墅 懷鄉園渡假別墅 宜蘭縣民宿321號 宜蘭縣 礁溪鄉 二龍村淇武蘭路12-1號 典雅的建築 融入大自然的景色中清脆鳥鳴 是這裡最悅耳的交響曲 在和風輕撫的庭園中 來一杯咖啡悠閒且淘醉的感覺 充斥在 [ 懷香園 ]白天，您在陽台就能夠清楚的看到龜山島的壯麗模樣；晚上，您可以坐擁整個蘭陽夜景。在這裡，鄉村的原始面貌及稻浪景觀會是您見過最美麗的一幅畫；夜間四周的蟲鳴鳥叫將是您聽過最特別的交響協奏曲。自然．純樸．閒靜，這就是「懷鄉園」。民宿就位於著名的二龍競渡龍舟的村落。新建而成的二龍河濱堤防，是散步、慢跑、騎自行車的好地方。宜蘭縣旅遊服務中心，提供您蘭陽地區的旅遊資訊。還有著名的五峰旗瀑布；可觀看夜景的林美高爾夫球場；及百年歷史的協天廟，都是值得一遊的觀光景點。

stays.name: 星嵐民宿
stays.description: 蓮花池旁賞星嵐～蓮花池畔水田旁，華房矗立美泉鄉。朝聞鳥鳴流水潺，夜觀夕照賞星嵐。 「礁溪民宿‧星嵐民宿」為一處座落在礁溪鄉間的巴洛克式的白色洋房，矗立於稻田中央、蓮花池畔，周圍景緻隨著四季變化而呈現不同風情，四時皆令人驚艷不已。民宿佔地廣大，內部空間寬敞，民宿內部設施多元而完善，旅客不需到各地景區奔波走訪，即可享有最休閒道地的蘭陽風情。 「礁溪民宿‧星嵐民宿」提供多種二人及四人房型，另提供包棟服務，旅人可以自身需求自由選擇，房內風格也如房間名稱一般浪漫而典雅，寧靜環境、溫馨風情、雅緻氛圍搭配浪漫情懷的裝潢擺設，為一舒適恬靜的鄉間雅居。
stays.descriptionEn: Gazing at stars veiled by the mist, next to the lotus pond, Among lotus pond and rice paddy, Luxurious house erects in a beautiful village, Sounds of birds chirping and stream water running in the early morning, Sunset evening and starry night. Jiaoxi B&B - Starshine Home Stay is a Baroque style white house situated in the countryside of Jiaoxi Township. Located in the midst of farmlands and lotus ponds, the surrounding scenery changes according to season. Each season presents a stunning view and a different sentiment. The B&B covers a large area with a spacious interior. It's well-run and well-equipped so guests don't need to worry about anything. They just need to enjoy themselves and soak in the beautiful Yilan lifestyle. Jiaoxi B&B - Starshine Home Stay has guestrooms for couples and for family of four. Guest with a big group can rent the whole house as well. The decor in each room corresponds to the names given to each room - romantic and elegant. The quiet location, warm hospitality, elegant atmosphere and romantic decor make this a comfortable and relaxing country house.

stays.description: 晶泉丰旅位於礁溪，設有室外游泳池和溫泉浴場，提供典雅的客房。客人可以使用位於屋頂的開放式電影院。酒店將不定期安排藝術展覽。所有公共區均提供免費WiFi。晶泉丰旅距離礁溪火車站有3分鐘的步行路程，距離礁溪巴士總站有8分鐘的步行路程，距離宜蘭市有20分鐘車程。空調客房均配有沙發、電熱水壺、迷你吧、冰箱和有線電視。部分客房享有城市或山脈的風景。私人浴室提供免費洗浴用品和吹風機。酒店內提供洗衣服務和免費的每日清潔服務。客人可以在圖書館享受閱讀時光。24小時前台的工作人員將很樂意為客人提供旅遊信息和行李寄存服務。
stays.descriptionEn: Featuring outdoor swimming pool and hot spring bath, Wellspring by Silks offers an elegant space for visitors in Jiaoxi. Guests can enjoy the open-air cinema on the rooftop. Nonscheduled art exhibitions will be arranged in the property. Free WiFi is available in all public areas.Wellspring by Silks is a 3-minute walk from Jiaoxi Railway Station, while Jiaoxi Bus Terminal is an 8-minute walk away. It takes a 20-minute drive from the property to Yilan City.Air-conditioned rooms come with a sofa, electric kettle, mini-bar, refrigerator and cable TV. Guests will have city or mountains views in certain rooms. Free toiletries and hairdryer can be found in the private bathroom.Laundry and free daily maid service are available on site. Guests can enjoy their reading time at the library. Hotel staff are glad to offer touring information and luggage storage service at the 24-hour front desk.

stays.name: 水岸星畔
stays.description: 星畔河岸位於礁溪鄉時潮休閒農業區，此地區是一處水鳥保護區，而星畔河岸得天獨厚除位於該區域之內，還緊鄰二龍溪河岸，二龍溪河岸天然原始，是未經人工雕琢的漂亮河川，而河岸之上的腳踏車步道，民宿主人極力推薦您來體驗。鄰近星畔河岸旁就有一條很棒的腳踏車步道，緊鄰二龍溪由191線道玉龍橋往山邊而上。而往海邊方向，沿二龍溪(得子口溪右岸)下游而下，也是相當不錯腳踏車步道兩旁綠蔭，再加上原始天然的河道，倘佯在此，可讓喜歡大自然的朋友不虛此行。
stays.descriptionEn: Star Riverbank is located in the Shichao Leisure Farm Area in Jiaoxi Township. This area is a waterfowl protected area. Not only is Star Riverbank lucky to be in this area, its close proximity to the riverbank of Erlong River is another desirable element. Erlong River is a natural river that has not gone through any man-made changes. The riverbank bikeway is highly recommended by the B&B owners. There is another excellent bikeway next to Star Riverbank where you can take County Road 191 at Yulong Bridge, near Erlong River, and ride in the direction of the edge of the mountain. To go toward the direction of the ocean, ride along Erlong River downstream (the right bank of Dezikou River), which is also a nice bikeway shaded by trees on both sides. The river and scenery here make it worthwhile for nature-loving visitors.

stays.searchText: 水岸星畔 水岸星畔 宜蘭縣民宿783號 宜蘭縣 礁溪鄉 時潮村塭底路1-8號 星畔河岸位於礁溪鄉時潮休閒農業區，此地區是一處水鳥保護區，而星畔河岸得天獨厚除位於該區域之內，還緊鄰二龍溪河岸，二龍溪河岸天然原始，是未經人工雕琢的漂亮河川，而河岸之上的腳踏車步道，民宿主人極力推薦您來體驗。鄰近星畔河岸旁就有一條很棒的腳踏車步道，緊鄰二龍溪由191線道玉龍橋往山邊而上。而往海邊方向，沿二龍溪(得子口溪右岸)下游而下，也是相當不錯腳踏車步道兩旁綠蔭，再加上原始天然的河道，倘佯在此，可讓喜歡大自然的朋友不虛此行。

stays.descriptionEn: The B&B is hidden in Jiaoxi, Yilan, and overlooks the mountains. From afar, you can see clouds rising from the mountains, and nearby, there is wisp of spring mist. When you are among them, it feels like you have encountered a paradise in the depths of the clouds.Why not leave behind the hustle and bustle of the world once in a while, give yourself a hide-and-seek holiday, empty your five senses and find the paradise that has been hiding in your heart for a long time.

stays.name: 活泉礁溪溫泉旅館
stays.description: 活泉礁溪飯店 LIVIN Hotel 坐落於宜蘭礁溪溫泉區核心，主打簡約典雅的設計風格與智慧旅宿體驗。全館客房配備頂級舒適床墊、高級織品、膠囊咖啡機與可控制冷氣、燈光與電視的智慧平板，提供專屬的放鬆空間。浴室配置獨特的蛋形浴缸，融合溫泉療癒與現代美感。飯店設有一樓開放式休憩區與頂樓景觀餐廳，讓旅人盡享礁溪風光與悠閒時光。無論是情侶度假、親子旅遊或個人療癒之旅，LIVIN Hotel 都致力打造舒適、智慧與美感兼具的住宿體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: LIVIN Hotel is located in the heart of Jiaoxi’s hot spring district in Yilan, offering a minimalist and elegant design paired with a smart lodging experience. All rooms are equipped with top-quality mattresses, premium linens, a capsule coffee machine, and a smart tablet that controls the air conditioning, lighting, and TV—creating a private space for relaxation. Bathrooms feature unique egg-shaped bathtubs that blend hot spring healing with modern aesthetics. The hotel also offers an open lounge on the first floor and a scenic rooftop restaurant, allowing guests to enjoy both relaxation and the beauty of Jiaoxi. Whether it's a romantic getaway, family trip, or a personal wellness retreat, LIVIN Hotel is dedicated to providing a stay that is comfortable, intelligent, and aesthetically refined.

stays.description: 家，是每個人的避風港。在外工作的上班族、在外縣市讀書的學生，在忙碌的一天後，總會想起家的溫度，想念永遠在背後支持的父母親，想念最親近、知心的手足。對於出外旅遊的旅人們，浮雲遊咫民宿希望能夠帶給他們一個溫馨、舒適，超越家的感受。我們有一個愛湊熱鬧、好客又囉哩八嗦的老媽子，一個外表看起來冷酷，講話總是口是心非的老爸，在浮雲遊咫民宿，你可以就像是回家一樣，享受一個人的空間，也可以與老闆泡茶聊天搭配現烤的蛋糕，度過一個悠閒卻又有溫度的午後。

We provide a cozy place which you can escape from the busy work. You also can experience the life in a conty of Taiwan.

stays.description: ? 打造專屬你的療癒時光 ?位於宜蘭礁溪鄉的「港享受」，是一間以輕工業風為主題的獨棟民宿，擁有舒適的客房與寬敞的公共空間，每個細節都是為了帶給旅客最放鬆的住宿體驗。明亮的落地窗設計，將窗外的山林景色與民宿內的精緻氛圍相融合，讓你一邊享受舒適床鋪，一邊欣賞大自然的美景。? 貼心設施 ? • 景觀玻璃屋：浪漫夜景、觀星觀月最佳場所，無論是情侶、朋友還是家庭聚會都能享受專屬時光。 • 免費停車位與特斯拉充電樁：讓開車旅行更加無憂。 • 烤肉與麻將：包棟客戶可在庭院享受BBQ或打麻將，與親朋好友一起度過歡樂的夜晚。
stays.descriptionEn: ? Create Your Own Healing Time ?Located in Jiaoxi Township, Yilan County, "Harbor Enjoyment" is a standalone B&B with a light industrial style. It boasts comfortable guest rooms and spacious common areas, with every detail designed to provide guests with the most relaxing stay. Bright floor-to-ceiling windows blend the mountain scenery outside with the B&B& #39;s refined atmosphere, allowing you to enjoy the natural beauty while relaxing in bed.? Thoughtful Facilities ?• Scenic Glass House: The perfect spot for romantic night views, stargazing, and moon watching. Ideal for couples, friends, or family gatherings to enjoy private moments.• Free Parking and Tesla Charging Station: Makes road trips worry-free.• BBQ and Mahjong: Guests who book the entire B&B can enjoy a BBQ or play mahjong in the courtyard, spending a joyful evening with family and friends.
