stays.description: 灣客棧礁溪館位於武暖路上，是一棟雙併別墅，不但有可以停6-8台車的社區車道，門前還有能夠BBQ的烤肉空地〈並附半自動式遮雨、遮陽帳棚，寬3*3米〉。灣客棧礁溪館共有2棟，每棟有4層樓，其中2樓、3樓都各有一間附大陽台的雙人雅房及附大觀景窗的雙人雅房，而第4樓則有4人雅房，總計12人床位〈頂樓須超過8人才開放〉；另外，2-3層各有一間乾濕分離的淋浴衛浴間，整潔寬敞，十分適合8-16人住宿！除了房型一致，每棟的娛樂設備：BBQ、KTV唱歌、電動麻將桌也都各有一套！讓親朋好友相聚能盡興地唱、盡興地玩！最後，灣客棧是寵物友善民宿──除了室外可以讓寵物奔跑，室內空間也超大、是寵物們也能放鬆度假的聖地！
stays.descriptionEn: WeInnOne Jiaoxi is located on Wunuan Road, consisting of a twin villa. It features a community driveway that can accommodate 6-8 cars, and there is a front yard for BBQ with a semi-automatic rain and sunshade tent measuring 3x3 meters. WeInnOne Jiaoxi has two buildings, each with four floors. The 2nd and 3rd floors of each building have double rooms with large balconies and double rooms with large panoramic windows. The 4th floor has 4-person rooms, with a total of 12 bed spaces (the top floor is only open for groups of over 8 people). In addition, the 2nd and 3rd floors each have a wet and dry bathroom with a shower, which is clean and spacious, making it suitable for 8-16 people to stay comfortably. In addition to the consistent room types, each building has entertainment facilities, including BBQ, KTV singing, and electric mahjong tables. This allows friends and family to gather, sing, and have fun. Finally, WeInnOne is a pet-friendly guesthouse—besides having an outdoor space for pets to run around, the indoor space is also very spacious, making it a perfect place for pets to relax and enjoy their vacation.

stays.descriptionEn: WeInnOne Jiaoxi is located on Wunuan Road, consisting of a twin villa. It features a community driveway that can accommodate 6-8 cars, and there is a front yard for BBQ with a semi-automatic rain and sunshade tent measuring 3x3 meters. WeInnOne Jiaoxi has two buildings, each with four floors. The 2nd and 3rd floors of each building have double rooms with large balconies and double rooms with large panoramic windows. The 4th floor has 4-person rooms, with a total of 12 bed spaces (the top floor is only open for groups of over 8 people). In addition, the 2nd and 3rd floors each have a wet and dry bathroom with a shower, which is clean and spacious, making it suitable for 8-16 people to stay comfortably. In addition to the consistent room types, each building has entertainment facilities, including BBQ, KTV singing, and electric mahjong tables. This allows friends and family to gather, sing, and have fun. Finally, WeInnOne is a pet-friendly guesthouse—besides having an outdoor space for pets to run around, the indoor space is also very spacious, making it a perfect place for pets to relax and enjoy their vacation.

stays.name: 甜園玉光民宿
stays.description: " 一切美好事物 從這裡開始 "受夠了在水泥叢林裡喘不過氣的生活 放下繁重的責任、壓力，出走到這處田園祕境 避上眼睛， 享受陽光暖暖的照拂與微風輕吹帶來的 稻禾香氣， 讓身體徹底融入藍天與綠地 親身走進宜蘭民宿「甜園玉光」中， 光與影交織成柔和景緻； 白色的牆面上， 掛著民宿主人親手會製的美麗風景 異國風情的精緻擺飾與歐式漫浪的旋轉樓梯 帶領著入內的訪客成就一段甜甜的動人回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: Sweetlight is located in Yilan, Taiwan, R.O.C. It only takes about 40 minutes from Taipei to Yilan by bus. When you travel to Yilan, you will experience green fields and fresh air. Take a break, enjoy a cup of coffee, go on bike rides, explore and discover the countryside. Enjoy all the splendor of nature. Better yet, you can stay, relax, enjoy the view of rice paddy and the comfort of home at Sweetlight Home Stay. Besides, it is easy to get to Lanyang Museum, Jiaoxi Hot spring, Yilan night market, Jimmy Square, and so on from Sweetlight. Please contact us by email(ilovesweetlight@gmail.com), we are looking forward to hear from you soon.

stays.name: 田念民宿
stays.description: 民宿本身是獨棟的建築以尊重大自然的方式融入在田野間，樸實的外觀卻有不同層次的美；約二百坪的空間；讓您的心靈能沉浸在最簡單的幸福中；廣大的庭院、青青的草一望無際的田野,隨著四季呈現不同的美景；值得您來細細品嚐。民宿主人精心規劃出優雅溫馨的家；有專屬的音樂欣賞室、圖書閱覽室、用餐區、Wii遊戲室、更有免費的視聽設備提供給包棟的客人歡唱娛樂，而在四個客房中，以四季做為主軸呈現出不同的色調與設計，配合著大型落地窗讓所有田野的美景盡收眼底，坐在專屬的陽台的您；來杯精心挑選的研磨咖啡是一種享受呦！另300坪庭院的戶外空間中；免費提供戲水池、烤肉區、還可以騎腳踏車；讓您親子同遊樂趣多多。
stays.descriptionEn: There is a natural beauty of the field and tiannian. Tiannian is a building with rustic beauty on the outside. About 7200 square feet, you can calm your soul down in the simplest happiness. The season changes the view of a big yard, green lawns, wide fields at the different times of the year. It is worth a visit. The hosts divide the warm and elegant house into 4 guest rooms, an audio-visual room, a reading area, a dining area, and a game room. We offer the guests who rent the whole building the equipment of entertainment for free . The color and decoration of 4 guest rooms are designed in accordance with seasons. You can have a great view in the room through French windows. To have a coffee and sit at your own balcony is also an enjoyment.

stays.name: 番茄計劃旅社
stays.description: 這是一間位於礁溪的簡單旅店，來這可以與各地的人交流，或是嘗試不同以往的生活步調，為旅人提供一個認識這個小鎮的機會。我們提供的是一個簡單的住宿空間，簡單卻不簡陋。有別於大飯店的豪華設施，讓你可以用自己的節奏放慢步調在這裡生活，單純為旅人提供一個認識這個溫泉小鎮的機會，在街道巷弄間探索昔日繁華。這個地方不大，但適合慢慢探索，或許每次都能讓你有新的發現和新的感受。我們邀請你用緩慢悠哉的步調感受礁溪的種種。
stays.descriptionEn: This is a simple hotel located in Jiaoxi. Come here to communicate with people from all over the world, or try a different pace of life, and provide travelers with an opportunity to get to know this town. What we provide is a simple accommodation space, simple but not crude. Different from the luxurious facilities of big hotels, you can slow down and live here at your own pace, simply providing travelers with an opportunity to get to know this hot spring town and explore the former prosperity in the streets and lanes. This place is not big, but it is suitable for exploring slowly, maybe it will give you new discoveries and new feelings every time. We invite you to experience the various things in Jiaoxi at a slow and leisurely pace.

stays.name: 礁溪寒沐行館
stays.description: 礁溪寒沐酒店承襲寒舍美學、人文和藝術兼具的獨到品味，委託亞洲藝術家與全球知名國際酒店設計團隊LTW合作，將當代藝術策展概念融合自然與文化，營造優雅與高品味的度假休閒氛圍！ 礁溪寒沐酒店與礁溪寒沐行館2棟建築體，共有6種房型，總數190間。12至90坪舒適寬敞的空間，採簡約自然的設計風格，回歸質樸風貌。每間客房都擁有獨立的溫泉浴池，其中，174間更具延伸露台的設計，通透開闊的空間引入飽滿陽光，悠閒舒適的度假享受為旅人喚醒能量。 礁溪寒沐行館提供2種房型包含12坪的詠泉居與20坪的望岳閣。另外，休閒設施 1F 光之湯，提供入住房客可免費使用露天溫泉。 礁溪寒沐行館融合自然與藝術，打造精品時尚的度假空間，讓旅人感受一步一風景、俯拾皆藝術的悠然心境，彷彿置身世外桃源！
stays.descriptionEn: Inheriting My Humble House’s unique taste on aesthetics, culture and art, MU JIAO XI HOTEL commissions Taiwanese artists and world-renowned LTW hotel design team to integrate contemporary art into local culture, curating an elegant, relaxing and tasteful space. MU JIAO XI HOTEL and MU JIAO XI RESERVE, 2 architectural styles, offers a total of 190 guest rooms, featuring 6 room types. Contemporary room spaces showcasing minimalism design, ranging from 12 to 90 pings, offers a retreat back to the basics. Every guestroom is outfitted with a private hot springs tub, and 174 guestrooms have an extended deck area. The open space design invites warm sunlight into the room, rejuvenating the body and soul. MU JIAO XI RESERVE offers two room types are SPRING SUPERIOR RESERVE PATIO ROOM, occupying 12 ping and HILL DELUXE RESERVE PATIO ROOM , occupying 20 ping. Furthermore, the outdoor hot spring at ONSEN on 1F is available for free to room guests. MU JIAO XI RESERVE blends the elements of nature and art to create a chic boutique vacation spot, which allows travelers to immerse, reflect and be inspired in this artistic, serene atmosphere.

stays.description: 起源於想照顧家族的念頭而新建了生平第一棟房子，因為熱心分享房間轉變成經營民宿，鐘爸親手種植的早餐菜、早餐鐘媽堅持自己下廚做給客人吃，這些都是把旅人都當做自己家人一般照顧！來到離市區五分鐘的稻畝中央，感受遠離煩囂的美好，隨性騎著腳踏車出走，領略四季更迭的美麗。 承蒙電視台青睞來此取景拍攝，中視MIT台灣誌採訪，台北市政府宣導影片取景拍攝。
stays.descriptionEn: The owner of Yun Ju House has 5 brothers and 1 uncle, and the 6 families gather together every Chinese New Year’s or major holiday. So the owner and his wife dreamed of having a big house where everyone could comfortably stay, and thus built this place in the outskirts of Jiaoxi as a vacation villa for relatives working in other parts of the country to return to. In order to maintain accommodation quality, whenever not occupied by relatives it is open to travelers who happen to make their way here. Yun Ju House is situated on a countryside path, with different scenery throughout the year, from the time of rice planting to harvesting. The little birds will serve as your alarm clock, and on clear days you can gaze out at the beauty of Guishan Island and the Xueshan Mountain Range, making this a great place for a day trip. Rest your weary body in the hot springs and enjoy the serenity of the countryside fields. Many of our customers choose to rent out the entire building. The first floor includes a spacious living room and tea brewing area with complete facilities for guests to use, while the spacious activity area behind the building lets guests fire up a countryside BBQ, chat with a group of friends, go for a leisurely bike ride through the fields and appreciate different scenery throughout the year. Located in a quiet spot away from the noise of the city, we’re a 2 minute bike ride away from King Car Ecological Orchid Garden, a 28,200 square meter greenhouse area where you can see butterflies and a sea of orchids. We’re a 3 minute drive from the Mary Leu Carving Art Gallery and 6 minute drive from Jiaoxi City, making this a great place to plan an art and fine cuisine-themed trip.

stays.description: 五星級評鑑 五年世界小型奢華飯店會員 礁溪老爺大酒店 聳立在五峰旗風景區、距離台北市50分鐘車程的礁溪老爺大酒店，後現代日式禪風結合宜蘭童玩意象，創造出簡約悠閒的空間，享受精緻服務、頂級渡假氛圍、當地文化活動及各種國際藝術表演，加上美人湯溫泉、堅持在地食材的岩波庭-宜蘭廚房，2011年更從引進日本盛行已久的運動創建「得天公園高爾夫球場」，提供更多元化的休閒服務，2012年榮獲天下金牌服務大賞國際觀光旅館與餐飲雙料冠軍，礁溪老爺已成為台灣頂級渡假飯店首選。

Hotel Royal Chiao Hsi, with post-modern Japanese Zen style integrated with Yilan Children's toys imagery, created a simple and relaxing space to enjoy exquisite service, top resort atmosphere, local cultural activities and a variety of international art performances, plus Beauty Spa Resort, Le Fooding - Yilan Kitchen adhere to local ingredients. In 2011, introduced a sport popular in Japan for many years to create "Royal Sky Park Golf Course" to provide more diversified leisure services. In 2012, won the World Gold Awards international tourist hotels and catering champion, Hotel Royal Chiao Hsi has become Taiwan's top resort hotel of choice.

stays.name: 美洲山莊
stays.description: 美洲山莊為礁溪第一間歷史溫泉館，全館熱水水源全接於溫泉源頭，讓來到本館的旅客能夠享受到全天然溫泉浴，像這樣道地的溫泉旅館宣布即將結束營業時，現任老闆一得知消息，為了想繼續發揚礁溪著名天然溫泉，決定身負重任接手這間附有天然資源的溫泉館。並聘請了名師來將它重新打造，不僅保有天然的泡湯水源，一進大廳讓人彷彿回到家裡一樣感受到礁溪溫泉鄉的溫暖風情。每間客房都配有免費Wife和平面電視，私人衛浴有單人浴缸供客人泡澡，除了房間浴缸可以泡外我們一樓還有獨立室包廂溫泉浴供客人使用，記衛生又能夠舒服安靜的享受溫泉情懷，彷彿踏入與世隔絕的天然秘境，遠離日常吵雜的塵世間，讓心靈即時放鬆處與笑傲風月之境界。我們位於礁溪溫泉中心，交通便利，距離火車站只需步行五~十分鐘即可到達，踏出旅館右手邊方向便可看見湯圍溝公園，離礁溪溫泉公園700公尺，來到礁溪別忘了到著名協天宮走走拜拜祈求身體健康，喜歡欣賞大自然風景吸取日月精華的旅客，猴洞坑瀑布、五峰旗瀑布、林美石磐步道、金車礁溪蘭花園、跑馬古道，都是礁溪著名景點而且路程都只需十~十五分即可抵達。來到礁溪選對旅館即可帶你抵達放鬆心靈的秘境，美洲山莊將是你第一手選，假日入住還能夠參與到本店豪華BBQ活動~

stays.descriptionEn: Yilan Aijia No.1 B&B is located in Jiaoxi Township, Yilan County. It is a newly completed single-family garden B&B with a wide view of the surrounding fields. It has a garden space of 100 square meters, a spacious public living room, and a good view of the room. It can accommodate 6 to 16 people for private accommodation; it provides filial piety rooms on the first floor, barbecues, karaoke, electric mahjong tables, and pet-friendly services; it is most suitable for family gatherings and company group accommodation; Aijia No.1 B&B is close to Jiaoxi City and next to Shandoli Hotel. Feel the most exciting Lanyang leisurely life. Yilan Aijia No.1 B&B welcomes you and your loved ones to come and experience it in person.

stays.name: 華閣溫泉飯店
stays.description: 礁溪溫泉素有美人湯之稱，溫泉招牌林立，溫泉旅店一家連著一家，在這片熱鬧的溫泉市集中，華閣溫泉飯店位於礁溪公園對面，顯得格外的安靜。以紫紅色為基調的logo，有如清新高雅的蝴蝶蘭，讓華閣溫泉飯店的氣息和周邊的溫泉旅店立刻所區隔。「感覺相當不錯」這是前來華閣溫泉飯店，住客口中最常聽到的一句話，40餘間的客房充分表現出最佳的空間與舒適性，建築外觀與內裝融合了現代與古典主義，嘗試獨具匠心的素材，無論配色、裝置... 都讓人處處是溫馨，樣樣皆用心的感受。在華閣，没有大批旅客的喧鬧與吵雜聲，這裡有的只是單純、寧靜、悠閒的住房感受，與接待人員最貼心、親切、自然的服務，這也是我門最引以為傲的飯店客房哲學。

stays.name: 葛瑪蘭之星飯店
stays.description: 葛瑪蘭之星為礁溪地區全新落成的高級溫泉飯店，位於礁溪最熱鬧繁華的街道，坐擁指標型建築及門市，以十二星座為主題的地面外觀設計。飯店擁有76間溫馨客房，為提供賓主盡歡的舒適空間與美味餐點，一樓設有自助餐廳與麵包坊，更有品牌合作星巴克；會議中心及影音視聽室設備齊全先進，無論是舉行商業會議或娛樂休閒，空間都可依活動需求靈活配置。健身中心配備最新的運動器材，頂樓另有露天溫泉、水療池、維琪浴以及三溫暖烤箱等多項休閒服務，邀請您共同體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Gamalan star hotel is located in the busiest street in Jiaoxi.The hotel has 76 warm guest rooms. In order to provide a comfortable space and delicious meals for guests and hosts to enjoy, there is a cafeteria and bakery on the first floor, and there is also a brand cooperation Starbucks; the conference center and audio-visual room are well-equipped and advanced. For meetings or entertainment, the space can be flexibly configured according to the needs of the event.The fitness center is equipped with the latest sports equipment. On the top floor, there are open-air hot springs, hydrotherapy pools, Vichy baths, saunas and other leisure services. We invite you to experience them together.

stays.name: 蘭田雅舍
stays.description: 位於宜蘭縣礁溪，環境清幽安靜，田園、山脈美景更是美不勝收！讓您能夠享受極致愜意的悠閒時刻，旅人們能在景觀陽台上吹著涼風，聊著旅遊趣事，美景、快樂心情、舒適的環境，這些看似簡單平凡的小事，卻能帶給您滿滿的幸福感！臨近頭城及烏石港，可借由旅行住宿至外澳海灘一帶衝浪。這裡的港灣形成衝浪的絕佳地域，其沙灘腹地廣大，又有適合的浪型，尤其是衝浪愛好者的天堂。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Jiaoxi, Yilan County, the environment is quiet and peaceful, and the scenery of the countryside and mountains is breathtaking! You can enjoy the ultimate relaxing moment. Travelers can enjoy the cool breeze on the landscape balcony and chat about interesting travel stories. Beautiful scenery, happy mood and comfortable environment, these seemingly simple and ordinary things can bring you a full sense of happiness! It is close to Toucheng and Wushih Harbor, and you can take advantage of the travel accommodation to go surfing in the Waiao Beach area. The harbor here is an excellent area for surfing. It has a vast beach and suitable waves, making it a paradise for surfing enthusiasts.

stays.nameEn: Lan Yang the Garden Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: 台灣最有看頭的民宿鳥園一、有珍稀美麗和變種的鳥共約四十種。二、每種鳥皆可在三步內近距離觀賞。三、各種鳥可在螢幕中觀看其孵卵、哺育。四、有的鳥可站上人手，與人合照。本園佔地567坪停車場可停20輛小汽車、5輛摩托車有5間客房，共16個標準床位含加床、軟墊地鋪最多可住24人另有蘭陽廳、玻璃屋近水台、陶然亭、木栈台與休息區總共90個餐飲座位 鳥園的主旨是「觀賞」、「教化」、「復育」，豢養珍稀美麗和白化、藍化、黃化與紅化的變種鳥共約四十種，每種鳥皆可在三步之內近距離觀賞，並可自由在螢幕中點選觀看其孵卵、哺育情形，有的鳥可站上人手，與人互動、拍照。此外，種植花和樹共約四十種。
stays.descriptionEn: Taiwan's most popular homestay bird park1. There are about forty species of rare and beautiful birds.2. Each bird can be viewed at close range within three steps.3. Various birds can watch their hatching eggs and nurture on the screen.4. Some birds can stand on their hands and take photos with them.The park covers an area of ​​567 pingsThe parking lot can hold 20 cars and 5 motorcyclesThere are 5 rooms with a total of 16 standard bedsCan accommodate up to 24 people with extra bed and padded floorLanyang Hall and Glass HouseNear water platform, Taoranting, wooden trestle and rest areaA total of 90 dining seats The main theme of the bird park is "watching", "enlightenment", "rehabilitating". There are about forty species of birds that breed rare and beautiful and albino, blue, yellow and red. Each bird can be in three steps. You can watch it from a close distance, and you can freely click on the screen to watch its hatching and feeding situation. Some birds can stand on their hands to interact with people and take pictures. In addition, about 40 species of flowers and trees are planted.

stays.name: 里奧東方礁溪民宿
stays.nameEn: Rio Oriental Jiaoxi Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: -里奧東方，源於一個簡單而深遠的願景—以創新旅宿概念，為注重生活質感的旅人打造溫暖的住宿體驗。這不僅是品牌的核心價值，更是我們故事的起點。長久以來，台灣的旅宿業者各自為戰，缺乏共同目標。里奧東方希望改變這個現狀，讓旅宿業者成為夥伴，共同成長，透過團結合作，創造更加獨特且有溫度的住宿選擇，讓每位旅客都能感受到無與倫比的旅行體驗。我們的品牌口號—「非凡的住宿體驗」，承載著里奧東方的承諾。我們不只是提供住宿，而是帶來全新的旅宿感受，專注於為每位客人打造令人難忘的住宿體驗，讓每次入住都成為值得回憶的精彩旅程。里奧東方的故事，沒有終點，只有不斷前行。我們始終堅持不滿足現狀，不畏懼改變，以創新的精神迎接未來挑戰。我們期待與每一位旅人一起創造美好瞬間，讓每一次停留，都充滿驚喜與期待。

stays.descriptionEn: The overall structure of A-SAN Hot-Spring Hotel was constructed with the front end trend of post-modern architecture, a simple, beautiful, soft, warm, and refreshing rendition. When the super novelty, very modern hotel is completed, Mr. Xu, the owner, recalled the plain sailing along the way of developing the business and asserted that it must have the blessing of the ancestors. Therefore, he named the hotel after his grandfather, A-San, to remember him for his love and taking care during childhood.

stays.name: 阿根庭民宿
stays.description: 看到寬闊的蘭陽平原，就讓人想起阿根廷的彭巴大草原。在宜蘭，你也可以享受道地的阿根廷風味餐點。 雖然我們只有樸實的外觀，但當您走進阿根廷，您會感受到優雅且別具異國風格的內部空間，更棒的是熱情好客的主人，親切的問候：你好~歡迎光臨! 這裡是我們的家，也是您在宜蘭的家與廚房，來這裡的輕鬆自在，就像與多年不見的老友，不陌生，不拘束，多的是一種溫暖與歡樂的氣氛。 從阿根廷回來的台灣人老闆，之前在阿根廷定居、做生意。在當地就是經營餐廳的，所以回國後，就想把那裏的美食，帶回來台灣跟大家分享，阿根廷風味烤肉餐廳、民宿...揭開序幕~~

stays.name: 風華渡假酒店-礁溪館
stays.description: 在宜蘭這個藝術城市裡,我們以一種網狀外飾格柵結構脫穎而出的建築風格,搭配清水建築工法,與大片的溫泉森林自然氛圍的露天風呂,並規劃溫泉式兒童遊區空間,營造出別樹一格的溫泉酒店,並在房間設置了半露天大理石溫泉浴缸,體驗在房間沒有干擾的露天溫泉感受。溫泉會館的基地位於宜蘭礁溪，宜蘭時常細雨綿綿，線性的雨絲是人與街道間未明的介質，重新詮釋也碎化了街道的樣貌；雨中礁溪的溫泉更合併了朦朧的霧氣，湯池裡人與人之間於是有了一種模糊的質感。我們企圖用一種未明的質感取代一個厚重的量體，讓不規則的線條產生一種量體的未明性，線條間混雜著房間內旅人的活動變換著樣貌，有時捲簾半遮、有時霧氣滿室、有時窗明几淨、有時夜光透出，街道行人對建築的閱讀也隨著移動不斷變化著，建築變成一種變動的質感，如同細雨霧氣中礁溪的謎樣。
stays.descriptionEn: In Yilan, an art city, we use an architectural style that stands out with a mesh exterior grille structure, combined with clean water construction methods, a large open-air bath with a natural atmosphere of a hot spring forest, and a hot spring-style children's play area space to create a It is a unique hot spring hotel and has a semi-open-air marble hot spring bathtub in the room, allowing you to experience the open-air hot spring experience without interference in the room. The base of the hot spring club is located in Jiaoxi, Yilan. It often rains continuously in Yilan. The linear raindrops are the unknown medium between people and the streets. The reinterpretation also fragments the appearance of the streets. The hot springs in Jiaoxi in the rain even merge with the hazy mist. There was a vague quality between people in the soup pool.We try to replace a heavy volume with an unknown texture, so that the irregular lines produce an unknown volume. The lines are mixed with the activities of travelers in the room and change their appearance. Sometimes the roller blinds are half-covered, and sometimes Fog fills the room, sometimes the windows are bright and clear, and sometimes the night light shines through. The pedestrians' perception of the building changes with the movement, and the building becomes a changing texture, just like the mystery of Jiaoxi in the drizzle and mist.

stays.description: 宜蘭，首先躍出腦海的場景是片片青綠隨著來自海洋的風，優雅律動的蘭陽平原，「麗翔酒店連鎖(礁溪館)」便隱身其中。洋溢歐洲風情的青銅屋瓦與花崗石的石材構築出線條俐落的極簡風貌。大廳挑高七米，讓人有完全舒展的輕鬆感，親切而專業的迎賓人員更讓出門在外的遊子忘卻舟車勞頓的疲憊。 獨棟十二層樓高的歐風建築環繞充滿設計感的庭園擺設，風味立現。步下後方花園的螺旋梯，緊接著新擴建的峇里風情溫泉戲水池、四季溫泉按摩池、能量水晶烤箱等，濃濃的熱帶風情撲鼻而來。想像當陽光撲簌而下，您可以恣意的悠遊，徹底感受揉合鄉村明媚和都會奢華的精采；而當燦爛的星光滿天，您可以用最空靈的視野去感受純淨的夜空。 最著名的是麗翔特意設計的「下沉式陶瓷浴缸」，兼顧了泡湯的私密性與衛生，客房內即可獨享世界知名的碳酸氫鈉溫泉，也就是俗稱的「美人湯」，讓您在身體獲得紓展的同時也讓心靈獲得解放。
stays.descriptionEn: The first impression of Yilan is one of abundant greenery, followed by an gentle ocean breeze and the idyllic pace of the Lanyang Plain. This is the setting for “Hotel Les Champs”, a minimalist granite building with a classic copper roof with a rich European ambience? The 7M tall lobby puts guests completely at ease while the attentive reception staff offers weary travelers a warm welcome. The 12-storey European style building is also surrounded by a carefully landscaped garden. Walking down the spiral staircase in the rear garden brings guests to the newly added Bali Hot Spring Swimming Pool, the Four Seasons Hot Spring Spa and the Crystal Energy Sauna where a tropical atmosphere awaits. During the day, you can wander beneath the warm sunlight to embrace the country ambience and metropolitan opulence. At night, you can relax and enjoy the purity of a sky filled with sparkling stars. Les Champs& #39;& #39;& #39;& #39; most famous feature is our special “Sunken Ceramic Bath”. Guests can enjoy the sodium hydrogen carbonate spring waters – also known as “Beauty Hot Spring” – in their own suits with perfect privacy and hygiene. We particularly recommend the “Yocyuan Hot Spring Suite” as it offers breathtaking views of Gueishan Island without having to go to see it. The French windows also offer unparalleled views of the Lanyang Plains. This is a unique experience that only Hotel Les Champs can offer out of all of the hotels in Jiaosi. At Les Champs, “To be a hotel worth visiting and a hotel worth remembering” is our philosophy. We hope to offer our guests an even better travel experience. The hotel& #39;& #39;& #39;& #39;s facilities are therefore regularly adjusted in keeping with the seasons. We also offer the best quality and most reasonably priced packaged tours of beautiful Lanyang. “Hotel Les Champs” is confident that our high quality suites and extensive facilities backed by the most attentive service will meet the needs of your mind and body. Why keep such a wonderful experience a secret? Come and experience for yourself the magic of “Hotel Les Champs”, rated by the Japanese publisher Shueisha as one of the “Top 50 Hot Spring Hotels in the World”.

stays.name: ９號溫泉旅店
stays.description: 9號溫泉旅店於2014年底開幕，位於宜蘭縣礁溪鄉觀光徒步區，距離火車站步行五分鐘路程即可抵達，鄰近礁溪鬧區。旅店外觀是以代表礁溪當地風貌的鏽蝕顏色幾何圖形「耐候鋼」覆蓋整棟大樓。幾何圖形用來表現礁溪地質的四稜砂岩堆砌及節理紋路，鏽蝕的顏色則代表礁溪溫泉水中所含的鐵質成分，是充滿礁溪在地特色的意象建築。旅店共有3層樓，擁有27間客房。不同於一般飯店的制式規格房間，NO.9擁有18間分別為北歐風格與玩客風格的標準客房，及9間帶有各式獨特設計的主題客房。房間的陳設均出自旅店主人的精心挑選與手繪、裝設容納至少一噸水位的泡湯池，每房配置智慧型電視及無線網路設備，提供旅客舒適的視覺放鬆及完美的睡眠空間。

stays.name: 三月三民宿
stays.description: 三月三民宿位於好山好水的宜蘭，從桃園中正國際機場開車至此只需八十分鐘，從三月三民宿經由全亞洲最長的雪山隧道至台北、信義區101大樓只需五十分鐘，面對雪山山脈美景，客廳挑高8米可欣賞日出光影投射在花樹之間產生了豐富而絢麗的色彩；聽蟲嗚鳥叫的天籟交響曲伴您優閒享用活力早餐。門前即是自行車道可悠遊鄉村田園風光，鄰近農場可體驗焢窯樂趣，夜市美食可品嚐台灣特色小吃，蘇澳冷泉及礁溪溫泉讓您放鬆身心，擁有不同的台灣­宜蘭之旅。前棟客廳挑高8米60坪的空間，可欣賞日出光影，蟲鳴鳥叫的天籟交響曲，伴隨休閒並享用活力早餐，客房每間20-50坪休閒空間，在流水潺潺池畔旁，夏日徐徐微風吹來，午後陽光輕輕地灑落，在這兒可遠離塵囂，放慢腳步體驗新慢調旅遊。
stays.descriptionEn: March 3rd Bed and Breakfast is located in the scenically beautiful area of Yilan, an 80 minute drive from Taoyuan International Airport, and a 50 minute drive (through Xueshan Tunnel, the longest in Asia) from Taipei, Xinyi District, and 101. Facing the beauty of the Xueshan Mountain Range, we feature a living room with an 8 meter-high ceiling from where guests can enjoy beautiful colors of the sunlight shining through the trees and flowers and listen to the natural symphony of chirping birds and croaking frogs as they enjoy a hearty breakfast. Outside the front door is a bike trail where you can ride through the scenic countryside fields, approaching farms and experiencing the fun of kiln ovens. Try out Taiwan specialty snacks at the night market, or relax your mind and body at Su’ao Cold Springs and Jiaoxi Hot Springs. Yilan – a different experience of Taiwan. The living room of the front building features an 8 meter-high ceiling and covers 200 square meters, where where guests can enjoy the sunrise and listen to the natural symphony of chirping birds and croaking frogs as they relax and enjoy a hearty breakfast. Rooms are 66 to 165 square meters in size. Next to babbling water of the pond, the gentle breeze blows in summer, and the sunlight gently shines in the afternoon. This is a place far from the noise and dirt of the city, where you can slow down and experience a deliberate journey.

stays.description: 乍見井然有序的住家設計，內部卻有著與外觀全然不同的空間安排，承襲外部簡潔樸實的設計，民宿主人提供一個更為人性的居家環境，全新打造的新穎裝潢、怡人的視覺享受、舒適的住宿設備，再加上民宿貼心的服務，是個讓每位來訪的朋友能夠完全放鬆身心的天地…在您紓解舟車勞頓的疲憊之後，不妨移步至屋後的公園，暫時褪去緊張的外衣，脫下咬腳的皮鞋，讓自己專心吸進呼出每一口新鮮的空氣，在頭頂上澆上一匙陽光，準備開始進行光合作用，入夜之後，在此溫馨的民宿裡，您會發現生命的活力正在身上慢慢聚集，像夢中裡螢火蟲的光，一閃一閃的…您將會驚奇於享亨民宿的魔力。
stays.descriptionEn: The neat and tidy design of the house is apparent at first sight, but the interior space is organized completely different from the outside. Based on the exterior style of simplicity, the owner has provided a guest-friendly living environment with all-new decoration, a pleasant visual experience, and comfortable facilities, in addition to attentive service, making this a place where every guest can completely relax their mind and body. After relaxing from the wearies of your travels, take a walk to the park in the back, shedding your burdensome coat and removing your stifling shoes, letting yourself take a deep breath of fresh air and pouring a spoonful of sunlight onto your head to prepare for photosynthesis. As night falls over this warm bed and breakfast, you’ll discover the power of life gathering within your body, like the twinkling light of fireflies in a dream. The charm of Xiang Heng House will amaze you.

stays.name: 優遊真綻民宿
stays.description: 優遊真綻民宿附近:◎羅東觀光夜市:最友善的夜市~羅東觀光夜市，越夜越美麗，您到優遊真綻就是要來開懷品嚐最有人情味的道地小吃美食，真正輕鬆喔!◎羅東林業文化園區:有城市裡的秘密花園~羅東林業文化園區佔地約16公頃，蛻變的森林賦予林業新生命，來趟生態之旅吧!到園區大約十分鐘啦!◎羅東運動公園:如詩如畫的景觀建設，綠草如茵及綠森林般的大樹，您可以席地而坐乘涼或仰望蔚藍天空，朵朵白雲跟您揮手，來個與眾不同的體驗吧!可讓您徹底放鬆~前往十五分鐘呦!◎冬山河親水公園:以人與水的自然倫理訴求，充滿蘭陽本土色彩結合大自然造景，每年端午節龍舟賽及國際名校划船邀請賽還有國際童玩節都在冬山河親水公園舉行，值得您的造訪，車程約5分鐘。◎國立傳統藝術中心:傳統意味著歷史傳承，藝術是人類對生活感觸加以創造兼具美感的產物，您來趟國立傳統藝術中心一定收穫比想像更多，車程差不多十分鐘。◎梅花湖風景區:您想要放空嗎?就來梅花湖風景區悠閒騎著腳踏車，享受依山傍水湖面風光，美不勝收的湖畔風光絕對讓您留下美好的記憶，梅花湖山麓上是道教總廟三清宮，與清靜脫俗的自然景觀相互輝映，蔚為人間仙境，車程大約二十分鐘。◎武荖坑風景區:特有的山水綺麗風光，水質清澈透明，享有蘭陽第一林泉的美稱~武荖坑，您也可以與它更近距離接觸，開車約二十分鐘抵達。◎羅東文化工場:羅東文化工場是由黃聲遠建築師規劃設計，也許您錯過了2012金馬獎頒獎典禮在羅東文化工場，這次您別錯過了，可前往建築風格十分前衛大膽，氣勢磅礡仿若太空飛船，眺望羅東全景.每年3月至11月是龜山島開放登島時間,來一趟龜山島賞鯨及龜山八景及難得的龜山島登島之旅,別在等待了就是現在,說走就走,來吧----龜山島等您---------.

stays.description: 體驗蘭陽的山河畔四季風情景色，就在『內行家』田園民宿『內行家』田園民宿位於蘭陽平原的中心點，來這裡一年四季都有不同的感受春天的百花齊放，羅東公園紫藤花盛開、林業文化園區樹木發出嫩芽，羅莊大排櫻花絢麗綻放；讓您眼光一亮，美麗異常。夏天的綠意盎然,，宜蘭國際童玩節的熱情活動，冬山河畔親水公園享受玩水沁涼消暑。秋天的秋高氣爽，自行車兜風欣賞羅東運動公園公園的落羽松黃綠紅交錯美景，老街碼頭餵魚，爬上望天丘鳥瞰著羅東的美景冬天的慢活幸福，休耕的寬廣農田讓您放下沉重的壓力，用心體會生活的樸實美好，來杯珍藏好茶，享受愜意人生我們在羅東，用溫馨舒適的民宿與最具純淨的鄉村美景，讓您來趟探索田園的旅程，遠離市區的喧囂，聆聽大自然的悠揚協奏曲。內行家田園民宿，帶你細細品味蘭陽樸質的幸福旅程。

stays.description: 宜蘭劉德華的家民宿，地理環境適中，周邊停車便利，可容納6-16人包棟住宿，提供戶外景觀庭院、烤肉場地、聚會大廳、廚房、麻將等設施，歡迎攜帶寵物入住；近冬山河親水公園（宜蘭國際童玩節）、傳藝中心、三奇美徑（冬山伯朗大道）、武淵水火同源（大碗公溜滑梯）、羅東夜市等景點；感受蘭陽田園美好，無論是親友家庭聚會或是旅遊包棟，宜蘭劉德華の家都是您到宜蘭包棟住宿最超值首選。
stays.descriptionEn: Liu Dehua's House B&B in Yilan offers a moderate geographical location with convenient parking. It can accommodate 6-16 people for exclusive use of the house. The facilities include an outdoor scenic courtyard, barbecue area, meeting hall, kitchen, and Mahjong set, and pets are welcome. It's close to attractions such as the Dongshan River Water Park (Yilan International Children's Folklore and Folkgame Festival), the National Center for Traditional Arts, Sanqi Beauty Trail (Dongshan Boulevard), Wuyuan Water and Fire Source (Big Bowl Slide), and Luodong Night Market. You can experience the beautiful Lanyang countryside, whether for family and friends gatherings or group travel. Liu Dehua's House in Yilan is the most value-for-money choice for group stays in Yilan.

stays.name: 夏爾民宿
stays.description: 宜蘭｜夏爾．住進隱居巷弄的靜好生活在涼爽的午後，放下生活的忙碌，踩著悠閒的步伐，穿越羅東運動公園。後方安靜的巷弄之間，一排排家宅，透著溫柔黃光的鏤空字體，夏爾，優雅地現身──原來，理想生活不在他方，就在此刻的眼前。隱身民宅裡的悠閒「夏爾 (Shire)」，出自《魔戒》裡哈比人的居住地名，正如電影中那一方有著溫度、閒靜生活和自然的美好之地，在這裡，主人Ivan與太太小蘭也實現了他們的理想生活。一腳踏入夏爾，迎接旅人的是透過大片落地窗灑落在柔軟地毯上的和煦日光，目光所及無處不是溫暖的木質家具。夏爾的空間設計簡單、好看卻不張揚，一樓紅磚地板鋪展出舒適的客廳、餐桌至廚房；而拼貼石牆悄悄吸附宜蘭的溼氣，讓這裡的一年四季都有剛剛好的溫度。僅僅是在屋裡，或坐、或臥、或隨意翻看書籍，都能享受悠閒。從大學時便學習景觀設計的Ivan，有著獨特的品味與專業，畢業後參與許多宜蘭重點建設，像羅東運動公園就是他很喜歡的作品，之後與小蘭相戀，便一起實現民宿的計畫與心願。回歸夏爾生活之前，原本就是宜蘭人的小蘭在台北擔任服裝助理，儘管繁華的都市有其魅力，但熟悉的宜蘭令小蘭十分想念。因此，當Ivan提出回宜蘭開民宿的想法，小蘭便毫不猶豫地投入其中，與愛人共創美好生活。 The Beatles音樂中的美好夜晚順著石牆上樓，簡約的設計、留白的單純生活，舒緩了日常的疲憊。走進浴室洗去疲累，牆上繽紛的色階磁磚，也為生活點上一抹隨興的色彩。延續夏爾一貫的木頭元素，房裡的原始木柱由Ivan親自挑選，不經防腐的天然檜木有著時光的痕跡，像是生活逐漸美好的過程。
stays.descriptionEn: Yilan｜Shire GuesthouseThe Tranquil Life in a Secluded AlleyOn a balmy afternoon, you set aside your busy life and take a leisurely stroll across the Luodong Sports Park. In the quiet alleys behind the park, among the many rows of residential houses, you see the elegant Chinese characters of the Shire Guesthouse sign. You need not go far to find your ideal lifestyle after all, for it now appears right before your eyes.The leisure to be found within a secluded residenceThe term “Shire” comes from Ｔhe Lord of the Rings and is the place where the Hobbits live. Shire Guesthouse is precisely like the Shire we know from the movies; a warm, leisurely, peaceful life amid the natural beauty of the land. In this place, your hosts Ivan and his wife Ivy have realized their ideal lifestyle. The moment you set foot in Shire Guesthouse, you are greeted by genial sunlight spilling across a soft carpet through large French windows with warm wooden furniture everywhere you look. The design of Shire Guesthouse has a simple beauty which is not showy. The red brick flooring throughout the ground level makes for a cozy living room, extending under the dining table and into the kitchen. The pastiche stone walls stealthily absorb the humidity of the Yilan air, making for ideal temperatures all year round. Even staying indoors, it is easy to find a spot to sit or lounge or flip through a book and enjoy a leisurely time.Ivan, who began learning landscape design when in university, has unique tastes and specialties. He worked with many important construction companies after graduation. The Luodong Sports Park is one of his works of which he is particularly fond. Later on, he fell in love with Ivy, after which time they worked together to realize their aspirations to build a guesthouse. Before retreating into their Shire lifestyle, Ivy who was born in Yilan was working in Taipei as a clothing assistant. Though the bustling city has its charms, Ivy longed to return to her familiar hometown. As such, when Ivan proposed returning to Yilan to open a guesthouse, Ivy threw herself into the project without hesitation in order to create a beautiful life with her lover. A beautiful evening with the BeatlesFollowing the pastiche stone walls upstairs, the unadorned whitewall design evokes the simple life, alleviating your everyday exhaustion. Walking into the shower to wash away your fatigue, the multi-colored porcelain wall tiles add a splash of excitement to life. Continuing the solid-wood theme of the Shire, the bedroom’s wooden pillars were handpicked by Ivan himself. The unpreserved Taiwanese cypress shows the vestiges of time, like the process of the beautification of life itself. In the quiet of the evening, you are accompanied by the Beatles singing “A Hard Day’s Night” as you recline on the retro leather sofa reading a book until the vinyl record clock on the wall points to 11 o’clock. Even nighttime at the Shire is full of vitality. If you are lucky enough, you may have the pleasure of engaging in deep conversation with Ivan and Ivy, which may be the start of a secret adult meeting. Make an appointment on a whim, chatting happily over some drinks from their private red wine collection - tonight you feel just as content as if meeting with intimate friends for the first time in ages. The courage to face your ideal lifeAs the first rays of sunlight spill into the room, you feel prepared to meet a new day. As your footsteps on the stairs signal your descent to the ground floor, Ivy starts to cook a hot breakfast and the delicious aromas fill the air - the Shire menu changes in accordance with the seasons. Yet one thing always stays the same: the courtesy and consideration extended to all travelling guests. The daily menu and ingredients are flexible, so that even the picky traveler can eat their fill. If you haven’t eaten enough, there is no need to feel awkward - Ivy will happily cook another portion for you! “You need a full belly to be able to head out to have fun!” Ivy’s warm, impassioned laugh and your full belly fill you afresh with energy.The appearance of the ideal life may be a little journey with your sisters, a delightful trip with your sweetheart, or perhaps running off bravely on your own adventure. As such, Ivan and Ivy have the consideration to offer a special package for independent travelers, as a way to assist you in setting off on a new life. If it is in your destiny, perhaps Ivy can even accompany you in exploring parts of Yilan you’ve never seen. “In fact, Ivy always says that I’m just like a hobbit, which is why this place is called the Shire.” Ivan smilingly jokes about Ivy. From time to time, the sound of their quarrels and laughter fills the whole house. The Shire feels like a simple, ordinary space, yet it is filled with an indescribable energy that brings warmth and happiness to all who stay there. In this place, the easy atmosphere and genuine ideal lifestyle are shared with you.

stays.name: 小窩旅店
stays.description: 小窩旅店-宜蘭縣旅館111號小窩旅店延續經營理念「慢生活。漫回想。再出發」這次我們隱匿羅東在鬧區的大樓裡，用恰到好處的空間，全新裝修小窩獨有的風格，讓我們與慢生活距離更近了，擁抱這趟旅程美好回憶，明天醒來整裝再出發。初識羅東小窩，最先映入眼簾的是裝飾各種不同的小門主題牆，彷彿看見各種可能及各種回憶，好想打開小門去到想去的地方，回到想去的過去，緊接著入口的藍色大門，充滿鄉村典雅風格，進門後，是潛入彩色花海中的接待區，感覺就像另一個世界，海是倒過來的天，真的是很棒的感受。整間旅店的裝潢及擺飾都是我們親手設計佈置，每間浴室的地壁磚是台北宜蘭二地挑選，每個房間的傢俱也是台北台中二地物色，就是要小窩風格，包含局部油漆及Logo等店內視覺識別，可都是由小窩動手設計施工呢。羅東小窩位於羅東巿中心，推薦窩友們來羅東深度旅行，天亮了到羅東林業文化園區，熟悉熟悉太平山林業與羅東林場的人文回憶，不遠處的中興文化創意園區也要去走走，說不定與拿杯咖啡的小文青來場邂逅，傍晚可要漫步在羅東運動公園，每每於夕陽下，總可以遇到值得發呆一小時的好景色，太陽下山了，羅東夜巿開始登場，必吃美食轉一圈，大塊朵頤一番後，回到小窩，慵懶的躺上涵碧樓專用名床，享受慢舒眠，完整了漫活的一天。我們與小窩旅店(羅東夜巿店)的距離～羅東夜市300公尺羅東林業文化園區850公尺中興文化創意園區1.9公里羅東運動公園2.3公里Learn moreStay a moment and Keep going!*本旅店全面禁菸*為提供旅客一個舒適的住宿環境，小窩旅店全面禁菸，訂房旅客於入住前一天，需完成線上簽署住宿守則，表示同意禁菸規定，若經發現違反禁菸規定者，本旅店有權要求支付三天房價做為清潔費，以進行房間除味淨化工程。

stays.description: 憑著愛交朋友的個性，在一次偶然的機緣下，自己的住家變成了和大家一起分享的民宿!由女主人vivi一手設計的幸福三百米，充滿了活潑的朝氣，22種顏色的搭配，彷彿將她繽紛的內心世界，完全呈現!分享是幸福的，我們將我們的生活分享給您的同時，您也將您的生活與我們分享!這是在民宿裡，最大的樂趣!我們不是飯店、也不是旅店，是一個您可以暫時拋開一切的小窩，也是您可以找尋幸福的落腳地，用最自在的方式與最輕鬆的心情，和我們一起種下幸福、分享生活!
stays.descriptionEn: A young couple born in the 1980s love to make friends, with this personality they incidentally had a chance to make their home a B&B to share with everyone. We are very happy to share with our favorite hometown and the life in here. It is happy to share. Let us have a cup of coffee on the couch, and continue to chat about it. As persons born in the 1980s, we decided to stay in our favorite place, Yilan, after the marriage to create a warm nest that belongs to us. Happiness 300 m was designed by the hostess Vivi. It is a building full of lively vitality, with 22 matching colors, which fully renders her colorful inner world. It was originally a home for the family of the three, and at the un-refusable request of enthusiastic old friends, we opened the house as a B&B to share our life with everyone. Sharing makes you happy, we will share our lives with you, and at the same time, you would be also willing to share yours with us. During the time of sharing a pot of tea, we could talk about anything and exchange each other's experience in the life. This is the most fun thing in a B&B. We are not a hotel, nor an inn. This is a small nest that you can temporarily put aside all things, also a place that you can stay for a time to find happiness, and with the most comfortable way, with the most relaxed mood, we can plant the happiness together to share the life.

stays.description: 本飯店1977年成立時是羅東鎮唯一觀光署前身交通部觀光局核定之觀光飯店，現在仍是唯一的星級飯店，也是唯一全棟免費wi-fi上網的飯店。本飯店位於宜蘭縣地理中心，北從礁溪溫泉南至蘇澳冷泉，東從傳統藝術中心西至三星，都在30分鐘內。到太平山也只要90分鐘。又緊臨最友善夜市第一名的羅東夜市，也靠近羅東運動公園、冬山河親水公園，梧荖坑等著名景點，交通非常便利。本飯店也提共免費shuttle bus及變速腳踏車服務，商務中心提供免費上網、掃描、傳真等，旅遊、商務都非常方便。
stays.descriptionEn: The hotel was established in 1977. At the time, it was the only tourist hotel in town approved by Taiwan Tourism Bureau. It is the only star tourist hotel in town, and is the only hotel offering whole building free wi-fi Internet. The hotel is located in the geographic center of Yilan County, to the north from Jiaosi Hot Springs, to the south from Su-ao Cold Springs, to the east from National Center for Traditional Arts and to the west from Sanxing, all within 30 minutes. 90 minutes from Taipingshan. Also close to the most friendly Luodong Night Market, near Luodong Sports Park, Dongshan River Water Park, Wu-Lao Mountain Stream, and other famous attractions. Very convenient. The hotel offers free shuttle bus service and bike with variable speed pedal, a business center with free Internet access, scanner, fax, etc., very convenient for tourism and business travelers.

stays.name: 月牙泉民宿
stays.description: 這兒是您最舒適、自然的窩，田園上除了兩排錯落的荷花池映入眼簾，一朵朵挺著殲細腰桿的粉色荷花，霸佔了我的視野；也可騎著鐵馬(腳踏車)優遊於自行車道上，聽著悅耳動聽的蟲鳴鳥叫，遠觀地景、細瞧草木；泉窩與60甲的羅東運動公園為鄰，步行五分鐘可到達，庭院正後方有湧泉公園可戲水，清涼消暑，距離羅東夜市騎單車十分鐘，可說是【入則寧靜、出則繁榮】，泉窩幽雅清靜，主客分棟，不受干擾，竭誠熱情歡迎您的來臨。
stays.descriptionEn: Yueyaquan Bed and Breakfast is your most comfortable and natural resting place, featuring a view filled with countryside fields with two uneven rows of lotus ponds and pink lotus flowers with standing slender and tall. Take a leisurely ride along the bike path, listening to the pleasing sound of birds and insects, gazing off at scenery in the distance, and closely observing the trees and plants. Quanwo is a 5 minute walk from the 60-hectare Luodong Sports Park, and the area behind the courtyard includes a fountain park where you can play in the water and cool off in the summer, a 10 minute bike ride from Luodong Night Market. We are truly a quiet and peaceful sanctuary within the busy city. Our environment is elegant, peaceful, and quiet, with the owner living in a separate building so as not to disturb guests. We warmly welcome you to Yueyaquan Bed and Breakfast!

stays.description: “松滿緣”原是土生土長孝順的屋主「阿松」，為圓兒時心願而立志買下的大屋，只為讓慈愛的父母及家人有更好的居住環境，但目前尚在台北打拼的他，還無法回來定居，而諾大的房子讓李爸和李媽更增孤寂，寧守在五結的老屋不肯入住，幾經商量，決定開放為民宿與有緣人共享。”松滿緣”室內挑高的客廳、沉穩原木的裝潢、雅致的客房，有如在家般的舒適自在，戶外擁有寬敞的庭園空間，夜晚時，能與親愛家人愜意的喝著咖啡，慵懶的坐在庭園上沉浸在宜蘭夜晚的寧靜，欣賞滿天的星斗，當黑夜來臨時，提供您寧靜的居家環境，讓你體驗完全放鬆的深沉睡眠；我們雖然沒有豪華的設施，但是”松滿緣”的一事一物都是我們的用心，此外，李爸李媽滿心期待來客入住時，帶給兩老的熱鬧與忙碌，直說要像是親朋好友來般認真的熱情款待，誠摯邀請您來作客相伴，也希望您不吝的指教，以便提供您更歡喜的旅遊心情。

stays.name: 果豆館
stays.description: 羅東果豆獨棟包棟民宿位於羅東交流道旁，羅東、冬山、五結交界處。鄰近冬山河親水公園、冬山河生態綠舟、武淵水火同源、國立傳統藝術中心、蠟藝彩繪館、虎牌米粉產業文化館、太平洋釣蝦場、清水大閘門、新月廣場、宜蘭伯朗大道、宜蘭餅發明館、蘇澳冷泉、南方澳漁港......羅東果豆包棟民宿適合~2天1夜之輕旅行，或是3天2夜放鬆之旅，甚至4天3夜以上深度旅行。您大可開車從果豆民宿前往羅東夜市約10分鐘、至礁溪湯圍溝公園約20分鐘、南方澳漁港吃海產，皆佔地利之便。羅東果豆1樓大客廳提供電動麻將桌、配有4K 65吋大電視及景觀吧台，在這您可以悠閒喝下午茶，跟朋友暢玩65吋的Switch(須自備)、夜晚打麻將、室內烤肉、唱歌 (原聲原影真人導唱)、聊聊以往豐功偉業事蹟,好不愜意。羅東果豆民宿提供四間客房皆為四人套房,每間皆配有冷暖氣、4K大電視、電熱水器、獨立衛浴，獨立陽台，不論是家庭出遊、親子同樂、三五好友相聚，在這您可以得到夢寐已久的心靈洗滌。

stays.name: 樂亞亞奇旅館
stays.description: 亞奇文旅Artch Inn座落在羅東夜市商圈，此地也是當地人平日交通的樞紐。在這裡，標誌了市井小民生活的真實樣貌；在這裡，收藏了旅人們漫遊的許多驚喜；在這裡，保存了城鎮歷經的絕代風華。我們將細細拾起散落在時間裡的微光，化為日常雋永的光源，點亮每一間小客房，等待你的光臨。
stays.descriptionEn: Artch Inn is located in the Luodong Night Market business district, which is also a daily transportation hub for locals. Here, the true appearance of life of ordinary people is revealed; here, many surprises of travelers' wanderings are collected; here, the unparalleled splendor of the town is preserved. We will carefully pick up the tiny glimmers scattered in time, turn them into timeless light sources for daily life, light up every small guest room, and wait for your visit.

stays.nameEn: Everything goes well Happiness Skyline Hotel
stays.description: 位於宜蘭羅東的精華地帶，獨具交通、飲食、觀光優勢的幸福星空旅店，以強烈的空間感，恰到好處的冷調，無造作的自然奢華，來達成羅東新時尚飯店的目標，每間房型為截然不同的設計，將設計巧思發揮的淋漓盡致，前衛彩光投射在每個房間角落，調配甜美、極簡、強烈、無印、前衛、奢華等各種氛圍，讓住所不只是一個休憩場所，更是「玩」美與體驗的空間。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the elite area of Luodong, Yilan, the Happy Star Hotel with unique advantages in transportation, food and sightseeing, with a strong sense of space, just the right tone, and unpretentious natural luxury, to achieve the goal of Luodong New Fashion Hotel, each room type For a completely different design, the design is incisively and vividly displayed. The avant-garde color light is projected on every corner of the room, and various atmospheres such as sweet, minimal, strong, non-printed, avant-garde, and luxurious are deployed to make the residence more than just a resting place. It is a space of "playing" beauty and experience.

stays.name: 綠禾豐民宿
stays.description: 綠禾豐民宿：回歸大自然的寧靜小天地隱身於宜蘭縣羅東鎮的綠禾豐民宿，是一個讓你遠離都市喧囂、放鬆心情的理想度假場所。這裡的每一寸空間都彷彿擁抱大自然，為每一位旅客提供一個安靜、悠閒的度假體驗。無論是短暫的周末小憩，還是長時間的深度休養，這裡都能讓你全身心地放鬆，重新與自然接軌。1. 來自自然的邀約綠禾豐民宿四周圍繞著翠綠的田野，這裡的空氣清新，沒有都市的噪音和車流聲，只有清脆的鳥鳴聲和偶爾吹過的微風，讓你不自覺地放慢腳步，深呼吸這片潔淨的空氣。白天，可以在陽台上欣賞美麗的田園景色；夜晚，則可以仰望星空，感受傍晚的寧靜與神秘。2. 以「回家」為設計理念民宿的設計風格簡約而不失溫馨，房間的每個角落，都透露出「回家」的感覺。淡雅的顏色搭配，以及柔和的燈光，讓人彷彿回到自己的家一樣，放下心中的疲憊。每間客房都提供完善的設施，讓你即便身處鄉間，也能享有舒適的居住體驗。窗外的田野景色，搭配室內的溫馨氛圍，營造出一個無壓力的休憩空間。綠禾豐民宿，是一個讓你徹底放慢腳步、親近自然的度假聖地。無論你是來自繁忙的都市，還是希望尋找一片遠離塵囂的寧靜天地，這裡都能給你最放鬆、舒適的體驗。回歸自然，擁抱安靜，讓綠禾豐民宿成為你放鬆心靈的理想選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: LuHeFeng Homestay: A Tranquil Retreat Back to NatureNestled in the serene town of Luodong in Yilan County, LuHeFeng Homestay is the perfect getaway for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and unwind in a peaceful, natural environment. Every corner of this place seems to embrace nature, offering guests a quiet and leisurely retreat. Whether you& #39;re here for a brief weekend escape or an extended stay to recharge, this haven allows you to fully relax and reconnect with nature.1. An Invitation from NatureSurrounded by lush green fields, LuHeFeng Homestay boasts fresh air, free from the noise and traffic of the city. Instead, you& #39;ll be greeted by the melodious songs of birds and the occasional gentle breeze, encouraging you to slow down and breathe in the clean, refreshing air. During the day, you can relax on the balcony and enjoy the beautiful rural landscape, while in the evening, you can gaze at the stars and experience the peacefulness and mystery of the twilight.2. Designed with the Feeling of "Home"The design of the homestay is simple yet warm, with every corner of the rooms exuding a "homey" feeling. The soft, neutral colors and gentle lighting create an atmosphere that allows you to unwind and leave behind the stress of everyday life. Each room is equipped with modern amenities, ensuring that you can enjoy a comfortable stay even in the countryside. The view of the fields outside, combined with the cozy indoor ambiance, creates a stress-free environment for your relaxation.LuHeFeng Homestay is a place where you can truly slow down and immerse yourself in nature. Whether you’re from a busy city or simply looking for a quiet sanctuary away from the noise of daily life, this homestay offers the perfect experience for relaxation and comfort. Reconnect with nature and embrace the tranquility – let LuHeFeng Homestay be your ideal choice for rejuvenating both body and soul.

stays.name: 緣點民宿
stays.description: 羅東緣點民宿緣點民宿位於羅東十六份古圳旁，鄰近羅莊櫻花步道與羅東夜市，地理位置便利，鬧中取靜。館內提供廚房設備與電動麻將桌，無論家庭旅遊或好友聚會，都能自在放鬆、盡情享受相聚時光。十六份水圳擁有得天獨厚的自然景觀，是結合自行車道與人行步道的綠意廊道，並一路延伸連結至冬山河。河畔草木青翠，沿途可見果菜園與稻田風光，水質清澈見底，福壽魚與各式淡水魚悠游其中。步道上常見釣客甩竿垂釣，橋上亦可見拋網捕魚的身影，充滿濃厚的在地生活氣息。清晨與傍晚時分，長輩牽著孫兒漫步水圳步道，微風徐徐，景色悠然，營造出溫馨而寧靜的氛圍。緣點民宿，為您打造輕鬆自在的住宿體驗，是您走訪羅東的理想選擇。誠摯歡迎您的蒞臨。
stays.descriptionEn: -Yuandian Homestay – LuodongYuandian Homestay is conveniently located in Luodong, just minutes from Luodong Night Market and the beautiful Luozhuang Sakura Trail. The property features a fully equipped kitchen and an electric mahjong table, making it a perfect choice for families and friends seeking a relaxing getaway.Situated beside the historic Shiliufen Canal, the homestay enjoys a unique and scenic setting. The Shiliufen waterway offers both cycling paths and pedestrian walkways, connecting to the Dongshan River and extending all the way toward the river mouth. Surrounded by lush riverside greenery, vegetable gardens, and rice fields, the canal’s crystal-clear waters are home to tilapia and a variety of freshwater fish. Along the way, you may often see locals fishing from the banks or casting nets from the bridges.In the early mornings and evenings, grandparents stroll along the canal paths with their grandchildren, creating a peaceful and heartwarming atmosphere.Yuandian Homestay offers a tranquil and comfortable stay—your ideal choice for a relaxing visit to Luodong.We warmly welcome you.

Being uniquely designed, it impresses every visitor at the first glance with its stylish clean cut tone, bright and comfortable leisure space. It combines the black and white to present a unique and elegant waltz. It conveys dedicated layout idea of the owner from lamp decoration to window sills to welcome the visitors from faraway places. With a little sign of imagination, you will find diversified themes in the guestroom full of child-touch.

stays.descriptionEn: ShuGo B&B is located at the junction of Luodong and Dongshan, away from the noise of the city, and provides a quiet and comfortable space for travelers.Not only has a high-quality accommodation environment, but also convenient transportation location.Come to Datong Township to enjoy the cherry blossom season in spring;In summer, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Inaho and go boating at Samsung Annong Creek;Fall pine in Luodong Sports Park in autumn;In winter, drive to Taiping Mountain to enjoy snow and red maple.If you want to ride a bike, you can rent a bike around Meihua Lake to relax around the lake ~The location of the Homestay is close to the three major night markets, whether it is dinner or supper.Luodong Night Market (5 minutes), Qinggou Night Market (3 minutes), Dongshan Night Market (10 minutes)Small Scold~The Qinggou Night Market is only open for business on Wednesday!The Dongshan Night Market is only open on Saturday!

stays.description: 「晴晴屋‧羅東夜市住宿」擁有極為便捷的交通位置，離羅東夜市3分鐘，距離羅東文化工場、羅東運動公園、羅東林業文化園區、羅東火車站、童玩節園區、傳藝中心及各大客運轉運站也都十分鄰近而便利，方便背包客及自駕旅人下榻入住。旅人們可以隨性踏遊夜市，從街頭逛到街尾，一次嚐遍蘭陽美食。 「晴晴屋‧羅東夜市住宿」提供多間窗明几淨的溫馨套房房型，諾大的房型空間及方正的格局，搭配雅緻的裝潢設計和潔淨的舒活空間，提供一處溫暖宜居的舒適空間，旅人們可以在此靜靜放鬆身心，補足體力後再行前往蘭陽各地觀光遊覽，帶回最美好難忘的旅遊記憶。 倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【0982-501646】晴晴屋‧羅東夜市住宿。

stays.name: 采亨民宿
stays.description: 帶有獨特設計風味的「采亨民宿」，讓您不用出國，也能感受到愜意的渡假風情；踏入大門後，映入眼簾的是氣派的接待大廳，深深吸引著旅人的目光，獨特的LED頂燈有著不同的色彩變換，與客房相呼應，今天您想住哪一間呢？不同色調帶來不同的心情：熱情的紅色，活潑的黃色，沉穩的藍色，溫柔的綠色…這兒有飯店的豪華質感，也有居家的溫馨舒適，讓您陶醉其中不捨離去，來「采亨民宿」寵愛自己幾天吧！「采亨民宿」鄰近火車站商圈，前往著名的「羅東夜市」和「羅東運動公園」都非常便利，讓您省去不少舟車勞頓的交通之苦，盡情享受宜蘭的濃厚人情味、多樣景色好風光、豐富小吃好滋味：來「武荖坑」參加綠色博覽會、到「冬山河親水公園」看龍舟競賽、到「國立傳藝中心」體驗古藝之美、到「林業園區」漫步綠林中，傾聽和諧輕快的自然樂章，沉澱紛擾已久的心靈。
stays.descriptionEn: "Chi Heng Homestay" designed with a unique flavor; it offers you a leisurely comfortable holiday atmosphere without going abroad. Stepping into the gate, you are greeted by a grand reception hall, which attracts the attention of travelers. Unique LED dome lights are transforming among different colors, corresponding to the guest rooms. What type of room do you want? Different shades bring different moods: passionate red, lively yellow, calm blue, gentle green. Here you have the luxurious texture of a hotel and cozy and comfortable home to let you revel in and are reluctant to leave the "Chi Heng Homestay." Pamper yourself a few days! "Chi Heng Homestay" nears the commercial district of the railway station, with easy access to the famous "Luodong Night Market" and "Luodong Sports Park," allowing you to save a lot of travel-worn, and enjoy the mien of Yilan, diverse good scenery, and snacks with rich tastes. Come to Wu-Lao Mountain Stream to participate the Green Expo, visit "Dongshan River Park" to watch the dragon boat races, take a tour to the "National Center for Traditional Arts" to experience the beauty of the ancient arts, and troll over the green woods of the "Luodong Forestry Culture Garden" and listen to the harmony, brisk natural movements, to settle the troubles of an awaited soul.

stays.description: 位於羅東火車站前，距羅東火車站僅須徒步1分鐘，緊鄰羅東觀光夜市步行只須5分鐘， 提供便捷的購物商圈及輕鬆品嚐羅東當地美食， 鬧中取靜、交通方便，百餘坪平面停車場，免費提供停車， 設備皆採用防火建材，住宿貴賓均享有三佰萬元之平安保險，住的安心且又有保障， 每間客房皆有窗戶，自然採光溫馨舒適。客房免費提供礦泉水、咖啡包和茶包，附贈元氣早餐。本店榮獲宜蘭縣旅館業評鑑『優良旅館獎』、台灣省衛生競賽『衛生優良店』及宜蘭縣政府『安心旅館獎』、觀光局星級評鑑『二顆星』。讓蒞臨金城客棧的旅客都住得安心。金城客棧親切的服務，優雅寧靜的環境，是我們誠懇的心意，以盡善盡美為宗旨，讓您住的溫馨又舒適!客房內提供免費無線寬頻上網服務，使用者需自備手提電腦。國民旅遊卡特約商店。
stays.descriptionEn: The hotel is in the heart of the Luo-Dong town and close to the train station. It''''s just a 1-minute walk to the Luo-Dong train station and a 5-minute walk to the Luo-Dong Night Market, where there are many shops and food restaurants. The hotel provides traditional Chinese breakfast buffet. The rooms have free tea, coffee and spring water. Free parking places and free WIFI also available for customers. The hotel also has fire resistant furniture and fittings. They also insure customers for damage caused. Good views available in every room. The government has recognized the cleanliness and the quality of the hotel. The excellent services and attentiveness of the staff will ensure you the most pleasurable stay. The hotel provides a 24-hour service for all your travel needs. If you’re looking for excellent service and facilities, King Town Hotel is a must for your stay.

stays.name: 靜園休閒民宿
stays.description: 健康、幸福、浪漫，為主軸的 靜園 位於繁華羅東鎮內，緊臨羅東溪畔的羅東運動公園旁，擁有近270度的自然景觀及寧靜環境。廣闊羅東溪隨著變換物移，宛如梵谷筆下畫景，遠眺雪山山脈、太平山、棲蘭山等青翠山巒，日出的曙光，夕陽的晚霞，坐在靜園的原木景觀台上，這一切就在眼前，垂手可得。三種不同風格主題設計客房 : * 東洋風 以日本俳聖”松尾芭蕉”之紀行巨著「奧之細道」為本。* 西洋風 以梵谷名畫誕生地及最經典電影「羅馬假期」，佈置充滿傳奇的空間及想像。 * 南洋風 以峇里島為主軸，約40坪的室內外空間的，最具休閒度假感。"
stays.descriptionEn: Memory Garden Villa, which emphasizes health, fortune, and romance, is located in Luodong Township, a busy and flourishing area, next to Luodong Sports Park and Luodong River, with a nearly 270 degree view of natural scenery and a tranquil environment. Along with changes and shifts, the broad Luodong River resembles a Picasso painting. Gaze out at the verdant mountain such as the Syue Mountain Range, Taiping Shan, and Qilan Mountain, observe the sunlight at dawn and clouds at sunset, or relax at the wooden scenic observation deck. Natural scenery and attractions are all laid out before you, at your fingertips. Rooms come in 3 different styles: *Oriental – based on Matsuo Basho’s great travel work “Oku no Hosomichi” *Western – A legendary space and imagination based on the birthplace of Picasso and classic film “Roman Holiday” *South Pacific – Based on Bali, with 130 square meters of space inside and outside the room, creating the best leisure and vacation atmosphere.

stays.name: 又一天文旅
stays.description: 從前有個南方澳在地熱門據點－南方澳大戲院，每天不只放映電影，還作為戲班、集會、教學的知識與訊息交流之地。戲院熄燈，夷為平地，爾後長出一棟作為旅店用途、佇立 50 年以上的老建築，期間有過兩種品牌與風格。如今，在此歷經的一切，皆會隨著日月升落迎來新的－【又一天 Koh Tsit Kang】。在【又一天 Koh Tsit Kang】，大家將與在地人成為鄰居，共享天井中的陽光遞嬗與生活起居。我們攫取南方澳的特色展現於此，不掩飾亦不誇飾，讓大家能來這裡待著，感受南方澳的輪廓、文化與時區。但我們更期待大家把這作為短憩的居所，嘗試與南方澳共頻，一起度過日常生活的一天～又一天 .ᐟ
stays.descriptionEn: Once, there was a beloved local landmark—the Nanfang’ao Theatre. It was more than just a movie house; it served as a venue for Taiwanese opera performances, gatherings, teaching and knowledge exchange. When the curtains fell for the last time, the theater was reduced to rubble. In its place rose a hotel—an aged building that has stood for over 50 years, undergoing transformations under different names and styles. Today, a new story begins within its walls—Koh Tsit Kang.At Koh Tsit Kang, you’ll become neighbors with the locals, sharing in the ebb and flow of daily life under the shifting sunlight of the open-air courtyard. We epitomize the essence of Nanfang’ao without embellishment—just as it is—so that visitors can linger, immerse themselves in its culture, and sync with its rhythm. Yet, more than anything, we hope that this place serves as a harbor for you—where you can experience one day in Nanfang’ao, and another day in rhythm with the sea.

stays.nameEn: RSL COLD & HOT SPRINGS RESORT SUAO
stays.description: 瓏山林蘇澳冷熱泉度假飯店位於台灣東北角宜蘭蘇澳，為全台唯一兼具全年恆溫的蘇澳冷泉與稀有的碳酸氫鈉溫泉的五星級飯店，三面環山、東臨太平洋，豐富的自然風光讓度假充滿悠閒。飯店擁有152間客房，其中包括9間頂級套房，所有房型均備有冷、溫雙泉。以親水為主軸規畫的18個冷、溫泉水區、親子水療區與景觀裸湯區，使泡湯成為完全私密享受。開放式主題餐廳與酒吧、健身房、DIY教室、兒童遊戲區及可容納近400人多功能宴會廳等設施，打造多元度假休閒環境。無論是旅遊住宿、會議假期或度假享受，瓏山林蘇澳冷熱泉度假飯店均能滿足，提供旅客優質住宿、頂級泡湯及美容SPA..等服務。瓏山林蘇澳冷熱泉度假飯店為旅客至宜蘭地區旅遊住宿、會議假期、度假享受之首選飯店。
stays.descriptionEn: Located at the beautiful Suao, Yilan on the northeast side of Taiwan, RSL Cold, and Hot Springs Resort Suao is the only five-star resort in Taiwan with both cold and hot natural springs.The luxurious resort is surrounded by mountains and the Pacific Ocean on the east side. The resort offers dual cold and hot springs guest rooms, 18 public cold and hot spring pools, water spa, and scenic naturist spring for the ultimate relaxation.The open kitchen restaurant, bar, fitness center, yoga class, children’s playroom, spa, and multi-functional banquet space accommodates every discerning traveler, making RSL Cold and Hot Springs Resort Suao the number one resort choice in Yilan top choice for leisure getaway, incentive meeting, or family and friend travel.

stays.description: 遇見蘇澳，美景盡覽全新裝潢的蘇澳飯店緊鄰蘇澳國際商務港，依山傍海、景色怡人，每當港內海面風平浪靜，船舶倒影入海，一眼望去有如樓閣連空而起之幻境，故名為『蘇澳蜃市』成為『蘭陽八景』之一。飯店獨特景觀， 讓旅客看日出、賞夜景、泡冷泉、呷海鮮。無論您是出差洽公、或是至此地遊覽名勝，是您旅宿的優質首選！飯店精心的格局設計，細緻的硬體設備，提供優雅舒適的住宿環境，以及溫馨親切的服務態度，讓您在外也能享受輕自在！
stays.descriptionEn: Meet Suao and enjoy the beautiful sceneryThe newly renovated Su'ao Hotel is adjacent to the Su'ao International Business Port, surrounded by mountains and the sea, with pleasant scenery. Whenever the sea in the port is calm, the reflections of ships in the sea look like an illusion of buildings rising from the sky, so it is named "Su'ao Mirage" and has become one of the "Eight Scenic Spots of Lanyang". The hotel's unique landscape allows travelers to watch the sunrise, enjoy the night view, soak in cold springs, and eat seafood. Whether you are on a business trip or visiting the scenic spots here, it is your first choice for accommodation! The hotel's meticulous layout design and sophisticated hardware facilities provide an elegant and comfortable accommodation environment, as well as a warm and friendly service attitude, allowing you to enjoy a relaxed and comfortable stay even when you are away from home!

stays.description: 寄居蟹是位於宜蘭頭城的家庭民宿, 一間透天三層樓的房子， 一樓為客廳與廚房的共用空間， 二樓是兩間雙人房間， 三樓是民宿主人自住空間，我們提供烤肉休閒的庭院、麻將間等設施，即將入住的您可以依人數及需求與我們討論。我們希望籍同住，共享的方式拉近人與人之間的關係,與您分享宜蘭人的熱情，體會鄉下人的漫活。 寄居蟹沒有很豪華的房間，也沒有很特別的特色， 有的只是全新設備、乾淨的房間、寧靜的環境，與宜蘭人的熱情 我們在此期待您的入住 請必須注意 1.房價不含早餐 2..提供廚房、餐具，需自行準備食材，使用完畢須清理乾淨，否則酌收清潔費。3.提供麻將桌、自助小型卡拉ok 4.響應環保不主動提供拋棄式備品(如有需求請洽房東)，如有增加人數，可提供加床、棉被、枕頭將依狀況酌收清潔費，5.住宅內請勿吸煙 6.如需攜帶寵物請配合寵物需放置屋外或與我們協調寵物的安置問題 7.提供免費寄放行李(退房當天),如有捐壞/遺失民宿恕不負責 8.如需接送服務請提前告知 9.與民宿主人同住，隨時為您服務 10.如若有其他需求疑問，可留言或 加入Line：@521cczht 我們的地址是頭城鎮頂埔路一段46號

stays.name: 山海衝浪民宿
stays.description: 山海衝浪民宿簡介】歡迎來到「山海衝浪民宿」，位於風景秀麗的東北角外澳地區，擁山面海，環境舒適宜人，是您度假放鬆的理想選擇。民宿距離沙灘步行只需數分鐘，白天可盡情衝浪、散步沙灘、體驗飛行傘，黃昏時分更可欣賞迷人的夕陽景致。本民宿設施齊全，備有卡拉OK娛樂空間、電動麻將桌，親朋好友聚會歡樂不間斷；戶外更設有烤肉區，讓您在海風中品嚐美味烤肉，享受悠閒時光。夜晚伴隨蟲鳴與海濤，讓身心徹底放鬆。附近景點豐富，旅客可前往金車伯朗咖啡館悠閒啜飲咖啡、感受藝文氛圍；也可至大溪漁港嚐盡新鮮海味，或搭船從烏石港出發，登上神秘的龜山島探險。喜愛登山健行的旅人更不可錯過後山的烏山古道、梗枋步道、平溪古道、石空步道等自然步道，沿途風景壯麗，四季皆有不同風情。無論是想放鬆休憩、親近自然，或與親友共度歡樂時光，「山海衝浪民宿」都能滿足您的期待。誠摯邀請您來體驗山與海的美好。
stays.descriptionEn: Welcome to "Mountain and Sea Surfing B&B," located in the scenic Wai& #39;ao area of ​​Northeast Coast. Nestled between mountains and the sea, this comfortable and pleasant environment is the perfect choice for a relaxing vacation. Just minutes& #39; walk from the beach, you can enjoy surfing, beach walks, and parasailing during the day, and admire the mesmerizing sunset at dusk.The B&B is fully equipped with a karaoke room and an electric mahjong table for endless fun with friends and family. An outdoor barbecue area allows you to enjoy delicious grilled meats in the sea breeze and relax. At night, the sounds of insects and the waves will help you completely unwind.Nearby attractions abound. Guests can leisurely sip coffee and soak in the artistic atmosphere at King Car Brown Cafe; savor fresh seafood at Daxi Fishing Port; or take a boat trip from Wushi Harbor to explore the mysterious Turtle Island. Hiking enthusiasts shouldn& #39;t miss the Wushan Ancient Trail, Gengfang Trail, Pingxi Ancient Trail, and Shikong Trail in the back mountains, all offering stunning scenery with different charms in each season.Whether you& #39;re looking to relax, connect with nature, or spend quality time with family and friends, "Mountain and Sea Surfing B&B" can meet your expectations. We sincerely invite you to experience the beauty of mountains and sea.

stays.searchText: 山海衝浪民宿 山海衝浪民宿 宜蘭縣民宿2040號 宜蘭縣 頭城鎮 濱海路2段469號 山海衝浪民宿簡介】歡迎來到「山海衝浪民宿」，位於風景秀麗的東北角外澳地區，擁山面海，環境舒適宜人，是您度假放鬆的理想選擇。民宿距離沙灘步行只需數分鐘，白天可盡情衝浪、散步沙灘、體驗飛行傘，黃昏時分更可欣賞迷人的夕陽景致。本民宿設施齊全，備有卡拉OK娛樂空間、電動麻將桌，親朋好友聚會歡樂不間斷；戶外更設有烤肉區，讓您在海風中品嚐美味烤肉，享受悠閒時光。夜晚伴隨蟲鳴與海濤，讓身心徹底放鬆。附近景點豐富，旅客可前往金車伯朗咖啡館悠閒啜飲咖啡、感受藝文氛圍；也可至大溪漁港嚐盡新鮮海味，或搭船從烏石港出發，登上神秘的龜山島探險。喜愛登山健行的旅人更不可錯過後山的烏山古道、梗枋步道、平溪古道、石空步道等自然步道，沿途風景壯麗，四季皆有不同風情。無論是想放鬆休憩、親近自然，或與親友共度歡樂時光，「山海衝浪民宿」都能滿足您的期待。誠摯邀請您來體驗山與海的美好。

stays.name: 海灘風情民宿
stays.description: 赤腳踩在細軟的沙灘上，海面上一波波的海浪拍打著岸邊，耳邊傳來聲聲浪濤聲，沉浸悠閒自在的蔚藍情懷之中，顯得格外浪漫。耀眼晨曦自遠方的海平線緩緩升起，舒爽海風恣意吹拂著，我在東北角感受最天然純淨的海洋風情～「宜蘭民宿‧海灘風情渡假別墅」位於宜蘭頭城鄉濱海公路旁，為安全的合法民宿，是一棟由設計師精心設計的獨棟建築，有著近百坪的寬敞空間，以潔淨的白色為主要色調，搭配深淺不一的褐色系家具，運用藤編桌椅點綴其中，瀰漫著濃厚的峇里風情～宜蘭民宿‧海灘風情渡假別墅」提供多間具有南洋情懷的舒適套房，並採用高優質設備，給您五星級的渡假饗宴，部分房型更設有陽台空間，您可隨時眺望湛藍海景，欣賞晨曦與黃昏優美景致～倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【0910-166575 03-9773674】宜蘭民宿．海灘風情渡假別墅。
stays.descriptionEn: Go barefoot in the soft beach sand as wave after wave beat against the shore. Listen to the sound of their crashing as you settle into a comfortable, leisurely, deep blue mood, feeling extra romantic. The dazzling morning light gradually rises from the distant ocean horizon, and the refreshing ocean breeze blows freely. Experience the purest and most natural beach landscape here at Beach Landscape Bed and Breakfast on the Northeast Coast. Located next to coastal highways in Toucheng Township (Yilan), we’re a legally-certified bed and breakfast housed in a thoughtfully designed stand-alone building, offering nearly 330 square meters of spacious area, a pure white color theme combined with furniture in different shades of brown, with rattan chairs arranged throughout, displaying a rich Bali style. Beach Landscape Bed and Breakfast provides several comfortable suite rooms with a South Pacific atmosphere and provides high-quality facilities to provide guests with a 5-star vacation experience. Some of the rooms come with balconies, where you can look out over the azure sea or appreciate the graceful beauty of the sunrise or sunset. For any questions regarding your trip or plans, please call Beach Landscape Bed and Breakfast at 0910-166575.03-9773674

stays.name: 烏石居
stays.description: 烏石居民宿 – 最貼近烏石港與蘭陽博物館的靜謐之所坐落於宜蘭縣頭城的烏石居民宿，是距離烏石港與蘭陽博物館最近的溫馨住宿選擇。這裡四季皆美，為旅人提供最貼近大自然的體驗。每年3月至11月，您可申請登島龜山島，每日名額有限，建議提前2個月預約，親身探索這座神秘海島的獨特風光。冬季推薦行程：✔ 礁溪溫泉——沉浸在暖湯之中，感受冬日的療癒溫度✔ 烏石港海鮮——品嚐肥美的冬季鰹魚生魚片與新鮮螃蟹，享受最純粹的海味為避開塞車時段，不妨在頭城住一晚，悠閒地感受這座海港小鎮的寧靜與美好，再經國道五號回家，讓旅程更加從容自在。立即預訂，體驗最純粹的宜蘭之美！
stays.descriptionEn: Wushi Inn – A Serene Retreat Near Wushi Harbor and Lanyang MuseumNestled in Toucheng, Yilan County, Wushi Inn is the closest and coziest accommodation near Wushi Harbor and Lanyang Museum. With breathtaking scenery all year round, this charming retreat offers travelers a unique opportunity to immerse themselves in nature.From March to November, visitors can apply for a Guishan Island tour. Due to limited daily slots, we recommend booking at least two months in advance to secure your spot and experience the island’s mesmerizing beauty up close.Recommended Winter Activities:✔ Jiaoxi Hot Springs – Soak in the soothing warm waters and enjoy a truly rejuvenating winter escape.✔ Wushi Harbor Seafood – Savor the rich flavors of fresh bonito sashimi and succulent winter crab, indulging in the essence of the sea.To avoid traffic congestion, consider staying overnight in Toucheng. Take your time to appreciate the peaceful charm of this coastal town before heading home via National Highway No. 5 for a more relaxed journey.Book your stay now and experience the pure beauty of Yilan!

stays.searchText: 烏石居 烏石居 宜蘭縣民宿1928號 宜蘭縣 頭城鎮 朝陽路93號 烏石居民宿 – 最貼近烏石港與蘭陽博物館的靜謐之所坐落於宜蘭縣頭城的烏石居民宿，是距離烏石港與蘭陽博物館最近的溫馨住宿選擇。這裡四季皆美，為旅人提供最貼近大自然的體驗。每年3月至11月，您可申請登島龜山島，每日名額有限，建議提前2個月預約，親身探索這座神秘海島的獨特風光。冬季推薦行程：✔ 礁溪溫泉——沉浸在暖湯之中，感受冬日的療癒溫度✔ 烏石港海鮮——品嚐肥美的冬季鰹魚生魚片與新鮮螃蟹，享受最純粹的海味為避開塞車時段，不妨在頭城住一晚，悠閒地感受這座海港小鎮的寧靜與美好，再經國道五號回家，讓旅程更加從容自在。立即預訂，體驗最純粹的宜蘭之美！

stays.name: 真情行館
stays.description: 宜蘭｜真情非凡行館．嚐一口來自深海的幸福滋味遠離台北城，出了雪山隧道，一切明亮了起來！在往烏石港的路上，搖下車窗，望向右邊的海，外澳沙灘邊的一整排面海民宿裡，一塊白色浪花圖案的招牌上寫著「真情非凡」，這裡是宜蘭頭城，一個很靠近海的地方！跟著海水及太陽直奔沙灘從後門走入真情館，旁邊的門內是一般民宿少見的專業廚房，不僅有中央料理餐檯，還有飯店級的烤箱和對開式不鏽鋼凍藏庫，來到餐廳，寬敞的空間和希臘的藍白色調，以及正門外的外澳沙灘，伴隨著浪聲。換下鞋子走上樓，以靠海的城市為房間命名，希臘米克諾斯與希臘愛琴娜，採用樓中樓設計，可以舒服窩在沙發或是坐在陽台的躺椅；法國馬賽和巴里島庫塔以歐式的南洋風格妝點，讓旅人能享受安靜假期。另一棟非凡館則是中古希臘風格，位在一樓的太陽神阿波羅房，可以在戶外的泡腳池邊看海，也能享用房內的蒸汽室；相仿格局的月神黛安娜，在客廳內有家庭劇院，在臥房裡也有影視設備；從後門進入美神維納斯房，陽台外是寬闊的海景，坐在床上就可以眺望日出，最令人驚艷的，則在海神波賽頓房裡，65吋的液晶電視結合環繞音響的影音享受，從陽台的樓梯往上走，還有獨享的露天泡澡池。每一口都是來自海洋的鮮美來到真情非凡的老饕都知道，一場舌尖上的盛宴即將在夜晚展開！主人聰哥仔細為你介紹在地食材與現撈漁獲，飛魚卵、吻仔魚和海菜的海鮮涼拌，清爽而帶有甜味；從在地魚市場嚴選的刺身冷盤，細心處理過的甜蝦、軟絲和少見的齒鰆魚，沾上特製沾醬，彷彿海浪在你的舌上跳舞；而以低溫蒸熟的茶碗蒸，鮮蝦、蛤蜊和花椰菜融合柴魚味道，十分美味。主菜是烤得恰到好處的紅鯸，沾些胡椒鹽或七味粉，每一口都吃得到魚肉的鮮嫩清甜，一碗肉燥飯，加上幾片主人家醃漬的蘿蔔乾，配著喝下溫熱的薑絲魚湯，餐後的甜點則是淋上椰漿紫米粥及白葡萄酒。
stays.descriptionEn: Yilan｜Sealuv HomestayThe Delightful Taste of The Deep Blue SeaComing out the other side of the Hsuehshan Tunnel, the world seems to become brighter the further you move away from Taipei city! On your way to the Wushi Marina, you roll down the window and look out to your right at the ocean. Amid the row of ocean-view guesthouses along Waiao Beach, you see a sign which reads “Enjoy Blue Paradise” on a wave-shaped white wall. Here in Toucheng Township of Yilan County, you’re always very close to the ocean!Make a beeline for the beach with the seawater and the sunshineEntering Sealuv Homestay from the back door, to one side, you notice a professional kitchen the likes of which is rarely seen in ordinary guesthouses. Not only is there a central food counter, they have a hotel restaurant grade oven and stainless steel freezer room. The spacious dining hall is painted white and blue in Greek style, and, overlooking Waiao Beach through the front doors, is filled with the sound of the waves breaking on the sand. Removing your shoes and walking upstairs, the guest rooms all bear the names of oceanside cities. The Greek Mykonos and Aegina rooms both employ a loft design, with comfortable sofas indoors and lounge chairs on the balcony for you to recline upon. The French Marseille and Balinese Kuta rooms employ a European South seas style decor to provide visitors with a peaceful vacation time.In contrast to this, the other Sealuv edifice employs a medieval Greek style. The Sun God Apollo room on the first floor has a wading pool from which you can admire the ocean. Indoors, you can enjoy the comfort of the steam room. Similar in layout, the Moon Goddess Diana room has a home theatre system in the living room, as well as a television in the bedroom. Entering the Goddess of Beauty Venus room from the back door, you can enjoy the expansive seaview from the balcony, and delight in watching the sunrise from the comfort of your bed. Yet the most breathtaking scene must surely be on the 65-inch liquid crystal display with full surround sound audio system furnishing the God of the Sea Poseidon room. From the balcony, take the staircase upwards and discover your own private outdoor pool.Every delicious mouthful is fresh from the seaAs every gourmand who travels to Sealuv Homestay surely knows, after night falls, you are in for a flavorful feast! Your host Brother Cong introduces each local ingredient and freshly caught seafood delicacy in detail. Flying fish caviar, whitebait, and seaweed prepared cold with special dressing taste sweet and refreshing. Then comes a plate of carefully selected sashimi from the local fish market, meticulously prepared sweet shrimp, neritic squid and the rare mackerel bonito served with special sauce gives the sensation that the ocean waves are dancing on your tongue. Gently steamed bowls of chawan mushi (savoury egg custard) with fresh prawns, clams, and broccoli harmonize perfectly with the delicious flavor of katsuobushi (dried skipjack tuna flakes). The main course is perfectly broiled red blowfish with a sprinkle of salt and pepper or shichimi spicing. Each bite of fish is bursting with zesty sweetness. Served with a bowl of stewed pork over rice and homemade daikon pickle, washed down with a bowl of warm ginger fish broth, and followed by a dessert consisting of coconut cream purple rice congee and a glass of white wine.Not only do you get to enjoy an evening banquet, you can savor a European style breakfast in the morning sunshine. A delicious breakfast embraced by the sea breeze provides the perfect start to a beautiful day. Your cordial host, Brother Cong, happily suggests a travel itinerary for you: the Lanyang Museum, followed by Toucheng old street and the paragliding base. And don’t forget the privately owned local restaurants.Enjoy a beautiful place to liveWhen Brother Cong was young, he left Yilan and moved to Sanchong in New Taipei City. Yet he always maintained an indescribable affinity for the Toucheng area and, at that time, he made a promise to his young self that he would one day return. In the year that the SARS epidemic broke out, the industry that Brother Cong worked in underwent massive changes. He suddenly found himself following a course which he had not planned but which somehow seemed perfectly arranged. Sometime before, he had seized the chance when housing prices were low to buy a house in Yilan in order to give his frequently ill son more opportunities to be close to nature. It suddenly occurred to Brother Cong that it would be best to return to Yilan and try his hand at opening a guesthouse. “First the guests benefit, then the locality benefits, and only afterwards do you yourself benefit.” According to Brother Cong, Sealuv Homestay isn’t just a guesthouse, it’s a place to appreciate life. From the very beginning, he went against local custom, constructing the main entrance facing the beach while the back door faced out onto the street. He was even ridiculed by his neighbors for this decision. Yet he was determined to place prime importance on the living environment and integrate it all with a gourmet restaurant. “Many people see operating a guesthouse as a part time business, a side job. In fact this is a kind of specialized occupation, in which there is much professional knowledge.” By nature, Brother Cong is very particular about the details. It was this character which allowed him to realize the vacation space of his dreams. He hopes that when you arrive, you’ll encounter Sealuv Homestay’s unique brand of happiness.

stays.description: 「宜蘭頭城民宿‧艷陽天」位於宜蘭頭城鎮，距離蘭陽博物館僅需2分鐘，頭城火車站僅需3分鐘；鄰近烏石港、伯朗咖啡館、頭城海水浴場、草嶺古道、頭城老街、頭城農場、北關螃蟹博物館、石盤寮瀑布和蜜月灣等熱門景點，旅人們可盡情徜徉海天一色的海岸風光，也可深入山林，欣賞景緻優美的山巒綠意。 「宜蘭頭城民宿‧艷陽天」提供雙人及四人房型，客房空間簡單、明亮、潔淨，以寬敞的空間格局搭配新穎的裝潢設計，融和可愛的小物造景，展現平實家居的溫馨與典雅氣息。房間內提供wifi無線上網、寬頻有線上網(需自備電腦、網路線)、液晶電視、有線電視、吹風機，歡迎您前來沉澱心靈、靜心休息。

stays.name: 藍海天晴民宿
stays.nameEn: Blue Sea Sunny Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: 位於宜蘭縣頭城鎮的「藍海天晴」，是一間融合自然風光與人文情懷的溫馨民宿。坐擁山海交會的絕美景致，緊鄰蘭陽博物館及烏石港，距離頭城老街僅數分鐘車程，是您放慢步調、享受寧靜假期的理想之地。特色：絕佳位置： 鄰近海邊，座落蘭陽博物館旁，可遠眺龜山島日出，步行即可到達烏石港品嚐在地海鮮。自然融合設計： 簡潔打造溫潤空間，落地窗讓陽光與海風自由流動。親切款待： 主人熱情好客，提供在地旅遊建議與精美早餐及香醇咖啡，讓旅人感受如家般的溫暖。多元房型選擇： 雙人浪漫海景房、四人溫馨家庭房，皆配備獨立衛浴、空調與免費Wi-Fi。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Toucheng Township, Yilan County, "Blue Sea and Sunny B&B" is a cozy B&B that blends natural beauty with a touch of human touch. Boasting stunning views where the mountains meet the sea, it& #39;s close to the Lanyang Museum and Wushi Harbor, and just a few minutes& #39; drive from Toucheng Old Street, making it the ideal place to slow down and enjoy a peaceful getaway.Features:Excellent Location: Located near the sea, next to the Lanyang Museum, you can gaze at the sunrise over Guishan Island, and within walking distance to Wushi Harbor for local seafood.Natural Blend Design: Simple yet warm design creates a cozy space, with floor-to-ceiling windows letting in sunlight and sea breezes.Warm Hospitality: The hosts are warm and welcoming, offering local travel tips, delicious breakfasts, and delicious coffee, making guests feel right at home.Various Room Options: Romantic ocean view rooms for two and cozy family rooms for four, all equipped with private bathrooms, air conditioning, and free Wi-Fi.

stays.description: 民宿以綠建概念設計，與周圍環境協調，整體造型宛似一隻大蜻蜓，故以名「蜻蜓石」，除建築特色外，周邊花園亦以生態經營為主，遍植蝴蝶食草及蜜源植物，每當春夏，吸引眾多蝴蝶棲息。另外一闢建生態池，除了營造蜻蜓點水之意境外，亦作為水生植物及動物之家。這是一處以生態為主體的休閒好去處。
stays.descriptionEn: Stonbo Lodge is built with green building concept design, harmonized with the surrounding environment. The overall shape resembles a large dragonfly, hence the name "Stonbo Lodge." Besides the architectural features, the surrounding gardens are also mainly eco-managed and are planted with butterfly herbivorous and nectar plants to become the habitat of many butterflies attracted in the spring and summer. Another ecological pond was built to serve as the house for aquatic plants and animals, in addition to creating the mood of dragonflies touching the water lightly. This is a fine place for leisure with an ecological theme.

stays.description: 『雪佛蘭之家』座落於國道五號、北宜公路與濱海公路的交會點，是前往礁溪的第一家民宿，交通網絡四通八達，也是通往冬山河、武荖坑、蘭陽博物館與烏石港的樞紐。遊客從雪山隧道出口後，下頭城礁溪交流道即可到達。「雪」山隧道、「佛」光大學、「蘭」陽平原在「家」全都可以看見，故命名為『雪佛蘭之家』站在屋前遠眺我們的精神堡壘龜山島，彷彿告訴旅客，快樂遊、平安「歸」建築物本身是RC結構的新建樓房，內部設備新穎，每個房間都有個別主題，歡迎蒞臨參觀。住芬蘭住荷蘭，不如住宜蘭，因為宜蘭"勁"好玩。
stays.descriptionEn: "Chevland B&B" is located beside the intersection of the National Highway No. 5, Taipei-Yilan Highway, and Coastal Highway. It is the first B&B you encounter on the way to Jiaoxio, where has a transportation network in all directions, and it is also a hub to connect to the Dong Shan River, Wu-lao Mountain Stream, Lanyang Museum, and Wushih Harbor. Visitors coming from the Hsuehshan Tunnel, take exit ramp to Jiaoxi, Toucheng, then you can reach Chevland." Hsuehshan Tunnel, "Fo Guang University," and "Lanyang Plain," staying at "home" you can see all of them; therefore their initials consist of the name "Chevland B&B." Standing in front of the house, look far into the distance at our spiritual fortress Guishan Island, which has the initial "gui" as if to tell visitors to have a happy journey, and a peaceful "return." The building itself is an newly built RC structure, new interior equipment, and each room has an individual theme, welcome to visit. Living in Finland or in the Netherlands, it is better to live Yilan, because Yilan has "powerful" fun.

stays.description: 雲心海係前宜蘭縣副縣長、頭城鎮長夫婦親自經營道地的合法民宿，榮獲交通部觀光局「好客民宿」、天下雜誌「微笑台灣」聯盟民宿暨環保署「綠傳唱計畫」環保民宿，位居東北角海岸國家風景區的海灣裡，充滿著海洋氣息的浩瀚格局，溫馨十足住宿環境，富有鄉下人的憨厚熱情，有家的感覺，免費代客烹調大溪漁港生猛海鮮，豐盛的地瓜粥，吻仔魚，櫻花蝦、鴨賞等十道養身早餐，讓您賓至如歸，流連忘返。旅人的心靈故鄉-宜蘭:旅途中最有家感覺-雲心海，依山傍海，看海景、吹海風、呷海鮮，蘭陽八景之首龜山朝日，浩瀚太平洋，神秘龜山島，點點漁舟近映眼簾，大溪漁港嚐鮮、蜜月灣、港澳沙灘親水衝浪、龜山島與賞鯨、北關海潮公園、大里海蝕平台、草嶺古道與芒花節、桃源谷、鷹石尖尋幽攬勝、草嶺隧道自行車悠遊、外澳飛行傘翱翔、蘭陽博物館、河東堂獅子博物館、螃蟹博物館、藏酒莊、烏石港風帆、頭城老街與搶孤、金車城堡咖啡.福隆沙雕與海洋音樂季別俱風格，且皆於5-20分鐘車程可到達，一趟蘭陽之旅絕對夠震撼。
stays.descriptionEn: Ocean Deep Bed and Breakfast is an authentic legally-certified establishment personally operated by the former deputy head of Yilan (as well as head of Toucheng Township) and his wife. It was designated as a Hospitable Bed and Breakfast by the Tourism Bureau, part of the Smile Taiwan Alliance of Bed and Breakfasts by Commonwealth Magazine, and Environmental Bed and Breakfast of the EPA’s Green Promotion Program. Located on the bay of the Northeast Coast National Scenic Area, it features a vast layout with a marine atmosphere and an extremely warm and accommodating living environment, with down-to-Earth countryside friendliness and a feeling of home. We offer free cooking service for fresh seafood from Daxi Fishing Harbor, which includes 10 highly nutritious breakfasts such as sweet potato porridge, bula fish, sakura shrimp, and sugarcane-smoked duck, making guests feel at home and creating unforgettable memories. Yilan – a spiritual home for travelers; Ocean Deep Bed and Breakfast – a place that feels most like home during the journey. Unique attractions and activities within a 5-20 minute drive include the mountains, ocean, seeing the ocean scenery, feeling the ocean breeze, trying out seafood, dawn at Guishan Island (Yilan’s top natural site), the vast Pacific Ocean, mysterious Guishan Island, the sight of fishing boats dotting the ocean, fresh fish from Daxi Fishing Harbor, Honeymoon Bay, Gang’ao Beach surfing, Guishan Island and whale-watching, Beiguan Tidal Park, Dali Marine Erosion Platform, Caoling Historic Trail and Restharrow Flower Season, Taoyuan Valley, exploration of Yingshijian, bike riding at the Old Caoling Tunnel, Wai’ao paragliding, Lanyang Museum, Lion’s Kingdom Museum, Crab Museum, Wine Village, Wushigang sailboating, Toucheng Old Street and Qiang Gu (pole climbing festival), Mr. Brown Coffee Castle, Fulong Sand Sculptures, and the Beach Music Festival. A trip to Lanyang is guaranteed to be exciting.

stays.descriptionEn: 7 of the world 10 Most Expensive Homes were built on the beach in places such as Hawaii and Miami Beach. Although Sealuv Homestay is not a mansion, it features Wai’ao Beach on the Pacific Ocean, with activities including playing in the waves, surfing, or paragliding, in addition to the Guishan sunrise, Yilan’s most beautiful scenic sight. Everyone should experience Greek romance at least once in their lives, and Sealuv’s blue and white atmosphere will give you a taste of Mediterranean romance and leisure without leaving Taiwan. The seafood from Guishan Island provides an excellent and satisfying addition to your trip. Forget about price and experience value; time should be wasted on things of beauty. The owner, a Virgo, and his wife, a Taurus, anticipate your arrival! Your perfect vacation begins here!

stays.name: 頭城休閒旅館
stays.description: 頭城休閒農場，創設於民國68年，在尊重自然、生態環境之前提下，利用農業生產、自然生態、及農村文化等資源，提供國內外遊客休閒遊憩、及對農業及農村之親身體驗。頭城休閒農場深耕國內外市場，致力成為國內外休閒農業之標竿農場，讓國內外顧客能藉著來訪農場，進而持續不斷地看見與發現農業對生命與生活的新價值。 農場全體同仁延續創辦人「卓陳明女士」，過去身為教育家的精神，及其企業經營的理念：健康、快樂、體驗、學習，不斷地創新，將農場各項資源轉換為各種不同有趣的學習活動，使農場能提供更多國內外遊客來體驗大自然與農村文化，並將農業資源在永續與友善土地的條件下盡情發揮與利用，以達友善環境、健康農業，循環使用資源，永續地球之目標。
stays.descriptionEn: Dreaming of life on the Farm? Many people may fantasize about living in the country, but only a very few ever get around to living the pastoral life a reality.Chuo Chen Ming had her epiphany 30 years ago on the eve of her 40th birthday. “If I don’t begin working on my dreams while my mind and body are at their peak,” she thought, “when am I going to do it?” Soon after, she was crossing hill and dale with a real estate agent haunting for the perfect place. When she found it at the mountains of Kengfeng village at Toucheng Township, Yilan County, she spent all of the more than NT$5 million she had earned from her garment factory and teaching, to buy it. Thus begun what was to become the legendary story of the farming Grandma. “Look, children!” exclaims Chuo Chen Ming, “That’s our national bird, the Formosa blue magpie. They’re very family-oriented birds. After the chicks grow up, they help their parents raise their younger siblings”. She then leans forward to make sure she doesn’t miss any of the questions coming from the large group of children before her.Her eyes and ears are surprisingly sharp in spite of her 68 years- there’s no movement in the forest that escape her notice. Visitors to the Toucheng Leisure Farm in Yilan County, all remember the grandmotherly old woman who pops up in the Farm. Always bursting with energy, she is happy to share her opinions with visitors, including her insistence that the farm grow its food organically, and prepare it in a traditional fashion. Her personality is so warm and frank that visitors almost always end up addressing as “Mama Chuo” regardless of their own age. Chuo Chen Ming was born in Chingshui Township, Taichung County, Taiwan in 1940. After graduating from The Taipei Women’s Normal College, (now the Taipei Municipal University of Education), she began working as a teacher primarily of sixth graders.

stays.name: 震點樂商務汽車旅館
stays.description: 震點樂商務汽車旅舘建築設計概念，建構出品味獨特、高尚素雅、時尚自然空間之美學，營造浪漫渡假情境來建造；迴異於一般汽車旅館以花俏、主題風之設計。本館Logo設計特色，想營造一種陽光、熱情、明亮及安全，讓所有旅人到訪時得以愉悅放鬆及安心。震點樂時尚旅店自然美學概念從車庫開始蔓延；車庫、房間均引自然光入內，SPA水柱浴池、七彩氣泡床按摩浴缸、還有維淇浴、蒸氣室、迷你點心BAR、商務洽談區及免費Wifi上網…等兼具私密和多元的貼心設施。
stays.descriptionEn: Gshock-Motel's design concept was based on the typical business motel architecture, and created a motel with unique, simple but classy environment. Different from typical motel's fancy theme, Gshock-Motel created romantic vacation themes. In addition, our unique sun-logo is intended to evoke a sunny, passionate, bright and safe atmosphere, so all of our guests will be happy, relaxed and safe when they stay with us. GShock-Motel's modern natural aesthetic concept begins from the garage and extends to the guestrooms. There are many individual and shared facilities and services, including spa bath, colorful bubble bed, jacuzzi, Vichy bath, steam room, mini bar, business area and free Wifi connection.

stays.name: 屏東の家
stays.description: 「屏東的家」不只是個給孩子返家休息的站，也是給退休者怡然自在生活的家。在這裡、您可以充分的放鬆──早晨在雞鳴中品嘗民宿主人準備的鄉間佳餚，午前能在迴廊靜靜品茗和享用陽光，午後則可騎乘自行車、體驗南部田野風景，晚上亦可迎著微風、在蟲鳴星光下聊天休憩…另外，因為民宿主人的興趣使然，有時候餐桌上會出現不同的時令鮮蔬，而品茗時的小點心也會不一樣喔！除了民宿本身能讓您放鬆慢活外，我們附近還有「六堆客家文化園區」、「原住民族文化園區」體驗不同的民俗風情，亦有「單車國道」、「涼山遊憩區」、「屏東科技大學」等當地特點好好遊玩。希望您和您的家人，能夠在「屏東的家」體驗我們既愉快又恬靜的生活。

stays.description: 2024 從．心．出．發今年10月HomeOne36 回來了正式進駐屏東勝利星村本棟歷史建築佔地百坪一次僅接待一組旅人室內活動空間三十坪全棟採開放式空間設計在日式房舍既有框架內我們加入了更多可能性融合現代無印、極簡、侘寂、綠植等自然、舒適氛圍捨棄快速、便利裝修方式堅持一點一滴親自手作完成而床頭的百年的檜木是我們對這棟歷史建築的致敬空間配有一廳一衛及陽光日式湯屋在客廳與難得相聚的家人好友席地而坐疲憊時在綠植環繞的湯屋中沐浴風呂一切是如此簡單而美好沿著戶外廊道逐步而下斑駁矮牆下是一片偌大的草坪盡情享受陽光與微風間的光影對話午后時光在躺椅上品嚐一杯咖啡身在都市中仍能體驗大自然的慢活身心皆舒暢了起來全．心．的 HomeOne36在老宅新作中開啟每日的儀式感秉持「愛」與「夢想」的初衷用．心．賦予老宅新的生命力希望持續傳遞「家的幸福感」獻給喜愛老屋顏的朋友們希望你們喜歡 HomeOne36 J.

It's close to the beautiful Sogo Department Store on Zhongshan Road, and the famous Pingtung Night Market. We continue to provide excellent servcie and aim to create a trendy and fashionable haven in the beautiful Sogo Department Store area.

stays.description: 鑽石商旅-在地經營已超過二十年，座落於屏東火車站前，步行約五分鐘，本飯店內部軟硬體設施設備持續不斷精進更新，不論硬體設備或服務品質，始終以追求最高的客戶滿意度，本飯店備有雙人、三人、四人套房，並以最經濟實惠的價位最優質的服務作為經營的目標。隨著網路時代的來臨，全館架設免費Wi-Fi及寬頻網路、提昇員工素質，以客為尊的服務態度與親切誠懇的問候，滿足您住宿、觀光等需求。鑽石商旅-專為商務、觀光旅客服務，可謂屏東市商旅模範生。除了靠近屏東火車站的地理優勢外，近年受惠於屏東火車站周邊交通整頓，鐵路地下化，改善迅速發展、鑽石商旅-對外交通更為便利，我們將更用心，在觀光商務旅遊業界，提供更出色的服務，我們將秉持南台灣熱情、重禮、好客的傳統歡迎您的蒞臨。鑽石商旅自1989年創業，起初只是單純以經營一家小旅館的心態而努力，歷經時空轉換、緩慢踏實地成長，我們的志向逐漸萌芽，現在以穩定拓店為目標，期望能在全國各大城市服務需要我們的顧客。琢磨幾行短短文字，背後卻是歷經了漫長二十餘年。回頭看著一路走來的痕跡，鑽石商旅曾歷經許多困難與挑戰，經營理念也並非創業之初就如此完整，而是經由不斷在錯誤中修正、反省，才在今日小有成果。二十多年的日常例行工作中，鑽石商旅曾因無法達到顧客滿意而遭到批評，也曾因用心服務顧客而受到鼓勵與支持。鑽石商旅歷練了台灣服務業環境長時間的變遷、也順應顧客對住宿需求的變化，調整過無數次軟、硬體細節，唯一沒有改變的，就是依然定期檢視所有顧客意見，並真誠地檢討、改善。至今擁有許多老顧客，這些就是當初給予我們最多批評及建議的人。他們陪伴、給予我們機會，讓鑽石商旅瞭解自己不夠完美，並願意等待鑽石商旅變得更好。現今的鑽石，沒有奢華誇張的裝潢、沒有高雅冷漠的姿態，所有夥伴都只專注一件事：用心聆聽顧客的聲音，以謙卑之姿。

stays.name: 崁頂家
stays.description: 崁頂家民宿,是一個利用位居屏東縣崁頂鄉田寮路，距離南二高崁頂交流道出口不遠處的一棟四樓透天公寓改建而成的民宿。居住北部的屋主原本看中其地理位置接近高速公路，開車交通便利，又有著鄉間田野風光，且客廳為少見挑高設計的四樓透天公寓，因此買下，預備退休之後能學陶淵明「採菊東籬下，悠然見南山」。並委請在新北市復興美工任教的史志宏老師南下設計、裝潢施工。史老師經過多次南北往返，感覺這樣的條件，應該要讓多一些人來共享，遂建議改為民宿經營；屋主正好也有此意；於是民宿之方向確立。 在施工時，史老師儘量保持老房子的格局，但前方房間苦無衛浴可用，置於房內頗犧牲空間，正巧房屋座向，窗外可見夕陽餘暉，於是將陽台改建為玻璃屋衛浴，讓居住者可以直接從房內欣賞美麗的夕陽。又因房子原本化糞池在後方，管道無法穿越，於是開挖前院地底為化糞池，而外露之管道，則以法國龐畢度藝術中心的藍綠色彩為參考上漆，營造後現代工業風格；室內的設計更巧妙融入超現實、新古典與中式風格，希望客人來居住時，能同時感受，且認識不同時期風格的藝術氣氛。 崁頂家民宿因為地處淳樸鄉間，白天舉目望去，四周盡是田園風光。晚上夜闌人靜 時，安靜又祥和，對於長久在都市化社會，車馬喧囂環境生活的人而言，相信可以在此，找到鄉間休閒慢活、舒暢與寧靜的心靈療癒感覺。

stays.name: Hana花宿民宿
stays.description: Hana花宿位於船帆石沙灘附近，舒適慵懶的巴峇島風客房擁有看山海之上的遼闊天空，讓您能拋開平日煩惱和瑣事。房源：．Free WIFI．房間內專屬有線電視、冰箱、衛浴設備交通：．公車站牌（中船帆石站）步行約3分鐘；約5分鐘車程方可抵達墾丁大街。．距離船帆石沙灘約200公尺，步行約4分鐘，就在大馬路對面，即使全身濕透黏沙，也很方便回本館沖洗。．便利商店 步行約5-7分鐘方可抵達。．如需租借電瓶車或機車，花媽會帶您前往出租店。．如開車前往，我們有專屬免費停車場。注意事項：．本館內無電梯，各樓層以樓梯相接，請勿在樓梯上跑跳。．如需加人請於訂房時告知（需另收費），加床為單人鋪地式的薄墊（非床墊）、枕頭、棉被、盥洗用品
stays.descriptionEn: Welcome to Hana B&B ~Away from the crowd ~When you come to stay with us at Kenting, Sail Rock Bay, we can arrange you the pleasure and convenience of taking a ride in the private shuttle bus or Limousine service for your transfers, with drop off and pick up at Zuoying High Speed Rail Station or at Kaohsiung Railway Station.We provide a choice of comfortable suites to provide you with the right amount of pampered care you'll find in only the best accommodations. With standard amenities like airconditioning, cable TV, Queen-sized/Double bed, Private toilet and bath/shower, and a mini refrigerator, you'll have all the comforts of home at your disposal. Here at Hana B&B, we let you enjoy this beautiful Sail Rock Bay by taking you far from the crowd upon your arrival and departure.Get away from it all while living in the lap of luxury right here at Hana Inn. Feel free to surf through our facebook address and find out about our Hana B&B's features and amenities. We guarantee it'll be worth the time.

stays.name: 丁香雅築民宿
stays.description: 旅宿簡介：丁香雅築位於恆春鎮西區德和里，是一處佔地寬廣（1400坪）可以腑瞰恆春盆地優美風景的庭園民宿。園內遍栽花、樹、草皮，一年四季各式花朵輪流開放。園中主建築丁香雅築，經重新整哩，以大片花崗石板為牆，單面透光九分落地景觀窗，三面圍繞南方松木地板迴廊，流露出人文與自然、建築與美學結合的特殊風格。民宿可以提供套房(雙人、四人)及家庭包棟不同住宿需求組合。客餐廚設備完善，室內裝潢家具以詩肯柚木為主，並附卡拉ok，戶外烤肉爐，是讓大家輕鬆休憩的好空間，也是很理想的旅遊住宿選擇。雙人套房2000~3000；四人套房3000~40008人包棟價格8000~1100012人包棟價格11000~15000
