stays.name: 三富大酒店
stays.description: Just a Daydream in FFF三富大酒店座落在台灣最南方的山、城、海之中，是一間結合住宿、音樂展演與美食佳餚的設計旅館； 「富」，是由宀及畐組成，宀代表居住的房子，畐則代表盛裝飲食的容器，兩者的結合，則象徵安居於室，豐於飲饌，是一種由內而外的豐盛與滿足。 透過現代而明亮的建築設計手法，大量方塊、灰與白堆疊而成形象鮮明的建築外觀，與恆春特有的藍天白雲景色相互呼應；建築內部空間則巧妙運用光影的穿梭交錯，讓在此停留的旅人們可以細細品嚐每時、每刻的變化萬千。 來到三富，不僅僅是提供您一晚美好的住宿體驗，它更是一個文化載體，一個人、事、物三者之間互相交流的場域；有點酷、有點好玩、有點新奇，是我們期望帶給您的感受。 在這裡，希望您可以同時體驗到新與舊、時髦與老派、創新與復古之間的美妙衝擊與兼容並蓄。 "每一個角落都是風景、每一個角落都是新的邂逅" 最好的時光，都在三富大酒店。
stays.descriptionEn: Just a Daydream in FFFFFFHotel is situated in Hengchun, 500 metres from Hengchun Old Town South Gate, and features a restaurant. Popular points of interest around the property include Hengchun Old Town West Gate and Hengchun Old Town East Gate. Kenting Forest Recreation Area is 9 km from the property.Hengchun is an old town with endless sunshine and magnificent mother nature is always the best place for tourists and travelers to visit. FFF hotel located between the southernmost mountains, city and ocean provides guests a cozy place to stay, music events to join, irregular exhibitions and finger-licking snack bar.The vivid appearance presents the bright and modern architectural technique by stacking cubes colored with grey and white, consisting of blue sky and white clouds of Hengchun. As for internal space, the criss-cross light changes by time and designed layout for guests to savor in every unique moment.When you come to FFF hotel, it is not only a wonderful staying experience, but a culture carrier is a place where people, events and substance interact. We hope you can find something cool, something fun and something interesting. Besides, we would like to invite everyone to gently soak in the contrast of now and past, fashion and old-school, novelty and retro.Every corner is a piece of view, a brand-new encounter.FFF hotel welcomes you with providing the most memorable times.

stays.name: 上仁民宿
stays.description: 位於恆春鎮省北路二段93號，居往墾丁、恆春之主道﹝屏鵝公路--台26號省道20公里處﹞旁，鄰近海生館、南灣、後灣、恆春老街及海角七號場景等各景點，只約五分鐘車程，到墾丁大街亦僅需約十分鐘的車程。到恆春、車城、四重溪都很方便喔！為2006年2月22日新開幕的全新建築，硬體設施首重安全性及健康，整體樸實清爽，空間陳設亦經過主人精心巧思，佈置得雅緻而溫馨，是到墾丁旅遊渡假最佳住宿點。偌大的別墅型房屋，有專屬的停車場。廣大的庭院不僅適合家族聚會，更適合團體出遊辦活動喔。另代辦水、陸上之活動及遊艇船票等服務。主人是恆春在地人—小楊哥，以服務墾丁青年活動中心19年經驗，個性好客熱誠及對經營民宿有著濃厚的興趣，希望有朋來分享果園收成之喜悅，而致力創造兼具教育啟發與休閒活動的純樸田園民宿。綠意平凡簡樸而慢活之樂趣，追風逐浪戲水、陽光夕陽觀星放空之情境，完成小人物真善美浪漫的故事。
stays.descriptionEn: Located at No. 93, Section 2, Shengbei Road, Hengchun Township, next to the 20 km mark on Pinge Highway (Provincial Highway No. 26, going toward Hengchun and Kenting), Shangren Bed and Breakfast is a short 5 minute drive from attractions such as the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium, Nanwan, Houwan, Hengchun Old Street, and scene of the film “Cape No. 7,” a 10 minute drive from Kenting Main Street, and conveniently close to Hengchun, Checheng, and Sichong Stream. In preparation for the grand opening on February 22, 2006, the hardware facilities of the all-new building emphasized security and health, with an overall simple and refreshing style. The space was carefully planned by the owner, who decorated it with elegance and comfort, making this Kenting’s best vacation spot. The large villa-style rooms have their own parking spaces, and the expansive courtyard is suitable for family gatherings as well as group activities. We also organize water and land activities and can purchase boat tickets for guests. Xiaoyang, the owner, is a local with 19 years of experience at the Kenting Youth Activity Center. With a friendly, hospitable personality and strong interest in bed and breakfast management, he hopes to share with others the joy of fruit garden harvests, and has worked hard to create a pure countryside bed and breakfast combining educational value and recreational activities. The charm of greenery, simplicity, and leisure, enjoying the wind and ocean, sunlight and sunsets and stars, a place to daydream; all of these complete the perfect romantic story of the common person.

stays.description: 訂房專線:08-8862993二手，代表不是新的，是 有些時間、有些磨損、有些記憶.......二手，是兩隻手，是情人、是夫妻、是親人、是朋友，是一種情感，是一種信賴。在我們的心底，總希望躲在某個年紀...二手童話，一座充滿故事的城堡，充滿奇幻與幽默，你就是故事的主角。為了讓不想長大的大人，和不是小孩的小孩，都能感受到不同的驚喜，於是創造了這座城堡，從建築外觀、公共空間到主題房間，在每個角落裡，都隱藏著許多故事，墾丁--二手童話，等待著你來發現。
stays.descriptionEn: Room reservation line: 08-8862993 Fax: 08-8861665 “Ershou” means second-hand, or not new, and some times, some trials, some memories… it also means “two hands,” the hands of lovers, couples, family members, and friends; a kind of feeling, or trust. Inside, we wish we were always a certain age… Our Fairyland is a castle full of stories, fantasy, and humor, where you are the main character. We built this castle to bring new surprises for adults who don’t want to grow up and children who aren’t little kids anymore. From the outside of the building and common areas to themed rooms, every corner is filled with stories. Kenting – Our Fairyland is awaiting your discovery.

stays.name: 亞維儂民宿
stays.description: 獲多家報章雜誌推薦墾丁亞維儂渡假莊園，是全新打造法式鄉村風莊園民宿，取名為亞維儂是因為民宿主人，崇尚自然，喜歡這個位於南法，每年七月以舉辦全世界最大戲劇節聞名的美麗小古城，結合當地美景及文化珍寶；以及亞維儂人天性喜愛陽光，隨處尋找歡樂，顯得如此熱情洋溢，是令人旅遊懷念的勝地。 亞維儂外有廣大庭園，四季花卉、生態池、涼亭、烤肉區、兒童遊戲區，內有精緻用心的裝潢，全新衛浴一流享受，處處令人驚艷，是旅遊達人絕佳新選擇。電話:08-8880231住址:屏東縣恆春鎮大埔路50號官網:http://www.avignon.com.tw
stays.descriptionEn: Avignon Bed and Breakfast, recommended by numerous newspapers and magazines, is an all-new French countryside-style villa bed and breakfast. The owner, a nature lover, named it after the beautiful old town in southern France that is home to the world’s largest drama festival, combining local scenery and cultural treasures, each year in July. The residents of Avignon love sunshine and are always searching for entertainment, and the friendly atmosphere makes it a memorable travel destination. Avignon features an outdoor courtyard with flowers of all seasons, an ecological pond, a pavilion, a BBQ area, and a children’s play area. The building features thoughtful, exquisite decoration, all-new bathing facilities providing top-class enjoyment, and other surprises in every corner, making this an excellent choice for expert travelers. Telephone: 08-8880231 Address: No. 50, Dapu Road, Hengchun Township, Pingtung County Website: http://www.avignon.com.tw

stays.name: 八八景觀民宿
stays.description: 給你一點空白，讓風和山陪你慢慢填。 在恆春的邊邊，有一個小地方。 山景很滿，空氣很輕，時間像是被悄悄放慢。 你可以什麼都不做，就坐著發呆、看雲走路、讓心靜一靜。 這裡不追行程、不趕進度，連風都慢慢吹。 八八沒什麼厲害的宣傳語， 只有一個地方，剛好讓人想待久一點。
stays.descriptionEn: Give you a little blank space, and let the wind and mountains help you fill it up slowly. There is a small place on the edge of Hengchun. The mountain scenery is full, the air is light, and time seems to be quietly slowed down. You can do nothing, just sit and daydream, watch the clouds move, and calm your mind. There is no need to rush the schedule or hurry the progress here, even the wind blows slowly. Baba doesn’t have any impressive slogans, it’s just a place that makes people want to stay longer.

stays.name: 凱撒大飯店
stays.description: 墾丁凱撒大飯店座落於恆春半島，緊鄰墾丁國家公園，憑藉得天獨厚的地理位置與豐富的自然生態環境，致力呈獻國際級的頂級度假體驗。飯店提供多元戶外活動體驗，無論是動感刺激的水上冒險、親子同樂的生態探索，或是兩人世界的浪漫時光，皆能在此尋得熱情、歡樂且永恆的回憶。自2007年起，墾丁凱撒大飯店持續榮膺「世界頂級島嶼飯店聯盟」（Exclusive Island Hotels & Resorts, EIHR）會員殊榮，成為台灣極具代表性的度假飯店。EIHR源自法國，以「美麗島嶼」、「頂級享受」、「貼心款待」為圭臬，匯聚全球最精緻島嶼度假酒店，包括杜拜帆船飯店、峇里島寶格麗度假酒店皆為其成員。能於眾多頂級飯店中脫穎而出，持續獲得EIHR肯定，不僅彰顯墾丁凱撒的卓越服務與頂級品質，更是對飯店的最高榮譽。
stays.descriptionEn: Caesar Park Hotel Kenting is situated on the Hengchun Peninsula, adjacent to Kenting National Park. With its prime location and rich natural ecosystem, the hotel is dedicated to providing a world-class luxury resort experience. Guests can enjoy a variety of outdoor activities, from exhilarating water adventures and family-friendly ecological explorations to romantic moments for couples, creating passionate, joyful, and unforgettable memories.Since 2007, Caesar Park Hotel Kenting has been honored as a member of the Exclusive Island Hotels & Resorts (EIHR), solidifying its reputation as one of Taiwan’s most iconic resort destinations. Founded in France, EIHR is committed to the principles of "Beautiful Islands," "Luxury Experience," and "Thoughtful Hospitality." The alliance brings together the world’s finest island resorts, including the Burj Al Arab in Dubai and the Bulgari Resort Bali. Being continuously recognized by EIHR among many prestigious hotels highlights Caesar Park Kenting’s exceptional service and top-tier quality, making it a true honor for the hotel.

images.description: 花園客房，一進房，印入眼簾的是以牡丹花為形象的特色主題牆面，結合復古窗花檯燈、跳色的絨布單人座椅到舒適的雙人沙發，這些簡單而經典的巧思，強化出整體空間的視覺感，隱身在樹林花叢間，客房均伸延至私人專屬户外花園，在花園裡您可以放心在有屋簷遮蔽的Jacuzzi按摩浴池泡澡、或在躺椅享受悠閒的日光浴，盡享用陽光綠意築起美好的愜意生活！

stays.name: 初見恆美
stays.description: 初見恆美坐落於恆春鎮外的寧靜田園裡，千坪庭園中矗立的當代度假風格建築。邂逅的第一眼就喜歡上這裡的盎然綠意，又寧靜寬闊的慢活環境。老闆本身就從事建築設計，八棟不同風格主題的優質休閒空間，全出自於他獨特的設計理念。細心的規劃與格局安排，讓賓客們入住後，就想在裏頭好好窩著犯懶，巴不得乾脆就住在這裡不走了。每棟Villa坪數室內約70坪，室外則約有80坪左右，共分為二人、四人與六人入住的渡假Villa房型。每棟Villa都設有私人泳池、造景庭院、寬敞室內客廳與親子遊戲區。二樓有挑高天花板的樓中樓格局設計，大面落地窗景，讓陽光照耀屋內，舒適而毫無壓迫感。每棟Villa不同風格的傢俱選擇與擺設，也呈現出每種主題設計的不同個性與質感。客房裡的裝飾均以簡約清爽為主，陽台外的遠眺美景更讓人只想待著放空，望著遼闊舒坦的遠山綠意，讓自己的身心靈全然舒放，重新開機。

stays.searchText: 初見恆美 初見恆美 屏東縣民宿787號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 三溝路麥火田巷72號 初見恆美坐落於恆春鎮外的寧靜田園裡，千坪庭園中矗立的當代度假風格建築。邂逅的第一眼就喜歡上這裡的盎然綠意，又寧靜寬闊的慢活環境。老闆本身就從事建築設計，八棟不同風格主題的優質休閒空間，全出自於他獨特的設計理念。細心的規劃與格局安排，讓賓客們入住後，就想在裏頭好好窩著犯懶，巴不得乾脆就住在這裡不走了。每棟Villa坪數室內約70坪，室外則約有80坪左右，共分為二人、四人與六人入住的渡假Villa房型。每棟Villa都設有私人泳池、造景庭院、寬敞室內客廳與親子遊戲區。二樓有挑高天花板的樓中樓格局設計，大面落地窗景，讓陽光照耀屋內，舒適而毫無壓迫感。每棟Villa不同風格的傢俱選擇與擺設，也呈現出每種主題設計的不同個性與質感。客房裡的裝飾均以簡約清爽為主，陽台外的遠眺美景更讓人只想待著放空，望著遼闊舒坦的遠山綠意，讓自己的身心靈全然舒放，重新開機。

stays.name: 半島旅宿民宿
stays.description: 在恆春半島的南端， 風比城市自由，時間走得比較慢。 我們選擇在這裡開一間民宿， 不是為了追求熱鬧， 也不是為了讓旅人成為娛樂的過客， 而是想讓一個空間， 成為一段旅程中最溫柔的停留。 ⸻ 現在的旅遊， 常常變成一場設備的競賽。 KTV、戲水池、電動麻將桌—— 好像少了什麼就不叫「好民宿」。 但我們相信， 真正打動人的， 不是這些設施， 而是一扇窗外的光， 一陣午後吹進來的海風， 一次與自己安靜相處的夜晚。 ⸻ 我們想讓你來到這裡， 不是為了什麼必拍打卡點， 而是為了重新感覺—— 陽光、風、樹影、街角的狗、 廟埕的香火味、早餐店奶茶的甜。 ⸻ 在這裡， 你不需要排滿行程。 走出去就是山與海， 待在屋裡也很安心。 你可以看書、發呆、寫字、 烘一壺茶，或者什麼都不做。 ⸻ 我們相信—— • 旅行不是逃避生活，而是與生活更靠近 • 恆春的美，不需要包裝，也能留下來 • 民宿不是商品，而是一種生活的邀請 • 越簡單，越真實；越慢，越深刻 ⸻ 這就是半島旅宿 一間不追求浮誇、只想讓你安靜下來的地方。 歡迎你來，聽風，聽自己
stays.descriptionEn: At the southern tip of Hengchun Peninsula, The wind is freer than in the city, and time goes slower. We chose to open a B&B here. It's not for the pursuit of excitement. Nor is it to make travelers just passers-by for entertainment, I want to make a space. Become the most gentle stop in a journey. ⸻ Today’s tourism, It often turns into a race for equipment. KTV, swimming pool, electric mahjong table—— It seems that if something is missing, it can’t be called a “good B&B”. But we believe that Really touching, Not these facilities, But the light from a window, A gust of sea breeze blew in in the afternoon. A quiet night to be alone. ⸻ We want you to come here. It's not for some reason to hit the checkpoint. But to feel again— Sunshine, wind, tree shadows, dogs on the street corners, The smell of incense in the temple and the sweetness of milk tea in the breakfast shop. ⸻ Here, You don’t need to fill your schedule. Go out to the mountains and the sea. It's also safe to stay indoors. You can read, daydream, write, Bake a pot of tea, or do nothing. ⸻ We believe that • Traveling is not about escaping from life, but getting closer to life • The beauty of Hengchun does not need to be packaged, it can be preserved • B&B is not a commodity, but an invitation to life • The simpler, the more real; the slower, the more profound ⸻ This is Peninsula Hotel A place that does not pursue exaggeration and just wants you to be quiet. Welcome to listen to the wind and yourself

stays.description: 屏東縣民宿1130號--墾丁南島假期旅宿坐落於恆春鎮郊仁壽里，距離知名景點--鹿境僅需3分鐘，到鎮中心麥當勞、星巴克僅需5分鐘，到海生館或墾丁大街僅需 15分鐘，周邊綠意盎然，無吵雜喧囂的環境。館內設有電梯到達各樓層，方便人員 行李進出。一樓室外有採光遮蔽休憩空間，炎炎夏日有兒童最愛的戲水池，大型烤肉架可舉辦烤肉、餐聚活動。一樓室內寬敞的大廳可容納多人，設有卡拉OK，盡情歡唱不用搶；70吋Netflix數位電視，可收看雲端影片，讓您追劇不間斷；喜愛摸兩圈的朋友，我們還幫你準備了電動麻將桌，讓您完全放鬆，省去洗牌疊牌的麻煩。餐廳內有吧檯及中島台，冰溫熱飲水機、電磁爐、瓦斯爐、冰箱，還有乾淨的碗 筷 盤餐具，都提供您使用。房間分雙人、四人房，每間房內衛浴全部採用乾濕分離，保持盥洗的乾舒適；飯店等級床墊、枕頭、羽絨被，以及天天更換的舒適床巾備品，讓您睡得安心舒服，客房間間都有落地窗及陽台，採光明亮，陽台外景色明朗，夜晚可以到陽台吹吹南島清涼微風，觀賞南島星空。
stays.descriptionEn: Pingtung County B&B No. 1130 -- Kenting South Island Holiday Hotel is located in Renshouli, a suburb of Hengchun Town, only 3 minutes away from the well-known scenic spot -- Lujing, and only 5 minutes away from McDonald's and Starbucks in the town center/b19> minutes, only 15 minutes to Haisheng Museum or Kenting Street, surrounded by greenery, no noisy and noisy environment. There is an elevator to reach each floor in the museum, which is convenient for personnel to enter and exit with luggage. On the first floor, there is a natural sheltered rest space outside, a children's favorite paddling pool in the hot summer, and a large barbecue grill can be used to hold barbecue and dinner activities.The spacious indoor hall on the first floor can accommodate many people, with karaoke, so you can sing and enjoy without grabbing; /b12>70-inch Netflix digital TV with cloud movies, allowing you to watch dramas without interruption; For those who like to touch two circles, we have also prepared an electric mahjong table for you, so that you can completely relax and save the trouble of shuffling and stacking cards. The restaurant has a bar counter and island counter, ice and water dispenser, induction cooker, gas stove, refrigerator, and clean dishes, chopsticks, plates and cutlery. The rooms are divided into double and quadruple rooms, and the bathrooms in each room are all separated from dry and wet to keep the washing dry and comfortable; Hotel-grade mattresses, pillows, duvets, and comfortable bed towels that change every day allow you to sleep comfortably, and the guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and balconies, with bright lighting, and the scenery outside the balcony is bright, and you can go to the balcony at night to blow the cool breeze of the South Island and watch the starry sky of the South Island.

stays.descriptionEn: Located in the surfing paradise of Kenting, Southern Sun Homestay North features modern yet cozy rooms with free WiFi and full length windows. The property has a garden and provides free private parking.Southern Sun Homestay North is a 3-minute drive to the beach and a 4-minute drive to Kenting National Park. Each room comes with a balcony and wooden flooring. A flat-screen cable TV and desk are included. Private bathroom has a stone bathtub, shower, hairdryer and free toiletries.A 5-minute drive away is a 24-hour convenience store and the Kenting Night Market, which offers a variety of seafood and snacks.

stays.name: 卡瓦那庭園民宿
stays.description: 2016，為了一同完成姊姊藍帶甜點藍圖創業了珊珊來食。離開了生活十多年的美國回到台灣，一個有家，有家人的地方。2017，並開始建造我夢想中關於家的美好模樣。 旅行了許多地方，始終對山與海的闊然，宇宙自然間的流動著迷。卡瓦那佇立於一大片的綠之中，在這裡，能享受日出與日落，收藏光影的變化 ; 在這裡，能盡情奔跑或臥躺，擁抱草地的悠閒 ; 在這裡，能觸碰月影與繁星，捕捉星空的追逐。卡瓦那每一天似乎都在自然間遊戲被大地的清新且溫柔養著。在起居中，不去設限任何的風格與走向，因為在這片自然中，我們只要以最坦然的態度存在著即可。簡單卻不失舒適的設備，讓前來的客人感受寫意與放鬆，僅需把所有精神留著享受這片不同於城市，美麗且細膩的恆春墾丁大地，包括打上腳踝的浪花與撫過臉頰的微風。如果恰好偷得閒暇，不妨到恆春墾丁來，讓自己與自然對話，緩慢的放鬆自我與澄淨心靈，回到單純的快樂。

stays.name: 厝旅店
stays.description: 「厝旅店」位於南灣海灘正對面，南灣是墾丁最受歡迎的遊憩沙灘之一，這裡的沙子比較細，沙灘較長且坡度平緩，相當適合玩水，這裡提供了各式各樣的水上活動，包含衝浪、帆船、香蕉船、水上摩托車……等設施，既刺激又好玩，海灘上許多陽光的衝浪男孩和比基尼女孩也是南灣的一大風景，無論四季，你永遠都能在這裡找到屬於南國的熱情和活力。 南灣位置也在恆春半島的中樞點，往南至墾丁大街，往北到恆春鎮老街或者往東南可到後壁湖漁港這些景點都差不多的車程喔。
stays.descriptionEn: "Cuo Hotel" is located directly opposite Nanwan Beach. Nanwan is one of the most popular recreational beaches in Kenting. The sand here is relatively fine, the beach is long and the slope is gentle, and it is quite suitable for playing in the water. There are a variety of Water sports, including surfing, sailing, banana boats, jet skis... and other facilities, are both exciting and fun. Many sunny surfers and bikini girls on the beach are also a major scenery in South Bay. No matter the season, you can always be in Find the enthusiasm and vitality that belongs to the southern country here. The location of Nanwan is also the central point of Hengchun Peninsula. Go south to Kenting Street, go north to Hengchun Old Street or go southeast to Houbihu Fishing Port.

stays.name: 原宿民宿
stays.description: 屏東縣恆春鎮 船帆石一個勇敢做夢實踐夢想的旅人愛上了南境的海與陽光，決定在充滿熱情的國境之南築夢踏實~~~選定離海很近的船帆石，獨棟原始灰色建築，沒有奢華的裝潢，只有最創意的設計，一切以生活的態度為出發點，提供給您「家」的舒適感。墾丁民宿「原宿」讓你暫時放下工作壓力，忘掉城市的庸碌與煩惱，盡情享受陽光、沙灘、比基尼 ！
stays.descriptionEn: Bed and Breakfast in Pingtung CountyA brave traveler who dreams and realizes his dream falls in love with the sea and sunshine in the south, and decides to build his dream in the passionate south of the country~~~We chose Sail Rock, which is very close to the sea. It is a single original gray building with no luxurious decoration, only the most creative design. Everything is based on the attitude towards life, providing you with the comfort of "home".Kenting B&B "Harajuku" allows you to temporarily put aside the pressure of work, forget the mediocrity and troubles of the city, and enjoy the sun, beach, and bikinis!

stays.descriptionEn: Legal B&B No. 0469 located in Hengchun Town, Pingtung CountyIt's another spring stay, hidden in the alleys of the town. stays.descriptionEn: Located at Outer Ring Road (next to Ping-Er Highway) of Hengchun, facing the green grass of the plains, Kenting Holiday has easy accesses to various tourist attractions. Kenting Holiday features spacious resort suites for two persons, three persons, and four persons, respectively. Rooms are equipped with modern facilities, and the hotel offers complete leisure facilities, tourist information. Although it is not a luxury five-star hotel, we provide warm and caring services to make you feel like home. Come here--we hope you take away with you the Kenting& #39;s enthusiasm, passions as wide and deep as the ocean, and many memorable memories. We look forward to welcoming you to experience personally the Kenting journey with surprises and joys.

stays.name: 墾丁光現特色民宿
stays.nameEn: Kenting light now Featured B & B
stays.description: 位於屏東縣的民宿墾丁位於台灣最南端的ㄧ顆珍珠，閃亮亮的照耀旅人的心。「光現」屹立在墾丁後壁湖山丘，由建築大師徐純一設計的類清水模質感灰色建築展現與大自然藝術合而為一的風格。整層樓面向後壁湖海港，清晨ㄧ張開眼便迎接盈盈的墾丁藍。ㄧ望無際的天空，千變萬化的白雲，風情萬種的大海。只要輕輕的看ㄧ眼，就能卸下城市的包袱。「光現」 每個房間都面海並各有不同特色設計，從「春光」到「霞光」，經過「時光」到「大光」。旅人流連在紅磚石板溫馨家的設計，躺在柔軟舒適的大床，聆聽大海的低語，星空的擁抱，與家人朋友度過愉快美好的假期。在 「光現」 可以放鬆心情什麼都不做，慵懶的靠在躺椅看海景的變化，有時像綠寶石有時是神秘的藍。大海無聲的與旅人對話，慢慢沈澱心中的雜思。窗外樹影搖曳，半眯著眼聆聽海風的低語。 墾丁藍溫柔的照亮你的心底。離 「光現」 散步可到的後壁湖秘境有綿延數公里神秘海灘。在大海旁踩著沙灘散步玩沙觀賞落日又復刻一次與家人朋友美好的回憶。「光現」願讓墾丁的陽光大海美好你的生活！
stays.descriptionEn: Bed and Breakfast in Pingtung CountyHomestays in Pingtung CountyKenting is a pearl located at the southernmost tip of Taiwan, shining brightly in the hearts of travelers. "Light Show" stands on the hill of Houbihu in Kenting. Designed by master architect Xu Chunyi, the gray building with a texture similar to exposed concrete shows a style that is integrated with the art of nature. The entire floor faces Houbihu Harbor, and when you open your eyes in the morning, you will be greeted by the clear blue of Kenting. The boundless sky, the ever-changing white clouds, and the charming sea. Just a quick glance can unload the burden of the city."Light Shows" Each room faces the sea and has different design features, from "Spring Light" to "Sunset Light", through "Time" to "Great Light". Travelers linger in the cozy home design of red bricks and slates, lie on the soft and comfortable big bed, listen to the whispers of the sea, embrace the starry sky, and spend a happy and wonderful holiday with family and friends.At "The-light", you can relax and do nothing, just lean lazily on a lounge chair and watch the changing seascape, which is sometimes like emerald and sometimes a mysterious blue. The sea talks silently to the travelers, slowly settling the random thoughts in their hearts. The shadows of the trees are swaying outside the window, and I am half-squinting my eyes to listen to the whisper of the sea breeze. Kenting blue gently illuminates your heart.The secret area of ​​Houbihu Lake, which is within a short stroll from "The-light", has a mysterious beach that stretches for several kilometers. Walking on the beach beside the sea, playing in the sand and watching the sunset recreate the beautiful memories with family and friends."The-light" wishes to make Kenting's sunshine and sea better for your life!

stays.name: 墾丁夏都沙灘酒店
stays.description: 墾丁夏都沙灘酒店位於國境之南的熱帶度假勝地墾丁，座擁綿延2.8公里的潔淨貝殼沙灘，榮獲觀光局「五星級認證」，提供頂級的遊憩環境，帶給度假的旅客快樂美麗的回憶。墾丁夏都沙灘酒店由美麗的沙灘、熱情的陽光與蔚藍的海洋結合，與飯店鮮豔活潑的建築特色連成一氣，目前館內擁有：普羅館、馬貝雅館及波西塔諾館三館客房，依不同風情設計，共295間各式客房，其中包含1間頂級皇家套房。襯著碧海藍天、欖仁樹蔭與椰林白浪，墾丁夏都沙灘酒店處處洋溢著悠閒又熱情的浪漫風采，提供給喜歡享受陽光、沙灘、海洋氣息的度假旅人，多樣的選擇。館內擁有愛琴海西餐廳、地中海中式宴會廳與馬堤斯咖啡酒吧、臨海網路咖啡廳，備有頂級Azure SPA、海天一線游泳池、霍比式帆船與獨木舟設施，讓旅客享受身心靈的極致放鬆，體驗一般顧客無法體驗到的海上活動，是墾丁夏都沙灘酒店成為全國休閒度假飯店標竿的宗旨。夏都沙灘酒店竭誠歡迎您的到來。
stays.descriptionEn: Chateau Beach Resort is located in the tropical resort of Kenting at the southern boarder of the country and has a clean shell beach stretching 2.8 km. It is the first leisure resort hotel in Taiwan certified by SGS International Certification Services, the first leisure resort hotel to be listed, and was awarded a five-star certification by the Tourism Bureau. We offer a top-class recreational environment for vacation travelers for happy and beautiful memories. Chateau Beach Resort consists of beautiful beaches, warm sunshine, and blue ocean combined with the hotel’s bright and lively architectural features. Currently Chateau has Provence Hall, Marbella Hall, and Positano Hall designed in different styles, with a total of 293 rooms of different types, among them a Royal Suite. Chateau Beach Resort lies on the beach set against a green ocean blue sky, whitecaps, and the shade of terminalia and coconut. It is imbued with a laid-back style and passionate romance to offer holiday travelers a variety of choices to enjoy the sun, sand, and sea air. Kenting Chateau features the Aegean and Atami Restaurant, Mediterranean Banquet Hall, and Matisse Bar, Ocean View Cafe & Internet Zone, as well as the Azure Spa, Skyline Pool, and Hobie catamaran and canoe facilities, to allow visitors to enjoy the ultimate of physical and spiritual relaxation and sea activities unavailable at other hotels, which is the benchmark purpose of Chateau Beach Resort as an international leisure resort hotel. We welcome you to the Chateau Beach Resort.

stays.searchText: 墾丁夏都沙灘酒店 夏都國際開發股份有限公司屏東分公司 屏東縣旅館003號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 墾丁路451號 墾丁夏都沙灘酒店位於國境之南的熱帶度假勝地墾丁，座擁綿延2.8公里的潔淨貝殼沙灘，榮獲觀光局「五星級認證」，提供頂級的遊憩環境，帶給度假的旅客快樂美麗的回憶。墾丁夏都沙灘酒店由美麗的沙灘、熱情的陽光與蔚藍的海洋結合，與飯店鮮豔活潑的建築特色連成一氣，目前館內擁有：普羅館、馬貝雅館及波西塔諾館三館客房，依不同風情設計，共295間各式客房，其中包含1間頂級皇家套房。襯著碧海藍天、欖仁樹蔭與椰林白浪，墾丁夏都沙灘酒店處處洋溢著悠閒又熱情的浪漫風采，提供給喜歡享受陽光、沙灘、海洋氣息的度假旅人，多樣的選擇。館內擁有愛琴海西餐廳、地中海中式宴會廳與馬堤斯咖啡酒吧、臨海網路咖啡廳，備有頂級Azure SPA、海天一線游泳池、霍比式帆船與獨木舟設施，讓旅客享受身心靈的極致放鬆，體驗一般顧客無法體驗到的海上活動，是墾丁夏都沙灘酒店成為全國休閒度假飯店標竿的宗旨。夏都沙灘酒店竭誠歡迎您的到來。

stays.name: 墾丁好消息民宿
stays.description: 墾丁好消息民宿位於恆春鎮上一間頗具風格的*合法民宿*，整棟建築採挑高的設計，民宿提供給客人很舒服的一個休憩的空間。 民宿的路口可以搭乘觀光巴士，到南灣3公里，車程約5分鐘，到墾丁大街7.8公里，車程約10-15分鐘，到海生館車程也是約10-15分鐘。 恆春半島範圍很大，墾丁大街是恆春鎮的一條街道，晚上特別熱鬧，商業活動很多，但白天大部分都會到墾丁大街以外的地方玩，如白沙灣，關山，貓鼻頭，鵝鑾鼻燈塔，龍磐公園，風吹沙，佳樂水，海洋館...等等。 墾丁好消息民宿位置就在這些景點中間的位置，民宿附近有很多的景點及特色的美食，如董娘的店，巷子廚坊，恆春糜谷，車庫小廚，六吋盤早午餐，台灣第一家鹹酥雞，大排檔，八寶冰，滷味，素食麵，小杜包子，十碗麵，泰式料理，海鮮料理，越南料理，7-11便利店，全聯福利中心，都在民宿附近，步行2到10分鐘左右就可以到達的。 民宿提供無線網路，每間房間都有獨立的衛浴及分離式冷氣，液晶電視，冰箱，及盥洗用品，住宿環境非常舒適及交通便利，民宿會提供完整的導覽地圖，介紹當地好吃及好玩的資訊給需要的旅客，更是一間散佈好消息的優質民宿。 這棟民宿將留給我的好朋友們，一個可以停靠休息的地方，我們將最舒適的住宿環境，及誠懇細心的服務態度，給您一個最美好的旅程．也祝大家有一個愉快的假期！ Line:goodnews.chang 微信:goodnews-chang 電話:886 923 898526郵件:goodnews.chang@gmail.com
stays.descriptionEn: Kenting Good News B&B is a stylish *legal B&B* located in Hengchun Town. The entire building has a high-ceiling design, and the B&B provides guests with a very comfortable resting space. You can take a sightseeing bus at the intersection of the homestay, which takes about 5 minutes to get to Nanwan, 3 kilometers away, and 10-15 minutes to get to Kenting Street, 7.8 kilometers away. It also takes about 10-15 minutes to get to the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium. The Hengchun Peninsula is very large. Kenting Street is a street in Hengchun Town. It is very lively at night with a lot of commercial activities, but during the day most people go to places other than Kenting Street to play, such as Baisha Bay, Guanshan, Maobitou, Eluanbi Lighthouse, Longpan Park, Fengchuisha, Jialesui, Oceanarium... and so on. Kenting Good News B&B is located right in the middle of these attractions. There are many attractions and special foods near the B&B, such as Dong Niang's Store, Alley Kitchen, Hengchun Mi Valley, Garage Kitchen, Six-Inch Plate Brunch, Taiwan's First Fried Chicken, Food Stalls, Eight Treasure Ice, Braised Food, Vegetarian Noodles, Xiao Du Baozi, Ten Bowls of Noodles, Thai cuisine, seafood cuisine, Vietnamese cuisine, 7-11 convenience store, and PX Welfare Center, all of which are near the B&B and can be reached in about 2 to 10 minutes on foot. The B&B provides wireless internet access. Each room has a private bathroom and split-type air-conditioning, LCD TV, refrigerator, and toiletries. The accommodation environment is very comfortable and the transportation is convenient. The B&B will provide a complete guide map and introduce local delicious and fun information to tourists in need. It is also a high-quality B&B that spreads good news. This homestay will be left to my good friends, a place to stop and rest. We will provide the most comfortable accommodation environment and sincere and attentive service attitude to give you the most wonderful journey. I also wish you all a happy holiday! stays.searchText: 墾丁好消息民宿 墾丁好消息民宿 屏東縣民宿867號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 恒南路2巷11-1號 墾丁好消息民宿位於恆春鎮上一間頗具風格的*合法民宿*，整棟建築採挑高的設計，民宿提供給客人很舒服的一個休憩的空間。 民宿的路口可以搭乘觀光巴士，到南灣3公里，車程約5分鐘，到墾丁大街7.8公里，車程約10-15分鐘，到海生館車程也是約10-15分鐘。 恆春半島範圍很大，墾丁大街是恆春鎮的一條街道，晚上特別熱鬧，商業活動很多，但白天大部分都會到墾丁大街以外的地方玩，如白沙灣，關山，貓鼻頭，鵝鑾鼻燈塔，龍磐公園，風吹沙，佳樂水，海洋館...等等。 墾丁好消息民宿位置就在這些景點中間的位置，民宿附近有很多的景點及特色的美食，如董娘的店，巷子廚坊，恆春糜谷，車庫小廚，六吋盤早午餐，台灣第一家鹹酥雞，大排檔，八寶冰，滷味，素食麵，小杜包子，十碗麵，泰式料理，海鮮料理，越南料理，7-11便利店，全聯福利中心，都在民宿附近，步行2到10分鐘左右就可以到達的。 民宿提供無線網路，每間房間都有獨立的衛浴及分離式冷氣，液晶電視，冰箱，及盥洗用品，住宿環境非常舒適及交通便利，民宿會提供完整的導覽地圖，介紹當地好吃及好玩的資訊給需要的旅客，更是一間散佈好消息的優質民宿。 這棟民宿將留給我的好朋友們，一個可以停靠休息的地方，我們將最舒適的住宿環境，及誠懇細心的服務態度，給您一個最美好的旅程．也祝大家有一個愉快的假期！ Line:goodnews.chang 微信:goodnews-chang 電話:886 923 898526郵件:goodnews.chang@gmail.com

stays.description: 田園風光的地中海風情當你來到墾丁灣三館，您會發現。我們的每一個空間都充滿溫馨、每一個角落都用盡巧思, 是優質地中海特色民宿。寧靜純樸的房宿，為的是讓貴賓們可以在每次來臨時，都有遠離塵囂的體驗。這裡有廣大草原.可以看星星可以烤肉的田園風光.是享受農村.無拘無束生活的好地方讓你能夠無拘無束的享受悠閒的一日，是我們所衷心期盼、也是我們最大的目的。
stays.descriptionEn: The rural scenery with Mediterranean styleWhen you visit Kenting Bay Bed and Breakfast III, you will find out that we have made the greatest effort to present an entire different B&B for you. We are the best mediterranean-style B&B. An accommodation with a tranquil and primitive environment is ideal for the tourist who wants to leave the hustle and bustle of the city behind. Living here, you can see the starry night or have a barbecue on the grassland to enjoy the rural life. We sincerely want to bring you a leisure day without any worry.

stays.description: 得天獨厚地理位置墾丁福華位於山、海交會的墾丁國家公園內，前眺大、小尖山，後倚墾丁牧場，緊鄰小灣沙灘，獨特的紅瓦屋在碧海、藍天和綠意映照下顯得格外耀眼。舒適寬敞住宿環境飯店占地三萬坪，以歐洲莊園式建築紅瓦、白牆及塔樓等元素為設計主軸，館內設計則融合當地環境與風土特色，隨處可見台灣原住民風格木雕，戶外寬廣的綠色腹地，吸引台灣特有種鳥類-烏頭翁駐足，飯店空中花園更是賞鳥及觀星的好地方。飯店有458間各式客房，為了給遊客更好的服務品質著手進行客房改裝，墾丁福華向來就以大坪數客房深獲消費者好評，這次特別運用不同色調呈現墾丁的熱情與活力，就是要讓遊客享受寬敞舒適的全新體驗。更規劃13間充滿異國情調的Villa，有慵懶悠閒的「峇里島風」、藍白相間的「希臘風」、熱情奔放的「西班牙風」、神秘奇幻的「印度風」與恬靜悠然的「日式禪」，每間皆有乾濕分離衛浴、戶外按摩浴池、專屬花園和戲水池、專屬Check-in及Lounge Bar服務，讓旅客盡情享受無拘無束與逍遙自在的時光。 多樣美味特色料理飯店擁有3處風格獨具的餐廳：「麗香苑」以無國界美食著稱，透過蒸、煮、燒、碳烤，演繹出異國料理與B.B.Q，更有熱情洋溢的LiveBand現場演唱；「蓬萊邨」則以中華美食及地方風味料理最負盛名，善於將饒富地方特色的農漁產食材，烹調出創新菜餚，讓各地饕客品嚐恆春在地風情；「七賢吧」則是與三五好友悠閒共飲調酒飲品的好去處，各餐廳配合四季變化推出美食活動，讓饕客享受一場視覺與味覺兼具的美食饗宴。會議旅遊首選飯店墾丁福華擁有墾丁最大型可容納900多人的多功能場地及10個各型會議室，全區可免費無線上網。休閒設施有標準戶外游泳池、按摩水療池、兒童戲水池、健身房、桌/撞球區、兒童遊戲區、籃/網球場、親子育樂中心等，飯店更緊鄰墾丁唯一室內水上樂園「水世界樂園」，不論大人、小孩都可輕鬆享受悠閒渡假氛圍。

stays.description: 墾丁羊角村民宿位於墾丁國家公園大尖山旁，面對寬廣的墾丁牧場和綺麗的羊角石風景。民宿頂樓露台可欣賞360度的山景、海景風光，也是觀星的好所在。從民宿到墾丁大街，海灘戲水都在步行可達的距離。墾丁羊角村民宿建築主體採現代簡約風格; 不論是室內外建材、個人衛浴用品、或每日現做早餐的食材選擇，都是主人精心挑選，希望能提供給您最有質感的度假享受。民宿二樓有交誼空間，歡迎住客在此品嘗美食、看書發呆、或認識新朋友。民宿內設置電梯，方便您搬運行李上下樓，也提供一個無障礙空間給有需要的客人。墾丁羊角村民宿的主人，是在墾丁地區服務十餘年的退休校長。因為深受這片美麗土地及熱情的住民所吸引，所以選擇退休之後在此經營民宿，讓更多人深度認識墾丁。無論您想來此輕鬆度假、體驗魅力墾丁、或想探索活力南台灣的這些人那些事，都歡迎您來墾丁羊角村。

stays.searchText: 墾丁羊角村 墾丁羊角村 屏東縣民宿738號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 墾丁路330之22號 墾丁羊角村民宿位於墾丁國家公園大尖山旁，面對寬廣的墾丁牧場和綺麗的羊角石風景。民宿頂樓露台可欣賞360度的山景、海景風光，也是觀星的好所在。從民宿到墾丁大街，海灘戲水都在步行可達的距離。墾丁羊角村民宿建築主體採現代簡約風格; 不論是室內外建材、個人衛浴用品、或每日現做早餐的食材選擇，都是主人精心挑選，希望能提供給您最有質感的度假享受。民宿二樓有交誼空間，歡迎住客在此品嘗美食、看書發呆、或認識新朋友。民宿內設置電梯，方便您搬運行李上下樓，也提供一個無障礙空間給有需要的客人。墾丁羊角村民宿的主人，是在墾丁地區服務十餘年的退休校長。因為深受這片美麗土地及熱情的住民所吸引，所以選擇退休之後在此經營民宿，讓更多人深度認識墾丁。無論您想來此輕鬆度假、體驗魅力墾丁、或想探索活力南台灣的這些人那些事，都歡迎您來墾丁羊角村。

stays.name: 墾丁貝拉司漫民宿
stays.description: 墾丁貝拉司漫是由印尼文所音譯「稻田旁的莊園」之意，因為有機的環境造就自然生態的豐富，時而有蛙叫蟲鳴鳥啼，運氣好時在夜晚還能碰見螢火蟲到訪，透過落地窗映入眼簾的彷彿是一幅畫作，隨著四季變化的景色，也為每次的假期帶來不一樣的體驗。墾丁貝拉司漫民宿，提供一個舒適且貼近自然的度假環境，擁有獨特的地理位置，周圍被翠綠的熱帶植物環繞，為遊客提供一個寧靜且清新的氛圍。民宿設計風格融入自然元素，建築物與周遭景觀和諧融合，讓每位入住的客人都能享受放鬆身心的假期。2民宿距離墾丁大街及墾丁國家公園的各大景點都不遠，恆春古城僅2公里車程，遊客可以輕鬆前往知名的海灘、夜市及自然景觀地點，無論是白天還是夜晚，周邊的熱帶氣息都能讓人徹底放鬆。客房內部設施齊全，並且注重細節，使用現代且簡約的裝潢風格，讓人感受到溫馨且舒適的居住體驗。房間內的床鋪柔軟舒適，讓人一躺下便能輕鬆入睡，配備的衛浴設施乾淨整潔，讓遊客有家的感覺。此外，景觀雙人房設有陽台，能夠讓入住的客人隨時享受窗外的美景，感受墾丁的日落或星空。墾丁貝拉司漫民宿以其優越的環境和高品質的客房設施，成為了度假旅客的理想選擇。無論是享受大自然的美麗，還是尋找一個安靜放鬆的場所，這裡都能提供理想的住宿體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: The name Beras Manor Kenting is a transliteration inspired by the Indonesian phrase meaning “a manor by the rice fields.” Nestled in an organic environment, the property is surrounded by rich natural ecosystems—frogs croak, insects buzz, and birds sing throughout the day. With a bit of luck, guests may even encounter fireflies at night. The view through the large floor-to-ceiling windows resembles a painting, constantly changing with the seasons and offering a unique experience every visit.Beras Manor Kenting provides a comfortable and nature-connected vacation setting. Its unique geographical location, surrounded by lush tropical greenery, creates a peaceful and refreshing atmosphere for visitors. The B&B’s design incorporates natural elements, blending harmoniously with the landscape to offer guests a relaxing and rejuvenating stay.Conveniently located just a short distance from Kenting Main Street and the major attractions of Kenting National Park, the manor is only a 2-kilometer drive from the historic Hengchun Old Town. Guests can easily explore famous beaches, night markets, and scenic spots. Whether day or night, the surrounding tropical ambiance offers a complete escape from the everyday.The rooms at Beras Manor Kenting cater to a variety of needs, whether you're traveling as a couple or with family. Each room is thoughtfully designed with modern and minimalist décor, creating a warm and cozy experience. The beds are soft and comfortable, ensuring a restful night’s sleep, and the bathrooms are clean and well-equipped—making guests feel right at home. Some rooms, such as the Scenic Double Rooms, even feature private balconies where guests can enjoy the view, soak in the sunset, or gaze at the stars.With its excellent environment and high-quality facilities, Beras Manor Kenting is an ideal destination for vacationers. Whether you're here to admire the beauty of nature or to find a quiet place to unwind, this charming retreat offers the perfect stay.

stays.description: 民宿主人小尤,是在地的恆春小孩,雖然在都市讀書長大,當兵完也在都市的飯店上班,但在25歲那年,決定辭掉飯店的工作,回到家鄉經營民宿,並從新更深入的了解自己的家鄉,小尤本身也會恆春半島跟恆春古城的導覽解說,有機會來到恆春,可以聽小尤說恆春的故事,帶你們看見不一樣的墾丁
stays.descriptionEn: The owner of the B&B, Xiao You, is a local Hengchun kid. Although he grew up studying in the city and worked in a hotel in the city after serving in the military, he decided to quit his hotel job at the age of 25 and return to his hometown to run a B&B and get to know his hometown more deeply. Xiao You himself can also give a guided tour of Hengchun Peninsula and Hengchun Old Town. If you have the opportunity to come to Hengchun, you can listen to Xiao You& #39;s stories about Hengchun and take you to see a different Kenting.

stays.name: 大尖山風情會館
stays.description: 大尖山風情會館距離墾丁總站僅10分鐘步行路程，提供附免費無線網路的色彩繽紛的客房。大尖山風情會館距離最近的巴士站有10分鐘步行路程，距離鵝鑾鼻有15分鐘車程。飯店提供免費私人停車場。所有客房均配有山景私人陽台、附燒烤設施的戶外用餐區、冰箱、有線電視、辦公桌和沙發。連接浴室配有浴缸或淋浴設施。旅遊諮詢台的工作人員將很樂意協助您規劃行程並提供票務服務。房客可以免費使用自行車。為了方便客人，飯店內還配有洗衣機。附近的當地餐廳距離酒店不到10分鐘的步行路程。
stays.descriptionEn: Only a 10-minute walk from Kenting Main Station, Da Jen Shan Style Resort features colourful guest rooms with free Wi-Fi.Da Jen Shan Style Resort is a 10-minute walk from the nearest bus station and a 15-minute drive from Eluanbi. Free private parking is possible.Offering mountain views from its private balcony, all rooms come with an outdoor dining area with barbecue facilities, a fridge, a cable TV, a work desk and a sofa. The en suite bathroom has bath or shower facilities.Staff at the tour desk will be glad to help you plan your trip and provide ticketing services. Free bikes are available for use. For guests' convenience, a washing machine can be found on site.Local eateries can be reached nearby within a 10-minute walk.

stays.name: 大樹房民宿
stays.description: 大樹房民宿是屏東縣政府核准合法民宿編號第054號 ，位於往墾丁後壁湖碼頭路上，房間平價且乾淨舒適，緊鄰順順、阿利海產店更可以滿足您外出旅遊用餐之便利性。 環繞大樹房民宿的景點有貓鼻頭、後壁湖碼頭、墾丁街、南灣、關山、海生館，這些距離大樹房民宿都僅是幾分鐘的車程，可以說是一處相當便利的渡假選擇，有機會到墾丁來，歡迎近來大樹房民宿坐坐 !! 大樹房民宿的特色：*可整棟/層出租~*每間都是套房喔 *代辦＊水上/陸上活動＊租機車/包車＊烤肉＊蘭嶼船票＊海生館門票(請提前告知以利安排)*距墾丁街約10分鐘車程~ *住宿免費附贈早餐 *後院附有免費專屬停車場 *前庭烤肉區免費提供烤肉架、休閒桌椅等設施~ *緊鄰阿利海產店、順順海產店~ *合法建築、完善消防設施~平價乾淨寧靜舒適~ 就是要給您乾淨、安靜的住宿環境
stays.descriptionEn: Tree Room Bed and Breakfast is Pingtung County legally-certified Bed and Breakfast No. 54, located on the road to Houbi Lake Fishing and Yacht Port in Kenting. Rooms are affordable, clean, comfortable, and we are close to Shun Shun and Ali Seafood Restaurant, making eating convenient. Attractions in the vicinity include Maobi Tou, Houbi Lake Fishing and Yacht Port, Kenting Street, Nanwan, Guanshan, and the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium, all within a few minutes drive, making this a convenient vacation choice. If you get the opportunity to come to Kenting, please pay us a visit!

stays.description: 近幾年來，大家對於休閒旅遊的意識抬高，都希望在工作之餘，能放鬆一下自己。墾丁是一個不錯的選擇，這裡的天氣溫和，風景優美，最適合公司員工，全家大小來渡假。有山有水，任你遨遊。 天工享棧 Super Inn 主題民宿，是2018全新的民宿，可包棟，也可烤肉，我們提供專業的烤肉架，讓你們盡情BBQ。天工享棧位置在海角7號阿嘉的家附近，飲食、交通，非常便利。距離恆春老街或是假日夜市，徒步也可到達。環境鬧中取靜，距離墾丁海邊也不遠，散步閒逛恆春老街，城門古蹟也是很愜意的。 我們非常用心設計，裝潢民宿的風格，從客廳到每間房間風格都不同，讓大家能夠各取所需，入住喜歡的房型，讓每一個貴賓來到天工享棧 Super Inn 主題民宿，都能夠有一個愉快的回憶。有朋自遠方來，不亦樂乎，這是我們做民宿的初衷。

stays.searchText: 天工享棧SUPER INN主題民宿 天工享棧SUPER INN主題民宿 屏東縣民宿799號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 恆西路33巷123弄6號 近幾年來，大家對於休閒旅遊的意識抬高，都希望在工作之餘，能放鬆一下自己。墾丁是一個不錯的選擇，這裡的天氣溫和，風景優美，最適合公司員工，全家大小來渡假。有山有水，任你遨遊。 天工享棧 Super Inn 主題民宿，是2018全新的民宿，可包棟，也可烤肉，我們提供專業的烤肉架，讓你們盡情BBQ。天工享棧位置在海角7號阿嘉的家附近，飲食、交通，非常便利。距離恆春老街或是假日夜市，徒步也可到達。環境鬧中取靜，距離墾丁海邊也不遠，散步閒逛恆春老街，城門古蹟也是很愜意的。 我們非常用心設計，裝潢民宿的風格，從客廳到每間房間風格都不同，讓大家能夠各取所需，入住喜歡的房型，讓每一個貴賓來到天工享棧 Super Inn 主題民宿，都能夠有一個愉快的回憶。有朋自遠方來，不亦樂乎，這是我們做民宿的初衷。

stays.descriptionEn: 4 Sisters Villa is 2.7 km from Fongchueisha, while Eluanbi Lighthouse is 5 km away. The famous Kenting Main Street can be reached in a 3-minute drive or a 30-minute walk from the property. Car hire and bicycle rental are possible based on request. Our rooms have been designed to guarantee the best comfort to our guests. Devised for relaxation, business, and leisure trips. 4 Sisters Villa offers interiors that masterfully combine luxury and comfort.Each elegant room features air conditioning, wardrobe, flat-screen TV with cable channels, refrigerator and electric kettle. The private bathroom comes with bath or shower facilities, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Certain room types have a private balcony with sea views.Outdoor furniture and a library are provided for all staying guests. The property staff are glad to assist guests with luggage storage and provide touring information. 4 Sisters Villa has an in-house restaurant serving tasty gourmets, local foods and fresh fruits.

stays.name: 寧靜海渡假旅店
stays.description: 「墾丁寧靜海渡假旅館」位於墾丁國家公園內面海區墾丁大灣路上，是一棟擁有海景的全新渡假旅館，前面是知名的墾丁大灣海灘，位處中間地帶視野瞭闊、景觀優美。設備完善，設有可容納8人搭乘的電梯設備、採用高效能中央空調冷氣全天供應、採用高效能環保低污染熱水系統全天供應、各樓設有RO殺菌飲水機及負離子殺菌空氣清淨機、完備的消防設施、洗衣房(免費)、公共淋浴間、室外聊天區、水幕牆噴泉造景賞魚區、頂樓觀海台(欣賞海岸及日落景觀絕佳)及免費停車場等；客房空間寬敞、裝潢豪華、採用高級床組(大號床、乳膠枕頭、羽絨被)、中央空調式冷氣設備、電冰箱、LED平面電視、全頻道有線電視、房內設有兩組免費有線寬頻網路及全館區可免費接收wifi無線上網、免費提供高級衛浴日用品等；浴室空間寬敞有單人浴缸、乾濕分離淋浴間可任選、檯面式洗臉台，海景房衛浴皆設有雙人按摩浴缸。距墾丁大街步行約兩分鐘，鬧中取靜，地點適中，方便逛街、用餐、購物。融合汽車旅館的設計概念，豪華、寬敞、精緻、悠閒，擁有精心設計的各式套房，不論是單身或結伴自助旅行、情侶渡假、家庭旅遊或公司團體旅遊皆符合您的需求，物超所值。提供您24小時旅遊諮詢及行程安排最優質、貼心的服務、最安全舒適的住宿環境，讓您享受一趟最美好、愉快的墾丁之旅。期待「墾丁寧靜海渡假旅館」是您來墾丁渡假最佳的選擇，誠摯歡迎您的光臨!

stays.name: 小丑魚度假村
stays.description: 墾丁小丑魚渡假村，位置處於恆春鎮龍水里，本里即有一處天然湧泉至今仍然泉湧不斷，因此造就出頗負盛名的龍水有機米，遊客到此一遊充分展現放鬆的渡假氣氛。晚上也可以觀星非常寧靜，山林美景也值您慢慢的欣賞。且鄰近龍鑾潭可觀察許多雁鴨與水鳥，而鄰近的景點有關山夕照、後壁湖漁港、海生館、白沙灣、貓鼻頭等……傍晚時分您也可以沿著西海岸線的小漁村及沙灘可嬉水，是墾丁地區鬧中取靜的渡假最佳之選。墾丁是個好美好美的地方，春天不只是吶喊的季節，一草一木都散發著海浪帶來的悸動；夏天不只是艷陽的熱情，更是青春的奔放；秋天不再只是落葉的蕭瑟，落日的餘暉更令人神往；冬天的季風吹亂了髮梢，卻在風中隱約嗅到洋蔥味。小丑魚度假村要讓悸動、奔放融合了落日餘暉及隱約的洋蔥味，要把墾丁的美在您的記憶中留下永恆。全【新】的設備，貼【心】的服務，是我們能給您的，竭誠歡迎您來品味墾丁，也來小丑魚度假村享受我們的用心。

stays.name: 小徑民宿
stays.description: 建築外觀具有繽紛色彩南歐地中海風格的面海城堡別墅，居高臨下的地理位置，擁有海天一色的蔚藍海岸全景。恆春半島東岸美麗的海岸線與墾丁國家公園地標大尖山、鵝鑾鼻燈塔及西岸的遊艇港區的美麗風光盡收眼底。主體建物外觀顏色乃以墾丁的自然特色陽光與沙灘、藍天和白雲為主軸，將最能代表墾丁陽光普照的顏色黃色搭配藍、白、綠、粉紅的繽紛色彩運用在主體建築物上。建築內部以樸質的色系與材質為基調，利用特殊設計表現油漆色彩的斑斕與剝落，並廣泛運用木質、布料家飾以營造懷舊放鬆的居家情境，再透過民宿主人旅行時購買收藏的繪畫、工藝品等陳設，點綴精緻細膩的人文風景。民宿擁有美麗的海景庭園，適合舉辦浪漫的海邊婚禮、歡樂的BBQ 主題派對及文藝展演活動。每間客房從空間的規劃、傢俱的製作設計、客房色彩的運用、燈飾的配置與裝飾皆出自民宿主人的構思，民宿主人希望將旅居歐洲的生活美學融入到每間客房內，讓每間客房都是獨一無二具有生命而且會呼吸的房間。希望在與家人與朋友共度的美好時光中，能享受悠閒解放的舒坦，並綻放生活中的熱情，醞釀更多的美好。民宿每間客房都擁有獨立的全海景陽(露)台，部分客房擁有面海浴缸，可觀賞美麗的海景、日出及月光海。客房空間為講究生活的舒適性，空間盡量維持明亮開闊。戶外陽光充足，除透過窗戶引光借景，內部選用的配色大多以暖色調呼應，以表現愜意氛圍，像粉橘、粉藍、粉黃、藍綠及米色，除了塗刷油漆，也選用仿舊花磚營造斑駁、遍佈顆粒的視覺切面，以豐富視覺感受。客房傢具藉由木質線條與造型，勾勒優雅且內蘊的生活質地，在舒適愜意中保留原味感動的生活價值。
stays.descriptionEn: Place de L is located at a high place and has a panoramic view of the coastline on the East Bank of Hengchun Peninsula, the landmark of Kenting National Park, Dajianshan, Erluanbi Lighthouse and the yacht port on the West Bank.Each guest room has its own seaview balcony or terrace. Some guest rooms have seaview bathtubs to enjoy the fine view of sunrise and moonlight sea. The Place de L has a beautiful seaview garden, which is suitable for holding romantic seaside wedding, joyful BBQ and art exhibition activities.Places of interest nearby*Houbihu Harbor 300 mHoubihu Beach 750 mLungluan Lake 1.5 kmSouth Bay 2.4 kmMaobitou Park 2.5 kmGuanshan sunset 3 kmBaisha beach 4.1 kmKenting Night Market 6 kmTransport Information*From Kaohsiung International Airport / THSR Zuoying StationPublic shuttle 120 minsPrivate shuttle 90 mins*Pre-payment pick-up/drop-off service is available, but reservation is required in advance.

stays.searchText: 小徑民宿 小徑民宿 屏東縣民宿871號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 大光路76之8號 建築外觀具有繽紛色彩南歐地中海風格的面海城堡別墅，居高臨下的地理位置，擁有海天一色的蔚藍海岸全景。恆春半島東岸美麗的海岸線與墾丁國家公園地標大尖山、鵝鑾鼻燈塔及西岸的遊艇港區的美麗風光盡收眼底。主體建物外觀顏色乃以墾丁的自然特色陽光與沙灘、藍天和白雲為主軸，將最能代表墾丁陽光普照的顏色黃色搭配藍、白、綠、粉紅的繽紛色彩運用在主體建築物上。建築內部以樸質的色系與材質為基調，利用特殊設計表現油漆色彩的斑斕與剝落，並廣泛運用木質、布料家飾以營造懷舊放鬆的居家情境，再透過民宿主人旅行時購買收藏的繪畫、工藝品等陳設，點綴精緻細膩的人文風景。民宿擁有美麗的海景庭園，適合舉辦浪漫的海邊婚禮、歡樂的BBQ 主題派對及文藝展演活動。每間客房從空間的規劃、傢俱的製作設計、客房色彩的運用、燈飾的配置與裝飾皆出自民宿主人的構思，民宿主人希望將旅居歐洲的生活美學融入到每間客房內，讓每間客房都是獨一無二具有生命而且會呼吸的房間。希望在與家人與朋友共度的美好時光中，能享受悠閒解放的舒坦，並綻放生活中的熱情，醞釀更多的美好。民宿每間客房都擁有獨立的全海景陽(露)台，部分客房擁有面海浴缸，可觀賞美麗的海景、日出及月光海。客房空間為講究生活的舒適性，空間盡量維持明亮開闊。戶外陽光充足，除透過窗戶引光借景，內部選用的配色大多以暖色調呼應，以表現愜意氛圍，像粉橘、粉藍、粉黃、藍綠及米色，除了塗刷油漆，也選用仿舊花磚營造斑駁、遍佈顆粒的視覺切面，以豐富視覺感受。客房傢具藉由木質線條與造型，勾勒優雅且內蘊的生活質地，在舒適愜意中保留原味感動的生活價值。

stays.description: 位於屏東縣恆春鎮的民宿，截然不同的一種氛圍，一種質感，一種舒適，一種放鬆~ 就在 山岳Mountains Inn，位於恆春鎮北門古城牆邊，環境鬧中取靜，飲食、交通停車極為便利。從事飯店旅遊業的主人，親手改建私宅融入自己的風格，運用了各種原木及日式風格設計的旅遊住宿品味，屋內的每一個小細節，都可以感受到民宿主人對DIY、木作及設計的堅持與熱情。前庭有個泥作拓印小庭園， 晚上大廳搖身一變山岳小酒吧，三五好友同坐在一起小酌聊天放鬆的空間歡度夜晚愉悅的時光，山景景觀客房設計大片窗台眺望遼闊的恆春山景與北門古城牆綠意盎然美不勝收，令人享受渡假放鬆的愉悅假期～

stays.description: 墾丁嵐海灣旅店是位於南灣面海區，旅店的外觀用色活潑，非常顯眼，一樓空間舒適，讓您入住旅店可以好好的放鬆一下，房間整體以現代風格為主，部份的客房有乾溼分離的超大衛浴也是設計的重點。海景房皆有陽台，讓你在房內也能享有海景的景觀，旅店有提供旅遊、交通服務諮詢，在頂樓也非常貼心替大家準備一個欣賞美麗的南灣海景大露台，晚上在頂樓聊天看星空也很浪漫哦~

stays.name: 嶼海民宿
stays.description: 我們位在交通超便利的恆春鎮上，傳達一個真正民宿的概念，提供簡單乾淨的房間與舒適的公共空間，​讓你享受舒服自在的南國日常。一樓大廳屬於旅人的共享空間，大空間的視聽投影區、愜意高腳吧檯區，還有咖啡調飲及女主人手做點心可以享用，我們喜歡在這裡與每個新朋友老朋友小酌閒話家常。兩位主人都是熱愛海洋的潛水教練，主要提供水肺潛水的各項服務，我歡迎來到恆春的朋友，除了享受南國風情，也跟我們一起探索比陸地還精彩的水下世界！小叮嚀：訂房前請詳讀旅宿須知，訂房即代表完全同意規定。​

stays.name: 希望民宿
stays.description: #希望民宿 位於屏東縣的民宿，到恆春鎮只要5分鐘，大隱於市，可看見恆春鎮夜景，遠離塵囂，更可享受田野寧靜，偶而也可以看到螢火蟲呢？距離南灣、白沙、紅柴坑、萬里桐、後壁湖玩水、墾丁逛街，也都相當方便。希望民宿 附近有恆春老街、海角七號景點、古蹟城門、恆春美食（綠豆饌、鹹粿、鴨肉冬粉、小杜包子、南方水餃 ）...等等，走路就到浚火鍋海鮮餐廳，坐在陽台還可以欣賞到龍鑾潭 台電發電風車、恆春鎮的全景、恆春日出、關山夕陽、赤牛嶺、更可以賞鳥及田野間的稻穗，全都一覽無遺。 不論是吃的美食、玩水或享受悠閒時光，放鬆一下身心的疲憊，都是唯一選擇***希望民宿***。
stays.descriptionEn: The bed and breakfast is located in Pingtung County, only 5 minutes away from Hengchun Town. It is hidden away from the city and you can see the night view of Hengchun Town. Away from the hustle and bustle, you can enjoy the tranquility of the fields and occasionally see fireflies? It is also very convenient to go to Nanwan, Baisha, Hongchaikeng, Wanlitong, Houbihu for water play and Kenting for shopping. Hope B&B is near Hengchun Old Street, Cape No. 7 Scenic Spot, the historic city gate, Hengchun delicacies (green bean dishes, salty rice cakes, duck vermicelli, Xiaodu buns, southern dumplings)... etc. It is within walking distance to Jun Hotpot Seafood Restaurant. Sitting on the balcony, you can enjoy the panoramic view of Longluantan, Taipower power plant windmills, Hengchun Town, Hengchun sunrise, Guanshan sunset, Chiniu Ridge, and you can also watch birds and rice ears in the fields. All are in full view. Whether you want to eat delicious food, play in the water or enjoy a leisurely time to relax your body and mind, ***Hope B&B*** is the only choice.

stays.name: 微光海岸民宿
stays.description: 姊妹沙灘別墅位於國家公園海景第一排.坐山觀海, 平均溫23度的海洋氣候，臨台灣海峽，太平洋，巴士海峽，三個海流交繪，堪稱人類生活的天堂。自然、藝術、品味的休閒美學就典藏在姊妹沙灘別墅。別墅分別由(早安領事館、魯賓遜漂流館、遠離非洲館、微光海岸館)組成
stays.descriptionEn: 4 Sisters Villa is 2.7 km from Fongchueisha, while Eluanbi Lighthouse is 5 km away. The famous Kenting Main Street can be reached in a 3-minute drive or a 30-minute walk from the property. Car hire and bicycle rental are possible based on request. Our rooms have been designed to guarantee the best comfort to our guests. Devised for relaxation, business, and leisure trips. 4 Sisters Villa offers interiors that masterfully combine luxury and comfort.Each elegant room features air conditioning, wardrobe, flat-screen TV with cable channels, refrigerator and electric kettle. The private bathroom comes with bath or shower facilities, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Certain room types have a private balcony with sea views.Outdoor furniture and a library are provided for all staying guests. The property staff are glad to assist guests with luggage storage and provide touring information. 4 Sisters Villa has an in-house restaurant serving tasty gourmets, local foods and fresh fruits.

stays.name: 恰好民宿
stays.description: 恰好民宿恰好民宿，恰恰好遇見剛好的快樂！一進來就被庭園的鳥語花香包圍，綠意滿滿，天空藍得剛剛好，山景遠得剛剛好，心情也放鬆得剛剛好～? 小孩最愛的戶外泳池，玩水放電沒煩惱！? 大人可以開心唱K、摸兩圈麻將、或一起烤肉大快朵頤。情侶甜蜜、小家庭溫馨、朋友熱鬧聚會，甚至整棟包下來，都是超棒選擇！? 每間房間都是實牆格局＋對外窗，隱私與景色兼具，乾淨舒適不馬虎。加上免費停車位，完全不用煩惱交通。? 想逛街？騎車6分鐘就到熱鬧的週日恆春夜市！白天享受寧靜，晚上轉換熱鬧模式，一次滿足。來到 恰好民宿，剛剛好，才最好！
stays.descriptionEn: JUST RIGHT INNJust Right Guesthouse — Happily Encountering the Perfect Kind of Joy!The moment you step in, you’re surrounded by the gentle songs of birds and the fragrance of flowers. Lush greenery fills the garden, the sky is perfectly blue, and the distant mountains are just the right distance away — everything feels wonderfully balanced and relaxing. ?☀️? Kids will love the outdoor swimming pool — endless fun and energy!? Adults can enjoy karaoke, play a few rounds of mahjong, or fire up the barbecue for a hearty feast. Whether you’re a couple seeking a sweet getaway, a family looking for warmth, or friends gathering for laughter — even renting the entire house — it’s all a fantastic choice!? Each room features solid walls and exterior windows, offering both privacy and beautiful views. Clean, cozy, and thoughtfully designed — plus free parking, so you won’t have to worry about transportation.? Want to shop or explore? It’s only a 6-minute scooter ride to the lively Hengchun Sunday Night Market! Enjoy peaceful mornings and vibrant nights — the best of both worlds.Come to Just Right Guesthouse, where everything feels just right — because that’s what makes it perfect!

stays.description: 位於屏東縣的民宿戀南灣‧愛墾丁 「墾丁包棟民宿‧戀南灣」鄰近墾丁南灣，前往南灣海灘暢玩沁涼海水僅須一分鐘的車程距離，您隨時都可以徜徉於墾丁專屬的樂活意境。民宿鄰近墾丁主要大道－台26線，前往關山日落、鵝鑾鼻燈塔、船帆石、墾丁大街、白沙灣也都相當方便。 「墾丁包棟民宿‧戀南灣」以包棟出租方式為主，灰色系的建築外觀簡易平實，一樓設有小巧精緻的前庭、寬敞的公用大廳及簡易中島型廚房，各項家用設備應有盡有，讓旅人感受彷彿回到自家般的方便自在。民宿頂樓設有可供觀星的玻璃屋，旅人們僅需坐在室內即可輕鬆享受抬頭仰望星空的浪漫。臥房空間則以明亮的空間照明及清新典雅的溫馨氣息恭迎旅人的來臨，希望讓每位來訪的旅人都能在這裡獲得最深層的舒適放鬆。 倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【0912-992809】墾丁包棟民宿‧戀南灣。
stays.descriptionEn: Love Nanwan‧Love Kenting "Kenting Private Bed and Breakfast‧Love Nanwan" is close to Kenting Nanwan. It is only a minute's drive from Nanwan Beach to enjoy the cool water. You can wander in Kenting's exclusive happy mood at any time. The B&B is close to Kenting's main highway - Provincial Route 26. It is also very convenient to go to Guanshan Sunset, Eluanbi Lighthouse, Chuanfan Rock, Kenting Main Street and Baisha Bay. "Kenting Private B&B‧Liannanwan" mainly rents private rooms. The gray building has a simple and plain appearance. The first floor is equipped with a small and exquisite vestibule, a spacious common hall and a simple island-shaped kitchen. All household equipment is available, allowing travelers to feel as convenient and comfortable as returning to their own home. There is a glass house on the top floor of the B&B for stargazing. Travelers can simply sit indoors and enjoy the romance of looking up at the stars. The bedroom space welcomes travelers with bright space lighting, various warm room types that can accommodate multiple people, and a fresh, elegant and warm atmosphere. We hope that every visiting traveler can find the deepest comfort and relaxation here. If you have any questions about your trip or itinerary, please call [0912-992809] Kenting Private B&B‧Liannanwan directly.

stays.name: 托斯卡尼莊園
stays.nameEn: Tuo Si Ka Ni Tese Homestay
stays.description: 或許妳從未發現女詩人梅耶斯的著作《托斯卡尼艷陽下》《托斯卡尼豔陽下》， 將托斯卡尼用一點一點想像的文字拼湊成圖像，彷彿用磚瓦在墾丁裡拼湊一個渾然天成的墾丁托斯卡尼…走進托斯卡尼，會不經意被一抹色澤醇厚的瓦頂石宅吸引，向後徐徐舒展的是萬化多變的綠坡層疊，隨著坡巒的脈動，佇立在房間內向外推開墨磚色的窗檯，旋即展開一場充滿豔陽卻也涼爽的旅程…在這，您可以在隨手的手札記下各種花草的名字、描素墾丁山巒的輪廓、紀錄自己走過的沙灘心情或是各式風格民宿的剪影素描，都將成為您在扥斯卡尼生活的起居記憶，迎接隨時隨地的驚喜… 在這裡，您是女主人…
stays.descriptionEn: Maybe you’ve never heard of “Under the Tuscan Sun,” by the poet Mayes. The work assembles an image through the use of words of imagination, just like we built an all-natural resort in Kenting, brick by brick. Here, you’ll be unconsciously drawn in by our tile-roofed stone building, with a diverse, changing green slope stretching into the background. Feel the pulse of the hill, stand in the room, and push out the ink brick-colored window ledge, commencing a journey of brilliant sunlight and cool shade. Here, in your personal notebook, you can record the names of different flowers and plants, sketch the outline of the Kenting Mountains, put down your feelings as you strolled the beach, or attach snippets of different-styled bed and breakfasts, all of which can be a memory of your life in Tuscany, ready to embrace new surprises. Here, you are the owner…

stays.name: 拉芙樂兒旅宿
stays.description: La Fleur B&B 拉芙樂兒 拉芙樂兒旅宿餐酒館位於台灣最端的屏東縣恆春鎮,在交通便利中,僅幾分鐘車程,皆可到達 所有知名景點,如墾丁國家公園和南灣最美的沙灘海景以及鎮內據有歷史性的城門等等. 無論是開車或交通車皆可方便到達本店.(僅2分鐘恆春工商公車站牌的路程) 拉芙樂兒旅宿餐酒館是傳統與歐式香村風格,設計以石板磚和原木結合.一樓餐廳將提供地中海的餐食以及披薩的美食. 我們有自在舒適的雙人大床和家庭房,以及奢華的別墅SPA房型 每一間房型皆有獨特設計和風格 這都是出自真心的拉芙樂兒旅宿餐酒館的歐式哲學觀來款待我的佳賓 負責人Cindy 沈
stays.descriptionEn: La Fleur B&B La Fleur is located in the south of Hengchun, only minutes away from all the popular spots in and around Kenting National Park and Hengchun Old Town, plus not to forget, the pristine sand beaches of South Bay [Nan Wan] & Shrimps Bay [Bai Xia], which are rated as belonging to the top 10 in Asia La Fleur is easy to reach by Car or Public Transportation [ 2min.walk from Hengchun Vacational High School Bus stop] La Fleur has a traditional & rustic European outside design featuring wood and stone materials. In the 1st floor will be located a Mediterranean & Pizza Restaurant. [coming soon] There are comfortable & cozy Double Rooms, Family Rooms and the Villa with Spa on the roof available. Each room has his unique design and features. It is the Philosophy of La Fleur introduce a real feeling of European Hospitality to our clientele Cindy Shen / Owner

stays.name: 新芽民宿
stays.description: 陽光‧沙灘‧無盡的大海‧恆春我來了～！屏東縣恆春鎮是國內旅遊勝地，一年四季皆有不同的面貌，不論是春天的微風、夏天的豔陽亦或是秋天的涼爽、冬天的浪漫都令人心醉於此，而「墾丁新芽民宿2館 - 輕工業」便座落在這國境之南，周邊鄰近恆春出火、阿嘉的家、漂浮城牆及南灣遊憩區等景點，距離墾丁大街也僅短短車程便可到達，便捷的交通加上美麗的景緻是來到恆春的住宿首選。旅宿業自114年1月1日起不主動提供旅宿一次用備品墾丁新芽民宿2館-輕工業「墾丁新芽民宿2館 - 輕工業」以繽紛色彩妝點外觀，熱情活潑地歡迎旅人到來，進入大廳後又是別有一番風情，帶著工業風的裝潢有著紐約時尚氣息；民宿提供5間雙人套房，房間延續著大廳的風格，並巧妙地運用家飾增添溫馨氛圍，主人精心挑選柔軟舒適床鋪，更規劃出潔淨寬敞的衛浴空間，讓旅人感到自在無拘，盡情地放鬆身心，在「墾丁新芽民宿2館 - 輕工業」渡過難忘的渡假時光。

stays.name: 日安寶貝民宿
stays.description: 我們的努力:1.2018年十大好客民宿親子類第一名2.2018年百大好客民宿3..2017年票選為屏東縣十大民宿之一4.榮獲好客民宿，合法民宿編號247號。5.香港viu電視台--借宿一宵採訪。6.媒體雜誌；行騙天下、跟著董事長遊台灣、食尚玩家介紹7.環保民宿認證標章8.公共電視台-台灣心動線-海角生態遊篇是一個適合安靜地放鬆、休息的地方，傍晚沿著關山夕照的腳印，便可到海邊踏浪、浮潛及盡情的享受太陽，夜晚有別於墾丁大街的絢麗，這裡更能清楚的窺視天上的星斗。清晨更可望見不同的恆春半島風貌，耳邊聽到是取而代之的田間鳥鳴聲。這樣單純而美好及感動，只有再此居住過一晚，才能體會。 每個房型皆有個人露臺及天然硫磺泉水浴池 ，搭配親自做的原木家具，絲毫不矯情的呈現出我們的用心。當然，用心的除了服務的細節之外，還有每日的現做早餐，與當地小農和在地有機蔬菜的配合，提供的是最新鮮的飲食，別忘了在匆忙的日子裏，停下手邊的工作和我們一起細細品嚐這寧靜而美好的時光。
stays.descriptionEn: (Bonjour be’’be)is a place suitable for you to relax and rest. By walking along the sunset footprint of Kuangshan area at night , you can reach the seaside to stroll along the beach, go diving or simply enjoy the sunshine. Unlike the glamorous night views of Keng Ting Avenue, you can clearly watch the twinkling stars high above during the night hours. When awakened in the early morning, you can see the very different scenery of the Heng Chung Peninsula where birds sing out their songs among the fields. Such a simple and sensational touch is worthy of spending another night. Each room is equipped with a private balcony and a natural sulfuric spring pool. Custom-made solid wood furniture presents our efforts to live in a simple and natural way. In addition to these thoughtful services, we also offer Bonjour be’’be ready-made breakfast. It is the freshest meal prepared from organic vegetables grown by local farmers. As a reminder. The snack offered when you check in is also our most favorite treat. After finishing a busy day, be sure to put aside your work and spend some time with us to savor some tranquil and wonderful moments here at “Ma Cha Homestay”.

images.description: 寶寶貝貝: 放假囉~手牽手，一起走。 今天我們不忙公事、不寫作業， 就照約定好的全員直奔台灣尾， 陪太陽公公日出玩到日落。 沙堡貝殼不會少，還有飛牛鐵馬好朋友。 渴了大口喝涼吃水果，累了我們數星星， 數完回到綿綿紗床，聽我和微風給你輕唱舒眠曲。

images.name: 夜色
images.description: 親愛的寶貝: 終於我們不再奔波， 可以多一點時間好好牽著妳的手， 帶妳輕踏湧浪、欣賞千色日落。 星空下細語呢喃、傾訴生活遼想的妳， 是我見過最柔美的夜色。 今晚，我們不需煩心其他，靠著我的臂彎妳儘管安然入睡。 當晨曦來臨時，最懂妳的夥伴將為你準備好最美味的早餐。
images.sourceLabel: 交通部觀光署旅宿網 / data.gov.tw dataset 7780

images.name: 暮色
images.description: 早安，寶貝: 謝謝你，這正是我的夢想假期。 一年當中有幾天可以好好睡到自然醒， 不用早起做早餐， 有最親愛的你們在身旁共享美景和佳餚， 歡慶輕鬆的一天正要開始。 人生最美滿的時光大概就是此刻了， 是你的溫暖體貼讓我們擁有一切。 我永遠依賴你，最最親愛的寶貝。
images.sourceLabel: 交通部觀光署旅宿網 / data.gov.tw dataset 7780

images.name: 風色雙人雅房
images.description: 寶貝們: 記得那些無所設限的日子嗎? 我們時時期盼各種改變、用半夢半醒的浪漫面對挑戰， 彷彿呼吸之間就有新的可能正在萌生。 此時此刻，這裡的微風正如你們的陪伴沁涼自在。 寶貝，多麼希望有一天可以一同居坐在這寬敞的木造舞台， 用我們的微笑和默契，讓夢想再次順風而行 。

stays.searchText: 日安寶貝民宿 日安寶貝民宿 屏東縣民宿247號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 砂尾路71-3號 我們的努力:1.2018年十大好客民宿親子類第一名2.2018年百大好客民宿3..2017年票選為屏東縣十大民宿之一4.榮獲好客民宿，合法民宿編號247號。5.香港viu電視台--借宿一宵採訪。6.媒體雜誌；行騙天下、跟著董事長遊台灣、食尚玩家介紹7.環保民宿認證標章8.公共電視台-台灣心動線-海角生態遊篇是一個適合安靜地放鬆、休息的地方，傍晚沿著關山夕照的腳印，便可到海邊踏浪、浮潛及盡情的享受太陽，夜晚有別於墾丁大街的絢麗，這裡更能清楚的窺視天上的星斗。清晨更可望見不同的恆春半島風貌，耳邊聽到是取而代之的田間鳥鳴聲。這樣單純而美好及感動，只有再此居住過一晚，才能體會。 每個房型皆有個人露臺及天然硫磺泉水浴池 ，搭配親自做的原木家具，絲毫不矯情的呈現出我們的用心。當然，用心的除了服務的細節之外，還有每日的現做早餐，與當地小農和在地有機蔬菜的配合，提供的是最新鮮的飲食，別忘了在匆忙的日子裏，停下手邊的工作和我們一起細細品嚐這寧靜而美好的時光。

stays.description: 位於台灣之南恆春半島，三面環繞海洋，有一座涵蓋路域與海域的國家公園， 是保育研究環境教育的自然博物館，也是國民休閒旅遊的怡情勝地。民宿房間採套房式，處於恆春古城旁，距離墾丁國家公園、四重溪溫泉區、佳樂水風景區及海洋生物博物館各約20分鐘路程，周圍名勝古蹟眾多，風景宜人。
stays.descriptionEn: Yue Yan Xianju Homestay is located on Hengchun Peninsula in southern Taiwan. Hengchun is surrounded by oceans, and there is a national park covering a sea area and landarea, which is a natural ecological area for conservation and environmental education as well as a tourist spot. The rooms are all suites. We are located near the Hengchun City Wall, and there are many resorts and historical sites around. It takes about 20 minutes to get to Kenting National Park, Sizhong River Hot Spring Area, Jialeshuei Scenic Area and National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium .

stays.searchText: 月芫閒居民宿 月芫閒居民宿 屏東縣民宿125號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 中正路232巷83號 位於台灣之南恆春半島，三面環繞海洋，有一座涵蓋路域與海域的國家公園， 是保育研究環境教育的自然博物館，也是國民休閒旅遊的怡情勝地。民宿房間採套房式，處於恆春古城旁，距離墾丁國家公園、四重溪溫泉區、佳樂水風景區及海洋生物博物館各約20分鐘路程，周圍名勝古蹟眾多，風景宜人。

stays.name: 有棵樹特色民宿
stays.description: 這裡，有棵樹，座落於恆春鎮關山陵線附近，在主人們種下土壤的那刻起，2年時間的細心照料下，終於，小樹變成大樹，用它結實的身軀，擋住強風，用茂盛的葉片，遮住烈陽，這棵樹就是我們的夢想。2014年末，有棵樹民宿誕生了，這過程有歡笑有淚水，一切的不愉快，在遠眺前方山海美景後，全部化為雲煙。猶記莫拉克風災大量的漂流木，也是有棵樹民宿主人踏入木工領域，蒐集建屋材料的開始。而撿拾的檜木、櫸木、黃連木等台灣一級木料，也應用在民宿的每個角落，我們珍惜樹木給予的創作材料與機會，為此我們將成果命名為『有棵樹』。有棵樹的美景我們願意與您分享，所以我們規劃7間客房，間間面海，不管是站在樹頂，樹腰，甚至是蹲在樹底，眺望前方，從北恆春、南灣、墾丁、船帆石到鵝鑾鼻燈塔，山海景色一覽無遺。而內部的每一張手作家具，由我們一點一滴，日以繼夜完成，不是專業，仍有缺陷，仍需您們蒞臨在享受美景之外，給予我們鼓勵與指點。一步步像蝸牛一樣慢慢的爬行，終於，104年5月1日我們通過了特色民宿的申請，成為墾丁地區少數的特色民宿，用心，值得被看見!
stays.descriptionEn: The Tree is here in Guanshan, Hengchun. The owner planted the tree and spent 2 years taking care of it. Finally, it has grown big. It shelters us with its leaves. The Tree is our dream. At the end of 2014, The Tree Homestay is born. There had been joy and sorrow. But all the sorrow had faded when we saw the the mountains and the sea in the distance.. The driftwoods brought by Typhoon Morakot is what started everything. All types of wood were collected and used in different parts of the homestay. The homestay is thus named The Tree. We wish to share the scenes here at The Tree. We have 7 guestrooms and all of them have ocean views. Wherever you are, you can see the views of Nanwan beach, Eluanbi lighthouse, and Chaunfan Rock. Every furniture is handmade with our own hands. Everyone is welcomed to come see and give us feedbacks. On May 1st 2015, The Tree is finally approved as one of the Featured B&B in Kenting. It is definitely worth visiting!

stays.description: 李寓。恆春的家位於恆春鎮，民宿以居家風格佈置，沒有豪華的傢俱與設備，但有愛喝咖啡及喜歡與人交談、親切好客的老闆，經營民宿有一段時間，在網路上的評價不錯，設備齊全，在戶外庭院空間規劃烤肉區及戲水池，有安全獨立的環境，讓有帶小孩出門的爸媽也能放心度假，民宿主要以包棟經營，一樓有客廳，並有提供廚房供房客使用，客房共有四間，簡約的佈置給房客有家的溫馨，而且民宿周邊吃喝玩樂很便利，非常適合隨性旅行的人來一場包棟之旅。
stays.descriptionEn: LeeHome is located in Hengchun Township and is designed in a cozy, home-style setting. There are no luxurious furnishings or extravagant facilities here, but you’ll be welcomed by a friendly and hospitable owner who loves coffee and enjoys meaningful conversations with guests. Having been in operation for some time, the homestay has received many positive reviews online and offers well-equipped spaces for a comfortable stay.The outdoor courtyard features a barbecue area and a small splash pool, providing a safe and private environment where families with children can relax and enjoy their vacation with peace of mind. The homestay mainly operates as a private rental. On the ground floor, there is a shared living room and a kitchen available for guests to use. The property offers four guest rooms in total, simply decorated to create a warm, homelike atmosphere.With convenient access to dining, shopping, and local attractions nearby, Li Yu • Hengchun Home is an ideal choice for travelers who enjoy spontaneous trips and wish to share a private, relaxed getaway with family or friends.

stays.name: 林房民宿
stays.description: 位於鄰近關山的林房是一家合法民宿，有著日式現代風的建築，庭園種植了主人喜愛的樹木，非常期待幾年後大樹茁壯，就可以在綠蔭下乘涼的喜悅那就更美了，其實當我走在一塊塊石板步道上時，便讓我好奇林房內部會是個什麼樣的風格呢，這時得說起民宿主人是一位恆春在地的少年郎，一年前從外地回到家鄉，就是要為阿爸阿媽一圓「起厝」的夢想，而喜歡簡單俐落的主人有了自己心中要為阿爸阿媽蓋起一棟住宅的畫面，是個有純樸家的味道，有實實在在親和力，還有每天女主人早起現做的早餐，也是為了給房客們一個入住輕鬆又自在的度假住宅，林房建築中有一間大面落地窗的交誼廳，在夜晚時的燈光特別有pub的氛圍，使人完全陶醉在假想空間內，室內的木製傢俱則選用好木材，增添整體感的視覺效果，房型的格局也都設計大片落地窗，在房間除了採光佳，也可以透視戶外景色，像躺在玻璃屋一樣欣賞綠意盎然的風景，是渡假中缺乏不了的愉悅時刻。

stays.description: 在森．五七，每一天都值得期待。早晨過後，大冠鷲嘹亮悠遠的鳴聲，充滿了湛藍的天空，碩大的身影滑翔於天際，「忽悠、忽悠」地彼此呼喚，並巡視著地面富饒的生態系中，天然豐沛的食物蹤跡；當牠們乘著熱氣流升起，盤旋於行館上空時，上揚的雙翼，為天空勾勒起一個大微笑，也悄悄牽動你的嘴角…停駐庭園一角的烏頭翁，是獨屬台灣花東及恆春半島的特有種，白色臉頰留著八字鬍，點上兩顆橘紅色的美人痣，與你一同享受陽光；迎面有風吹來，靜靜傾聽，就知道海洋在不遠處；搖擺的稻浪使你嗅到天晴，腳下柔軟的綠草，蘊藏土地溫暖的能量；大自然的氣息使你分外安心，在南台灣炙熱燦爛的異地，你聽見了微小溫柔的召喚，找到心靈深處再熟悉不過的寧靜美好。 熱愛生態攝影的民宿主人，名字裡有個「森」，似乎早預見了他喜愛與大自然為伍的性格，森哥以妻子的生日「五月七日」，將人生中的摯愛與夢想結合，在墾丁國家公園區裡的一方靜謐角落，安頓一個家，在線條俐落的現代清水模質感裡，牽手展開新的旅程，用心當主人，邀請各地的家人，回到這個溫暖的地方，森．五七，因此而生。

stays.description: 屏東｜橘月．百年麵包樹下的橘色假期從墾丁大街轉個彎走入小巷，散步在南國的日常。在小巷的那頭，你遇見了已在這生長百年的麵包樹，頭頂上熾熱的陽光，透過樹蔭灑落了閃亮亮的溫暖印記，橘月就藏身在這株麵包樹的樹蔭下，若隱若現地伸出雙手，邀請你，將假期沉浸在墾丁橘色的溫暖裡。用日光點綴的溫暖生活推開原木大門，或許是因為躲在麵包樹的懷裡，盛夏的陽光溫柔地灑落在屋內的橘色牆面。簡約內斂又不失質感的原木空間和水泥牆面，襯托出展售的可愛雜貨和不時給你的橘色巧思，像一首輕巧的小品，陪你展開微暖假期。樓梯間擺放的暖心收藏和書籍，都是來自民宿主人原本在墾丁經營的「橘月書店」所保留下來的，盛夏午後，在大廳天井的挑高空間，旅人可以挑本自己喜歡的書，隨意翻看。錯層設計的橘月，以半層樓為單位，每間房間都有代表色和植物，像熱情的紅是浪漫的玫瑰，沉靜的藍有野薑花作伴，還有以特殊工法雕刻成的屏東在地植物棋盤腳、林投、雞蛋花等等。除了有適合朋友們的四人房，橘月也體貼地提供了單人房，讓一個人旅行的你也能夠享受專屬自己的角落。和空間對話的結構美學橘月雖然簡單，但在這自在的氛圍中，處處都可以發現留給旅人和建築對話的空間巧思。門口的水泥結構立面，參考了窗花的造型；二樓貫穿整棟建築的天井，讓陽光流洩而下，也邀請了風，成了橘月空氣中的律動。經民宿主人設計的橘月，不僅貼心設計了氣動梭電梯載運行李，更結合簡約的生活美學，讓每一位旅人在適度的留白中自在享受。
stays.descriptionEn: Pingtung｜Orange Moon InnOrange vacation beneath a century-old breadfruit treeTurning a corner off Kenting’s Main Street and heading down a small lane, you embark on a stroll through the daily happenings of this southern Taiwanese town. A little down the lane, you encounter a stately breadfruit tree that has inhabited this place for a century. Tucked away in the shade of the tree sits Orange Moon Inn, almost as if extending both hands to you in welcome. Your vacation is about to be immersed in the orange warmth of Kenting.A life adorned with the warmth of the sunPerhaps because it sits in the embrace of a breadfruit tree, as you push open the wooden doors of Orange Moon Inn, you are struck by the gentle warmth of the midsummer sun dancing on the orange interior walls. However simple and reserved, the wooden space with its bare cement walls is not devoid of texture. The simple decor is offset by various displays of adorable goods which from time to time surprises you with their orange ingenuity. Genial collectibles and stacks of books adorn the stairwell, inherited from the “Orange Moon Bookstore” once owned and operated in Kenting by host and guesthouse owner, Alumi. Feel free to peruse which ever book may catch your eye.Orange Moon Inn is a split-level structure, and each half-storey level is represented by a different color and botanical theme. For instance, the romantic Rose level is painted in passionate red, while the Ginger Lily level is clad in calming blue. A number of specially crafted carvings represent such local flowers as Small-leaved Barringtonia, Narrow-leaved Dracaena, Frangipani, and others, all indigenous to Pingtung county. The four-person rooms are suitable for groups of friends, while, in consideration of lone travelers, Orange Moon Inn also offers single rooms. If you’re travelling alone, Orange Moon Inn has the perfect nook for you to enjoy. Architectural aesthetics in dialogue with spaceThe eight conceptually colored rooms spread across four stories are replete with ingenuity, inspiring a kind of dialogue between travelers and the building they inhabit. The facade of the cement wall in the entrance is modeled after traditional iron window grates. As the second floor atrium running up through the entire building allows sunlight to trickle downwards, it also invites the wind into Orange Moon Inn, inspiring the atmosphere with rhythmic life. Having been retrofitted by Alumi with a pneumatic luggage elevator, the Orange Moon Inn has integrated an increasingly simple aesthetic. The purpose: to provide each and every traveler the right amount of space to enjoy true freedom and ease.All of these design concepts were generated by guesthouse owner Alumi himself. Alumi once acted as editor in chief of his university magazine, at which time he developed his seemingly endless ingenuity in artistic culture and design. Alumi was previously the owner of a bookstore here in Kenting, when his wife began to dream of opening a bed and breakfast. “Architecture needs to correspond to the environment, and must harmonize with it, the experience of which cannot be replaced by any particular style of interior design.” With such staunch dedication to architectural aesthetics, Alumi resolved to introduce sunlight and shade, wind and form into his design. Close your eyes and you can hear the space breathe, as if all the sunlight and tranquility of Kenting has been gathered in this place.Jubilant mornings beneath the breadfruit treeBreakfast is made fresh every morning. Travelers who stay more than one night will be treated to different breakfast creations every day. Sitting in the wooden space of the main hall as a hot chicken sandwich is placed on the table, you enjoy every toasty bite, washing it down with ice-cold milk tea in a state of pure satisfaction.Before you leave Orange Moon Inn, why not linger a moment beneath the breadfruit tree! Look into the near distance and see the morning sun shining upon Dajianshan mountain and the pastures of Kenting ranch. Beneath the hundred-year-old breadfruit tree, tucked away down a little lane, enjoy your very own orange vacation.

stays.descriptionEn: Our guesthouse is located right on the bustling Kenting Main Street — step outside and you’re instantly immersed in the vibrant night market. Whether you’re tasting local delicacies, shopping, or simply soaking in the lively atmosphere of Kenting, everything is just a few steps away. The beautiful Dawan Beach is only a 5-minute walk, perfect for relaxing under the sun and enjoying the ocean breeze. Surrounded by restaurants and convenience stores, our location offers unbeatable convenience, making your stay worry-free. We also provide scooter and car rental services, giving you the freedom to explore every corner of Kenting — from Baisha Bay and Eluanbi to the diving spots of Houbihu, everything is within easy reach. Whether you’re a couple on vacation, a family traveling together, or friends on a getaway, our guesthouse is your warm and welcoming home in Kenting. Come and experience the unique charm and laid-back spirit of the South!

stays.name: 歐都上特色民宿
stays.description: ＊墾丁歐都上特色民宿(屏東縣民宿0390號)＊合法營登統一編號:37600126全新獨棟搭建的歐都上特色民宿位於恆春(墾丁)的後壁湖地區，鄰近白沙灣、貓鼻頭及美國CNN評鑑世界十大美景的關山日落、龍鑾潭自然賞鳥區、瓊麻展示館、台電展示館，『歐都上』在日文音譯上是爸爸的意思，老闆因為很尊敬他的爸爸故而把民宿命名為『歐都上』。 另外房間格局採取簡約純白式，民宿老闆特別強調二樓房間外砌成圓弧型的結構建築是他最引以為傲的，而每間房間在任何角度觀看都有它不一樣的景色之美，民宿前有兩棵百年以上的老樹(瓊瑤海棠)是民宿主人先祖父所留下來的，另有老闆親自打照舒適且寬闊的草原步道及園區內有數十種台灣原生種植物，可直接讓您享受大自然的氛圍，也可吸收森林芬多精及日月精華，為旅客提供完善豐富的生態休閒旅程，讓旅客有著舒適安靜的睡眠品質，到了夜晚還能在庭院觀望美麗燦爛的星空，更奇特的是該民宿竟然有硫磺冷泉...實在是太特別了(也能稱之為硫磺泉的故鄉)！
stays.descriptionEn: When visiting Kenting, you'll feel right at home at Otousann B & B, which offers quality accommodation and great service. From here, guests can enjoy easy access to all that the lively city has to offer. With its convenient location, the hotel offers easy access to the city's must-see destinations.Otousann B & B also offers many facilities to enrich your stay in Kenting. Guests of the hotel can enjoy on-site features like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, private check in/check out, taxi service, 24-hour front desk.All of which exude an atmosphere of total peace and harmony. stays.searchText: 歐都上特色民宿 歐都上特色民宿 屏東縣民宿390號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 大光路142之8號 ＊墾丁歐都上特色民宿(屏東縣民宿0390號)＊合法營登統一編號:37600126全新獨棟搭建的歐都上特色民宿位於恆春(墾丁)的後壁湖地區，鄰近白沙灣、貓鼻頭及美國CNN評鑑世界十大美景的關山日落、龍鑾潭自然賞鳥區、瓊麻展示館、台電展示館，『歐都上』在日文音譯上是爸爸的意思，老闆因為很尊敬他的爸爸故而把民宿命名為『歐都上』。 另外房間格局採取簡約純白式，民宿老闆特別強調二樓房間外砌成圓弧型的結構建築是他最引以為傲的，而每間房間在任何角度觀看都有它不一樣的景色之美，民宿前有兩棵百年以上的老樹(瓊瑤海棠)是民宿主人先祖父所留下來的，另有老闆親自打照舒適且寬闊的草原步道及園區內有數十種台灣原生種植物，可直接讓您享受大自然的氛圍，也可吸收森林芬多精及日月精華，為旅客提供完善豐富的生態休閒旅程，讓旅客有著舒適安靜的睡眠品質，到了夜晚還能在庭院觀望美麗燦爛的星空，更奇特的是該民宿竟然有硫磺冷泉...實在是太特別了(也能稱之為硫磺泉的故鄉)！

stays.name: 河堤墾丁渡假酒店
stays.description: 恆春半島地標，西面關山日落餘暉，東面日出朝陽。館內的裝潢設計採用峇里島全新風貌浪漫舒適，「創意為本，從心出發」以溫馨服務每位貴賓、賓至如歸的感動，是您旅遊的最佳選擇。我們是一家以親切服務為主的飯店，貫徹以客為先的服務精神，深知飯店是旅人的重要休憩所。以真誠及南台灣的熱情來款待每一位賓客，帶給您賓至如歸的溫馨感受。入住河堤墾丁渡假酒店讓您體會不受干擾的度假時光，感受此處的遼闊舒暢，自然之美，擁抱台灣最美的墾丁風味，真正倘佯在南洋風情中，讓每位前來度假的旅客，都能徜徉在恆春半島的南洋風情，來一趟踏浪逐陽的休閒之旅。河堤墾丁渡假酒店客房總數100多間全新的客房設備，不論是商務洽公或休閒旅遊，都是您最佳的旅宿選擇。我們的使命提供您乾淨、舒適的住宿環境，誠摯邀請您前來體驗，讓出門在外的您享受一個最優質的服務。
stays.descriptionEn: A new hotel surrounded by mountainsThe Hotel is a landmark of Hengchun Peninsula. Visitors can see the sunset of Guanshan at the west and sunrise at the east. Decorated in new Bali romantic styles, the Hotel serves each visitor heartwarmingly and comfortably with “creative-based sincerity from the bottom of their heart.” It is the best choice for travelers because of its feel-at-home services. The Hotel provides the most friendly services under customer-first principle because we know that hotels are important places for travelers to take a rest. We would treat each visitor with sincerity and friendliness particular in Southern Taiwan so that you will feel cozy like you were home. Staying at River Inn-Kenting, you can have a vacation undisturbed and enjoy the beauty of nature in the broad space. You can absorb yourself in Kenting, the most beautiful area in Taiwan, relax yourself in Hengchun Peninsula around Southern seas, and take a leisure trip at the beach.River Inn-Kenting contains more than 100 whole new rooms and facilities. It is your best choice for accommodation no matter you go on a business trip or a vacation. We sincerely welcome you to enjoy the clean and comfortable space we provide for you so as to enjoy the best services during your trip.

stays.name: 河堤時尚旅店
stays.description: 酒店位置： 河堤時尚旅店恆春館位於歷史文化區，鄰近恆春古城南門、出火特別景觀區及南灣海灘。區內其他旅遊景點包括墾丁國家公園及國立海洋生物博物館。酒店特色：酒店每天早上提供免費早餐。公用地方提供免費有線及無線寬頻上網服務，酒店亦設有電腦。其他設施包括旅行諮詢/購票服務、洗衣設備及大堂免費報紙。住客可免費泊車，車位有限，先到先得。這是全面禁煙的酒店。客房介紹： 河堤時尚旅店恆春館 提供 59 間冷氣客房，設有洗衣機/乾衣機和咖啡機/泡茶機。住客可使用房內的免費無線及有線寬頻上網服務。客房附有32 吋LCD 電視，提供有線電視頻道。所有客房均備有書桌及直撥電話。浴室設有淋浴設備、風筒、拖鞋及免費浴室用品。客房設有冰箱和免費瓶裝水。酒店提供客房清潔服務 (每日)。
stays.descriptionEn: Location. The Riverside Hotel Hengchun is in the historical district and close to Hengchun Old Town South Gate, Chuhuo Special Scenic Area, and Nan Wan Beach. Additional area attractions include Kenting National Park and National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium.Hotel Features. A complimentary breakfast is served each morning. Complimentary wireless and wired high-speed Internet access is available in public areas and a computer station is located on site. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include tour/ticket assistance, laundry facilities, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Guest parking is complimentary, and available on a limited first-come, first-served basis.Guestrooms. The 59 air-conditioned guestrooms at The Riverside Hotel Hengchun. Guests can use the in-room complimentary wireless and wired high-speed Internet access. 32-inch LCD TVs are equipped with cable channels. All accommodations provide desks and direct-dial phones. Bathrooms offer showers, hair dryers, slippers, and complimentary toiletries. In-room refrigerators andcomplimentary bottled water are provided. Housekeeping is offered daily.

stays.description: 波拉波拉渡假村波拉波拉渡假村包含三個主題館，每館的主題設計不同，有歐風館、南洋館和埃及館，讓來墾丁旅遊的人可以享受不同風情的住宿環境。一樓設有餐廳，在寬敞明亮的建築內悠閒的品嚐早餐，有如置身歐洲的慵懶氛圍。 庭院的設計是老闆最引起為傲的，您可脫下鞋子漫步在草皮上，享受不同的午後時光。 房內則陳設豪華進口傢俱，配置大型螢幕液晶電視，都凸顯出老闆的巧思。衛浴都採用頂級淋浴設備。為滿足不同顧客需求，有些房型更加設SPA池，想體驗不同的異國風情嗎？一定要來波拉波拉渡假村。

stays.name: 海之戀旅店民宿
stays.description: 海之戀，在美麗的墾丁船帆石旁，建築以地中海風為主。有別於其他墾丁民宿，海之戀座落於寧靜的巷子裡，沒有車水馬龍的吵雜聲，亮麗的外觀使人有耳目一新的感動。 海之戀的房間運用不同特色、主題呈現地中海風情，從事水上活動多年的民宿主人，將墾丁民宿與水上活動做結合，充分運用當地自然美景佈置民宿，使整個空間充滿青春氣息。 海之戀，建築採用希臘、愛琴海沿岸的地中海風格，客廳採用地中海特有的白色色調，牆面帶有粉質質感，地面帶點青白色澤，使空間顯得安寧靜謐。一系列原木、米白的藤製桌椅，配上白色地磚，徹底展現廣闊的海天一色。 房間內有各式圓拱形設計、不同造型的觀景窗，從不同角度觀看，會有不同景致。室內室外運用不同的圓形拱門，將地中海風情發揮的淋漓盡致。 這美麗的墾丁民宿居家擺飾取材大自然，捕捉自然明亮光線，加上豐富的海洋氣息、自然浪漫的色彩，以及當地人悠閒的生活步調，讓遊客輕鬆遠離陰霾，重新獲得工作動力。還將南法普羅旺斯，大膽明亮的黃色、紅色、藍色色調，運用在牆面上，營造另一種地中海風格。 海之戀主人龔先生，從事水上活動多年，利用墾丁得天獨厚的海洋資源，提供遊客多樣性活動選擇，遊客可以享受水中仙境、欣賞美麗的海洋奇景。好相處的龔先生會親自參與、帶領，遊客也能夠放心的享受水上活動。

stays.name: 海境渡假民宿
stays.description: 屏東｜海境渡假民宿・無盡的藍、臨海之境在墾丁的山上，一片無盡之藍的海邊，有著一幢美麗的純白民宿。像一對天使的翅膀，眺望藍海與人間。繞過恆春小鎮，在綿延的山丘與草原之後，白色的海境民宿現身，用專屬的溫柔，陪伴你們的美好假期。海與光的祝福，白色的夢土南國的海風、沿途的小樹與盛夏的陽光，彷彿一場美好的白日夢。停下車，遠處八座山巒圍繞著恆春小鎮，望向兩幢如翅膀的白色牆面，一格一格的小窗，都藏著天使的秘密。幾隻可愛的臘腸狗搖著尾巴奔向你，主人Lisa親切地向你微笑揮手，歡迎你來到這安靜的白色夢土。走進室內，大片落地窗外是湛藍的天空和海，所有旅途所帶來的疲憊瞬間流入那無盡的藍中。接著，你來到草地上愉悅的午茶時光，一邊品嚐甜點，一邊欣賞遼闊風景。和愛人牽著手，走到觀海平台，午後的金黃夕陽如此美麗，在海與光的祝福下，親吻彼此的心。十二間房，大海相伴的假期十二間房，十二把通往幸福的鑰匙——黎明、艷陽、落日、月光、白雲、藍天、彩虹、星空、綠野、碧波、春風、寧夏，每間都有海天相伴的美好風景。四人房的寬敞為家人保留溫馨回憶，戶外的花園綠意盎然，紅色扶桑綻放，搭配著木質南洋風家具與搖擺的音樂，十分愜意。在「雙人房Ａ」的簡約裡，用海聲當作背景音樂，一起在露台的木頭躺椅上交換心事；多了山景窗的「雙人房B」，清爽而舒適。「VIP雙人房」最讓人不捨離開，在看得見大海的景觀浴池，享受日光與水流的溫柔；夜裡，也許幸運的你拉開窗簾就可以看見月光海，或者一片星空銀河。山丘上的幸福境地早晨，走到一樓的餐廳空間，與愛人選一個靠窗的位置，享用美味早餐，那片溫暖的海仍在，你拿起一本書閱讀，他拾一支筆寫作，在這寧靜中度過美好時光。幾個孩子在外頭玩沙嘻笑，跟著臘腸狗們散步草原，看著牛隻們在牧地悠閒吃草，這裡就像被大自然包圍的天堂。海境，是天使留在人間的一個秘密。在這裡，總覺得幸福很靠近。
stays.descriptionEn: Pingtung｜Ocean Paradise ResortEndless azure views from a resort beside the seaUp in the mountains of Kenting, beside the endless azure ocean, you discover a beautiful, pure white guesthouse. Two buildings sit like the two wings of an angel overlooking the sea and the human world. After circumventing the small town of Hengchun and driving past endless rolling hills and grasslands, the Ocean Paradise Resort appears before you, your companion for a beautiful vacation.Blessings of sea and sun in a white dreamlandThe sea breeze in southern Taiwan, the shrubbery along the road, and the midsummer sun all feels like a beautiful daydream. Your car stops before the distant scenery of the eight great mountain ranges which surround the small town of Hengchun. You look out at the pair of buildings with white walls like the two wings of an angel speckled with small windows, each one hiding the angel’s secrets. A couple of wiener dogs rush towards you wagging their tails, with your host Lisa waving and smiling at you, welcoming you to this tranquil, white dreamland. Walking indoors, you see the azure sky and deep, blue sea through the large French windows, and all of the exhaustion you may have carried with you along your journey slips away into that distant azure horizon. Next, you enjoy delightful afternoon tea on the lawn, tasting desserts and admiring the scenery. You walk with your special friend to the ocean lookout and wonder at the beauty of the golden sunset, offering each other a kiss under the blessings of sea and sun.Twelve guest rooms offer a vacation in the company of the seaTwelve rooms, like twelve keys to happiness - Daybreak, Splendid Sun, Sunset, Moonlight, White Cloud, Blue Sky, Rainbow, Starry Sky, Meadow, Jade Wave, Spring Breeze, Summer Peace - each room providing beautiful vacation scenery to accompany you.Each four-person suite is sure to provide your family with warm memories; the outdoor gardens overflow with verdant scenery, the red Chinese hibiscus in full bloom provide the perfect backdrop for solid-wood, Southeast Asian furnishings as pleasant music plays in the background. In the simplicity of “Double Room A” the lapping sea provides the background music as you recline on the balcony in wooden lounge chairs discussing life. “Double Room B” has additional mountain-view windows and is relaxed and comfortable. The “VIP Double Room” is the most attractive of all, with a bathtub that offers an ocean view, allowing for the tender enjoyment of both water and sunlight. In the evening, if you are lucky, you may pull open the curtains to behold the moonlight sparkling on the surface of the ocean, with the Milky Way sparkling overhead.Happiness in the Kenting hillsWhen morning breaks, you and your special friend walk to the first-floor dining room and choose a table near the windows where you enjoy a delicious breakfast beside the ever-present blue sea. You pick up your book to read a few pages while your partner writes in a journal, both of you enjoying this tranquil time.Children frolic with the weiner dogs on the lawn outside the window, while the cattle ruminate over the grass in the neighboring field. You feel like you’re in nature’s paradise. The ocean is like a secret left in the human world by the angels. In this place, you feel like blessings are always near, as if that distant ocean is always nearby.

stays.searchText: 海境渡假民宿 海境渡假民宿 屏東縣民宿097號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 紅柴路2-7號 屏東｜海境渡假民宿・無盡的藍、臨海之境在墾丁的山上，一片無盡之藍的海邊，有著一幢美麗的純白民宿。像一對天使的翅膀，眺望藍海與人間。繞過恆春小鎮，在綿延的山丘與草原之後，白色的海境民宿現身，用專屬的溫柔，陪伴你們的美好假期。海與光的祝福，白色的夢土南國的海風、沿途的小樹與盛夏的陽光，彷彿一場美好的白日夢。停下車，遠處八座山巒圍繞著恆春小鎮，望向兩幢如翅膀的白色牆面，一格一格的小窗，都藏著天使的秘密。幾隻可愛的臘腸狗搖著尾巴奔向你，主人Lisa親切地向你微笑揮手，歡迎你來到這安靜的白色夢土。走進室內，大片落地窗外是湛藍的天空和海，所有旅途所帶來的疲憊瞬間流入那無盡的藍中。接著，你來到草地上愉悅的午茶時光，一邊品嚐甜點，一邊欣賞遼闊風景。和愛人牽著手，走到觀海平台，午後的金黃夕陽如此美麗，在海與光的祝福下，親吻彼此的心。十二間房，大海相伴的假期十二間房，十二把通往幸福的鑰匙——黎明、艷陽、落日、月光、白雲、藍天、彩虹、星空、綠野、碧波、春風、寧夏，每間都有海天相伴的美好風景。四人房的寬敞為家人保留溫馨回憶，戶外的花園綠意盎然，紅色扶桑綻放，搭配著木質南洋風家具與搖擺的音樂，十分愜意。在「雙人房Ａ」的簡約裡，用海聲當作背景音樂，一起在露台的木頭躺椅上交換心事；多了山景窗的「雙人房B」，清爽而舒適。「VIP雙人房」最讓人不捨離開，在看得見大海的景觀浴池，享受日光與水流的溫柔；夜裡，也許幸運的你拉開窗簾就可以看見月光海，或者一片星空銀河。山丘上的幸福境地早晨，走到一樓的餐廳空間，與愛人選一個靠窗的位置，享用美味早餐，那片溫暖的海仍在，你拿起一本書閱讀，他拾一支筆寫作，在這寧靜中度過美好時光。幾個孩子在外頭玩沙嘻笑，跟著臘腸狗們散步草原，看著牛隻們在牧地悠閒吃草，這裡就像被大自然包圍的天堂。海境，是天使留在人間的一個秘密。在這裡，總覺得幸福很靠近。

stays.name: 海韻渡假旅店
stays.description: 海韻旅店坐落在墾丁大灣路海景第一排，距離墾丁大街及美麗的大灣海灘都僅約100公尺的距離。旅店提供免費WiFi和免費私人停車位(停車位停滿時會安排到附近公有停車場停車，並補助停車費用)，部分客房設有海景陽台。旅店距離小灣沙灘約1公里，距離船帆石約3.6公里，距離墾丁森林遊樂區約4公里，距離鵝鑾鼻燈塔約9公里，距離貓鼻頭公園約13公里，距離恆春市區約10公里。旅店設有電梯到各個樓層，所有房間都配有衣櫃、平面電視、冷氣空調、乾溼分離衛浴設施和免費盥洗用品(包含毛巾、浴巾、二合一瓶裝洗髮沐浴乳)。依政府規定114年1月1日起，牙刷牙膏、梳子、浴帽、刮鬍刀、刮鬍泡等一次性備品須自行攜帶或向櫃台購買。我們的早餐是跟附近的早餐店合作。如果您的房費包含了早餐，我們會提供早餐劵給您，您可拿著早餐劵到早餐店免費享用您的早餐。早餐店提供包括單點、美式和台式的美食。旅店跟當地業者合作提供自行車、摩托車，汽車租賃服務。最近的機場是高雄國際機場，距離旅店約100公里，最近的高鐵站是左營高鐵站，距離旅店約115公里，有提供付費的機場或高鐵站包車接送服務。
stays.descriptionEn: Harmony Ocean Hotel is located on the first row of the sea view on Dawan Road in Kenting, only about 100 meters away from Kenting Main Street and the beautiful Big Bay Beach. The hotel provides free WiFi and free private parking spaces (when the parking spaces are full, parking will be arranged in a nearby public parking lot and parking fees will be subsidized). Some rooms have balconies with sea views. The hotel is about 1 km from Little Bay Beach, 3.6 km from Chuanfan Rock, 4 km from Kenting Forest Recreation Area, 9 km from Eluanbi Lighthouse, 13 km from Maobitou Park and about 10 km from Hengchun City.The hotel has elevators to each floor. All rooms are equipped with wardrobes, flat-screen TVs, air-conditioning, dry and wet bathroom facilities and free toiletries (including towels, bath towels, and two-in-one bottles of shampoo and shower gel). According to government regulations, starting from January 1, 2025, disposable supplies such as toothbrushes, toothpaste, combs, shower caps, razors, and shaving foam must be carried by yourself or purchased at the counter.Our breakfast is in cooperation with a nearby breakfast shop. If your room rate includes breakfast, we will provide you with a breakfast coupon. You can take the breakfast coupon to the breakfast shop to enjoy your breakfast for free. The breakfast shop offers a la carte, American and Taiwanese cuisine.The hotel cooperates with local businesses to provide bicycle, motorcycle, and car rental services.The nearest airport is Kaohsiung International Airport, which is about 100 kilometers away from the hotel. The nearest high-speed rail station is Zuoying High-speed Railway Station, which is about 115 kilometers away from the hotel. There is a paid chartered shuttle service from the airport or high-speed rail station.

stays.description: 民宿主人張世源為感恩先人，以父親張清來先生的「清」、母親張王春桃女士的「桃」以及民宿主人的「源」字取名，命名為「清桃源」，希望子孫能飲水思源，同時也期盼民宿能如同世外桃源一般，讓旅客有一趟別於都市生活的體驗。 藍色和黃色組成的獨棟別墅，宛若城堡般矗立在寬敞的草原上；戶外庭園出自主人的創意巧思及用心佈置，以原石造景、景觀涼亭和遊樂器材做造景，景觀精美、環境清幽，引領旅人們進入夢幻的童話國度，也提供孩童們嬉戲玩樂的空間；客房空間採用簡潔現代的風格為設計基礎，搭載木質地板、舒適寢具及民宿主人更把每間客房都當成自己的房一樣的用心整理，讓所有旅客有個乾淨舒適的居住品質。 「墾丁．清桃源民宿」擁有極佳視野，可以遠眺赤牛嶺的群山景致，也可以眺望龍鑾潭的湖光山色和群鳥飛舞！在欣賞晨曦之際，別忘了大口吸清新空氣；當悠閒漫步在園內時，請靜下來找找是那些鳥兒為大家歌唱；更可享受田野樂趣及夕照之美；夜裡別忘了，抬頭向星空說晚安！ 旅行是為了發現另一種生活！另一種對生活的樂趣！
stays.descriptionEn: The owner of this B&B is Mr. CHANG, Shih-Yuan. To commemorate the ancestor, the B&B is named Qing Taoyuan Homestay representing the name of CHANG, Qing-Lai, his father; CHANG WANG Chung-Tao, the mother; and part of his own name Yuan respectively. The name is adopted in the hope that their off-springs will remember the hardship of developing the home at the very beginning and that the B&B will serve as a Shangri-La, allowing every visitor an experience different from city life. It is an individual blue and yellow villa, resembling a castle standing tall and firm in a wide meadow. The outdoor courtyard is specifically designed and arranged by the innovative ideas of the owner decorated with stone, pavilion and recreational facilities in presenting delicate and secluded landscape guiding visitors to the dream-like fairy tale land while serving as a playground for children. The guestrooms are designed in modernized concise style adorned with wooden flooring and comfortable bedding. In this way, every room is subtly designed by the owner like his own room to provide a clean and comfortable living quality for every guest. "Kenting - Qing Taoyuan Homestay" has a great view and allows you to look far into the mountains . You may look toward the mountain ranges along the “Niu Shan Ling Mountain and further to the lake scenery of the “Lung Luan Lake” and the birds flying around there. While taking in the dawn, be sure to take a big breath of the fresh air. When strolling in the garden, stop occasionally to find the species of the birds that are singing. Enjoy the fund of the wild field and the beauty of sunset dusk. Before turning in, do not forget to look upward and say good night to the stars. Travel is to discover another level of life! A quest for the fun of life.

stays.name: 漫步莊園
stays.description: 葡萄酒是來自天堂的霖露，甘美純粹中又輕輕抹了層夢幻般的神秘，品啜一口戀愛般的甜蜜 感受些許摘星似的飄然，在林蔭小徑的盡頭，專屬於您的酒香世界悄悄坐落。溫暖而不炙人的陽光為綠葉點上金橙色胭脂，襯托著鬱金香型酒杯的七彩絢麗杯中甘雫波光閃耀，或深紅帶紫或淡金澄澈，輕啜一口芬芳，那是令人忘卻煩憂的餘在唇間與心頭盪漾；享受一個人的自在，沉浸兩人世界的浪漫，與三五好友的促膝長談，共享親人間的天倫之樂，獨自啜飲，抑或是舉杯同慶，就在墾丁山城中的...MY Château
stays.descriptionEn: Wine is the dew of Heaven, sweet and pure with a slight tinge of fantastic mystery, and a sip of lovely sweetness. Experience the feeling of floating through the sky and touching the stars; your private world of wine fragrance is quietly waiting at the end of the forest path. The warm sunlight paints the green leaves with a golden orange, set off by the seven gorgeous colors of the tulip-shaped wine cup. The sweetness in the cup reflects and shines, dark red with a bit of purple or a clear light yellow. A sip of the fragrance is enough to make you forget your worries. Enjoy the comfort of solitude, absorb the romance of the couple’s world, chat with a group of friends, or enjoy the company of family. Drink alone, or raise a toast to friends…at My Chateau, in Kenting.

stays.name: 灣臥民宿
stays.description: 山海環繞‧世外桃源灣臥位於恆春半島西北邊原始山稜線上，前有海洋、背有山色，建築擁抱在樹林及草原之中，最近一座村莊位於1.5公里以外，僅有一條鄉間小徑進出，是處墾丁鮮為人知的世外桃源，讓人遠離塵囂，完全地投入大自然的懷抱裡。灣臥-漫遊的牆在恆春特有的落山風吹拂下，灣臥三個樓層的牆面如絲帶般自由展開，流線型的弧牆延展並劃分了公與私、內與外及建築與景觀的空間介面，甚至在樓梯間大膽地飛越出挑成為捕捉相思樹林隨風搖曳聲音的迴聲牆，這些自由流動的牆面建構了灣臥最具特色的建築外觀，亦成了我們的名稱 – 「灣臥」Wandering Walls（漫遊的牆）。
stays.descriptionEn: Surrounded By Nature・A Utopian RetreatWandering Walls is located on the original mountain ridge on the northwest side of the Hengchun Peninsula,there are mountains between the front and the northwest.The building is surrounded by acacia forests and grasslands.The nearest village is 1.5 kilometers away, and there is only one country path in and out.The well-known utopia retreat allows people to stay away from the hustle and fully immerse themselves in nature.Wandering wallsBlown by the unique downhill wind in Hengchun, the walls of the three floors unfold like ribbons.Boldly flying over the overhangs to become echo walls that capture the sound of the acacia trees swaying in the wind.The streamlined arc wall extends and divides the spatial interface between public and private, interior and exterior, and architecture and landscape.These free-flowing walls constitute the most distinctive architectural appearance of the building.This is the name of “Wandering Walls” came about.

The B&B offers three distinctive room types: the "Shiguang Main House" six-person room with a private kitchen and courtyard; the "Travel Study" four-person room with loft beds and soft lighting; and the "White Cabin" double room with a comfortable bathtub and a small courtyard. Whether renting the entire house or sharing rooms, Milk Candy is an ideal choice for enjoying a wonderful life and private space.
