stays.name: 珊瑚園民宿
stays.description: 珊瑚園民宿座落於墾丁國家公園內。建築外觀主體為西班牙式建築，搭配簡約歐風裝潢與裝飾，呈現出異國的農莊風情。客房分別有珊之部屋與瑚之部屋，其中客房為了營造舒適的環境，每間部屋除了面積超過12.5坪外，更以特別訂製的床單被套組，讓旅客擁有高品質的睡眠，更高規格的使用愛馬仕衛浴用品做為祕境裡的奢華享受。珊之部屋的珊與山同音，故名以觀看山景為主的房型，擁有專屬陽台且外推出去為一片庭園綠地。瑚之部屋的瑚與湖同音，故名以觀看整個後壁湖海岸為主的房型，其中房間更以挑高的室內設計，窗外山水一色的美景輕易地映入眼簾。寬廣的草原腹地，為珊瑚園民宿的主要一大特色，除了超過三百顆的原生種珊瑚樹以外，更有七里香、白水木、紅花玉芙蓉與各式各樣品種的花卉來點綴綠色的畫布。檜柏群們更是畫框之姿，整齊排列在林園邊緣。
stays.descriptionEn: Situated in Kending National Park. The style of building is spanish architecture. House decoration is simplicity European style.It's made guests feel about it's different comparing Coral B&B with traditional Taiwanese farm.Guest rooms have two kinds of style, One is Shan room and other one is Hu room both are suites. The room area is over 42 square-metres in each room. For Shan room, you can see the mountain-view and the part of seaview even if Shan-rooms are ground floor. The balcony connects garden.For Hu room, it's high-ceiling and private balcony, the best one is you can see the mountain-view and the bay because Hu-rooms are first floor. The wide grassland is one of the landscapes on Coral B&B. We have over three hundred sweet viburnum trees which are native tree of Hengchun. In addition, we also have other kinds of tree, let Coral B&B be more colourful.

stays.descriptionEn: The Kenting farm plain extends into the distance, while Ma Ma Lu Lu, Kenting’s prominent landmark, is located next to the farm and busy Kenting Main Street, a 5 and 3 minute walk away, respectively. The independent building includes a private garden and parking lot, and from the rooms guests can enjoy an unobstructed view of Dajianshan. This is a place of blue skies, green fields, ocean waves, and the sounds of birds and insects. The warm, peaceful, and comfortable environment helps guests feel at home and welcome, making this your ideal choice for visiting Kenting.

stays.name: 白水木民宿
stays.description: 陽光、沙灘、海浪、藍天、綠山與大朵的白雲，略帶海味的清新空氣，在得天獨厚的自然滋養下，孕育出一棵獨特的白水木。它並非名貴樹種，卻以堅韌適應環境，活出自己的格調——在逆境中頑強，在寧靜中優雅。自然的樹形透著禪意，如出淤泥而不染的蓮，清新脫俗。我們像精品酒店一樣堅持品質，又如民宿般親切款待。白水木民宿，重新定義度假住宿體驗。本館旗下品牌：白水木民宿臻品民宿均獲台灣【好客民宿】認證，在墾丁地區，為您提供最優質的住宿享受。
stays.descriptionEn: Sunshine, sandy beaches, ocean waves, blue skies, green mountains, and billowing white clouds,The fresh air carries a hint of sea breeze,Nurtured by nature's unique blessings,A distinctive "Messerschmidia argentea" (White Water Wood) thrives.Though not a rare or noble species,It adapts with resilience, flourishing in its own graceful way—Tenacious in adversity, serene yet vibrant by the waters.Its natural form exudes Zen-like tranquility,Like an untainted lotus, pure and unpretentious.We uphold the standards of a boutique hotel,While offering the warm hospitality of a B&B."Baishuimu" redefines your vacation stay.Our brands:Baishuimu B&BZhen Pin B&BBoth certified as Taiwan's 【Friendly B&B】,Promising the finest accommodation experience in Kenting.

stays.name: 白沙35民宿
stays.description: 白沙35民宿白色線條的建築位於白沙貝殼沙灘對面，隨時步行三分鐘可到白沙海灘探訪珊瑚礁生態系享受寧靜舒服的沙灘，探索台灣最美麗的生態保護區珊瑚海域後壁湖約5公里，最適合親子旅遊探訪海底生態的海生館距離15公里。 白沙35民宿循著自然農法與生態共生的理念，讓園區充滿鳥語與多樣性的生物，在空間中有著主人手作的原木空間、散發芬多精的檜木床、原木椅與大片的落地窗，品嘗低溫慢烘的滿州小黑豆與咖啡，靜靜地閱讀，讓旅人享受空間裡的旅行。 旅人可預定白沙35的滿豐料理晚餐，料理中有著主人從土地到餐桌的鮮甜活力與隨時間醱酵醞釀的小品。早餐可吃到現採的園區生菜與在地小農的水果，展開充滿活力與能量的一天。
stays.descriptionEn: The white-lined building of Baisha 35 B&B is located opposite the Baisha Shell Beach. You can walk to Baisha Beach in three minutes to enjoy the quiet and comfortable beach. You can explore Taiwan& #39;s most beautiful ecological protection area, the Coral Sea, Houbi Lake, about 5 kilometers away, and the Aquarium, which is most suitable for family travel to explore the underwater ecology, is 15 kilometers away.Baisha 35 B&B follows the concept of natural farming and ecological symbiosis, making the park full of bird songs and diverse creatures. The space has a log space handmade by the owner, a cypress bed that exudes phytoncides, log chairs and large floor-to-ceiling windows. Visitors can taste the Manchurian black beans and coffee that are slowly roasted at low temperatures, read quietly, and enjoy the journey in the space.Travelers can book a dinner of Manfeng cuisine at Baisha 35. The cuisine features the sweet vitality that the owner has brought from the land to the table, as well as small creations that have fermented over time. For breakfast, you can enjoy freshly picked lettuce from the park and fruits from local small farmers, starting the day with vitality and energy.

stays.name: 盤古拉渡假花園(民宿)
stays.description: Taking deep breath in SUMMERLAND 《 異國情調．奢華體驗 》 這裡... 是一座精心打造的渡假景緻空間，為了營造頂級 Villa 式的慵懶度假氛圍，將峇里島風情與自然景致完整刻劃於此，走進盤古拉，沿著石板小徑，鋪滿盤固草的綠色大草原在眼前鋪展開來，遠眺無邊無際的蔚藍海洋，微風輕撫臉龐，稍來挾帶著熱帶奇異花草的南洋氣息，再回到一方休憩空間舒放所有身心靈，盡情體驗滿足五感的真實生活。來到這，請暫時拋開疲累的都市靈魂，感受南國墾丁時而熱情奔放、時而悠閒愜意、時而神秘優雅的萬種風情... 在綠意悠悠的盤古拉留下一抹艷夏般的笑靨。
stays.descriptionEn: Taking deep breath in SUMMERLAND 《 Exotic．Luxury experience 》 Here ... is a well-built holiday landscape, in order to create a top Villa-style lazy resort atmosphere, will BaliStyle and natural scenery completely carved here, into the Pangu, along the slate trails, covered with grass green grass prairie spread in front of the eyes,Overlooking the boundless blue ocean, the breeze stroking his face, slightly with a tropical tropical flowers,And then back to the side of the open space Shu all the body and mind, enjoy the experience to meet the five real life.Come here, please temporarily put away the tired city soul, feel the southern Kenting sometimes passionate, sometimes relaxed and comfortable,Sometimes mysterious and elegant million kinds of style ... in the green long Pangu pull left a touch of summer like a smile.

stays.description: 『攬山擁水；福容最美』矗立墾丁國家公園境內，坐擁大圓山丘陵之顛，眺望波瀾壯闊巴士海峽，占地約五公頃，居高臨下一望無際俯瞰南島邊境船帆石海景，與百年歷史領航漂泊數萬船隻平安歸而著名美譽的”東亞之光”- 鵝鑾鼻燈塔。海灣風情徐徐吹拂，一覽無遺優越視野的海景BBQ、四季廳、田園咖啡廳、福園中餐廳，饗宴慾望勾勒出極品美饌，健康美學零酯肪，自然、創意、養生食材，中、西、法式爐火純青精湛廚藝，道盡人間醍醐美味。簡約時尚、精雕細琢，媲美西班牙設計風韻，186間典雅、素淨兼具的各式溫馨舒適客房，斜陽夕照金黃色沙灘暉映朵朵浪花綻放波影，霞海、觀月、暮星，遠離塵囂、紓解壓力，館內提供適合全家闔府互動培養親子關系，享天倫樂多功能設施，戶外泳池，室內SPA水療、兒童戲水區、兒童遊戲室、星光大道KTV、健身房、桌球、撞球、保齡球、電玩遊戲區等，洗滌疲憊身心，釋放心靈枷鎖，鳥語花香，翠綠青山，探索著墾丁依山傍水得天獨厚渾然天成景致。
stays.descriptionEn: "Surrounded by hills, embracing waters, Fullon is the most beautiful resort hotel." It is located in the Kenting National Park, sits on the top of the hills of Mt. Dayuan, surveying the magnificent Bashi Channel, and covers an area of about 5 hectares. It overlooks Sail Rock (Chuanfan Rock) on the border of South Island and the "Light of Asia"--Eluanbi Lighthouse, which has been piloting thousands of passing boasts and ships for more than one hundred years. Ocean breeze blowing, with an elegant ambiance overlooking the seascape, Fullon features Scenic B. B. Q, Four Seasons Restaurant, Arcadia Café, Fuyuan Restaurant, offering masterworks of delicacies sketched out by your feast desires. A healthy aesthetic features zero fatty, natural, creativity, and health food, prepared exquisite cuisines in the Chinese, West, or French style with consummate culinary skills, way to make flawless delicacies in the human world. 186 elegant, clean, cozy, and comfortable rooms designed in a variety of simple, stylish, crafted way, comparable to Spanish design charm. Enjoy settling sun, sunset glow, golden sands, glittering waves and sheds, misty sea, moon, and evening stars, keeping you away from the hubbub and relieving your stress. Offer multifunctional facilities suitable for the interactions, for improving relationship between parents and kids, and for enjoying happy family, including outdoor swimming pool, indoor SPA, children's swimming area, children's playroom, Avenue of Stars KTV, gym, table tennis, billiards, bowling, video games area, etc., to wash up the exhaustion of body and mind, release soul from shackles, and enjoy flowers, green mountains, exploring the unique scenery of Kenting richly endowed by nature.

stays.searchText: 福容大飯店 墾丁 福容大飯店股份有限公司墾丁分公司 屏東縣旅館107號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 船帆路1000號 『攬山擁水；福容最美』矗立墾丁國家公園境內，坐擁大圓山丘陵之顛，眺望波瀾壯闊巴士海峽，占地約五公頃，居高臨下一望無際俯瞰南島邊境船帆石海景，與百年歷史領航漂泊數萬船隻平安歸而著名美譽的”東亞之光”- 鵝鑾鼻燈塔。海灣風情徐徐吹拂，一覽無遺優越視野的海景BBQ、四季廳、田園咖啡廳、福園中餐廳，饗宴慾望勾勒出極品美饌，健康美學零酯肪，自然、創意、養生食材，中、西、法式爐火純青精湛廚藝，道盡人間醍醐美味。簡約時尚、精雕細琢，媲美西班牙設計風韻，186間典雅、素淨兼具的各式溫馨舒適客房，斜陽夕照金黃色沙灘暉映朵朵浪花綻放波影，霞海、觀月、暮星，遠離塵囂、紓解壓力，館內提供適合全家闔府互動培養親子關系，享天倫樂多功能設施，戶外泳池，室內SPA水療、兒童戲水區、兒童遊戲室、星光大道KTV、健身房、桌球、撞球、保齡球、電玩遊戲區等，洗滌疲憊身心，釋放心靈枷鎖，鳥語花香，翠綠青山，探索著墾丁依山傍水得天獨厚渾然天成景致。

stays.descriptionEn: Hermit Crab Guesthouse is located in the western suburbs of Hengchun Township, close to Kenting National Park, about 2 km away from the downtown area of Hengchun Township. It is a townhouse with an elevator. It has a wide view, low-density buildings and convenient parking.This guesthouse has four guest rooms, including two standard twin-bed quadruple rooms, one superior double room and one bunk bed six-people room, which can accommodate approximately 16 travelers.In addition to providing comfortable and safe accommodation space and a variety of audio-visual leisure and entertainment, we can also plan and arrange outdoor activities for you, and provide support in local transportation; providing you with a full range of services.We are committed to making your trip to Hengchun Peninsula a wonderful one, so you can enjoy a rich and wonderful holiday.

stays.description: 窩一窩 OliO B&B, 一家運用豐富色彩與幾何光影說故事的旅宿空間。「窩一窩」位於恆春老街與四座古城門內；海邊、沙灘、溫泉、浮潛、衝浪、漁港、國家公園、生態社區等觀光景點開車也僅10-15分鐘。 窩主將老房子保留些許經典，半翻新打造成舒適、乾淨、溫暖的「窩一窩 OliO b&b」旅店，秉持在地人的熱情與飯店人的專業迎接各地旅人。 交通資訊: ** 自行開車: 台26線進入恆春市區, 左轉省北路, 約3分鐘即可抵達. 房源周圍停車很方便. ** 客運站牌: 搭乘墾丁快線或是聯合客運至「恆春轉運站或恆春電信局站」, 步行約3至8分鐘即可抵達。一人成行、兩人有伴、三人有趣。恆春窩一窩歡迎你來、慢慢住、慢慢看、慢慢喜歡上恆春！
stays.descriptionEn: Tucked on a quiet corner of Hengchun, our mint-green walls catch the sunlight by day, and the golden sky by dusk. Olio b&b is where design meets warmth, and every stay feels like a small chapter in your favorite travel journal.Here, we reimagine that charm through a modern lens—blending nostalgic tones with contemporary design. As sunlight shifts into dusk, Olio becomes more than a place to stay. It becomes a frame of stillness in motion.OliO b&b has furnished with 4 suites and the library adjacent to the recreation area and information center to the reception. The urban interiors, bright and unwind colored are all designed to create a cozy ambiance while on the vacation.

stays.description: 2022年全新完工的新建案，經過近半年與歐德裝潢團隊的討論而打造的舒適環境，民宿沒有豪華的造景、沒有優美的景色，但是一定讓你一進門就有回家的感覺~~~以下為竹睎民宿房源規定，請詳細閱讀(如有爭議我們有權拒絕房客入住並扣除住房費用)●入住時間下午三點到六點，如提早可以先與房東聯絡看是否可以先入住，當然如果會晚到也請先跟我們告知大約抵達的時間●退房時間為上午11:00，請準時退房●每一房間都有獨立衛浴與電視，所以請愛護我們提供使用的物品●房源沒有提供早餐/洗衣機/冰箱●民宿無電梯●民宿內全面禁止吸菸、吸毒，請務必配合●交通資訊如以下(1)距離恆春鎮開車5分鐘(2)距離南灣開車15 分鐘(3)距離四重溪開車15分鐘(4)距離海生館開車10分鐘(5)距離墾丁大街開車20分鐘●落山風期間風勢會很大，開車的人開關門要注意(很重要)

stays.description: 【平日、假日定義】平日：週日至週五假日：週六及連續假日、國定假日旺季定義：6月15日～8月31日連續假期定義：連續假期三天以上【訂房須知】押金：酌收房價1000。（退房時歸還押金）訂房時間早上09:00至晚上09:00，請於訂房時間來電。進房時間：＊下午 3:00~06:00＊, 逾時請務必主動電話通知。若您無法於下午6點前入住，請主動連絡我們，以免我們另忙他事，疏於招呼。退房時間：＊上午11:00，倘逾時退房需另加收NT500/小時＊，尚請見諒!我們謝絕非當天住宿房客者參觀及入內，感謝您的配合。【訂房程序】訂房時請告知入住人數(含小孩及歲數)及用素人數。為確保您的權益，經我們回覆訂房確認後，請於訂房後2日內（含訂房當日）匯訂金(房價的50%)，若於保留時間內未收到匯款訂金則將取消訂房，並且不另行通知。匯款後請務必e-mail【easyinn178@gmail.com】或來電【08-8899178】或【0988-771707】告知，並說明『姓名』、『電話』、『住房日期』、『房型』若您是以轉帳方式，請務必告知您的『帳號後五碼』，以便確認，我們收到訂金後，將為您保留房間，餘款到付。請遵照您訂房時的入住人數(含小孩及歲數)，入住房客若超過房間限定最大容納人數等偷渡行為，有權拒絕房客入住並沒收訂金。Check-in 時請出示身份證件，以填寫旅客住宿登記表，並結清餘額。12歲以上及身高140cm以上房客皆視同成年人招待。【加床服務】每間房間配置的床位人數剛好，若需要增加住房人數，則需酌收費用如下：※2歲以下免費※加人不加床：400元/人（含毛巾、早餐）※加床：800元/人（含備品、早餐、單人床墊、枕頭、棉被）※雙人房限加人一位；通鋪可加至兩位額外加棉被一條100元，枕頭30元【延期與退費說明】匯款後若因故欲更改日期，請於7日前來電通知(更改以一次為限)，延期後若取消訂房恕無法退還訂金。若需取消或更改訂房，相關規定如下：（非旺季期間）旅客於入住日（含）~入住日前2日（含）取消者，訂金須扣款100%。旅客於入住日前3日（含）~入住日前13日（含）取消者，訂金須扣款50%。旅客於入住日前14日（含）以前取消者，訂金須扣款0%。＊民宿旺季6/15~08/30期間是訂房高峰，21日前退全部訂金；14日前退一半訂金；14日後全額不退。有任何不便請見諒。謝謝您～＊住房當日逢發佈路上颱風警報（陸上警報區須包含屏東縣）或屏東縣宣佈停止上班上課時，可全額退還訂金或保留訂金三個月。（以中央氣象局頒佈狀況為準）5間客房以上之訂房除天災人禍外，皆不可延期及取消訂房，訂房務必請考慮清楚！本場所不能帶寵物住宿及室內全面禁止吸煙，吸煙者請至戶外空間(陽台及庭院備有煙灰缸)。另室內吸菸者，依菸害防制法報請屏東縣政府裁罰NT10,000元。嚴禁吸毒、嗑藥、大聲喧嘩、打麻將、嚼檳榔、房內煮食、攜帶違禁品及危險物品，如發現即報警處理。我們歡迎小朋友入住，惟有帶10歲以下小朋友入住者，請確實注意並負責小朋友之安全與行為。※※若有不慎損壞仍須照價賠償，民宿內非自身物品請勿攜帶出門，請斟酌後再訂房。

stays.searchText: 簡單旅宿 簡單旅宿 屏東縣民宿891號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 德和路746號 【平日、假日定義】平日：週日至週五假日：週六及連續假日、國定假日旺季定義：6月15日～8月31日連續假期定義：連續假期三天以上【訂房須知】押金：酌收房價1000。（退房時歸還押金）訂房時間早上09:00至晚上09:00，請於訂房時間來電。進房時間：＊下午 3:00~06:00＊, 逾時請務必主動電話通知。若您無法於下午6點前入住，請主動連絡我們，以免我們另忙他事，疏於招呼。退房時間：＊上午11:00，倘逾時退房需另加收NT500/小時＊，尚請見諒!我們謝絕非當天住宿房客者參觀及入內，感謝您的配合。【訂房程序】訂房時請告知入住人數(含小孩及歲數)及用素人數。為確保您的權益，經我們回覆訂房確認後，請於訂房後2日內（含訂房當日）匯訂金(房價的50%)，若於保留時間內未收到匯款訂金則將取消訂房，並且不另行通知。匯款後請務必e-mail【easyinn178@gmail.com】或來電【08-8899178】或【0988-771707】告知，並說明『姓名』、『電話』、『住房日期』、『房型』若您是以轉帳方式，請務必告知您的『帳號後五碼』，以便確認，我們收到訂金後，將為您保留房間，餘款到付。請遵照您訂房時的入住人數(含小孩及歲數)，入住房客若超過房間限定最大容納人數等偷渡行為，有權拒絕房客入住並沒收訂金。Check-in 時請出示身份證件，以填寫旅客住宿登記表，並結清餘額。12歲以上及身高140cm以上房客皆視同成年人招待。【加床服務】每間房間配置的床位人數剛好，若需要增加住房人數，則需酌收費用如下：※2歲以下免費※加人不加床：400元/人（含毛巾、早餐）※加床：800元/人（含備品、早餐、單人床墊、枕頭、棉被）※雙人房限加人一位；通鋪可加至兩位額外加棉被一條100元，枕頭30元【延期與退費說明】匯款後若因故欲更改日期，請於7日前來電通知(更改以一次為限)，延期後若取消訂房恕無法退還訂金。若需取消或更改訂房，相關規定如下：（非旺季期間）旅客於入住日（含）~入住日前2日（含）取消者，訂金須扣款100%。旅客於入住日前3日（含）~入住日前13日（含）取消者，訂金須扣款50%。旅客於入住日前14日（含）以前取消者，訂金須扣款0%。＊民宿旺季6/15~08/30期間是訂房高峰，21日前退全部訂金；14日前退一半訂金；14日後全額不退。有任何不便請見諒。謝謝您～＊住房當日逢發佈路上颱風警報（陸上警報區須包含屏東縣）或屏東縣宣佈停止上班上課時，可全額退還訂金或保留訂金三個月。（以中央氣象局頒佈狀況為準）5間客房以上之訂房除天災人禍外，皆不可延期及取消訂房，訂房務必請考慮清楚！本場所不能帶寵物住宿及室內全面禁止吸煙，吸煙者請至戶外空間(陽台及庭院備有煙灰缸)。另室內吸菸者，依菸害防制法報請屏東縣政府裁罰NT10,000元。嚴禁吸毒、嗑藥、大聲喧嘩、打麻將、嚼檳榔、房內煮食、攜帶違禁品及危險物品，如發現即報警處理。我們歡迎小朋友入住，惟有帶10歲以下小朋友入住者，請確實注意並負責小朋友之安全與行為。※※若有不慎損壞仍須照價賠償，民宿內非自身物品請勿攜帶出門，請斟酌後再訂房。

stays.descriptionEn: Red House Hotel is located on the beautiful beach "Nanwan" in Kenting, and is only a 3-minute walk to the beach. Red House is a European light industrial style, with white, wood and gray. The room has large floor-to-ceiling windows, which provide excellent lighting and ventilation. If you want to have an intimate sunbath with the sun in Kenting, you can do so on the balcony or by opening the floor-to-ceiling windows in the room. Such a comfortable and carefree life is waiting for you to share and experience~

stays.description: 記錄．每一次開懷大笑的心情收集．值得珍藏的每一段回憶 QQ:148-296-1039 微信:doll886915068178 位於恆春鎮中心的「墾丁民宿．墾丁經典公仔主題民宿」，裡頭有著吸引大人小孩的終極武器．．．「公仔」，民宿內所見各式各樣的主題公仔，全是主人花了十幾年時間所收集的，極富趣味性的可愛妝點，打造出令人為之一亮的空間領域，即使只是小小的公仔模型，也能發揮出團結力量大的強力特色。 「墾丁民宿．墾丁經典公仔主題民宿」擁有如此多款式的公仔模型，客房當然也是針對公仔所設定的主題房型，像是大家所熟知的Kitty、小丸子、多啦A夢、航海王ONE PIECE，以及迪士尼系列，房內格局及裝潢雖大致相同，但透過各式公仔的進駐，卻能製造出不同風情的氛圍氣息。 除了能在客房內看見公仔的可愛身影，「墾丁民宿．墾丁經典公仔主題民宿」另外也在大廳及樓層的走道上規劃了櫥窗及展示區域，擺上更多更經典的公仔及作品，供住客們玩賞回味；一間能讓您勾起童年回憶的優質民宿，「墾丁民宿．墾丁經典公仔主題民宿」期待您的蒞臨。 一個讓大人找回童真的地方一個讓小孩尋找歡樂的城堡墾丁～經典公仔主題民宿，帶您進入精彩無比的卡通世界裡 倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎加入我的QQ:148-296-1039微信:doll886915068178 [微博]:垦丁恒春经典公仔主题民宿或直接電洽【08-8894176或0915-068178】墾丁民宿．墾丁經典公仔主題民宿

stays.description: 一處集結著青春氣息與無盡魅力的海洋聖地～快快前往國境之南，揮灑那熱情如火的青春活力！「墾丁民宿．墾丁綠院子民宿」，擁有鄰近恆春市區、生活機能便利的住宿優勢，前往墾丁大街、海生館、鵝鑾鼻燈塔、關山夕陽、南灣、白沙灣、等熱門景點也都能快速到達，為一處集結了各項旅遊交通往來的絕佳優勢，是旅客們的最佳選擇。全新建造，不論屋外或屋內皆有全新面貌，採用簡約時尚為設計主軸，營造出明亮寬敞、乾淨舒適的宜人氛圍，房內採用大金空調、飯店特級的舒適床組與精緻備品；在衛浴空間中也採用TOTO衛浴，乾濕分離的空間增加居住安全性，為旅人們打造一處溫馨、舒適、乾淨的旅遊休憩空間，享有就像回到家一般的無所拘束。「墾丁民宿．墾丁綠院子民宿」為登記合法的墾丁民宿，在各項設施規劃上皆十分嚴謹，提供給旅人們一處安心的旅居住所，是我們對旅人們最大的承諾；來到「墾丁民宿．墾丁綠院子民宿」，帶回最難以忘懷的放鬆之旅！
stays.descriptionEn: Head to southern Taiwan to unleash your passionate and blazing energies in the hallowed land of beaches, oceans, and youthful vigor. Kenting Homestay - GREEN YARD B&B is right next to downtown Hengchun and has plenty of amenities in the neighborhood, offering a definitive advantage of quick and easy access to popular destinations such as Kenting Boulevard, National Museum of Marine Biology & Aquarium, Eluanbi Lighthouse, Guanshan Sunset, Nanwan (South Bay), and Baishawan (White Sand Bay), making this B&B the best option for visitors. The accommodations are newly constructed, with all-new furnishings for both the indoors and outdoors. Minimalist design themes were adopted to create a bright, spacious, clean, and comfortable atmosphere. Rooms are provided with Daikin air conditioning, hotel-grade bed sets and carefully prepared items. Bathrooms are furnished with TOTO toilets and separate wet and dry areas to improve guest safety. The aim is to provide travelers with a cozy, comfortable, and clean environment for leisure and comfort while making them feel right at home. Kenting Homestay - GREEN YARD B&B is a legally registered B&B. Every facility is meticulously planned, providing travelers with safe and comfortable accommodations to fulfill our single greatest pledge to our guests. Those who have stayed at Kenting B&B - GREEN YARD B&B will definitely return home with plenty of unforgettable memories of a most relaxing and enjoyable holiday.

stays.name: 耳東華苑渡假會館
stays.description: 『耳東華苑，是這輩子集合最多人才的共同創作』創辦人陳先生常常笑著這麼說。建設一棟房子，就要在地表上創作一棟可以流傳百年且具美感的建築作品 ; 要建設一家渡假會館，就要讓每一位來到旅店的朋友，停泊的時間享受到有品質的休閒渡假生活;一家在台灣的渡假會館，我們要能超越全世界的標準，可以讓台灣被國際看見。因為處處用心，陳先生表示，那就以我們台灣人的文化用家族姓氏來命名，『耳東華苑』一期許成為一家優質的台灣文化旅店。
stays.descriptionEn: Mr. Chen often laughed and said that this is biggest artwork he has in his life, and it is also the co-creation of the most talented people in his life. To build a house, we must make this architecture aesthetic and can be passed down for centuries. To build a hotel , we must let every guest experience hight quality and content during their stay. For a hotel in Taiwan, we must be able to surpass the high standards of the world, and make Taiwan to be seen around the world.Mr. Chen said that this manor would be named after their surname according to typical Taiwanese tradition. “Er Dong Manor”, the best Taiwanese cultural hotel, the co-creation of many Taiwanese talents, and it is worth your expectation.

stays.descriptionEn: Fenxiangzhijia Bed and Breakfast is located outside the East Gate of Hengchun, Pingtung, close to the famous “Chuhuo.” Covering nearly 3,000 square meters, Fenxiangzhijia features a private, independent courtyard as well as surrounding mountains and beautiful scenery nearby, making this one of the top reasons guests choose this place. We welcome travelers to Kenting and hope this beautiful, all-natural environment puts you in a great vacation mood. Fenxiangzhijia features a spacious outdoor environment as well as comfortably roomy interior. The open style of a divided living and dining room makes both areas feel more spacious and helps guests feel at home, without any restraints or pressure. We offer 4 and 6 person rooms, 2 – 4 person accommodation, beds for extra guests, or renting out the entire building. Rooms are spacious, well-lit, and decorated with a simple, efficient style, providing a clean, warm feeling of home. They also come with scenic windows so guests can gaze out at the limitless beauty outside while resting or chatting with friends.

stays.name: 花園紅了民宿
stays.description: 屏東｜花園紅了．南國盛開的祕密花園穿過熱鬧的墾丁大街，往船帆石駛去，沿路上的行人越來越少，最後陪著你的只剩右邊那片被太陽映射成三個顏色的海天一線。急轉彎上一個小石頭坡後，緩步向前，接著，眼睛亮了，因為花園紅了。用生命綻放的精緻花園花園紅了隱身在船帆石的小徑裡，推開門，迎面而來的是片面海的小花園，就像這兒的名字一樣，努力地艷紅著。花園面積不大卻精緻整齊，依循著地勢有著高低不同的層次，每個角度看都有不同風貌。花叢間躲著從峇里島帶回的小石雕，那裡是尊沉靜的佛像，遠方是條悠游的小鱷魚，他們像是與花兒們做伴，更像是與旅人們玩鬧，不論是白天或夜晚，都能在這裡待上好久好久，尋找心中那一抹綺麗。沿續花園的特色，花園紅了的空間鮮明而浪漫，熱情的橘紅與鮮黃勾勒著牆面，深綠色的藤蔓彎彎曲曲地攀附其上，你抬頭看著頂樓微微開啟的窗戶，幻想這是南國裡長髮公主的小屋，日日夜夜披散如綢緞的長髮，從窗戶望向遠方，等待海上騎著白馬的王子前來。細膩迷人的南洋童話進入室內，充滿異國風情的布置，巧妙地融合了峇里島的元素與原住民的圖紋，創造出花園紅了特有的南國景致，低調卻奔放。浴室裡擺著盛裝備品的小陶瓶，地板鋪上火山岩，高低落差的設計和屋外的花園相互呼應。夜深，躺在白色大床上，隱約能聽見海浪的聲音，昏黃的燈光、散落的鮮花和飄散在空氣中的檀香味像是在耳邊呢喃，迷人地令人不捨睡去。穿著一襲飄逸的長裙，主人Amy姊就是呵護這片花園最美麗的園丁，從小住在墾丁的她，熱情且堅強，放棄了原本足球員的夢想，卻靠著運動員的執著與拚勁，從飯店外場重新出發。因緣際會下，她轉到了飯店主廚開的餐廳裡工作，學做菜、也學英文，從學徒變為能獨當一面的餐廳老闆。在那兒，她也認識了來自英國的摯愛── Neil，而花園紅了，就是見證他們幸福的豐美果實。
stays.descriptionEn: Pingtung｜Red Garden ResortA blooming secret garden in the south of TaiwanYou pass through Kenting’s bustling main street and head toward Sail Rock. The number of pedestrians gradually decreases until, finally, your only company is the sunny skyline along the coastal highway. You make a sudden turn up a sloping gravel lane and continue unhurriedly along until your eyes light up at the sight before you: behold Red Garden Resort.An exquisite garden abloom with vibrant lifeRed Garden Resort is hidden down a little alley in Sail Rock. Open the gate and you are greeted by a little garden facing out over the sea which, as the name implies, is full of colorful red flowers. Though small in size, the terrace is delicate and orderly, arranged into multiple impressive layers so that the style of the garden changes depending on where you stand. Small stone carvings imported from Bali hide between blossoming shrubs; here a tranquil Buddha, there a calm little crocodile. It’s as if they are keeping company with the flowers or playing with the travelers. No matter day or night, this enchanting venue allows you to linger a long, long time.In keeping with the design of the gardens, the dwelling of Red Garden Resort is equally bright and romantic. Walls are accentuated with passionate orange and bright yellow paint, and are covered with winding, dark green vines. Looking up at the windows of the top floor left slightly ajar, you might imagine this to be the Taiwanese abode of Rapunzel, unravelling her long, silk-like hair out those windows day and night, awaiting the arrival of her prince charming.An exquisite and enchanting Southeast Asian fairy taleAn ingenious mix of exotic decorations from Bali and various other indigenous cultures greets you as you step indoors, giving Red Garden Resort a uniquely tropical, southern style, at once subdued yet bold. The bathrooms exhibit clay bottles of shampoo and shower gel, and volcanic rock flooring, the varied heights of the design elements echoing the multi-level composition of the gardens outside. Lying on the white bedding of the large wooden bed late at night, you hear the faint lapping of waves against the seashore. The subtle yellow lighting, the fresh cut flowers and the scent of sandalwood in the air are so charming that you feel loathe to let sleep overtake you.Your hostess Amy, in her long, flowing skirt, is the beautiful caretaker of this elegant garden. Passionate and strong, Amy was born and raised in Kenting. Giving up her dream of being a professional soccer player, her athletic vigor and perseverance allowed her to go from serving in a hotel restaurant to become an apprentice at another establishment opened by the hotel chef where she learned to cook and to speak English. She later took charge of her own restaurant, at which time she met her true love, an Englishman named Neil. Red Garden Resort is the fruit of their labor, bearing witness to their good fortune and happiness.Blooming in the hearts of travelersOriginally employed in the field of shipbuilding design, Neil found himself making frequent trips to Taiwan. An avid surfer, he would escape to the beaches of Kenting nearly every week. It was on one of those trips that he met Amy, who was working in a restaurant he patronized. Their exotic foreign romance culminated in Neil giving up his career to stay in Taiwan and start a family with Amy. At that time, Amy was growing increasingly weary of her hectic restaurant job, and began to imagine the contentment of a leisurely lifestyle in a garden paradise. In order to fulfill his wife’s dreams, Neil once again took up his design profession. He drew up all the designs and oversaw the construction work himself. The details of Red Garden Resort took shape in each meticulously drawn blueprint, as if with each stroke of his pen, Neil was bringing his commitment to Amy to life, each gorgeous flower nurtured with his love for her. So long as they hold hands, the flowers in their garden will bloom eternally in brilliant red.When you stay at Red Garden Resort, you feel like you’ve arrived at your own private villa. The atmosphere gives travelers the warm sensation of returning home for the holidays. As you enjoy a delicious breakfast under the garden trellis, the sea breeze caresses your skin and the sound of ocean waves rolls in the distance. Sometimes, you might find yourself lounging in a garden chair with a good book, at others strolling the beach in the sunshine. Passing your days in such cordial comfort, you feel utterly free. For over ten years, it is precisely this secret that Red Garden Resort has been planting in the hearts of travelers.

stays.searchText: 花園紅了民宿 花園紅了民宿 屏東縣民宿024號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 船帆路846巷18號 屏東｜花園紅了．南國盛開的祕密花園穿過熱鬧的墾丁大街，往船帆石駛去，沿路上的行人越來越少，最後陪著你的只剩右邊那片被太陽映射成三個顏色的海天一線。急轉彎上一個小石頭坡後，緩步向前，接著，眼睛亮了，因為花園紅了。用生命綻放的精緻花園花園紅了隱身在船帆石的小徑裡，推開門，迎面而來的是片面海的小花園，就像這兒的名字一樣，努力地艷紅著。花園面積不大卻精緻整齊，依循著地勢有著高低不同的層次，每個角度看都有不同風貌。花叢間躲著從峇里島帶回的小石雕，那裡是尊沉靜的佛像，遠方是條悠游的小鱷魚，他們像是與花兒們做伴，更像是與旅人們玩鬧，不論是白天或夜晚，都能在這裡待上好久好久，尋找心中那一抹綺麗。沿續花園的特色，花園紅了的空間鮮明而浪漫，熱情的橘紅與鮮黃勾勒著牆面，深綠色的藤蔓彎彎曲曲地攀附其上，你抬頭看著頂樓微微開啟的窗戶，幻想這是南國裡長髮公主的小屋，日日夜夜披散如綢緞的長髮，從窗戶望向遠方，等待海上騎著白馬的王子前來。細膩迷人的南洋童話進入室內，充滿異國風情的布置，巧妙地融合了峇里島的元素與原住民的圖紋，創造出花園紅了特有的南國景致，低調卻奔放。浴室裡擺著盛裝備品的小陶瓶，地板鋪上火山岩，高低落差的設計和屋外的花園相互呼應。夜深，躺在白色大床上，隱約能聽見海浪的聲音，昏黃的燈光、散落的鮮花和飄散在空氣中的檀香味像是在耳邊呢喃，迷人地令人不捨睡去。穿著一襲飄逸的長裙，主人Amy姊就是呵護這片花園最美麗的園丁，從小住在墾丁的她，熱情且堅強，放棄了原本足球員的夢想，卻靠著運動員的執著與拚勁，從飯店外場重新出發。因緣際會下，她轉到了飯店主廚開的餐廳裡工作，學做菜、也學英文，從學徒變為能獨當一面的餐廳老闆。在那兒，她也認識了來自英國的摯愛── Neil，而花園紅了，就是見證他們幸福的豐美果實。

stays.description: 對喜歡上墾丁的人，總有道不盡的故事。來自柬埔寨，最後情定墾丁意想築夢的「莎莎の拉夢」女主人說道---由一間破舊老房到脫胎換骨，從走訪中國絲路選材及裝飾一直到裝櫃運抵墾丁，全一手包辦，為的是以不同風格打造出自己的夢想屋。 「莎莎の拉夢」結合墾丁海天一色景緻搭配特有灌木，襯托屬於墾丁的萬般風情，讓您盡情獨享墾丁的艷陽、沙灘、啤酒海…。朋友們！相約在墾丁的「莎莎の拉夢」！款款盛情等待您在沙灘上的足印與跫音。
stays.descriptionEn: Countless sentimental stories are told by those who have visited Kenting. I would love to share mine, as your hostess at Sasa L’amour Villa.When I first arrived in Hong Kong from Cambodia, I thought that Hong Kong would be my final destination. As it turned out, my heart brought me to Kenting.Making a profit is never my focus, rather, it is to build my dream home. To build this dream, I have ventured through China collecting items for the interior design of Sasa L’amour. I have devoted to turning the dilapidated old house that I found here years ago into a welcoming home with a unique and delightful design.The Sasa L’amour Villa is surrounded by evergreen shrubs unique to the area and scenery in Kenting. As our guest, you will immerse in the pleasant and relaxing Kenting lifestyle full of sun, sand, and sea breeze. Delicious food, drinks and refreshments are prepared for you with care.Your friends at Sasa L’amour welcome you with open arms and heart, inviting you to plant your footprints on the soft sand and set your spirit to sail through the wild, rocky coastline

stays.description: 我們是潛水店＋旅宿的結合，1樓為潛水店，2～5樓為房間，房型有雙床雙人房(可併成為大床,或加一床,成為三人房)、大床雙人房（可加床）及4人背包房（上下床舖二張,房內有衛浴），提供您各種選擇，每個房間都有獨立衛浴，有WIFI及mod電視，陽台（可欣賞夕陽及夜景），整個建築物有電梯，上下樓很方便，大門皆為感應式刷卡.附近很大的空地可供停車,一樓有客廳區,有桌遊可供遊戲,適合大家小酌聊天.(基於減塑政策,我們不提供牙刷牙膏,房內禁止飲食)

stays.description: 「通海」座落於風景秀麗的墾丁國家公園大灣海濱住宿區，位於熱鬧的墾丁市街中心，購物、用餐、逛街皆方便，且鬧中取靜，設備完善，全棟每間客房皆有邊窗，面海景觀，採光、通風、視野均佳、清靜幽雅，大灣海岸景觀、落日、夕陽、晚霞美景盡收眼底。全新套房，精緻典雅、設備完善，客房內日常用品一應俱全，房務有請專人管理，講究衛生、清潔、美觀、舒適。提供最優質的服務、最平價的收費、最安全舒適的住宿環境，讓您享受一趟美好、愉快的墾丁之旅。祈望「通海」是您來墾丁渡假最佳的選擇，期待您的光臨，歡迎上網查詢及來電洽詢預訂。 榮獲2002及2003年墾丁形象商圈優良商店票選「最親切的商店」獎 客房設施：套房衛浴、冷氣機、冰箱、全頻有線電視、內線電話、衣櫃、梳妝台、吹風機、保溫壺、雙層彈簧床、羽絨被、衛浴日用品。 公用設施：專用停車場、寬頻無線上網(自備電腦)、RO純水飲水機、洗衣( 脫水 )機、腳底按摩健康步道、大廳、旅遊佈告欄。

stays.name: 遇見，白居旅宿
stays.description: 位於恆春古城北門與東門之間，徒步行走只須3~5分鐘即可到達目的地；離公車轉運站也僅有600公尺，徒步只須6分鐘。入住白居易旅店不僅在晚間可以享受優雅的古城靜瑟氛圍，也可褪去白天從優美風景中所帶回來愉悅感的疲累，能為精打細算的您，量身打造「玩在墾丁，住在恆春」的超值組合。其中北門廣場所助力的戰車亦為知名電影《海角七号》拍攝場景之一，白居易旅店所處地理位置，不論東、北、西三城門皆是幾分鐘步行可到之處，東門廣場保有古城年度盛事─國際搶孤活動，西門廣場則不定時舉辦節慶活動所在地，一址串聯東、北、西、南古城門，悠然徒步老街行。
stays.descriptionEn: Located between the north gate and the east gate of Hengchun Old Town, it only takes 3 to 5 minutes to reach the destination on foot.It is only 600 meters away from the bus terminal and only takes 6 minutes on foot.The chariot at the North Gate Square was also one of the filming locations for the famous movie Cape No. 7. The location of Bai Juyi Hotel is such that the east, north and west gates are all within a few minutes’ walk.

stays.searchText: 遇見，白居旅宿 遇見，白居旅宿 屏東縣民宿664號 屏東縣 恆春鎮 北門路110巷15號 位於恆春古城北門與東門之間，徒步行走只須3~5分鐘即可到達目的地；離公車轉運站也僅有600公尺，徒步只須6分鐘。入住白居易旅店不僅在晚間可以享受優雅的古城靜瑟氛圍，也可褪去白天從優美風景中所帶回來愉悅感的疲累，能為精打細算的您，量身打造「玩在墾丁，住在恆春」的超值組合。其中北門廣場所助力的戰車亦為知名電影《海角七号》拍攝場景之一，白居易旅店所處地理位置，不論東、北、西三城門皆是幾分鐘步行可到之處，東門廣場保有古城年度盛事─國際搶孤活動，西門廣場則不定時舉辦節慶活動所在地，一址串聯東、北、西、南古城門，悠然徒步老街行。

stays.descriptionEn: 4 Sisters Villa is 2.7 km from Fongchueisha, while Eluanbi Lighthouse is 5 km away. The famous Kenting Main Street can be reached in a 3-minute drive or a 30-minute walk from the property. Car hire and bicycle rental are possible based on request. Our rooms have been designed to guarantee the best comfort to our guests. Devised for relaxation, business, and leisure trips. 4 Sisters Villa offers interiors that masterfully combine luxury and comfort.Each elegant room features air conditioning, wardrobe, flat-screen TV with cable channels, refrigerator and electric kettle. The private bathroom comes with bath or shower facilities, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Certain room types have a private balcony with sea views.Outdoor furniture and a library are provided for all staying guests. The property staff are glad to assist guests with luggage storage and provide touring information. 4 Sisters Villa has an in-house restaurant serving tasty gourmets, local foods and fresh fruits.

stays.name: 邱比特民宿
stays.description: 邱比特民宿位在恆春鎮內，正對面就是海角七號拍攝過的取景點「恆春郵局」，距離「恆春夜市」地點50公尺，鄰近100公尺就是熱門景點海角七號「阿嘉的家」，到「恆春老街」、「恆春轉運站」、「恆春西門城門」、「恆春南門城門」、「猴洞山公園」、「恆春共融遊戲場」等等景點也都在200公尺至500公尺內，交通相當便利。邱比特民宿設有共用休息空間、WiFi（免費）以及豪華寵物貓屋，所有房型都有空調、平面電視、冰箱、吹風機，以及部分房型提供私人衛浴設施，部分房型提供共用衛浴設施，皆提供免費盥洗用品（114年1月1日起不提供一次性個人衛生用品，註明一），住宿提供德國倍世 BWT四道式鎂離子生飲級淨水飲用水及電熱水壺。周圍其他景點設施，距離墾丁大街 10 公里，距離貓鼻頭公園 11 公里，距離四重溪溫泉 13 公里，距離船帆石 13 公里。住宿距離高雄國際機場 90 公里，距離左營高鐵站105公里，提供付費 左營高鐵站 與 高雄國際機場 接駁服務。註明一：114年1月1日起不提供一次性個人衛生用品，既小於180毫升且一次性包裝之液態盥洗及保養用品（洗髮乳、潤髮乳、沐浴乳及乳液）、個人衛生用品（梳子、牙刷、牙膏、刮鬍刀、刮鬍泡及浴帽），以及一次用拖鞋等11類品項。
stays.descriptionEn: Cupid B&B is located in Hengchun Town. It is directly opposite the "Hengchun Post Office", the filming location of Cape No. 7. It is 50 meters away from the "Hengchun Night Market" and 100 meters away is the popular tourist attraction Cape No. 7. "Ajia's Home", go to "Hengchun Old Street", "Hengchun Transfer Station", "Hengchun West Gate", "Hengchun South Gate", "Houdong Mountain Park", "Hengchun Integration Game" Scenic spots such as "Shanghai Stadium" are also within 200 meters to 500 meters, and the transportation is very convenient.Cupid B&B has a shared lounge space, WiFi (free) and a luxurious pet cat house. All room types have air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, refrigerators, hairdryers, and some room types provide private bathroom facilities, while some room types provide shared bathroom facilities, and all provide free toiletries. Supplies (disposable personal hygiene products will not be provided from January 1, 2020, please note 1). The accommodation provides German BWT four-channel magnesium ion drinking grade purified drinking water and an electric kettle.Other surrounding attractions and facilities are 10 kilometers from Kenting Main Street, 11 kilometers from Maobitou Park, 13 kilometers from Sichongxi Hot Spring, and 13 kilometers from Chuanfan Rock. The accommodation is 90 kilometers from Kaohsiung International Airport and 105 kilometers from Zuoying High-speed Railway Station. Paid shuttle service between Zuoying High-speed Railway Station and Kaohsiung International Airport is provided.

stays.descriptionEn: The B&B is located in Hengchun Township, Pingtung County, about a three-minute drive from Houbihu Port. The double suite with sea view (with balcony) has a sea view from the room; the room is all hand-made, unique wooden furniture, the whole building is made of green building materials, without too much gorgeous decoration, presenting a simple beauty, allowing tourists to feel the relaxation of body, mind and soul as soon as they arrive here......The courtyard covers an area of ​​about 1,000 square meters and is designed without light pollution, so you can watch the stars at night. In the early morning, you can stroll in the courtyard, enjoy the chirping of insects and birds, and leisurely feel the sea breeze.You can have a barbecue in the courtyard of the B&B, and we also provide private room service. Pets are also welcome to stay with you!For more details, please contact the reservation hotline: 0901-018-228Or add LINE to serve you ID: @323qxgpm

stays.name: 阿月民宿
stays.description: 阿月民宿位於恆春鎮古蹟城門(北門)附近，是一間重新裝潢開幕的合法民宿，屋內設備簡約、清潔，環境生活機能超強、附近餐廳、便利商店、銀行、郵局等等…路程皆在5-10分鐘內，離附近景點除了墾丁大街、恆春老街、古蹟城門，出火(晚上才能看見的自然生態火光)，還有一年一度恆春鎮公所舉辦的搶孤比賽，非常熱鬧，值得前往最南邊的恆春鎮去瞧瞧！
stays.descriptionEn: A-Yue's B&B is located near Beimen, a historic city gate of Hengchun Township. It has been newly remodeled, and is a licensed B&B. The interior is simple but clean. It's conveniently located near restaurants, convenience stores, bank and post office - all within a 5-10 minute walk away. Nearby attractions include Kenting Road, Hengchun Old Street, Historic City Gate and Fire from the Earth (Natural gas coming through the cracks on the rocks and creates flames when ignited. This can only be seen at night). Also, the annual Qiang Gu Competition, held by the Hengchun Township Office, draws a big crowd. It's worthwhile to come to this southernmost part of Hengchun Township to enjoy all these attractions!

stays.name: 靚南灣
stays.description: 位於屏東縣的民宿靚南灣‧愛墾丁 「墾丁包棟民宿‧靚南灣」鄰近墾丁南灣，前往南灣海灘暢玩沁涼海水僅須一分鐘的車程距離，您隨時都可以徜徉於墾丁專屬的樂活意境。民宿鄰近墾丁主要大道－台26線，前往關山日落、鵝鑾鼻燈塔、船帆石、墾丁大街、白沙灣也都相當方便。 「墾丁包棟民宿‧靚南灣」以包棟出租方式為主，法式的建築外觀浪漫典雅，小巧精緻的前庭、寬敞的公用大廳和親朋好友話家常，更備有電動麻將桌和親友來場方城之戰各顯神通，簡易中島型廚房提供簡易烹煮餐具，讓旅人感受彷彿回到自家般的方便自在。民宿頂樓露台設有簡易燒烤區和親朋好友享受燒烤樂趣，旅人們僅需坐在室內即可輕鬆享受抬頭仰望星空的浪漫。臥房空間則以清新典雅的溫馨氣息恭迎旅人的來臨，希望讓每位來訪的旅人都能在這裡獲得最深層的舒適放鬆。 倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【0912-992809】墾丁包棟民宿‧靚南灣。
stays.descriptionEn: Bed and Breakfast in Pingtung CountyBeautiful Nanwan‧Love Kenting "Kenting Private Bed and Breakfast‧Beautiful Nanwan" is adjacent to Kenting Nanwan. It is only a minute's drive from Nanwan Beach to enjoy the cool water. You can wander in Kenting's exclusive happy mood at any time. The B&B is close to Kenting's main highway - Provincial Route 26. It is also very convenient to go to Guanshan Sunset, Eluanbi Lighthouse, Chuanfan Rock, Kenting Main Street and Baisha Bay. "Kenting Private B&B‧Beautiful Nanwan" mainly rents private rooms. It has a romantic and elegant French-style architectural appearance, a small and exquisite front courtyard, a spacious common hall, where family and friends can chat with each other. It is also equipped with an electric mahjong table for friends and family to show off their skills in a square city battle. A simple island-shaped kitchen provides simple cooking utensils, allowing travelers to feel as convenient and comfortable as if they were back at home. There is a simple barbecue area on the rooftop terrace of the B&B for families and friends to enjoy the barbecue. Travelers can simply sit indoors and enjoy the romance of looking up at the stars. The bedroom space welcomes travelers with a fresh, elegant and warm atmosphere, hoping that every visitor can find the deepest comfort and relaxation here. If you have any questions about your trip or itinerary, please call [0912-992809] Kenting Private Bed and Breakfast‧Beautiful South Bay directly.

stays.name: 靜觀行館
stays.description: 閒來無事不從容，睡覺東窗日已紅。萬物靜觀皆自得，四時佳興與人同。道通天地有形外，思入風雲變態中，富貴不淫貧賤樂，男兒到此是豪雄。－「秋日偶成」宋朝程顥靜～下心，聽浪濤拍打上岸的細語觀～視野，一幕幕海洋山巒的美景熱力四射的日陽高掛天際，蔚藍天際中飄浮著朵朵白雲，四季如春的南國墾丁，熱情迎接每一位前來放鬆、渡假的旅人。奔馳於通往墾丁的道路上，不論是伴隨的綠意山景，或是時現時隱的海洋景觀，渾然天成的山巒海景，總是令人內心不禁充滿著喜悅與感動。「墾丁住宿～靜觀行館」以船帆石屹立在海邊符合宋朝詩人程颢秋日偶成的意境命名，鄰近船帆石沙難，步行二分鐘即可輕撫貝殼沙灘，盡情玩樂各項水上活動。在民宿建築中，以全新房間設計、裝潢，將帶給每一位住宿旅人全新感受，採用與五星級飯店相同材質的床具、進口羽絨被等舒適設備，享有最輕鬆、無負擔的好眠品質。提供一處優質的住宿環境，「墾丁住宿～靜觀行館」設有電梯、無線網路等設備，不需提著大小包行李疲憊爬樓梯，也可和親朋好友隨時分享悠閒的墾丁渡假。若想深度暢玩、探索美麗的墾丁，我們也可為您量身打造專屬行程，不論是上山或是下海，都將讓您留下最難忘的南國印像。倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【08-8851555】墾丁民宿～靜觀行館。～2013年榮獲Agoda.com全球傑飯店指標「金環獎」四星級評鑑～

stays.description: 我們共有6間雙人房、2間四人房，每間皆為合法民宿！房間約7坪以上，皆有陽台｜大廳備有電梯、飲水機、微波爐、咖啡機｜提供4台腳踏車供旅人預約免費使用｜提供幼兒澡盆、小椅凳｜磁卡進出房間（防火門）｜50吋螢幕搭配近80個頻道網路電視（亦有Youtube）｜房間獨立WIFI｜日立冷氣｜Queen size大床｜簡約風化妝台｜沙發椅和小茶几｜大同小冰箱｜Kolin快煮壺｜提供港口茶包、三合一咖啡包｜洋蔥焦糖薄片、華珍福爾摩莎手燒煎餅-黑豆口味｜歐萊德O'right洗沐潤乳、毛巾、浴巾、拖鞋等盥洗用品｜浴室乾溼分離｜HCG水洗免治馬桶｜吹風機｜提供刷卡、國旅卡、Line Pay、街口、台灣Pay等支付方式。不論是想優閒宅、想在玩累回來舒爽的睡場好覺都很適合朋友、情侶、夫妻或家庭入住唷！

stays.name: 飾浰浦睡民宿
stays.description: sleep inn旅店位於恆春鎮外環道上，是一間工業風非常濃厚且有質感的旅店，一進廳內便看見黑與灰色調的傢俱擺設，在大廳中央設計一區高腳桌椅的吧檯，很有情調的酒吧氛圍，挑高天花板顯得整間空間寬敞自在，而大廳後區隔出一間遊戲室，入住民宿也能享樂到不一樣的玩樂。 客房規劃在二樓至四樓，每個地方都有巧思規劃，住在這裡絕對不會感到無趣，每間必有它的顏色與擺設，客房與衛浴空間設計流暢又懷舊，不得不說每間小編我都愛也都很有特色，但唯一不同的一間四樓房間是除了空間大，還能從大片窗戶看見美麗夕陽之外，最喜歡它的獨立戶外陽台了，不是一般陽台喔...是有經過設計的造景陽台，不管白天還是夜晚都有不同的美色，走到房間又走到陽台，這麼大的空間都是你的，所以這間才取名-First Class整層都是我的，如果你喜歡工業風住宅或者還沒體驗住過粗獷工業風的朋友，非常推薦這間sleep inn，主人小吳也很健談，找個機會到墾丁試試不一樣的新感受吧~

stays.description: 曾經養育一家子長大的藥廠舊址，經過第二代努力重建與裝潢，以極簡風格作為基調， 通透的玻璃帷幕，將一大片依傍成長的陽光帶回這個熟悉的位置； 我們期待每一隅光影與自然色彩，陪伴即將來到住宿及用餐的人們， 即使一個短暫週末、或是一段夏日假期，都能讓您感受藍天白雲的溫暖力量， 於住宿期間感受我們的熱忱與款待。 黑牛角善用灰白牆面及低調裝潢，以保留自然光線折射時的光影變換。 在此能夠忘卻都市生活的繁忙駁雜，盡情享受陽光之美好。

stays.name: 帆船會館
stays.description: 在Sailing Inn 的和室落地窗前看書最棒了。陽光偷偷灑在身上發亮，抬眼是綠草芳菲、生氣盎然，風從芒果樹下跑過，追逐著蟲鳴鳥囀，伴在字裏行間時便是舒適愉悅。屋前的草皮長上高大的椰子樹和綻開的九重葛相映於藍天裡搖曳，泳池的波光反射裡藏著桃紅粉黛的落花，戲水時有花相伴，氛圍多少的恬靜雅緻。一排長型窗裡瞅見偌大的客廳，中島流理台下列著多少原文小說，吉他斜倚在沙發旁，誰走過撥弦出一曲清脆嘹亮，唱和於彼此間的笑語歡暢。你還能光著腳在三樓的露台看夕陽，看遠方的鵬灣橋後勾著亮橘色的落日，雲都捲上了粉紫色的邊，星星正偷偷閃爍，在南國的夏夜晚風裡伴著旅人共眠。小鎮裡望遠有山，眼前是鵬灣佐海，在緩慢自在的步調裡，來過上漁港生活的歲月靜好。

stays.name: 幸福灣民宿
stays.description: 民宿位於屏東縣東港鎮，這裡有著溫暖的陽光、遼闊的大海、迷人的自然景觀，值得您來走一趟，享受輕旅行。主要以藍白色系相間打造出地中海風情外觀，民宿內公共空間佐以歐式鄉村風格讓空間呈現出慵懶的氛圍。館內提供二至多人房型，不論三五好友或是親子家庭...等，各種組合的旅客皆能找到適合的休憩空間，每間房間皆有不同主題，希望讓每位到來的旅人都能夠享有愉快放鬆的渡假時光。本館所在位置，無論是大眾交通工具(公車Bus:9127)、國道3號(林邊/東港交流道)都能抵達，無論進入東港市區或是南下墾丁都相當便利，周邊景點有鵬灣跨海大橋、大鵬灣賽車場...等，距離東港夜市與東港東琉線碼頭約3-5分鐘車程。
stays.descriptionEn: The B&B is located in Donggang Town, Pingtung County, where there is warm sunshine, vast sea and charming natural scenery. It is worth a visit to enjoy a light trip.The Mediterranean-style exterior is mainly created with blue and white colors, and the public space in the homestay is decorated with European country style to give the space a lazy atmosphere.The hotel provides rooms for two or more people. Whether it is a group of three or five friends or a family, all kinds of travelers can find a suitable resting space. Each room has a different theme, hoping that every traveler who comes here can enjoy a happy and relaxing vacation.The hotel is located in a convenient location, accessible by public transportation (Bus: 9127) and National Highway 3 (Linbian/Donggang Interchange). It is very convenient to enter Donggang City or go south to Kenting. The surrounding attractions include Pengwan Cross-sea Bridge, Dapeng Bay Race Track, etc. It is about 3-5 minutes' drive from Donggang Night Market and Donggang Dongliu Line Pier.

stays.name: 幸福風帆渡假民宿
stays.description: 『與幸福的夢想相遇』一直以來，男女主人 都有一個共同的夢想，要如何讓外地的旅客放慢腳步停留在東港，慢慢品味東港的人文及東港的美，而不是來去匆匆..無意間遇見一棟美麗的建築物，揭起女主人想法，決定買下它、並把它打造成一棟風格獨特、溫馨滿滿的民宿-《幸福風帆 渡假民宿》入住《幸福風帆 渡假民宿》 女主人有別於其他民宿所提供的制式早餐、而是自己親手烹煮無菜單料理、菜色都是以當地當季的新鮮食材來設計、希望入住的每一個客人都能品嚐到，熱騰騰又豐盛的早餐，每一口都有幸福的感覺，讓您在旅遊中，能『睡的舒服、吃的幸福』。《幸福風帆 渡假民宿》 每個房間都非常的寬敞舒適、而且每個房間內有許多《男主人》手工製作的原木 擺設，如森林風的 掛衣架、床框、燈具..海洋風的船槳 大廳的吃飯鐘、原木花架、庭園的石雕畫框、風車、還有每間房間的門牌號，都有意境造型，還有木製門牌號鑰匙圈，有好多的手工創意，歡迎親臨感受。東港是一個純樸的小漁村，東港人好客樸實，東港擁有豐富鮮美的漁產、以及百年宗教文化，和許多的美食名店，在東港，您可以隨意的到處走走，或是悠閒的騎著腳踏車遊樂大鵬灣，青洲樂園，水上驛站。美麗多元的《大鵬灣 國家風景區》內，自然生態豐富，更是運動天堂，每年舉辦的星光路跑、自行車比賽、風帆比賽、長泳競渡、獨木舟、卡丁車、賽車、獨木舟、風帆船、沙灘車，就能讓您玩上一整天，令人流漣忘返。黃昏後可以到華僑市場 品美食，買漁產。隔天也可以從東港搭船前往小琉球，享受另一個海洋行程。

stays.searchText: 幸福風帆渡假民宿 幸福風帆渡假民宿 屏東縣民宿381號 屏東縣 東港鎮 沿海5路208巷71號 『與幸福的夢想相遇』一直以來，男女主人 都有一個共同的夢想，要如何讓外地的旅客放慢腳步停留在東港，慢慢品味東港的人文及東港的美，而不是來去匆匆..無意間遇見一棟美麗的建築物，揭起女主人想法，決定買下它、並把它打造成一棟風格獨特、溫馨滿滿的民宿-《幸福風帆 渡假民宿》入住《幸福風帆 渡假民宿》 女主人有別於其他民宿所提供的制式早餐、而是自己親手烹煮無菜單料理、菜色都是以當地當季的新鮮食材來設計、希望入住的每一個客人都能品嚐到，熱騰騰又豐盛的早餐，每一口都有幸福的感覺，讓您在旅遊中，能『睡的舒服、吃的幸福』。《幸福風帆 渡假民宿》 每個房間都非常的寬敞舒適、而且每個房間內有許多《男主人》手工製作的原木 擺設，如森林風的 掛衣架、床框、燈具..海洋風的船槳 大廳的吃飯鐘、原木花架、庭園的石雕畫框、風車、還有每間房間的門牌號，都有意境造型，還有木製門牌號鑰匙圈，有好多的手工創意，歡迎親臨感受。東港是一個純樸的小漁村，東港人好客樸實，東港擁有豐富鮮美的漁產、以及百年宗教文化，和許多的美食名店，在東港，您可以隨意的到處走走，或是悠閒的騎著腳踏車遊樂大鵬灣，青洲樂園，水上驛站。美麗多元的《大鵬灣 國家風景區》內，自然生態豐富，更是運動天堂，每年舉辦的星光路跑、自行車比賽、風帆比賽、長泳競渡、獨木舟、卡丁車、賽車、獨木舟、風帆船、沙灘車，就能讓您玩上一整天，令人流漣忘返。黃昏後可以到華僑市場 品美食，買漁產。隔天也可以從東港搭船前往小琉球，享受另一個海洋行程。

stays.name: 愛晴海民宿
stays.description: 「愛晴海」其實很簡單就是「愛上晴空萬里的海洋」。民宿位於屏東縣東港鎮，這裡有著溫暖的陽光、遼闊的大海、迷人的自然景觀(晨曦、黃昏、星月)，這裡承載著一家人長久以來的夢想，想和大家分享我們從小到大的家鄉，值得您來走一趟，享受輕旅行。以藍白色系相間打造出充滿海洋風情的外觀，民宿內公共空間延續著相同的風格，並佐以鄉村氣息讓空間呈現出慵懶不拘的氛圍。館內提供二至多人房型，亦有溜滑梯親子房供親子家庭入住，讓不論各種組合的旅人都能找到適合的休憩空間，並以不同主題打造出各具特色風格房間，令人感到舒服放鬆，希望讓每位到來的旅人都能夠享有難忘愜意的渡假時光。我們所在的區域，無論是大眾交通工具(公車Bus:9127)、國道3號(林邊/東港交流道)都能抵達，無論進入東港市區或是南下墾丁都相當便利，周邊景點有鵬灣跨海大橋、大鵬灣賽車場...等，距離東港夜市與東港東琉線碼頭約3-5分鐘車程。
stays.descriptionEn: Enjoy staying in the warm sun and blue sky. All spacious rooms have independent bathroom equipment, which can satisfy different types of passengers.Traveling does not require purpose, what you need is to release your impulse.

stays.name: 月掬31行館
stays.description: 「東港民宿‧月掬31行館」位於東港夜市附近，鄰近大鵬灣國家風景區、東港渡船頭、華僑市場、海產街、東隆宮…等熱門景點，且附近設有許多飲食商店極為便利。旅客們可騎乘摩托車至大鵬灣國家風景區，體驗各種水上設施，或是搭乘生態船探索濕地的奧妙，刺激的賽車場更值得挑戰，多項設備應有盡有。到了夜晚美景美不勝收，海水光雕秀更是壯觀。著名的華僑市場提供新鮮美味的海鮮料理，保證令人大飽口福，也不能錯過東港三寶「黑鮪魚、烏魚子、櫻花蝦」。每三年一科王船繞境盛事歡迎各位旅客一同共享當地的風俗文化及熱忱。而每4~6月當地舉行黑鮪魚文化觀光季，結合在地特色舉辦遊街及拍賣會，也請知名歌手high翻全場，另可品嚐鮮美黑鮪魚，簡直是場視、聽、味覺的饗宴。月掬31行館秉持著熱情服務及簡約活潑風格，招待每一位入住的旅客，本館共有5間套房，每間風格皆為不同，並室外打造出一座空中花園，讓入住的旅客擁有舒適又放鬆的空間，享受在外的悠閒時刻。若您須訂房或想進一步了解任何問題，請與【月掬31行館】聯繫，電話【0900-111-883】。
stays.descriptionEn: YUE JU 31 B&B is located around Donggang Night Market, Surrounded in the neighborhood of Dapeng Bay National Scenic Area, Donggang Ferry Terminal, Hua Qiao Market, Seafood Street, Donglong Temple, lots of famous spots and soon. There are very convenient, plenty of restaurants nearby.Visitors can ride the motorcycles to Dapeng Bay National Scenic Area, experience water activities or take the ecological boat to explore the wonders of wetland. Also you can challenge the racetrack, plenty of equipment that can fit all your needs. The night scene was glamorous, and the Water Light Show was stunning.Famous Hua Qiao Market provide Delicious and fresh seafood, you can’t miss Three Treasures of Donggang,” Bluefin tuna, Oilfish, Sakura shrimp "will totally feast your appetite.The King Boat Ceremony is held every three years; we welcome visitors come to feel the local customs, culture and enthusiasm. Pingtung BlueFin Tuna Cultural Festival held on every April to June will invited famous singer creating an atmosphere of enjoyment, it’s a great sense of vision, hearing, taste of the feast. 31 Hotel has initiative fully enthusiasm and lively service to invite all our visitors. 31 Hotel have 5 suites with different styles. Also we have an outdoor creation, Sky Garden, a place for you to relax and enjoy the casual moment staying outdoor. If you have any further questions or you would like to make a reservation, please contact with 31 Hotel.Tel: 0900-111-883

stays.description: 樂遊趣民宿以古典珍珠白彩繪傢俱搭配主題色彩, 營造出浪漫與清新的鄉村風格, 一個溫馨的地方. 民宿管家曾媽媽以在地人迎接賓客的心,讓遠方的旅客感受到如自家般溫暖與舒適的住宿環境. 樂遊趣民宿誠摯地邀請您一起發現大鵬灣, 小琉球碧海藍天共一色之美.
stays.descriptionEn: Leyouqu B&B uses antique pearl white painted furnitures as the main focus in each room, and matches them with different color beddings and wall color. The antique pearl white bed frames are also painted with pictures to match the color of the room. The decor evokes a warm, refreshing and romantic country-style home. Housekeeper Mama Ceng treats guests with warm local hospitality and helps guests who travelled a long distance to feel warm and comfortable in an inviting environment. Leyouqu B&B sincerely invites you to come to Pingtung to see the picturesque Dapeng Bay and Xiaoliuqiu.

stays.name: 東港海風民宿
stays.description: 在2013年重新進行了裝修後，無論是來屏東出差還是休閒旅遊，您都可在東港海風民宿得到滿意的服務。 這家飯店離東港市中心僅隔0.5 km，方便遊客外出。 飯店位置優越讓遊人前往市區內的熱門景點變得方便快捷。 東港海風民宿提供優質貼心的服務和方便實用的設施，贏得了客人的普遍好評。 客人可享受飯店的一些服務：單車出租, 旅遊行程, 定點接駁服務, 機場接送, 公共區域Wi-Fi。 此外，這裡的所有客房配有各種舒適的房內設施。許多房間甚至還提供了衛星頻道/有線電視, 空調, 無線上網(免費), 禁菸房來滿足客人的需求。 除此之外，飯店各種娛樂設施一定會讓您在留宿期間享受更多樂趣。 不管您是哪一種類型的遊客，東港海風民宿都是來屏東的理想下榻飯店。
stays.descriptionEn: If what you're looking for is a conveniently located hotel in Pingtung, look no further than Hi Fun House. With its location just 0.5 km from the city center and from the airport, this 2-star hotel attracts numerous travelers each year. With its convenient location, the hotel offers easy access to the city's must-see destinations. Hi Fun House offers impeccable service and all the essential amenities to invigorate travelers. The hotel offers access to a vast array of services, including shared lounge/TV area, BBQ facilities, luggage storage, airport transfer, shuttle service. Hi Fun House is home to 8 bedrooms. All are tastefully furnished and many even provide such comforts as non smoking rooms, television, hair dryer, air conditioning, internet access – wireless (complimentary). Besides, the hotel's host of recreational offerings ensures you have plenty to do during your stay. Hi Fun House is your one-stop destination for quality hotel accommodations in Pingtung.

stays.name: 東港許願宿民宿
stays.description: 「屏東東港民宿‧許願宿民宿」鄰近大鵬灣、東港碼頭、東隆宮及青洲遊憩區…等熱門景點，也是前往小琉球最好的中繼休息站。旅人們可騎乘自行車沿著大鵬灣自行車道繞行；也可至擁有陽光和海洋風情的沙灘踏遊；或可乘船至小琉球來場海洋小島之旅；還可至林邊體驗路亞釣遊的樂趣；更可深入體會南台灣的在地文化和風土民情。
stays.descriptionEn: "Pingtung Donggang Bed and Breakfast．Donggang Wish & Dreaming B & B" is near popular attractions, such as Dapeng Bay, Tungkang Port, Donglong Temple, and Chingchou Ocean Recreation Area, etc. It also serves as rest stop before you go to Liuqiu. Travelers can ride bicycles along the Dapeng Bay cycle path or play on the beach with the sun and the sea. Or they can get on a boat to go to Liuqiu for a ocean island trip. They can go to Linbian Township for lure fishing or deeply experience the local culture, customs and practices in South Taiwan.

stays.descriptionEn: Chen, the host of Water Reflections at Ease B&B near Dapeng Bay, is fond of the thick, solid and solid touch of logs; thus, he has been gathering logs. He got to know a woodcarving expert of Sanyi by chance, and they became close friends due to their passion towards logs. Chen starts to design on the logs, and the expert will perform the woodcarving works. Each piece of log is unique, and the expert keeps the natural character of the logs when carving. Chen wants to build a house for these woodcarving works - Water Reflections at Ease B&B. There is a piece of distinctive woodcarving work in each corner of the house, and every bed, table and chair is special and unique. Water Reflections at Ease B&B is Chen's dream come true.

stays.description: 房間陽台上，大鵬灣的美景一覽無遺，讓借由旅行放鬆的旅客，在海闊天空的美景下，心靈可以充分的休息。室內備有電梯，讓想登高望遠的旅客，不用帶著大包小包的行李爬樓梯，輕鬆享受旅程。有別一般民宿只是裝潢美美的，玉灣鵬灣民宿除了室內裝潢不馬虎之外， 特別在每間房間鋪設隔音棉，吸震地板，氣密窗，膠合玻璃，吸音窗簾，將噪音減至最低，就是要給住宿的旅客有最優質的住宿品質。 比旅客更在乎住宿品質的細節，為求旅客在旅程中享受充分的休息與放鬆。 步行1分鐘即可抵達大鵬灣環湖道路，開車2分鐘即可抵達大鵬灣管理處的行政中心、國際賽車場、青州濱海遊憩區，開車3分鐘即可抵達東港市中心，開車5分鐘即可抵達東港著名古蹟東隆宮，開車7分鐘即可抵達小琉球渡船碼頭。 有無比的海景，有優質的房間，有專業的咖啡，有親製的早餐，有親切的主人，有方便的地理位置。 玉灣鵬灣民宿真的是東港、大鵬灣優質民宿的首選 歡迎來大鵬灣玩的朋友親自來體驗看看~~
stays.descriptionEn: From the balcony of the room, you can have an unobstructed view of the beautiful scenery of Dapeng Bay, so that travelers who are relaxing during travel can fully rest their minds under the beautiful scenery of the vast sea and sky. There is an elevator indoors, so travelers who want to climb high and see far away can enjoy the journey easily without having to carry large and small luggage up the stairs. Different from ordinary B&Bs that only have beautiful decorations, Yuwan Pengwan B&B not only has an impeccable interior decoration, but also specially lays sound insulation cotton, shock-absorbing floors, air-tight windows, laminated glass, and sound-absorbing curtains in each room to minimize noise. It is to provide the highest quality accommodation to the guests staying there. We care more about the details of accommodation quality than tourists, so that tourists can enjoy sufficient rest and relaxation during the journey. It takes 1 minute to walk to the Dapeng Bay Lake Road, 2 minutes to drive to the administrative center of the Dapeng Bay Management Office, the International Circuit, and Qingzhou Coastal Recreation Area, 3 minutes to drive to the center of Donggang, and 5 minutes to drive. You can reach the famous historical site Donglong Palace in Donggang, and it takes 7 minutes to drive to Xiaoliuqiu Ferry Terminal. There are incomparable sea views, high-quality rooms, professional coffee, homemade breakfast, kind hosts, and convenient location. Yuwan Pengwan B&B is really the first choice for high-quality B&Bs in Donggang and Dapeng Bay. Friends who come to Dapeng Bay are welcome to experience it for themselves~~

stays.searchText: 玉灣鵬灣民宿 玉灣鵬灣民宿 屏東縣民宿536號 屏東縣 東港鎮 嘉新一街26號 房間陽台上，大鵬灣的美景一覽無遺，讓借由旅行放鬆的旅客，在海闊天空的美景下，心靈可以充分的休息。室內備有電梯，讓想登高望遠的旅客，不用帶著大包小包的行李爬樓梯，輕鬆享受旅程。有別一般民宿只是裝潢美美的，玉灣鵬灣民宿除了室內裝潢不馬虎之外， 特別在每間房間鋪設隔音棉，吸震地板，氣密窗，膠合玻璃，吸音窗簾，將噪音減至最低，就是要給住宿的旅客有最優質的住宿品質。 比旅客更在乎住宿品質的細節，為求旅客在旅程中享受充分的休息與放鬆。 步行1分鐘即可抵達大鵬灣環湖道路，開車2分鐘即可抵達大鵬灣管理處的行政中心、國際賽車場、青州濱海遊憩區，開車3分鐘即可抵達東港市中心，開車5分鐘即可抵達東港著名古蹟東隆宮，開車7分鐘即可抵達小琉球渡船碼頭。 有無比的海景，有優質的房間，有專業的咖啡，有親製的早餐，有親切的主人，有方便的地理位置。 玉灣鵬灣民宿真的是東港、大鵬灣優質民宿的首選 歡迎來大鵬灣玩的朋友親自來體驗看看~~

stays.description: 留下旅舍於2014年成立，是東港第一家背包旅館，位於大鵬灣環灣道路旁。 我們提供上下舖房，並有包房的折扣，住宿的房客可免費使用我們所提供的腳踏車去探索東港小鎮裡古老廟宇、小巷弄和海景，看看海口人的生活方式；在東港，您可以享用到最鮮美的海鮮與嘗試各式各樣的水上活動，也可看到百年黃金牌樓、廟宇與大鵬灣環灣道路的美麗風光，其中三年一次的燒王船慶典與東港的華僑市場更是不容錯過的，歡迎您來細細品味東港風光，和我們一起享受海風與海港人的生活。

stays.name: 綠芳水岸民宿
stays.description: 「屏東東港民宿‧綠芳水岸」位於東港鎮內，鄰近東港漁港漁產品直銷中心(原華僑市場)、小琉球交通船碼頭、進德大橋、大鵬灣風景區、東隆宮…等熱門景點，不論旅人們欲品嚐新鮮肥美的黑鮪魚等魚貨料理，或想要深入探索東港特有的人文風情；亦或是計畫前往景色明媚的小琉球來場放鬆之旅，這裡都能成為您最佳的休息中繼站。「屏東東港民宿‧綠芳水岸」周邊景色怡人，環境清幽而寧靜。白日您可在民宿頂樓遠眺蔚藍海景和小琉球島嶼。夜幕時分，林園工業區的繁華夜景，以及進德大橋紅色的橋身搭配璀燦的燈光秀，更是璀燦奪目。民宿提供寬敞潔淨、時尚高雅的二人、四人及六人的套房房型，俐落的風格設計搭配完善的家電設備，帶給旅人猶如商務旅社般的高品質住宿享受。
stays.descriptionEn: "Pingtung Donggang Bed and Breakfast．Lu-Fang B&B" sits in the Donggang Township and is near popular attractions, such as the Donggang Fishery Port Marine Product Direct Sale Center (formerly known as Hua Qiao Market), Liuqiu Shuttle Boat Port, Jinde Bridge, Dapeng Bay, and Donglong Temple. No matter whether visitors want to eat fresh and big Blackfin tuna or explore local culture, customs and practices, or plan to go to Liuqiu with beautiful sceneries for a relaxing trip, this is the best rest place for them. "Pingtung Donggang Bed and Breakfast．Lu-Fang B&B" The sceneries in the surrounding is pleasant to the eyes with a quiet and peaceful environment. You can overlook the blue and Liuqiu Island on the rooftop of the B&B in the daytime. At night, the Linyuan Industrial Park has a bustling night view and a dazzling light show will be performed on the Jinde Bridge. The B&B provides clean, spacious, and elegant Twin, Quad, and Six-People suites. The neat style and design are complemented with comprehensive household appliances which make visitors have good accommodation experience.

stays.name: 芳鄰民宿
stays.description: 民宿介紹:(芳鄰民宿)就如同字面一樣是一間友善,有別於一般民宿只提供[床]和[簡易早餐].在歐式快樂鄉村風格中,一進門就如同回到家中自在沒有任何拘束.但管家們己經悄悄的為您準備了以下的服務:一,食:第一道:管家為你準備了第一道(暖胃豆漿)。管家特製的豆漿不僅口感滑順、味道更是濃郁香純，有別於市面上的一般豆漿哦！ 第二道:蛋(不老蛋)。這也是管家逼著家人吃了近百顆的蛋才決定了蛋的熟度及搭配的醬油。 第三道:沙拉(鮮蝦沙拉)。這道沙拉不僅有最新鮮的口味，再搭配特調的醬汁，吃起來非常爽口。 第四道: (東港海鮮)。也許是整塊整塊的花枝丸，也許是一條美味的魷魚，也許是烤得香味四溢的風螺。這是一值得你期待的餐點。 第五道:在地特色小吃。烤饅頭、蔬菜燒餅、肉粿、飯湯、肉圓.....等。 第六道：(咖啡或紅茶)。最後一道是管家為您親自手工現磨現泡的飲料！二,極佳地理位置大鵬灣:步行約2分鐘東港市區:步行約10分鐘麥當勞：步行約10分鐘東港夜市:步行約15分鐘跨海大橋：步行約15分鐘東隆宮：步行約15分鐘三、住：我們為您準備了King sixe的大床(國際標準尺寸),讓你舒舒服服的缷下一天的疲累,你更可以在房間內遠眺[大武山]近觀[大鵬灣]夜賞跨海大橋的[光雕秀].四,行:代租腳踏車五,娛樂:芳鄰有規劃多樣好玩的套裝行程，如果你不知道怎麼玩?不用擔心,芳鄰作你免費的專業導遊,更可以陪你一起挑戰極限.若有任可疑問歡迎打管家專線: 0988-610-213***為嚮應環保芳鄰民宿已加入環保旅宿行列，即日起將不主動提供一次即丟盥洗用品短期續住不更換毛巾及床單床被套。網址:funnybnb.com
stays.descriptionEn: Introduce of the B&B: (Funny B&B) Just like its name, Funny B&B is a friendly B&B with fun. Different from other B&B which only offers a bed and simple breakfast, we give you a different feast. After you go into the room, you may feel free, just like being at home, while the housekeepers have prepared the following services for you: I. Delicacy: 1st dish: The housekeeper has prepared a cup of warm soybean milk. The specially-made soybean milk tastes smooth and rich. It is different from the one sold on the market! 2nd dish: Eggs (soft-boiled eggs) The housekeeper and his family have eaten about 100 eggs to find out the perfect way to boil eggs with the ideal degree of doneness and the proper joy sauce. 3rd dish: Salad (shrimp salad) The housekeeper uses the freshest vegetables with the proper dressing, a refreshing taste! 4th dish: (Donggang Seafood) It could be fried cuttlefish balls, a tasty squid or grilled escargot with aroma. It is a delicacy you should try. 5th dish: Local snack Such as grilled bun, sesame flat bread with vegetables, pork rice pudding, rice soup, Ba Wan. 6th dish: (Coffee or black tea) It could be freshly ground coffee, or the housekeeper would make you a pot of black tea. II. A great location. It won't take too much time to walk to the tourist spots from here.Dapeng Bay: 2-minute walkDonggang downtown: 10-minute walkMcDonald's: 10-minute walkDonggang Night Market: 15-minute walkDapeng Bay Bridge: 15-minute walkDonglong Temple: 15-minute walkIII. Accommodation: We have prepared the standard king size beds for you to rest and relax. In the room, you can look far at [Dawu Mountain], view [Dapeng Bay] and enjoy the [projection mapping show] over Dapeng Bay Bridge.IV. Transportation:We will arrange rentedbicycles for you.V. Entertainment: We offer various fun package tours, and we can be the tour guide for you if necessary. If you have any questions, please call the direct line: 0988-610-213***In order to being environmental friendly, we will not provide single-use toiletries. We will not change towels, bed sheets and duvet covers for customers for short extension. Website: funnybnb.com

stays.name: 輕旅宿民宿
stays.description: 輕旅宿--青年旅舍 自由行旅人的家輕旅宿位於東港鎮博愛街全聯福利中心左斜對面。輕旅宿整體設計風格是採藍白相間的地中海風情，所以一走進迎客大廳，您就能感受到椰風俆俆，放鬆 愉悅撲面而來！輕旅宿共有四層，一樓迎賓大廳，二 三樓一房八床，四樓一房六床，另在二樓有個迴廊可以三兩好友泡茶品咖啡，也可以烤肉做活動，四樓有個約四坪大的陽台，可眺覽街景，觀賞東港溪 進德橋 夜間漁火，可說東港全貌盡在眼前腳下！從旅宿前門左轉就是東港溪觀光堤岸和傳說中滿街香醇四溢的咖啡街，再往前眺，可見豔光四射的黯夜彩虹拱橋，琉球渡船場，生猛海鮮華僑市場。當然您可至觀海亭看日出觀夕陽，與點點星火的海域和迷幻的夜琉球say hello。更愰論老饕心目中的東港美食雙糕潤 燒烤饅頭 肉粿 旗魚黑輪…盡在百尺之內！還有還有，大鵬灣洋帆 青州衝浪奔馳沙灘車 左岸右岸看生態 渡輪環灣遊 大鵬灣上登蚵島…等等，都可以在民宿主人指引，甚或導覽中一一玩透透！ 您是省錢一族，可又嚮往到此一遊？那找輕旅宿就對了，500至700元一宿，便宜又可以玩遍東港 !等您來喔！訂房專線08-83334430966869443提供全棟WIFI共用浴室皆備有吹風機一樓提供共用冰溫熱飲水機無附早餐，盥洗用具請自備，無特別說明房型皆為上下舖男女混住，如需男女分住，請事先提出需求！我們的地址為：屏東縣東港鎮博愛街171-9號（全聯福利中心東港博愛店斜對面）

stays.name: 鐵馬騎跡
stays.description: 歷經十幾年來忙碌於工作的節奏裡，近年做了一個重大的調整，將運動帶入平常的生活中，其中又以游泳、跑步及騎車為主。當進行這些運動時，開始注意到生活週遭人、事、物的變化，而這是之前全力投入在工作且回家就不想動的日子裡所未能體驗的。運動除了讓我保持健康，意外地讓自己步調也開始放慢了，慢到開始發現另一個美好的空間。而這空間值得每次花個幾小時與自己對話、與他人輕鬆閒聊、並向大自然問聲好。清晨慢跑在馬路上，穿越街頭巷尾可以感受每日吵雜前的寧靜；單車騎乘在公路上，跨越不同鄉鎮可以看到各地風景特色，舒暢的揮灑著汗水，享受著許多不可思議的驚喜。鐡馬騎跡建構與提供這樣的機會，讓忙碌的您給自己或帶著家人、朋友一起放慢節奏，並抱著輕鬆愉悅的心情，讓鐡馬輪轉環繞大鵬灣及漫遊東港小鎮，藉著放慢步伐，盡情享受吃、喝、玩、樂並留下回憶無窮的足跡。

stays.name: 浩斯國際-枋客文旅
stays.description: 每次的停留都是種享受，享受從 #枋客文旅 開始...枋客文旅坐落於屏東平原中央－枋寮，後有壯闊大武山，伸擁屏東平原與恆春半島，前有湛藍台灣海峽，遠眺遼闊海洋。枋寮是往來南台灣的交會重鎮。在台1線、台17線與鐵路南迴線上看顧往返於高雄、墾丁、台東的旅客，更有著蘊養在地數十載的枋寮漁港。2018年起，#枋客文旅在此為停留的旅人預留一段悠閒時光。 休憩住宿、會議集思空間，輕鬆享有面海大落地窗景房，悠浮於無邊際泳池中，擁抱金黃色的海天一線。走出房門，枋客文旅也協助旅人探索枋寮秘境、規劃社區漫步路線感受在地生活、安排F3藝文特區體驗、品嘗在地鮮活漁人料理枋寮轉瞬之間與美好，等您親臨感受。
stays.descriptionEn: Every stay is a pleasure—begin your enjoyment with Fangliahotel.Nestled in the heart of the Pingtung Plain—Fangliao, Fangke Inn is embraced by the majestic Dawu Mountain to the rear, stretching across the Pingtung Plain and Hengchun Peninsula, while facing the deep blue Taiwan Strait with sweeping ocean views.Fangliao serves as a vital hub in southern Taiwan, located along Provincial Highways 1 and 17, and the South-Link Railway. It welcomes travelers journeying between Kaohsiung, Kenting, and Taitung, and is home to the Fangliao Fishing Port, which has nurtured the local community for decades.Since 2018, Fangke Inn has been reserving moments of leisure for travelers passing through. Whether it’s restful accommodation or inspiring meeting spaces, guests can unwind in ocean-view rooms with expansive floor-to-ceiling windows, float in the infinity pool, and embrace the golden horizon where sea meets sky.Step outside your room, and Fangliahotel will guide you to uncover Fangliao’s hidden gems—plan a stroll through local neighborhoods, experience the vibrant F3 Art Zone, and indulge in fresh, locally-sourced seafood prepared with fishermen’s craftsmanship.Fangliao’s fleeting beauty awaits your discovery—come and feel it for yourself.

stays.searchText: 浩斯國際-枋客文旅 浩斯國際股份有限公司屏東分公司 屏東縣旅館123號 屏東縣 枋寮鄉 中興路22-19號 每次的停留都是種享受，享受從 #枋客文旅 開始...枋客文旅坐落於屏東平原中央－枋寮，後有壯闊大武山，伸擁屏東平原與恆春半島，前有湛藍台灣海峽，遠眺遼闊海洋。枋寮是往來南台灣的交會重鎮。在台1線、台17線與鐵路南迴線上看顧往返於高雄、墾丁、台東的旅客，更有著蘊養在地數十載的枋寮漁港。2018年起，#枋客文旅在此為停留的旅人預留一段悠閒時光。 休憩住宿、會議集思空間，輕鬆享有面海大落地窗景房，悠浮於無邊際泳池中，擁抱金黃色的海天一線。走出房門，枋客文旅也協助旅人探索枋寮秘境、規劃社區漫步路線感受在地生活、安排F3藝文特區體驗、品嘗在地鮮活漁人料理枋寮轉瞬之間與美好，等您親臨感受。

stays.name: 蘭心山莊民宿
stays.description: 民宿位置於台一線東港往墾丁省道〈438.6K〉水底寮加油站旁，東側有大武山、大漢山山脈，西側有小硫球、枋寮漁港，石班魚、海蝦專業養殖區，四周有寬廣農田，生產黑珍珠蓮霧、愛文芒果、鳳梨、蔬果等；旁有蘭欣山莊農場生產世界級最辣鬼椒與DIY加工體驗。房間設備新穎，內有42吋液晶電視、雙人按摩浴缸(超大浴室)、乾濕分離SPA淋浴柱、六尺席夢思透氣彈簧床、沙發床組、無塵防火木質地板、3噸分離式冷氣、按摩椅，設有專用停車空間與免費西式早餐。 101~102年獲屏東林管處生態旅遊合作住宿商家，2011年獲屏東縣政府藝文旅宿合作商家，2012年獲交通部觀光局好客民宿遴選商家；位於墾丁國家公園與大鵬灣風景區之間，房價設施與前者地區相比最平價，所以旅遊行程規劃，以白天晚上遊墾丁北上夜住蘭心，隔天遊大鵬灣、小硫球及體驗枋寮農漁業為最經濟實惠。
stays.descriptionEn: Lansin Villa Bed and Breakfast is located next to Shueidiliao(Shuidiliao) Gas Station at the 438.6K mark on Provincial Highway No. 1 going from Donggang to Kenting. On the east side is Dawu Shan and the Dahan Shan Mountain Range, and on the west is Liouciou (Liuqiu), Fangliao Fishing Harbor, and the Grouper Fish and Shrimp Breeding Area, and the surroundings are home to expansive agricultural fields producing black pearl wax apples, Aiwen mangoes, pineapples, and other fruits and vegetables. Nearby is the Lansin Villa Farm, producing ghost chili peppers (the world’s hottest) and DIY processing experiences. Rooms come with the latest facilities and equipment, including 42-inch liquid crystal TVs, double-person massage tubs (huge bathrooms), separate wet/dry sections and spa body showers, 6-foot Simmons ventilated spring beds, sofa beds, dust-free fire-proof wooden floors, 3-ton separate-style air conditioning, massage chairs, private parking, and free Western-style breakfast. From 2012-2013, we were selected as an Ecological Tour Partner Accommodation Business by the Pingtung Forest District Office, in 2011, as an Artistic and Cultural Accommodation Partner Business by the Pingtung County Government, and in 2012, as a Hospitable Bed and Breakfast Business by the Tourism Bureau. Located between Kenting National Park and Dapeng Bay National Scenic Area, this is the most affordable place in the area. The best value trips may include day or night tours of Kenting, spending the night at Lansin, and the next day visiting Dapeng Bay and Liouciou (Liuqiu) and experiencing the Fangliao agricultural and fishing industry.

stays.name: 訪寮民宿
stays.description: 位於枋寮火車站旁，一下車就能抵達的溫馨據點，枋寮火車站民宿是你通往恆春、墾丁、東港等地的最佳中繼站。簡約舒適的空間設計，融合在地藝術氣息與海風悠閒，適合背包旅人、情侶出遊、親子小住。民宿步行3分鐘即可到達海邊、夜市與在地小吃，不論是想要發呆看海、探索鐵道風情，還是騎車深入南台灣的熱情風土，這裡都是絕佳起點。 入住我們的民宿，讓你從車站踏出的第一步，就感受到家的溫暖與旅行的期待。
stays.descriptionEn: Located next to Fangliao Railway Station, this cozy base is within easy reach of the train. Fangliao Railway Station B&B is the best stopover for you to Hengchun, Kenting, Donggang and other places. The simple and comfortable space design combines local art with the leisurely sea breeze, making it suitable for backpackers, couples, and family stays. The bed and breakfast is only a 3-minute walk from the beach, night market and local snacks. Whether you want to stare at the sea, explore the railway, or ride a bike to explore the warm local customs of southern Taiwan, this is a great starting point. Staying in our B&B, you will feel the warmth of home and the anticipation of travel from the first step you take from the station.

stays.name: 大武山民宿
stays.description: 我們位於登北大武山必經之半山腰，海拔500公尺是個得天獨厚的地方，因為健身、養生、知性、美食咖啡(均含)，交通便利更不在話下，團客也好，三五成群的散客也好，只要事先預約，我們就可享受為您服務的樂趣。我們可安排三、二日的文化深度遊程規劃，嘗地方小吃，亦可體驗原住民山豬、風味餐、感動火鍋大餐、５種親子ＤＩＹ課、掬把溪水透沁涼活動等等。 最主要是我們願以帶動地方產業與社區結合，利用當地種植之無毒疏果為主要食材，並有廣大之庭院森林浴場、步道、原住民傳統文化活動廣場等設施。
stays.descriptionEn: We’re located on the mountainside on the way up North Dawu Mountain, at an elevation of 500 meters, featuring unique natural scenery and offering health, mental stimulation, delicious food, coffee, and of course convenient transportation, making this place perfect for groups or smaller parties. Please reserve beforehand, and we will be happy to be at your assistance. We arrange 2 and 3 day in-depth cultural tours that include trying out local food, aborigine mountain boar feasts, local flavor restaurants, hot pot, and 5 types of DIY courses for parents and children. Most importantly, we integrate with the community by promoting local industry, using locally-grown, pesticide free vegetables and fruit. We also include a large courtyard forest bath, trail, and traditional aboriginal culture activity area.

stays.name: 小墾丁渡假村
stays.description: 南台灣的陽光、藍天、綠地一向是渡假者的最愛，而墾丁地區的豐富生態更是得天獨厚；墾丁旅遊住宿墾丁渡假飯店首選：小墾丁渡假村─位居牧草之鄉—滿州的小墾丁渡假村是一個座落翠綠山林中的美麗村莊、在沒有擁塞緊湊的都會氣息，只有迷漫在空中的休閒舒暢。小墾丁群山環繞的特殊地形往往吸引大群候鳥進駐，您可以騎乘著小墾丁渡假村為你準備的單車，穿梭於木屋間的羊腸小徑，聆聽清脆鳥鳴，面迎清涼的微風；亦可登上小墾丁渡假村左翼山坡上的『賞鳥亭』，視野遼闊令人心曠神怡，每年秋冬正逢候鳥過境的高峰期，在小墾丁村內隨時可見紅尾伯勞的芳蹤及數以千計的國慶鳥棲息的狀態場面；於黃昏時分，更可見落鷹安靜悠閒的在空中翱翔。佔地40公頃擁有304間木屋的小墾丁渡假村讓您在渡假旅途中擁抱自然、享受山林的同時獨享原木自然散發的淡淡清香!木屋裡聽不到車聲喧擾的不安，只有屋外蟲嗚鳥啼的自然呼喚!木屋裡看不到都市叢林的生冷，只有窗外自然美景的輪動播放!村內每楝木屋都座落在綠樹成蔭的草毯上，打開窗門映入眼前的都是一幅幅栩栩如生、獨一無二的生態動畫，片刻間，在都會中的奢華物質都已變得累贅多餘!來到小墾丁渡假村的幸福莊園就是那麼~怡然自得

stays.name: 小豬愛吃地瓜葉民宿
stays.description: 整體設計的概念，圍繞在溫馨愉悅的情感表達、大自然與時尚的結合、無與倫比的舒適搭配，希望藉由當地的純樸與人情味，讓旅人找回最真誠無憂無慮的初心。我們座落於台灣東南方的一個海灣，岩岸與沙灘混合的天然特殊地形，造成海浪拍打陸地的聲音較小，人們發現此處的海浪無聲，因此當地人稱這裡為啞吧海，寧靜的漁港村落，清淨、溫馨、放鬆，距離佳樂水沙灘僅僅只有幾步之遙 。

stays.name: 祥園民宿
stays.description: 享受暖陽的溫柔洗禮感受浪沙輕柔的撫摸國境之南的四季風情，絕對讓您深刻難忘 國境之南的墾丁，有著最具異國風情的渡假休閒勝地，無陽的陽光、閃閃發亮的湛藍海洋，還有綠意盎然的森林公園，不論您是愛好生態、深愛海洋或是只想放空、休息身心，這裡都可以滿足您的各項需求～ 「墾丁民宿～祥園民宿」座落於屏東滿州鄉，鄰近出火風景區、佳樂水、恆春市區、恆春老街等景點，有著遠離喧囂的絕佳地理環境，也可方便您安排前往墾丁各地區玩樂；擁有寬闊佔地的「墾丁民宿～祥園民宿」，盡情享受南台灣陽光與微風的洗禮，更可欣賞滿天無垠的璀璨星空。 「墾丁民宿～祥園民宿」設有二人與四人套房房型，採光良好，寬敞舒適的空間裡，處處都可感受到民宿主人的用心，提供冰箱、電視等多項現代化設備，不僅滿足您的渡假需求，更打造一處親切、自在的旅居空間，讓您深刻體會國境之南的慢活情懷。 倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【08-8802798、0928-709236】墾丁民宿～祥園民宿。
stays.descriptionEn: Enjoy the warm sunshine, Feel the waves and sand gently brushing against your skin, The beautiful Southern Taiwan is definitely memorable. Kenting is the most exotic vacation spot in Taiwan's southern border. The warm sun shining on the deep blue ocean, and the lush green Forest Park are going to satisfy your interest, whether you like to explore local ecology, participate in water activities or just relax. Kenting B&B - Xiangyuan B&B is located in a quiet spot in Manzhou Township, Pingtung County. Some of the local attractions - Chuhuo Special Scenic Area (fire from the earth), Jialeshui, Hengchun downtown and Hengchun Old Street - are all very convenient to get to. Covering a wide area, Kenting B&B - Xiangyuan B&B allows you to fully enjoy Southern Taiwan's sunshine and cool breeze. You can even see the endless starry sky at night. Kenting B&B - Xiangyuan B&B has rooms for two and four people. The great lighting, spacious and comfortable living space are evidence of the owner's care. There are refrigerator, television and many other modern conveniences to satisfy your every need. We create a warm and relaxing vacation spot so you can experience southern hospitality and our leisure lifestyle.

stays.name: 竹安莊民宿
stays.description: 暖陽高掛在南國墾丁的天空上，眺望大尖山、門馬羅山陵線、有如觀看天與地的寬螢幕、迎面吹徐的溫暖海風，墾丁的一切總是令人難以人忘懷。 鄰近出火、佳樂水、風吹沙等東海岸熱門景點，位於交通中樞的優勢位置，前往恆春市區(8分鐘)、南灣(12分鐘)、墾丁大街(18分鐘)等也是十分便利；佔地廣闊的竹安莊民宿，低調的灰色建築在綠意草坪中，就好似大自然中的一部分，四周綠意盎然的景致，不論時刻靜躺在前院的休閒椅上，或是在後院享受鄉野的清新、蝴蝶的翩翩起舞，像這個需要慢慢體會的南國情懷，建議您帶著一顆放鬆的心、輕便的行李，讓南國的碧海藍天、活潑浪花或是樸實鄉野，滿足您的心靈細胞，徜徉南國墾丁的熱情懷抱吧！ 隨著主人的腳步走進竹安莊民宿室內，設有四人套房房型，大片落地窗帶入熱情陽光、溫暖海風，採光良好、寬敞舒適的空間中，處處可見民宿的用心，室內峇里式的籐椅、獨立私有陽台上的躺椅，或是房內有線網路、陽台無線網路，讓你不論是商務人士、家庭式遊玩，朋友聚會，都能讓你隨時享受無所拘束的渡假情懷；充分休息後再騎乘自行車慢遊南國中的鄉野間，深刻了解慢活中的無比幸福時光。 進入網站還有優惠方案及民宿精采MV介紹唷http://088801118.okgo.tw/
stays.descriptionEn: The warm sun shines high in the sky over the southern region of Kenting. Look out over Dajianshan and Menmaluo Shan, resembling a great picture of scenery stretching from the ground to the sky, and feel the soft, warm ocean breeze. Everything about Kenting is unforgettable. Our location is excellent, near popular tourist sites on the east coast of Taiwan, such as Chufor：Nature ground fire, Jialeshuei： Mountain sea water fall, and Fengchueisha ：Wind blown sand, as well as convenient for transportation - an 8 minute drive from downtown Hengchun, 12 minutes from Nanwan, and 18 minutes from Kenting Main Street. Covering expansive grounds, Zhu An Villa Bed and Breakfast’s subdued grey building amidst green grass looks like it’s a part of nature, surrounded by luxuriant green scenery. Whenever you feel like it, quietly lay back on the lounge chairs in the front courtyard, or enjoy the refreshing countryside and dancing butterflies in the back yard. To really experience this atmosphere of southern Taiwan, we recommend that you relax, pack light, and let the green sea and blue skies, lively waves, and simple countryside satisfy your soul. Experience the friendly embrace of southern Taiwan’s Kenting! Follow the owner inside the villa, where we offer 4 person suite rooms with large French windows that let in the friendly sunlight, warm ocean breezes, good lighting, and a spacious and comfortable area, with the owner’s care evident in all the details. The Bali-style rattan chairs, lounge chairs on the private stand-alone balcony, cable Internet in the rooms, and wireless Internet on the balcony combine to provide an unrestrained vacation atmosphere, whether you’re a businessperson, family, or group of friends. When you’re fully rested, take a bike ride through the southern Taiwanese countryside, deeply enjoying and understanding the wonder of relaxed living. Website includes discount plans and a video introducing us. http://088801118.okgo.tw/

stays.description: 移居恆春半島 自地自建的家 歡迎您來居住～ #蕎伊絲的店Joyce's House Kitchen 。 恆春是個天然純淨的自由之地， 令人有著強烈的勇氣在這裡落腳下來 造夢、追夢。 在這裡有許多來自外地的追夢人 創造了許多的特色店家。 聽說恆春的泥土很黏人 一但踏上就被黏住了。 而我嚮往最初的單純生活 選擇了離恆春市區五公里 滿州永靖村一塊純淨綠天地 自地自建、 築上我的大夢想。 在這個的綠天地裡 依山傍海，景色怡人， 這的生活更是浪漫的許多。 夜空繁星點點，晨夕雲霧繚繞，不時一陣幽幽清風拂過，空氣清爽，蟲嗚鳥叫，農村的迷人風光在此表現的無疑。 望山、看海、泡湯、聽風、賞星，這都有。⋯⋯蕎伊絲的店民宿呈現給你最純淨的住宿環境，它的美待你來細品。 ＃我們在墾丁國家公園區域內，在佳樂水衝浪海灘附近，墾丁的火紅旅遊景點都距離不遠哦！ ＃國境之南住宿的新選擇。 Joyce‘House

stays.searchText: 蕎伊絲的店民宿 蕎伊絲的店民宿 屏東縣民宿1199號 屏東縣 滿州鄉 永靖村21鄰和興路8號 移居恆春半島 自地自建的家 歡迎您來居住～ #蕎伊絲的店Joyce's House Kitchen 。 恆春是個天然純淨的自由之地， 令人有著強烈的勇氣在這裡落腳下來 造夢、追夢。 在這裡有許多來自外地的追夢人 創造了許多的特色店家。 聽說恆春的泥土很黏人 一但踏上就被黏住了。 而我嚮往最初的單純生活 選擇了離恆春市區五公里 滿州永靖村一塊純淨綠天地 自地自建、 築上我的大夢想。 在這個的綠天地裡 依山傍海，景色怡人， 這的生活更是浪漫的許多。 夜空繁星點點，晨夕雲霧繚繞，不時一陣幽幽清風拂過，空氣清爽，蟲嗚鳥叫，農村的迷人風光在此表現的無疑。 望山、看海、泡湯、聽風、賞星，這都有。⋯⋯蕎伊絲的店民宿呈現給你最純淨的住宿環境，它的美待你來細品。 ＃我們在墾丁國家公園區域內，在佳樂水衝浪海灘附近，墾丁的火紅旅遊景點都距離不遠哦！ ＃國境之南住宿的新選擇。 Joyce‘House

stays.name: 313民宿
stays.description: 313民宿是屏東縣潮州在地的第1042號合法民宿, 為了您我健康，全館採用乳膠漆，不僅無毒環保、自然無味，還兼具長效抗菌與塗膜細緻等優點。313民宿距離潮州河濱公園距離800公尺，是個傍晚放風，欣賞日出及夕陽的好所在，全台種植最多桃花心木的平地森林遊樂區及八大森林博覽樂園，潮州圓環邊日式建築更是網美拍照之好地方。距離最熱鬧的圓環商圈僅需1分鐘的路程，冷熱冰、烤玉米、牛肉湯、阿婆炒粄條、青草茶、木瓜牛奶...等，都是當地最傳統的小吃，可以透過探索潮州這樸實的小鎮來放鬆自己的心情，放慢平日緊張的步調，迎來一趟完美的旅程。

stays.name: 66号小院子
stays.description: 『66号小院子』為坐落在屏東潮州鄉間的獨棟小墅，觀山、賞夕照、看星星景致絕佳，渡假、放空兩相宜。室內空間採小清新妝點風格，共有兩個樓層，一樓有2人客房『邊邊好行房』，二樓是兩間2人臥室『轉轉復古房』、『角角陽光房』合用1間衛浴，全戶共可容納6人入住。公共區域包括客餐廳、屋頂花園等，入住貴賓皆可悠閒享用，另提供WIFI、現做早餐與專屬車庫。本民宿每樓層一天僅接待一組房客，自在、溫馨、舒適，是旅遊高屏最佳的住宿選擇，寧靜的氛圍可提供入住貴賓一夜好眠。從『66号小院子』至潮州鎮區行車僅10分鐘，到萬巒豬腳街、林後四林平地森林園區也只要5分鐘，離塵不離城，漫步看山、大啖美食、悠閒騎單車，暫離都會，偷得浮生半日閒，徜徉山水，何其快哉！
stays.descriptionEn: "Little Yard No. 66 Homestay" is a single villa located in Pingtung's Chaozhou countryside, with an excellent view of the mountains, sunset, and the stars, making it ideal for both vacationing and relaxing.The interior is decorated in a small and fresh style, and there are two floors, the first floor has a guest room for two people, "Bian Bian Xing Xing Room", and the second floor has two bedrooms for two people, "Revolving Retro Room" and "Corner Sunshine Room", which share a bathroom, and the whole house can accommodate a total of six people. The common areas include a dining room and a roof garden, which can be enjoyed by all guests, as well as WIFI, freshly made breakfast and a dedicated garage.Each floor of the B&B only receives one group of guests per day, which is comfortable, cozy and comfortable, and is the best choice of accommodation for traveling to GaoPing, and the quiet atmosphere can provide guests with a good night's sleep.It takes only 10 minutes to drive from "Little Yard No. 66 Homestay" to Chaozhou Township, and only 5 minutes to Wan Ruan Pig's Foot Street and Lin Hou Si Lin Ping Di Forest Park, so it's a great way to get away from the dusty city, take a stroll to see the mountains, eat a lot of food, and ride a bicycle leisurely, so it's a great way to get away from the city and steal a half day of leisure time to roam around in the mountains and waters, so it's a great way to get away from the city!

images.description: 『邊邊好行房』位於『66号小院子』的一樓，為2人客房配備專屬衛浴。『邊邊好行房』具有免爬樓梯的優點，是不少貴賓的熱門選擇。洋溢自然感的室內空間，有大面積窗戶引進充沛採光，帶來清爽、活力的氛圍，搭配木材質予人溫暖、潤和的感受，還有心情語錄挹注一絲文青質感。並選用老字號100％台灣手工製造的德泰彈簧床，提供深層好睡眠。

images.name: 轉轉復古房 + 角角陽光房
images.description: 『轉轉復古房』+『角角陽光房』位於『66号小院子』二樓，為2間2人房共用1套衛浴，屬於4人房。(若貴賓人數為2人，我們也可以接待喔！請向房東詢問細節與房價。) 『轉轉復古房』提供木地板與厚度適中的日式床墊，可坐、可臥的舒適感受，鋪排出自然溫潤的基調。搭配舊唱片、老窗框的陳設，營造出別具風情的復古氛圍，緩慢療癒的節奏，既紓壓又放鬆。 『角角陽光房』擁有專屬陽台，每當晨曦初露便灑入一室柔和日光，透過窗簾隱隱約約，瀰漫著甜蜜浪漫。選用柔軟服貼的席夢思名床，舒適慵懶就想賴整天。清新唯美的布置，賦予質感與暖度。

stays.name: 樂活藝術家
stays.description: 樂活藝術家(以下簡稱家)家結合了民宿、代書、咖啡、健康及藝術，希望帶給人們身心靈上不一樣的感動。民宿共五個房間，4間4人房，1間2人房，乾淨，衛生，舒適，有一種淡淡的輕柔與家的感受，就好像心目中的那個理想的家，沒有珍奇瑰麗的裝飾，也沒有刻意做作的，營造各種異國風情，真真實實的內在美呈現出來，寬敞舒適是空間的感覺。從門口走到房間，處處都有藝術的巧思，沒有宏偉的裝潢，全是藝術家獨特的創意，希望呈現出樂活及藝術的風格。走到這裡就像回到家，可以好好的休息。樂活LOHAS是Life Of Health And Sustainability.第一個英文字母的組合，意味著健康及自給自足的生活方式。家提供了高級的跑步機、腳踏車、垂直律動機及一些舒壓按摩器材，在一天疲累之餘，滿足了不同的需求，只要體驗過家的器材，必定感覺回到了年輕時代，身體輕盈的像是飄到了雲端。而且做運動不再是一件苦事，一邊運動一邊看大螢幕、聽音樂，忘了呼吸的急促，也甚至不用自己動一下，就達到打籃球30分鐘的效果。絶對不是老王賣瓜自賣自誇，您試了就知道。潮州交通四通八達，美食小吃不勝枚舉，附近景點更是風光明媚。胡志強是我本人名字，國小教師退休，愛好爬山、下棋、畫畫、投資、有地政士資格，法律檢定通過，古意樸質，潛心向佛，若不嫌棄，可以和本人做好朋友。金剛經云：修一切善法即得阿耨多羅三藐三菩提，希望藉由家帶給大眾更多的幸福。官網：lohas-artist.com來電：0989509875

stays.name: 沐雨鍾林靜心民宿
stays.description: 【沐雨鍾林】是一處結合生態、環境、生命、身心靈教育的場域，提供民宿、靜心舒壓課程、教室場地租借(研習、在職進修、心靈課程、禪修等) 及生態導覽。 沐雨鍾林願與世間廣結善緣，護生護大地。「雨」代表甘露與智慧，願每一位來到這塊土地的朋友，能得到雨露般的滋養，享受寧靜、放鬆與喜悅。沐雨鍾林為特色民宿，提供【五行養生早餐】及【靜心舒壓課程】與朋友們分享靜心放鬆、慢食、慢行、慢呼吸、慢活，獲取正向能量，重新找回最單純、最自在的心，活出最自然流動的喜樂生命。農場建築體由一來一荷夫婦親自設計監造完成，其中有許多巧思，如：銹鐵雕刻、彩繪壁畫及裝潢舊木料的廢物利用作品。園區樹種豐富，有栽種25年200多棵的大樹、近4000棵的綠籬植栽、自然生態工法施作的生態池、果園、桂花林、獨角仙光臘樹林。 這兒有鳥聲、蛙聲、蟲鳴聲、風聲、雨聲、流水聲，邀請您，遠離塵囂，體驗沒有電視、熱對流循環的綠建築空間，回歸自然寂靜的放鬆。農場鄰近1000多公頃的林後四林平地森林公園，週邊生態豐富，還有自行車道及芬多精步道，是生態及身心靈養生之旅的好去處。

stays.name: 茴香戀戀溫泉會館
stays.description: 茴香戀戀溫泉會館是四重溪地區最新的成員之一，結合希臘、地中海的蔚藍浪漫元素及排灣族的粗獷風格。會館主人來自於新竹，因認識當地排灣族的妻子，而在四重溪落地生根，並開設了充滿浪漫風情的茴香戀戀溫泉會館。擁有這樣風情的一家溫泉會館，是館主的理想實現，舉凡店裡的小擺飾、空間一隅的設計，以及整體所要呈現的設計感，皆出於廣告出身的老闆所構思，女主人亦在園內種了很多茴香(回鄉)，茴香戀戀在雙重語意下誕生。
stays.descriptionEn: Fennel Resort is the newest member of the Sichong Stream Area, integrating Greek and Mediterranean romantic elements with the rough style of the Paiwan people. The owner is from Hsinchu, and after marrying a woman from the Paiwan tribe, he settled in this area and created the romantic Fennel Resort. With such beautiful natural scenery, the villa was a dream come true for the owner. Its decoration, layout, and overall design were all conceived of by the owner, who has a background in advertising. His wife planted the garden with fennel (in Chinese, a homonym for “returning home”), and the Fennel Resort was thus born.

stays.name: H會館
stays.description: H會館位於屏東縣獅子鄉，屹立於屏鵝公路旁，倚山面海而建，坐擁9.9公頃廣大腹地，背倚山林綠意之中，前納湛藍自然海天，會館外觀造型獨特，為恆春半島最高、視野最美的高級景觀渡假會館。得天獨厚的地理優勢，會館精心打造126間各式舒適客房，每間客房均有面海觀景落地窗，簡潔的室內優雅設計，處處可見貼心巧思。房內設施備有國際直撥電話、免費寬頻網路及迷你酒吧丶多頻道液晶電視、保險箱、浸泡式浴缸、隔離式淋浴間、精品沐浴組等設備，滿足多樣化需求，營造出自在放鬆客房氛圍。
stays.descriptionEn: H Resort is situated beside Ping-Er Provincial Highway in Shizi Township, Pintung County.Sitting against the mountains, it faces the vastocean, and embraces a natural space of 9.9 hectares.With greenery in the back as well as the azure sky and sea waters before eyes, theunique facade of H Resort stands at a position higher than any other high-class holiday resort on Hengchun Peninsula,and is among theones with the best scenery.Given exclusive geographic advantages, H Resort comprises 126 exquisite guest rooms of all varieties, each with floor-to-ceiling windowslooking out to sea, along with a simplistic and elegant interior design laced with ingenuity everywhere. Rooms are equipped with phonesfor direct international calls, free broadband Internet access, multi-channel LCD TVs, safes, bathtubs, separated shower rooms and luxurytoiletries to satisfy all needs and to create a relaxing comfy atmosphere.

stays.name: 夢想家民宿
stays.description: 小琉球民宿---夢想家農莊式民宿每個人心目中，都有存在著一個簡單、幸福的夢想。想在綠油油的草地上恣意翻滾跳躍？還是在涼爽夜晚仰望著浩瀚的宇宙星空？歡迎來到夢想家完成這個最原始的感動、體驗最簡單的幸福。純潔的貝殼白沙灘、琉璃藍的海水、成群的熱帶魚、保育的綠蠵龜、超大片的草地，還有一望無盡的美麗星空。夢想的世界，就是離我們這麼近…在這簡單的幸福構圖裡，夢想家農莊式民宿在此誕生，寬廣舒適的住宿空間，每間客房各具特色讓遊客在自然山林環境下，享受高級雅致住宿品質。夢想，在此等候您來實現...
stays.descriptionEn: Hsiao Liouciou homestay - Dreamers Farmhouse B&B. Everyone harbors a simple dream of happiness in their heart. Do you want to prance and roll around on lush, green lawns? Or do you want to experience cool, comfortable evenings admiring the vastness of the universe and its stars? Welcome to Dreamer B&B where dreamers are able to achieve their simplest dreams and experience the happiness derived from these simple joys! Pristine beaches of white shell sand, azure oceans, schools of tropical fish, green sea turtles (a protected species), vast grassy plains, and an infinite expanse of beautiful, starry skies. This dream is within your grasp. We drew upon these simple pleasures to give birth to the Dreamer Farmhouse B&B. Our guest rooms are spacious, comfortable, and uniquely furnished, offering first-rate elegance and quality accommodations to our guests within a natural, mountainous forest. We wait here for you to achieve your dreams...

stays.description: 融入自然與藝術氣息的民宿以曲線、童趣、抽象理念作為建築風格的藝術民宿彷彿置身於奧地利藝術街頭的小琉球尊順祿藝術民宿尊順祿藝術民宿就位於屏東縣琉球鄉的一個可愛小島，獨特的民宿外觀，利用大量的馬賽克色塊拼接，展現出充滿熱愛小島感的設計與其他小琉球的民宿相比，更能凸顯我們的與眾不同房型特色大不同，各式風格及家具設計，帶給大家多重視覺體驗，更是在細節上特別用心，極具滿滿藝術感擺設，在尊順祿處處讓大家挖掘驚喜，絕對可以一來再來。這充滿異國風情的尊順祿藝術民宿，適合親子同樂、家族旅遊、情侶享樂又或是獨自前往的您，現在就跟著我們談一場異國風情的戀愛吧!

stays.description: 沉重的工作壓力及冗長的工作時間，這就是高科技公司待了七年的我每天生活模式，直到某星期假日帶著疲憊身心及家人回到老婆娘家小琉球, 深深被這裡純樸且富有人情味的風俗、眼前處處山水的風景、保育完好的潮間帶生態以及陸域生態所吸引,女兒們說：「她們想留在小琉球，不想讓爸爸回去上班，每天可以陪我們玩」, 於是情商家人一起展開了古拉克民宿之夢。經營理念我們秉持以客為尊的服務精神，保護當地生態環境為原則，用親切、真誠的服務態度為大家提供住宿和旅遊。精心設計的套裝行程，使旅客們從交通到入住民宿後有安心、放鬆、賓至如歸的感覺。本民宿適合渡蜜月、親子及團體旅行等具備應有的設備，以溫馨、體貼環境，照顧旅人的生活起居。我們規劃有雙人房、三人房、四人房以及八人房共十三間客房，不同特色的房型，城堡造型的櫃檯以及舒適明亮的大廳、提供全方位的完善設施，是您最佳休閒住宿最好的選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: Heavy work pressure and lengthy working hours, this is my high-tech company& #39;s seven-day daily life mode, until a week& #39;s holiday with a tired body and mind and family back to his wife Ryukyu Ryukyu, deeply here is simple and full of human touch The customs of the landscape, the landscape of the landscape, the ecology of well-preserved intertidal zone and the ecology of the terrestrial ecosystem. The daughters said: "They want to stay in Little Ryukyu. They do not want Daddy to go back to work and play with us everyday." The hotel is suitable for honeymooners, family and group travel, and has the necessary equipment to warm and considerate environment, take care of travelers life daily life. We plan to have double, triple, quadruple room and a total of 13 rooms with eight rooms, different characteristics of the room, castle style counter and comfortable bright hall, provides a full range of facilities, is your best leisure The best choice for accommodation.

stays.name: 小琉球船屋特色民宿
stays.nameEn: Xiao Liu Qiu Chuan Wu Tese Homestay
stays.description: 座落於小琉球碼頭附近，特別的船頭造型是為了突顯小琉球漁村風情特意下錨象徵著我們已新建於在這個海上樂園。蔚藍海洋、遨翔魚群及百豔珊瑚群礁...窺探神秘海底到船屋民宿就讓您身臨其境。我們喜歡這遠離塵囂的小島，原本以經營餐廳為業(見煮餐廳)，在迎來送往的服務生活，每當旅客帶著開心的笑臉離開小琉球，在我們心裡總有一種小小的得意與滿足，得意的是這座美麗的島是我們的故鄉，滿足的是又多了一個人看見這島的美麗。這間以遊輪為想法的民宿─船屋，停泊在小琉球， 為入住的遊客提供它獨一無二的尊榮服務。跟著我們的民宿暢遊小琉球海上樂園，船屋裡有不同風情的艙房，在船上您能輕易的被渡假的心情旋律感染，我們有專業的生態解說員，讓您近距離的感受小琉球的生態之美，豐富的潮間帶生態，在解說員的帶領下您會發現驚喜處處。把雙腳泡在海水中隨著海浪起伏，或躍入海中尋找海中的新奇，看這小島、海裡的風景，你會愛上了它!在民宿餐廳有我們為您提供當地海產，新鮮無污染的海鮮大餐是這小島的特色。 現在，我們誠心的邀請每一位朋友來小琉球，來感受這座島的美麗熱情，放下煩擾的俗事，給自己一個渡假的好理由，放鬆自已來小琉球，讓我們給你一個不同的海洋假期。
stays.descriptionEn: Located close to Liouciou (Liuqiu) Wharf, Boathouse Specialty Bed and Breakfast’s special wharf shape was designed to highlight the local features of Liouciou (Liuqiu) Fishing Village, with the anchor symbolizing our new establishment in this ocean paradise. If you want to experience the deep blue sea, schools of fish, fantastic coral reefs, and glimpse the mysterious ocean depths, Boathouse Bed and Breakfast is the place to visit. We love this little island, far from the dirt and noise of the city, and originally worked in the restaurant business. While servicing customers, we felt a twinge of pride and satisfaction every time customers left here smiling. We were proud of the fact this beautiful little island was our home, and satisfied that another person could witness its beauty. Our cruise ship-themed bed and breakfast is “docked” at Liouciou (Liuqiu), where we provide travelers with unique, honorable service. Come tour the ocean paradise of Liouciou (Liuqiu) with us; we offer various themed cabins where you’ll soon catch the vacation spirit. We offer professional ecological tour guides so you can experience the beauty of this place up close, and you’ll discover one surprise after another as the guide leads you through the rich intertidal zone. Dip your feet in the water as the waves come forward and recede, or dive into the sea and search for new surprises. You’ll fall in love with this island and the ocean scenery! Our restaurant offers local seafood, and the fresh pollution-free seafood banquet is a special feature of this place. We’d like to sincerely invite everyone to Liouciou (Liuqiu) to experience the beauty and friendliness of this place. Put aside worries and cares, give yourself a reason to take a vacation, and relax with a trip to Liouciou (Liuqiu), where we’ll bring you a different seaside experience.

stays.name: 星月旅店特色民宿
stays.description: 以金黃月光為主題 星雲為想像空間 彷彿置身於銀光星河之間空間不再以直線直角切分 讓律動感存活於空間中 賦予建築新生命賽克拼貼出宇宙無垠的月球星空 嬌豔美人魚同游清涼池水中落地長條窗與彩雕玻璃窗引入南國陽光 大膽玩弄色彩 挑動你的視覺海島旅行融合西班牙的熱情活力與慵懶自在享受一場奇幻美麗冒險之旅～舞動小琉球 擁抱新春熱情活力以星月為主題 星雲想像空間 彷彿置身於銀河系建築應該融合於大自然 建築不應該有太多無謂的直角建築須要賦予新的生命熱情、慵懶、奔放、真誠、美食是許多人對西班牙下的形容詞耀眼的陽光 晴朗的藍天白雲 熱情的音樂與律動 星月有如一件藝術品都等著您來發掘熱情、也像走訪了一趟西班牙文化之旅
stays.descriptionEn: We took the shining moonlight as the theme and the universe as the imagining space to decorate the rooms to make you feel like being in the galaxy. The space is not segmented in lines or angles. We let the rhythm exist in this space, giving the building a new life. We used mosaics to present the boundless starry sky as well as the beautiful mermaid swimming in the water, and the sunlight shining into the French windows and carved glass windows to attract your attention. Travel with enthusiasm and relaxation and enjoy a fantastic trip in this island! Live in Liuqiu! We take the shining moonlight as the theme and the universe as the imagining space to make you feel like being in the galaxy. Buildings should combine with nature instead of rigidity. We gave this building a new life. Enthusiasm, laziness, ebullience, sincerity and delicacies are the impressions which most people have for Spain. Possessing the shining sunlight, beautiful blue sky and great music, Star Moon Villa is waiting for your coming to enjoy a trip being like in Spain.
