stays.name: 正好友生態環保旅店
stays.description: 屏東｜正好友生態環保旅店．住進小琉球的生態教室！難得的假期，想來個特別的小島旅行嗎？來小琉球吧！這裡正好有豔陽、大海和自然生態孕育的豐厚人文。想住在交通便利的碼頭旁，來正好友生態環保旅店吧！這裡正好有舒適的空間、熱血的主人，還有旅人們的歡笑聲。你需要的，正好全都有了！老街裡的生態教室走進小琉球最熱鬧的老街，一拉開正好友顯目的鮮黃大門，主人正男便微笑地走出吧台迎接你們，熱愛自然生態的他將旅宿規劃成一個生態小教室，寬敞的大廳是旅人的交誼空間，環顧四周，不論是桌上的衛生紙套、牆上自製的小琉球地圖、甚至是海龜模型，全都是和生態有關的小物。來到正好友，每一位旅人都是正男的好朋友，你可以無止盡地發問，看他拿出一個個用心收藏的珍貴模型，耐心地為你介紹他最愛的海洋生物。從小在小琉球的漁夫家庭長大的正男，雖然高中後便離開家鄉到高雄獨立生活，但當女兒出生後，便讓他決心返鄉，想讓女兒在小琉球生活，認識這塊土地美好的一切，而回來後擔任管家所累積的旅宿經營經驗，以及對海洋生態的滿腔熱血，全都落實在現今的正好友裡。從七間房認識琉球之美正好友的方正外觀下，其實藏著傳統建築深長的空間，七間房，全都採用工業風設計，佈置簡約舒適的空間；每間房名都蘊含和這塊土地連結的特殊意義與故事，螃蟹、寄居蟹房內的牆上寫下正男的小叮嚀，「除了攝影什麼都別帶走」、「除了足跡什麼都別留下」呼籲入住的旅人們，一同守護小琉球的生態；魚人房、人魚房裡，藏著烏鬼洞的神秘傳說，最適合兩位好友一同入住；另外還有小琉球房、海洋超人房、海兔房，也都值得你來一探究竟。不只空間，正男還將生態與文創結合，設計了許多文創小物；也準備了小禮物，打算送給每一位入住的旅人。打開用環保材質製造，可以變身成面紙盒的禮物盒，裡頭躺著一件屬於今晚房間的T恤、明信片，用有趣的文字介紹今晚的房間主題。
stays.descriptionEn: Taitung｜TRUE FDs INNExperience Life in an Ecological Classroom on Little Liuqiu!If you get some rare time off, why not embark on a special island journey? Little Liuqiu is the perfect spot! This place has it all, including splendid sunshine, sea views, and a wealth of ecological culture. If you’re seeking travel accommodations near the convenience of the wharf, look no further than TRUE FDs INN, where you will find comfortable rooms, passionate hosts, and the joyous laughter of travelling guests. Everything you need awaits you at TRUE FDs INN!An ecological classroom located on the Old StreetEntering Little Liuqiu’s bustling old street district, you come to the bright yellow door of TRUE FDs INN. Pulling the door open, the host of the guesthouse, Cheng-Nan steps out from behind the bar to greet you. With his love of natural ecology, he has turned his guesthouse into a little classroom devoted to ecological education. The spacious living room provides a place for travelers to interact. From tissue boxes, to the homemade map of Little Liuqiu on the wall, to models of sea turtles, look around to see the entire space devoted to ecological awareness.TRUE FDs INN sees all guests as dear friends - all of your questions are welcome. Your host will share information about his treasured collection of sea animal miniatures. The son of a fisherman, Cheng-Nan was born and raised in Little Liuqiu. After high school, Cheng-Nan left the island life for a time to pursue his independence in Kaohsiung. After his daughter was born, he decided to return to his hometown to raise her. He was determined to introduce her to all the beauty of this little island. He applied his experience in hotel management as well as his passion for ocean ecology to create the TRUE FDs INN we see today.A lesson in seven rooms on the beauty of LiuqiuThe clear, square exterior appearance of TRUE FDs INN actually contains traditional construction which is long and deep. All seven rooms are decorated in a simple yet comfortable industrial style. The name of each room contains both a story and special local significance. In the “Crab” and “Hermit Crab” rooms, Cheng-Nan urges travelers to “take nothing but pictures” and “leave nothing but footsteps” so as to protect the ecology of Little Liuqiu. The “Fisherman” and “Mermaid” rooms conceal the secret legend of the Black Dwarf Cave, and are most suitable accommodations for two good friends to check into. Furthermore, the “Little Liuqiu”, “Ocean Superman” and “Sea Hare” rooms are all well worth checking out.Beyond the rooms, Cheng-Nan has combined local ecology with cultural creativity in his design, even preparing small gifts for each traveler who checks in. The gift box made of eco-friendly materials can be used as a tissue box, and contains a t-shirt of the nightly theme, postcards, and descriptions in an interesting passage introducing to travelers the nightly theme for their room. Little Liuqiu: a profound exploration “Sleeping accommodations are the first and most direct line of contact with travelers!” Cheng-Nan firmly believes that travel accommodations offer the best opportunity to educate travelers. Travelers are usually left with a profound impression of the natural beauty of Little Liuqiu, yet very few people know about the rich cultural history of the island. In the future, Cheng-Nan plans to launch a different kind of itinerary for travellers, allowing visitors to go beyond the educational ocean eco-tourism that is now prevalent, to become acquainted with local culture, and to have a deep experience of life on the island. Furthermore, Cheng-Nan is beginning to promote habitat regeneration of intertidal zones, beach clean-up efforts, and weekly lectures from ecological experts and environmental protection figures. Through this series of discussions, he hopes to allow more and more people to understand ways in which to coexist and thrive within the natural environment.TRUE FDs INN is built upon Cheng-Nan’s passion for natural ecology, and his dreams and determination are visible in every nook and corner. Above and beyond the wish to offer travelers a comfortable space in which to stay, Cheng-Nan hopes that after his guests will gain a deeper knowledge of natural ecology, and work together to protect the environment, and become friends of the ocean!

stays.name: 法拉民宿
stays.description: 小琉球第一家以蝴蝶為題材的民宿(Farfalla義大利文)。沒有華麗的建築，以色彩鮮艷的方塊磚不規則拼貼出活耀的氣質，加上宛如空中花園般的外觀，蝴蝶漫妙飛舞讓人有種幸福加倍感喔!室內是主要是以浪漫田園風為主調，但為了讓朋友們有新鮮感，我們還精心佈置不同風格的房型，都很有feel喔！不管是一群好友、一家大小，攜手夫妻還是甜蜜到爆的情侶都適合，因為我們很用心讓大家有賓至如歸的感受，讓旅行成為幸福的出走，溫馨的環境可以加溫彼此的感情，釋放長期累績的壓力，我們還在不斷努力中讓新民宿更茁壯喔！本民宿位於寧靜的巷道內，空氣新鮮，離觀光碼頭及熱鬧的老街都很近喔!步行約3-5分^0^，民宿旁還有采蝶小花園，是聊天說笑的好地點，也有專屬停車場，便利性佳，請放心!Farfalla全體小幫手歡迎大 家來我家住一晚^^
stays.descriptionEn: The first butterfly-themed B&B in Hsiao Liouciou (Farfalla in Italian means ‘butterfly’) There’s no fancy architecture, but the construction features an irregular mosaic of brilliantly colored square tiles that present a lively atmosphere reminiscent of the hanging gardens of legend, while fluttering butterflies double the sensation of happiness. Indoor settings are established around the main theme of romantic rural gardens, and we have also provided various furnishing styles to add a wondrous, refreshing vibe to our rooms. Our rooms are perfect for friends, families, married couples, and passionate lovers, and we have invested a great deal of effort to help our guests feel right at home. Holidays should provide an enjoyable getaway experience, and the cozy environment will help provide warmth and bring people closer while eliminating pent up stress. We are also pursuing continuing improvements to this new B&B to ensure its healthy, lovely growth! This B&B is located on a quiet street with refreshing air and is extremely close (just a 3 to 5-minute walk ^0^) to the Tourist Wharf and bustling boulevard. We are right next to a butterfly garden, a perfect place to hold delightful conversations with friends and family. Don’t worry if you’re driving since there’s also an exclusive parking area to add to our already excellent convenience. The Farfalla family welcomes you to stay with us!

stays.description: 本民宿位於杉福生態廊道旁，距杉板灣約100公尺環島道路旁，建築以標準閩式三合院風華再現，復古整建彰顯古式建築之美，主體仍保有咕咾石土角磚檻，冬暖夏涼是小琉球唯一保存完整閩式三合院，四周環境皆有深度綠化活動空間近兩千坪，並有規劃泡茶區、烤肉區，並榮獲交通部觀光局大鵬灣國家公園評鑑為小琉球最具特色民宿並頒給好客民宿標章。
stays.descriptionEn: Sea-Shoy (Three-section building) Specialty Bed and Breakfast is located next to the Sanfu Ecological Path and Roundabout Road (100 meters from Shanban Bay). The building is a remodeled version of a standard Sanheyuan (traditional Taiwanese-style three-section building compound) renovated to display its antique beauty. As Liouciou (Liuqiu) only completely preserved Sanheyuan, it retains the antique stone and earth brick door threshold, warm in the winter and cool in the summer. The building is surrounded by luxuriant green areas (nearly 6,600 square meters) for activities, including a tea brewing and BBQ area. The Dapeng Bay National Scenic Area of the Tourism Bureau designated us as Liouciou (Liuqiu Best Specialty Bed and Breakfast as well as awarding a Hospitable Bed and Breakfast certification.

stays.name: 海洋風情渡假旅館
stays.description: 小琉球觀光住宿、套裝行程、潮間帶生態之旅浪漫海洋風情貝殼景觀住宿，色彩繽紛絕美夢幻，套裝行程推出中，帶你探訪特色潮間帶，給您自在樂活幸福生活！戀戀清澈海水、漫步白色沙灘，徜徉假期從小琉球出發！帶你體驗獨特潮間帶生態、無光害滿天星斗、火金姑，特色港邊海洋風情民宿，別出心裁為您營造不同的生活氛圍，讓您旅遊小琉球留下獨特記憶軌跡。精心使用各種不同大小種類的貝殼裝飾每一個角落，色彩繽紛絕美夢幻，彷彿置身小美人魚的海底龍宮，獨具巧思親手打造大法螺、千手螺、唐冠螺、金口蠑螺、貓眼蠑螺、地圖寶螺、龜甲寶螺、水字螺、海兔螺等以貝殼為主題的景觀套房，為您的假期更增添趣味回憶！獨特海洋假期，可以知性、可以寫意、可以悠閒、可以狂歡，來到海洋風情民宿，你將會看到風與海的對話，發現生活不一樣的美。

stays.name: 漁埕民宿
stays.description: 漁埕古意 遵循台灣造屋方法保留最原始的面孔，因就近於小琉球當地漁埕港，故以古名命之。 居住在傳統建築所改造的新民宿，結合小琉球當地風俗文化特色， 襯托出最傲人的色彩，保留台灣原有造屋四方正高雅格局，更顯文人雅致、清風道德氣息。 只有親自體驗、親自尋找才能道出無盡的情意。 我們相信，在漁埕，能讓久待喧囂都市的朋友們徹底放鬆心靈， 不管是旅遊或體驗都能像漁船滿載盈歸一樣收穫豐盛。自然體驗小琉球 本民宿位於小琉球東邊左近龍蝦洞右近旭日亭，以配合當地潮汐時間， 導覽潮間帶的生態特色，體驗其豐富的生命力，希冀達到純欣賞而不破壞之保育原則。 漁埕民宿為維持旅客享有完善的生態之旅、體驗自然品質，我們確切建立並呼籲保育觀念。

stays.searchText: 漁埕民宿 漁埕民宿 屏東縣民宿357號 屏東縣 琉球鄉 三民路19號 漁埕古意 遵循台灣造屋方法保留最原始的面孔，因就近於小琉球當地漁埕港，故以古名命之。 居住在傳統建築所改造的新民宿，結合小琉球當地風俗文化特色， 襯托出最傲人的色彩，保留台灣原有造屋四方正高雅格局，更顯文人雅致、清風道德氣息。 只有親自體驗、親自尋找才能道出無盡的情意。 我們相信，在漁埕，能讓久待喧囂都市的朋友們徹底放鬆心靈， 不管是旅遊或體驗都能像漁船滿載盈歸一樣收穫豐盛。自然體驗小琉球 本民宿位於小琉球東邊左近龍蝦洞右近旭日亭，以配合當地潮汐時間， 導覽潮間帶的生態特色，體驗其豐富的生命力，希冀達到純欣賞而不破壞之保育原則。 漁埕民宿為維持旅客享有完善的生態之旅、體驗自然品質，我們確切建立並呼籲保育觀念。

stays.name: 琉夏萊八村旅店
stays.description: 琉夏萊旅店 StayHotel位在熱鬧核心，享受簡單生活的理想之地在小琉球的熱情陽光與湛藍海洋中，琉夏萊旅店以簡約舒適的風格，為旅人打造一個溫馨、放鬆、沒有壓力的「島嶼日常」。⸻絕佳地理位置，輕鬆探索島嶼風情 • 市區中心｜熱鬧不擁擠飯店座落於小琉球熱鬧地段，鄰近便利商店、餐飲美食、租車行與商店街，生活機能齊全。 • 碼頭步行距離從白沙尾碼頭出站後約步行8分鐘即可抵達，不必奔波，即刻開始假期。 • 地標花瓶石只要5分鐘！小琉球最具代表性的天然景觀「花瓶石」，從飯店出發散步就到，是晨間散步或夕陽打卡的絕佳選擇。⸻簡約風格．自然舒適 • 設計理念：回歸純粹，放下疲憊飯店採用自然色調與簡潔線條設計，營造靜謐又輕鬆的氛圍，讓每位旅人都能安心沉澱、自在休息。 • 房型設備齊全，滿足各類需求雙人房、家庭房、多人住宿空間皆備，搭配舒適床墊、冷氣、Wi-Fi、盥洗用品等，注重每一處細節。 • 乾淨明亮，注重衛生與品質每日客房清潔與消毒流程，讓您住得安心無虞。⸻我們相信：旅行，應該簡單又溫暖不論是第一次來到小琉球，還是每年都會回來的熟客，琉夏萊旅店都是您最輕鬆無負擔的選擇。我們在這裡，等你回來。

stays.description: 民宿就位於屏東縣琉球鄉的一個可愛小島，獨特的民宿外觀，利用大量的馬賽克色塊拼接，展現出充滿熱愛小島感的設計與其他小琉球的民宿相比，更能凸顯我們的與眾不同房型特色大不同，各式風格及家具設計，帶給大家多重視覺體驗，更是在細節上特別用心，極具滿滿藝術感擺設，在尊順祿處處讓大家挖掘驚喜，絕對可以一來再來。這充滿異國風情的尊順祿藝術民宿，適合親子同樂、家族旅遊、情侶享樂又或是獨自前往的您，現在就跟著我們談一場異國風情的戀愛吧!

stays.descriptionEn: The hotel is located just a few minutes walk from the pier and is located in the center of Otaru. It is also the highest inn in the island. It has the title of Little Ryukyu 101 and is the first hotel in the island with a hotel license. It is also the first hotel in the island with an accessible elevator. The top floor has more subtleties, overlooking Beida Wushan to Kaohsiung East Emperor, and at night it is a great place to enjoy coffee and watch the night scene!

stays.description: 小琉球第一家以蝴蝶為題材的民宿(Farfalla義大利文)。沒有華麗的建築，以色彩鮮艷的方塊磚不規則拼貼出活耀的氣質，加上宛如空中花園般的外觀，蝴蝶漫妙飛舞讓人有種幸福加倍感喔!室內是主要是以浪漫田園風為主調，但為了讓朋友們有新鮮感，我們還精心佈置不同風格的房型，都很有feel喔！不管是一群好友、一家大小，攜手夫妻還是甜蜜到爆的情侶都適合，因為我們很用心讓大家有賓至如歸的感受，讓旅行成為幸福的出走，溫馨的環境可以加溫彼此的感情，釋放長期累績的壓力，我們還在不斷努力中讓新民宿更茁壯喔！本民宿位於寧靜的巷道內，空氣新鮮，離觀光碼頭及熱鬧的老街都很近喔!步行約3-5分^0^，民宿旁還有采蝶小花園，是聊天說笑的好地點，也有專屬停車場，便利性佳，請放心!Farfalla全體小幫手歡迎大 家來我家住一晚^^
stays.descriptionEn: The first butterfly-themed B&B in Hsiao Liouciou (Farfalla in Italian means ‘butterfly’) There’s no fancy architecture, but the construction features an irregular mosaic of brilliantly colored square tiles that present a lively atmosphere reminiscent of the hanging gardens of legend, while fluttering butterflies double the sensation of happiness. Indoor settings are established around the main theme of romantic rural gardens, and we have also provided various furnishing styles to add a wondrous, refreshing vibe to our rooms. Our rooms are perfect for friends, families, married couples, and passionate lovers, and we have invested a great deal of effort to help our guests feel right at home. Holidays should provide an enjoyable getaway experience, and the cozy environment will help provide warmth and bring people closer while eliminating pent up stress. We are also pursuing continuing improvements to this new B&B to ensure its healthy, lovely growth! This B&B is located on a quiet street with refreshing air and is extremely close (just a 3 to 5-minute walk ^0^) to the Tourist Wharf and bustling boulevard. We are right next to a butterfly garden, a perfect place to hold delightful conversations with friends and family. Don’t worry if you’re driving since there’s also an exclusive parking area to add to our already excellent convenience. The Farfalla family welcomes you to stay with us!

stays.descriptionEn: "Liuqiu Homestay～Jin Gan Dan Homestay" sits on the bustling Jhongshan Rd. in Liuqiu. When you get off a boat, you can arrive at Jin Gan Dan Homestay shortly. It is in the vicinity of attractions, such as Baisha Port, ChungAu Beach, Vase Rock, etc. No matter whether you come to and depart from Liuqiu, buy travel souvenirs, go shopping, or taste local special dishes, it is very convenient. You can easily have a good time in Liuqiu～ "Liuqiu Homestay～Jin Gan Dan Homestay" provides Twin and Quad rooms. The well-designed decorations by the owner of the Homestay create a warm, elegant, refreshing, and pleasant atmosphere. Everywhere you look it says holiday! Our suites are equipped with a comprehensive of equipment supplies which allows you to have a free and comfortable space to rest after your activities

stays.name: 首瓦設計民宿
stays.description: 『首』綠新栽集逸趣、『瓦』建傳承思起源}~~ 首瓦建築外觀為斜屋頂、白牆、使用LOWE抗UV強化玻璃，以節能建築(採光設計、使用自然光源、減少能源消耗(熱泵熱水器))的設計方向為建築主軸。而開放性的客廳與餐廳，加上透空的木梯，以及琉球特有之漂流木，經過簡單表面處理後，期讓空間變成獨一無二之裝置；另隔而不斷的開放廚房，亦是休憩小酌的小空間，而二樓開放區退縮的小庭院，加上前庭採光，讓我們的通風採光極佳！另〞首瓦〞之取名發想，乃此屋位於出生血脈地〞瓦厝內〞，而瓦厝內亦是小琉球第一棟使用瓦片建造之三合院，故取名為首瓦設計名宿，以此感恩緬懷先祖們之辛勤打拼。『我們每天只接待一組旅人，以期獨享首瓦整棟的悠閒自在住宿空間』
stays.descriptionEn: Shou Watt, pronounced as "Shou-Wa", means "first tile". The name represents the first tile put on the roof that started the heritage and origin of Shou Watt Design B&B. Shou Watt B&B has a slanted roof and white walls. Its building principal is energy conservation - UV-resistant tempered glass, energy-efficient building materials such as using natural light, and reducing energy consumption by using a heat pump water heater, etc.. The open-style living room and dining room, open staircase and the simply treated driftwood (unique to Liuqiu) all make the living space special and unique. In addition, the open kitchen has a small space to rest or take a break. The small open area on the second floor has a small courtyard that brings a lot of natural light to the room. The history behind the name "Shou Watt" was that this house was built on the location of the owner's ancestral home, "Wa-Cuo-Nei". Since Wa-Cuo-Nei was the first courtyard house in Xiaoliuqiu built with tiles, therefore the name "Shou Watt Design B&B" was given to remember the ancestor's hard work. In order for our guests to fully enjoy and relax in the privacy of their own home, we only receive one group of guests each day.

stays.description: 來去鄉下住一晚。玩遍青山綠水、萬里祕境，來一趟下鄉放鬆之遊吧～好奇餐桌的青菜蘿蔔、香甜入口的水果，是如何長成的？到高屏大橋旁的橋畔民宿走一趟就知曉！這裡是是阿公阿嬤精心維護的後花園，種有多種當季水果-草莓、芭樂、百香果、番茄、紅龍果、芒果等；都是兒孫們桌上的珍饈，更是前來住宿旅人們體驗採摘樂趣的好所在。房型清爽舒適，適合三代同遊或親朋好友相約共往。放空。放風。放鬆。

stays.description: 蒼勁樸拙的盆栽，典雅的歐風建築，令您眼光一亮的依山農園。位於車城鄉至恆春鎮的省道旁，便利的交通位置，距離恆春半島的知名景點，如海生館、恆春古城、南灣海水浴場、車城福安宮、四重溪溫泉、海口港、牡丹水庫等名勝，皆可在十分鐘左右的車程到達。客房陽台，清晨可東望丘陵絢爛的日出，黃昏可眺望海峽的落日餘暉。四周更有四季不同作物的更迭，秋冬洋蔥成長的青蓊，春夏稻浪的起伏，即使不是農夫，也享有耕作收成的喜悅。餐廳提供旅遊恆春半島必食的四重溪知名大山羊肉爐與眾多風味特色菜。來依山農園，享用美食，還有折扣優惠，絕對能為您的墾丁之旅更添遊興。

stays.name: 墾丁後灣發宅民宿
stays.description: 這棟小旅店存在的目的是讓你也想到村子裡的海灣，或背面小山丘上走走，而不只是待在房間裡看海。房間裡有時候反倒是希望能讓你發發呆，因為這已經是現代世界工作人生的一種奢侈。我們堅持蓋一棟清水模建築，表達對這裡環境的善意。少了鬧鐘提醒，多了台灣原生木香氣的呼喚，少了規律緊湊的節奏，多了海的視角，人們在建築空間與光影交織下鬆弛，回到自然的節奏。宅在後灣，充飽生命電源重新出發。
stays.descriptionEn: Back Bay Fa Haus has a Architectural Concrete carriage with double Elevations.It stands still with low key under the pure blue sky.The upright walls outside cover the zigzag architecture is neat and tidy. When footsteps appreciate, when the glow of the setting sun shines and bells ring, open the gate and enter the field of ray with fascinated and unwilling to leave feelings.It also feels like breaking in a secrete Gallery maze…..

Just a short drive from Sichongxi Hot Springs, the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium, and the scenic Kenting area, our guesthouse offers a peaceful, sunlit environment with warm, comfortable rooms. Whether you’re traveling with family, your partner, or friends, we provide thoughtful service and a home-like atmosphere to make your stay truly relaxing. stays.name: 村野奇遇民宿
stays.description: ＊村野奇遇旅宿有兩間房，每間可使用平面坪數約33坪(室內22坪)，可舖3張雙人床 (樓下一張，樓上兩張)，一套衛浴，一套廚房，室外有泡澡戲水池，可烤肉(需事先告知，如遇下雨將不提供場地烤肉），有專屬停車空間，距離房門僅4米。*孩童戶外泡澡戲水時，須有成人陪同，注意濕滑，並請勿於後院奔跑，避免危險。*自106年9月份開始，為維護親子住宿空間及環境舒適度，將不再提供加床服務，住宿每房限定六位，110公分以下不佔床小朋友每房最多可再一位，總人數不得超過七位，四人房價格舖二張床，最多也只能含一位不佔床小朋友，超過一位即以舖三張床計費。*住宿人數有變更，必須提前告知，確定入住價格，現場才加人數，業者有拒絕入住（訂金不退還）及加價之權利。*訪客留宿，請確實告知，違者加收房價50%金額。*烤肉為提供場地與烤肉架，需事先告知，其餘食材.木炭.網子及免洗餐具自備。*烤肉為提供住宿客人晚餐方便與趣味的體驗，非住宿訪客如欲前來一同烤肉，需酌收每位100元清潔費用，並請如實告知會有訪客參與。*戶外烤肉後，請協助自行整理打包殘餘食材及廚餘，並放入垃圾桶內，並請於晚間10點後，如在庭園等開放空間，降低音量，避免影響他人住宿品質。*目前並未開放寵物入住。*親子民宿訴求歡樂，家族聚會。吸毒等違法一律報警處理。*室內一律禁煙，房屋木造裝潢及噪音問題，請勿施放煙火及鞭炮類。*為維護住房客人安全，颱風季節如有發佈屏東縣陸上警報，將取消當日訂房，預付之訂金無條件全數歸還。***最新公告: 因應各項成本調漲，與民宿內部設備提升，將於110年1/1開始，每週五調整為假日價格，其餘平日一樣是維持原價，歡迎各位多多安排於平日來渡假放鬆唷…

stays.description: 海悅灣民宿於108年全新完工，於車城鄉圖書館對面，附近停車方便，走出巷口有7-11及萊爾富、農會超市，距離熱鬧的福安宮不遠，附近有很多著名的在地小吃，如車城綠豆蒜、芋粿、鴨蛋...等，飲食機能相當方便。民宿非常新穎乾淨，裝潢帶有一種甜美清新的感覺，從燈飾到抱枕，隨處可見民宿主人細心佈置的可愛擺設品，如果你是喜歡溫馨舒適風格的旅客，這間民宿會是你很不錯的選擇。 有8坪房間及衛浴空間大，室內燈光明亮，還有提供烤肉設備及位置，一間是旅宿卻又像家的溫馨住宿，值得你們來體驗喔!
stays.descriptionEn: Haiyuewan Homestay was completely completed in 108 years. It is opposite the Checheng Town Library. It is convenient to park nearby. There are 7-11 and Lai Erfu and Nonghui Supermarkets. It is not far from the lively Fu'an Palace. There are many famous nearby. In the local snacks, such as Checheng green bean garlic, clams, duck eggs, etc., the diet is quite convenient. The homestay is very clean and fresh, with a sweet and fresh touch. From lighting to pillows, you can see the lovely furnishings of the owner. If you are a warm and comfortable guest, this homestay is a good choice. . There are 8 ping rooms and large bathroom space, bright indoor lighting, barbecue equipment and location, and a homely accommodation that is like a home. It is worth your experience!

stays.name: 湯之丘民宿
stays.description: 位於屏東縣的民宿,王爸不是什麼時尚美學的追隨者，更不懂什麼遺世獨立的人生哲學。他的小屋只要樸實溫暖是他勤奮人生的寫照反映即可，小屋自己住，空房想要與人分享，王爸的小屋仍舊持續變化中，小花園的景色日益豐富，可擁美人湯泉，享山林幽靜。王爸退休生活最大的願望是結識四方有夢想待實現的人，王爸可以分享他實踐夢想的經驗，這裡有個專注的故事講給你聽，努力與自然共存，回歸與土地應有的合諧關係，王爸的退休理念是在嫻靜的山林中體悟日常生活的規律。實踐夢想是快樂的，他始終堅定地這樣傳遞給家人。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Pingtung County, Wang Dad is not a follower of fashion aesthetics, nor does he understand the philosophy of life that is independent of the world. His cottage is simple and warm, reflecting his diligent life. He lives in the cottage himself, and wants to share the empty room with others. Wang Dad& #39;s cottage is still changing, and the scenery of the small garden is becoming more and more rich. You can enjoy the beauty of the hot springs and the quietness of the mountains and forests. Wang Dad& #39;s biggest wish in retirement life is to meet people from all over the world who have dreams to realize. Wang Dad can share his experience in realizing his dreams. Here is a story of concentration to tell you, striving to coexist with nature and return to the harmonious relationship with the land. Wang Dad& #39;s retirement concept is to understand the rules of daily life in the quiet mountains and forests. It is happy to realize dreams, and he always firmly passes this on to his family.

stays.nameEn: Long Beach Sports and Leisure Hotel
stays.description: 長灘打造小朋友放電,爸爸媽媽放鬆,阿公阿嬤放空的親子渡假飯店！結合港口沙灘創造絕無僅有的運動休閒交流場域!全館196間舒適客房部分有獨立戶外陽台，整體設計溫馨舒適、色彩鮮明高達九成以上皆能欣賞到台灣海峽的壯闊風景。來客傍晚盡可沉浸於沙灘夕陽的浪漫餘暉之中,白天醒來望向窗外，窗景如畫，盡情徜徉於蔚藍海洋的無邊遼闊。豐富休閒設施 ｜在一樓中庭打造350坪大型兒童賽車場FUN 速甩尾車，讓親子盡情享受電動卡丁車甩尾奔馳的樂趣。B1更是規劃500坪超大室內遊樂場FUN電屋，有彈跳床、旋轉木馬、球池、溜滑梯、互動遊戲等，絕對讓小朋友High翻天另設有男女三溫暖，完善的烤箱、蒸氣室與冷熱水池配備，也是在墾丁唯獨有的三溫暖休閒設施，希望給予大人們全身舒緩筋骨、徹底紓壓。另外還有戶外戲水區磨石溜滑梯、戲水池、沖擊池等，讓大小朋友清涼放鬆的好地方。而3F健身房更將規畫親子瑜珈課程，絕對是親子同樂的渡假天堂。餐飲美食｜ Dining一樓設有海遇餐廳提供早晚餐的中西式自助餐及桌菜、簡餐，主廚使用在地當令食材及海鮮發想創意料理，呈現最新鮮的美味。二樓規劃為戲陽咖啡藝廊，享受美麗海景與精緻下午茶。多功能宴會廳，適合舉辦各類型會議以及小型宴會活動，為海口港的美食及聚餐的最佳選擇。飯店緊鄰海口港與海口沙灘沙灘步行即可抵達，享受豐富的海陸活動如馬術、獨木舟、 衝浪、 SUP 立式划槳、遊艇出海夜訪梅花鹿、觀星及潮間帶生態等…。飯店鄰近知名景點：海口港、看海美術館、海生館、車城福安宮、龜山步道、四重溪溫泉逛恆春古城玩海角七號車程都約15分鐘，距離墾丁大街約23 分鐘車程!結合海景長灘，遼闊海岸，雕塑出國際水準的渡假飯店，是您來墾丁旅遊渡假的最佳選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: Long Beach Hotel creates a parent-child resort hotel where children discharge, parents relax, and grandparents let go! Combined with the port beach to create a unique sports and leisure communication field!The large-scale playground of more than 700 square meters, FUN speed drift car, paddling pool, sauna and other facilities specially designed for parents and children allow children to release their vitality to the fullest. The beach near Haikou is within walking distance, and you can enjoy a wealth of marine and land activities such as horse riding, parasailing, snorkeling, yachting and intertidal ecology… The hotel is close to well-known attractions: Haisheng Pavilion, Checheng Fu’an Palace, Guishan Trail, Sichongxi Hot Spring, Haikou Port, Hengchun Ancient City, and Cape No. 7 are all about 15 minutes’ drive away, and Kenting Street is about 23 minutes’ drive away! Combined with the sea view Long Beach, the vast coast, has carved out an international-level resort hotel, which is the best choice for you to travel and vacation in Kenting.

stays.name: 長鈺溫泉飯店
stays.description: 「長鈺溫泉飯店(Samiling Resort)」在2022年初開始試營運。是首家以「長鈺」命名的旅店品牌。擷取頂尖人士世界旅遊體驗；結合地方特色；旅店優勢，採「精品式」經營。一如常玉畫家，開創將中國藝術筆法融入西畫的創作，恣意揮灑，成就了他獨特的簡約流暢繪畫風格。其知名畫作-裸女系列，僅以線條表現卻餘韻猶存，人體更似水墨山石，富含力量的線條與穩定的構圖，與長鈺溫泉飯店的戶外山景相互輝映。長鈺溫泉飯店 充滿藝術人文與自然泉源之處，洗滌一身的城市塵囂與繁瑣，享受當代簡約建築與自然景觀交相融合的寧靜祥和。
stays.descriptionEn: Similar to the artist Sanyu, a pioneer who integrated western art into Chinese calligraphy. His unbridled work established his simple, flowing art style.His renowned works, series of female nudes, utilize lines to express a lingering sentiment. The human body flows similar to ink and mountains, full of powerful lines and a solid composition that echoes the scenes of mountains found at Samiling Resort, a hotel where guests may enjoy peace and tranquility created through the integration of modern minimalistic architecture and natural scenery.

stays.searchText: 長鈺溫泉飯店 鼎立飯店股份有限公司 屏東縣旅館130號 屏東縣 車城鄉 溫泉村6鄰溫泉路玉泉巷27、27-1、27-2號 「長鈺溫泉飯店(Samiling Resort)」在2022年初開始試營運。是首家以「長鈺」命名的旅店品牌。擷取頂尖人士世界旅遊體驗；結合地方特色；旅店優勢，採「精品式」經營。一如常玉畫家，開創將中國藝術筆法融入西畫的創作，恣意揮灑，成就了他獨特的簡約流暢繪畫風格。其知名畫作-裸女系列，僅以線條表現卻餘韻猶存，人體更似水墨山石，富含力量的線條與穩定的構圖，與長鈺溫泉飯店的戶外山景相互輝映。長鈺溫泉飯店 充滿藝術人文與自然泉源之處，洗滌一身的城市塵囂與繁瑣，享受當代簡約建築與自然景觀交相融合的寧靜祥和。

stays.name: 台三線豐景民宿
stays.description: 一、民宿基本資料：1.台三線豐景民宿為合法民宿，登記：屏東民宿1404號。於113年1月16日取得合法證照。2.區域：位於屏東縣里港鄉與高雄市旗山區的交界。3.訂房專線：0932753131莊又璋/0928558267陳小姐/08-77317894.請加民宿line搜尋電話號碼(ID)：0932753131莊又璋5.訂房時間：上午7:00~晚上9:006.民宿臉書：搜尋「台三線豐景民宿」粉絲專頁。7.在Google Map搜尋「台三線豐景民宿」，別用地址搜尋，不容易找到。二、 房型價格：更新日期：113/07/01房型：平日/假日/春節期間(定價)2號二人套房：平日1500/假日1700/春節期間27001號三人套房：平日2000/假日2200/春節期間32003號四人套房：平日2300/假日2700/春節期間37005號六人雅房和室：平日2500/假日3000/春節期間4000包棟(其中一間為主人房間)：平日9800/假日11200/春節期間16100三、民宿特色：1.請使用Google Map搜尋「台三線豐景民宿」即可到達(豐富的豐，不是風景的風)。2.民宿對面為「十三甲輪胎行」。民宿距離土庫中油台糖加油站3公里。距離屏東里港三和國小3公里。3.民宿附近無商家，建議先至旗山老街(距離13分鐘)、美濃鎮上(距離10分鐘)、里港街上(距離12分鐘)、佛光山與佛陀紀念館(距離15分鐘)用完晚餐，再前往民宿。4.本民宿為屏東北部與旗山交界之合法民宿，為罕見的農莊式、獨棟別墅型一層樓民宿，充滿濃厚田園氣息，位在台三線省道旁，目標大、地點佳，適合渡假、休憩、家庭包棟、聚會踏青、婚嫁迎婜、鐵馬重機中途停靠，絕對是您到屏北區入住的最佳選擇! 5.民宿生態豐富，石縫草皮花卉間，常可見小動物優游自在生活著，夜間有機會看到零星螢火蟲。怕蚊蟲者，建議穿著薄長袖長褲、攜帶防蚊液。6.本民宿擁有開闊的植栽景觀，寬大的庭院空間，適合兒童遊戲；處處驚喜的綠意、壯麗豪華的建築，歡迎情侶打卡拍照、享受甜蜜兩人時光；平坦的無障礙空間、環型自然健康步道，適合老年人渡假散步；偌大的室外休閒空間、舒適的迴廊聊天角落，適合家庭成員各取所需。若是天公作美、能見度高，傍晚的「夕照豐景」、夜間的「映月觀星」，更是您不容錯過的絕美風景!四、 民宿位置：1.在Google map上搜尋「台三線豐景民宿」(豐富的豐)，即可找到。2.民宿位置：在旗屏二路、台三線413公里處，在「十三甲輪胎行」的對面。省道大馬路邊，有棟「圍牆別墅」，請事先打手機0932753131莊又璋詢問。3.絕對不要用地址搜尋(屏東縣里港鄉土庫村北安路1之38號)，容易被導引到小路而走錯路。五、 民宿交通：【開車交通資訊】：1.國道3號(南二高)下「九如交流道」往北，往里港、旗山方向，沿台三線 九如路三段—中山路—里港路，上里港大橋—三和路—南興路—土庫路—北安路，看到台糖中油土庫加油站，再往北走、往旗山方向1公里，約1分鐘，就會看到田野中有棟「圍牆別墅」。2.國道3號轉國道10號高雄支線，下「里港交流道」往北、往旗山方向，沿台三線走約8公里，就會看到田野中有棟「圍牆別墅」。3.走國道10號往「旗山」方向，到終點，右轉往南、往里港方向，約5公里，即可到達。【坐公車資訊】一、北上：由屏東方向，搭乘屏東客運或高雄客運往旗山美濃公車，在「北安站」下車，再步行1公里即可到達。二、南下：由旗山方向，搭乘屏東客運或高雄客運往里港、屏東公車，在「吉洋站」下車，再步行1公里即可到達。六、 民宿設施設備：【公共設施】飲水機、客廳電視、戶外桌椅、免費停車場、健康步道【客房設施】電視、吹風機、電扇、冷氣、WiFi、洗髮精、沐浴乳、毛巾、室內拖鞋、茶杯、衣架【不主動提供】未提供早餐、未提供一次性牙刷、牙膏、梳子、浴帽、刮鬍刀、刮鬍泡。七、 匯款資訊敬請您於2日內，預付一半或全額訂金，匯款資訊：郵局（700）帳號0071275－0039030，完成匯款後，請電話通知：姓名、電話、帳號末五碼、金額、住宿日期、房型、人數，即完成訂房手續。請來電 0932753131莊又璋先生。
stays.descriptionEn: Taiwan Third Line Fengjing B&B(1). Basic information of B&B:1. Taiwan Third Line Fengjing B&B is a legal B&B, registered: Pingtung B&B No. 1404. Obtained legal license on January 16, 2013.2. Area: Located at the junction of Ligang Township, Pingtung County and Qishan District, Kaohsiung City.3. Reservation hotline: 0932753131 Zhuang Youzhang/0928558267 Miss Chen/08-77317894. Please add the B&B line search phone number (ID): 0932753131 Zhuang Youzhang5. Reservation time: 7:00 am ~ 9:00 pm6. B&B Facebook:7. Search "Taisan 3rd Line Fengjing B&B" on Google Map. Don't search by address, it's not easy to find.(2). Room price:Update date: 113/07/01Room Type: Weekdays/Holidays/Spring Festival (Pricing)Triple Suite No. 1: 2000 on weekdays/2200 on holidays/3200 on Spring FestivalSuite No. 2 for two persons: 1,500 on weekdays/1,700 on holidays/2,700 on Spring FestivalQuadruple Suite No. 3: Weekdays 2,300/Holidays 2,700/Spring Festival 3,700No. 5 Japanese-style room for six people: 2,500 on weekdays/3,000 on holidays/4,000 on Spring FestivalPrivate rooms (one of which is the master room): 9800 on weekdays/11200 on holidays/16100 on Spring Festival(3). B&B Features:1. Please use Google Map to search for " Taiwan Third Line Fengjing B&B "2. Opposite the B&B is the "Shisanjia Tire Shop". The property is 3 km from Tuku CPC Taisugar Gas Station. Pingtung Ligang Sanhe Elementary School is 3 km away.3. There are no businesses near the B&B. It is recommended to go to Qishan Old Street (13 minutes away), Meinong Town (10 minutes away), Ligang Street (12 minutes away), Fo Guang Shan and Buddha Memorial Hall (15 minutes away) After dinner, head to the B&B.4. This B&B is a legal B&B located at the junction of northern Pingtung and Qishan. It is a rare farm-style, single-family villa-style one-story B&B, full of pastoral atmosphere. It is located next to Provincial Highway No. 3, with a large target and good location. It is suitable for vacation, rest, family reservation, gathering, wedding, and motorcycle stopover. It is definitely the best choice for you to stay in Pingbei District!5. The B&B has a rich ecology. Small animals can often be seen living freely among the rocks, grass and flowers. There is a chance to see sporadic fireflies at night. If you are afraid of mosquitoes, it is recommended to wear thin long-sleeved shirts and long pants and carry mosquito repellent.6. This homestay has an open plant landscape and a large courtyard space, which is suitable for children to play; the greenery is surprising everywhere, and the magnificent and luxurious buildings welcome couples to check in and take photos and enjoy a sweet time for two; the flat barrier-free space and circular The natural health trail is suitable for the elderly to take a walk during vacation; the large outdoor leisure space and comfortable corridor chat corner are suitable for family members to meet their needs. If the weather is good and visibility is high, the "sunset scenery" in the evening and the "moon and stargazing" at night are the beautiful scenery you cannot miss!(4). Location of B&B:1. Search for " Taiwan Third Line Fengjing B&B " on Google Maps and you will find it.2. Location of the B&B: On Qiping 2nd Road, Provincial Highway 3, at km 413, opposite the "Shisanjia Tire Shop". There is a "walled villa" on the side of the provincial road. Please call Zhuang Youzhang on 0932753131 in advance for inquiries.3. Never use the address search (No. 1-38, Bei'an Road, Tuku Village, Ligang Township, Pingtung County) as it is easy to be led to a side road and take the wrong road.(5). Transportation to B&B:【Driving Traffic Information】:1. Take National Highway 3 (South Second Highway) and get off at Jiuru Interchange. Go north towards Ligang and Qishan. Follow Provincial Highway 3, Jiuru Road Section 3 - Zhongshan Road - Ligang Road. Go up Ligang Bridge - San He Road - Nanxing Road - Tuku Road - Beian Road, you will see the Taisugar-CNPC Tuku gas station, then walk north towards Qishan for 1 km. After about 1 minute, you will see a "walled villa" in the field. ".2. Take National Highway 3 and turn to National Highway 10 Kaohsiung Branch Line. Exit at Ligang Interchange and head north toward Qishan. Go along Provincial Highway 3 for about 8 kilometers and you will see a "walled villa" in the fields.3. Take National Highway 10 towards "Qishan". At the end, turn right south towards Ligang. After about 5 kilometers, you will arrive.【Bus Information】1. Going north: From Pingtung, take the Pingtung Bus or Kaohsiung Bus to Qishan-Meinong, get off at Bei'an Station, and walk 1 km to the destination.2. Going south: From Qishan, take Pingtung Bus or Kaohsiung Bus to Ligang or Pingtung Bus, get off at Jiyang Station, and walk 1 kilometer to arrive.(6). B&B facilities and equipment:[Public facilities] Water dispenser, living room TV, outdoor tables and chairs, free parking, health trail【Room Facilities】TV, hair dryer, fan, air conditioning, WiFi, shampoo, shower gel, towel, indoor slippers, tea cup, hanger[Not provided proactively] No breakfast is provided, and no disposable toothbrushes, toothpaste, combs, shower caps, razors, or shaving foam are provided.(7). Remittance InformationPlease pay half or the full deposit within 2 days. Remittance information: Post Office (700) account number 0071275-0039030. After completing the remittance, please call to inform: name, phone number, last five digits of account number, amount, accommodation date, room type, The reservation procedure is completed. Please call Mr. Zhuang Youzhang at 0932753131.

stays.searchText: 台三線豐景民宿 台三線豐景民宿 屏東縣民宿1404號 屏東縣 里港鄉 土庫村北安路1-38號 一、民宿基本資料：1.台三線豐景民宿為合法民宿，登記：屏東民宿1404號。於113年1月16日取得合法證照。2.區域：位於屏東縣里港鄉與高雄市旗山區的交界。3.訂房專線：0932753131莊又璋/0928558267陳小姐/08-77317894.請加民宿line搜尋電話號碼(ID)：0932753131莊又璋5.訂房時間：上午7:00~晚上9:006.民宿臉書：搜尋「台三線豐景民宿」粉絲專頁。7.在Google Map搜尋「台三線豐景民宿」，別用地址搜尋，不容易找到。二、 房型價格：更新日期：113/07/01房型：平日/假日/春節期間(定價)2號二人套房：平日1500/假日1700/春節期間27001號三人套房：平日2000/假日2200/春節期間32003號四人套房：平日2300/假日2700/春節期間37005號六人雅房和室：平日2500/假日3000/春節期間4000包棟(其中一間為主人房間)：平日9800/假日11200/春節期間16100三、民宿特色：1.請使用Google Map搜尋「台三線豐景民宿」即可到達(豐富的豐，不是風景的風)。2.民宿對面為「十三甲輪胎行」。民宿距離土庫中油台糖加油站3公里。距離屏東里港三和國小3公里。3.民宿附近無商家，建議先至旗山老街(距離13分鐘)、美濃鎮上(距離10分鐘)、里港街上(距離12分鐘)、佛光山與佛陀紀念館(距離15分鐘)用完晚餐，再前往民宿。4.本民宿為屏東北部與旗山交界之合法民宿，為罕見的農莊式、獨棟別墅型一層樓民宿，充滿濃厚田園氣息，位在台三線省道旁，目標大、地點佳，適合渡假、休憩、家庭包棟、聚會踏青、婚嫁迎婜、鐵馬重機中途停靠，絕對是您到屏北區入住的最佳選擇! 5.民宿生態豐富，石縫草皮花卉間，常可見小動物優游自在生活著，夜間有機會看到零星螢火蟲。怕蚊蟲者，建議穿著薄長袖長褲、攜帶防蚊液。6.本民宿擁有開闊的植栽景觀，寬大的庭院空間，適合兒童遊戲；處處驚喜的綠意、壯麗豪華的建築，歡迎情侶打卡拍照、享受甜蜜兩人時光；平坦的無障礙空間、環型自然健康步道，適合老年人渡假散步；偌大的室外休閒空間、舒適的迴廊聊天角落，適合家庭成員各取所需。若是天公作美、能見度高，傍晚的「夕照豐景」、夜間的「映月觀星」，更是您不容錯過的絕美風景!四、 民宿位置：1.在Google map上搜尋「台三線豐景民宿」(豐富的豐)，即可找到。2.民宿位置：在旗屏二路、台三線413公里處，在「十三甲輪胎行」的對面。省道大馬路邊，有棟「圍牆別墅」，請事先打手機0932753131莊又璋詢問。3.絕對不要用地址搜尋(屏東縣里港鄉土庫村北安路1之38號)，容易被導引到小路而走錯路。五、 民宿交通：【開車交通資訊】：1.國道3號(南二高)下「九如交流道」往北，往里港、旗山方向，沿台三線 九如路三段—中山路—里港路，上里港大橋—三和路—南興路—土庫路—北安路，看到台糖中油土庫加油站，再往北走、往旗山方向1公里，約1分鐘，就會看到田野中有棟「圍牆別墅」。2.國道3號轉國道10號高雄支線，下「里港交流道」往北、往旗山方向，沿台三線走約8公里，就會看到田野中有棟「圍牆別墅」。3.走國道10號往「旗山」方向，到終點，右轉往南、往里港方向，約5公里，即可到達。【坐公車資訊】一、北上：由屏東方向，搭乘屏東客運或高雄客運往旗山美濃公車，在「北安站」下車，再步行1公里即可到達。二、南下：由旗山方向，搭乘屏東客運或高雄客運往里港、屏東公車，在「吉洋站」下車，再步行1公里即可到達。六、 民宿設施設備：【公共設施】飲水機、客廳電視、戶外桌椅、免費停車場、健康步道【客房設施】電視、吹風機、電扇、冷氣、WiFi、洗髮精、沐浴乳、毛巾、室內拖鞋、茶杯、衣架【不主動提供】未提供早餐、未提供一次性牙刷、牙膏、梳子、浴帽、刮鬍刀、刮鬍泡。七、 匯款資訊敬請您於2日內，預付一半或全額訂金，匯款資訊：郵局（700）帳號0071275－0039030，完成匯款後，請電話通知：姓名、電話、帳號末五碼、金額、住宿日期、房型、人數，即完成訂房手續。請來電 0932753131莊又璋先生。

stays.name: 山豐民宿
stays.description: 位於霧台部落社區，''山豐民宿''已經營近20年，為了更好的住宿環境，2020年中旬整建，營造乾淨、簡單、舒適的住宿環境，加上霧台空氣品質淨、風景優美，到了夜晚非常寧靜，來霧台住一晚讓身心放鬆休息吧！重建後民宿風格爲簡約風格，但民宿外戶外廣場則是魯凱族頭目貴族的居住空間（民宿老闆的住家）有傳統石版屋、廣場石板立柱，我們提供的烤肉區也是搭建成過去魯凱族烤芋頭的窯喔！烤肉起來別有一番風味。 ※住宿不含餐，若需提供餐點，可事先通知預約闆娘（可提供魯凱傳統美食、家常菜） ※民宿一樓附設廚房，廚房餐具皆可使用（酌收瓦斯費、清潔費 300元/房） ※戶外廣場有烤肉區，可自帶設備（不收費用），若使用傳統石板烤肉窯（酌收清潔費/木材費用500元/房）※民宿外提供4輛車位停放。 ※民宿房內禁止吸菸。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the Wutai Tribe Community, Shanfeng B&B has been in business for nearly 20 years. In order to provide a better accommodation environment, it was renovated in mid-2020 to create a clean, simple and comfortable accommodation environment. In addition, Wutai has clean air quality and beautiful scenery. It is very quiet at night. Come to Wutai and stay for a night to relax your body and mind!After reconstruction, the style of the B&B is simple, but the outdoor square outside the B&B is the living space of the chieftains of the Rukai tribe (the home of the B&B owner). There are traditional stone houses and stone pillars in the square. The barbecue area we provide is also built like the kiln where the Rukai people used to roast taro! The barbecue has a unique flavor.※ Accommodation does not include meals. If you need meals, you can inform the host in advance (traditional Rukai cuisine and home-cooked dishes can be provided)※There is a kitchen on the first floor of the B&B, and all kitchen utensils can be used (gas fee and cleaning fee of 300 yuan/room will be charged)※There is a barbecue area in the outdoor square. You can bring your own equipment (free of charge). If you use a traditional stone barbecue kiln (cleaning fee/wood fee of 500 yuan/room)※There are 4 parking spaces outside the hotel.※Smoking is not allowed in the guesthouse rooms.

stays.name: 11家･民宿
stays.description: 11家・民宿（11 House）位於台灣唯一酒莊密度最高小鎮，在彰化西南角，就靜靜坐落在二林酒莊小鎮裡。它不是制式旅宿，而是一棟原本為「生活」而生的房子，後來，成為旅人暫時回家的地方。在這裡，你可以放慢腳步，在一樓大廳與庭院聊天、閱讀、發呆，和來自不同國家的旅人交換故事，也重新認識台灣鄉鎮最溫柔的樣子。11 House 延續青年旅館的交流精神，卻保留鄉間住宅的安靜與自在。沒有過度包裝，只有剛剛好的距離感與真誠的款待。如果你正在尋找——✔ 一個不擁擠的小鎮✔ 一段貼近土地的旅行✔ 一個能讓人安心停下來的地方那麼，二林，與 11家・民宿（11 House），正在等你，一起～找．回家的感動！

stays.descriptionEn: "Changhua Accommodation-Beidou Qixing B&B" is located in Beidou Town, Changhua County. stays.name: 員林商務旅館
stays.description: 座落員林三義路上的員林商旅，鄰近、購物商圈、商辦大樓、火車站、快速道路，便利的生活機能是員林商旅之優勢，步行約10分鐘就即抵熱鬧的購物商圈；前往田尾公路花園更僅4公里，且距76快速道路約5分鐘的路程，讓您不論是前往鹿港、埔心，或是商務交通往來都相當便利。 走進飯店大廳，馬上就能感受到不同於一般商務型飯店的陳設，在飯店內各個角落都能看到精心挑選的藝術品與畫作，不僅提昇整間飯店的品味，也為每位來到員林商旅的貴賓，增添了不少藝術氣息。除此之外，為了讓住房客感受不同驚豔，所有傢俱均特別訂做，再搭配不同房型及空間設計，呈現極簡風格的低調奢華。 員林商旅強調優於五星級飯店的服務品質，由小細節的觀察來延伸服務有著各式需求的顧客，從踏進飯店的第一步起，直至離開飯店的那一刻，期望每位顧客感受到的是「均質」的服務，而非僅限於初次來到飯店時才能享受的熱情接待。 員林商旅提供住房客絕佳隱私以及寧靜的住宿空間，每位前來入住的貴賓，都會有每間客房專屬的房間卡，只有手持這組專屬於您的卡片，才能夠在商旅內自在的進出，充份的保障您的住宿安全。 專業、體貼、真誠、用心是我們對每位員工的期許，來到員林商旅的每位顧客，不論是商務人士，還是旅遊的國內外旅客，都是需要用心服務的對象。我們的每位服務人員均透過完善的教育訓練、定期的員工會議，以及總經理親自教導的服務禮節。對員工而言，他們秉持專業素養來服務每位顧客；但對顧客而言，感受到的卻是無微不至、量身打造的真誠服務。 員林商旅的優質專業形象與口碑將會是您的首選，誠摯邀請閣下蒞臨，讓我們有榮幸為您提供至高無上的服務。
stays.descriptionEn: Yuan Lin Hotel is situated on the Sanyi Rd., Yuanlin. The convenient shopping mall, commercial building, train station and expressway nearby is our competitive edge. The shopping area is only a 10 minutes' walk from our hotel. The Tien Wei Highway Garden is just 4km away. It only takes you 5 minutes to drive to the Provincial Highway 76 from which you can go to Lukang, Puxin or everywhere with ease. As you enter the hotel lobby, you can see the furnishings that are different from common business hotels. You can admire well-chosen art works and paintings at every corner of the hotel. These art collections can not only enhance the taste of the entire hotel, but give every guest a sense of art. In addition, all of our furniture has been tailored to match different rooms and interior design. This creates a sense of simple and implicit luxury to amaze the guests. Yuan Lin Hotel focuses on a service quality that's better than 5 star hotels. We extend our services from the smallest details to guests with all kinds of needs. We hope that every of our guests can experience an "consistent quality" of service from check in to check out, not just a passionate reception that only appears when you first come to the hotel. Yuan Lin Hotel offers our guests a definitely private and quiet space to live in. Every guest will receive a dedicated room card. Only with this card can you go in and out freely. This way, your safety is fully guaranteed. We wish every of our staff can be professional, thoughtful, sincere and attentive. Every guest who comes to Yuan Lin Hotel, no matter a business person or a traveler, is the most important person that we have to treat with care. Our staff are all well-trained and they attend staff meetings periodically. Our general manager will coach them all service etiquette in person. Perhaps it's our staff's profession and duty to serve every guest, but to the guests, it's meticulous, tailored and sincere service what they can perceive. Yuan Lin Hotel's professional image and reputation is your best choice. We invite you to our hotel with true heart. Let us provide you the greatest service.

stays.searchText: 員林商務旅館 員林商務旅館有限公司 彰化縣旅館076號 彰化縣 員林市 三義路115號2,3,4,5,6,7樓 座落員林三義路上的員林商旅，鄰近、購物商圈、商辦大樓、火車站、快速道路，便利的生活機能是員林商旅之優勢，步行約10分鐘就即抵熱鬧的購物商圈；前往田尾公路花園更僅4公里，且距76快速道路約5分鐘的路程，讓您不論是前往鹿港、埔心，或是商務交通往來都相當便利。 走進飯店大廳，馬上就能感受到不同於一般商務型飯店的陳設，在飯店內各個角落都能看到精心挑選的藝術品與畫作，不僅提昇整間飯店的品味，也為每位來到員林商旅的貴賓，增添了不少藝術氣息。除此之外，為了讓住房客感受不同驚豔，所有傢俱均特別訂做，再搭配不同房型及空間設計，呈現極簡風格的低調奢華。 員林商旅強調優於五星級飯店的服務品質，由小細節的觀察來延伸服務有著各式需求的顧客，從踏進飯店的第一步起，直至離開飯店的那一刻，期望每位顧客感受到的是「均質」的服務，而非僅限於初次來到飯店時才能享受的熱情接待。 員林商旅提供住房客絕佳隱私以及寧靜的住宿空間，每位前來入住的貴賓，都會有每間客房專屬的房間卡，只有手持這組專屬於您的卡片，才能夠在商旅內自在的進出，充份的保障您的住宿安全。 專業、體貼、真誠、用心是我們對每位員工的期許，來到員林商旅的每位顧客，不論是商務人士，還是旅遊的國內外旅客，都是需要用心服務的對象。我們的每位服務人員均透過完善的教育訓練、定期的員工會議，以及總經理親自教導的服務禮節。對員工而言，他們秉持專業素養來服務每位顧客；但對顧客而言，感受到的卻是無微不至、量身打造的真誠服務。 員林商旅的優質專業形象與口碑將會是您的首選，誠摯邀請閣下蒞臨，讓我們有榮幸為您提供至高無上的服務。

stays.name: 昇財麗禧酒店
stays.description: 麗禧酒店位於繁華熱鬧的員林市區，是彰化地區最具口碑的住宿及餐飲宴客場所。全館均以觀光飯店同級建材精心打造，由花崗岩大理石堆砌成的高貴質感，是政商名流禮賓宴客的第一選擇。麗禧酒店秉持「誠摯、體貼、尊榮、服務」的經營理念，提供給客戶「安全、便利、舒適、健康、休閒」的住宿品質，親切有禮的服務人員、無微不至的貼心服務，讓您在疲憊的旅途之中也能感受到猶如回家的舒適感。 飯店客房採用與五星級觀光飯店同等級之高級建材、衛浴設備、傢俱寢具，現代化風格，每個房間均有大型景觀窗戶，晨昏街景讓您一覽無遺、盡收眼底。另有歐亞樂西餐廳融入東方飲食元素，提供豐富多樣的精選主餐，並可搭配餐檯豐富多元的開胃菜、熱食區、冷食區、季令蔬果沙拉、繽紛甜點...等自助吧及采逸樓中餐廳為粵菜及台式海鮮，滿足每一位饕客的味覺慾望。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the bustling and lively city of Yuanlin, Grand View Hotel is the most popular accommodation and dining venue in Changhua. The whole building is carefully built with the same level of building materials as the International Tourist Hotel. The noble texture of granite and marble is the first choice for political and business celebrity concierges. With the business philosophy of “Sincere, Considerate, Honorable and Service”, Grand View Hotel provides customers with “Safe, Convenient, Comfortable, Healthy and Leisure” accommodation quality, friendly and courteous service staff, and meticulous service. You can feel the comfort of being home during a tired journey. The hotel has a total of 80 luxurious and comfortable rooms with high-grade building materials, sanitary equipment and furniture bedding in the same level as the five-star tourist hotel. Each room has large landscape windows give you an unobstructed view. In addition, the Semi buffet restaurant and Cantonese restaurant incorporate oriental food elements, offering a wide variety of exquisite meals, unlimited enjoyment of the light food theme.

stays.name: 台灣大飯店
stays.description: 誠摯服務、賓至如歸台灣大飯店，擁有五十年歷史，座落在彰化市中心火車站旁，佔盡觀光、洽商的地利之便。2011年為了提供更好的服務品質與環境，不惜以巨資重新裝潢，品質提昇，呈獻給您品味時尚、設備貼心、空間寬敞的嶄新面貌。全部工作人員，態度親切，為您做最誠摯的服務。裝置藝術-顏雲連大師石化時期經典作品本館收藏抽象畫大師顏雲連先生8件大型裝置藝術創作。顏大師因設計台北波麗路西餐廳一炮而紅，成為台灣首席室內設計師，也是首位將幾何抽象構圖運用帶入台灣室內設計的原創者，被冠上【台籍抽象畫家第一人】，與趙無極、朱德群等抽象大師齊名。溫馨、明亮、時尚的客房台灣大飯店擁有45間精緻時尚客房，採用全新TOTO衛浴設備和32吋液晶電視、系統傢俱、無聲冰箱、氣密窗、防火門、光纖寬頻上網及獨立式空調系統，每間客房格調迥異，各展情趣，是一處溫馨、舒適的住宿環境。大師手筆、不同凡響客房部公共區域寬敞設置免費自助吧休閒區，提供報紙、雜誌及無線上網，三五好友品茗、喝咖啡聊天，訪客洽商皆可利用。館內完整保留抽象畫大師顏雲連8件大型裝置藝術創作，歷經53年淬煉更加綻放藝術光芒，歡迎您來見證。
stays.descriptionEn: Sincere Service - A Home Away From Home Hotel Taiwan has 50 years of history. It's located next to the train station in downtown Changhua, a convenient location for tourism and business. In order to provide better service and a better environment, a large sum of money was spent to redecorate the hotel. The updated hotel has improved facilities and presents a modern and spacious new look. The staff here are friendly, warm and sincere. Decorative Art - Hand-carved Stone Art by Artist, Yen Yun-lian Our motel houses eight large scale hand-carved stone art created by the master abstract artist, Yen Yun-lian. Mr. Yen became well-known for designing Taipei's Bolero Restaurant, thus becoming Taiwan's number one interior designer. He is also the original creator who incorporated geometric abstract compositions into interior design. He is referred as The First Taiwanese Abstract Artist, enjoying equal popularity as abstract artists Zhao Wo-ki and Chu Teh-chun. Warm, Bright and Modern Guestrooms Hotel Taiwan has 45 exquisite and modern guestrooms. Each room has brand new Toto bathroom fixtures, 32" LCD TV, furniture sets, silent refrigerator, airtight windows, fireproof door, fiber broadband internet and independent air conditioning system. stays.searchText: 台灣大飯店 台灣文化企業股份有限公司 彰化縣旅館006號 彰化縣 彰化市 中正路二段48號 誠摯服務、賓至如歸台灣大飯店，擁有五十年歷史，座落在彰化市中心火車站旁，佔盡觀光、洽商的地利之便。2011年為了提供更好的服務品質與環境，不惜以巨資重新裝潢，品質提昇，呈獻給您品味時尚、設備貼心、空間寬敞的嶄新面貌。全部工作人員，態度親切，為您做最誠摯的服務。裝置藝術-顏雲連大師石化時期經典作品本館收藏抽象畫大師顏雲連先生8件大型裝置藝術創作。顏大師因設計台北波麗路西餐廳一炮而紅，成為台灣首席室內設計師，也是首位將幾何抽象構圖運用帶入台灣室內設計的原創者，被冠上【台籍抽象畫家第一人】，與趙無極、朱德群等抽象大師齊名。溫馨、明亮、時尚的客房台灣大飯店擁有45間精緻時尚客房，採用全新TOTO衛浴設備和32吋液晶電視、系統傢俱、無聲冰箱、氣密窗、防火門、光纖寬頻上網及獨立式空調系統，每間客房格調迥異，各展情趣，是一處溫馨、舒適的住宿環境。大師手筆、不同凡響客房部公共區域寬敞設置免費自助吧休閒區，提供報紙、雜誌及無線上網，三五好友品茗、喝咖啡聊天，訪客洽商皆可利用。館內完整保留抽象畫大師顏雲連8件大型裝置藝術創作，歷經53年淬煉更加綻放藝術光芒，歡迎您來見證。

stays.descriptionEn: Changhua Laurel Motel has a unique style. The owner hired six well-known designers from either Hong Kong or Taiwan to design every room with different style and especially incorporate the sunlight, air, water, plants, and other elements into the design, so that the travelers can stay for resting or accommodation and at the same time fully enjoy the open, spacious, and the natural environment, A total of 23 rooms with different styles were designed with the main elements of the natural planting as structure, 7-9 meters wide glass windows, high ceiling louvres on the patio, power sunroof, automatic air convection, and sunlight entering indoor. The only common element is the bed of presidential suite level, which is offered without considering cost, and provide passengers with comfortable, respectful, considerate and warm service. Changhua Laurel Motel is the first hotel passed the highest ISO9001: 2008 international quality certification, won Happy Stay 100 sponsored by the Tourism Bureau and Taiwan Top 100 by vote organized by the Taiwan Travel News. Affectionate Changhua, attentive Laurel Motel, and sincere treatment, unswerving from start to finish.

stays.description: Timios 提米好旅 τίμιος tímios, tim'-ee-os; from 希臘文; valuable, i.e. (objectively) costly, or (subjectively) honored, esteemed, or (figuratively) beloved:—dear, honourable, (more, most) precious, had in reputation. 尊貴的、寶貴的、尊榮的意思。為發掘、啟發每個人生命的寶貴，為人的生命注入動力，鼓勵成全彼此，成為更好的自己，成為彼此的祝福。我們的品牌精神：伸展、旅行、生活、回歸。伸展-取自大樹跟生命一樣會不斷的伸展。旅行-每片葉子都有個最棒的故事。生活-用自己的方式活出自我享受人生。回歸-回到原點都是良好的循環。到Timios 提米好旅—旅行、交友、成長、移動、工作、偷閒，尋找你夢中的橄欖樹吧！結出你一生最甜美的果子～

stays.description: 彰化福泰商務飯店位於彰化市中心，近彰化火車站及彰化基督教醫院，集各類高級客房、餐飲、休閒、商務活動於一體，飯店一樓大廳華麗風格的水晶燈飾與極具現代藝術感的時間牆裝置，讓人一進來就能完全感受與眾不同嶄新面貌的商務飯店，全館 100 間高雅簡約客房，貼心提供現代化軟硬體設備；飯店內設有餐廳「 食旅匯 」，提供房客豐盛的自助式早餐，午間更推出精緻的中西式套餐；飯店內設有健身房及設備齊全的商務中心，更能迅速滿足住客各種商務需求，為中南部地區最有特色的豪華飯店。
stays.descriptionEn: The Forte Hotel Changhua is located the downtown area of Changhua City, near the Changhua Train Station and Changhua Christian Hospital. The Hotel consists of 100 deluxe guestrooms, three restaurants, meeting and banquet spaces. The modern and spacious design of the hotel welcomes guests into a brand new experience of the business hotel. All 100 of the deluxe guestrooms in the Hotel are equipped with modern amenities and functions. The Hotel restaurant, the “Forteat” are dedicated to supplying fresh Chinese and Western cuisine, original Chinese meals, delicate snacks and handmade bread. The gym and commercial center inside the Hotel can also meet guests' business or travel needs promptly. Forte Hotel Changhua is recognized as a very characteristic and luxurious hotel in Central and Southern Taiwan.

stays.name: 金城旅社
stays.description: 金城旅社，有著懷舊又摩登×濃淡合宜的工業風，而且房型配置多元;除了有各種不同主題的套房外，二樓還有女性專用背包客房和三樓男性背包客房，將男女分區，隱私又安全。 屋內建材則使用玻璃磚牆、花格磚、紅磚、裸磚及金屬鐵片等，讓沈穩的空間中跳脫出一絲活潑又復古的氣息。加上溫潤的木頭質感去呈現濃厚的工業設計風格，令人流連於復古與時尚，新舊交織的時光走廊。 舒適的大廳除了接待旅人的到來，座位區的陳設規劃了一個像是小酒吧的空間，在玻璃座位旁，旅人們可以休憩片刻，享受恣意灑落的陽光。 天井的旋轉梯蜿蜒而上，明亮的光線由天井灑下，像是走進了往日時光裡，駐足在妳我的心中~ 陽台保留著過去燒熱水的鍋爐，斑駁的鐵銹，在一盞盞小燈泡的陪伴下，訴說著過往的故事，也為金城旅社構築出嶄新風貌。
stays.descriptionEn: Jincheng Hostel has a nostalgic and modern industrial style, and a variety of room types; in addition to a variety of suites with different themes, there are women-only backpacking rooms on the second floor and men-only backpacking rooms on the third floor. In addition to a variety of suites with different themes, there is also a backpacking room for women on the second floor and a backpacking room for men on the third floor, which is divided into male and female sections for privacy and safety. The interior materials used include glass tile walls, lattice tiles, red bricks, bare bricks and metal sheets, giving a lively yet vintage flavor to the calm space. The interior of the house is made of glass tile walls, lattice tiles, red bricks, bare bricks and metal sheets, giving a lively and retro flavor to the stable space. In addition, the warm wood texture presents a strong industrial design style, allowing people to linger in a time corridor where the old and the new are intertwined with the retro and fashionable. The time corridor where old and new are intertwined. In addition to the comfortable lobby to receive travelers, the seating area is designed like a small bar, where travelers can relax by the glass seats. The seating area is designed like a small bar, where travelers can take a break and enjoy the sunshine that falls freely on them. The winding staircase on the patio, the bright light from the patio, like walking into the past time, stopping in your heart and mine! The balcony retains the boiler that used to boil hot water, the mottled rust, accompanied by a small light bulb, tells the story of the past. It also creates a brand new look for Jincheng hostel.

stays.description: 2019年9月田中文旅全新落成，乾淨舒適、服務熱忱，座落在彰化的「稻米之鄉」田中小鎮上，緊鄰著田中火車站，是南彰化第一家全新設計旅店。田中文旅設計的初衷不僅僅是成為每一位旅行者的落腳點，而是另一個家的溫暖及歸屬感，旅者可以暫忘煩惱，漫步於市井之間、探索這座城市的生活文化。田中文旅TIAN ZHONG HOTEL一定是您彰化旅遊住宿的首選，簡單潔淨工業風的優質旅店，完善的設備與舒服的環境，讓旅人可以停下腳步休息放鬆，繼續迎接美好的一天。

stays.name: 馥御花園酒店
stays.description: 馥御花園酒店坐落於有「臺灣穀倉」美稱的彰化縣田中鎮，為彰化縣最大型的商務兼旅遊飯店，緊鄰南彰化交通樞紐——台灣高鐵彰化站。在這裡，除了能一睹台灣最快鐵路的風采，更能坐擁周圍田園美景與山光水色，伴隨著四季的變化，讓您感受專屬此地獨有的魅力所在。全館規劃110間雅靜客房，多種房型滿足旅客不同的住宿需求。館內設有全日供餐的「花園全日餐廳」，提供多樣化的美食饗宴。二樓則有可容納超過300位的「御上園」宴會廳，為您的宴會、會議及餐敘需求提供最舒適優質的空間。此外，歡樂室的溜滑梯球池、不定期開放的DIY活動及戶外廣場獨具特色的樂園，讓您能與寶貝來此體驗親子天倫之趣。馥御花園酒店，是您商務、渡假、美食及會議活動的最佳首選。
stays.descriptionEn: Floramos Hotel, Changhua, is located at the beautiful Tianzhong Township, usually known as the Granary of Taiwan, is the largest business and leisure hotel of the city and also at the city’s traffic hub, the Taiwan High Speed Rail Changhua station.Here, you can not only be impressed by the fastness of the High Speed Rail trains but also feel the pulse of the Taiwan’s traditional rural village life which is surrounded by the glamorous view from the nearby countryside with season’s changes.The hotel’s 110 elegant guest rooms and the Garden Dinning Restaurant can not only meet the various accommodation needs but also provide diverse gourmet food selection during your travel. The Gala Floor on the hotel’s second floor can offer a-more-than-300-seats spacious venue to fulfill each different and unique banquet function request.Furthermore, the kids’ playground and DIY hand-made courses on 3F Recreation Club and Sunny Place are also wonderful places for your kids to create joyful memories.Floramos Hotel helps you enjoy every moment during your trip, regardless of business, leisure, dining or meeting or event.

stays.name: 花桂民宿
stays.description: 在田尾1公頃康乃馨花海走不遠處，靜謐民宿～房內可遙望窗外花田可步行至田尾公路花園及阿嬤的私房菜，可預約至全得玫瑰園。田尾慢行・在綠意中找回生活的節奏位於花鄉田尾的心臟地帶，我們民宿是一個讓旅人能「放慢腳步、自在呼吸」的地方。這裡適合喜愛自然、喜歡用雙腳與雙輪探索的朋友的秘密基地。四周環繞著花田與農園，騎上單車就能漫遊田間小路，沿途的花卉園區、鄉村小徑與假日農產市集，讓旅程多了人情味與生活感。我們貼心提供：* 自行車停放區* 在地食材早餐與旅人茶點，補給一天活力* 鄉村單車路線與私房小店推薦在這裡，你可以早晨聽鳥鳴看花露、午後逛花市、傍晚看夕陽靜靜灑落花田。讓時間慢下來，用車輪的節奏去感受田尾的柔軟與溫度。田尾，適合停靠，也適合出發。

stays.description: 花田葉舍:座落彰化縣田尾鄉(公路花園) 民族路2段173巷30弄36號,是一家新成立合法民宿(彰化民宿 110號) 公路花園有種類多元的花草,苗樹,盆栽及周邊產品其中玫瑰,菊花,百合,洋桔梗......是本產區種植最大宗產品.白天漫遊於田園中可發現非常多有特色美麗的植栽 .一般遊客大部分安排都是白天到公路花園市集逛逛或騎賞花腳踏車漫遊.當夜深人靜 約 PM:23:00 --AM:2:00會有全國最大型燈光秀多點綻放-菊花燈海美不勝收.清晨漫步於田園中的花海真是輕鬆舒活.值得多一天的停留.體驗身在花海中的寧靜及發現純樸花農專業捻花惹草的功力.*花若盛開, 蝴蝶自來,人若精彩，來此就是你對家人最好的安排.*田園處處好,遊客胡不歸.*葉子綠了從遠古至今綠色永遠是葉子的初心,無論世事經歷多少風雲變幻,葉子依然一抹新鮮的綠.. 花田葉舍民宿在此服務需要放鬆漫遊舒活旅客(本民宿提供:英語 韓語 中文 台語 客語 服務) .是遊客白夕最佳選擇.本民宿有4間套房供遊客 1至14人優質選擇,設備新穎有KTV ,有自行車,全面化智能化門控,WIFI 100M 交誼廳 餐廳 4樓觀景台欣賞:"花田月色"!有朋自遠來不亦樂乎. 誠心歡迎您們大駕光臨!

Everyone is welcome to come and explore together!

stays.name: 童年往事莊園民宿
stays.description: 童年往事莊園民宿－是鹿港地區第一家合法民宿，位於天后宮遊覽車停車場後方，距離天后宮、鹿港老街只有6百多公尺，可漫遊老街，是距離古蹟區最近的一家民宿。擁有八百坪的民宿是莊主吳志忠用心全新打造的一座懷舊莊園，有排球場、籃球場、兒童遊戲區、草坪區、烤肉區、開心農場等設施~童年往事莊園民宿結合巴洛克式的建築及傳統閩式三合院的藝術建築，每一間房間皆精心設計，老板將多年的收藏布置於每個主題房間，讓每一個房間猶如一個小小的博物館，透過老板執著的文物收藏，還原那段失落的生活記憶~讓你回到童年、回味往事~讓你細細品嚐生活的真、人性的善、歷史的美，讓台灣的文化成為生命延續的一部分!
stays.descriptionEn: Tongnian Wangshì B&B is the first legitimate B&B in Lukang, located behind the tour bus parking lot of Tin Hau Temple, and about 600 meters from Tin Hau Temple and Lukang Street. You can stroll through the Lukang Street and the nearest B&B to the Historic District. The B&B covers over an area of 2,640 square meters. It is an new nostalgic manor that Mr. Wu Zhizhong, the owner, has carefully built. It features volleyball courts, basketball courts, children's play area, lawn area, barbecue area, happy farm and other facilities ~ Tongnian Wangshì B&B is an artistc architecture that combines baroque architecture and Fujian-style Sanhe Yuan houses. Each room is well designed, and the host furnished the rooms with his collections accumulated for many years to make each room like a small museum. Through the host's collections, you can restore the lost part of childhood. Let your life back to your childhood memories and ponder over the past events ~ let you savor true life, humanity goodness, and the beauty of history, so that Taiwan's culture has become a part of the continuation of life.

stays.descriptionEn: Business travelers don& #39;t have to worry about it, they can stay fast and comfortably.The coastal light welcomes the morning sun, and Changbin Business Hotel is the most reliable.Located in the Changbin Industrial Park in Xixian, it is only a 1-minute drive from the Xibin Expressway on Provincial Highway 61. It is convenient and can be easily reached from north to south without taking a detour. The coastal scenery is unique and far away from the hustle and bustle of the city, giving you a simple and pure resting space.The surrounding living functions are complete, and convenience stores and bento stores are close at hand. Whether it is temporary needs or long-term accommodation, it can be easily dealt with. If the business trip is tight, starting from here will not only save commuting time, but also improve efficiency and quality.Huasu Changbin Express Business Hotel is designed for business and groups with practicality, speed and convenience as the core, giving you a simple but reliable travel experience.

stays.name: 王功皇后休閒旅館
stays.description: 「王功皇后休閒旅館」位於彰化縣芳苑鄉的寧靜鄉間，王功漁港近在呎尺，是熱門旅遊的景點之一，是台灣西半部最美麗的潮間帶，採蚵、戲蝦、觀夕照、燈塔、生態景觀橋;豐厚純美的人文風光，觀光資源豐富而多元，彰化的美說不完也道不盡，各鄉鎮知名的美食無不令人吮指回味，若是親自來走一遭，就能深刻體會。 ，我們提供安全、乾淨、安靜、舒適、清潔的環境，另準備自行車讓您悠遊歡迎您來一趟知性之旅吧!【非開車族】．高鐵停靠站：彰化站，到站須轉搭其他大眾運輸（建議搭乘：員林客運「二林站」，轉搭往「王功」班次）．客運停靠站：王功總站；員林客運或鹿港轉車至王功【接駁服務】．高鐵站（田中站／烏日站）付費接駁車→王功皇后飯店單趟費用：1人@1200元 // 2人@1400元 // 3人@1500元 // 4人@1600元（一車最多4人座位）．客運站接駁二林車站→王功皇后飯店單趟費用：1人@400人 // 2人@500元 // 3人@600元 // 4人@700元溪湖站／鹿港站→王功皇后飯店單趟費用：1人@700元 // 2人@800元 // 3人@900元 // 4人@1000元 彰化站→王功皇后飯店單趟費用：1人@900元 // 2人@1000元 // 3人@1100元 // 4人@1200元．機場接駁台中清泉崗機場→王功皇后飯店單趟費用：包車服務（最多四人一趟）@1500元

stays.name: 雪花雅居
stays.description: 王功是臺灣西岸的一個小漁村 村民有部份的人是靠著養蚵剝蚵為生 養生蛋雞的居民也不少近年來由於觀光業興盛於是美食 提供蚵車服務的村民相對增加 民風相當淳樸 來到這裡可以享受蚵的美食 看夕陽 蚵田 鷺鷥林 招潮蟹 玩沙戲水吹海風欣賞大自然的美景 在這片潮間帶裡有著無數的生態等著大家來拜訪 我們的民宿是一個閩南三合院的建築 民宿裡住了一位90歲的雪花阿嬤 一個印尼來的朋友 有一隻拉布拉多的帥哥流浪犬及我 這裡是我從小長大的地方也是我的娘家 很歡迎大家來到我的故鄉體驗潮間帶的生態 漁村的風情 三合院的建築 熱情的村民 相信當你穿梭在矮牆小巷中 您一定會有更多....... 謝謝你們。
stays.descriptionEn: Wang Gong is a small fishing village in western Taiwan. Some of the villagers who were relying on raising oysters and shelling oysters for a living, and some were relying on raising laying hens. In recent years due to the thriving tourism industry, villagers providing gourmet food services with oyster cars are correspondingly increased. The folk custom is quite simple and honest. Coming to stay here, you can enjoy oysters cuisine, watch the sunset, oyster fields, egrets forest, and fiddler crabs; playing with sand bathing, blowing sea breeze, and enjoying the beauty of nature. In this piece of intertidal zone, there are numerous ecological activities, waiting for you to visit. Our B&B is a traditional Sanhe Yuan house of Minnan style. B&B lived a 90-year-old white-haired grandma, a friend from Indonesia, a handsome Labrador stray dog, and me. Here is where I grew up and is also my mother's family home. Welcome you to my hometown to experience the intertidal ecology, the mien of the fishing village, traditional Sanhe Yuan building, and making friend with enthusiastic villagers. I believe that if you stroll through the alleys of low wall, you are sure to find out more.... Thank you very much.

stays.name: 一日鹿港人民宿
stays.description: 一日鹿港人民宿位於鹿港鎮地政事務所旁清幽的巷子裡，原本是屋主規劃作為退休後返鄉自住用的，建物裡外的園藝造景設計、房間佈置，全由自家人DIY營造出來，減去了商業氣息，讓訪客有種回家的感覺。訪客雖然不是生長在鹿港小鎮，但是來小鎮一日遊並住上一晚享受小鎮的古樸悠閒樂當一日鹿港人。若是有機緣在此落地深根，過客也可以是歸人，一日鹿港人也可以是一世鹿港人。
stays.descriptionEn: One day Lukang B&B is located in the quiet alley next to the Lukang Town Land Office, which was originally planned by the owner as a retirement to return to his hometown for self-residence, and the gardening and landscaping design and room layout inside and outside the building are all created by DIY by his own family, minus the commercial atmosphere, so that visitors have a feeling of going home. Although the visitors did not grow up in Lukang Town, they came to the town for a day trip and stayed overnight to enjoy the quaint and leisurely fun of the town, and became Lukang people for a day. If there is an opportunity to land deep roots here, passers-by can also be returnees, and one day Lukang people can also be Lukang people forever.

stays.name: 宮后文旅
stays.description: 2018年，在香火鼎盛的鹿港天后宮後方，誕生了一幢結合文創與旅舍的新地標，坐落於鬧中取靜的巷口，外型簡潔俐落，有著新舊融合的新氣象，為風韻猶存的鹿港小鎮注入一股新氣息。因為地處於宮後巷，取其「宮」字，又加上主人是位女性，取其「后」意，故命名為「宮后文旅」。宮后文旅的主人在紙類設計行業深耕多年，她將多年來所累積的設計能量與專業，貫注於宮后文旅中，為鹿港增添一抹新色。本著對於鹿港的深厚情感，「彰化鹿港民宿‧宮后文旅」皆以「鹿」做主題，亦取其福「祿」的吉祥含意。「彰化鹿港民宿‧宮后文旅」一樓規劃成咖啡廳，二三樓為旅宿，每個房間風格各異且獨特，內部設施更是比照飯店等級，極致寵愛旅人，提供給每位旅客一個精緻且難忘的住宿新體驗！

stays.searchText: 宮后文旅 宮后文旅 彰化縣民宿055號 彰化縣 鹿港鎮 宮後巷63號 2018年，在香火鼎盛的鹿港天后宮後方，誕生了一幢結合文創與旅舍的新地標，坐落於鬧中取靜的巷口，外型簡潔俐落，有著新舊融合的新氣象，為風韻猶存的鹿港小鎮注入一股新氣息。因為地處於宮後巷，取其「宮」字，又加上主人是位女性，取其「后」意，故命名為「宮后文旅」。宮后文旅的主人在紙類設計行業深耕多年，她將多年來所累積的設計能量與專業，貫注於宮后文旅中，為鹿港增添一抹新色。本著對於鹿港的深厚情感，「彰化鹿港民宿‧宮后文旅」皆以「鹿」做主題，亦取其福「祿」的吉祥含意。「彰化鹿港民宿‧宮后文旅」一樓規劃成咖啡廳，二三樓為旅宿，每個房間風格各異且獨特，內部設施更是比照飯店等級，極致寵愛旅人，提供給每位旅客一個精緻且難忘的住宿新體驗！

stays.name: 東皋歇暝
stays.description: 東皋歇暝（Tang-ko Hioh-mî）民宿位於鹿港牛墟頭聚落，民宿名稱「東皋」取自聚落庄頭廟景靈宮匾額「東皋福地」，皋為田野、高地之意，且牛墟頭聚落位於鹿港大街（中山路）東邊，因此「東皋福地」除了意指景靈宮奉祀的鹿港東方福德正神，也象徵此地為神仙所居的安樂福地。取其美意及庇佑，民宿特以鹿港人常用的台語發音取名，期盼每位來到「東皋」的旅客在此「歇暝」（過夜），締造美好的回憶。民宿步行5分鐘可至鹿港第一市場品嘗在地小吃，10分鐘可至九曲巷、鹿港老街漫遊巷弄，往北或往南1公里內分別可至鹿港天后宮、龍山寺欣賞廟宇建築。在東皋歇暝住宿，除了有機會欣賞傳統鹿港之美，民宿共同經營團隊含括餐飲（禾火食堂）、酒吧（勝豐吧）、深度導覽及藝文策展（橫街工作室）、青年品牌（參先生工作室），提供在此住宿旅客多元又豐富的路徑，一同探索、體驗鹿港生活的不同層面。

stays.name: 澄悅商旅
stays.description: 澄悅商旅Joy Inn緣起於中台灣文化小鎮鹿港，磊泰建設繼與世界精品咖啡星巴克合作在鹿港引領新時代風潮後，於2017年再創澄悅商旅，打造微笑旅遊新意象！讓賓客以澄悅為起點，暢所自由的享受旅遊時光澄悅提供您如自家般的舒適以及至高的服務品質讓您的微笑，起源於此位於商旅頂樓，夜幕低垂之際坐覽優雅歷史小鎮與深夜星空，主廚專研亞洲風味美食,純熟燒烤技術，搭配當季生猛海鮮與高級肉品，您可以在室內與三五好友透過高畫質大型螢幕共同為進球歡呼，也可以選擇在室外星空區與親友一同將鹿港夜色盡收眼裡，一同分享快意人生。

stays.name: 鹿港宏旭民宿
stays.description: 鹿港宏旭民宿｜精品旅宿，品味鹿港之美沉浸於「鹿港宏旭民宿」的優雅氛圍，體驗結合設計美學與在地文化的精品住宿空間。民宿位於歷史悠久的鹿港小鎮，將現代旅宿舒適度與台灣傳統人文底蘊完美融合，為旅人打造一處靜謐、質感與品味兼具的度假場域。每一間客房皆精心規劃，配備高速免費 WiFi、空調系統與高畫質平面電視，部分房型提供共用衛浴，並備有高品質盥洗用品與吹風機，細節之處展現精品旅宿的用心。民宿設有專屬停車空間、親子友善家庭房與全面禁菸環境，讓您在旅途中也能享受純粹與舒適的生活質感。貼心的迎賓接待服務，為您的旅程注入溫度與儀式感，讓每一次入住都如同回到專屬的私人別墅。地理位置優越，距離台中火車站、逢甲夜市、國立台灣美術館與台中國際機場皆交通便利，周邊環境靜謐清幽，是探索鹿港古城文化、慢遊彰化風情的理想起點。「鹿港宏旭民宿」不僅是一處住宿空間，更是一段講究生活品味的旅宿體驗。

stays.searchText: 鹿港宏旭民宿 鹿港宏旭民宿 彰化縣民宿140號 彰化縣 鹿港鎮 永安三路25號 鹿港宏旭民宿｜精品旅宿，品味鹿港之美沉浸於「鹿港宏旭民宿」的優雅氛圍，體驗結合設計美學與在地文化的精品住宿空間。民宿位於歷史悠久的鹿港小鎮，將現代旅宿舒適度與台灣傳統人文底蘊完美融合，為旅人打造一處靜謐、質感與品味兼具的度假場域。每一間客房皆精心規劃，配備高速免費 WiFi、空調系統與高畫質平面電視，部分房型提供共用衛浴，並備有高品質盥洗用品與吹風機，細節之處展現精品旅宿的用心。民宿設有專屬停車空間、親子友善家庭房與全面禁菸環境，讓您在旅途中也能享受純粹與舒適的生活質感。貼心的迎賓接待服務，為您的旅程注入溫度與儀式感，讓每一次入住都如同回到專屬的私人別墅。地理位置優越，距離台中火車站、逢甲夜市、國立台灣美術館與台中國際機場皆交通便利，周邊環境靜謐清幽，是探索鹿港古城文化、慢遊彰化風情的理想起點。「鹿港宏旭民宿」不僅是一處住宿空間，更是一段講究生活品味的旅宿體驗。

stays.name: 鹿港永樂酒店．臻品之選
stays.nameEn: Yong Le Lukang,a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
stays.description: 鹿港永樂酒店Yong Le Lukang位在鹿港五百年歷史記憶的老城區，鄰近龍山寺、杉行街、摸乳巷、意樓、九曲巷，是百年鹿港最繁華的古蹟保存區域。永樂酒店引進國際飯店品牌規格的豪華旅宿空間，與精緻化的台灣味親切服務，結合在地國寶工藝的導覽與在地美食饗宴的體驗。鹿港永樂酒店Yong Le Lukang是彰化地區第一家獲萬豪國際集團認證的頂級飯店，秉持著「Tribute Portfolio 臻品之選」品牌承諾，致力帶給旅客的是超越五星級的六星體驗，讓每位到訪的旅客，不僅能深入鹿港在地、感受古鎮魅力，在永樂酒店裡有最深刻的溫暖感動，擁有難忘、獨特的旅遊回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: Yong Le Lukang is located in the heart of Lukang, a district with more than 500 years of rich history. Neighboring popular destinations like Longshan Temple, Shan Hang Street, Moru Lane, Yi Lou (Remembrance Hall), and Jiuqu Lane (9 Turns Alley), the location showcases the pristinely-preserved cultural and historical heritages from celebrated past of Lukang. Yong Le Lukang incorporates the environment of a world-class international hotel with the care and amenity of Taiwanese hospitality. Our services include guided tours of our exquisite artisan craftsmen and tastes of local, authentic Taiwanese cuisines to bring guests a unique travel experience.

stays.nameEn: HOUSE OF SAN SIA AH KUEI
stays.description: 在這裡「山」離您很近，在這裡「雲海」就在眼前，在這裡「蝴蝶」自在飛舞，在這裡「大自然」就在您身旁。三峽阿桂的家民宿-距三峽老街僅半個小時車程地方，竟然可以享受到群山環抱的大自然美景—來過的人都會有這樣的驚嘆！這也是十多年前、阿桂到處尋覓退休生活地點，最後找到這片土地的原因，十多年前送我們櫻花樹的朋友們都高官晉爵了，所以我們也非常相信這裡的磁場一定很好，也希望住客們來到阿桂的家可以完全放鬆身心，讓身心回到大自然母親的懷抱，讓這裡的自然景觀滋養您的心靈，因為眼前即是層層疊疊的綠色山景，恰到好處的高度讓視野極為寬廣，由於面向西、到了傍晚可以觀賞紅紅的太陽，觀賞千變萬化的日落更是一級棒，夜晚在無光害欣賞美麗的星空更加體會臺灣的星空真是明亮，在這裡會讓您的心情隨之開闊。三峽阿桂的家距離大板根10分鐘三峽阿桂的家距離五寮尖15分鐘三峽阿桂的家距離滿月園30分鐘三峽阿桂的家距離三峽老街、鶯歌老街30分鐘三峽阿桂的家距離兩蔣文化園區40分鐘
stays.descriptionEn: Here, the mountains are close; here, the clouds are right in front of you; here, the butterflies dance carefree through the air; here, nature is right by your side. A-Kuei’s House Bed & Breakfast is only a half-hour drive from Sanxia Old Street, and the ability to so easily enjoy the embrace of nature and the mountains comes as quite the surprise to many! Over 10 years ago, A-Kuei was looking for a place to retire, finally settling on this slice of land. Now, we hope that you’ll find “A-Kuei’s House” a place to unwind and return to the embrace of Mother Nature as the natural scenery nourishes your soul and spirit. With the rolling hills and mountains curled up in front of you, the views from up here are spectacular; and as dusk comes, it offers a fantastic place to watch the sun go down as the skies turn a burning orange. Then, as night falls, the lack of light pollution means the starry night is on full display. A-Kuei’s House is only 10 minutes from The Great Roots Forestry Spa Resort, 15 minutes from Wuliaojian, 30 minutes from Manyueyuan National Forest Recreation Area, 30 minutes from Sanxia and Yingge Old Streets, and 40 minutes from the Culture Resort of the Chiangs.

stays.name: 秀川居
stays.description: 秀川街在百年以前的清朝時是商店街，三峽河舊碼頭位於此處，商帆雲集、風光無限；街上的「宰樞廟」緊臨河岸，是三峽最早的信仰中心。當時居民生活中的食衣住行需求都聚集在此，逐漸環繞形成傳統建築群；到了日治時期，這一帶的商業活動沒落，多數的商店便轉移到目前的三峽老街，但秀川街周邊仍充滿著濃濃的庶民生活感，是臺灣最具有歷史價值的老街之一。為重現老屋往昔的美好，甘樂文創以簡約溫柔的視角，重新演繹一幢老房子為獨棟民宿《秀川居》。屋內裝潢保有老屋風味，懷舊的地磚及暖黃色的吊燈，自然散發出一份說不出的溫柔家庭親暱感，我們希望來此短暫入住的您，在現代的此時此景體驗往日的懷舊時空，與親人、朋友、同事、同學…共度愉快的假期，銘刻屬於彼此的美好回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: Xiuchuan Street was a bustling commercial street during the Qing Dynasty, more than a hundred years ago. The old dock of the Sanxia River was located here, attracting numerous merchant ships and presenting a picturesque scene. Adjacent to the riverbank stood the Zaisu Temple, the earliest center of worship in Sanxia. The street gradually became surrounded by traditional buildings as it catered to the residents& #39; daily needs for food, clothing, shelter, and transportation. However, during the Japanese colonial period, commercial activities in this area declined, and most shops moved to the current Sanxia Old Street. Nevertheless, Xiuchuan Street and its surroundings still retain a strong sense of ordinary life and are considered one of Taiwan& #39;s most historically valuable old streets.To revive the beauty of the old houses, Gandle Creative Studio has reinterpreted a historic building as an independent homestay called "Xiuchuan Residence," through a minimalist and gentle approach. The interior decoration preserves the charm of the old house, with nostalgic floor tiles and warm yellow pendant lights that naturally exude an indescribable sense of familial intimacy. We hope that during your short stay here, you can experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the past in this contemporary setting, and create wonderful memories with your family, friends, colleagues, and classmates.

stays.descriptionEn: Ching Ching Garden Motel is located in the culturally and artistic rich area of Sanxia, New Taipei City, close to Sanxia Qingshui Zushi Temple and Yingge Ceramic Art Area, a uniquely advantageous environment. We created several Roman architectural garden castles, where visitors can feel like they’re a part of the film “Roman Holiday.” Ching Ching Garden Motel is a secluded place surrounded by botanical beauty, with a romantic and mysterious charm, giving customers a fresh new experience. It’s also Sanxia’s first international-class hotel, featuring European architecture, providing travelers and businessmen with a place to relax, and exhibiting decoration that makes guests feel at home. Complete room facilities, including large Simmons beds, massage chairs, rosewood furniture, and exquisite, fashionable design. A great place to put away all your cares and worries. Bathrooms come with massage chairs, massage jets, and steam rooms for you to take care of your body and mind. Rooms start from $680 NT, and $1780/night. Website: http://www.chingching-motel.com.tw/

stays.name: 虹橋民宿
stays.description: 三芝虹橋民宿---住我家好精采 Its brilliant to stay at our homestay!千紅－春夏之際日本楓火紅艷麗 萬紫－鳶尾、紫藤最為美麗群青－睡蓮百花爭豔，色彩繽紛碧綠－落羽松綠樹成蔭，浓郁葱茏 深褐－自家烘培咖啡豆，香氣迷人白青－白沙灣,老梅綠澡海天一片春黃－蟬鳴鳥叫，蛙聲不斷混彩－曇花、杜鵑、繡球花團錦簇調色－藝術家親自繪製園區壁畫虹橋民宿坐落於三芝金牌農村獎共榮社區山谷內，小溪作伴，安靜宜人．經在地農村保育，時常可見老鷹在天空盤旋，生態豐富健康，民宿主人用心經營，園區色彩繽紛，楓樹火紅、紫藤、睡蓮、鳶尾、曇花、落羽松、菖蒲等植物維護有成．春節花季吸引不少攝影師駐足拍攝，畫家寫生也將園區作為特色景點．來到這裡，建議離開電視，您會看到老闆娘溫暖又真誠的招呼聲，遞上自家烘培咖啡或花茶，讓您來到民宿便放鬆心靈．來園區慢活，小溪泡腳，鄉村散步，欣賞二代藝術家老闆的壁畫創作，隔日享用精心準備的中西式早餐，有老闆娘自製蘿波糕，友善根種蔬菜，保證吃得健康養生．遊玩景點如白沙灣、淺水灣、野柳、淡水老街等北海岸線，皆為著名景點，晚餐也可提早向民宿預定，我們會用心為您準備創意料理，或品嘗大塊牛排、漁港海產、越南口味，當季蔬食等三芝著名美食．民宿經營至今，已累積不少回頭客，感謝客人對我們的真心，不論是全家住宿、情侶求婚、輕旅行、公司旅遊、同學會、化裝舞會，我們都很歡迎．讓我們來分享這裡的生活，我們會熱情的與您做朋友．
stays.descriptionEn: Its brilliant to stay at our house!The Rainbow Bridge Home-stayThe flourishing scenes have enriched the Rainbow Bridge Home-stay via various colors of blooming. You would see the vivid red brought by the Japanese maples and gradient purple of Irises and wisterias. The mediating green of the Water lilies and Pines. Our nice coffee has added a color of brown with unforgettable coffee scent. Furthermore, our Silk flowers, Rhododendrons and Hydrangeas play the stimulating roles to enrich the unique view of the Rainbow Bridge Home-stay.Locating at the center of the Award-Winning village for it& #39;s thriving and Eco-friendly, San Zhi Village. Through the years of conservation, we proudly introduce you a rich and healthy ecology which is only in San Zhi. A river that sometimes has the ducks comfortably swimming in it while an eagle has been seen few times on the sky. With love and effort, we have successfully developed all kinds of nature plants. At Rainbow Bridge Home-stay, you could be really surprised by the flourishing scene of the Maples, Wisterias, Water lilies, Irises, Silk flowers, Pines and Calamus. Our unique garden always attracts heaps photographers over to take photos and artists to sketch during the Spring season. At Rainbow Bridge Home-stay, please enjoy the privilege of being our precious guest. Our hospitable staff always welcome the guests with the home-baked coffee and herbal tea and they are out of charge. Have a walk in the Village for a good meditation, moreover, soak your feet into the nice chill river to feel really fresh. We would like to also invite you to our wall-painting gallery which has been contributed by the Award-Winning artists. Fulfilling your tummy next morning with our buffet-style breakfast. Providing with the choices of Chinese and Western breakfasts. All dishes are organic and some are from our own farm. You would be guaranteed of a healthy and organic eating style. In addition to the breakfast, we accept the dinner reservation and providing you with the choices of seafood, steak, seasonal vegetables and other oriental cuisines such as Japanese and Vietnam cuisines. Exciting with the great convenience to reach other famous scenery, e.g. Whit Sand Bay, Yehliu Geopark, Tamsui Old Street, and Cianshuei Bay. Our friendly staff would like to assist you with the sight seeing guide and please feel free to ask us. The day since we have opened the Rainbow Bridge Home-stay, we have had many guests returned to stay again with us. Our guest friends are not only for locals, but also from USA, New Zealand, Germany and England. We appreciate everything that has given to us. Especially thank to our lovely guests, thank you so much. We would like to continue our passionate and love on this Home-stay. Your enjoyment in the experience staying with us is the most important thing and the priority to us. Thank you so much.

stays.name: 隨喻而安民宿
stays.description: 隨喻而安位於新北市三芝區的芝柏山莊，民宿主體主要是以鄉村風格為主，我們一共有四間房間，每個房間皆經過設計規劃，像是有多數女生最喜愛的歐式玫瑰風格以及走清新的淡雅鄉村風格，當然我們也為了小家庭特地規畫了一間日式風格的合室，相信不管是小家庭或是家族旅遊甚至是朋友同事想一同出遊都能找到適合您的房間，三芝除了空氣以及景觀非常棒之外，附近還有許多豐富的人文景觀以及許多有名的觀光地點，像是貝殼廟、源興居、白沙灣、富基漁港、石門洞、老梅綠石槽等等不勝枚舉的景點，每到了周末假期總是有非常多觀光人潮湧入，號稱台北後花園的三芝真的是非常迷人，真的要您親自來看看才能知道這裡的迷人之處。
stays.descriptionEn: "Peaceful Life B&B" is located in Zhibo Community, it is a bed and breakfast of rural style offering four themed rooms, including European rose loved by young women, plain rural life, and Japanese dormitory for small families. We believe you will have a good time here with your family and/or friends. Besides great air quality and scenic spots, there are more destinations to visit, such as Shell Temple, Yuanxing House, Baisha Bay, Fuji Fishing Port, Shimen Cave and Stone Trench of Laomei Coast. This is a popular travel spot at weekends, and we invite you to explore the charisma of "the back garden of Taipei".

stays.name: 沃客商旅-正義館
stays.description: 沃客商旅-正義館座落於正義南路上僅靠中山高三重交流道5分鐘距離，交通便利四通八達，是地處三重鬧區喔！鄰近三重埔的三和夜市這裡是夜晚三重最熱鬧的地方，傍晚以後擠得水洩不通，尤其是賣服飾的攤販特別多，人車雜沓的景象和著攤販的叫賣聲，規模相當龐大，充滿了最道地的夜市氣息。在美食部分，這裡的豬腳、魚丸湯、蛋餅、脆腸、臭豆腐、木瓜牛奶、蝦仁羹、肉圓、蚵仔煎、魷魚羹等等都很受歡迎，而且價位比一橋之隔的臺北市更加實惠，非常適合老饕來這裡「挑戰」，試試從街頭吃到街尾的暢快樂趣。 然而房間設計舒適乾淨，提供舒適休閒的旅館空間，及十分完善的房間規劃，簡潔溫馨的平價住宿，房間內部設有乾淨典雅的擺設。
stays.descriptionEn: Walker Hotel - Zhengyi is located on Zhengyi South Road, only 5 minutes away from the Sanchong Interchange of Zhongshan Highway. It has convenient transportation and is located in the downtown area of ​​Sanchong! The Sanhe Night Market near Sanchungpu is the liveliest place in Sanchung at night. It is packed with people after dusk, especially the stalls selling clothing. The bustling scene of people and vehicles and the shouting of vendors make it a large place full of the most authentic night market atmosphere. As for food, the pig's trotters, fish ball soup, egg pancakes, crispy intestines, stinky tofu, papaya milk, shrimp soup, meatballs, oyster omelette, squid soup, etc. are all very popular, and the prices are more affordable than those in Taipei City, which is just across the bridge. It is very suitable for gourmets to come here for a "challenge" and try the fun of eating from the beginning to the end of the street.However, the room design is comfortable and clean, providing a comfortable and relaxing hotel space, and very complete room planning, simple and warm affordable accommodation, and the interior of the room is equipped with clean and elegant furnishings.

stays.description: 黑熊好眠站位於三重,提供設有空調的膠囊式客房適合獨自旅行的背包客、商務旅客、大型團體。全館皆可使用免費 WiFi。每間客房皆鋪有木飾地板,提供客人私人空間。共用浴室中設有淋浴設施、洗髮精、沐浴乳和吹風機。在黑熊好眠站,客人可在共用休息室享受閒暇時光。館內提供遊戲和電視。前台,在此工作人員將很樂意協助客人行李寄存,以及提供旅遊訊息。此外也設有飲料自動販賣機。
stays.descriptionEn: Heybear is located in Sanchong and offers air-conditioned capsule rooms, ideal for solo travelers, backpackers, business travelers, and large groups. Free WiFi is available throughout the property. Each room features wooden flooring, providing guests with a private space. The shared bathrooms are equipped with showers, shampoo, body wash, and hairdryers. At HeyBear , guests can relax in the shared lounge area, which includes games and a TV. The front desk staff is happy to assist with luggage storage and provide travel information. Additionally, a vending machine for drinks is available on-site.

stays.description: 君迪商旅位於臺北縣中和市，鬧中取靜的地理環境，最能符合現代人的需求，君迪商旅是全新的商務旅館，也是各位放鬆心情的最佳選擇。 我們位於北二高中和交流道旁，也就是大臺北縣商業區的心臟中樞。便利的地緣性對於出差洽公者是最貼心的首選。通往大台北的都會區，凡舉工業，商業和消費區塊，交通動線便利無礙，還有.還有最為客戶讚賞的莫過於每間房間設置的吧檯及用餐區， 寬敞空間，設備齊全，適合長期經商進駐。當然囉!我們也瞭解您工作上的需要，特別為各位準備了一張大型辦公桌，更具備有高速寬頻網際網路，為您連接世界的任何一個角落。您也就不必擔心,錯過重要的電子郵件或企業通信。君迪最為重視的,就是各位的睡眠品質了，我門所有房間床型,有雙人的一大床或是兩張標準大床/母子床做為您寬敞的睡眠空間。有了充足的休息,有助您在次日工作或活動上能夠有效率的進行。
stays.descriptionEn: Introduction:Situated in the city of Chung Ho, bustling with activities by day, but tranquil by night, SLV is the newest Business Hotel in Taipei County, in the heart of the newly developed eastern business district. Our location is most ideal for business travelers, with easy access to industrial, commercial and recreational areas around Greater Taipei.Business travelers will appreciate our array of spacious and brightly lit rooms, all fitted with a bar counter for your convenience. We also understand that you would require a large desk for your work preparation, all fitted with High Speed Internet Connection for you to stay connected with the rest of the world. You don’t have to worry about missing an important e-mail or business communication. Your have also ensured that all rooms come with a King / Queen Sized bed or 2 Standard Queen beds for Twin Sharing Rooms so that you can be assured of a good night’s rest and be ready for your activities the next day.

stays.description: 位於新北市北二高中和交流道旁的瓏山林台北中和飯店(RSL Hotel Taipei Zhonghe)，鄰近板橋、三峽..等新北市鬧區及著名觀光區，全館共有126間舒適客房，分為精緻客房、豪華客房、行政主管套房，每房皆免費提供快速、便利的網路，讓房客可隨時輕鬆悠遊網路世界。一應俱全的備品，不論在軟、硬體上面都以顧客需求為導向。針對不同的需求，來滿足顧客心中對於飯店住宿的理想要求。住房還可免費使用及享有健身中心、每日中文或英文報紙、礦泉水等多項館內設施及服務。除了住房之外，館內共有2間餐廳提供中西美饌。1樓的國際酒吧〈The Bar〉提供經典道地歐式料理及多樣化餐飲服務，並可輕鬆悠閒的享受下午茶、週末早午餐和酒吧服務。另附設美食外賣區，供應瓏山林台北中和飯店點心房手工製作麵包、點心及館內經典美饌。隨著大廳樓梯登上2樓，觀音石地板的延伸，映入眼簾的是帶有現代感的窗花屏風，沉穩的木質窗花。溫暖的紅餐廳餐點以單點吃到飽的方式提供消費者輕鬆消費嚐美食。一如其名「紅」餐廳，在亮麗、時尚、摩登的外表下，引申出內斂傳統、豐富多變的中式佳餚。除了餐廳之外，館內於3F並有挑高四米的宴會廳提供各式會議、宴會舉辦。
stays.descriptionEn: RSL Hotel Taipei Zhonghe is located at Second Northern Freeway and interchange, neighboring Banqiao, Shanxia, downtown New Taipei City, and other famous tourist areas. The hotel offers 126 comfortable rooms divided into exquisite rooms, deluxe rooms, executive suites, and each room provides free fast convenient network, so that guests can enjoy in the online world. The comprehensive range of accessories, both in hardware and software, are all customer-orientated provisions. According to different needs, we are trying hard to satisfy the ideal hotel accommodation requirements that are in the mind of customers. Use and enjoyment of fitness center, daily Chinese or English newspaper, mineral water, and many other facilities and services are offered free for hotel staying guests. In addition to housing, the hotel features two restaurants offering Chinese and Western delicacies. On 1st floor, The Bar, an International Bar, offers classic European dishes and diversified and authentic catering services, and you can enjoy a relaxing afternoon tea, weekend brunch, or bar service here. Attached gourmet takeout area and serves offers handmade breads, pastries, and classic delicacies made by dessert kitchen of RSL Hotel Taipei Zhonghe. Walking up along the hall stairs to the second floor, you see the extension of Guanyin stone floor, then modern grilles screens and calm wooden grilles greet you. Warm RED restaurant features á la carte style all you can eat to provide customers easy consumption of gourmet food. RED restaurant, as its name implied, has bright, stylish, modern exterior, and provided restrained, traditional, rich and varied Chinese cuisine. Apart from the restaurant, the hotel features a ballroom with four meters high ceiling on the third floor available for all kinds of meetings, banquets to be held here.

stays.descriptionEn: On the bustling and noisy Jhongjheng Rd., Jhonghe, there is a mysterious and romantic urban getaway for you to relive yourself from the mental and physical fatigue. In your personal space, you can enjoy peace of mind, solitude and a sense of comfort. We provide 30 scenario rooms of different styles that come with 37" LCD TV, VOD system, large separate bathroom, free wired and wireless broadband, one-touch steam bath equipment, large deluxe whirlpool bath, safe electronic sauna cabinet and nano-milk bath. To strengthen the romantic sensation between sexes, all of our suites are equipped with sexual accessories, including electronic sex chair, electronic love chair, bed with soft mattress and horse riding machine. The rich set of in-room equipment and the high quality of the accommodation come at an affordable price. We are the best choice for you. The hotel can be reached by driving north or south bound as we are located near vital arterial roads of the Jhonghe Interchange and viaduct of the Northern Second Highway.

stays.descriptionEn: The Merry Day Motel offers a variety of room types, featuring six-star furnishings, thoughtfully curated personal amenities, double massage bathtubs, stone bathtubs, golden rain showers, and steam rooms. Whether celebrating a birthday, hosting a party, or simply indulging in entertainment, this place caters to all your needs.

stays.description: 本館位於交通便利的關渡橋頭，往八里方向有八里渡船頭、八里左岸、十三行博物館、廖添丁廟、八仙樂園等景點，往淡水方向有淡水老街、紅毛城、漁人碼頭等景點，二大旅遊路線讓您方便就近遊玩，是您絕無僅有的選擇。 為了方便來賓住宿，我們設有免費的停車場及專屬車庫，電梯直達房間，絕對滿足來賓私密的感覺。本館堅持完美的舒適性及安全性，採用RC建築結構外觀，幻彩按摩浴缸、情趣椅、反偷拍偵測系統及餐點等服務，提供了最精緻的休閒住宿品質，讓您的身心完全自由自在解放。全體員工，以客為尊，秉持著貼心、用心、安心的宗旨，溫馨儒家並體貼照顧，以滿足客戶的最大需求為服務宗旨。以全新的風貌、完善的服務，專業精緻的格局、體貼入微的心，為您隔絕都會的喧嘩、遠離塵囂，以體貼的心、熱情的服務，為您精心設計各項現代化設備溫馨典雅，充滿浪漫的休憩天堂。
stays.descriptionEn: New Bali Motel is conveniently located by Guandu Bridge. Attractions in the direction of Bali include Bali Wharf, Bali Zuo-An, Shihsanhang Museum of Archaeology, Liao Tian-Ding Temple, and Ba Xian Waterpark, and in the direction of Tamsui include Tamsui Old Street, Fort Santo Domingo, and Fisherman’s Wharf. These two travel routes provide a unique choice for visiting nearby sights. For the convenience of customers, we provide free parking, designated garages, and elevators directly to rooms to protect guest privacy. We are commited to security and comfortability, with an RC architectural structure, exotic massage tubs, independent steam showers, dry saunas, love chairs, bathroom TVs, anti-spy camera detecting systems, and food and beverage service to provide the best accommodation quality and put your mind and body at rest. Our staff is committed to putting the customer first, and our goal is to take care of them, help them feel at ease, and meet their needs. New Bali Motel is newly-renovated and features complete and attentive service and professional layout, providing guests with a refuge from the noise and dirt of the city. With caring, friendly service and warm, elegant design, this a romantic paradise.

stays.description: Q MOTEL 是新北市土城區第一家進駐的七星級精品汽車旅館；Q MOTE精品旅館 結合了地方人文與自然生態，跳脫了封閉空間的束縛；因為Q MOTEL認為，有陽光、自然空氣，才能真正享受放鬆、感受浪漫的兩人世界自然就會高潮迭起。此外，為了與地方特色結合，Q.MOTEL 秉持「透光，不曝光」的設計理念，規劃了十九款主題造型房間，在一千八百坪的土地上僅蓋37間房，因為有了充分空間，才能獨享私密花園，讓每一位來到這裡的貴賓在享受陽光與新鮮空氣之餘，也能抒解現代的工作壓力。
stays.descriptionEn: Q MOTEL is the first seven-star boutique motel in Tucheng City, Taipei County. Q MOTE combines local culture and natural ecology. Get rid of the shackles of a closed space, because Q MOTEL believes that only with sunshine and natural air can you truly enjoy a relaxing and romantic world for two, and climaxes will naturally follow.In addition, in order to combine with local characteristics, Q MOTEL adhered to the design concept of "light transmission, no exposure", and planned 19 themed rooms. Only 37 rooms were built on the land of 1,800 ping. Enough space allows you to enjoy the private garden exclusively, so that every VIP who comes here can relieve the pressure of modern work while enjoying the sunshine and fresh air.

stays.description: 將藝術時尚化身為居住空間的一份子，大量留白的空間，造就出空間本質上的開闊大器，讓俐落的空間線條成為美學的座標，這是馥華大觀商旅所營造的空間魅力。馥華大觀以簡單化、理性化功能的設計理念出發，化繁為簡之設計，呈現出空間優雅秀緻的面貌，強調優質的旅居機能，打造出最清爽舒適的居住空間，純粹的俐落美學，讓來訪的每一位旅客享有最輕鬆自在的旅程。
stays.descriptionEn: To make art and fashion a part of Hotel Purity living style, we leave a great much space to create a ambience of extension and generosity. Simplified lines are changed with the theme of esthetics, which sharms all our visitors. Hotel Purity is designed in accordance with the idea of simplification and intelligence. Therefore it turns out a succinct and functional hotel. Our visitors save themselves out of their busy life space and enjoy a cozy moment here with us in a bright and smart space.

stays.name: 安盛商務旅館
stays.description: 爺爺的話.安盛開始成長茁壯這是關於我們的旅館故事。二十年前,二十張路。爺爺開啟了一間簡單的旅館。理念很簡單…來這裡,像回家。那時爺爺,在館內放了一隻很大的孔雀雕朔,是旅館的精神象徵,要讓這裡安穩地、盛開不息。簡單旅館平靜的座落在二十張路,時代不同,溫情與信念卻可以不變。我們像當年一樣,為旅人提供柔軟被臥與暖胃餐點,在溫度上多了點創意和摩登,在美妙生活概念上添加了新想法。我們喜歡有溫度空間,我們和你一樣喜歡旅行,我們和你一樣喜歡藝文創作,我們和你一樣喜歡精緻烘焙。於是,它們也住進了旅館裡頭。親愛的旅人,HôTEL 20 Allée和你道聲Hello!歡迎下禢;我們,交個朋友。
stays.descriptionEn: This is a story about our hotel…Twenty years ago, in the road named Ershizhang, grandpa established a plain hotel. The core value was simple－ to be here is to be at home. At that time, grandpa displayed a statue of peacock inside the lobby, which was a spiritual symbol of the hotel. The symbol protected here soundly and developed steady.Three generations pass, this simple hotel located quietly in Ershizhang road grows up, and is more than simple. With the changing in the world, what never changes is our sincere heart and faith. The core value of ours is still the same, to provide you a soft and warm bed, and to cook you a hot and tasty food, but just add a little more creative and modern atmosphere to all feelings. The hotel is full of new thoughts in the concept of a beautiful life.We cherish a warm space, and we like to travel as you are; we love arts and creations as you do, and delicate bakery is our mutual choice. Therefore, they all move in this warm home.
