stays.name: 谷點咖啡民宿
stays.description: 桃園｜谷點咖啡民宿．依傍山谷、綠意環繞的怡然小屋離開市區，沿著彎曲的小路深入山林，搖下車窗，帶著青草香的微風，輕輕地拂過，你減緩車速，層層疊疊的綠跟著窗景變換美好心情。一個轉彎，你便與山間的旅人驛站相遇——谷點咖啡民宿，低調地座落在拉拉山谷之間，擁抱藍天與綠意，等待每一位期待重回自然的你。坐擁心曠神怡的山間綠意將引擎熄火，耳邊聽見山風流動，呼吸也悄悄地有了涼意，你揚起微笑環顧周遭，樸實的木屋與綠意相伴，山林間的生活融入深色的木頭建築裡，成了一幅和諧的畫面。熱情的柯基甜甜快步向前，圓圓的大眼彷彿笑著迎接你，跟著牠的步伐，走入令人心曠神怡的拉拉山間。與接待木屋相連的是雙層的戶外咖啡露台，你舒服地坐在椅子上，飲一口香氣四溢的咖啡，少了窗門的阻隔，更顯山群的壯麗氣勢，塔曼溪水流動著大自然的生命力。在大雨過後，還可能幸運地碰上難得美景，薄紗般的霧氣繞著翠綠山野，也輕輕包裹住你的焦慮，相信一切的煩憂，終會隨著雲霧緩緩散去。山谷間的愜意生活推開房門，山林的質樸在主人育任的悉心妝點下，成了簡約大方的舒適。走進雙人房「楓葉」、「銀杏」和「紫藤」，清雅的配色更凸顯落地窗外一望無際的綠景。懶洋洋地躺臥在鬆軟的床上，將山的變化萬千收進眼底，讓人不知不覺地墜入夢鄉。三間房組成的櫻花家庭房則可以容下一起出遊的大家族，午後，調皮的孩子們在臨近的魚池餵魚，長輩們在客廳聊著近來的日常生活；屋外懸吊的木鞦韆，讓大小朋友都開心，喚回童年般的天真笑容。夜裡，在廚房烹調簡單的宵夜，大夥兒酒足飯飽，享受團聚的時光。幸福，就是這麼的簡單。人情味就是最好的調味料育任、弟弟及父母一起住在這裡，一同管理民宿及偌大的山林園區。可愛寡言的爸爸還規劃了一處飼養特殊動物們的地方，媽媽則負責烹飪和果樹。為了給遠道而來的旅人更多便利。
stays.descriptionEn: Taoyuan｜Goo Dian Coffee HouseA happy little house beside a verdant green valleyYou drive out of the city on a winding country road and head deep into the mountains. Opening the car window, the breeze brushes by smelling of green grass. Slowing down the car, the layers of greenery outside the window put you in a fine mood. Turning a corner, you come upon a traveler’s relay station in the mountains - Goo Dian Coffee House is subtly located in a valley on Lala Mountain, embraced by the blue sky and green environment and just waiting to bring you in touch with the natural world.Situated in relaxed and carefree mountainsShutting off the engine, you hear the wind flowing through the mountains. As you breathe the cool mountain air, you smile and raise your head to take in your surroundings; a simple wooden house sits in the embrace of the green mountain forests. House and forest merge together, creating a harmonious scene. Tiantian (literally means “sweet”), the enthusiastic little Corgi, rushes forward to welcome you with his big, round eyes. You follow Tiantian into the relaxing environment of Lala Mountain.Attached to the wooden reception building is a two-level outdoor coffee terrace. You sit comfortably in a chair sipping a cup of flavorful coffee. The terrace is without windows and doors, so there is no separation between you and the grandeur and magnificence of the mountain range. The Daman creek flows by, revealing the vitality of nature. After a heavy rain, you may have the good fortune to see white gauze-like clouds enshrouding the emerald green mountains. Those clouds also envelope your worries, and you feel convinced that all your troubles will slowly scatter with the clouds and mist.Serene life in the mountain valleyIn your bedroom, host Lin has created a cozy, simple decor that mirrors the rustic character of the mountains. In the three double rooms - the Maple Leaf, Ginkgo, and Wistaria rooms - elegant color schemes further accentuate the endless green scenery outside the windows. Lying lazily upon the soft bed, you can admire the myriad transformations of the mountains as you drift naturally into slumberland. The three-room Sakura Suite is large enough to accommodate a large family on vacation together. In the afternoon, playful children can feed the koi fish in the nearby pond while adults chat about life in the living room. The wooden swing hanging outside the house brings innocent smiles to the faces of young and old alike. In the evening, you prepare a simple late-night snack. After everyone has eaten and drunk to their heart’s content, you sit enjoying each other’s company. It is such simple things that fill life with happiness.A generous and friendly ambiance is the best spiceLin lives here with his younger brother and parents, working together to operate Goo Dian Coffee House and maintain the vast forest park surrounding it. His cute, taciturn father has created an area for raising special and unusual animals, while his mother is responsible for cooking and taking care of the fruit trees. For the convenience of travelers from afar, Goo Dian provides both breakfast and dinner using vegetables from the local mountain landscape to satisfy the taste bud of their guests. Fresh, crisp bamboo shoots, crispy yet tender trout that is grilled to perfection - with fine skill, the chef produces dish after dish of beautiful, seasonal cuisine, with a mother’s home-cooked touch. It is almost as if you’ve returned to your own home away from home in the mountains.Early spring is the time to appreciate the sakura blossoms and in summer, you can savor the fragrant sweetness of juicy peaches. Winter is the time to marvel at a romantic landscape of snow-covered mountains. Stay for a single night at Goo Dian Coffee House and allow your body and spirit to be completely absorbed into the embrace of Lala Mountain. Leave the gloom of the city far behind and return to nature to enjoy the beauty of mountain life.

stays.name: 尞LIAU
stays.description: 這裡，位在桃園新屋的永安漁港附近，JI Stay 將一棟紅磚老屋重新整理復原。我們保留了老屋原有的風貌與溫度，並融入現代旅居的輕盈節奏。讓老宅不只被記憶收藏，也能重新與當代生活對話。透過我們精心設計的角落，老屋的格局與手感家具被妥善保留，讓日光、微風、植物與聲音自然成為空間的一部分——每一處都是緩慢生活的註解。這裡，推薦給喜歡深度旅行、想真正「住進」一個地方的你。在這裡，你可以：- 到海邊看海，讓心靜下來- 走進稻田，親近土地與自然- 坐在廣場上靜靜看著日落- 夜晚，幸運的話能仰望銀河，與螢火蟲邂逅- 感受一段純粹的台灣客庄日常不少來訪的旅人說：「像是回到外婆家，但多了一點設計感與自在感。」這裡不是觀光景點，而是一種生活方式的邀請。給想好好生活的你，一個剛剛好的理想提案。
stays.descriptionEn: Near Yong’an Fishing Harbor, we restored a red-brick house and brought it back to life. We kept the home’s original warmth and texture, then added a light, modern rhythm so the old house doesn’t just sit in memory—it speaks to the present.The original layout and hand-touched furniture remain, and sunlight, breeze, plants, and everyday sounds flow through the rooms. Every corner gently slows you down and invites a slower way of living.This place is for travelers who like to go deeper and “move in” for a while. You can walk to the sea and clear your mind, wander through rice fields and feel the land, sit in the square and watch the sunset, and at night—if you’re lucky—look up at the Milky Way and meet fireflies. It’s a simple day in Taiwan’s Hakka countryside.Many guests say it feels like visiting Grandma’s house—only with a touch of design and more ease. This isn’t a tourist spot; it’s an invitation to a way of life, a just-right place for anyone who wants to live well.

stays.name: 我愛你學田
stays.description: 稻田 埤塘 老磚屋書籍 寵物 慢生活你是否對每天繁忙、沒有溫度的生活感到倦了?嚮往自在奔跑於田野之間、單純享受與親友相聚的時光嗎?這裡沒有吵雜的喇叭聲，也無須應付走馬看花的制式行程；白天與孩子和毛小孩一同擁抱自然、盡情放電，黃昏時，划著獨木舟追逐沉落埤塘中的夕陽，這是屬於我愛你學田民宿獨享的鄉村慢生活。稻田與老磚屋未來將與新屋水牛書店結合，交棒給兩個年輕人，一個學的是資訊，卻決定當一位專職農夫，一個學的是文學，卻選擇做工作犬領犬員，這裡將提供嶄新服務，但仍保留原來水牛書店公益書店的精神，歡迎一同造訪稻田裡的書店。民宿保留傳統客家磚瓦屋構造，內部提供舒適現代化設施。適合家庭旅遊、朋友聚會、員工旅遊、教育訓練、活動場地租借。室內提共5間獨立套房、視聽會議廳、共用客廳、廚房、及書房。戶外大片草皮、埤塘適合烤肉、划船、踢球、慢活欣賞田野風光，自種無毒稻米、養蜂、及萃取茶樹精油，提供最純粹的自然生活體驗。

stays.descriptionEn: Hotel located in Taoyuan CityLocated just a 5-minute walk from Taoyuan Station, 191 Hotel offers cosy accommodation. Free WiFi is covered in all areas. With a convenient location, the hotel offers easy links to various department stores as Far Eastern, Tonlin and Shin Kong Mitsukoshi.191 Hotel is a 13-minute drive from Hutoushan Park. New Taipei City Yingge Ceramics Museum and Taoyuan Airport are both 25 minutes' car ride away. Taipei city can be reached in 30 minutes' train ride.Each comfy room is air-conditioned and features an electric kettle, a fridge and a flat-screen cable TV. The private bathroom comes with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer.There is a 24-hour front desk at the property offering luggage storage. A fax and photocopying service is available. Coffee and tea can be enjoyed on site while coin-operated washing machine is offered on each floor.

stays.name: 住都大飯店
stays.description: 住都大飯店成立於１９９９年，在負責人認真經營下，相關機關的佳評如潮，是一間深具國際高級飯店水準的旅館。 位於桃園市的後站，住都飯店提供一系列別出心裁的房間與餐廳。使得客人得以在繁忙之餘，享受到精緻的服務品質及別出心裁的飯店特色。在房間方面,住都各房間格外典雅舒適，再加上飯店中各項設施及俱樂部的使用，客人能以合理價格享受尊榮禮遇。 在餐廳方面，住都大飯店提供與眾不同的特色餐廳。一樓 海鮮百匯自助餐廳 特聘名設計師精心設計讓您倍感溫馨。 海鮮百匯自助餐廳 提供全天供豐富精緻的菜餚、美味可口的甜點及各式高級飲料，口感特別，值得大家推薦品嚐。二樓設有典雅宴客廂房共７間，由名廚親自料理精緻菜餚，吃過的客人均讚不絕口。一樓及三樓的宴會廳，在精心規劃後，提供一個婚宴喜慶、謝師宴及會議的另一個絕佳場所。 住都大飯店特有的品味及水準，是名流人士流連忘返的場所，但住都全體員工仍秉持一份熱誠的心，竭誠等待您的光臨指教，希望有朝一日您也可體會到我們的特色，與我們分享您的寶貴意見。

The hotel features exceptionally elegant and comfortable rooms, plus facilities and clubs, and guests can enjoy privileges at reasonable prices. For dining, Chuto Hotel offers distinctive specialty restaurants. Seafood Buffet Cafeteria, on the 1st floor, is carefully designed by distinguished designers to make you feel comfortable and warm. Seafood Buffet Cafeteria offers exquisite cuisine, rich, delicious desserts, and a variety of beverages, with special mouthfeel, and it is worthy of recommendation and tasting. On the 2nd floor, the hotel features 7 elegant banquet rooms, and delicate dishes are personally prepared by the famous chef, and after the dining, guests praise the foods to high heaven. The banquet halls on the 1st and 3rd floors are the perfect places for wedding, celebration, teacher appreciation, and meeting banquets, after a careful planning. Chuto Hotel, with its features and level of standard, attracts celebrities and public figure to come and to linger, but the staff is still upheld a passionate heart with dedication and await your advice. I hope one day you can appreciate our specialty and share your comments with us.

stays.searchText: 住都大飯店 住都飯店股份有限公司 桃園市旅館010號 桃園市 桃園區 桃鶯路398號5-12樓,398-1號1-9樓,398-2號1-9樓,388-5號1-11樓 住都大飯店成立於１９９９年，在負責人認真經營下，相關機關的佳評如潮，是一間深具國際高級飯店水準的旅館。 位於桃園市的後站，住都飯店提供一系列別出心裁的房間與餐廳。使得客人得以在繁忙之餘，享受到精緻的服務品質及別出心裁的飯店特色。在房間方面,住都各房間格外典雅舒適，再加上飯店中各項設施及俱樂部的使用，客人能以合理價格享受尊榮禮遇。 在餐廳方面，住都大飯店提供與眾不同的特色餐廳。一樓 海鮮百匯自助餐廳 特聘名設計師精心設計讓您倍感溫馨。 海鮮百匯自助餐廳 提供全天供豐富精緻的菜餚、美味可口的甜點及各式高級飲料，口感特別，值得大家推薦品嚐。二樓設有典雅宴客廂房共７間，由名廚親自料理精緻菜餚，吃過的客人均讚不絕口。一樓及三樓的宴會廳，在精心規劃後，提供一個婚宴喜慶、謝師宴及會議的另一個絕佳場所。 住都大飯店特有的品味及水準，是名流人士流連忘返的場所，但住都全體員工仍秉持一份熱誠的心，竭誠等待您的光臨指教，希望有朝一日您也可體會到我們的特色，與我們分享您的寶貴意見。

stays.descriptionEn: "Metropolish Hotel," after six months of re-decorating, debuted a new look in June 1, 2023. The "Metropolish Hotel" is located in downtown Taoyuan city, near the Taoyuan County Government offices and the District Court, and is about eight minutes from the Taoyuan Train Station, 15 minutes from the Taiwan High Speed ​​Rail Station, and 20 minutes from Taoyuan International Airport; it’s just 20 minutes' drive from Daxi, Cihu by car, arriving from No. 2 East-West Freeway. Exit from the Freeway Taoyuan Interchange and follow Daxing West Road until you reach Guoji Road. Turn right, continue for about 500 meters, and turn left onto Yanshou Street. Look for the Metropolish Hotel. It is convenient transportation and accessible from all directions. Whether for a business trip, or leisure travel, the Metropolish Hotel is definitely the best choice for your stay.

stays.description: 桃園智選假日酒店位於臺灣桃園，緊鄰購物中心，驅車6分鐘即可至桃園火車站，酒店距桃園國際機場也只有20分鐘車程，驅車至臺北市中心只需30分鐘，距高鐵火車站僅20分鐘車程，交通十分便利，是商務及休閒旅客最佳的選擇。 酒店樓高12層，共有138間舒適的客房，每間客房提供免費上網服務和精緻的早餐。房間清新雅致的裝飾、賞心悅目的空間、寬大通透的玻璃窗、柔軟舒適的睡床、可供選擇的枕頭、完美畫質的液晶電視、乾淨寬敞的浴室、TOTO淋浴設備、冷暖空調、無線上網等細膩貼心的人性化設計定讓您感覺溫馨舒適。我們細緻入微的服務貫穿始終，譜寫您旅途的輕鬆樂章。 酒店設有1個會議室，提供演示用活頁紙、標記筆、數位投影儀、白板等設備，滿足您的會議需求。商務中心提供秘書服務、高速上網、郵件快遞、傳真、列印、免費上網等服務，滿足您的商務需求。酒店自助早餐品種多樣、口味多元，開啟您健康精彩的一天。Great Room餐廳裝飾清新環境雅致，彙集世界各地的饕餮美食，供您甄選，還提供免費網路，是商務聚會和休閒的理想場所。
stays.descriptionEn: Choose Holiday Inn Express Taoyuan, a modern high-rise hotel just 20 minutes by taxi from Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport.Relax, arriving at Holiday Inn Express Taoyuan is a breeze thanks to our proximity to the airport and Taoyuan Railway Station. It's not just our handy location in downtown Taoyuan that keeps guests coming back, but our friendly staff, complimentary breakfast buffet and complimentary wireless Internet throughout the hotel.Hire our intimate meeting room to welcome up to 10 people to your presentation, and feel free to use the PCs in our 24-hour Internet Corner at your leisure. Holiday Inn Express Taoyuan is just 20 minutes' drive from major electronics companies in Huaya Technology Park and Guishan Industrial Zone.Sample local favourite popcorn chicken at vibrant Taoyuan Night Market, and go bargain-hunting in neon-lit TaiMall shopping centre. Tranquil Tiger Head Mountain, set in a leafy park 2.5km from the hotel, provides a quiet retreat away from the bustle of the city centre. A public bus service to Taipei, Taiwan's largest city, leaves from outside the hotel and takes around 40 minutes.Holiday Inn Express Taoyuan's helpful Front Desk staff are happy to help you plan your stay, from travel tips to where to find the best pork chop stall in town. Children stay free in their parents' room, making us a good-value choice for family breaks.

stays.name: 桃花園飯店
stays.description: 桃花園飯店坐落於熙來攘往的桃園火車站市中心商圈，交通便捷，30分鐘車程可到桃園高鐵，桃園國際機場，以及台北火車站。優雅的新古典主義建築，營造簡約風尚；生活機能便利，緊鄰3家百貨公司，各式國際知名連鎖餐飲。飯店提供商務中心、交誼廳、健身房，多功能會議室等多元都會便利功能，並充分傾聽旅人的需求，以人性化思維織構旅人美好的住宿經驗。一樓大廳寬敞視野無壓迫感，後院綴以景觀庭園，令心靈自在舒坦。 二樓廊道開放空間供藝術展覽，多包廂式多功能會議中心，設施完備，是商務旅客的極佳聚會選擇。 三樓至十二樓精心雕琢240間各式精緻客房，以茶園和天燈意象、襯托出桃園古城的古典風尚，入住其中，一股清香韻味令人心曠神怡。殷切貼心的專業服務，是您商務旅行、會議、餐宴、社交最適意與優質的最佳選擇。全館共有七款房型，分別以台灣茶園、平溪天燈等特有元素為設計主題，貴賓入住即可感受台灣的美麗風情。房內設施完善，備有乾濕分離衛浴設備、大尺寸液晶電視、舒適沙發、WiFi無線上網服務等，並於每間客房皆擁有大片窗景，可供您輕鬆遠眺大桃園美麗景緻。提供尊榮服務與舒適環境是我們的核心理念，歡迎蒞臨桃花園飯店，我們將竭誠一切為您服務，務求讓您享有賓至如歸的感受。
stays.descriptionEn: Situated in the busy business district near Taoyuan Railway Station with easy access to Taoyuan High Speed Railway, Taoyuan International Airport and Taipei Railway Station, Tao Garden Hotel is an elegant designed hotel with the most convenient surroundings. Close to the 3 department stores, international restaurant chains, guest may enjoy casual dining and shopping experience. The hotel offers a business center, common room, gym, and conference room, fully capable of satisfying any business needs. It’s the most user-friendly accommodation for any business and leisure travelers.The lobby on the first floor is a visual pressure free space with a scenery garden at the back, a treat for your mind.The second floor is open for art exhibitions, multipurpose conference rooms fully equipped with the finest facilities.From the third floor to the twelfth floor, 240 exquisite rooms designed with the concept of tea gardens and sky lanterns bring out the traditional Taoyuan. Hospitable attitude and professional service, it’s the finest accommodation for any business, seminar, company retreat and leisure travel.We offer 7 room types decorated with themes of Taiwan like tea gardens and sky lanterns for guests to admire the beauty of Taiwan the moment they step in. The rooms are installed with the finest facilities, separate washlet and shower, LCD TV, couch, wireless internet access, and each room offers large glass windows for better lighting. Comfortable and relaxing, the spacious room will soothe your weariness.

stays.name: 歐悅精品汽車旅館桃園分館
stays.description: 桃園館於2010年落成，別名「歐悅花漾館」，全館28種風格套房，以搜羅自世界各地的花朵語意作為靈感來源，寄語花情、內斂綻放呈現出百花焉然含笑卻語意深長的情愫，在卓越的設計與營造團隊全力打造下客房呈現出繽紛多變的視覺特效， 每個細微處皆是精工細作百花繽紛的情景躍然紙上。沿襲歐悅一貫的「光」、「水」、「綠意」精神，桃園館更大量的將綠景、活水設計巧妙融入客房的每個角落， 更貼近使用者的親水設計擺脫了一般旅館飯店較為封閉的制式化計，讓往來的貴賓在休憩的同時也可享受到相當珍貴的芬多精，優良的採光與通風設計、健康的活水綠景規劃除了要給您精緻奢華的休憩空間，也要為每位貴賓所使用的健康空間的把關。
stays.descriptionEn: Oh-Ya Motel - Taoyuan Branch is also known as Oh-Ya Hua-yang Motel. The design of the 28 suites were inspired by various types of flowers from around the world. Floral motives and essence are expressed in the interior design by fully capturing the sentiments evoked by each blossom. The design team did an excellent job in creating guestrooms with colorful and varied visual effect. Every small detail shows the intent on refinement and perfection. Consistent with Oh-Ya's usual design features - light, water and greenery - the Taoyuan Branch further pushed the enevelope by cleverly incorporating the concept of lush green plants and water features into every guestroom. This innovative design concept broke away from the traditional standard look employed by typical hotels. This allows our guests to relax and enjoy their surroundings even more. The excellent usage of lighting, ventilation and soothing greenery not only gives our valued guests a luxurious restful space, but also allows them to have control over their comfort and health.

stays.descriptionEn: "IF Motel in Fashion" is located in the Taoyuan Zhongshan Arts and Cultural Business District. It takes about 30 minutes by car from the Motel to Taoyuan International Airport and Taiwan High Speed Rail and 15 minutes to TRA Taoyuan Station. We provide each single room with Beautyrest® Dornier Plush / Panaray 402 Series IV Loudspeaker used by cinemas and theaters / Bose PM4250 PowerMatch Amplifier / Bose Panaray MB4 Modular Bass Loudspeake r / Panasonic Induction Stove / Wireless Mobile Charger / Professional Gaming Chair/ SPA Outlet Gooseneck / 65-inch 4K LCD TV/ 27-inch Computer Display Monitor (same in the Internet Cafe) and Free WIFI. We also provide free private car parks. The air-conditioner is installed in every single room. The light of interior decorating is delicate with different styles for each room. In addition, we provide each room with a mini bar, an induction stove, a dining area with a refrigerator, a flat screen TV with premium TV channels and sofas. In the private bathroom, there is either a massage bathtub or shower facilities, accompanied with free toiletries and a hair dryer. To provide convenient hotel experience, IF Motel offers private rental, check out and free luggage storage services as well. Customers can have meals in our restaurant, or enjoy our room services, which allow customers have meals in their own room. We sincerely thank you for your visit from the bottom of our heart. Thanks to your support and visit, we keep growing and become better and better. IF Motel will always offer the most considerable services and give you the extraordinary enjoyment. We hope that you can keep giving us any advice and we also hope that you can have a great time staying in our motel.

stays.name: 薇緹文旅
stays.description: 華庭花園酒店位於桃園市的中心地帶，距離台北公交車站僅幾步之遙。這家典雅的酒店設有一間餐廳和免費無線網絡連接，還提供佈置高雅的住宿設施。這棟現代化建築距離桃園火車站有15分鐘步行路程。熱鬧的桃園夜市有8分鐘的步行路程之遙，而桃園國際機場有20分鐘的車程。華庭花園酒店的客房內全都舖有地毯，並配備了一台平面電視、梳妝台和一扇窗戶。現代化的連接浴室內配備了浴缸和免費洗浴用品。客人可以使用酒店的會議設施和卡拉OK設施，也可在健身中心鍛煉身體。酒店的其他設施包括一個24小時前台和免費停車設施。酒店每天提供免費自助早餐，而內部的意大利餐廳供應各類新鮮的意式菜餚。
stays.descriptionEn: Set in Taoyuan in the Taoyuan Municipality Region, 22 km from Taipei, Well Garden Hotel features a sun terrace and fitness centre. Guests can enjoy the on-site bar. Free WiFi is offered and free private parking is available on site.Each room is equipped with a flat-screen TV. Certain rooms have a seating area for your convenience. You will find a kettle in the room. Each room is fitted with a private bathroom fitted with a bath. For your comfort, you will find free toiletries and a hairdryer.You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property.Wulai is 29 km from Well Garden Hotel, while Hsinchu City is 40 km away. The nearest airport is Taoyuan Airport, 12 km from the property.

stays.name: 蘇活汽車旅館
stays.description: 蘇活汽車旅館成立於民國92年，位於桃園市都會中心，靠近桃園交流道、桃園機場及桃園高鐵站，四周交通便利，是出外旅客休憩住宿及商務住宿之首選。蘇活商務汽車旅館，搭配頂級之設備(歡唱KTV，VOD隨選電影，Wii遊戲機，奈米豐養泉，幻彩水流氣泡按摩浴缸，頂級鵝頸噴水療，蒸氣浴，維琪浴等設備)，以創造主題，引領風騷之概念，打造出優質情境之汽車旅館，多樣風貌之客房，貼新細心之服務，塑造出休閒渡假、浪漫約會及歡樂聚會等全方位之汽車旅館。本館歷年來積極參與政府所舉辦之各項評鑑，並屢獲佳績，桃園縣優質旅館、時尚旅館評鑑之旗艦獎等，更是通過交通部觀光局所推動之星級旅館評鑑，並榮獲三星級之殊榮。
stays.descriptionEn: Soho Motel was set up in 1992, located in Taoyuan City urban center, close to Taoyuan Interchange Road, Taoyuan International Airport and Taoyuan High Speed ​​Rail Station, surrounded by convenient transportation, and it is travelers' leisure or business accommodation of choice. Soho Motel, equipped with the top-rated device ( KTV, VOD-demand movies, Wii, Nano Feng Yang spring water, colorful Jacuzzi, top water treatment, steam bath, Vichy showers, and other equipment), in order to create topics for pioneering the fashion concept to create a quality motel. Diverse room styles, dedicated and attentive services, to offer a relaxing break, romantic dating, and fun gatherings, among others. Over the years, the hotel has actively involved in the evaluations organized by the government and won awards and medals, including Taoyuan County-quality Hotels, the flagship award from stylish hotel evaluations, and a certification of 3 star hotel awarded by the Tourism Bureau.

It is a 25-minute drive from Taoyuan Airport and a 30-minute drive from Taoyuan High Speed Rail Station.All rooms in the hotel are equipped with cable TV, refrigerator, electric kettle and seating area. The private bathroom includes shower facilities, hairdryer and free toiletries. There is also free bottled water.

stays.description: 嫺靜的小城，舒適的住所。活在不同的時空背景，人與人的經歷截然不同，風閣取自英文 Vogue ，本義為時尚引領潮流，是一間沒有框架的汽車旅館，館內提供的不只是休息或住宿！38種不同的空間，每間都有著它獨特的韻味，讓每位入住的旅客依個人喜好得到有別以往的感受，因為這裡不Boring！風閣營造出享、樂、遊、趣的氛圍，讓充滿欲望的人得到能量釋放、讓想狂歡慶祝的同好獲得新聚點、讓計劃旅行的您能安心休息、讓懷有赤子心的人們拾起童真、讓期盼孩子快樂的爸媽獲得安慰。這一切的體驗，風閣秉持著以平價消費服務每位賓客的精神，並積極地以在地品牌合作為目標前進著，持續茁壯。風閣精品旅館的服務宗旨，平價的享受，給您用心、貼心優質服務的楊梅住宿。

stays.name: 麗多森林度假酒店
stays.description: 「麗多森林溫泉酒店」坐落於桃園市楊梅千年風水寶地上，佔地3萬坪，周圍盡是原始樹林與山巒層疊的秀麗山景，得天獨厚的地理環境，將自然、養身、生態、渡假、超星級服務集於一身，世界級生態森林浴，國家級養生美人湯，離台灣國門最近的距離，享受全球頂級渡假禮遇，南來北往的觀光客，以楊梅作為中繼點，1日遊、或是3天2夜的行程，都無比便利，歡迎來這裡體驗幸福，圓一個心靈深處的夢境，同時變成真實的記憶帶回家。不計成本引入高檔食材酒店內現有複合式餐飲、中餐、西餐、下午餐以及改良式精緻客家美食餐廳。在飄香中餐廳的客家美食方面，強調少油低鹽、重視食品安全，這是酒店不變的堅持。主廚群以傳統料理作為基底，配合時令，精心研發多道創意手工料理，透過大量採購，突破選用食材的限制，提供數十道菜色：子姜爆脆腸、客家鹹蛋杏鮑菇、客家小炒……等應有盡有，客人們反應甚佳。而採購自鄰近永安漁港、南寮漁港、在地農莊之食材，也為縮短食物里程盡一份心。另外，東森山林渡假酒店優先晉用在地廚師，期提供桃園子弟們更多的就業機會。美好空間創造幸福東森山林渡假酒店，未來將進行ISO認證、推行環保旅館、優化加強客房服務，以及生態園區改良規劃等措施。餐飲方面，不僅整頓擴建空間，並由鄰近農場提供有機蔬菜，持續開拓服務的可能性，期望讓人們享受生活的緩慢步調，品味最美的燦爛時光。

stays.searchText: 麗多森林度假酒店 麗多國際顧問股份有限公司 桃園市旅館184號 桃園市 楊梅區 東森路3號 「麗多森林溫泉酒店」坐落於桃園市楊梅千年風水寶地上，佔地3萬坪，周圍盡是原始樹林與山巒層疊的秀麗山景，得天獨厚的地理環境，將自然、養身、生態、渡假、超星級服務集於一身，世界級生態森林浴，國家級養生美人湯，離台灣國門最近的距離，享受全球頂級渡假禮遇，南來北往的觀光客，以楊梅作為中繼點，1日遊、或是3天2夜的行程，都無比便利，歡迎來這裡體驗幸福，圓一個心靈深處的夢境，同時變成真實的記憶帶回家。不計成本引入高檔食材酒店內現有複合式餐飲、中餐、西餐、下午餐以及改良式精緻客家美食餐廳。在飄香中餐廳的客家美食方面，強調少油低鹽、重視食品安全，這是酒店不變的堅持。主廚群以傳統料理作為基底，配合時令，精心研發多道創意手工料理，透過大量採購，突破選用食材的限制，提供數十道菜色：子姜爆脆腸、客家鹹蛋杏鮑菇、客家小炒……等應有盡有，客人們反應甚佳。而採購自鄰近永安漁港、南寮漁港、在地農莊之食材，也為縮短食物里程盡一份心。另外，東森山林渡假酒店優先晉用在地廚師，期提供桃園子弟們更多的就業機會。美好空間創造幸福東森山林渡假酒店，未來將進行ISO認證、推行環保旅館、優化加強客房服務，以及生態園區改良規劃等措施。餐飲方面，不僅整頓擴建空間，並由鄰近農場提供有機蔬菜，持續開拓服務的可能性，期望讓人們享受生活的緩慢步調，品味最美的燦爛時光。

stays.description: 富立登國際大飯店位於桃園市南崁區大坑溪河畔，四周綠蔭步道，清幽雅靜，於2013年7月5日正式開幕。飯店以「精緻、個性、獨特」計結合復古摩登及現代簡約風格，獨特9米挑高大廳，光線明亮通透，空間寬敞舒適，氣派非凡。全館共181間客房，具有10坪-45坪不同格局的房型，客房皆具有對外窗，並使用YKK氣密門窗，客房設備齊全，全面配置微波爐、提供5G無線網路，房內採用進口木質地板、衛浴乾溼分離，各樓層配置洗衣機及乾衣機。擁有500坪戶外休閒區域，是旅客放鬆身心及兒童玩樂的休憩空間，適合商務差旅、夫妻情侶度假、家庭旅遊住宿飯店。離桃園機場、高鐵桃園站約10至15分鐘車程，距南崁交流道約1.8公里，沿著河畔走路五分鐘就可到達台茂購物中心，地理位置相當優越。
stays.descriptionEn: Freedom Design Hotel is located in Nankan, Taoyuan, surrounded by lush greenery and serene landscapes, providing a tranquil and peaceful environment. The hotel officially opened on July 5, 2013.The hotel features a design concept of "exquisite, unique, and distinctive," blending retro-modern and minimalist styles. It boasts a striking 9-meter-high glass ceiling, designed to maximize natural light, with carefully placed lighting fixtures that enhance brightness and create an impressive ambiance.The hotel offers 181 guest rooms, with layouts ranging from 33 m² to 148 m². All rooms feature exterior windows and are equipped with YKK airtight windows. The rooms are fully equipped with essential amenities, including microwaves and 5G wireless internet. Hotel also feature imported wooden floors, bathrooms designed with separate wet and dry zones, and each floor is equipped with washers and dryers for guest convenience. The hotel also offers a 1,600 m² outdoor leisure area, providing a relaxing space for travelers and a play area for children, making it ideal for business trips, romantic getaways, and family vacations.The hotel is located just a 10-15 minute drive from Taoyuan Airport and Taoyuan High-Speed Rail Station, and only 1.8 kilometers from the Nankan Interchange. A five-minute walk along the river leads to the TaiMall Shopping Center, offering an excellent location.

stays.name: 林口維多利亞民宿
stays.description: 本民宿的屋頂及門窗皆是用百年檜木建造的，民國23年落成，是當年蘆竹區最好的房子，也是當時代官員騎馬出差由淡水廳往桃園新竹方向走古道，休憩打尖的地方。屋主祖先輩為林口竹林山觀音寺創辦人之一，再遷居至此地。歷經時代變遷，此種房屋在台灣已經極為少見，門窗造型也類似淡水紅毛城，見證台灣88年前（民國23年）的生活軌跡和建築特色，是值得探訪的特色建築。現經維護整修設計，讓「特色老屋再現風華」！竭誠歡迎貴賓蒞臨體驗88年前的鄉村仕紳的居家生活，帶給您和家人親友滿滿的幸福回憶！1.家族歷史淵源西元1751年(雍正28年) 王家祖先第九世如寵公帶領三個兒子移居林口，於現今林口區東林里粉寮地區，墾地種植蕃薯，養家糊口，並將多餘的蕃薯研磨成粉供應至艋舺，苦心經營奠定基業，世代相傳，眾悉王厝草寮即是王家磨坊之處，也是林口粉寮地名的由來。至十一世宗順公遷居至蘆竹庄坑子赤塗崎497蕃地，四子自立門戶，購置土地種植水稻及茶葉，建立家園及擴大家族產業，並且擔任保正，熱心公益及地方事務；民國38年林口竹林山觀音寺創辦人之一王金生，即是先祖父王傳立的堂兄。本民宿英式維多利亞風格建築是先祖父王傳立先生擔任無盡會社社長時，於日治時代昭和九年(民國23年)委託楊阿虎建築師設計並興建完成，呈現當時日式與歐式的融合特色，做為其經營家族事業，親近鄰里及家人之居所。在鼎盛時期，屋內曾居住有四戶家庭，男女老少共二十餘人，相當熱鬧，屋主亦有保存相關照片，未來可作為展覽之素材。王家祖厝傳承至今已88年仍屹立不搖，歷經地震亦未見牆壁有裂痕，見證當年鄉村仕紳的生活，充滿各式各樣的生命故事，且此型式的建築在台灣大多數因都市建設被拆除，目前是具有特色之建築。2.老屋建築特色「林口維多利亞民宿」由王先生的祖父建造，完工於民國23年，時值日治時期昭和9年。當時日本致力於西化運動，仿效歐美先進國家成為時尚風潮，此種融合日本及英國家居風格的歐風日式建築，在當時頗為流行，與台北市金華街的行政院院長官邸頗類似，在現今的日本及義大利的鄉間也尚存有類似的建築樣式，此類型的房屋建築在台灣因年代已久，能夠完整保留至今已很稀少。本建築材料使用百年檜木做屋頂及主要支柱，另輔以加強磚造結構，承重牆主要是由兩塊磚造，可以抵消地震的力道，雖已使用88年，仍是堅固耐用、冬暖夏涼。建築物外部配上外國進口的英式木製門窗設計，採上下拉窗形式，造型獨特，窗戶高度相較台灣常見規格尺寸更高，使得室內各處空氣流通、光線充足。而門扉規格亦有所不同，與現今常見的門扉相較之下比例較短，且處於建物不同位置的門扉有高低之分，展現建築物空間的不同層級，如此有別於台灣日常建築的空間體驗，非常具有特色。3.位處生態豐富的大自然中本建築位於坑子里的赤塗崎，是桃園最先有人居住生活的地區之一，但本地區的大部分土地自民國59年被劃入林口都市計畫區，人口外移情形相當嚴重，固有的生活與歷史文化逐漸式微，早期耕耘的稻田與茶園因工業化社會而快速荒廢。然而，長年實施管制的結果，延遲了地區發展的進程，但保留了原始的閩南生活樣貌，也使得周遭環境免於工業汙染的威脅。數十年以來，山林田地逐漸地荒野化，也形成了野生動植物的良好棲地，意外造就了豐富的自然生態景觀，與周遭的南崁及林口新市鎮相比，別有一番風味，成為了蘆竹的後花園。 近年來，屋主王先生 tony Wang 有感於都會生活繁忙，回憶早期純樸的生活環境，他自外商公司財務長退休後，因興趣使然而開始著手整理老屋周遭環境，一切從零開始的園藝生活非常繁忙但也相當充實，親自清除雜草、園藝整理，努力至今稍有成果。目前種植有香草園及多種本土景觀植物，四季輪流綻放花朵吐露芬芳，景色優美，如山櫻花、桂花、樟樹、肖楠、羅漢松、茶花、黃花風鈴木、梔子花、南洋衫…等。後山有自然林間小徑，前又有赤塗崎溪生態園區、坑子溪休閒農業區、鄰近羊稠坑步道…等，提供踏青郊遊的多樣選擇，傍晚時段非常涼爽，天邊升起的月亮也很美，添加更多美好的時光。
stays.descriptionEn: Welcome to Linkou Victoria Homestay — a charming century-old cypress wood villa nestled in a peaceful neighborhood just 5 minutes from Linkou city center and 30 minutes from Taipei or Taoyuan. Our exclusive full-house rental offers four spacious rooms, each with a private bathroom. Originally converted from seven rooms, the layout is flexible to accommodate 10 to 16 guests. The 330 m² indoor space and a 6,000 m² garden provide ample room for families, school trips, or corporate retreats. The building blends British Victorian and Japanese design elements, recreating the elegance of 1930s Taiwan. Enjoy your stay in an environment surrounded by nature and history, with convenient access and free parking. We welcome international guests to book easily through Agoda or Airbnb. Come and experience a stay that combines warmth, comfort, and culture in northern Taiwan.

stays.name: 貝克漢汽車旅館
stays.description: 貝克漢汽車旅館(Beckham Motel)於桃園南崁交流道下約5分鐘車程,位於南崁最熱鬧的中正路後方之桃園街,是一處交通方便鬧中取靜的休閒環境,在這裡可以享受高級的舒適環境，也可以享受交通的便利，貝克漢汽車旅館以高格調的設計，營造出溫馨高級的住宿環境，讓平常忙碌的您可以在這裡好好休息，徹底放鬆。本館設備新穎，館內設施包括VOD豪華影音隨選系統、Wii趣味遊戲、室內獨立車庫、液晶電視，每間客房內部裝潢設計匠心獨運，兼具隱密、舒適、浪漫與藝術，按摩浴缸、SPA淋浴、蒸氣及牛奶浴、氣泡浴，可以讓您倍感心曠神怡。在這裡不只是解決您住宿的問題，更是休閒養生的好去處，歡迎您來貝克漢汽車旅館品味不同的優質環境。如果您出差桃園，或到桃園旅遊、出國，請給我們一次機會，包您不虛此行，謝謝～歡迎您的光臨～
stays.descriptionEn: Beckham Motel is about a 5-minute drive from the Taoyuan Nankan Interchange. Located on Taoyuan Street, behind Nankan's busiest Zhongzheng Road, Beckham Motel has the advantage of being in a quiet and relaxing environment, but transportation is still convenient. The motel's stylish design creates a warm and classy ambiance. You will feel completely relaxed after a busy day. Our motel has the most up-to-date equipment, including VOD delux video on-demand system, fun Wii games, individual indoor parking space and LCD TV. The interior design in every room is unique and carefully thought-out by keeping in mind the importance of privacy, comfort, romantic atmosphere and art display. In addition, the jacuzzi tub, spa shower, steam bath, milk bath and bubble bath are all available to give you the ultimate relaxation. We're not just here to provide you a place to sleep, we're also a great place to go to for relaxation and wellness. We welcome you to come to Beckham Motel to experience a different kind of excellence.If you have to come to Taoyuan for business or pleasure, please give us a chance to serve you. We guarantee you will have no regrets. Thank you, and we welcome your visit!

stays.name: 草漯居
stays.description: 觀音草漯電梯別墅，共六層樓近百坪，最多可接待18位住客，除五間套房外，還有二樓客餐廳及五樓寬廣的公共空間，及4個車位（依車型大小而定）。五樓有休憩區和開闊露台,晴朗時六樓可見山稜線和海岸線。我們提供高速無線上網，高畫質有線電視頻道，大金冷暖空調，自有停車位。密碼鎖進出，不與房東同住。備有洗浴用品，請自備牙刷，環保愛地球！夜間十點後請降低音量。非住客請勿入內，否則視為住客收費，如有訪客需求請先行溝通，公共區有攝影機以維彼此權益。草漯隸屬觀音區的一里，是個小而美的地方。整個鬧區範圍不大，但應有盡有。我們的位置在鬧區旁的住宅區內，鬧中取靜、機能便利。步行3分鐘至便利商店，4分鐘至壘球場運動公園，7分鐘至天幕籃球場。開車8分鐘至白千層林道，10分鐘至草漯沙丘，20分鐘至藻礁生態區、青埔 X PARK、華泰outlet、永安漁港、竹圍漁港、桃園國際機場。

Because of your staying, support, and love, any demand and suggestions from you will continue to improve and encourage us to provide you with the most attentive service as always. stays.name: 名人堂花園大飯店
stays.description: 飯店簡介位於環島一號線上，坐擁樸拙的兄弟棒球場，南面石門水庫、遠眺雪霸群山。在這裡你能徜徉於四季交替的花園，靜觀群山與變化無窮之雲瀑，在無光害的觀星平台仰望閃爍群星與浩瀚宇宙。 你也可以從陽台觀賞棒球場高手雲集令人為之屏息的球賽，或是召集家人好友進場同樂。完備的室內球場，給雨天也想活絡筋骨的你。 棒球名人堂展示館眼花撩亂的棒球互動遊戲，即使你一點都不懂棒球，也能玩得不亦樂乎。史努比x棒球的主題樓層，更讓大人小孩都為之瘋狂。 除一般客房，更有獨特的史努比、棒球、老兄弟三種主題房型；多樣化的餐飲服務，從西式、日式、臺菜港點甚至台灣小吃應有盡有，滿足您挑惕的胃。 國際級高規格之宴會廳可容納至 600 人，距離桃園機場僅半小時的車程。無論是國內外會議研習、一生只有一次的婚禮宴會、或是各級運動比賽、國內外球隊訓練，名人堂都會是你最棒的選擇。 愛棒球的你、愛史努比的你、愛自然的你、愛愜意的你、愛派對的你… 無論你是大人小孩，成雙成對、三五好友還是單身貴族，無論雨天晴天，名人堂都能留給您一個令人難忘的美好體驗。 棒球名人堂+飯店，前無古人後無來者的獨特組合，會激盪出怎樣的火花？快來名人堂享受你最與眾不同的假期吧！

stays.searchText: 名人堂花園大飯店 優美飯店有限公司 交觀宿字第1507號 桃園市 龍潭區 民生路141巷150號 飯店簡介位於環島一號線上，坐擁樸拙的兄弟棒球場，南面石門水庫、遠眺雪霸群山。在這裡你能徜徉於四季交替的花園，靜觀群山與變化無窮之雲瀑，在無光害的觀星平台仰望閃爍群星與浩瀚宇宙。 你也可以從陽台觀賞棒球場高手雲集令人為之屏息的球賽，或是召集家人好友進場同樂。完備的室內球場，給雨天也想活絡筋骨的你。 棒球名人堂展示館眼花撩亂的棒球互動遊戲，即使你一點都不懂棒球，也能玩得不亦樂乎。史努比x棒球的主題樓層，更讓大人小孩都為之瘋狂。 除一般客房，更有獨特的史努比、棒球、老兄弟三種主題房型；多樣化的餐飲服務，從西式、日式、臺菜港點甚至台灣小吃應有盡有，滿足您挑惕的胃。 國際級高規格之宴會廳可容納至 600 人，距離桃園機場僅半小時的車程。無論是國內外會議研習、一生只有一次的婚禮宴會、或是各級運動比賽、國內外球隊訓練，名人堂都會是你最棒的選擇。 愛棒球的你、愛史努比的你、愛自然的你、愛愜意的你、愛派對的你… 無論你是大人小孩，成雙成對、三五好友還是單身貴族，無論雨天晴天，名人堂都能留給您一個令人難忘的美好體驗。 棒球名人堂+飯店，前無古人後無來者的獨特組合，會激盪出怎樣的火花？快來名人堂享受你最與眾不同的假期吧！

stays.name: 悅華大酒店
stays.description: 走入悅華 市外桃源，一處遠離城市的最佳休憩場所。配合國際標準27洞高爾夫球場、客房與餐飲，以最貼心無微不至的服務，讓您享受高品質的悠閒時光。90公頃大花園，期望短暫休假的您，充份享有輕鬆的運動、舒適的住宿環境以及品嚐美食的用餐空間等多重享受，在這裡您將發現，人和空間、陽光和自然的關係如此密切。熱情邀請您跳脫繁忙的生活，穿越陌生的路徑，沿途看山看海，讓不熟悉的景色為您釋壓放鬆，來到悅華盡情呼吸大自然的新鮮空氣與芬多精，讓純然不可多得的世外桃源，沉澱您的心。氣派12米挑高中庭，以原木石材展現踏實風格，高聳的椰子樹直入天井，閃耀充滿活力的陽光，客家圓樓式建築，營造和諧圓滿的溫馨氣氛。早晨誘惑您起床的是穿過薄紗窗婆娑漫舞的陽光，與落地窗外嬉鬧的雲雀叫聲，住宿可免費使用酒店的休閒設施：玻璃健身房、撞球檯、戶外游泳池及兒童遊戲區，在這裡，我們都幫您準備好了，只要帶著一顆渡假的心，輕鬆自在地走進悅華。擁有61間舒適客房均可免費寬頻上網、中西薈萃的翠庭與陽光咖啡廳提供多元化餐飲服務。挑高6米，寬敞無柱的宴會廳、獨立完善可量身打造的各項設施會議室，及16道擊球台高爾夫練習場。是您大宴小酌、商務、渡假旅遊首選！
stays.descriptionEn: Come to Yaward Resort, a calm oasis away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Here you will find a 27-hole golf course, guest rooms and dining options, as well as attentive and personalized service so that you can enjoy your leisure time in luxury. Amidst our 90 hectares grand gardens, if you are looking to take a short break, you will be able to enjoy many pleasures such as plenty of space to exercise, cozy accommodations and a splendid dining space. At Yaward, you will feel how close people can be to open space, sunshine and nature.We sincerely invite you to escape a busy life and go through this refreshing path to see the sea and the mountains and let this entirely new scenery release your stress. Come to Yaward with a stress-free vacation experience, and also to enjoy the nature fresh air and quiet your mind in this rare Shangri-lar full of phytoncide.The luxurious 12-meter-high atrium space with natural wood and stone materials displays a practical style. The soaring coconut trees standing straight into the patio, the lively sunshine together with the Hakka round buildings create a harmonious and welcoming atmosphere. In the morning, you will be waken up by the sunshine through the window and lark& #39;s singing outside the French window. Upon accommodation, you can enjoy the hotel& #39;s leisure facilities free of charge: glass gym, pool table, outdoor swimming pool and children& #39;s play ground. We are ready to welcome you to enjoy a relaxing and comfortable vacation free from any stress.The hotel owns 61 comfortable rooms with free broadband internet access. Jade Restaurant and Sunshine Cafe are well-known for Chinese and Western cuisines. The 6-meter-high banquet hall, spacious and pillar-free, the fully-equipped meeting rooms capable of providing customized services and the 16-fairway tee box golf practice course, is the first choice for any banquets, gathering, business, or vacations!

stays.descriptionEn: Puti Business Hotel is located on the main traffic road leading to Liufu Village, Xiaorenguo, Longtan, Kansai and other tourist attractions. It is close to Provincial Highway 3 and is only 10 minutes& #39; drive from Beier Highway Longtan Interchange. The traffic is very convenient. Multi-line national highway passenger transportation, Sightseeing buses and Hsinchu passenger transport both pass by the hotel, providing tourists with an affordable, safe and comfortable rest environment with resort facilities. The rooms are newly furnished, simple and comfortable, and fully adopt five-star high-grade latex independent cylinder mattresses, and are equipped with wireless WI. -FI and wired broadband network facilities. In addition, there is a parent-child VR TV play area in the lobby of the museum. There is a viewing platform on the top floor overlooking the beautiful scenery of Longtan. The third floor has a water play area, a steam bath, an oven, a barbecue area, and a small basketball court. .. etc., free facilities allow you to escape from the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy a leisurely stay.

stays.descriptionEn: Wunsin Motel's mission has always been to provide 100% customer satisfaction. We continue to be innovative and have expanded our services in order to better meet your needs. Our motel is licensed by the county. We met the safety inspection and our price is reasonable. We also received the honorary title of Trendy Motel Award in 2006, Best Service Award in the Value Motel category, and two-star rating from the 2013 Motel Evaluation. Though our motel is located in the downtown area, it's relatively quiet. It's also centrally located near a number of tourism attractions. It's great for visitors who want to do shopping or who are here for business. Our excellent and friendly service gives our guests a sense of belonging and give them the feeling of having a home away from home.

stays.name: 烏樹林從前從前
stays.description: 桃園｜烏樹林Before．徜徉於書本間的微醺美好不用一小時，這一次，我們只要微微向南走，就能抵達田野中，書本與美酒相聚的渡假小墅。藍天下的橘黃建築──烏樹林Before，邀你前來，一起自在地寫下旅途的篇章。嚐一口醇酒、翻一頁書香走進烏樹林Before，日光透進大片玻璃，灑落在磨石子地板上的方形花樣上，大廳兩側的木製櫃架，就像樹林裡因為生長速度不一，而高低錯落的林木；然而，藏放於林木間的秘密不是小鳥遺落的窩巢，而是主人Danny哥精選的書籍與精釀啤酒！他說，書本是充實內心的夥伴；啤酒則是談笑人間的良伴，看似毫不相干的存在，卻都是他生命中不可或缺的伴侶。於是Danny哥在旅宿裡的一樓裡，特別開設了同時賣酒的獨立書店，不為營利，只為滿足自己一顆渴望閱讀與分享的真心。「我的民宿就是生活的一部分。生活的延伸，你要來就要喜歡我的生活。」Danny哥帶有一絲臭屁且自豪地說，因為有幾分的用心，才能有幾分的自信。當家中決定將原本的老舊三合院翻新時，成了烏樹林Before誕生的契機，烏樹林Before，烏樹林，是當地的村名，而before其實是「b4」的諧音，4個b包含了bed、breakfast、book、beer，全是Danny哥迫不及待想與旅人分享的人生美好；你可以直接付錢帶走一本一見鍾情的書，或一瓶順喉的啤酒，度過一個悠閒的午後。打開一本本拼貼生活樣貌的故事書沿著整片書牆上樓，烏樹林Before是一本色彩繽紛的精裝故事本，翻開的每一頁都藏著不一樣的景色，一如五間房型的名稱：時而翻開了「生活風格」，遠方的中央山脈就在眼前；時而掀起了「文學小說」和「原民文學」的書角，樓中樓的挑空設計，讓日光透進天窗，樓梯下的小空間，是你們享受時光的秘密基地。「旅遊飲食」那頁，則是一片溫柔的青草色，溫暖陽光和點點粉色小花，陪你一起迎接春天的到來。
stays.descriptionEn: Taoyuan｜Before B&BThe intoxicating delight of lingering between booksIn open fields only an hour south of Taipei sits a small villa, which brings together books and fine beer. Sitting brightly under a blue sky, the amber colored building of Before B&B invites you to join in writing the story of your unrestrained journey.Sipping beer with your nose in a bookAs you enter Before B&B, sunlight streams through large windows and spills across the square pattern of the terrazzo floors. The uneven wooden bookshelves along both walls give the sensation of being in a forest where the trees have grown to varying heights. In this staggered forest, the treasures hiding between the trees are not birds’ nests, but rather the book collection of B&B host Danny, as well as his collection of craft beer! According to Danny, books are like friends who enrich our innermost selves, while beer is a good companion for pleasant worldly conversation. These two items appear to be unrelated, yet they are Danny’s indispensable life companions. So the first floor of Danny’s B&B is an independent bookstore that sells beer. This design is not for profit, but rather to satisfy Danny’s heartfelt desire for sharing his passions with others. “My B&B is a part of my life. It is an extension of me, so you have to appreciate my lifestyle to stay in my B&B.” Danny comes across as somewhat arrogant and proud, but after all, confidence comes from working hard at what you do. The moment his family decided to refurbish their aged courtyard home, the opportunity to create Before B&B was born. Black Forest is the name of the area were Before B&B is situated, while Before is actually a play on “b-four”, as in bed, breakfast, books, and beer - all delightful things which Danny just can’t wait to share with travelling guests. You may buy a book with which it was love at first sight, or perhaps a bottle of mouthwatering beer to pass a relaxing afternoon.Volume after volume recounting the collage of lifeHeading upstairs past walls lined with books, you discover that Before B&B is itself a colorful hardcover storybook, each page containing different scenery, as the names of the five guest rooms imply. Occasionally flipping this storybook open to the “life style” page, the central mountain range, however distant, appears right before your eyes. Occasionally opening it up to the “fiction & literature” section or the pages describing “indigenous literature” and light streams in through skylights, illuminating the split-level loft design of the B&B. Meanwhile, you share your discoveries with friends in the nooks beneath the stairs. The page of this B&B storybook about “travel & food” is the tender green color of a grassy field, the warmth of the sun and the specs of pink flowers accompany you in welcoming springtime. Meanwhile in the gosling-yellow story regarding “kids’ picture books” you and your friends have ample room to roll freely around like children on the two large double beds. Yet no matter which meticulously collaged page you open the Before B&B storybook to, it is sure to bring your imagined scenery to life.Discover story after brilliant storyStanding there in a simple t-shirt with a bottle of beer in hand, Danny looks just like the character Ling Hu-chong out of Jin Yong’s famous 1967 martial arts novel “Swordsman” who regarded the liquor in his cup as a lifelong friend. Most surprising, though, is that the practice to which he has devoted more than twenty years of his life is not what is in his cup, but rather what lies between the pages of his books! With a laugh, Danny proclaims, “Not a day goes by that I don’t read a book, nor a day when I don’t drink alcohol.” Danny exudes an open and generous humor, and is quite insistent on realizing the ideals he feels passionate about. Though it isn’t easy to operate a bookstore, he still hopes to use the magic of his shop to help people fall in love with reading. Even when work keeps him busy, whenever he meets a like-minded traveler, he’s more than willing to discuss books over bottles of beer all night long. Danny appreciates life and is apt to follow his whims, just like that free and easy character Ling Hu-chong, laughing his way through life.When you arrive at Before B&B, please remember to leave your hurried urban pace at the door, take the time to truly enjoy a good book, a bottle of beer, or an amusing phrase from your amiable host, Danny. Shouldn’t everyone’s life contain just this kind of carefree comfort? On this trip, you need not travel far, just a little to the south and you can find yourself in the midst of lush nature, fine literature, and craft beer. Put yourself in a holiday frame of mind, and enjoy the intoxicating delight of books and beer!

stays.searchText: 烏樹林從前從前 烏樹林從前從前 桃園市民宿032號 桃園市 龍潭區 龍平路115巷138弄76號 桃園｜烏樹林Before．徜徉於書本間的微醺美好不用一小時，這一次，我們只要微微向南走，就能抵達田野中，書本與美酒相聚的渡假小墅。藍天下的橘黃建築──烏樹林Before，邀你前來，一起自在地寫下旅途的篇章。嚐一口醇酒、翻一頁書香走進烏樹林Before，日光透進大片玻璃，灑落在磨石子地板上的方形花樣上，大廳兩側的木製櫃架，就像樹林裡因為生長速度不一，而高低錯落的林木；然而，藏放於林木間的秘密不是小鳥遺落的窩巢，而是主人Danny哥精選的書籍與精釀啤酒！他說，書本是充實內心的夥伴；啤酒則是談笑人間的良伴，看似毫不相干的存在，卻都是他生命中不可或缺的伴侶。於是Danny哥在旅宿裡的一樓裡，特別開設了同時賣酒的獨立書店，不為營利，只為滿足自己一顆渴望閱讀與分享的真心。「我的民宿就是生活的一部分。生活的延伸，你要來就要喜歡我的生活。」Danny哥帶有一絲臭屁且自豪地說，因為有幾分的用心，才能有幾分的自信。當家中決定將原本的老舊三合院翻新時，成了烏樹林Before誕生的契機，烏樹林Before，烏樹林，是當地的村名，而before其實是「b4」的諧音，4個b包含了bed、breakfast、book、beer，全是Danny哥迫不及待想與旅人分享的人生美好；你可以直接付錢帶走一本一見鍾情的書，或一瓶順喉的啤酒，度過一個悠閒的午後。打開一本本拼貼生活樣貌的故事書沿著整片書牆上樓，烏樹林Before是一本色彩繽紛的精裝故事本，翻開的每一頁都藏著不一樣的景色，一如五間房型的名稱：時而翻開了「生活風格」，遠方的中央山脈就在眼前；時而掀起了「文學小說」和「原民文學」的書角，樓中樓的挑空設計，讓日光透進天窗，樓梯下的小空間，是你們享受時光的秘密基地。「旅遊飲食」那頁，則是一片溫柔的青草色，溫暖陽光和點點粉色小花，陪你一起迎接春天的到來。

stays.description: 桃園石門水庫福華渡假飯店位於石門水庫旁，結合中國古意與當代藝術之概念設計，湖綠與木褐之原色，蘭香與檜木之清雅，予您視覺與嗅覺的自然感受，將繁鬧與喧嘩隔絕在桃花源外，讓您細細品味私人別館的關懷極致。桃園石門水庫福華渡假飯店內有94間精緻優雅客房，春桃、夏蔭、秋楓、冬梅之四季絕色，盡入眼簾，秉持福華的尊爵禮遇，享受住房、退房專人服務。貴賓享有無限次使用俱樂部設施，並提供相關旅遊景點諮詢服務，讓您細細品味私人別館的關懷極致。
stays.descriptionEn: Howard Lake Resort Shihmen Dam is located beside the Shihmen Dam. It was built with the concept of traditional Chinese decorations and modern art. The natural color of the green lake and the brown wood, the aroma of the orchid and the juniper will give your sense of sight and smell a fresh enjoyment. Away from the disturbance and tumult in this Utopia, our guests can taste the beauty and superiority of the private mansion. Howard Lake Resort Shihmen Dam has 94 splendid rooms, bringing you the charm of four seasons–spring peach, summer shade, autumn maple and winter plum. You can enjoy one-on-one check-in and -out services as special privilege that Howard always insist on offering. The VIPs can use the equipment in the club without any limit on the number of times. We also offer a consulting service on tourist attractions related information to make it easer for you to enjoy the amenities and excellence of the private mansion.

stays.description: 稻禾棧-2024年，欣逢龍潭信仰中心龍元宮建廟兩百年，廟方將此處閒置空間交予在地青年團隊「野菱蔓生」活化再造，空間名為「稻禾棧」，呼應龍元宮主祀神農大帝(五穀爺)，期待讓巷弄一隅，重拾生活的溫度與時氣的節奏，悄悄長出與土地同行的日常風景。
stays.descriptionEn: Dauhejhan-In 2024, as Longyuan Temple — the heart of faith in Longtan — celebrates its 200th anniversary, the temple invited a local youth team called “Wild Water Caltrop” to breathe new life into an old unused space. That’s how Daohe Inn was born — a name that pays tribute to the temple’s main deity, Shennong Dadi, the God of Agriculture and Five Grains.Here, we hope to bring back the warmth of everyday living and the easy rhythm of the seasons — letting a simple, grounded way of life quietly grow again in the heart of the neighborhood.

images.description: 稻禾棧為遠道而來的旅人打造兼具隱私與交流的舒適環境。床榻皆有獨立的隱私空間，設有充電插座與個人照明設備，方便深夜閱讀及使用電子裝置。 住宿環境及設施說明 1. 每間床位皆設有獨立拉簾，提供隱私與舒適的休息空間。床頭附有充電插座與閱讀燈，方便旅客使用。另備有置物櫃與衣架，可安心收納個人物品。 2.全館提供免費Wi-Fi，房內及交誼區皆備有多組席位，支援多種電子設備充電，空間明亮、清新。 3.共用浴室空間乾淨整潔，並提供洗髮精與沐浴乳。全館禁煙，常駐工作人員配有監控設備，確保入住安心與安全。 4.空間佈置溫馨簡約，館方提供經常在地的旅遊及生活資訊，鼓勵旅人體驗龍潭的日常，感受家的溫度。無論是短暫休息或長期停留，都能享受自在又貼心的住宿體驗。

stays.description: 馬廄地坪為298坪，建坪為85坪，外觀為西班牙式建築。粉橘色的外牆，加上手工壁面線條，讓人不由自主地彷彿回到了童年時光。您可盡情的在院子玩耍，當然也可以發呆或騎腳踏車繞著房子跑，那是我最愛做的事。也可到旁邊渴望會館的數萬坪公園散步或騎腳踏車，那裡也備有單車出借喔!還有室內溫水游泳池和7-11便利商店，生活機能可是非常方便。 為了完全不受外人打擾(民宿一天只接待一組貴賓, 採包棟方式出租～)，您將完全擁有屬於您歡樂又愉快的早晨。
stays.descriptionEn: The Spanish style Stables Garden Villa sits on an area of 985 meters with 281 meters of living space. The light orange, hand-textured exterior wall reminds us of storybook houses from our childhood books. You can play or daydream to your heart& #39;s delight in the courtyard, or ride your bike around the house, which is my favorite activity. You may also take a stroll or ride your bike in the huge park at the nearby Aspire Resort, which has bikes available for rental. There are also indoor heated swimming pool and a 7-Eleven store, making it very convenient indeed. To avoid unnecessary inconveniences to our guests, we only receive one group of guests per day, and each group has to rent the whole house. This will give you privacy and allow you to enjoy your space comfortably.

stays.name: 悅徠舘
stays.description: 夢的開端 The Prelude銀髮如霜，是歲月打造出的人生勳章，沒有案牘勞形的晚年，家人親友是最寶貴的珍藏，放慢腳步，與摯愛的人們常聚首，這正是悅徠館萌芽的伊始，萬事起頭難，要找到合適所在，諸多考量與阻滯，不遜昔日創業的艱辛。理想中的地點，要兼具都會生活便利、鄉居自然開揚、往返交通要快要多，家人朋友圈成員就更易於來往，更重要的，是能保有「結廬在人境，而無車馬喧」的靜謐，踏遍北台灣，幾經波折，就在林口的熱鬧商圈旁，竟意外發現了這「應許之地」。荒煙蔓草變成心靈棲所，是門大學問，厭惡安養院的垂暮沉沉，高級飯店的歡快華麗，才是該有的氛圍，但浮誇的表象、市儈的銅臭，都必須剔去，親近如家、更勝於家，才是該保有的純淨，以星級旅館概念打造的客房，配色清雅，格局方正，動線順暢，搭載娛樂通訊設備，房間配置的露台，雲影天光相伴的空間更通透，窩在房裡也不無聊。開放式的公共空間，現代中國風的簡潔細緻，線條素雅俐落、色調沉穩暖心、木作觸手溫潤，拋開老套而制式的畫作，穿行其間，就已經如人在畫中，也讓悅徠館蛻變成別有洞天之美的宅邸。2020 年初，前所未有的疫情橫掃全球，我們習慣的想法作法，都隨之產生結構變化，我們更珍惜與家人相處的時光，壓力或許更嚴峻，隨手可得的小確幸，將成為紓壓的最好出口，與其等待遠行，不如利用空檔，隨時來個小旅行，給自己調勻呼吸的機會，這個綠洲雖小，卻水草豐美舒適宜人，是日常生活裡輕易可得的⼀扇窗，於是，在幾經思考後，我們決定將悅徠館 JOYFULTEL，絕非尋常的全新旅宿體驗，結合圓融練達的高雅宅邸風(Sophisticated Residence Style)、專業而溫暖的尊榮禮遇，自即日起獻給懂得欣賞的您。

stays.descriptionEn: The Motel is fashionable, leisure, characteristic, high-tech, romantic, honorable and cares about privacy. Combining fashionable experience and architectural aesthetics, the Motel attracts guests with its meticulous care about each detail, upgrading the need for accommodation to sensual satisfaction and pursuit for taste. At the Motel, you will feel extremely loved. It provides luxurious services extravagantly. Designed by famous professional designers under the theme of a master room in a mansion, the Motel is devoted to establish a new leisure resort exclusively for modern metropolitans. With luxurious Samode Palace, leisurely Southeastern Asian ambience, elegant Zen’s bathing area, and fashionable Chanel, the guest seems to enter a colorful world of his (her) dream. 3-5 minutes away to Linkou Interchange, the Motel is conveniently near Taipei and Taoyuan, able to enjoy the convenience in both places perfectly.

stays.name: 福容大飯店 桃園機場捷運 A8
stays.nameEn: Fullon Hotel Taoyuan Airport Acess MRT A8
stays.description: 座落於機場捷運線A8長庚醫院站的「福容大飯店桃園機場捷運A8店」，與長庚醫學中心、國際轉運樞紐及環球購物中心共構，一踏出捷運出口，即可直接連接飯店大樓，從此處搭乘捷運，18分鐘可抵達機場，17分鐘到達台北，極具交通地利之便，是國際旅客、商務洽公最為便捷的住宿首選。總坪數約6000坪的A8店，擁有189間客房，6至10樓挑高3米客房樓層，配置智慧電視、無線Wi-Fi，符合旅客多元的商務需求。另外提供住客和VIP會員使用的貴賓交誼廳–The Space，沿用國際機場VIP休息室概念，免費供應鹹、甜口味的輕食點心、水果、咖啡、茶、果汁、汽水等各式飲料，另外還有小型會議室，包含公用電腦、網路、影印、掃描傳真功能俱全的商務中心。挑高七米無樑柱宴會廳，搭配270吋LED大屏幕及千萬環繞影音設備，為大桃園地區頂級婚宴場地首選。 港式飲茶餐廳「福粵樓」，手工港點，精緻美味。自創品牌「麗会所」，專業私人教練客製化健身指導，定期開設運動及瑜珈課程，舒緩身心。結合機場捷運、商場、餐廳、健身俱樂部與飯店共構複合式經營型態，為國際商務出差旅客住宿絕佳選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: “Fullon Hotel Taoyuan Airport MRT A8” is located beside Chang Gung Memorial Hospital Station of the Taoyuan Airport MRT. It is located near Chang Gung Medical Center, Taoyuan International Airport, and Global Mall. When you walk out of the MRT station, you can directly go to the hotel buildings. You can take the MRT here. It takes 18 minutes and 17 minutes to go to the Airport and Taipei by MRT respectively. Due to its convenient location, it is the best choice for international travelers and business travelers. With an area of 19,835 m2, it has 189 guest rooms. Those guest rooms on the 6th to 10th floors are 3 m high with intelligent TVs, L-shaped office area, Wi-Fi, and simple kitchens which can meet diverse business needs. In addition, it also has a lounge for its guests and VIP members–The Space. Inspired by the lounge in an international airport, it serves free sweet and salty snacks, fruit, coffee, tea, juice, and soda. Besides, there is a small meeting room with PCs. It is a versatile business center which provides Internet surfing, copying, scanning, and faxing services. The banquet hall is 7 m high and provides delicious dishes made by a chef. It is the best place to hold a wedding in Taoyuan. The “Fu Yue Lou Dim Sum” provides hand-made and delicious dim sum. Our brand “Lih Club” provides private coaches and regularly holds sports and yoga courses to relax yourself.It operates near the Airport MRT, shopping malls, restaurants, gyms, and hotels. It is the best choice for business travelers and free individual travelers.

stays.descriptionEn: Fullon Poshtel Linkou is located at the junction of in Linkou, New Taipei City, and Guishan, Taoyuan, close to the technology core in northern Taiwan -- HWA YA Technology Park and biotech and medical center -- Chang Gung Memorial Hospital, just 20 minutes from Taipei area, 25 minutes from Taoyuan International Airport, and convenient transportation routes, whether for business trip, city shopping, or sightseeing, can quickly reach. The best choice for business and technology personnel to have accommodation, catering, or meeting. We provide Chinese and Western food services, prepared by star-rated chef with exquisite craftsmanship, and an intimate dining space, offer you customized creative dishes blended with seasonal ingredients, which is in line with your pursuit of exquisite taste and your identity. We sincerely invite you to enter this rich and diverse gluttonous world. In 2012, the hotel was awarded 4-star rating by Taiwan Tourism Bureau. stays.description: 【關於鄭家莊的住宿】鄭家莊位於澎湖七美島正中央，是島內較具規模的閩式古建築聚落。自明朝末年由福建沿海移居至此，其宗族最有名氣的人物便是國姓爺鄭成功。歷經百年的鄭家莊建築群經過這幾年的逐步翻修更新，雖然抹去了一世紀刻劃的痕跡，但也為旅人提供更舒適的休息空間。坐臥在大廳或是圍牆邊角的陰影下，感受七美風的流動與呼嘯，傾聽耆老的生活美學，享受七美島的自然地景與鄭家人的歷史軌跡。【鄭家莊的房源】除了給您一個舒適的休息空間外，也期許能帶給您不同的七美體驗。房間是一張大雙人床（160x180）的獨立套房，並有冷氣，搭上簡約的室內設計風格。床組採用詩肯柚木床俱組佐硬獨立筒床墊。我們致力提供您有個舒適的睡眠。我們【不提供電視】，但音樂、WIFI隨手可得，為了讓您享受七美乾淨無暇的天空與寧靜的夜晚。
stays.descriptionEn: The room is a double room in Qimei (Chimei) island. It's a Penghu traditional style house. The room is a suite room with aircon. One queen size bed for 2 people. For your relax, the room without TV. Cheng Village has 300 years of history. You can discover the traditional house as well, reading books, talking with local friends, listening music, maybe take a walk around the village. Experience the life of Qimei island and enjoy it. Wish you love this small island.All books and music in the B&B house that you can use it. Public fridge and water dispenser are available outside the room. Please do not go inside the Non-reserved house without allowed.The Manager (Mr. Cheng) stay in the other house at Cheng village. If you like to know about the history of here or Qimei island, find him and talk with him. Buy the way, Chinese will be best.NO night life in Qimei island. Convenience store ( 7-11, Family mart) are near the main pier. There are several local restaurants that you can try it. Mack sure the opening time.【To Qimei island】There's a public ferry from Makung to Qimei at 0930AM everyday. You can buy the ferry ticket before departure. Search【Penghu government ferry】.Daily air have 2-3 flight service from Kaohsiung to Qimei everyday, and 1 flight service from Makung to Qimei everyday. Search【Dailyair】.【Island traffic】There's NO public transport in Qimei. Renting a motorbike (or scooter, bicycle) to visit this island is the best way. Please tell us if you like to.

stays.name: 嚎鯎饗住民宿
stays.description: 位在澎湖湖西鄉的【嚎鯎饗住民宿】，是一棟只有一層樓的溫馨平房，以簡約風格設計，打造出如家一般自在的空間。民宿擁有寬敞的公共區域，非常適合家庭出遊、三五好友相聚，一起慢下腳步、享受島嶼時光。為了讓包棟的旅客擁有完整的放鬆時光，我們提供KTV與電動麻將桌等娛樂設施（僅限包棟使用），讓每一晚都充滿歡笑與陪伴。清晨，還能品嚐主人親手準備的家常早餐，用在地食材開啟美好的一天。在這裡，你不只是旅人，更是我們的家人。嚎鯎饗住民宿，讓你在澎湖，有個像家的地方。
stays.descriptionEn: Nestled in the quiet countryside of Huxi Township, Penghu, Hao-Giang Stay is a one-story guesthouse designed with simplicity and comfort in mind. With its spacious common areas, it’s perfect for family vacations or gatherings with friends — a place to slow down and truly enjoy island life.For guests booking the entire house, we offer exclusive access to fun facilities like a KTV room and an automatic mahjong table, making evenings full of laughter and togetherness.In the morning, wake up to a warm, home-cooked breakfast made with local ingredients — the perfect start to your day.At Hao-Giang Stay, you’re more than just a traveler — you’re family.Come experience a home away from home in Penghu.

stays.name: 夏灩民宿(特色民宿)
stays.description: 澎湖｜夏灩．夏日裡的一方瀲灩越過一望無際的海藍，船隻停在澎湖馬公碼頭，遠離市區一路往北，從203縣道切至澎11鄉道，拉下車窗，藍天和白雲陪你一起迎接假期，然後你來到夏灩，一方連著潮間帶的陽光黃渡假之地，一方夏日裡解憂的樂土。療癒暖心的店狗與海潮走進這一抹濃艷的黃色建築中，主人Summer親切的笑容有如門外的夏日，店狗Boss叼著飛盤在你腳邊繞啊繞，帶著你繞過紅磚地板和實木桌椅，一腳踩進陽光普照、潮汐環抱的後院。Boss隨著飛盤在草皮上興奮地奔跑，一人一狗沐浴在海風裡相互追逐。過午之後的海水漸漸淹過石子滿了上來，Boss也跟著慵懶了起來。靠在面海的木椅上，面對海潮聲和海湧，感覺自己何其渺小，也何其幸運；一無所有，也擁有所有。夏灩的每個房間都有自己的名字，每個名字都透露著這個地方的小秘密。純淨海風房位於二樓，有著跟海風一樣的高度，外推的陽台可以看清楚退潮時石子上苔癬的生綠、滿潮時水藍色的海水；寧靜星空房有開闊的陽台，安靜的晚上不妨接受星辰的邀請走出房外，享受星光閃耀的夜空；蔚藍海域房坐擁一大片面海的落地窗，美麗的海景讓你直到太陽在海平面的那端透出絲絲微光，才捨得入睡。隔天早晨，循著香氣來到早餐面前，兩片烤得恰好的吐司擁抱著火腿和煎蛋，爽脆的生菜淋上濃郁的千島醬，咖啡香喚醒你的胃，簡單卻色香味美，開啟美好的早晨。
stays.descriptionEn: Penghu｜Summerya HouseA Place Overflowing With Sparkling Summer WatersCrossing the vast blue ocean, your boat anchors at Penghu island’s Magong Harbor. You set off along County Highway 203 for the distant city district in the north, eventually turning onto Township Road 11. Roll down the car window and let the blue sky and white clouds welcome you to the start of your journey. You arrive at Summerya House; a sunny-yellow vacation ground situated along the intertidal zone, where worries dissolve and summer cheer prevails.Inn dog and the tide: therapeutic and heartwarmingEntering the brilliant yellow building, the smile of your host Summer is as amiable as the summertime sun. Boss, the inn’s dog, circles your legs with a frisbee in his mouth, guiding you across the red-tile floor and by the solid wood table, after which you step into the sun-soaked backyard encircled by the tide. Boss runs excitedly across the lawn chasing the frisbee, you and he soaking in the ocean breeze as you chase each other around. In the sweltering afternoon, as the tide gradually rises, seawater covering the rocky seashore, Boss lazes around, too. As you sit in wooden chairs facing the ocean and listen to the burbling tide, you feel your own insignificance in the face of nature’s majesty. You also sense how fortunate you are; though you own nothing at all, at the same time, you have it all.Each room at Summerya has its own name, and each name reveals a little secret about this place. The Pure Sea Breeze room is located on the second floor and has ceilings just as lofty as the ocean winds. From the attached outdoor balcony, you have a clear view of the seaweed draped over the seaside rocks revealed by the receding tide, and the azure ocean waters at high tide. The Serene Starry Skies room also has a spacious balcony from which you might as well greet the evening stars, inviting you outside to take a stroll and enjoy the sparkling night sky. The Azure Seas room has an entire wall of floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the ocean. The beautiful ocean vista will keep you captivated all night until the first rays of the new day sun appear over the horizon. The following morning, follow your nose to the breakfast table where two slices of perfectly toasted bread with ham and eggs, a crispy salad with rich dressing, and a fragrant cup of coffee are waiting to wake up your belly. The simple yet rich flavors provide the perfect start to the day.Heartfelt regard for this piece of land, this stretch of seaRecalling the first time she saw the original piece of land where Summerya House now stands, extroverted and lively hostess Summer makes a silly face and exclaims, “It was practically in ruins!” Summer’s hometown is in the Lugu township of Nantou county. Having grown up in the mountain forests, Summer had a kind of inexpressible yearning for island life. At 17, she had saved up enough money from her part-time jobs to take a trip to Penghu, and it was that visit which left an indelible impression on her. From then on, she would seize any chance she got to go relax on Penghu island. After starting to date host Michael, Summer dragged him over to visit her beloved island. Little did she know that for Michael, Penghu would also be love at first sight! The moment he was able to wrap up the business at hand, he unhesitatingly decided to move to Penghu, the place that both he and Summer were longing for, to start a new life together and construct the beautiful Summerya House.After operating Summerya House for exactly ten years, another place that they both really liked came up for sale, the place where Oasis Hotel now sits. When asked why they wanted to create Oasis Hotel, Michael gave a mysterious answer, “Operating guesthouses is a path of no return; once you’ve begun, you end up investing all of your resources.” Perhaps it is precisely their sincere love of this land, their high self-demands, and the pull of destiny that conspired to establish them in the life that they now find themselves.Their backs to the azure ocean as they share with us their ideas about operating guesthouses, Summer and Michael laugh in unison when they get to the happy moments and listen attentively to each other when discussing the times things didn’t go as intended. Their seemingly very different personalities tacitly complement one another on account of their mutual love. In the same way, coming to Penghu from the distant main island of Taiwan, their love of the place has crystalized into the two guesthouses known as Summerya House and Oasis Hotel.Remembering the embrace of the ocean vista and the bustling journeySummerya House is like a benevolent friend who is always there to listen to your troubles and to share in your happiness. Sometimes there are layers of shape-shifting clouds, at others a vast, serene body of water. No matter if it’s early morning or late evening, no matter which season it may be, they always have a new and beautiful surprise for you. Coming to Summerya House, it’s best to bring your most sincere state of mind, and you are sure to forge a wonderful friendship!

stays.name: 夢砌民宿
stays.description: 夢砌民宿位於澎湖本島馬公機場附近，臨近隘門沙灘，且為本島僅有的森林海岸休閒沙灘。當您初次探訪夢砌您會愛上他的寧靜與清幽， 想體驗澎湖離島不同的假期，來到夢砌有如回到家的感覺，讓您感受到處處貼心與品味。夢砌的建築是藝術的打造， 我們們保留鄉土的風味完全沒有富麗的裝潢，且保有清爽舒適的空間，推薦您來到夢砌古典的鄉村，感受最輕鬆沒有壓力的空間，享受最悠閒的渡假。民宿私房行程：夜訪潮間帶(俗稱夜照)由民宿主人親自帶領前往潮間帶觀賞海洋生態，認識海洋生物之多樣性，如螃蟹、蝦子、魚，螺貝類、海參、海膽等等千奇百怪，有趣又好玩且充滿海洋知性之旅，適合各年齡層參加的活動，參加過的人都說讚唷！
stays.descriptionEn: Situated near Penghu’s Magong Airport, Mengqi Bed & Breakfast is close to Aimen Beach, the only forested recreational beach on the island. You’re sure to fall in love with Mengqi’s tranquility and peace from the moment you begin your exploration. A visit to Mengqi is like coming home, with a sense of comfort and consideration everywhere around.Mengqi Bed & Breakfast is itself a work of art, preserving the local architectural style without unnecessary embellishment. Instead, you can experience an atmosphere of comfort and calm; a visit here is the best way to shed the stresses of modern life and enjoy a little rural relaxation.A private itinerary: At night, visit the tidal belt with the owners of Mengqi to enjoy the environment there and learn about the diverse sea life that calls it home, a weird and wonderful assortment of crabs, shrimps, fish, shellfish, sea cucumbers, and sea urchins. It’s a fun activity for all ages that will expand your mind as well as entertain!

images.description: 木質的溫潤地板，典雅舒適的兩張歐風大床， 浪漫的金色簾幕，璀璨水晶燈流洩出晶瑩燈光， 沈浸在美麗的圖畫與歐式裝潢氛圍中...。 坐在窗邊沙發上、看電視、曬太陽， 走進明亮潔淨的超大浴室，泡在陽光灑落的浴缸， 誰說人間不能是天堂?
images.sourceLabel: 交通部觀光署旅宿網 / data.gov.tw dataset 7780
images.license: 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版

images.name: 喜悅天堂
images.description: 簡潔高雅的房間，木質的溫潤地板，典雅舒適的歐風大床，白色富造型感的兩張床頭櫃，和現代感的美麗檯燈，充滿花草的壁飾、壁畫與盆栽，讓人忘卻塵世煩憂，享受靜謐安詳的舒適感。
images.sourceLabel: 交通部觀光署旅宿網 / data.gov.tw dataset 7780
images.license: 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版

images.name: 快樂天堂
images.description: 走進「快樂天堂」，從挑高天花板、美麗藝術燈上流洩著的像是來自天堂的光亮。 寬敞的木頭地板，讓人不由自主地想在其上跳舞。 舒適柔軟的兩張大床，感覺一躺下就會進入甜蜜的夢鄉；燦爛的花朵，提醒我們天堂的繽紛璀璨。 歡迎來到這裡，讓身體與意識自由飛舞，輕鬆自然地進入快樂天堂。

stays.name: 歐船長民宿
stays.description: 歐船長民宿位在澎湖本島湖西鄉的一處小漁村, 沿著澎202或澎203縣道, 再接澎11鄉道, 進入沙港村土地公前社區就是我們所在位置! 民宿正前方就是澎湖傳統的小漁港, 清晨或是黃昏時刻, 散步在漁港看著日出或日落, 以及船隻進出漁港的瞬間, 有種遠離都市塵囂的放鬆! 在這裡新鮮的空氣, 寧靜的漁村生活絕對是釋放壓力的最好選擇! 我們所在的位置距離馬公市區約15-20分鐘車程, 距離機場約10分鐘車程! 喜歡放鬆度假的您不妨來住宿體驗喔!
stays.descriptionEn: Homestay located in Penghu!Captain Ou B&B is located in a small fishing village in Huxi Township, Penghu Island. Follow Penghu County Road 202 or Penghu County Road 203, then Penghu Township Road 11, and enter the Tudigongqian Community in Shagang Village to find our location! Right in front of the B&B is Penghu's traditional small fishing port. In the early morning or at dusk, take a walk in the fishing port to watch the sunrise or sunset, as well as the moment when the boats enter and leave the fishing port. It feels like a relaxation away from the hustle and bustle of the city! Here, the fresh air and quiet fishing village life are definitely the best choice to relieve stress! Our location is about 15-20 minutes drive from Magong City and about 10 minutes drive from the airport! If you like to relax on vacation, you may wish to come and experience it!

stays.name: 海被子民宿
stays.description: "海被子民宿" 是一家位於台灣澎湖的溫馨民宿，以其絕佳的地理位置和舒適的住宿環境聞名。每間房間都能欣賞到迷人的海景，讓旅客彷彿置身於海洋的懷抱中。民宿熱情歡迎前來澎湖參加花火節的遊客，提供一個放鬆身心、享受節慶氛圍的理想落腳處。無論是靜靜地欣賞窗外波光粼粼的海面，還是參與熱鬧的花火盛會，這裡都是您探索澎湖之美的完美起點。
stays.descriptionEn: "Sea Quilt B&B" is a cozy B&B located in Penghu, Taiwan, famous for its excellent location and comfortable accommodation. Each room offers a charming sea view, making travelers feel as if they are in the embrace of the ocean. The B&B warmly welcomes visitors who come to Penghu to attend the Fireworks Festival, providing an ideal place to relax and enjoy the festive atmosphere. Whether you are quietly admiring the sparkling sea outside the window or participating in the lively fireworks festival, this is the perfect starting point for you to explore the beauty of Penghu.

stays.name: 清靜民宿
stays.description: 清靜民宿位於澎湖馬公機場的隘門村75之5號。 從我們的頂樓可以眺望馬公機場，一方面可以欣賞飛機的 起降，在入夜後還可在頂樓欣賞澎湖無光害的夜空景致， 繁星點點，讓您對澎湖留下一個不一樣的印象與體驗。 對於喜歡沙灘戲水的朋友來說，隘門擁有全澎湖最長的白 色珊瑚碎屑的黃金沙灘，綿延三千多公尺的美麗海岸，就 像一條白色錦帶，包圍著湖西南面的海灘，相當壯觀。清 靜雅居(民宿)到隘門沙灘步行約10分鐘，騎車約3分鐘即可 到達，遠眺碧海藍天、海天一色，更襯托出黃金沙灘之柔 美。
stays.descriptionEn: Qing Jing Homestay is located at No.75-5, Aimen, Huxi Township, Penghu County. You can overlook Magong Airport from the rooftop of the Homestay. You can watch the take-off and landing of airplanes while watching the night sky of Penghu without light pollution from the rooftop. This starry night sky will give you a different impression of Penghu. For those who loves beaches: Aimen Beach is the longest beach with coral in Penghu. A beautiful coast which is more than 3 kmlong looks like white brocade surrounding the beach located southwest of the lake. It takes about 10 minutes from Qing Jing Homestay to walk to Aimen Beach or about 3 minutes to drive to this beach. You can see the blue sky and sea which sets off the beauty of this golden beach.

stays.name: 澎湖海水正藍民宿
stays.description: 海水正藍民宿比鄰潮間帶及成功水庫，濕地上四季不乏各式候鳥與留鳥覓食遨翔，海水正藍得地利之便，從窗子便可架起望遠鏡追尋候鳥芳蹤，成為喜愛大自然遊客絕佳投宿點。民宿庭院巧心造景，包括古意盎然的老水缸，澎湖漸漸失傳的牛車，迎風飛揚的風車，加上民宿旁就是道地澎湖古厝群，在在凸顯民宿營造的鄉居寫意。 民宿大廳牆壁上有鄰近國小老師協助彩繪的鮮豔壁畫，與成排桌椅供遊客用餐談天。頂樓的桌椅可於夜間上此乘涼看星子，太陽能熱水器兼具環保省電的功能。 套房分雙人及四人，亦提供包棟服務，房間內寢具以雪白底色為主，表現出高貴與潔淨的感覺，浴室則是乾濕分離的設計。住宿海水正藍民宿於交通上往返市區或北環、湖西都極為便利，民宿位於飛機起降航道附近，也可欣賞飛機俯衝而過。
stays.descriptionEn: Blue Lagoon Penghu B&B sits near the tidal belt and Chenggong Reservoir, and the wetlands are home to all kinds of migratory birds all year round. With its excellent location, Blue Lagoon’s windows are like observatories for the local bird life, making it a popular choice with nature lovers. The carefully landscaped environs include historical water vats, ox-carts (a sight gradually disappearing from modern Penghu), windmills spinning in the wind, and even a barbeque area. The authentic antique Penghu flavor of Blue Lagoon makes it stand out from the competition.The walls of the B&B are adorned with murals painted with the help of the neighborhood elementary school, and inside the lobby are tables and chairs lined up for the dining pleasure of the guests. Upstairs are chairs available for a cool night’s stargazing, and the solar water heater helps save energy and do our part for the environment. Two-person and four-person rooms are available, as well as the option to rent the entire building, and the bedding is themed around pure white, giving an air of class and cleanliness, while the bathrooms are divided into wet and dry sections. Blue Lagoon is also convenient to the city, as well as for getting to Beihuan and Huxi, and the planes taking off and landing nearby make for an amazing sight.

stays.searchText: 澎湖海水正藍民宿 澎湖海水正藍民宿 澎湖縣民宿072號 澎湖縣 湖西鄉 成功村8-7號 海水正藍民宿比鄰潮間帶及成功水庫，濕地上四季不乏各式候鳥與留鳥覓食遨翔，海水正藍得地利之便，從窗子便可架起望遠鏡追尋候鳥芳蹤，成為喜愛大自然遊客絕佳投宿點。民宿庭院巧心造景，包括古意盎然的老水缸，澎湖漸漸失傳的牛車，迎風飛揚的風車，加上民宿旁就是道地澎湖古厝群，在在凸顯民宿營造的鄉居寫意。 民宿大廳牆壁上有鄰近國小老師協助彩繪的鮮豔壁畫，與成排桌椅供遊客用餐談天。頂樓的桌椅可於夜間上此乘涼看星子，太陽能熱水器兼具環保省電的功能。 套房分雙人及四人，亦提供包棟服務，房間內寢具以雪白底色為主，表現出高貴與潔淨的感覺，浴室則是乾濕分離的設計。住宿海水正藍民宿於交通上往返市區或北環、湖西都極為便利，民宿位於飛機起降航道附近，也可欣賞飛機俯衝而過。

stays.description: 澎湖民宿「好朋友民宿」座落於整個澎湖縣的中心點，距離馬公市區只要8分鐘車程即可到達，距離澎湖各大景點也都很近(如白沙鄉跨海大橋、通樑古榕，湖西鄉奎壁山摩西分海、隘門沙灘，山水沙灘、風櫃動等等)，是一個地理位置極佳的住宿地點，另外住宿包含早餐以及每天都有提供額外的小點心，住宿的老闆一家也都十分親切，有什麼需要都可以跟我們說，我們會盡力的協助旅客處理～每一間套房都有獨立衛浴，除了2樓海洋團體房以及1樓鄉村房沒有陽台之外，其餘3樓花園雙人房以及2樓星月四人房皆有陽台哦～另外本館全面禁菸，若是有菸癮的房客再麻煩到外面抽菸，謝謝您！
stays.descriptionEn: Penghu B&B "Good Friends B&B" is located in the center of Penghu County, only 8 minutes' drive from Magong City, and close to major attractions in Penghu (such as the Baisha Township Cross-Sea Bridge, Tongliang Ancient Banyan, Huxi Township Kuibi Mountain Moses Sea, Aimen Beach, Shanshui Beach, Fengguidong, etc.), it is an accommodation with an excellent geographical location. In addition, the accommodation includes breakfast and extra snacks every day. The owner of the accommodation is also very kind. You can tell us if you need anything, and we will do our best to assist the tourists~ Each suite has an independent bathroom. Except for the Ocean Group Room on the 2nd floor and the Countryside Room on the 1st floor, there is no balcony. The other 3rd floor Garden Double Room and the 2nd floor Star Moon Quadruple Room all have balconies~ In addition, this hotel is completely non-smoking. If you are addicted to smoking, please go outside to smoke. Thank you!

stays.name: 龍門舊舍民宿
stays.description: 民宿網址:http://www.longmenhouse.com.tw龍門舊舍民宿是將一棟民國13 年所蓋的澎湖閩式建築三合院陳家古厝，翻修而成的民宿，最主要是希望讓遊客體驗澎湖漁村古厝之美，讓心情放鬆渡個好假期的地方。來到龍門舊舍，轉動牛車輪做的大門，首先看到費心鋪上的澎湖全島地圖，接下來敲敲漆木大門，腳下的紅色地磚，中庭兩側的囍窗，大廳裡放置竹椅及阿嬤紅木床，彷彿讓你走入時光隧道。民宿戶外涼亭，是陳老爸用他雙手一點一滴的完成，耗時四個月的戶外涼亭及漂流木花園，還有近年才完工的澎湖船懶人亭，讓人悠由自在的坐在幸福搖搖椅，搖丫搖，或是躺在澎湖船懶人亭上，享受夜晚星光燦爛，還有人生最棒的美食享宴，就是在涼庭下，享用澎湖最鮮美的海鮮BBQ，一口小管，一口清涼飲品，開心的歡樂著，攸閒地渡過美妙的澎湖夜晚。另外您也可以坐在古厝三合院的二樓平台上，抬頭仰望著滿天星星，海風徐來，喝口熱茶或咖啡，在這寧靜的夜裡，可以忘卻許多的煩惱及苦悶！歡迎您來澎湖龍門舊舍民宿做客。
stays.descriptionEn: Longmen House Bed & Breakfast was built for the Chen family in 1924 in the traditional Hokkien sanheyuan style, which incorporates three structures around a courtyard, and has been converted into a bed & breakfast in the hopes of sharing the beauty of Penghu’s traditional fishing-village style. When you first turn the oxcart-wheel door and enter Longmen House Bed & Breakfast, you’ll be met with a carefully crafted tiled map of Penghu. Then, after knocking on the stained wooden door, you’ll set foot on a red-tile floor and enter the central courtyard, flanked by traditional tiled windows and equipped with bamboo chairs and redwood bed, like a trip backward in time. The outdoor pavilion was hand-built by Mr. Chen from driftwood over the course of four months, and sits near another recently completed “Penghu boat” pavilion which is perfect for lying down in and enjoy the starry nights. One of life’s great pleasures is dining in these cool pavilions, enjoying a fresh Penghu seafood barbeque under the beautiful nighttime skies. Or you could sit in one of the second-floor balconies, looking out across the starry night sky and enjoying the sea breeze as you sip on a cup of coffee or tea. During these tranquil nights, troubles and stress just seem to melt away. Come visit us at Longmen House! Website: http://www.longmenhouse.com.tw

stays.name: 候鳥潮間帶民宿
stays.description: 澎湖｜候鳥潮間帶．候鳥歸巢，海天一色的原始海鄉傍晚順著美麗夕陽的指引，彎進白沙鄉城前小村，路的盡頭無縫接著前方的澎湖內海，就在打開車門的剎那，視線還沒準備好接受眼前遼闊無際的景色，遼闊的海洋味道就先撲進鼻中，而候鳥潮間帶，就獨立在這片海天一色之間，與海只有不到20公尺的距離，像一個歡迎你們這群都市候鳥回到原始大自然的海邊老家。棲息於潮間帶的白色候鳥不規則的建築，在夏日南風中，宛如一隻即將鼓翅的白色候鳥，屋前那片黃亮沙灘與延展開來的海景，獨攬碼頭與潮間帶的美景；而眼前的景色與生態隨著海水進退與天光，構成一幅具有充沛生命力的無價畫作，片刻都是不同的動人美景。除了坐擁了前方潮間帶以外，候鳥潮間帶的名字源自於民宿主人美滿姊與楊大哥都是愛鳥人士，身為澎湖野鳥學會會員的她們，熱衷於澎湖大小鳥事；也期待每個都市裡的旅人都能像候鳥歸巢般，定期回到這裡，享受完整的大自然和這個海邊的老家。用心感受最簡單的幸福「我們家沒什麼特色，這裡什麼都沒有；但就是用心感受。」美滿姊說，候鳥潮間帶沒有華美的裝潢，沒有繁複的設計，回歸原始的自然幸福就來自於簡單的「感受」二字。敞開胸懷用心感受吧！把平時在城市堆積心上的灰塵抖散，將心與眼通通打開，候鳥潮間帶讓你擁有新的感官與心胸，以更加細膩的姿態感受美好的大自然：也許是早晨迎接海面日出的到來，也許是打開窗戶享受海風輕拂的幸福感，也許是看到店狗阿new衝向海中玩耍的興奮，也許是仰望滿天星空的浪漫，又也許是早餐第一次吃到鍾記燒餅的滿足，在這總能找到太多感動的時刻，讓人重新補充快樂的能量。
stays.descriptionEn: Penghu｜Migrant Intertidal GuesthouseMigratory Birds Return to Roost in their Primitive Ocean HometownYou turn into a small village before Baisha township and the road leads seamlessly straight up to the inner Penghu ocean. As for the migratory bird intertidal zone, it is unique to this ocean area and is less than 20 meters from the hostel. Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse welcomes you city birds to return to your primitive, natural seaside home.White migratory birds perched in the intertidal zoneThe irregular design of the building, like a white migratory bird preparing to take flight, is caressed by the southern summer winds. The bright, yellow beach and expansive ocean scenery in front of the guesthouse, the independent docks and the beautiful vistas of the intertidal zone; all of these ecological landscapes before your eyes fluctuate with the ebb and flow of the tide and the come and go of daylight. These elements combine into a veritable painting of priceless abundant vitality wherein, each moment, a new and moving vista appears.Besides embracing the intertidal zone along the shore in front of the guesthouse, the name of Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse originates from hosts Amy and Ken’s love of birds. They are both members of the Penghu Wild Birds Association and are passionate about everything relating to birds on the island. They also look forward to helping all their city-dwelling guests to feel as if they are returning to roost, to invite them to come back regularly to enjoy the intact natural ecosystem as well as their own oceanside home.Earnest perception of the simplest blessings and happiness “There is really nothing special about our home, as there’s nothing of note in this area. All we have is our earnest perception and appreciation.” In the words of Amy, Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse doesn’t have any ornate decorations or elaborate designs, but is rather a return to primitive natural happiness, all of which is made possible by one’s willingness to “perceive”.Open your mind and strive to perceive, then! Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse will help you open your senses and your mind, and to cultivate an even more attentive attitude toward experiencing nature. Perhaps it will happen in the morning, when welcoming the sunrise over the ocean, or perhaps when observing the A-New, the guesthouse dog, running down to the ocean to frolic excitedly in the water. Or perhaps it will come to you in the morning over breakfast when you experience the taste of Zhongji baked sesame seed-coated cakes for the first time. In any case, you’ll experience so many moving moments in this place. Nighttime exploration of intertidal pools!Yet the most unforgettable experience on offer at Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse is surely exploring the intertidal pools in the pitch-black darkness of night. Follow Ken on a magnificent intertidal nighttime adventure! Holding your flashlight, you put on shorts and sandals and, stepping over the vines on the beach, you enter the knee-high tidal pool. You catch sight of bright, silver clove fish as their slender bodies dart to and fro beneath the surface. They bump into your legs as you pass through and, before you have time to get used to this clove fish encounter, to your delighted surprise, Ken picks up a plump, round blowfish, spines protruding at all angles. If you make the trip to Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse, you simply cannot pass up the opportunity to go out with Ken to explore the abundant ecological wonders of the intertidal pools. It will be a meeting with nature that you won’t soon forget!It’s hard to imagine that, after leaving the intertidal pools and returning to the guesthouse, yet another surprise awaits: a bowl full of a summer-season delicacy - fresh oysters! You use tongs to hold the shells of the oysters while you remove the rich milky flesh. No matter how much you eat, you never get tired of these oysters, especially when washed down with a cup of draft beer. How delightful!Life is simple at Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse, yet the experience is rich and plentiful. For city-dwelling travelers who are weary of the bustle of everyday life, it is a true blessing to return to such a place, like migratory birds returning to roost each year. After visiting such a place, with spirits revitalized, you can set off to achieve your next big goal.

stays.name: 喔哈娜民宿
stays.description: 喔哈娜(Ohana)～這是夏威夷語『家人』的意思；我們特別以此為名，象徵著賓至如歸的溫馨體驗～希望每位顧客都能把這裡當成自己的家一般放鬆，也闡述著我們將顧客當成家人看待的熱情招呼和溫情理念。 「澎湖民宿‧喔哈娜民宿」座落於白沙鄉講美村，前往北環路線的中間地帶，鄰近中屯風車、水族館、岐頭旅客中心及北海旅客中心。更是前往跨海大橋、鯨魚洞、二崁聚落及西嶼等景點的必經之路，讓想選擇遠離都市塵囂的你寧靜放鬆最佳住宿。現代化的外觀，以石砌外牆和玻璃圍牆展現大方時尚的輝煌氣度；大廳採用落地式的玻璃帷幕，不但成功引入戶外光線，增添室內採光，更提昇了雅致的尊榮氣息。 寬敞、明亮的客房空間運用了各式各樣的牆面色彩和壁紙花樣為造景，結合精巧別緻的裝潢設計，打造出別具特色的私有領域，每一位旅客都可以完全自在的放鬆休息，深刻感受澎湖菊島的熱情魅力。

stays.description: 在我的民宿告知裡，已告訴大家我的民宿很簡單，沒有頂級家俱裝璜，沒有電視等豪華配備，更沒有專業服務。那你會疑問？我的民宿值得賣什麼？我現在告訴你我賣什麼？我賣澎湖的一角視窗給你。很久沒到過嵵裡了，每想到嵵裡就想要哭出來。小時候嵵裡的馬路旁緊鄰著黃金沙灘，整個海天接鄰，沙灘上停著漁作的舢舨，站在海灘上就像迪斯尼卡通消失的帝國中所說的【它是它的一部份，它也是它的一部份】一個無分別的融合的空間。而現在，巨大的海堤、超重的消波塊吞噬了整個海岸，壓碎了童年的回憶，封閉了與自然的對話，成了消失的海岸。現在從屋內的玻璃望去，看著潮水的漲退，海面變化萬千的光影，好久沒有這種感覺了。來看房子的人都會誇說我的眼好，怎麼會找到這麼好的地方？講到這裏，就會勾起我的心痛。我再一次傷心的告訴你，澎湖比這裏美的地方及海岸太多了，可是我們卻做了什麼？任憑著水泥大肆的進住，週邊生態美景漠視的被破壞，如果在這裏會讓你有些心動的話，請多再愛一下大家身邊的土地。所以我常常自嘲的說：『整個澎湖的破瓌越大，我這裏的價值就越高』。城前，一個小小的村落。還好鄉村小，經費爭取不易，所以鮮少的破壞工程在這裏出現，目前仍保有自然的部份海岸線及內海潮間帶的豐富生態，可以眺望對面繁華的馬公市、曲折的西嶼島嶼及內海的明珠－大倉，白日的海天一色及夜晚的星夜爭輝，一個原始的澎湖海景一角原版的呈現給你，希望你會喜歡。
stays.descriptionEn: In the announcement, I've told everyone that the B&B is simple and unadorned. There is no high class furniture and decoration, no luxurious facilities and no professional services. You may have questions. What does the selling point of my B&B? I will tell you the answer. I sell the scenery of Penghu to you. I had not been to Shili in a long while. Every time when I thought of it, I would burst into tears. When I was a kid, the road of Shili was next to the beach, and the sea and the sky were of one hue. The fishing sampans were hauled on the beach, and I stood on the beach, feeling that it was a merging space, like what it said in the Disney cartoon Atlantis: The Lost Empire, "It is part of it, while it is also a part of it." But now, the huge sea walls and overweight tetrapods have occupied the coast, crushed the memory of childhood and broken off the dialogue with nature. The coast is disappearing. Now, I look at the tide water rising and ebbing and the shadow changing on the sea surface from the glass window in the house, and I haven't done this for a long time. The people who visit here always praise that I am clear-eyed. What chance would it be for me to find such a nice place? When it comes to this question, I feel distressed about it. Sadly, I have to tell you that there were other places and coasts more beautiful than here in Penghu. But what have we done to the beautiful islands? People keep constructing buildings and ignore the destruction of ecological environment. If you feel touched when staying here, please love the land you live on. So I often sell my B&B with the sad irony of, "the more destruction in Penghu, the higher the value of my place." Chengqian, a small village. Thanks to being small and without large budgets, few destructing construction appears in Chengqian, which forms part of the natural coastline and the rich ecology of an intertidal zone. You can see prosperous Magong City on the other side, the tortuous islands of Xiyu Township and the precious location of the inner sea, Dacang village. The blue sea and sky of the day and the glittering stars of the night present the original sea viewing of Penghu. We hope you will like it.

stays.name: 愛麗詩民宿
stays.description: Iris 是梵谷筆下浪漫的名畫－紫蝶鳶尾花 。 Iris 是希臘神話中的彩虹女神，他往來於天地宇宙間， 能關閉天地間的暴風之門，爲人間帶來安寧； 她是眾神與凡間的使者，這愛的使者美麗而絢爛， 不論是飛鳥動物或是蜜蜂昆蟲都愛戀著她， 流水都要停下來欣賞她，她寓意著『愛』與『彩虹』。 Iris 是聖經裡的光明之花、彩虹之花，他給人間帶來光明與平安、 希望與愛。 Iris 是名牌服飾、是精油保養品， Iris 是高貴的象徵、是美麗的代名詞， Iris 是我的英文名字。 嘲笑自己的膚淺就像自己從不明白Iris在生命中的意義， Iris只是巧遇外國遊客才會提起的一句話， 然而，這偶爾被惦記的名字，一夕間神聖了起來， 只因為，我的夢土，眾裡尋她千百度，那樣的桃花源， 在神的安排下，我感恩能創造出這塊唯美的度假聖地， 我深深的愛上Iris，我無法形容她的美好， 只能說在上帝的寵愛裡，遇見Iris我是幸福的，我是感恩的， 然而，我願意將上帝的恩典分享與你，榮耀你， 如果，你見過Iris，你將一見鍾情， 如果，你住過Iris，相信你也將深深的愛上她，戀著她， 在此，願將我的Iris分享給有緣的朋友。
stays.descriptionEn: Iris could be the famous painting of Vincent Van Gogh. In Greek mythology, Iris could be the goddess of rainbow. She travels between the sky and the land as well as the universe, and can close the door of storm to bring peace for human beings. She is the messenger of gods and mortals. This messenger of love is beautiful and glamorous, and all creatures are fond of her. She represents “love” and “rainbow.” In Bible, Iris could be the flower of rainbow, bringing light and safety, hope and love to the mortals. Iris could be a brand of clothes, and the flavor of essential oil. Iris represents nobility and beauty. Iris is my name. I did not know the meaning of “Iris” in my life; it is only a name when I introduce myself to foreign tourists. However, the name suddenly becomes sacred (for me), since I have searched for dreamland for a long time, and it is just by my side. It is God’s will that I am appreciative of creating such a beautiful and perfect place. I love Iris deeply, but I don’t know how to describe how perfect she is. All I can say is, being with her, I feel happy and thankful. I would love to share this grace of God with you. If you’ve seen Iris, you will fall in love with her; if you’ve visit Iris, you will love her deeply as I do. My friends, welcome to Iris Homestay!

stays.searchText: 愛麗詩民宿 愛麗詩民宿 澎湖縣民宿350號 澎湖縣 白沙鄉 港子村1鄰港子20之5號 Iris 是梵谷筆下浪漫的名畫－紫蝶鳶尾花 。 Iris 是希臘神話中的彩虹女神，他往來於天地宇宙間， 能關閉天地間的暴風之門，爲人間帶來安寧； 她是眾神與凡間的使者，這愛的使者美麗而絢爛， 不論是飛鳥動物或是蜜蜂昆蟲都愛戀著她， 流水都要停下來欣賞她，她寓意著『愛』與『彩虹』。 Iris 是聖經裡的光明之花、彩虹之花，他給人間帶來光明與平安、 希望與愛。 Iris 是名牌服飾、是精油保養品， Iris 是高貴的象徵、是美麗的代名詞， Iris 是我的英文名字。 嘲笑自己的膚淺就像自己從不明白Iris在生命中的意義， Iris只是巧遇外國遊客才會提起的一句話， 然而，這偶爾被惦記的名字，一夕間神聖了起來， 只因為，我的夢土，眾裡尋她千百度，那樣的桃花源， 在神的安排下，我感恩能創造出這塊唯美的度假聖地， 我深深的愛上Iris，我無法形容她的美好， 只能說在上帝的寵愛裡，遇見Iris我是幸福的，我是感恩的， 然而，我願意將上帝的恩典分享與你，榮耀你， 如果，你見過Iris，你將一見鍾情， 如果，你住過Iris，相信你也將深深的愛上她，戀著她， 在此，願將我的Iris分享給有緣的朋友。

stays.description: 漁鄉魚香民宿位於白沙鄉港子村，站在40坪的陽台上看到360度的美麗海景，卻可將附近無人島的風采盡收眼底。早晨黃昏到鎮海灣散步，享受寧靜、休閒，海景變化萬千；也可以到港子和岐頭海域觀賞招潮蟹和紅樹林，甚至退潮時還可走到潮間帶撿螺貝抓螃蟹等活動。 民宿房間內乾淨、簡單，詩肯柚木的床組，讓您到澎湖來聞到海洋的氣味，也聞著木頭香味入眠。 如果暫時哪兒都不想去，坐在庭院，悠哉一邊品賞咖啡茶飲、一邊欣賞花草樹木、一邊看著自己喜歡的書，既放鬆又舒適的渡過悠閒時光也是不錯的選擇。 歡迎來到漁鄉魚香來體驗。

stays.description: 「草根民宿」的經營理念，是保留建物初建的原貌與裝修設計格調，僅室內老舊衛浴、窗台及傢俱汰換，是無法與後期新建民宿相比較，主要為營造一個乾淨、舒適的居住環境，與保有在地人情味及提倡維持「民宿」的本質經營，所以內部的擺設亦留前屋主的華麗貴氣，在價格的訂定上，為大眾消費可接受的範圍。
stays.descriptionEn: The business philosophy of "Caogen Homestay" is to retain the appearance and decorations of the original building. The facitiles which were replaced only include the old bathrooms, windows, and furniture which are inferior to those used in the newly built buildings. The main purpose is to create a clean and comfortable environment while retaining the local appearance and advocating the concept of "homestay." Therefore, we retain the glorious layout of the previous owner and provide affordable prices.
