stays.name: 鎮海灣休閒民宿
stays.description: ｢澎湖‧白沙‧鎮海｣白沙鄉鎮海村，位於馬公市郊，是個擁有豐富海洋生態又遠離塵囂的小村落，她的寧靜樸實，足以慰藉許多來自城市人們的心靈。目前村內仍然留有許多澎湖閩式傳統建築及純樸的可愛住民，社區街道簡潔工整，周邊環境保留了小鎮既有的風味，清新自然。踏入鎮海灣民宿之際，匠心獨具的空間規劃，推開大門就有讓人耳目一新的感受，與旅客親切的交談及舒適簡潔的房間，更是讓人有種回到自己家中的安全舒適感。隨時想與海水親近，離民宿不遠處的鎮海沙灘便可輕易地一償宿願，漲潮時是海灣裡的沙灘是相對安全的戲水海域，在此可參加民宿舉辦的SUP划槳競速活動，與來自世界各地的朋友挑戰記錄。潮水退去時，大片裸露的潮間帶，可以撿拾蝦蟹螺貝，遼闊的視野，亦可從此處遠眺一旁的澎湖水族館及員貝嶼等東北海諸島，而入夜後更是精彩萬分，蝦、蟹紛紛從沙石中竄出，參加最道地的"抱礅"活動，在星空下近距離地與海洋生物接觸，是非常適合全家人享受悠閒時光的完美地點。
stays.descriptionEn: "Penghu – Baisha - Chenhai" Chenhai Village, Baisha Township is located in the suburb of Magong. It is a small village with an abundant marine ecosystem and is far away from the city. Its tranquility and simplicity comfort many urban residents. Currently many Fukienese traditional houses still remain in the village, inhabited by simple villagers. The streets in the community are designed in a concise and neat manner and the ambient areas are also conserving fresh and nature touch pertaining to this smaller village. When you open the door and set the foot in “ChenHai Bay”, you will be instantly impressed by the unique design. Intimate conversation with the visitors and clean-cut comfort rooms, it gives a home-like secureness and coziness. You can easily get near to the sea on the Tsen Hai Beach not far away from the B&B. During high tide, the beach here is also an absolutely safe water activity ground. You can also participate in the SUP paddling races held by the B&B, competing with foreign friends hailing from every corner of the world. When the tide recedes, you may gather prawns, crab and shells in the vast exposed inter-tidal zone while looking over the Penghu Maritime Museum and northern islands around Yuan Bei Island. During the night, the beach is also teeming with life as prawns and crab emerge from the sand. You may take part in the “Bao Tung” fishing activity and experience the marine life in close distance under the twinkling stars. It is really a perfect location for the family to spend some leisurely days.

stays.name: 香榭民宿
stays.description: 吉貝嶼─這座因坐擁綿延沙嘴而美麗的沙灘之島，黃色的沙灘綿延數千公尺,是世界難得一見的沙嘴地形,來到這裡旅行最好的方式不是走馬看花，而是該放慢腳步與心情旅宿於此，好好感受屬於這座島嶼的萬千風情。來到吉貝旅宿，您可以擁有更精緻而舒適的住宿服務！全新落成的吉貝香榭民宿，坐落於吉貝嶼的黃金地段，最熱鬧的市集、吉貝沙嘴便在鄰近，散個步就可以到達，生活機能十分便利。擁有全澎湖唯一的石滬執照，是我們的私房景點，讓來到香榭民宿的遊客更多一份驚喜；頂級的民宿設施、和善親切的民宿主人，將為您的小島假期留下更浪漫而深刻的旅行回憶～吉貝的夜晚有著不ㄧ樣的寧靜，望著星空，遠離塵囂，聽著海浪聲入眠，是來到吉貝最大的享受．．
stays.descriptionEn: Jibei Island--This is a beautiful sandy islet because it embraces a hooked spit with a beach of yellow sand stretching thousands of meters long, one of the world's rare spit terrain. The best way to enjoy your trip here is not to take a superficial, cursory observation, but to slow down the steps and collect your mood here to better feel the islet's thousand amorous feelings. Came to Gibay Sunshine, you'll have a more refined and comfortable accommodation!The newly completed Gibay Sunshine is located in a prime location of Jibei Island, near the most lively bazaar and neighboring Jibei Spit, and convenient life functions are all just within a walking distance. We have Penghu's only license of operating stone tidal weirs, which is one of our privately owned attractions to offer visitors staying Gibay Sunshine a surprise. Top-rated B&B facilities and gracious innkeepers will give you a romantic, profound memory of island vacation you'd leave. The nights falling on Gibei Island inherit different kind of tranquility. Staring at the sky, staying far away from the madding crowd, and listening to the sound of the sea waves to fall asleep, are the greatest enjoyments here on Jibei Island.

stays.name: 夢田民宿
stays.description: 赤馬村是個遺落在繁華之外的小漁村，有紅瓦老厝石頭牆和超凡脫俗的絕美沙灘，地處澎湖縣西嶼鄉。 自從海洋資源枯竭傳統漁業式微，年輕人不再延續父執輩代代相傳的謀生方式，紛紛出走都市另闢活路，人口逐年外流，小舢舨寂寞的被擱置在沙丘上任憑風吹日曬，捕魚的網子如今用來圍養家禽，整個村子一下子冷清了起來。古樸的閩南式宅院終年門扉緊閉，斑剝的牆壁爬上翠綠的青苔，軟枝黃蟬從石頭窗花攀爬而出，彷彿宣告主人已多年未歸。厝邊空地上日治時期引進當薪材的銀合歡久無人砍伐，也已盤據出一股頑強氣勢宛如密林，更有甚者堂堂在頹圯的屋宇中落地生根佔地為王。海邊一座幾乎被海沙掩埋的碉堡，述說著這裡也曾經是海防重地的陳年往事，一旁黝黑冷硬被沖刷成圓滑的玄武岩石塊則不發一語，將歲月的故事全吞進腹中。這個村子的昔日比今天繁榮，未來將何去何從？卻無人知曉。 起初出外的子弟仍惦記著家中父老，隔三差五總要回來轉轉，也有打算退休後搬回定居的，後來家鄉父老相繼辭世返鄉的頻率逐年拉長，有一天子弟在外地也垂垂老去，這條與故鄉相連的臍帶就斷了，年輕人習慣了都市生活慢慢就不回來了，這裡的祖厝等不到翻修也不支倒塌，斷簷殘壁可以抵擋強勁的東北季風常常被鄰人整闢利用來種菜，種出甜美的高麗菜、紅蘿蔔、花生、玉米寄給出外子弟療癒了鄉愁。 夢田民宿主人阿貴是憑著記憶回來尋找先人足跡的，因為不忍祖先的胼手胝足消失於無形、不忍美麗的故鄉黯然蕭條，以他擅長的藝術元素與懷舊典藏，用現代的住宿環境，介紹鄉下的生活趣味，建起一座橋樑希望引來都會人來這裡看看，或許可以引來多一點關注給故鄉一點機會。

stays.searchText: 夢田民宿 夢田民宿 澎湖縣民宿211號 澎湖縣 西嶼鄉 赤馬村緝馬灣30號 赤馬村是個遺落在繁華之外的小漁村，有紅瓦老厝石頭牆和超凡脫俗的絕美沙灘，地處澎湖縣西嶼鄉。 自從海洋資源枯竭傳統漁業式微，年輕人不再延續父執輩代代相傳的謀生方式，紛紛出走都市另闢活路，人口逐年外流，小舢舨寂寞的被擱置在沙丘上任憑風吹日曬，捕魚的網子如今用來圍養家禽，整個村子一下子冷清了起來。古樸的閩南式宅院終年門扉緊閉，斑剝的牆壁爬上翠綠的青苔，軟枝黃蟬從石頭窗花攀爬而出，彷彿宣告主人已多年未歸。厝邊空地上日治時期引進當薪材的銀合歡久無人砍伐，也已盤據出一股頑強氣勢宛如密林，更有甚者堂堂在頹圯的屋宇中落地生根佔地為王。海邊一座幾乎被海沙掩埋的碉堡，述說著這裡也曾經是海防重地的陳年往事，一旁黝黑冷硬被沖刷成圓滑的玄武岩石塊則不發一語，將歲月的故事全吞進腹中。這個村子的昔日比今天繁榮，未來將何去何從？卻無人知曉。 起初出外的子弟仍惦記著家中父老，隔三差五總要回來轉轉，也有打算退休後搬回定居的，後來家鄉父老相繼辭世返鄉的頻率逐年拉長，有一天子弟在外地也垂垂老去，這條與故鄉相連的臍帶就斷了，年輕人習慣了都市生活慢慢就不回來了，這裡的祖厝等不到翻修也不支倒塌，斷簷殘壁可以抵擋強勁的東北季風常常被鄰人整闢利用來種菜，種出甜美的高麗菜、紅蘿蔔、花生、玉米寄給出外子弟療癒了鄉愁。 夢田民宿主人阿貴是憑著記憶回來尋找先人足跡的，因為不忍祖先的胼手胝足消失於無形、不忍美麗的故鄉黯然蕭條，以他擅長的藝術元素與懷舊典藏，用現代的住宿環境，介紹鄉下的生活趣味，建起一座橋樑希望引來都會人來這裡看看，或許可以引來多一點關注給故鄉一點機會。

stays.name: 歐瓃渡假屋民宿
stays.description: "OLÉ Villa 位在橫礁濱海路上，地址西嶼鄉合界頭1-28號，擁有超級美麗的海景。女主人在合界村長大，對澎湖的海有深厚的感情，也是兩屆全國運動會風浪板冠軍。大學畢業後，出國留學工作，嫁給美國人，一直無法忘記在合界長大的生活點滴。有機會回到故鄉蓋房子，分享這裏的美好給大家。"OLÉ 起源 Olé 是西班牙語感嘆詞，用於歡呼或讚揚表演，尤其與鬥牛和弗朗明哥表演的觀眾有關。在鬥牛比賽中，每當鬥牛士避免被公牛擊中時，人們就會大聲喊出這句感嘆詞。 常用於慶典、節慶，表達喜悅與感激。（用作表示贊同、好極了或鼓勵的呼喊。）也是鼓勵的感嘆詞，常聽於體育比賽、音樂會或任何其他的競技場。後來，這種說法被引入運動，主要是足球，當球員成功運球過掉對手時就會大喊這句話。OLÉ Villa 共兩層樓高，100 坪室內空間及150坪室外面海大前廊＋150 坪後庭院（加工中）。歐美式開放廚房，200公分長的中島吧，不想外食可放心大展廚藝。（大同電鍋，洗碗機，快煮壺，烤箱，微波爐，麵包機，中島吧過濾飲用水，Espreso濃縮膠囊咖啡機，個式煮具與餐具）。唱歌設備，麻將桌，頂級ToTo衛浴，洗衣機，紅酒小吧台。

stays.description: 見見灣海景民宿欲邀請您，登上五孔頂分享澎湖的夜景及滿天的星星！享受赤馬漁港〝夜釣〞與拜訪〝潮間帶〞的樂趣！拜訪北環風景區沿線美麗的漁翁島，濱海公路、二崁古厝、玄武岩柱、牛心山、東台古堡、內垵沙灘....透過落地窗觀賞對岸觀音亭美麗的澎湖花火！
stays.descriptionEn: Jian Jian Wan Homestay invites you to climb up Wukongding to share the night scenery and the stars of Penghu at night! Enjoy the fun of ”night fishing” at Chima Harbor and visiting the “tidal zone”! Visit the beautiful Yuwong Island along the way of Beihuan Scenic Area, as well as the coastal highway, Erkan Old House, the basalt columns, Niousinshan, Dongtai Fort and Neian Beach…etc., you may also admire the beautiful Penghu fireworks at Guanyin Pavilion on the opposite side of the bank!

stays.name: 三和院民宿
stays.description: 三和院創立初衷在澎湖這片靜謐純粹的海島上,三和院誕生於對「和諧、安定、歸屬感」的追求。「三和」代表著人與自然的和諧、旅人與土地的和諧、身心靈的和諧,我們希望每位來到這裡的旅人,不只是短暫停留,而是能夠感受到家的溫度,讓心靈找到安放的地方。不論你是來自都市的旅人,還是探索島嶼的探險家,三和院都願意成為你心靈的棲息地。
stays.descriptionEn: The original intention of the establishment of SanheyuanOn the peaceful and pure island of Penghu, Sanheyuan was born out of the pursuit of "harmony, stability, and a sense of belonging.""Sanhe" represents the harmony between man and nature, the harmony between travelers and the land, and the harmony between body, mind and spirit.We hope that every traveler who comes here will not only stay for a short time, but also feel the warmth of home.Let your soul find a place to rest.Whether you are a traveler from the city or an explorer exploring the island,Sanheyuan is willing to become the habitat of your soul.

stays.nameEn: Lai Wan Zhu Wo Jia Homestay
stays.description: 民宿雖離市區有點距離，卻能夠遠離吵囂的城市氣息，出來玩就是要快樂，要快樂就是要放輕鬆。短短的距離，能讓你多呼吸些澎湖清新的空氣，出來玩就是要放慢腳步。鄰近山水沙灘，是您黃昏或者夜晚去散心的好去處呢!或水或者踩著滿腳砂完，不用擔心回家麻煩，因為民宿就在附近。民宿對面就是7-11，讓你再晚都有東西吃，對面就是警察局，讓你的渡價有安全保障，旁邊也有郵局，提款機相當便利呢!
stays.descriptionEn: While this Bed & Breakfast may be a little far from the city, that makes it the perfect place to escape the rat race. Breathe deep of the fresh Penghu air and take a stroll along neighboring Shanshui Beach, a great place to take in the dusk and the nighttime skies. Or maybe get in the water and have some fun without the hassles of having to get home on time, since the B&B is right nearby. Across from Live in My House is a 7-Eleven where you can grab late-night snacks, while the neighboring police station will ensure you always feel safe and secure. There’s even a post office nearby, giving easy access to an ATM!

stays.name: 傻風民宿
stays.description: 澎湖的美，將永遠映在我們心中。無論離開多少年，總是還是會想念那艷陽、那海水、那既強烈又挾帶海水的東北季風，可能偶爾還會出現那一位老船長。由於這樣的牽掛，使得在台南擁有許多事業的劉姐一直想再這樣一個自己生長的地方開設他人生中第二家民宿，他想把澎湖的美，分享給更多的人，他想把他故鄉的點滴呈現在眾人的面前。於是集結了居住在澎湖的表妹及友人，開始了這麼樣一段實現夢想的故事。
stays.descriptionEn: The beauty of Penghu is not only a wonder to see, but an impression to remember: Sunshine, waves, monsoon, and that old captain. Ms. Liu, who was already successful in Tainan, decided to invest for the second bed and breakfast business here because she felt bonded with Penghu and wanted to share the goodness of her homeland with visitors. With the help from her cousins and friends, the dream finally came true.

stays.descriptionEn: Hotel GHotel G and Gama Travel Agency insists on offering the most innovative service with the most affordable price. Hotel G combines the travel agency and car rental service to provide the most complete travel information for tourists. The most convenient one-stop service can be gained by contacting us.In Penghu, we greet visitors from Taiwan and all over the world!Gama looks forward to your visit and hopes you to create your own wonderful moment with us in Penghu. Surroundings：Hotel G is located on the city center. - The largest local market: It is the most convenient place for you to buy and eat seafood.- Zhongzheng shopping district (about 5 min): You can visit the night market to taste some street snacks.- The special breakfast street (about 3 min): You will have many choices for the local special breakfast.- Duty Free Shopping Mall (about 3 min): You can buy many duty-Free items, such as tobacco, alcohol, and fashion accessories.- Penghu South Visitor Center (about 3 min): If you want to experience night-fishing and island hopping, you will set off from here.- Guanyin Temple (about 5 min): Firework Festival will be hosted here.- The beach near Guanyin Temple (about 5 min): You can go windsurfing and take part in many water activities.

stays.name: 半天鳥精品民宿
stays.description: 汲汲營營的結果，雖頗有收益，卻也賠上了健康與精神生活。自忖，人生歲月苦短，怎能虛渡？不時憶起曾混跡北、中、南各部都會叢林中，繁忙、緊張的都市生活，工作壓力及令人窒息、無力的生活，故重拾返鄉前的民宿大夢。澎湖人的慢活、閒適、不與人爭，更是讓我逐夢的最佳動力，期盼藉由民宿經營，結識四方好友，共同分享澎湖之美，悠哉、慢活、休閒的新生活。
stays.descriptionEn: The result of being busy and hardworking certainly allows you with income, but at the expense of health and spiritual life. Think to oneself, life is bitter and short, how can one waste it? Often thought about the busy and tense urban life when back in the various urban jungles in the northern, central and southern regions, with the work stress and the suffocating lifestyle, hence decided to return to hometown and pursue the dream of homestay. The Slow Life, leisure and non-competitive nature of Penghu people is further the motivation for my pursuance towards the dream; I hope to make friends from all places through the homestay, to share the beauty of Penghu, the carefree, Slow Life and leisurable new life.

stays.description: 位於澎湖縣的民宿 和煦創意民宿位於澎湖西衛，距離海灘僅約1分鐘路程。部分房型享有部分海景，是一家親子主題民宿。每間房型都擁有獨特風格主題，整個設計包括木工製作、主題燈飾和牆壁彩繪均由民宿主人精心打造完成。儘管可能不盡完美，但我們用心經營，期望給每位旅客留下美好回憶。除了房內設施外，我們還提供嬰兒床、消毒鍋、洗澡盆、兒童餐椅、遊戲區和咖啡茶飲區供免費使用。心靈舒壓療癒區則需預約體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Bed and Breakfast in Hexu Creative B&B (parent-child theme B&B) is located in Xiwei, Magong City, about 2 to 3 minutes' walk from the intertidal zone. Each room type has a unique style theme, and some room types have a bathtub balcony with partial sea view. Air conditioning, wifi ( Free), shower facilities, independent shower head. Private parking space provided.All room types provide LCD Internet TV, wireless WIFI Internet access, air conditioning, refrigerator, independent wet and dry shower head, hair dryer, and quick boiling kettleEU organic certification, 100% imported from Italy, bath series, mineral water, towels, bath towels, tea bagsThis property offers rental cars and motorcycles.In addition to room facilities, it also provides sterilizers, bathtubs, children's dining chairs, game areas, slides, small paddling pools, children's fishing board games with water guns in the vestibule, courtyards, coffee, tea, and biscuits. Stress-relieving and healing area for the soul. (reservation required for experience)There is also a private room service (electric mahjong can be used)It is 3 kilometers from Four Eyes Well, 3.1 kilometers from Xiying Rainbow Bridge, 1.1 kilometers from Penghu University of Science and Technology, about 2.4 kilometers from Life Museum, 2.7 kilometers from Penghu First Hotel, 3.1 kilometers from Central Old Street, and 3.2 kilometers from Tianhou Temple. About 6 kilometers from the airport.

stays.name: 和田大飯店
stays.description: 和田飯店以簡潔簡約的設計感、舒適舒坦的空間感與俐落清新的現代感為主要設計理念，為您呈現悠閒的客房空間、餐飲空間以及SPA體驗。 和田飯店位於馬公市中心，中正-仁愛商圈、良風徐徐的漁人碼頭木棧道、觀賞日落與風帆活動的觀音亭、媽宮古城碩果僅存的順承門、見證當初軍民合一精神的舊眷村-篤行十村以及中央老街-天后宮等主要古蹟區均步行可達，讓您除了享受澎湖的南島風光，也能來一趟穿梭古蹟知性放鬆的慢遊之旅。 為了能讓您在百忙中難得的休閒假期中，獲得一個寧靜、舒適、輕鬆的渡假時光，我們可為您規劃一些旅遊行程，例如：浪漫的南海離島、知性的東海潮間帶、刺激的北海水上活動等。讓您在充滿陽光海水的島嶼空間裡有個多采多姿、回味無窮的慢賞澎湖假期。除了澎湖豐富的人文古蹟及璀璨的島嶼風光之外，和田飯店提倡樂活LOHAS悠閒的慢享行程，邀請您一同體驗澎湖純真的沙灘、清爽的海風與愜意的旅程。
stays.descriptionEn: MF hotel combines old tradition with modern style and comfort, bring you a leisurely spatial of guest rooms, dining area and spa experience in a unique way, his small and exclusive hotel is beautifully situated in the Magong city center, where the business circle, fisherman wharf, Goddess temple, ancient city gate, and the old military base village are all by walking distance, as well as the main historical site area. We wish you enjoy not only the southern island aura of Penghu, but also feasted upon a journey of history. In order to make your precious leisure time a cozy, tranquil and relaxing vacation, we could organize some tour for you, such as romantic boat tour of south islets’, fishing activities at east islets’ tidal flat and exciting water sports at north islets’ …etc. Wish to bring you a splendid and unforgettable holiday at our sunny island. With the rich historical in heritages and resplendent islets sceneries, we wish to give you a comfortable and refreshing pied-a-terre after visiting Penghu, the archipelagos scatter over the azure blue Taiwan Strait.

stays.name: 圓頂瓦舍民宿
stays.description: 澎湖 澎湖民宿 "圓頂瓦舍 海景民宿"位於澎湖縣山水沙灘第一線，擁有澎湖最美的沙灘，藍天、白雲以及展翅飛翔的海鳥，踩在細軟的沙灘上撿拾著貝殼，感受海水的清涼，一望無盡的自然美景盡收眼底。 夜晚悠閒地坐在 澎湖 山水沙灘前"圓頂瓦舍"的屋頂上，喝著Latte、吹著徐徐的海風、聆聽著海浪聲潮來潮往、凝望著繁星點點，一顆、二顆、三顆…彷彿伸手就可摘下滿天星斗，讓您忘卻塵囂。 無敵海景、坐擁山水、樂活鄉村、簡單生活，想要體驗自然美景與優質的民宿，"圓頂瓦舍"是您最好的選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: Penghu Penghu Islands bed and breakfasts"WASHE dome haijingmin" Pescadores on Shanshui beach front line, with Penghu's most beautiful beach, blue sky, white clouds, and sea birds to fly, step on the soft gathers shells on the beach, feel the cool sea water, with a panoramic view of endless natural beauty.Night sitting leisurely in Penghu's scenic beach front "dome WASHE" on the roof, sipping Latte, breezes of the sea breeze blowing,Listen to the sound of the sea tides go, staring at the stars, one star, two star, three star ... Reach out and pluck the starry, let you forget it all.A great ocean view, sitting on landscapes, LOHAS, simple life in the countryside, who want to experience the natural beauty and high quality accommodation, the "dome WASHE" is the best choice for you.

stays.name: 夏之旅民宿
stays.description: 夏之旅民宿~提供二人、四人、六~八人房的住宿選擇，房內營造出溫馨而舒適的氛圍，平實、寬敞、明亮、簡潔的陳設裡，處處散發著令人徹底放鬆的感受，無壓迫性的住宿空間就像回到家一般的自在，依照不同房型提供各項設施設備，十分適合學生團體、家庭共同出遊旅宿。位於南環地區的合法民宿「夏之旅民宿」，座落在純樸鄉村中的白色獨棟別墅建築，讓旅人可以真正放鬆身心壓力，來場舒適、寧靜、悠閒的旅程，極適合親子住宿的環境，此外，夜晚還可觀看無光害、獨有的閃閃星空，民宿前方就是潮間帶，走在木棧道的海堤防，讓暖暖海風帶走您的各種煩憂，讓這片美景帶給您最輕鬆的心情感受。

stays.name: 夏之長灘民宿
stays.description: 本民宿位於馬公市山水里黃金沙灘旁，近於溼地公園。為獨棟的白色建築，以石砌設計作為點綴，讓整體外觀造型更為獨樹一格。民宿周圍環境清閒幽靜，從陽台及頂樓眺望，還可以看見大片綠意和遼闊海景，山水沙灘的美景就直接映入眼簾，令人心曠神怡。悠悠夏日～來趟菊島之旅。看盈盈日光長照山水，觀點點星塵灑落沙灘。
stays.descriptionEn: Summer Long Beach B&B is located next to the Huangjin (Golden) Beach, near Wetland Park, in Shanshuili, Magong City. It's a stand alone white building with stone embellishments, which makes the exterior quite unique. The surrounding is serene and quiet. The balcony and top floor offer a great view of the lush green surrounding and vast ocean. Having the mountain and beach landscape so close by is refreshing and relaxing. Summer is the perfect time to visit the Penghu Islands. You can see the sun shining on the mountain and water, and starlight reflecting on the beach.

stays.name: 夏天來了民宿
stays.description: 夏日的顏色是海天交織的藍與白，仰望天際晴空無限 ，眼望海洋潔淨透明 ，俯仰之間內心的悸動喜悅不已。清爽的海風吹拂著，人們閒散地在沙灘上，盡情享受熱情的陽光，有在沙灘上編寫屬於自己的劇本，想像自己是偶像劇裡的男女主角，有帶著面鏡呼吸管潛入，清澈見底的珊瑚礁區，在尋找小丑魚的蹤跡。澎湖民宿，夏天來了，誠心歡迎你，民宿除了提供舒適溫馨的房間，另備有澎湖當天風味的豐盛早餐(海鮮粥、南瓜米粉...等多種澎湖當地美食)。
stays.descriptionEn: With the beautiful blue skies stretching out overhead and the crystal-clear ocean in front, Summertime Penghu Bed & Breakfast is a place of complete calm. As the cool sea breezes blow over, people stroll along the beach, soaking up the brilliant sun. Become the lead actor or actress of your own story on the beach, and if you’ve got a snorkel, why not dive down and explore the coral reef and hunt for some clownfish?Summertime Penghu welcomes you to this comfortable, homely homestay. Enjoy the provided breakfasts, made fresh with local produce, including seafood congee, pumpkin noodles, and other Penghu treats.

A car rental service is available at this accommodation. Penghu Living Museum is 1.9 km from SummerMallika Homestay, while Penghu First Hotel is 2.4 km from the property. This property is 6 km from Penghu Airport, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

stays.nameEn: Dream Ocean View Bed and Breakfast fortress
stays.description: 現代童話、城堡風格~本建築以現代童話城堡為構思，搭配上巴洛克風格，再結合了復古與優雅元素，作為本民宿主體風格走向。並以引人注目活潑鮮亮的色彩，輔以彩色玻璃與拱型門窗為點綴，城堡式的圍牆與復古原木的大門，讓建築物增添了如童話故事般浪漫夢幻的氛圍。 為了要讓來到山水住宿的旅客能真正感受山水沙灘日夜的美，讓遊客能親身體驗浪濤聲，聞到真正的海味。不僅2.3樓客房各自擁有獨立觀景陽臺。頂樓更有全天候開放，讓遊客能在白天觀賞海景。黃昏賞夕陽，夜晚摘星星，看漁火點點的最佳選擇，讓住宿夢的堡壘的旅客如同公主王子般的享受人間仙境。

stays.name: 大牛的家民宿
stays.description: 「澎湖民宿‧大牛的家民宿」潔白且線條分明的外觀大方氣派，庭園草皮造景更是賞心悅目，主人也貼心地設置戶外休閒桌椅讓旅人白天可在此曬曬太陽、感受微風徐徐的愜意，而到了夜晚更是抬頭便能欣賞浩瀚閃爍的銀河天際，使人忘情醉心！除清閒雅緻的庭園造景外，「澎湖住宿‧大牛的家民宿」大廳空間也毫不馬虎，簡單之中散發著文青風格的品味，以優雅的姿態歡迎著旅人到來，也使人心情跟著舒暢起來；民宿內提供二至四人套房，以包層為主，讓旅人可與熟識夥伴共享空間；每個房間皆有不同主題搭配著合宜裝潢，讓不論是情侶、好友或是家庭出遊等都能挑選到適合房型入住，部分房間更有大型落地窗戶可接引戶外草皮綠意與溫暖陽光，使空間更添幸福滋味！房內寬敞明亮的規劃巧妙地減輕了旅途間的疲憊，而精心挑選的家飾更顯示了主人對旅人的重視，希望每個到來的貴客都能夠有賓至如歸的感受，讓您在「澎湖民宿‧大牛的家民宿」相陪的旅程之中留下難忘美好的回憶。服務項目：澎湖住宿、澎湖民宿、澎湖包棟民宿、澎湖民宿推薦、澎湖行程建議、澎湖旅遊諮詢其他設施：停車場、無線上網、觀景平台、露天休閒桌椅

stays.name: 大茉莉民宿
stays.description: 炎熱的熱情仲夏，要到哪裡出遊去呢?喜歡徜徉海濱沙灘、藍色汪洋的您~澎湖菊島就是您最優先的出遊選擇！ 這裡有著特殊的玄武岩地質、豐富的海洋資源和雋永的人文文化，更有著毫無壓力的悠閒與快意，您可騎乘機車造訪各大熱門景點，也可乘船至吉貝、望安、七美等美麗島嶼，享受無拘無束的島嶼風光。 「澎湖民宿‧大茉莉民宿」位於馬公市，前往天后宮、四眼井和馬公老街和花火節的主要舉辦場地-觀音亭海濱公園(西瀛虹橋)僅需約3分鐘車程，旅客們可享有最便利的交通優勢，前往探訪菊島海洋風情或大啖特有的在地小吃都十分方便。 「澎湖民宿‧大茉莉民宿」擁有恢弘壯闊的氣度外觀，整面的落地玻璃，讓戶外的光線和街景映入屋內，讓空間更為明亮清新。民宿提供簡單潔淨的2人及4人套房，簡單的繽紛色系，展現單純和樸實意旨，使得旅人的渡假心境更為放鬆無拘。

stays.name: 太陽民宿
stays.description: 太陽民宿倚靠在西衛的西北側海岸，頗有遺世獨居的玩味，每一天的晨曦和晚霞從我們頭頂上走過，故名太陽。雖然如此，我們最顯眼的標誌其實是圖片中能看見的七色彩柱，人人都嚮往太陽的光芒和溫暖，但雨過天晴的力量才是最珍貴的，所以太陽民宿的太陽是在雨後，天放晴，讓彩虹出現的太陽。太陽民宿為新造，今年盛大啟動~走進這個總計一百多坪大的空間裡，最先感受到的就是濃濃的木竹香，全局皆用復古的風味，營造出懷舊的溫暖情懷。房間部分呼應大格局，雙人房都已接近8坪，盥洗空間皆採用乾濕分離，除六人房外，皆配置約1.5坪的陽台，為的是除了日出日落，還有澎湖夜晚如繁星點點的燈光漁火，環視整個西嶼鄉、白沙鄉，綿長路燈點點串連，正北邊，是大倉島的親切問候，或著猛然回頭，觀音亭的彩虹橋在遠處閃爍著。我們在整個澎湖本島的中心位置，觀望。PS：民宿額外配置全新的腳踏車，據民宿約莫50公尺外就是西衛的腳踏車步道，一路沿著澎湖西海岸能夠通往觀音亭，馬公市區。此外我們也提供機場接送的服務，有需求的朋友也請多多善用，感謝。

stays.description: 來澎湖享受悠閒渡假的氣息，那自在的氛圍、那舒服的環境、那如家一般的親切～有時溫度剛剛好、有時太陽有點曬，大部分的時候天氣都是爽朗～如同民宿主人般的親切～好山好水民宿成立於2020年，我們的合法編號是918，合法民宿，讓您安心入住，來到這裡，就如同在家一般自在～這裡就是您在澎湖暫時的家～歡迎包棟！來吧！別再猶豫了！交通便利、鬧中取靜的休閒環境，依照旅人不同的需求，分別提供套房、包棟不同的住宿服務，溫馨潔淨、雅緻清新。每一間房間的舒適、整潔、設備都不馬虎，希望給旅客此趟旅程最棒的回憶！鄰近多處知名景點，讓您深刻地感受到屬於澎湖的好，澎湖的美麗風景，澎湖特有的人情味跟淳樸，來這裡放鬆身心呀～

stays.name: 好朋友民宿
stays.description: 澎湖民宿「好朋友民宿」座落於整個澎湖縣的中心點，距離馬公市區只要8分鐘車程即可到達，距離澎湖各大景點也都很近(如白沙鄉跨海大橋、通樑古榕，湖西鄉奎壁山摩西分海、隘門沙灘，山水沙灘、風櫃動等等)，是一個地理位置極佳的住宿地點，另外住宿包含早餐以及每天都有提供額外的小點心，住宿的老闆一家也都十分親切，有什麼需要都可以跟我們說，我們會盡力的協助旅客處理～每一間套房都有獨立衛浴，除了2樓海洋團體房以及1樓鄉村房沒有陽台之外，其餘3樓花園雙人房以及2樓星月四人房皆有陽台哦～另外本館全面禁菸，若是有菸癮的房客再麻煩到外面抽菸，謝謝您！
stays.descriptionEn: Penghu B&B "Good Friends B&B" is located in the center of Penghu County, only 8 minutes' drive from Magong City, and close to major attractions in Penghu (such as the Baisha Township Cross-Sea Bridge, Tongliang Ancient Banyan, Huxi Township Kuibi Mountain Moses Sea, Aimen Beach, Shanshui Beach, Fengguidong, etc.), it is an accommodation with an excellent geographical location. In addition, the accommodation includes breakfast and extra snacks every day. The owner of the accommodation is also very kind. You can tell us if you need anything, and we will do our best to assist the tourists~ Each suite has an independent bathroom. Except for the Ocean Group Room on the 2nd floor and the Countryside Room on the 1st floor, there is no balcony. The other 3rd floor Garden Double Room and the 2nd floor Star Moon Quadruple Room all have balconies~ In addition, this hotel is completely non-smoking. If you are addicted to smoking, please go outside to smoke. Thank you!

stays.name: 媽宮古街10號民宿
stays.description: 媽宮古街10號民宿座落於馬公市的中央街，這裡是澎湖先民最早開拓和聚集的歷史特定風景區。雖然我們位於古老的街道中，但我們的民宿卻散發著全新的活力。在民國94年，由於建築物年久失修，已無法居住，在政府的批准下，我們對房屋進行了重新改建，並細心保留了每一塊磚瓦的歷史風貌。來到這裡，您彷彿置身於民國初年的時光中。 我們的民宿地理位置極為便利，處於市中心的一隅，遠離喧囂。周邊有多處一級古蹟，如天后宮、台廈郊會館（水仙宮）、萬軍井、四眼井、施公祠等，均可輕鬆步行到達。您可以在這古色古香的老街中漫步，感受早期先民的生活風情。除此之外，我們的民宿四通八達，無論是前往觀音亭海水浴場欣賞花火，還是到中正路鬧區、漁人碼頭等市區景點，都是十分便捷的選擇。 我們真誠地邀請每一位旅客放慢腳步，體驗穿越時光的感覺，沉浸在媽宮古街10號民宿的獨特魅力中。 ☆我們的榮譽：◆2023年榮獲「永續低碳島，節電更美好」節電競賽第一名◆2024年1月被評為「好客民宿」◆提供旅遊介紹及客制化服務​☆貼心小提醒：◆為了保留歷史風貌，本民宿為三層樓建築，無電梯設施，但我們有強壯的小幫手可以協助搬運行李。◆由於位於市中心的老街內，停車可能稍有不便，但我們的小幫手可以提供詳盡的停車資訊。​☆★☆訂房後，請務必加入我們的官方LINE：@mk864，獲取更多資訊！
stays.descriptionEn: No. 10 Magong Ancient Street B&B is located on Central Street in Magong City, a historical scenic spot where the ancestors of Penghu first developed and gathered. Although we are located in an ancient street, our B&B exudes a brand new vitality. In 2005, the building fell into disrepair and was no longer habitable. With the approval of the government, we rebuilt the house and carefully preserved the historical features of every brick and tile. When you come here, you feel as if you are in the early years of the Republic of China.Our bed and breakfast is very conveniently located in a corner of the city center, away from the hustle and bustle. There are many first-class historical sites around, such as Tianhou Temple, Taixiajiao Guild Hall (Narcissus Temple), Wanjun Well, Siyan Well, Shigong Temple, etc., which can be easily reached on foot. You can stroll through this quaint old street and experience the lifestyle of the early ancestors. In addition, our homestay is well connected, whether you are going to Guanyinting Beach to enjoy the fireworks, or to the downtown area of ​​Zhongzheng Road, Fisherman's Wharf and other urban attractions, it is a very convenient choice. We sincerely invite every traveler to slow down, experience the feeling of traveling through time, and immerse yourself in the unique charm of No. 10 Magong Ancient Street B&B.☆Our Honor:◆Won the first place in the "Sustainable Low-Carbon Island, Saving Electricity for a Better Life" electricity saving competition in 2023◆Rated as "Hospitable B&B" in January 2024◆Provide travel introduction and customized services​☆Tips:◆In order to preserve the historical features, this B&B is a three-story building without elevator facilities, but we have strong helpers who can assist in carrying luggage.◆Because it is located in the old street in the city center, parking may be a little inconvenient, but our little helper can provide detailed parking information.​☆★☆After booking, please be sure to join our official LINE: @mk864 to get more information!

stays.descriptionEn: Located in Suogang Community, Magong City, and Anshang Bed & Breakfast is a standalone building renovated in 2007 into a Bed & Breakfast and run by Papa Wu and his family. Run by Suogang locals, it is brimming with the casual, down-home flavor of Penghu, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy the homely atmosphere. While Suogang may be in the outskirts of the city, it is the largest community in Pengnan District, and is thus very convenient in terms of everyday necessities. (Shuttle service: pickup from the airport is available at no cost, while shuttles to the pier must be booked in advance and will be charged for.)

stays.name: 安利民宿
stays.description: 安上安利民宿位於馬公市鎖港里，地處市郊，獨棟建築為2007年全新落成的新民宿，由民宿主人吳爸爸一家人所共同經營。鎖港在地人所經營的民宿，充滿了澎湖人特有的隨和與草地性格，來到安上安利民宿大可盡情放鬆心情，和民宿主人們享受像親朋好友般的感覺。鎖港雖然位處市郊，卻是澎湖澎南區最大的一個里，各項生活機能依然十分便利。(接駁服務：機場接駁需預約不收費；碼頭接駁需預約需收費)
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Suogang Community, Magong City, and Anshang Bed & Breakfast is a standalone building renovated in 2007 into a Bed & Breakfast and run by Papa Wu and his family. Run by Suogang locals, it is brimming with the casual, down-home flavor of Penghu, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy the homely atmosphere. While Suogang may be in the outskirts of the city, it is the largest community in Pengnan District, and is thus very convenient in terms of everyday necessities. (Shuttle service: pickup from the airport is available at no cost, while shuttles to the pier must be booked in advance and will be charged for.)

stays.name: 寶島別館民宿(特色民宿)
stays.description: 澎湖～旅人夏日的離島天堂。不論是擁有浪漫傳說的七美島嶼、特殊而壯觀的玄武岩地形；好玩刺激的水上玩樂遊戲、或是美食人文齊聚的馬公市區，還有吸睛奪目、璀璨耀眼的花火節…等～每一個菊島風情都在呼喚著您～快來澎湖玩一〝夏〞～澎湖住宿‧寶島時尚別館位於熱鬧的馬公市區自民國70年成立以來便一直為遠道而來的旅客及商務人士提供便利的溫馨住居。別館座落的駐地位置，讓住客們都能擁有完善的生活機能及便利的交通位置。精緻時尚的住宿品質，讓來賓都能感受一場極致放鬆的舒適饗宴。「澎湖住宿‧寶島時尚別館」提供多種不同風格的精緻房型，包含：湛藍簡約的北歐丹麥風情、簡潔奢華的現代主義時尚風格、鮮明藝術的視覺情境風格及藍白相映的地中海度假風格…等，不同的房間設計及風格佈景，卻擁有相同的簡約舒適、典雅氣息，讓旅人們都能夠充分感受到澎湖的悠閒輕快。
stays.descriptionEn: Penghu is the dream land for travelers in summer. May it be Qimei to see the basalt landscape or to play water sports, to discover local foods or culture, or to explore the sparkling Fireworks Festival, "Bao Dao Bie Guan B&B" welcomes you with convenient accommodation service. Since 1981, it serves to provide easy access to necessities and fast travel, as well as delivers accommodation service of fashion and dedication for your satisfying vacation. "Bao Dao Bie Guan" provides rooms of variable well-designed themes including plain Denmark style, modern fashion, bright colors or vacation in Mediterranean, and all of them serve with comfort and hospitality, allowing you to enjoy every moment in Penghu!

stays.name: 小確幸民宿
stays.description: 微小而確實的幸福～「澎湖民宿‧澎湖小確幸民宿」為合法澎湖民宿，位處馬公市區與北環的中間地段，不論旅人要前往馬公老街，品嘗新鮮海產與道地小吃，造訪四眼井、天后宮、觀音亭、西瀛虹橋…等熱門景點；或前往北環，探遊鯨魚洞、中屯風車、通樑古榕、跨海大橋、二崁古厝等佳景，都十分便利而鄰近。溫馨、自在、舒適 是「澎湖民宿‧澎湖小確幸民宿」要給遠道而來的朋友們的美妙感受。整棟裝潢以簡單舒適作為主軸，我們備有雙人、四人及六至八人客房，另也有提供包棟服務。小確幸期盼與你們相見，讓您享有回到家般的舒適感覺，並和您一同分享生活中、旅程中微小而確實的幸福。
stays.descriptionEn: In "Siao Cyue Sing B&B", a registered bed and breakfast in Penghu, it's all about satisfaction: it's located between Magong Downtown and Beihuan, providing easy access to the Makung Old Streets for fresh seafood or snacks, as well as other popular sites including the Four-Eyed Well, Mazu Temple, Guanyin Pavilion and Xiying Rainbow Bridge, or you can head for Beihuan to explore the Whale Cave, Zhongtun Windmills, the old ficus tree named "Tong Lian", cross-sea bridge, and Erkan old mansion. These sites are just minutes away! Don't forget to have a stay in "Siao Cyue Sing B&B" for absolute warmth and comfort: The building is designed with simplicity and coziness in mind and provides rooms for 2, 4 or 6-8. We also welcome groups that wish to book the entire building! Contentment is a virtue that makes you feel at home, and that's exactly what the owner looks for.

stays.description: 漫步迷人的海島國度，吹著微徐的海風，記錄所有的旅行感動～「澎湖民宿～澎湖居歇座民宿」有著絕佳的地理環境，座落於馬公市區的優勢，讓您前往各旅遊景點，都相當快速便利，不論您此行是來造訪古蹟名勝，或是想深入自然了解生態，澎湖所蘊藏的豐富內容，絕對能讓您此趟的澎湖之旅，大感滿意且收獲滿滿。另外，澎湖人特有的熱情活力，也將能協助您的旅途行程更加的順暢。座民宿的內部環境，是兼具著舒適性與質感的品味空間；在客房的部份，規劃有二人及四人的房型選擇，以舒服溫馨的居家色調，打造出數間主題式的客房空間，優雅中帶點時尚的混搭風格，也使得溫馨的客房面貌注入了更多的精彩元素。這次的澎湖之旅，「澎湖民宿～澎湖居歇座民宿」將會是您旅人生活的理想居所，讓我們一同望著星空、聆聽浪聲，共渡一個美好的離島之夜。

stays.name: 山水貝殼沙民宿
stays.description: 坐落在馬公市郊的山水貝殼沙民宿，位於靜謐的村落中，讓您遠離喧囂與煩惱，且鄰近知名的山水沙灘，僅需步行五分鐘，即可到達這片洋溢著青春和夏天氣息的美麗細白沙灘，感受村落中的人文風情，亦可與觀光客一同逐沙，和衝浪客一起踏浪。往沙灘的右邊走，即是山水30高地，向著山走，遠離人群，在這裡可將山水沙灘的全景盡收眼底，另一邊則是台灣海峽，坐在山上，獨攬這美麗的景色，度過慵懶地下午，才明白人生可以過得無此愜意。當你在外享受了一整天的艷陽，返回到民宿中，處處可見到老闆的用心，從小跟著爸爸學攝影的民宿老闆，以攝影者的角度，選擇了最佳的大範圍自然採光，讓入住者感受熱情的陽光，坐在民宿內，就能看見光影所帶來的美好，民宿的餐廳區，更是讓人可以悠閒坐著看書、曬太陽放鬆的好地方，就算不出門，也能感受到澎湖空氣中獨特又自然的鹹水味，徐徐的海風彷彿在這時候吹走了您的煩憂。來到房間，藍色和白色作為主體顏色，代表著澎湖的藍天、白雲和四面環海的景緻，在這裡，讓您既有在家的悠閒與自在感，亦能繼續延續著度假的海島氛圍，山水貝殼沙民宿─讓您的美好假期從這裡開始。

stays.descriptionEn: With a Mediterranean style and situated on an island with a climate much like that of Greece, Greek Frontier is like a distant outpost for the blue and white of Greece. This is not just a home repurposed as a Bed & Breakfast, but rather a place that strives to provide guests is pure relaxation and an escape from the rat race. Here, free of the stresses of work, you can simply appreciate the broad expanse of the ocean and the warmth of the sun, relaxing in a unique space with quality facilities; so relaxed is it here that each minute feels more like 120 seconds. We hope everyone who’s dreamed of going to Greece will make a trip to the Greek Frontier and get a taste of the sun, sea, and sand of the Mediterranean.

stays.descriptionEn: The spacious and bright hall is matched with the furniture carefully selected by the owner, making the space exude extraordinary taste. The B&B has double rooms and quadruple rooms, as well as parent-child quadruple rooms specially designed for parents and children. Whether you are traveling with friends, couples or families, you can find the most suitable room type in "Penghu Accommodation·Love Landscape B&B". The room continues the stylish and elegant taste of the lobby. The walls and ceilings full of design are stunning. The warm-toned lighting creates a warm atmosphere, allowing travelers to relax here and feel the touch brought by "Penghu Accommodation‧Love Landscape B&B".

stays.name: 慈愛居民宿
stays.description: 「澎湖民宿．慈愛居」鄰近南海遊客中心、澎湖馬公市區，僅需五分鐘的車程即可享有便利生活與美食小吃，或是乾脆搭船出海體驗夜釣小管、海上釣魚的樂趣。澎湖本島有天后宮、四眼井、跨海大橋、中屯風車等熱門景點，騎著機車享受海風吹拂遊覽各式景點是最適合也不過了。 「澎湖民宿．慈愛居」位處便利、鬧中取靜，民宿的年輕主人俊偉因為對大海有著深厚的情感，以及懷著想要在家鄉打拼的鄉土情懷，便與父母親攜手打造「澎湖民宿．慈愛居」，民國104年正式落成的民宿以溫馨典雅為設計主軸，潔白簡約的房間搭配上現代化高雅的衛浴設備，最適合想要享受澎湖悠閒的旅客入住，給您如同回家般的舒適感受。倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【0927-795202】澎湖民宿．慈愛居
stays.descriptionEn: Penghu B&B - Residents love places is close to the Nan Hai Visitor Center located in downtown Makung City, and it only takes 5 minutes of driving to the convenient stores and eateries. You may also hire a boat out to sea to experience the joy of nighttime fishing, such as small squid. Penghu main island is provided with popular scenic spots like Matsu Temple, Four-Eyed Well, Penghu Cross-Sea Bridge and Zhongtun Spin Wheel, etc. By renting a motorcycle, you may easily visit these scenic spot in the gentle sea breeze. Penghu B&B - Residents love places is located at a convenient location and a quiet spot among the hubbub of the city. Obsessed by a deep emotion for the sea and a strong bond with his hometown, Mr. Jung Wei, the young owner, came back home and developed his life by opening the “Penghu B&B - Residents love places” together with his parents. The B&B facility formally opened in 2015. It is designed in warm and elegant touch where whitish tone of room is adorned with modernized high-class sanitary facilities. It is most suitable for the passengers who want to savor the real life in Penghu. It gives a home-like coziness. stays.searchText: 慈愛居民宿 慈愛居民宿 澎湖縣民宿348號 澎湖縣 馬公市 東文里15鄰東文澳260之6號 「澎湖民宿．慈愛居」鄰近南海遊客中心、澎湖馬公市區，僅需五分鐘的車程即可享有便利生活與美食小吃，或是乾脆搭船出海體驗夜釣小管、海上釣魚的樂趣。澎湖本島有天后宮、四眼井、跨海大橋、中屯風車等熱門景點，騎著機車享受海風吹拂遊覽各式景點是最適合也不過了。 「澎湖民宿．慈愛居」位處便利、鬧中取靜，民宿的年輕主人俊偉因為對大海有著深厚的情感，以及懷著想要在家鄉打拼的鄉土情懷，便與父母親攜手打造「澎湖民宿．慈愛居」，民國104年正式落成的民宿以溫馨典雅為設計主軸，潔白簡約的房間搭配上現代化高雅的衛浴設備，最適合想要享受澎湖悠閒的旅客入住，給您如同回家般的舒適感受。倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【0927-795202】澎湖民宿．慈愛居

stays.name: 我宿休閒民宿
stays.description: 嗨…各位朋友們，我行、我宿(Be-My-House)位於馬公市的近郊，就像台北的陽明山(這是民宿主人的遐想)…這兒的靜謐，就在夜晚時刻，搖椅上的旋律，詮釋最深刻，您能想像它的樣子嗎？不如親身來一趟澎湖之旅，希望您能拋開工作與壓力，用輕鬆的心情感受我們這兒的悠閒與愜意！外觀盎然綠意~是給你的第一印象，走進每個房間，色彩鮮明，獨具風格，更重要的是~給你屬於自己家裡的溫馨感覺，來感受感受吧！
stays.descriptionEn: Hi, friends! Welcome to Be-My-House, located in the outskirts of Magong City. It’s like Yangmingshan of Taipei (a whimsical thought from the host). The tranquility is captured best at night along with the melody of the rocking chair. Can you imagine it? Why not take a trip to Penghu in person? We hope you can put aside your work and stress and embrace the leisure and comfort we offer with a relaxed heart! The greenery of the exterior will be your first impression, and as you step into each room, you’ll find vivid colors and unique designs. Most importantly, it’ll give you the warm and cozy feeling of being at home. Come and experience it yourself!

stays.name: 旅居澎湖沿菊文旅
stays.description: 位於澎湖縣的旅館，2019年，沿著菊島旅行將澎湖人文與深度旅行內涵推向住宿的觸角，正式成立擁有14個房間的沿菊文旅，並與地方非營利組織等合作，將每個房間設計出具有澎湖文化與自然保育教育意義的房型，從住宿費中回饋公益團體現金，推動澎湖改造工程，沿菊文旅除住宿服務以外，更與沿菊旅行社及沿菊人文慢空間整合在同一棟大樓內，提供遊客完整的從住宿到深度旅行，以及文創商舖與文創體驗活動的整合服務，這是創時代的整合與服務系統建立，將讓顧客的旅遊經驗一次結合具有文化意義的住宿體驗，有深度的旅遊規劃，以及美好的文創商品、文創活動購買及參與，一個屬於旅遊的複合式文創基地的誕生。
stays.descriptionEn: The hotel is located in Penghu County. In 2019, Yanju Island Travel pushed the connotation of Penghu culture and in-depth travel to the tentacles of accommodation, and officially established Yanju Cultural Hotel with 14 rooms. It also cooperated with local non-profit organizations to design each room with Penghu cultural and nature conservation education significance, and gave cash back to public welfare groups from the accommodation fees to promote the Penghu transformation project. In addition to accommodation services, Yanju Cultural Hotel is integrated with Yanju Travel Agency and Yanju Humanistic Slow Space in the same building, providing tourists with a complete range of services from accommodation to in-depth travel, as well as integrated services of cultural and creative shops and cultural and creative experience activities. This is the establishment of an integration and service system of the creative era, which will allow customers& #39; travel experience to combine culturally meaningful accommodation experience, in-depth travel planning, and beautiful cultural and creative products, purchase and participation in cultural and creative activities, and the birth of a complex cultural and creative base belonging to tourism.

stays.searchText: 旅居澎湖沿菊文旅 旅居澎湖沿菊文旅 澎湖縣旅館035號 澎湖縣 馬公市 啟明里惠民路36號 位於澎湖縣的旅館，2019年，沿著菊島旅行將澎湖人文與深度旅行內涵推向住宿的觸角，正式成立擁有14個房間的沿菊文旅，並與地方非營利組織等合作，將每個房間設計出具有澎湖文化與自然保育教育意義的房型，從住宿費中回饋公益團體現金，推動澎湖改造工程，沿菊文旅除住宿服務以外，更與沿菊旅行社及沿菊人文慢空間整合在同一棟大樓內，提供遊客完整的從住宿到深度旅行，以及文創商舖與文創體驗活動的整合服務，這是創時代的整合與服務系統建立，將讓顧客的旅遊經驗一次結合具有文化意義的住宿體驗，有深度的旅遊規劃，以及美好的文創商品、文創活動購買及參與，一個屬於旅遊的複合式文創基地的誕生。

stays.name: 旅采民宿
stays.description: 地理簡介民宿位於澎湖南環島地區，週圍有森林、潮間帶、濕地公園、一望無際海水及金黃色沙灘，澎南地區可謂澎湖觀光景點一級戰區。有著名鎖港鎮風石塔、山水濕地公園、山水沙灘山水、三零海景高地公園、蒔裡沙灘、青灣玄武岩、青灣仙人掌公園、蛇頭山、風櫃洞、民宿主人提倡自由行漫活之旅，喜歡民宿地理位置在這些光觀景點的旅人們歡迎你們來找我。民宿介紹旅采民宿是負責人所屬營業行政結構之一，將娛樂休閒結合旅遊及旅宿是我們主要發展，我們的營業除了提供旅宿、在負責人營運結構內還有音樂展演、水域遊憩活動、小船營業、汽機車承租、干貝醬冰品販售,希望透過旅遊來到我們民宿的旅人們，都能夠留下美好的回憶，並對我們有進一步的認識。民宿特色建築面於森林及背海位置,於是在整體建築外觀造型,以簡易鄉村風格結合現代建築設計,希望能呈現給旅人回到家後舒適又溫馨的感覺,所以民宿庭院內外規劃及大廳房間都以現有空間,簡易規劃出溫馨簡易鄉村風格,管家為了打造獨一無二森林與花園結合,從民宿出入口道路至民宿營造出約200米長九重葛花樹一路至民宿, 每日晨間一早可感受鳥鳴花香的氣息,傍晚日落有蟲鳴蛙叫交響樂,這就是旅采民宿。
stays.descriptionEn: Geographical Introduction The B&B is located in the southern island area of ​​Penghu, surrounded by forests, intertidal zones, wetland parks, endless sea water and golden beaches. The Pengnan area can be regarded as a first-class battle zone for Penghu tourist attractions. There are the famous Fengshi Tower in Suogang Town, Shanshui Wetland Park, Shanshui Beach, Sanling Seaview Highland Park, Shili Beach, Qingwan Basalt, Qingwan Cactus Park, Snake Head Mountain, Fenggui Cave. The owner of the B&B advocates a free and leisurely journey. Travelers who like the location of the B&B near these scenic spots are welcome to come to me.

stays.description: 習慣了汲汲營營的都會生活逐漸地忘記了天的顏色還有海的氣息來到澎湖～重新出發感受～海洋之母的輕柔撫育享受～無需言語的樸實恬靜 「澎湖‧月之海民宿」為合法澎湖民宿，步行僅需5分鐘即可抵達觀音亭，旅人們無須出門即可在頂樓輕鬆欣賞到精心動魄又震撼人心的美麗花火。前往澎湖開拓館、順承門、馬公港、天后宮、中央古街、四眼井、菊島之星、漁人碼頭及南海遊客中心…等多處熱門景點也僅需約5至15分鐘車程距離，交通十分方便。 「澎湖‧月之海民宿」相當講究住宿的舒適性與寧靜的舒眠品質，大小合宜的寬敞房型，簡單、高雅又不失溫馨，致力帶給旅客如家一般的舒適愜意。民宿所提供的部分房型可望見美麗的蔚藍海景，旅人們可無需東奔西跑、汲汲營營，也可隨性的窩在房內，恣意享受慵懶的度假情調。
stays.descriptionEn: Sometimes we are so used to the city life that we forget about the color of the sky and the scent of the ocean. Come to Penghu and feel the mother earth. Feel the tranquility beyond words. SEA OF THE MOON is a registered homestay. The famous Guanyinting Recreation Area is only a 5-minute walk away. You can enjoy the stunning fireworks without even leaving the homestay. Penghu Reclamation Hall, Shuncheng Gate, Magong Harbor, Tianhou Temple, Zhongyang Old Street, Four-eyed Well, Star of Gaillardia Island, Fishermen's Wharf, and South Sea Visitor Center are all just a 5 to 15 minute drive away. SEA OF THE MOON is meticulous about the comfort and the sleeping quality of our guests. We have spacious rooms that are simple but elegant and warm. We hope to make every traveler feel at home. Some of our rooms have views of the ocean just outside the window. If you don't feel like going out, stay in our room is also very relaxing.

stays.name: 月橘民宿
stays.description: 澎湖｜月橘Villa．依天傍水的閩式古典假期初夏的澎湖午後天色晴明，開車駛在201縣道上，沒了市區的熱鬧與嘈雜，沿途的空曠景色鮮明了起來。往海邊的路上草和樹循著風拂過的方向搖曳，如同柔美自由的現代舞姿，你不禁將車窗打開，哼起輕快的鄉間小調；忽然一陣清香飄來，好像一種指引，跟著香氣前進，古色古香的月橘Villa就等在小路的那頭，期待與你在旅行裡溫柔相依。安歇放鬆的清幽，一磚一瓦的講究月橘華美的牌門以橘色磚為基調，色彩亮麗的花式瓷磚框住「月橘」二字，盛裝歡迎來訪的旅人們。走進月橘，涼風吹來，屋前水塘上浮著幾株欲待盛放的荷花，有幾分迷人的詩意，抬頭一望，馬鞍形狀的閩式屋脊下，精巧的花鳥嬉戲飾圖生動地躍出，仔細一瞧，竟是幾近失傳的「剪黏」手藝！月橘的主人Well特別請來專門修復老屋的團隊，整體建築結構按照古法施工，結合澎湖特有的咕咾石，老屋新造，讓來訪的旅人也能享受古厝典雅之美。黃澄的太陽爬過月橘的屋頂，日光下的月橘及一草一木皆撒上金箔色的光；落日餘暉、夜晚亮燈，盞盞燈黃妝點紫羅蘭色的晚霞。光影隨時間移動，古厝與池中相互倒映的倩影，在不同時刻的交替下如畫一般，既堂皇富麗，又清雅寧靜。古而不陳舊，雅而能自適而古樸的大門後，不是小橋流水的人家，竟是獨享的私人游泳池，正閃耀美好波光！讓你們在古厝裡也能享受現代舒適、沁涼玩耍；水光倒映著度假的歡樂，推開漆上金箔的復古紅色木門，房內擺放著優雅的中式古典家具。無論是太師椅、老菜櫥還是床頭的描金櫃，每一樣器物都文雅別緻。稍歇片刻，燈光從漂流木的蛀洞透出，你為自己沖一杯清心的風茹外婆茶，這一刻，就猶如一杯好茶般讓人回味無窮，接著，梳理被風吹亂的幾縷髮絲，從荷花瓷洗水檯掬一把水洗洗風塵、躺進浴缸，看夕陽的餘光滑落在屋脊馬背之後，一邊舒展身軀，一邊準備與月光相擁，進入一宿好眠的夢境。
stays.descriptionEn: Penghu｜Murraya Paniculata VillaA classical Fujian-style vacation home beside the waterDriving along County Road 201, you see none of the hustle and bustle of Penghu City, as the spacious scenery along the sides of the road comes alive. You begin to hum a little country ditty, as you drive towards the classically appealing style of Murraya Paniculata Villa which sits at the end of the lane as if awaiting your arrival.Go to bed in secluded relaxation, surrounded by exquisite brick and tileThe gorgeous courtyard entrance to Murraya Paniculata Villa employs orange brick as its basic style while brightly colored ceramic tiles frame the two characters of the Chinese name to extend a magnificent welcome to all visiting travelers. A refreshing breeze blows by as you enter the premises and see several lotus blossoms are just waiting to burst into bloom in the pool out in front of the house. You raise your head and look upwards beneath the saddle-shaped Fujian-style roof ridge to see elaborate, vivid paintings of birds and flowers frolicking as if about to leap out at you. Upon closer inspection you realize that the scene is made by the nearly-lost traditional art of Taiwanese ceramic applique! Guesthouse owner, Well, especially sought out a team of old-house restoration specialists who carried out their renovation of the entire structure using ancient construction methods. Using the coral stone material unique to Penghu, the old building was made new so that visiting travelers might also enjoy the beauty of an ancient homestead.As the clear yellow sun creeps over the rooftop of Murraya Paniculata Villa, each square inch appears, under the brilliant sunlight, as if sprinkled with gold leaf. In the afterglow of sunset, and in the lamplight after darkness falls, numerous yellow lights appear like ornaments under the violet night sky. Light and shadow move with the passing of time, and the homestead’s winsome reflection is inverted in the waters of the pool. The picturesque reflection appears as if anew at progressive moments throughout the day, at once imposing and beautiful, yet refined and tranquil. Ancient but not old-fashioned, elegant yet adaptiveBehind the simple entrance, however, you’ll be surprised to find your own personal swimming pool! Inside the ancient homestead, you can enjoy all the modern comforts, and allow the light-reflecting water to mirror all the happiness of your vacation. As you push open the gold-leaf painted wooden shutter doors, you behold the elegant furniture in classical Chinese-style. Whether it is the “imperial tutor’s chair”, the old food cabinet, or the wooden linen dresser, each and every implement is refined and unique.When the moment comes to rest and light penetrates outward from the holes in driftwood lamp shades, you make yourself a refreshing cup of Hsiang-ju teasane, a local specialty, and once more wash the dust away with a handful of water from the ceramic lotus flower sink. You savor the remaining light of the sunset which slides down the roof ridge in preparation to embrace the moon in a sound slumber. Enjoy your own meditative purelandOpening the doors in the morning, the brightly smiling housekeeper delivers a diverse breakfast: plump, round meatballs, crisp fried dumplings, tasty iced black tea, and the local favorite of Zhongji baked sesame seed-coated cakes, with a refreshing fruit sandwich to finish the meal. The sumptuous food is deeply satisfying, like a classical nanguan musical performance; sometimes singing, sometimes playing a tune, each delivering its own clever magic whilst making harmonious music together.You push open the front gate and leave Murraya Paniculata Villa, with the dazzling noonhour sun shining on the water of the pool. You approach the surface of the water and discover the lotus flower has bloomed, while little tilapia fish dart between the lotus leaves, their charming silhouettes dancing on the surface of the water. You secretly store this amiable scene deep in your heart, as if, now, you and Penghu share a beautiful secret.

stays.searchText: 月橘民宿 月橘民宿 澎湖縣民宿375號 澎湖縣 馬公市 五德里1鄰雞母塢185號 澎湖｜月橘Villa．依天傍水的閩式古典假期初夏的澎湖午後天色晴明，開車駛在201縣道上，沒了市區的熱鬧與嘈雜，沿途的空曠景色鮮明了起來。往海邊的路上草和樹循著風拂過的方向搖曳，如同柔美自由的現代舞姿，你不禁將車窗打開，哼起輕快的鄉間小調；忽然一陣清香飄來，好像一種指引，跟著香氣前進，古色古香的月橘Villa就等在小路的那頭，期待與你在旅行裡溫柔相依。安歇放鬆的清幽，一磚一瓦的講究月橘華美的牌門以橘色磚為基調，色彩亮麗的花式瓷磚框住「月橘」二字，盛裝歡迎來訪的旅人們。走進月橘，涼風吹來，屋前水塘上浮著幾株欲待盛放的荷花，有幾分迷人的詩意，抬頭一望，馬鞍形狀的閩式屋脊下，精巧的花鳥嬉戲飾圖生動地躍出，仔細一瞧，竟是幾近失傳的「剪黏」手藝！月橘的主人Well特別請來專門修復老屋的團隊，整體建築結構按照古法施工，結合澎湖特有的咕咾石，老屋新造，讓來訪的旅人也能享受古厝典雅之美。黃澄的太陽爬過月橘的屋頂，日光下的月橘及一草一木皆撒上金箔色的光；落日餘暉、夜晚亮燈，盞盞燈黃妝點紫羅蘭色的晚霞。光影隨時間移動，古厝與池中相互倒映的倩影，在不同時刻的交替下如畫一般，既堂皇富麗，又清雅寧靜。古而不陳舊，雅而能自適而古樸的大門後，不是小橋流水的人家，竟是獨享的私人游泳池，正閃耀美好波光！讓你們在古厝裡也能享受現代舒適、沁涼玩耍；水光倒映著度假的歡樂，推開漆上金箔的復古紅色木門，房內擺放著優雅的中式古典家具。無論是太師椅、老菜櫥還是床頭的描金櫃，每一樣器物都文雅別緻。稍歇片刻，燈光從漂流木的蛀洞透出，你為自己沖一杯清心的風茹外婆茶，這一刻，就猶如一杯好茶般讓人回味無窮，接著，梳理被風吹亂的幾縷髮絲，從荷花瓷洗水檯掬一把水洗洗風塵、躺進浴缸，看夕陽的餘光滑落在屋脊馬背之後，一邊舒展身軀，一邊準備與月光相擁，進入一宿好眠的夢境。

stays.name: 朝昔廬客棧民宿
stays.description: 客棧主人本著對先人運用真材實料，以及融入老師傅心血和感情一刀一斧，純手工製作器物的著迷與熱愛於2007年7月12日創立 [朝昔廬]。朝昔廬古玩真藏不盡，與王口元廟厝述說無窮，就是本店朝昔廬的詮釋。朝昔加部首就是[廟厝]，因本店內外獨特的視覺空間都是運用古廟及古厝遺留下來的器物裝置而成，把先人遺留的寶貴文化資產透過巧思的營造，讓他的生命再延續，更融入生活裡面。人文飲食更具承襲澎湖人海風的堅持，料理出一道道令人懷念的滋味。而行腳住宿位於澎湖本島的中心點。靠近海邊潮間帶，房間寬敞舒適延伸寬大的露臺，180渡海景映入眼簾，讓人美不勝收。
stays.descriptionEn: The owner of this guesthouse shares a belief in using authentic materials with his forebears, along with a passion for and fascination with handicrafts, and to help promote this, on 12 July 2007 he opened Chaoxilu Guesthouse. The distinctive interiors and exteriors of this guesthouse are due to the use of authentic items from historic temples and homesteads, giving new life to these treasured, thoughtfully crafted items. Penghu is also particularly known for its cuisine culture, and the meals provided are an authentic taste of Penghu. Near the tidal belt, this comfortable, spacious guesthouse also has a tremendous verandah that offers a 180-degree view of the ocean, a sight beyond compare.

stays.name: 森源民宿
stays.description: 澎湖森源民宿 Sun-Young 位於澎湖馬公市西衛社區，這裡是一位男孩從小到大的夢想，伴隨著熱情的太陽、活力的青春在這築夢。幸運擁有從小看到大百看不厭的美景，並期望它能成為旅人們心中的一片回憶。早晨的清新與晨曦、黃昏的夕陽西下，海水的清澈美麗、澎湖人的親切熱情，是最值得駐足的時刻；讓我們放慢自己的腳步、聆聽海浪的聲音，悠閒的度假去吧~~Let's go to Penghu, stay Sun-Young-距離市區約8分鐘距離機場約15分鐘從民宿前往南、北環路線都相當方便唷~-對了!!!民宿附近還有一間7-11走路5分鐘就到了唷~騎車更只要1分鐘，是不是超方便的呢~

images.name: 海洋星空
images.description: 說到澎湖，大家都知道這是一個四面環海的小島，本房型就是以海洋為概念而設計。 讓熱愛海洋的旅人，感受身在海上，遠眺目斗嶼燈塔的感覺。 在白天，抬頭能看到湛藍的天空及熱情的陽光照耀著你。 在夜晚，抬頭能看到夜晚的星空陪伴著你入睡。 旅人們~~~快來體驗吧!!!

images.description: 紫の寧靜-浪漫城市四人房 採用紫羅蘭的輕鬆氛圍，讓長時間身居熱鬧喧譁的都市人，能享受那難得的寧靜。 緊湊的腳步亦能隨之放緩，感受那路上時常錯過的美麗風景，沉澱那早已渾濁的心靈之湖。 快來奔向這寧靜又美麗小島吧～～～

stays.searchText: 森源民宿 森源民宿 澎湖縣民宿500號 澎湖縣 馬公市 西衛里12鄰西衛83之35號 澎湖森源民宿 Sun-Young 位於澎湖馬公市西衛社區，這裡是一位男孩從小到大的夢想，伴隨著熱情的太陽、活力的青春在這築夢。幸運擁有從小看到大百看不厭的美景，並期望它能成為旅人們心中的一片回憶。早晨的清新與晨曦、黃昏的夕陽西下，海水的清澈美麗、澎湖人的親切熱情，是最值得駐足的時刻；讓我們放慢自己的腳步、聆聽海浪的聲音，悠閒的度假去吧~~Let's go to Penghu, stay Sun-Young-距離市區約8分鐘距離機場約15分鐘從民宿前往南、北環路線都相當方便唷~-對了!!!民宿附近還有一間7-11走路5分鐘就到了唷~騎車更只要1分鐘，是不是超方便的呢~

stays.name: 沙灘城堡民宿(特色民宿)
stays.description: 早在1993年起即開始經營民宿的我們，可以算是澎湖最早經營民宿的店家之一，為了打造心目中理想的民宿，阿順花了很多時間和老婆大人到處收集資料，也實地考察了許多優質民宿；在打造沙灘城堡與觀海別墅的過程中，我們秉持著打造《澎湖最好的優質民宿》的初衷，一路前進。在此阿順也衷心的感謝老婆大人與家人無怨無悔的支持！澎湖民宿佔地300坪，分別為觀海別墅與沙灘城堡(觀海別墅二館)，沙灘城堡都為四人房，主要是為家庭式與朋友相聚的客人所設計，而觀海別墅則多為二人套房，專為夫妻或情侶所設計，二棟民宿均走南洋渡假風格，所有的房間均有陽台可眺望山水沙灘與大海，阿順希望能提供一個優閒的渡假空間給旅客，也希望能讓每個旅客擁有滿滿的美好回憶，希望所有住宿的旅客能用慢活的方式細細品味-屬於您的澎湖之旅。
stays.descriptionEn: Since 1993 , we began operating B&B that can be regarded as one of the first Penghu B&B stores.In order to create the ideal of B&B , A-Shun boss and his wife spent a lot of time to gather information everywhere , and also to investigate a lot of high-quality B&B ;In the process to build Sea-view villas and Beach castle villas , we uphold to create "The Penghu best quality B&B in mind , all the way forward.Hereby , A-Shun sincerely thanks to his wife along with their families regrets for their support !Sea-view villas and Beach castle villas are about 990 square meters , Beach castle are quadruple rooms that primarily designed for family and friends to get together , and Sea-view villas are mostly double rooms, designed for couples or lovers . Both of them are south eastern style , and all the rooms have balconies that can overlook the beach and sea . A-Shun hope to provide a space for leisure vacation travelers , and also want to make every passenger has full of great memories , hoping that all passengers can stay the way to savor the slow living, Belong to your Penghu trip.

stays.name: 海之徑民宿
stays.description: 以向日葵黃色作為外觀的「海之徑」，就正如民宿主人的個性活潑、開朗、熱情、專業，座落於馬公市郊西衛社區的海之徑，以色彩鮮豔的外觀和室內時尚簡約的陳設，來到這裡彷彿到了國外小鎮裡，傍晚時分或晚間，在庭院或太陽傘底下，讓微風吹上臉龐，喝上一杯飲料最是愜意。房內設施完善；液晶電視、小冰箱、羽絨被、乾濕分離浴室。二樓房間有採光佳的海景房，每間有落地窗陽台，可近觀西衛漁港碼頭，遠眺中屯風車。公共空間提供電腦及RO飲水機供貴賓使用。造訪菊島何不放慢腳步好好享受主人用心提供這美麗海景的渡假環境。
stays.descriptionEn: The sunflower-yellow of Seaway is a perfect reflection of the personality of the owner — vibrant, outgoing, passionate, and professional. Situated in Xiwei Community on the outskirts of Magong City, this eye-catching Bed & Breakfast is designed with fashionable simplicity. A trip here is like stepping into an exotic small town, and sitting in the courtyard or under a sun umbrella in dusk or nighttime as the sea breeze blows across your face and you sip on a drink is pure relaxation. The rooms all include LCD televisions, small fridges, down duvets, and wet-dry bathrooms. Rooms on the second floor offer a tremendous view of the ocean, and each has full-height windows to make the most of the vistas. The common space also provides computers and a drink vending machine for guests. Why not put up your feet and enjoy the carefully crafted beauty of Seaway on your next visit to Penghu!

stays.name: 海旅巢民宿
stays.description: 曾經懷抱著夢想投入軍中，漫長的軍旅生涯，臺灣、馬祖奔波，但心中對故鄉－澎湖，一直有著難以割捨的眷念因為這裡除了有親愛的家人外，還有上天賦予的大自然美景，令我無法忘懷…退伍後因緣際會下，投入澎湖導遊的行列一方面介紹澎湖的好沙、好水，同時更認識了幾位志同道合的好朋友，多年相處，大伙兒有個相同想法—「築巢共居」除了老來互相照顧外，經營民宿更可發揮咱們的專長並提供旅客一個舒適的休閒環境於是，「西衛海民宿村」—【海旅巢民宿】就在這個構想下於98年5月誕生了！
stays.descriptionEn: After realizing his dream of joining the military and spending years with them around Taiwan and Matsu, the owner of Sea, To Stay always had his heart back in Penghu, missing not only his family, but also the beautiful natural scenery of home. And so, after leaving the military, he seized the opportunity to get into the tourism industry in Penghu, working as a tour guide and introducing the sand and seas to guests while also making like-minded friends. After several years, he and some of these friends decided to make the most of their skills and set up a place for people to say and enjoy everything Penghu has to offer. Thus was Sea, To Stay born in May 2009 as part of Siwei Ocean Village!

stays.name: 海星灣民宿
stays.description: 海星灣民宿(Starfish-Bay)所在位置就是鎖港。鎖港以前甚多漁船從事捕撈小管，現在仍然有小管加工廠，於是先民稱呼這個聚落為小管(台語發音)，後來政府取諧音「鎖港」為名。鎖港聚落規模可以算是澎南地區之首，所以社區內生活機能是澎南地區最完善的，包括7-11、好彩頭超市、鎖港派出所、澎南圖書館等等均散佈在鎖港村內。鎖港碼頭下午三點過後會有漁船紛紛入港，很多魚販會聚集在此整批購買魚貨，遊客也可以來此搶購便宜新鮮剛入港的海鮮，回到住宿點請住宿老闆或拿去海鮮餐廳請廚房料理。

stays.name: 海灣灣民宿
stays.description: 發現海灣灣民宿位居於馬公市西衛里漁港邊的中心位置，是一處眺望海景、感受漁村、寧靜的旅遊休憩最佳去處，五位好友五棟民宿的西衛海民宿村，共同的庭院、公共設施及同時享受五位主人的服務，主人更是從事多年的導遊經歷，是您行程中的交通、美食、遊程安排的GPS。騎機車約5分鐘即可到達熱鬧的馬公市區，交通生活機能方便。您可以選擇放空...清新的空氣.安靜觀海、觀星...此時此刻放鬆心情的感覺真好!，徹底地放鬆自己，毌需遠赴海外跋山涉水，於此即可享受大自然的美妙!
stays.descriptionEn: HiOneOne HomeStay sits by Xiwei Village Harbor in Magong City, offering tremendous views of the ocean and a powerful sense of the lifestyle and tranquility of a traditional fishing village. One of five B&Bs working together in the area, all run by friends, the owner of HiOneOne is an experienced tour guide and can provide fully detailed itineraries complete with travel, food, and GPS information. A five-minute scooter ride from Magong City proper, HiOneOne is conveniently located, while also providing a great place to relax and enjoy the fresh air or watch the stars come out. Unwind completely without having to go overseas, and enjoy the beauty of nature right in your back yard!

stays.name: 海璞民宿
stays.description: 感謝上帝的恩典，邀約了幾個志同道合的好朋友，選了具生活機能環境又幽靜的西衛海邊做為基地，一起蓋個社區來養老，彼此可以互相照應；但現在養老又太早，不如就來打造更優質的民宿回饋給旅人，大家達成共識後於是西衛海民宿村的概念就油然而生，一起朝著共同的夢想邁進，用最挑剔的標準尋覓台灣最優秀的設計師，創造出五間風格各異的特色民宿，用資源共享互相支援的經營模式，讓我們的客人得到最優質的服務。海璞這個名稱的涵義就是海中璞玉的意思，代表著澎湖的簡樸與純潔，我們用最高標準創造住宿品質，與最自在的互動盼望能帶給您賓至如歸的感覺！
stays.descriptionEn: Through the grace of God, a group of friends came together to set up bases in Penghu’s convenient Xiwei seaside area, building a community to help care for each other as they grow old. But old age is still a way off yet, and so they’ve turned their attentions to creating a community of Bed & Breakfasts of the highest quality. Hiring some of Taiwan’s best designers and putting in place the most exacting standards, they came together to create five distinctive Bed & Breakfasts, sharing the effort of running them between them and providing their guests with the best possible service. Simple Sea aims to offer a simple, pure seaside experience that will make every visitor feel right at home.

stays.description: 位於澎湖縣的民宿涵湘居坐落在馬公市市區外環，騎車約五分鐘可抵達市中心，讓您遠離喧囂與煩惱，擁有鬧中取靜,景致優美的絕佳地理位置,可遠眺菊島之星.及第一漁港的彩繪大油桶,港內美景靜謐,,度過您的悠閒假期. 且鄰近祖師廟夜市，讓你美食吃不完,還有生活博物館(讓你了解澎湖風俗及文化的博物館)、孔廟、忠烈祠, 無論交通、飲食、古蹟巡禮、遊玩都相當便利喔！
stays.descriptionEn: Bed and Breakfast in Penghu CountyHanxiangju is located in the outer ring of Magong City. It takes about five minutes by car to reach the city center, allowing you to stay away from the hustle and bustle and troubles. It has an excellent geographical location with a quiet and beautiful scenery. You can overlook the star of Chrysanthemum Island and the painted oil drums of the First Fishing Port. The beautiful scenery in the port is quiet and you can spend your leisurely vacation. It is also close to the Zushi Temple Night Market, so you can eat endless food. There is also a Life Museum (a museum that allows you to understand the customs and culture of Penghu), Confucius Temple, and Martyrs' Shrine. Whether it is transportation, food, historical site tours, or entertainment, it is very convenient!

stays.name: 溫蒂媽媽民宿
stays.description: 位於澎湖的有善民宿,澎湖的媳婦--溫蒂媽媽 當我在1988年第一次來到澎湖旅遊時，我就深深的愛上了澎湖這塊土地，也為了能住在這裡，所以就嫁給了，同在五專讀書的老公，老公常說:我是愛澎湖，勝過於他。 能住在澎湖這個美麗的地方，是我今生最大的幸福，這裡的人很善良和純樸，有清澈的海水，新鮮的空氣，海水是我和家人的玩伴，我們全家人都熱愛游泳。 在這裡我認識了一些來澎湖旅遊的外國朋友，一直到現在，我們的感情就像家人一樣，當我到國外去拜訪他們時，都受到他們熱情的款待，為了他們能常回來看我們，溫蒂媽媽民宿就是他們的娘家。

stays.description: 澎湖夏日新民宿推薦：橙欣民宿極致休閒享受！1.鄰近機場，快速入住這間全新建造的民宿，距離澎湖機場僅需五分鐘車程，無論是否啟程回家，您輕鬆安排行程，享受旅途中的便利。2.現代奢華，完美住宿房屋新建全新民宿，設置感應互動式電梯，每個房間均配有獨立空調系統和寬敞的私人陽台，為您提供最大程度舒適的休息空間，讓您每刻都沐浴家的溫暖。3.探索澎湖，交通四通八達靠近主要縣道，探索澎湖的各處景點和浪漫海灘，輕而易舉。4. 當地風味，美味早餐供應提供網紅排隊特色早餐，讓您免去排隊的辛勞，醒來後便能在餐桌上享用澎湖的特色飲食文化。5.夜幕即將來臨，星空盡收眼底晚上，登上民宿頂層觀景台，眺望澎湖灣的璀璨夜景和繁星點點，這片浪漫的海上星空將成為您旅行中最難忘的時刻。橙欣民宿不僅是理想的住宿選擇，更是探索澎湖風光、夏日風情和文化魅力的絕佳起點。我們將盡所能提供服務，為您帶來一段充滿回憶的難忘之旅。澎湖橙欣民宿官網:https://sites.google.com/view/chengxinminsu

stays.name: 澎湖風鳶民宿
stays.description: 「澎湖風鳶」為澎湖首座兼具節能、通風、採光、環境綠美化及生物多樣性之低碳綠能民宿；主要提供遊客享受澎湖鄉村的自然寧靜，體驗當地農漁事生活與風土民情、產業文化、人文景觀、自然生態等知性渡假旅遊資訊，高質量的客製化行程規劃感動服務，滿足不同族群的旅遊休閒與商務需求；獲交通部觀光局「好客民宿」星級旅宿評鑑標章表揚，行政院環保署環保旅店與跟著董事長遊台灣經典民宿、國防部福利總處、國軍軍眷住宅公用合作社優良特約商店。
stays.descriptionEn: Penghu fong yuan homestay is the first low-carbon green-based BB&B facility in Penghu attributing to its design focus on energy-saving, ventilation, light-introducing, green beautification and diversified biological environment. Here, visitors may enjoy the natural tranquility of the Penghu countryside, experience the fishery life of the local people while learning the vacation and touring information in aspects of folk customs, industrial culture, cultural landscape and eco-system, etc. With high-quality custom-made itinerary planning and heart-touching services, it can satisfy the touring, leisure and business demands of different groups. In the meantime, it is also honored “Hospitable B&BB&B” class of assessment and citation by the Tourism Bureau under the Ministry of Transportation and Communications, the “Green Hostel Award” issued by Environmental Protection Administration under the Executive Yuan, the classic BB&B recommended by “Follow the President to Visit Around Taiwan” TV program, and the superior chartered store honored by Military Dependent Housing Public Cooperative under the Directorate General of Welfare Service under Ministry of National Defense.

stays.descriptionEn: Cora Sea Homestay is in Suogang Township, Magong, Penghu. Magong Airport is 3.5 km north, about 6 or 7 minutes away. Shan Shui Beach is 3 km south. The downtown is 9 km to the west, a 20-minute drive. Squid and sardine fishing are popular in Suogang. The village still has fish stoves and two century-old shigandang, memorial tablets to ward off evil, which have been classified as third-degree monuments. To the north and south shine like two small dunes.

stays.name: 白日夢海景民宿(特色民宿)
stays.description: 澎湖｜ 白日夢海景旅店．夢遊白雲裡的棉花糖飛船窗外那自由自在的白雲流浪在藍空中，讓窗內渴望旅行的心蠢蠢欲動，車內音響傳來一陣悠揚的配樂，將思緒牽引到騰空的幻想，路邊那幢被潔白圍繞的柔軟夢境，彷彿一踏進，即刻乘上一艘棉花糖飛船……，你，正身在澎湖迷人的白日夢裡！夢幻系夏天打開白日夢的大門，彷彿來到女孩的夢幻天堂，有照耀著陽光的大片草地，綠油油地將煩惱都除去，草地上的公主床溫柔地擁抱著假期、清澈湛藍的游泳池讓人好想一躍而下、感受沁涼！，玩耍後，躺上陽光下的木製躺椅，溫暖自己的身軀，往西邊望去，是一望無際的海景。看著清透的水面上漂浮著繽紛俏皮的游泳圈，笑靨不自覺地掛在嘴邊，這樣的夏天，是從夢裡蹦出來的吧？當穿著花瓣裙的可愛主人禾詩從門裡走出時，你才想起這是真實存在的地方，隨著禾詩的腳步一同踏入白日夢，輕鬆的氛圍添上浪漫的公主風配色，這不正是女孩最期待的夢境？白日夢畫布一樓挑高的空間和半面雪白的牆鋪展著空間，偌大的窗戶將屋外的風景收攏，也讓大廳寬敞明亮，馬卡龍配色的小抱枕在沙發上，像繽紛的斑點灑在畫布上一樣搶眼可愛；走到一旁的餐廳區，美味的黑糖糕和風茹茶已經擺在桌子上歡迎你，悠閒的點心時間讓人感覺自己化身備受呵護的公主與王子，在夢裡的城堡享受下午茶，一邊與好姊妹聊天、一邊品嚐美味，旅人綺麗的天馬行空，在這裡可以毫不保留地恣意揮灑。沿著樓梯與戶外陽台漫步，可以看見禾詩如何用心地打造這個白色的夢境，在純白的牆上鑲著月亮和星星、坐在牆上小窗台的可愛水手娃娃，白日夢所有的飾品和格局全是禾詩一家親手設計的，她們的可愛巧思在這裡各個角落隨處可拾，彷彿就為了某天與你相遇、給你驚喜！踩在雲端的腳尖走進房間，精緻的備品籃裝著馬鞭草的沐浴用品和一雙軟絨絨的室內拖鞋，這是禾詩專門委外訂做的，就是要你穿起來就像舒服地踩在雲端上，讓每一刻，都是白日夢的真實觸感。
stays.descriptionEn: Penghu｜ DaydreamCotton candy spaceship sailing the white clouds of a dreamOutside the car window, carefree white clouds drift in the blue sky, stirring up the wanderlust of the travelers within. The radio provides melodious accompaniment invoking further flights of fancy. Beside the road sits Daydream, Penghu Islands’ enchanting guesthouse, like a cotton candy spaceship just waiting to fly you away!Summer fantasyOpen the gates to this dreamland and behold a fantasy paradise out of a young girl’s daydream. A princess bed sits in the middle of a vast green field. Teak lounge chairs surround an inviting, clear swimming pool. Glance westward and behold an endless ocean view. There’s a variety of charming inflatable swim rings floating upon the clear water of the pool. The whole summer scene seems to have burst from a dream.Only when Heshi, the owner of this dreamland, walks out the front doors in her flowery skirt to greet you do you realize that this place is truly real. You follow Heshi into Daydream guesthouse, contemplating the relaxing atmosphere and princess-style decor which seems just like a little girl’s fantasy land.A daydream canvasThe high ceilings and huge windows make for a spacious and bright lobby. Macaron-colored sofa cushions catch the eye like bright paint splattered across a canvas. Tasty brown sugar cakes and tisane tea, a local specialty, sit welcomingly on the table before you. Travelers move unconstrained throughout the space.As you stroll up the stairs and along the outdoor balcony, you observe the attentive efforts Heshi has put into the creation of this white dreamland. Moon and star inlays decorate pure white walls. Cute little sailor dolls adorn window sills. Every element of the decor and design was executed personally by Heshi and her family, with their cute and dainty ornaments appearing in every corner as if awaiting to surprise you upon arrival!Tiptoeing in the cloudsYou enter a room, where a basket of exquisite Verbena bath products and velvety soft slippers sits on the bed waiting for you. The slippers are customized according to Heshi’s requirements. She wants you to feel so comfortable it’s as if you’re walking above the clouds, making sure that every second you spend at Daydream is a real sensual experience.The room overlooking the ocean offers more than just an impressive seaside view - the Penghu sunset makes a daily appearance as well. After dark, if your visit happens to be during the Penghu Fireworks Festival, you can admire the fireworks exploding into colorful blooms in the distance out of the same windows. No matter what time it is at Daydream guesthouse, the most splendid views are there for you just outside the window.Daydream guesthouse does everything possible to give you a genuine dreamland experience. In the future, whenever you look out the window of a plane and see white clouds drifting through blue skies, you’ll think of that time when you rode the cotton candy spaceship in Penghu.

stays.name: 福容徠旅 澎湖
stays.description: 福容徠旅 澎湖島嶼度假勝地・趣海島漫遊藍白交織的「郵輪飯店」外觀，成為澎湖獨特風格的地標建築，每扇窗都是對風景的邀請，每道曲線彷彿正迎風啟航，飯店鄰近馬公第三漁港，距馬公機場約15分鐘車程，至馬公港僅約5分鐘，交通便利。全館102間溫馨客房，空間設計簡約而溫潤，讓旅人自在沉浸於慢活時光。澎湖四季皆宜旅遊：春賞海濱花影、夏玩沁涼水上活動、秋嚐在地美食文化、冬觀季節候鳥風姿，建議安排行程三天兩夜以上漫遊澎湖，這裡是放鬆身心、療癒旅程的理想選擇。 推薦景點：馬公古蹟群、跳島風光、七美雙心石滬、天后宮、跨海大橋澎湖縣馬公市大賢街99號06-9221888

stays.description: 葉媽媽是負責房間打掃的女主人，對於房間的衛生整潔很重視，所以我們民宿的客房可是很乾淨漂亮的唷！我們民宿有三種房間類型，分別是雙人房、四人房及八人房，位於馬公市區中心，所以並沒有依山傍海的景致，但卻有地利的優勢唷，可以隨意的逛街並品嚐澎湖的道地小吃美食，另外市區的景點可是非常有名的，有菊島之星、漁人碼頭、夏日風情、海洋之母、中央老街、媽祖宮、四眼井、中正路鬧區，順城門、觀音亭（彩虹橋）、澎湖開拓館、海洋資源館等，都是不可錯過的好去處。

stays.name: 綠空間民宿
stays.description: 澎湖是個有美麗豐富自然地質地景，歷史人文藝術兼具，海洋漁獲資源生態豐富的地方，適合多次體驗，深度探詢的旅遊景點，春夏秋冬皆有不同呈現的美，無重工業污染的海鮮、在地美食、島嶼、沙灘、潮汐、玄武岩地質、碧海藍天 、晨光暮日....數不清的自然美麗地景等待您來漫遊細細共享體會～ ［綠空間］的設計結合綠能概念，採光通風、自然無漆料的天然石材牆面、室內多用原木設計，衛浴乾濕分離，數位科技馬桶，乳膠獨立筒床墊，房間皆有獨立陽台可欣賞戶外海天美景，各樓層皆有好友們可共享的大露台，每一位來到澎湖旅遊的友人們，能夠放下在城市的煩悶壓力，在綠空間裏簡單的享受放輕鬆的放空日子！ 綠空間位處於澎湖鎖港25縣道的海邊，晨曦日落皆可觀賞，能見度佳時更可遠望中央山脈山海連天，距離機場僅5分鐘，隘門金沙灘約6分鐘，山水沙灘更只需3分鐘，夜釣小、海底漫步只需2-3分鐘，至馬公市區僅10分鐘路程，景色地理位置極佳。

stays.description: 很多人都在問Mirage 不是美海奇的翻譯阿...阿這是怎麼來的..當初要設計這民宿名字真是很傷腦筋...想要的名字google都蒐的到，不然都是很俗的名字例如：愛琴海.....我媽選的....哈哈因為我弟弟很愛喝咖啡，有次遇到市區某店老闆，我弟弟便問老闆名字的由來，老闆稀哩呼嚕講了一大篇，讓我知道，名字要有故事！偶然朋友跟我弟弟說可以叫海市蜃樓....我弟弟心想好像還不錯，但是太普通了，名字也不好唸，沒想到維基百科有解釋。【英文字源自拉丁文的mirare，再經由法文的mirage而來，意思是 {看見的奇景}，也就是海市蜃樓。】而我們的民宿~美海奇~正是由法文音譯中文而來。每一個人心中都有一個夢想，我跟我弟弟的夢想是能有一棟屬於自己的房子，整棟房子從無到有都是自己一手包辦，當然以小弟及我兄弟的才能想設計一棟房子是很難的，所以退而求其次，內部的裝潢設計、傢俱擺飾，都是親自處理；那麼既然有了自己的夢想，那麼何不如將我們的夢想讓更多人知道呢??所以我跟我兄弟的夢想從此將為世人所知!!【注意事項】凡住宿即提供澎湖機場（馬公碼頭）來回免費接機（船）服務，請於住房前30日告知飛機班次或船班時間。依房型免費提供代訂早餐(有目錄)，雙人房提供2份早餐，四人房提供4份早餐，以此類推，每人額度50元，可自行加費用加購。早餐供應時間為上午7時開始。為維護房客權益，禁止攜帶寵物入住。為維護社區安寧，晚上10時以後及清晨7時前，請避免於本民宿內外大聲喧嘩。本民宿全面禁止吸菸、酗酒及其他違法行為。請愛惜本民宿內外所有設施。貴重物品應自行妥善保管，外出時請務必隨身攜帶，本民宿不負保管之責。為節能減碳，房客外出時請務必將房內電源及電器用品關閉，謝謝合作。本民宿在大廳及門口有裝設監視器，若有顧慮之客人，請勿訂房。本民宿包棟需與民宿管家同住，民宿管家留在民宿居住，是慎防客人有緊急需求，須請人處理問題，若須包棟訂房或零散訂房之客人，無法接受，請勿訂房，謝謝。【延期與退費說明】匯款後若因故欲更改日期，請於7日前通知，可保留房間三個月，否則訂金沒收、恕不另行通知。取消訂房說明（以下退費皆須酌收手續費100元）：於住宿日起算14天前(含住宿當日)通知退訂者，可全額退還訂金或保留訂金6個月。於住宿日起算10至13天前(含住宿當日)通知退訂者，可退還訂金70%(酌收手續費100元)或保留訂金6個月。於住宿日起算7至9天前(含住宿當日)通知退訂者，可退還訂金50%或保留訂金6個月。於住宿日起算4至6天前(含住宿當日)通知退訂者，可退還訂金30%或保留訂金6個月。未於住宿日起算3天前(含住宿當日)通知退訂者，恕不接受改期或退訂。住房當天如遇不可抗力之因素(如颱風、地震等)，導致飛機班次或船班取消時(依當地縣市政府公告為準)可選擇:全額退還訂金或保留訂金6個月。如住房當天本縣處於紅色旅遊警戒地區，本民宿將全額退還訂金。若您須要訂房或想進一步洽詢任何問題，請與『Mirage美海奇民宿』聯繫，電話【0910-884-720(蕭元哲)】。交通資訊:【衛星定位】民宿衛星定位座標：經度(E)23.577413 緯度(N)119.583507
stays.descriptionEn: Many people are asking if Mirage is not the translation of Mei Haiqi...Ah, how did this come about?It was really a headache to design the name of this B&B...You can search any name you want on Google, otherwise they are all very common names, such as: Aegean Sea... My mom chose it... HahaBecause my brother loves drinking coffee, one time when he met the owner of a store in the city, my brother asked the owner about the origin of his name. The owner talked a lot and made me realize that a name must have a story!By chance, a friend told my brother that it could be called a mirage…My brother thought it seemed pretty good, but it was too common and the name was hard to pronounce. I didn’t expect Wikipedia to have an explanation.[The English word comes from the Latin word mirare, which then comes from the French word mirage, meaning "a strange sight seen," that is, a mirage. 】Our homestay, Meihaiqi, is a transliteration of French into Chinese.Everyone has a dream in their heart. My brother and I dream of having our own house.I built the entire house from scratch by myself.Of course, it is difficult for me and my brother to design a house with our talents.So as a second choice, I personally handled the interior design and furniture decoration;Now that we have our own dreams, why not let more people know about our dreams?So my brother and I's dream will be known to the world from now on!!【Notes】All accommodations include free round-trip pick-up (ferry) service from Penghu Airport (Magong Pier). Please inform the flight or ferry schedule 30 days before check-in.Free breakfast is provided according to the room type (there is a catalogue). Double rooms provide 2 breakfasts, quad rooms provide 4 breakfasts, and so on. The quota per person is 50 yuan, and you can purchase additional breakfasts at your own expense.Breakfast is served from 7am. To protect the rights of tenants, pets are not allowed.To maintain community peace, please refrain from making loud noises inside or outside the homestay after 10pm and before 7am.Smoking, drinking and other illegal activities are strictly prohibited in this property.Please take good care of all facilities inside and outside this homestay.Valuables should be kept properly by yourself. Please be sure to carry them with you when you go out. This homestay is not responsible for their safekeeping.To save energy and reduce carbon emissions, please be sure to turn off the power and electrical appliances in the room when you go out. Thank you for your cooperation.This B&B has surveillance cameras installed in the lobby and at the door. If you have any concerns, please do not book a room.Guests who book a room in this B&B must live with the B&B manager. The B&B manager stays in the B&B to prevent guests from having urgent needs and needing to hire someone to handle the problem. If guests need to book a room in the whole building or book individual rooms, we cannot accept this. Please do not book a room. Thank you.【Delay and Refund Instructions】If you wish to change the date for any reason after remittance, please notify us 7 days in advance and the room can be reserved for three months. Otherwise, the deposit will be forfeited without further notice.Instructions for cancelling a reservation (the following refunds are subject to a handling fee of 100 yuan):If you notify us of your cancellation 14 days before your stay (including the day of your stay), your deposit will be fully refunded or retained for 6 months.If you notify us of cancellation 10 to 13 days before the check-in date (including the check-in date), 70% of the deposit will be refunded (with a handling fee of NT$100) or the deposit will be retained for 6 months.If you notify us of cancellation 7 to 9 days before the check-in date (including the check-in date), 50% of the deposit will be refunded or the deposit will be retained for 6 months.If you cancel your reservation 4 to 6 days before the check-in date (including the check-in date), 30% of the deposit will be refunded or the deposit will be retained for 6 months.If you do not notify us of cancellation 3 days before your stay (including the day of your stay), we will not accept any changes or cancellations.If there is force majeure (such as typhoon, earthquake, etc.) on the day of check-in, resulting in the cancellation of flight or boat flights (subject to the announcement of the local county or city government), you can choose to: refund the deposit in full or keep the deposit for 6 months.If the county is in a red tourism alert area on the day of check-in, the B&B will refund the deposit in full.If you need to book a room or want to inquire about any further questions, please contact Mirage B&B at [0910-884-720 (Xiao Yuanzhe)].Transportation Information:【Satellite positioning】Satellite coordinates of the B&B: Longitude (E) 23.577413 Latitude (N) 119.583507

stays.name: 花妹民宿
stays.description: 「澎湖住宿‧花妹民宿」位在渡假勝地-澎湖，坐擁絕佳地理位置，在陽台上可以在寧靜的夜晚抬頭一望就能看到星星俏皮地眨眼，想輕鬆享受這麼美的景色非得親自來趟「澎湖花妹民宿.住宿‧」！ 「花妹」提供雅房、雙人房與四人房，不論是單身出門散心、情侶甜蜜出遊、好友歡樂旅行以及家庭天倫之旅都能挑選到適合的房型入住，「花妹」也有提供包棟服務，即便是員工旅遊或畢業小旅行皆能夠滿足您的需求！ 「澎湖‧花妹民宿」備有多樣化格調各異的套房房型，不論是輕工業、海洋風情、浪漫甜美、粉紅玫瑰，或是小孩喜歡的童趣風氣～這裡通通都有！旅客們可以自己挑選喜歡的風格，恣意享受輕鬆愉悅的菊島假期～

stays.name: 菘之屋民宿
stays.description: 澎湖菊島的清新小屋【菘之屋】、位於馬公市效，部份日式現代感的外觀建築，以一橫一豎的筆直線條勾勒出簡約俐落且時尚的雅緻氣質，參雜著些許的木質元素和小花輔綠意花草，讓整體更為柔和淡雅。澎湖菘之屋、備有簡易舒適的雙人、四人及六人房，開闊寬敞的空間格局，新穎明亮且通風。以舒適的寢具、完備的家具和簡單的小物佈景，融會高雅的裝潢設計，展現空間的單純與清新，也讓來訪的旅人備感溫馨舒爽。
stays.descriptionEn: "Song Jhih Wu Homestay" presents as a modern, elegant Japanese style building comprising straight lines, wood materials and miniature garden and showing harmony. In "Song Jhih Wu Homestay", you can select from rooms for 2, 4 or 6, and all of them are spacious with adequate lighting and air exchange. Also, the comfortable bed, full furniture set, simple decorations and quality interior shows optimal use of space and make every visitor feel at home.

stays.description: 萊恩晴旅位於澎湖縣馬公市西衛里，緊鄰市區（車程3-5分鐘），距離澎湖機場約8公里（車程12～15分鐘），距離馬公港約3.5公里（車程7～10分鐘），距離觀音亭(花火節施放地點)約2.9公里(車程5-7分鐘)，無論是到市區逛街品嚐美食、或是到觀音亭觀賞花火、或是到沙灘海邊曬太陽玩沙踏浪都很方便，交通位置相當便利。 萊恩晴旅是一間以7歲兒子Ryan命名的透天別墅，屋內住著一家三口簡單的家庭，目前提供四間舒適的房間給旅客入住。 萊恩晴旅經營的出發點是以「家」為概念，希望提供給旅客們一個像家一樣舒適的住宿空間，努力打造出每一間好的臥房、好的環境和提供好的服務，讓旅客們都可以帶著全家大小一同入住渡假，在這個寧靜又舒適的住處與親朋好友們甜蜜相聚渡過幸福快樂的時光，也讓自己的身心能好好放鬆一下。民宿共有五房，目前提供四房(四人房二間、雙人房二間)給旅客入住。 房客使用權限包含可共同使用客廳、餐廳、廚房(可烹飪)、戶外庭院、二樓自助吧台、三樓自助吧台。其他注意事項有民宿內及房間陽台一律禁止吸菸吸毒等違法行為，請您至一樓戶外庭院吸菸；另晚上10點後至早上8點前請降低音量避免擾鄰。

stays.name: 蘿蔔民宿
stays.description: - 一座隱藏於菊島煙花下的暖心美宿 - 『澎湖菊島，蘿蔔的橘』，由一位自由派藝術家主理，將情感〝畫〞為藝術，打造出宛如畫廊的住宿空間，每個房間都蘊含獨特故事，融入主理人的藝術創作，讓旅程充滿驚喜與靈感。 浪漫溫馨的氛圍，遠離城市喧囂的自由夢境，這裡是旅人們的心靈驛站 —— 人生如旅，途中相遇，縱是萍水相逢，也值得片刻駐足相伴。

stays.name: 觀海別墅
stays.description: 早在1993年起即開始經營民宿的我們，可以算是澎湖最早經營民宿的店家之一，為了打造心目中理想的民宿，阿順花了很多時間和老婆大人到處收集資料，也實地考察了許多優質民宿；在打造沙灘城堡與觀海別墅的過程中，我們秉持著打造《澎湖最好的優質民宿》的初衷，一路前進。在此阿順也衷心的感謝老婆大人與家人無怨無悔的支持！澎湖民宿佔地300坪，分別為觀海別墅與沙灘城堡(觀海別墅二館)，沙灘城堡都為四人房，主要是為家庭式與朋友相聚的客人所設計，而觀海別墅則多為二人套房，專為夫妻或情侶所設計，二棟民宿均走南洋渡假風格，所有的房間均有陽台可眺望山水沙灘與大海，阿順希望能提供一個優閒的渡假空間給旅客，也希望能讓每個旅客擁有滿滿的美好回憶，希望所有住宿的旅客能用慢活的方式細細品味-屬於您的澎湖之旅。
stays.descriptionEn: Since 1993 , we began operating B&B that can be regarded as one of the first Penghu B&B stores.In order to create the ideal of B&B , A-Shun boss and his wife spent a lot of time to gather information everywhere , and also to investigate a lot of high-quality B&B ;In the process to build Sea-view villas and Beach castle villas , we uphold to create "The Penghu best quality B&B in mind , all the way forward.Hereby , A-Shun sincerely thanks to his wife along with their families regrets for their support !Sea-view villas and Beach castle villas are about 990 square meters , Beach castle are quadruple rooms that primarily designed for family and friends to get together , and Sea-view villas are mostly double rooms, designed for couples or lovers . Both of them are south eastern style , and all the rooms have balconies that can overlook the beach and sea . A-Shun hope to provide a space for leisure vacation travelers , and also want to make every passenger has full of great memories , hoping that all passengers can stay the way to savor the slow living, Belong to your Penghu trip.

stays.name: 語榕花園民宿
stays.description: 以寧靜舒適的環境與永續旅行理念，為旅人打造海島住宿體驗。規劃季節限定的生態文化小旅行，結合在地工藝、自然探索與人文風情，帶您深入感受澎湖的獨特韻味。秉持綠色旅宿精神，從節能設施到減塑行動，致力於降低旅遊對環境的影響。無論是悠閒放鬆、手作工藝，或漫步於海風輕拂的海岸，帶您細細品味澎湖慢旅的理想選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: With a tranquil and comfortable environment rooted in the principles of sustainable travel, we offer a unique island accommodation experience. Our seasonal eco-cultural tours blend local craftsmanship, nature exploration, and cultural heritage, allowing you to immerse yourself in the charm of Penghu. Committed to green hospitality, we implement energy-saving facilities and plastic reduction initiatives to minimize the environmental impact of travel. Whether you seek relaxation, hands-on crafting, or a leisurely stroll along the sea breeze-kissed shores, we invite you to savor the essence of slow travel in Penghu.

stays.name: 貝富門澎湖灣行旅
stays.description: 前身是莒光新村的澎湖灣行旅，是跨越日據和國民政府兩個時代的歷史眷村，為全台最古老的眷村。渡假村共60間客房。每房皆是獨立的一棟平房在紅磚、水泥，乃至鋼筋等建築材料出現以前，澎湖的住宅多半由咾咕石或澎湖特有的玄武岩岩塊搭建的。渡假村所有客房所間隔的矮牆就是由咾咕石堆砌而成，房屋牆體外觀也可以看到一塊塊的玄武岩蹤影走在清幽恬靜的園區中，可以感受到這裡的寧靜與美好。園區每一角都充滿著懷舊復古的眷村味，彷彿穿越到純樸的50-60年代
stays.descriptionEn: Known previously as Juguang New Village, a military dependent’s village, Penghu Bay Resort has its history rooted across two different historical eras: Japanese colonization, and the exodus of the Republic of China Government from China. Juguang New Village is one of the oldest military dependent’s village in Taiwan.Penghu Bay Resort offers 60 individual rooms. Each room is its own bungalow.Before the advent of red brick, concrete, and materials like steel rebars for construction, much of Penghu’s residences were made from coral stone or Penghu’s specialty: basalt.Every room in the resort is separated by a wall of coral stone, and when viewed from the outside, one can see the individual basalt pieces that form the outer wall of the bungalows.Walking in the quiet resort, you can feel the tranquility and beauty of this historic village.Every corner of this resort is filled with history and nostalgia, transporting you through time back to the simpler 50s and 60s Taiwan.

stays.name: 賽蒙特民宿
stays.description: 坐在沙灘上，海風撫過略帶凌亂的秀髮，緩緩的抬起頭來，感受陽光灑在臉上的幸福，渡假就該這樣愜意自在。「澎湖住宿‧賽蒙特民宿」位在渡假勝地-澎湖，坐擁絕佳地理位置，在陽台上就可遠眺散發銀色光芒的大海，寧靜的夜晚抬頭望就能看到星星俏皮地眨眼，想輕鬆享受這麼美的景色非得親自來趟「澎湖住宿‧賽蒙特民宿」！「澎湖住宿‧賽蒙特民宿」提供雅房、雙人房與四人房，不論是單身出門散心、情侶甜蜜出遊、好友歡樂旅行以及家庭天倫之旅都能挑選到適合的房型入住，「澎湖住宿‧賽蒙特民宿」也有提供包棟服務，即便是員工旅遊或畢業小旅行皆能夠滿足您的需求！「澎湖住宿‧賽蒙特民宿」是個愛作夢愛幻想的民宿，總幻想著能成為阿姆斯壯,迎向月球，走向星空，喜愛科幻片蒐藏太空戰士，希望能打造出太空科幻的飄渺場景，讓旅人放鬆自我，遠離煩惱，跟著「澎湖住宿‧賽蒙特民宿」一起來趟澎湖冒險旅程！

stays.description: 民宿可使用國旅旅遊補助【訂房後請務必加官方LINE ID】:@354dlaat【臉書粉頁】:@penghuspeace歡迎來到「邂逅老街精緻民宿」，這是一棟承載家族記憶的老宅，位於馬公市最古老的中央街。過去是商號、是住家，也是一段段故事的起點。如今我們用心修繕，保留老屋風貌，融入現代設計，讓旅人感受時光與溫度。民宿位處市中心，步行可達多個景點。夜晚老街靜謐，白天則熱鬧迷人，適合細細品味旅程。我們與在地人氣早餐店合作，讓您免排隊享用美味早餐，是我們的小小貼心。這裡是寵物友善空間，無論獨旅、情侶、家庭或毛小孩同行，我們都誠摯歡迎。願您在「邂逅老街」不只是落腳，更留下難忘記憶。

stays.description: 澎湖 Wild Hotel 野渡假旅店有別於澎湖旅宿業的清新風格，以鮮明獨特的工業風格設計，獨樹澎湖旅宿的全新「粗野」的奔放風格。LOGO黑漬感的W字樣為首 , 以山與水的型態代表澎湖的地景及海洋 , 狂野的大自然中 , 像家一樣的靜候著旅人們歸巢。房內原始的水泥牆，看見澎湖最原始的「狂野」魅力，牆面砌上復古紅磚，民宿主人秉持匠人精神 , 提供乾淨 , 舒適 , 安靜的環境 , 躺在床上就能感受像家一般溫馨的「Wild」。澎湖 Wild Hotel 野渡假旅店的地理位置優越，來到澎湖，就要與海共舞。在Wild Hotel只需步行3~5分，即可欣賞海洋的一片遼闊。步行3~5分鐘有24H便利超商/自助洗衣店 & 全聯超市及各式風味餐廳 , 距離市中心商店街步行約15分鐘。澎湖的「野」生活，邀您一起放空體驗。

stays.description: 澎湖2010年新蓋地下1樓，地上11層，總共150間客房的雅霖景觀大飯店，一樓接待大廳佔地三百坪，設有早餐吧和咖啡吧及商務中心；二樓為擺設40桌之中餐廳、會議室，讓您用餐中也能享受第三漁港景觀；三樓設有健身房、烤箱室和蒸氣室，室外另有25公尺標準游泳池和spa池，是各界囑目的澎湖新地標，位於第三漁港馬公市未來商業中心，緊臨南海遊客中心，不僅設備新，視野好，創意也十足，讓住客充滿驚喜。
stays.descriptionEn: Ya Ling Hotel was opened in 2010 and boasts 12 floors, including one basement floor, and 150 refined rooms. The first floor lobby covers almost 1,000 square meters, and is home to a breakfast bar, coffee bar, and business center. The second floor contains a 40-seat Chinese restaurant and a conference room, offering fantastic views over the harbor as you dine. The third floor has a gym, sauna, and steam room, along with a 25m swimming pool and a spa. Situated in the growing commercial center of Magong City near the Third Fishing Port, it is also near the Nanhai Visitors Center, offering convenience alongside the excellent views, creative design, and comprehensive, brand-new facilities.

stays.name: 雲享民宿
stays.description: 蒼海白「雲」～浪漫盡「享」「澎湖民宿‧澎湖雲享民宿」位於馬公市區，鄰近馬公港，不論您要騎車前往馬公市區品嘗美食、走訪歷史古蹟；或是您要驅車前往南環，造訪山水沙灘、蒔裡海灘、蛇頭山或風櫃洞…等自然風景；還是您想搭船漫遊七美、望安…等濱海島嶼都十分方便。「澎湖民宿‧澎湖雲享民宿」外觀採行簡明俐落的現代感直線設計，搭配整面落地玻璃的光亮大廳，呈現非凡的壯闊氣度。坐落於市區周邊的良好地理位置，不僅保有交通的便利性，更帶來了遠離喧囂及可眺望綠地的視野景觀，讓您能夠盡情徜徉於澎湖的熱情陽光。「澎湖民宿‧澎湖雲享民宿」提供雙人、四人及可容納五人至六人的通舖套房，房間內部也採用同樣的現代化風格，寬敞的房間空間、方正的臥房格局、搭配開闊的採光照明，讓屋內通風良好且光線極佳。省去繁雜富麗的裝潢佈景和造景陳設，僅以整潔的臥房空間、簡單的家具設備和明媚的窗外景色，讓旅人回到最原始本質的家居氣息，真正享有回到自家一般的放鬆感受。倘若您有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【0918-348211、0912-968211】或LINE ID【wls348211】澎湖民宿‧澎湖雲享民宿。
stays.descriptionEn: "Yun Xiang Homestay" in Penghu is located at Magong Downtown, with Magong Harbor not far away. It is convenient to ride to the downtown for a few local specialty dishes and a visit to historical sites, or to drive to Nanhuan to take a walkthrough of Shanshui Beach, Shihli Beach, Serpent Head Mountain, Fongguei Cave and other scenic sites. You may also take a ferry to Qimei, Wangan or other smaller islands! "Yun Xiang" applies simple, modernist design with French windows in the lobby to show unmatched excellence. It sits at an ideal location at the edge of the downtown area where the you can reach your destinations "Yun Xiang Homestay" provides rooms for two or four as well as group rooms for five to six guests. The modern design provides good lighting and leaves abundant space for relaxing. "Yun Xiang" does not shine with luxurious decorations and themed interiors, but keeps the budget for clean bedrooms, fair utensils and most importantly, the clear sky reminds you the simple happiness of suburban life! For any questions, feel free to consult by dialing 0918-348211 or 0912-968211, or by LINE "wls348211".

stays.name: 雲涵堡休閒民宿
stays.description: 民宿緣起.........對於一個想要二度就業又可以兼顧到小孩的我來說，經營澎湖民宿無疑是一個很好的事業，而且最重要的是經營民宿過程中又可以結交到更多的好朋友。有了這個念頭便開始有所行動，首先必須先說服阿勇（我的老公），因為要經營民宿必定要有房子，這是要花一大筆費用的，而且跟阿勇預計擁有房子的計劃提早了好幾年，但拗不過我的堅持，最後還是決定放手去做。要做就不能是普通的房子，一定要有特色的。於是阿勇把他打電玩「世紀帝國」的構想，加到我們的城堡民宿上，這也成為了整棟建築的特色，或許我們看不到澎湃的海洋，但我們可以讓您在玩了一天的海洋活動後，能擁有享受寧靜的山野。而且我們堅持做好每件事，希望大家有緣能一起來感受與眾不同的城堡民宿。
stays.descriptionEn: The origin of the homestay......For me, who wants a second job and can take care of my children, I run Penghu B&B.It is undoubtedly a good career, and the most important thing is that in the process of running a homestay, you can make friends withMore good friends. With this idea, I started to act. First of all, I had to convince Ayong (my husband),Because to run a homestay, you must have a house, which costs a lot of money.Moreover, I had planned to own a house several years ahead of schedule with Ayong, but I couldn't resist my insistence, so I finally decided to let it go.It can't be an ordinary house, it must have characteristics. So Ayong put his idea of playing the video game "Empire of the Century",Added to our castle homestay, this has also become the feature of the whole building, maybe we can't see the surging ocean,But we can let you enjoy the peaceful mountains after a day of marine activities. And we keep doing itIn everything, I hope everyone has the predestined relationship to experience the unique castle B&B together.

stays.description: 顏韻風帆，一間隱身在馬公市雙頭掛小巷裡的寧靜住所。距離機場車程五分鐘，離市區不遠，保有離塵的安靜。四間房各自獨立，適當地空間感與距離。不熱情打擾、不刻意寒暄，讓每一位旅人都能自在進出，把這裡當作旅途中真正能休息的地方。民宿共四間房，分別位於二、三樓，提供適合雙人與親子的小型套房。每間房皆設有獨立衛浴、冷氣與乾濕分離空間，乾淨舒適。我們相信，好的住宿，不一定需要過度服務。這裡不會主動打擾你，也不會干涉你的行程安排。有需要的時候，我會在這裡；沒有需要的時候，就安心自在地住幾天。不打擾，是一種尊重；留點距離，也是一種溫柔。民宿主人就住在一樓，不會頻繁出現及互動，但只要你有需要，隨時都能找到我。這裡不是華麗的飯店，是一點一滴慢慢啟航的空間。希望用實在的價格，提供一個簡單、乾淨、安靜的住宿選擇。歡迎你來澎湖看看，也歡迎你在這裡，好好休息。
stays.descriptionEn: Serene Sails Inn — A tranquil stay tucked away in the quiet alleys of Shuangtougua, Magong.Just a 5-minute drive from the airport and close to the city center, yet far enough to offer peace and quiet.Our four guest rooms are located on the second and third floors, each with its own private entrance and a sense of space and distance.No forced interactions, no overly enthusiastic greetings — just a calm place where every traveler can come and go freely, and truly rest.Each room is a compact suite suitable for couples or small families, equipped with private bathrooms, air conditioning, and separate wet-dry zones — clean, simple, and comfortable.We believe that good accommodation doesn’t require overbearing service.We won’t disturb you or interfere with your travel plans.When you need something, I’m here.When you don’t, feel free to stay quietly and peacefully.Silence is a form of respect.Distance, a kind of gentle care.As the host, I live on the first floor. You won’t see me often,but I’m always close by if you need anything.This is not a luxury hotel — it’s a space built slowly, bit by bit, with heart.We hope to offer an honest, clean, and quiet place to stay, at a fair price.Come see Penghu.And while you’re here, take a real rest.

stays.name: 風島民宿
stays.description: 『風島民宿』位於馬公市區，地理位置優勢，讓『風島民宿』同時擁有便利的交通及澎湖的風情與靜謐。「澎湖民宿．澎湖-風島」距離馬公港(5分鐘)、北環(20分鐘)、機場(15分鐘)，民宿位處交通往來交界處，不僅可使遊客便捷的暢遊澎湖明媚風光的景色，山明水秀和壯麗海景更近在咫尺。 「澎湖民宿‧澎湖風島民宿」民宿老闆為了能夠讓每位來澎湖的旅客都能玩得開心、住的安心，在興建過程中，透過高度嚴密的監督，房間所有材質均以高規格的品質要求，設有多種溫馨的客房空間，包含乾濕分離的浴室、”獨立筒”床墊、強化玻璃、窗簾、隔音設備...等所有客房用品，不論在品質或是安全上，絕對讓你擁有高度享受。\^0^/ 民宿親切而熱情的服務、乾淨整潔的房型，讓遊客們在深入感受澎湖當地風土民情的同時，也能享有一處舒適寧靜的休息環境。 倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【0981-161485 李小姐】澎湖民宿‧澎湖風島民宿。

stays.description: 馬公老街民宿位於馬公市中心,中央街為歷史風貌特定區，天后宮，施公祠、萬軍井，四眼井，台廈交會館等歷史古蹟都在四周。馬公老街民宿為一棟三層樓仿閩式建築的新厝，紅瓦白牆，住在這裡，穿梭老街，更引人懷思古幽情，感受先民居住之情境,鄰近觀音亭,順承門，馬公港，漁人碼頭，中正商圈，吃海鮮，購物逛街，市區觀光，步行可到觀音亭彩虹橋看夜景，選擇住這裡，讓您真正享受旅遊之快樂。預約住宿提供十項服務一、機場免費接送。二、免費提供自選早餐。三、宿內免費提供礦泉水。四、提供旅遊地圖一份。五、景點行程解說 介紹好吃的 好玩的。六、代租汽車、機車。代購行程及船票。七、提供冰蘆薈塗敷曬傷皮膚。八、一樓設交誼廳吃早餐 泡茶 喝咖啡。九、自備電腦可無線上網。十、本民宿為國民旅遊卡特約商店。
stays.descriptionEn: Makung Traditional Home Stay is situated in the heart of Magong City, in the historical area of Zhongyang Street, surrounded by places of historical note like the Matsu Temple, Shigongci (Shrine to Shi Lang), Wanjun Well (Well of Ten Thousand Troops), Siyan Well (Four-eyes Well), and the Taiwan-Xiamen Merchants Association Hall. Comprised of three buildings in a faux-ancient Hokkien style with red tiles and white walls, Makung Traditional Homestay provides a great place from which to wander the old streets and soak up the old-fashioned ambience. Nearby are the Guanyin Pavilion, Shuncheng Gate, Magong Harbor, Fisherman’s Wharf, and Zhongzheng Commercial District, making it an excellent starting point for sampling the seafood, doing some window shopping, exploring the city, or walking to the Rainbow Bridge at Guanyin Pavilion to enjoy the nighttime view. Bookings grant you 10 services: 1) airport pick-up and drop-off, 2) free breakfast buffet, 3) free mineral water in your room, 4) a tourism map, 5) a guided tour of the area, introducing the fun places to eat and visit, 6) car or scooter rental and travel or ferry vouchers, 7) cool aloe vera to help with sunburn, 8) access to the first-floor lobby, where you can enjoy breakfast, tea, or coffee, 9) wireless Internet access (bring your own computer), and 10) access to a shop that accepts the Citizen Travel Card.

stays.name: 龍弘民宿
stays.description: 龍弘民宿座落於馬公市區光復路上(路口旁為鮮茶道)鄰近北辰市場，步行至觀音亭或市區中正路約10分鐘路程。民宿設施介紹每層樓均為兩間套房，『金碧華麗』房有別於傳統床鋪為四方形特別採用圓形床鋪讓入住房客享受不同的體驗。『溫馨和風』房全面採用木質地板，整體空間舒適優雅且溫馨。房內配有基本家電(32吋電視、分離式冷氣機、吹風機、冰箱、電熱水壺)和乾溼分離盥洗室。於一樓接待大廳處設有舒適沙發可三五好友喝茶談天說地，並提供WIFI無線上網。鄰近的小吃美食有顛覆傳統燒餅作法的鐘記燒餅(沙拉、蔥蛋、鮪魚等口味)、光復路上古早味的應時勢筒仔米糕、位於市場內的老地方意緬、北辰市場古早味圓仔湯、北辰市場蚵仔麵線、北辰市場肉圓、北辰市場鹹粥等。
