stays.name: 老爺大酒店
stays.description: 台北老爺大酒店，1984年成立，委由大倉日航酒店管理集團(Okura Nikko Hotel Management Co., Ltd.)經營管理，為台灣第一家國際日航連鎖飯店(Nikko Hotels International)。酒店由日本頂尖設計公司「久米設計」全新打造，以穩重純淨的白色基調，呈現出獨特的後現代歐風，強調現代、摩登、明亮採光的穿透性空間感，隱約透露東方圖騰的韻味，令人為之驚艷。酒店設有三間主題餐廳：Le Café咖啡廳、中山日本料理廳、明宮中餐廳以及烘焙坊、Royal VIP Lounge、2間會議室及休閒設施等，可滿足客人不同之需求。這座十二層建築物位於台北市中山北路的商業中心區，45分鐘車程可至桃園國際機場、15分鐘車程可至松山國際機場、步行3分鐘可至捷運中山站 。酒店客房總數202間，新穎的客房設施，兼顧商務與休閒需求，並強調其安全性，讓每位旅客感受舒適安心。榮獲交通部觀光局星級旅館評鑑，中華民國觀光旅館最高評等「五星級觀光飯店」榮耀，肯定台北老爺大酒店細膩的服務與新穎的硬體設施，讓在國際上榮獲極高評價之台北老爺大酒店持續受到全球的矚目與青睞。
stays.descriptionEn: Hotel Royal-Nikko Taipei is an international chain hotel managed by Nikko Hotels International that operates under Okura Nikko Hotel Management Company Limited.The hotel is located on Chung Shan North Road, in the heart of Taipei's commercial district, which is suitable for both business and leisure travelers. It is a 45-minute drive from Taoyuan International Airport, a 15-minute drive from Taipei SongShan Airport , and a 3-minute walk from MRT Chung Shan Station.The hotel is a 12-storey structure with 3 basement levels. There are 202 exquisite guest rooms and suites, all furnished with Wi-Fi internet and shower toilet. The hotel was remodeled by Kume Sekkei, a leading Japanese design company. The poised, off-white base tone is designed to elicit a tranquil air and homely comfort. The fusion of modernistic European architecture and unique oriental ambience, as well as urban convenience and exquisite Japanese-style hospitality has earned high international reputation.There are three dining establishments on premise: all-day dining restaurant "Le Café", Japanese restaurant "Nakayama", and Cantonese restaurant "Ming Court". A bakery, Royal VIP Lounge, two meeting rooms, and other facilities are also available.With its top-notch facilities and services, Hotel Royal-Nikko Taipei has received five-star certification awarded by Taiwan Tourism Bureau.

stays.name: 薇閣精品旅館
stays.description: 薇閣大直旗艦館斥資十億 締造台灣時尚享樂新紀元薇閣大直館，是薇閣自成為台灣精品旅館的領導品牌以來斥資最大的旗艦館。大直館重金禮聘蔣家第四代蔣友柏 英籍旅台夜店設計大師林馬克等五大設計公司，二十多位最精銳的頂尖設計師共同打造台灣第一座Design Hotel，也是以新享樂主義概念出發的Fun-tel(funny hotel)。一個「驚奇!歡樂!感動!」一個「永遠未完成的樂園」一座巨型的圓形水晶燈，一組雅痞風又帶點頹廢的紅色沙發，臥室中超大的圓床，床邊一具唐突的十字架造型躺椅，大得誇張的浴室牆壁上，更誇張得吊掛一部65吋的大電視，我們一直在為客人「非常非常滿意」以及將薇閣視為一個「永遠未完成的樂園」而努力 現在就讓我們一起進入充滿「驚奇!歡樂!感動!」的Wego party room。近40種的主題客房 都是造夢者與實用主義的邂逅薇閣一直以來都是夢想的製造者，同時我們也了解消費者開始重視商品的內涵，講究商品的功能，並且要求凸顯獨特的個人品味與生活態度。於是此次旗艦館計既”Fun肆”又”細緻”，能兼顧把顧客的夢想變成商品之餘，又能讓客人真正的感動。在近40種的主題客房中，每個房間都是造夢者與實用主義的邂逅，都是一座成人Disney Wolrd的載具。
stays.descriptionEn: A new era of hedonism designed with fortune, only in Wego Boutique Hotel (Dazhi)Wego Boutique Hotel(dazhi) has become the flagship house of Wego with the highest investment since Wego established its leadership in the boutique hotel enterprise in Taiwan. With a considerable salary offer, Wego has hired over twenty top-class designers from five well-known design companies, including the studio of Demos Chiang, a great-grandson of Chiang Kai-shek, and Mark Lintott Design. With this collaborative effort, the first Designer Hotel in Taiwan is made, which is a realization of New Hedonism, a Fun-tel (Fun Hotel). Surprise! Delight! Excitement! – A Paradise Never CompletedA huge round chandelier, a set of yuppie-style red sofa with a tint of decadence, a king-size round bed, a distinguished armchair in the shape of a cross, and a television with its huge 65'' screen, which is hung on a dramatically big wall. With all these, we're always trying to make our guests 'over-satisfied', and view Wego as 'a paradise never completed'. Now, let's step into our Wego party room, a space of Surprise! Delight! And Excitement!40 Themed Bedrooms: an Encounter of Dream-makers and FunctionalistsWego has always been a dream-maker. In the meantime, we know the focus of the consumer is on the essence of the commodity. Therefore, a lot of our attention is paid to improve the functionality of our design and demonstrate its unique aesthetic value and personality. That's why our designs are wild and at the same time delicate, not only making the dreams of our guests tangible, but also touching our guests deeply. Our guest-rooms are furnished in as many as 40 themes, and each of them is an encounter of dream-makers and functionalists, a vehicle taking our guests to a Disneyland for adults.

stays.name: 長榮桂冠酒店 (台北)
stays.description: 長榮桂冠酒店(台北)是以豪華遊艇為主題所打造的五星級精緻酒店，它宛如是艘停泊在都會大道上的豪華遊艇，而它所停泊之處正是享譽全球的長榮海運公司昔日之企業總部。酒店位居台北國際都會金融、商業中心，政商名流相繼入住，讓您掌握咫尺商機，帷幄自如，決策千里。進入飯店映入眼簾盡是與海洋息息相關的設計及各式船模型珍藏品。船槳門把、牆面上的錨鏈飾邊、波浪形天花板、19世紀的泰晤士河古畫、施華洛世奇水晶裝飾的滿天星斗，讓您彷彿乘坐在一艘超級豪華遊艇上，航行於浩瀚大海中，透過船艙向天空眺望，處處感受到長榮桂冠酒店（台北）與海洋深厚的情感。95間寬敞舒適的豪華客房與套房，設計與內裝皆完全比照超級豪華遊艇之規格，採用進口自義大利之國寶級Dubini傢俱、荷蘭名師手工打造之24K包金洗臉盆、日式免治座廁、超音波按摩浴缸、超靜三層隔音玻璃、專屬服務按鈕、多功能事務機、42吋電視、e化無線通訊系統等。集錦各式美饌佳釀的長園廳、咖啡廳與桂冠廊，為饕客們大啖中西美食及各式飲品的殿堂，名廚掌勺，色香味美極致品味，讓食客領略師父們的精湛手藝，絕品佳餚不容錯過。休閒設施備有健身中心與Spa館，則是提供您舒緩身心的另一處靜謐桃花源。網址：http://www.evergreen-hotels.com/branch/taipei
stays.descriptionEn: Evergreen Laurel Hotel (Taipei) is a luxury yacht-themed 5-star hotel, stationed in the capitol like a great ship. The area was once the headquarters of the Evergreen Marine Corporation, and the hotel is now situated in the financial and economic center of Taiwan, frequented by politicians, business leaders, and celebrities. Come for a stay and plan your grand strategy for seizing economic opportunity. The inside of the building is filled with ocean-themed designs and a variety of ship models and valuable items, including oars, door handles, anchors and ornamental borders on the walls, a wave-shaped ceiling, 19th century paintings of the River Thames, and Swarovski crystal decorations across the ceiling, creating the feeling of riding a luxurious yacht across the wide ocean. Looking out at the sky, you can feel Evergreen Laurel Hotel’s deep connection to the sea. 95 spacious, comfortable, luxurious suites and rooms are designed and decorated at luxury yacht scale, featuring Italian nationally-acclaimed Dubini furniture, 24K gilded wash basins handmade by Dutch masters, Japanese-style bidet toilets, supersonic massage tubs, triple layer sound-proof glass, special service buttons, all-in-one printers, 42-inch TVs, and wireless communication systems. The hotel includes the Garden Hall, serving a variety of fine foods and beverages, the coffee shop and Evergreen Passage, and another large hall providing diners with a chance to enjoy Western and Eastern cuisine. Famous chefs prepare delicious, fragrant, colorful dishes, giving diners a taste of their expertise; this exquisite cuisine is not to be missed. Recreational facilities include a fitness center and spa, another serene paradise to relax your mind and body. Website: http://www.evergreen-hotels.com/branch/taipei

stays.description: Stay easy Stay Smart. 不同以往的體驗，是我們想提供的一切。貫穿飯店整體設計的工業LOFT風格，雖說看來簡約，其實蘊含著許多用心， 在化繁為簡後，盡力照顧到每一處細節，力求質感至上；為了響應環保減少資源浪費，我們不求「多」，但，在這不多的部份，我們卻要求自己要做到最「好」。房內具備3大特色 CAS：#Charging 電器用品充飽飽：房間內配備至少8個國際萬用插座，讓您充電再也不用東翻西找或克難輪流充電。#Amenity 洗澡洗頭不馬虎：CHECK inn 有機天然精油洗沐系列#Sleeping 睡眠品質很重要：與國際星級飯店香格里拉 Shangri-La, 萬豪酒店 Marriot 同步選用SIMMONS，讓您也能擁有有國際5星級旅館的享受。我們相信，心意加上用心能讓每位旅客沒有負擔、舒適自在地享受旅遊，了解到原來平價也能擁有如此美好的體驗。如果說旅遊的回憶需要由自己去塑造，那麼請將住宿的體驗交由我們來創造。

stays.descriptionEn: The development of cities is full of contrasts and blends, old and new, fast and slow, bustling and quiet, which complete the personality of Taipei. stays.name: 首都唯客樂飯店
stays.description: 首都唯客樂飯店鄰近台北市東區的南京東路繁華地段，四平街商圈步行5分鐘可達，四通八達的交通路線讓您前往台北世貿中心、微風廣場、SOGO百貨，不論是商務洽公或休閒觀光，我們都具備非常便利的地理位置。首都唯客樂飯店我們以歐式高貴建築設計來營造出典雅精緻的設計風格，多年以來，我們更強調以用心、細心、貼心的態度服務每位蒞臨的客人，2011年我們更榮獲觀光局三星級以上的星級評鑑成績，我們將繼續秉持以客為尊的理念，提供您無微不至的住宿體驗。 在首都唯客樂飯店的設計中，將讓您彷彿身為優雅的歐洲貴族，古典中帶點華麗。燈飾華美烘托氣氛，連枕繡被紋都一針一線的講究精緻細膩，連復古傢俱與壁角的原木電視櫃與濃濃懷舊風味的書桌，都讓人彷彿有置身異國風情的飯店體驗，我們深信這絕對會是您來台北出差洽公旅遊的最佳選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: Capitol Waikoloa Hotel is located on Nanjing East Road in Taipei’s bustling East District, a 5 minute walk from Siping Street Commercial Area. A network of roads leads to the Taipei World Trade Center, Breeze Center, and SOGO Department Store, making this a convenient location whether you’re here for business or pleasure. The hotel building features high-class, elegant European architectural design, and over the years we have been committed to serving our customers with care, detail, and attention. In 2011 we received the Tourism Bureau’s 3-star rating. We continue to maintain a policy of putting customers first, providing the perfect accommodation experience. Our design makes you feel like a member of European nobility, with a classic, lavish atmosphere. Magnificent lighting provides the backdrop for the atmosphere, and every detail, down to the pillows and bedding, attended to.. Antique furniture, wooden TV cabinets, and retro desks provide an exotic hotel experience. Whether you’re in Taipei for business or pleasure, we guarantee Capitol Waikoloa Hotel is your best choice.

stays.searchText: 首都唯客樂飯店 首都唯客樂飯店有限公司 臺北市旅館031號 臺北市 中山區 長春路187號1-9樓 首都唯客樂飯店鄰近台北市東區的南京東路繁華地段，四平街商圈步行5分鐘可達，四通八達的交通路線讓您前往台北世貿中心、微風廣場、SOGO百貨，不論是商務洽公或休閒觀光，我們都具備非常便利的地理位置。首都唯客樂飯店我們以歐式高貴建築設計來營造出典雅精緻的設計風格，多年以來，我們更強調以用心、細心、貼心的態度服務每位蒞臨的客人，2011年我們更榮獲觀光局三星級以上的星級評鑑成績，我們將繼續秉持以客為尊的理念，提供您無微不至的住宿體驗。 在首都唯客樂飯店的設計中，將讓您彷彿身為優雅的歐洲貴族，古典中帶點華麗。燈飾華美烘托氣氛，連枕繡被紋都一針一線的講究精緻細膩，連復古傢俱與壁角的原木電視櫃與濃濃懷舊風味的書桌，都讓人彷彿有置身異國風情的飯店體驗，我們深信這絕對會是您來台北出差洽公旅遊的最佳選擇。

stays.description: 麗雅精品旅館榮獲台北市政府評核為安全、安靜、乾淨之優良旅館。交通部觀光局評鑑為二星級旅館.是無餐廳旅館最高等級之榮譽.麗雅精品旅館設址於台北市長春路62號8樓，成立於民國92年10月，為合法經營旅館，同時亦為旅館公會之會員，以完美親切與乾淨舒適為經營理念。本旅館為精緻商務休閒旅館，擁有各式東洋、南洋、歐美等風格的寬敞套房，內部裝潢皆為名師設計並採用高級豪華建材。各套房皆設置除濕機與24小時免費網路等設備並具備清香乾淨的時尚衛浴、舒適按摩浴缸等設施，讓您在出外玩樂、商務辦公之餘能享受無比舒暢的放鬆。本旅館服 務對象以一般商務人士及與夫妻、情侶為主，在滿足您的各式需求中務必達到盡善盡美甚至超越滿意的境界。不論是商務洽公、旅遊或休息等，麗雅精品旅館絕對會 是您最佳的選擇。您的光臨絕對會是我們最大的榮幸，衷心期待您的光臨並享受我們最佳品質的服務。
stays.descriptionEn: Dear Hotel is proud to receive the Excellent Hotel Award from the Taipei City Government for being a safe, quiet and clean hotel. The Tourism Bureau rated our hotel as a two-star hotel, the highest honor for hotels without a restaurant. Dear Hotel is located on No. 62 Changchun Road, 8th Fl., Taipei. It was legally established on October 2003, and was a member of the Hotel Association since then. Our business philosophy is to strive for perfection, treat our guests cordially and provide a clean and comfortable environment. Our hotel is a boutique business and leisure hotel. The spacious guestrooms are decorated in different styles - Japanese, Southeast Asian, European and American. The interior is designed by a famous interior designer, and only the best quality building materials were used. Our facilities and services include: dehumidifier in every room, 24-hour free internet access, clean and pleasant bathroom and comfortable jacuzzi tub. After a busy and fun day of travels, or a long day of business meetings, you will be able to fully relax and enjoy yourself in our hotel. Our target clients are business people and couples. We aim to satisfy your various needs and requirements, and strive for perfection or even exceed your expectation. Whether you're here for business or pleasure, Dear Hotel is your best choice. Your patronage is our honor. We sincerely wish that you will visit us and enjoy our excellent service.

stays.description: 城市的天際線，要從市中心望去。台北的旅程，就從儷萊商旅開始。台北儷萊商旅不僅坐擁城市風景線，更擁有得天獨厚的地理位置，台北最大交通樞紐－台北車站僅需步行約10分鐘即可到達車站入口，五鐵共構的台北車站將帶領您進入旅行的無限想像。另一頭距離商旅僅3分鐘路程的西門町，則是年輕人的朝聖天堂，聚集全台北的流行元素，服飾、電影院、美食、書店……，在這裡更有永遠說不完的，屬於年輕的故事。僅僅約100公尺的距離，台北儷萊商旅將喧囂隔絕於外，鬧中取靜不受雜音干擾，靜靜感受舒適空間帶來的單純美好。儷萊商旅擁有多種客房，房內簡約溫馨，秉持「以客為尊」的服務精神，允諾給予旅客安全舒適的住宿體驗。旅途的意義，並非匆忙趕路，而是停下腳步，欣賞圍繞四周的美好。台北儷萊商旅四周多個景點代表了台灣的成長史，每個建築都有他的歷史意義。西門紅樓、總統府、228公園等皆步行即可到達，距離大稻埕、中正紀念堂、龍山寺等地也僅需5到10分鐘車程，更可踏上捷運往來於台北四方，士林夜市、台北故宮、台北101、敦南誠品、淡水老街……數不盡的台北風光，都在旅途中不斷驚奇上演。
stays.descriptionEn: Relite Hotel Taipei is a contemporary hotel, providing the perfect haven between tranquility and proximity in the vivid leisure district of Ximending near MRT Ximen Station for your Taipei travel. Ximending, also known as “Harajuku of Taipei,” is Taipei’s fashionable shopping center famed for the diversity of entertainments and activities that allure large numbers of young people and foreigners. Boasting a wonderful location, our hotel is only 3 minutes stroll away from the shopping heaven- Ximending, while Taipei Main Station, the major transportation hub, is about a 10-minute walk away, offering a swift access to other thriving destinations throughout city and beyond. Our hotel is strategically towered in a quiet alley away from the traffic noises of the main road, ensuring you utmost peaceful atmosphere and relaxations. Each room of our hotel is designed with modern furnishings that blend perfectly with intimate comforts to ensure you an intimate stay. Our hotel is one of the best choices among hotels in Taipei for all discerning travelers. Towered in the excellent location of Taipei City, numbers of noted historical sites are within a short walking distance from our hotel, including the Presidential Office Building, 228 Peace Memorial Park, and Red House Ximending. Dadaocheng, Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, and Wanhua Mongjia Longshan Temple are some of the attractions nearby about 5-10 minutes drive away, while Danshui Old Street, National Palace Museum, Taipei 101, and Shilin Night Market can be reached within a short MRT ride. The convenience in location of our hotel make your Taiwan travel an easy and efficient one.

images.description: 房間設計新頴寬敞、壁紙風格生動亮眼，房客入住時彷若進入一個綺麗而夢幻的奇幻世界，是綺幻客房的靈感來由。從單人座沙發、宜人的客房動線，到可調式符合人體工學辦公椅，專屬於您的秘密基地，同時滿足賓客商務與城市度假的需求。賓客可享用豐富迷你吧、便利型萬用插座、免費無限上網以及寬敞的辦公桌，在旅程中以不同的角度欣賞生活中的美好，發現小確幸。

stays.name: 台北天晴旅店
stays.description: 全館全新裝修以青年旅館慨念的台北天晴旅店座落在交通便利且鬧中取靜的台北中正區，距離交通便利台北車站及熱鬧的西門町商圈步行約10分鐘左右，離最近的捷運（地鐵）台大醫院站步行只需要短短的1~2分鐘。 充滿台灣人熱情且溫馨的台北天晴旅店，雖然是青年旅館但提供獨立私人空間精緻2人房,4人房及6人房，房內都有獨立的衛浴設備、消毒過的毛巾、拋棄式牙刷牙膏、空調、閱讀燈、電視，一樓大廳設有交誼廳、廚房、飲水機、投幣式洗衣機、投幣式烘衣機、還有可免費使用公共區的電腦。台北天晴旅店提供免費旅遊諮詢服務、代訂接送機車輛及包車旅行車輛、行李寄存。 台北天晴旅店非常非常靠近捷運站所以只要旅客想得到台北任何的景點交通都是非常便利的，附近擁有多個商場、各種台式、日式、義式、泰式.....等各國餐館和咖啡館。
stays.descriptionEn: Sunny Hostel is a brand new hostel, located right next to the beautiful 228 park in central Taipei city, close to Taipei main station with many shopping areas, restaurants nearby. The closest MRT station (NTU Hospital station) is just 2 minutes away and the popular Ximending area is only 10 minutes away on foot!The hostel provides clean towels, toothbrushes and has private en-suite bathroom in every room, there’s also a kitchen, water dispenser, coin laundry room and computers in the common area for every guest to use.

stays.name: 台北時代寓所
stays.description: 「臺北時代寓所」為希爾頓全球酒店集團旗下一員，已于2020年底開業，并為亞太地區第一家Tapestry Collection by HiltonTM品牌精選飯店。以富有巧思的設計與細節規劃、摩登現代的藝術空間，結合臺灣獨有濃厚人情味與待客之道的上心服務，臺北時代寓所致力提供所有旅客難忘的美好時光。 酒店位在臺北市中正區幸福里（日治時代劃為幸町）；在這個城市的新與舊、過去和未來、文化和商業、自然與工業的交叉路口，所在位置便利，走路１分鐘即抵善導寺捷運站，和臺北人氣早餐店「阜杭豆漿」比鄰；２分鐘車程抵臺北火車站、３分鐘車程可抵「華山1914文化創意產業園區」和亞洲50最佳咖啡廳「興波咖啡」等，除此之外，臺北藏有許多的后巷迷趣、美食地圖、快閃藝術等話題，值得旅人們花時間去探索。 酒店共有175間客房，其中包括：118間客房，41間轉角客房、3間豪華客房、4間尊榮客房、2間無障礙客房、和7間時代套房。完備的健身房與SPA各種精選課程，讓商務人士及城市探索者鍛煉之余亦能放松身心。
stays.descriptionEn: One-of-a-kind stay in Zhongzheng DistrictFind us in the city center, just steps from the MRT Shangdao Temple Station. Taipei Art Village, heritage sites, and Michelin-starred dining are all within quick reach. stays.name: 台北花園大酒店
stays.description: 「旅艋舺 遊西門」全新主題客房登場一府、二鹿、三艋舺，艋舺為萬華舊名，其名由平埔族之船Bangka得名而來，艋舺位於大漢溪、淡水河與新店溪交匯處，早期擁有極佳水運優勢，更為早期商業貿易重心，艋舺林立名勝古蹟，像是龍山寺、清水祖師廟、剝皮寮......等，鄰近的華西街觀光夜市美食及小吃更受到國內外旅客愛戴，經過百年洗禮，成為流行與傳統兼具的繁華之都。坐落艋舺(萬華)於及西門商圈的「台北花園大酒店」為西區頂級商務觀光飯店，擁有241間挑高舒適的客房及中西薈萃多元化餐飲服務，以「旅艋舺 遊西門」為飯店主題，並結合在地Bangka船舟語彙，藉由設計手法交織出熱情及文化涵蘊。台北花園大酒店擁有241間舒適的客房、中西薈萃的饗聚廚房、花園thai thai、PRIME ONE 牛排館、花比麵包坊......等多元化餐飲服務。挑高7米寬敞無柱的多功能宴會廳、獨立完善可量身打造的會議室、商務中心及健身中心等多項設施，提供您舒適住宿及良好之用餐環境。大器的七米挑高中庭，以白色系石材展現其風格，奢華吊燈在玻璃與不鏽鋼的混搭質材上，閃耀亮眼的光澤，加上匠心獨具之玻璃雕塑，營造出一個閃耀水晶光芒的特有氣氛。公共走廊空間設計，則延續主題的一致性，創造耳目一新的住宿體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: The “Taipei Garden Hotel”, located between Manga (Wanhua) and Ximen Business Circle, is a deluxe business and tourist hotel in Western Taipei that provides 241 comfortable high-ceiling suites and versatile catering service that blends Chinese dishes with Western ones. With “Travel in Manga and Ximen” as the theme of the hotel and combining it with the meaning of Bangka boat, enthusiasm and cultural meanings are created through design techniques.Taipei Garden Hotel has 241 comfortable and spacious guest suites, as well as a great selecion of dining options, including To-Gather Kitchen that serves a fusion of Western and Asian cuisine, the popular Taipei Garden Café Toast & Thai, PRIME ONE Steak House and Hanabby Bakery. Also available are a large pillar-free multi-purpose banquet hall with 7-meter ceilings, several fully customizable, self-contained conference rooms, and well equipped business center and fitness center. Our goal is to offer you a comfortable stay and a delightful dining experience, so you can enjoy calm and tranquility amid the hustle and bustle of the city.White marble sets the tone for the magnificent seven-meter high atrium while the luxurious glass chandelier is a glittering presence among the stainless steel. This fusion of different materials together with the one-of-a-kind glass sculpture creates the kind of sparkling ambience that only crystal can achieve. The design of the corridors keeps the theme of consistency and provides a brand new accommodation experience.

stays.name: 和逸 台北忠孝館
stays.description: 和逸‧台北忠孝館，緊鄰捷運善導寺站6號出口及星巴克典藏門市，位處台北車站商圈，接近充滿藝文氣息的華山文創園區附近，園內匯聚了書店、咖啡館、電影院、展演空間等等，自然散發的閒適氛圍，吸引許多年輕族群或外國人士前往，相當切合目標客層的需求。全館客房123間，在整體空間氛圍的營造上，持續COZZI在天然素材的品牌設定，採用大量的原木、石材與玻璃等天然素材，以及每間客房皆有大面開窗，自然光搭配暖色燈光等頂級房間視野。除掌握完美交通樞紐的便利性外，更能悠然放鬆的享受COZZI傳達的「時時體貼，處處合意」的品牌經驗。
stays.descriptionEn: The first hotel brand under Cathay Hospitality Management, HOTEL COZZI understands the lifestyles and traveling needs of young and mature travelers in the country and from abroad. It aims to create a brand new and fitting accommodation experience for them. The hotel emphasis on “cozy accommodation experience” is an unprecedented initiative in the hotel industry in Taiwan. Through appropriate service that is friendly and yet subtle, the spirit of branding is externalized from within, subsequently upgraded the positioning and standard of local chain hotels.Located in the heart of the city with accessible transportation, HOTEL COZZI is ideally affable in hope to enhance the traveling experience of every guest, and ensure that they feel unwound and relaxed. The hotel outlined its services and equipments around its motto “Unwind, Relax”, and offers a variety of signature COZZI experience and tailored services, including, comfortable beds in every room, 3C products friendly environment, fast payment service, and a house guest exclusive dining area that offers nutritionally balanced Colorful Sunshine Breakfast and around the clock snacks..Aiming for guests to unwind and relax, the service at HOTEL COZZI is informal, relaxed but at the same time offers warmth and friendliness that are lacking in big hotels. Whether you are a business traveler who has been out making business calls, or a leisure traveler exploring the city for a whole day, HOTEL COZZI offers a cozy environment to let down their hair and relax.

stays.description: 品格子旅店從早期日本膠囊旅館發想，擷取其善用空間的巧思，卻改良其隔音差及缺乏隱私的缺點，期待能打破台灣傳統旅館格局，創造出一種適合台灣都會的新型態旅宿，滿足旅客想省錢又不失住宿品味的需求。創始店『北車館』就在捷運台北車站M8出口，具有無敵方便的交通優勢，並提供遊客免費桌遊的空間，以及可以讓您放鬆的空中小花園~~
stays.descriptionEn: Taking inspiration from the early Japanese capsule hotels, we capture their ingenuity in making good use of space, but improve their shortcomings of poor sound insulation and lack of privacy. We hope to break the traditional hotel pattern in Taiwan and create a new type of hotel suitable for Taiwan& #39;s cities. Meet the needs of travelers who want to save money without losing the quality of their accommodation.

stays.description: 2015年台北最熱鬧繁華的城中區，誕生了一座如黑珍珠般耀眼的新地標－Hotel Midtown Richardson，藉由名設計師獨特的品味打造，堆砌成SOHO都會風的住宿空間，外觀典雅的黑色大樓搭配光彩奪目的 LED 設計，成為城中區一塊最炫麗的瑰寶，在台北西區最熱鬧的西門町，建構出獨樹一格的現代設計風格酒店，讓前來西門町觀光商務的旅客們，享受最舒適方便的休憩空間。Hotel Midtown Richardson以最親切的服務，最舒適的旅宿空間，最便利的交通路線，為旅人們帶來旅行台北的最佳選擇，捷運西門站5號出口即可到達。全館535間客房，每間客房展現簡約時尚設計，區分成15種不同類型客房，各具特色適合各種屬性的旅客，商務中心免費提供房客電腦上網服務。
stays.descriptionEn: A dazzling new landmark - Hotel Midtown Richardson was born in the bustling, vibrant midtown district of Taipei City in 2015. Built with unique taste, the hotel offers SOHO style metropolitan accommodation. With elegant black exterior complemented with glittering LED lighting, the hotel is a stunning treasure in the midtown district. Situated in the bustling Ximending area, this contemporary hotel offers tourists and visitors comfort and convenience. With its friendly services, comfortable accommodation and most convenient location, Hotel Midtown Richardson is the best choice for people visiting Taipei. The hotel is near Exit 5 of MRT Ximen Station. The hotel has 469 guestrooms with simplistic chic design in 15 room types to suit the needs of different guests. The hotel's Business Center offers the guests free Internet access service.

stays.name: 天使青旅
stays.description: 自由旅行的國度天使青旅．台北西門為天使商旅集團2016年全新設計的合法青年旅館〈hostel〉，裝潢走紐約樂活工業風，期望帶給旅人與背包客溫馨、自由與舒適的住宿感受，實現每個人心中對於旅行的夢想與渴望。絕佳的位置與交通位於台北西門町商圈旁，距離捷運西門站4號出口300公尺，走路5分鐘即可到達；近台北車站商圈、新光三越，周遭生活便利，交通四通八達，不管是購物逛街、享用美食小吃、看電影、皆很便利，適合自由行或背包客入住台北的最佳地點！貼心的專屬設備與公共設施天使青旅提供單人與雙人住宿床位，區分為男生住宿區、女生住宿區、男女共宿區，並將女生住宿區與女生淋浴間規劃為專屬空間，進出需房卡感應，給予女性旅客滿滿的安全感，營造Girl’s Paradise！房內提供空調、Free WiFi，每個床位提供閱讀燈、獨立電源插座〈附USB插座〉、個人保險箱與專屬置物櫃，服務櫃檯並提供寄放行李箱的服務。天使青旅附設交誼廳、閱讀區、休閒區、茶水區與電腦上網區等公共設施，歡迎旅客使用，讓喜愛交朋友的您有更多機會認識自助旅行的新夥伴！綠色環保天使青旅支持綠色環保愛地球的理念，不提供牙刷、牙膏與毛巾、浴巾等個人盥洗用品，如有需要可至櫃台購買。淋浴間提供沐浴乳、洗髮精、潤髮乳、洗手乳、吹風機等盥洗用品。
stays.descriptionEn: Angels' Hostel. Taipei XimenKingdom of free travelAngels'Hostel . Taipei Ximen provides a new-launched hostel brand of Angels' Chain Hotel Group. Distinguishing from other common hostels or backpacker's inn, Angels' Hostel . Taipei Ximen is elaborately designed in a LOFT industrial style, which bring coziness, warmth and comfort to travelers, aiming to make everyone's dream and desire for the journey come true.Secure & legitimate accommodationThe security is the first priority during the travel. Angels'Hostel. Taipei Ximen is one of the legitimate hostels among minority, boasting legal hotel license, which ensures the accommodation security.Incomparable location and transportationOur hostel is located beside Ximending Commercial District, 300 feets away from the Ximen MRT Station Exit 4 , just need to takes 5 minutes by walk. Also, the location is close to Taipei Railway Station Commercial District, Shin Kong Mitsukoshi shopping mall with convenient transportation and daily life.Whether your desire is shopping, enjoying delicacy or watching movies, all can be greatly satisfied. Angels' Hostel . Taipei Ximen is the best choice for travelers.Well-prepared exclusive equipment and public facilitiesAngels'Hostel furnishes with single and double rooms, divided into men, women and mixed dormitory, making women dormitory and women’s shower room as exclusive space with induction door card to get in, which gives women tourists enough sense of security, creating a Girl's Paradise.The rooms are equipped with air-conditioners, free wi-fi, reading lamp, independent power socket (with USB outlet, personal safe box, exclusive locker, as well as the counter service and luggage placement service.Besides the aforementioned, our hostel also have some public areas such as social hall, reading area, recreation area, pantry area and internet-access area and some other public facilities. Please feel free to use and we sincerely hope our guest who like to make friends to have more opportunities to meet new friends!Environment-friendlyFor the environmental protection, Angels’ Hostel only provides shower gel and shampoo to our guests. Please prepare toiletries like toothbrush, toothpaste and towel before you come to our hostel. Or you can buy them at the front desk.

stays.name: 天成大飯店
stays.description: 台北天成大飯店成立於1979年，座落於捷運台北車站M3出口旁，為捷運、高鐵、台鐵、客運、公車等交通樞紐地帶，擁有極佳的地理優勢。台北天成大飯店數年來秉持著親切、貼心又專業的服務精神，穩定、扎實的餐飲品質，深獲國際旅客、商務人士的青睞，更是許多機關團體指定的聚會場所。秉持著不斷提升品質及追求卓越的精神，台北天成大飯店於2011年斥資數千萬全面升級館內外硬體設備，以大器簡約之設計宣告嶄新的開始。在多元且完善的服務之外，更期望每位賓客在倍感尊榮之餘，也能有如回家般的舒適感受。
stays.descriptionEn: Cosmos Hotel Taipei is conveniently located by the M3 exit of the MRT Taipei Station, at the heart of Taipei’s well establish public transit system. Since its grand opening in 1979, it has been the hotel of choice for many international tourists and business travelers, as well as a popular destination for corporate meetings and group seminars. Over the years, Cosmos Hotel Taipei has strived to provide distinguished services and high quality dining experiences, always seeking further improvement. In 2011, with over tens of millions of NT invested in total renovation, Cosmos Hotel Taipei now carries a sleek, modern look and is fitted with top of the line facilities, eager to provide even better services to our guests and customers.

stays.description: 帥客旅店近台北車站，整體以時尚、精緻、優雅為設計，提供安全、安心、安靜的住宿品質，以客為尊是我們的服務宗旨，希望來入住的旅客都能感受到我們的用心。全館無線上網外，還設有洗衣房及健身房等設施，讓在城市中忙碌的旅人，可享有片刻的寧靜，好好享受放假的時光。帥客的理念 >>1.輕鬆預算舒適享受:現代裝潢藝術和尖端時尚設備,帥客給您物超所值的全新體驗.2.貼心的款待–舒適的3B:洗滌一天的疲憊,再度充滿活力.Bed:帥客依照您的需要提供舒適的軟/硬床墊讓您放鬆入眠;Bath:不同的房型配備不同的浴缸,蒸氣浴和烤箱讓您不必外出,便能享受三溫暖; Breakfast:中西式的自助早餐讓您一早就有好氣色.3.愛護地球做環保:為節能減碳,您可使用帥客提供的環保代幣來選擇您需要的用品及設施,不致產生額外的消耗品.亦可租用自行車悠遊於台北,來個輕鬆愜意的深度之旅,不會造成空氣的污染.同時閱覽室亦擺設有I-Pad電子書供您閱讀以節省紙張的浪費.我們於服務之餘也同時為環保盡一份心力.
stays.descriptionEn: Saual Keh Hotel is located close to Taipei Main Station, and is a fashionable, elegant, beautiful building providing a safe, secure, quiet lodging. Our service puts the customer first, which we hope is experienced by every guest. In addition to wireless Internet service throughout the hotel, facilities include a laundry room and fitness center, giving busy city travelers a place of peace and quiet to rest and enjoy their vacation. Our principles: 1. Comfortable experience on a low budget: Modern decoration and art, and cutting edge facilities. Saual Keh gives you an all-new experience at great value. 2. Caring hospitality, and comfortable 3B’s: Reinvigorate yourself with a bath after a long day. Bed: Saual Keh provides soft or hard mattresses based on customer needs. Bath: Different types of bathtubs based on room type. Enjoy a sauna without leaving the hotel. Breakfast: Chinese or Western-style breakfast to start the day off right. 3. Environmental friendliness: To save energy and reduce carbon, visitors can use tokens to choose desired items and facilities, eliminating excess waste. Or rent a bike and take a pleasant, relaxing tour of the city without contributing to pollution. The reading room provides i-Pad electronic books to cut down on paper waste. In addition to great service, we’re doing our part for the environment.

stays.descriptionEn: Sunny hotel Taipei is a contemporary hotel, providing the perfect haven between tranquility and proximity in the vivid leisure district of Ximending near MRT Ximen Station for your Taipei travel. Ximending, also known as “Harajuku of Taipei,” is Taipei’s fashionable shopping center famed for the diversity of entertainments and activities that allure large numbers of young people and foreigners. Boasting a wonderful location, our hotel is only 3 minutes stroll away from the shopping heaven- Ximending, while Taipei Main Station, the major transportation hub, is about a 10-minute walk away, offering a swift access to other thriving destinations throughout city and beyond. Our hotel is strategically towered in a quiet alley away from the traffic noises of the main road, ensuring you utmost peaceful atmosphere and relaxations. Each room of our hotel is designed with modern furnishings that blend perfectly with intimate comforts to ensure you an intimate stay. Our hotel is one of the best choices among hotels in Taipei for all discerning travelers. Towered in the excellent location of Taipei City, numbers of noted historical sites are within a short walking distance from our hotel.

stays.name: 承攜行旅台北台大館
stays.description: 『儷園飯店』位於充滿人文氣息的中正區商圈，鄰近師範大學、台灣大學、台灣金融研訓院、捷運新店線台電大樓站、師大夜市、公館夜市…等，絕佳的地理環境，讓您能夠盡情體驗台北魅力四射的萬種風情。走進儷園，清新雅致的氣氛在空氣中縈繞，以簡單的色調為基底，搭配上米黃色大理石鋪陳的地坪，藉由那潔淨的質感，散發出宜人的氣息。儷園的專業團隊秉持著『處處用心，時時關心』的信念，迎接您每ㄧ次的到訪住宿，以一些看似細節但是卻充滿巧心的設計，傳遞出飯店團隊的用心與貼心，親切溫暖的服務人員，貼心入微的服務，以及多元便利的設施規劃，讓您住宿的每一刻，充滿最舒適溫馨的服務。
stays.descriptionEn: Li Yuan Hotel is located in Taipei’s culturally rich Zhong Zheng Commercial Area. Nearby locations include National Taiwan Normal University, National Taiwan University, Taiwan Academy of Banking and Finance, Taipower Building MRT Station, Shida Night Market, and Gong Guan Night Market, making this a well-situated hotel from which you can experience the wealth of charm and attractions Taipei has to afford. Li Yuan Hotel is surrounded by a refreshingly elegant atmosphere and features simple color tones and yellow marble floors, with general cleanliness that gives off a hospitable feeling. Our professional team is dedicated to “attentive service at all times” and are welcoming every time you pay a visit; their attention to detail is evident in the hotel’s thoughtful design. Warm and friendly staff, thorough service, and convenient facilities and planning make every moment of your stay pleasant and comfortable.

stays.description: 新驛旅店為追求高品質的設計作品，特別邀請設計豪宅的築內國際設計公司、美國Love Tomorrow Today設計團隊、潮流服飾Pizza Cut Five設計團隊及國內UID設計公司參與規劃設計，以西門町為據點創造新一代的平價旅店風格。Cityinn Plus的全新風貌，再度詮釋多元創意的設計整合，讓旅客享受高質感的平價設計旅店。客房提供舒適個性化空間，配置32吋國際牌液晶電視、有線電視及免費高畫質的隨選電影(VOD)，免費有線及無線寬頻高速上網服務，小冰箱提供您保存新鮮的食品或飲料，保險箱保護您私人貴重物品，舒適的泡澡淋浴空間，享受前所未有的時尚設計風格。
stays.descriptionEn: In pursuit of a high quality design standard, Cityinn Plus invited internationally renowned design studio “Architecture Interior” to execute its interior and exterior design. The artistic installations in the hotel’s public areas and guest rooms were jointly developed by street wear brand “Pizza Cut Five” and “Love Tomorrow Today” to reflect a chic lifestyle and environmental consciousness. The brand new CityInn Plus is a product of dynamic design integration, a truly magnificent budget accommodation for all to enjoy. As the fast expansion of Cityinn Hotel Chain over the past 4 years, The Taipei inn Group has decided to upgrade the level of design and luxury of Cityinn Hotel, and name it as “The Cityinn Hotel Plus”, The new product hoping to suit the Taipei inn Group& #39;s ultimate vision, to re-define the high quality of a budget hotels for traveler or backpacker to enjoy. Rooms provide a comfortable space for travelers to stay 1-4 people. The rooms provide a standard 32-inch LCD TV, more than 70 channels and the guest can enjoy free high-definition movies on demand and free high-speed wired or wireless broadband Internet access, small refrigerator provides you to keep fresh food or drink, a safe to protect your personal valuables and comfortable bath or shower room and enjoy an unprecedented new fashion design.

stays.description: 旅樂序…貼心為您顧及身心靈的釋放，提供舒適溫暖的休憩空間，輕鬆徒步即到交通站的便捷樞紐， 為每一段旅程帶來結實累累的成果與美麗的詩篇，展開旅樂無窮的序章。旅樂序 由一群熱愛台灣、藝術，充滿服務熱誠，專精於設計，行銷的菁英團隊組成，成員都接受了嚴格的訓練並提供高品質的服務，為旅客提供最便捷舒適的休憩空間，以期達到您的滿意與推薦！旅樂序 從2013年五月 開始運營, 集結高人氣訂房與年年都獲獎的優秀成績, 目前已經有四個館別, 且四個館徒步2~5分鐘內都可抵達。站前一館位於台北市館前路和開封街口; 站前二館三館五館都緊鄰二分鐘徒步距離 地處於台北市中心每日達數十萬人次的台北車站前，新光三越百貨旁，購物、飲食、交通非常便利。近鄰台鐵、高速鐵路、台北捷運、桃園機場捷運、客運、公車的交通樞紐位置。徒步到京站廣場8分鐘,西鄰西門町可徒步15分鐘或一站捷運。距離繁華東區商圈只有8分鐘捷運車程，知名景點中正紀念堂僅兩站，距離桃園國際機場45分鐘車程。交通四通八達，十分便利。

stays.searchText: 旅樂序精品旅館 大員昌實業有限公司 臺北市旅館449號 臺北市 中正區 館前路8號10樓、11樓 旅樂序…貼心為您顧及身心靈的釋放，提供舒適溫暖的休憩空間，輕鬆徒步即到交通站的便捷樞紐， 為每一段旅程帶來結實累累的成果與美麗的詩篇，展開旅樂無窮的序章。旅樂序 由一群熱愛台灣、藝術，充滿服務熱誠，專精於設計，行銷的菁英團隊組成，成員都接受了嚴格的訓練並提供高品質的服務，為旅客提供最便捷舒適的休憩空間，以期達到您的滿意與推薦！旅樂序 從2013年五月 開始運營, 集結高人氣訂房與年年都獲獎的優秀成績, 目前已經有四個館別, 且四個館徒步2~5分鐘內都可抵達。站前一館位於台北市館前路和開封街口; 站前二館三館五館都緊鄰二分鐘徒步距離 地處於台北市中心每日達數十萬人次的台北車站前，新光三越百貨旁，購物、飲食、交通非常便利。近鄰台鐵、高速鐵路、台北捷運、桃園機場捷運、客運、公車的交通樞紐位置。徒步到京站廣場8分鐘,西鄰西門町可徒步15分鐘或一站捷運。距離繁華東區商圈只有8分鐘捷運車程，知名景點中正紀念堂僅兩站，距離桃園國際機場45分鐘車程。交通四通八達，十分便利。

stays.name: 梧邸酒店台北杭州
stays.description: 雀客杭州梧邸酒店（OOD HOTEL）位於台北市中心，OOD Hotel 以 Oasis of Downtown 為核心概念，融合永續建築、在地文化與質感選品，打造一處能在城市節奏中短暫抽離的停留空間。建築坐落於杭州南路林蔭大道旁，將自然綠意引入室內視野，並榮獲 EEWH 綠建築標章，透過節能設計與減塑政策，實踐更輕負擔的住宿方式，讓空間回歸簡單而舒適的本質。在體驗層面，從在地文化的融入到細節選品的配置，讓住宿不只是停留，而是一段節奏轉換的過程。全館採用 Simmons 席夢思床墊，搭配 **Crabtree & Evelyn 瑰柏翠（荷荷芭油系列）**沐浴備品，並配置 TOTO 免治馬桶、Nespresso 膠囊咖啡機與部分房型之 Dyson Supersonic™ 吹風機，在細節中維持穩定且舒適的品質。飯店鄰近捷運善導寺站與華山文創園區，兼具交通便利與文化氛圍；導入 24 小時自助報到系統，讓旅程更有效率且流暢。
stays.descriptionEn: -CHECK inn Select Taipei Hangzhou (OOD Hotel)Located in the heart of Taipei, OOD Hotel is built on the concept of Oasis of Downtown, combining sustainable architecture, local culture, and curated amenities to create a space where guests can step away from the rhythm of the city.Situated along Hangzhou South Road’s tree-lined boulevard, the hotel brings natural greenery into the interior spaces. The building has been awarded the EEWH Green Building Certification, and through energy-efficient design and plastic-reduction initiatives, it offers a more sustainable and comfortable stay.From cultural elements to carefully selected amenities, every detail is designed to transform a stay into a moment of reset. All rooms feature Simmons mattresses, along with Crabtree & Evelyn (Jojoba Oil Collection) bath amenities, TOTO washlets, Nespresso coffee machines, and selected rooms include Dyson Supersonic™ hair dryers, ensuring a consistently refined experience.Conveniently located near MRT Shandao Temple Station and Huashan 1914 Creative Park, the hotel combines accessibility with cultural surroundings. A 24-hour self check-in system is also available for a seamless and efficient arrival.

stays.descriptionEn: It provides a comfortable and warm resting space and is a convenient hub within easy walking distance of the transportation station, making it easy for you to travel in the city.Hotel B7 Journey is located at a transportation hub close to the Taiwan Railway, expressways, Taipei MRT, Airport MRT, passenger transportation, and buses. It takes 15 minutes to walk to Beijing Station Square and 7 minutes to walk to Ximending to the west. It is only a 13-minute MRT ride from the 101 business district, a short walk to the famous Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, and a 40-minute drive from Taoyuan International Airport. The transportation extends in all directions and is very convenient.Hotel B7 Journey is composed of a group of service teams who love Taiwanese culture and artistic activities and are full of enthusiasm for service. The members have received systematic training and provide high-quality services to provide travelers with the most convenient and comfortable rest space in order to achieve your satisfaction and recommendation.

stays.descriptionEn: Fun Inn Taipei Hostel is located in only a 5-minute walk from MRT Beimen Station. It offers simple and affordable accommodations with free WiFi access. It takes an 7-minute for guests to walk to MRT Ximen Station and Ximending shopping area.From Taipei Main Station, a terminal of Taipei Metro, Taoyuan Airport Metro, bus, train and high speed rail, guests can walk to Fun Inn Taipei Hostel in just 10 minutes. The hostel is a 20-minute drive from Taipei Songshan Airport, while Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport is a 40-minute drive away.Dormitories for 4 to 12 people and female dormitories are offered. Sheets and beddings, lockers, private curtains around the bed are provided. Bathroom and toilet are inside the room but shared with other guests.At Fun Inn Taipei you will find a shared kitchen and a shared lounge. Luggage storage is possible at the front desk. There are also a wash machine and dryer. In line with the concept of environmental protection, no personal hygiene products are provided in the museum.

stays.name: 皇家大飯店
stays.description: 皇家飯店成立於1964年4月，歷史悠久，頗負盛名，擁有早期旅館業的指標地位；來往的旅客以日本觀光團、省府官員及中南部富商巨賈為主。1978年交通蓬勃發展，隔年桃園中正國際機場正式啟用，世界各國旅客大量湧入台灣，使皇家飯店的住房率及業績達到高峰。爾後二十年，皇家飯店秉持著「服務至上」的經營理念，依舊是國內外商務人士洽公、休閒旅遊的優質首選。 今年適逢中華民國建國百年，皇家飯店也以全新的面貌重新呈現，希望能以優越便捷的交通位置，專業友好的迎賓態度，搭配環保建材的創新內裝及簡約雅緻的設計風格，隔離塵囂吵雜，提供兼具質感與家居般的高貴享受，讓每一位旅客都能感受細緻溫馨的住房經驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Royal Hotel, the most influential hotel in the past hotel industry, was established in April 1964.Most of the customers are Japan tourism, businessman and government officers. Since 1978, Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport has been operated. Due to the public transportation has progressively became prosperous, a lot of foreigners visited Taiwan. Business was thriving in Royal Hotel since 1978. Royal Hotel has been managed with the attitude of "Customers come first". After several decades, we still play an important role in the hotel industry. We redecorated with an innovative style. With the convenient location and hospitality, Royal Hotel is always the best choice for everyone.

stays.searchText: 皇家大飯店 皇家大飯店(股)公司 臺北市旅館105號 臺北市 中正區 懷寧街5-1號1-6樓 皇家飯店成立於1964年4月，歷史悠久，頗負盛名，擁有早期旅館業的指標地位；來往的旅客以日本觀光團、省府官員及中南部富商巨賈為主。1978年交通蓬勃發展，隔年桃園中正國際機場正式啟用，世界各國旅客大量湧入台灣，使皇家飯店的住房率及業績達到高峰。爾後二十年，皇家飯店秉持著「服務至上」的經營理念，依舊是國內外商務人士洽公、休閒旅遊的優質首選。 今年適逢中華民國建國百年，皇家飯店也以全新的面貌重新呈現，希望能以優越便捷的交通位置，專業友好的迎賓態度，搭配環保建材的創新內裝及簡約雅緻的設計風格，隔離塵囂吵雜，提供兼具質感與家居般的高貴享受，讓每一位旅客都能感受細緻溫馨的住房經驗。

stays.description: 歡迎您來到美好行旅 WonderTime 北車三館，一個為您打造的溫馨旅居，讓每一位旅客都能感受到家的溫暖與舒適。我們精心設計了多種房型，包括專屬女子八人房、專屬男子八人房、男女混合八人房、四人房及VIP雙人房，滿足不同旅客的需求與偏好。我們提供高品質的公共衛浴設施，並配備了知名品牌MR.SMITH的洗沐浴用品和戴森吹風機，確保您在旅途中能享受到舒適的沐浴體驗。美好行旅 WonderTime 北車三館位於台北市中心，毗鄰台北火車站，距離西門町及捷運站僅幾步之遙，周邊美食林立，是探索台北的絕佳起點。在這裡，您不僅能享受便捷的交通和優越的地理位置，還能感受到我們無微不至的服務與關懷。我們期待您的光臨，並願在美好行旅 WonderTime 北車三館，為您留下難忘的美好回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: Starting from August 1, 2025, our hostel will be exclusively for female guests.Welcome to WonderTime Taipei Station - Hankou Ladies Hostel, a warm and cozy space thoughtfully designed to make every traveler feel at home.We offer a variety of room types, including female-only dormitories and VIP double rooms, to meet different travel needs and preferences.Our shared bathroom facilities are equipped with premium bath amenities and Dyson hairdryers, ensuring you enjoy a comfortable and refreshing shower experience during your stay.Located in the heart of Taipei, WonderTime Taipei Station - Hankou Ladies Hostel is just steps away from Taipei Main Station, Ximending, and MRT stations. Surrounded by countless dining options, it’s the perfect starting point for exploring Taipei.Here, you’ll not only enjoy the convenience of excellent transportation and location, but also our attentive service and genuine hospitality.We look forward to welcoming you to WonderTime Taipei Station - Hankou Ladies Hostel and creating wonderful memories together.

stays.name: 詩漫精品旅館
stays.description: 詩漫精品旅館位於台北車站附近，是台灣三鐵共構的理想選擇，擁有台灣鐵路、高速鐵路和捷運的交匯點。步行僅需五分鐘即可抵達台北車站商圈，毗鄰購物中心和西門町商圈，為您的旅程提供極大的便利。台北車站不僅是交通樞紐，還擁有前往各大景點的便捷交通，包括淡水、陽明山、國立故宮博物院、士林夜市、饒河街五分埔商圈、信義區購物中心以及台北世貿中心展覽館等。詩漫精品旅館以現代化的客房裝飾和獨特風格自豪，為您提供舒適愉悅的住宿體驗。每間客房均經過精心設計，無論是背包客、商務旅客還是散客團體，我們都致力於提供最優質的服務。期待您的光臨，讓我們一同創造難忘的台北之旅！
stays.descriptionEn: Smile INN is ideally situated near Taipei Main Station, serving as a hub for Taiwan's three major transportation systems: railway, high-speed rail, and metro. A mere five-minute walk takes you to the bustling Taipei Main Station commercial district, adjacent to shopping centers and the lively Ximending area. Taipei Main Station is not only a transportation nexus but also offers convenient access to various attractions such as Danshui, Yangmingshan, the National Palace Museum, Shilin Night Market, Raohe Street Night Market, Xinyi District shopping centers, and the Taipei World Trade Center Exhibition Hall.Proudly featuring modern room decor with unique styles, Smile INN ensures a comfortable and delightful stay for guests. Each room is meticulously designed, catering to backpackers, business travelers, and group tourists alike. We are committed to providing the highest quality service. We look forward to welcoming you to Smile INN, where we aim to create unforgettable memories for your Taipei journey!

stays.description: 位於東門捷運站‧東門郵局正上方，地處台北市中正區、大安區交界、捷運重點轉乘站，交通便利，在台北美食代表永康街、文化菁粹青田街交叉口，鄰近台北時尚潮流第一線東區，是為台北城區美食、文化、娛樂交匯的核心地帶。謙商旅‧東門館以清爽、簡約、舒適的風格，親切、貼心的服務，在知性與感性兼具的空間氛圍中，期望為您充實的旅途帶來最美好的一刻。
stays.descriptionEn: Right above the Dongmen metro station and the Dongmen post office, the hotel is located on the boundary between Taipei City's Zhongzheng and Da'an District. As this location is one of the major metro transfer stations, we benefit from convenient transportation. This place is also on the junction between Yongkang street, the representative of Taipei's delicacies, and Qingtian street, the culture essence of Taipei, and near Taipei's fashion front, the Eastern District. It's safe to say we are in the core area that converges food, culture and entertainment of Taipei City. With our refreshing, simple and comfortable style and nice and heartening service, Chaiin Hotel - Dongmen will bring out the best moment in your journey in a space that combines intellectuality and sensitivity.

stays.description: 路境行旅，就像一塊魔幻的境域，想讓在這裡停留的旅人，可以暫時失去方向感、忘記現實的軌跡，休憩後獲得滿滿的能量，再次出發前往下個目的地。館內大廳天馬行空的氣息，綠意盎然的點綴，並處處可見大膽巧妙的藝術品，彷彿走進一片古靈精怪的奇幻森林；舒適的房間讓你入夜後像是躺在落葉大地，貼心熱情的員工讓你來這像是在拜訪遠方的好朋友。路境行旅這片森林將一直在你的旅途路上，等著你來這暫停腳步。
stays.descriptionEn: It’s a magical wonderland in Finders; wanderers can easily escape from reality and get lost in direction, just to rest, relax and get refueled by its mysterious powers and overflowing energies.You’d find daring artworks cleverly displayed in every corner, decorated with plenty of green and a dash of eccentricity, as if you were walking into an enchanting forest. Our comfortable bedding hugs you warmly at night, freeing your imagination to a world full of happiness, mythical creatures and unlimited possibilities. In this surreal land, passionate and caring staff are always smiling, and waiting wholeheartedly to be your friends.Here in Finders Hotel, we await you to linger, to experience, to dream with us.

stays.name: 路徒PLUS行旅-主題館
stays.description: 陪你任性．一座大人系的遊樂園『世界再怎麼變，我的玩心不可變。』長大了也不該放棄任性的期待，出發吧！讓說走就走成為你的日常成就。行者從來不會滿足於終點，停留也隨心，所以你選擇的冒險總是比別人特別一點。時而緩慢、時而奔放；以為你深思熟慮，突然又讓人摸不著頭緒。這次，就由路徒PLUS行旅 站前館來承接你的玩心。我們將樂園搬進了台北核心，館內時刻上演嘉年華般的瘋狂場景，驚呼聲隨著透明屋旋轉，樂趣的味道瀰漫全場，聚樂堡壘讓你我戲玩不停歇。在這裡，你可以好好感受那些被現實偷走的少時夢，舉辦一場心靈慶典。準備好讓路徒PLUS團隊引領你了嗎？從台北車站即可輕易步入這片奇異地接下來就請放心，將你自己交給時間，而我們負責將驚喜交給你。
stays.descriptionEn: An Amusement Park for Willful AdultsPlayfulness is eternal; let's embrace adventure and make traveling a way of life.Let's embrace our inner whimsy together! Embarking on journeys becomes a part of daily life.Travelers are perpetual wanderers. The incredible adventure lies within your own choices.At times, it's leisurely; other times, it's unrestrained. It can be reflective, and occasionally perplexing.We will channel this playfulness at Roaders PLUS Hotel.The heart of Taipei holds an amusement park with scenes reminiscent of a carnival. Together, we revel in the transparent chambers and the pervasive sense of fun.You could even host a surprise celebration to relive the days of childhood.The team at Roaders PLUS Hotel is excited to guide you. Are you prepared? It's simple to reach this magical realm from Taipei Main Station. The key is to take your time, and leave the surprises to us.

stays.description: 用旅行開拓心靈的視野，用冒險找到生命的亮點，用好奇探索未知的旅程。每位旅人，旅行當中就如同拓荒者披荊斬棘，在蠻荒大地上不停地開拓，不斷地前進，探索前方未知的領域。路徒行旅亦將此意念融入旅館的每個角落之中，呈現粗曠中不失細膩、獨特而又有趣的風格，並以親切細緻的服務及多元豐富的服務項目，為您帶來一段充滿驚喜和樂趣的旅程。68間時尚獨具風格的客房提供旅客舒適的氛圍及寬廣的空間感；全新的衛浴設備及齊全的小家電，讓旅客在每日的微型冒險後可以安心的沉靜、休憩。24小時櫃台服務、吧檯遊戲區及自助飲料零食吧讓晚睡的旅客深夜也不愁吃喝玩樂的好去處；精心打造的公共空間及貼心呵護的服務品質讓旅客們洗淨一身的疲憊，為明日的路途做好充足的準備。
stays.descriptionEn: Explore the world with curiosity and an open mind, go the extra mile where no man has gone before, and cleanse your heart with new cultures and experiences beyond your normal imaginations, hence we travel. Roaders Hotel offers 68 comfortable, stylish and spacious guest rooms with brand new equipment and appliances that relax you after your daily mini-adventures. A 24-hour front desk, game zone and self-served snack/drink areas offer night owls a different option to enjoy the evening. Guests may enjoy the caring and attentive services that cleanse you from the weariness of the trip, and get you ready for the road ahead.

stays.description: 『想要和您分享金來的最好，是因為想將生活裡的美好呈現給您』 當您選擇走進金來，您已經是懂得選擇最好的生活美學實踐者，朗白的迎賓大廳，馨雅的空間色調，溫暖宜人的氣氛，熱情的招呼聲，引人駐足流連。 金來商旅坐落於台北市金山南路，絕佳地理環境讓您處在華美的城市中，依然能夠感受到大自然的清新綠意，鄰近新生高架、建國南北交流道以及徒步三分鐘路程的東門捷運站；便捷的交通讓您擁有絕佳的便利性，大安森林公園、光華商圈、永康公園商圈、建國花市、袖珍博物館、樹火紀念紙博物館…等景點，讓您享受購物的樂趣之外也能感受到知性感性的豐富旅程。 讓金來商旅最貼心入微的巧思與細心，帶給您最甜蜜美好的旅居時光，您的到訪入住將讓我們感夠無限的光彩與榮幸。
stays.descriptionEn: Royal Biz Taipei Hotel is the ideal location for business or pleasure and is within walking distance of Taipei''s business district and the finest shopping and cultural venues.Conveniently located in the heart of downtown Taipei, it is close to the Zhongzheng district of Taipei, near Xin Yi and Renai road and close to the Xinsheng viaduct. 3 minutes walking distance to MRT Dongmen station.The hotel boasts a spacious, elegant lobby, large well-appointed guestrooms and a range of full service amenities. A grand and stylish hotel, the Royal Biz Taipei is full of character, it''s 48 rooms spacious, appealing and comfortable.

stays.descriptionEn: we providing the perfect haven between tranquility and proximity in the vivid leisure district of Ximending near MRT Ximen Station for your Taipei travel. Ximending, also known as “Harajuku of Taipei,” is Taipei’s fashionable shopping center famed for the diversity of entertainments and activities that allure large numbers of young people and foreigners. Boasting a wonderful location, our hotel is only 3 minutes stroll away from the shopping heaven- Ximending, while Taipei Main Station, the major transportation hub, is about a 10-minute walk away, offering a swift access to other thriving destinations throughout city and beyond. Our hotel is strategically towered in a quiet alley away from the traffic noises of the main road, ensuring you utmost peaceful atmosphere and relaxations. Each room of our hotel is designed with modern furnishings that blend perfectly with intimate comforts to ensure you an intimate stay. Our hotel is one of the best choices among hotels in Taipei for all discerning travelers. Towered in the excellent location of Taipei City, numbers of noted historical sites are within a short walking distance from our hotel.

stays.descriptionEn: Apause Inn is located in Taipei, 700 meters from Taipei Zhongshan Hall. It features a shared lounge, 100% non-smoking rooms, and free WiFi throughout the hotel. This property is close to several famous attractions, including 1.2 km from Ximen Red House, 1.9 km from Taipei Botanical Garden and 1.5 km from Ningxia Tourist Night Market. Guests can enjoy city views.The rooms at Apause Inn are equipped with air conditioning, a seating area, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a safe and a private bathroom with shower facilities, a hairdryer and slippers. Bedding and towels are provided in every room of this accommodation.Popular attractions near Apause Inn include Taipei Main Station, the Presidential Palace of the Republic of China and Ximen MRT Station. The nearest airport is Taipei Songshan Airport, 6 km from Apause Inn.

stays.name: 台北W飯店
stays.description: 「台北W 飯店」共有405個房間，從標準房型「奇妙客房(Wonderful Room)」、到超過百坪的最高級房型「頂級驚喜套房(Extreme Wow Suite)」，每間均配備超大海島風情浴缸，房內的W之床、高級羽絨床墊、350織棉質床單、輕柔羽絨棉被等，讓賓客放鬆身心，恣意享受城市度假(urban escape)。館內設施包含健身中心FIT和AWAY®紓壓艙，餐飲則擁有Seasons by olivier e.法式餐廳、紫艷中餐廳和三間酒吧，提供各式新穎的感官體驗。除此之外，一反其他傳統飯店的型態，不定期舉辦「W熱門動向 (W Programming)」等精彩主題活動。台北W 飯店外觀大樓係由現任東京都市大學都會生活學部的准教授及設計師山根 格(Tadashi Yamane)構思、國內的三大建築師事務所建設而成，英國設計菁英團隊GA Design International則是負責室內設計，結合自然元素和現代化科技，成就「Nature Electrified自然大放電」的概念。最引話題的是位處10樓視野寬廣、可遠眺信義區美景的碧波泳池，以及具W代表性的WOOBAR，白天溫暖的木質基底和釉光綠牆帶有森林般舒適氛圍，適合享受陽光灑落的咖啡時光；夜晚營火升起、不同DJ主題配合聲光效果，讓調酒與音樂撼動不夜城。
stays.descriptionEn: Situated in center of Xinyi District and connected to Metro system, W Taipei features the most convenient location for both business and leisure travelers. Through its design theme "Nature Electrified", W Taipei brings luxury, modern and culture to the stay experience. Being a destination, W Taipei offers 405 guest rooms, 10 event spaces, signature restaurants & bars and recreation facility. What’s more! The iconic Taipei 101, department stores and upscale & local B&F venues are just within walking distance. W TAIPEI, YOUR HOME AWAY FROM HOME!

stays.name: 台北君悅酒店
stays.description: 台北君悅酒店是凱悅國際集團在台灣的第一家旅館，於1990年初開始營業；同年9月21日正式對外開幕。座落於台北市新興的商業及娛樂聚點，台北君悅酒店與鄰近的世貿展覽大樓、國際貿易大樓及國際會議中心整合形成一個多功能的複合建築群，此外，毗鄰台北101金融大樓。而四通八達的捷運站亦在步行的距離內，讓您便捷地暢行市區。台北君悅距離台北世界貿易中心南港展覽館僅20分鐘車程，而與桃園國際機場亦僅45分鐘車程。台北君悅由沈祖海建築師事務所負責設計外觀及空間結構，美國知名國際室內設計公司赫斯‧貝德納聯合設計顧問公司(Hirsch Bedner & Associates) 負責內部設計。設計重點在於融合中國文化並呈現豪華氣派的國際風格。全部工程由太平洋建設公司承建，希望能為國人及所有住宿的旅客提供最親切、最舒適的高雅環境。飯店建地面積達118,900平方公尺，地面樓高25層，地下3層；大廳採君悅一貫特有的挑高中庭設計，典雅的花藝佈置與寬敞明亮的風格，令人耳目一新。客房設計高雅舒適，各式商務科技設備新穎完善，寬敞的浴室設有浴池、淋浴間及精緻備品，讓每位住房的旅客都能有賓至如歸的感受。「嘉賓軒」不僅提供一系列體貼入微的個人化服務，更有新穎完善的多項設備，是到台北商務洽公或休閒度假的絕佳選擇。入住嘉賓軒樓層的賓客可享受嘉賓軒貴賓專屬禮遇，包含免費寬頻上網、免費使用嘉賓軒交誼廳、免費自助早餐、晚間雞尾酒、專屬會議室及全日供應各式飲品及精緻小點等，而專屬服務中心亦全日提供貴賓各種協助及諮詢服務。台北君悅獨具風貌的餐廳與酒吧，包括供應精緻港式佳饌的漂亮、以頂級歐陸料理聞名的寶艾西餐廳、輕鬆氛圍的Cheers、全日供應自助餐的凱菲屋、具現代風格的彩日本料理、位於大廳中庭右側的迎賓廊。不論是正式的商業餐敘，或是溫馨的親友聚會，台北君悅提供您充滿時尚品味、用餐雅趣的豐富饗宴。
stays.descriptionEn: Grand Hyatt Taipei is located in the city& #39;s vibrant Xinyi district. Our 5 star luxury hotel is right next to the Taipei 101, financial tower, Taipei World Trade Centre and International Convention Center. Our guestrooms and suites offers a residential ambience with scenic views of Taipei 101, the mountains and Taipei city, while our Grand Club rooms provide added luxury and personalized services. The spacious suites on the top floor of the hotel provide exclusive accommodations.Our restaurants and bars span the culinary globe, with Café offering international cuisine in buffet style, authentic Japanese buffet at Irodori, Bel Air for fine dining, Pearl Liang offering traditional Cantonese cuisine and dim sum, Ziga Zaga for Italian cuisine with international live band performance, light meals at Cheers, elegant afternoon tea buffet at Cha Lounge with live piano performance and Baguette bakery, offering cakes, fresh bakeries, brewed coffees and hampers.To relax and rejuvenate, Club Oasis offers a 24-hour gymnasiums, women and men spa and an outdoor heated swimming pool.

stays.name: 台北寒舍艾美酒店
stays.description: 以人文、藝術聞名全球的艾美酒店，起源於時尚之都-巴黎，以其富有前瞻性且引領時尚的內涵，不僅為賓客奉上完美的入住享受，更帶來駕馭自如的探索之旅。2010年12月3日正式開幕的台北寒舍艾美酒店，位於台北時尚+藝文核心地帶--信義區內，以當代藝術的策展概念為基礎，選擇「光和影」作為思維主軸，將藝術品融入在每一位旅客都能接觸到的角落，以非傳統的方式引領賓客與藝術做直接性的互動，配合酒店的空間與環境，集結了來自台灣、中國、日本、韓國、美國、英國和比利時的多位當代藝術家，共近七百件跨媒材、跨形式的作品與裝置藝術創作，藉由藝術家們的獨具慧眼，觸動賓客感官神經，進而激發創意思維。以時尚簡約的建築美學為設計核心，酒店匠心打造160間客房與套房，並以挑高格局規劃六款獨具特色的房型。每間客房均精選艾美特色睡床，搭配60吋平面電視、立體環繞音響、高速網路、多媒體切換器及illy義式濃縮咖啡機，營造兼具舒適與機能的靈活辦公與休憩空間，讓每位賓客盡享便捷奢華的住宿體驗。浴室設計亦體現細膩品味，配備熱帶雨林花灑、免治馬桶，與美國品牌MALIN+GOETZ的天然溫和大瓶備品，兼顧環保理念與尊貴享受。此外，大部分房型更設有獨立浴缸，搭配寬敞高雅的衛浴空間，營造出恣意放鬆的沉浸式沐浴體驗，讓每次入住都成為一場難忘的奢華之旅。此外，酒店精心匯聚多元餐飲體驗，以匠心獻上極致饗宴。「寒舍食譜」演繹經典粵菜的精湛工藝，呈現細膩講究的頂級粵式風味；「探索廚房」則網羅世界各國珍饌，提供現點現做的創意美饌，帶來舌尖上的無限驚喜。「北緯二十五」大廳酒吧則揉合illy®咖啡的人文巧思與全球收藏家夢寐以求的珍釀佳釀，為賓客打造品味非凡的休憩時光。2024年，更推出兩大全新館內的餐飲品牌，「Drip & Dough」以溫潤木質調營造靜謐優雅的氛圍，融合現代藝術氣息，精選香港手沖冠軍咖啡品牌 Cupping Room，搭配精緻烘焙與輕食，邀請旅人邂逅一場悠然愜意的味覺之旅。「TIPSY Sparrow」則由米其林餐廳擔任廚藝總監攜手冠軍調酒師，以美法風格為基礎，運用當代手法重新詮釋經典料理，打造適合輕鬆共享的現代餐飲體驗，並獨家推出融合台灣茶韻的特色調酒，為味蕾帶來別具匠心的創新驚喜。
stays.descriptionEn: Le Méridien Hotels, renowned worldwide for their deep connection to culture and art, trace their origins to the fashion capital—Paris. With a forward-thinking and trendsetting essence, Le Méridien not only provides guests with a flawless stay but also offers an inspiring journey of effortless exploration.Officially opened on December 3, 2010, Le Méridien Taipei is located in the heart of Taipei’s fashion and arts district—Xinyi. Rooted in the curatorial concept of contemporary art, the hotel embraces the theme of "light and shadow," seamlessly integrating art into every corner accessible to guests. This non-traditional approach fosters direct interaction between guests and artistic expression, transforming the hotel into a dynamic gallery space. The curated collection features nearly 700 works and installations by contemporary artists from Taiwan, China, Japan, Korea, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Belgium, spanning various mediums and forms. Through these visionary artworks, guests are invited to engage their senses and ignite their creative thinking.Designed with a modern and minimalist architectural aesthetic, the hotel meticulously crafts 160 guestrooms and suites, offering six distinct room types with lofty ceilings. Each room is thoughtfully furnished with the Sealy bed, a 60-inch flat-screen TV, an immersive surround sound system, high-speed internet, a multimedia hub, and an illy espresso machine, creating a seamless blend of comfort and functionality for both work and relaxation.The bathroom design exudes refined sophistication, featuring a rainforest shower, a bidet toilet, and premium large-sized amenities from the American brand MALIN+GOETZ, harmonizing sustainability with luxury. Additionally, most room types include an independent bathtub, set within a spacious and elegantly designed bathroom, offering an indulgent and immersive bathing experience—transforming each stay into an unforgettable journey of refined comfort.Le Méridien Taipei brings together a diverse array of dining experiences, crafted with meticulous attention to detail to offer the ultimate gastronomic indulgence. My Humble House Restaurant showcases the exquisite artistry of classic Cantonese cuisine, presenting refined and masterfully prepared gourmet delights. Latest Recipe curates global delicacies, offering freshly made-to-order creative dishes that captivate the palate with boundless surprises. Meanwhile, Latitude 25 Lobby Bar harmonizes the cultural essence of illy® coffee with an exclusive selection of fine wines coveted by connoisseurs worldwide, creating an unparalleled ambiance for relaxation and refinement.In 2024, the hotel unveiled two new in-house dining concepts. Drip & Dough offers a tranquil ambiance with warm wooden tones and a contemporary artistic flair, featuring hand-brewed coffee from Cupping Room, a Hong Kong-based champion roastery, paired with exquisite pastries and light bites—inviting travelers to immerse themselves in a leisurely, sensory journey. TIPSY Sparrow, a collaboration between a Michelin-starred chef and an award-winning mixologist, reinterprets classic cuisine through a modern lens, creating a social dining experience inspired by French and American flavors. The bar also introduces an exclusive selection of cocktails infused with the rich essence of Taiwanese tea, delivering a uniquely sophisticated and innovative tasting experience.

images.name: 純淨豪華客房
images.description: 409 平方英尺 / 38 平米 台北寒舍艾美酒店的豪華客房位於五層至十層，將現代奢華提升至一個全新的境界。 整間客房色調中性而質樸，並採用溫暖黑木和清涼大理石精心裝點。 起居區內設有線條簡潔流暢的現代化傢俱，如大理石辦公桌、皮革及鋼制座椅和兩把木制尼龍安樂椅。 寬大的落地窗牆沿一側牆面延伸開來，讓白天的自然光線灑滿房間，讓夜晚的城市美景映入眼簾。 起居區內和睡床上方的牆面上點綴著出自當地藝術家之手的原創藝術品。 辦公區配有虛擬辦公室媒體中心、IP 電話和高亮度檯燈，可滿足旅行常客的辦公需求。 其他設施還包括一台 60 英寸純平電視和高保真音響 。 為了給客人帶來更多的舒適享受，艾美酒店特別配有獨具特色的特大床或雙人床，定能確保您安享一夜好眠。 客房浴室內採用大理石和玻璃檯面裝飾，配有寬大梳粧檯、獨立雨林淋浴間、艾美衛浴用品系列以及浴袍和拖鞋。 此外，每間客房還提供室內保險箱、茶點中心、illy膠囊咖啡機以及每日報紙遞送服務。

images.name: 艾美套房
images.description: 1,690 平方英尺 / 157 平米 艾美套房位於酒店 11 層的拐角處，擁有寬闊精緻的居住空間。 套房內的落地玻璃幕牆設計可讓您欣賞到多維城市美景，而令人印象深刻的臺北 101 大廈這一著名的標誌性建築也將盡收眼底。 裝潢典雅的起居室和餐廳均採用柔和的大地色調裝飾，並以精美的超大弧形落地燈與定制布藝沙發進行點綴。 皮質桶形椅完美裝點於空間寬敞的就座區。 牆壁上裝有先進的壁掛式 60英寸純平電視，並與時尚的邦•奧陸芬音響系統相連。 時尚的木制餐桌和座椅可供 6 人輕鬆共用私密正餐，或者您還可使用illy膠囊咖啡機烹煮美味咖啡，打造愜意的會議茶歇時光。 而套房門廳的獨立大理石化妝間則為來訪的其他客人提供了方便。 寬敞的大理石辦公桌配有虛擬辦公媒體中心、高清晰度多媒體介面、IP 電話和高速上網接入，營造出理想的辦公環境。 另一套辦公桌椅可讓這一靈活自由的空間隨意變換。 客人還可使用文具、書寫本和鋼筆撰寫私人或公務信函。 與眾不同的臥室配有艾美套房特大睡床、精美的背光式床頭板與窗簾及時尚的床頭燈控制台。 緊鄰臥室的主浴室佈局寬敞，配有大理石雙梳粧檯、光可鑒人的檯面、獨立雨林淋浴間、浴缸及衛浴用品。 此外，艾美套房的客人還享有艾美行政酒廊的使用權，以及茶點中心提供的多種免費軟飲料、悉心周到的 24 小時代客洗衣服務、每日報刊遞送服務和每日擦鞋服務。

images.name: 總統套房
images.description: 2,400 平方英尺 / 223 平米 總統套房空間佈局寬敞流暢，自然採光充足，且可將城市美景盡收眼底，是活力市中心的一處無可比擬的迷人綠洲。從起居室到臥室，每個房間都採用柔和的大地色調裝飾，而精美的弧形落地燈、寬大沙發、曲形皮質安樂椅和長形鉻黃大理石茶几則彰顯出前衛大膽的設計理念。套房內的娛樂設施包括一台可與邦•奧陸芬音響系統相連的壁掛式 60英寸純平電視。 起居室內雅致的大理石辦公桌營造出寬敞舒適的辦公環境。虛擬辦公媒體中心、IP 電話、高速上網接入和高清晰度多媒體介面可讓您隨時與外界保持聯絡，更有文具、書寫本和鋼筆供您撰寫私人信函。 用餐區時尚的木制桌椅與牆壁上的幾何圖案原創藝術品交相輝映，適合舉辦 10 人以內的私人聚會。 總統套房可讓您盡享無比舒適的住宿體驗。寬敞的步入式衣櫥和更衣區緊鄰豪華大理石和玻璃材質裝飾的浴室。寬敞的雨林淋浴間為玻璃封閉式設計，而深位獨立浴缸位於窗戶旁，可讓您一邊沐浴一邊欣賞臺北 101 大廈的壯麗景象。雙洗手台提供了充足的伸展空間，更有精選的衛浴用品帶來舒緩宜人的沐浴體驗。 寧靜的臥室設有特色的特大號艾美睡床，精緻華麗的背光式床頭板與其上方採用藝術品裝飾的牆面相得益彰。床頭櫃上的控制台可讓您輕鬆調節燈光亮度和電動窗簾。您可于清晨時分在窗旁的獨立起居區，一邊品嘗套房專屬廚房烹煮的美味咖啡，一邊閱讀報刊雜誌。 此外，總統套房的客人還擁有艾美行政酒廊的使用權，同時亦可享受代客洗衣服務、套房茶點中心提供的免費軟飲料和每日擦鞋服務。

images.name: 卓越套房
images.description: 807 平方英尺 / 75 平米 寬敞的單臥室行政套房巧妙利用了整個空間佈局，專門為客人設立了可供工作、休息和社交的不同區域。 起居室和臥室內的落地窗設計為套房增加了寬敞通風的視覺效果。 織物和傢俱的柔和中性色調營造出一種簡約開放的美感，而溫馨木制、豐富皮質、光滑大理石和閃亮金屬材質的裝飾更為套房增添了幾分時尚現代之感。 規則的時尚組合沙發正對先進一流的 60英寸壁掛式純平電視。 其他休閒設施還包括兩張時尚的皮質桶形椅。 工作區配有帶虛擬辦公媒體中心、高清晰多媒體介面、IP 電話和高速上網接入的大理石辦公桌。 一系列令人印象深刻的高科技設備可讓您隨時與外界保持溝通互聯，包括與電視相連的高保真音響以及可連接至您個人電腦的視聽設備。 此外，我們還提供一套豪華文具用品。 為了讓您盡享靈活自由的居住空間，我們還提供了另一套木制桌椅，可供您舉辦小型會議，或一邊享用illy膠囊咖啡機烹煮的美味咖啡，一邊閱讀每日報紙。 獨立臥室配有頗具特色的艾美睡床以及柔軟舒適的背光式床頭板。 每個床頭櫃都設有便於操作的窗簾和燈光控制台。 牆壁上點綴有出自當地藝術家之手的精選現代化藝術品。 主浴室採用大理石和玻璃材質裝飾——設有兩個寬敞的洗手台、一個深浸泡浴缸和一個獨立的雨林淋浴間。 更有浴袍、拖鞋及各式舒緩宜人的衛浴用品為您帶來極致呵護。 獨立的大理石化妝間位於玄關，讓來訪客人盡享便利。 行政套房可與豪華雙床房或艾美行政雙床房連通，讓空間更為靈活自由。 輕觸一下按鈕，即可享受代客洗衣服務，我們將確保迅速及時地滿足賓客的一切需求。 此外，行政套房的客人還享有 12 樓艾美行政酒廊的使用權以及套房茶點中心供應的各式免費軟飲料。

images.name: 露臺套房
images.description: 807 平方英尺 / 75 平米 寬敞的單臥室行政套房巧妙利用了整個空間佈局，專門為客人設立了可供工作、休息和社交的不同區域。 起居室和臥室內的落地窗設計為套房增加了寬敞通風的視覺效果。 織物和傢俱的柔和中性色調營造出一種簡約開放的美感，而溫馨木制、豐富皮質、光滑大理石和閃亮金屬材質的裝飾更為套房增添了幾分時尚現代之感。 規則的時尚組合沙發正對先進一流的 60英寸壁掛式純平電視。 其他休閒設施還包括兩張時尚的皮質桶形椅。 工作區配有帶虛擬辦公媒體中心、高清晰多媒體介面、IP 電話和高速上網接入的大理石辦公桌。 一系列令人印象深刻的高科技設備可讓您隨時與外界保持溝通互聯，包括與電視相連的高保真音響以及可連接至您個人電腦的視聽設備。 此外，我們還提供一套豪華文具用品。 為了讓您盡享靈活自由的居住空間，我們還提供了另一套木制桌椅，可供您舉辦小型會議，或一邊享用illy膠囊咖啡機烹煮的美味咖啡，一邊閱讀每日報紙。 獨立臥室配有頗具特色的艾美睡床以及柔軟舒適的背光式床頭板。 每個床頭櫃都設有便於操作的窗簾和燈光控制台。 牆壁上點綴有出自當地藝術家之手的精選現代化藝術品。 主浴室採用大理石和玻璃材質裝飾——設有兩個寬敞的洗手台、一個深浸泡浴缸和一個獨立的雨林淋浴間。 更有浴袍、拖鞋及各式舒緩宜人的衛浴用品為您帶來極致呵護。 獨立的大理石化妝間位於玄關，讓來訪客人盡享便利。 行政套房可與豪華雙床房或艾美行政雙床房連通，讓空間更為靈活自由。 輕觸一下按鈕，即可享受代客洗衣服務，我們將確保迅速及時地滿足賓客的一切需求。 此外，行政套房的客人還享有 12 樓艾美行政酒廊的使用權以及套房茶點中心供應的各式免費軟飲料。

images.description: 409 平方英尺 / 38 平米 台北寒舍艾美酒店的豪華客房位於五層至十層，將現代奢華提升至一個全新的境界。 整間客房色調中性而質樸，並採用溫暖黑木和清涼大理石精心裝點。 起居區內設有線條簡潔流暢的現代化傢俱，如大理石辦公桌、皮革及鋼制座椅和兩把木制尼龍安樂椅。 寬大的落地窗牆沿一側牆面延伸開來，讓白天的自然光線灑滿房間，讓夜晚的城市美景映入眼簾。 起居區內和睡床上方的牆面上點綴著出自當地藝術家之手的原創藝術品。 辦公區配有虛擬辦公室媒體中心、IP 電話和高亮度檯燈，可滿足旅行常客的辦公需求。 其他設施還包括一台 60 英寸純平電視和高保真音響。 為了給客人帶來更多的舒適享受，艾美酒店特別配有獨具特色的特大床或雙人床，定能確保您安享一夜好眠。 客房浴室內採用大理石和玻璃檯面裝飾，配有寬大梳粧檯、獨立雨林淋浴間、艾美衛浴用品系列以及浴袍和拖鞋。 此外，每間客房還提供室內保險箱、茶點中心、illy膠囊咖啡機以及每日報紙遞送服務。

images.name: 主管套房
images.description: 646 平方英尺 / 60 平米 每間精緻套房都為您工作、娛樂和休息提供了良好環境。 寬敞的空間可分為兩處不同的區域，一處為超現代化且無比時尚的起居室，另一處為安寧幽謐的臥室。 落地窗幕牆設計可讓這兩處區域均自然採光充足。 起居室配有時尚的低位元組合沙發，正對面是一台可與 高保真身歷聲音響系統相連的 60 英寸壁掛式純平電視，讓您盡享愜意的娛樂時光。 鉻黃大理石茶几和皮質桶形椅同樣展現了現代化的設計風格，而低調樸素的色系也為整個空間增添了幾分精美與雅致。 大理石辦公桌配有虛擬辦公媒體中心、IP 電話、高清晰度多媒體介面、高速上網接入及豪華文具用品，是一處高貴典雅的工作區，而獨立的木制桌椅則可讓您在享用illy膠囊咖啡機烹煮的美味咖啡的同時，舒適地閱讀每日遞送的報紙。 臥室內配有特色艾美睡床以及精美背光式床頭板，牆壁均採用由臺灣當地藝術家製作的原創藝術品裝飾。 床頭櫃配有可控制窗簾和光線的電子面板。 相鄰的浴室設計時尚，採用大理石和玻璃材質裝飾，配有雙梳粧檯、雨林淋浴間和獨立深位浴缸，更有舒適的衛浴用品帶來極致呵護。 此外，精緻套房的客人還可享受代客洗衣服務、艾美行政酒廊使用權、茶點中心的美味軟飲料和每日擦鞋服務。

images.name: 艾美行政客房
images.description: 409 平方英尺 / 38 平米 艾美行政客房位於酒店 11 樓和 12 樓，為所有商務旅行者的居住氛圍又增添了幾分優雅。 低調樸素的中性色調與出自當地藝術家之手的豐富深色木制活力原創藝術品交相輝映。 客房內的傢俱設計現代時尚，線條簡潔明快，並採用皮質、鋼鐵和大理石裝飾。 寬敞辦公桌和獨立木制桌椅為您提供了更多伸展和工作空間，而落地窗幕牆設計則使房間的自然採光充足。 獨立的就座區配有可供休閒放鬆的尼龍及木制安樂椅。 眾多高科技設施，如高速上網接入、虛擬辦公媒體中心和 IP 電話都可讓您與外界輕鬆互聯。 60 英寸純平電視和高保真音響系統也讓您在工作之餘擁有更多娛樂選擇。 每間客房均配有客房內保險箱、可供應各種免費軟飲的茶點中心、illy膠囊咖啡機以及每日報紙遞送服務。 臥室區內配有艾美特色特大睡床或雙人睡床，為您提供了一處安享好眠的幽謐天堂。 緊鄰臥室的豪華浴室採用大理石及玻璃檯面裝飾，擁有寬敞的洗手台和獨立的雨林淋浴區。 浴室和拖鞋可讓客人享受無比舒適的沐浴體驗。 艾美行政客房的客人可獨享艾美行政酒廊的使用權。

stays.searchText: 台北寒舍艾美酒店 寒舍餐旅管理顧問股份有限公司 交觀宿字第1472號 臺北市 信義區 松仁路38號 以人文、藝術聞名全球的艾美酒店，起源於時尚之都-巴黎，以其富有前瞻性且引領時尚的內涵，不僅為賓客奉上完美的入住享受，更帶來駕馭自如的探索之旅。2010年12月3日正式開幕的台北寒舍艾美酒店，位於台北時尚+藝文核心地帶--信義區內，以當代藝術的策展概念為基礎，選擇「光和影」作為思維主軸，將藝術品融入在每一位旅客都能接觸到的角落，以非傳統的方式引領賓客與藝術做直接性的互動，配合酒店的空間與環境，集結了來自台灣、中國、日本、韓國、美國、英國和比利時的多位當代藝術家，共近七百件跨媒材、跨形式的作品與裝置藝術創作，藉由藝術家們的獨具慧眼，觸動賓客感官神經，進而激發創意思維。以時尚簡約的建築美學為設計核心，酒店匠心打造160間客房與套房，並以挑高格局規劃六款獨具特色的房型。每間客房均精選艾美特色睡床，搭配60吋平面電視、立體環繞音響、高速網路、多媒體切換器及illy義式濃縮咖啡機，營造兼具舒適與機能的靈活辦公與休憩空間，讓每位賓客盡享便捷奢華的住宿體驗。浴室設計亦體現細膩品味，配備熱帶雨林花灑、免治馬桶，與美國品牌MALIN+GOETZ的天然溫和大瓶備品，兼顧環保理念與尊貴享受。此外，大部分房型更設有獨立浴缸，搭配寬敞高雅的衛浴空間，營造出恣意放鬆的沉浸式沐浴體驗，讓每次入住都成為一場難忘的奢華之旅。此外，酒店精心匯聚多元餐飲體驗，以匠心獻上極致饗宴。「寒舍食譜」演繹經典粵菜的精湛工藝，呈現細膩講究的頂級粵式風味；「探索廚房」則網羅世界各國珍饌，提供現點現做的創意美饌，帶來舌尖上的無限驚喜。「北緯二十五」大廳酒吧則揉合illy®咖啡的人文巧思與全球收藏家夢寐以求的珍釀佳釀，為賓客打造品味非凡的休憩時光。2024年，更推出兩大全新館內的餐飲品牌，「Drip & Dough」以溫潤木質調營造靜謐優雅的氛圍，融合現代藝術氣息，精選香港手沖冠軍咖啡品牌 Cupping Room，搭配精緻烘焙與輕食，邀請旅人邂逅一場悠然愜意的味覺之旅。「TIPSY Sparrow」則由米其林餐廳擔任廚藝總監攜手冠軍調酒師，以美法風格為基礎，運用當代手法重新詮釋經典料理，打造適合輕鬆共享的現代餐飲體驗，並獨家推出融合台灣茶韻的特色調酒，為味蕾帶來別具匠心的創新驚喜。

stays.name: 台北艾麗酒店
stays.description: 台北艾麗酒店為寒舍國際酒店股份有限公司旗下第一家自創品牌飯店，代表的是一個融合藝術、文化及生活的新品味層次。酒店擁有235間客房、洋溢自然氛圍的義大利餐廳以及簡約高雅的宴會廳，係由世界知名飯店設計顧問公司Hirsch Bedner Associates負責室內設計，營造城市中的花園為主題，呈現細緻優雅的空間氛圍，館內匯集國際藝術家經典作品，讓藝術創作融入空間詮釋，致力於打造「藝術即生活」及「生活即藝術」的品味哲學。
stays.descriptionEn: Humble House Taipei is the first self-owned hotel brand of Humble House Hotels Co. Ltd. The hotel represents a non-conventional aesthetic taste that blends art, culture, and living together. Humble House Taipei offers 235 rooms, an Italian restaurant that features natural elements, and the simple and stylish Grand Ballroom. Designed by Hirsch Bedner Associates Pte. Ltd. Design Consultants (HBA), a world-renowned hospitality design company, the hotel presents a simple and relaxing style, impressing our guests with the image of Gardens in the City and creating an exquisite and sophisticated environment. With displays of great artistic works made by international artists, art is delicately blended in the environment to demonstrate the philosophy “art in life, life in art.”

stays.description: 關於誠品行旅誠品，是城市人的集體創作，誠品行旅，一處對美好生活無限想像之所在，提出「人文、藝術、創意、生活、自然」五大概念，彙集松山文創園區及鄰近創意街區的設計商店、咖啡館、書店、藝術電影院、表演廳等場所與誠品集團的豐沛資源，發展出體現臺灣風土民情並連結國際文創風華的品牌風格，開創嶄新的經營模式，打造臺灣第一家聚合人文閱讀、文創展演、音樂、電影、綠意自然、體驗生命感動的人文旅館。
stays.descriptionEn: About eslite hoteleslite hotel is the first to offer a harmony of love for reading, music & art, and creative entertainment within the lush setting of a park that exudes the unique culture of Taiwan, where you experience the timeless joy of life and the touching moments of history where you discover world-class talent in the service industry, the door that leads to other worlds linked to the courteous people of Taiwan. At the Songshan Cultural & Creative Park, the refreshing sound of a fountain greets the early morning sun, rest under the shade of a tree beside a lotus pond, marvel at historical relics amid an ecological oasis, closely observe the creations of traditional and industrial arts, discover other worlds through books, quench your thirst for knowledge, music, film, and performances bring gladness to our souls, we taste the sweetness of a wonderful life.

stays.descriptionEn: Hotel located in Taipei CityLocated in Neihu, 1 minutes’ from MRT Xihu Station, Elegance Hotel offers accommodation in Taipei. Free WiFi is available in the public areas.It takes 3 metro stops ride or 15 minutes’ drive to Taipei Songshan Airport from Elegance Hotel, while Taipei Main Station can be reached in 20 minutes by car. Neihu Technology Park is only a few minutes stroll away from the property. Hotel can arrange airport shuttle based on request.Featuring air conditioning, all guest rooms have a wardrobe, working desk, refrigerator and flat-screen TV. The private bathroom comes with free toiletries and a hairdryer.Hotel staff at the 24-hour front desk are glad to provide touring information and assist guests with luggage storage free of charge.

stays.name: 仙渡莊旅社
stays.description: 「仙渡莊旅社 XDZ HOTEL」位於關渡，離台北捷運關渡站步行僅3分鐘可達，交通方便。各房間包含獨立衛浴、獨立空調、免費WIFI、電視等，外牆簍空紅磚牆成為旅社的招牌，內部採無印簡約風格裝潢，提供優質、平價且舒適的住宿環境，獲得顧客好評。在地景點如關渡自然平原、關渡自然公園、金色水岸自行車道、八里河岸等，是許多單車環島及單車一日遊的指定住宿。鄰近北投溫泉區、士林夜市、故宮博物館、陽明山、淡水老街、北海岸風景區等，是來台北旅遊的住宿好選擇。溫馨提醒：*本旅社無提供早餐。*本旅社無提供停車場，如有停車需求可至附近立功街55巷收費停車場。
stays.descriptionEn: "XDZ HOTEL" is located in Taipei Guandu, only a 3-minute walk from Taipei MRT Guandu Station. The location is convenient. Each room contains private shower room, independent air-conditioning, free WIFI, TV, etc. We provide high-quality and comfortable accommodation, which is well received by customers.We are close to Beitou Hot Spring Area, Shilin Night Market, National Palace Museum, Yangming Mountain, Danshui Old Street, North Coast Scenic Area, etc. We also close to the Tamsui and Bali Bicycle Trail, so we often designated by many cyclists who are on round island bike tour. We believe it is a very good choice for you when visiting Taipei.

stays.description: 隨著旅遊型態的多元發展，臺灣度假飯店服務越趨細緻，以豐富現代旅人的休閒度假生活。北投老爺為臺灣首屈一指的飯店集團「老爺酒店集團」旗下之新型態度假飯店，首創以「健康療癒」為主題概念，旨在為現代生活忙碌的旅人，打造蘊含健康概念的度假體驗，從住宿、美食、溫泉、Spa到各室內外活動等，都將「健康療癒」的良方化為體貼入微的服務，讓旅客從度假裡得到的不只是舒壓與放鬆，更能享受療癒身心靈所展開的美好生活。
stays.descriptionEn: The Hotel Royal Group’s brand vision is to create a hotel that is an amazing place to be, where unforgettable memories are created. After three years of planning a high-end health and lifestyle resort, we launched the Hotel Royal Beitou as a completely new kind of hotel, incorporating both fitness and health treatments.Hotel Royal Beitou is the only hotel in Taipei to offer a range of hotel-based and outside classes and activities. With our three core offerings—fitness, stretching and relaxation, and hydrotherapy—we use both dynamic and static exercise to revitalize your body and reinvigorate your mind.Our guiding concept is to incorporate health management in a hotel so as to build lasting health through a comprehensive service which comprises nutrition, aromatherapy, hydrotherapy, a wide range of indoor and outdoor exercise, and professional consultation. When our guests leave, they take with them a deeply planted understanding of health which opens up to them new vistas of healthy living. We hope to become known as the first choice for travelers staying in Beitou.

stays.name: 北投麗禧溫泉酒店
stays.description: 大自然與人文的相遇位在北投的制高點，緊鄰陽明山國家公園、遠眺丹鳳山脈、坐擁大屯山系，盡享「山、水、天、地」的麗禧酒店，全館由李祖原建築師一手規劃，以原木和石材為主、鍍鈦金屬和天然植栽為輔，將珍貴的自然生態景觀與建築概念巧妙融合，呈現出自然天地與人文結合的深沉內斂、雋永脫俗的不凡特質。台式原味 就地取材的休閒美學有別於其他溫泉酒店富含日本風格的服務與設計，北投麗禧酒店強調以台式服務及台灣就地取材的概念將建築美學、住宿休憩、飲食文化、泡湯享樂等多種元素融入在飯店各個角落，希望將北投與台灣的美與韻味傳達給所有造訪酒店的貴賓，帶給旅人富含人文素養與自然氣息的休閒空間。盡攬山色 馳放心靈的渡假經驗共提供66間頂級客房、中西式餐飲、24小時禮賓接待服務、8間私人湯屋、露天風呂、麗漾spa等多項服務，當您置身麗禧宛如徜徉在最美的渡假天堂。每一間客房除了擁有16坪以上的私人空間，也都擁有絕佳的山林視野，讓您住宿於客房時，享有最舒適的休憩環境。中餐雍翠庭與西式歐陸餐廳，擷取當地認證的新鮮食材，透過主廚巧思創意，有如魔法般烹調出讓您的視覺與味蕾盡享驚豔的特色美食，讓飲食成為一種美學態度。滋養泉水 身心靈放鬆的美好感受而更值得您品味的是麗禧為您規畫的泡湯享受，山林環繞的隱密空間、溫潤滋養的白磺溫泉，是全球四大白磺泉水之一，讓您身、心、靈全然歸零與放鬆，如此美好的境界麗禧為您完美呈現。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Beitou high ground, neighboring Yangmingshan National Park, overlooking the Danfeng mountains, embracing Datun Mountains, Grand View Resort Beitou enjoys "mountain, water, heaven, earth." The hotel was designed by the architect CY Lee. The building utilized wood and stone materials, supplemented with titanium metal and natural plantings, to infuse cleverly architectural concepts into the precious natural landscapes, presenting the deeply introverted, timeless, refined, extraordinary qualities ofa combination of natural and human world. Unlike other services and design of Japanese-style spa hotel, Grand View Resort Beitou emphasizes on Taiwanese-style services and the concept of making the best out of local materials to blend architectural aesthetics with accommodation, leisure, food culture, bathing enjoyment, and many other elements into every corners of the hotel, hoping to convey the beauty and charm of Taiwan and Beitou to all guests visiting the hotel, bringing travelers rich humanities and the natural flavor of the leisure space. The hotel offers a total of 66 top-level rooms, Chinese and Western restaurants, 24 hours concierge, eight private baths, open-air baths, Le Spa, and many other services. When you are in the hotel you will feel like wandering in the most beautiful vacation paradise. Each room has more than 16 pings (floor area) of private space with a great mountain view, allowing you enjoy the most comfortable leisure environment, why you are staying in your room. Chinese Cuisine and Western European Restaurants select certified local fresh ingredients, and our chefs magically prepare specialty cuisine stunning your visual and taste buds to make eating an aesthetic attitude. The hotel's bathing enjoyment planning is definitely worth tasting. The intimate space surrounded by mountains, and the warm, moist, nourishing white sulfur springs is one of the four largest white sulfur springs in the world. Grand View Resort Beitou perfectly presents you so beautiful realm to allow your body, mind, and soul to be completely returned to zero and relaxed.

stays.searchText: 北投麗禧溫泉酒店 北投麗禧溫泉酒店股份有限公司 交觀業字第1365號 臺北市 北投區 幽雅路30號 大自然與人文的相遇位在北投的制高點，緊鄰陽明山國家公園、遠眺丹鳳山脈、坐擁大屯山系，盡享「山、水、天、地」的麗禧酒店，全館由李祖原建築師一手規劃，以原木和石材為主、鍍鈦金屬和天然植栽為輔，將珍貴的自然生態景觀與建築概念巧妙融合，呈現出自然天地與人文結合的深沉內斂、雋永脫俗的不凡特質。台式原味 就地取材的休閒美學有別於其他溫泉酒店富含日本風格的服務與設計，北投麗禧酒店強調以台式服務及台灣就地取材的概念將建築美學、住宿休憩、飲食文化、泡湯享樂等多種元素融入在飯店各個角落，希望將北投與台灣的美與韻味傳達給所有造訪酒店的貴賓，帶給旅人富含人文素養與自然氣息的休閒空間。盡攬山色 馳放心靈的渡假經驗共提供66間頂級客房、中西式餐飲、24小時禮賓接待服務、8間私人湯屋、露天風呂、麗漾spa等多項服務，當您置身麗禧宛如徜徉在最美的渡假天堂。每一間客房除了擁有16坪以上的私人空間，也都擁有絕佳的山林視野，讓您住宿於客房時，享有最舒適的休憩環境。中餐雍翠庭與西式歐陸餐廳，擷取當地認證的新鮮食材，透過主廚巧思創意，有如魔法般烹調出讓您的視覺與味蕾盡享驚豔的特色美食，讓飲食成為一種美學態度。滋養泉水 身心靈放鬆的美好感受而更值得您品味的是麗禧為您規畫的泡湯享受，山林環繞的隱密空間、溫潤滋養的白磺溫泉，是全球四大白磺泉水之一，讓您身、心、靈全然歸零與放鬆，如此美好的境界麗禧為您完美呈現。

stays.nameEn: Jia Bin Ger Hot Spring Resorts Hotel
stays.description: 嘉賓閣，一間歷史悠久的溫泉旅館，位在台灣溫泉旅館的發源地-北投，從光復初期開始經營已近70個年頭，從日治時期建物歷經多次改建裝修，發展至今，已轉型為現代化的溫泉旅館，在北投地區獨樹一格，提供舒適且具有時尚感的休閒渡假空間，讓每位路過的旅人都想留連駐足！ 館址位於北投溫泉區的心臟地帶，近新北投捷運站，正對世界最美圖書館之一的北投圖書館，周邊如新北投公園、北投文物館、北投溫泉博物館、凱達格蘭文化館、地熱谷…等知名旅遊聖地，近在咫尺，是情侶或全家輕鬆出遊，體驗泡湯文化的最佳選擇! 館內提供多樣化的溫泉房型選擇，每間房間均設有精心設計的溫泉泡湯浴室，舒適的空間讓人忘卻一切的疲憊，不論是泡湯、渡假、休閒，皆能滿足您不同的需求，享受身心的舒緩。 交通方面, 若您是捷運族，便利的捷運是您光臨北投嘉賓閣溫泉旅館的最好方法，新北投捷運站徒步可及；若您選擇開車渡假，本館一樓附有停車場，提供您安心的泊車服務。 以客為尊，用心秉持優質的服務，是嘉賓閣經營團隊對每一位貴賓的承諾。
stays.descriptionEn: JBG Hot Spring Resort Hotel is a hot spring resort with a history. It is located in Beitou, where the first hot spring resorts began. Over 70 years of soothing the weariness, the resort grew and remodeled into the modern hotel as we see now. It is one of the most comfortable and modern resort in the area.Situated in the center of Beitou near Xinbeitou MRT Station and Beitou Library, JBG Hot Spring Resort Hotel is close to many attractions like Xinbeitou Park, Taiwan Folk Arts Museum, Hot Spring Museum and Beitou Geothermal Valley. It is the best place to explore and enjoy the hot spring culture.The hotel provides a variety of hot spring rooms. Each room is installed with complete hot spring facilities to guarantee the best hot spring experience. It is suitable for vacation, getaway and family.The Taipei MRT takes you straight to Beitou where only a few minute walk to JBG Hot Spring Resort Hotel. The hotel also provides parking space for personal vehicles and valet parking service.To ensure the best hot spring and accommodation experience for all guests with the finest facilities and service is what JBG Hot Spring Hotel Resort hopes to accomplish.

images.description: 風采雲集，touching每一份期待 在雲集感受氣的流動，洗滌一切紛紛擾擾，將心靈沉澱回歸最原始的樣貌，尋找純粹的感動原點。簡約的線條、淡雅的暖色系色調，高張力的床墊，柔和的燈光配置，每一處細節都為您的深度睡眠而考慮周延，如同我們自己的需要。 觸目潔淨無染，觸手則是不忍離手的創意器皿，每一個小小的貼心備品、小小的驚喜設計，觸動著每一顆渴望著被呵護、被寵愛的心靈。 每一種房型、每一個房間，都是這麼令人觸目、觸手、觸心。

images.description: 丹鳳翩翩，寧靜華美 如果，您偏愛音樂，這裡正巧有許多來不及叫喚名稱的鳥兒為您奉上。它們或許只是路過，或許正巧停留在您窗前的樹梢頭；這時，窗外滿眼的綠意，點綴著幾分好動的色彩，竟是這些不名音樂的歌手，且它們非常的擅長。 緊依丹鳳的窗，正如同一幅會唱歌的畫；從清晨變幻到入夜，從鳥叫變幻到蟲鳴；色彩隨同音樂，最是人間忘憂大藥。

stays.description: 台北山樂溫泉就位於著名的泡湯勝地─北投泉源路上，搭乘捷運至新北投站，只要步行數分鐘的時間便可體會到這嶄新寧靜的泡湯空間，山樂溫泉所提供給您的不只是單純的泡湯，更是一個讓您體會裝潢藝術與徹底放鬆的人文住宿空間。優越的地理位置與絕佳的泡湯氣氛，是您休息、住宿、商務約會的最佳溫泉飯店選擇山樂溫泉為每一位來此泡湯的旅客們準備了各種精緻的湯屋，使用高級的飯店備品並提供寬倘的泡湯空間，讓您享有一個隱密且不被打擾的環境，體會您每吋肌膚及每個毛細孔與原湯的親暱，天然的溫泉結合溫馨的套房，一掃您平日的忙碌與陰霾，享受愜意悠閒的幸福生活，讓彼此情感更為甜蜜，使泡湯感受更昇級！ 天然原湯加上濃厚的人文氣息所建構的湯屋，撫動著全身細胞，住宿在山樂溫泉飯店，盡情享受屬於您的尊寵禮遇。山樂溫泉的水質、水溫、水量及各項溫泉設施都有安全人員嚴密控管，衛生品質上也比地面湧泉來的純淨安全。是屬於白磺泉(酸性硫磺鹽泉)屬弱酸性；對慢性皮膚病、關節炎、婦人病等都有顯著的改善效果。山樂溫泉將湯屋與套房結合，提供您私密的泡湯空間，可盡情享受泡湯樂趣，體會您每吋肌膚及每個毛細孔與原湯的親暱，天然的溫泉結合溫馨的套房，一掃您平日的忙碌與陰霾，享受愜意悠閒的幸福生活，彼此情感更為甜蜜，使泡湯感受更為昇級！

stays.name: 日勝生加賀屋國際溫泉飯店
stays.description: 位於臺北市的一般觀光旅館，全館採和風建築原則，講求均衡比例且圓融的風格， 館內並裝飾日本石川縣具代表性的特有工藝品，如輪 島漆、九谷燒、金箔等，讓賓客處處可感受日本藝術之美。全館共有九十間客室，樸質的客房內設有榻榻米的精巧和室客廳，以障子門或木門區隔出多功能的起居空間，每間客室內皆設置舒適的泡湯設備，而臥室間則分別有西式床鋪與日式床墊，讓賓客有更多舒適的選擇。位處大屯山系下，擁有大自然恩惠的白磺泉，洗滌身心靈的疲憊，讓每位造訪的賓客能獲得全然的放鬆。四樓大眾湯「望月」、「遠山」面對北投山系綠意，內設置室內浴池、水療水床、烤箱和蒸氣室等完善設施。五樓個人湯屋十六間靜謐且風格各具的個人湯屋，浴池各自以陶藝、檜木、天然磨石為主題，呈現各種不同的樣貌。由日本頂級沙龍 Socie 施舒雅打造， 特別引進英國知名名牌 ESPA 之保養品，以無壓的空間設計，和專業的手法和課程，體會再次甦醒的澄靜放鬆之旅。料理依隨季節變化，嚴選上等食材與能登傳統的調理手法，透過食材美好的滋味來滿足每位賓客的味蕾。料理長並親自精心挑選雅緻的食器搭配，讓每道佳餚都展現最風雅的姿態。位於六樓的宴會廳，共有六間以傳統日本風格打造的宴會場地。場地內備有完善的會議設備，亦提供會議午餐或日式會席晚宴料理。讓賓客留下與眾不同的難忘經驗。三樓天翔廳提供精緻午間套餐和豐盛晚間會席料理。設有 7 間用餐包廂，是親友歡聚、商務宴客的絕佳場所。二樓日和 lounge，可輕鬆於此享用特製輕食小點和下午茶點，二樓夕月 bar，供應豐富的日本藏酒、多款異國精選佳釀和特調。
stays.descriptionEn: The Radium Kagaya International Hotel is located in the Beitou district of Taipei City, less than a 5 minute walk from the Xinbeitou Metro Rail Transit (MRT) Station. Conveniently situated across the hotel are historic landmarks such as the Beitou Hot Spring Museum and the eco-friendly Taipei Public Library (Beitou Branch).AccommodationsThe hotel offers 90 exquisitely appointed Japanese Sukiya style guestrooms ranging in size from 13 pings to 32 pings. All guestrooms feature cypress wood or marble hot springs bathing facilities, generous living spaces, premium mattresses and luxurious down beddings for an unforgettable night’s rest. Public and Private Hot Spring Rooms The public hot-spring facility overlooks the picturesque Beitou mountainside and is equipped with indoor bathing areas, sauna and steam rooms allowing guests to experience total relaxation. 17 individual hot-spring rooms provide guests with the utmost privacy; these bath houses employ cypress wood and natural millstones as themes, displaying various different decor, and providing guests with another type of choice. The Spa by Socie (5F)Operated by Japan’s top spa “Socie”, using renowned E-SPA skin care products imported from England, employing a tranquil interior design and professional techniques and treatments, bringing you a once in a lifetime luxurious serenity.Dining (In Room)The chef serves a traditional “Kaiseki” meal comprised of numerous dishes featuring the freshest ingredients from Taiwan and Japan while employing classical cooking methods originating from the Noto region of Japan, the birthplace of the original Kagaya. Each dish and utensil has been handpicked to enable the guest to experience a truly authentic Japanese meal. Tenshou Restaurant The restaurant overlooks the lush mountains of Beitou. Aside from the Kaiseki meals, Tenshou provides authentic Japanese dishes for lunch and dinner. Tenshou also has 7 private dining rooms to cater to larger parties, family gatherings and business banquets. Yuuduki Bar (2F)The bar overlooks Beitou Park and serves an impressive collection of Japanese sakes, red & white wines, imported and local beers.Function/Conference Rooms (6F) Conference rooms are located on the sixth floor and are adorned in the traditional Japanese-style. The 6 rooms cater to small and larger groups depending on the need. The venues are equipped with complete conference facilities and meal facilities. Guests will leave with an unforgettable meeting experience.

stays.description: 綠徑尋幽現芳蹤轉入幽雅路，身邊的城市消失在北投的綠蔭中，空氣中發酵著硫磺及芬多精的氣息，一路稀釋著由塵囂帶來的疲憊。從春天酒店大門走入，清爽明亮的空間感迎面而來，如春風般的笑容、頷首致意的表情，讓人打從心底有如沐春風之感；耳畔傳來古典優雅的樂章，讓人在尋常的日子裡，常保美麗好心情。春天酒店四周明亮的落地玻璃，將目光引向花木扶疏的庭園，藉此空間延伸向戶外，心境也隨之開朗，在這裡為您揭開春的序曲；花園式庭園景觀，巧妙結合著環繞山群與綠意盎然的林木；四季依時序綻放的花卉，創造出倚景賞景開放環境。春天的庭園延伸大廳與南國風情餐廳的空間，不論晴雨晨昏，景致變化萬千，讓時空落在愛麗絲的夢幻仙境中，邀您立即呼朋引伴，展開與春天的約會。 浸浴白磺幸福湯北投春天近於台北市陽明山系大磺嘴源頭，所提供的白磺泉，泉質為弱酸性單純泉，平均溫度約38~42度，酸鹼值在PH4-5。因白磺泉呈乳白色，而有牛奶湯之稱，又幫助改善皮膚病，美容具有效果，又有美人湯之美名。春天酒店提供四種不同風格的客房式湯屋，讓您在私密的空間裡享受完全放鬆的泡湯體驗；露天風呂更設有多種SPA功能池，讓您去除身心壓力，必能幸福滿分！幽雅空間享寧靜春天酒店共有81間客房，米白色系調和出溫馨舒適氣息，簡單雅緻設計，創造寧靜空間感，客房內觀音石浴池，讓房客輕鬆享受白磺原湯。全館提供免費無線上網(FREE WIFI)、有線電視、電冰箱、獨立浴缸和淋浴設備和泡茶機，房客還可使用露天風呂、紅檜俱樂部、戶外泳池、健身房、SPA、中/日式餐廳等設施服務，是您遠離塵囂拜訪北投渡假的首選！閒逸竹林 日式桌宴遠近馳名的「竹林亭」，是北投最有特色的日式料理餐廳，更是北投唯一能夠端出日式料理「桌宴」的溫泉饗宴，師傅高超手藝、新鮮天然食材、匠心組合搭配，彷彿演奏一場華麗視覺與細膩味蕾的交響樂，讓人如癡如醉，久久不能忘懷。超鮮美上等刺身拼盤、物超所值特色揚、燒、煮、鍋物，一場精采絕倫的日式春酒尾牙宴就等您來品嚐~幽雅18 中西美食座落於四季庭園的「幽雅18」中式餐廳，與心曠神怡露天庭園美景相連，「幽雅18」以精巧手藝將經典台式與中華料理的美味發揮淋漓盡致，將來自豪華辦桌概念，加入主廚新創元素，把頂級佛跳牆、活跳海上鮮、美膳煲湯等名菜佳餚，呈現出精緻不凡、高雅獨特的闊氣桌宴，這是最讓賓客們豎起大拇指讚不絕口的美宴！

It provides hot spring, spa, and beautiful views of Guanyin Mountain and Guandu Plain. & #39;Located near Liuhuanggu (Sulfur Valley,) Spring City Resort offers pure and milky colored springs for guests. The pH level of this spring is considered as weak acid, which is acceptable for human body. stays.name: 泉都溫泉會館
stays.description: 泉都溫泉會館位於新北投捷運站旁,出捷運站步行至會館只需2分鐘,為全臺交通最便利的溫泉會館,不論至台北市中心101大樓、淡水、士林、陽明山國家公園….等皆非常便捷.並且附設大型室內停車場,免除停車的困擾. 會館呈現歐式裝潢精緻雅麗,共有多種客房、1處資訊中心及歐式新穎餐廰.客房內皆附有白磺溫泉,住客可享有私人泡湯空間,並提供多種不同泡湯房型可供選擇,滿足賓客不同的喜好。會館也取得臺北市政府所核發”溫泉標章”,證實為一安心泡湯、住宿場所!除此之外,免費提供多項e化娛樂設備(客房內皆附設免費影音頻道、可無線上網....等),讓您完全體會浪漫時尚的台北溫泉之旅.
stays.descriptionEn: Chyuan Du Spring Resort is not far from downtown to have fresh air and natural surroundings. It is located near Xinbeitou MRT Station ; with only two minutes walking distance. With MRT, travelers can reach almost every major tourist attraction in Taipei, whether it is to the 101 building in the center of Taipei, Tamsui, Shilin, Yangmingshan National Park, etc. And there is a large indoor parking lot to avoid the trouble of parking. The hall presents a European-style exquisite and elegant decoration, with a variety of guest rooms, 1 information center and a new European-style restaurant. The rooms are equipped with white sulfur hot springs, and guests can enjoy a private bathing space, and a variety of different bathing room types are available to meet the different preferences of guests. The hall has also obtained the "Hot Spring Seal" issued by the Taipei City Government, which is confirmed to be a safe bathing and accommodation place! In addition, a number of e-entertainment equipment are provided free of charge (all rooms are equipped with free video channels, wireless Internet access.... etc.), so that you can fully experience the romantic and fashionable Taipei hot spring trip.

stays.nameEn: Li De Bei Tou Hot Spring Hotel
stays.description: 倆人旅店座落於北投幽雅路11號，因門牌「11」圖像看似兩個人，因此飯店以「倆人旅店」為之命名。本飯店為一棟地上三層、地下一層之建物，共有19間各式客房與1間餐廳，由知名設計師李瑋珉所設計，以「鮮明色彩帶動品味」與「簡約中流露浪漫氛圍」為設計重點，打造有別於其他北投溫泉飯店的風格，讓到訪的旅客都能有不同於以往的視覺饗宴。 北投倆人旅店每一層樓都是一個溫暖的小世界，地下一樓以溫暖的「巧克力」色系為主，創造出戀人間濃濃的愛意、1F以奔放的「玫瑰紅」色系為主，將倆人熱情愉悅的渡假心情表現無遺、2F以高雅的「香檳金」色系為主，強調尊榮典雅品味、而3F則以寬廣寧靜的「水藍」色系為主，要讓大家體驗倆人渡假美學、享受倆人旅店的魔幻魅力。
stays.descriptionEn: Hotel Double One, named after their address 11, Youya Rd., is a luxury hot springs hotel in Beitou District, Taipei City. The hotel consists of 3 levels above ground and a basement. Featuring in total of 19 prestigious rooms and a high quality restaurant. The hotel was designed by a famous local designer, breaking the traditional designing style used in other hotels in the area by focusing on the themes of “colors & taste” and “simplicity & romantic”. Applying to every aspects of hotel from interior decorations to furnishings. By doing so, Hotel Double One separates itself from other Beitou hot spring hotels with excellent facilities and one-of-a-kind hot springs accommodating experience. Hotel Double One ensures a unique yet luxurious hot springs accommodation like no other.Every floor within Hotel Double One offers different types of pleasure and visual sensation for guests. Visitors are welcomed with colors of “Red Roses” on the 1st floor, “Champagne Gold” colors were used to project a sophisticated and elegant atmosphere on the 2nd floor. “Aqua Blue” on the 3rd floor represents the magical hot springs accommodation experience Hotel Double has to offer while the basement is covered with “chocolate” themed colors to emphasis the sweetness of love.
