stays.name: 馥悅溫泉酒店
stays.description: 皇室風範-北投溫泉館 位於台北市郊的北投溫泉館則承繼了皇家季節酒店一貫的堅持與品味，於2008年12月以歐洲宮廷風格為溫泉寫下新的意義。 每間客房內以淡色大理石手工打造的浴室，展現羅馬的浴場風格，天然的白磺泉自獅頭的口中傾洩而下，讓你遠離俗世的塵囂。北投溫泉館特別摒棄大眾池的設計，以湯屋的型式提供服務，為每一組顧客保留專屬的入浴空間。湯屋裡擺放特別訂製加寬的貴妃椅、壁面加掛的電視，讓你在泡湯之餘，也可輕鬆休閒小憩。因為深知顧客的需要，每間湯屋都有各自獨立的廁所。北投溫泉館不以華麗取勝，卻奢侈地讓顧客擁有最大的空間，是令人感動的溫暖心意。
stays.descriptionEn: Royal Style - Beitou Spring House At the suburb of Taipei City, Beitou Spring House inherited the persistence and style passed down consistent;y within the Royal Seasons Hotel and redefined the hot spring with the European court style back in December 2008. In every room, a bathroom is hand crafted with light tone marble to demonstrate a Roman bath style. From the lion head shaped faucet, white sulfur spring flows out to wash away your worldly disturbances. In defiance of the public bath design, our bath provide a spring service in the form of private bath where every group of guests can enjoy their personal bathing space. The bath has a custom-made wide chaise longue and a wall-mounted TV for you to relax inside during your time at the bath. Based on our insight into customers& #39; needs, we have set up independent restrooms for every bath. Here at Beitou Spring House, we feature the widest space for guests rather than luxury to show our heartwarming care for customers.

stays.searchText: 馥悅溫泉酒店 東南大飯店(股)公司 臺北市旅館148號 臺北市 北投區 中山路26號1-5樓 皇室風範-北投溫泉館 位於台北市郊的北投溫泉館則承繼了皇家季節酒店一貫的堅持與品味，於2008年12月以歐洲宮廷風格為溫泉寫下新的意義。 每間客房內以淡色大理石手工打造的浴室，展現羅馬的浴場風格，天然的白磺泉自獅頭的口中傾洩而下，讓你遠離俗世的塵囂。北投溫泉館特別摒棄大眾池的設計，以湯屋的型式提供服務，為每一組顧客保留專屬的入浴空間。湯屋裡擺放特別訂製加寬的貴妃椅、壁面加掛的電視，讓你在泡湯之餘，也可輕鬆休閒小憩。因為深知顧客的需要，每間湯屋都有各自獨立的廁所。北投溫泉館不以華麗取勝，卻奢侈地讓顧客擁有最大的空間，是令人感動的溫暖心意。

stays.name: 麗之湯別館
stays.description: 嚮往幽靜的旅人啊，你是不是正在尋覓一個天堂，能遠離塵囂、忘卻時光流逝的地方…麗之湯溫泉會館坐落於台灣溫泉源頭之地-北投，典雅精緻的日式風格，令許多觀光客慕名而來，走上露天陽台，一抹氤氳迷濛絕美，和風吹拂，藏不住那若隱若現的翠綠青山，沿著指標，滿谷悠然硫磺香，地熱谷、綠建築圖書館、北投溫泉博物館僅幾步之遙…走累了，為您獻上特有美人牛奶浴湯，100%天然白硫磺泉質，呈淡黃半透明水色，淺淺硫磺味，搭配細緻的原石溫泉浴池，讓飄散的蒸氣與硫磺，帶走您一身的疲憊。若這地方讓您流連忘返，不如在此駐留一晚吧！

stays.name: 南港老爺行旅
stays.description: 老爺酒店集團旗下風格設計品牌「老爺行旅」，以the place為名，強調與飯店所在地意象文化的深度連結，並堅持「Fun、Fusion、Fashion」的品牌精神，2014年第一家行旅於台南開幕，接續宜蘭傳藝、台中大毅，2019年正式落腳台北。飯店室內設計特聘荷蘭設計團隊Mecanoo規畫179間簡約時尚客房、藝文公共空間、會議室及特色餐廳。運用港口、紅磚、茶葉等具歷史意義的圖紋元素，將不同時刻的南港意象呈獻於館中。飯店建築外觀及燈光設計由國際知名大師李祖原與袁宗南共同操刀，外觀以流線造型豐富天際線的輪廓，點綴建築在區位的特色，強調位處於交通樞紐的重要位置；夜晚新穎獨特的舞動燈光照明，為台灣首座使用WIFI操作新型芯片，共同創造出南港極具特色的新地標。
stays.descriptionEn: "The Place", is a brand crafted with style under the Hotel Royal Group. The name of "the Place" stresses deep link to local culture where the hotel locates, and insists the spirit of "Fun, Fusion, Fashion". The Place first opened in Tainan in 2014, then the Place Yilan, the Place Taichung were born. In 2019, the Place officially opens in Taipei.Design team from Mecanoo architecten in Holland was appointed on a project basis for the interior design of the hotel. The team planned for 179 chic and simple rooms, the public art space, meeting rooms and specialty restaurants. The team uses ports, red bricks, tea and other historical and pictorial elements in the hotel to present different periods of Nangang.The exterior and lighting of the hotel building are designed by internationally famous C.Y. Lee and James Yuan. The façade is streamlined to enrich the silhouette of skyline, adding to local features of the building, and stressing the importance of being the center of transportation; the unique, innovative and moving lighting at night is the first system to operate by new type of chip with WIFI, together creating a very distinctive landmark in Nangang.

stays.description: 台北漢來大飯店總樓高26樓、地下4樓及近900格停車位，承襲「漢來式感動服務」精神，具備國際飯店服務指標的金鑰匙與英式管家協會雙認證，與國際五星級奢華住宿體驗接軌。飯店擁有425間精緻客房及可俯瞰大台北全景的奢華套房，客房面積自13坪至160坪不等，俐落簡約的世紀中期現代主義元素與灰白色系相互映襯，搭配大片落地玻璃設計，盡收南港周邊與基隆河景、都會夜景，還有風情萬千的戶外禮堂及無邊際泳池景致。
stays.descriptionEn: The Grand Hilai Taipei stands at a height of 26 floors with 4 underground levels and nearly 900 parking spaces.Inheriting the spirit of “Grand Hilai-style Hospitality and Heartwarming Services,” the hotel holds dual certificationsfrom the Les Clefs d’Or (Golden Keys) and the British Butler Guild (UKBG), aligning it with the luxury experience of international five-star accommodations. The hotel offers 425 exquisite guest rooms, including luxurious suites with panoramic views of Greater Taipei. Room sizes range from 43sqm to 528sqm. The well-appointed rooms feature a sleek and minimalist mid-century modern design with a grayscale color palette, complemented by expansive floor-to-ceiling glass, offering breathtaking views of Nangang District, Keelung River, Taipei skyline, as well as charming outdoor venues and an infinity pool.

stays.name: 台北馥華商旅南港館
stays.description: 飯店歷史繼台北馥華商旅松江館開幕後，馥華集團以成功打造板橋馥華飯店、馥都飯店、馥麗商旅、新莊馥華大觀商旅等飯店之經驗，歷經1年時間的改造及翻修，再度成功打造台北馥華商旅南港館，成為南港經貿園區首家商務精品旅店，簡潔的歐洲建築物外觀為南港經貿園區帶來優閒的浪漫氛圍。舒適乾淨是台北馥華商旅所要傳達的感覺，從典雅的白色系裝潢到時尚的現代北歐設計概念，有著北歐風的多開窗設計，使得每個房間都能享有明亮的自然採光，營造柔和溫馨的氣氛，也希望能提供旅客更溫馨舒適的住宿環境，嶄新的「台北馥華商旅南港館」就此誕生。簡介台北馥華商旅(南港館)，建築物外觀以歐式風格藍白色系為主色調，潮流線條式的風格，整棟座落於南港三重路上，南港經貿園區旁，南港展覽館步行約5分鐘；正前方有捷運板南線及文湖線步行約5分鐘，緊鄰環東快速道路、國道中山高、北二高交通非常便捷；典雅大方的設計、濃厚的異國風情，為南港經貿園區帶來優閒的浪漫氛圍。館內66間客房均提供32吋液晶電視、免費寬頻有線無線上網、日本衛星收視頻道NHK等，讓您的商務旅程資訊零時差。使用防燃建材及自動偵煙設備，讓每位住客都能安心享受高雅舒適的住宿環境；大廳提供24小時電腦、網路、郵件收發、傳真，提供商務商旅最便利貼心的服務。
stays.descriptionEn: After the opening of the Songjiang branch, Forward Group opened Banqiao Forward Hotel, Grand Forward Hotel, Fu Li Hotel, Xinzhuang Hotel Purity, and after a year of remodeling and renovation, the Forward Hotel Taipei in Nangang, which became Nangang Business Park’s top business hotel. The simple European architecture brings a relaxing, romantic atmosphere to Nangang Business Park. Forward Hotel Taipei wishes to convey an impression of comfort and cleanliness, from elegant white decorations to modern, fashionable European design. Northern European window design allows for great natural lighting and creates a warm atmosphere, and it was our hope to provide visitors with the most warm and comfortable living environment when opening the new Forward Hotel Taipei in Nangang. The building features European architecture, a blue-white color theme, and trendy line-style exterior. It’s located on Sanchong Road in Nangang, next to Nangang Business Park and a 5 minute walk from Taipei World Trade Center Nangang Exhibition Hall. In front are the Bannan and Wenhu MRT lines, about a 5 minute walk away, and transportation is quite convenient with nearby roads including the Huandong Expressway and National Highway 1 and 3. Elegant, tasteful design and an exotic style bring a romantic atmosphere to Nangang Business Park. The hotel’s 66 rooms come with 32-inch liquid crystal TVs, free wireless Internet service, and the NHK channel to keep visitors up to date with the latest news and information. Fire-proof building materials and smoke detectors provide our elegant, comfortable rooms with a sense of security. For the convenience of business travelers, computer, Internet, mail, and fax services are available 24 hours a day in the main lobby.

stays.searchText: 台北馥華商旅南港館 台北馥華商旅南港股份有限公司 臺北市旅館369號 臺北市 南港區 三重路23號1-4樓 飯店歷史繼台北馥華商旅松江館開幕後，馥華集團以成功打造板橋馥華飯店、馥都飯店、馥麗商旅、新莊馥華大觀商旅等飯店之經驗，歷經1年時間的改造及翻修，再度成功打造台北馥華商旅南港館，成為南港經貿園區首家商務精品旅店，簡潔的歐洲建築物外觀為南港經貿園區帶來優閒的浪漫氛圍。舒適乾淨是台北馥華商旅所要傳達的感覺，從典雅的白色系裝潢到時尚的現代北歐設計概念，有著北歐風的多開窗設計，使得每個房間都能享有明亮的自然採光，營造柔和溫馨的氣氛，也希望能提供旅客更溫馨舒適的住宿環境，嶄新的「台北馥華商旅南港館」就此誕生。簡介台北馥華商旅(南港館)，建築物外觀以歐式風格藍白色系為主色調，潮流線條式的風格，整棟座落於南港三重路上，南港經貿園區旁，南港展覽館步行約5分鐘；正前方有捷運板南線及文湖線步行約5分鐘，緊鄰環東快速道路、國道中山高、北二高交通非常便捷；典雅大方的設計、濃厚的異國風情，為南港經貿園區帶來優閒的浪漫氛圍。館內66間客房均提供32吋液晶電視、免費寬頻有線無線上網、日本衛星收視頻道NHK等，讓您的商務旅程資訊零時差。使用防燃建材及自動偵煙設備，讓每位住客都能安心享受高雅舒適的住宿環境；大廳提供24小時電腦、網路、郵件收發、傳真，提供商務商旅最便利貼心的服務。

stays.name: 丹迪旅店-天母店
stays.description: 雅緻、異國風座落於外籍人士聚居，素有小聯合國稱號的天母地區。街道上濃厚的異國情調，以遠處的陽明山自然風光，有別於市區的紛擾喧囂而獨樹一格。街道上不見西裝革履神色匆忙的路人，取而代之的是怡然自在有如身在歐洲的浪漫氛圍。人文、沉穩、低調丹迪旅店精心擘劃建立一間屬於天母地緣的特色旅館，融入天母地區高格調的生活品味。特別遠道邀請義大利米蘭建築及室內設計師 Massimo mussapi，以人文、沉穩、低調為主軸，在簡約設計的概念中，展露深刻的人文品味，並注入創新、時尚的氛圍，讓您有一個難忘的旅遊饗宴。全館共有8層樓面，54間客房。來預約一份充滿愉悅的旅宿體驗吧！當陽光渲染滿天，灑落一地，將您從熟睡之中喚醒的剎那，您是否感到假期充滿愜意的氣息？悠閒地伸個懶腰，步出輕盈的步調，這才是假期應享的生活。旅店每位同仁隨時期待與您微笑相接。

Dandy Hotel Tianmu branch takes pride on its elegant decors and chic, Italian-inspired interior, with 54 guest rooms that are tastefully-appointed, spacious and readily equipped with modern amenities to suit the needs of today''''''''s travelers. For added luxury, there are 42-inch LCD TV with satellite channels, in-room safe and Internet access available. The “X-Cafe” on the ground floor is the Hotel’s first collaboration with TEDx Taipei. The beautiful alfreco cafe provides international buffet breakfast as well as signature cocktails throughout the day.

stays.searchText: 丹迪旅店-天母店 丹迪旅店股份有限公司 臺北市旅館301號 臺北市 士林區 中山北路六段728巷2號1-7樓 雅緻、異國風座落於外籍人士聚居，素有小聯合國稱號的天母地區。街道上濃厚的異國情調，以遠處的陽明山自然風光，有別於市區的紛擾喧囂而獨樹一格。街道上不見西裝革履神色匆忙的路人，取而代之的是怡然自在有如身在歐洲的浪漫氛圍。人文、沉穩、低調丹迪旅店精心擘劃建立一間屬於天母地緣的特色旅館，融入天母地區高格調的生活品味。特別遠道邀請義大利米蘭建築及室內設計師 Massimo mussapi，以人文、沉穩、低調為主軸，在簡約設計的概念中，展露深刻的人文品味，並注入創新、時尚的氛圍，讓您有一個難忘的旅遊饗宴。全館共有8層樓面，54間客房。來預約一份充滿愉悅的旅宿體驗吧！當陽光渲染滿天，灑落一地，將您從熟睡之中喚醒的剎那，您是否感到假期充滿愜意的氣息？悠閒地伸個懶腰，步出輕盈的步調，這才是假期應享的生活。旅店每位同仁隨時期待與您微笑相接。

stays.name: 智慧環境會館-菁山遊憩區
stays.description: 於陽明山區七星山下，與紗帽山相望的菁山遊憩區，在陽明山國家公園的重新規劃下，成為北市極為難得的渡假聖地。經過1年多的整修後重新開幕，整個園區煥然一新，6公頃的園區提供了獨棟別墅、景觀湯屋、景觀咖啡、桌菜宴會、豪華露營、環境教育課程與親子Diy及攀樹活動等，非常適合三五好友及親子全家出遊。 園區的餐點以浙江菜聞名，由五星名廚主廚團隊掌勺，搭配陽明山在地食材，設計出精緻豪華的合菜料理及在地養生的精緻料理。近期更推出西式料理滿足不同年齡層的味蕾。當然也少不了精緻美味的下午茶蛋糕，享用餐飲之餘，還可遠眺紗帽山、七星山、觀音山等美景，賞花賞鳥賞夕陽。 相較於台北市區炎熱氣候，位於海拔600公尺高度的園區，氣溫低了約4~5℃舒適宜人。獨特的地理環境孕育了豐富的生態資源，最適合自然環境課程及戶外探索及攀樹活動，放鬆之餘還能充實自我。 工作之餘漫步在大自然的山林步道，左右伴隨著蟬鳴鳥叫，不時還可見到成群的台灣藍鵲互相爭豔啁啾，或是松鼠出來散步覓食，陽明山菁山遊憩區可說是大台北市最近最舒活的世外桃源。
stays.descriptionEn: Yangmingshan Jingshan Recreation AreaThe Jingshan Recreation Area, surrounded by the Mt. Shamao, Mt. Qixing and Mt. Datun, is a legal recreation area in Yangmingshan National Park, only a 40 minutes drive from downtown Taipei. With hot spring cabins, camping areas, campers, landscape restaurants and other facilities, and natural ecology and local elements to create a beautiful rest park, we also provides parent-child diy or tree climbing outdoor activities. It is also the best spot for viewing flowers, bird watching, star watching, watching the sunset. The natural pH value of the springs is close to neutral. After soaking in the hot spring, you can enjoy the famous cuisine of jiangsu and zhejiang or enjoy the delightful afternoon tea.

stays.searchText: 智慧環境會館-菁山遊憩區 智慧環境科技股份有限公司 臺北市旅館638號 臺北市 士林區 菁山路101巷71弄16號 於陽明山區七星山下，與紗帽山相望的菁山遊憩區，在陽明山國家公園的重新規劃下，成為北市極為難得的渡假聖地。經過1年多的整修後重新開幕，整個園區煥然一新，6公頃的園區提供了獨棟別墅、景觀湯屋、景觀咖啡、桌菜宴會、豪華露營、環境教育課程與親子Diy及攀樹活動等，非常適合三五好友及親子全家出遊。 園區的餐點以浙江菜聞名，由五星名廚主廚團隊掌勺，搭配陽明山在地食材，設計出精緻豪華的合菜料理及在地養生的精緻料理。近期更推出西式料理滿足不同年齡層的味蕾。當然也少不了精緻美味的下午茶蛋糕，享用餐飲之餘，還可遠眺紗帽山、七星山、觀音山等美景，賞花賞鳥賞夕陽。 相較於台北市區炎熱氣候，位於海拔600公尺高度的園區，氣溫低了約4~5℃舒適宜人。獨特的地理環境孕育了豐富的生態資源，最適合自然環境課程及戶外探索及攀樹活動，放鬆之餘還能充實自我。 工作之餘漫步在大自然的山林步道，左右伴隨著蟬鳴鳥叫，不時還可見到成群的台灣藍鵲互相爭豔啁啾，或是松鼠出來散步覓食，陽明山菁山遊憩區可說是大台北市最近最舒活的世外桃源。

stays.name: 有誠商旅
stays.description: 本飯店坐落於士林區外雙溪地區，與世界五大博物館之一的「國立故宮博物館」比鄰而居，獨到的地理位置，讓本飯店具有鬧中取靜的獨有特色。鄰近北市著名景點士林夜市、士林官邸、陽明山國家公園、天母市集等，更是旅遊休閒的優質選擇。飯店整體大量使用天然木質材料，風格沉穩內斂，結合自然素材與大地色調，以簡單設計勾勒高雅品味。舒適潔淨的客房加上親切體貼的服務，提供每一位旅客享受回歸自然、溫暖如家的貼心感受，成就您美好旅遊的休憩時光。

stays.name: 三德大飯店
stays.description: 三德大飯店於1979年正式營運以來，始終堅持「以客為尊」的尊榮服務、闊綽風範的現代雅緻套房、高科技隱密安全設備，來體貼每一位蒞臨貴賓，因此無論是從商務洽公到國際觀光旅行，多年來一向特別深受歐、美、日國際觀光旅客及全球商務菁英人仕的青睞。本飯店週邊交通便捷、四通八達，民權西路捷運站、台北火車站，及眾多公車網絡都近在咫尺之內無論是觀光出遊、洽公都暢快便捷；腹地內之旅遊景點首推台北美術館及孔子廟，不但有豐富的藝術生活、人文體驗，更是大台北亙古之今的文化代表。
stays.descriptionEn: Santos Hotel, since its inauguration in 1979, has always adhered to offering "customer-oriented" services that is considerate to every guests, such as modern elegant suites of generous style and hidden high-tech security equipment. So, over the years, whether it is for a business trip or for an international tourism and travel, Santos Hotel has always been popular in international leisure travelers and global business elites of all ages from Europe, America, and Japan. Transportation surrounding the hotel is convenient and accessible. Minquan West Road MRT Station, Taipei Main Station, and many bus networks are within easy reach. Whether sightseeing trip or business trip, it is fun and convenient. The first two recommended attractions in the vicinity of the hotel are Taipei Fine Arts Museum and Taipei Confucius Temple, where you can find not only a wealth of artistic life, humanistic experiences, but also the cultural representatives of Taipei since time immemorial.
stays.operatorName: 三德觀光大飯店股份有限公司

stays.description: 台北市重慶北路二段172號（地下三層地上十四層）。其一至三層爲古蹟保留，其原為臺灣鳳梨王葉金塗古宅，葉宅建於西元1926年，於1929年落成，外觀1到3樓是古建築，紅色磚瓦加上洗石子結構，為古典巴洛克式風格；4樓以上則是由灰色花崗石材所砌成的全新建物。新與舊，原本看似衝突的兩種元素，獨具絕色。
stays.descriptionEn: About Taipei City HotelFEATURES OF THE HOTELNo.172, Sec. 2, Chongqing N. Rd., Datong Dist., Taipei City (3 floors underground and 14 floors on the ground). The 1st to 3rd floors are preserved historic relics. It was the ancient house of top Taiwanese pineapple merchant, Ye Jin-tu. The house of the Ye family was built in 1926 and completed in 1929. The 1st to 3rd floors are the ancient building. The red tiles and the structure of facial washed terrazzo belong to Baroque style. The 4th to 11th floors are the new building with grey granite. The seemingly conflicting new and old elements are uniquely integrated.

stays.name: 北門文旅
stays.description: 承襲台北府城北門承恩門，台北城自古以來的入口，開辦了北門這個老字號旅社，接待來自各地的旅人們；重新裝修規劃後以「北門文旅」的全新形象呈現，復刻鯤溟會館的經典繡面，將歷史文化與視覺創意結合，並運用AR與VR最新虛擬、擴增實境技術重現舊時大稻埕百年風華，注入旅館之中，賦予全新的生命，在世代的交替中寫下創新的一頁！位於台北市大同區的北門文旅，在捷運、台鐵、高鐵的共構範圍內，交通的便利性不在話下，未來完工的機場捷運，同時提供旅人全方位的交通選擇。鄰近寧夏夜市、後站商圈以及中山、京站廣場，體驗當個摩登台北人享受美食與購物的樂趣；當代藝術館與華山文創園區所提供的空間，讓人沉浸在脫俗的藝文生活中，北門多元生活圈提供旅人外出留宿的最佳選擇！
stays.descriptionEn: Inherited from Taipei Prefecture Capital North Gate, Beimen Cheng-En Gate, also known as the ancient entrance to Taipei City, this old famous hotel opened at Beimen used to receive tourists from around the world; after being renovated and redecorated, “Bayman Hotel” is presented with a brand new image. Engraved with the classical embroidery of Kun Ming Hall, its historical culture is integrated with visual creativity, presenting the ancient elegance of Tataocheng with the latest virtual and augmented reality technology of AR and VR. All introduced into the hotel, a new life was given, composing a new page during the shifting of the generations!Located at Datong District in Taipei City, Bayman Hotel is within the scope of MRT, Taiwan Railways and Taiwan High Speed Rail, accessible in all senses. In the future when the airport MRT is constructed, it will also provide the travelers a full range of transportation options. Closed to Ningxia Night Market, rear station commercial district, Zhongshan Square and Q Sqaure, one can experience the life of a modern Taipei resident, enjoying delicacies and shopping fun. The areas provided by Museum of Contemporary Art and Huashan 1914 Creative Park allow everyone to be immersed in the otherworldly artistic and cultural life. Thus, the dynamic life in Beimen provides the travelers the best option for accommodation!

stays.name: 北門臥客青年旅舍
stays.description: 北門臥客青年旅舍WE COME Hostel，座落於台北最古老的人文薈萃之地「大稻埕」之中。 循著充滿歷史氛圍的街道巷弄，北門臥客永遠亮著燈，歡迎您的到來。在這裡您可以卸下旅途的辛勞、認識來自世界各地的旅伴、或是消磨一個上午的時間待在臥客裡看一本書，好好放鬆沉澱。 每個人都是一盞燈，發出獨特的光芒，用不同色彩、亮度照亮這個空間。我們相信，點亮北門臥客的，是每一位來自世界不同角落的旅客，希望在這裡我們能夠互相交流，進而更加認識彼此旅途的故事。
stays.descriptionEn: WE COME Hostel is located in the oldest area where was aggregation of human life back in the time called "Da Dao Cheng".Follow the old streets and walk along the laneways which has full of historic atmosphere, WE COME Hostel will always lighting up to welcome your arrival. Here, you can leave the stress behind, have a nice little chat with other travellers from all over the world. Or just relax in the morning stays in with your favorite book, enjoy your time.Everyone shines in unique light, different color and different brightness. We believe our guests from all over the world light up our light. We are hoping to know more about our guests and to exchange our stories during our journey, to get to know about you and your stories.

stays.name: 台北君品大酒店
stays.description: C’est Bon! C’est Magnifique! C’est Unique!座落於台北西區，君品酒店以頂級、精巧且摩登的空間與服務，為來自世界各地的商務及觀光客呈現宛如城市綠洲的體驗，提供充滿奢華美學表現的舒適環境，以及個人化的細緻、貼心服務。結合頂級美饌（C’est Bon）、奢華住宿（C’est Magnifique）以及貼心的「一站式服務」（C’est Unique），君品酒店完美再現了中國與巴黎這兩個分居東西世界歷史文化上的中心，創造出無可比擬的酒店新美學。美學極致君品酒店以法式新古典風格呈現奢華美學表現的舒適環境，以充滿特色的空間、豐富的藝術收藏與進口家具，映照出高貴的氣質以及歐洲文化的深度，位於14~16樓的「君璽」行政樓層提供絕佳美景與頂級服務。君品酒店以優雅兼具功能的設計為主，有如歐式宮殿的空間中，配備有最先進的通訊視聽器材及設計巧思，不論商務或觀光，君品酒店都能提供一個舒適、有效率的環境。 尊榮體驗君品酒店定位為國際級精緻的商務酒店，以富藝術氣息的歐式風格及家具為主，輔以中國風元素，規劃286間舒適的商務客房，包括單人客房97間、雙人客房175間、豪華套房12間。另有總統套房及副總統套房各1間。「君璽」商務樓層位於酒店14~16樓。旅館地址：臺北市大同區承德路1段3號(君品樓層為地上1樓至地下3樓，地上5樓至地上17樓)
stays.descriptionEn: Located in western Taipei, Palais de Chine Hotel offers exquisite, compact and modern space and services to present urban oasis experience to business persons and tourists from around the world, and features a comfortable environment full of luxury aesthetic expression, as well as personalized meticulous, caring services. Combining top delicacies (C& #39;est Bon), luxury accommodations (C& #39;est Magnifique), and considerate "one-stop service" (C& #39;est Unique), Palais de Chine Hotel perfectly reproduces China and Paris, the two separated historic cultural centers of the world, to create a new unrivaled hotel aesthetic. Palais de Chine Hotel renders the luxury aesthetic of a comfort space in French neoclassical, and uses a space full of character and an extensive art collection and imported furniture to reflect the noble qualities as well as the depth of European culture. The Executive Floors Sceau Imperial located on the 14th to the 16th floors offers great views and top quality service. Palais de Chine Hotel combines functionality with elegant design-based, European-style palace like space, equipped with the latest audiovisual equipment and design ingenuity, whether for business or sightseeing, Palais de Chine Hotel offers a comfortable and efficient environment. Palais de Chine Hotel Taipei is positioned as a world-class sophisticated business hotel, with rich artistic European-style design and furniture, supplemented by Chinese style elements, and offers 286 comfortable guest rooms, including 97 single rooms, 175 double rooms, 12 deluxe suites. In addition, a modern yet comfortable Vice Presidential Suite La Rose, and a luxurious Presidential Suite Charles V. Executive Floors Sceau Imperial are located on the 14th to 16th floors. Hostel Address: No. 3, Section 1, Chengde Road, Datong Dist.,Taipei, Taiwan (Palais de Chine Hotel, Taipei occupies ranging from the 1st ground floor to the 3rd underground floor, and from the 5th ground floor to the 17th ground floor.)

stays.searchText: 台北君品大酒店 雲品國際酒店股份有限公司 交觀宿字第1612號 臺北市 大同區 承德路1段3號(1樓.5樓~16樓及地下1樓.地下3樓) C’est Bon! C’est Magnifique! C’est Unique!座落於台北西區，君品酒店以頂級、精巧且摩登的空間與服務，為來自世界各地的商務及觀光客呈現宛如城市綠洲的體驗，提供充滿奢華美學表現的舒適環境，以及個人化的細緻、貼心服務。結合頂級美饌（C’est Bon）、奢華住宿（C’est Magnifique）以及貼心的「一站式服務」（C’est Unique），君品酒店完美再現了中國與巴黎這兩個分居東西世界歷史文化上的中心，創造出無可比擬的酒店新美學。美學極致君品酒店以法式新古典風格呈現奢華美學表現的舒適環境，以充滿特色的空間、豐富的藝術收藏與進口家具，映照出高貴的氣質以及歐洲文化的深度，位於14~16樓的「君璽」行政樓層提供絕佳美景與頂級服務。君品酒店以優雅兼具功能的設計為主，有如歐式宮殿的空間中，配備有最先進的通訊視聽器材及設計巧思，不論商務或觀光，君品酒店都能提供一個舒適、有效率的環境。 尊榮體驗君品酒店定位為國際級精緻的商務酒店，以富藝術氣息的歐式風格及家具為主，輔以中國風元素，規劃286間舒適的商務客房，包括單人客房97間、雙人客房175間、豪華套房12間。另有總統套房及副總統套房各1間。「君璽」商務樓層位於酒店14~16樓。旅館地址：臺北市大同區承德路1段3號(君品樓層為地上1樓至地下3樓，地上5樓至地上17樓)

stays.description: 城市商旅南西館，以重現大稻埕商務繁華及振興台北城歷史文化為理念，成為台北市西區首屈一指、兼具商務與文化的酒店，提供商務人士及各地旅人寧靜的休憩空間，寬敞挑高氣派的接待大廳，沉穩寬闊的設計、及貼心的住房設備，客房搭配知名家飾設計Gallery Su的家飾精品，讓旅客在此真正的放鬆。旅客可在充滿英式風格的閱讀室，閱讀各類中外報章、雜誌、書冊，輕鬆舒適的體會閱讀的箇中樂趣，並免費品味濃醇香郁的咖啡。酒店提供自助式營養元氣早餐，讓您的旅行有一個精神飽滿的開始。全館80間客房，免費提供商務房客24小時無線上網設備及咖啡、茶飲服務。酒店設置兩間獨立式會議廳（容納30人)，可供商務房客會議租借使用。
stays.descriptionEn: Built based on the ideology of re-presenting the commercial prosperity of Dadaocheng and promoting the history and culture of Taipei City, City Suites Taipei Nanxi is now a premium hotel in Taipei West that exudes both commercial and cultural atmosphere and offers businessmen and travelers from around the world with quite, relaxing accommodation. The hotel's grand spacious lobby, calm expansive design, thoughtful amenities and spacious guestrooms decorated with furniture made by famous designer Gallery Su enable guests to truly relax. The British style reading room offers Chinese and foreign language newspapers, magazines and books, and richly flavored coffee for guests to experience the pleasure of reading in a cozy atmosphere. The hotel also offers wholesome breakfast buffet to give the guests an energy boost to start the day.The hotel has 80 guestrooms and offers 24-hour free WIFI connection, coffee and tea services for business guests. The hotel also has two independent conference rooms (each accommodating 30 people) for business guests to hold meetings.

stays.descriptionEn: LORE Hotel is located at the intersection of Minquan West Road and Yanping North Road in Taipei, a central hub of the city. It is just a minute’s walk from the Daqiaotou MRT Station exit and boasts a prime location near the Dihua Street cultural and creative district and the Yan San Night Market. The hotel features 20 elegantly designed rooms. LORE Hotel not only offers the convenience of city sightseeing and everyday amenities but also focuses on providing a sensory experience. Whether you& #39;re taking a restful break after exploring the city or unwinding after a delicious meal, the hotel aims to create a stress-relieving environment, offering each guest a relaxing space to fully enjoy their carefree Me Time.

stays.description: 旅宿業自114年1月1日起，不主動提供旅宿一次用備品，如有需求可向旅宿索取。位於臺北市的旅館，酒店充滿了歐洲皇家風格，古典藝術融入酒店的設計中，營造出彷彿時光靜止的氛圍，隨著歲月的流逝愈發優雅。位於台北市西區黃金地段，緊鄰台北車站、南京西路及重慶地區迪化商圈，具有文化、歷史與現代特色，是台北市重要的交通樞紐。東臨市民大道，直達台北世貿展覽中心，西臨環河高速公路，北臨重慶北路，連接士林。陽明山。天上的母親。北投、淡水也靠近中山高速重慶北路交會處，減少往返機場的時間。毗鄰著名的100年歷史的迪化街和台北車站。寧夏夜市。步行即可輕鬆抵達台北捷運中山站和各大百貨公司。
stays.descriptionEn: From January 1, 2025, the hotel will no longer provide disposable toiletries. If necessary, please ask the front desk.Hotel located in Taipei CityThe hotel is full of European royal style, and classical art is integrated into the hotel& #39;s design, creating an atmosphere as if time has stood still, becoming more elegant as time goes by. Located in a prime location in the West District of Taipei City, close to Taipei Main Station, Nanjing West Road and the Dihua business district in Chongqing area, it has cultural, historical and modern characteristics and is an important transportation hub in Taipei City. It is adjacent to Citizen Avenue in the east, leading directly to the Taipei World Trade Exhibition Center, Huanhe Expressway in the west, and Chongqing North Road in the north, connecting to Shilin. Yangmingshan. Heavenly Mother. Beitou and Tamsui are also close to the intersection of Zhongshan Expressway and Chongqing North Road, reducing the time spent traveling to and from the airport. Adjacent to the famous 100-year-old Dihua Street and Taipei Main Station. Ningxia night market. Taipei MRT Zhongshan Station and major department stores are easily accessible on foot.

stays.name: 蜂巢 Bee House
stays.description: 蜂巢(台北車站館)為全新打造的時尚精品旅店，同時為天成飯店集團、台北花園大酒店聯手打造，取其蜜蜂歸巢的概念，來提供每位旅客一個自然簡約的時尚住宿空間，並且以輕鬆不羈的氣氛與貼心完整的服務，來讓每位旅客留下一個難忘的住宿經驗。 (Google地圖)由花園延伸出來的品牌與概念，引申出與花為伍的蜜蜂，辛勤地採集花粉，象徵著勤勞、具有生命力，宛如充滿熱情的各地旅人，忙碌事業或是四處旅行，飛 來飛去終究歸巢。「蜂巢」一個嶄新的品牌，北歐簡約的調性、舒適溫馨的氛圍、體貼的服務，迎接著各地疲憊的旅客，猶如歸巢回家的溫暖，入住感到身心舒暢。蜂巢(台北車站館)整體設計運用了暖色調對比，畫龍點睛的鮮豔色彩則展現出活潑奇趣，大廳採用木紋質感與大片留白，透過巧妙的光線裝置，產生暖意與悠閒氛圍，營造 出家的自在。旅館內外，處處充滿巧思，以蜂巢的六角結構進行視覺規劃，充分呈現蜂巢的概念與意象，舒適的休憩空間，搭配經典款沙發、木質傢俱，創造出清 新、自然不矯作的氣氛，適時溫暖了無數旅人的心！蜂巢(台北車站館)，全館六樓層，擁有31間舒適的客房，滿足各地旅人的需求。【Garden Café】採用木質元素加上簡約吊燈，打造出北歐風格的咖啡館，精選手作質感溫潤的杯具，從觸感開始就充滿人情溫度。手沖嚴選單品咖啡、各種義式咖啡，透過不同的香氣、果酸、花香、回甘的香醇，不單是味覺上的燦爛，就連空氣中也瀰漫著溫暖心靈的氣氛。隨意的擁有片刻閒適，盡情享受生活的小確幸！【花比麵包坊】以精緻歐風的手工甜點與麵包為主，隨時提供最新鮮美味的口感，滿足味蕾一次次的感動。同時，為滿足全方位旅客需求，完善打造大廳網路服務、自助洗衣房、星空童樂室與自助柑仔舖等多項設施，提供您舒適住宿及良好之用餐環境，旅人宛若置身「家」，身心靈得到釋放。
stays.descriptionEn: Bee House(Taipei Station Branch ) is a brand new chic boutique hotel situated in the Taipei rear station shopping district. Jointly created by Cosmos Hotel Group and Taipei Garden Hotel, the hotel’s name is derived from the concept of bees returning home to offer each traveler a natural, minimalistic and fashionable accommodation space. Furthermore, the guests will be treated to a memorable accommodation experience through the relaxing atmosphere and comprehensive, thoughtful service.(Google Map) The brand and concept is inspired by the flower garden to portray the image of bees diligently collecting pollen, symbolizing industriousness and vitality, just like enthusiastic travelers from all over the world; although they are busy expanding their businesses or traveling everywhere, they must ultimately come home. As a brand new label, Bee House welcomes travelers worldwide to come back to the warmth of home through Scandinavian minimalism, comfort, cozy ambiance and thoughtful services. The overall spatial design employs warm, contrasting hues with a touch of vibrant colors to present a sense of liveliness and playfulness. In the lobby, the wood grain and vacant spaces create an aura of warmth and leisure through the ingenious lighting arrangement. Such ingenuities are abundant inside and outside the hotel. For example, the beehive’s hexagonal structure is used as the source of visual planning to fully embody express the concept and imagery of the Bee House. The comfortable space is matched with a comfortable recreational space, classic sofa and wooden furniture to create the refreshing, natural and unadulterated ambiance that has warmed the hearts of many a traveler! Bee House(Taipei Station Branch ) has six stories and 32 well appointed guestrooms with natural, rustic elements as well as sunshine-like radiance and dazzling colors to create painting-like vibrant colors. The unique and cleverly executed home décor will bring surprise and a smile on your face. At the same time, the Garden Café on the first floor ,From the generous wood accents of its interior, to the elegantly simple chandeliers, Garden Café embodies the sophistication of the Scandinavian style café. Enjoy a hand crafted specialty coffee or espresso masterpiece in our specially commissioned handmade mugs and cups, and you will feel the warmth of every sip right down to your heart and soul. Come in and be prepared to be greeted with the pleasant aromas of flower, fruit, tea and coffee, and thoroughly enjoy your precious moment of peace and comfort in the relaxed warmth of Garden Café. The Bakery serves mainly exquisite, European-style desserts and breads to satisfy the palate of our guests. Furthermore, in order to cater to our guests’ every need, we have created Internet services in the lobby together with other facilities such as launderette, play room, and self-help snack bar. We would like to provide you a comfortable accommodation and dining environment. Just like coming home, travelers will feel total relaxation of the body, mind and spirit.

stays.name: 迪樂商旅
stays.description: 【迪樂商旅】位於台北市大同區內，緊鄰盛名大稻埕商圈，見證百年繁華錦繡歷史篇章。悠遊南北貨商鋪、喜嘗國內外點心吃食；感受香火鼎盛的廟宇信仰文化，或穿梭古意街廓品味古蹟雅宅，還有雨後春筍各式文創潮藝。城西獨有的韻緻風情值得旅人細細一探。【迪樂商旅】週邊交通網絡便捷，距離北門捷運站步行僅約5〜10分鐘。旅店步行至【桃園機場捷運/A1台北車站】亦僅幾分鐘路程，距離交通樞紐『台北火車站』亦僅5分鐘左右車程。迪樂商旅距離台北轉運站僅約 700 公尺，最近的機場是台北松山機場，距離約 4 公里。附近景點探索，豐富您的旅程故事。著名的僅需10分鐘車程。台北名聞遐邇的以及、商圈，距離旅店亦僅是5分鐘車程。潮流匯集的西門町商圈也在10分鐘左右車程不遠處。台北地下商店街Taipei City Mall Y位於鄭州路下方，連通北車與捷運交通動線出入新選擇。館內1F大廳設有24小時迎賓櫃檯，部分套裝住房提供免費經典台式或西式現做早餐選擇。住客免費歡享研磨咖啡及冷熱飲料，一樓開放咖啡廳即可就近停歇。館內中央空調客房，全館提供免費WiFi連網。房內多有浴缸設施&以及私人衛浴，乾淨舒適的休旅空間，【迪樂商旅】是您台北休憩旅宿好選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: 【The Dealer Hotel】 is located in Datong District, Taipei City, close to the famous Dadaocheng business district, witnessing a century of prosperous history.Wander around the local shops, enjoy snacks from home and abroad; feel the temple culture of worship, or walk through the ancient streets to appreciate the ancient monuments and elegant houses, as well as all kinds of cultural and creative arts that have sprung up. The unique charm of the west of the city is worth a careful exploration by travelers.【The Dealer Hotel】 has a convenient transportation network around it, and it is only about 5 to 10 minutes walk from Beimen MRT Station.The hotel is only a few minutes walk from [Taoyuan Airport MRT/A1 Taipei Station], and it is only about 5 minutes drive from the transportation hub "Taipei Railway Station".The Dealer Hotel is only about 700 meters away from Taipei Transfer Station, and the nearest airport is Taipei Songshan Airport, about 4 kilometers away.Explore nearby attractions to enrich your travel story.The famous is only a 10-minute drive away. Taipei& #39;s famous , , and business districts are only a 5-minute drive from the hotel.The trendy Ximending business district is also about 10 minutes away by car.Taipei City Mall Y, an underground shopping street in Taipei, is located under Zhengzhou Road, connecting the Taipei Railway Station and the MRT transportation line.There is a 24-hour reception counter in the 1F lobby of the hotel, and some suites provide free classic Taiwanese or Western breakfast options. Guests can enjoy ground coffee and hot and cold drinks for free, and the first floor cafe is open for a rest.The hotel has central air-conditioned rooms and free WiFi access throughout the hotel. Most rooms have bathtub facilities and private bathrooms, clean and comfortable leisure space, [Di Le Business Hotel] is your good choice for rest and accommodation in Taipei.

stays.descriptionEn: Natural, Charming, an ExperienceWalking into the Dandy Hotel who will immediately find a bold contrast to the city’s often plush and over-powering hotel lobbies. Dandy Hotel’s Nordic ambience is calming with minimal décor, it is a place where you can relax and soak in a natural elegance. After your long journey, settle down, and rediscover your tempo. The Hotel faces Daan Park, which feels like you’re facing New York City’s CENTRAL PARK.Natural X Basic The log furniture, cozy and snug with simple and modern design, extends a charming creation of power and beauty. This fashionable decor, elegant and understated, provides you with a brand new accommodation experience. There are 73 guest rooms in the Hotel, with 9 floors and 6 types of designs based on natural themes; our guests are provided with a variety of settings for a feeling of comfort and ease.

stays.name: 二十輪旅店大安店
stays.description: SWIIO以優雅質感生活為主軸、舒適住宿空間為前提，在大安區建造了一個專屬品味生活旅人的住所。由設計師方序中操刀的旅館品牌識別，內部空間則是擅長電影美術設計的郭志達負責。幾何形狀的白色建築外觀是經營者董鴻林的設計發想，在密布灰色建物的都市裡，醒目得彷彿是座落於質感象限內的風格指標，用純淨潔白的色澤說著故事，架構出一個獨立於空間之外的旅行思維，成為每個旅人停留過後都會想再次入住的家。
stays.descriptionEn: SWIIO regards an elegant and high quality life as the most important goal, and creating a comfortable living space is the premise for this motto. Thus they have created a residence for travelers who value exclusive tastes. Designer Fang Xu Zhung (Joe Fang) is the chief designer in charge of the brand vision for the hotel. Guo Zhida is responsible for the interior design and is known for his finesse in film art design. The staff uniform is designed by plain-me, a brand of menswear design known for its matching pieces. The concept of the geometrically shaped white building façade is the brainchild of Tung Hung-Lin CEO (CEO Anderson Tung). The exterior wall is coated with waterproof paint of German STO and serves as an eye-catching beacon of style amongst a sea of densely packed gray buildings. The pure white luster emanating from the building itself tells a story and creates a thought of travel, independent of the surrounding space. We hope all travelers who cross our doorstep feels compelled to stay once again.

stays.name: 凱統大飯店
stays.description: 搭捷運FUN臺北玩透透住凱統飯就對啦。優越的位置讓您不注意到都很難。凱統大飯店就在臺北市中心位於板南、中和新蘆線兩條繁忙捷運線交會處忠孝新生站三號出口隔壁，絕對是全臺北市最最靠近捷運出口飯店之一。附近SOGO百貨、頂好商圈、光華電子商場以及華山文藝中心短短走路距離就可到達。透過搭乘捷運可以直達信義商區、南港以及信義世貿、行天宮、西門町商圈或是龍山寺完全不需要轉車。飯店提供一般轎車免費停車(限車高150公分以下)。蘆洲線通車後更顯現凱統飯店位置優越性。除捷運之外，凱統飯店更有超過30條公車現在此附近交會到達臺北市、新北市。凱統飯店超優地理位置、舒適客房、親切服務以及優惠房價絕對是您臺北洽商、參展、旅遊最佳飯店選項之一。
stays.descriptionEn: KDM Hotel is your best choice when traveling around Taipei City.KDM Taipei is just located at Exit 3 of MRT Zhongxiao Xinsheng Station (National Taipei University of Technology), just on the cross route of Banciao-Nang-Kang Line (MRT blue line), and Lu-Zho Line, right at the middle of downtown Taipei City.With MRT, you could easily visit Sogo department stores, East town Ding-Hao Plaza, Guang-Hwa electronic market, and Hwa-Shan Art centre for less than 10 mins. You could also travel with the convenient MRT system to visit Taipei World Trade Center, Taipei 101, Shi-Men, Long-Shan Temple etc., without any bothering of transferring bus or taxi.KDM Hotel, with our great location, nice and clean rooms, and wonderful services, is certainly the best choice for your business/traveling needs in Taipei .We also offer free parking services for your needs. (Notice: Car, height limited : 150 cm)

stays.nameEn: Madison Taipei, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
stays.description: 漫步敦南林蔭間，註定遇見那橄欖石綠的身影，隨著清晨、白天、黃昏、黑夜映照的表情，春夏秋冬的陽光與雨露風霧轉化的語言，尋著無邊際線延伸出的視覺輪廓，如同賦予著他深度與品味般的外衣，那就是他，MADISON TAIPEI台北慕軒，倚著台灣最美的欒樹林蔭大道，綠葉成蔭、蟲鳴鳥語、鬧中取靜，提供旅客在旅途中享受渴慕之旅、靜心之處。「Madison」命名的由來，源自紐約中央公園旁的麥迪遜大道(Madison Avenue)，沿著中央公園貫穿紐約的上東城至中城，此區是全紐約匯集了頂尖、創意、科技與精品的金字塔頂端特區，居住在此便具有一種獨特身份與高度品味的意義，而MADISON TAIPEI台北慕軒渾然天成的地位與價值，散發著不凡卻低調態度，吸引著品味與名流人士的流連與駐足，如同時空轉換飛越千里來到紐約上東城區。暫佇於此，不僅只是飯店的住宿體驗，而是另種對生活品味的堅持與提升，在鬧中取靜的飯店空間裡，隱含了高度地位與氣度非凡的因子，為每位懂得生活品味的成功人士，營造一個渴望慕求的旅程與靜謐安心的空間。「On a busy journey, a moment of calm 渴慕之旅，靜心之處」
stays.descriptionEn: Stroll along the Dunnan Boulevard and encounter the silhouette of the olive green. As the day goes from dawn, daytime, dusk to the night, different sides of the MADISON TAIPEI is presented. Found along Taiwan’s most beautiful Dunnan Boulevard, MADISON TAIPEI presents its tranquillity in the midst of urban city with its lush trees and chirping birds.The name “Madison” was inspired by the Madison Avenue along New York’s Central Park. This is the district where all the city elites, creativity and boutiques gather. Living in this area represents a unique identity and exceptional taste. MADISON TAIPEI’s location and value exudes a unique yet low-profile attitude, luring elite people and those with discerning taste to frequent and stay. It is almost as if New York’s Upper East Side has been transported here.Staying at Madison is not just a mere hotel stay, it is an type of insistence and enhancement on taste in lifestyle. In this tranquil haven amid the city, the hotel offers elements of high status and exceptional manner. We offer every single individual that enjoys savouring tasteful lifestyle a tranquil, soothing space much longed for during a hectic journey. “On a busy journey, a moment of calm.”

stays.searchText: 台北慕軒飯店，臻品之選 國泰商旅股份有限公司 臺北市旅館452號 臺北市 大安區 敦化南路一段331號1-13樓 漫步敦南林蔭間，註定遇見那橄欖石綠的身影，隨著清晨、白天、黃昏、黑夜映照的表情，春夏秋冬的陽光與雨露風霧轉化的語言，尋著無邊際線延伸出的視覺輪廓，如同賦予著他深度與品味般的外衣，那就是他，MADISON TAIPEI台北慕軒，倚著台灣最美的欒樹林蔭大道，綠葉成蔭、蟲鳴鳥語、鬧中取靜，提供旅客在旅途中享受渴慕之旅、靜心之處。「Madison」命名的由來，源自紐約中央公園旁的麥迪遜大道(Madison Avenue)，沿著中央公園貫穿紐約的上東城至中城，此區是全紐約匯集了頂尖、創意、科技與精品的金字塔頂端特區，居住在此便具有一種獨特身份與高度品味的意義，而MADISON TAIPEI台北慕軒渾然天成的地位與價值，散發著不凡卻低調態度，吸引著品味與名流人士的流連與駐足，如同時空轉換飛越千里來到紐約上東城區。暫佇於此，不僅只是飯店的住宿體驗，而是另種對生活品味的堅持與提升，在鬧中取靜的飯店空間裡，隱含了高度地位與氣度非凡的因子，為每位懂得生活品味的成功人士，營造一個渴望慕求的旅程與靜謐安心的空間。「On a busy journey, a moment of calm 渴慕之旅，靜心之處」

stays.name: 台北遠東香格里拉
stays.description: 台北遠東香格里拉位於台北市中心，昂然矗立于繁華的敦南商圈，是遠企中心雙塔式建築的其中一棟，結合購物中心與辦公大樓，滿足旅客洽公、逛街需求；2018 及 2019連續兩年榮獲台北米其林指南評鑑為奢華酒店、連續8年榮獲亞太商旅雜誌「台北最佳商務飯店」，並榮獲康泰納仕旅遊者雜誌2023年讀者之選「最佳酒店」的肯定，更是台灣唯一上榜的酒店！樓高43樓，不僅提供優質細膩服務，其融合東西優雅設計全新改裝的客房寬敞舒適，擁有絕佳城市景觀。
stays.descriptionEn: Awarded as a “Luxury Hotel” by the MICHELIN Guide Taipei in 2018 and 2019 and recognized as the “Best Business Hotel in Taipei” for eight consecutive years by Business Traveller Asia-Pacific magazine, Shangri-La Far Eastern, Taipei is the preferred choice for corporate travelers and discerning guests. Situated in the heart of Taipei, the hotel offers panoramic views of the city and unparalleled convenience within the dynamic Dunhua South Road business district.As part of the iconic twin-tower Far Eastern Plaza complex, the hotel seamlessly integrates shopping, dining, and office facilities to cater to both business and leisure needs. Its newly renovated interiors combine contemporary elegance with a harmonious blend of Western and Asian influences, inspired by the refined aesthetics of the Song Dynasty. Guests can enjoy authentic and memorable experiences delivered with exceptional creativity, local flair, and heartfelt hospitality.

stays.description: 國聯大飯店坐落於光復南路近忠孝東路口，不僅地理上佔據核心，更是文化與便利的交匯點。飯店鄰近台北大巨蛋、國父紀念館、松山文創園區、台北101、台北世貿中心及信義商圈等地標性景點，從捷運國父紀念館站1號出口步行1分鐘內即可抵達，便利的交通與周邊豐富的城市魅力，滿足旅客多樣需求。無論是欣賞棒球賽事、參加演唱會、探索文化藝術，或漫步商圈，國聯大飯店始終是您的住宿首選。國聯大飯店擁有243間舒適客房，健身中心、宴會廳、北馥樓中餐廳與板石Lounge & Bar，為旅客帶來身心平衡的細膩體驗。在這裡，旅程是心與城市的交流，每一刻都值得珍藏。
stays.descriptionEn: Located on Guangfu South Road, United Hotel occupies a central position and serves as a nexus of culture and convenience. Adjacent to the famous Taipei Dome and Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, the hotel is also just a walk away from landmark attractions such as Taipei 101 and the Xinyi Shopping District. Whether seeking fashionable shopping, leisurely comfort, or cultural exploration, every step from the hotel promises surprise and discovery. With 243 guest rooms, a fitness center, a Banquet Hall, the Slate Lounge & Bar, the Pei-Full Restaurant, each visit offers a distinct experience, inviting you to savor every moment.

stays.descriptionEn: 101 Amici Hotel Six Star Hostel is located in Taipei’s most popular shopping district, just a 2-minute walk from MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing Station. Free WiFi is available in all rooms.101 Amici Hotel Six Star Hostel is 700 meters from the Jianguo Holiday Jade and Flower Markets and the lively Liaoning Night Market. stays.description: 你好咖啡旅館（NiHao Cafe Hotel）位於台北市大安區，地理位置優越，距離捷運大安站1號出口僅約15公尺，步行約1分鐘即可抵達。 ​旅館融合了咖啡館與設計旅店的概念，環境中充滿綠意植物，提供道地的當地美食和專業咖啡。 ​旅館提供多樣化的客房選擇，包括雙人房、迷你雙人房、雙床房、迷你雙床房、三人房和四人房等。​每間客房均為禁菸房，配有空調、精緻書桌、平面電視、冰箱以及附設的私人浴室，內備免費盥洗用品。 ​咖啡館營業時間為每日早上8點至下午7點，供應早午餐、甜點與飲品等。​櫃檯服務時間為早上8點至晚上11點。​旅館亦提供免費無線網路、行李寄存、自助洗衣等服務，滿足旅客的多樣需求。 ​
stays.descriptionEn: ​NiHao Café Hotel is a boutique hotel located in Taipei's Da'an District, just a 1-minute walk from Exit 1 of MRT Da'an Station. The hotel uniquely combines a city café with a design hotel, creating a green environment filled with plants, and offers authentic local cuisine alongside expertly crafted coffee.​The hotel provides a variety of room options, including double rooms, mini double rooms, twin rooms, mini twin rooms, triple rooms, and quadruple rooms. Each non-smoking room is equipped with air conditioning, a refined desk, flat-screen TV, refrigerator, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. ​The on-site café operates daily from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM, serving brunch, desserts, and beverages. The front desk is available from 8:00 AM to 09:00 PM. Additional amenities include free Wi-Fi, luggage storage, and self-service laundry facilities to cater to various traveler needs. ​Overall, NiHao Café Hotel offers an ideal accommodation choice with its convenient location, comfortable environment, and quality dining services.​

stays.searchText: 姆提文創旅店 姆提文創實業股份有限公司 臺北市旅館546號 臺北市 大安區 信義路三段147巷5弄4號1樓 你好咖啡旅館（NiHao Cafe Hotel）位於台北市大安區，地理位置優越，距離捷運大安站1號出口僅約15公尺，步行約1分鐘即可抵達。 ​旅館融合了咖啡館與設計旅店的概念，環境中充滿綠意植物，提供道地的當地美食和專業咖啡。 ​旅館提供多樣化的客房選擇，包括雙人房、迷你雙人房、雙床房、迷你雙床房、三人房和四人房等。​每間客房均為禁菸房，配有空調、精緻書桌、平面電視、冰箱以及附設的私人浴室，內備免費盥洗用品。 ​咖啡館營業時間為每日早上8點至下午7點，供應早午餐、甜點與飲品等。​櫃檯服務時間為早上8點至晚上11點。​旅館亦提供免費無線網路、行李寄存、自助洗衣等服務，滿足旅客的多樣需求。 ​

stays.name: 富裕自由商旅
stays.description: RF HOTEL 富裕自由商旅是集商務、旅遊、超商為一體的多功能商務旅館。經營服務採用國際星級標準之高品質的服務，服務商務與觀光旅客為主要訴求，更將超商概念崁入旅店內，販賣各式點心、飲料等，只要一通電話就可立即送達客房，完全不收取任何服務費，商品價格不變，但旅客可處處感受到細膩與貼心。房型等級：標準客房、經濟客房、商務客房、豪華客房；房內設備完善齊全，每房皆提供保險箱、免費寬頻上網、40吋液晶電視及寬敞衛浴空間等設施。所有房型採用繽紛的色調與商旅外的世界呼應，踏入客房即能感受到台北的朝氣與活力。與Sogo商圈和信義商圈接軌，交通及購物十分便利，優渥的地理位置、繁華的生活機能，提升本館的附加價值，物超所值的平價優質住宿，不論商務出差或旅行出遊，RF Hotel富裕自由商旅絕對是您優質的住宿選擇，您時尚溫馨的第二個家。
stays.descriptionEn: The RF Hotel is a multifunctional business hotel catering to business and leisure travellers and features its own in-house convenience store.Room Type: Mini Rooms,Economy Rooms, Business Rooms and Deluxe Rooms. The rooms come fully equipped with a safety box, complimentary broadband Internet access, a 40-inch LCD TV and a spacious bathroom.Conveniently located between the famous SOGO Department Store and the Xinyi Central Business and Shopping District, the RF Hotel is easily accessible by public transport. For business or pleasure, the competitively priced RF Hotel makes for a convenient and contemporary home-away-from-home in Taipei.The bright colour scheme of the business hotel keeps you connected to the vibe and vitality of Taipei City.

stays.name: 怡品商旅
stays.description: 我們的品牌–怡品商旅，「怡」是「心」「台」，心愛台北之意，「品」代表了三個年輕人的合力，一起建立起這間旅館。地點位於台北市熱鬧的東區–忠孝東路四段，捷運文湖線與板南線的交會處。除了交通便捷，美食餐廳及商店密集群聚，百貨公司如：SOGO復興/忠孝/敦化館，及微風廣場/忠孝店，都在步行2~10分鐘的範圍內。我們的裝潢風格為簡約，並融入台北都會的元素，如建築物及街頭景色，希望推廣台北的景點與美食。房間內用品將採用具口碑的品牌(如：席夢思床墊、TOTO衛浴、歐舒丹梳洗用品等)。希望能為來台北短期參訪的商務旅客或自由行旅客，帶來平價且舒適的居住體驗，進而對台北城留下友善的美好印象。
stays.descriptionEn: Eastin Taipei Hotel is located in East District, one of the most bustling areas in Taipei City beside the MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing station which is intersected by Wenhu Line and Bannan-Tucheng Line. It is extremely convenient because hundreds of restaurants are nearby and easily enjoy many kinds of delicious food. Also, stores for shopping are everywhere including department stores such as SOGOs, Breeze Center and Eslite bookstore within 2-10 minutes on foot. By the minimalist interior design blended with urban elements in Taipei, such as the architecture and scenes on the street, we hope to promote our favorite city - Taipei . The amenities in the rooms are also highly concerned with famous brands (e.g. Simmons, Toto, L’occitane and etc.) because we would like to make a great impression on the tourists either business or vacation in Taipei with a comfortable environment at a reasonable price range.Location Eastin Taipei Hotel is located in East District, one of the most bustling areas in Taipei City beside the MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing station which is intersected by Wenhu Line and Bannan-Tucheng Line. stays.searchText: 怡品商旅 良晨股份有限公司 臺北市旅館545號 臺北市 大安區 忠孝東路四段87號13﹑14樓 我們的品牌–怡品商旅，「怡」是「心」「台」，心愛台北之意，「品」代表了三個年輕人的合力，一起建立起這間旅館。地點位於台北市熱鬧的東區–忠孝東路四段，捷運文湖線與板南線的交會處。除了交通便捷，美食餐廳及商店密集群聚，百貨公司如：SOGO復興/忠孝/敦化館，及微風廣場/忠孝店，都在步行2~10分鐘的範圍內。我們的裝潢風格為簡約，並融入台北都會的元素，如建築物及街頭景色，希望推廣台北的景點與美食。房間內用品將採用具口碑的品牌(如：席夢思床墊、TOTO衛浴、歐舒丹梳洗用品等)。希望能為來台北短期參訪的商務旅客或自由行旅客，帶來平價且舒適的居住體驗，進而對台北城留下友善的美好印象。

stays.description: 新都心旅憩 City Life Traveling Mind座落於敦化南路及基隆路口，坐擁台北精華經貿地段，全館採用『後現代』設計的視覺意念，讓出門洽商之餘彷彿置身於時尚空間。下榻柯達飯店台北敦南，讓您的行程更多了都會旅憩的優雅。充實的客房設施、精緻的空間設計以及影音系統，提升在外地洽商的生活品質，讓您不會錯過任何商機，滿足商務行程的所有需求。柯達大飯店台北敦南鄰近六張犁捷運站，步行僅需10分鐘。距離台北市區、通化夜市、信義新天地、威秀影城、公館商圈等知名都會景點皆只需10分鐘車程，無論您是洽公行程或都會旅遊，柯達大飯店台北敦南全體員工期待為您服務。
stays.descriptionEn: City Life Traveling MindLocated at the heart of Taipei business, intersection of Dunhua South Road and Keelung Road, the Hotel adopts a visual design concept of "post-modern" and creates a fashion sense for our guests even for their business trips. Reserve a room with us and allow us to offer you complete relaxation and introduce you the elegance of city accommodation to your journey.Fully furnished room facilities, delicate space design and sound video system enhances your quality of life on your business trips, we make sure you do not miss any business opportunities while satisfying all your needs for business trips.K Hotel is only 10 minutes walking distance away from Liuzhangli MRT station and 10 minutes driving distance from various tourist attractions such as Taipei CBD, Tonghua Night Market, Xinyi Place, Vieshow Cinemas and Gongguan Business Circle. Whether you travel for business or as tourist, we are right there at your service.

stays.description: 藏於巷弄內，與周邊的靜謐住宅融為一體，展現自在踏實的寧靜。離開靜巷，外頭又是一番世外桃花源，近在咫尺的捷運忠孝新生商圈，為城市四通八達的中樞紐點，便利於一日的城市旅遊安排。感受台北創意之都的文化精髓，五分鐘路途的華山文創園區，提供豐富的設計饗宴。
stays.descriptionEn: Hidden in an alley, it blends in with the surrounding quiet residences.Show the tranquility of ease and stability.Leaving the quiet alley, there is another paradise outside.The MRT Zhongxiao Xinsheng Business District is just around the corner.It is the central hub of the city extending in all directions.Convenient for one-day city tour arrangements.Feel the cultural essence of Taipei, the creative city,The Huashan Cultural and Creative Park, five minutes away, offers a wealth of design feasts.

stays.name: 福容大飯店 台北一館
stays.description: 福容大飯店 台北矗立於台北市仁愛、信義兩大主要幹道之間，緊鄰建國南路交流道。往返信義計畫區、車程僅需10分鐘。鄰近台北忠孝購物中心，為一個繁華的商務、購物和休閒娛樂區域，自飯店出發車程亦僅需10分鐘。優越地理位置非常適合國內外商旅人士及購物旅遊。福容大飯店 台北為國際級觀光飯店，大廳採國際型飯店一貫特有的挑高設計，綠意盎然的花草盆栽佇立其中；展現出清新明亮的典雅風格。擁有120間頂級精緻客房與套房，時尚的設計風格，安全的住宿環境，科技化的客房設備，迎合商務差旅、觀光旅客的各項需求。結合品味與時尚，獨一無二的廣闊窗景，更將世界級地標101金融大樓盡收眼簾。國際化的館內設施、寬敞雅緻客房以及應有盡有的餐飲服務和精心打造的頂級俱樂部設施，誠摯貼心的專業服務，讓來自世界各地的商旅名仕，置身於愉悅自在的氣氛中。
stays.descriptionEn: Fullon Hotel (Taipei) stands in an area between Ren'ai Road and Xinyi Road, the two thoroughfares in Taipei, near Jianguo South Road Interchange. Only 10 minutes by car from Xinyi Planning District. Nearby Taipei Zhongxiao Mall (which is a bustling business, shopping and entertainment area) is also only 10 minutes drive away from the hotel. With its prime location, the hotel is the ideal choice for leisure and business travel by domestic and international travelers. Fullon Hotel (Taipei) is an international tourist hotel, the unique high ceiling design of the lobby, where potted flowers and greenery stands, reflects an amazing, fresh, bright, and elegant atmosphere. The hotel features 120 exquisite guest rooms and suites with trendy designs, secure accommodation, and high-tech facilities to cater the demand of the business and leisure travelers. Combining taste and fashion, the unparalleled window view allows Taipei 101, one of the world-class landmarks, to greet you. With international facilities, spacious and elegant rooms, all food services and well-built top club facilities, and sincere and thoughtful professional services, the hotel offers business travelers and dignitaries from around the world to be engaged in a pleasant comfortable atmosphere.

stays.searchText: 福容大飯店 台北一館 福容大飯店股份有限公司台北分公司 交觀業字第1425號 臺北市 大安區 建國南路1段266號 福容大飯店 台北矗立於台北市仁愛、信義兩大主要幹道之間，緊鄰建國南路交流道。往返信義計畫區、車程僅需10分鐘。鄰近台北忠孝購物中心，為一個繁華的商務、購物和休閒娛樂區域，自飯店出發車程亦僅需10分鐘。優越地理位置非常適合國內外商旅人士及購物旅遊。福容大飯店 台北為國際級觀光飯店，大廳採國際型飯店一貫特有的挑高設計，綠意盎然的花草盆栽佇立其中；展現出清新明亮的典雅風格。擁有120間頂級精緻客房與套房，時尚的設計風格，安全的住宿環境，科技化的客房設備，迎合商務差旅、觀光旅客的各項需求。結合品味與時尚，獨一無二的廣闊窗景，更將世界級地標101金融大樓盡收眼簾。國際化的館內設施、寬敞雅緻客房以及應有盡有的餐飲服務和精心打造的頂級俱樂部設施，誠摯貼心的專業服務，讓來自世界各地的商旅名仕，置身於愉悅自在的氣氛中。

stays.descriptionEn: Howard Plaza Hotel Taipei is located at Ren’ai Road boulevard. In 2011, the hotel was rated five-star international tourist hotel by the Tourism Bureau. Since its inauguration in 1984, Howard Plaza Hotel Taipei always upholds the sound pragmatic management philosophy and expertise, and is committed to develop the best services of five-star hotel accommodation and restaurant to provide people more diverse selection of Hospitality. Howard Plaza Hotel Taipei features 606 rooms furnished in rosewood mahogany and an attentive service team to provide you with a comfortable home-like warmth. 10 different style restaurants serve a variety of Chinese and Western dishes. Howard Plaza Hotel Taipei, in 2012 and 2009, respectively, obtained ISO22000 and HACCP double certifications, which was the first time that a hotel of local brand in Taiwan was awarded two international certified quality certifications. stays.name: 謙商旅(谷墨商旅-師大館)
stays.description: 谷墨商旅於2017年8月全新開幕，昔日六張犁大道，今日的和平東路寫照，坐落於台北城區文化熱點，不只旅行家，更吸引生活行家停駐。白日車水馬龍的街道，一轉身即是靜謐的小街巷弄，這裡的住客心中各有一套谷墨旅行散策。左漫步師大商圈，到文青孕育地，溫州街／泰順街品讀咖啡書香、右探索東門商圈；走進全台北最美的街廓，青田街／麗水街感受歷史；或走進大安森林公園，與綠蔭相伴。享受 一個人旅行 不用熱熱鬧鬧彼鄰而居，在這有獨立個人小窩與衛浴設備，讓旅人歸來時能擁有自己個人生活空間，自在休憩、書寫、沐浴。入住谷墨商旅，從推開木質大門那刻起感受東方文化底蘊，來場憩心之旅！只要你懂玩，懂門路；懂慢，懂生活。
stays.descriptionEn: Established in August, 2017, Goodmore Hotel is located in nowadays Helping East Road, formerly known as Liuzhangli Avenue, which is a cultural hotspot in Taipei City, attracting many travelers and even more life artists to stay.Turning around from day bustling streets to tranquil little streets. The guests have their own sets of travel plan here. On the left side is National Taiwan Normal University Commercial District. Travelers can promenade Taishun St. to feel the aroma of literature and coffee. Right side is Dongmen Commercial District. Walking into the most beautiful area in Taipei, Lishui St., to experience historical atmosphere, or surrounded by greenery in Daan Forest Park.Enjoy traveling alone. stays.searchText: 謙商旅(谷墨商旅-師大館) 謙商旅股份有限公司 臺北市旅館627號 臺北市 大安區 和平東路一段145號2至4樓、147 號5至6樓、6樓之1、6樓之2 谷墨商旅於2017年8月全新開幕，昔日六張犁大道，今日的和平東路寫照，坐落於台北城區文化熱點，不只旅行家，更吸引生活行家停駐。白日車水馬龍的街道，一轉身即是靜謐的小街巷弄，這裡的住客心中各有一套谷墨旅行散策。左漫步師大商圈，到文青孕育地，溫州街／泰順街品讀咖啡書香、右探索東門商圈；走進全台北最美的街廓，青田街／麗水街感受歷史；或走進大安森林公園，與綠蔭相伴。享受 一個人旅行 不用熱熱鬧鬧彼鄰而居，在這有獨立個人小窩與衛浴設備，讓旅人歸來時能擁有自己個人生活空間，自在休憩、書寫、沐浴。入住谷墨商旅，從推開木質大門那刻起感受東方文化底蘊，來場憩心之旅！只要你懂玩，懂門路；懂慢，懂生活。

stays.name: 金普頓大安酒店
stays.description: 台北市中心的城市方舟隱身於台北東區靜謐街巷內，金普頓大安酒店與購物中心和捷運站僅隔一個街區。獨特地理位置，攘往熙來人潮看似近在咫尺，卻猶如世外桃源般靜謐。各式迷人充滿詩意的人文咖啡館、個性精品店與文藝畫廊，散落酒店周圍。而擁有129間舒適客、套房的金普頓酒店，以精緻細膩的設計詮釋復古與白瓷的層疊美學，相映著透光的天井建築，每一個轉彎都透著設計師巧思，邀請大膽創新的世界旅遊家和在地設計師一同品味徘徊探索。而當步入位於12樓的英式摩登餐酒館，可瞧見風情萬種的亞熱帶陽光灑落在寬敞戶外露台，除了可放鬆品酩美酒佳餚外，令人醉心的台北城景與聳入天際的台北101盡收眼底，徹底讓賓客體驗與挖掘新舊台北魅力與脈動。
stays.descriptionEn: An Urban Sanctuary Hotel In TaipeiTucked away from the main street, and only steps away from Zhongxiao Fuxing MRT station, Kimpton Da An stands still between tradition and modernity, frenetic energy and slow pace. The walkable neighborhood has a buzzing energy as people flow in and out of the city. Each corner, turn, or block is a journey of discoveries infused with sophistication and tranquility. A definite sanctuary for laid back savvy travelers, the 129 tranquil rooms hum the melody of calm and beauty also demonstrate a designer’s piece itself. At our cozy lobby living room, start your day with the famous Morning Kickstarter or chill out during the Social Wine Hour. Embrace Taipei’s skyline at our rooftop terrace. Join our biking or hiking program to live like a local and feel the beauty of authenticity. It is here you feel a sense of belonging and the true Taiwanese hospitality.

stays.name: 麗都大飯店
stays.description: 台北麗都唯客樂飯店、即使是暫時的家，品味也絕對講究台北麗都唯客樂飯店提供您如同家一般溫馨與舒適的空間，用心在每一處地方，一進入大廳，充滿復古情懷與典藏價值的掛燈、隨著電梯扶搖而上的巨型壁畫，將一路引領您進入本館猶如古今中西縮影的九種浪漫風格房型。台北麗都唯客樂飯店除了關心您台北住宿的舒適和美學享受外，台北麗都唯客樂飯店也貼心為您的隱私做最安全的把關，採用全頻偵測器全天候偵測防止針孔攝影機，通過市政府消防安全檢查，合法飯店領有執照，裝置有緊急發電照明燈、滅火器、灑水設備、緩降機等，絕對讓您安心且放心地前來台北洽公、旅遊住宿。台北商務、洽公－貼心的服務在台北麗都唯客樂飯店台北麗都唯客樂飯店擁有優越的地理位置優勢，座落於台北市主金融商業區中心，飯店面對著六萬坪大安森林公園，讓您感受與豪宅等級的視野景觀，除了洽公洽商的交通便利性，距離熱門的永康街、鼎泰豐商圈更是可以直接的步行逛街前往，距離附近的光華電子3C廣場、台北101、台北世貿中心也只需您5~10分鐘的車程距離，因此，不論洽公購物或休閒娛樂，台北麗都唯客樂飯店都是國際旅客及國人您的最佳住宿選擇。台北麗都唯客樂飯店讓每一位旅客得以在繁忙的市中心，享受到精緻的服務品質及別出心裁的飯店特色，所有客房皆採用國際標準的防火門及防火材，消防設施經市府評定合格，並定期申報檢查保養，台北麗都唯客樂飯店最吸引人的，不只是天生美景人文美感，還有整個飯店團隊磅礡宏偉的經營氣宇，貼心的考量，讓每一位旅客的期待；得到無比的滿足。台北麗都唯客樂飯店己提供線上訂房機制台北麗都唯客樂飯店己經使用線上訂房系統，網友將可以輕鬆的指定入住日期及房型，而台北麗都唯客樂飯店也將不定期的開放特殊優惠專案及房型來回饋使用線上訂房機制的網友，趕緊訂房，台北麗都唯客樂飯店為您台北旅遊留下豐富精彩的回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: Taipei Rido Hotel has excellent location advantages. Sitting at the center of Taipei City's main financial district and facing towards Da'an Forest Park which is of 60 thousand ping, Taipei Rido Hotel makes you experience a brilliant view as if staying in a mansion. In addition to convenient transportation providing an easy access for conferences or meetings, the hotel is also close to the popular Yungkang Street and Din Tai Fung restaurant; you could simply visit there by walk. If you prefer visit the nearby Guanghua electronics 3C Plaza, Taipei 101 or Taipei World Trade Center, you could take a bus or taxi; it is only about 5 to 10 minutes drive. Therefore, no matter you are here for business trip, shopping or just visiting, Taipei Rido Hotel is the best accommodation choice for both international visitors and Taiwan local people. Taipei Rido Hotel provides you a comfy and warm space and makes you feel like at home. Upon entering the lobby, the vintage and priceless hanging lamp immediately gives out a European sentiments and romantic atmosphere of medieval center, adding a sense of elegant to the hotel. A series of unique and creative suites allows every guest enjoys exquisite service quality and the artistically crafted hotel architecture features while in the busy town center. Every suite in this hotel has adopted international standard fire door and fire-proving woods. Taipei Rido Hotel's fire-fighting facilities have passed the standard of Taipei City Government and have regularly report for inspection and maintenance. The most attractive part of Taipei Rido Hotel is not only for the beautiful landscape and the aesthetic style, but also for the majestic managing manner and thoughtful considerations, meeting the expectations of every guest.

stays.descriptionEn: Opened in late 2005, the In-Stone Boutique Motel has adopted numerous meticulous design philosophies. Through our facilities and services, we strive to achieve perfection in order to provide each guest with a comfortable and pleasant accommodation experience.The In-Stone Boutique Motel offers nearly 20 exquisitely decorated guest rooms with 5 distinct categories and ambient lighting has been installed to create a romantic, chic vibe indicative of a boutique motel. The In-Stone Boutique Motel hopes to offer you a unique, novel and romantic accommodation experience.．Weekday accommodation: Sunday to Thursday (after 18:00)．Weekend accommodation: Friday to Saturday (after 20:00)．New Year’s Eve accommodation: After 00:00．Guests may stay for up to 12 hours if they check-in after 00:00.．During long weekends or special holidays, please refer to the announcements at the motel for the room price and check-in time.．Each room is limited to 2 guests, no visitors permitted.．No pets allowed.．There is a no smoking policy within the entire motel.

stays.descriptionEn: Jingmei Hotel is one of the licensed excellent hotels in the Health Self-Management announcement made by the Taipei City Government's Department of Health. Our room rate is inexpensive and we are within walking distance from the Ministry of Examination (Examination Yuan and Hujiang High School). During exam period, many students would make room reservations with us. Across from our hotel is the famous Jingmei Night Market. Restaurants, convenience stores, 7-Eleven and library are all close by and take less than a minute to get to. Some of the nearby popular toursim attractions are Maokong Gondola, Zhinan Tea Road, Qinshan Trail, Zhinan Temple, Xianji Yan Qinshan Trail, Mushan Maokong Tea Garden and Mushan Zoo (Taipei Zoo). Convenient Transportation: There are several buses you can take to get to our hotel from the Taipei Station. You can also take the subway - Xindian line to Jingmei Station (about 15 minutes) - and exit at No. 1 exit, then walk for 2 minutes. Our hotel is very convenient for students who have to take exams. ~ Jingmei Hotel sincerely wish you will stay with us on your next visit ~

stays.name: 瑪奇商務旅店
stays.description: 一、瑪奇文旅是由一間老旅店改造誕生的節能輕旅店，於2016年底全面整修竣工，整體呈現現代極簡風格，並結合典雅人文空間規劃，令人感覺潔白而素雅。本旅店座落於台北文山區，由捷運景美站2號出口往斜對面即可看到；在地理位置上鄰近景美夜市、台大、公館商圈、新店碧潭風景區、木柵動物園、深坑觀光老街以及國家考試院、萬芳醫院與警察專科學校等景點，交通與生活迅速便捷。 「旅館即是文創館」，文山區是早年生產文山包種茶之重要人文據點，店內除提供旅客文山茶的享用外，另以推動台灣人文、藝術與創意為出發點，賦予旅館新生命，並置入文創空間，以此結合各界藝文雅仕，創造一個旅宿與藝術創意共生的平台。 本旅店不定期的邀請國內外新銳文創藝術家、並規劃社區藝文講座或藝文沙龍課程，結合多元的創意主張，將台灣的文化與國際接軌，讓來自世界各地的旅客都能感受到台灣的熱情與創意，提供商務、家庭、輕旅行度假休閒及國家考試的朋友們最理想的旅宿空間。

stays.description: 兄弟大飯店承續了中國傳統「殷勤、好客」的美德，融合健康（Health）、榮譽（Honor）、協和（Harmony）、誠實（Honesty）、謙虛（Humility）五種H訴求為經營信念。兄弟飯店全體同仁表裡一致，同心協力，樹立出品質優越、服務至上的國際觀光旅館。飯店座落於南京東路繁華商圈，緊鄰捷運出口，極富交通便利之優勢。250間雅潔客房，多樣化的大小房間，設備高雅、安靜、舒適，堅持溫馨的服務與安全管理。館內設有7間深受好評的優質餐廳(日本料理、義大利料理、粵菜飲茶、台菜海鮮、中西合璧自助餐、鐵板燒、川菜小吃和酒廊)，讓貴賓們能品嚐到中、西、日式多樣化的美食饗宴。一樓大廳還有飯店自營的麵包坊、蛋糕餅乾部及壽司飯丸專門店，可口、衛生、平價的外帶小品，亦是讓國內外賓客有口皆碑的便利美味。WE TREAT OUR GUESTS LIKE BROTHERS.（我們接待客人有如照顧兄弟）絕不是口號! 每一間舒適靜雅的客房、每一道衛生健康的料理，種種細微體貼都是我們珍視客人如照顧家人般的真摯用心
stays.descriptionEn: Brother Hotel is located right in the heart of Taipei's commercial district where all the actions are 2 minutes from Taipei Arena, and 5-minute drive from Songshang Airport. One of the MRT station (Nanjing East Road) is just next door. There are banks, securities firms, airlines, department stores and cinemas nearby. Furthermore, here is a convenient and speedy way to Nangang Exhibition Hall (TWTC NANGANG Exhibition Hall) from Nanjing East Road MRT station. Air-conditioning deluxe rooms with private bath & IDD telephone, color LCD TV with satellite channels, mini bar and complimentary ADSL /wireless unlimited internet access. Catering Chinese cuisine (Cantonese with Dim-Sum, Taiwanese and Szechuan), Japanese cuisine, Western cuisine (Sino-european, Italian and Teppan), cocktail lounge, bakery, sushi‧riceball specialty, cake & pastry division, laundry, store, parking lot and airport limousine service, Banquet room (wedding party, meetings).Here at Brother Hotel, we treat our guests like brothers and it is not merely a slogan. Every comfortable and elegant guestroom; every healthy and carefully prepared dish and every gesture of thought and consideration reflects the dedication and earnestness we extend to our guests as if they were our family.

stays.description: 台北文華東方酒店座落於台北市繁華商業中心與人文薈萃的敦化北路，壯麗的外觀建築充滿歐式風格，豪華精緻的設計，是台北市最著名地標之一。酒店擁有全台北市國際星級酒店中最寬敞的客房，303間品味卓絕的客房與套房，以古典雅致融合當代風格的設計理念，提供貴賓極致奢華與舒適的住宿空間。6間風格獨具的餐廳與酒吧，提供創新細緻的豪華美饌；佔地寬廣、極具規模的芳療中心引進集團屢獲殊榮的芳療概念，提供賓客完整的經典療程。此外，氣派非凡的會議及宴會場地，為所有會議活動提供圓滿成功、無與倫比的極致體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Mandarin Oriental, Taipei, with a prime location in the city’s most established business district, ushers in a new era of luxury hospitality. Renowned for its stunning European-inspired architecture and luxurious design, the hotel stands as one of Taipei’s most iconic landmarks. Featuring 303 of the city's most spacious rooms and suites, each elegantly appointed with classic inspirations and contemporary touches, the hotel offers an unparalleled level of comfort and luxury. Six distinctive restaurants and bars showcase innovative and exceptional culinary experiences, while the spacious spa introduces the Group’s award-winning wellness concepts together with holistic signature treatments and a range of wellness programmes. In addition, the magnificent meeting and event spaces set a new benchmark for sophistication and elegance elevating every occasion truly unforgettable.

stays.name: 台北碧瑤飯店
stays.description: 歷經三十年的傳承，台北碧瑤於2009年全新出發！有雅緻古典溫馨的氣氛及明燦現代時尚的空間，邀您一起細細品味在台北市都會中心那份喧鬧中的寧靜，提供給所有貴賓在忙碌步伐中悠閒的心情。另外備有餐廳、健身房、商務中心、會議室、洗衣間，以及mini-kitchen的服務，都希望能為所有光臨碧瑤的貴賓每天帶來歇息的享受與方便。現代的設備，故人的溫情，在在都是碧瑤體貼旅客的心意。不論您是耗盡體力盡興的旅遊者，還是絞盡腦力辛勤的工作者，竭誠邀請您光臨碧瑤體驗我們所有服務人員貼心的服務，也讓您感受到專屬於台灣濃厚的熱情。
stays.descriptionEn: With 30 years of experience, after re-opening in 2009, Taipei Hotel B was honored with the Taipei Fine Hotel Award in 2009 and 2010, and was also given the honor of being the co-organizer of the 2009 Taipei Deaf Olympics. Hotel B received the Three-An Hotel authentication, and is your best choice for accommodation in Taipei.We are located between 2 MRT stations—Zhongxiao Fuxing Station and Nanjing Fuxing Station, and right next to the International Airport Bus Stop. Whether you wish to visit Jioufen or the suburbs, or even the night market to savor delicious traditional food, view the scenes of 101 at night…the convenient MRT takes you anywhere you wish to go.

Also, it takes about 15 minutes drive to Neihu Technology Park, Nankang Software Park, Taipei World Trade Center, and Taipei World Trade Center Nangang Exhibition Hall.

stays.descriptionEn: Taipei’s Delight Hotel sits in the heart of the city, near the Nanjing and Dunhua commercial districts, as well as being close to the Taipei Arena, the Interchange Association, Chang Gung Memorial Hospital, and several major department stores. Just a two minute walk from Nanjing East Road Metro Station, from Delight Hotel you can quickly reach Taipei Songshan Airport, Jiannan Rd. Station Miramar Entertainment Park, and Taipei World Trade Center Nangang Exbition Hall. heading north on the Wenhu Line; Taipei Zoo and the Maokong Gondola south along the same line; Taipei Main Station, Ximending, and Banqiao to the west along the Bannan Line; and National Dr. Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, City Hall, and the Zhongxiao-Fuxing commercial district heading east. With its convenient location, Delight Hotel offers the best opportunities for its honored guests. Whether you want to visit a park, attend an exhibition, or catch a concert, you can rely on Delight Hotel to offer an oasis of tranquility in the bustling city. Recently renovated, the hotel provides 32-inch to 42-inch LED televisions in every room, all housed in a funky, fashionable Asian aesthetic. With ISO 9001 certification from ANAB as well as Taiwanese government certification, Delight Hotel offers high quality bilingual service in a clean, hygienic environment. Delight Hotel is committed to providing the best, most professional service all its honored guests.

images.description: 409 平方英尺 / 38 平米 台北寒舍艾美酒店的豪華客房位於五層至十層，將現代奢華提升至一個全新的境界。 整間客房色調中性而質樸，並採用溫暖黑木和清涼大理石精心裝點。 起居區內設有線條簡潔流暢的現代化傢俱，如大理石辦公桌、皮革及鋼制座椅和兩把木制尼龍安樂椅。 寬大的落地窗牆沿一側牆面延伸開來，讓白天的自然光線灑滿房間，讓夜晚的城市美景映入眼簾。 起居區內和睡床上方的牆面上點綴著出自當地藝術家之手的原創藝術品。 辦公區配有虛擬辦公室媒體中心、IP 電話和高亮度檯燈，可滿足旅行常客的辦公需求。 其他設施還包括一台 42 英寸純平電視、高保真音響和 DVD 播放機。 為了給客人帶來更多的舒適享受，艾美酒店特別配有獨具特色的特大床或雙人床，定能確保您安享一夜好眠。 客房浴室內採用大理石和玻璃檯面裝飾，配有寬大梳粧檯、獨立雨林淋浴間、艾美衛浴用品系列以及浴袍和拖鞋。 此外，每間客房還提供室內保險箱、茶點中心、奈斯派索咖啡機以及每日報紙遞送服務。

stays.descriptionEn: Located across from Songshan MRT Station (Exit 2), Hotel Lee-Chan offers accommodations in Taipei. Hotel Lee-Chan features free WiFi throughout the property.Each room at this hotel is air-conditioned and features a flat-screen TV with cable channels. Certain units feature a seating area to relax in after a busy day. All rooms have a private bathroom equipped with a bath. For guests' comfort, you will find slippers and free toiletries.There is a 24-hour front desk where luggage storage is available. Hotel Lee-Chan also has a shared lounge. For guests' convenience, a coin-operated washing machine and a dryer are offered.Raohe Street Night Market and Songshan Railway Station are both a 4-minute walk from Hotel Lee-Chan. The nearest airport is Taipei Songshan Airport, a 12-minute drive from the property.

stays.name: 臺北嘉佩樂酒店 Capella Taipei
stays.description: 臺北嘉佩樂酒店坐落於臺北市最美的林蔭大道⸺敦化北路，完美詮釋現代優雅與永恆經典的交融之美。由國際知名的André Fu設計事務所操刀，以「當代藝術雅居」為靈感，結合傳統人文藝術與現代城市活力，展現臺北的獨特風貌。酒店擁有86間典雅客房和套房，俯瞰臺北市天際線的壯麗景致，盆地群山美景盡收眼底，更可觀賞臺北101大樓。酒店擁有五間風格獨具的餐飲空間和一間特色三層酒吧，展現卓越的美食體驗。Capella Wellness提供量身打造的療程，滿足追求身心靈煥發的旅客，而標誌性的「Living Room」將由嘉佩樂文旅官在此精心策劃專屬遊程，為這座城市度假勝地增添魅力，成為啟發心靈的靜謐之地。
stays.descriptionEn: Capella Taipei is a transcendent blend of contemporary elegance with timeless sophistication in the heart of Taiwan’s dynamic capital. Nestled in the vibrant Songshan district, Capella Taipei fuses tradition with a modern-day narrative of the city, capturing André Fu’s personal interpretation with a “modern mansion” concept. 86 exquisitely crafted rooms and suites offer sweeping views of the city skyline, highlighting the Taipei 101 landmark and surrounding mountains, while culinary excellence abounds with five dining venues and a tri-level destination bar. Capella Wellness offers holistic treatments for those seeking rejuvenation, and the signature Living Room, where Capella Culturists curate personalised experiences, rounds out this urban retreat—a haven designed to indulge and inspire

stays.descriptionEn: In Meistay, the paintings are changed from time to time. You will be impressed by all these paintings from the moment when you enter a room or the moment when you return to it for a rest. When you stay at Meistay, you will open the door to an immersive artistic experience.In the museum of Meistay, lazy sofas allow you to choose your favorite viewing place, whether it is to be alone with the paintings, to share with your friends, to enjoy a comfortable and private space, to enjoy the unique atmosphere of Taipei day and night, to take a sip to forget about worries. All in all, every of these moments will become an unforgettable journey of yours.Meistay is an art-themed hotel. In addition to the extensive artworks displayed in the hotel, various art exhibitions will be held from time to time for providing artists with more exhibition opportunities and allowing guests to stay in the hotel and enjoy the art of cleansing the soul.

stays.description: 座落交通便捷的臺北市中心、綠樹成蔭、敦化北路與南京東路口，面對臺北小巨蛋、比鄰雙捷運站，距離臺北松山機場僅1公里、臺北101僅3公里的路程，是商務洽公旅遊購物的首選。擁有現代、典雅兩款不同風格的客房與套房，設備齊全的健身中心與戶外游泳池，讓旅客在忙碌、喧嘩的城市中，享有寧靜、放鬆的住宿體驗。設有玉蘭軒、挑高16樓的SUNNY BUFFET、SUNNY CAFE 三間餐廳；無樑柱挑高5米宴會廳、獨立可彈性調整的會議室，可容納至多1,000人的會議及宴會場地，適合舉辦各式國際大型活動、宴會、會議，更是舉行婚宴的絕佳選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: Nestled in the heart of Taipei City, ILLUME TAIPEI is ideally located on the corner of Nanjing East and Dunhua North Road, a lush green main artery with verdant trees on both sides. Facing the Taipei Arena and next to two MRT stations - Taipei Arena, and Nanjing-Fuxing Station – the hotel is just a mile down the road from Taipei Songshan Airport. With the Xinyi Shopping District and Taipei 101 Building only 3km away, the hotel is a super-convenient choice for business and leisure travelers to experience affordable, down-to-earth luxury.ILLUME TAIPEI boasts a diverse collection of guest rooms and suites. Our new well-appointed guest rooms offer the very best in comfort and privacy, while providing a peaceful retreat in which to relax and unwind throughout your stay. The well-equipped health club and outdoor swimming pool allow the traveler to enjoy a quiet, relaxing experience within the metropolis.The hotel features 3 restaurants, offering Chinese cuisine, buffet and snacks. There are pillar-less banquet venues with elevated ceilings on the 2F and 5F floors of the hotel, as well as 11 independent, partitioned VIP rooms, convention centers and banquet venues that can accommodate up to 1,000 guests. Thus the hotel is suitable for organizing various large international events, weddings, events, meetings and seminars.

stays.name: 蒲園飯店
stays.description: 蒲園隨著新商圈的發展，從小型商務旅館走出新格局，地處八德路四段，緊鄰京華城、101世貿中心、新光商圈、市民大道及高架道等交通網路的脈絡連結，使擁有51間客房的蒲園飯店正式擺脫北市旅賓館既有形象，朝向提供經商、旅遊、購物等短期住宿為主的「精緻型商務休閒旅店」。蒲園為配合商圈發展不斷地創新，並於去年年初重新裝修整建，正式營業後，由於房內設備建材考究與規劃有如觀光飯店的少見兩進式門廳設計，無論就住宿舒適性、休憩安全性等多方面審視。重新開幕以來即廣受區域內商務客好評。蒲園之特色：為方便洽公、經商、旅遊、購物、休憩之精緻型商務旅店，51間客房依不同之房型提供旅客選擇之所需，在城市之心，取一園幽靜。蒲園之堅持：「親切服務，在外如家」為蒲園秉持之理念，堅持以空間詩學、如家適然為服務之宗旨。賓至如歸、家的感覺，蒲園希望不僅是旅客的休憩點，也能成為一個回憶站。
stays.descriptionEn: Along with the development of the new commercial area, Golden Garden Hotel has gone from a small business hotel to a new layout. Located on Sec.4, Bade Road, it is nearby Living Mall, Taipei 101, Taipei World Trade Center, Shin Kong Commercial Area, Civic Boulevard, and the elevated highway. With 51 rooms, Golden Garden Hotel has officially surpassed the common image of Taipei hotels and is developing into an “exquisite business and tourist hotel” to meet the needs of business travelers, tourists, shoppers, and short-term residents. Golden Garden Hotel is constantly innovating in order to keep up with the development of the commercial area. Renovated and redecorated at the beginning of last year, the building’s facilities and materials of the rooms were planned based on the rarer tourist hotel style of a double entrance hall, therefore aspects such as living comfortability and security were examined and assessed. Since reopening, the hotel has been well-received by business people in the area. Golden Garden Hotel’s features: An exquisite business hotel convenient for conducting business, travel, shopping, or recreation. 51 rooms provide customers with a variety of choices, as well as a serene garden in the heart of the city. We’re committed to friendly service, making this your home away from home. With the poetics of space and a home ideal as our service mission, customers feel at home, and Golden Garden Hotel aims to be not only to provide accommodation but also be a place where memories are born.

stays.name: WESTGATE HOTEL 永安棧
stays.description: 永安棧座落於西門町商圈核心，矗立於綠蔭的中華路旁，以都會時尚為主軸，獨立全棟飯店為西門町的新地標。飯店以線條元素作為空間設計的主軸，巧妙融合室內室外環境，提供121個精緻俐落的住宿空間，以光線、色彩營造旅行休憩所需的質感，感受如家一般的溫柔舒適。從踏進永安棧那刻起，會有專人親切的替你打開大門、寄送行李。一抹微笑、一聲您好，是櫃檯人員與入住房客的第一次接觸。客梯的門禁系統，讓每位旅客僅能到達所屬客房及公共空間設施樓層，讓注重隱私及安全的每位客人入住的更安心。來到房間更是驚喜連連，每間客房配著高規格打造的無線網路、床頭邊有蘋果專用的充電器與鬧鈴設備。同時飯店透過與西門町商家不定期的合作，讓房客在西門町部分商家享有商品優惠折扣，更能感受到入住WESTGATE永安棧的貴賓禮遇。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the heart of the energetic Ximending, WESTGATE is steps away from trendy boutiques, unique shops and restaurants, and other upscale establishments and cultural attractions.Indulge and relax in a stylish yet cozy environment. Each of the 121 rooms at WESTGATE is uniquely designed with our guests comfortable and pleasure in mind. From your first step into our lobby, immerse yourself in our warm surroundings, boutique designs, and one-of-a-kind artworks. Let our intimate lightings and cozy beds help you sink in and relax.

stays.description: 台北美系列飯店─俞美精品飯店位於台北市西門町武昌街，近捷運西門站六號出口，步行約10分鐘。西門町是遠近馳名的潮男型女集散地，也是在國際間享負盛名的觀光朝聖地，是台北必遊的景點之一。俞美精品飯店座落於電影街內，無論飲食、交通、購物及休閒娛樂，周邊商店林立，應有盡有。俞美精品飯店鄰近峨嵋停車場、聯合醫院、誠品、萬年大樓、MOMO藥妝、好樂迪KTV、星聚點KTV、U2、國賓及威秀等各大電影院、生活機能一應俱全！俞美精品飯店共計42間客房，分別為標準雙人房、高級雙人房、豪華三人房及頂級四人房。每一間客房皆配有LCD液晶電視、乾溼分離獨立沐浴間、免費Mini bar，高速寬頻網路及免費無線上網等。俞美精品飯店地理位置優越，西門町商圈食衣住行育樂的包羅萬象，加上台北美系列飯店堅持的品質保證，俞美精品飯店將為您每一段旅程激發出無限的驚喜，成為您旅途中溫暖舒適的第二個家
stays.descriptionEn: Beauty Hotels Taipei – Hotel B6 is located at Ximending, it just takes 10 minutes by walking from Hotel B6 to Exit 6 of MRT Ximen Station. Ximending is one of the most popular tourist spots among both local and international travelers. Ximending features not only a wide selection of fashionable clothing and accessories but a diversity of entertainments and activities. Hotel B6 near Ermei Car Park, Eslite Department Stores, movie theaters, KTV, MOMO Beauty & Care Shop, Taipei City Hosipital and so on. With an excellent location close to Ximending, Hotel B6 offers great convenience in transportation and entertainment.Wonderfully located adjacent to Ximending and MRT Ximen Station, Hotel B6 features easy access for your journey. There are abundant options of shops and restaurants. Hotel B6 must be your sweet second home to travel in Taipei.

stays.name: 凱達大飯店
stays.description: 凱達大飯店座落於台北新地標雙子星大樓，視野超棒的高樓層飯店，與台鐵萬華火車站共構，到站即到家。距離捷運龍山寺2號出口站步行僅3分鐘，搭乘捷運一站即達「西門商圈」，距離兩站即達五鐵共構的「台北車站」，前往香火鼎盛的「龍山寺」步行僅需5分鐘，距離「華西街國際觀光夜市」及「剝皮寮文化園區」約500公尺。飯店內共擁有745間品味卓絕的客房與套房，提供免費Wi-Fi、多功能免治馬桶、分離式衛浴、衛星頻道，提供物超所值的住宿體驗。飯店設有健身中心、游泳池、兒童遊戲室，附設3間風格獨具的中西式餐廳與酒吧，挑高七米氣派非凡的會議及宴會場地，另提供免費停車、行李寄存、24小時接待櫃檯、外幣兌換、旅遊諮詢等服務，精通多國語言的服務人員必能提供旅人賓至如歸的絕佳感受。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the heart of Taipei west district, Caesar Metro Taipei, Twin Towers of the new Taipei landmark, possesses the convenient location to easily access to the city's must-see destinations. The hotel is adjacent to WanHua Railway Station, and only three minutes away from MRT Longshan Temple Station on foot. The main transportation city point, Taipei Railway Station is just 2 MRT stops away and Ximending shopping area is only one stop away. A five-minute walk to the famous Longshan Temple is easy accessible and Hwahsi Tourist Night Market and Bopiliao Old Street are both 500 meters away only. All 745 newly designed rooms and suites enjoy the stunning city views, and all furnished with free Wi-Fi internet access, washlet, separate bathroom and TV Satellites. Caesar Metro Taipei ensures an unbeatable value and tourism experiences.The hotel provides a superb range of recreation and leisure facilities, such as fitness center, outdoor pool and playroom. There are 3 unique restaurants and a bar to serve Chinese and Western cuisines, and 7 meter-high ceiling ballrooms provide the best banquet and meeting venues. The hotel offers variety of services, including free car parking, 24-hour Front Desk with multi-language speaking staff, luggage storage, foreign currency exchange and tour information, Caesar Metro Taipei is an ideal accommodation for travelers who are seeking for fun, charm, comfort and convenience experiences in Taipei.

stays.description: 保持西日本鐵道株式會社旗下索拉利亞飯店系列一貫的理念，索拉利亞西鐵飯店台北西門以一個位於都市中可以提供客人既優雅又時髦的空間與時間的飯店為目標預定將於2023年在台北年輕人的靈魂中心西門町開幕。身為台北市數一數二熱鬧的觀光區，西門町一直都是台灣年輕族群文化與流行的發烊地，聚集了電影院、咖啡廳、流行服飾店或是角色周邊商店與飾品店。不能錯過的還有各式知名的老店與觀光景點，不只是台北的年輕人，西門町也一直是世界各地來訪的旅客於台北不容錯過的地區。處於如此充滿活力的環境，索拉利亞西鐵飯店台北西門為您準備了對應一大床、兩小床或是三床房的的各式房間滿足各種背景客人的需求，全館現代台灣風格的房間可讓處於如此幾乎過於熱鬧環境中的旅客依然可以擁有一個安靜舒適的休息空間。
stays.descriptionEn: Following the tradition of Nishi-Nippon Railroad Company, Ltd. on the Solaria Hotel chains, providing a stylish and elegant space and time in the city, Solaria Nishitetsu Hotel Taipei Ximen is schedule to open in 2023 at the passion center of youngsters in Taipei, the Ximending.As one of the most crowded tourist spot in Taipei city, Ximending has always be the center of culture and fashion of the young generations in Taipei, you can find the movie theaters, café, fashion boutiques and shops with character goods or accessories around every corner. With also famous shops that never get overwhelm by the flood of time and tourist spots, Ximending has always hold the reputation of a tourist spot must go for tourist from all over the world.Standing within these endless energies, Solaria Nishitetsu Hotel Taipei Ximen prepares numerous room types holding either double, twin or triple beds to match the needs of guests with different needs. Presenting a modern Taiwanese style interior, we will provide you a quiet and comfy stay even in the middle of these overwhelming energy.

stays.description: 品格子旅店西門館是位於臺北市的西門町的旅館，從早期日本膠囊旅館發想，擷取其善用空間的巧思，卻改良其隔音差及缺乏隱私的缺點，期待能打破台灣傳統旅館格局，創造出一種適合台灣都會的新型態旅宿，滿足旅客想省錢又不失住宿品味的需求。『西門館』鄰近西門捷運站，週邊擁有無數的吃喝玩樂據點，是您體驗西門町精彩玩樂生活的最佳選擇，並附設3~4人的好友房型，也有日曬機和紅光機等設施，讓您在旅途中也可以享受光療的樂趣喔~~~
stays.descriptionEn: Inn Cube Ximen is a hotel located in Ximending, Taipei City. It is inspired by the early Japanese capsule hotels, capturing their ingenuity in making good use of space, but improving their shortcomings of poor sound insulation and lack of privacy. It hopes to break the traditional hotel pattern in Taiwan and create a new type of accommodation suitable for Taiwan& #39;s metropolises, meeting the needs of travelers who want to save money while maintaining a taste for accommodation. The Ximen Branch is close to the Ximen MRT Station and is surrounded by numerous places to eat, drink and have fun. It is the best choice for you to experience the wonderful entertainment life in Ximending. It also has rooms for 3 to 4 people, as well as facilities such as tanning machines and red light machines, so that you can enjoy the fun of light therapy during your trip~~~

stays.description: 此飯店位於萬華區中心，距離西門町商業區僅 2 分鐘步行路程。飯店提供附設免費無線上網的客房。新麗旅店距離台北捷運西門站 10 分鐘步行路程。客人搭乘火車15分鐘即可抵達華西夜市。桃園國際機場距離本飯店店有一小時車程。當代風格的空調客房配有線頻道的平面電視、電熱水壺和冰箱。客房設有私人保險箱和電話。時尚的套房浴室配有淋浴設施和浴缸。24小時接待櫃檯的工作人員可以提供禮賓或行李寄存服務。旅遊諮詢台可以安排旅遊行程。
stays.descriptionEn: Situated in the centre of Wanhua District, this hotel is just a 2-minute walk from the Ximending business area. It offers rooms with free Wi-Fi access.Newful Hotel is a 10-minute walk from Taipei Metro Ximen Station. Guests can take a 15-minute train ride to get to Huaxi Night Market. Taoyuan International Airport is an hour’s drive away.The contemporary air-conditioned rooms feature a flat-screen TV with cable channels, an electric kettle and a fridge. A personal safe and a telephone are included. The stylish suite bathroom has shower facilities and a bathtub.Staff at the 24-hour front desk can assist with concierge or luggage storage services. Travel arrangements can be made at the tour desk.

stays.description: 明日大飯店台北市便利的位置，距離西門捷運站和著名的西門町購物區有不到3分鐘步行路程，設有現代客房和覆蓋各處的免費無線網絡連接。 酒店距離著名的蔣介石紀念堂僅有15分鐘步行路程，距離台北火車站和台北松山機場均有20分鐘車程，距桃園國際機場有不到40分鐘車程。 空調客房配有木質地板、書桌、平面電視以及帶免費沏茶設施的電熱水壺。連接浴室則配有毛巾、淋浴、吹風機和免費洗浴用品。 明日大飯店友好的員工全天提供服務，提供傳真/影印服務和禮賓服務。旅遊諮詢台則可提供票務服務、觀光服務和旅行安排。 明日大飯店在公共用餐區供應每日自助早餐。大飯店距離眾多供應本地菜餚的餐館和食品攤位有不到5分鐘步行路程。
stays.descriptionEn: Conveniently in Taipei City, Tomorrow Hotel is within a 3-minute walk from Ximen MRT Station and the popular Ximending shopping district. It has modern rooms and provides free Wi-Fi access throughout the property. The hotel is just a 15-minute walk to the well-known Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall. Taipei Train Station and Taipei Songshan Airport are a 20-minute drive away, and Taoyuan International Airport is accessible with a 40-minute drive. Fitted with hardwood floors, air-conditioned rooms include a desk, a flat-screen TV and an electric kettle with complimentary tea-making facilities. The attached bathroom includes towels, shower, hairdryer and free toiletries. Available round-the-clock, the friendly staff at Tomorrow Hotel can assist guests with fax/photocopying and concierge services. Ticketing, sightseeing and travel arrangements can also be made at the tour desk. At Tomorrow Hotel, guests are served with daily buffet breakfast at the common dining area. Alternatively, a variety of restaurants and food stalls offering local dishes are available within a 5-minute walk away.

stays.name: 橙舍背包客國際青年旅館
stays.description: 「橙舍」是一家以「青年旅館」為名的合法旅館，「橙舍」位於台北市最流行熱鬧的西門町徒步區旁，這裡有數之不盡的商店、小吃、服飾店、電影院、甚至幾十年的老店。來西門町不僅可以滿足吃、喝、玩、樂，還可以隨處發現百年歷史的建築物。從「橙舍」步行到「西門捷運站」僅約五分鐘，到機場巴士等候站步行約一分鐘，到「台北車站」車程也僅5分鐘 。 「橙舍」原為一棟老舊的建築物，於2010年重新整修後，整體呈現具巴洛克風格，明亮乾淨綠意盎然的佈置提供背包客一處截然不同的住宿環境。全館提供24小時門禁密碼管理與監視系統、旅遊資訊服務區、羽絨暖被、寬敞的洗手檯、免費使用高速無線寬頻網路、公用電腦、緊急電話、置物櫃、廚房、洗衣機、晾衣區、24小時淋浴熱水、貼心的服務，讓背包客宛如回家般的舒適自在。我們訴求以最低廉的價格提供最超值的服務，讓來自世界各地的背包青年在此國際文化交流，我們自許成為臺灣青年旅館的標竿，也期待有為您服務的機會。
stays.descriptionEn: TW I is located next to the popular yet sophisticated walking path in XiMenDing. There are myriad stores, shops, movietheaters, diverse array of cuisines, distinctive local delicacies to satisfyand impress both domestic and foreign visitors. One can also find traces ofprehistoric buildings recalling the era of 100 years ago leaving you with abreathtaking sight. MRT Ximen Station is only approximately one minutewalking distance, Airport Bus Stop is approximately five minutes walkingdistance and Taipei Main Station is approximately 5 minutes by car. All of thisallows you to get the most exciting venues of Taipei in the shortest time. TW I was originally a prehistoric ancient building, renovated in 2010 to a baroque style appearance which boldly contrasts with the city’s plush and modernism. TW Hostel I ’s ambience istranquil with minimal décor; it is a place where you can relax and soak in natural elegance. We provide 24 hour security control with monitoring system, travel information area, duvet covers, spacious basin, free high-speed internet, touch screen computers, emergency telephone, lockers, kitchen, self-operated laundry area, hot showers, and most importantly, attentive service to give you maximum convenience just as if at home. With the most affordable price, we provide you with excellent service in which backpackers from all over the world can experience this extraordinary cultural difference.

stays.descriptionEn: Located in prosperous western TaipeiLocated at the prosperous and classical street of Ximending, the Hotel serves as an important base for visitors. Once walking out of the Hotel, the visitors would immediately encounter popular Taiwanese snacks.Tourist attractions are only blocks away.The tourists can take a cultural trip and explore the history of Taipei at Longshan Temple, Wanhua, Monga, and Dadaocheng. It is also convenient to go to Taipei Main Station from the Hotel. The tourists can travel around Taipei easily, as the MRT Bannan Line is only a 10-minute walk away.
