stays.description: Comma Boutique Hotel 位置很方便，位於臺北的萬華區，距離西門紅樓 600 公尺，距離捷運西門站 600 公尺，距離總統府 1.2 公里。這間住宿距離青山宮約 1.3 公里，距離剝皮寮老街約 1.4 公里，距離艋舺龍山寺約 1.8 公里。住宿有 24 小時櫃檯服務、機場接送服務、共用休息室，設有全館 WiFi（免費）。 Comma Boutique Hotel 的客房均備有電熱水壺。這間住宿的所有客房均提供平面電視、空調以及備有淋浴設施和免費盥洗用品的私人衛浴。部分客房有露臺。 Comma Boutique Hotel 的每間客房都有寢具和毛巾。 Comma Boutique Hotel 附近的人氣景點包括臺北市中山堂、華西街觀光夜市和臺北車站。最近的機場是臺北松山機場，距離這間住宿 6 公里。
stays.descriptionEn: Well situated in the Wanhua District district of Taipei, Comma Boutique Hotel is located a 7-minute walk from The Red House, 600 yards from MRT Ximen Station and a 14-minute walk from Presidential Office Building. The property is close to several well-known attractions, a 15-minute walk from Qingshan Temple, 0.9 miles from Bopiliao Old Street and 1.1 miles from Mengjia Longshan Temple. The property has a 24-hour front desk, airport transportation, a shared lounge and free WiFi throughout the property.Complete with a private bathroom equipped with a shower and free toiletries, all rooms at the hotel have a flat-screen TV and air conditioning, and some rooms also offer a terrace. At Comma Boutique Hotel all rooms have bed linen and towels.Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Taipei Zhongshan Hall, Huaxi Street Tourist Night Market and Taipei Main Station. The nearest airport is Taipei Songshan Airport, 3.7 miles from Comma Boutique Hotel.

stays.descriptionEn: Surrounded by various dining and shopping options, Cho Hotel is in Ximending. It& #39;s only a 2-minute walk from Ximen MRT Station and Eslite Bookstore. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property.The hotel is a 5-minute drive from Longshan Temple and Taipei Main Station, a 10-minute drive from Ninsha Night Market, and a 20-minute drive from Taipei 101 Mall. It takes 25 minutes by taxi from Songshan Airport, and Taoyuan Airport is a 50-minute drive away.Simply decorated, air-conditioned rooms here will provide a flat-screen cable TV and private bathroom with a shower. A hairdryer and free toiletries are also included.There& #39;s a 24-hour front desk and a Cafe at Cho Hotel.

stays.description: 位於臺北市的旅館-町 ‧ 記憶旅店3館用記憶，留下回憶。以懷舊回憶打造的「町．記憶旅店」是西門町知名的文青旅店，除了經典復古的裝潢擺飾外，別出心裁的服務及設施更讓旅客們讚不絕口。而新打造的三館一別復刻手法，改將復古元素融入現代設計，享受高質感的休憩體驗。旅行可以是豐富、精采的電影，可以心靈的流浪，可以是生活的營養針，也可以是段充滿各種人生的縮影。我們將這一切稱為：記憶。跨越了圖像與文字，用整座旅店說出它蘊藏雋永的記憶，讓所有的記憶在你的旅行中重新洗牌，創造出來的便是留在你我人生當中，最無價的獨家回憶。「老城不死，永不凋零。」就由「西門印象」做為起點吧！串起從歷史文化到各巷弄角落，帶你走進時間長廊，細細品味著百年風華「記．憶」。最後，旅人們請放慢你的旅行步伐，留下你的隻字片語，在舊時空的引領下，讓我們一起開始拼組堆疊這屬於我們的新時代小故事。絕佳位置：位於熱鬧的西門町商圈，徒步 6 分鐘即可抵達捷運西門站，逛街購物、觀光旅遊、享受美食一次擁有！貼心服務：提供免費 Wi-Fi、24 小時接待櫃台、多語接待人員、行李寄存等。

With the highly rated, the newly Cho Hotel 3 are integrated into the modern design. We adding an egg-shaped bathtub, so that travelers can enjoy a high-quality experience.Excellent location: Located in Ximending , only a 6-minute walk to MRT Ximen Station. Shopping, sightseeing, and enjoying delicious food all at once!Service: Free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception counter, multilingual reception staff, luggage storage, etc.

stays.name: 禾順行旅
stays.description: Wholesome Hotel 禾順行旅位於台北萬華心臟地帶，巧妙融合老艋舺的歷史風華，為每位旅客打造獨特且難忘的住宿體驗。步行即可抵達龍山寺、華西街夜市與西門商圈，隨時享受在地美食、夜市小吃與豐富的街頭文化。飯店設計兼具雅緻舒適與文創氛圍，無論是商務出行、文化探訪或休閒旅遊，都能讓您在繁忙城市中找到放鬆與自在。交通極為便利，捷運龍山寺站步行約 5 分鐘即可抵達，附近公車與主要道路也方便自駕或叫車，輕鬆串聯台北各大景點。無論您是美食愛好者、文青探險客，還是想體驗台北城市生活的旅人，Wholesome Hotel 禾順行旅都是您理想的落腳選擇，帶您走進萬華的歷史韻味與潮流魅力。
stays.descriptionEn: Wholesome Hotel is located in the heart of Taipei’s Wanhua District, skillfully blending the historic charm of Old Mengjia to create a unique and unforgettable stay for every guest. Within walking distance are Longshan Temple, Huaxi Street Night Market, and Ximen Shopping District, allowing you to enjoy local delicacies, night market snacks, and vibrant street culture at any time.The hotel combines elegant comfort with a creative, cultural atmosphere, making it perfect for business trips, cultural exploration, or leisure travel. Transportation is extremely convenient: just a 5-minute walk from Longshan Temple MRT Station, with nearby bus stops and main roads for easy access to Taipei’s major attractions.Whether you are a foodie, a culture seeker, or a traveler wanting to experience Taipei city life, Wholesome Hotel is your ideal base, guiding you into Wanhua’s rich historical charm and trendy appeal.

stays.descriptionEn: MEI LODGE provides safe, clean rooms and quiet space for a relaxing stay. The lodge just recently remodeled, is located in prosperous Ximen Shopping Area. Due to very close to lots of sightseeing places such as The Red House, the Presidential Palace, Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall, Longshan Temple, Huahsi Night Market, Eslite Bookstore, and Far Eastern Department Store etc., MEI LODGE is the best choice for lodging plus business trip. Ximen Shopping Area which contains various popular elements is the consuming paradise in young people’s mind, but also attracting many domestic and foreign tourists. If you are a backpacker, the convenient transportation and nearby shopping area make MEI LODGE your top selection. It only takes about 3 minutes on foot from Ximen to our lodge if you take MRT Bannan Line at Taipei Main Station. Also you can transfer to the north Taiwan or South Taiwan by TRA or HSR from Taipei Main Station.

stays.name: 豪景大酒店
stays.description: 坐擁觀音山脈的優雅，俯攬淡水河景的壯闊，豪景大酒店以卓越的自然景觀，提供您住房餐飲最宜人的所在。 介於山水之間，豪景不離人群，結合西門町的現代風貌和萬華、龍山的傳統精粹，豪景以講究效率和細緻的服務、兼蓄中國固有的待客美德，邀您在自然人文的丰采裡，感受「客臨豪景 、賓至如歸」。 恬靜溫馨，以客為尊是豪景引以為傲的特色之一。無論是住舒適，食的美味或是視野的開闊、服務的貼心，都是您忘卻生活於現代的緊張，享受休閒的至高樂趣。 名家造景、滿室古董真跡、高雅的裝潢蘊涵東方的含蓄，歐洲的典雅，重新詮釋家的感覺。在高雅舒適的氣氛中、消除您旅途的疲勞。
stays.descriptionEn: Embracing the elegance of Mt. Guanyin and grasping the magnificence of the view of the Danshui River, Hotel Riverview Taipei provides you with the most agreeable and pleasant dining and accommodation environment in gorgeous natural scenery. Located between the mountain and the river, Hotel Riverview Taipei is never away from the city. Coming with the modern urban appearance of Ximen and the traditional essence of Wanhua and Longshan, Hotel Riverview Taipei invites you to enjoy the homelike feelings and our efficient and thoughtful services supported by the hospitality virtue in Chinese culture. Tranquil and warm, putting the customer first is the pride of Hotel Riverview Taipei. Whether it is comfortable accommodation, exquisite delicacies, the boundless view, or heart-touching services, they can always help you forget about the tense modern life and enjoy the ecstasy of leisure. With landscaping planned by celebrated designers, a full house of genuine antiques, and the graceful decorations incorporating the essence of Zen with European elegance, we redefine the feeling of home. In the elegant and comfortable atmosphere, your fatigue from travel is alleviated.

stays.name: 十份塩居
stays.description: 來到台南七股，您可站於鹽山頂端看著四周的景色風光，或是選擇前往鹽山的博物館探索台灣製鹽的歷史與文化；最夯的玩法則是乘座竹筏出海慢遊潟湖，品嚐七股肥美飽滿的蚵仔，最愜意的則是於午後時光，漫遊鄉間小路，在土溝裡與招潮蟹玩玩捉迷藏，萬種風情的七股，正在等著您前來造訪。
stays.descriptionEn: Arriving at Qigu, Tainan, you may enjoy the surrounding scenery while standing on top of the salt mountain, or choose to go to the Taiwan Salt Museum for an exploration of Taiwan’s salt production history and culture. The most popular is to ride on a bamboo raft for a trip in the lagoon, to savor Qigu’s juicy oysters; the most leisurable is the stroll in the rural trails during afternoon hours, to play hide and seek with fiddler crabs in the earth ditches. All types of fun in Qigu are waiting for you.

stays.description: Chapter127跨越海洋最終落腳府城臺南。即使隔了一片海洋，最終我們還是遇到了彼此\\因為一次偶然的旅行，而促成了新的篇章。//幾年前房東來了台灣旅行，與當時熱門的台北不一樣，房東選擇了清閒且當地文化色彩強烈的台南。一踏入台南，就感受到台南的熱情還有台南的獨特氛圍，就好比一小滴顏料滴到一大桶色彩鮮艷的油漆裡面一樣，一下子就融入了。而我們旅客就是顏料，台南的鮮豔就是那桶油漆，讓當時的房東感到新奇卻又親切。過了多年以後再回來台南，這次是真的想留在台南生活。但多年旅居國外的房東，還是想要將原本的生活環境帶入台南，在出門與回家間，形成一種對比，喜歡台南的環境，又可以同時保有在家鄉的感覺。那何不直接把國外的生活經驗帶到台南給大家呢?就這樣Chapter127誕生了，所有的房間都以簡單的線條跟單純的配色所組成，清新脫俗，又不失時髦感，讓外地來台南的旅客多一種選擇，讓台南當地人偶爾想逃家的好選擇 (開玩笑~也讓外國旅客有種熟悉的感覺~

stays.description: [住的質感]LOFT的簡約沉穩，是瑞斯特給人第一印象，不做作的空間設計，乾淨、舒適的住宿品質， 平易近人的收費，讓旅人可以輕鬆入住，且自在體驗瑞斯特的美好。[窩的空間]瑞斯特背包客棧是三層的獨立建築，為提供舒適寬敞的住宿環境，全棟只設置2間房， 為上下舖單人床房型，並分層設置男女衛浴間，皆配置免治馬桶座。 一樓開放式交誼廳，讓旅人們自在分享旅行資訊。
stays.descriptionEn: [Quality of living]Finding affordable accommodation is not easy. That’s where REST Backpackers comes in! Decorated with contemporary furnishings, REST Backpackers offers stylish LOFT fashionable design with luxury amenities, clean and comfortable living accommodating within your budget. Our friendly staff is always happy to help with their local knowledge of surrounding areas including great place to visit or simply by suggesting a great eatery that suits your palate.Come along and stay at REST Backpackers; we’re sure like many others you will be highly satisfied with REST experience.[Accomodations]REST Backpackers is a three-floor high, independent building. We offer 2 dormitory rooms with single bunk beds for essential comfort. Linen is supplied for the bunk beds. All floors have en-suite facilities including washlets and are separate by gender. Guests can exchange travel information in our relaxed lobby located on the first floor.

images.description: 入住注意事項 熱水供應截止時間：22:00；房間大燈熄燈時間：22:00；夏季冷氣供應時間：22:00至10:00。 請勿攜帶寵物入住。 為提供舒適及安全的住宿空間，室內禁止吸菸及嚼檳榔，我們也不提供烹煮設備， 請旅客勿在屋內烹煮食物，如有需飲食的旅客，可於交誼廳內飲食，恕不可攜入房間內，影響其他旅客權益。 旅客個人貴重物品請隨身攜帶並妥善保管，如有遺失恕不負責。 請於規定時間內辦理入住，入住時請出示身分證件或護照，以供登記，並繳清餘額。 為維護住宿安寧，晚間22：00過後請降低音量，勿大聲喧嘩，避免影響其他旅客權益。 我們的房間均為雅房型態，有男性及女性專屬房〈若包間可變成混合房〉，床位由我們分配，恕無法指定床位， 我們主要採男女分房住宿，且為單人床型，適合單獨或少數自助旅行的背包客們。 我們是以背包客為主客群的青年背包客棧，採半自助管理方式，退房時，請自行將床單、枕套、被套拆下，拿至樓梯間的換洗籃內。 腳踏車租借僅服務性質，不負安全之責，請背包客小心騎乘。 所提供之物品或設備若有損壞，照價賠償。 聯絡手機：〈+886〉0911-835437 Line ID: gonwane Wechat ID: restbackpacker

stays.name: Weloft Inn
stays.description: 古蹟即是一種文明的表徵,也是人類走過歷史痕跡的紀錄,更是顯現人類提昇生活水準與技術之見證。古蹟走過歷史,不僅禁得時間的考驗所留下,更重要的是他背後所代表的歷史脈絡與意義,不同地方有屬於自己的文化與歷史,而古蹟即是痕跡,紀錄過往歷史的點點滴滴..在大學時,學校位於台南地區,人家說一府二鹿三艋舺,台南擁有許多的古蹟文化資源,也因緣際會的時常放假之時就會往台南各地的古蹟與歷史建築參觀遊憩,發覺其實「古」也能引發許多的聯想與讓人想親近的感覺,也讓我對古蹟漸漸的產生了興趣！ 台南有許多老舊的歷史建築,都是過去活過的象徵,如何活化與再利用也深深地在我腦中思考著,在台南緩慢的旅行吧！透過空間與氛圍發現遺失在時間洪流裡的美好記憶..

stays.name: 二弄八號
stays.description: 關於 台南民宿 二弄八號由台灣第一位女建築師 王秀蓮女士 所建造。矗立於老府城中西區的寧靜巷弄內，已將近一甲子的時光了 。民宿裡頭空間不大，但麻雀雖小，五臟俱全，盥洗用品非常齊全，各個空間完全獨立使用，而且舒適又乾淨。我們保留了早期建築的歷史痕跡，不管是樓梯，檜木窗戶，洗石地板…同時再以軟件部份及部份牆面，去添加了新的輕工業原素，可謂是新舊完美融合。跟現在的台南很像！附近美食更是讓您吃到撐。進福炒鱔魚意麵，太陽牌冰品，阿龍意麵，莉莉冰果店，福記肉圓………景點呢，孔廟，林百貨，藍晒圖……交通也方便，距離火車站步行的話，只要約13分鐘就到民宿了。搭公車去任何景點也很方便。愛騎腳踏車的朋友也有T-bike可租（延平郡王嗣站）！而且也有專用汽車停車場，完全不用擔心停車問題。台南民宿 二弄八號 誠摯邀請您來台南作客！

stays.name: 來七桃旅店
stays.description: 【來七桃。不同於喧囂，位在古街巷道寂靜的歷史感。】來七桃旅店傳承老台南老飯店亞都大旅社的生命，在圓環邊的巷弄中呼吸著舊時繁華街道的榮景，圍繞在台南老厝之間，感受著昔日的老台南商業中心的味道。散落滿街的歷史文化，走一趟小巷弄如拾起一地的寶石，串成一串歷史的項鍊。-從來七桃散步經過「石鐘臼」(石精臼)，走到赤崁樓，短短的一路下來我們可以輕易地從城市的表情中閱讀到歷史，歷史就是這麼活生生地真實存在著。-【來七桃。遇見新台南的繁華鼎盛的觀光與美食。】我們可以說，走出來七桃，便走進了歷史。舊時鼎盛的米街(新美街)，自然地感受老街的生命力，不需要經過觀光的刻意包裝。-經過米街巷弄中靜靜等待重建的廣安宮，我們走後門散步走進了葉老，葉石濤筆下的美食「石鐘臼」(石精臼)，這個由昔日繁華演進至現今的台南飲食一隅。-來七桃一帶聚集了許多有名的小吃，石精臼、廟前的虱目魚粥、鱔魚麵、度小月擔仔麵...等，在這樣一個充斥美食的地方，來七桃將成為您尋訪美食的起點與小憩的歇腳亭，百年茶店金德春，蜿蜒街道中藏有開基武廟屋頂起翹的陰影。-西門圓環邊小巷道，感受飲食的台南，我們不在為觀光刻意營造的老巷弄，來七桃，請您跟我們來七桃。-【來七桃讓您一飽老台南特有的澎派早餐。】來七桃的早餐，不是到處充斥的早餐店文化，而是台南特有的澎派。-倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【06-2221766】台南住宿．來七桃旅店。-【來七桃Facebook粉絲頁】http://www.facebook.com/lcthotel

stays.searchText: 來七桃旅店 裕力開發有限公司 臺南市旅館260號 臺南市 中西區 西門路二段372巷6號1-4樓 【來七桃。不同於喧囂，位在古街巷道寂靜的歷史感。】來七桃旅店傳承老台南老飯店亞都大旅社的生命，在圓環邊的巷弄中呼吸著舊時繁華街道的榮景，圍繞在台南老厝之間，感受著昔日的老台南商業中心的味道。散落滿街的歷史文化，走一趟小巷弄如拾起一地的寶石，串成一串歷史的項鍊。-從來七桃散步經過「石鐘臼」(石精臼)，走到赤崁樓，短短的一路下來我們可以輕易地從城市的表情中閱讀到歷史，歷史就是這麼活生生地真實存在著。-【來七桃。遇見新台南的繁華鼎盛的觀光與美食。】我們可以說，走出來七桃，便走進了歷史。舊時鼎盛的米街(新美街)，自然地感受老街的生命力，不需要經過觀光的刻意包裝。-經過米街巷弄中靜靜等待重建的廣安宮，我們走後門散步走進了葉老，葉石濤筆下的美食「石鐘臼」(石精臼)，這個由昔日繁華演進至現今的台南飲食一隅。-來七桃一帶聚集了許多有名的小吃，石精臼、廟前的虱目魚粥、鱔魚麵、度小月擔仔麵...等，在這樣一個充斥美食的地方，來七桃將成為您尋訪美食的起點與小憩的歇腳亭，百年茶店金德春，蜿蜒街道中藏有開基武廟屋頂起翹的陰影。-西門圓環邊小巷道，感受飲食的台南，我們不在為觀光刻意營造的老巷弄，來七桃，請您跟我們來七桃。-【來七桃讓您一飽老台南特有的澎派早餐。】來七桃的早餐，不是到處充斥的早餐店文化，而是台南特有的澎派。-倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【06-2221766】台南住宿．來七桃旅店。-【來七桃Facebook粉絲頁】http://www.facebook.com/lcthotel

stays.name: 來了
stays.description: 位於台南的七八十年的老房子有著來自幾不同領域的人藝術創作者，長租在這幾間大小不等的房間，分別為花藝設計師、潛水旅行者、攝影師、旅遊作家..我們提供這些創作者長租在這個環境，而這些不同領域的人，透過設計、藝術、旅行經驗、人生品味等，在這和大家分享故事，讓來台南體驗生活的人，能了解這裡的慢活步調以及感受台南房子的溫度。

stays.description: 位於台南市市中心區，斜對面就是著名的古蹟赤崁樓；緊鄰火車站、林百貨、新開幕的美術館、台灣文學館及新光三越及海安路藝術街，孔廟、天壇、武廟、大天后宮及百年馬雅各教堂景點近在咫尺。聞名全台的度小月擔仔麵、富盛號碗粿、森茂碗粿、再發號肉粽、義豐冬瓜茶等百年小吃老店。劍橋大飯店四通八達的地理環境，絕對是您觀光旅遊，商務洽公住宿的最佳選擇。劍橋連鎖飯店榮觀光局評鑑全國最佳商務飯店獎、省旅遊局優良旅館評鑑審定特優、台南市政府頒發衛生優良店家與環保旅店等多項殊榮並通過ISO-9001和ISO-9002國際品保認證。
stays.descriptionEn: Cambridge Hotel is conveniently located in the central part of Tainan city, nearby the train station and the airport. There are several popular department stores and well-established financial institutions in the area. Furthermore, the hotel is located directly the opposite of the Chih-Kan Tower, which is a grade one historic site in Tainan. You can also enjoy eating at the famous Tainan traditional snack shops near our hotel. The ideal location of Cambridge Hotel not only provides you with a better choice for business travel, but also with comfortable accommodations for tourists.

stays.name: 友愛閤睏漫旅
stays.description: 友愛閤睏漫旅位於台南市區，周邊眾多美食與景點林立，地理位置方便。鄰近台南孔廟、台南市美術二館、司法博物館、赤崁樓、以及新光三越西門新天地等知名景點，讓您輕鬆體驗台南的深厚文化底蘊，感受百年古城的迷人魅力。大廳格局溫馨，設有舒適的休息區，讓您在旅途中放鬆休息。所有客房皆全面禁菸，致力營造舒適環境，讓您在入住期間感受到家的溫馨。全館提供免費 WiFi，讓您隨時與親友分享旅程中的美好時刻。除了舒適的住宿環境外，也提供旅遊諮詢服務，以及行李寄放服務，讓您輕輕鬆鬆暢遊台南，充分探索台南的風土人情。無論您是商務出差還是旅遊度假，友愛閤睏漫旅都能滿足您對舒適、便利和服務的需求。
stays.descriptionEn: Yoai Nemuru Inn is situated in downtown Tainan, surrounded by a variety of dining options and attractions, making it conveniently located. Nearby landmarks include Tainan Confucius Temple Cultural Park, Tainan Art Museum Building 2, Judicial Museum, Chihkan Tower, and Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Ximen New World, allowing guests to easily explore Tainan's rich cultural heritage.The lobby is cozy with a comfortable resting area for guests to relax during their stay. All rooms are smoke-free, ensuring a comfortable environment. Free WiFi is available throughout the hotel for guests to stay connected with friends and family. In addition to comfortable accommodation, the hotel offers travel consultation services and luggage storage, allowing guests to explore Tainan effortlessly. Whether traveling for business or leisure, Yoai Nemuru Inn is committed to providing a comfortable, convenient, and service-oriented experience.

stays.description: 1.不附早餐 2.假日定義：星期五、星期六、國定假日前一晚 3.可接受6歲以下小朋友不佔床同住，收100元清潔費，但不提供寢具、毛巾、飲料等備品 4.兩位入住僅提供雙人床寢具，若有另加一床單人棉被(不加床)需求，需另付150元乾洗費 5.*榻榻米區為四疊，加床3人以上較為擁擠，比較不建議，但若客人覺得OK，我們還是可以幫您準備 6.連住2晚以上，入住期間不入內打掃、換床單及毛巾，第2日起每日優惠 300元 7.為了安全考量，小房子的熱水器是選用儲熱式的，冬天熱水用量較大時，建議您第三、四位客人沐浴時間與前二位相隔15-20分鐘 左右，第五、第六位客人同樣也與前面2位相隔15-20分鐘， 以免發生熱水不夠用的狀況 8.備品：礦泉水、茶、掛耳式咖啡、毛巾（浴巾+長巾），浴帽，沐浴乳、身體乳、洗髮精、 潤絲精《請自備牙刷、牙膏》 設備：冷氣、冰箱、快煮壺、電磁爐及簡易烹飪鍋具及餐具、藍芽功能小音響、Wi-Fi、 吹風機《沒有電視》" 9.格局: 小房子為兩層樓建築，共約24坪。一樓為起居空間，有小小的客、餐廳及厨房與洗手間；二樓是完全開放的睡眠空間與一間衛浴。有一張標準雙人床及4帖榻榻米，榻榻米區可以加床，每帖榻榻米尺寸，90*180公分。嚴格說来，小房子是没有隔房間的，請自行評估是否符合您的需求" 10.加床：提供上層羽絨、下層記憶泡綿的日式床墊，並搭配全套寢具及備品 11.入住時間:下午4時以後 / 退房: 早上11時以前 12.小房子位於安靜的街區，晚上10時以後請輕聲細語，以免影響鄰居作息。並請勿於室內吸菸。

stays.name: 台南晶英酒店
stays.description: 座落於台南市中西區的國際五星級商務度假酒店，為晶華麗晶酒店集團旗下之飯店。鄰近新光三越新天地百貨公司、新光三越小西門商圈，步行可抵城市內的古蹟景點，擁有豐富歷史典藏、蘊含人文風貌、商業機能完善之特色，車行30分鐘可至台南高鐵站與台南科學園區，交通便利，兼具商務與休閒度假的環境與功能。台南作為台灣第一個城市，在城市發展的紋理中，與其一同生息的歷史文物與文化扮演著重要的推手，遙想百年前文風隱身於街道巷弄間，朗讀的詩詞曾在晝夜裡傳頌不休，本飯店將其儒風意象化為設計元素，相信『現代且雋永』，館內裝潢設計處處可見中西融合、經典現代的巧思，運用閩式建築特色妝點空間，書院收藏著老讀物，大廳兩旁的鼓藝是呼應千百年來禮樂相傳的敬意，隱身其中的文創藝術有著溫和的態度，走入飯店，皆是藏於細節中的心意。全館擁有255間客房，挑高六米的大型多功能宴會廳，可席開百桌無樑柱婚宴與多間多功能會議空間，延伸集團餐飲優勢，設有中、西式精緻料理餐廳，廚藝團隊大量運用在地食材，滿足您崇尚在地、美味與視覺等多重饗宴。位於四樓休閒樓層，規劃空中泳池休憩空間、健身房、與親子互動遊戲室，打造完美且完善的商務度假環境。秉持著與在地共生共榮的品牌精神，將溫厚的歷史氛圍與書院文化融於旅宿空間之中，謹以『文風再現‧創藝傳承』作為使命，承襲府城首學的風範與驕傲，感念舊世代的智慧，期許在新時代的文化裡共同努力，為旅人們創造豐富、滿足的住宿體驗！
stays.descriptionEn: Superbly positioned for both business and leisure, Silks Place Tainan is situated in the heart of this enchanting city that was once a bustling cultural capital. A mere thirty-minute drive from Tainan High Speed Rail station, we are just a stone’s throw away from Shin Kong Mitsukoshi shopping district and major historic landmarks.Timeless designs, from the suspended calligraphy brush lamps in each of the 255 guest rooms to the motif of pottery rooftop tiles in the lobby walls, gracefully reflect Tainan’s rich history of art, literature, and architecture. Without compromising on modern luxury, our hotel features a stunning outdoor swimming pool, a magnificent banquet hall, a sublime Chinese cuisine restaurant, and a Western steakhouse and teppanyaki, popular among both locals and travelers. With our junior guests in mind, our Kid’s Club offers a stimulating array of activities from story time and Xbox games to our exclusive Chinese “Six Arts”, where families can enjoy simple calligraphy exercises, bean bag toss, abacus practice, and more. Art lovers looking to soak up a splash of local culture are invited to join our guided tour of the exquisite collection of paintings, photographs and other works by local artists on display throughout Silks Place Tainan. A pioneering local author once wrote, “Tainan is the perfect place to daydream, to work, to fall in love, to get married, and to live in utter bliss.” We invite you to discover this charming city for yourself. Welcome to Silks Place Tainan!

stays.searchText: 台南晶英酒店 晶華國際酒店股份有限公司 臺南市旅館273號 臺南市 中西區 和意路1號1-13樓,1-1號1樓 座落於台南市中西區的國際五星級商務度假酒店，為晶華麗晶酒店集團旗下之飯店。鄰近新光三越新天地百貨公司、新光三越小西門商圈，步行可抵城市內的古蹟景點，擁有豐富歷史典藏、蘊含人文風貌、商業機能完善之特色，車行30分鐘可至台南高鐵站與台南科學園區，交通便利，兼具商務與休閒度假的環境與功能。台南作為台灣第一個城市，在城市發展的紋理中，與其一同生息的歷史文物與文化扮演著重要的推手，遙想百年前文風隱身於街道巷弄間，朗讀的詩詞曾在晝夜裡傳頌不休，本飯店將其儒風意象化為設計元素，相信『現代且雋永』，館內裝潢設計處處可見中西融合、經典現代的巧思，運用閩式建築特色妝點空間，書院收藏著老讀物，大廳兩旁的鼓藝是呼應千百年來禮樂相傳的敬意，隱身其中的文創藝術有著溫和的態度，走入飯店，皆是藏於細節中的心意。全館擁有255間客房，挑高六米的大型多功能宴會廳，可席開百桌無樑柱婚宴與多間多功能會議空間，延伸集團餐飲優勢，設有中、西式精緻料理餐廳，廚藝團隊大量運用在地食材，滿足您崇尚在地、美味與視覺等多重饗宴。位於四樓休閒樓層，規劃空中泳池休憩空間、健身房、與親子互動遊戲室，打造完美且完善的商務度假環境。秉持著與在地共生共榮的品牌精神，將溫厚的歷史氛圍與書院文化融於旅宿空間之中，謹以『文風再現‧創藝傳承』作為使命，承襲府城首學的風範與驕傲，感念舊世代的智慧，期許在新時代的文化裡共同努力，為旅人們創造豐富、滿足的住宿體驗！

stays.name: 同心旅棧
stays.description: 同心旅棧位於台南中西區忠孝街巷裡，附近臨近兌悅門-西元1836年建成。因於正西方而以八卦中的「兌」卦為名，巷內裡富有台南歷史街景。同心旅棧以老宅再生為特色規劃舒適住宿空間，讓來台南的旅人們除了吃道地美食外，也可以沉浸在富有文創再生的空間裡休憩享受旅遊的快感。
stays.descriptionEn: Tongxin Inn is located in Zhongxiao Street, Central and Western District, Tainan, near Duiyue Gate - built in 1836 AD. Named after the "Dui" hexagram in the Bagua because it is located directly in the west, the alley is full of Tainan's historical street scenes. Tongxin Hotel features comfortable accommodation spaces designed with the regeneration of old houses in mind, so that travelers to Tainan can not only eat local delicacies, but also immerse themselves in a space rich in cultural and creative regeneration and enjoy the pleasure of traveling.

stays.name: 和逸 台南西門館
stays.description: HOTEL COZZI 和逸飯店·台南西門館座落於台南市中西區，鄰近新光三越新天地百貨公司、小西門商圈、藍晒圖文創園區、台南美術館，步行10分鐘內即可抵達知名古蹟景點和國華友愛商圈，交通十分便捷。2019年5月HOTEL COZZI與美國卡通頻道Cartoon Network攜手合作，結合三部超人氣動畫：探險活寶、飛天小女警和熊熊遇見你，全館超過1,000坪公共空間，戶外奇趣操場、卡通頻道室內遊憩區與54間卡通明星主題客房，打造全台唯一卡通頻道聯名旅宿。& lt;br/& gt;【客房介紹】飯店客房樓層於6樓至13樓，擁有220間客房(包含54間卡通主題房)，舒適客房採光絕佳、明亮舒適，寬闊的客房空間中備有獨立式浴缸，搭配加厚窗簾與完整隔音建築，並提供多種高度與功能的枕頭可作選擇，讓您享受台南市區的鬧中取靜，充分休息舒緩一日的疲勞。& lt;br/& gt;飯店內6樓與7樓為卡通頻道主題樓層，共有54間卡通頻道主題房，從梯廳廊道就開始被卡通明星角色生動姿態所吸引，卡通頻道主題房中有18款不同情境主題，還原卡通故事場景，入住即可將獨家卡通週邊商品，包含卡通玩偶(每房2隻隨機贈送)、主題客房盥洗備品、購物袋、卡通明星旅行3件組(飛天小女警衣物收納袋、探險活寶盥洗包、熊熊遇見你方巾)，市值約$2000元。& lt;br/& gt;【奇趣操場】飯店內最受歡迎的親子設施，位於飯店４樓戶外空間「奇趣操場」，巧妙地將卡通明星們融入設施中，提供「和逸愛嘟嘟小火車」環繞整個奇趣操場，卡通明星「熊熊遇見你」也在車站旁迎接著您；館內人氣第一的親子設施「飆風電動車」，有寬敞車道，讓小小飆車手也能開車兜風馳騁(限體重25kg以下)，另有「小女警沙池」、「噴泉池」及卡通明星公仔等等，讓大小朋友們與最愛卡通明星們一同度假享受歡樂氛圍。& lt;br/& gt;【卡通主題室內遊憩區】位於飯店５樓的室內主題遊憩區，原汁原味重現卡通場景，「探險活寶糖果王國」以探險活寶卡通中的糖果王國為主題，設有趣味十足的泡泡球池、糖球遊戲牆和糖果書屋，在充滿童趣和驚喜的空間互動同樂；另外2023年全新打造「森林遊戲屋」，以熊熊遇見你三位主角們居住的森林情境打造，導入五款大型遊具，分別有樹洞山丘、樹木溜滑梯等設施，耗資百萬打造出獨一無二的遊樂氛圍，所有設備都經過完整的安全測試，提供孩子們安全玩耍的遊戲空間。，大小朋友都可以玩得盡興又滿足。& lt;br/& gt;【Cozzi KITCHÉN餐廳】位於4樓的Cozzi KITCHÉN卡通頻道派對歡樂廚房，【早餐時段】提供「自助式多彩晨光早餐」，供應豐富營養的中、西式餐食，並特別提供道地台南古早味小吃，例如牛肉湯、肉圓、米糕等，讓您以滿格能量迎接充溢探險和驚喜的一天。【午餐及下午茶時段】中午12:00至下午17:00，供應各式主廚特選料理，從輕盈爽口的沙拉、經典義式風味、精緻日式商業午餐，到療癒的甜點下午茶與特調飲品，每一道都是為你精心設計，不論是中午輕鬆聚餐、午後嘴饞時光，都能在這裡找到剛剛好的選擇。

stays.searchText: 和逸 台南西門館 國泰商旅股份有限公司 臺南市旅館282號 臺南市 中西區 西門路一段658之2號4-13樓 HOTEL COZZI 和逸飯店·台南西門館座落於台南市中西區，鄰近新光三越新天地百貨公司、小西門商圈、藍晒圖文創園區、台南美術館，步行10分鐘內即可抵達知名古蹟景點和國華友愛商圈，交通十分便捷。2019年5月HOTEL COZZI與美國卡通頻道Cartoon Network攜手合作，結合三部超人氣動畫：探險活寶、飛天小女警和熊熊遇見你，全館超過1,000坪公共空間，戶外奇趣操場、卡通頻道室內遊憩區與54間卡通明星主題客房，打造全台唯一卡通頻道聯名旅宿。& lt;br/& gt;【客房介紹】飯店客房樓層於6樓至13樓，擁有220間客房(包含54間卡通主題房)，舒適客房採光絕佳、明亮舒適，寬闊的客房空間中備有獨立式浴缸，搭配加厚窗簾與完整隔音建築，並提供多種高度與功能的枕頭可作選擇，讓您享受台南市區的鬧中取靜，充分休息舒緩一日的疲勞。& lt;br/& gt;飯店內6樓與7樓為卡通頻道主題樓層，共有54間卡通頻道主題房，從梯廳廊道就開始被卡通明星角色生動姿態所吸引，卡通頻道主題房中有18款不同情境主題，還原卡通故事場景，入住即可將獨家卡通週邊商品，包含卡通玩偶(每房2隻隨機贈送)、主題客房盥洗備品、購物袋、卡通明星旅行3件組(飛天小女警衣物收納袋、探險活寶盥洗包、熊熊遇見你方巾)，市值約$2000元。& lt;br/& gt;【奇趣操場】飯店內最受歡迎的親子設施，位於飯店４樓戶外空間「奇趣操場」，巧妙地將卡通明星們融入設施中，提供「和逸愛嘟嘟小火車」環繞整個奇趣操場，卡通明星「熊熊遇見你」也在車站旁迎接著您；館內人氣第一的親子設施「飆風電動車」，有寬敞車道，讓小小飆車手也能開車兜風馳騁(限體重25kg以下)，另有「小女警沙池」、「噴泉池」及卡通明星公仔等等，讓大小朋友們與最愛卡通明星們一同度假享受歡樂氛圍。& lt;br/& gt;【卡通主題室內遊憩區】位於飯店５樓的室內主題遊憩區，原汁原味重現卡通場景，「探險活寶糖果王國」以探險活寶卡通中的糖果王國為主題，設有趣味十足的泡泡球池、糖球遊戲牆和糖果書屋，在充滿童趣和驚喜的空間互動同樂；另外2023年全新打造「森林遊戲屋」，以熊熊遇見你三位主角們居住的森林情境打造，導入五款大型遊具，分別有樹洞山丘、樹木溜滑梯等設施，耗資百萬打造出獨一無二的遊樂氛圍，所有設備都經過完整的安全測試，提供孩子們安全玩耍的遊戲空間。，大小朋友都可以玩得盡興又滿足。& lt;br/& gt;【Cozzi KITCHÉN餐廳】位於4樓的Cozzi KITCHÉN卡通頻道派對歡樂廚房，【早餐時段】提供「自助式多彩晨光早餐」，供應豐富營養的中、西式餐食，並特別提供道地台南古早味小吃，例如牛肉湯、肉圓、米糕等，讓您以滿格能量迎接充溢探險和驚喜的一天。【午餐及下午茶時段】中午12:00至下午17:00，供應各式主廚特選料理，從輕盈爽口的沙拉、經典義式風味、精緻日式商業午餐，到療癒的甜點下午茶與特調飲品，每一道都是為你精心設計，不論是中午輕鬆聚餐、午後嘴饞時光，都能在這裡找到剛剛好的選擇。

stays.description: 位於台南市中心卻隱藏在寧靜且充滿歷史巷弄裡的背包客棧。雖然是老房子但是我們十分愛惜這有歷史的房子，所以我們很重視整齊清潔,讓每個人房客住起來感覺很舒服。我們以老式房子配上簡單的家具來營造您回家的感覺，讓您的旅行過程中充滿了輕鬆休閒的居家回憶,另外因為位置在市區內的巷弄裡,所以相當的安靜,不用擔心有噪音的問題打擾到您的睡眠。房型有分合住四～五人房（男女分開）。來哈木家不但可以認識很多日本朋友，我們還會為您介紹台南景點及美味小吃,並且還可以體驗不同國家的熱情及風趣，在這歡迎大家來入住。我們位於忠義路的巷弄裡，到赤崁樓只需步行3分鐘，離台南火車站步行約10分鐘，鄰近台南市中心名勝古蹟。雖然位於市中心，但在小巷弄內,所以不用擔心噪音問題,無論是白天或是晚上都非常安靜，我們以老式房子配上簡單的家具來營造您回家的感覺，整齊清潔的房間,讓每個人房客住起來感覺很舒服,能讓您的旅行過程中充滿了輕鬆休閒的居家回憶,這是我們的一直努力的方向。

stays.name: 哩賀佳住
stays.description: 哩賀佳住｜台南中西區哩賀佳住位於台南市中西區，交通便利，鄰近多個知名觀光景點與商圈，是旅客探索台南歷史文化、美食與在地生活的理想住宿選擇。本館為合法登記旅館，為獨棟建築，配有電梯設備，館內全面禁菸，提供安全、整潔、舒適的住宿環境。客房設有乾濕分離衛浴設備，並使用Oright歐萊德品牌沐浴用品與洗手乳，重視旅客住宿品質與環保理念。自2025年起，本館響應永續旅遊政策，不提供一次性備品，敬請旅客自備個人盥洗用品。本館鄰近多個台南指標性景點，距離新光三越西門店約步行10至15分鐘，旅客可順道造訪藍晒圖文創園區。開車約10分鐘可抵達花園夜市，為台南規模最大的夜市之一，每週四、六、日營業，集結台灣各地美食與特色小吃。周邊亦有永樂市場、鴨母寮市場等傳統市場，適合體驗在地風味與人文風情。入住時間為每日15:00至17:30，退房時間為翌日11:00前。哩賀佳住期待每位旅客在此留下安心、舒適的旅遊回憶，感受台南獨有的慢活魅力。**請注意，我們的櫃台服務時間為每天上午8:30至下午5:30，若您計劃於此時間以外入住，我們提供自助入住服務。**自助入住的詳細流程會透過官方LINE帳號 @lihejiazhu 傳送給您。為確保順利入住，請您在入住前先結清房費，並提供入住者的個人資料作為登記。這些資料將用於合法登記並符合相關法規要求。我們是合法的旅宿業者，所有入住過程都將遵循相關法律規定，確保您的住宿安全與隱私。若您有任何問題，請於營業時間內或透過官方Line聯絡我們，我們將竭誠為您服務。期待您的到來，祝您有個愉快的住宿體驗！
stays.descriptionEn: Li He Jia Zhu | Tainan West Central DistrictLi He Jia Zhu is located in Tainan West Central District, with convenient transportation and close proximity to many famous tourist attractions and shopping areas. It is an ideal accommodation choice for travelers looking to explore Tainan history, culture, food, and local life.Our establishment is a legally registered hotel, a standalone building with elevator access, and a smoke-free environment throughout the property, providing a safe, clean, and comfortable stay.The guest rooms are equipped with separate shower and toilet facilities, and we use Oright brand shower products and hand soap, emphasizing both guest accommodation quality and environmental sustainability.Starting from 2025, we will support sustainable travel by not providing single-use amenities, so we kindly ask guests to bring their own personal toiletries.Our hotel is located near several iconic Tainan landmarks. The Shin Kong Mitsukoshi West Gate Store is about a 10-15 minute walk away, and guests can also visit the Blueprint Cultural and Creative Park along the way.It takes about 10 minutes by car to reach the Garden Night Market, one of the largest night markets in Tainan, which operates on Thursdays, Saturdays, and Sundays. It offers a variety of food and specialty snacks from all over Taiwan. There are also traditional markets nearby, such as Yongle Market and Yamu Liao Market, where guests can experience local flavors and cultural atmosphere.Check-in time is from 15:00 to 17:30 daily, and check-out time is before 11:00 the following day.Li He Jia Zhu looks forward to providing every guest with a safe and comfortable travel experience, allowing you to experience the unique slow-living charm of Tainan.**Please note that our front desk service hours are from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM daily. If you plan to check in outside of these hours, we offer self-check-in service.**The self-check-in process will be sent to you through our official LINE account @lihejiazhu.To ensure a smooth check-in, please settle your room payment in advance and provide the guest& #39;s personal details for registration.This information will be used for legal registration and to comply with relevant regulations. We are a legitimate accommodation provider, and all check-in processes will follow legal requirements to ensure your safety and privacy.If you have any questions, please contact us during business hours or through our official LINE account. We are here to serve you. We look forward to your visit and wish you a pleasant stay!

stays.searchText: 哩賀佳住 哩賀佳住有限公司 臺南市旅館363號 臺南市 中西區 美學街88號 哩賀佳住｜台南中西區哩賀佳住位於台南市中西區，交通便利，鄰近多個知名觀光景點與商圈，是旅客探索台南歷史文化、美食與在地生活的理想住宿選擇。本館為合法登記旅館，為獨棟建築，配有電梯設備，館內全面禁菸，提供安全、整潔、舒適的住宿環境。客房設有乾濕分離衛浴設備，並使用Oright歐萊德品牌沐浴用品與洗手乳，重視旅客住宿品質與環保理念。自2025年起，本館響應永續旅遊政策，不提供一次性備品，敬請旅客自備個人盥洗用品。本館鄰近多個台南指標性景點，距離新光三越西門店約步行10至15分鐘，旅客可順道造訪藍晒圖文創園區。開車約10分鐘可抵達花園夜市，為台南規模最大的夜市之一，每週四、六、日營業，集結台灣各地美食與特色小吃。周邊亦有永樂市場、鴨母寮市場等傳統市場，適合體驗在地風味與人文風情。入住時間為每日15:00至17:30，退房時間為翌日11:00前。哩賀佳住期待每位旅客在此留下安心、舒適的旅遊回憶，感受台南獨有的慢活魅力。**請注意，我們的櫃台服務時間為每天上午8:30至下午5:30，若您計劃於此時間以外入住，我們提供自助入住服務。**自助入住的詳細流程會透過官方LINE帳號 @lihejiazhu 傳送給您。為確保順利入住，請您在入住前先結清房費，並提供入住者的個人資料作為登記。這些資料將用於合法登記並符合相關法規要求。我們是合法的旅宿業者，所有入住過程都將遵循相關法律規定，確保您的住宿安全與隱私。若您有任何問題，請於營業時間內或透過官方Line聯絡我們，我們將竭誠為您服務。期待您的到來，祝您有個愉快的住宿體驗！

stays.name: 嘉旅館(2館)
stays.description: 嘉旅館 (2館) 前身 「金屋旅棧」是一間49年歷史的老旅棧，為了幫老屋注入新生命的靈魂，我們透過點滴的努力，努力保留歷史的痕跡的同時更新了設施提升舒適度。簡樸的裝潢，溫馨的格局，公共空間也提供茶水及桌遊等，讓旅人可安心的下榻之餘，更可輕鬆休憩一番。我們地處台南精華地段，前有"國華街"，後有"丹丹漢堡"，左有"赤崁樓"，右有"海安路"，佔盡地利之便。早上到國華街永樂市場吃豐富特色台南早餐，中午到丹丹漢堡享用南霸天的美食，晚餐到赤嵌樓附近石精臼區吃台南傳統小吃，夜晚到海安路點一杯微醺之夜，皆是散步都會到的地方，小管家們還有自己口袋名單，也可以為你建議台南的旅程。
stays.descriptionEn: the Retro Tai-Pan 2Formerly known as Kingwow Inn, our guesthouse carries nearly half a century of history—49 years of memories within its walls. In recent years, we& #39;ve worked carefully to breathe new life into this old building, preserving its historic charm while upgrading facilities for modern comfort.We don& #39;t rely on extravagant décor; instead, what we offer is a heartfelt love for Tainan. Perfectly located in the city’s vibrant core, the Retro Tai-Pan is surrounded by local attractions : Guohua Street in front, Dandan Burger behind, Chihkan Tower to the left, and Hai& #39;an Road to the right.

stays.name: 太陽慢慢走
stays.description: 在台南體驗太陽慢慢走的生活吧！Red Letter Day 是指發生好事的，值得在日記上用紅筆標記的一天。我們有六隻貓咪管家與兩隻狗狗管家，插畫家創作手繪的特色房間！還有無包裝商店與來自台灣、香港的文創商品可以選購喲！我們臨近孔廟、五妃街、台南美術館，距離火車站車程僅4分鐘，汽機車停車皆方便！✿寵物友善住宿空間✿性別友善住宿空間✿地址：臺南市中西區大埔街89巷35號。✿
stays.descriptionEn: Experience the life of the sun walking slowly in Tainan!Red Letter Day refers to a day when something good happens that is worth marking with a red pen in your diary.We have six cat butlers and two dog butlers, and illustrators create hand-painted special rooms!There are also unpackaged shops and cultural and creative goods from Taiwan and Hong Kong to buy!We are close to Confucius Temple, Wufei Street and Tainan Art Museum. It is only 4 minutes drive from the train station, and it is convenient to park cars and motorcycles!✿ Pet-friendly accommodation space ✿ Gender-friendly accommodation space ✿ Address: No. 35, Lane 89, Dapu Street, Zhongxi District, Tainan City. ✿

stays.description: 旅行對你來說是什麼？去探索、發現、感受生活中的美好，是我們對「好趣」的定義。好趣旅店呈現的不只是房間的風格，而是生活該有的樣子。我們希望在這裡，每個人都能找到自己最喜歡的樣貌，在旅行的途中探索對生活的各種想像。我們邀請 Lo-Fi house 生活風格師，打造紳士質感、度假叢林、復古懷舊 3種詮釋旅行的方式，讓台南的美好故事跟記憶，與你的朋友們一同分享，散播在充滿溫度的每個細節裡。Chill out，沈浸在充滿歷史人文氣息的正興街，我們是好趣。HowChill Inn 2019年・夏

stays.name: 定春行旅
stays.description: 定春提供一個安靜、乾淨的住宿空間。在您遊覽歷史、人文、風景、美食… 等多采多姿的台南之餘，放鬆舒服的歇一腳。 1. 定春為自助入住(self check-in)民宿，大門及房門採密碼門禁管理。 2. 預訂後請加定春官方Line( @700wynha )或使用Booking的訊息平台，以方便告知您房門密碼及後續聯絡事宜。 3. 無提供早餐及汽車停車位，門口則可以停機車。需要汽車停車場資訊歡迎提問喔。 4. 提供大浴巾+沐浴乳+洗髮乳+吹風機，定春為環保永續認證民宿，牙刷、牙膏、刷鬍刀、浴帽等一次性物品已不再提供囉。 5. 室內全面嚴禁吸菸，包含電子菸，懇請配合。 6. 勿私自攜帶寵物。 7. 包棟或兩日以上訂房歡迎來電或Line詢問，可享優惠價格喔。 再麻煩貴客預約前先閱讀以上說明喔！感恩感恩~
stays.descriptionEn: Haru guesthouse provides a quiet and clean accommodation space. Take a relaxing break while exploring Tainan's diverse history, culture, scenery, food, and more.1. Haru guesthouse is a self-check-in B&B, and the main door and room door are managed with password access control.2. After booking, please add Haru guesthouse’s official Line (@700wynha) or use Booking’s messaging platform to conveniently inform you of your room door password and follow-up contact information.3. No breakfast or car parking spaces are provided, but motorcycles can be parked at the door. If you need car parking information, please feel free to ask.4. Large bath towel + shower gel + shampoo + hair dryer are provided. Haru guesthouse is an environmentally friendly and sustainable certified B&B. Disposable items such as toothbrushes, toothpaste, shaving razors, and shower caps are no longer provided.5. Smoking, including e-cigarettes, is strictly prohibited indoors. Please cooperate.6. Do not bring pets without permission.7. For private rooms or reservations for more than two days, please call or Line for enquiries, and you can enjoy preferential prices.I would like to trouble you to read the above instructions before making a reservation! Thank you, thank you~

stays.name: 富華大飯店
stays.description: 台南富華大飯店 由皇鼎建設轉投資興建，為富信大飯店旗下的品牌，座落於台南市市區內，中正路與忠義路交叉口，緊鄰火車站、北門商圈、新光三越及海安路藝術街，更與南台灣第一家百貨公司「林百貨」（五層樓仔）和孔廟景點近在咫尺。鄰近赤崁樓、武廟、天壇、大天后宮及台南文學館等著名古蹟景點，及聞名全台的虱目魚粥、富盛號碗粿、再發號肉粽、克林肉包、義豐冬瓜茶等百年小吃老店，台南富華大飯店四通八達的地理環境，絕對是您休憩旅遊，商務洽公的最佳選擇。飯店全館96間客房以現代簡約的設計風格，營造出舒服、整潔、溫馨的全方位住宿旅館，提供外出旅客舒適的住宿空間、商務出差人士各項商旅需求；房內提供無線網路，方便隨時查詢資訊、分享心得，並設有商務中心提供上網、傳真、影印等商務服務；入住期間，旅客可向櫃台免費租借腳踏車，提供您暢遊府城的另一管道；飯店3樓及5樓備有自助洗衣間，洗脫烘設備方便每位來此住宿的旅人們。二樓富麗廳提供中西自助式早餐，用心烹調的各式季節性菜色，開放明亮的用餐空間，讓您享用美味餐點的同時，感受早晨幸福快樂時光。地下一樓設有健身房，備有多項運動器材，住宿期間隨時歡迎愛運動的您免費使用。
stays.descriptionEn: FUWARD Hotel Tainan was invested and constructed by Founding Construction. It is a brand under FUSHIN Hotel. It is located in Tainan City Center, at the intersection between Zhongzheng Road and Zhongyi Road, close to the railway station, Beimen Shopping District, Shinkong Mitsukoshi and Hai'an Road Art Street. It is also in the vicinity of the first department store in Southern Taiwan "Hayashi Department Store" (Five-Stories House) and the attraction, Confucius Temple.It is close to Fort Provintia, Martial Temple, Tian Tan, Grand Matsu Temple, National Museum of Taiwan Literature and other well-known monuments and attractions. It is also near to food like milkfish porridge, Fusheng Bowl Cakes, Zaifa Meat Dumpling, Klin Taiwan Bun, Yifeng Wintermelon Tea and other old 100-year snack eateries famous in Taiwan. The accessible location of FUWARD Hotel Tainan makes it the absolute best choice for your leisure travel and business trips. The hotel has 96 guest rooms. It's modern and minimalist design creates a comfortable, neat and cozy all-rounded accommodation and hotel, providing travelers with comfortable accommodation and meeting the various business needs of business travelers; wireless Internet access is provided in the rooms, making it convenient for guests to search for information and share their experiences at any time. The Business Center also provides Internet access, fax, photocopy and other business services; during your stay, travelers can rent bicycles from the counter free of charge to explore Fucheng in another way; there are self-service laundry rooms and washing, spinning and drying equipment on the 3F and 5F in the hotel, providing convenience to all the travelers who stay here. The Fuli Restaurant on 2F provides Chinese and Western buffet breakfast. Various seasonal dishes are carefully prepared for you to enjoy a delicious meal in the open and bright dining space, and to enjoy a happy morning. There is a gym on B1 and it is equipped with a lot of fitness equipment. You are free to use them at any time during your stay.

stays.description: 小南天生活輕旅是為小資女孩打造的台南旅館，位在市中心 ，走路或騎旅店的免費單車，步行可到台南火車站、國華街小吃、台南美術館、林百貨等熱門景點。閒逛在巷弄內，感受台南的慢活和老台南人的口味，省下的租機車或計程車費可以再吃十種特色小吃。制式的旅館太高價，民宿的設備、服務和清潔品質不一，青年旅館最平價但卻常常無法真正放鬆休息－－難得假期的小旅行，想要民宿的親切舒服，但又想要旅館的乾淨及便利配備，同時不要忘了精打細算－－小南天生活輕旅為妳的需要而生。 沒有旅館的拘謹，讓妳感受如民宿的人情味；旅館的乾淨、安全，我們卻也沒有少。連單人房都配備租屋處鮮少有的浴缸，搭配各房型提供浴鹽、Dyson吹風機，澡可以盡情泡；三折式高密度床墊，好睡到淺眠者都易入眠。旅館巷弄內就有文青咖啡館、日雜選貨店，幾乎所有台南小吃也都走路可及，放鬆、簡單度過一個下午。 小南天也是台南百年巷弄內的老屋，由設計團隊改造，新設計與舊元素交會，全棟旅館以白色與木質為主色調，小巧俱全的日系和洋風格，恍如帶妳走入台南的歷史。徹底從忙碌的生活放鬆，且深刻感受台南的巷弄魅力。 讓旅館不再只是暫時睡一晚的地方，回旅館也成為美好回憶。 小南天生活輕旅期待與妳一起傳遞美好人情味。
stays.descriptionEn: SSSlife Hotel is a Tainan hotel for petty-bourgeois girls. It is located in the city center. It is within walking distance of Tainan Railway Station, Guohua Street Snacks, Tainan Art Museum, Lin Department Store and other popular attractions. Wander in the alleys and feel Tainan’s slow work and the tastes of old Tainanese. You can eat ten kinds of special snacks if you save on renting a motorcycle or taxi.Standard hotels are too expensive, and the equipment, services and cleaning quality of the homestays are different. Youth hotels are the cheapest but they often can’t really relax and rest-a rare holiday trip. I want the kindness and comfort of the homestay, but I also want the cleanliness of the hotel. And convenient equipment, and don’t forget to plan carefully-SSSlife Hotel is born for your needs. Without the restraint of a hotel, you can feel the human touch of a hotel; the hotel is clean and safe, but we are not less.Even the single rooms are equipped with bathtubs that are rarely found in rental houses, and each room type provides bath salts and Dyson hair dryers. You can soak in the bath as much as you want. The tri-fold high-density mattress makes it easy for people to sleep well to light sleep. In the alleys of the hotel, there are Wenqing coffee shops and Japanese grocery stores. Almost all Tainan snacks are also within walking distance. Relax and simply spend an afternoon.SSSlife Hotel is also an old house in Tainan’s Centennial Alley. It was renovated by the design team. The new design meets the old elements. The whole building is made of white and wood as the main color. The compact Japanese and Western styles seem to take you into Tainan. history.Completely relax from the busy life, and deeply feel the charm of Tainan's alleys. Let the hotel no longer be just a place to sleep for a night, returning to the hotel will also become a good memory. SSSlife Hotel is looking forward to sharing a beautiful human touch with you.

images.description: 旅館少見的「樓中樓」房型，用輕旅負擔就有民宿包棟的舒適感！ 空間感升級，配備當然也要頂級！除了德國進口的無噪音冰箱、熱水器等完整的房間設備，再提供日本Dyson吹風機的享受！ 日式風格挑高樓中樓，雙層空間利用多元，雙人旅行時仍可享有獨處的時光，空間亦為小資房的兩倍，最適合追求獨特體驗、難得想犒賞自己的妳

images.description: 「小資」房型價格平實，最適合精打細算的女孩，享有民宿級便宜房價、舒適體驗不折扣！ 省下來的兩頓晚餐費，讓妳盡情買回各種台南小吃、甜點，吃不完可以存放在冰箱內（冰箱是德國進口的，無噪音唷～），還有熱水瓶讓妳泡杯茶，和旅伴輪流在浴缸盡情泡澡。 恰好的空間，像在家中一樣舒適自在。高評價、高CP值首選。

stays.name: 屎溝墘客廳
stays.description: 台南｜屎溝墘客廳・屎溝裡的黃金，跨越三世紀的老屋用緩慢的步伐走入府城窄小的信義街，走過一間間古今交錯的老屋與新宅；最後，停在其中一扇掛上門聯的白色老木門前──屎溝墘客廳，輕輕推開那道藏著記憶的門，彷彿回到百年前的美好歲月。故事開端，從有味的河說起「屎溝墘」是五條港最北的一條支流，昔日曾用來運送水肥，因此有了這個看起來很「臭」的名稱；而建於1897年的這棟老街屋就位在這條河道旁，台南運河完工後，舊河道因泥沙淤積而被填平，居民便逐漸將房屋擴建、拉高，形成了今日的住所樣貌。踏入屎溝墘客廳，簡單的木製、竹籐家具，展現復古老台南的生活風景，主人蔡廳長說，之所以取名為「屎溝墘客廳」，就是希望能夠延續客廳的意象，讓人們能夠自在地聚在這裡生活。頂上的屋梁、地上的白卵石與一旁的紅磚牆都保留著歷史的痕跡；一百多年前，日據時代日本人到台南實施都更計畫，拆除了許多老舊的城牆、建築，附近的碼頭工人便將這些來自荷據、明清時期的磚塊集結起來，建造起自己的房子。與老靈魂的深入對談這裡是跨越三世紀的老屋，也是蔡廳長的家族老厝。四十幾年前，蔡廳長的爸爸買下了這間老屋供長輩安享餘年，但之後長輩搬遷，老屋於是閒置了二十多年；直到2011年，主人蔡廳長決心回到台南生活，他認為「台南真正的價值就在這些老巷弄、老屋以及文化。」於是將老屋翻修成民宿，希望能夠向旅人訴說關於回憶的故事。溫柔的日光照著旅人，爬上陡斜木梯，來到二樓的壓艙樓房，房裡擺飾著蔡廳長曾經壯遊歐洲的蒐藏；「這棟老屋就像是一位百歲人瑞，是有靈魂的哦！」接著，蔡廳長要你赤腳踩在老舊的木地板上，聽它唱起吱拐、吱拐的歌曲。
stays.descriptionEn: Tainan｜Sai Kau Kin Old HouseGold in the Gutter, An Old House that Spans Three CenturiesWalking at an unhurried pace through the narrow streets of the old capital city, you turn down Xinyi Street, walking past a mixture of residences both old and new. Eventually, you stop before an old wooden door painted white with couplets handwritten on red paper framing the doorway - on the horizontal scroll above the door are the characters for Sai Kau Kin Old House. You lightly push the door open, feeling the wealth of stories it must contain, and are seemingly transported a century into the past to a beautiful bygone time.The story begins with a smelly riverSai Kau Kin (literally “The Bank of the Open Sewer”) is the name of the northernmost tributary in Wu Tiao Gang (“Five Channels Harbor”). In olden days, it was used for the storage and transportation of the city’s sewage waters, hence the rather smelly sounding name. Built in 1897, the old house of today’s visit is located on the bank of this river channel. After construction of the Tainan Canal was completed, the accumulating silt and sludge filled up the channel, at which time residents in the area began to expand their dwellings outward and upward, creating the Sai Kau Kin living environment that we see today.As you set foot in Sai Kau Kin Old House, the simple wooden construction, the bamboo and wicker furniture exhibits the classical style of life in Tainan. James, the owner of the guesthouse, chose the name Sai Kau Kin Old House in the hopes of preserving the local culture, and of giving people a place to enjoy a life of freedom and ease. The roof beams overhead, the pebble-inlaid flooring underfoot, and the red brick wall all preserve the traces of history. More than a hundred years ago, during the era of Japanese occupation, the Japanese came to Tainan to implement plans for urban renewal and tore down many old city walls and buildings. The workers from the local harbors collected these bricks dating back to the era of Dutch occupation and the Ming and Qing dynasties, using them to build their own houses.Deep conversations with an old soulThis is a house that spans three centuries, as well as James’s old family home. Over forty years ago, James’s father bought this old house to provide his parents with a place to enjoy their golden years in peace. However, his parents later moved elsewhere, after which time this old house sat vacant for over twenty years. It wasn’t until 2011 that James decided to return to live in Tainan, with the belief that, “The true value of Tainan is to be found in these old laneways, these old houses, and this culture.” Thus he set about rebuilding the old building into a guesthouse with the intention of sharing memories and stories of the past with his travelling guests. Illuminated by the warm sunshine, travelers climb the steep wooden steps, arriving at the “Ballast Room” which is decorated with collected items from James’s travels through Europe when he was a young man. “This house is like a centenarian, it actually has a soul!” Continuing on, James invites you to walk barefoot upon the wooden floorboards, which sing their creaky song with every step you take.As you climb even higher, you reach the top-floor sleeping quarters. On a peaceful afternoon, you recline on the old sofa lost in thought, and looking out across the sloping open balcony which has no enclosing walls, you see all the neighboring rooftop balconies. Turning around, you notice that behind you there is another sliding door which connects to the “Matsu Room” in the attic. Looking out from the small hatch-like window, you feel like a child again, hiding in a small corner and peering out at the scenery of the laneways below. In the tranquility of night, you close your eyes, the gentle smell of rushes accompanies you as you drift into dreams of olden days.Still, the story of an old city continuesIn the morning, with Sai Kau Kin Old House as your starting point, you begin to walk along Xinyi Street. This place is different than other cities - there are no high-rise apartment buildings, only short old single-story houses one after another. These gifts that time and history have left to the city reveal the culture and enchanting atmosphere of which the people of Tainan are so proud.Xinyi Street lies between the Matsu Building and the Jifu Temple, and so receives the protection of these two great deities. It is the kind of precious land found in legends, and the place where James was born. After growing up, he backpacked around Europe and Asia, travelling to Germany, Singapore, Hong Kong, and China, even experiencing the fall of the Berlin Wall, the Tiananmen Square incident and other significant historical events, all of which nourished him to become who he is today. Afterwards, he attended advanced courses at Tokyo College of Photography. After returning to Taiwan James and his wife first decided to return to Tainan to establish their own photography studio. After striving for more than twenty years, they happened to encounter the Foundation of Historic City Conservation and Regeneration. Deeply moved by their philosophy, it was after this time that James began to operate his guesthouse and put down roots in the local culture.Beyond the operation of his guesthouse, James also devotes his efforts to putting on all kinds of different activities pertaining to arts and culture, establishing Sai Kau Kin Old House as an arts and culture space to increase interaction and exchange within the community. Check-in to Sai Kau Kin, sip a cup of tea, savour the slow passage of time, and look forward to the memories written down by each and every traveler who comes by to visit.

stays.name: 帕鉑文旅
stays.description: 帕鉑文旅：一首會呼吸的城市詩我們生於這片土地，長於這座城市。創辦人在台南求學、創業，從不起眼的巷弄裡汲取靈感，從歷史斑駁的城牆中學會謙卑。於是，我們帶著感恩與勇氣，回到夢開始的地方，用旅宿的形式，向台南說一句：「我們回來了。」不只是旅店，是一種台南的生活方式帕鉑文旅，外表是旅店，靈魂卻更接近一本「會呼吸的詩集」。我們用設計，跟老建築對話；用服務，把人情溫度遞到旅人手中；用故事，把城市的記憶編織進你的旅程。在這裡，你不是過客，而是這座古城的臨時鄰居。或許一個轉角，就是熟悉的騎樓香味；或許早餐桌上，端來的不只是食物，還有老台南人最驕傲的「生活的節奏」。立足府城，心懷遠方我們深信，熱愛會讓地方被看見，會讓故事被記住。帕鉑文旅選擇扎根台南，不是因為浪漫，而是因為我們知道——當一座城市的靈魂被妥善保存，它就能自信地走向世界。所以，我們想讓旅人感受到的不只是「停留」，而是一場「與台南心跳共振」的體驗。一點幽默，因為旅行本就該輕鬆別擔心，我們不是考古館，也不是圖書館。我們會很認真地幫你鋪床，但也可能在你轉身時偷偷在床頭留張小卡片，提醒你「別忘了多看一眼今晚的星星」；我們能帶你感受百年文化，但更希望你能笑著說：「原來這樣的台南，我第一次遇見。」帕鉑文旅：立足府城，心懷遠方。期待與你相遇，在傳統與創新之間，寫下屬於你的下一段美好。
stays.descriptionEn: PAPO’A LABS: A Breathing Poem of the CityWe were born on this land, raised in this city.Our founder studied and started his first venture in Tainan—drawing inspiration from humble alleyways and learning humility from weathered city walls. With gratitude and courage, we have returned to the place where the dream began. Through the form of hospitality, we say to Tainan: “We are home.”More Than a Hotel—A Way of Living in TainanPAPO’A LABS may look like just a hotel, but its soul is closer to a “breathing anthology of poetry.”Through design, we converse with old buildings; through service, we pass along the warmth of human connection; through stories, we weave the memory of the city into your journey.Here, you are not a passerby, but a temporary neighbor of this ancient city. Perhaps around a corner, you’ll encounter the familiar fragrance beneath the arcades; perhaps at the breakfast table, you’ll be served not only food, but also the proud rhythm of life that belongs to old Tainan.Rooted in Tainan, With a Heart Set on the WorldWe believe that passion makes places visible, and stories memorable.PAPO’A LABS chose to take root in Tainan not for romance, but because we know—when the soul of a city is preserved with care, it can walk confidently onto the global stage.That is why what we want travelers to feel is not just “a stay,” but an experience of resonating with the heartbeat of Tainan.A Touch of Humor—Because Travel Should Be EasyDon’t worry—we are not an archaeological museum, nor a library.We will make your bed with great care, but we might also slip a little note by your bedside reminding you to “take one more look at tonight’s stars.” We can lead you through centuries of culture, but even more so, we hope you leave with a smile, saying: “I’ve never experienced Tainan quite like this.”PAPO’A LABS: Rooted in Tainan, With a Heart Set on the World.We look forward to meeting you,and writing your next beautiful chapter,between tradition and innovation.

stays.name: 廣發寓所
stays.description: 廣發寓所，我們位於台南市正中心，體驗三步一景點五步一美食的隨性。當回到鬧中取靜的寓所，在寬敞浴缸中沉浸，讓繁雜的思緒隨著水面蕩漾，徹底放鬆一切，感受在異地重新充電的片刻時光。-簡約清水模與寧靜環境的相互輝映，在咖啡廳品嚐義式咖啡與手工甜點的相結合，此刻我們期待與您分享台南時光及認識彼此。-無論您是商務旅行還是休閒度假，我們都期待著為您提供最好的服務，讓您留下美好的回憶。期待您的光臨！-自2025年1月1日起，依法規將不主動於客房內提供一次性備品(包含牙刷、牙膏、梳子、刮鬍刀)
stays.descriptionEn: Guangfa Hotel is located in Tainan, just steps away from local sights and delicious street food. Whether you’re here to explore or take it slowly, you’ll enjoy the local foods out of our place.End of the day, return to a quiet escape from the bustle. Sink into a spacious bathtub, let your thoughts drift, and take a moment to truly relax and recharge.Our minimalist concrete design blends seamlessly with the peaceful surroundings. Enjoy a cup of Italian coffee and handmade desserts in our café—we’d love to share a slice of Tainan with you and get to know you during your stay.Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, we’re here to make your visit a memorable one. We look forward to welcoming you!Please note: Starting January 1, 2025, in accordance with regulations, we will no longer provide single-use amenities (including toothbrushes, toothpaste, combs, and razors) in guest rooms.

stays.name: 微光藝宿
stays.description: 您好！歡迎與「微光藝宿」的親密接觸，藝術的美來自於生活的體驗，請用細膩心思感受，沈浸⋯⋯位於台南市中西區繁華地-金華路三段，每當暮色降臨，原本日間稀少的人群變得熙攘，街道兩旁有名的台南小吃林立，接待著一飽口福的旅人! 同時鄰近台南市美術館一館和二館 ，以及文藝購物商圈藍晒圖和新光三越新天地都僅一公里的路程 ，輕鬆漫步即可接近藝術、享受美食 !原建築是曾承載五十四年風霜的老屋，主人以不打破原有風貌的方式進行修繕，保留其初始的瓦片木屋頂及樓層格式 ; 將現代燈光與藝術結合，穿透著古老的歷史與文化，在幕逅光影中迎接每一位喜愛台南的旅行者!!!!
stays.descriptionEn: Hello! Welcome to the intimate contact with "Twilight Art Villa." The beauty of art comes from the experience of life. Please feel it with your delicate mind and immerse...The original building has to have over 50 years of history. The owner repaired the building without breaking the original style to keep its original wooden roof and floor format. In addition, it combines modern lighting with art, penetrating ancient history & culture. In the shadow of the curtain, we are welcoming all of the travelers who love Tainan!Located in the Sec. 3, Jinhua Rd., West Central Dist., Tainan City, Taiwan.When dusk falls, the sparse crowds become bustling during the day. There are many famous Tainan snacks on both sides of the street, welcoming travelers with a feast!At the same time, it is close to Tainan City Art Museum 1st and 2nd Hall, the Blueprint Culture & Creative Park and Shin Kong Mitsukoshi. It is only one kilometer away. You can walk to the art and enjoy the food!

stays.description: 碳佐麻里商務旅館駐立於台南市文化古蹟之都，擁有大廳寬敞簡約的設計，輝煌明亮的照明採光，館內裝潢簡約清新，精緻美觀，實惠的住宿品質以及服務人員以客為尊的貼心服務，為的就是讓旅客擁有幸福與感動。提供自行車租借服務及預約機場、科學園區接送給國內外旅客。飯店內並附有特約停車場全館免費光纖高速上網、商務中心提供全新的電腦設備貸給您便捷的服務。無論您前往台南旅遊亦或是出差洽商，碳佐麻里商旅都以平實的價位、超值的服務，為您準備好優質休憩處所，讓您有如同回到家一般的尊榮享受。位於台南市中心著名商圈，步行5分鐘即可海安路藝術街 保安路傳統小吃街 夏林路露天海鮮碳烤街國華友愛中正商圈...3分鐘車程可達;新光三越新天地百貨 孔廟文化園區 赤崁樓文化園區....5分衝車程可達;台南著名花園夜市 安平觀光文化商圈當您台南旅遊住宿於此，將可以就近體驗台南文化，放慢腳步呼吸濃濃的城市風情享受一趟古蹟美食之旅
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Tainan, a city of history and culture, this spacious, simple hotel, with its eye-catching lighting and clean, elegant aesthetic, offers top quality accommodation and customer-centric service. With bicycle rentals available and shuttles able to be booked to the airport or science park, it’s a convenient stay for domestic and international guests alike. The hotel also has its own parking lot, free fiber-optic Internet access, and a business center with all new computers, making your stay even more convenient. Whether you’re coming to Tainan for business or for leisure, Tan Tso Ma Li Commercial Hotel offers top-quality service at affordable prices, making it a home away from home. The hotel is just a five-minute walk from Tainan’s renowned commercial districts, as well as Haian Rd. Art Street, Baoan Rd. Traditional Snack Street, Xialin Rd. Open-air Seafood Barbeque Street, and Guohua Youai Zhongzheng Commercial District;a three-minute drive from Shinkong Mitsukoshi, Confucius Temple Historical Area, and Chikan Cultural Area; and a five-minute drive from Tainan’s well-known Huayuan Night Market and Anping Tourist Culture Commercial District. From here, you can experience all of Tainan’s cultural offerings at your own pace, taking in the rich environment of the city and enjoying a mix of history and cuisine.

stays.description: 位於台南市中西區正興街的「放輕鬆民宿」，以簡約質感的工業風設計，為旅人打造溫暖舒適的居住空間。鄰近台南最具人文氣息的熱門景點，無論是散步逛街、品味小吃，或感受老城魅力，這裡都是您的最佳落腳處。我們注重環保理念，不提供牙膏牙刷、刮鬍刀、梳子等一次性盥洗用品，邀請旅人共同守護地球。此外，本民宿全面禁煙，以維持清新的住宿環境。 選擇「放輕鬆民宿」，讓您在歷史與現代交融的台南，享受輕鬆自在的慢旅行時光。
stays.descriptionEn: “Funky Song B&B" located on Zhengxing Street, Central West District, Tainan City, uses a simple and textured industrial style design to create a warm and comfortable living space for travelers. It is close to Tainan's most popular and cultural attractions. Whether you are walking shopping, tasting snacks, or experiencing the charm of the old city, this is your best place to stay. We pay attention to the concept of environmental protection and do not provide toothpaste, toothbrushes, razors, combs and other disposable toiletries, and invite travelers to protect the earth together. In addition, this B&B is completely non-smoking to maintain a fresh accommodation environment. Choose "Funky Song B&B" to enjoy a relaxing slow travel time in Tainan, where history and modernity blend.

stays.name: 日初漫漫
stays.description: 位於臺南市的民宿long_sunrise_日初漫漫歷經了一年的改建日初漫漫終於在我們的雛形裡面誕生，過程裡面有很多的聲音和建議,有人建議砍掉樹加蓋遮雨棚，有人建議加裝鐵捲門以後進出較方便但是反骨的倆夫妻堅持留下日初最原形最漂亮的外觀和可愛的鐵門，更留下連鄰居都覺得不可思議的兩顆大樹和奶奶的茉莉花，尤其是那滿屋熏香的桂花我們的理念是改建是為了讓房子呼吸接受更多的陽光和空氣，讓房子自然呼吸室内的空間為了讓人居住得更舒適自由，我們選擇改建將陳舊的衛浴設備全面重建，讓居住在裡面的人生活更有品質改建的過程裡面，我們察覺使用了50幾年的英式老家具居然歷久彌新如此迷人，當時的卡榫製作，加上美麗的實木經過歲月的洗禮更發的韻味留存，夫妻倆決定留下珍貴的英式老家具考慮到新生代的女兒，所以特別用融合的方式來表現，就像剛柔並濟一樣必須表現得恰如其分日初漫漫就這樣誕生了保留了庭院的桂花和紅丹樹風飄進來房子呼吸了滿屋的桂花香，桂花落院日初漫漫新的一年日初漫漫開始全新的旅程
stays.descriptionEn: B&Bs in Tainan Citylong_Sunrise_ located in Tainan CityAfter a year of renovation, long_Sunrise was finally born in our prototype. During the process, there were many voices and suggestions. Some suggested cutting down the trees and building a canopy, while others suggested installing iron rolling doors to make it easier to enter and exit.But the rebellious couple insisted on leaving behind the original and most beautiful appearance and the lovely iron gate. They also left behind the two big trees that even the neighbors found incredible, and grandma's jasmine flowers, especially the fragrant osmanthus flowers that filled the house.Our philosophy is that the renovation is to allow the house to breathe and receive more sunlight and air, allowing the house to breathe naturally.In order to make the indoor space more comfortable and free for people to live in, we chose to completely rebuild the old bathroom equipment, so that the people living there can have a better quality of life.During the renovation process, we found that the old British furniture that had been used for more than 50 years was still so charming. The use of the lattice work at that time and the beautiful solid wood retained its charm after the baptism of time. The couple decided to stay. Precious old British furnitureConsidering the daughter of the new generation, I specially used a fusion method to express it, just like the combination of hardness and softness, it must be expressed appropriately.This is how long_Sunrise was born.The osmanthus and red osmanthus trees in the courtyard were preserved. The wind drifted into the house and breathed in the fragrance of osmanthus that filled the house. The osmanthus fell in the courtyard.The beginning of the day is longAt the beginning of the new year, a new journey begins

stays.description: 「日安蝸牛」是一棟超過60年的透天厝，只有2層樓、3間房，經過重新整修後，以舒適優雅的風格為主軸，改造成為包棟入住的民宿，小巧精緻的隱身在市區的巷弄中。每次只接待一組客人入住，旅客們可以在完全獨立的空間中，輕鬆自在的感受台南在地生活，「日安蝸牛」位於台南市中西區，是台南市最早開發的區域，以古蹟眾多、人文歷史豐富、新舊混雜的景觀為特色，附近有河樂廣場、神農街、正興街、海安商圈、中正商圈，騎車或開車15分鐘內可抵達赤崁樓、孔廟文化園區、林百貨、藍晒圖文創園區、安平老街、四草生態保護區⋯等，民宿附近更是美食聚集的熱點。無論是市區觀光覓食、逛逛古蹟景點或只是漫無目的閒晃，享受台南的巷弄風情，「日安蝸牛」絕佳的位置，是您台南旅遊時的好選擇！
stays.descriptionEn: BONJOUR ESCARGOT is a townhouse over 60 years old with only 2 floors and 3 rooms. After renovation, it was transformed into a private B&B with a comfortable and elegant style. It is small and exquisitely hidden in the alleys of the city.Only one group of guests is accepted each time, and travelers can experience the local life of Tainan in a completely independent space.BONJOUR ESCARGOT is located in the West Central District of Tainan City, which is the earliest developed area in Tainan City. It is characterized by numerous historical sites, rich cultural history, and a mixture of old and new landscapes. Nearby are Hele Plaza, Shennong Street, Zhengxing Street, Hai'an Business District, and Zhongzheng Business District. It takes only 15 minutes by bike or car to reach Chihkan Tower, Confucius Temple Cultural Park, Hayashi Department Store, Blue Print Cultural and Creative Park, Anping Old Street, Sicao Ecological Reserve, etc. The area near the B&B is also a hot spot for food gathering. Whether you are sightseeing in the city, looking for food, visiting historical sites or just wandering aimlessly and enjoying the alleyways of Tainan, the perfect location of "Good Day Snail" is a good choice for your trip to Tainan!

stays.searchText: 日安蝸牛 日安蝸牛 臺南市民宿517號 臺南市 中西區 西寧街6號 「日安蝸牛」是一棟超過60年的透天厝，只有2層樓、3間房，經過重新整修後，以舒適優雅的風格為主軸，改造成為包棟入住的民宿，小巧精緻的隱身在市區的巷弄中。每次只接待一組客人入住，旅客們可以在完全獨立的空間中，輕鬆自在的感受台南在地生活，「日安蝸牛」位於台南市中西區，是台南市最早開發的區域，以古蹟眾多、人文歷史豐富、新舊混雜的景觀為特色，附近有河樂廣場、神農街、正興街、海安商圈、中正商圈，騎車或開車15分鐘內可抵達赤崁樓、孔廟文化園區、林百貨、藍晒圖文創園區、安平老街、四草生態保護區⋯等，民宿附近更是美食聚集的熱點。無論是市區觀光覓食、逛逛古蹟景點或只是漫無目的閒晃，享受台南的巷弄風情，「日安蝸牛」絕佳的位置，是您台南旅遊時的好選擇！

stays.name: 星象商旅
stays.description: 穿梭於台南府城的街弄巷道，享受古蹟文物的風情洗禮，下個彎，您將發現一個新園地～台南古都的文化、美食旅遊，漫遊於規劃完速的行人步道或自行車道上，享受微風吹徐、落日餘暉的自然景致，走進各式古蹟文物中體會歲月的痕跡，盡情徜徐美景與時光的流逝中，享受全然舒適、放鬆的心靈饗宴；再來個府城美食體驗，蝦捲、蝦餅、豆花等安平美食，獲得生理上的大大滿足…座落台南市區內的「台南星象商旅」，處於四通八達、交通便利之地理位置上，前往各大景點都非常方便哦！以現代簡約的設計風格，打造出舒服、整潔、溫馨的全方位的住宿旅館，提供外出旅客的舒適住宿空間、商務出差人士各項商旅需求，從小空間到房間內的每個環境，都經過精心的設計與準備，讓您在此可以洗滌一整天的疲憊，徹底舒緩情緒、放鬆壓力，享受心靈沉澱的住宿休憩空間。與一早的陽光來個甜蜜約會，飽餐後再騎著自行車暢遊府城，享受古城中的無限魅力！！
stays.descriptionEn: Wander through the roads and alleys in Tainan, the ancient capital city of Taiwan. Immerse in the splendor reflected by the historic relics and monuments A brand new world awaits you at the next turn - In Tainan, the ancient capital city of Taiwan, you can go on a tour of culture and delicacies and roam the well planned walking trails or bike paths Enjoy the gentle breeze and let it lead you into the traces of history surrounded by historic relics and artifacts. Lost in the picturesque scenery and the passing of time and savor a mind banquet of total relief and relaxation. Peace of mind should be followed by an experience of Anping delicacies, such as shrimp roll, shrimp patty and bean curd pudding, for the bodily satisfaction...""Bean Curd Pudding"" sits on a geographic location boasting a well connected and easily accessible transportation owing to its wonderful position inside Tainan City downtown. This allow guests to travel to major scenic spots with ease! The design style of modern simplicity create an all-around hotel of comfort, cleanness and friendliness Such comfortable accommodation space meets the needs of every traveler on vacation or on business away from home From the smallest space to the entire room, the hotel is designed and prepared with the utmost care Guests will be able to recover from their exhaustion, tension and pressureand enjoy an accommodation and resting space of mind equilibrium. Wireless network is provided in all rooms for you to access information and share your thoughts at any time. Our business center also provides other services, including internet access, fax and copying. Chines and Western breakfast buffet is served with well-cooked seasonal cuisines. From the sweet date with the early morning sunshine to the bike tour of the wonderful old town the infinite attractiveness of Tainan is yours to discover!

stays.name: 暖時嚼旅
stays.description: 台南SOMER(夏天英文Summer的古字)的日頭，暖而不烈。一份承自南國陽光的熱情，老靈魂展現出全新的建築風貌；一份熟悉又歡愉的兒時回憶，開展出暖時出發的動人旅程。承自南國陽光的熱情，全新的建築，記憶裡的溫暖時刻，全都蘊含在暖時呈現給你的動人體驗。 「一種米，養百種人生。」從米街開始，SOMER要帶給你，無限的熱情、聽不完的府城故事，從中找到旅程出發的線索!「一種美，走出百種旅程。」回到SOMER，貼心舒適的旅宿，讓你細數一日走來，那不忍離開的精彩畫面，無可取代你的專屬旅途。
stays.descriptionEn: The sun on Tainan SOMER (the ancient English word for "Summer") is warm and gentle.Inspired by the passion and hospitality of the South, the new architectural style is reminiscent of its old soul.It is a trip down memory lane; an inspiring journey starting from Somer. “One kind of rice feeds hundred kinds of life.“It all begins with Rice Street. SOMER will feed your enthusiasm to explore the stories of the Fucheng Castle Town, from which to find clues to your own journey!"Hundreds of journeys can stem from one beautiful source". SOMER is a thoughtful and comfortable home away from home.After a few days' stay, it will be hard to move on from this breathtaking, unique part of your journey.

stays.name: 木木家
stays.description: 經營理念｜生活可以慢，空間也該有記憶我們相信，住宿不只是睡一晚的地方，而是一段與城市連結的開始。弄時光為熱愛台南生活的人所打造，保留巷弄的靜謐感，同時融入現代簡約與自然風格的設計，讓每位旅人都能在這裡真正「住進台南」，感受生活的溫度與時間的流動。我們珍惜土地、尊重文化、在乎每一次相遇，也希望來到這裡的你，不只是過客，而是另一位寫下弄時光故事的人。特色亮點 • 歷史共居：與延平郡王祠比鄰而居，三分鐘即達古蹟現場。清晨可聽鐘聲、午後可散步在祠園綠蔭中，沉浸於鄭成功精神與府城文化。 • 靜謐地點，鬧中取靜：藏身小巷，遠離喧囂，但步行即可抵達孔廟、赤崁樓、國華街，吃喝玩樂與歷史風景兼得。 • 簡約暖系設計：白色建築、木質調與植物點綴的空間，搭配自然採光，讓身心一起鬆下來。 • 在地體驗推薦：我們熱愛分享，也樂於推薦你台南最不觀光、卻最道地的在地小店與秘密角落。⸻我們相信，旅行不是一場奔波，而是一次心靈的慢舞。來弄時光，讓時間變柔軟，讓記憶在老巷裡悄悄生根。
stays.descriptionEn: Property DeionAlley of Time – Stay in the heart of Tainan’s quiet charmTucked away in a peaceful alley beside the historic Koxinga Shrine, Alley of Time offers a warm, minimalist retreat in the center of Tainan. Designed with white walls, wooden textures, and lush greenery, our space is a blend of simplicity and soul—perfect for travelers who want to slow down and truly live the city.Within walking distance of Chihkan Tower, the Confucius Temple, and Guohua Street, you’ll enjoy both cultural landmarks and local eats just steps away—while still enjoying the calm and quiet of our hidden corner.Whether you& #39;re here for the history, the food, or a moment of stillness, Alley of Time invites you to make memories in the flow of Tainan’s gentle rhythm.? Key Features?️ Next to Koxinga Shrine – 3-minute walk to the historic site and tranquil garden paths? Quiet alley location – Peaceful stay just minutes from city landmarks? Warm minimalist design – White walls, wooden accents, natural light?️ Local tips from hosts – Hidden gems and local shops off the tourist path? Walkable to everything – 10 mins to Chihkan Tower, Confucius Temple, Guohua Street

stays.name: 梧藏民宿
stays.description: 歡迎你們來到「梧藏 美萊茵旅宿」一起感受台南精品老宅的風華年代。平實、溫潤、卻又絢爛流光的世代特斯拉充電樁「梧藏美萊茵」專屬車庫3～4輛包棟一天只接受一組客人免費:WiFi/停車區/飛鏢機/麻將區/雀巢咖啡膠曩機(米其林官方指定)廚房/輕食吧台區/牙刷/牙膏...義大利沐浴乳/洗髮精.近河樂公園/神農/康樂/海安/國華/正興/水仙宮房源空間透天包棟。一天只接一組客人★圖片中看到的都是你們可使用的範圍，歡迎入住★【入住須知】1）抵達民宿前30分鐘，請先聯繫小管家為您開門。2）如因故延遲抵達，請事先聯繫小管家並告知預計抵達時間，晚上10:00後（視當日狀況）將有可能採遠端視訊開門入住。 《房間保留至晚上10:00整，逾時無事先通知且無法聯絡訂房者，將取消訂房，恕不退訂或延期》3）當天現場入住者只收現金，恕無法刷卡。4）室內皆禁止吸菸，2F嚴禁吸菸及飲食，房間均設有煙霧探測器裝置。5）入住當日請攜帶身份證明文件（身份證/護照/駕照/健保卡）以便資料登記。6）本館不提供早餐，可自備材料於廚房自行烹煮。備有米其林官方指定"雀巢膠曩咖啡機"供客人午茶 或 早餐享用7）房間需爬樓梯，為保有老舊建築部份樣貌，保留閣樓木樓梯，若有長者及孩童，訂房前請務必斟酌再下單。╭ーーーーーーーーーーー★入住時間：下午3:00後★退房時間：上午11:00前★停車場：可停4部車(退房後最慢上午11:30前駛離，以便下組客人停放)★管家電話：0973861818 Poppy★ Line ID：0973861818╰ーーーーーーーーーーー房型渡·2人(單人床x2床)森·2-4人(雙主床)+雙人沙發床雲·4-7人(雙主床X2床)+單人日式記憶墊X3床川·2-3人(雙住床)+單人沙發床房間由管家安排,若有特殊要求,訂房前請提前告知10人以上才會安排沙發床組及日式記憶床墊~~~訂房時即表示同意遵守入住需知，如無法配合請勿下訂隱藏房客使用權限一天只接一組客人其他注意事項1）抵達民宿前30分鐘，請先聯繫小管家為您開門。2）如因故延遲抵達，請事先聯繫小管家並告知預計抵達時間，晚上10:00後（視當日狀況）將有可能採遠端視訊開門入住。 《房間保留至晚上10:00整，逾時無事先通知且無法聯絡訂房者，將取消訂房，恕不退訂或延期》3）當天現場入住者只收現金，恕無法刷卡。4）室內皆禁止吸菸，2F嚴禁吸菸及飲食，房間均設有煙霧探測器裝置。5）入住當日請攜帶身份證明文件（身份證/護照/駕照/健保卡）以便資料登記。6）本館不提供早餐，可自備材料於廚房自行烹煮。備有米其林官方指定"雀巢膠曩咖啡機"供客人午茶 或 早餐享用7）房間需爬樓梯，為保有老舊建築部份樣貌，保留閣樓木樓梯，若有長者及孩童，訂房前請務必斟酌再下單。╭ーーーーーーーーーーー★入住時間：下午3:00後★退房時間：上午11:00前★停車場：可停4部車(退房後最慢上午11:30前駛離，以便下組客人停放)★管家電話：0973861818 Poppy★ Line ID：0973861818╰ーーーーーーーーーーー房型定價渡·2人(單人床x2床)森·2-4人(雙主床)+雙人沙發床雲·4-7人(雙主床X2床)+單人日式記憶墊X3床川·2-3人(雙住床)+單人沙發床房間由管家安排,若有特殊要求,訂房前請提前告知10人以上才會安排沙發床組及日式記憶床墊~~~訂房時即表示同意遵守入住需知，如無法配合請勿下訂房客使用權限一天只接一組客人其他注意事項【注意事項】1）室內全面禁煙，違規者嚴辦；吸煙區設置於本棟一樓前門、後門外。2）本館不得攜帶寵物；導盲犬及助聽犬不在此限，訂房時需事先告知。《未告知而強行攜帶寵物進入館內視為違規，需支付訂房費3倍外加清潔費，並請求離開》3）請勿攜帶危險物品入館（刀子、槍械、易燃物、有毒物品...等）。4）嚴禁派對、聚賭、酗酒，違者將報警處理。5）館內收藏品、寢具、傢飾如遭毁損遺失，除以造價雙倍賠償外，並保留法律追訴權。6）使用廚房烹煮食物請務必注意安全；嚴禁自行攜帶有火源的電爐具及木炭火爐等。7）為維護館內及居住者的安全考量，於館內公共空間區域皆有裝設攝影機。★我們會針對入住人數鋪床，訂房前請報實際入住人數，如果要分床，也請在訂房時先告知，這都會影響我們為你們服務的床數。★房源為透天，有樓梯有年長者、小孩 下單前請列入考慮，請勿因樓梯因素而給努力的我們負評，再次感謝您！●緊急聯繫人：管家Poppy

stays.searchText: 梧藏民宿 梧藏民宿 臺南市民宿474號 臺南市 中西區 民權路三段197號 歡迎你們來到「梧藏 美萊茵旅宿」一起感受台南精品老宅的風華年代。平實、溫潤、卻又絢爛流光的世代特斯拉充電樁「梧藏美萊茵」專屬車庫3～4輛包棟一天只接受一組客人免費:WiFi/停車區/飛鏢機/麻將區/雀巢咖啡膠曩機(米其林官方指定)廚房/輕食吧台區/牙刷/牙膏...義大利沐浴乳/洗髮精.近河樂公園/神農/康樂/海安/國華/正興/水仙宮房源空間透天包棟。一天只接一組客人★圖片中看到的都是你們可使用的範圍，歡迎入住★【入住須知】1）抵達民宿前30分鐘，請先聯繫小管家為您開門。2）如因故延遲抵達，請事先聯繫小管家並告知預計抵達時間，晚上10:00後（視當日狀況）將有可能採遠端視訊開門入住。 《房間保留至晚上10:00整，逾時無事先通知且無法聯絡訂房者，將取消訂房，恕不退訂或延期》3）當天現場入住者只收現金，恕無法刷卡。4）室內皆禁止吸菸，2F嚴禁吸菸及飲食，房間均設有煙霧探測器裝置。5）入住當日請攜帶身份證明文件（身份證/護照/駕照/健保卡）以便資料登記。6）本館不提供早餐，可自備材料於廚房自行烹煮。備有米其林官方指定"雀巢膠曩咖啡機"供客人午茶 或 早餐享用7）房間需爬樓梯，為保有老舊建築部份樣貌，保留閣樓木樓梯，若有長者及孩童，訂房前請務必斟酌再下單。╭ーーーーーーーーーーー★入住時間：下午3:00後★退房時間：上午11:00前★停車場：可停4部車(退房後最慢上午11:30前駛離，以便下組客人停放)★管家電話：0973861818 Poppy★ Line ID：0973861818╰ーーーーーーーーーーー房型渡·2人(單人床x2床)森·2-4人(雙主床)+雙人沙發床雲·4-7人(雙主床X2床)+單人日式記憶墊X3床川·2-3人(雙住床)+單人沙發床房間由管家安排,若有特殊要求,訂房前請提前告知10人以上才會安排沙發床組及日式記憶床墊~~~訂房時即表示同意遵守入住需知，如無法配合請勿下訂隱藏房客使用權限一天只接一組客人其他注意事項1）抵達民宿前30分鐘，請先聯繫小管家為您開門。2）如因故延遲抵達，請事先聯繫小管家並告知預計抵達時間，晚上10:00後（視當日狀況）將有可能採遠端視訊開門入住。 《房間保留至晚上10:00整，逾時無事先通知且無法聯絡訂房者，將取消訂房，恕不退訂或延期》3）當天現場入住者只收現金，恕無法刷卡。4）室內皆禁止吸菸，2F嚴禁吸菸及飲食，房間均設有煙霧探測器裝置。5）入住當日請攜帶身份證明文件（身份證/護照/駕照/健保卡）以便資料登記。6）本館不提供早餐，可自備材料於廚房自行烹煮。備有米其林官方指定"雀巢膠曩咖啡機"供客人午茶 或 早餐享用7）房間需爬樓梯，為保有老舊建築部份樣貌，保留閣樓木樓梯，若有長者及孩童，訂房前請務必斟酌再下單。╭ーーーーーーーーーーー★入住時間：下午3:00後★退房時間：上午11:00前★停車場：可停4部車(退房後最慢上午11:30前駛離，以便下組客人停放)★管家電話：0973861818 Poppy★ Line ID：0973861818╰ーーーーーーーーーーー房型定價渡·2人(單人床x2床)森·2-4人(雙主床)+雙人沙發床雲·4-7人(雙主床X2床)+單人日式記憶墊X3床川·2-3人(雙住床)+單人沙發床房間由管家安排,若有特殊要求,訂房前請提前告知10人以上才會安排沙發床組及日式記憶床墊~~~訂房時即表示同意遵守入住需知，如無法配合請勿下訂房客使用權限一天只接一組客人其他注意事項【注意事項】1）室內全面禁煙，違規者嚴辦；吸煙區設置於本棟一樓前門、後門外。2）本館不得攜帶寵物；導盲犬及助聽犬不在此限，訂房時需事先告知。《未告知而強行攜帶寵物進入館內視為違規，需支付訂房費3倍外加清潔費，並請求離開》3）請勿攜帶危險物品入館（刀子、槍械、易燃物、有毒物品...等）。4）嚴禁派對、聚賭、酗酒，違者將報警處理。5）館內收藏品、寢具、傢飾如遭毁損遺失，除以造價雙倍賠償外，並保留法律追訴權。6）使用廚房烹煮食物請務必注意安全；嚴禁自行攜帶有火源的電爐具及木炭火爐等。7）為維護館內及居住者的安全考量，於館內公共空間區域皆有裝設攝影機。★我們會針對入住人數鋪床，訂房前請報實際入住人數，如果要分床，也請在訂房時先告知，這都會影響我們為你們服務的床數。★房源為透天，有樓梯有年長者、小孩 下單前請列入考慮，請勿因樓梯因素而給努力的我們負評，再次感謝您！●緊急聯繫人：管家Poppy

stays.name: 榮興金鬱金香酒店
stays.description: 禾寮港碑靜默於街角，寂靜訴說歷史的烽火扁舟；360年前鄭成功部隊登陸循此收復了台灣；360年後，法國羅浮宮酒店集團旗下荷蘭品牌連鎖酒店金鬱金香，落腳於此碑旁，是此，榮興金鬱金香酒店Golden Tulip RS Boutique Hotel – Tainan.TW以台南旅遊之鑰自居，質樸文藝風華、歐式美學再現；360度蒂芬妮玻璃穹頂大堂、庫肯霍夫餐酒館、皇家禮賓廳、葛洛莉魔法空間，以及47間各式歐風客房，猶如達文西遇上JK羅琳，藝術與趣味兼具。赤崁樓、武廟、天后宮，慢遊古蹟的起點；百貨、商場、傳統市集的中心點；Tainan Travel Key ，榮興金鬱金香酒店Golden Tulip RS Boutique Hotel – Tainan.TW以臺南旅遊必遊景點為期許。
stays.descriptionEn: The Heliaogang stone tablet sits quietly at the street corner, telling of war and the past. Koxinga landed here with his troops 360 years ago and reclaimed Taiwan. The Golden Tulip RS Boutique Hotel – Tainan, part of the Louvre Hotels Group, opened here 360 years later, aiming to be the key to Tainan travel. With unadorned Renaissance style, the hotel exudes European aesthetics. It has a 360-degree Tiffany glass dome lobby, Keukenhof de Bistro, Glory Magic, Royal VIP Room, and 47 European style guestrooms. It feels like the meeting of da Vinci and JK Rowling, artistic and interesting.The hotel is your starting point for exploring historic sites such as Chikan Tower, God of War Temple, and Tianhou Temple. It is surrounded by department stores, shopping malls, and traditional markets. A key to Tainan travel, Golden Tulip RS Boutique Hotel – Tainan is a must-visit attraction in Tainan.

stays.name: 民國58年-花好月圓
stays.description: 「民國58年 - 花好月圓」位於中西區永福國小對面的巷弄之中,該巷弄也是台南已故文學家葉石濤的筆下的「蝸牛巷」。葉石濤的故居也在此巷之中。「民國58年 - 花好月圓」是五十年前建成的老透天,擁有磨石子地板和彩色鵝卵石浴缸。我們把老房子活化,每個房間都有其特色,希望來台南旅遊的您,挑選一間屬於自己的房間,感受「這個適合人們做夢、幹活、戀愛、結婚,悠然過日子的好地方」。透天位處台南市市中心,步行可到達火車站、孔廟商圈、赤崁樓、吳園、林百貨和渡小月擔仔麵等必去景點。 附近有公車站和T-Bike (公共自行車租借站),方便往安平老街和觀夕平台等景點觀光。巷口可停泊多部機車,附近亦有汽車停車場,透過我們還可以在火車站附近的指定的機車出租行獲得租機車優惠。 葉石濤的文章「往事如雲」中寫道:「在這蝸牛巷的巷頭買了老屋居住,貪的是這巷路位於府城西門町最繁華熱鬧的宮古座戲院後頭,是鬧區中幽靜的山谷的關係。」我們邀請您一起在「民國58年–花好月圓」感受葉老筆下的慢活和悠然。
stays.descriptionEn: "1969-Elixir of Love" is tucked away in a small alley across from Yongfu Elementary School in Tainan's West Central District. This very alley was famously described by the late Tainan literary figure Yeh Shih-tao as "Snail Alley." His former residence still stands within this quiet lane.This townhouse, built over 50 years ago during the 58th year of the Republic era (1969), retains its original terrazzo flooring and a colorful pebble stone bathtub. We have revitalized the old house, giving each room its own character. We hope travelers visiting Tainan will find a room that speaks to them, and experience what Yeh once described as “a place where people can dream, work, fall in love, get married, and live a leisurely life.”Located in the heart of Tainan City, the townhouse is within walking distance of key attractions such as the Tainan Train Station, the Confucius Temple area, Chihkan Tower, Wu Garden, Hayashi Department Store, and the famous Du Hsiao Yueh Dan Zai Noodles. Public bus stops and T-Bike rental stations are also nearby, making it easy to explore further sites like Anping Old Street and Sunset Viewing Platform.Motorbikes can be parked at the alley entrance, and car parks are available nearby. We also offer discounted motorbike rentals from a designated shop near the train station.In his essay Memories Like Clouds, Yeh Shih-tao wrote: “I bought an old house to live in at the head of Snail Alley, drawn by its location—just behind the bustling Miyako Theater in West Gate Town. It’s like a peaceful valley tucked within the lively city.” We invite you to experience the calm and unhurried lifestyle that Yeh so beautifully captured, right here at 1969-Elixir of Love.Let me know if you’d like a more concise version for marketing material or booking platforms.

stays.description: 「民生美宿館」位在台南市人文薈萃的民生綠園旁，圓環四周充滿人文韻味的文學館、美術館、孔廟、林百貨等歷史建築和古蹟。走進每一個轉彎處，都有前人駐足的軌跡和隱藏的小故事，吸引旅人一再來訪。園區附近經過官方與民間共同努力下，空間活化與再造，地方藝術、產業經濟、觀光文化都相映而生；「民生美宿館」幸運地能夠參與在這承載著台南人記憶中時代變遷的老故事、新靈魂，與旅人一起尋探永不退色的臺南魅力。 日治五十年，以「民生綠園」為中心，日本人引進風格多樣的建築，這些富變化的西洋建築風情與東洋建築風格，把台南城市建築的天際線變得很活潑和熱鬧。 園區範圍以圓環為中心，經由放射軸線道路的規劃設計，串連每個圓環，增強彼此的聯結關連。「民生綠園」圓環周遭設置重要的機關廳舍，如台南州廳(現為台灣文學館)、合同廳舍(現為消防史料館)、警察署(現為台南美術館一館)、土地銀行、地方法院(現為司法博物館)、測候所、林百貨……等，這些都在「民生美宿館」步行可達範圍內。 「民生美宿館」是一棟有五十年屋齡的透天厝，屋主經營製造業事業有成，這棟屋子閒置多年之餘想要將其活化再造，因緣際會下民宿經營者租下之後進行改造工程，「民生美宿館」就在雙方共識下因運而生。 「民生美宿館」建築特色為打破傳統透天格局兩側沒有開窗的光線不足缺點，將頂樓打開用玻璃帷幕引入天光，白天室內不須開燈有自然光照亮正下方的樓梯間。整座樓梯更是用鋼構加上彩色強化厚玻組成，更有著新造型主義大師蒙德里安的構圖型式和色彩，用垂直與水平直角的純粹抽象構成，如同大師主張透過直角可以靜觀萬物內部的安寧。這是在建構民生美宿館時希望創造的空間想法與初衷。 「民生美宿館」運用科技物聯網整合設備，做到比星級飯店更貼心的智能門鎖、燈光、冷氣、門窗開關感應設備，雖然館址坪數不大，打造六間套房的用心與投入可見一斑。在軟體部分，「民生美宿館」有著民宿經營團隊十年的經驗，先前所打造的民宿均獲得好客民宿的標章，相信在未來「民生美宿館」定能提供優質的住宿空間給來到台南的旅人，為旅人的旅遊加分也為台南的觀光盡一份心力。

stays.name: 永福97.1
stays.description: 《永福97.1》位於永福路二段97巷內，清朝時期97巷亦叫「益春巷」，乃因益春堂中藥房而得名，走入巷內，益春藥房的老招牌訴說著過往的榮景，走過招牌，映入眼簾的就是97巷1號的老房子，而此街區在臺南文學家葉石濤的作品中，又稱之為「蝸牛巷」，不論如何走逛，都可通往永福路、民生路、中正路、及西門路，在老巷弄裡的每個景物都訴說著屬於自己的一段故事，而老巷弄的美自有它深邃雋永之處，就如同老房子一樣，而我們盡心守護著老房子，花費將近二年的時間，一點一滴整修復原，延續它的生命力，因為這裡是那個年代送我們最好的禮物，我們保留了老房子原始的迷人外觀、有趣的格局、老物的元素…等，希望留住過去的記憶，讓旅人在這裡感受到當時的氛圍，老房子的味道、老東西的溫度、老技藝的樸質，都值得細細品味，它散發出獨特的迷人氣息、堆疊著經年累月的痕跡，它的完美姿態，就在於它不完美的優雅，我們希望提供給旅人的是：一個溫暖的空間，讓旅人就像“回到小時侯記憶中的老家”，在這裡找到一些回憶、一些感動、一些溫暖…放慢腳步，靜靜地 感受過生活的單純美好。

stays.name: 湧福驛站
stays.description: 台南｜湧福驛站．台南旅人的活力驛站出了台南火車站的剪票口，豔陽高照的好天氣，是台南的熱情歡迎，在附近車行租了機車，發動引擎，出發！轉入巷口一幢三層的透天厝，滿面的鐵花窗留下時光的腳步，推開木門，這裡就是台南旅人的湧福驛站！為透天老屋留下迷人窗花湧福驛站的兩位主人一個是台北的設計師，另一個則是嘉義的營造商，當初只是因為參加喜宴來到台南，卻意外看中這裡的老房子，於是發揮各自的專長，將老屋翻新，取兩個人名字裡各一個字，成了「湧福驛站」。兩間透天厝皆保留了舊時的磚牆和鐵花窗，一走進大廳，舊式中藥櫃、老電視，全是主人的收藏，帶領旅人感受舊時光；在大福館，沿著復古的紅色樓梯把手上樓，還能看見廊道旁特意留下的舊式鏤花氣窗，而別館的樓梯板更漆上繽紛的色彩，將新風貌注入老房子中。在這充滿創意夢想的老房子，記憶與活力共存著，禪淨房裡舊時的木框窗搖身一變成隔簾，毛玻璃上的花紋仍然清晰，彷彿帶你回到童年的場景；二樓，大帥房窗外搖擺的樹影映在寬敞浴缸，用溫暖的水洗去你的疲憊，讓你享受悠閒，而舒活房的一整面的鐵花窗架，在陽光裡倒映迷人的光影。而在別館內，小清新房則用湖水藍色牆面搭上木框壁櫃；走上階梯來到三樓，抬頭竟是陽光中滿天飛舞的白蝴蝶，坐上小陽台房裡老舊的搖椅，跟著蝴蝶的指引，回憶美好的老時光。木門、榻榻米、老沙發除了透天厝外，轉進公園附近的巷弄，還有兩幢供包棟的木造Villa房，就靜靜地佇立在巷底。Villa 45號內的客廳擺入兩張復古沙發，一旁高起的起居空間留給你們坐著歇腳，熟悉而復古的磨石子地板，為雙腳帶來清涼的感受；走上階梯，二樓斜屋頂底下，一整片的榻榻米通鋪，在日光裡曬得暖烘烘的，充滿陽光的氣味，躺在潔白的床被上頭，好像也嗅見生活的美好氣息。
stays.descriptionEn: Tainan｜Chung Fu Inn Invigoration relay station for Tainan visitorsNo sooner do you leave the Tainan Train Station than the warm southern sun welcomes you. Rent a scooter at a nearby dealership, turn the ignition and set off! Turning into the lane, you see a three-story townhouse with ornate iron window grates, vestiges of former times. You push the wooden doors and enter Tainan’s Chung Fu Inn!Preserving the enchanting iron window grates of a townhouseChung Fu Inn is co-owned by a designer from Taipei and a building contractor from Jiayi. They were attending a wedding banquet in Tainan when the old local townhouses caught their eye. They went on to apply their respective specialties in refurbishing it and named it Chung Fu Inn, using one character from each of their names.Each of Chung Fu Inn’s two townhouses preserves the original brick walls and ornate iron window grates. Once you enter the lobby, you are greeted by antique Chinese medicine cabinets and an ancient television set, which belong to the owners’ personal collections. As you climb the stairs in the Da Fu building, you see the ornate cement air vents along the top of the hallway walls. The stairwell of the outbuilding has been painted in rich and various colors, giving the old edifice a novel and vivid look.In the Da Fu building, antique wooden frames are reborn as partition screens to divide the interior of the Tranquil Room. In the Shu Huo Room, an entire wall of ornate iron window grates creates charming inverted patterns in the sunlight. Inside the outbuilding, the decor of the little Qing Xin Room incorporates vivid blue wall paint and wood-framed cabinets. Raise your head as you walk up the stairs to the third floor, and you are greeted by an array of fluttering, white butterflies. When you sit in the old rocking chair in Small Balcony Room, the butterflies will guide you in recollections of beautiful bygone times.Wooden doors, tatami mats, antique sofasBeyond the townhouses, you find two wooden single-storey houses as you enter the alley near the park, each of which are rented by one party at a time. The living room of Villa Number 45 is furnished with two retro sofas, and an elevated room to one side offers you a place to sit and rest. Take the steps onto the second floor and find a tatami sleeping area under the slanted roof, where you enjoy the air made warm and fragrant by the sunlight.Across the way sits Villa Number 47, with a similar Japanese layout and decorative elements. The bathtub on the first floor is remarkable, but even more surprising is the polished bar counter at the far end of the living room! After night falls, a cork pops out of a bottle of red wine and glasses are poured one-third full. It’s bottoms up in a toast to friendship!Now this is the passion of Tainan! When it comes to Tainan, the most anticipated part for most people is all the delicious and diverse foods. Chung Fu Inn is assisted in this regard by a varied host of well-known snack vendors. Not only do the owners of Chung Fu Inn offer recommendations for local scenic spots but they are even considerate enough to prepare local refreshments for their guests. The feeling of friendship is richly felt at Chung Fu Inn and leaves an indelible impression of Tainan. Chung Fu Inn won’t be the last stop on your journey, but rather a relay station where you can rest and recharge. Take the cordiality of Tainan with you today as you mount your scooter, turn the key and set off on the next leg of your adventure!

stays.description: 煙波大飯店台南館位於機能完善的市中心精華地段，鄰近藝術人文薈萃的美術園區及古蹟景點等重要文化資產節點，交通便利，散步就能完成一趟舒心旅程。全館除備有專屬商務會員空間，更悉心規畫義式餐酒館「隱糧」，提供入住旅客或一般顧客西餐料理及各式精選酒品，以南方豐厚人情盛宴款待。
stays.descriptionEn: Lakeshore Hotel Tainan is located at the convenient downtown area, neighboring the Tainan Art Museum and some of the most sought-after cultural attractions of the city, all of them within walking distance. To make your stay pleasant and enjoyable, the hotel offers a selection of facilities, such as members-only business clubs and an Italian bistro called SECRET AND SENSES, which serves a wide range of western cuisine and wines to excite the spirit and taste buds. Come and experience with us the true hospitality of Tainan!

stays.name: 珍友愛
stays.description: 珍友愛（台南市民宿編號592）為南美館零距離的景觀包棟民宿，歷經兩年籌備規劃，在友愛街上悄然呈現。 原為地主自地自建的台灣常見街屋型態，在緣份下看見，這對應美二館窗景的美好，團隊透過對外整合資源媒介後，與新產權人取得合作，由珍寓團隊管理經營。 「打開」、「退讓」，是為了珍友愛在空間調整上取得最適的平衡點。 打開，讓風、光、景，甚至是雨進入空間；將自身投放在空間裡，風、光、自然界的日月星辰，與戶外的街景，逛美二館的人們、遛狗散步的在地居民，還有很棒的森山市集…。 退讓，也是讓自身投放在空間使用上最好的方式。退縮房間的規劃，讓出和旅伴增進互動關係的大露臺，同時也是能夠盡情放空獨處的好場域。​ 「珍友愛」是設計師與團隊的共同作品；為了讓旅人擁有不同以往居住感受而呈現的作品。 打開、退讓是一種新關係可能的開始，歡迎用您的方式在這停留體驗，並與我們分享。
stays.descriptionEn: J Youai House(No.592) is a building for entire place rental, which is close to Tainan Art Museum Building 2. The process was planned for two years, and now J Youai House stands silently at Youai street.The building originally looked like a Taiwanese classic townhouse. Team members from June June House met this building and regarded it as their serendipity. Being fascinated at a wonderful view from the art museum, team members start managing J Youai House after combining all of the materials and cooperating with a new ownership.J Youai House achieves a smooth balance of space through open-mindedness and compromise.Open-mindedness allows the wind, light, scenery, and even the rain to enter the space. Immerse ourselves in the space, wind, light, celestial bodies in nature, outdoor streets, people and citizens who wander around the art museum, and the amazing Mori Mountain Market…Compromise is the best way to reflect yourself on the space. We tried to scale down the size of rooms and created a big balcony that can gather people together or enjoy solitude.J Youai House is a collaborative work by the designer and team with the aim of providing travelers with a unique experience. Being open-minded and willing to compromise can lead to the new beginning of a new relationship. We would like to invite you to make yourself at home, enjoy your stay, and share your experience with us.

stays.name: 珍遇珍寓
stays.description: 歡迎提問官方賴: @junejune.house 台南市民宿 570 號~珍遇珍寓⠿ 珍遇珍寓 • 獨棟電梯民宿 ⠿珍寓位於中西區，為市中心蛋黃精華寧靜區，接近孔廟商圈與台南美術館，到市內任何景點都很方便唷！⠿ 空間簡介 ⠿https://junehouse.weebly.com/junejunehouse.html⠿ 預訂提醒 ⠿• (國定)假日/連續假期以包棟為主，平日視房況開放單房散訂。• 包棟服務8人起，最佳居住品質的建議總人數最多12位。• 非寵物友善民宿，恕無法接待毛小孩入住。• 公共區域為大理石地面及房間內部錯層地板設計，建議「12歲以上」旅客入住。*台南是從早吃到晚的美食之都 ，我們不供餐以免佔據您的胃容量。一樓公共空間:陽光的午後，占據著窗邊坐位飲一杯喜愛的飲料，配上喜歡的音樂和書或者網站，是旅途中慢步調的享受。抑或在大圓桌上吃著自己口袋名單蒐集而來的台南美食，也是一大享受。喜歡烹飪的你，附近有五大市場（保安市場、鴨母寮、水仙宮、東市場、友愛市場）享受採買樂趣之後，可以在超大廚房盡情發揮。房型本身有採光良好美麗窗景陽台。房間配備雙人床、獨立洗衣機、49吋電視、冰箱。使用手工訂製床墊並提供無線網路。公共空間和私人房間是分開的。這樣的規劃，是希望私人休息空間不被打擾有最大隱私性。整棟只有5間房間，空間很舒適。入住提醒事項：＊全棟禁煙並禁止攜帶及飼養寵物。＊續住期間不提供清潔服務，且不更換床單、毛巾。
stays.descriptionEn: Questions welcomeOfficial Lai: @junejune.houseTainan City B&B No. 570 ~ Zhen Yu Zhen ApartmentIt is located in the quiet area of ​​egg yolk essence in the urban area. Currently, there are self-construction buildings nearby. The construction period is expected to be 111/2~112/2, which is hereby explained.Please comply with epidemic prevention regulations when bookingTravellers with 3-day home quarantine + 4-day self-prevention can not be accepted.Any violation will be refused admission.*Tainan is the food capital from morning to night, we do not serve meals to avoid occupying your stomach capacity.Public space on the first floor:On a sunny afternoon, taking a seat by the window and drinking a cup of your favorite drink, accompanied by your favorite music, book or website, is a slow-paced enjoyment during the journey.Or eating Tainan delicacies collected from your pocket list at the big round table is also a great enjoyment.If you like to cook, there are five nearby markets (Banbao Market, Duck Mother’s Liao, Narcissus Palace, Dong Market, Youai Market). After enjoying the fun of shopping, you can play in the super large kitchen.The room type itself has a balcony with a beautiful window view that is well lit. The room is equipped with a double bed, a separate washing machine, a 49-inch TV, and a refrigerator. Use hand-made mattresses and Wi-Fi.Public spaces and private rooms are separated.This kind of planning is to hope that the private rest space will not be disturbed and have maximum privacy.There are only 5 rooms in the whole building, so the space is very comfortable.Check-in reminder:＊The whole building is non-smoking and prohibits bringing and keeping pets.＊No cleaning service is provided during the extended stay, and bed linen and towels will not be changed.

stays.name: 田町旅宿
stays.description: 田町、三田，提供4人包棟住宿。很適合小家庭、或是朋友間的小旅行。房子很老、很小，不過超温馨。入住後，徒步就可以走到擁有很多歷史風情的信義街上散散步，在1935年建造的兌悅門前拍張照，藉由旅行去了解一個城市。年輕的時候每天醒來，只想著怎麼賺錢，怎麼讓身邊的人過上更完美的生活，現在，生活步調慢了一點，才真切的感受到，其實生活已經很完美！每一段旅行，都會更認識自己，我們都需要適當的為自己安排一段旅行，無論是直接癈在民宿裡或是吃很多小吃、又或是排很多行程，真的都很舒壓！涼爽的秋天在台南，最享受騎著機車繞遍大街小巷。，我是個地地道道的台南人，超愛台南，要說有什麼特別的地方，需要大家自己來感受。

stays.name: 神悅屋
stays.description: 神悅屋位於台南市中西區，鄰近延平郡王祠、孔廟、台灣文學館、台南美術館1館、台南美術館2館、司法博物館、愛國婦人館等古蹟及歷史景點。民宿附近小吃林立，種類繁多，台南許多的在地美食也可以使旅客享受豐富的美食饗宴。神悅屋離台南火車站步行約10~15分鐘，從延平郡王祠也可搭車到奇美博物館、高鐵、或是安平，交通四通八達，十分便利。神悅屋為親子民宿，非常適合家長帶孩童前來住宿遊玩，房間內皆有溜滑梯設施，民宿內也有其他各式各樣的玩具及玩偶，使孩童充滿童趣及歡樂的回憶。

images.name: 三隻小豬
images.description: 此房型為三隻小豬，四人房。 房間內有1張雙人床、2張單人上下舖，附有兒童溜滑梯設備及玩具。 民宿內提供第四台電視、WIFI無線網路、盥洗用具備品、礦泉水、可可亞包、咖啡包、浴巾等。 房間牆壁上的壁畫主要是以三隻小豬的故事為主題，希望透過卡通彩繪的故事，幫助小朋友認識辛勤勞苦的人，必然會得到甜美的果實。 若是遇到危險，要團結起來一起想辦法，任何困難必能迎刃而解。

stays.description: 「窩廟邊民宿(Temple Side Hostel)」位於臺灣臺南市中西區，建物始建於民國55年間，為三層樓透天厝建築，原為米倉庫，屋內天井頂端還可見到昔日用來運送米糧上下的大鐵鉤。本民宿鄰近三個國定古蹟：「赤崁樓」、「祀典武廟」及「祀典大天后宮」，附近並有許多臺南美食小吃，如蔡三毛豬血湯、碳烤三明治、義豐冬瓜茶、武廟肉圓、台南擔仔麵、棺材板、安平豆花、悅津鹹粥、裕成冰果，以及走路距離的國華街各式小吃等，民宿內並有由達人師傅手繪之台灣傳統民俗活動壁畫，包括八仙過海、宋江陣、跳鼓陣、車鼓陣、犛牛陣、桃花過渡陣等，栩栩如生，搭配文字簡介，讓旅客可以深刻瞭解及感受台灣豐富的民俗文化。 本民宿位於赤嵌文化園區內，位於「赤崁樓」之南、「祀典武廟」旁，緊鄰「馬使爺廳」，鄰近三個國定古蹟，包括華盛頓郵報旅遊版曾特別推薦的「赤崁樓」、由明寧靖王關帝廳改建而成的「祀典武廟」、以及昔明寧靖王府邸的「祀典大天后宮」，整個園區充滿荷蘭、鄭氏、明清兩朝跨時空的歷史軌跡氛圍。 「赤崁樓」乃荷蘭人於西元1652年創建，原稱普羅民遮城，漢人則稱之為「赤崁樓」、「番仔樓」或「紅毛樓」，赤嵌樓可說是臺南中西區內最主要的古蹟建築，歷經300多年的整修改建，內有海神廟、文昌閣及蓬壺書院，外圍草皮上立著國姓爺受降的雕像，最吸引目光的莫過於移自大南門城邊的9塊御碑，由狀似石龜的贔屭所乘載，傳說贔屭為九龍生子之一，生性喜歡負重，也因為贔屭而讓「赤嵌樓」增添不少傳說故事。到了夜間，樓的周邊點起黃色的燈光，讓古味十足的建築增添不少韻味，前方廣場常舉辦音樂會，是許多臺南市民夜晚最愛的去處。 「祀典武廟」主要奉祀關聖帝君，為全台首座關帝廟，係於西元1665年官建，清永曆十九年鄭成功子鄭經於承天府(即今之臺南市)建四大廟，文廟即今日之「孔廟」，武廟即今日之「祀典武廟」。本民宿緊鄰武廟之「馬使爺廳」，馬使爺稱「舍人公」，又稱「馬舍公」，簡稱「馬公」，是關帝的馬伕，感念其殉主的忠心，使其永遠隨侍在主人之側。 「祀典大天后宮」又稱臺南大媽祖廟，原為明寧靖王的府邸，是臺灣最早的祀典媽祖廟。大天后宮為三門四殿兩廊的縱深式建築，後側毗連祀典武廟，右側是供奉觀音佛祖的佛祖廳，陪祀於媽祖左右的千里眼與順風耳，是工藝美術上難得的佳作，論建構氣勢的宏偉，歷史地位的崇高，當非臺南市「祀典大天后宮」莫屬。 本民宿之經營理念是以乾淨、舒適、方便為原則，提供國內外旅客一處可以就近感受與品味臺南歷史與文化的最佳住宿選擇。

stays.name: 築樂窩
stays.description: 每一個人的心中，都有一個長不大的小孩，夢想中的童話故事在現實生活之中，並不容易被實現，於是我們打造一個童話故事家，藉由這個家讓在旅途中的爸爸媽媽還有可愛的寶貝都可以有一個美好回憶。我們座落在台南市中心，鄰近國華友愛商圈，國華街、保安路及海安路上有許多知名的美食老店家，例如：金得春捲、富盛號碗稞、阿村牛肉湯、邱家小捲米粉、六千牛肉湯...等等，都是步行可到的距離。除了知名的國華友愛商圈、海安商圈、保安路小吃、西門新光三越百貨及對面的藍曬圖文創園區、神農老街、孔廟及府中老街、赤崁樓、林百貨、花園夜市...都是鄰近點，相當適合喜歡吃吃喝喝，逛逛台南文化古都的旅客們。距離安平古蹟景點、十鼓文創園區、奇美博物館，開車也只需15-20分鐘，是不是很方便呢?入住時，我們提供免費的美食及景點地圖，期盼入住的旅人們都能有一個美好的旅程回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: In everyone’s heart, there is a child who is not growing up. The fairy tales of dreams are not easy to be realized in real life. So we build a fairy tale home, through this home, let the parents on the journey. There are also lovely babies that can have a good memory. We are located in the center of Tainan, adjacent to the Guohua Youai business district. Guohua Street, Baoan Road and Haian Road have many well-known old gourmet restaurants, such as: Jinde Spring Rolls, Fusheng Hao Wan Barley, A Village Beef Soup, Qiu Home small roll rice noodles, six thousand beef soup... etc. are all within walking distance. In addition to the well-known Guohua Youai Commercial District, Hai'an Commercial District, Baoan Road Snacks, Ximen Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Department Store and the opposite Lanshatu Cultural and Creative Park, Shennong Old Street, Confucian Temple and Fuzhong Old Street, Chihkan Tower, Lin Department Store, Garden Night Market ...They are all close to each other, which is suitable for travelers who like to eat, drink, and visit the ancient cultural capital of Tainan. It only takes 15-20 minutes to drive to Anping historic sites, Ten Drum Cultural and Creative Park, and Chimei Museum. Isn’t it very convenient? When checking in, we provide free food and scenic spots maps. A wonderful journey memory.
