stays.name: 米宿
stays.description: 位於台南市中西區的民宿。「米宿」在赤崁樓隔壁舊稱「米街」的歷史街區-新美街上，鄰近台南三大一級古蹟（赤崁樓 大天后宮 祀典武廟），庶民小吃與府城文化俯拾即是。 我們的米宿保留原有老屋格局氛圍，一次僅接待一組的住宿。 一樓入口進來會是小交誼廳，方便旅人聚餐聊天。 米宿的客房在2樓，我們在2樓空間的配置上，有一間和式的榻榻米客廳，一間配置極舒適的加大雙人床臥房。 過度的浮誇，沒有。 有的僅是些日常的美；而這樣的美，我們希望能讓旅人咀嚼再三。 如果你喜歡的是台南府城的閒逸氛圍，歡迎您來米宿住上一宿， 純真質樸的在地生活，我想，這是最好的體驗方式。 民宿電話：0911-686713（ 民宿LINE：@qji1016i ）/（民宿Facebook：米宿）

stays.name: 米宿館
stays.description: 米宿館位於台南市中西區，靠近美術館，孔廟和台南文學館。 米宿館是我們的第二間民宿，在城隍街、開山路與府前路的交會上。因鄰近台南美術館，所以我們以美術館的台語諧音，取名『米宿館』。 米宿館是屋齡超過50年的小房子，我們添加自己的喜好和風格，把老房子重新復活並且融合現代化。一樓為交誼廳，二樓是客房，我們努力讓它成為一個與各地旅人，分享台南美好日常生活的基地。 一如之前我們對於「米宿」的形容~過度的浮誇，沒有！有的僅是些日常的美；而這樣的美，我們希望能讓旅人咀嚼再三。這個初心，從『米宿』到『米宿館』，從來不變。 如果你喜歡的是台南府城的閒逸氛圍，歡迎你來這兒住上一宿。想去哪玩呢...請與我們聯絡，我們很樂意分享台南人心目中的好所在。我們的電話：0911686713 Line：@qji1016i

stays.name: 紡南
stays.description: 在台南府城的繁華街區，有一處被熙攘掩映的幽靜老宅，名為紡南。這座老宅靜靜地依偎在歷史悠久的五條港文化園區內，與燈火通明、華燈絢爛的神農街為鄰，距離台南的美食寶庫國華街和餐酒館林立的海安路藝術街僅幾步之遙。紡南精心保留著老宅的古韻，每一塊磚瓦與木樑都承載著歲月的記憶。這古宅地理位置絕佳，兼具繁華與寧靜，保留復古老宅美好樣貌，讓您穿越時空，感受現代與歷史的融合，尋找屬於自己的悠閒時光。
stays.descriptionEn: In the bustling block of Tainan Fucheng, there is a quiet old house, named Fangnan, which is hidden by the hustle and bustle. This old house nestles quietly in the historic Wujiaogang Cultural Park, adjacent to Shennong Street with bright lights and gorgeous lanterns, and only a few steps away from Guohua Street, a food treasure house in Tainan, and Haian Road Art Street with restaurants and pubs.Fangnan carefully retains the ancient charm of the old house, and every brick and wooden beam carries the memory of the years. This ancient house has an excellent geographical location, which is both prosperous and quiet. It retains the beautiful appearance of the retro old house, allowing you to travel through time and space, feel the integration of modernity and history, and find your own leisure time.

stays.name: 耶伊親子民宿
stays.description: 耶伊就是讓入住的父母及孩童大喊Yeah!地理位置～位於台南中西區，鄰近五條港園區，步行5分鐘即可達正興街、神農街、海安街，享受漫步在這傳統與新世代結合出來的特殊氛圍。走著走著來到國華街，來場美食饗宴吧！讓你越來越甜美～海安路上有T-bike,騎著鐵馬10分鐘來到處處是古蹟的安平，認識這台灣歷史的起源地～林百貨、赤崁樓、百年廟宇⋯等台南不是三言兩語可以說明，多來幾趟吧！好好認識它，跟它談戀愛吧！屋內設施～1樓為公共空間，有兒童遊戲區及繪本可供孩子閱讀、電鍋可加熱孩童副食品、奶瓶刷及清潔液、奶瓶消毒鍋、醫藥箱、耳溫槍、成人及兒童口罩、酒精噴液、防蚊液、冰箱、冷熱水飲水機、廁所；冰箱內備有牛奶、土司及果醬，為自助式，供旅客食用。每間客房皆有獨立衛浴，依旅客的需求，可提供兒童沐浴用品、澡盆、兒童牙刷牙膏、男孩小便斗、兒童馬桶座。所有房型皆有溜滑梯及不同主題的壁畫，讓你進入童趣世界。使用產品～兒童沐浴用品：台塑生技沐浴乳洗髮乳：台南在地產品古寶無患子咖啡包：台南東山咖啡洗手乳：沙威隆、依必朗洗滌廠商：光潔洗衣（熱水洗滌）

stays.description: 聖旺商旅座落於台南市中心、新光新天地商圈內，全館擁有44間精緻舒適的客房，提供您旅行中一個休憩的居所、出差洽公下班後一個放鬆的環境。前來聖旺的交通非常便利。從聖旺出發，往小西門圓環走大約5分鐘不到的［小西門］公車站牌，方便您前往台南火車站、台南高鐵站、安平。若您想來趟鐵馬悠遊，走路5分鐘左右就有T-bike租借。聖旺不提供早餐，因為附近的小西門圓環、五妃街有許多著名的早餐，諸如鹹粥、牛肉湯、蛋餅...等等。此外，有不少道地小吃的保安路、國華街都是在步行10分鐘可抵達的範圍。快來聖旺享受台南的熱情、文創藝術與街頭風味小吃吧！

stays.description: 艸祭Book inn坐落於台南市中心孔廟對面，是一間以書為主題的背包客棧，我們有大量的藏書及以珍藏老物件改造的生活空間；一個個床位是你的小天地，在一天的探索這城市後，讓你保有享受一個人的獨處時光；走下床，大大的公共空間，可以談天說笑、可以下廚做菜、可以分享你的才藝，也可以靜靜地窩在某個角落沉浸在書海裡，我們鼓勵您用不同的方式結交來自各地的朋友，透過人與人間的交流，感受共處的樂趣。在這，著名景點及知名美食散步皆可到達，交通便利、生活機能佳，歡迎大家一起來探索台南。
stays.descriptionEn: CaoJi Book inn, located across the Confucius Temple in downtown Tainan, is a hostel featured with books. We renovate the living areas with a good many of antiques and the massive book collections. Every sleeping-nook is your own universe- you can enjoy some moments of solitude after exploring the city all day long. Climbing out of your nook, there is a big public area where you can chat and laugh, cook, share talents, or sit in cozy corners and read quietly. We encourage you to make friends from all over the world in every possible way, feeling the fun to be together through interpersonal connection.Well-known tourist attractions and gourmet’s selections are all within walking distance. There is accessible transport in the neighborhood supplied with all you need for a breezy living. Welcome to check in here and explore Tainan.

stays.name: 芷築民宿
stays.description: 歡迎來到我們位於台南市中心鄰近神農老街的旅宿！這間旅宿位於神農老街跟康樂街附近，周邊有文化‧飲食、娛樂和老屋聚集於一體，能讓您能感受到充滿古都府城的魅力!旅宿位於巷弄裡，讓您感受喧囂城市裡唯一的寧靜處；浪漫主義的裝修風格極具現代感，大廳裡面的冰箱跟咖啡茶水都可以隨時使用，如果你想要好好放鬆度假，在這裡就絕對可以棒您做到。 您的房間將有一張加大雙人床和桌椅可擺放私人物品；窗台正對著古都的街景，可以眺望到美麗的城市景；特別是在晚上，您待在房間就可以欣賞到古都的夜景。除此外，套房内設施齊全，有免費Wi-Fi、空調、熱水跟咖啡茶包；浴室乾淨整潔，并配備盥洗用品，也有吹風筒提供，希望能讓正在出門旅遊的您倍感方便。旅宿的附近有好吃的美食跟咖啡店以及著名的神農老街、知名的丹丹漢堡就在附近；亦有各樣的小吃在康樂街國華街選擇無數，讓您一一品嘗道地的台南美食。從旅宿出發，神農老街3分鐘街，海安路5分鐘‧國華街6分鐘‧花園夜市8分鐘；到安平老街15分鐘，到哪都很方便快捷，讓您可以盡情遊覽景點而無需把時間花費在路程中。祝您旅途愉快 ！

stays.descriptionEn: Ying Dai Hotel is located in Tainan, 600 metres from Chihkan Tower. It offers free bicycle rentals and free private parking spaces. The hotel is conveniently located in the West Central District, 1.2 km from Tainan Confucius Temple and 35 km from Neimen Zizhu Temple. The accommodation offers free WiFi and room service.Each room at Ying Dai Hotel has a desk, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, bedding and towels. All rooms have a refrigerator.The front desk staff speaks English and Chinese and can help guests plan their trips.

stays.name: 茲沐丘
stays.description: 茲沐丘民宿(Tsum Chill)發想於台南層疊積累豐厚歷史文化，就像山丘般一層一層堆積成山。茲沐丘民宿位於台南市中西區忠義路，恰好介於歷史底蘊深厚的赤崁樓與充滿現代美學的台南美術館之間。這裡既擁有豐富的歷史文化，又不失現代藝術氛圍，是新舊交融的完美地帶。茲沐丘的空間設計每一層風格鮮明，同時加入現代的舒適感。無論是想探索台南的老街，或是享受當代藝術的洗禮，這裡都是理想的住宿選擇。距離赤崁樓和美術館僅需幾分鐘的步行路程，讓您輕鬆規劃行程，輕鬆感受台南的古今風貌。茲沐丘民宿不僅提供舒適的住宿空間，也希望成為您台南之旅的溫暖驛站。期待您的光臨，讓我們一起發掘台南的獨特魅力！

stays.searchText: 茲沐丘 茲沐丘 臺南市民宿778號 臺南市 中西區 忠義路二段116號 茲沐丘民宿(Tsum Chill)發想於台南層疊積累豐厚歷史文化，就像山丘般一層一層堆積成山。茲沐丘民宿位於台南市中西區忠義路，恰好介於歷史底蘊深厚的赤崁樓與充滿現代美學的台南美術館之間。這裡既擁有豐富的歷史文化，又不失現代藝術氛圍，是新舊交融的完美地帶。茲沐丘的空間設計每一層風格鮮明，同時加入現代的舒適感。無論是想探索台南的老街，或是享受當代藝術的洗禮，這裡都是理想的住宿選擇。距離赤崁樓和美術館僅需幾分鐘的步行路程，讓您輕鬆規劃行程，輕鬆感受台南的古今風貌。茲沐丘民宿不僅提供舒適的住宿空間，也希望成為您台南之旅的溫暖驛站。期待您的光臨，讓我們一起發掘台南的獨特魅力！

stays.name: 覓境
stays.description: 本民宿座落於”台南舊城區民宿”，並為臺南市區中央，近火車站、公車站牌交通便利，是個市區內鬧中取靜民宿。獨棟透天住宅，我們沒有豪華裝潢，但我們有放鬆、悠閒、安靜空間、回到家的感覺，在房間皆可看到台南市吳園藝文中心。近年，臺南的民宿如雨後春筍般快速發展，但大多數集中於安平區，卻也少了民宿該有的風味。臺南民宿以在我看來少了那麼些臺南古蹟特色的味道，有些民宿的裝潢顧不得自己的楚地，做了裡外不和諧的裝修，忘記了家的感覺，忘記了古蹟景觀，忘記了臺南最令人留戀的鬧中取靜的感覺，這也是取名為覓境的原由。臺南身處百貨公司林立的商圈，但巷弄之間卻藏覓這一座古色古香的吳園。

stays.name: 言本舍
stays.description: 60平方米大坪數房間，擁有私人客廳及衛浴，還有戶外空間，美術館訂製藝術家具，台南知名榻榻米名店鋪設，床墊依附榻榻米。這是一棟傳統三進建築,天井、古厝、紅磚與歷史的空間。位於神農街，前望海安藝術大街，緊接國華街與水仙市場，繼續前往正興街文創巷弄，連接台南美術館、文學館、赤崁樓與孔廟等文化古蹟皆在10分鐘路程內。超過10個廟宇與50個半百老店，台灣小吃與文化古蹟一覽無遺。
stays.descriptionEn: The 60-square-meter room has a private living room and bathroom, as well as an outdoor space with custom-made art furniture from the Museum of Fine Arts and a famous Tatami store in Tainan, with a mattress attached to the tatami mats. It is a traditional three-story building with a patio, old houses, red brick and historical space.Located on Shen Nong Street, it looks forward to Haian Art Street, close to Guohua Street and Shui Xian Market, and continues to the cultural and creative alleyways of Zheng Xing Street, connecting to cultural monuments such as the Taiwan Museum of Art, the Museum of Literature, Chikan House and Confucius Temple, all within a 10-minute walk. More than 10 temples and 50 half-century-old stores provide an unparalleled view of Taiwanese snacks and cultural monuments.

stays.name: 赤崁璽樓民宿
stays.description: 民宿證134號「赤崁璽樓民宿 」為東亞皮件富商洪氏故宅，它的歷史最早可追溯至大正時期，現行建築改建於民國34年，花費7年時間、以現代RC（鋼筋水泥）工法建造完成，在台灣早期民間私人住宅中，相當少見。本棟建築的總高4樓半，曾是附近重要地標，相傳為當時台南地區最高的民宅，高度僅次於「林百貨（市定古蹟）」。因它坐落於赤崁樓西邊的巷弄內，早期能直接眺望赤崁樓景色，我們遂以「赤崁小西樓」暱稱它，後將「西」改為發音相似之「璽」字，正式定名為「赤崁璽樓民宿」。如今，關於此樓的說法很多，皆來自街坊鄰居的口耳相傳，或有加油添醋、後人任憑想像附會之處，真實與否，幾乎已不可考，但我們仍被其中的一些故事深深吸引。譬如一個孝子的故事，為了讓裹小腳的母親方便前往鄰近的大舞台（赤崁樓旁），觀賞她最愛的歌仔戲和布袋戲表演，一家人才特地搬遷至此並重新建造這棟房子。或許正因如此，才讓整棟建築在大器之餘，少了份剛硬線條，多了些許女性的柔和元素，造就其獨特韻味。

Hanlin Tea House and Songcun Luwei are at the entrance of the alley. It is a five-minute walk to Yongle Market snack district. Being in it is like being transported back to that simple and warm time. The hotel also provides water dispensers, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, luggage storage, and laundry services.

stays.name: 路境行旅-台南西門館
stays.description: 魔法是一種，你必須要相信它可能存在，才有機會顯現於眼前的事物。不是幻象、不是戲法，是真真切切存在，構築於想像之上、超越現實的事物。曾幾何時，我們能夠想像的樣貌因著現實逐漸減少，卻鮮少有機會拾回。路境行旅-台南西門館便是這樣的，允許我們思想奔放之處。時刻邀請擅於想像的夢遊者，在鏡面反覆映照的綠意中，找回自己曾失落的夢境。
stays.descriptionEn: Magic is something that you have to believe in for it to exist.It is not an illusion or a trick, but a real existence, built on imagination and beyond reality.There was a time when the appearances we could imagine were gradually diminished by reality, but there was rarely a chance to regain them.This is the state of the road, allowing our thoughts to run wild.The mirror invites imaginative dreamers to find their lost dreams in the greenery reflected repeatedly on the mirror.

stays.name: 邑宿
stays.description: 台南民宿「邑宿」位於歷史巷弄的新美街，是荷據時期所建造的第一條縱貫公路，也是台灣南北的 交通要道，周邊古蹟豐富。現在的新美街，原為正義街；更早清代名為帆寮，即曬帆修帆的地方。 常聽老人家說道，才發現原來新美街正是府城最有古蹟味的街區， 想更瞭解台南中西區的歷史跟你可能還不知道的小道內容，來台南民宿「邑宿」， 有位84歲的奶奶會高興的對妳娓娓道來，歡迎大家的到來！交錯著新舊年代的建築，「邑宿」有著日據時代的建築結構。 至今七十年了，還完完整整的伴隨每個角落！ 整間房子都是用檜木做成的，還有著檜木做成的窗戶跟門片；地板磨石的技工更是唯美精湛。 跟台南中西區的林百貨有異曲同工之妙，只要到過「邑宿」的客人都豎起大拇指說讚。 決定要把老屋建築技術與大家來台南旅遊的遊客分享， 我將屋內做了維護裝修讓老房子更能延續它的生命，讓更多的下一代看到歷史的脈動。

stays.description: 民宿以本業油漆供應商作為設計發想,本業為爺爺傳承,房源是爺爺在自己子女還小時買下,希望自己的子女都在臨近,互相照顧及相互照應,在一間將近五十年的房子,而這代的孫女希望將爺爺最單純的關愛帶給來到這的每位旅人. 來到鑏,可以好好享受在台南鬧區中的一處寧靜,簡單的裝潢,帶一點工業風,而因家族本業油漆供應商,在裝潢上多了一點小巧思,但不失家的溫馨感,請來到這裡的旅人盡情地放鬆,起床後,走到巷外就能感受到一天開始的精神來源,水仙宮菜市場每位市場人的熱情招呼,台南精神美食也在附近,在慵懶又悠活的台南生活是讓人那麼感受到快樂,歡迎每位旅人都能來好好享受台南生活,歡迎你們的到來.

Every traveler is welcome to come and enjoy life in Tainan, and welcome your arrival.

stays.description: 開山芳庭民宿位於台南市中心開山路35巷29號，鄰近著名的孔廟文化園區和歷史悠久的府中街，步行即可輕鬆抵達這些地標和其他台南著名景點。開山芳庭民宿完美融合了台南傳統與現代風格，為旅客提供一個獨特且舒適的住宿體驗。民宿特色：設施與設計：民宿內部設計典雅現代，房間裝潢高雅，提供舒適的休憩環境。每個房間都配備先進的設施，包括免治馬桶的衛浴間，並且設有陽台或露台，通透採光。公共空間：民宿擁有舒適的交誼廳，提供一個放鬆與社交的場所，旅客可以在這裡享受輕鬆的時光，結識其他旅行者，或是進行閱讀與休息。服務與便利：提供旅遊諮詢服務、免費Wi-Fi、以及交流台南在地豐富的美食小吃選擇。民宿地理位置優越，附近有多條公共交通路線，方便旅客前往台南市的各個區域。開山芳庭民宿不僅提供舒適的住宿環境，更是探索台南文化與歷史的理想出發點。對於想要感受台南獨特魅力的旅客來說，這裡是絕佳的選擇。

stays.description: 歐洲宮廷式的汽車旅館以全新的風貌與您相見，歐式宮廷造景賞心悅目，羅馬柱外觀及宏偉牌樓，彷彿置身歐洲，享受浪漫的時光，貼心舒適的服務，為您的生活空間多添了一份新意！在喧囂吵嚷的城市中，一座隱身都會叢林的私人秘密花園，在這裡你能以最經濟的價格，享受最頂級的尊客款待，盡情感受彷如置身世界各國風情般的浪漫悠閒，恣意縱情的私密空間，讓您有最安全、最隱密、最乾淨、最舒適以及最佳的享受！本旅館交通便捷，距台南交流道僅兩分鐘車程，距台南世貿展覽館僅三分鐘車程,距台南市區僅五分鐘車程，距高鐵歸仁站僅八分鐘車程，無論是旅遊、洽商、約會、休息、住宿，國妃鷹堡都是您最佳的選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: This all-new motel in a European palatial style is waiting for you! With its pleasant aesthetic, including magnificent decorated archways and Roman columns, it’s as if you’ve been transported to Europe at its most romantic. With our friendly service, King & Princess Motel Rende hopes to add a little spice to your life! Come visit our secret garden of peace amongst the noise and bustle of the city with our quality service at affordable prices. With an air of international romance coupled with privacy, we invite you to enjoy a clean, comfortable, safe, and secluded getaway with us!King & Princess Motel Rende is conveniently placed just a two-minute drive from the Tainan Interchange, a three-minute drive from the Commercial Exhibition Center Tainan, a five-minute drive from urban Tainan, and an eight-minute drive from the Tainan Station on the Taiwan High-Speed Rail. Whether you’re on business or vacation, King & Princess Motel Rende is your first choice!

stays.description: 位於台南仁德交流道下，鄰近奇美博物館及南紡夢時代，約5分鐘路程。抽象意境的彩繪外牆，營造幻影燈光夜景。入口處典雅的燈光設計、幻彩迎賓車道讓旅客在進房前便有賓至如歸的感受。本館主題房精緻浪漫、家庭房溫馨舒適。另有為出差旅客設計了商務房型。設計師處處著重細節與人性化考量，規劃有新潮、簡約及時尚的裝潢與設備。有特色挑高的樓中樓設計、豐盛美味的自助式早餐為本館的優勢之一。無時無刻讓貴賓們擁有輕鬆愜意渡假時光、及優質的休閒環境。
stays.descriptionEn: Windsor Castle Motel Rende Branch is located at the Rende Interchange in Tainan, close to Chimei Museum and Tainan Textile Dream Era, about 5 minutes away. The abstract painted exterior wall creates a phantom lighting night scene. stays.name: 六宿
stays.description: 用三圓圈的理念取中間的交集點（住宿、文化、觀光）來推廣台南 綜合誠信的服務好態度、乾淨簡單的住宿品質 成就每一位旅人夢想的足跡源自於37年創立太和堂製藥 首創「猴標六神丹」腸胃藥 因為天然的成分，珍貴的藥材，遵古法製，故療效迅速卓著 當時光復時期，正處於衛生條件不佳時，必備的良藥，改善台灣人很大的生活品質 而位於2020年後的我們 遇到了傳說中六神丹的起家厝 這裡隱藏了許許多多台南的故事 六宿 保留民國37年 珍貴的裝潢 保留台灣正興起 人們卻單純的模樣 不破壞房屋結構 保留原始風貌 您不但可以參觀 還可以置身其中 享受當時台灣正起飛 六神丹老闆的家居生活 讓你彷彿回到過去 有個深度的台南回憶

stays.name: 天下南隅
stays.description: 天下大飯店成立於民國74年，是台南地區最早的幾間商務旅館之一，曾接待過兩屆台灣總統與無數中外貴賓，2020年秋天，在走過三十五年歲月後進行全面性的翻修，同時更名以「天下南隅 Provintia Hotel」再出發。全館87間客房，過半數配有陽台、浴缸，平均大小達八坪以上，其中位於南側的客房更是享有台南唯一俯瞰赤崁樓視野。頂樓「圓頂西餐廳 La Cupola」為台南歷史最悠久的西餐廳，採業界少見的半自助式服務，開幕至今一直深受台南市民愛戴，是許多家庭與親友聚會時的首選。飯店坐落於台南雙城歷史區，基地緊鄰德慶溪水道遺址，原址日據時代為東本願寺布教所，長久以來位處台南市歷史發展的核心地區，緊鄰赤崁樓、祀典武廟文化商圈，距離負盛名之國華街、石精臼小吃聚落亦在步行範圍內；地理優越、機能健全，是您停留台南作為旅遊、洽商、會議之最佳選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: La Plaza Hotel, established in 1985, is a time-honored business hotel in Tainan. It has received two Taiwan Presidents and numerous Taiwan notable personages. It is also the long-term designated hotel for the professional baseball team, Brother Elephants (now Chinatrust Brothers). We are located near Fort Provintia and State Temple of the Martial God cultural district, and within walking distance to Tainan City's famous Guohua Street and “Shi Chong Jiu ” eatery cluster. With our excellent geographical location and complete amenities, it is your perfect place to stay while in Tainan for travel, business or conference.

stays.searchText: 天下南隅 天下大飯店股份有限公司 臺南市旅館060號 臺南市 北區 成功路202號1樓及4至11樓 天下大飯店成立於民國74年，是台南地區最早的幾間商務旅館之一，曾接待過兩屆台灣總統與無數中外貴賓，2020年秋天，在走過三十五年歲月後進行全面性的翻修，同時更名以「天下南隅 Provintia Hotel」再出發。全館87間客房，過半數配有陽台、浴缸，平均大小達八坪以上，其中位於南側的客房更是享有台南唯一俯瞰赤崁樓視野。頂樓「圓頂西餐廳 La Cupola」為台南歷史最悠久的西餐廳，採業界少見的半自助式服務，開幕至今一直深受台南市民愛戴，是許多家庭與親友聚會時的首選。飯店坐落於台南雙城歷史區，基地緊鄰德慶溪水道遺址，原址日據時代為東本願寺布教所，長久以來位處台南市歷史發展的核心地區，緊鄰赤崁樓、祀典武廟文化商圈，距離負盛名之國華街、石精臼小吃聚落亦在步行範圍內；地理優越、機能健全，是您停留台南作為旅遊、洽商、會議之最佳選擇。

stays.name: 富信大飯店
stays.description: 府城古典巴洛克式建築 - 台南富信大飯店 2014 年全新完工，座落於西門路與成功路口，近台南火車站，臨近國華街小吃及海安路藝術街，著名一級古蹟赤崁樓、大天后宮、孔廟等比鄰而立，步行可至在地老字號美食富盛號碗粿、阿松割包、武廟肉圓等，飯店絕佳的地理位置，是商務洽公、旅遊住宿的首選。台南富信飯店以巴洛克宮廷式建築風格興建，星級飯店規格打造，提供旅客便利舒適的專業服務。全館共174間客房，典雅貴族的裝潢風格，與當地文化特色交融，一樓富麗廳提供自助中西式早餐，接待中心協助安排旅遊路線及景點諮詢服務，健身房、KTV、商務中心等設施，滿足住宿旅客完美驚豔的五感體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Classical Baroque building - The construction of FUSHIN Hotel Tainan was completed in 2014 and it is located at the junction between Ximen Road and Chenggong Road.The hotel is close to Tainan Railway Station, the eateries on Guohua Street, and Hai'an Road Art Street; the renowned Grade I monuments Fort Provintia, Tianhou Temple, Confucius Temple etc. are positioned adjacent to the hotel, and it is of walking distance to old and famous food stores such as Fusheng Bowl Cakes, Asong Pork Belly Buns and Martial Temple Meatballs. This excellent geographical location of the hotel makes it the best accommodation for business trips and travel.FUSHIN Hotel Tainan was constructed in a Baroque palatial architectural style and to be a starred hotel. It provides travelers with convenience, comfort and professional services.The entire hotel has 174guest rooms, and is decorated in an elegant and royal style, blended with local cultural features. The Restaurant on 1F provides Chinese and Western buffet breakfast, the Reception Center assists guests in making travel journey arrangements and provides inquiry services on attractions; facilities such as the gym, KTV and Business Center offer guests a perfect and amazing multi-sensory experience.

stays.descriptionEn: Leisure Homestay hopes to strike a balance between architecture and natural environment, allowing travelers to enjoy the tranquility of harmonious coexistence with nature in the busy urban life. It also takes an exciting and in-depth journey to explore with the characteristics of experience, food and aesthetics. There are many secret places, delicacies, and rich cultural heritage in this city. Please forget your identity and become a street person for a while, spend wonderful moments together, feel the original intention of this land, and find your own original intention.

stays.name: 新東亞旅埕
stays.description: 「新東亞旅埕」歷經一甲子歲月與時代變遷的旅社，經過重新整理保留原始的風貌後在建物空間裡反映著不同年代的軌跡，邁入大廳即可看到磨石子的櫃台與高挑的石柱在向你招呼歡迎你的到來，磨石子的樓梯、地板與牆面仍舊呈現過往亮麗的風貌。它沒有華麗的裝潢，沒有刻意地包裝修飾與人造美化，就為了保留著那獨特的日式建築風貌讓來此的旅客可沈浸於古典優雅空間，探詢歷史的足跡。 處處可見修補的痕跡但卻沒有刻意掩飾的衝突，瑕不掩瑜下你可感受它的質樸，有許多物件與氛圍可觸動你的心弦在心底蘊中思古之幽情，更值得你探索它蘊含的故事。 喜歡老屋風貌，探訪在地人文的旅人歡迎你的光臨。
stays.descriptionEn: After years of change, the Neat Hostel, still retain the original style of the building, the space reflects the trajectory of different years. When travelers walk into the hall you can see the grindstone counters and pillars seem to greet and welcome your arrival, those terrazzo stairs, floors and walls still showing past beautiful style.It has no ornate decoration, without deliberately packaging decoration and artificial landscaping, in order to retain the unique style of Japanese architecture so that travelers can sink into the classical elegant space, explore the history of the footprint.There are many objects can touch your heart, recall with nostalgia feelings, it is worth your exploration of the stories it contains. Welcome to those who like the style of the old house to investigate local culture.

stays.searchText: 新東亞旅埕 新東亞旅埕 臺南市民宿180號 臺南市 北區 成功路68巷45號 「新東亞旅埕」歷經一甲子歲月與時代變遷的旅社，經過重新整理保留原始的風貌後在建物空間裡反映著不同年代的軌跡，邁入大廳即可看到磨石子的櫃台與高挑的石柱在向你招呼歡迎你的到來，磨石子的樓梯、地板與牆面仍舊呈現過往亮麗的風貌。它沒有華麗的裝潢，沒有刻意地包裝修飾與人造美化，就為了保留著那獨特的日式建築風貌讓來此的旅客可沈浸於古典優雅空間，探詢歷史的足跡。 處處可見修補的痕跡但卻沒有刻意掩飾的衝突，瑕不掩瑜下你可感受它的質樸，有許多物件與氛圍可觸動你的心弦在心底蘊中思古之幽情，更值得你探索它蘊含的故事。 喜歡老屋風貌，探訪在地人文的旅人歡迎你的光臨。

stays.name: 榮美金鬱金香酒店
stays.description: 佇立於俗稱放炮街，現為藝術大道的海安路上，俯拾盡是令人留連忘返的生活體驗，往左穿過人聲鼎沸吆喝叫賣的水仙宮老市集，神農街近在咫尺。往右漫步花園夜市，體驗傳統與現代味蕾的交融。臺南，代表著歷史記憶的堆疊集合體。榮美金鬱金香酒店Golden Tulip Glory Fine Hotel – Tainan.TW代表著融合現代與過去的新生命；07-14全自助早午餐、105間各式客房、120人標準會議室、24小時開放的休閒生活區，以及慵懶慢活的懶人電影院等設施。榮美，外來遊子探訪文化之都的休息站、異國旅客品味美食之都的起始點；榮美，更是眾神之都的應許之地。
stays.descriptionEn: The hotel is located on today's “Art Avenue,” Hai’an Road, of fering various memorable life experiences. Go left and pass through the bustling old Shuixian Temple market with the calls of vendors filling the air. Shennong Street is close by. Turn right and wander through Huayuan Night Market and taste traditional and modern flavors. Tainan represents the accumulation of historical memory.Golden Tulip Glory Fine Hotel – Tainan represents new life that combines modernity and the past. Facilities and services include buffet breakfast, 105 guestrooms of various styles, a standard meeting room accommodating 120 persons, a 24-hour leisure area, and a “lazybones” theater for lazy and slow living.Golden Tulip Glory Fine Hotel – Tainan is the ideal place to rest for visitors exploring the city’s rich culture and Tainan’s gastronomic delights. The hotel is also where wishes come true in this capital of the gods.

stays.description: 『鐵街house』，坐落於台南市北區自強街與公園南路交界點，鄰近火車站。藏身於寧靜的巷弄中。而鐵街house的命名來自於地緣關係，也是家業的起源點，皮雕及製鞋工具製造。相信許多人對於這類工具應該相當陌生，因此鐵街想把這些器具介紹給更多人認識。當來趟台南小旅行時，也可以看到不一樣的東西。雖然沒有華麗的裝潢擺飾，我們想要呈現的簡單是令人舒服的溫潤風格。希望來到『鐵街house』就像回家一般舒適自在。而我們也在106年4月7日通過並核發觀光局合法民宿編號:136號，府觀業字第1060350473號，給旅客們有品質與保障的住宿環境。房型可以點進下面網址看喔 ↓http://5658tn.com/Iron/ 另外目前有推出一些課程及DIY的活動，對皮雕有興趣的朋友們及來台南玩的朋友們可以過來晃晃看看喔！住宿的旅客另有優惠喔！！因為DIY是採預約制的，所以有興趣想要嘗試的朋友們需要先提前跟我們連絡預約喔！謝謝。

stays.description: 1976年至1981年間臺鹽公司為了照顧鹽民於北門和「井仔腳」興建鹽工厝，1981年於「井仔腳」庄廟北側興建1列2棟總計12戶，俗稱「12戶」，由於購買者大多為鹽工，因為是鹽工住過的房舍，因此取名為「鹽舍」。井仔腳是個純樸鄉下的地方，有夕陽、鹽田、豐富的鳥類及生態，讓出外的旅客能放下都市繁忙的步伐輕鬆休閒地體驗當地居民不一樣的漫步生活。
stays.descriptionEn: From 1976 to 1981, the Taiwan Salt Company built salt workers' houses in Beimen and "Jingzijiao" to take care of the salt farmers. In 1981, a row of two buildings with a total of 12 households were built on the north side of the "Jingzijiao" temple, commonly known as "12 Households". Since most of the buyers were salt workers, the houses were named "Salt Houses" because they were the houses where the salt workers lived. Jingzijiao is a simple countryside place with sunsets, salt fields, rich birdlife and ecology, allowing travelers to relax and unwind from the busy pace of the city and experience the different strolling lifestyle of the local residents.

stays.descriptionEn: Make a Wish; Dreams do Come True. Designed in an elegant baroque architectural style, King & Princess Motel is your lucky star in Tainan. With ISO9001:2008 accreditation, easy access, and a Tourism Bureau three-star rating, this motel stands out from the crowd. King & Princess Motel’s rooms are elegant and luxurious and its service friendly, and with an emphasis on a clean, private space, it is somewhere you can truly relax. It has 33 twin rooms and four family rooms. Tainan is a city known for its cuisine, and King & Princess Motel upholds this tradition with its breakfast, lunch, and dinner service, offering food that is fresh and freshly prepared, giving you the best. Being near Huayuan Night Market, Anping Scenic Area, the Eternal Golden Castle, and the Gold Coast, it is easy to get to and ready to serve. Weekday rates start at NT$1380 a night and Saturdays at NT$1880 a night, and you can also stay for shorter periods starting at NT$480 for two hours. Weekday check-ins end at 6pm, with check-out at 12pm; on weekends and holidays, check-ins end at 8pm, while check-out remains at 12pm.

stays.description: 溪上明月皎皎，溪中見月、月中見溪」，月見溪之名不脛而走，「月見」在日文中為賞月之意，月光如流水般緩緩地撫慰人心，月見溪行館座落於台南鬧中取靜的巷子裡，周遭為幽靜隱密的高級住宅區，鄰近體育公園、台南市立棒球場、孔廟、赤崁樓等多處景點。並距離火車站與台南機場約只要10分鐘的車程，優質便利的地點，是您出差、旅遊、渡假的最佳選擇。館內設計以周遭綠林為發想，採用大量的木材質，呈現讓旅客放鬆，溫暖的設計，採光明亮，寬敞舒適的空間中，盡情享受旅行中片刻寧靜的完美假期。另有商務中心、健身房、閱讀室、酒吧等多功能設施場地，提供多樣化的需求，細心熱忱的服務人員，永遠帶著微笑，隨時為您提供親切貼心的服務。
stays.descriptionEn: Sukimi in Japanese means to gaze at and appreciate the moon. Japanese tourists has been known to come and find solace in the Sukimi Creek – a creek that beautifully reflects the moon in its slow and steady waters. Named after the Sukimi Creek, this hotel is situated in a quiet alley in the heart of a wealthy neighborhood. It is closed to a sports park, the Confucian Temple, Fort Provintia and other tourist attractions. Just 10 minutes away from the train station and Tainan Airport, the convenient location makes the hotel ideal for business and leisure.

stays.name: 樂宅17民宿
stays.description: 民國49年建造的老宅-西元1960年-三年多前很有緣分的買下這年久失修拉圾雜物滿間的房子!經過了一至二年的構思及一年多的施作整修!終於完成了!保留絕大部份那個年代的原始建築!明亮的采光-磨石子的樓梯及地板-台灣檜木的門窗!能時時感受那個年代簡單知足-單純的美好!101年我當了爸爸生了個女兒叫(樂晴)我希望女兒這輩子都能很快樂幸福的過每一天都像晴朗的天空每天都很燦爛!她的到來是我人生中最幸福快樂的事!更是責任的開始!所以我把房子的名字以(樂)為中心點!故而把名字取名(樂宅17)讓寶貝女兒知道民宿的名字是用她的名字取的。希望每位有緣份的朋友來到這。都能感到親切-自在-快樂! 更祝福你們有快樂的人生幸福的未來。歡迎你們的到來。 樂宅1960。

stays.description: 善化，位於大台南地理中心，亦為【台南科學園區】的所在地。南科贊美酒店恰好座落於市中心，距離善化火車站3分鐘、國道三號5分鐘、國道一號也只要10分鐘，鄰近交通路網四通八達!南科贊美酒店二館由著名建築師－黃建鈞融合蒙德里安的色塊藝術，及西藏風馬旗的祈福色彩打造而成。酒店園區占地逾萬坪，遠遠就可望見具有鮮明色彩的特色建築外觀，坐擁嘉南平原絕佳之田園景觀，腹地十分廣闊。館內設施及餐飲選擇豐富，包括阿嬤の菜園-無毒親子農園、虹橋港式飲茶、漆彈場、戶外游泳池、池畔酒吧等，另設有百坪宴會廳、玻璃打造的夢幻珍愛教堂及落羽松環繞的心之湖，提供貴賓舉行婚宴或戶外證婚，許下一生僅一次的浪漫誓約。 南科贊美酒店鄰近亦有包含善化老街、新化老街、牛墟、山上花園水道博物館、南瀛天文台、蘭科植物園、烏山頭水庫、大內彩繪村、胡厝寮彩繪村等景點，不同於鬧區的喧囂，非常適合團體及家庭旅客來一趟深度旅遊，體驗台南的慢活輕旅行。
stays.descriptionEn: Shanhua, located in the geographic center of Tainan, is also the location of the [Tainan Science Park].Nanke Zhan Hotel is located right in the city center, 3 minutes away from Shanhua Railway Station, 5 minutes away from National Highway No. 3, and only 10 minutes away from National Highway No. 1. It is close to the transportation network extending in all directions!The second hall of Nanke Zhan Hotel is created by the famous architect Huang Jianjun, which combines the color block art of Mondrian and the blessing color of the Tibetan Fengma Flag. The hotel park covers an area of ​​more than 10,000 square meters. From a distance, you can see the distinctive architectural appearance with distinctive colors. It sits on the excellent idyllic landscape of the Jianan Plain, and the hinterland is very broad. There are abundant facilities and dining options in the museum, including grandma's vegetable garden - non-toxic parent-child farm, Hongqiao Hong Kong-style tea drinking, paintball field, outdoor swimming pool, poolside bar, etc. There are also Baiping banquet hall, glass-made Dream Treasure Church and Luoyu The lake of the heart surrounded by pine, provides VIPs to hold wedding banquets or outdoor weddings, and make a once-in-a-lifetime romantic vow. There are also nearby attractions including Shanhua Old Street, Xinhua Old Street, Niu Xu, Mountain Garden Waterway Museum, Nanying Observatory, Orchid Botanical Garden, Wushantou Reservoir, Dannei Painted Village, Hucuoliao Painted Village and other attractions. , different from the hustle and bustle of the downtown area, it is very suitable for groups and families to take an in-depth tour and experience the slow and light travel of Tainan.

stays.description: 位於大台南市中心點、善化交流道旁，激情密碼不僅便於前往台南各大旅遊景點，更與台南科學園區為鄰，無論情侶約會、家庭出遊，或是業務洽商，皆能滿足需求。擺脫過去消費者對汽車旅館的刻板印象，激情密碼以「藝術」品味為出發點，保留「商」務住宿的功能， 又兼具汽車「旅」館的情趣，精心打造全館55 種房型，多樣化的藝術主題空間，讓每位住客一打開房門，即進入一個充滿品味魅力的時空，超乎想像的豐富內涵，高質感的休閒所在，打造出與眾不同的幸福情境。 「五心級」服務滿足不同需求不僅房內布置用心，在激情密碼3000 坪的寬廣空間裡，綠意中庭即佔了1500 坪，其中規劃了花園、果嶺、沙坑等休閒區域，加上館內KTV 包廂、商務會議室及餐廳應有盡有，讓每一位外出旅客，不論是商旅或是度假，都能在此盡情徜徉，讓身心得到充分的解放。激情密碼秉持用心、貼心、細心、熱心、安心的「五心級」服務原則，本著「以客為尊」的精神，讓每位來到激情密碼的顧客宛如置身世外桃源，擁有賓至如歸的享受，創造出無價的歡愉幸福感。
stays.descriptionEn: Romantic Code Hotel is located in downtown Tainan, next to Shanhua Interchange. The hotel is conveniently located close to various tourism attractions in Tainan and is in the same neighborhood as the Southern Taiwan Science Park. The variety of attractions and activities available here make it a great lodging choice whether you're here on a date, for a family outing or for business. Unlike the steotypical image that most motels represent, Romantic Code Hotel has an artistic and tasteful ambiance. It retains the function of a business hotel, but has the fun and interesting elements of a motel. The 55 guestrooms are carefully designed with a variety of art themes. As soon as you step inside a room, you will be immediately transformed into a tasteful and charming space. The creativity, quality and comfort created in each room set us apart from other motels. We're a Five-star Hotel that Meets All Your Needs Besides having beautifully decorated rooms, Romantic Code Hotel covers an area of more than 9,900 meters, with close to 5,000 meters of courtyard space. Within the courtyard, there are plants and flowers, fruit trees, sandpit and other recreation areas. There are also KTV rooms, meeting rooms and restaurants. All the facilities and equipments available here make this a great hotel for business or vacation. Romantic Code Hotel upholds our five-star hotel status and continues to put our customers first. We want our customers to feel like they are home away from home when they stay with us, and leave with happy and precious memories.

stays.description: 鴻綾雅苑位於風景如畫的台南善化地區，提供舒適、優雅的住宿環境，是您放鬆心情、享受自然的理想選擇。這裡融合了現代設計與傳統元素，讓每位來賓都能感受到家的溫暖。### 住宿設施- **客房類型**： - 標準雙人房 - 高級家庭三人房 - 豪華雙人套房- **設施**： - 免費Wi-Fi - 空調 - 平面電視 - 茶水設備 - 獨立衛浴或共用衛浴 -開放式廚房 -停車位 服務項目- **旅遊諮詢**：我們的工作人員樂意為您提供當地旅遊資訊和建議。- **接送服務**：可安排機場或車站接送，讓您的行程更加便捷。### 周邊景點- **自然風景區**：步行可達的美麗步道，適合健行和觀賞自然風光。鄰近官田，六甲，東山，關子嶺，麻豆，新營- **文化古蹟**：附近有多處歷史悠久的景點，讓您體驗當地文化。- **美食街**：周圍有許多當地特色餐廳，滿足您的味蕾。阿牛仔牛肉湯，八方緣烤鴨，善化夜市等等### 預訂資訊若您想要預訂或了解更多資訊，歡迎聯繫我們的管家，☎️：0936-809-039程先生無論您是想要放鬆身心，還是探索當地文化，鴻綾雅苑都是您的理想選擇。期待您的光臨！

stays.name: 幸福種子
stays.description: 歡迎您來玩~ 我們「學甲」是台南「虱目魚」主要產地之一。米其林店虱目魚與牛肉清湯名店緊鄰民宿，值得您來品嚐。 學甲景點-充滿神話傳說的【台南幫】名人發跡老厝-【烏鴉落洋穴】風水寶地傳奇、南台灣最大野生動物園【頑皮世界 】、臺灣國寶「葉王交趾陶」【學甲慈濟宮】、、影視古裝場景【老塘湖藝術村】、賞鳥區【學甲濕地】，全台最大「麥田」與「蜀葵花海」都在學甲。也緊鄰鹽水區「月津港燈節」與北門區「井仔腳瓦盤鹽田」、「南鯤鯓代天府」等景點。非常適合親子同遊或好友聚會一起深度探索! 「幸福種子 民宿」本身是一間手作教室，民宿裏收藏許多的天然植物果實、種子作品，全是民宿主人 黃老師 的巧手佈置。從最早的手作開班授課到斜槓經營民宿，主人 一樣會開設「種子手作DIY課程」，給房客參與。歡迎大家透過手作的療癒過程，體驗不同的住宿樂趣！ 「種子是生命之源，讓人充滿幸福感」
stays.descriptionEn: Homestay located in TainanWelcome to play~ Our "Xuejia" is one of the main production areas of "milkfish" in Tainan. Xuejia attractions - the [Tainan Gang] full of myths and legends, the old house where celebrities made their fortunes - [Wu Ya Luo Yang Xue], the legendary Feng Shui treasure land, the largest wildlife park in southern Taiwan [Naughty World], Taiwan's national treasure "Ye Wang Jiaozhi Pottery" [Xiajia Tzu Chi Temple], film and television costume scenes [Laotanghu Art Village], bird watching area [Xiajia Wetland], Taiwan's largest "wheat field" and "hollyhock flower sea" are all in Xuejia. It is also close to the "Yuejin Port Lantern Festival" in Yanshui District and the "Jingzijiao Wapan Salt Field" and "Nankunshendai Tianfu" attractions in Beimen District. Very suitable for family travel or friends to explore together! "Seeds of Happiness B&B" itself is a handcraft classroom. The B&B houses many natural plant fruits and seed works, all of which are skillfully arranged by the B&B owner, Mr. Huang. The host provides "seed handmade DIY course" for tenants to participate. Everyone is welcome to experience different accommodation pleasures through the healing process of handcrafting! "Seeds are the source of life and make people feel happy."

stays.name: 回家旅行
stays.description: 優質｜平價｜人文｜美食，一次滿足！ 台南住宿首選【回家旅行民宿】，給你最安心、最舒適的旅宿體驗！ 為什麼選擇我們？好客民宿認證優質民宿 ✔ 優美環境 ✔ 平實價格 ✔ 專屬停車位 ✔ 提供高級洗沐用品與備品 無論親子旅遊、情侶出遊或好友聚會，讓你住得舒適又安心交通便利，樂遊文化台南 車程 20 分鐘直達市中心：海安路、國華街、神農街美食與老屋浪漫一次擁有 漫步林百貨、台南美術館，文藝氣息滿滿 夜晚可小酌爵士居酒屋，感受台南夜生活的靜謐與魅力 歷史與自然的完美結合 漫遊安平運河、河樂廣場，享受午後慢活時光 林默娘公園、安平漁人碼頭，享受海風與歷史交融的寧靜 深度台南之旅 鹿耳門天后宮步行可達，香火鼎盛、古韻悠長 搭船探訪四草綠色隧道、七股潟湖與鹽山，鹽田夕陽美不勝收 青鯤鯓扇形鹽田、井仔腳瓦盤鹽田，每一處都是攝影打卡勝地 超人氣景點與在地美食 奇美博物館藝術饗宴 玉井冰品、善化牛墟、在地小吃讓你一吃成主顧 不論自然、文化、親子、美食，通通找得到！ 來台南旅行，不只是住宿，更是一段「回家」的美好體驗！【回家旅行民宿】──住過的人都說讚！你一定也會愛上！

stays.name: 水薯魚a家
stays.description: 台江地區具有豐富生態、遠離都市塵囂。推崇喜歡親近自然、慢活步調旅行的您。我們希望在民宿停留的客旅，除了能體驗當地生態之美，也能放慢腳步享受生活。暫時拋開繁忙喧嘩的都市型態，獲得充分休息，再度出發! 無論您將規劃來趟深度探索及漫遊輕鬆之旅，或是在地小吃尋味之旅,不妨與親友停留一宿，讓您們在旅程後,回到水薯魚a家後,有舒適的寢具、靜謐的環境、新穎的硬體，讓有溫度的四草民家，進入放鬆深沉的休息，感受彷彿回到家一樣的自在愜意。水薯魚a家屬新建透天宅,一樓客餐廳,二樓及三樓住宿區,可完整提供包棟(或半包棟)式旅宿服務,客房內寢具置入五星級飯店等級備品,讓住客睡得舒適安穩(一樓後陽台及四樓是屬於我們的私人空間)。清潔消毒使用DUSKIN系列用品;為確保宿主及住客安全,本宿共計安裝4支監視器,分別為臨路捲門入口即接待區(車庫)各安裝1支外,一樓後陽台及四樓也各安裝1支監視器,住宿活動空間確保完全隱私;另整棟透天有基本消防安全考量，房間內有緊急照明燈和偵煙，樓梯間有滅火器。防疫整棟自來水源安裝濾砂及軟水系統洗浴時會有滑潤感屬正常現象。入住期間有任何問題請讓我們知道!

stays.name: 南岸山．綺
stays.description: 整個想法必須從建築談起 2004年與元根建築在安平一起合作的碧波飛，是我與吳武易建築師對於建築實踐的開始，然而重要的是，我看到了一群人為了將話語中與畫筆下的理想在傳統的營建體系裡重新啟動住宅新模式所付出近乎執著的堅持，總在不經意的地方讓人感動不已……… 所以我和家人起了一個願，希望將這美好的事物讓更多人可以體會，因此我們在武易建築師不捨的割愛下接手元根建築工坊在安平繼碧波飛、天天容海色後，於2015年完成的share house，以民宿的型態延續share house分享的精神讓更多的旅者享受台南種種的同時，也可以進入新時代的透天住宅設計體驗小住宅卻有難能可貴的前庭後院與夜晚專屬自己一片夜空的生活品質 是起於住宅的發想，是行於民宿的型態，但終究是想讓我們與孩子從心體會每天與生活在一起的房子，有多少的可能等待著我們去開發，尤其是與微風、光線自然而然的再次相遇……，我們多想靠近自然，因為我們來自於自然，如果在都市的環境中可以，更屬珍貴一群人努力著，所以值得推薦給大家，從再平凡不過的都市細長基地條件中，卻讓連棟透天房子的模樣有如藝術的饗宴，而內部的空間與生活方式也充滿了與傳統思維的不同 一群人努力且繼續堅持著⋯⋯⋯ 所以值得推薦給大家在台南多了一處想回的家，我們誠摯的與大家分享，關於空間的陳設。我們在元根建築一氣呵成的材料、色系及細部設計中，將過去20年旅行中收穫佈置其中，藉此與大家分享旅行中的點點滴滴 「家」承載著在生活中的累積，家人間永遠會為對方給出最好的自己，並不斷地有形無形的蓄積幸福的美好。我們也希望大家把這裡當作在台南的家，輕鬆自在的享受而沒有旅途中的疲憊。
stays.descriptionEn: The whole concept started from architecture. In 2004, Yuan Ken Architecture Workshop and us built BIBOFI in Anping. This project is the initial point of architecture for me and Architect WU-I WU. What's more, I saw a group of people making effort to turn out their ideal under the traditional system of constructing. They are making the change, restarting a new house pattern by focusing on every single detail which would also touch you in various ways. That's why my family and I made a wish. We hope that more and more people can experience such fragrant thing. We then took over Share House which is built in 2015, making it into a guesthouse. Hoping to continue the spirit of sharing and provide the oppurtunity for more travelers to enter a new generation of townhouse. A house that's minuscule but has it's own front and backyard at the same time, this gains you a peaceful night just for you and you companions. Inspired by architecture, turned out by Guesthouse The final goal is hoping we and our next generation to resonate the houses we live in everyday. The possibilities that we can seek in buildings, especially to feel the breeze, the sun naturally in urban. We desire to get close to mother nature because we are borned from it, If we can be surrounded by nature in urban, how precious could it be? A group of hard-working people fulfilled this building so it worth recommending. The base of Share House is nothing but a slim land, by the effort of those people we can see how different they are using the interior and changing the way of life from the traditional ways. This is not just a townhouse, but also a feast of living and seeing. The effort of us keep on going Such worthy of recommendation, we hope all of you would find here as another home that you would want to come back often. We sincerely share this Share House with you. About interior furnishing We decorated Share house with our collection in the past 20 years of traveling under the systematic material. colour and detail design of Yuan Ken Architecture Workshop. We hope to share our travel experience with all travelers. Home bears the accumulation of life. Family will always devote the best of themselves to each other. This would increase the happiness between everyone visbly and invisbly. We hope that everyone can consider Share House as your home in Tainan. Leisurely enjoy traveling and clear out the tireness in Share House.

stays.name: 台南大員皇冠假日酒店
stays.description: 台南大員皇冠假日酒店位於自然生態與歷史人文古蹟所在地-安平，地理位置得天獨厚，距離台南機場、台南火車站、高鐵台南站，只需要20至40分鐘車程。驅車5分鐘即可抵達台江國家公園、四草紅樹林隧道；近在咫尺的安平古堡、安平老街，可盡情飽覽名聞遐邇的旅遊勝地。酒店建築巧妙融合了現代時尚元素與在地文化精神之特色，無論是度假休閒、商務會議，還是浪漫婚禮，台南大員皇冠假日酒店都將是您心儀之選。231間舒適客房及套房，現代時尚設計，攬窗而立，近賞鹽水溪口生態水色景緻，遠眺安平老街古樸人文之美。所有房間均配備50吋液晶電視，以及高速的無線網路，尊享家一般的溫馨與愜意。精選英國皇室認證御用的斯林百蘭名床、多款安睡之選枕頭與乾濕分離的衛浴設備，搭配義大利貝佳斯SPA美膚名牌的沐浴用品，迷人的清新沐浴，都能讓您一夜好眠。酒店擁有多國特色餐廳，包括：「元素」、「彩豐樓」、「煉˙瓦」、「289吧」，菁英名廚齊聚，呈現匠心獨到的美饌饗宴。
stays.descriptionEn: Crowne Plaza Tainan situated in Anping District with rich natural environment, historical and cultural attractions. Only 20 to 40 minutes’ drive from Airport, Train Station and High Speed Rail Station. 5 minutes away from Taijiang National Park and Sicao Mangrove Green Tunnel; just walking distance to the famous Fort Zeelandia and Anping old street. The hotel architecture features a mixture of modern design and local culture. Crowne Plaza Tainan will be your best choice, whether it is for holiday, business meeting or romantic wedding. 231 modern rooms and suites with either view of Yanshui Estuary Wetland or the ancient beauty of Anping old street. All guest rooms are equipped with 50-inch LCD TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, cosy and comfortable atmosphere. Borghese bathroom amenities, choices of pillows and British Royals preferred - Slumberland beds will definitely help you relax and ensure you enjoy a great night’s sleep. 3 specialty restaurants with elite and talented chefs, present selections of finest gourmet.

stays.searchText: 台南大員皇冠假日酒店 大員開發事業股份有限公司 交觀宿字第1620號 臺南市 安平區 州平路289號 台南大員皇冠假日酒店位於自然生態與歷史人文古蹟所在地-安平，地理位置得天獨厚，距離台南機場、台南火車站、高鐵台南站，只需要20至40分鐘車程。驅車5分鐘即可抵達台江國家公園、四草紅樹林隧道；近在咫尺的安平古堡、安平老街，可盡情飽覽名聞遐邇的旅遊勝地。酒店建築巧妙融合了現代時尚元素與在地文化精神之特色，無論是度假休閒、商務會議，還是浪漫婚禮，台南大員皇冠假日酒店都將是您心儀之選。231間舒適客房及套房，現代時尚設計，攬窗而立，近賞鹽水溪口生態水色景緻，遠眺安平老街古樸人文之美。所有房間均配備50吋液晶電視，以及高速的無線網路，尊享家一般的溫馨與愜意。精選英國皇室認證御用的斯林百蘭名床、多款安睡之選枕頭與乾濕分離的衛浴設備，搭配義大利貝佳斯SPA美膚名牌的沐浴用品，迷人的清新沐浴，都能讓您一夜好眠。酒店擁有多國特色餐廳，包括：「元素」、「彩豐樓」、「煉˙瓦」、「289吧」，菁英名廚齊聚，呈現匠心獨到的美饌饗宴。

stays.description: 「台南安平●水岸180」曾獲得2009年台灣室內設計住宅空間類TID獎，是台南名設計師的作品，坐落在美麗的安平港灣畔，走的是都會極簡風，讓港灣的美景及悠藍的天空伴您渡過難得的假期。 我們的設計不同於坊間住宅，強調的是無限空間感，讓您來到這裡，不會被冰冷的牆面所侷限，夜晚有港灣的美景和星空的陪伴，白天則有自然光穿梭於屋中，無論站在屋內的任何一個角落，皆能將四周的視野盡收眼底。 我們的初衷是希望來安平渡假的朋友們能擁有一個專屬的私人渡假空間，讓平時緊繃的身心靈可以得到片刻的緩解，因此我們每天只接待兩組客人，享受設計師打造的獨特空間，能讓您真正Feel like home......

stays.name: 台南昱家小巷
stays.description: 「台南安平．昱家小巷」鄰近於安平市區，騎車三分鐘、步行十分鐘的距離即可享有超便利生活，吃喝玩樂通通都有，假日還可漫步樹屋、安平古堡、德商東興洋行、夕遊出張所、億載金城、漁人碼頭等景點，探訪台南歷史軌跡，慢活於風味悠長古城之中。充滿現代感的客廳，溫馨雅緻的套房氛圍，成功塑造出如家一般的自在、舒適，是出門在外的您「台南安平．昱家小巷」二F透天庴;一F是客廳+二F是四人房+雙人房.最優質住宿選擇.◆平價也能享受頂級住宿 房間價格 (純住宿) 「台南安平．昱家小巷」提供兩人及四人套房出租房型，房間風格典雅溫馨，貼木地板營造出舒適自在氛圍。另外房東還準備有一個共用客廳，三五好友聚會也不怕沒地方去，晚上一齊談天吃宵夜，抓住青春尾巴，好不愜意～

stays.name: 四季洋房
stays.description: 四季洋房民宿的介紹喜歡美食的女主人跟一個熱愛植栽台南大叔,原本經營服飾業時常飛往國外採購～因緣際會下遇到一棟有緣分的房子,把原本房子改造成歐式風格種滿植栽地點離安平海邊很近,四季洋房總能讓人有置身國外小度假的氛圍另外離安平美食老街也很近歐～可以騎車吃美食逛逛小巷老屋感受在地台南悠閒時光停車方便：民宿附近有許多車位，路邊也很好停車,走進民宿一分鐘即可抵達,連過年都好停車。客製化服務：慶生,結婚週年,求婚,寶寶性別趴氣球佈置,也可以客製化服務呦。台南美食行程推薦：也是女主人強項,台南在地隱藏版美食可以搜尋ig：seasonbnb，都是親自品嚐過所以來台南請多帶幾個胃來。 房型的介紹每間皆套房,都有對外窗和沙發桌椅的休息空間,進屋就讓人時間都慢了下來可以單間可以包棟,適合各種與家人朋友出遊的住宿四間房間以春夏秋冬四季命名,每間房也有不同風格,常遇到客人像收集關卡一樣,每間房間都來住過暖暖：（六人樓中樓套房）暖色調,最適合家庭入住～暖色調佈置好拍照,有個小陽台.吊床.閣樓空間挑高連大人都可以站直,還有個隱藏版小空間小孩超愛,房間到處都可以看到很用心佈置跟擺飾,還有一棵小樹呢！天堂鳥：（雙人套房）莫蘭迪綠色調,也是最多人首選房型,主人將原本可以做四人房空間留作雙人房所以房間很寬敞,有沙發.吊椅茉莉：（雙人套房）白色調,跟茉莉花語一樣象徵最純粹的浪漫愛情,藤編椅系列搭配床上紗幔,整體空間光線很美紅花：（雙人套房）莫蘭迪經典紅色調,也是整棟最有風格的一間,雖然空間最小,但是女主人的最愛

stays.name: 大魚漫步旅店
stays.description: 台南大魚漫旅是一家位於台南市安平區的旅館，地理位置優越，鄰近著名的安平老街和安平漁人碼頭。這家旅館的最大特色是面對著大型鯨魚裝置藝術「大魚的祝福」，讓您在享受住宿的同時，還能欣賞到遼闊的視野。白天，您可以輕鬆步行前往安平老街，探索這片具有歷史魅力的古城巷弄；而到了晚上，則可以在旅館遠眺寧靜的漁港，欣賞美麗的夕陽景色。此外，台南大魚漫旅位於市政中心，前往台南各大夜市都十分便捷，無論是想要品嚐當地小吃或是體驗夜市熱鬧氛圍，都非常方便。對於自駕遊的旅客，旅館提供免費的公有汽車停車位，是您在台南旅遊期間理想的住宿選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: Tainan Big Fish Hotel is a hotel located in the Anping District of Tainan City, offering an excellent location near the famous Anping Old Street and Anping Fisherman's Wharf. The hotel's main feature is its view of the large whale-shaped installation art, "Blessing of the Big Fish," allowing you to enjoy a broad and open vista during your stay. During the day, you can easily walk to Anping Old Street to explore the charming historical alleys, and in the evening, you can enjoy a peaceful view of the fishing port while watching the beautiful sunset.In addition, Tainan Big Fish Hotel is located in the city center, making it very convenient to visit Tainan's major night markets. Whether you're looking to taste local snacks or experience the vibrant night market atmosphere, everything is within easy reach. For travelers who drive, the hotel provides free public parking, making it the ideal accommodation choice for your trip to Tainan.

stays.name: 安平作夥憩海邊
stays.description: 關於【作夥憩海邊】 「作夥憩海邊」位於安平港歷史風貌園區，在安平舊聚落與海邊中央（各約1公里），鄰近景點有夕遊出張所、安平樹屋、古堡與老街、台江國家公園、觀夕平台、綠色隧道。與招潮蟹、陸蟹、鷺鷥、高蹺鴴與候鳥黑面琵鷺等為鄰，前方是綠地與河堤自行車道。安平沿海一帶是親水活動愛好者的秘密基地，我們與教練、船家合作提供隱藏版的安平水上活動行程如風帆、獨木舟、衝浪與重型帆船，亦可輕鬆搭乘生態膠筏認識台江國家公園的特色風貌（冬日還可欣賞黑面琵鷺）。 因為我們喜歡寧靜、悠閒、視野寬廣且親近大自然的生活品質，我們的家位於市區近郊，就座落在安平古堡與海邊中間，其實距離鬧區很近，從熱鬧的安平舊聚落過來僅1分鐘車程，從大路轉進小巷，就會瞬間進入我們這個安靜又被大自然環繞的神奇角落。距安平古堡1分鐘車程、海邊2分鐘車程、市中心15~20分鐘車程，附近步行5分鐘內有2條路線的公車，路邊停車便利免費。周遭入夜後路燈較少，我們的巷子會化身隱士（晚上來的夥伴需請定睛尋找），也由於沒有太多光害，因此多了些星星為伴。希望讓夥伴們在擁擠豐富的古蹟與美食行旅回來，享受一個舒適、放鬆的空間。 我們邀請你來安平！慢遊台灣最古老的小鎮、大啖海鮮與小吃，更可以體驗親水休閒活動！歡迎與我們作夥！ 專業──臺南唯一一家民宿主人通過英語導遊國家考試 我們積極通過了英語導遊國家考試，為的並不是獲得證照，而是因為每位夥伴的造訪對我們來說都是難得的緣分，就像我們去任何地方旅行，可能好幾年才去一次，或甚至一輩子就那麼一次（世界好大～），所以我們想要提供更專業的旅遊服務，讓夥伴們的旅行美好又順暢！ 在地──民宿獲頒交通部觀光局「百大好客民宿」榮譽 【作夥憩海邊】從全台9千多家民宿中獲選為百大好客民宿，代表著我們樂於分享的心意。「民宿」的魅力就是與來訪夥伴的交會，我們最希望的就是讓每位夥伴來到臺南、來到安平，能夠感受到最在地的人文風情，盡享當地的美食與活動！貪吃愛玩的我們渴望將臺南好吃好玩的點點滴滴分享給你，有一趟身心靈（還有肚皮）滿足且愉悅之旅！********周圍免費停車方便附近有專業的自行車租賃行有合作的機車、電動車行，可代運行李或送車過來位於海邊與古蹟之間，前面是河堤自行車道，可通往海邊或古堡街、安平樹屋步行15~20分鐘：安平古堡與老街區、安平樹屋、觀夕平台（海邊）步行3~5分鐘：2條不同路線的公車、新鮮平價的海鮮小吃、知名安平豆花總店、萊爾富便利商店、咖啡店車程5~10分鐘：台江國家公園水上屋遊客中心、台江生態膠筏、四草綠色隧道車程15~20分鐘：花園/武聖夜市、神農街、藍晒圖文創園區、林百貨、台南火車站
stays.descriptionEn: About Taiowan One Piece Anping House Located in Tainan – Taiwan’s historical capital, close to Taijiang National Park, Sicao Green Tunnel, Anping Fort, Anping Matsu Temple and Anping Tree House.Fiddler crabs, land crabs, egrets, stilt plovers and migrant birds including black-faced spoonbills are our precious neighbors. We like uncrowded and peaceful life quality, so the house is not in the center of downtown, and is located between Anping Fort and the beach. Our home is close to nature and quiet at night; we don’t have many bright street lights surrounded though, there’re more stars staying with us. We would like to provide a comfortable, cozy and relax place for partners to have a rest after walking all day through the historical city with its temples, night markets and narrow old streets. To help you enjoy Tainan, we’ll be happy to share the tourist attraction and food tips with you. Have a great stay at Taiowan One Piece Anping House! Professional – the hosts passed the National Tour Guide We realize that every partner’s visiting Tainan might be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, so we’re eager to provide better travel service for our partners. That’s the reason why we asked ourselves to learn the professional skill and knowledge in tourism industry. We’re the only one hosts in Tainan who passed the National Tour Guide. Local – the guest house won the official Hospitality Award The meaning of winning the official Hospitality Award for Taiowan One Piece Anping House is the recognition of our hearts of sharing the local life styles, special events and yummy food information with our partners. We would love to be your best local partner in your trip and share Tainan’s wonderful things with you! Welcome to Anping!********Easy (Free) Parking15~20 min walk – Anping Fort and the old streets, Anping Tree House, Sunset Platform (seaside)3~5 min walk – Bus Stops (2 lines: 2 and 99), fresh and yummy seafood, famous Anping Bean Jelly shop, convenience store, cafe10~20 min by bike – Taijiang ecological boat, Sicao mangrove green tunnel15~20 min by taxi (appr. $200) – Tainan Train Station, Chikan Tower (Fort Provintia), Garden Night Market, Blueprint Culture & Creative Park, Hayashi Department Store20~30 min by taxi – Tucheng Orthodox Luermen Matsu Temple, Salt Mountain and salt field village

stays.description: 安平光影位於安平運河旁的靜巷內，巷口即是府城著名的美食伴手街。鄰近依蕾特、周氏蝦捲、文章牛肉湯、王氏魚皮、丹丹漢堡、義豐冬瓜茶、永泰興、所長茶葉蛋、DOGA…。輕鬆閱覽 安平老街、安平樹屋、四草大橋看夕陽、安平港、台江國家公園~綠色隧道。驅車前往海安路、保安路、國華街、正興街，神農街，赤崁樓，花園夜市......等舊台南市區景點，車程僅需10~15分鐘。
stays.descriptionEn: Anping light and shadowIt is located in a quiet alley next to the Anping Canal. At the entrance of the alley is Fucheng's famous gourmet souvenir street. Nearby are Elite, Zhou's Shrimp Rolls, Wen Zhang Beef Soup, Wang's Fish Skin, Dandan Burger, Yifeng Winter Melon Tea, Yong Tai Xing, Director Tea Egg, DOGA...Easily browse Anping Old Street, Anping Tree House, watch the sunset from Sicao Bridge, Anping Port, Taijiang National Park ~ Green Tunnel. It only takes 10 to 15 minutes to drive to Haian Road, Baoan Road, Guohua Street, Zhengxing Street, Shennong Street, Chihkan Tower, Garden Night Market, etc. and other old Tainan city attractions.

stays.name: 府城峰情文旅
stays.description: 關於峰情 ─ 起於海拔1638公尺的初心2006年，嚮往了「清新空氣任君取，境地優雅是仙居」，毅然地拋下了喧鬧紛擾的人間，即將的峰情主人 Julie來到了這海拔1638m的仙境~在這塊決意造就豐美的小小土地上，用優雅的花草樹木做成藍圖～遠眺著群巒層疊的山峰，輕撫著恣意變幻的雲霧，聆賞著競鬥音韻的飛鳥～然後吟詠著詩賦開始著手打造了，一個要讓每位旅人轉換了空間的「家」，最後用心底那份親切關懷裝潢完工，稱之為『峰情』........希望旅人們對家的定義能有更深一層的體驗與幸福的歸屬感，並且成為好友，將心定居下來，於是，從那年中秋，這山峰一隅的真情，便逐漸的蔓延開來峰情沒有被包裝的故事，真正的故事只有峰情人的「情熱」，真情而熱。這份情熱在2014、2015、2016，在旅人好友們回應的熱情中擴散增生了，不忘初心，方得始終........

stays.name: 思慕嶼
stays.description: 在思慕嶼 驚艷安平港灣的美！ 思慕嶼位於『安平港歷史風貌園區』，面前安平港灣三方匯聚的港口，從思慕嶼的房間陽臺可以欣賞270度安平港灣，絕對讓您驚豔的美景。清晨波光粼粼、漁船遊艇的停泊、水鳥白鷺鷥親水翱翔、對岸林默娘公園風箏隨風漫舞、景緻如畫，城市文明因水而，這裡是現代人夢想的倚水而居。 生活在思慕嶼，您可以騎著單車或散步至安平古堡，老街，樹屋、夕遊出張所，黃昏時到觀夕平台踩沙灘看夕陽，讓心悠遊在文化古都中，感受府城的人文景觀、美食溫度。或者您驅車十分鐘來到四草體驗竹筏穿梭綠色隧道，坐完渡船再到台南美食商--赤崁樓國華街品小吃，開車騎車也只需20分鐘。用短短的車程遠離塵囂，讓身心全然放鬆，第二天清晨水上日出的陽光，帶給您充滿陽光朝氣的一天。

stays.description: 大人們總說：我小時候......我小時候......我小時候最愛去......最喜歡......最害怕......最討厭......小時候，不懂外面的世界長得怎樣， 我們難過就哭高興就笑小時候，不懂現實世界的爾虞我詐， 我們說出口就是真心話可以大叫、可以大笑、可以大哭、可以大鬧，自由自在~ 沒有設限擁有一點好玩、好吃的東西就是我們最大的幸福！在台南這極富文化古味的地區下，終究我們不是文青，無法逼自己做出多有文化多有意境的作品，我們只想做自己所好，想做甚麼就去做，真心.真情.真行動，色彩.單純.自然，回歸最原本心中的自己---------我小時候。我小時候設計旅店就猶如小飛俠彼得潘所住的，讓人永遠不會長大的Neverland。回到我小時候， 回想家溫暖的懷抱，重溫童年大無畏的夢想， 休息一下，找回自己什麼都不怕的勇氣。邀請你來「我小時候」，這裡有最簡單的幸福、最純真的嚮往，和最溫暖的避風港，你可以卸下生活的包袱、拋開沉重的期望，脫下堅強的面具， 給自己一個最輕鬆自在的旅行......不論你年紀多大，都歡迎來到我小時候， 再次拉回那種無拘無束的自由， 享受我們帶給你-那心中最純粹的小時候。每個人的內心都住了一個小孩，藏著我們的童年； 在我們的人生歲月裡，每個時刻都不要忘記： 那個心裡小小的我，曾經勇敢無懼於世界！

images.name: 浪漫少女心
images.description: 被窗外小鳥歌聲喚醒，洗個泡泡浴，哼著歌，迎接美好的早晨 下午茶，甜點，時裝雜誌，悠閒的度過一個下午 眼影，腮紅，唇蜜... 洋裝，禮服，蕾絲... 珠寶，項鍊，耳墜... 好猶豫，好難抉擇，今晚就要跟他見面了，內心一直噗通噗通...... 少女心是粉紅色 少女心是馬卡龍 少女心是從海洋泡沫中優雅誕生的璀燦珍珠 備註:可加一床(500元/床，春節800元/床) 我小時候痞客邦部落格： http://wikid.pixnet.net/blog 我小時候FB粉絲團： https://www.facebook.com/wikid123/

images.name: 糖果工廠
images.description: ＂嘿咻～嘿咻～齁嘿呦～！＂ 貝果工人每天都辛苦的在糖果工廠工作，為的就是要做出全世界最好吃的糖果！ ＂唉呦！好燙！＂ ＂不是說過很多次巧克力池很燙要注意嗎？＂ 貝果工人小心翼翼的將巧克力冷卻，凝固 接著又要前往果園採收草莓，櫻桃...... ＂梯子很高，要小心啊～！＂ 最後貝果工人用餅乾，糖果，巧克力，草莓，奶油，糖霜等建材，蓋出一座巨大的糖果屋！ 滿屋子甜甜的糖果盡是童年的滋味～ 我小時候痞客邦部落格： http://wikid.pixnet.net/blog 我小時候FB粉絲團： https://www.facebook.com/wikid123/

images.name: 夢遊仙境
images.description: 咻～ 跌進了兔子洞，一切都顛倒了，一切都不合邏輯，一切都...越來越奇怪！ 淚之池，微笑貓咪，永無止境的瘋狂茶會，巨大的花園迷宮，鏡子中的特老大和特老二，紅心皇后的咆嘯以及飛撲而來的撲克牌士兵，這是愛麗絲天馬行空的幻想，歡迎來到愛麗絲夢中的仙境！ 在這房間，請盡量保有創新與豐富的想像力；拋下一切的理性與規範，讓童稚的心靈恣意徜徉在這奇幻的國度裡 閉上眼睛，你可以跟著愛麗絲一起參加高加斯賽跑，皇室槌球大會，跳著龍蝦的方塊舞，傾聽毛毛蟲暢談哲理並且思索瘋狂帽客的古怪謎題 ＂為何烏鴉會像寫字桌？＂這個問題的答案，或許在你一覺醒來之後能夠思考出來！ 備註: 可加一床(500元/床，春節800元/床) 有浴缸可享戀人情、親子趣 我小時候痞客邦部落格： http://wikid.pixnet.net/blog 我小時候FB粉絲團： https://www.facebook.com/wikid123/

images.name: 未來
images.description: ＂砰！＂ 轟然巨響，一個巨大的機器人頭撞破了水泥牆 ＂那是什麼？這是什麼地方？＂受到驚嚇的少年心想 未來，一個人與機器人共存的時代，一個充滿戰爭的時代 駕駛坐在好幾層樓高的機器人體內，操控著這精密的高科技產物 命令他跑步，跳躍，飛行，甚至是作戰 ＂未來不該是這個樣子的......＂ 機器人應該帶給人類方便，不應該造成破壞 ＂我要導正這一切！＂ 誤闖未來的少年，或許是上天的安排，要他成為帶來和平的救世主...... 備註:可加一床(500元/床，春節800元/床) 我小時候痞客邦部落格： http://wikid.pixnet.net/blog 我小時候FB粉絲團： https://www.facebook.com/wikid123/

stays.name: 時驛精品旅館
stays.description: 初衷是源自精品旅店的品牌意象，加上對建築的渴望，建構出我們對STABLE的夢想！STABLE 隱含許多原創設計的概念，結合生活的體驗，重新詮釋旅居空間 ─ 以工業風的精神，搭配現代風格傢俱，展現出獨一無二的面貌！每間客房設計都是團隊間獨一無二的發想，我們衷心期盼這裡能成為您在台南的住宿選擇，沒有最好、只有更好，是打造這個品牌的理念精神，也是給在此停泊的旅人一趟美好舒適的旅程，體驗STABLE的細膩，再以此為出發點，走讀台南的美好。從零到壹的過程中，揉合團隊中諸多不同的想法，激盪出豐富多元的巧思，由衷希望每位旅人喜歡這棟建築所營造的設計氛圍，也小小的奢求這裡有那麼一點點與眾不同！請你們也無限期支持臺南，這座城市的人文風情及在地文化，都等著您來發掘。

stays.name: 朗香洋房
stays.description: 朗香洋房是致敬法國建築師柯比意於1964年完成的朗香教堂而命名，其建築的表現形式與彰顯特徵，不禁讓我們遙想這股設計風潮是如何影響台灣土地，從1954年到1964年的設計脈動從歐洲到台灣，老洋房見證社會的發展軌跡並紀錄時代容顏，為安平留下值得保存的文化瑰寶。
stays.descriptionEn: The Ronchamp Villa is named in tribute to the Ronchamp Church completed by the French architect Le Corbusier in 1964. Its architectural expression and distinctive features make us think about how this design trend affected the land of Taiwan from 1954 to 1964. The design pulse of the year has spread from Europe to Taiwan. Old bungalows have witnessed the development trajectory of society and recorded the appearance of the times, leaving Anping with cultural treasures worth preserving.

stays.name: 木本樹民宿
stays.description: 座落於鹽水溪畔,曾經的屋後還是魚塭,溪畔的堤防上,徒步小徑蜿蜒於蔓草間。在晨昏交替中走過了數十個年頭,經過了八個月的勘查.整理及更新,舊家蛻變出了現代風貌,同時也保留了時光的記憶,婆娑四十年的樓梯扶手和兒時玩耍的庭院。溪景變清澈,日出日落有了新的意義,新的旅程也將由這裡展開～
stays.descriptionEn: Located on the bank of Yanshui Creek, there used to be a fish pond behind the house. On the embankment along the creek, a hiking trail meanders among the weeds.After decades of alternation between day and night and eight months of investigation, sorting and renovation, the old house has transformed into a modern look while retaining the memory of time, including the stair railings that have been swaying for forty years and the courtyard where children played as children.The river scenery has become clearer, sunrise and sunset have new meanings, and a new journey will begin here~

stays.name: 樹說
stays.description: 初來乍到，映入眼裡是需仰望的大樹，茁壯的姿態象徵著，欣欣向榮，草木生命力，清水模與其挑高的木門架構出，內斂沉穩，不凡的氣度。是鳥鳴，抬頭望似真如假的鳥低頭望著，我彷彿聽到鳥鳴的聲音，推開沉沉木門，迎面而來是律動得潺潺流水音，和煦的陽光與藍天吸相映，霎時天成美景，一靜一動，一動一靜，才不過幾步之遙~我聽見大自然的聲音!進到房裡，漫開的花朵，搖曳的光影，朵朵嬌妍朵朵艷麗。坐定了身子，不禁發現我聽見得不是鳥語蟲鳴或潺潺流水音，而是自己的聲音，唯有心閑靜才有如此感知力，我想這就是旅行的意義，聽見自己的聲音，聽著自己訴說著自己。

stays.name: 橙居
stays.description: 安平觀光地區，作為台南市的歷史文化重鎮，擁有豐富的歷史背景和獨特的地理特色。該地區不僅擁有傳統的古蹟，也充滿了現代創意和文化氛圍。讓住客了解安平的歷史，例如介紹安平古堡的歷史故事，或是帶領遊客參觀當地的歷史景點，讓住客不僅是來住宿，而是體驗一場文化之旅。因為想把這份美好，介紹給世界各地來到台南的旅人，所以開設橙居民宿，讓來到台南的人都能時常想起臺南的好與溫暖。

stays.name: 白鹿詩行旅
stays.description: 白鹿詩 行旅位於港濱歷史公園風貌園區，是一棟有五十年歲月的建築物，經由屋主的巧思修復而成的民宿，建築物前方面對整個安平港灣，正前方是漁人碼頭，大魚的祝福，及守護漁船出海平安的林默娘雕像，左側通往鹽水溪，右側為出海台灣海峽，在此三方匯集之焦點正前方，面向東方，住在此可以迎接每個溫暖日出的陽光。白鹿詩行旅位在安平區港濱歷史公園與對岸林默娘公園相連，是一座結合歷史文化與海濱景觀所打造出的港濱公園，延續著台南府城歷史的意義。園區中設置有二鯤鯓砲台、亞太美術館及親水遊憩區，廣闊的園區相當適合舉辦大型活動，親水自然堤岸假日時寬闊的草地吸引許多民眾前來放風箏，漫步在水岸與綠地之間的休閒步道，享受傍晚涼爽的微風吹拂，還可看見成群的白鷺鷥在沿岸覓食，夏季時不妨捲起褲管到親水遊憩區中消暑，是民眾假日休閒的好去處。附近的觀光景點有安平古堡 安平老街 樹屋 夕遊出張所 觀夕平台，不論是散步，騎著自行車，均可以輕鬆到達，在此可以慢活一整天，體會府城歷史與品嘗台南道地美食如:虱目魚粥 牛肉湯 蚵仔煎 蚵嗲 蝦餅 椪餅 蜜餞等等大飽口福。民宿主人居住安平多年，深愛這塊保有歷史文化價值的土地，希望將這裡的美好與人情味分享給來到此地旅行的旅人，白鹿詩因此孕育而生，這是一棟溫馨的小宅，有二個房間，並有廚房中島餐廳可以使用，設備完善齊全，面對安平港灣的房間躺在床上就可以欣賞港灣風光的日出，希望來此的旅人可以完全放鬆，不受他人干擾的家庭旅遊或是和好友共聚，房間數不多，但民宿主人過往有多年的經營民宿經驗，且為好客民宿的肯定，相信白鹿詩民宿會是一個讓旅人放鬆度假的好所在，並為台灣觀光旅遊盡一份力量，將台南安平的美好推廣出去。

stays.name: 福爾摩沙遊艇酒店
stays.description: 聽臺灣的故事，從府城開始讀府城的生活，從福爾摩沙遊艇酒店開始福爾摩沙遊艇酒店座落於安平港水景灣畔，與安平古堡隔灣相望，步行至安平老街只要５分鐘，是台灣唯一擁有遊艇碼頭的酒店，可搭乘遊艇探索府城400年的人文歷史、溯源台灣。在旅行中實踐永續理念酒店鄰近市區交通便利，卻擁有度假景點的悠閒自在，陸續獲得「綠建築鑽石級」標章、「友善自行車旅宿」認證、「環保餐廳」標章、「環保旅店」標章、「環保標章使用證書」銅級環保旅館，以及「臺南優質旅館認證」等殊榮。融合在地脈絡與頂級享受入住酒店免費使用超夢幻的無邊際泳池、SPA水療池、三溫暖、抱石&攀岩區、槌球場、親子遊戲室、兒童電動車等多項設施，以及頗受廣大旅客喜愛的搭遊艇賞海景、水上遊憩活動(SUP、海洋獨木舟、水上自行車)、親子手作課程、漫遊安平文化導覽等付費行程，邀請旅人停下腳步，探索府城在地風情與安平海灣美景，適合家庭親子來台南旅遊的住宿首選。藍海白金意象 高規格宴會廳曾於2024年榮獲總統指定520就職國宴場地及友邦元首住宿酒店，福爾摩沙遊艇酒店的國際宴會廳，備有視聽設備，活動舞台，滿足各種規模的婚宴、工商會議餐敘等活動，一樓的「鳳凰廳／丹桂廳／寰宇廳」，全廳方正俐落，動線規劃暢通無礙，挑高8米無樑柱設計，東方內蘊紅牆時尚奢華，宏偉水晶吊燈錯落有致，極大視野空間，可容納一千人。位於三樓的「水景廳／海灣廳」氣派寬敞，全廳無樑柱，舞台視野通透，襯托出無與倫比的氣派奢華，搭配雙邊7米挑高玻璃帷幕，輕透陽光將廳內渲染成金色夢幻天堂，宴會佳餚由國宴廚藝團隊親自操刀，精湛手藝，結合在地特色食材，巧妙融合多種菜系風味，將經典菜色提升至新境界。國宴名廚獻藝 共創美好回憶中華料理餐廳「湖光廳」，嚴選當季食材，以精湛手藝呈現經典粵菜美味。多國特色百匯「威尼斯餐廳」，秉持「在地，新鮮，健康」精神，主打歐亞中日多國美食吃到飽，超過200道菜品與甜點，松露茶碗蒸、帝王蟹仙貝煲湯、鮑魚土瓶蒸、爐烤牛排、生魚片、握壽司、和牛鐵板燒等特色料理，以及安平漁港產地直送的海釣魚獲，全都無限量供應，美食琳瑯滿目，讓人大快朵頤！

stays.searchText: 福爾摩沙遊艇酒店 福爾摩沙酒店股份有限公司 臺南市旅館355號 臺南市 安平區 安平路988號 聽臺灣的故事，從府城開始讀府城的生活，從福爾摩沙遊艇酒店開始福爾摩沙遊艇酒店座落於安平港水景灣畔，與安平古堡隔灣相望，步行至安平老街只要５分鐘，是台灣唯一擁有遊艇碼頭的酒店，可搭乘遊艇探索府城400年的人文歷史、溯源台灣。在旅行中實踐永續理念酒店鄰近市區交通便利，卻擁有度假景點的悠閒自在，陸續獲得「綠建築鑽石級」標章、「友善自行車旅宿」認證、「環保餐廳」標章、「環保旅店」標章、「環保標章使用證書」銅級環保旅館，以及「臺南優質旅館認證」等殊榮。融合在地脈絡與頂級享受入住酒店免費使用超夢幻的無邊際泳池、SPA水療池、三溫暖、抱石&攀岩區、槌球場、親子遊戲室、兒童電動車等多項設施，以及頗受廣大旅客喜愛的搭遊艇賞海景、水上遊憩活動(SUP、海洋獨木舟、水上自行車)、親子手作課程、漫遊安平文化導覽等付費行程，邀請旅人停下腳步，探索府城在地風情與安平海灣美景，適合家庭親子來台南旅遊的住宿首選。藍海白金意象 高規格宴會廳曾於2024年榮獲總統指定520就職國宴場地及友邦元首住宿酒店，福爾摩沙遊艇酒店的國際宴會廳，備有視聽設備，活動舞台，滿足各種規模的婚宴、工商會議餐敘等活動，一樓的「鳳凰廳／丹桂廳／寰宇廳」，全廳方正俐落，動線規劃暢通無礙，挑高8米無樑柱設計，東方內蘊紅牆時尚奢華，宏偉水晶吊燈錯落有致，極大視野空間，可容納一千人。位於三樓的「水景廳／海灣廳」氣派寬敞，全廳無樑柱，舞台視野通透，襯托出無與倫比的氣派奢華，搭配雙邊7米挑高玻璃帷幕，輕透陽光將廳內渲染成金色夢幻天堂，宴會佳餚由國宴廚藝團隊親自操刀，精湛手藝，結合在地特色食材，巧妙融合多種菜系風味，將經典菜色提升至新境界。國宴名廚獻藝 共創美好回憶中華料理餐廳「湖光廳」，嚴選當季食材，以精湛手藝呈現經典粵菜美味。多國特色百匯「威尼斯餐廳」，秉持「在地，新鮮，健康」精神，主打歐亞中日多國美食吃到飽，超過200道菜品與甜點，松露茶碗蒸、帝王蟹仙貝煲湯、鮑魚土瓶蒸、爐烤牛排、生魚片、握壽司、和牛鐵板燒等特色料理，以及安平漁港產地直送的海釣魚獲，全都無限量供應，美食琳瑯滿目，讓人大快朵頤！

stays.description: 胖卡親子民宿有4間主題式親子友善房型，提供質感溜滑梯與多樣安全兒童遊具設備，還有一應俱全親子住宿備品，消毒鍋、嬰兒床、兒童餐椅、兒童澡盆、奶瓶清潔備品；是親子輕鬆住宿歡樂享受的首選。胖卡鄰近安平景點，提供主題式溜滑梯親子房。，呈現異國風情；，跟隨熱氣球飄飛天空追尋夢想；有可愛大小企鵝陪伴入眠，讓小朋友可以盡情探索森林天地。胖卡最懂親子客的需求~，讓入住的大人小孩們能在台南慢吃、慢活、並能舒適地度過每個入住「胖卡」的夜晚，孩子的幸福笑臉是做父母最想看見的。
stays.descriptionEn: Panka Family-Friendly B&B offers four themed family-friendly rooms, featuring high-quality slides and a variety of safe children's play equipment. It also provides comprehensive family accommodations, including sterilizers, baby cribs, children's dining chairs, baby bathtubs, and bottle-cleaning supplies, making it the top choice for a relaxing and enjoyable family stay.Located near the attractions of Anping, Panka offers themed rooms with slides for families. The Bohemian Double Room showcases exotic charm; the Hot Air Balloon Quad Room invites you to soar through the skies and chase dreams with hot air balloons; the Penguin Igloo Room lets you fall asleep accompanied by adorable penguins; and the Nordic Forest Room allows children to explore a magical forest world.Panka truly understands the needs of families, ensuring that both adults and children can savor the slow pace of life in Tainan and spend every night at Panka comfortably. A child’s happy smile is the most cherished sight for parents.

stays.name: 胖蝸牛親子民宿
stays.description: 「胖蝸牛」鄰近安平老街、安平古堡、億載金城等觀光景點，有著安平在地特色主題式溜滑梯親子民宿，民宿共有三種房型：二樓古堡房、三樓運河房及四樓Totoro樹屋房，每種房型皆以安平的特色做裝潢佈置。裝潢皆採用進口超耐磨木頭地板、每間房間內設置兒童溜滑梯，及提供通過安全檢驗的親子互動/益智玩具，讓您的寶貝能盡情安全地玩耍。浴室皆為乾濕分離，採用日本衛浴第一品牌TOTO衛浴設備，並且提供兒童專用的盥洗用具、兒童澡盆、幼兒馬桶坐墊、造型孩童浴袍等，讓您和家人能安心地帶寶貝來居住。民宿大門及每間房間我們都採用先進密碼電子鎖，大門及一樓公共空間皆裝設24小時監視器，所以非常安全。一樓設置兒童遊戲空間、親子天下童書繪本及公共廚房、並提供大型飲水機及冰箱供您全家人使用。本民宿為親子友善空間，一樓公共廚房內備有Combi奶瓶消毒鍋、奶瓶刷、奶瓶清潔劑等，讓媽媽出門旅遊期間不須煩惱小小孩奶瓶清潔消毒問題。且備用大同電鍋，方便爸比媽咪加熱嬰幼兒副食品。「胖蝸牛」希望入住的旅客都能在台南慢吃、慢活、並能舒適地度過每個入住「胖蝸牛」的夜晚，同行小朋友也能玩得開心、盡情放電，孩子的幸福笑臉是做父母最想看見的。

stays.searchText: 胖蝸牛親子民宿 胖蝸牛親子民宿 臺南市民宿164號 臺南市 安平區 州平二街15號 「胖蝸牛」鄰近安平老街、安平古堡、億載金城等觀光景點，有著安平在地特色主題式溜滑梯親子民宿，民宿共有三種房型：二樓古堡房、三樓運河房及四樓Totoro樹屋房，每種房型皆以安平的特色做裝潢佈置。裝潢皆採用進口超耐磨木頭地板、每間房間內設置兒童溜滑梯，及提供通過安全檢驗的親子互動/益智玩具，讓您的寶貝能盡情安全地玩耍。浴室皆為乾濕分離，採用日本衛浴第一品牌TOTO衛浴設備，並且提供兒童專用的盥洗用具、兒童澡盆、幼兒馬桶坐墊、造型孩童浴袍等，讓您和家人能安心地帶寶貝來居住。民宿大門及每間房間我們都採用先進密碼電子鎖，大門及一樓公共空間皆裝設24小時監視器，所以非常安全。一樓設置兒童遊戲空間、親子天下童書繪本及公共廚房、並提供大型飲水機及冰箱供您全家人使用。本民宿為親子友善空間，一樓公共廚房內備有Combi奶瓶消毒鍋、奶瓶刷、奶瓶清潔劑等，讓媽媽出門旅遊期間不須煩惱小小孩奶瓶清潔消毒問題。且備用大同電鍋，方便爸比媽咪加熱嬰幼兒副食品。「胖蝸牛」希望入住的旅客都能在台南慢吃、慢活、並能舒適地度過每個入住「胖蝸牛」的夜晚，同行小朋友也能玩得開心、盡情放電，孩子的幸福笑臉是做父母最想看見的。

stays.description: 自在家民宿，是一位愛好旅行的室內設計師打造了一間位在承載安平歷史底蘊的運河畔，巷口是知名依蕾特布丁店，周氏蝦捲，散步十分鐘可以品嘗到文章牛肉湯，王氏魚皮的道地知名美食，距離安平老街古堡，或是中西區的赤崁樓等歷史文化，美食街區都只要短短的十分鐘車程，地點位置佳。自在家民宿的空間設計絕對讓您驚豔，帶著工業風的大廳卻有著溫度精緻感，還有一個天井可看到藍天，在擁擠的現代都市裡，這裡的每個房間的設計，擺設，或是使用的織品，備品，都經由設計師一一為您準備。四人房的格局更是一房一廳，有專屬自己的起居室，70寸大電視宛如視聽娛樂房，絕對是物超所值的選擇。屋主更用心於睡眠品質，提供名牌乳膠釋壓床墊，更特別的是還有提供精油蠟燭香氛讓可人在check in時可以挑選自己喜歡的香氣，帶入房間使用，暖檯燈的設計更是舒眠。這些都是自在家民宿規劃初為旅人打造的優質空間，希望能讓您放慢生活腳步 好好地渡個假吧！

stays.nameEn: TayouanVilla Heritage WholeHouse Stay in Anping Tainan downtown
stays.description: 安平 X 臺窩灣Mosa Tayouan Villa 臺窩灣民居 台灣之名，一說源自來台南安平的舊稱“台窩灣” 建於1947年的「臺窩灣民居」，為安平歐姓家族的古厝。老建築費時3年整修，廚房和盥洗室已改建為現代化設備。除此之外，保留了70年正統臺灣老厝精華，前庭空間佇立著「日月麒麟」照牆。牆下有台灣圖案花圃，洗石子外牆上，有著台南虱目魚的圖形，壁上還有蚵、招潮蟹、白鷺鷥的立+陶磚，展現古厝所在的安平特色。臺灣民居 X 張粒才出自木匠大師「貓排」張粒才之手民居建築設計別具特色，木匠大師張粒才「貓排」依循傳統工法建成穿斗式三合院，宅外門廊至院子的前半段，上有屋頂叫「抱廈」為安平獨有建築型式。Tayouan Villa 配備中式起居室、前庭花園水池、後花園廊道、中式涼亭及4間雙人臥室共265平方公尺，非常適合喜歡有獨立空間的旅客，彷彿置身夏宮之中。傳承 X 潘春源一窺彩繪大師潘春源的作品 正廳兩側及每個房門的楹聯、詩書畫作品除了作品係出自已故台南詩書畫家潘春源之手，正廳左壁四幅併連詩句，分別以行草、隸、魏碑、楷書，書寫洪自誠的菜根譚詩句。右壁則是淡泊明志的四季文人畫：春季是蘇東坡柳堤聽鶯；夏季是雲林子洗桐；秋季是陶淵明採菊東籬；冬季是林和靖孤山訪梅。
stays.descriptionEn: In 1915, the fourth year of the Taisho period in Japan, Cai Fen and Cai Jiang borrowed money from the treasury to purchase and build the Taiwowan residence. After the war, in 1946, the three brothers Ou Shanfa, Ou Shande, and Ou Haifa joined forces and hired Da Mu as chief engineer. My father built it as a traditional humanistic residence in Sanheyuan and hired master Pan Chunyuan to paint it himself.

stays.description: 坐落於台南市政府正對面，緊鄰安平文化園區、海安路藝術街；集結了住宿、休閒、餐飲、會議等功能於一體，為台南地區精緻路線走向的商務旅店代表。客房以六種風格情境打造您居家無法完成的夢想，103間客房。每間客房都是精心完美打造融合了先進的軟硬體設備、精緻高雅的訂製傢俱及體貼舒適的衛浴設備讓前來住宿的每位旅客都能得到完美無瑕的休憩體驗。旅客大廳以精緻高雅為設計主軸；簡約、明亮舒適的空間，伴著精心挑選的藝術品點綴，讓所有旅客可以輕鬆、自在的辦理登記、離房手續。完美的旅行，需要美食襯托；在臺邦帕莎餐廳享受著玻璃帷幕自然撒落的陽光悠閒的品嚐主廚精心烹調的豐盛營養早餐，給遠道而來的您一天滿滿的活力。臺邦商旅以”知性 雅緻”的服務文化及經營理念，為前來台南洽商或旅遊的旅客打造最有家的感覺的旅店。
stays.descriptionEn: Located directly across from the Tainan City Government, and adjacent to the Anping Cultural Park and the Hai'an Road Art Street, this hotel combines accommodation, leisure, dining, and conference facilities into one, making it a representative business hotel in the Tainan area with a refined and sophisticated approach. The hotel offers 103 guest rooms, each designed in one of six distinct styles and settings, creating a dream experience that cannot be achieved at home. Each room is meticulously designed, blending advanced hardware and software facilities, elegant custom-made furniture, and thoughtful, comfortable bathroom amenities, ensuring that every guest enjoys a flawless and relaxing stay.The lobby is designed with an emphasis on elegance and sophistication, featuring a simple, bright, and comfortable space adorned with carefully selected artworks, allowing all guests to easily and comfortably complete check-in and check-out procedures.A perfect trip requires a perfect meal. At the Taibang Pasha Restaurant, guests can enjoy a leisurely and nourishing breakfast prepared by the chef while basking in natural sunlight pouring through the glass curtains, giving visitors from afar a full day of energy.With a service culture and business philosophy centered on "intellect and elegance," Taibang Business Hotel offers guests visiting Tainan for business or tourism the warm and welcoming feeling of home.

stays.description: 民宿主人原本想要看世界，卻發現走了越多國，越是看見台灣的美。決定在喜愛的府城，打造一間民宿，分享旅行的樂趣，作為旅行的起點。 民宿命名為花水木，一方面傳達關懷大自然理念，同時紀念摯愛的家人。民宿主人的奶奶名為「牡丹」，是象徵幸福的百花之王 ，爺爺名為「水林」，意為川流不息的大海與森林。​結合祖父母名字，並以接待至親好友的心情，迎接每位旅客，成就了這間旅宿。民宿的努力，也獲交通部觀光局肯定，頒布「好客民宿」獎章。花水木文旅位於台南最富盛名的安平區，周圍古色古香。誠摯邀請熱愛旅行的你，到訪用心打造的民宿，自然放鬆心情，體驗台南單純美好的慢時光。

stays.descriptionEn: Huatian Hotel is a brand new elevator hotel located in Anping District, Tainan City.The location of Huatian Hotel is very convenient. You can easily reach international attractions after a good sleep without spending too much time on transportation. The B&B provides an elevator, eliminating the trouble of carrying luggage.The lobby is spacious and well-lit. The floor uses warm wood tiles and is matched with green plants to create a comfortable space suitable for travelers to communicate and relax. In addition, walking 200 meters from the flower field, you can reach Tainan's famous Zhuxiangyuan Wengtan Chicken, Hongpin Beef Soup, Carbonara Mari⋯ and other well-known restaurants, eliminating the hassle of traveling.If you plan to visit Tainan’s Anping District, this is definitely an accommodation option worth considering!

stays.description: 荷蘭村汽車旅館座落於台南市安平區，外館採用17世紀華麗、雕塑性強烈的巴洛克建築，加上緩緩轉動的風車是代表著荷蘭村汽車旅館獨有的特色，入住貴賓彷彿置身於熱情浪漫的歐洲世界。本館鄰近安平古蹟、永華市政府、台南地方法院；著名的旅遊景點有億載金城、林默娘公園、安平舊港、安平古堡、安平老街、小吃、安平樹屋…..等；更離台南著名的『花園夜市』僅10分鐘車程。全館全區按摩浴缸、浴室電視；部分房型按摩椅或情趣椅、三溫暖紅外線烤箱、精油蒸氣浴等設備。並提供免費WIFI上網服務。本館不但是政府立案合法旅館、服務品質更佳、歷年均被市府評為優等旅館，出差、休閒、度假，荷蘭村安平館是貴賓最佳住房選擇!!!

stays.name: 赤坂旅宿
stays.description: 安平，是台灣的起源台南，是我的源起時光流逝，安平仍保有300年前的歷史風貌，安平港區的繁華與興衰，見證了時代的推移。曾經的風華，已蛻變為創新的思維。老街裡的新風貌，已在這裡悄悄的生根，所以生生不息。我，也在台南，茁壯成長！時光依舊蒼翠，我已不再年輕，歲月必教我智慧，但我仍保有童心。人生路上不會永遠平順無波，我的房子會為你燃起篝火，然後擁抱著你的疲憊，讓你可以安心入睡。藍灰相間的廳堂，是沙灘與大海的色澤，有光才有色，我們總會為你留下一盞光，讓你可以真切的感受到房子的温暖，在沙發上閉上雙眼，想像著海浪的聲音，輕輕的為自己哼唱一首歌～～If we're caught in a wave, I will carry you over～～～安平，帶著晚霞的日落，有著豐富飽滿的色彩，很美！我們也希望能為你們留下充滿色彩的美好回憶。旅行的初心，就是讓自己快樂的閃閃發光。獨享設備戶外：停車空間（可停１台小車，停車時無法關院子門），走路１分鐘另有３個戶外停車位客廳：沙發、電視、麻將（非電動麻將）廚房／餐廳：雙口電磁爐、熱水壺、各式飲料、啤酒、瓶裝水、吧台桌、餐桌、餐椅（無提供個人使用之碗筷）房間：電視、床、床墊、無線網路、MOD、桌子、椅子、馬桶、淋浴間、沐浴用品（含一日茶道＜洗髮乳、沐浴乳、>、浴巾、吹風機)其它：室內拖鞋
stays.descriptionEn: Set in Tainan, Akasaka Family Villa is a recently renovated accommodation, 3.9 km from Chihkan Tower and 4.1 km from Tainan Confucius Temple. This property offers access to a balcony, free private parking and free WiFi. The property is non-smoking and is located 38 km from Neimen Zihjhu Temple.Offering a terrace with quiet street views, this villa also has a flat-screen TV, a well-equipped kitchen with a fridge, a stovetop and a minibar, as well as 4 bathrooms with a bath and slippers. Additional in-room amenities include chocolates or cookies.Guests can also relax in the shared lounge area.Cishan Old Street is 45 km from the villa, while Kaohsiung Fudingjin Baoan Temple is 47 km away. Tainan Airport is 7 km from the property.

stays.description: 擁有50年歷史的日式洋房三合院 誕生於白河大地震後 見證台灣農村的轉變 接待世界各國的草根大使 傳續於明鄭時期諸葛--陳永華參軍 遺留台灣唯一後裔陳家子孫的聚落 官佃藝想田開民宿 值得您駐足品嘗歷史的文溫隔壁就是西拉雅國家風景區官田遊客中心，經常舉辦熱氣球及三鐵及單車及路跑及毛小孩活動，並設有台灣好行寧波官田觀光公車站，可連接新營隆田善化火車站，並暢遊柳營六甲官田善化山上大內等各景點，更設有Ubike站，可暢遊官田菱田風光各景點。官田非常適合慢遊
stays.descriptionEn: The 50-year-old Japanese-style courtyard house was built after the Baihe earthquake. It witnessed the transformation of rural Taiwan and received grassroots ambassadors from all over the world. It was inherited from the Ming Zheng period when Zhuge -- Chen Yonghua joined the army. The only descendants of the Chen family in Taiwan are left behind. The official homestay Yixiangtian opened a B&B. It is worth your stop to enjoy the warmth of history.Next door is the Guantian Visitor Center of the Siraya National Scenic Area, which often hosts hot air balloon, triathlon, cycling, road running and pet-friendly activities. There is also a Taiwan Travel Ningbo Guantian Sightseeing Bus Station, which can connect to Xinying Longtian Shanhua Railway Station and travel to various scenic spots such as Liuying Liujia Guantian Shanhua Mountain and Danei. There is also an Ubike station, which allows you to travel to various scenic spots in Guantian and Lingtian.

stays.name: 想半天民宿
stays.description: 我是道地的台南人，出生於稻米的故鄉-後壁。雖然我對台南非常熟悉，但左鎮這個地方對我來說卻是陌生的。在我的記憶裡，雲海日出是高山峻嶺才有的曇花一現，但四年前某次的因緣際會，讓我改變了想法；我親眼目睹在清晨、低海拔長滿刺竹的山林間，竟湧現出濃厚且流動的雲層，伴隨著太陽自中央山脈稜線上緩緩探出，那一刻，真是太美了！景物如同一幅山水潑墨畫，竹林末梢勾勒出雲海的層次，猶如仙境，令人陶醉....。那為什麼民宿要取名想半天呢？說來話長，當初為了民宿的命名，我就想了好久，有一派友人建議直接以門牌號取名為「岡林42之1」，乍聽之下有一點心動，本想以此為名，但又有另一派友人，發現此處春秋之際，氣候涼爽宜人，建議取名為「岡林涼」，當下我又心動了，認為氣候涼爽的岡林，值得用這個名字推廣，試想如果客人打電話來，我拿起電話回答，“岡林涼您好“，客人一定會倍感親切！不過仔細想想，那群人是要害我的，我不能如他們的意啊，想了半天，到底民宿要命何名呢？那就叫想半天吧！這裡是個鳥不生蛋的地方，非常安靜，歡迎大家前來想半天品嚐「無聊」！想半天的寧靜，寧靜的想半天。
stays.descriptionEn: I am a native Tainan native, born in Houbi, the hometown of rice.Although I am very familiar with Tainan, Zuozhen is a strange place to me. In my memory, the sunrise over the sea of ​​clouds is a short-lived phenomenon that often occurs in the mountains. However, a chance encounter four years ago changed my mind. I witnessed with my own eyes that in the early morning, among the lowland forests covered with thorny bamboos, there were actually dark and flowing clouds, and the sun slowly emerged from the ridge of the Central Mountain Range. At that moment, it was so beautiful! The scenery is like a landscape splash-ink painting, with the tips of the bamboo forest outlining the layers of the sea of ​​clouds. It is like a fairyland, intoxicating...This is a deserted place, very quiet, everyone is welcome to come in and think for a while and act "bored"!I want peace for half a day. I want peace for half a day.

stays.description: 「台南．山居166」為獨棟山莊渡假別墅，座落於新化虎頭埤旁的幽靜山丘上，鄰近新化老街、新化國家植物園、二寮觀日亭、大坑休閒農場、九層嶺生態園區…等多處知名景點，距離國道3號交流道更是僅需車程10分鐘的距離，相當便利。 「台南新化．山居166渡假別墅」獨自享有百坪的花草庭院，繽紛花草搭配亮麗的庭園造景，更顯綠意盎然。其內部格局更為完善，純白色的主體建築，擁有寬敞的客廳及餐廳，並設有二至四人的雅房空間及三人和室房，整棟可容納8~10人。屋內寬敞明亮，舒適宜人使得整體空間呈現溫馨、親切的居家旅宿氛圍。 「台南新化．山居166渡假別墅」提供一處放鬆樂活的渡假空間，讓您在專屬的渡假別墅中享有寧靜無擾的山居生活。絕對是處相當適合安排家族渡假、享受親子之樂的渡假美地！ ＊＊ 一次只接待一組客人，快來搶先訂下專屬的別墅假期！

stays.description: 宇田商旅E HOTEL，從科技人出差需求出發，全區寬頻上網服務。南科最高商旅獨享美景，風格簡約沉穩。客房全部皆為獨立空調及對外通風窗戶，提供商務人士及各地旅人寧靜的休憩空間。 各式精緻客房、貴賓交誼廳、會議研討室、池畔早餐，並備有地下室平面汽車位，讓出差、渡假的房客能充電休息，展現經營者對貴賓的用心。---Enjoy our Service. Enhance your Energy.2020年初在臺南科學園區周邊第一間住商型旅館-「宇田商旅E Hotel」對外營運。 座落於陽光大道上，靠近兒南、蓮潭公園，並有健身房、游泳池、籃球場等設施；緊鄰南科火車站、國道3號善化交流道及國道8號新市交流道。大廳明亮舒適，24H服務櫃台，並備有咖啡機、無線充電，期盼旅客有如回到家般的安心自在。---HOME Away From HOME 您遠行的家----

stays.description: 本商務型汽車旅館座落於台南南科核心地段，鄰近科學園區與主要交通幹道，地理位置優越，無論是商務出差或短期休憩皆十分便利。館內規劃共43間精緻客房，融合現代設計與舒適機能，每間房皆配備專屬車庫，確保隱私與便利性。客房空間寬敞明亮，設有高速網路、智慧影音系統與高品質寢具，提供旅客放鬆與高效率兼具的住宿體驗。旅館同時注重安靜與安全，打造一處能讓商務人士在繁忙行程中安心休憩、快速充電的理想據點。
stays.descriptionEn: This business-oriented motel is located in the core area of the Southern Taiwan Science Park in Tainan, in close proximity to the science park and major transportation routes. Its prime location offers excellent convenience for both business travelers and short-term stays.The property features a total of 43 well-appointed guest rooms, thoughtfully designed to combine modern aesthetics with functional comfort. Each room is equipped with a private garage, ensuring both privacy and convenience.All guest rooms are spacious and well-lit, and are furnished with high-speed internet access, smart multimedia systems, and premium bedding, providing guests with a stay that balances relaxation and efficiency.The motel also emphasizes a quiet and secure environment, creating an ideal retreat where business travelers can rest with peace of mind and quickly recharge amid busy schedules.

stays.description: 新營館於2005年落成，別名「歐悅情人館」； 全館34種風格套房， 為了打造浪漫時尚的新營情人館，給顧客的氣氛是一個可以讓情侶們輕鬆且會有另一種浪漫的新甜蜜，彷彿如熱戀般的甜蜜，注重每一個細節，認真的呈現出最美麗的一面，不論是時尚與東方或是浪漫宮廷風，都是為了來給旅人在旅途中的一個新景點與新浪漫時光。而每年到了該地區最盛大的盛會---「鹽水蜂炮季」，湧入大批遊客讓近水樓台的新營館一房難求，在這裡絕對能感受到台南的文化特色，與在地人的人情溫暖，讓每位旅客心中留下深刻的回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: Oh-Ya Motel - Xinying Branch, also known as Oh-Ya Sweatheart Motel, was established in 2005. The 34 romantic and stylish suites provide lovers and couples a relaxing, romantic and sweet atmosphere that reminds them of the sweet feeling of being in love. Every detail is carefully considered to present the most beautiful outcome. Whether it's the trendy eastern look or the romantic palace style, the goal is to give our guests a room with a fresh and romantic look while they are traveling. Each year during Yanshui District's Lantern Festival, thousands of tourists come to this area to witness the magnificent event. During that time, all the rooms at the Oh-Ya Xinying Branch will be completely booked because our hotel provides a great view of the festival. You will definitely be able to experience Tainan's local culture and hospitality here and have lasting memories.

stays.description: 溫莎堡汽車旅館(豪情股份有限公司)-經營者累積了二十幾年服務業的經營理念，樹立了良好的制度、健全的組織，品質至上，服務為先及卓越的管理，來提升客人的滿意度與再消費意願。為此，我們積極參與政府機關的認證與評鑑，並榮獲交通部觀光局三星級評鑑(汽車旅館最高等級)及獲頒台南市衛生優良店等殊榮。我們堅持著五心級的服務-用心、專心、貼心、細心、關心，為每一位賓客打造一個優質、溫馨、浪漫、舒適的好地方，讓您來到溫莎堡有回家的感覺。本旅館佔地1800坪，是南部高速公路下唯一鬧中取靜與住宿休息的好選擇。我們時時用心，讓您住的安心我們時時更新，讓您永遠歡心--溫莎堡歡迎您的光臨--
stays.descriptionEn: WSB Motel has over 20 years of history in the field, and thus a well-established system, strong organization, and a service-oriented mentality striving to provide superlative service and magnificent management to keep our guests satisfied again and again. We are actively involved with government certification and inspection efforts, and have been honored with a three-star ranking from the Ministry of Transport’s Tourism Bureau — the highest such ranking a motel can receive — as well as awards for excellence from the Tainan City Government. We are committed to offering dedicated, professional, considerate, detail-oriented, and passionate service, and to giving every guest a warm, comfortable place to stay; a veritable second home. Sitting on nearly 6000 square meters of land, we are an oasis of peace along the Southern Expressway. With our commitment to giving you peace of mind and to always offering something fresh, you’re always welcome at WSB Motel.

stays.name: 台南老爺行旅
stays.description: 老爺酒店集團旗下風格設計品牌「老爺行旅」，以the place為名，強調與飯店所在地意象文化的深度連結。首發作品座落於台灣最有故事的台南，於2014年年底開幕，為集團內第12家飯店。台南老爺行旅，由荷蘭Mecanoo建築師事務所操刀，並邀約英國dpa燈光設計顧問等國際級團隊共同合作，以新舊融合作為主軸，大量使用窗花、磚瓦、木材等元素，讓台南的地貌、傳統意象透過現代摩登的設計在飯店內重現。飯店座落於台南市東區精華地段，與南紡夢時代百貨共構，為台南新興據點。館內計有223間客房，餐飲空間設有甘粹義式餐廳、廿一酒吧、回甘咖啡，另備有輕型健身房及洗衣室。 台南老爺行旅著重於當地文化的呈獻，因此特於館內設有共120坪的展覽空間，並於大廳一隅成立甘情商號設計產品店，精選在地設計師與職人的傑作，推件質感的設計作品與工藝好物，讓文化透過深刻設計，在旅人的來往間傳遞交流。
stays.descriptionEn: The design hotel brand of Royal Hotels & Resorts, The Place that sets to connect with local cultures wrote its first chapter in a city full of stories – Tainan in the end of 2014, as the group’s 12th hotel. The Place Tainan is a masterpiece of collective efforts, including the architecture firm Mecanoo of the Netherlands, the lighting from the DPA of the UK and other international teams. To showcase the theme of new and old, window grille, bricks and wood materials are widely used in the hotel, reflecting Tainan’s landscape and traditional images through modern design.Located in downtown Tainan, the east district, The Place Tainan shares the same complex with the T.S. Dream Mall, a new must-go of Tainan. The hotel has 223 rooms, the Ganchui Italian Restaurant, the Bar 21 and the Huigan Café, as well as the fitness center and the laundry room. To highlight local arts and culture, The Place Tainan also features an exhibition space (400 square meters) and the Ganching Shop on one corner of the lobby, presenting selective works from local designers and craftsmen. It is hoped that local culture through sophisticated design works and artifacts could be better appreciated and shared amongst travelers.

stays.name: 台南遠東香格里拉
stays.description: 台南遠東香格里拉位於台南火車站的正後方，交通便捷。大廳設計於2009獲美國第29屆Gold key Award《最佳大廳設計獎》。飯店樓高38層，擁有331間客房，皆可俯覽台南日夜景致，標準房型15坪更是台南飯店中最寬敞的客房，設有健身房、戶外游泳池、SPA芳療等設施。飯店內有醉月樓、遠東Café自助餐廳、大廳茶軒、THE MEZZ牛排龍蝦餐酒館、品味坊等五間餐廳與酒吧，提供中西式料理美食。並設有可容納1,000名賓客的遠東宴會廳、南台灣唯一圓形劇場式的國際會議廳與多功能會議室，滿足各種國際會議與宴會等需求，提供國內外商務休閒旅客的香格里拉獨有的殷勤待客情。飯店毗鄰國立成功大學與FE21’Mega大遠百購物中心，從飯店可輕鬆步行到台南市火車站，而前往台南機場與高鐵站，也分別僅需15分鐘與25分鐘的車程。
stays.descriptionEn: Shangri-La Far Eastern, Tainan, located in downtown Tainan, offers 331 guestrooms and suites, three restaurants, one lounge, one bar and seven banqueting and function rooms. The 38-storey hotel has the largest guestrooms in the city spanning a minimum of 50 square meters. All rooms showcase an elegant, Asian-inspired decor with contemporary accents and panoramic view that invariably distinguish the hotel from other luxury hotels in Taiwan. In addition, the Health Club provides state-of-the-art fitness machines, aerobic room, sauna facilities, and an outdoor heart-shaped swimming pool. Sports lovers will have a happy and relaxing time here while exercising.The hotel is also within walking distance of the city''s main railway and bus stations, while Tainan''s domestic airport and Taiwan High Speed Railway (THSR) station are just a 15-minute and 25-minute drive respectively.

stays.descriptionEn: Evergreen Plaza Hotel (Tainan) is located in the eastern district of Tainan City, a place filled with a thriving arts & culture atmosphere, close to the Tainan Municipal Cultural Center, and has received numerous renowned performers and celebrity guests from around the world. With widely known exquisite cuisine and attentive service, the hotel was awarded the first Five Star Rating Hotel in Tainan by Tourism Bureau. The hotel features 197 superior rooms, a gym, outdoor landscape swimming pool, sauna, and other leisure facilities, as well as Chinese and Western restaurants, versatile meeting spaces and banquet rooms, etc., and it is suitable for all kinds of conferences, meetings, or banquets. Surrounding environment includes a well-known ecological Barclay Memorial Park and convenient shopping department, only 15 to 20 minutes' walk from Tainan Railway Station, Tainan High Speed Rail Station, or highway Rende Interchange. With convenient transportation, the hotel is suitable for travelers of business, as well as leisure, such as tasting Tainan snacks, touring historic monuments, Taijiang National Park, Southwest Coast National Scenic Area, and Siraya National Scenic Area. stays.description: 文化信然商旅座落於台南市東區，臨近台南市文化中心、國際巴克禮公園，位置四通八達，交通便利，搭乘高鐵接駁公車奇美醫院線至(崇明、崇學站)下車步行至飯店只要1分鐘，台南火車站、台南機場車程距離本飯店僅需10~20分鐘，鄰近府城知名古蹟景點，赤崁樓、延平郡王祠、孔廟等，飯店提供免費出借腳踏車，讓您騎程單車暢遊府城、逛古蹟、品嚐小吃。搭乘觀光巴士88、99公車踏遍台南古蹟，逛安平老街、參觀四草野生動物保護區，探索鹽田生態文化村，飯店附近生活機能相當方便，是您到台南尋幽訪古的最佳休憩首選。近台南市科技園區，並與園區內廠商簽訂住宿合約，提供來自各國的工作人員或洽公的客戶溫馨舒適的住宿，因此來到台灣出差總是指定要住文化信然商旅。文化信然商旅篤信：待以上賓之禮，是款待客人的最佳服務，因此從賓至如歸的豪華客房 到專業機能的商務中心，我們 都堅持國際化的宏觀經營和無微不至的細膩周到，使您感覺賓至如歸，不論旅行或出差都是您最好的選擇，文化信然商旅對每一位旅客以服務用心、待客用心、深得您心為導向，以誠信品質服務客人，努力讓客人把文化信然商旅當作在台南第二個家為訴求。
stays.descriptionEn: CulturalTrust Hotel sits in Tainan City’s East District, near the Tainan City Culture Center and Barclay Memorial Park. Transportation is easy and convenient, with the hotel only a minute’s walk from the Chongxue or Chongming stops on the Chi Mei Hospital high-speed rail shuttle bus route. From Tainan Train Station or Tainan Airport, it is only a 10-20 minute drive. CulturalTrust Hotelneighbors many of Tainan’s well-known historical landmarks, including Chihkan (Chikan) Cultural Area, Guoxingye's Shrine (Yanping Junwang Temple), and the Confucius Temple, and provides free bicycle rental to help you enjoy the city, its history, and its food at your own pace. You can also take tourist buses 88 and 99 to travel Tainan’s historical sites, see Anping Old Street, visit Sihcao (Sicao) Wildlife Preserve, or explore Tainan Salt Pan Eco-Village. Shopping is also convenient, with several commercial districts, along with T.S. Mall and Poya Living Mart, We are committed to offering the best service to our guests, and as part of that we not only offer luxurious rooms, but also a business center, demonstrating our commitment to international perspective and attention to detail. Every guest is a VIP to us, and we strive to provide dedicated, quality service to all. We hope you will make CulturalTrust Hotel your home away from home.

stays.name: 五隆園咖啡民宿
stays.description: 台南東山五隆園咖啡民宿冬暖夏涼、四季如春，早晨有雲海、雲瀑環繞，四周有中花園一般。景觀可瞭視雲林縣台西海岸線至嘉義布袋港東石港海平線、台南縣全景、台南市大遠百、高雄市興達港二支大煙囪。夜間園區內有罕見蝙蝠屋窩、整個嘉南平原夜景。園區內還有有機果園（蔬菜、水果）、咖啡樹園區、神奇罕見的鹼水池。園區美食簡餐合菜都採用山中最自然無污染冷泉（本冷泉對於皮膚過敏膚質亦有改變）所沖煮，一定讓各位回味無窮，本民宿有提供無線上網。而在園區旁也有登山步道：可從園區到大凍山、大獅嶺、小獅嶺和天池。附近有關子嶺溫泉、水火同源、崁頂福安宮、崁頭山仙公廟、曾文水庫、小瑞士出水口……等風景觀光區。車程從本園區出發大約15～30分鐘左右。
stays.descriptionEn: Wulong Coffee is a bed & breakfast located in Tainan’s Dongshan area, which boasts a mild climate making it like springtime all year round. The views are spectacular, spreading all the way out to the western coastline from Taixi in Yunlin County along to Budai Harbor and Dongshih (Dongshi) Harbor in Chiayi, and covering virtually all of Tainan County out past Tainan City to the two prominent smokestacks of Kaohsiung City’s Xingda Harbor. By night, the lights of the Jianan Plains stretch out in front of you. Wulong Coffee Bed & Breakfast itself boasts organic gardens of fruit and vegetables, a coffee plantation, and even a saltwater pond. The food on offer, whether full meals or simple snacks, is cooked using natural, unpolluted, locally sourced spring water, creating a peerless flavor. The bed & breakfast also offers wireless Internet access. The mountains nearby boast beautiful hiking trails, passing from the premises through Mt. Dadong, Dashihling (Dashiling), Siaoshihling (Xiaoshiling), and Tianchi, while nearby destinations include the hot springs of Guanzihling (Guanziling), Fire and Water Cave, Kanding Fuan Temple, Mt. Kantou Xiangong Temple, and Zengwun(Zengwen) Reservoir, all reachable within a 15 to 30 minute drive from Wulong Coffee Bed & Breakfast.

stays.name: 向陽田園居民宿
stays.description: 在地作家楊好，為感謝鄉親的疼愛，也為圓一個能提升在地經濟發展的夢想，提供樓房，成立「向陽田園居民宿」，由蘇美惠與楊維蓉婆媳共同經營。倚窗擁綠意，草色入眼簾，推窗而望，遠處椰子樹及綠田，近處果樹和花，可眺望關子嶺頂，感受綠色慢活生活。每個房間均有2面八角窗，高挑寬敞、光線好、舒適木板，堅持全日曬被單棉被，展現陽光的香氣與純淨。早餐提供自種天然蔬果與行銷在地美食，設有旅客專用新廚房，另提供腳踏車免費使用，多樣化植物花園，讓客人驚豔不已。帶旅客採果及下田農事工作；製作破布子、辣椒醬、洛神花醬、芒果醬，給旅客最純樸的特殊體驗。推動笑笑功、跳跳功、慢跑、按推舒壓、練太極拳及「與作家有約」活動，帶給旅客歡笑與運動風潮。熱情好客，提供交通接駁及引導旅遊路線，免費帶國際旅客及老人旅遊兼解說，而客制化服務最受感動。官網詳細介紹旅遊景點與按季節規畫套裝行程。貼心協助辦理新婚迎娶，已有25對新人及親友團入住。本店家曾榮獲台南百家好店、金讚百家好店、台南旅宿網路票選第一名、環保旅店及交通部國際媒體踩線圓滿成功。今（107）年參加交通部首辦「精彩萬分.百大好客票選活動」，榮獲交通部107年百大好客民宿獎、107年十大好客民宿菁英獎及107年好客民宿特殊體驗主題全國首獎。
stays.descriptionEn: Sunny Villa—Our sincerity brings you a memorable journey.Sunny Villa is run by a retired teacher Mei-hui Su and her daughter-in-law Wei-rong Yang. “Sunny” is our attitude—we are always optimistic. We treat every visitor as our close friend, hoping to radiate soothing warmth anytime. On July 14, 2012, Sunny Villa was reported in Liberty Times, “Sunny Villa often sponsors local cultural and artistic activities and it puts Dongshan Section in the spotlight.” It was also chosen as one of the best stores in Tainan in 2014. Sunny Villa earnestly invites you to join our rural and humanistic feast.Director Hsu of Tainan City Government once saw our Honors Award Wall and said, “Sunny Villa is Miss Ho Yang’s (a writer) home.” Many visitors like Miss Yang’s wonderful sense of humor. Qin-han (a famous writer) complimented Miss Yang as the most attractive pictue in Sunny Villa. We often invites writers to stay here so that the visitors get the chance to have a close contact with them.In our garden, we set up a board with the word “laughchi” on it to promote the popularity of “laughchi.” On June 26, 2014, Liberty Times Net reported, “Laughchi makes Sunny Villa famous overnight. Granny Wang could’t stop laughing and she asked her son to show their utmost appreciation to the host at Sunny Villa.” Besides, we advocate jogging in the country road. We run with our visitors all around the neighborhood. In this way, our visitors can stay healthy, and the local people join us to jog every day.Our guest rooms are named after the fruits we grow. The fruits are offered to our visitors for free. We hold the activity of fruit picking on local farms. Melons, dragon fruits, papayas, watermelons, tomatos, tangerines and longans are all local products. In addition, we like to share the information about the local customs, history, and people with our visitors.Our guest rooms are all laid with costly logs. Every room is pleasantly tidy and bright. All the sheets are purely clean with the sunny odor. In each room, you can see through the octangle windows a vista of green fields and coconut palms. You can simply do nothing but sit by the windows all day long watching the breathtaking sunrise, sunset and the beautiful panoramic views. The fresh air and the quiet country life will fully relax your body and soul.Mr. Lu (a well-known antique collector) is our frequent visitor. He has come here for fifty-four times. He said, “The room is big and comfortable. I can sleep well here.” Sunny Villa is also your best choice for class gathering or honeymoon. So far, sixteen newlyweds and their relatives have lodged here. Hakohato Sadao (a Japanese backpacker) gave so much praise to our hospitality. Mitchell, the retired chief of French Tourism Bureau, has stayed here for four times. He falls in love with our cordiality and friendliness.A report in Tainan City Industry Magazine says, “Sunny Villa—Its sincerity brings every visitor a memorable journey.” Our philosophy is LPCM. Love is the power to move forward. Passion is in our blood. Cultural heritage is our mission. Miracle stories in the region are waiting for us to explore.

stays.searchText: 向陽田園居民宿 向陽田園居民宿 臺南市民宿059號 臺南市 東山區 大客里凹仔腳56-7號 在地作家楊好，為感謝鄉親的疼愛，也為圓一個能提升在地經濟發展的夢想，提供樓房，成立「向陽田園居民宿」，由蘇美惠與楊維蓉婆媳共同經營。倚窗擁綠意，草色入眼簾，推窗而望，遠處椰子樹及綠田，近處果樹和花，可眺望關子嶺頂，感受綠色慢活生活。每個房間均有2面八角窗，高挑寬敞、光線好、舒適木板，堅持全日曬被單棉被，展現陽光的香氣與純淨。早餐提供自種天然蔬果與行銷在地美食，設有旅客專用新廚房，另提供腳踏車免費使用，多樣化植物花園，讓客人驚豔不已。帶旅客採果及下田農事工作；製作破布子、辣椒醬、洛神花醬、芒果醬，給旅客最純樸的特殊體驗。推動笑笑功、跳跳功、慢跑、按推舒壓、練太極拳及「與作家有約」活動，帶給旅客歡笑與運動風潮。熱情好客，提供交通接駁及引導旅遊路線，免費帶國際旅客及老人旅遊兼解說，而客制化服務最受感動。官網詳細介紹旅遊景點與按季節規畫套裝行程。貼心協助辦理新婚迎娶，已有25對新人及親友團入住。本店家曾榮獲台南百家好店、金讚百家好店、台南旅宿網路票選第一名、環保旅店及交通部國際媒體踩線圓滿成功。今（107）年參加交通部首辦「精彩萬分.百大好客票選活動」，榮獲交通部107年百大好客民宿獎、107年十大好客民宿菁英獎及107年好客民宿特殊體驗主題全國首獎。

stays.name: 柳營尖山埤渡假村
stays.description: 嘉南平原風景著名全臺，各具特色的旅遊景點星羅棋布其中，由台灣糖業公司經營的「柳營尖山埤渡假村」，以秀麗的自然景觀、完善的設施規劃以及親切的專業服務，成為南臺灣別具特色的渡假勝地，柳營尖山埤渡假村於觀光局的考核評鑑中，自97年起連續榮獲特優等觀光遊樂區的殊榮，再加上水庫週遭靜謐清幽的山水景緻，有如人間仙境、世外桃源。 在這裡，搭著遊湖船可以欣賞到湖岸邊的葉葉垂楊葉葉楓及湖面上葉葉扁舟葉葉蓬的美景，並且享受臺南道地的獨特美食。且讓自己及家人揮去生活的庸碌與繁忙，到柳營尖山埤渡假村攬勝、賞景、享受森林浴或野炊露營，暢徉於山林之樂。另外園區為豐富遊園行程特別規劃有漆彈、遊湖、獨木舟及游泳SPA的行程，讓每位來渡假的旅客，都能抱著滿滿的美好回憶返家。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the scenic Chianan Plain, Jianshanpi Resort, managed by Taiwan Sugar Corporation, is a unique vacation destination in southern Taiwan. With its beautiful natural scenery, well-planned facilities, and warm professional service, the resort has become a well-known leisure spot. Since 2008, it has been continuously awarded the highest honor as an “Outstanding Tourist Recreation Area” by the Taiwan Tourism Bureau. Surrounded by tranquil landscapes of lakes and hills, the resort offers a peaceful escape resembling a hidden paradise. Here, guests can take a lake cruise to admire the picturesque willows, maples, and boats drifting on the serene waters, while savoring authentic Tainan-style cuisine. It’s the perfect place to unwind from the hustle of daily life — enjoy sightseeing, forest bathing, outdoor barbecues, or camping with family and friends. For a richer experience, the resort also offers activities such as paintball, canoeing, lake tours, and swimming with SPA facilities, ensuring every visitor returns home with lasting, joyful memories.

stays.searchText: 柳營尖山埤渡假村 台灣糖業股份有限公司 臺南市旅館185號 臺南市 柳營區 旭山里60號 嘉南平原風景著名全臺，各具特色的旅遊景點星羅棋布其中，由台灣糖業公司經營的「柳營尖山埤渡假村」，以秀麗的自然景觀、完善的設施規劃以及親切的專業服務，成為南臺灣別具特色的渡假勝地，柳營尖山埤渡假村於觀光局的考核評鑑中，自97年起連續榮獲特優等觀光遊樂區的殊榮，再加上水庫週遭靜謐清幽的山水景緻，有如人間仙境、世外桃源。 在這裡，搭著遊湖船可以欣賞到湖岸邊的葉葉垂楊葉葉楓及湖面上葉葉扁舟葉葉蓬的美景，並且享受臺南道地的獨特美食。且讓自己及家人揮去生活的庸碌與繁忙，到柳營尖山埤渡假村攬勝、賞景、享受森林浴或野炊露營，暢徉於山林之樂。另外園區為豐富遊園行程特別規劃有漆彈、遊湖、獨木舟及游泳SPA的行程，讓每位來渡假的旅客，都能抱著滿滿的美好回憶返家。
