stays.name: 徠・歸仁飯店
stays.description: 漫步天下．慢步歸仁徠·歸仁飯店座落於極富人文色采的台南歸仁。作為歸仁新地標，象徵徠·歸仁對世界敞開雙門的態度，傳達徠·歸仁對世界旅人的溫度。徠·歸仁品牌核心：「三度兩味」。「三度」，即愛之溫度、體驗深度、文化寬度；「兩味」，即品味、回味。徠·歸仁注重以客為尊。 『徠』字由五個人字組成，代表著旅人、商人、家人、新人、歸人，希冀每位客人來到這裡，得以身、心、靈全面觸動，藉由環境和服務感受來源於人和自然的溫度，真正放下舟車勞頓的旅途疲憊，讓身心靈得以滋養，帶著笑容滿意而歸。徠·歸仁著重於當地文化的呈獻，整座飯店將本土特色與人文關懷，注入每一個建築物中，其中嘉德利雅園發想源於在地蘭花品種-嘉德麗雅；而紅瓦埕原料使用台灣傳統紅磚，讓文化透過用心設計，使來訪的旅人，能夠更貼近在地文化，感受當地的熱情與能量。內部擺設以真樸簡約路線為主，透過自然簡單的巧思設計，帶出高質感卻不失親和力的風格，使客人真正置身其中，營造出回『家』的感覺。徠·歸仁，願意傾聽，來自世界的聲音。
stays.descriptionEn: LAI HOTEL GUIREN is located in Guiren Township of Tainan with abundant historic and cultures. LAI HOTEL GUIREN is a new landmark in Guiren that shows the opening attitude to the world and express the warm care to travelers coming from other countries.LAI HOTEL GUIREN brand core: "three degrees and two flavors". The meaning of "three degrees" is a symbol of warm love, experience depth and culture width; "two flavors" expresses taste and recollection. We focus on customers' demands. The word "LAI" consist of five people, and it means travelers, businessmen, family members, newly-wed couple and home returners; we also expect each guest staying here can be inspired and experience the warm of people and nature with service and environment. Therefore, everyone can get rid of the fatigue caused by long journey, and the whole body and mind is nourished and go home in satisfaction.Moreover, we pay attention to present local culture and integrate the particular features and humanistic care in building design concepts, and Cattleya garden concept originates from the local orchid species- Cattleya, and Red Tile Castle was constructed in Taiwanese traditional red tiles with dedicated designs in order to let travelers experience much more local culture, passion and energy from local residence. The internal arrangement is a simple style to present high quality and affinity and customers can feel like live at "home" with natural and meticulous design concepts.LAI HOTEL GUIREN is willing to accept any viewpoint from the world.

stays.searchText: 徠・歸仁飯店 吉立寶投資股份有限公司 臺南市旅館331號 臺南市 歸仁區 中山路三段455號 漫步天下．慢步歸仁徠·歸仁飯店座落於極富人文色采的台南歸仁。作為歸仁新地標，象徵徠·歸仁對世界敞開雙門的態度，傳達徠·歸仁對世界旅人的溫度。徠·歸仁品牌核心：「三度兩味」。「三度」，即愛之溫度、體驗深度、文化寬度；「兩味」，即品味、回味。徠·歸仁注重以客為尊。 『徠』字由五個人字組成，代表著旅人、商人、家人、新人、歸人，希冀每位客人來到這裡，得以身、心、靈全面觸動，藉由環境和服務感受來源於人和自然的溫度，真正放下舟車勞頓的旅途疲憊，讓身心靈得以滋養，帶著笑容滿意而歸。徠·歸仁著重於當地文化的呈獻，整座飯店將本土特色與人文關懷，注入每一個建築物中，其中嘉德利雅園發想源於在地蘭花品種-嘉德麗雅；而紅瓦埕原料使用台灣傳統紅磚，讓文化透過用心設計，使來訪的旅人，能夠更貼近在地文化，感受當地的熱情與能量。內部擺設以真樸簡約路線為主，透過自然簡單的巧思設計，帶出高質感卻不失親和力的風格，使客人真正置身其中，營造出回『家』的感覺。徠·歸仁，願意傾聽，來自世界的聲音。

stays.name: 福爾摩沙花園酒店
stays.description: *「福爾摩沙花園酒店」座落於台南永康，為您提供一個靜謐舒適的度假環境。酒店擁有68間精緻客房，以「花園」為主題，帶領旅者探索台灣的自然之美與文化精髓，結合花園景觀、藝術創作及當地特色，提供獨具風格的住宿體驗。我們的專業服務團隊致力於為每位客人打造量身訂製的服務，無論是浪漫的蜜月旅行或是商務會議，「福爾摩沙花園酒店」都是您理想的選擇。酒店內設有豐富的設施，包括戶外游泳池、健身房、以及舒適的休閒區，讓您在繁忙的日常中找到放鬆的空間以永康在地的自然景觀為靈感，「福爾摩沙花園酒店」融合了當地文化與現代設計，提供一個鬧中取靜的度假場所。我們的專業服務將為您的假期及商務活動增添無限魅力。酒店創辦人對於這片土地懷有深厚的情感，誠摯邀請每位旅客暫停腳步，沉浸於永康的自然美景與人文氛圍中，深入體驗台灣的獨特風情。
stays.descriptionEn: ** The Formosa Garden Hotel is located in Yongkang, Tainan, offering you a tranquil and comfortable resort environment. Featuring 68 exquisitely designed rooms with a "garden" theme, the hotel guides guests to explore the natural beauty and cultural essence of Taiwan, combining garden landscapes, art installations, and local features to provide a unique accommodation experience.Our professional service team is dedicated to creating a tailored service for each guest. Whether it& #39;s a romantic honeymoon or a business meeting, the Formosa Garden Hotel is the ideal choice.The hotel boasts a wealth of facilities, including an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness center, and a comfortable relaxation area, allowing you to find a relaxing space amidst your busy daily life.Inspired by the natural landscape of Yongkang, the Formosa Garden Hotel blends local culture with modern design, providing a peaceful retreat amidst the bustling city. Our professional service will add immeasurable charm to your vacation and business activities.The hotel& #39;s founder has a deep affection for this land and sincerely invites every traveler to pause, immerse themselves in the natural beauty and cultural atmosphere of Yongkang, and deeply experience the unique charm of Taiwan.

stays.descriptionEn: Business Tourism X Culture: New Hearty ServicesSituated in Yongkang District, Tainan’s transportation hub, Justwin Grand Hotel is a Baroque-style masterpiece by celebrated architects, with the lofty interior and elevated ceilings letting in the pleasant sunshine by day and breathtaking starlight by night. Integrating cultural, historical and contemporary architectural elements with modern amenities in every aspect of life, from dining, transportation and entertainment to business activities, without a doubt, Justwin Grand Hotel is your perfect accommodation option!Justwin Grand Hotel is in the vicinity of Tainan Science Park and Yongkang Industrial Park, just 3 minutes (by car) from the freeway, 10 minutes from downtown Tainan and 20 minutes from the Taiwan High Speed Rail (THSR) Tainan Station. Equipped with a gym, saunas and steam rooms, this is definitely your best choice for business trips, sightseeing tours, accommodations, dining and conferences!Enjoy the New Hearty Services of Justwin Grand Hotel, where our friendly services will make you feel at home!

stays.name: 派森家
stays.description: 派森家民宿位於台南玉井，對面就是玉井虎頭山運動公園，清幽的環境，沒有喧鬧吵雜的聲音，在忙錄的生活中可以停下腳步休息一下，本民宿一樓設有客廳、餐桌、娛樂設施及冰箱，貼心提供即溶咖啡、即溶茶和小點心，不必擔心口渴或肚子餓。入住可享山光景色與免費 WiFi。派森家針對每一客房有獨立的設計，客房配有空調、平面電視、客房有衛浴、淋設施和熱水壺，部分客房附有獨立陽台或露台。 浴室皆有提供浴巾毛巾、吹風機，讓您享受輕鬆愉快的旅程。派森家對面就是虎頭山運動公園，公園位居虎頭山下，綠樹扶疏且生態多樣，良好的森林步道，讓您忙錄的生活中獲得平靜，公園裡吸取芬多精，放慢步調，享受放鬆的好去處。若您想要來趟不一樣的遊程，可到附近著名景點逛逛，如走馬賴農場、玉井白色教堂、有間冰舖芒果冰、南灜天文館、台南左鎮化石園區、西拉雅國家風景區、烏山頭文庫親水公園等景點。
stays.descriptionEn: Paison's B&B is located in Yujing, Tainan. Opposite is Yujing Hutoushan Sports Park. It has a quiet environment and no noisy sounds. You can stop and take a rest in the busy life. The first floor of this B&B has a living room and dining table. , entertainment facilities and refrigerators, and thoughtfully provide instant coffee, instant tea and snacks, so you don’t have to worry about being thirsty or hungry. Stay with mountain views and free WiFi.Paison has an independent design for each room. The rooms are equipped with air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, bathrooms, shower facilities and hot water kettles. Some rooms have independent balconies or terraces. Bath towels, hairdryers and toiletries are provided in the bathrooms, allowing you to enjoy a relaxing and enjoyable journey.Opposite Paison's house is the Hutoushan Sports Park. The park is located at the foot of Hutoushan. It has sparse green trees and a diverse ecology. It has good forest trails, allowing you to find peace in your busy life. In the park, you can absorb phytoncides and slow down your pace. , a great place to relax.If you want to take a different trip, you can visit nearby famous attractions, such as Zoumarai Farm, Yujing White Church, Youjian Ice Shop Mango Ice, Nanhui Planetarium, Tainan Zuozhen Fossil Park, Siraya National Scenic Area District, Wushantou Library Water Park and other attractions.

stays.description: 「藝海民宿」為合法民宿(台南市民宿300號)，座落於台南市-玉井區，雖然是在玉井山區，但民宿位置鄰近84號快速道路及台三線，交通便利，周邊生活機能完善，步行約3-5分鐘皆有超商、夜市及餐館。「藝海民宿」是隱藏在芒果故鄉的「文藝範」民宿，建築外觀為巴洛克風格，房內由主人親自彩繪以多元的藝術風格為主題設計，有如藝術之海，每間套房各有不同風格的彩繪壁畫及擁有舒適的住宿環境，讓旅客們身心靈都能良好的休憩。一個人從旅行中得到多少不在於他去過多少美麗的地方，而在於他在一個地方發現了多少美麗的故事。——阿蘭•德波頓我們的故事，則源於對藝術的熱愛。巴羅克風格外觀，不同風格的彩繪壁畫，不同年代的故事，我們讚美色彩，重現經典，藝術交匯成海。在體驗藝術的同時，我們追求優質的住宿：乾淨的房間，完善的設施，優雅的環境，讓我們身心靈都能良好的休憩。。這，就是藝海民宿。我們座落於芒果之鄉—台南市玉井區(台南市民宿300號)，鄰近84號快速道路及台三線，周邊生活機能完善，交通便利。 如果你想在縱情山水過後感受藝術，尋找藝術的故事，相信我們，這裡不容錯過。
stays.descriptionEn: Art Ocean Homestay is a legally registered homestay (Tainan Homestay #300) in Tainan City´s Yujing District. Although the homestay is located in the Yujing mountainous region, it is easily accessible as it is near both Provincial Highway 84 and Provincial Highway 3. The environs offer a wide variety of activi-ties, and convenience stores, night markets, and restaurants are all reachable with only a three- to five-minute walk.Art Ocean Homestay is an art-themed guesthouse nestled in Taiwan´s mango hometown. The exterior of the building is in a Baroque style, and the interior fea-tures artwork of different styles personally created by the owner. It´s like an ocean of art. Every suite has its own style of painted murals and a comfortable accommodation environment, allowing guests to rest and relax.“The pleasure we derive from a journey may be dependent more on the mind-set we travel with than on the destination we travel to.＂ – Alain de BottonOur story starts with our love of art.The Baroque-style exterior, the different styles of the painted murals, the stories from different eras… we admire color and reproduce the classics, allowing art to become an ocean.We not only offer the opportunity to experience art, but also quality accommoda-tions – clean rooms, comprehensive facilities, an elegant environment – to relax our bodies, minds, and spirits.This is Art Ocean Homestay.We are located in the hometown of mangoes, Tainan City´s Yujing District (Tain-an Homestay #300), near Provincial Highway 84 and Provincial Highway 3.The environs offer a wide variety of activities and the transportation is convenient.If you want to experience art and seek the story of art after enjoying the land-scapes, then you must come here. Take our word for it.

stays.name: 雲頂景觀民宿
stays.description: 「台南民宿‧雲頂景觀民宿」外觀建築由雕刻精美石柱、大理石階搭配大面玻璃組合而成，呈現雄偉非凡的輝煌氣度，優質的建材可見民宿主人對於住宿品質的要求及用心。只為讓特來住宿的旅客們都能住的安心、放心。 「台南民宿‧雲頂景觀民宿」鄰近走馬瀨農場、曾文水庫風景區、梅嶺、玄空法寺、加利利漂流木方舟教堂、大內天文館、南化水庫、龜丹溫泉、烏山台灣獼猴保護區，民宿周圍視野極佳，朝可觀日出雲海，暮可賞夕陽、夜景，玉井地區的山嵐雲霧、優美景緻皆可輕鬆盡收眼底，鄰近山頭的果樹也都清晰可見。除了房間大量採用玻璃帷幕外，民宿內多數房型皆設有戶外陽台，您可靜靜坐在躺椅上欣賞周圍山巒上的景緻，享受登高遠眺的極佳視野。 「台南民宿‧雲頂景觀民宿」房內空間寬敞，採光明亮，木質地板搭配玻璃帷幕，使得房內呈現清新自然、潔淨宜人的舒適氣息。再加上民宿地處清幽之境，夜晚無人聲雜亂，更為靜謐，提供旅客最為舒適的休眠住宿品質。 除了優良的住宿空間外，民宿另外設有餐廳，提供精緻火鍋、風味鬆餅、果醋、各式冷飲及熱飲，旅客可一邊品嘗美食，一邊欣賞美景及夜色。
stays.descriptionEn: The exterior of Tainan B&B - Yunding Landscape B&B is featured by beautifully carved pillars, marble steps and big glass windows, which create an extraordinarily majestic and brilliant ambiance. The top quality construction materials used in the B&B speak to the owner's high demand in quality and care. Ultimately, his intention is for his guests to have a comfortable and safe stay. Yunding Landscape B&B is close to Tsou-Ma-Lai Farm, Zengwen Dam Scenic Area, Meiling, Xuankungfa Temple, Galilee Driftwood Ark Church, Tainan Science Education Museum, Nanhua Dam, Guidan Hot Spring and Wushan Formosan Rock Macaque Protected Area. The views around the B&B are quite nice. In the morning, you'd see sunrise and a sea of clouds. In the evening, there is beautiful sunset, and at night, the Yujing night scene and rolling fog can all be seen from the B&B. During the day, you can also see the fruit trees on the nearby mountain top. All the guestrooms have curtain walls, and most of them have balconies where you can sit quietly, enjoy the mountain view and have a commanding look of the scenery around you. The guestrooms at Tainan B&B - Yunding Landscape B&B are spacious and bright. The wooden floor and curtain walls make the rooms look refreshing, natural, clean and comfortable. In addition, the B&B is located in a quiet setting, which is another advantage as guests will be guaranteed to get a quality and restful sleep. Besides the excellent living condition, the B&B also has a dining room that serves exquisite hot pots, delicious waffles, fruit vinegar and various kinds of cold and hot beverages. Guests can taste delicious cuisine while enjoying the beautiful scenery.

stays.name: 在人旅館_台灣意象書法館
stays.description: 交通部觀光局西拉雅國家風景區管理處將台南市廢校多年的白河崎內國小重新改造，成立「在人旅館_台灣意象書法館」，由白河在地書法家陳世憲擔任館長，將結合書法藝術展演、餐廳、住宿等整合服務，提供不定期藝術主題換展， 除靜態展覽也將結合3D動畫，呈現書法動畫影片，希望呈現地方藝文特色，帶動地方藝文觀光發展。書法館周邊擁有豐富旅遊資源，除季節限定的林初埤木棉花道、白河蓮花公園及玉豐綠色隧道，也可至關子嶺體驗泥漿溫泉、品嘗特色美食，期望透過書法館營運整合周邊旅遊資源，將書法館打造為旅遊中繼站，帶給遊客多元而豐富的遊程體驗，並結合在地藝術家、社區與周邊觀光產業，將台灣意象書法館打造成具指標性之觀光新亮點。
stays.descriptionEn: The Siraya National Scenic Area Management Office of the Tourism Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation renovated the Shirakawa-Zaki Nei Elementary School that had been abandoned for many years in Tainan City and established the "In-person Hotel_Taiwan Imagery Calligraphy Museum". Chen Shih-hsien, a local calligrapher in Shirakawa, serves as the director. Combining calligraphy art performances, restaurants, accommodation and other integrated services, it provides irregular art-themed exhibitions. In addition to static exhibitions, it will also combine 3D animations to present calligraphy animation videos, hoping to present local artistic characteristics and promote the development of local arts and tourism.There are rich tourism resources around the Calligraphy Museum. In addition to the seasonal Kapok Road in Linchupi, Baihe Lotus Park and Yufeng Green Tunnel, you can also go to Guanziling to experience the mud hot springs and taste special food. We hope to integrate the surrounding tourism through the operation of the Calligraphy Museum Resources are used to build the Calligraphy Museum into a tourist relay station, bringing tourists a diverse and rich travel experience. It also combines local artists, communities and surrounding tourism industries to build the Taiwan Image Calligraphy Museum into a new iconic tourist attraction.

stays.name: 悠爾庭園
stays.description: 民宿簡介: 悠爾庭園隱匿在幽靜的鄉村角落，綠意盎然。 在悠爾庭園，您可以享受到寧靜的鄉居生活，一甲子古厝民宿保留傳統的建築樣貌，充滿著濃厚的懷舊風。 山麓旁，優雅的白鷺鷥翩然展翅翱翔，各式鳥囀啼鳴，愜意田園。 在園內閒情望山，關子嶺、大凍山近在咫尺；風雨來時，山嵐縹緲，另有一番浪漫情懷。 這裡是我們的家，同時也願將此景分享給您，真摯歡迎您來此留宿。悠爾庭園近竹門綠色隧道，清新快意，是談心漫遊的好去處。 夏季時，綠色隧道旁芒果結實纍纍，鄉野處蓮花隨風擺動風姿綽約，別有一番滋味。 悠爾庭園附近景點包括白河蓮花(夏季)、關子嶺(泡湯及秋冬季紅葉公園賞楓)、林初埤木棉花道(春末夏初)、東山咖啡和龍眼(秋冬季)、烏樹林台鐵小火車之旅及蘭花科技園區(初夏)、土溝美術村等。 民宿地理位置及環境︰悠爾庭園位於台南市白河區竹門里社區，隸屬白河區北方，北接將軍山，東連鹿寮水庫，東南緊鄰關子嶺，近嘉義、新營約30分鐘車程，是典型的農村聚落。 白河以蓮鄉聞名全台，在竹門里同樣可以觀賞到畝畝荷田及香水蓮，景致優美！ 竹門靠山，早期居民以竹子來蓋房子，現今這裡仍保有不少老厝。 除了稻米、蓮子、蓮藕粉等農作特產，在竹門鄰近山坡也種植了許多品質相當好的柳丁。

stays.name: 毓軒園民宿
stays.description: 毓軒園民宿前有綠色隧道後有水塘花園，座落在南90道路上，百年芒果樹綠色隧道、蓮田、稻田之中，一望無際的嘉南平原，綠色大地，田野風光盡覽無遺。清晨、傍晚散步，鐵馬行看日出、夕陽，空氣新鮮，悠閒自在，遠眺關子嶺山景賞心悅目，心曠神怡。步行15分鐘可到達蓮花資訊館，往西約1公里到林初埤和木棉道，再往西約5公里到達小南海自然生態公園，往北1.5公里抵達蓮花公園。白河小鎮在毓軒園之南約4.5公里，往東行到關子嶺約14公里，開車或來趟鐵馬泡湯之旅也很不錯喔!是您選擇放鬆自己的好所在。民宿後面的祕密花園噴水生態池 (香水蓮花、錦鯉魚)，涼亭兼具現代與古典之美，綜合園藝區種植什錦果樹和樹木，空氣清新，景色宜人，聽聽蟲鳴鳥叫聲，此時此刻遠離塵囂，放鬆心情的感覺真好!每年6-8月蓮花盛開，香味四溢，賞蓮品蓮的好季節，賞蓮最佳時刻清晨6-8時。三月有木棉花、五月有阿勃勒可賞，四至五月是綠色隧道採小芒果做情人果的時節，六月可以體驗採摘成熟芒果的樂趣，十二月可親睹或體驗挖蓮藕以及觀看蓮藕粉製作的甘苦，因此夜宿民宿是有其必要的。於此即可享受大自然的神奇美妙!增進身、心、靈的健康。毓軒園民宿經營至今已13年有餘，在民國100年榮獲交通部觀光局領發 [百大幸福旅宿獎]和[101年好客民宿獎]，實在難能可貴，得來不易啊!
stays.descriptionEn: In front of Yu Xuan Yuan Bed & Breakfast is a green tunnel, and behind it, a pond and garden. Situated on Tainan Road 90, it is in close proximity to the hundred-year-old mango tree green tunnel, as well as fields of lotuses and paddies of rice. Looking out across the Jianan Plain, a huge expanse of greenery and fields as far as the eye can see, is an amazing experience. In the early morning or at dusk, why not take a walk or ride, watch the sun rise/set, breathe deep of the fresh air, and relax? Or how about just taking in the majestic sight of Mt. Guanzihling (Guanziling) A mere 15-minute walk will get you to the Lotus Information Center, and one kilometer to the west sits the Linchupi Cotton Trail. About five kilometers to the west lies Xiaonanhai Natural Ecological Park, and 1.5 kilometers to the north is Lianhua (Lotus) Park. Baihe Township is 4.5km south of Yu Xuan Yuan, and about 14km to the east is Guanzihling (Guanziling), a wonderful place for a drive or a ride, with the promise of hot springs at the end! Behind Yu Xuan Yuan itself sits a “secret garden” complete with fountain, lotuses, and carp, as well as a beautiful pagoda that combines classic and modern design. With fruit trees and shrubs abounding, the air is crisp and clean, making it a refreshing place to relax and listen to nature, far from the madding crowds. The lotuses are at the best between June and August each year, filling the air with fragrance — and if you want to fully enjoy them at their peak, the best time would be between 6am and 8am. In March, the cotton trees bloom, while May sees the golden shower trees on show; April and May are also when the mangoes and passionfruit are at their best, while June offers the chance to try your hand at picking fully ripened mangoes. December, meanwhile, is the perfect time to try picking, or just appreciating, the lotus roots and having a go at making lotus flour — and of course, you’ll need somewhere to spend the night too! A stay here is truly great for the mind, body, and soul. Yu Xuan Yuan Bed & Breakfast has been running for over 13 years now, and was even recognized by the Tourism Bureau, Republic of China (Taiwan) in 2011 as one of the “100 Happy Stays” and received a “Taiwan Host” award in 2012! It truly is a place well worth a visit!

stays.name: 關子嶺富野溫泉會館
stays.description: 來到台南關子嶺泥漿溫泉，彷彿進入了一個悠閒、靜謐的時光隧道。這裡是放鬆身心的理想去處，將您帶入一場慢活、恬靜的泉水饗宴，讓您在悠閒中感受大自然的慷慨餽贈。 蜿蜒的山徑和翠綠的樹影交織成迷人的畫面，似乎在邀請您隨心漫遊。泥漿溫泉在微風拂過的時候，帶來一陣溫暖，恍若悠閒的低語，讓身心仿佛融化在大地的懷抱中。 泥漿溫泉浴池的水面如詩如畫，悠然宛如沐浴在自然的清流之中。您可以盡情沈浸其中，感受溫暖泥漿包覆身體的愉悅，漸漸忘卻生活的煩囂，將一切壓力漸漸釋放。
stays.descriptionEn: When you come to Guanziling Mud Hot Spring in Tainan, you feel like you have entered a leisurely and quiet time tunnel. This is an ideal place to relax your body and mind, bringing you into a slow and peaceful spring water feast, allowing you to feel the generous gifts of nature in your leisurely time. The winding mountain paths and green tree shadows interweave into a charming picture, seeming to invite you to roam as you please. When the breeze blows by, the mud hot springs bring a burst of warmth, like a leisurely whisper, making the body and mind feel as if they are melting into the embrace of the earth. The water surface of the mud hot spring bath is picturesque, as if you are bathing in the natural clear stream. You can immerse yourself in it, feel the pleasure of the warm mud covering your body, gradually forget the hustle and bustle of life, and gradually release all stress.

stays.name: 阿梅溫泉
stays.description: 阿梅溫泉民宿用心清潔每間客房的環境，使每位貴賓可以使用到乾淨且衛生的客房，另外為了讓每位貴賓享有舒適的泡湯環境不被打擾，我們亦於每間客房內張貼禁菸公告，室內全面禁菸，有吸菸需求的貴賓我們於戶外有提供吸菸區。關子嶺的泥漿溫泉是一大特色，阿梅溫泉民宿的泥漿溫泉來自於寶泉橋的水源頭，我們對於水質相當講究，務必讓每位客人享受最好的泡湯體驗是我們的核心理念。我們親切地接待每位蒞臨的客人，希望每位客人踏進阿梅溫泉民宿都能感受到家的感覺，泡湯完還可以欣賞我們種植的花卉植物。在阿梅溫泉民宿，每位貴賓可以遠離都市塵囂，放鬆心靈，藉由泡湯以及賞花使我們疲憊的身心獲得舒緩。
stays.descriptionEn: Amei Hot Spring cleans the room with great carefulness, which means guests have clean and hygienic room. In addition, in order to make each guest have a comfortable bathing environment without being disturbed, we also post a non-smoking notice in each room , Indoors are completely non-smoking. We provide smoking area outside for guests who smoke.Guanziling is as known as its mud hot spring. The source of our mud hot spring comes from the Baoquan Bridge. We care about the mud hot spring quality, so we spend a lot of time keeping it in high quality. To ensure that guests have the best experience is the most important to us.We entertain guests hospitably, hoping guests feel like at home, and guests also can admire the beauty of flowers and plants after the bath. In Amei Hot Spring, guests can get away from the hustle and bustle, just relax their minds, and soothe their tired body and mind by going to a hot spring and viewing flowers.

stays.name: 西港小久窩
stays.description: 西港小久窩民宿位於台南西港一處寧靜的住宅巷弄裡，這裡遠離市區的喧囂人潮，是一個能讓人真正慢下腳步、好好休息的小角落。沒有華麗的裝潢，也非熱門觀光區，但提供的是一個簡單，卻能讓人感到安心的小窩。我們主打 安靜、乾淨、舒適，希望每位來到西港的旅人，都能在這得到真正的休息和充電，不論是出差、環島旅行、返鄉探親，或是單純想遠離塵囂好好睡一晚，小久窩隨時歡迎您的到來。房型與空間介紹： • 雙人房與四人房：適合獨旅、情侶、小家庭、朋友旅行，需要安靜與舒適空間的旅客。 • 1樓公共客廳：備有微波爐與快煮壺，各式碗盤，晚上吃宵夜紓壓的好地方 • 入口處室內車庫：可停放自行車與機車 • 2樓誠實柑仔店：販售泡麵與飲料的無人商店，半夜餓了不用出門也能隨時補給，24小時皆能自行投幣購買—— 忙碌之餘，別忘了好好休息 ——

stays.name: 西港歇腳居
stays.description: 當一個鄉間平凡的小角落化身為歇腳釋壓休憩的悠然鄉境 期待您的到來 我們不是頂級的度假山莊 豪華的五星級的飯店 卻有平凡中帶有素雅高貴的空間 鄉土而不落後休閒方式 讓您真正能靜下來休息的小居 遠離城鎮享受一下不同的度假風味 休息歇腳居 遊玩台南市！西港歇腳居 是一個結合鄉土 人文 藝術 美食 因地而產生的休閒小居 或許這裡不是一個人所皆知的鄉鎮 但這裡周邊環境豐富的人文氣息 鄉土的故事等您來挖掘 .這裡有美食 有夜空 有鄰近鄉鎮的旅遊景點 :廣為人知的 全台首香西港慶安宮 善解人意的樹王公 七股鹽山鹽村 潟湖 賞候鳥(黑面琵鷺) 佳里台糖舊倉蕭壠文化園區 麻豆代天府 等 都值得你來走一遭.我們全棟一次出租只接待一組客人 ,讓您真正有回家輕鬆自在的感覺 .
stays.descriptionEn: When an ordinary place in the countryside transforms into a stress-free and relaxing rest spot, we would like to welcome you to our home. We& #39;re not a top vacation villa or luxury 5-star hotel. Our B&B is ordinary but has a simple elegance. Our country-style home is where you can enjoy some peace and quiet and stay restful. Take a break from the busy city and enjoy a different lifestyle in Tainan! Xigang Vacation B&B combines country-style living, local culture, art and fine cuisine into our business operation. This may not be a well-known town, but there are rich culture, diverse ecology and many stories about country living waiting for you to discover. Some of the nearby tourist attractions worthwhile seeing are the well-known and most popular temple in Taiwan - Xigang Qing& #39;an Temple, Shuwanggong (a giant old tree), Qigu Salt Mountain/Village, a lagoon to observe migratory birds (black-faced spoonbill), Taiwan Sugar Corporation& #39;s Jiali old warehouse, Xiaolong Cultural Park and Madou Daitian Temple. We only rent out the whole house and only receive one group of guests at a time. You will have the whole house to yourself and enjoy the privacy as in your own home.

stays.description: 亞灣飯店位於知本溫泉區附近(知本溫泉橋前方)，沿著斜坡而上，周圍盡是碧綠山林，讓您感受到遠離塵囂的幽靜; 清晨—在愉悅的鳥語中醒來， 而知本的夜是不寂寞的，因為您一仰天就有無盡的星光， 正訴說著神秘悠久的“卑南傳奇” ……在台東這一片令人心曠神怡的山野間，感受原民文化的風華，風味獨具的亞灣飯店，即將給您全新的感受。也可順道參觀原住民藝品，了解雕刻藝品以及各式掛飾的淵源以及文化意涵，讓亞灣飯店擴展您台東旅遊的深度和廣度。亞灣飯店擁有各式套房，能滿足您各種不同的需求。戶外溫泉SPA為您補充滿滿的能量，來到亞灣的每一天都是全新的開始！
stays.descriptionEn: Yawan Hotel is located near the Jhihben (Zhiben) hot springs (in front of Jhihben Hot-spring Bridge) on a slope, and is surrounded by hills and mountains, away from the hubbub of city life, making you feel secluded. In the morning, birds wake you up with pleasant chirps, and in the night in Jhihben, you won& #39;t feel lonely, when looking up at the sky, you will find you have an endless accompanying sky and stars telling you a long story of the mysterious "Puyuma legend." In the breathtaking mountains of Taitung, you can feel the elegance of aboriginal culture, experience the unique herb bath, at Yawan Hotel we offer you brand new feelings. You may also tour aboriginal art to understand the origin and cultural implications of sculpture art and other hanging decorations, to allow Yawan expanding the breadth and depth of your journey. Yawan Hotel features a variety of spa suites to meet your various needs. The various hot spring and fitness facilities are designed for filling up your energy, making every day of your stay to be your new beginning.

stays.nameEn: Taitung County Farmers' Association East Travel Season Hot Spring Resort
stays.description: 東遊季溫泉渡假村，座落於台東縣卑南鄉溫泉村知本溫泉區，鄰近知本森林遊樂區。園區占地15公頃，邀您走踏柔軟草皮，遠眺高山，無拘無束的徜徉在寧靜的山谷森林浴中。距離台東市約16公里，依山傍水景色怡人、生態豐富、遠離塵囂，扼知本溫泉區必經之出口，無塞車之虞，交通極為便利。 東遊季溫泉渡假村規劃各式房型，舒適典雅、擁有全知本最寬廣，設備最完善的養生溫泉SPA區，另有會議中心、露營區、烤肉區。主要目的在於服務全國農民、農民團體組織與農業相關從業人員辦理各項農業推廣活動、進修講習訓練、研習及活動舉辦場地。
stays.descriptionEn: Toyugi Hot Spring Resort & Spa is located within the Zhiben Hot Spring Area in Wenquan Village, Beinan Township, Taitung County, and. close to Jhihben (Zhiben) National Forest Recreation Area. The Resort covers 15 hectares. Visitors are lured into stepping on the soft grass and viewing the towering mountains so that they will forget all their mundane troubles and enjoy a forest bath in the valleys. It’s 16 km from downtown Taitung City. Surrounded by mountains and the sea, Toyugi has splendid views and is blessed with great ecological diversity. Away from the hustle and bustle of the city life, Toyugi is free of traffic jams yet extremely accessible. Toyugi Hot Spring Resort & Spa features all types of comfortable and elegant rooms, as well as the largest and most comprehensive wellness Spa area. The Resort also provides conference centers, campsites, and barbecue zones. Its main goal is to serve famers across the country, farmers& #39; organizations, and those working in the agricultural sector by providing venues for agricultural promotions, continuing education sessions, workshops and other activities.

stays.name: 吉鄉民宿
stays.description: 全新民宿正式推出── 位於台東的“吉鄉民宿”亦可稱之“果園民宿”，近千坪的土地，有著廣大的庭院及果園，是每天整理花花草草為生活重心的退休夫婦，他們傾盡五年的時間，精心打造出心目中的理想民宿，1樓、2樓均有獨立客廳，有5個精緻的套房，另設有玻璃屋餐廳，寬敞的用餐空間可容納15人以上，更適合遠方朋友的您來"包棟"。 民宿綠意盎然的景觀，果園裡種植了芭樂、芒果、柑橘、巴西櫻桃、以及每年2次結果的樹葡萄…等，歡迎來此一遊，品嚐這特殊的風味水果。此外，另闢的菜園區，可讓住宿的朋友嚐嚐主人親自種的新鮮蔬果，來此的遊客必能體驗這化外的自然之美。 從踏上台東開始，遠離緊張的都市節奏，深深感受與大自然合而為一的真實體驗。讓旅人得到一絲放鬆，向外望去是映入眼簾的大片綠色，不僅治癒了疲勞的雙眼，讓芬多精舒緩您的心神。

stays.name: 咓露樂咔民宿
stays.description: 位於台東縣卑南鄉利嘉村 卑南族利嘉部落 卑南語Likavung 音譯是 利卡夢，咓露樂咔 也是卑南語的音譯 咓露：Walru 糖果 樂咔：Zekalr 部落，中文就是 糖果部落民宿用目前流行閩南語諧音梗 我是樂腳 也是 嗨咔的意思。我們住1F 民宿在2F，沒有電梯 所以行動不方便者 可能會不好上2F。我們沒有提供早餐 鼓勵到部落消費，當然 我們也是可以幫買早餐。歡迎來到 卑南族傳統大部落 也期待您來深入旅遊或長住~
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Lijia Village, Beinan Township, Taitung County, the Puyuma tribe, Lijia tribe. The Puyuma language Likavung is transliterated as Likameng. WalruZekalr also a transliteration of the Puyuma language. Walru candy, Zekalr tribe, in Chinese it is Candy Tribe B&B.Using the popular Hokkien homophonic pun, I am happy foot also means Hika.We stayed on the 1st floor and the B&B was on the 2nd floor. There was no elevator so people with limited mobility might have trouble going up to the 2nd floor.We do not provide breakfast to encourage consumption in the tribe, but of course we can help buy breakfast.Welcome to the traditional Puyuma tribe. We look forward to your in-depth travel or long-term stay~

stays.name: 四季春民宿
stays.description: 四季春田園民宿位於環境清幽的泰安村，背靠中央山脈，自然生態多樣且豐富，宛如一座天然的寶庫。在這裡，您可以遠離城市的喧囂，讓心靈來場舒活漫遊之旅。四季春田園民宿為全新打造的優質民宿，民宿內提供寬敞的空間，讓您更能感受到自在的氛圍。當日光昇起，您可以往森林前去，享受芬多精的洗禮；而當月夜來臨，滿天星光閃閃，更是增添了幾分浪漫的情趣！四季春田園民宿誠摯邀請您，來台東體驗悠活的田園風光！
stays.descriptionEn: Sijichun Countryside B&B is located in the quiet Tai& #39;an Village, backed by the Central Mountain Range. The natural ecology is diverse and rich, like a natural treasure house. Here, you can get away from the hustle and bustle of the city and let your mind take a relaxing wandering journey.Sijichun Countryside B&B is a newly built high-quality B&B with spacious space, allowing you to feel more comfortable. When the sun rises, you can go to the forest and enjoy the baptism of phytoncide; and when the moonlit night comes, the sky is full of twinkling stars, which adds a bit of romance!Four Seasons Spring Countryside B&B sincerely invites you to come to Taitung to experience the leisurely rural scenery!

stays.name: 小熊Villa村611民宿
stays.description: 關於我們體驗小木屋渡假風 小熊Villa村位於卑南溪畔，坐擁花東縱谷山林成趣的原始森林，是一處遠離塵嚣、自成一景的渡假樂園，在萬坪綠地以紅檜原木構建了6棟森林木屋，一踏進園內，便可感受到撲鼻而來的陣陣檜木清香，這裡有蟲鳴、蝶舞，還有浪漫星空~~~園區設有會議設施和觀光旅遊櫃台，並提供行李寄存服務。住客可在館內或周邊地區享受和釣魚等各項活動。館內提供大型免費停車位、排球場、籃球場、兒童沙池........等多種設施。渡假式住宿~享受快樂悠閒 小熊Villa村提供雙人房、三人房、四人房，也可包棟五、六、七、八、九人木屋。小倆口的甜蜜假期或成群結隊的好友同遊，小熊Villa村都是您的最佳選擇。溫馨可愛的森林小木屋，鄉村風格的設計，空間寬敞明亮，園區內也提供各式的休閒設施：東台灣最迷人的礦泉泳池、超HIGH的直排輪溜冰場、咖啡廣場、兒童戶外遊樂區、原木風味餐廳、羽球場、藍球場、小熊卡拉OK免費歡唱、釣魚池、腳踏車等，讓遊客輕鬆享受渡假情趣，忘卻煩憂。
stays.descriptionEn: About Us Experience a Cabin VacationLittle Bear Villa is located on the banks of the Beinan River, nestled within the picturesque primeval forests of the East Rift Valley. It& #39;s a secluded resort paradise, far from the hustle and bustle of city life. Six forest cabins, constructed from red cypress logs, are situated on a vast green space. Upon entering, you& #39;ll be greeted by the fragrant aroma of cypress, the sounds of insects and butterflies, and a romantic starry sky. The resort offers meeting facilities, a tour counter, and luggage storage. Guests can enjoy various activities on-site or in the surrounding area, including fishing. The resort provides ample free parking, a volleyball court, a basketball court, a children& #39;s sandpit, and more.Resort-Style Accommodation – Enjoy a Relaxing and Joyful GetawayLittle Bear Villa offers double, triple, and quadruple rooms, and can also book entire cabins for five, six, seven, eight, or nine people. Whether it& #39;s a romantic getaway for couples or a group of friends, Little Bear Villa is the perfect choice.The cozy and lovely forest cabins feature a rustic design and spacious, bright interiors. The park also offers a variety of recreational facilities: the most charming mineral spring swimming pool in eastern Taiwan, a super exciting inline skating rink, a coffee plaza, an outdoor children& #39;s playground, a log-style restaurant, badminton courts, basketball courts, a free karaoke room with a bear-themed karaoke, a fishing pond, bicycles, and more, allowing visitors to easily enjoy their vacation and forget their worries.

stays.description: 位於卑南鄉的民宿，山田美居可遠眺山丘、藍天白雲的天空，擁有綠意盎然的植栽庭園，混凝土樸素的建築就像是佇立在森林中小城堡般，現代工業風格的裝潢、無過多繁複裝飾的空間裡有著自在不羈的高質感品味，等待著旅人的到來。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Beinan Township, Shantian Meiju offers panoramic views of the hills and a blue sky. stays.name: 幸福旅行舍民宿
stays.description: 我們民宿起初源自於老闆娘兒時對於那家鄉小村落的憧憬幸福感，當還是兒時時，還是個在鄉下的孩子，或許過的不是與城市相當的生活，但長大後，在城市居住多年歷經繁華瑣事，令老闆娘非常思念家鄉的一切生活，而親手規劃設計打造了幸福旅行.舍。在鄉下或許房子裡的家俱、浴室、廁所、床、桌子、椅子、碗筷都平凡而非常不起眼，交通也非常的不便利，公車、火車、校車都是必須離家徒步一段路才可到達，但是就因土地寬敞，擁有很大一片的田園空間，種滿了花花草草、與老媽媽的農作物、與一池生態豐富的小水池，與一望無際的山水景色，老闆娘決定想要重返兒時那幸福的記憶，把這憧憬連同記憶與旅客們共享。幸福旅行.舍的初建儘管當初創不被受看好，支持度低落，不過這也無法擊敗老闆娘的夢想，辛苦的獨自一人熬過那最辛苦的創建期，一步一步向前推進，過程十分辛苦且費心，最終甜蜜的果實終究被人認同設定就是希望旅客能夠台東體驗這種緩慢不起眼卻幸福的平凡生活，嚮往那當初老媽媽生下了七個女兒同擠在同一房間，有些睡上鋪、有些則是睡下鋪，那兒時記憶也是七姊妹們最打入回憶裡的深刻印象，進而打造出以空間寬敞、舒適無壓力的空間設計，或許當你一進門，大廳的寬敞設計，坐在大廳，享受一杯台東最在地的咖啡，觀望那框景住的台東富士山，與山巒間的雲霧繚繞，是多麼能讓人卸下一切壓力，體驗那仰望天空的放空感。
stays.descriptionEn: Taitung owns the reputation as "Taiwan& #39;s Rear Garden," which combines the natural mountain and sea scenery and cultural humanity as well as the resort and delicacy. Taitung is the best place for traveling. Happy Traveler-Inn is located in Taiping Village near the mountain and by the river, just 10 minutes away from the train station by foot. To be a best place for relaxing, we avoid the hustle and bustle of downtown and create a comfortable and tranquil life for you. Besides the normal suites, we also provide "Happiness Hostel" and "Luxurious Ladybug Theme Honeymoon Suite" for choices. With their great view, comfortable beds, natural light as well as the spacious room, they are the best choice for couples, family and friends. In the romantic "Luxurious Ladybug Theme Honeymoon Suite," artworks of ladybugs can be seen everywhere, and the room and the courtyard are abuzz with great vitality in every corner. The host makes the artistic works elaborately. We are looking forward to your visiting and becoming our friends.

stays.name: 御安民宿
stays.description: 御安民宿對於各位好奇為何老闆跟闆娘高雄人為何要選在台東開民宿，就只因一次帶孩子來遊玩認識了一個民宿老闆娘大姐，經營民宿態度與熱情讓我們覺得住在自己家的感覺，而且早餐又好吃，然而老闆跟老闆娘在高雄從事木地板行業，想說這途都是苦力，以後老了想在台買棟民宿養老，說快不快再一次巧緣看上了卑南太平這間房子，樓上天氣好可以看見鯉魚山、再延伸出去是美麗太平洋，挑望遠處有一座小島就是綠島、而且旁邊還有一個五臟俱全的太平夜市，去初鹿只要15分鐘，鹿野25分鐘的路程實在不錯、想遠離都市的塵囂這裡是個不錯的選擇好地方，我們也把內部打掃乾乾淨淨讓客人來到民宿也有回家舒適的感覺~讓你們愛上台東這塊土地+青山綠+台東藍
stays.descriptionEn: Yu An B&BFor those who are curious about why the boss and the proprietress Kaohsiung chose to open a homestay in Taitung, it was just because I brought my children to play and met a lady proprietress of the homestay. The attitude and enthusiasm of the homestay management made us feel like living in our own home, and the breakfast was delicious. However, the boss and the proprietress are engaged in the wood flooring industry in Kaohsiung. The Pacific Ocean is beautiful, and there is a small island in the distance, which is Green Island, and there is a Taiping Night Market next to it. It only takes 15 minutes to go to Chulu, and 25 minutes to Luye.

stays.name: 悅來民宿
stays.description: 園區佔地千坪，位於台東山線與海線（花東縱谷及海岸線）各風景點地理中心。離台東火車站約10分鐘車程(實際路測)，離新台九線6百公尺，到市區車行約15分鐘，品嚐台東最夯美食。民宿四周釋迦果園環繞，環境清幽寧靜，係都會邊緣型民宿，具生活機能，並有方便停車及大活動綠地空間之特性。園區前可眺望中央山脈，左則遠望台東市區及太平洋，夜晚蟲鳴鳥叫、青蛙咕咕，還可欣賞滿天星斗，也可與民宿男主人董爸討論基礎天文。客房獨立出入，有景觀大窗台，房內佈置溫馨典雅、舒適潔淨明亮，庭園種滿花草，綠意盎然，提供住慣都市的客人最優先期望的乾淨、舒適、悠閒、物超所值的住宿條件是園主的經營方向。適合閤家出遊、重機車、自行車族、背包客及歐美自助旅客入住。民宿女主人董媽以最熱忱的心款待您，讓您彷彿置身於自己的家中，渡過一個舒適、溫馨、美好、難忘的假期。

stays.searchText: 悅來民宿 悅來民宿 臺東縣民宿334號 臺東縣 卑南鄉 太平村民生路197號 園區佔地千坪，位於台東山線與海線（花東縱谷及海岸線）各風景點地理中心。離台東火車站約10分鐘車程(實際路測)，離新台九線6百公尺，到市區車行約15分鐘，品嚐台東最夯美食。民宿四周釋迦果園環繞，環境清幽寧靜，係都會邊緣型民宿，具生活機能，並有方便停車及大活動綠地空間之特性。園區前可眺望中央山脈，左則遠望台東市區及太平洋，夜晚蟲鳴鳥叫、青蛙咕咕，還可欣賞滿天星斗，也可與民宿男主人董爸討論基礎天文。客房獨立出入，有景觀大窗台，房內佈置溫馨典雅、舒適潔淨明亮，庭園種滿花草，綠意盎然，提供住慣都市的客人最優先期望的乾淨、舒適、悠閒、物超所值的住宿條件是園主的經營方向。適合閤家出遊、重機車、自行車族、背包客及歐美自助旅客入住。民宿女主人董媽以最熱忱的心款待您，讓您彷彿置身於自己的家中，渡過一個舒適、溫馨、美好、難忘的假期。

stays.name: 春楓民宿
stays.description: 春楓民宿春楓民宿，為一間卑南族部落間的民宅。主人因為學習助人公作相關領域,喜歡交友、也喜歡分享空問,因此在常常分享朋友來訪後, 經過朋友們鼓勵,有了成立民宿的想法,也想將空間分享給期待到台東生活與漫活的旅人。民宿空問為於卑南鄉利嘉村鄉野間,距離台東巿中心約20分鐘、知本溫泉約15分鐘,並非一交通方便的場所。若喜歡熱鬧與便利的旅人,建議住宿地點選擇台東車站附近民宿為佳。春楓民宿，空間預計每次只接待一組旅人，最多為一台輛人數，建議可為熟識友人或一組約4人的親子家庭。客廳與廚房皆能為簡單分享空問,可以方便使用。民宿空問可於門囗側邊停車《一般轎車停車位大小)或停於利民路上步行約1分鐘可以抵達住宿空間。因住宿空間位於部落,需注意夜問音量,也可能一早就會參與部落的動物因為鳴叫而起床。部落後山有寧靜步道可以緩慢散步,亦可於高點觀看夜景,享受部落寧靜。民宿空問成立主要為分享空間,提供旅人安靜休息的地方,亦提供親子/好友,可以有一個舒服相聚的場所。透過熟悉的旅人彼此居住於整個空問(房問、客廳、廚房及浴室等) ,可以到放鬆與自在。
stays.descriptionEn: Spring Maple B&BChunfeng B&B is a private house among Puyuma tribes. Because the owner is learning to help others in related fields, he likes to make friends and share space. Therefore, after sharing friends& #39; visits frequently, and with the encouragement of friends, he has the idea of ​​establishing a homestay, and wants to share the space with people who are looking forward to living in Taitung. A wandering traveler.The B&B is located in the countryside of Lijia Village, Beinan Township, about 20 minutes from the center of Taitung City, and about 15 minutes from Zhiben Hot Spring. It is not a place with convenient transportation. For travelers who like excitement and convenience, it is recommended to choose a B&B near Taitung Station as the place of accommodation.Spring Maple B&B, the space is expected to accommodate only one group of travelers at a time, with a maximum of one vehicle. It is recommended that it can be acquaintances or a family of about 4 people. Both the living room and the kitchen can be used for simple sharing and convenient use.You can park on the side of the entrance (the size of a parking space for ordinary cars) or park on Limin Road and walk for about 1 minute to reach the accommodation space. Because the accommodation space is located in the tribe, you need to pay attention to the sound volume at night, and the animals participating in the tribe may get up early in the morning because of their singing. There are quiet trails in the back mountain of the tribe, where you can take a slow walk, and you can also watch the night view from the high point and enjoy the tranquility of the tribe.B&B space is mainly established as a sharing space, providing a place for travelers to rest quietly, and also providing a comfortable place for parents and children/friends to gather together. Through familiar travelers living with each other in the entire space (room, living room, kitchen, bathroom, etc.), relaxation and freedom can be achieved.

stays.description: Maura（茂良）是爺爺的名字，他是一位退休的老校長，從前的夢想，就是能坐山面海，享受純淨的鄉村生活，終於在40年的努力下，辛苦打拼換來第一個家，從挑選位置，到一磚一瓦設計，長達5年的籌建，終於完成。而從小，這裡就是我們每年寒暑假最期待回來的地方，直到現在爺爺老了，身體無法再像年輕時候的硬朗，需要更好的醫療資源，只能搬離這裡。為了讓這住了將近20年的建築物重新活絡，我們3個孫子，決定一起貸款，將它重新裝修，並且傳承爺爺帶給我們的快樂把它變成度假民宿，並用爺爺的名字取名為Maura's house，讓更多人能體驗這樣的快樂，而「有漁」民宿位於富山小漁村，諧音是年年有餘，期許這裡，能永續經營爺爺的愛。

stays.name: 東台溫泉飯店
stays.description: 東台飯店位於知本溫泉區，鄰近知本國家森林遊樂區，擁有絕佳的天然景觀與溫泉資源，飯店內共有146間精心設計之各式溫泉套房及可容納500人的中餐廳，另有氣氛高雅、空間寬敞的卡拉OK等。飯店提供住宿、餐飲、休憩、會議、套裝旅遊……等各項服務。 東台溫泉養生館結合台灣原住民南島文化風格，為一座具備養生、休閒、聯誼、親子等多功能的溫泉設施。在經營理念上，東台溫泉飯店定位為為主題明確之溫泉渡假旅館。提供安全、舒適、衛生的食宿環境；專業團隊的貼心服務及多功能的溫泉設施，最終期許能讓所有旅客獲得一個身心徹底放鬆的休閒旅遊。
stays.descriptionEn: Situated in Chihpen hot spring area and close to the Chihpen National Forest Recreation Area, DONG TAIR SPA HOTEL has a wonderful natural scenery and hot spring resources. A total of 146 carefully designed hot spring suites are available in the hotel, in addition to a Chinese restaurant with a capacity of 500 people and a elegant karaoke lounge with ample space . The services provided include accommodation, dining, rest, conference, tour package and so on. DONG TAIR Spring Resort is a multi-purpose hot spring resort with health improvement, recreation, networking and family management capabilities through the integration of the style of Austronesian cultures from Taiwan's Indigenous Cultures. Based on our business philosophy, we position DONG TAIR SPA HOTEL as a hot spring resort with a clear theme. Through the provision of a safe, comfortable and healthy environment of food and accommodation, the caring service from a professional team, and the multi-purpose hot spring facility, the ultimate goal is to give all guests a completely relaxed trip.

stays.name: 椰子海岸民宿
stays.description: 椰子海岸民宿位在太平洋畔沿11號省道的都蘭灣底隱約在椰子樹林間，側身在海岸山脈下，白天終年白日的山間雲霧，晚上變成落山風經過民宿房子吹向海洋。房子不對海岸搶眼，沒有華麗、房舍裡的設備講究是絕對理所當然的舒適。椰子海岸提供當地美食，海岸山脈及太平洋圍繞起來的地方、沒有工業污染，清潔的地方食材；山間野菜有黑甜菜、鳥莧菜、厚帽子。自然放牧的雞、羊、沒有藥物的助長，太平洋現撈的魚；加上紅甘、長尾鳥、石斑魚、海雞母，加上簡單傳統的烹調方式。
stays.descriptionEn: Coconut Coast B&B is hidden among the coconut trees on Doulan Bay, by the coast of the Pacific Ocean, along Provincial Highway 11. Being near the coast and at the foot of the mountain, Coconut Coast B&B seems to be veiled by a sheet of fog and cloud all year long. At night the mountain breeze travels downward, passes the B&B and moves towards the ocean. The B&B doesn't face the ocean and is not luxurious, but all the furnishings in the house are very comfortable. Coconut Coast B&B serves delicious local gourmets. There are no industrial pollution, so all the local ingredients are safe to eat. Some of the mountain grown wild vegetables include Black Nightshade, Slender Amaranth and Houmaozi. The organic free-range chickens and lamb are free of antibiotics. The fish caught in the Pacific Ocean include yellow tail, marbled rockfish, grouper and snapper. They are prepared simply to retain freshness.

stays.name: 海水藍民宿
stays.description: 海水藍民宿(aquamarine)名稱的由來，相傳台東都蘭山具有豐富的藍寶石礦脈，其中少數被開發出來具清澈透藍色澤，顏色接近碧海藍天的寶石，在國際珠寶界被稱之為頂級”海水藍寶石(aquamarine)”。海水藍民宿恰巧依偎在都蘭山腳下的杉原海灣旁，向外望去映入眼簾是陽光灑落在廣闊太平洋上，海面就如同就像數以千計的寶石閃爍著 漫遊在花東海岸一陣海風吹拂過身旁在這裡品味著海洋的氣息浪花拍打在礫石海岸的聲音不絕於耳海水藍歡迎旅人們帶著自在的心情來體驗美好的一天
stays.descriptionEn: The origin of our hostel’s name, Aquamarine, comes from the beautiful and rich sapphire mineral deposits in the Dulan Mountains of Taitung. The ones that has been explored have the beautiful shade of blue that is close to the wonderful blue skies of Taitung, the mineral is the world renounced Aquamarine jewel.The Aquamarine is located under the Dulan Mountain, in front of the Shanyuan beach. Giving our guests the breathtaking view of the sunlight bouncing off of the Pacific ocean, like a sea of crystal dancing to the rhythm of the ocean.Long strolls along the East Coast of Taiwan, with the breezy ocean scent, lay back and submerge yourself in the wide spread arms of the Pacific Ocean.With the sound of the waves against the coast as our background music, the Aquamarine welcomes our guests to experience the wonderful Taitung with a relaxed and open heart.

stays.description: 淺山深居民宿簡介風景中最精采的元素,就是一點天真無邪的陽光· (亨利·梭羅)為了贖回生命中的自由,回歸理想中的簡單生活我們在淺山·深居在淺山中瀡著四季的交替,可以遠眺太平洋的晨光與伴著萬家燈火的夜晚也可以在窗台近觀山嵐環抱群山峻嶺的風貌 如果你想更貼近大自然,可以沿著淺山後院林道緩緩步入 深山林內在這一完全不受文明入侵的原始森林裡會稍微遠離愛說閒話的環境· 森林像極了大地的眼睛帶著你看見不曾看見的~自己淺山深居提供旅人們的不僅僅是舒適的環境也奉上大自然的心

stays.descriptionEn: Hotel Royal Chihpen is situated in the scenic Chihpen area of Taitung County. It is blessed with natural hot spring water and surrounded with rich, natural scenic attractions such as gorges, waterfalls, the Chihpen Forest Recreation Area, etc. The natural hot spring resources and an international setting have made the Hotel Royal Chihpen the first, world-class hot spring leisure resort in the eastern part of Taiwan. It offers 183 guest rooms in a variety of interior designs, and each with a landscaped window view of the flourishing mountains. Indoor recreation facilities include both in-and out-door hot spring bathing facilities, professional spa service, fine dining and a wide-range of conference equipment to satisfy the varying needs of our guests.

stays.description: 民宿位於卑南鄉與台東市交界，交通便利，附近知名景點有:國立史前博物館、卑南文化公園及台東綠色隧道。園內占地廣大且種植眾多花草果樹，除供旅客駐足欣賞外，在此住宿還可體驗蟲鳴鳥叫的鄉村生活。房間為挑高10坪建築，屋內通風好採光佳，兩人房及四人房床鋪皆使用原木床架及天然乳膠床墊，希望讓前來住宿的朋友們享受一夜好眠。
stays.descriptionEn: The B&B is conveniently located at the border of Beinan Township and Taitung City, with nearby attractions including the National Museum of Prehistory, Beinan Cultural Park, and the Taitung Green Tunnel. The extensive park boasts numerous flowers, plants, and fruit trees, offering visitors a chance to admire the scenery while experiencing rural life amidst the chirping of insects and birds. The rooms feature 10-ping (approximately 10 ping) high ceilings, providing excellent ventilation and natural light. Both the double and quad rooms feature wooden bed frames and natural latex mattresses, ensuring a good night& #39;s sleep.

stays.name: 花媽民宿
stays.description: 其實我想出租的不是房間，我想推薦的是我們這的風景，真的很棒！早晨清新的空氣，寧靜的鄉間，只聽得見環繞在耳邊的蟲鳴鳥叫聲，仿佛像一曲大自然交響樂，瞬間感覺所有都市塵囂都離你而去，彷彿至身於世外桃源，所有壓力得到釋放，整個人會感到很放鬆，真的很值得大家來體驗一下，夜晚無光害的天際，星星掛滿整個夜空，微微的風徐徐吹來，聽著大自然的音樂，真的好美，好放鬆！
stays.descriptionEn: In fact, what I want to rent out is not the room. What I want to recommend is the scenery here, which is really great! The fresh air in the morning, the quiet countryside, you can only hear the chirping of insects and birds surrounding your ears, like a symphony of nature. In an instant, you feel that all the urban hustle and bustle has left you, as if you are in a paradise, everything The stress is released and the whole person will feel very relaxed. It is really worth experiencing it. The sky is light-free at night, the stars are all over the night sky, the gentle wind is blowing slowly, and it is really beautiful to listen to the music of nature. , so relaxing!

stays.name: 醇旅民宿
stays.description: 醇旅一間獨棟的民宿二間舒適的客房，三層樓的絕佳景色。我們位於臺東最美小村子 卑南鄉利嘉村，離市區僅10幾分鐘的車程，就能享有在都市感受不到的寧靜感,也因為在半山腰上，所以在民宿頂樓也能看到台東市的夜景，在夏日的夜晚也能在樓上觀星，只要在對的時間，並且天候極佳時，就能用肉眼看見許多流星~~三樓的戶外空間可以讓一起來的三五好友一起在這裡聊天，享用美食。醇旅二樓有兩間客房，外出遊玩最重要的睡眠，我們提供了疊放兩張獨立筒的彈簧床,還有一個共用客廳，這裡有 烏克麗麗 .電子琴.體感遊戲機冰箱以及飲水機都在這裡可以取用，冰箱裡每天都會泡一壺冷飲供大家取用，洛神花茶是大家的最愛。另外，如果你們也剛好是小叮噹迷，那可真的千萬不要錯過二樓的收藏櫃，這裡有滿滿的小叮噹收藏品，歡迎每一個愛小叮噹的朋友們一起來交流。
stays.descriptionEn: mellow travelA detached B&BTwo comfortable rooms,Excellent views from three floors.We are located in Lijia Village, Beinan Township, the most beautiful village in Taitung. It is only a 10-minute drive from the city. You can enjoy a sense of tranquility that you cannot experience in the city. Because we are halfway up the mountain, you can also see the night view of Taitung City from the top floor of the B&B. You can also watch stars upstairs on summer nights. As long as the time is right and the weather is excellent, you can see many shooting stars with the naked eye. The outdoor space on the third floor allows friends who come together to chat and enjoy delicious food.mellow travelThere are two guest rooms on the second floor. Sleep is the most important thing when traveling. We provide spring beds with two independent tubes stacked on top of each other. There is also a shared living room with a ukulele, an electronic keyboard, and a somatosensory game console.The refrigerator and water dispenser are available here. A pot of cold drinks is brewed in the refrigerator for everyone to use every day. Roselle tea is everyone's favorite.In addition, if you happen to be a Tinker Bell fan, then don’t miss the collection cabinet on the second floor. There are full of Tinker Bell collectibles. Everyone who loves Tinker Bell is welcome to come and exchange.

stays.name: 依三山民宿尚武一館
stays.description: 位於台東縣大武鄉政通五街23巷6號，緊鄰大武火車站僅步行約 3–5 分鐘，交通極為便利。大武村周邊有阿塱壹古道、濱海公園等自然景點，適合沿海踏浪、散步健行?️ 空間與住房種類全部為雙人房型，坪數約 6 平方公尺，提供標準雙人床，房間配置 空調、風扇、遮光窗簾、吹風機，附設 共用衛浴 。可包棟預訂，一棟可容納約 8 位成人。價格親民且乾淨，適合背包客、情侶或小資旅行者。設施與服務特色全館 公共區域提供 Wi‑Fi，並設有小小共享聊天空間，提升旅居的交流感 一樓有免費提供的 餅乾與茶包，供旅客自由取用 完全 禁止吸菸與晚間低音量規定，維護住宿環境安靜者友善
stays.descriptionEn: Located at No. 6, Lane 23, Zhengtong 5th Street, Dawu Township, Taitung County, it is close to Dawu Railway Station and only about 3-5 minutes& #39; walk away, with extremely convenient transportation. There are natural attractions such as the Alangyi Ancient Trail and the Coastal Park around Dawu Village, which are suitable for coastal surfing and walking and hiking. ?️ Space and housing types All double rooms are about 6 square meters, providing standard double beds, air conditioning, fans, blackout curtains, hair dryers, and shared bathrooms. You can book a whole building, which can accommodate about 8 adults. The price is affordable and clean, suitable for backpackers, couples or small travelers. Facilities and service features Wi-Fi is available in the public areas of the whole building, and a small shared chat space is set up to enhance the sense of communication during travel. There are free biscuits and tea bags on the first floor for travelers to use freely. Smoking is completely prohibited and low volume regulations are in place at night, which is friendly to those who maintain a quiet accommodation environment.

stays.name: 丹堤金崙溫泉民宿
stays.nameEn: Dan Di Jin Lun Hot Spring Homestay
stays.description: 位於臺東縣太麻里鄉，金崙溫泉區的溫泉民宿，排灣族部落區域。丹堤溫泉民宿依傍金崙溪，緊鄰原金崙野溪溫泉旁。溫泉屬於典型的溪谷型溫泉，泉質為碳酸氫鹽泉(舊名碳酸氫鈉泉)，另含有微量硫化物。客房有獨立湯屋。住宿提供早餐、大眾池泡湯、車站接送、Wi-Fi無線網路、公播有線電視。大眾池，為純泡湯客人提供純泡湯服務，需自備泳裝、泳褲、泳帽。二個大小溫泉池，一個大冷水池。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Taitung County, Taimali Township, in the Jilun Hot Spring area, a traditional Paiwan tribe village. Danti Hot Spring Inn is situated beside Jilun Creek, adjacent to the original Jilun natural hot spring. The hot spring is a typical valley-type hot spring, with bicarbonate-rich water (formerly known as sodium bicarbonate spring), also containing trace amounts of sulfur. Each guest room has a private hot spring bath. Amenities include breakfast, a public hot spring pool, airport/train station pick-up service, Wi-Fi, and cable TV. The public hot spring pool is for guests who wish to enjoy a soak; bathers must bring their own swimwear, swim cap, and other necessary items. There are two hot spring pools of different sizes, and one large cold water pool.

stays.nameEn: Tai Mali Chengbao Hot Spring Homestay
stays.description: 來到台東太麻里一定不可錯過享受放鬆的泡湯行程，環繞著美麗山景的太麻里城堡溫泉有著豐富的大自然景色，泡著溫泉看著山景，彷彿置身人間仙境般的奢華享受，擁有溫泉會舘少見的雙湯溫泉「黃金湯」與「美人湯」，一邊泡湯、一邊觀賞風景或抬頭仰望星空，呼吸山林的負離子及芬多精，洗滌內在心靈並去除外在文明病的渡假保養聖地。太麻里城堡溫泉歡迎您的蒞臨！
stays.descriptionEn: When you come to Taimali, Taitung, you must not miss a relaxing hot spring trip. Surrounded by beautiful mountain scenery, Taimali Castle Hot Spring has rich natural scenery. Soaking in the hot spring and looking at the mountain scenery will make you feel like you are in a fairyland on earth. Enjoy the luxurious experience. The two hot springs "Golden Hot Spring" and "Beauty Hot Spring" are rare in hot spring resorts. While soaking in the hot springs, you can enjoy the scenery or look up at the stars, breathe in the negative ions and phytoncides of the mountains and forests, cleanse the inner soul and remove the external diseases of civilization. This holiday care Holy place. Taimari Castle Hot Spring welcomes you!

stays.description: 「忘憂館景觀旅店」在南迴線最美麗的一角，坐擁大片海景與山景，用藍色畫出藍天，白色點綴海與天，打造出屬於地中海的一片天地，以希臘地中海風格細心打造的地中海渡假Villa，藍色圓頂與白牆映照著海洋，拱型窗框堆疊出濃濃的地中海風情。露臺上斜倚著藤椅，感受海風溫柔的吹拂著，就這樣慵懶地過一下午。夜晚有滿滿星空，伴您進入沉靜夢鄉。來到這裡您只需全身放輕鬆，放慢您的腳步，閉上眼睛聆聽大自然的音樂，感受海風徐徐吹來，忘卻所有的煩惱和憂愁，彷彿置身於地中海，享受片刻的寧靜和悠閒。「忘憂館景觀旅店」位於台東太麻里地區，鄰近台9線，不論旅人欲深入探訪太麻里各大私房景點，享受金崙溫泉的山林美泉、欣賞隨風搖曳的金黃色忘憂草(金針花)；或是欲沿著景色壯麗、山海佳景交疊的南迴公路南下/北上，前往台東各大景點探訪，皆十分便利。「忘憂館景觀旅店」提供雙人、四人及家庭浪漫套房，大小適中的房型空間，運用明亮的室內燈光結合高雅的裝潢設計，融入戶外的自然採光和秀麗景緻，展現寧靜的清新雅緻氣息，讓到訪的旅人們皆能暫時忘記塵世煩憂，如走入世外桃源般輕鬆自如～
stays.descriptionEn: The Forget Worry Villa is located at the most beautiful part of Taiwan’s South-Link Line. Staying at the villa, you can enjoy both ocean and mountain views. The Mediterranean style resort villa is decorated with colors of sky and sprinkled with white to create the atmosphere of Greek sea line. The blue dome and white building reflects the waves from ocean, arched window frame makes you feel right in the Mediterranean Ocean. You can enjoy a cozy afternoon lying on the poolside chairs on the balcony feeling the sea breeze. At night, bed times will be watched over by the starry sky. You should relax and slow down your pace when you arrive at the villa. Close your eyes and listen to the nature’s symphony, feel the sea breeze, and leave all the agony and sorrow behind and indulge yourself in Mediterranean to enjoy the peacefulness and leisure. The Forget Worry Villa is in Taitung’s Tai Mai Li district, neighboring Provincial Highway 9. The villa is conveniently located near the popular attractions such as the Kinluan Hot Spring, fields of lily flowers; or you can follow the beautiful landscape South Link Line to other attractions in Taichung. The Forget Worry Villa offers Twin Rooms, Quad Rooms, and Family Suites. The comfortable room space is elegantly decorated with natural lighting and beautiful scenery, demonstrating fresh and daintiness. Guests can leave behind all the worries and feel like staying at paradise.

stays.name: 被風吹的人背包客民宿
stays.description: 40年前，這個家誕生了。以排灣族語「Mavaliw」為家屋命名，譯成漢文為「被風吹」的意思，象徵這是一個經得起風吹考驗、屹立不搖的家；而你我，都是在人生旅途中需要「被風吹」的人。人生即是一場不斷經歷風起雲湧的旅程，無論你正承受著怎樣的風吹，如今我們在金崙這塊土地上相遇，願這裡成為你短暫停歇、重新整理步伐的地方。本民宿提供男女混合背包客八人房，採上下舖房型設計，適合獨自旅行的旅人、背包客，以及喜愛與不同旅人交流的人入住，空間簡單自在，在同一個屋簷下，分享旅途的故事與片刻的安定。每床每人700元／晚，包棟另有優惠。歡迎加入官方 LINE 訂房與洽詢，掌握最新房況與優惠資訊。
stays.descriptionEn: Forty years ago, this home was born. Named “Mavaliw” in the Paiwan language, it means “being blown by the wind,” symbolizing a home that can withstand the wind and stand firm, and reminding us that each of us, on our life’s journey, is someone who needs to be shaped by the wind. Life is a journey filled with changing winds and waves, and no matter what kind of wind you are facing, today we meet here on the land of Jinlun. May this place become a stop for rest, reflection, and regaining your strength. stays.name: 金讚溫泉飯店
stays.description: 本飯店位於台東太麻里鄉靜謐海岸邊的金崙，共有36間客房，將大海的療癒力量與溫泉的舒緩效果完美結合，為您打造不一樣的渡假感受。飯店擁有鹹水溫泉池，讓您在享受渡假的同時，感受到鹹水溫泉的特殊泡湯感受，其富含豐富的碳酸氫鹽，鐵質，與對人體有益的微量元素和礦物質，能舒緩身心、滋潤肌膚，抗衰老保健，為您帶來前所未有的養生體驗。無論您是尋求自然療癒，還是希望遠離都市塵囂，我們的飯店都將成為您的理想選擇。本飯店客房能俯瞰海景與有"台灣最美高架橋"之稱的金崙大橋，您可以一邊享受私人溫泉池的溫暖，一邊欣賞蔚藍太平洋海景和日出美景，讓溫泉與東海岸的力量，療癒您的心靈與身體，帶您進入一個真正放鬆的世界。
stays.descriptionEn: Our hotel is nestled in Jinlun, a serene coastal area of Taimali Township in Taitung, where the healing power of the ocean seamlessly blends with the soothing effects of hot springs, offering you a unique holiday experience.The hotel features a total of 36 guest rooms and a restaurant, complete with a saline hot spring pool. This allows you to enjoy a special hot spring bathing experience while on vacation. Rich in bicarbonate, iron, and beneficial trace elements and minerals, the saline hot spring can soothe your mind and body, moisturize your skin, and provide anti-aging health benefits, delivering an unprecedented wellness experience.Whether you are seeking natural healing or a retreat from the hustle and bustle of the city, our hotel is your ideal choice. Our rooms offer a view of the sea and the Jinlun Bridge, known as "Taiwan& #39;s Most Beautiful Viaduct." You can enjoy the warmth of a private hot spring bath while admiring the azure Pacific Ocean and the beauty of the sunrise. Let the hot springs and the power of the East Coast heal your soul and body, taking you into a truly relaxing world.

stays.name: 三仙台小月光民宿
stays.nameEn: Sanxiantai Little Moonlight Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: 【三仙台小月光民宿】位於台東縣成功鎮，不僅擁有青山綠水的絕美環境，入口便是石雨傘風景區的景觀亭，周邊鄰近石傘澳、金剛山及比西里岸等景點宛如比鄰，而距離三仙台也僅需短短車程便可抵達，是旅人來到台東享受完美渡假之旅的最佳住宿選擇。【三仙台小月光民宿】西鄰海岸山胍，東邊為無垠太平洋，前方可鳥瞰男人石與無敵山海景色，入夜後可欣賞繁星點點的浪漫夜景。民宿內提供雙人與四人套房，房間以日式簡約風格為主軸，呈現出優雅又愜意的氛圍，天花板上特別規劃的天窗，讓旅人在床上便能觀看滿天星斗高掛天際。三仙台小月光民宿邀請旅人以最悠閒的步伐，來趟三仙台，渡過難忘的美好假期。

stays.name: 千成湯海
stays.description: 依山面海，用白色地中海風格，大膽勾勒藍黃白色彩，讓整個建築物呈現，輕鬆、舒適、慵懶的感覺。除了建築物的特色外，並同時擁有3、4千坪的花園綠地，本著自然生態的保護，設立了自然生態池與自闢小溪、流水，結合園區前方的沙灘海灣，形成一副不可多得的風景勝地，有山有海、有池有溪、綠樹成林，有果有花。園區內處處可休閒﹝吊床、鞦韆﹞烤肉玩樂，這是民宿主人特地營造出慵懶休閒，親子歡樂、闔家聚會的園地。園外位置更是接近東部海岸風景管理處、阿美族民俗中心、泰源幽谷、東河口衝浪勝地、安通溫泉......有各式各樣的旅遊景點，動靜皆宜。以下略述園區可遊玩的活動：1.撈魚：﹝小溪中有孔雀魚可讓小孩撈取，也可少量帶回。﹞2.栽取作物：園區有小黃瓜、絲瓜、百香果、、水耕空心菜、番茄、釋迦、番石榴、芒果、蓮霧、等作物，可以進行栽取。3.觀鳥：園區的來往鳥類有環頸雉雞、水雉、班鳩、八哥、綠繡眼、黑頭翁、白鷺鷥、蒼鷺、三色鳥、戴勝、白腹鶇、紅嘴黑鵯、以及自己餵養的杜波鸚鵡、鴿子。4.賞花：栽種的植物有黃金香水玉蘭、玫瑰、印度橡膠樹、原生種百合、九重葛、重瓣朱槿、木槿、蒜香藤、桂花、狀元紅、春不老，白水木、羊蹄甲，黃蟬、流蘇、大花紫葳、孤挺花、黃懷、金鐘花、日日春、日日櫻、櫻花、橄欖、金露花、…………5.沙灘：可玩砂、戲水﹝暫不建議游泳﹞玩風箏、釣魚、抓寄居蟹、挖鐘螺幸運時也有九孔﹝要退潮時﹞6.可泡SPA、觀海、看日出﹝有觀景台﹞、喝咖啡、喝啤酒、花茶、………7.備有鞦韆、吊床、溜滑梯、石桌椅組、木桌椅組、大片木造平台皆可供休息、玩耍8.工具貨櫃屋中備有：石雕工具組、木工雕刻工具組、鏈鋸、釣竿釣具等用品，可供商借。
stays.descriptionEn: With back to the mountains and facing the Pacific Ocean, the architecture is built with white Mediterranean style, outlined boldly with blue and yellow colors, and created a building that presents a relaxed, comfortable, and lazy feeling. Besides the characteristics of the building, it has a greenery garden with an area of nearly 13,200 square meters. Based on the spirit of the natural ecological protection, we built a natural ecological pond, creeks, flowing water, to integrate with the sandy bay in front of the park, forming a rear unique scenic resort that includes mountains, sea, river, pond, trees, fruits, and flowers. In the garden, you can enjoy your leisure activities at any corner of the garden, including hammock, swings, or having barbecue fun. This is the garden that innkeepers to create specially for lazy leisure, family fun, and family gatherings. Outside the garden, it is close to the East Coast National Scenic Area Administration, Ami Folklife Center, Taiyuan Valley, Donghe estuary surfing resort, Antong Hot Springs ... and a variety of tourist attractions. Activities of your choices. The following outlines the available activities: 1. Catching Fish: (Kids can catch guppy fish in creek, and may bring a small amount back.) 2. Planted Crops: Cucumber, luffa, passion fruit, hydroponic water spinach, tomatoes, sugar-apple, guava, mango, wax apple, and other crops that can be harvested. 3. Bird Watching: Wild birds include Common Pheasant, Pheasant-tailed Jacana, Spotted Dove, Crested Myna, Japanese White-eye, Formosan bulbul, Little Egret, Grey Heron, tri-colored bird, Hoopoe, Pale Thrush, Black Bulbul, as well as domestic Ducorp& #39;s Cockatoo parrots, pigeons. 4. Flowers: Planted plants include: gold perfume magnolia, rose, Indian rubber tree. Native species: lilies, bougainvillea, Hibiscus rosa-sinensis L, Hibiscus, garlic vine, sweet-scented osmanthus, Osmanthus Fragrans, Ceylon Ardisia, Silvery Messerschmidia, Bauhinia, Allamanda, Chinese Fringe-tree, Giant Crape-myrtle, Dutch Amaryllis, Huang Huai, Lady& #39;s eardrops, Madagascar periwinkle, Rose-flowered Jatropha, cherry, olive, Golden Dewdrop, etc. 5.Beach: build sand castles, play with water (swimming not recommended), fly kites, go fishing, catch hermit crabs, dig turban snails, and Taiwan abalone (during low tide) if lucky.6. Enjoy SPA, sea views, sunrise (viewing platform), coffee, beer, and tea.7. Equipped with swings, hammocks, slides, stone tables and chairs sets, wooden tables and chairs sets, and large wooden platforms are available for rest and play.8. Tools container house offers: stone carving tool sets, wood carving tool sets, chain saws, fishing rods, fishing tackles, and other supplies are available to borrow.

stays.name: 大尾山姆民宿
stays.description: 台東｜大尾・山姆 維拉．山海相伴的光影假期車子沿著東海岸線行駛，一個轉彎，把海遠遠拋在後頭，轉進了左邊通往小馬和平山的入口，一條花間小徑出現在眼前，兩旁的花草樹木隨風搖擺，你期待著等在盡頭的「大尾．山姆 維拉」，會是什麼樣的驚喜呢？山坡上溫柔堆疊的夢想一棟灰色的建築坐落在山坡上，那就是「大尾．山姆 維拉」，保留混凝土的原色牆面刷上水泥粉光，方方正正的外觀，像是一格格堆疊起的積木，忽然鮮豔的黃跳進了視線，主人David說，那一面牆代表了他的心情。迎著藍天，每一天都是燦爛的假期。本來在電腦公司擔任工程師的David笑聲洪亮，卻有個柔軟的心，曾在台東當兵的他，因此愛上這裡的山海美景，十年前，為了讓年長的雙親休養，在山腰蓋了第一棟房子當作自宅，平常種蔬果、整理植栽。為了讓更多人體驗簡單而美好的生活，三年前開始規劃民宿，在山坡上蓋了第二棟房子，並將英文名字David、中文名字賢宗SamStrong和villa結合，為這個空間取了詼諧的名字──「大尾．山姆 維拉」。框住日光的各種姿態大尾山姆一次只接待一組客人，在這裡，你可以很放鬆地享受，找到自己最舒適的角落。一樓的兩間雙人房，灰色樸實的牆面，有大片的黃點綴，房間內沒有華麗的傢俱，而是用大片的玻璃窗，框進太平洋的海。半開放式的空間，你可以待在庭院，沿著花圃的步道散步，被綠意環繞；或是坐在房門口的雙人沙發，看著後方陽光灑落的山丘；你也可以走到樓梯後方，那裡有一道牆，牆上大小不一的矩形是光的小劇場，每個分秒每個角度，上演著光影舞動的魔幻戲碼。爬上樓梯來到二樓，屋內的客廳和廚房延續簡單樸實的風格，灰色水泥牆面襯托出木頭傢俱的溫暖，一旁的餐桌上放著David自製的迎賓蜜餞和乾菓，戶外陽台的兩張躺椅最適合瞇起眼享受日光浴，望著翠綠的山坡，一直延伸到山腳下太平洋海天一線的藍，此刻，只願時間就此打住，就待在這如詩般的風景裡。
stays.descriptionEn: Taitung｜David SamStrong VillaA seaside mountain vacation with sunlight and shadeDriving down the eastern coast, your car turns a corner and leaves the ocean behind. Another left turn and you head towards the entrance to Hsiaoma Hoping Mountain as an alley opens up between flowers to one side of the road. Wind ripples the trees and grass beside the alley as you make your way expectantly towards the end of the road where David SamStrong Villa is situated. You can’t help but wonder what kind of pleasant surprises await.A tender dream stacked in layers upon the hillsideA gray building sits upon the hillside. The concrete walls of David SamStrong Villa maintain their original color and are coated with a monolithic finish, the building itself square-shaped, like a stack of toy building blocks. Suddenly, a burst of bright yellow enters your line of sight. As David, the host of this guesthouse, explains, that splash of color represents his frame of mind. Every day is a splendid vacation under such blue skies.Originally employed as an engineer in a computer company, David has a resonant laugh and a soft heart. While performing his military service here in Taitung, David fell in love with the beautiful mountains and ocean vistas of the area. In order to give his elderly parents a place to retire and rest, he built a personal residence in the Taitung hills. At that time, now 10 years past, he spent his days tending the fruits, vegetables, and plants in his gardens. Three years ago, he began planning construction of a bed and breakfast, in the hopes of introducing even more people to the beauty of the simple life. Once built, he named this second building by combining his English (David) and Chinese (SamStrong) names. Thus, the jocular name David SamStrong Villa came into being.Framing the various postures of sunlightDavid limits admission to a single group of travelers at one time. In his villa, you can relax and live it up, and are guaranteed your favorite corner to lounge in. First floor accommodations consist of two double rooms which exhibit simple concrete-gray walls sprinkled with large splashes of yellow decor, yet are devoid of fancy furniture. Instead, large windowpanes allow the vastness of the Pacific Ocean to spill indoors. The semi-open design allows you to linger in the courtyard, strolling along the verdant garden paths. Alternately, you can sit in your doorway in a comfortable loveseat, savoring the sun-bathed hills in the distance. You can also stroll out behind the stairs, finding a wall fashioned with rectangular openings of different sizes through which the sunlight dances and plays in magical ways all day long.Climbing the stairs to the second floor, you find a living room and a kitchen in the same simple, down-to-earth style. Gray walls accentuate the natural warmth of the wooden furniture. David’s own handmade dried fruit preserves sit to one side of the dining table for the enjoyment of his guests. Two lounge chairs, ideal for sunbathing and admiring the emerald green mountainside, await you on the balcony outside. Gazing towards the base of the mountain, sky and sea meet at the horizon in a poetic landscape where time seems to stand still.Straightforward design highlighting spectacular viewsThe following morning, you are greeted by a table full of David’s handmade delicacies. Such things as eggs, salads, hibiscus tea, peanut butter and bread - all breakfast ingredients are organically grown and prepared by David and his mother. This distinctive, nourishing breakfast is made even more enjoyable by the blue backdrop of the Pacific Ocean beyond the windows.Light and shadow play through every corner of the semi-open and dynamic design of David SamStrong Villa. Wherever you go, you follow the tracks of sunshine and shade, whether standing or sitting or lying down. The green of the mountains and the blue of the ocean always seem easily within reach. How could a single day living in such luxury possibly be enough?

stays.searchText: 大尾山姆民宿 大尾山姆民宿 臺東縣民宿516號 臺東縣 成功鎮 信義里8鄰小馬路134-7號 台東｜大尾・山姆 維拉．山海相伴的光影假期車子沿著東海岸線行駛，一個轉彎，把海遠遠拋在後頭，轉進了左邊通往小馬和平山的入口，一條花間小徑出現在眼前，兩旁的花草樹木隨風搖擺，你期待著等在盡頭的「大尾．山姆 維拉」，會是什麼樣的驚喜呢？山坡上溫柔堆疊的夢想一棟灰色的建築坐落在山坡上，那就是「大尾．山姆 維拉」，保留混凝土的原色牆面刷上水泥粉光，方方正正的外觀，像是一格格堆疊起的積木，忽然鮮豔的黃跳進了視線，主人David說，那一面牆代表了他的心情。迎著藍天，每一天都是燦爛的假期。本來在電腦公司擔任工程師的David笑聲洪亮，卻有個柔軟的心，曾在台東當兵的他，因此愛上這裡的山海美景，十年前，為了讓年長的雙親休養，在山腰蓋了第一棟房子當作自宅，平常種蔬果、整理植栽。為了讓更多人體驗簡單而美好的生活，三年前開始規劃民宿，在山坡上蓋了第二棟房子，並將英文名字David、中文名字賢宗SamStrong和villa結合，為這個空間取了詼諧的名字──「大尾．山姆 維拉」。框住日光的各種姿態大尾山姆一次只接待一組客人，在這裡，你可以很放鬆地享受，找到自己最舒適的角落。一樓的兩間雙人房，灰色樸實的牆面，有大片的黃點綴，房間內沒有華麗的傢俱，而是用大片的玻璃窗，框進太平洋的海。半開放式的空間，你可以待在庭院，沿著花圃的步道散步，被綠意環繞；或是坐在房門口的雙人沙發，看著後方陽光灑落的山丘；你也可以走到樓梯後方，那裡有一道牆，牆上大小不一的矩形是光的小劇場，每個分秒每個角度，上演著光影舞動的魔幻戲碼。爬上樓梯來到二樓，屋內的客廳和廚房延續簡單樸實的風格，灰色水泥牆面襯托出木頭傢俱的溫暖，一旁的餐桌上放著David自製的迎賓蜜餞和乾菓，戶外陽台的兩張躺椅最適合瞇起眼享受日光浴，望著翠綠的山坡，一直延伸到山腳下太平洋海天一線的藍，此刻，只願時間就此打住，就待在這如詩般的風景裡。

stays.name: 寂里雅嵐民宿
stays.description: 「寂里雅嵐」是阿美族語「有海的地方」之意，得天獨厚的自然環境，面向太平洋，背倚海岸山脈第二高山成廣澳山，北有都威溪，南眺石雨傘石空鼻海岬。為大海、山脈、溪流，三景合一的絕佳勝境。 一路之隔石雨傘月牙海灘，夏季是廣闊沙灘，適合水上活動。冬季地貌變化成石灘，可以觀浪、釣魚、撿玉石，為四季皆宜的旅遊秘境。 若您有浪跡天涯放空的想望，邀 您與我們共享~
stays.descriptionEn: A Spanish-style villa in southern France, nestled against the mountains and facing the sea.We call it "Jili Yalan," which means "place with the sea" in Amis language.The rooms are decorated by our Amis hostess, who loves floral art.Lying in bed, you can see the beautiful Pacific Ocean, sunrise, and moonrise.Boasting a unique natural environment,it features an easily accessible winding beach,and the Duwei Creek, nurtured by the coastal mountains.It& #39;s a perfect blend of eastern coastal mountains, ocean, and stream, a truly stunning destination.If you yearn for a life of wanderlust and relaxation,we invite you to join us.

stays.name: 嵐海民宿
stays.description: 嵐海民宿位於台11線102公里處，過馬路即可到海邊，鄰近石雨傘、三仙台，都在車程5-15分鐘內可抵達，地理位置非常便利。早晨在房間就可以觀看太陽從海面昇起，若是滿月的夜晚，紅色的月亮會從海面慢慢浮出，場面之震撼讓您永生難忘。南歐風格的特色建築，白牆、紅瓦、拱門等元素與大海藍天互相輝映，給人閒適寧靜的感覺，讓人聯想到在地中海民族緩慢放鬆的生活步調。想聆聽大海的聲音嗎？間間面海，蔚藍的天空、朵朵白雲，壯闊無垠的海景，期待一次浪漫又療癒的旅程嗎？就從『嵐海民宿』開始！

stays.name: 巴斯拉岸民宿
stays.description: — 巴斯拉岸為阿美族語休息的地方 —顧名思義為希望每個旅客能放下世俗，丟掉煩惱，自由自在的渡假放鬆!巴斯拉岸民宿位在好山好水、親近大自然的地方，吸取芬多精，放眼望去萬叢高山與寬闊大海一飽眼福!一樓為大廳，寬裕的空間提供賓客無盡的使用，可自助烹煮美食、喝下午茶、看書、聽音樂﹔二樓則提供夜宿的賓客房間，房門皆為密碼鎖，擁有完善隱私的獨立套房﹔三樓為露台區，遠眺一望無際的山海，天氣晴朗時還可幸運的觀望遠方的綠島山。此外還貼心的提供特大號躺椅及陽傘涼椅配備 。白天輕盈的看風景 ～晚上備上小酒看星星 ～另外我們也擁有良好的交通位置，鄰近成功市區、便利商店、提款機、風景區、及漁港。巴斯拉岸提供家一樣的感覺，希望造訪的旅客們，能夠放下所有包袱，輕輕鬆鬆的來旅行，帶著滿滿的回憶回家。
stays.descriptionEn: Baslaan means "resting place" in the Amis language.As the name suggests, it encourages travelers to let go of worldly concerns and relax freely on their vacation!Baslaan B&B is nestled in a beautiful natural setting, close to nature. Enjoy the breathtaking views of towering mountains and the vast ocean while absorbing the phytoncides!The first floor houses the lobby, offering ample space for guests to enjoy their meals, enjoy afternoon tea, read, and listen to music.The second floor houses the overnight guest rooms, each with a combination lock, offering complete privacy.The third floor features a terrace overlooking the vast sea and mountains. On clear days, you can even see Green Island Mountain in the distance.We also thoughtfully provide king-sized lounge chairs and parasols. Enjoy the scenery during the day and stargaze at night with a glass of wine.We also enjoy a convenient location close to Chenggong City, convenience stores, ATMs, scenic spots, and the fishing port.Basraan offers a home-like feeling, hoping that visitors can let go of all their burdens, travel with ease, and return home with full of memories.

stays.name: 梅花鹿庭園家屋民宿
stays.description: 位在台東成功市區的梅花鹿庭園家屋，推開大門欄杆，便能看到一條出自於主人用心打造出的庭園小徑，讓造訪的旅客們漫步在寬敞的庭園，靜靜的享受這愜意的氛圍，享受完戶外悠閒時光，走進屋內，空氣裡瀰漫著一股淡淡的木香味，原來這就是傳說中的小木屋，擁有寬敞的交誼空間，還有一個大型的泡茶木桌，無論是在屋內泡茶聊天或是屋外賞景談心，這就是梅花鹿庭園家屋提供給來度假的旅客們一個溫馨且放鬆的好地方。
stays.descriptionEn: Meihualu Tingyuan Jiawu Homestay is located in the downtown of Chenggong Township, Taitung County. Pushing the door open, you can see a delicate path, on which you can walk in the spacious garden to enjoy the great atmosphere. At this point, having a cup of roselle tea will help to relax the chaotic mind and tense body. Stepping into the house, you can smell a faint scent of wood, because you stepped into a log cabin. Inside the cabin, there is a spacious lounge and a huge wooden tea table. You can stay in the house for a cup of tea or go outside for landscape viewing. This is what we want to do for you, enjoy and relax!

The B&B is conveniently located approximately 5 km from Chenggong Township, 60 km from Taitung Train Station, and 37 km from Hualien Yuli Train Station.All rooms at the B&B feature private bathrooms and air conditioning, as well as flat-screen TVs and free Wi-Fi. stays.name: 油桐花坊民宿
stays.description: 「油桐花坊曙光篇」位於台東縣成功鎮，東部海岸的第一線坐落於台11線109.3公里處，民宿建築外以捕魚網為設計概念，外觀採菱紋圖案設計。不同角度的嶄石工法，讓建築物在不同季節、不同角度的光線下，呈現不同的光影變化及建物風情。每個角落都面對三仙台海景，充滿了藝術創作氛圍，任何季節到此，都可以將美景盡收眼底。花坊更準備了道地又新鮮的海鮮料理，室內可容納將近200人以上的大型餐廳，海岸美景伴您用餐，不論是團體用餐或是家庭旅遊都讓您有愉快的享受。
stays.descriptionEn: "TUNG LODGE" sits in Chenggong Township, Taitung County. The wind beaten site of the East Coast is located at 109.3K of Provincial Highway 11. The building is designed based on the fish net theme with diamond patterns. Different stone cutting techniques allow the building to produce various light and shadow combinations and as well as a sense of architectural brilliance. You can see the sea beside Sanxiantai in every corner with an artistic and creative atmosphere. No matter when you come here, you always have a full view of beautiful sceneries. TUNG LODGE also prepares local fresh seafood. Its large restaurant can accommodate more than 200 people. During the dining time, you can see the beautiful sea scenery. No matter whether it is group dining or family travel, you will have joyful experience,

stays.description: 海意願名思義就是Hayi嗨呀～像是見到對方後熱情的招呼聲能夠帶給經過此地的旅人感受到這小鎮滿滿的熱情老闆為在地青年在窕鄉創業打拼淨意位於有人情味的成功鎮，一到中午成功漁港就會開娼湧入人潮，喊魚、標魚，體驗在地漁港生活，牛後還有三仙台風景區能夠看著東部的太平洋散散步，來到此遊玩記得有熱情的海意Hayi嗨咿～
stays.descriptionEn: The name Haiyi means Hayi~like a warm greeting after seeing the other person.It can make travelers passing by feel that this town is full of enthusiasm. The boss is working hard for the local youth to start a business in the countryside.Jingyi is located in the humane Chenggong Town. At noon, the Chenggong Fishing Port will be open and crowds of people will be shouting and marking fish to experience the life of the local fishing port. There is also Sanxiantai Scenic Area in Niuhou where you can take a walk while looking at the Pacific Ocean in the east. When you come here, remember to have a warm sea feeling Hayi ~

stays.name: 灣·淡麗
stays.description: 誠摯邀請您來體驗這片山海間的寧靜。這裡，我們沒有電視，只有自然的聲音和溫暖的壁爐。 絕美山海景：每天清晨與傍晚，山嵐與海潮為你帶來不同的美景。 獨立包棟：可容納6~7人，無論是家庭還是好友，享受專屬的空間。 壁爐與龍眼木香：夜晚的壁爐會帶來溫暖和舒適，木香四溢。 完備廚房：為你準備了齊全的廚房用具，還有提供部分食材，讓您可以隨心所欲運用，施展您久違的精湛廚藝。
stays.descriptionEn: We cordially invite you to experience the tranquility nestled between mountains and sea. Here, we have no television, only the sounds of nature and a warm fireplace. Stunning mountain and sea views: Every morning and evening, the mountain mists and ocean tides bring you different beautiful scenery. Private rooms: Accommodating 6-7 people, whether family or friends, enjoy your own private space. Fireplace and the aroma of longan wood: The fireplace brings warmth and comfort at night, filling the air with the fragrance of wood. Fully equipped kitchen: We have prepared a full range of kitchen utensils and provided some ingredients, allowing you to use them to your heart& #39;s content and showcase your long-lost culinary skills.

stays.name: 眠花糖民宿
stays.description: 眠花糖民宿位於台東縣成功鎮上，成功鎮擁有壯闊的太平洋海景、豐富的在地漁港文化與自然景觀，是喜愛海景、日出、悠閒生活旅人的熱門旅遊目的地。住客可以在清晨欣賞海面日出、傍晚散步於海港或沿海自行車道上享受海風。周邊還有三仙台、東海岸國家風景區、阿美族文化村等豐富景點，非常適合安排多日旅遊行程。民宿充滿質感與華麗風格，住客除了享受大海，也可體驗民宿的生活美學。
stays.descriptionEn: Mianhuatang B&B is located in Chenggong Township, Taitung County. Chenggong Township boasts magnificent Pacific Ocean views, rich local fishing port culture, and natural landscapes, making it a popular tourist destination for travelers who love seascapes, sunrises, and a leisurely lifestyle. Guests can enjoy the sunrise over the sea in the morning and stroll along the harbor or coastal bike path in the evening, feeling the sea breeze. Nearby attractions include Sanxiantai, the East Coast National Scenic Area, and the Amis Cultural Village, making it ideal for multi-day trips. The B&B exudes a sophisticated and luxurious style, allowing guests to not only enjoy the sea but also experience the lifestyle aesthetics of a B&B.

stays.name: 知也民宿
stays.description: 知也 tomoya 是一家位於台東海岸山脈與太平洋之間的小型民宿。建築以清水模與自然材質為主，空間保留簡單的線條與光影，讓風與光在屋內慢慢停留。民宿共有五間客房，有些房間迎著海風，有些接住午後的光。每個房間，都有自己的樣貌。早晨提供簡單而用心準備的早餐，食材多選自台東在地農產，搭配手作麵包、季節蔬果與咖啡。知也只是準備了一個地方，讓旅人可以慢慢住上一晚。在海風與天空之間。
stays.descriptionEn: Tomoya is a small guesthouse set between the Coastal Mountains and the Pacific Ocean in Taitung.The building is made with exposed concrete and natural materials.The spaces keep simple lines and soft light,allowing wind and daylight to settle quietly indoors.There are five guest rooms in the house.Some face the sea breeze, others catch the afternoon light.Each room has its own character.In the morning we prepare a simple breakfast with care.Many ingredients come from local farms in Taitung,served with house-made bread, seasonal fruit and vegetables, and coffee.Tomoya is simply a place prepared for travelersto slow down and stay for a night—between the sea breeze and the open sky.

stays.name: 馬可樓民宿
stays.description: 馬可樓民宿（民宿編號：1028）位於台灣東部海岸線成功鎮八嗡嗡原民部落位址，是擁抱太平洋，徜徉海岸山脈的好地方。隨著冬北季風，冷熱氣流的交錯，海岸山脈每天都呈現出不同的山嵐景色，有如神國般的意境。夏季的夜晚，正有一條銀河帶由馬可樓上方畫過……。需要遠離塵囂，讓靈、心、身充分舒解的您，誠摯的邀請您來一趟台東――馬可樓民宿，接受我們來自靈深處的熱情款待。
stays.descriptionEn: Cenacle House B&B (B&B No.: 1028) is located at the site of the Ba-Om-Om Aboriginal Tribe in Chenggong Township on the eastern coastline of Taiwan. It is a great place to embrace the Pacific Ocean and wander along the coastal mountains. With the winter north monsoon and the intersection of cold and hot air currents, the coastal mountains present different mountain scenery every day, like a divine kingdom. On summer nights, a Milky Way band was passing over the Cenacle Building... If you need to get away from the hustle and bustle and fully relax your soul, mind and body, we sincerely invite you to come to Taitung - Cenacle House B&B and accept our warm hospitality from the depths of your soul.

stays.description: 山海之間的世外桃源－歡迎來到M先生都蘭飯店& gt;地點：M先生都蘭酒店坐落於風景秀麗的都蘭部落，位於台東最迷人的角落之一，環抱蔚藍的太平洋和雄偉的都蘭山，宛如大自然雕琢的世外桃源。無論您是探索山脈、眺望大海，還是沉浸於都蘭獨特的藝術氛圍和悠閒的生活節奏，每一步都是身心療癒之旅。& gt;獨特設計：舒適享受 M先生都蘭酒店的設計理念基於“簡潔流暢的線條和自然混凝土風格”，將當地文化元素與現代舒適完美融合。每一個細節都旨在為旅行者帶來最純粹的放鬆體驗。打開窗戶，輕柔的海風和山間的芬芳撲面而來。這裡不只是一處住所，更是一次回歸自我的美好體驗。& gt; 探索大自然：沉浸於慢節奏的生活 都蘭先生週邊地區擁有壯麗的都蘭山步道、幽靜的海灘和充滿藝術氣息的當地社區。每一次探索都將讓您愛上這片土地的魅力。您可以騎上自行車，沿著海岸公路悠閒騎行，欣賞波光粼粼的太平洋；或者花一個下午的時間，漫步於充滿魅力的商店，品嚐都蘭獨具特色的手工藝品和當地美食；又或者沿著海灘漫步，欣賞美麗的銀河和璀璨的星空。& gt; 品味美食：體驗台東的道地風味 漫步於都蘭村落的特色商店，品嚐使用新鮮當地食材烹製的美味佳餚——每一口都飽含著台東的溫暖與用心。晚上，您可以前往附近的餐廳，享用新鮮的海鮮和當地特色美食，讓您的味蕾沉浸在旅程的美麗之中。來體驗獨一無二的假期吧！無論您是獨自旅行、享受浪漫之旅，還是與家人和朋友共度美好時光，M Dulan 先生度假村都是您放鬆身心、享受生活的理想之選。來吧，放慢腳步，聆聽大海和山脈的低語，我們熱忱歡迎您的到來！
stays.descriptionEn: A Secret Haven Between Mountains and Sea – Welcome to Mr. M Dulan& gt;Location: Nestled in the beautiful Dulan Tribe, a corner of Taitung& #39;s most enchanting landscape, Mr. M embraces the azure Pacific Ocean and the majestic Dulan Mountain, a veritable paradise sculpted by nature itself. Whether exploring the mountains, gazing at the sea, or immersing yourself in Dulan& #39;s unique artistic atmosphere and slow pace of life, every step is a journey of healing for both body and mind.& gt;Unique Design: Comfortable Enjoyment Mr. M Dulan& #39;s design philosophy is based on "simple and clean lines and a natural concrete style," blending local cultural elements with modern comfort. Every detail brings travelers the purest sense of relaxation. Open the window to be greeted by the gentle sea breeze and the scent of the mountains. This is not just accommodation, but a beautiful experience of returning to oneself.& gt;Explore Nature: Immerse Yourself in a Slower Pace of Life The area surrounding Mr. M Dulan boasts the magnificent Dulan Mountain Trail, secluded beaches, and local art communities. Every exploration will make you fall in love with the charm of this land. You can hop on a bicycle and leisurely cruise along the coastal highway, admiring the shimmering Pacific Ocean; or spend an afternoon exploring the charming shops, savoring Dulan& #39;s unique handcrafted crafts and local flavors; or stroll along the beach to admire the beautiful Milky Way and starry night sky.& gt;Savor the Cuisine: Experience Taitung& #39;s Local Flavors. Wander through the unique shops of Dulan& #39;s villages, where fresh local ingredients are used—every bite is imbued with the warmth and care of Taitung. In the evening, visit nearby restaurants to savor fresh seafood and indigenous cuisine, immersing your taste buds in the beauty of your journey.Come for a unique vacation experience. Whether you& #39;re traveling alone, on a romantic getaway, or spending quality time with family and friends, Mr. M Dulan is the perfect choice to relax and enjoy life. Come, slow down, listen to the whispers of the sea and the mountains, and let us warmly welcome you!

stays.name: 三十里蔚藍民宿
stays.description: 台東｜三十里蔚藍．綿延三十里的湛藍海景明朗午後，奔馳在台十一線上，一個轉彎，廣闊綠地和藍天在眼前展開，那天的湛藍、山的蒼翠，與落在其中的一幢暖白色的斜屋頂建築，彷彿是歐洲鄉村裡的一幅日常速寫。這天，在大山大海之間遇見綿延的——三十里蔚藍。歐式鄉村裡的優雅生活循著庭院小徑走入三十里蔚藍，一旁的狗兒在寬闊的草地上自在玩耍、奔跑，脫下鞋踏進大廳，雅緻的皮沙發和木家具詮釋鄉村風格的經典日常，隨處可見女主人Shirley 喜愛的貓頭鷹意象、以及在地藝術家的作品，素材多元但卻和諧如一，與其廣泛地稱之為歐式風格，倒覺一切都「很Shirley」，如同眼前一身碎花洋裝、笑得輕盈的女子，既溫暖也明快。看著Shirley俐落地打理一切，目光所見三十里蔚藍的一切，從上到下，由最細節的擺盤到房子概念的發想溝通，全由她一手包辦。曾經叱吒商界的Shirley，發揮自己卓越的能力，擔任過Pizza Hut、中橡、 Levi’s等知名公司的財務長，而那是Shirley事業的高峰，亦是身心壓力到達極限的時刻。在連續工作二十一天後，不堪負荷的身體發出警訊，讓她終於明白了平安健康才是人生中最大的福氣，於是決心放下一切繁務，回歸單純的生活。醉心於太平洋的迷人景致，Shirley特地在台東找了一片能看見遠方綠島的土地，蓋起屬於自己的三十里蔚藍，帶領旅人一起找回生活的舒適節奏，享受無邊無際的蔚藍。在山與海的陪伴下，品味美好假期「我們這裡都是用世界烘豆冠軍的豆子哦！如果運氣好，說不準還能碰巧喝到頂級的Geisha（藝妓咖啡）呢！」以自身的旅行經驗出發，身經百戰的Shirley無論如何都想要給客人最好的。悠閒的午後，嚐一口Shirley準備好的迎賓午茶，以木盤盛裝的各式小點精緻而可口，內餡透涼的泡芙、手作布朗尼和伊思尼奶油脆餅，再配上一杯現沖的咖啡，來到三十里蔚藍，就該放慢步調，品味假期的美好。
stays.descriptionEn: Taitung｜Coastline AzureA long coast of unbroken ocean blueOne clear afternoon, you rush along Taiwan’s East coast Highway 11. As you round a corner, the vast, grassy landscape stretches out ahead of you under an azure sky. In the middle of this magnificent scene sits a welcoming, white guesthouse, resembling a countryside sketch from a European diary. Today, between the mountain and the sea, discover -- Coastline Azure. The elegance of European country lifeWalking up to Coastline Azure along the courtyard path, you see dogs at play on the lawn nearby. Remove your shoes and enter the lobby where refined leather seating and wooden furniture bespeak of the classic country life. Shirley, the owner of Coastline Azure, has decorated this space with her favorite owl imagery as well as local works of art. These eclectic elements work seamlessly together to create a style which is totally Shirley. Her floral print dress and graceful smile are as warm and bright as today’s sunshine. Shirley skillfully manages every detail at Coastline Azure, from the meticulous dinner table arrangements to the inspired decor of each room. Once a part of the bustling world of business, Shirley’s extraordinary sense brought her great success as the chief financial officer of such distinguished companies as Pizza Hut, China Synthetic Rubber Corporation and Levi’s. At the peak of her business career, Shirley also experienced the greatest mental and physical stress of her entire life. After a 21-day period of continuous work with no time off, she realized that without a doubt health turns out to be the greatest wealth. She vowed to give up her busy career and return to a simple life. A love of the Pacific Ocean led her to seek out property in Taidong, with a view of Green Island on the horizon, where she would build her own guesthouse. At Coastline Azure, Shirley delights in leading travellers back into a slower, simpler rhythm where they can enjoy a broad slice of endless azure blue. A beautiful vacation in the company of mountains and sea “We only use world-champion roast coffee beans in our house! If you’re lucky, who’s to say you won’t end up with premium Geisha coffee in your cup!” Working from her own ample experience, seasoned traveler Shirley aims to provide her guests with nothing but the best. On a leisurely afternoon, guests are welcomed by a taste of her own afternoon tea preparations: an array of exquisite and delicious snacks on a wooden platter, such as cream puffs with cool filling, handmade brownies, and Isigny butter cookies accompanied by a cup of freshly brewed coffee. Guests arriving at Coastline Azure ought to slow down and savour the fine flavor of their vacation. On the second floor, Coastline Azure has two- and four-person rooms available. Each room derives its name from the movement of the sun and moon through the sky. In the rooms called “Moon Companion” and “Star Gazing”, the warm yellow glow of the moon and the resplendent stars illuminates the pitch-black night sky. You can greet the first rays of dawn as you sit enveloped by the boundless ocean vista in rooms with the names “Listen to the Ocean” and “Sunrise”. Shirley’s meticulous planning of the small two-person loft allows guests to soak in exclusive tranquility as they sit quietly near windows, overlooking the ocean. After a night in such a room, you’ll understand that the connection to the landscape is the best part about this place. Step out onto the spacious balcony where the rhythmic slap of the waves sounds nearby and revel in the exquisite company of the sun, moon, and stars. Living by the boundless water If you feel like an even farther view, then ascend to the rooftop patio and gaze into the distance. At a glance, take in the entire coastline from Jinzun in the North to Fugang in the South. Turn toward the west and behold the mighty and continuous ridge of the mountain range. Wrapped in the embrace of both mountains and sea, forget your worries and return to the purity of yourself. With your spirit enriched and refreshed by nature, the exhaustion you brought with you has long since disappeared without a trace. At Coastline Azure, put contentment back in your step as you walk abreast the mountains and the sea and embark on your next journey.

stays.name: 大石民宿
stays.description: 大石民宿位於台東縣東河鄉。背倚蓊鬱巍巍大山，遠眺蔚藍浩浩大洋，居高鳥瞰馬武窟溪及平行並列的新、舊東河雙橋。沿著蜿蜒的鄉間小道，慢步即可抵達富饒人情味的東河老街。民宿內、外牆是不經雕琢修飾的混泥土建築。低調、寧靜、樸實、飽滿。猶如一顆矗立在山坡上的大石，與散佈於馬武窟溪河床上的帝王石巨石陣，相映成趣。民宿位處之農地，種植各類香草、果樹。作物收成用以製造香料、果醬及肥皂等農業加工品。行車30分鐘內，可達東河橋風景區、金樽漁港、陸連島、柑橘之鄉泰源幽谷、成功漁港、都蘭糖廠文創園區等地。是衝浪、泛舟及旅遊的熱門景點。大石空間希望停留的旅人們，感受到終極簡單的美好。
stays.descriptionEn: THE ROCK B&B is located in Donghe Township, Taitung County. It leans against the towering mountains and overlooks the vast blue ocean. From a high position, it has a bird& #39;s-eye view of the Mawu Ku River and the parallel new and old East River bridges. Along the winding country roads, you can reach Donghe Old Street, which is rich in humanities. The interior and exterior walls of the B&B are made of uncarved concrete buildings. Low-key, quiet, simple and full. It is like a large stone standing on the hillside, contrasting with the imperial stone monoliths scattered on the bed of Mawu Ku River. The farmland where the B&B is located is planted with various herbs and fruit trees. The harvest is used to make agricultural products such as spices, jams and soaps. Within 30 minutes of driving, you can reach Dongheqiao Scenic Area, Jinzun Fishing Port, Lulian Island, Taiyuan Valley, the hometown of citrus, Chenggong Fishing Port, Dulan Sugar Factory Cultural and Creative Park and other places. It is a popular spot for surfing, rafting and tourism. Dashi Space hopes that travelers who stay here can feel the beauty of ultimate simplicity.
