stays.descriptionEn: Taitung& #39;s rich scenery and culture are the most primitive and natural features, simple and attractive. Green House Bed and Breakfast is located in the city center. You can experience the most local people and things by taking a stroll. You will encounter the sudden scenery and the joyful mood. Every throbbing moment intertwined will be firmly retained in your memory. Green House knows the importance of rest during travel. We leave the hustle and bustle outside and provide a comfortable space full of Taitung style to make you feel at home. You can relax and rest in the tranquility of Taitung and look forward to tomorrow& #39;s adventure.Green House Bed and Breakfast is located in Taitung City, Taitung County, right behind the downtown Starbucks and Donghai Sports Park. Free private parking is available.All accommodation types are air-conditioned and feature a private bathroom, flat-screen TV, fully equipped kitchen and balcony. A terrace is available for guests to use.The railway station is 6 km from Green House Bed and Breakfast.The airport is 3 km from Green House Bed and Breakfast.Tiehua Village is 2 km from Green House Bed and Breakfast.The Tourism Night Market is 2 km from Green House Bed and Breakfast.

stays.descriptionEn: Taitung [Traveller-Inn Day Moon Hotel] is your first choice for a great tourist accommodation. You don& #39;t have to go far to get a holiday here, just walk out of the hotel entrance and you can experience the Tiehua Village, the Railway Art Village, and the music settlement. Literary atmosphere. This museum is suitable for couples, parents, and backpackers to experience the cultural and creative, music, activities, the atmosphere of the story of the Eslite Story House in Tiehua Art Village, and the charm of Tiehua Art Village. The museum is located in Taitung& #39;s most lively urban area, next to Tiehua Village, Tiehua New Settlement, Railway Art Village, Eslite Bookstore, Starbucks, Showtime Studios, and is next to Taitung Passenger Terminal, famous snacks and tourist night markets, and convenient transportation , The best place for travelers to let you enjoy sightseeing spots such as Taitung City, Forest Park, and Seaside Park.

stays.description: 轉運站旁，全新落成。延續鐵花文創館的風格，「旅人驛站鐵花文創二館」於2019/7開始營運。「旅人驛站鐵花文創二館」位置臨秀泰影城廣場。對面即是台東客運轉運站，緊鄰鐵花村文創聚落。住房除享免費單程台東火車站/機場/富岡漁港與飯店間的「鼎東客運海線」接駁服務外，簡單樸實的客房風格中，維持了一貫令人窩心的設計，例如：非壁掛式的吹風機，客房內的免費飲料等；期待我們的這些細緻貼心，能令您的旅程更添美好回憶。另外本館有別於文創一館的以公路為主題，文創二館以對面台東舊火車站的鐵路為主軸，希望能帶給旅人們不同於以往的住宿體驗。歡迎大家來好山好水的台東，我們深信一次愉快的旅行～將給您帶來一年的好心情。
stays.descriptionEn: The hotel is a design hotel for stories and ideas. The rooms are fresh and simple, with simple and bright spaces, so that the materials present a real texture. Designed with themes, guided styles, using passenger routes to explore popular attractions. The hotel provides Chinese and Western buffet breakfast, and provides MOD and wireless WiFi network (please bring your own computer). It also sells cultural and creative products, agricultural special products, etc., which are good things in the east of Taiwan, to provide visitors with a one-time shopping convenience; it also provides meeting room space, so that company lines and other companies have sufficient hardware and software service.

stays.descriptionEn: Taitung Traveler Hotel is an ideal accommodation choice for two travelers who want to explore the vibrant charm of Taitung City. The hotel is close to green parks and cultural landmarks, and is convenient to Tiehua Village (538 meters) and Siwei Night Market (875 meters). Guests can relax in the soothing hot tub, enjoy room service, or join a guided tour to explore the local coastal atmosphere. Each room is equipped with free WiFi, air conditioning and a mini refrigerator to ensure you feel comfortable after a day of exploration. Experience convenience, relaxation and Taitung& #39;s unique culture in this prime location.

stays.name: 日出天際民宿
stays.description: 「日顯雲散彩虹處處 萬里一片天 出龍現鳳白鶴紛紛 千山無邊際」台東擁有遼闊的藍天白雲，生機盎然的綠意，清新的空氣以及美麗的日出。我們希望能將這些在大自然中體驗的美好，分享給旅人朋友們，希望您們來到這都能放鬆身心、沉澱心靈。在這裡不妨放慢腳步，深呼吸，為自己充飽能量！日出天際民宿位居東海岸一隅，前方可眺望獨具特色的「利吉月世界」與太平洋海面日出之美，後方可近觀台東卑南山脈。屋中有典雅而自然的天井設計，採光佳、空氣流通；室內還有各主題花柔美協調的彩繪牆，營造出優雅恬適的空間氛圍，讓您們同時享受旅遊生活的愜意與美感。
stays.descriptionEn: Taitung is blessed with vast blue skies, fluffy white clouds, vibrant greenery, fresh air, and beautiful sunrises. We hope to share the beauty of these natural experiences with travelers, so that when you come here, you can relax your body and mind, and find inner peace. Here, take a moment to slow down, breathe deeply, and recharge yourself with positive energy.The Sunrise B&B is located on a corner of Taiwan’s East Coast.In the front, you can enjoy the unique landscape of the “Liji Badlands (Moon World)” and the magnificent sight of the sunrise over the Pacific Ocean.Behind, the Beinan Mountain Range of Taitung stands in view.The house features an elegant and natural atrium design, allowing in abundant daylight and fresh airflow. Inside, each room has hand-painted walls adorned with floral themes, creating a graceful and cozy ambiance, so you can enjoy both the leisure and the beauty of travel life.

stays.name: 日安綠茵民宿
stays.description: 日安綠茵民宿位於卑南休間農場內，與綠茵小筑民宿(www.greenhouse.idv.tw)共享寬廣的綠地空間，及仰望都蘭山的開闊視野。圓拱型的房屋造型，有別於一般的建築，內部採用原木地板，提供舒適的住宿體驗。民宿於台東新站附近，交通方便，更緊臨台東市環市單車步道系統，住宿貴賓可使用民宿免費提供的單車，暢遊景觀多元的台東市；為方便住宿貴賓，民宿提供營養健康的早餐，期望蒞臨。
stays.descriptionEn: Ri An Green House is located in the Beinan Resort Farm, shares a wide green space with Green House B&B (www.greenhouse.idv.tw), and has a vast horizon to enjoy the lanscape of Mt. Dulan. A dome shaped house makes it distinctive from general architecture, and has an interior with wood floors, offering a comfortable stay. The B&B is close to the Taitung New Station and has convenient transportation, and next to Taitung City Circle Bike Trail System. Staying guests can use the bicycles provided by the B&B free to tour the diverse landscapes of Taitung City. For the convenience of lodging guests, we provide nutritious healthy breakfast. We hope your arrival.

stays.name: 星棧101民宿
stays.description: 星棧101民宿為商務和休閒旅遊遊客而設計，位於得天獨厚的臺東市地區，是本市最受歡迎的飯店之一。 在這裡，旅客們可輕鬆前往市區內各大旅遊、購物、餐飲地點。 這家飯店氣氛閒適安逸，而且離市區台東火車站,台東機場及小黃山,利吉惡地 卑南水利公園,卑南文化公園(卑南考古遺跡)等景點僅數步之遙。 為使客人感到賓至如歸，星棧101民宿盡一切努力提供最優質的服務和最優良的設施。 客人可享受飯店的一些服務：自行車出租服務, 免費無線網路等.。 走進5間漂亮客房之一，好好享受寬頻上網（無線）, 無線上網（免費）,衛星頻道/有線電視等設施，將一天的煩惱與壓力拋諸腦後。 飯店設施豐富多樣，包括花園等。 專業的服務與豐富的特色活動盡在星棧101民宿。
stays.descriptionEn: Starinn 101 House is designed for both business and leisure travels. Conveniently located in downtown Taitung City and it is one of the city& #39;s most popular hotels. Here, guests can enjoy easy access to the city& #39;s major tourist, shopping, and dining areas. This hotel has quiet, comfortable atmosphere, and is just a few steps from the Taitung Station, Taitung Airport, and Little Huangshan, Liji Badlands, Beinan Dazun Water Conservation Park, Beinan Cultural Park (Puyuma archaeological sites), and other attractions. To make guests feel at home, Starinn 101 House makes every effort to provide the best service and the best facilities. Hotel guests can enjoy some of the services: bicycle rental, free wireless internet, etc. Walking into one of five beautiful guest rooms, enjoy internet access (wireless), wireless internet access (complimentary), satellite/cable TV, and other amenities. Enjoy the amenities and put troubles and stress behind us. Hotel facilities include garden, etc. Starinn 101 House offers professional service and a wide array of features.

stays.descriptionEn: Located in Taitung County, “Taitung Xing Yang Guesthouse” sits beside Fengli Elementary School near the city center. Guests can enjoy the lively atmosphere of downtown while still experiencing a peaceful and tranquil environment.The guesthouse is decorated with a fresh, elegant, and modern minimalist style. Inside, you’ll find a stylish mini bar and a fully equipped kitchen, creating a cozy, home-like atmosphere for travelers visiting Taitung.“Taitung Xing Yang Guesthouse” is primarily designed for whole-house rentals, making it the perfect choice for families and friends to gather, strengthen bonds, and immerse themselves in Taitung’s unique cultural charm.✨ We warmly welcome you to Taitung Xing Yang Guesthouse! ✨

stays.name: 普悠瑪民宿
stays.description: 普悠瑪（PUYUMA）源自台東卑南族對自身的稱呼，意涵為「團結、聚集」。我們以「普悠瑪」為名，希望在這片土地上，邀請來自各地的旅人相聚於此，一起放慢腳步，感受台東最真實、最純粹的美。在這裡，沒有匆忙的節奏，只有自然的風、溫暖的人情，以及貼近土地的生活方式。透過在地文化的體驗，讓旅人重新找回單純的幸福，體會簡單卻深刻的慢活人生。普悠瑪不只是一個停留的空間，更是一個讓人放鬆、交流、連結彼此的所在。期待每一位到訪的朋友，都能在這裡留下屬於自己的台東回憶。? 地址：台東縣台東市岩灣里15鄰樂利路61之1號
stays.descriptionEn: Puyuma, derived from the name of the Puyuma people of Taitung, means "unity and gathering." We named it "Puyuma" to invite travelers from all over to gather here, slow down, and experience the most authentic and pure beauty of Taitung.Here, there is no hurried pace, only the natural breeze, warm hospitality, and a lifestyle close to the land. Through experiencing local culture, travelers can rediscover simple happiness and experience a simple yet profound slow-paced life.Puyuma is not just a place to stop, but a place to relax, communicate, and connect with each other. We hope that every visitor will leave with their own Taitung memories.? Address: No. 61-1, Leli Rd., Lane 15, Yanwan Village, Taitung City, Taitung County, Taiwan

stays.searchText: 普悠瑪民宿 普悠瑪民宿 臺東縣民宿2280號 臺東縣 臺東市 岩灣里15鄰樂利路61之1號 普悠瑪（PUYUMA）源自台東卑南族對自身的稱呼，意涵為「團結、聚集」。我們以「普悠瑪」為名，希望在這片土地上，邀請來自各地的旅人相聚於此，一起放慢腳步，感受台東最真實、最純粹的美。在這裡，沒有匆忙的節奏，只有自然的風、溫暖的人情，以及貼近土地的生活方式。透過在地文化的體驗，讓旅人重新找回單純的幸福，體會簡單卻深刻的慢活人生。普悠瑪不只是一個停留的空間，更是一個讓人放鬆、交流、連結彼此的所在。期待每一位到訪的朋友，都能在這裡留下屬於自己的台東回憶。? 地址：台東縣台東市岩灣里15鄰樂利路61之1號

stays.name: 晴川樹民宿
stays.description: 位於臺東縣的民宿晴川樹*取自：長江千萬里，何處是儂鄉？忽見晴川樹，依稀辨漢陽。讓旅人在飄泊疲憊之後，能夠在晴川樹得到放鬆，如同在家一樣自在無束。 這裡是綠色園區，週邊有大樹環抱，還有稻田圍繞，一年四季有不同的田間風情，隨著農夫春耕，夏耘，秋收，冬藏，呈現不同的風貌。大樹上常吸引不同鳥類佇足，早上有啾啾聲做晨喚，有時鳥兒落地覓食，與狗兒追逐遊戲。 在這裡雖然沒有豪華的房間設施，但是乾淨明亮，還有大自然的清新與乾淨的天空，早上在東方可以享受溫暖的陽光洗禮，下午有美麗的落日餘暉陪伴你迎接黑幕，黑幕來臨時可以仰望璀璨星光。 你可以在露台喝咖啡，享受喧囂都市沒有的寧靜與放鬆，與家人好友共度美好的時光，這裡是不錯的選擇。 晴川樹的女主人快樂做工作，民宿不會滿房，也不會天天接待客人，因為我們必須自己清洗浴毛巾，被單，床罩，枕頭巾及所有寢具，它們要在太陽下曝曬，充分殺菌後，才給下一組客人使用，所以衛生是高標要求的。我是退休女教師，雖然沒有專業的接待能力，但有一顆善良熱誠的心，與你分享晴川樹的一切。 我快樂做民宿女主人，不為賺錢，所以不會經常接待客人。我會在接待一天之後休息幾天，把民宿房間打掃乾淨，把寢具清洗曝曬陽光，讓下一組客人有乾淨的環境。鄰近機場，可遠眺飛機降落。附近有希臘式建築--豐源國小，跨過一座橋可以到達台東大學。週邊一望無際的田園，綠色饗宴可以盡情享用。

stays.description: 木頭人民宿名字的來源于兒時的遊戲一二三木頭人，大學畢業后到臺東專科任職木工科教師，家里的家具大部分是實木製作，民宿的床鋪是自己親手做的實木床，于2015年8月正式開幕，客房風格以簡單，明亮，寬敞為主，庭院式的停車場可停汽車四部。主人住在民宿的一樓，定居臺東30多年，對臺東各大個景點熟悉，可以代為安排行程。民宿旁邊就是臺東美術館和臺東基督教醫院，生活機能健全，位于臺東市中心，離夜市，森森公園，鐵花村等均在5分鐘車程內，有免費的腳踏車可供使用。提供車站，機場收費接送，希望來臺東玩的朋友住的玩的開心。

stays.name: 東之棧民宿
stays.description: 我們的民宿鄰近糖廠與鐵花村，散步即可抵達。白天可以在糖廠感受懷舊氛圍，晚上則到鐵花村欣賞音樂與文創特色。無論是休閒散心或深度旅行，這裡都是體驗台東魅力的理想住宿選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: Our guesthouse is conveniently located near the Sugar Factory and Tiehua Village, both within walking distance. Spend the day soaking up the nostalgic atmosphere of the Sugar Factory, and in the evening, enjoy live music and creative vibes at Tiehua Village. Whether you’re here to relax or explore, it’s the perfect place to experience the charm of Taitung.

stays.name: 東糖官邸民宿
stays.description: 。台東市區僅存庭園老屋民宿。前身為屋齡近70年的【台東糖廠廠長宿舍】，外觀與內部皆保持民國50年代樣貌，客房則混搭北歐風格，兼具復古風情與住宿舒適。屬於I型人的空間。房舍庭院占地近200坪，只有3個房間，一次最多只招待2組客人；採自助入住，沒有電視、卡拉Ok、麻將桌，但有大樹、草地，跟鞦韆。一卡皮箱體驗台東慢生活。有廚房、洗烘衣機，有腳踏車；停車方便，離車站、市中心開車10分鐘；巷口有公車站、蜜鄰超市，生活機能完整便利。歡迎來旅行、放空、Workation。
stays.descriptionEn: ●In Taitung City, there is a garden-style old house bed-and-breakfast that still remains. Originally the Taitung Sugar Factory Manager’s Residence, the building is nearly 70 years old. Both the exterior and interior retain the style from the 1950s, while the guest rooms are a mix of Scandinavian design, offering a combination of retro charm and comfortable accommodation. ●This is a space designed for Type I personalities. The property spans nearly 200 ping (approx. 660 square meters) with only three rooms, hosting a maximum of two groups of guests at a time. Self-check-in is available, and there are no TVs, karaoke machines, or mahjong tables, but there are large trees, grass, and swings. ●Experience Taitung's slow living with just a suitcase. The house is equipped with a kitchen, washer-dryer, and bicycles. Parking is convenient, and it’s only a 10-minute drive to the station and city center. A bus stop and a nearby supermarket are just around the corner, making everyday life convenient and complete. You are welcome to come for a trip, relax, or enjoy a Workation.

stays.name: 東陽峇里商旅酒店
stays.description: 台東峇里商旅酒店座落於繁華的台東市區內，館內大廳洋溢著濃郁的渡假風情，搭配著慵懶的峇里樂聲和貼心專業的服務人員，充分呈現出台東所在地的南島氛圍。台東峇里商旅酒店擁有135間寬敞、潔淨、明亮的舒適套房，包含峇里蜜月房、峇里雙人房、峇里四人房、峇里VIP豪華家庭四人房、商務單人房、精緻雙人房、標準雙人房、家庭四人房、VIP豪華家庭四人房與家庭六人房等各式房型，提供旅客最優質的台東住宿空間。每間客房都提供有線電視節目、吹風機以及冷氣空調，齊全的衛浴設備、衛浴日用品，提供電視、衣櫃、梳妝台、電話、冰箱等設施，並依房型附贈中西自助式早餐。除此之外，每間客房皆提供無線上網功能 (需自備筆記型電腦)。本酒店清潔、高雅、舒適的住宿環境使您感覺賓至如歸，不論台東旅遊、綠島旅遊、蘭嶼旅遊或是出差洽公，本酒店都是您最好的選擇。餐飲美食部份，本酒店每天從早晨07:00至09:30，都為每位住宿旅客準備豐盛的中西自助式早餐。菜色變化多樣，營養又豐富，精緻的早餐更讓您活力充沛、精神飽滿的迎接這一天快樂的旅程！此外，本酒店二樓太平洋時尚海鮮餐廳的餐飲空間能夠滿足32張以上的婚宴喜慶 (包含獨立包廂)，餐廳除了提供各式台式海鮮合菜之外，更首創阿美族的海洋風味料理與各種風味的特色佳餚，期待能提供給台東縣市地區一個嶄新的用餐氛圍，度過一個更快樂美好的用餐聚會時光。台東峇里商旅酒店擁有位於台東市區這得天獨厚的地理環境，距離台東火車站、台東機場或是台東市各觀光景點，都非常的方便。本酒店期望提供給來台東旅遊、綠島旅遊或是蘭嶼旅遊的旅客便利的台東線上訂房服務，更能有一個舒適自在的台東飯店住宿環境。而本酒店既是商務會館、旅者客棧、渡假旅館，也是背包客的好去處，讓您在悠遊台東山水的同時也能保持工作效率，卻不忘在繁華塵囂中許您一個寧靜，台東峇里商旅酒店全體員工，誠摯期待您的光臨。

Taitung Bali Suites Hotel boasts spacious guestrooms set with South Pacific décor and fully equipped with standard amenities, making it the perfect base for both business and leisure travelers. Catering to a variety of events, the business center and conference rooms are well-appointed with advanced equipment. Taitung Bali Suites Hotel will undoubtedly enhance your trip in Taitung.

stays.description: 民宿位於市區，至鐵道藝術村及夜市都只要5分鐘車程，停車便利。民宿內一樓擁有一個大交誼廳及60吋大電視，是家庭、朋友聚會的溫馨會所，唯獨民宿無提供廚房，有此需求的請多斟酌。主人與管家皆不與客人同住，基於住客安全於公區(一樓客廳)設有監視器予於告知。於各樓層梯間設有小冰箱，各房間基本的備品、水、大小巾、茶包、熱水壺等皆具備，每各房型都是套房，有各小巧的陽台，裝潢設計清新，能讓旅客放鬆的家~

The only thing is that the B&B does not provide a kitchen, so please consider it carefully if you have this need.The owner and the housekeeper do not live with the guests. For the safety of the guests, there are surveillance cameras in the public area (living room on the first floor) to inform them.There are small refrigerators in the stairwells on each floor, and each room is equipped with basic supplies, water, large and small towels, tea bags, kettles, etc. Each room type is a suite with a small balcony. The decoration design is fresh and can make travelers relax at home~

stays.descriptionEn: LOHAS is a life style that modem men put an effort to pursue sustainable living, organic diet, physical and spiritual growth. We, in Lohas B&B Homestay, uphold and promote the spirit and aesthetics of LOHAS to "love yourself, love your family, and love the earth," but also to entertain you with three safety principles, namely "safe, well-being, peace of mind."

stays.description: 樂知旅店YES HOTEL位台東市正氣路夜市商區與鐵花村商圈，近台東公車客運站、知名台東美食米苔目、臭豆腐、炸雞、豆花、湯圓與青草茶等特色小吃步行即可到達。台東市樂知住宿享豐富中西自助式早餐，旅遊商務住宿專屬停車場與免費自行車租借，騎著單車就能到旁邊的海濱公園、活水湖、森林公園、鯉魚山、鐵花藝術村、秀泰影城、鐵路步道觀光旅遊。樂知有全館Wi-Fi、自助洗衣烘衣服務，大廳有台東釋迦、蜂蜜、乖乖、麻糬、地瓜酥等伴手禮。感謝旅遊部落客達人、食尚玩家來去住一晚住宿樂知採訪拍攝推廣台東旅遊，台東樂知旅店秉持著商務旅遊住宿專業與服務熱誠接待每位來台東的旅客，堅持不斷提升良好住宿與服務品質帶給旅人，樂知旅店YES HOTEL是旅人國民旅遊、家庭親子旅遊、青年旅遊商務出差台東市住宿溫馨又便利的家。

stays.description: 這是一棟全新裝潢的電梯民宿，整棟裝置過濾軟水設備，讓你飲水與沐浴有如洗溫泉般的柔軟細緻感，華麗的客廳、家庭劇院環繞音響、真皮沙發與座椅、飯店級的淋浴設備、舒適全新的臥房寢具，都是主人精心為住客放鬆心情、安心入住的貼心設計。從這裡到卑南文化公園5分鐘的路程，早晨清新的空氣、舒適的環境、讓住客能夠在清晨散步，享受台東的大自然之美，鄰近走路約1分鐘的seven還有全家，一轉角處的早餐店，都非常方便。位於台東火車站、卑南文化公園、卑南大郡水利公園附近。
stays.descriptionEn: This is a newly decorated elevator B&B. The whole building is equipped with filtering soft water equipment, allowing you to drink and bathe as soft and delicate as a hot spring. Gorgeous living room, home theater surround sound, leather sofas and seats, hotel-level shower The equipment, comfortable and brand-new bedroom bedding are all carefully designed by the owner for the guests to relax and stay at ease. It is 5 minutes away from here to Beinan Cultural Park. The fresh air in the morning and the comfortable environment allow residents to take a walk in the morning and enjoy the beauty of nature in Taitung. It is just around the corner from Seven and the whole family, which is about a 1-minute walk away. The breakfast shop is very convenient.It is located near Taitung Railway Station, Beinan Cultural Park, and Beinan Dajun Water Conservancy Park.

stays.description: 「歐拉民宿（馬亨亨民宿C館）」水藍色牆面搭配紫色腰帶，顯得活潑熱力十足，與台東戶外熱情陽光相互輝映，更顯悠閒度假氣息。歐拉民宿設有2人、3人、4人及6人套房，套房採用木質地板、每間房更是以不同顏色主題布置，搭配雅緻吊燈及純白床組，讓房間整體更顯典雅高貴，大片可開式的落地窗戶使得戶外的陽光灑滿屋內地板，更顯明亮舒適。民宿位於火車站5分鐘路程，便利生活，但夜晚寧靜舒適、讓您享有舒眠的恬靜氛圍，的旅人們皆可獲得真正愜意自在的絕佳住宿品質。
stays.descriptionEn: "Ola B&B (Mahengheng B&B C)" has aqua blue walls with purple belts, which looks lively and energetic, and complements the warm outdoor sunshine in Taitung, which makes it more leisurely and holiday-like.Ola B&B has 2-person, 3-person, 4-person and 6-person suites. The suites are made of wooden floors, and each room is decorated with different color themes. With elegant chandeliers and pure white beds, the room is more elegant and noble. The large openable floor-to-ceiling windows allow the outdoor sunlight to fill the floor, making it brighter and more comfortable.The B&B is located 5 minutes away from the train station, which is convenient for life, but the night is quiet and comfortable, allowing you to enjoy a quiet atmosphere for a good sleep. All travelers can get a truly comfortable and comfortable accommodation quality.

stays.description: 來到美麗東海岸，享受壯麗的山海風情之餘，是否還在煩惱著住宿地點?正一商務汽車旅館(中華路一館) 是您夜泊休憩最好的選項，位於台東市近郊，距離東海岸不到兩公里，周圍綠意盎然，環境清幽舒適，提供情侶約會、朋友結伴、居家旅遊或是商務出差的最佳選擇。房型寬敞、獨立衛浴，館內設施豐富，提供免費早餐及Wifi。附近鄰近景點包括熱門IG打卡景點-地中海式建築的豐榮國小、麥當勞中華店、星巴客中華門市、東海運動公園，開車族往台九線可達泡湯勝地-知本溫泉，不妨來趟放鬆心靈的甜蜜之旅吧!
stays.descriptionEn: Welcome to the stunning East Coast! While enjoying the magnificent mountain and sea scenery, are you still worrying about where to stay?Zhengyi Business Motel (Zhonghua Road Branch) is your best choice for a restful night. Located on the outskirts of Taitung City and less than two kilometers from the East Coast, it is surrounded by lush greenery, offering a tranquil and comfortable environment. It is the ideal option for couples, friends traveling together, family vacations, or business trips.The rooms are spacious with private bathrooms, and the motel provides a variety of facilities, including free breakfast and Wi-Fi.Nearby attractions include the popular Instagram-worthy spot Fengrong Elementary School with its Mediterranean-style architecture, McDonald's Zhonghua Branch, Starbucks Zhonghua Branch, and the East Coast Sports Park. For those driving, you can head to the renowned hot spring destination, Zhiben Hot Springs, along Highway 9. Why not embark on a sweet and relaxing getaway?

The newly opened hotel is well equipped to offer a clean, bright, comfortable, safe and convenient environment. In addition to the warm hospitality of all hotel staff, the surroundings of our accommodation will definitely give you a wonderful memory.

stays.description: 正方行民宿鄰近台東火車站，地理位置極具優勢，是旅人抵達台東後最輕鬆無負擔的住宿選擇。民宿空間以簡約清新為設計主軸，營造溫暖放鬆的入住氛圍，客房乾淨明亮、設備完善，讓人一進門就能卸下旅途疲憊。正方行民宿不僅是一處住宿，更是一個讓人安心停留、輕鬆出發的據點。無論是短暫停留或深度旅行，都能在這裡找到剛剛好的舒適與自在，為台東旅程增添一份從容與質感。
stays.descriptionEn: Zheng Fang Xing Homestay is conveniently located near Taitung Railway Station, offering an excellent location that makes it an easy and stress-free accommodation choice for travelers arriving in Taitung.Designed with a simple and refreshing style, the homestay creates a warm and relaxing atmosphere. The rooms are clean, bright, and well-equipped, allowing guests to unwind and relieve travel fatigue as soon as they step inside.More than just a place to stay, Zheng Fang Xing Homestay serves as a comfortable and reliable base for your journey. Whether for a short visit or a longer stay, guests can enjoy a perfect balance of comfort and ease, adding a sense of calm and quality to their Taitung experience.

stays.name: 民宿庫民宿
stays.description: 「民宿」一詞，其源自日本的民宿(みんしゅく 音Minshuku) .故本館以此取名為民宿庫。本館是屬於主題民宿，前庭院更有相相如生的3D立體畫，一樓屬於工業風格，房問有六大主題(兒童樂園、城堡樂園、衝浪、電影、禪風、復古)，讓客人每次來住都有不同的感受，尤其是兒童樂園及城堡樂園內有溜清梯，更是兒童夢寐以求的天堂，主人親自參與設計的風格，讓住過的容人都可以感受到其用心。早餐有時會搭配原住民美食、當地水果成當地農產品，讓旅客休驗台東飲食文化。民宿庫也期盼遠道而來的訪容放慢腳步，不急不徐，用不同的角度不同的視野，來認識現在不一樣的台東。
stays.descriptionEn: The word "B&B" comes from the Japanese Minshuku (みんしゅく sound Minshuku). Therefore, the hotel is named B&B Library after this. This hotel is a themed B&B. There are life-like 3D paintings in the front courtyard. The first floor is in industrial style. The rooms have six major themes (Children's Paradise, Castle Paradise, Surfing, Movies, Zen Style, and Retro). Guests have different feelings every time they come to stay. Especially the children's paradise and castle paradise have sliding stairs, which are children's dream paradise. The owner personally participated in the design style, so that everyone who stays here can feel his intentions. . Breakfast is sometimes paired with aboriginal delicacies, local fruits and local agricultural products, allowing travelers to experience Taitung's food culture.The B&B also hopes that visitors from afar will slow down, take their time, and use different angles and different perspectives to understand the different Taitung now.

stays.name: 水菓糖民宿
stays.description: 水菓糖民宿 Fresh Juice B&B 於2013年05月正式開張，起初我們以經營民宿結合新鮮果汁、手作早午餐、麵包甜點，重新整修的全新空間讓我們能提供給顧客更棒的住宿及飲食空間。2018年12月下旬，我們決定將早午餐獨立出來搬往距離水菓糖民宿150公尺處的『樂食 Love Eat』，並將一樓的餐飲空間提供給入住的旅客使用，可以聚餐、聚會聊天。​2019年06月，第六年的水菓糖，我們決定有點不一樣。不僅在服務上的升級，早餐的變化結合當地食材及當地風味以及提供預約式晚膳服務，我們希望讓曾經入住過的旅客，重新回味水菓糖民宿 Fresh Juice B&B。
stays.descriptionEn: Fresh Juice B&B was officially opened in May 2013. At first, we operated a B&B with fresh juice, handmade brunch, and bread and desserts. The renovated new space allows us to provide customers with better accommodation and dining space.In late December 2018, we decided to separate the brunch and move it to "Love Eat" 150 meters away from Fresh Juice B&B, and provide the dining space on the first floor to the guests staying in the hotel for dinner, gathering and chatting.In June 2019, the sixth year of Fresh Juice, we decided to be a little different.Not only the upgrade in service, the change of breakfast combines local ingredients and local flavors, and provides reservation-based dinner service. We hope that the guests who have stayed in the hotel will revisit Fresh Juice B&B.

stays.name: 沐舍文旅-鐵花秀泰館
stays.description: 【沐舍文旅】得天獨厚的地理位置，座落在美麗的城市中心，您可以輕鬆前往市區各大旅遊景點、悠遊台東夜市，品嚐台東著名小吃，從飯店出發到縣內各熱門景點，交通方便且快捷。品質優良又經濟實惠的沐舍文旅，是您來台東從事商務活動或是休閒旅遊的最佳休息地點，讓您慵懶放鬆的渡過美好假期。飯店設有二十四小時前台服務，提供行李寄放處、貼心的旅遊諮詢台，另外設有投幣式自助洗衣機。為忙碌的您提供放鬆身心的理想去處。【沐舍文旅】以最熱情誠摯的心歡迎您的到訪，以家為本的概念，親切的服務讓您感受如家一般的溫暖。沐舍文旅擁有不同的房型，滿足您不同的需求。客房內擁有多項設施如：電熱水壺、平面有線電視、電子保險箱、玻璃門無聲冰箱，浴室設有吹風機、淋浴設備及免治馬桶。另外貼心的沐舍文旅為您準備豐盛的自助中西式早餐，讓您活力滿滿展開一天精彩的旅程；3樓交誼廳設有24小時供應的咖啡吧、飲料吧、點心吧讓您填滿旅程中的能量。【沐舍文旅】是您探訪台東這塊美麗土地的最佳選擇，一處讓人心動的地方，現在就拾起行囊和沐舍文旅一起感受台東的魅力吧！
stays.descriptionEn: ● It is the second tallest building in the city and has the most beautiful scenery: This 12-story hotel is the second tallest building in Taitung City, and its room overlooks Taitung City downtown, Liyu (Carp) Mountain, Jhihhang (Zhihang) Air Force Base, East Coast, Fugang Fishery Harbor, and so on. ● The most convenient hotel for business trip: The hotel is located in the downtown area, near the Central Market, County Government, County Police Department, County Education Bureau, County Tourism Bureau, and other official agencies, as well as Taitung Branches of major banks, and also near Stadium, National Taitung University, is the first choice for a business trip. ● The most convenient hotel to access: This hotel is located in the most wanted downtown area, provides convenient transportation for accommodation, singing, eating, parking, or other facilities and services, a first choice among urban hotels. ● The most convenient hotel for shopping: Near Central Market (morning market), close to Taitung Tourist Night Market (at Zhengqi Road), and various shops are within walking distance. ● The most convenient hotel for relay transportation: 12 minutes from the harbor to take a boat ride to Green Island or Orchid Island (Lanyu), 10 minutes from airport, and 15 minutes from Train Station.

stays.name: 浪居Lounge Away民宿
stays.description: 我們的主旨是讓大家不只能享受旅途，也能學習專業課程並對環境保育做出貢獻。浪居- Lounge away的創辦人是鄭子倫，浪居位於台灣東海岸台東，富有豐富的自然環境及人文風情。致力於格鬥業界已經有10年的教學經驗以及選手經驗。主要是為了推廣格鬥運動與戶外訓練的結合，讓旅客不只能體驗專業的格鬥教學也能享受台東戶外的美景和當地風俗民情。除了格鬥運動以及戶外訓練的項目，我們也會結合淨灘等自然保育的活動。
stays.descriptionEn: Alan is the founder of Lounge away. We are located in Taitung, is in the Southeastern corner of Formosa where is rich aboriginal history and stunning natural environment views. Dedicated in combat sports for 10 years as fighter and coach. My goal is promoting combination of tropical vacation, outdoor training and environmental-protection. stays.name: 湯園二館
stays.description: 湯園民宿是一棟以白色和橘色文化石建成的建築，晚上更有漂亮的氣氛燈投射，增添了詩意的氛圍。民宿提供免費早餐和免費停車場，讓旅客感到更加便利。室內裝潢也是民宿主人精心設計，每間房間的色彩與風格都各具特色。大廳較偏美式風格，一樓更有一面牆是民宿老闆娘親手設計的馬賽克拼貼圖案。室內的黃光營造出溫馨舒適的氛圍。此外，湯園民宿還設有電梯，為旅客帶來更便利和舒適的住宿體驗。湯園民宿位於台東市中心，距離台東火車站只需10分鐘車程，交通便捷。民宿提供引導式入住，下午5點過後房客可自動入住，更增加了方便性。民宿內部提供免費腳踏車，讓旅客可以輕鬆探索周邊景點，如台東美術館、鐵花村、台東森林公園、海濱公園等，享受美好的假期。此外，附近還有平價美味的餐廳，可以讓您品嘗到台東在地美食，深度體驗台東文化之美。在湯園民宿中，您可以漫步在精心打造的空間中，感受到台東淳樸的氛圍，並在這個舒適的環境中放鬆身心，享受愜意的旅程。無論是家庭、情侶或商務旅客，都能在湯園民宿中找到自己旅途的樂章。我們期待著您的入住，讓湯園民宿成為您台東之旅最美好的回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: Tang Home B&B is a charming building made of white and orange cultural stone, which looks even more beautiful at night with atmospheric lighting that creates a poetic vibe. The B&B offers free breakfast and free parking for added convenience. The interior design is thoughtfully curated by the owner, with each room having its own unique color scheme and style. The lobby has a more American-style vibe, and on the first floor, you& #39;ll find a mosaic wall art designed by the owner herself. The warm lighting inside creates a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. Additionally, Tang Home B&B is equipped with an elevator, making your stay even more comfortable.Located in the heart of Taitung City, the B&B is just a 10-minute drive from the Taitung Train Station, making it very accessible. For your convenience, the B&B offers self-check-in after 5 PM, allowing for a smoother arrival process. Guests can also enjoy free bicycles to explore nearby attractions like the Taitung Art Museum, Tiehua Village, Taitung Forest Park, and Seaside Park—perfect for a relaxing and enjoyable vacation. There are also affordable and tasty local restaurants nearby, where you can savor the flavors of Taitung and experience its rich culture.At Tang Home B&B, you can take a leisurely stroll through the thoughtfully designed space, soak in the authentic atmosphere of Taitung, and unwind in a comfortable setting that promises a pleasant journey. Whether you& #39;re here with family, a partner, or for business, Tang Home B&B offers the perfect retreat for all types of travelers. We look forward to welcoming you and making your Taitung trip unforgettable.

stays.description: 訂房前加入官方LINE，可領取優惠訊息，請google 搜尋 "漫光時旅"，即可連結官網領取最優惠資訊。 《漫光時旅》名字的由來是希望旅人能夠能在此入住時能有浪漫且漫步的時光之旅。在我們的民宿內外都有獨樹一幟的人工智慧主題畫作，而我們非常重視客人的住宿體驗，因此民宿所有的房間都設計得非常舒適且溫馨。每個房間都擺放了故事性的畫作，讓您可以在放鬆休息之餘，也能夠享受一場奇幻知性之旅。 自助入住： 漫光時旅採用自助入住，讓你享受自在舒適無打擾的自在生活。你不需要等待前台的服務，也不需要擔心鑰匙或卡片的遺失，訂房後與我們聯繫，我們會提供密碼，就可以輕鬆自由進入房間。打造你想要的氛圍。 超值優惠介紹： 二樓為超值套房，適合兩人無打擾的輕旅行；一樓為家庭式整層公寓，包含兩個雙人套房、一個星空客廳、一個吧台餐廳。客廳沙發床可提供加床服務，整層最多可住 6 人。 位於市區： 漫光時旅位於台東市市區，靠近鐵道，你可以沿著鐵道散步到達鐵花村，感受台東的文化和藝術。這裡還提供瓶裝水，入住期間本住宿有提供沐浴乳、洗髮乳、潤髮乳、洗手洗面乳等。 漫光時旅民宿，是你旅行台東的最佳選擇，快來預訂吧！民宿中的所有畫作皆是用民宿主人自創，民宿公共空間的主題，分別是漫光時旅大廳、塞普勒斯餐廳，共有五個主題房，分別是獅王房、極地企鵝房、獨角獸房、北極熊房、長毛象房，歡迎大家一睹為快。 google 搜尋 "漫光時旅"連結官網 ，加入官方Line即可領取最優惠資訊。 此間民宿居在台東市正市區，鬧中取靜，離最著名觀光景點鐵花村、觀光夜市、微光市集及步道走路僅有10-15分鐘步行路程，旁邊美食小吃、便利超商、全聯商店林立，離機場與火車站開車僅10-15分鐘可達。我們沒有專屬停車場，但附近也有很多免費停車格與付費停車場。漫光時旅豪華家庭房，是你和你的家人在台東的最佳選擇。這裡有一個主題客廳，讓你感受時光旅行的浪漫和奇幻。這裡有兩間豪華雙人套房，讓你享受舒適和私密的休息空間。這裡還有一個餐廳，讓你品嘗台東的美食和特色。這裡讓你擁有整層的自在享受，把整個家來台東。如果你需要更多的床位，沙發還可以張開為沙發雙人床，提供額外加床服務，讓你充分的家庭旅遊的感覺。漫光時旅豪華家庭房，是你和你的家人在台東的溫馨之家，快來預訂吧！
stays.descriptionEn: Join the official LINE before booking to receive discount information. Please search "Manguang Travel" on Google to link to the official website to receive the best discount information.The origin of the name "Long Light Time Travel" is that travelers can have a romantic and strolling time journey when staying here. There are unique artificial intelligence-themed paintings inside and outside our B&B. We attach great importance to our guests' accommodation experience, so all rooms in the B&B are designed to be very comfortable and warm. Storytelling paintings are placed in each room, allowing you to enjoy a fantasy and intellectual journey while relaxing. Self-service check-in: Manguang Travel adopts self-service check-in, allowing you to enjoy a comfortable and undisturbed life. You don't need to wait for service at the front desk, and you don't need to worry about losing your keys or cards. Contact us after booking and we will provide you with the password, so you can easily enter the room freely. Create the atmosphere you want.Super value offer introduction: The second floor is a value-for-money suite, suitable for two people to travel without interruption; the first floor is a family-style whole-floor apartment, including two double suites, a starry sky living room, and a bar restaurant. Extra beds are available on the sofa bed in the living room, which can accommodate up to 6 people on the entire floor.Located in the urban area: Manguang Hotel is located in the urban area of ​​Taitung City, close to the railway. You can walk along the railway to Tiehua Village and experience the culture and art of Taitung. Bottled water is also provided here. During your stay, the hotel provides shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, hand wash and facial cleanser, etc. Manguang Time Travel B&B is your best choice for traveling in Taitung, come and book now!All the paintings in the B&B are created by the B&B owner. The themes of the B&B’s public spaces are the diffuse travel lobby and Cypress Restaurant. There are five themed rooms, namely the Lion King Room, the Polar Penguin Room, and the Independent Room. You are welcome to take a look at the horned animal room, polar bear room, and mammoth room. Search "Manguang Travel" on google to link to the official website, and join the official Line to get the best deals. This B&B is located in the downtown area of ​​Taitung City, a quiet place amidst the hustle and bustle. It is only a 10-15 minute walk away from the most famous tourist attractions, Tiehua Village, the tourist night market, the Shimmer Market and the walking trail. It is next to delicious snacks and convenience supermarkets. , Quanlian shops are numerous, and it is only 10-15 minutes drive from the airport and train station. We do not have an exclusive parking lot, but there are many free parking spaces and paid parking lots nearby. Manguang Hotel Deluxe Family Room is the best choice for you and your family in Taitung. There is a themed living room here that allows you to feel the romance and fantasy of time travel. There are two luxurious double suites here, allowing you to enjoy a comfortable and private resting space. There is also a restaurant here where you can taste Taitung’s food and specialties. Here you can enjoy the entire floor and bring your whole home to Taitung. If you need more beds, the sofa can also be opened into a double sofa bed, providing extra bed service, giving you the full feeling of family travel. Manguang Travel Deluxe Family Room is a warm home for you and your family in Taitung, come and book now!

stays.name: 潘朵拉民宿
stays.description: 我是民宿的主人，太太姓潘，太麻里人，我姓游，大家叫我阿不拉，"朵"在日文有"和"的意思，所以我們民宿的名字就叫潘朵拉。我從事旅館業三十餘年退休下來，喜歡上台東的藍天白雲及青山綠水，就毅然在此開了一家民宿，過著退而不休的生活，也可以交到一些新朋友。潘朵拉是一家電梯民宿，我們體恤遠道而來的旅客，有些帶著小孩，拖著行李，甚至還有年邁的長輩，我們免去他們再爬樓梯之苦，所以這裡是台東最先有電梯的民宿！我們的地點就在台東火車站附近，步行約七、八分鐘，租腳踏車、機車、轎車非常方便，台東市的景點也都在15分鐘車程內，交通便利，地處幽靜，在此休息一晚，可以洗去一身的疲憊，潘朵拉無疑是最佳住宿地點！
stays.descriptionEn: I am the owner of the B&B. My wife's surname is Pan, and she is from Taimali. My surname is You. Everyone calls me Abla. "Duo" means "and" in Japanese, so the name of our B&B is Pandora.I worked in the hotel industry for over 30 years and when I retired, I fell in love with the blue sky, white clouds, green mountains and clear waters of Taitung, so I decided to open a homestay here. I can live a retired but not retired life and make some new friends.Pandora is an elevator B&B. We are considerate of travelers who come from far away, some of whom bring children, drag luggage, and even elderly elders. We save them the pain of climbing stairs, so this is the first B&B in Taitung with an elevator!Our location is near Taitung Railway Station, about seven or eight minutes' walk. It is very convenient to rent bicycles, motorcycles, and cars. The attractions in Taitung City are also within a 15-minute drive. The transportation is convenient and the location is quiet. Resting here for a night can wash away all your fatigue. Pandora is undoubtedly the best place to stay!

stays.name: 澄靛民宿
stays.description: 澄靛民宿簡介澄靛，靜止明亮的藍，台東的天空總是乾淨清澈的。沈澱，當車緩緩駛進南迴，心情就開始安定下來，終於回到那個日思夜想的台東沈澱身心。民宿位於台東機場旁，備有電梯，雙人房四間，自有停車位二個，適合家族旅遊，超大的客廳及中島式廚房、8人大餐桌；設計採IKEA北歐風格。四樓為尊親房，兩面都有窗戶，向北可欣賞有台東富士山之稱的都蘭山美景，面西窗可欣賞中央山脈的風起雲湧氣象萬千，前方大露台可遠眺太平洋、綠島，傍晚時分有夕照彩霞相伴。三樓前為哥哥房，前有獨立小陽台及落地窗，採光明亮，視野極佳。三樓後為弟弟房，二樓後為父母房，雙面開窗，空間明亮。民宿主人從小喜歡全家在餐桌上話家常，慢慢煮慢慢吃，所以用餐空間沒有電視，家人的感情就是這樣堆積滋養而來的。客廳有舒適的真皮沙發，可以三代同堂享受沙發電影院，或是姊妹淘舒服的來杯紅酒聊心事。客廳有大片窗戶，窗外有日式庭園，草皮、石階及各式盆栽花奔，一早起床就有好心情。如果你是露營咖，四樓大露台，絕對可以滿足你想露的心情，在獨立的空間盡情烤肉，烤肉用品讓電梯幫你送上來，不用走樓梯，烤完的杯盤還有洗碗機代勞。
stays.descriptionEn: Introduction to Chengdian B&BIndigo, still and bright blue, the sky in Taitung is always clean and clear.After a while, when the car slowly drove into Nanhui, my mood began to settle down, and I finally returned to Taitung, where I thought about it day and night, to calm down physically and mentally.The B&B is located next to Taitung Airport. It is equipped with an elevator, four double rooms, and two parking spaces. It is suitable for family travel. It has an oversized living room, an island kitchen, and a large dining table for 8 people. The design adopts IKEA Nordic style.The fourth floor is a family room with windows on both sides. To the north, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Dulan Mountain, known as Mount Fuji in Taitung. The west window can enjoy the turbulent scenery of the Central Mountains. The large terrace in front can overlook the Pacific Ocean and Green Island. In the evening The hour is accompanied by colorful sunset.The front of the third floor is the brother's room. There is a small independent balcony and floor-to-ceiling windows in front, which provide bright lighting and excellent views.Behind the third floor is the younger brother's room, and behind the second floor is the parents' room, with windows on both sides, making the space bright.Since childhood, the owner of the B&B has liked the whole family to have homely conversations at the dining table and cook and eat slowly, so there is no TV in the dining space. This is how the family's feelings are accumulated and nourished. There is a comfortable leather sofa in the living room, where three generations can enjoy the sofa movie theater together, or sisters can chat over a glass of red wine in comfort.There are large windows in the living room, and there is a Japanese garden outside the window, with grass, stone steps and various potted flowers running around. You will be in a good mood when you wake up early in the morning.If you are a camping fan, the large terrace on the fourth floor can definitely satisfy your mood. You can enjoy barbecue in a separate space. The barbecue supplies can be brought up by the elevator for you without having to take the stairs. There is also a dishwasher for the finished cups and plates. Do it for you.​

In addition to expressing the meaning of mutual help , also has similar words to "Hateruma Island", the southernmost inhabited island in Japan. It belongs to the Austronesian culture like Taitung and has a similar climate. It is also a scenic spot that the host of the B&B often visits, so this B&B is named "Hateruma Island". stays.description: 旅行，就是放下一切，沒有牽絆，舒適、自在、放鬆。眼前，童話般的佈置與擺設，彷彿回到孩童時光般，無憂無慮，悠閒快樂。踏入「瑪吉外宿」，感受到民宿主人用心設計的巧思。華麗奢華與活潑可愛，搭配出獨特的衝突感，吸引著您的目光。這裡，如家一般溫馨舒適，一定是您的最佳選擇。平凡的生活中，該來點不一樣的了。平時壓抑自己在一個緊迫的時間與空間，都沒機會好好休息，這樣難得的假期，可不能讓它浪費了。與朝陽一同盛開綻放，讓陽光與清新的空氣洗滌您一身的壓力吧！我們將最真誠的幸福，滿滿傾注給您，好好享受這個假期的美麗片刻吧！
stays.descriptionEn: Traveling means letting go of everything, without any ties, being comfortable, free and relaxed. In front of you, the fairy-tale-like layout and furnishings are like returning to childhood, carefree, leisurely and happy.Step into "Maggie& #39;s Homestay" and feel the ingenuity of the homestay owner& #39;s careful design. Gorgeous luxury and lively and cute, with a unique sense of conflict, attract your attention. Here, as warm and comfortable as home, it must be your best choice.It& #39;s time to do something different in ordinary life. Usually I suppress myself in a tight time and space, and I don& #39;t have a chance to rest well. Such a rare holiday can& #39;t be wasted. Bloom with the morning sun, let the sunshine and fresh air wash away your stress! We will give you the most sincere happiness, and enjoy the beautiful moments of this holiday!

stays.name: 留園民宿
stays.description: 「好宅，才要和旅人朋友分享」，民宿主人這麼說道。即使許多人都認為將如此美麗的房子做成民宿相當可惜，主人仍抱持著分享的心，提供好的環境、優質的貼心服務，與過往旅客結緣，這棟以男主人-清留之名而命的「留園民宿」，與中國四大名園之一的留園不謀而合，更擁有寧靜、優雅的氣息，每間房間都有舒適的陽台可遠眺都蘭山雲瀑霞光，不僅如此，留園民宿距機場、火車站及市區各景點都相當便捷，而後方即是鐵馬步道，旅客可悠閒地散步，欣賞台東之美。
stays.descriptionEn: "A good house should be shared with travellers and friends," said the owner of the B&B. Even though many people think it is a pity to turn such a beautiful house into a B&B, the owner still holds the heart of sharing, providing a good environment and high-quality and considerate services to establish a relationship with past travelers. This "Liuyuan B&B" named after the male owner, Qing Liu, coincides with the Liuyuan Garden, one of the four famous gardens in China, and has a quiet and elegant atmosphere. Each room has a comfortable balcony with a view of the clouds and waterfalls of Dulan Mountain. Not only that, Liuyuan B&B is very convenient to the airport, train station and various attractions in the city, and behind it is the Iron Horse Trail, where tourists can take a leisurely walk and appreciate the beauty of Taitung.

stays.name: 癒室民宿
stays.description: 這裡有一個屬於民宿主人、也屬於這片土地的小故事。 民宿主人成長在基隆的都市部落裡，是漢人與阿美族的混血兒，對於自己身為原住民的身份始終感到驕傲。當部落朋友提到回原鄉時，總是心生嚮往，渴望找到屬於自己的根源。帶著這份期待，來到了台東，卻發現這裡無人認識。 在台東的生活有些孤單，直到某天，貓咪們的陪伴讓我找到一絲安慰。動物的無條件愛與陪伴，在這片陌生的土地上找到了一種熟悉的溫暖，也成了創立這家民宿的動力。透過癒室貓咪咖啡廳民宿，希望每一位來到這裡的旅人，不僅能感受到動物的療癒，也能接觸到原民文化的美麗。 在這裡，希望每位旅人能放鬆心靈，從中體會到這片土地深處的溫暖。
stays.descriptionEn: Here lies a story that belongs to the host of this guesthouse and this land. The host grew up in the urban tribal area of Keelung, a mixed heritage of Han and Amis descent, and has always felt a deep sense of pride in their indigenous identity. When tribal friends spoke about returning to their homeland, it sparked a longing to reconnect with their roots. Carrying this hope, they came to Taitung, only to find themselves without connections or a guide to lead them back to the tribe. Life in Taitung was lonely at times until one day, the companionship of cats brought a sense of comfort. The unconditional love and support of these animals provided a familiar warmth on this unfamiliar land and became the inspiration for creating this guesthouse. Through **Healing Cats Café and Guesthouse**, the host hopes that every traveler who visits can not only experience the healing presence of animals but also discover the beauty of indigenous culture. Here, they wish for every visitor to relax their hearts and feel the warmth that flows deep from this land.

stays.name: 白練shironeri民宿
stays.description: 歡迎來到「白練 Shironeri 民宿」——位於臺東市中正里 12 鄰 中正路 251 巷 22 號的靜謐寶地。在這裡，我們致力於為每一位旅人打造一處「慢 ・ 深 ・ 自在」的歸屬感。民宿名稱「白練 Shironeri」，取自日語中的「純淨白練」色彩意象，象徵純粹與恬靜。走進我們的空間，陽光透過木質窗框灑入，柔和的米白與淡木調交織出一份溫柔的氛圍。
stays.descriptionEn: Welcome to Shironeri B&B – a tranquil haven located at No. 22, Lane 251, Zhongzheng Road, Neighborhood 12, Zhongzheng Village, Taitung City.Here, we are dedicated to creating a sense of belonging that is "slow, deep, and comfortable" for every traveler. The name "Shironeri" is derived from the Japanese word for "pure white ribbon," symbolizing purity and tranquility. Stepping into our space, sunlight streams through the wooden window frames, creating a gentle atmosphere with soft off-white and light wood tones.

stays.nameEn: Royal Well House Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: 位於臺東市區的民宿Royal House皇家好宅提供花園、露台以及附陽台和免費WiFi的空調住宿，距離海濱公園僅有2.6公里。 旅舍距離台東夜市有800米，設有共用廚房。 民宿設有家庭間。每間房間都配有帶餐桌的設施齊全的小廚房、帶有線頻道的平板電視以及帶淋浴設施、拖鞋和吹風機的私人浴室。 這間家庭式住宿的客房提供寢具和毛巾。民宿的客人可以在台東市及其周邊地區進行健行等活動。 客人還可以在共用休息區放鬆身心。Royal House皇家好宅附近的熱門地標包括台東美術館、台東故事館和鯉魚山公園。 最近的機場是台東機場，距離這間住宿5公里。
stays.descriptionEn: Situated 2.6 km from Seaside Park Beach, Royal House offers a garden, a terrace and air-conditioned accommodation with a balcony and free WiFi. It is located 800 metres from Taitung Night Market and features a shared kitchen. The homestay has family rooms.Each unit comes with a fully equipped kitchenette with a dining table, a flat-screen TV with cable channels and a private bathroom with shower, slippers and a hair dryer. At the homestay, units include bed linen and towels.Guests at the homestay will be able to enjoy activities in and around Taitung City, like walking tours. Guests can also relax in the shared lounge area.Popular points of interest near Royal House include Taitung Art Museum, Taitung Story Museum and Liyushan Park. The nearest airport is Taitung Airport, 5 km from the accommodation.

stays.description: 眠極文旅是一家注重便利性和現代化的電子化管理民宿。我們採用先進的電子鎖系統，讓您的入住和退房過程更加方便和安全。我們的電子鎖系統讓您無需使用傳統的金屬鑰匙，而是透過電子密碼或智能卡來進入房間。這樣您就不必擔心遺失鑰匙或需要將鑰匙帶在身上。只需輸入指定的密碼或使用智能卡，您就可以輕鬆進入您的房間。除了便利的電子鎖系統，眠極文旅還提供舒適和溫馨的住宿環境。我們精心設計的客房提供舒適的床鋪、現代化的設施和便利的生活用品，以確保您的住宿體驗盡善盡美。我們的工作人員將竭誠為您服務，並提供必要的協助和指導，以確保您的入住期間愉快和無憂。如果您有任何問題或需求，請隨時與我們聯繫，我們將盡力滿足您的需求。
stays.descriptionEn: Mianji Hotel is an electronically managed B&B that focuses on convenience and modernity. We use an advanced electronic lock system to make your check-in and check-out process more convenient and secure.Our electronic lock system allows you to gain entry to your room via an electronic code or smart card instead of a traditional metal key. This way you don’t have to worry about losing your keys or needing to take them with you. Simply enter a designated password or use a smart card to gain easy access to your room.In addition to the convenient electronic lock system, Mianji Hotel also provides a comfortable and warm accommodation environment. Our thoughtfully designed guest rooms offer comfortable beds, modern amenities and convenient amenities to ensure your stay is the best it can be.Our staff will be happy to serve you and provide the necessary assistance and guidance to ensure your stay is enjoyable and worry-free. If you have any questions or needs, please feel free to contact us and we will try our best to meet your needs.

stays.descriptionEn: Zhiben Fuli Resort Hotel is situated alongside Highway 9 in Chihpen, next to the acclaimed Chihpen hot spring area and National Forest Recreation Area. An outstanding view with the mountains in the back and the sea at the front is thus obtained. The 5-meter high lobby is designed and decorated with simple yet breathtaking stones in earth tone, creating a stylish, exquisite, extraordinary and comfortable space! The hotel provides 168 rooms of different sizes and all rooms are spacious, comfortable and fully equipped. Our rooms are able to meet the distinct needs of every guest. The convenient communication can take you to all scenic spots of your interest. A 5, 20 or 30 minute ride will lead you Chihpen Railway Station, Taitung Airport and Taitung City. Here at FHotel, you can enjoy the distant view of the Taiwan's east coast or have a laid-back holiday bythe pool. Welcome to FHotel, the new landmark of Chihpen, and the beautiful environment of eastern Taiwan to escape from the urban life.

stays.name: 知本踢踏民宿
stays.description: 位於臺東縣的民宿在這裡 夜晚的星空 會讓你驚呼 在這裡 枝頭小鳥 會在稻中穿梭飛舞在這裡 栩栩微風 可以讓你感受清新的吹拂我們的民宿 沒有很高檔 但是有台東最自然、最純樸的味道 最有家的味道輕鬆 自在 倘徉於稻香之中踢踏民宿位於知本 鄰近台東大學、知本火車站約五分鐘路程環境寧靜悠閒 遠離城市喧囂 距離市區約15分鐘不熱鬧 但提供你最安靜最自然的鄉村味道以及熱情的踢踏舞教學 歡迎旅客一起歡唱搖擺一下更棒的是....距離全台灣最棒的知本天然溫泉只要10分鐘就可以抵達喔!!
stays.descriptionEn: A B&B located in Taitung CountyHere, the starry sky at night will make you exclaim. Here, the birds on the branches will fly among the rice.Here, the breeze will make you feel the fresh breeze.Our B&B is not very high-end, but it has the most natural and simple taste of Taitung. It has the most homely taste.Relax and wander in the fragrance of rice.Tap B&B is located in Zhiben, close to Taitung University and Zhiben Railway Station, about five minutes away.The environment is quiet and leisurely, away from the hustle and bustle of the city, about 15 minutes away from the city.It is not busy, but it provides you with the quietest and most natural rural taste.And enthusiastic tap dance teaching, welcome tourists to sing and swing together.What& #39;s even better is...it only takes 10 minutes to get to the best Zhiben natural hot spring in Taiwan!!

stays.name: 福美民宿
stays.description: 發現位於台東市的Fun Trip - 福美民宿無敵海景交誼廳，這裡的豐富文化遺產和青翠景觀創造出獨特的旅行體驗。這間民宿提供快速入住和退房服務，以及安全的行李寄存，確保兩位旅客的便利。客房配有免費Wi-Fi、空調和備有存貨的冰箱，讓您住得舒適。客人還可以享受現代化的淋浴和豪華的洗浴用品。地理位置優越，步行即可到達四維夜市和鐵花村，附近還有台東森林公園可供自然探索。非常適合尋求放鬆和當地冒險的旅客。
stays.descriptionEn: Discover Fun Trip - Fumei B&B in Taitung City, where rich cultural heritage and verdant landscapes create a unique travel experience. This B&B offers express check-in and check-out services, as well as secure luggage storage, ensuring convenience for both travelers. Rooms are equipped with free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and a stocked refrigerator to make your stay comfortable. Guests can also enjoy modern showers and luxurious toiletries. The location is ideal, with Siwei Night Market and Tiehua Village within walking distance, and Taitung Forest Park nearby for natural exploration. Perfect for travelers seeking relaxation and local adventures.

stays.descriptionEn: Titanium alloy European aesthetic design Spectacular view of Dulan mountain landscapeRice Resort Hotel is only 700 meters away from Taitung station in Taitung city. The location is perfect for the nearby Star Tribe watching airplane landing and taking off in the daytime and beautiful starry sky at night. Sunday night market on Siwei road, sightseeing night market on Zhengqi road, and Tiehua village musical settlement are at a distance of a mere 10-minute drive from our hotel.Each room offers spectacular view of Dulan mountain landscape. The hotel is built with 5000-pound earthquake-proof construction and Titanium alloy European aesthetic design of interior low-profile luxury style. Delicate and ingenious design can be seen everywhere. Free WiFi and indoor parking space are available for hotel guests. Each room has wooden floors. Each bathroom has biological light energy shower head and shampoo/body wash gel extracted by rice peptide.

stays.name: 稻町民宿
stays.description: 我們是稻町，這個名字的靈感源自於台語「在一起」。這不僅僅是一家酒店，也不僅僅是一家民宿，而是將旅行與日常生活交織在一起的空間。溫暖的木質空間，俏皮的色彩點綴其中。舒適的沙發、書籍、咖啡機，以及一個可以靜靜享受的空間——在這裡，您可以一起享受。我們歡迎旅客、家庭以及所有珍惜清潔和自由的人。無論您是想入住一晚、一周，還是只想順便沐浴在台東的陽光，我們都歡迎您。陶庭剛開業，這將是我們的生活和空間日記。我們誠摯邀請您加入我們。
stays.descriptionEn: We are Tau-Tin, a name inspired by the Taiwanese word for “together.”This isn’t a hotel—nor just a guesthouse—It’s a space where travel and everyday life can intertwine.There’s warmth in the wood, and playful pops of color.A comfy sofa, books, a coffee machine, and space to simply do nothing—together.We welcome travelers, families, and those who value cleanliness and freedom.Whether you& #39;re staying for a night, a week, or just dropping by to bask in Taitung’s sunshine—you& #39;re welcome here.Tau-Tin has just opened, and this will be our journal of life and space.We invite you to be part of it.

stays.name: 等等民宿
stays.description: ・一樓是共用空間，可用於用餐等。所有房間均位於二樓（無電梯），其中有 1 間 4 床房、1 間帶淋浴的 2 床房、2 間帶浴缸的 2 床房和 1 間 6 床房。此客房最多可容納 16 人入住（無需加床）。・本設施並非飯店，而是業主住宅的一部分向公眾開放的私人民宿。如果您期望享受飯店般的設施和服務，請在預訂時考慮這一點。・屋主住在三樓。如果您想租用整個房產，您可以使用一樓和二樓（但不能使用廚房）。・所有房間的天花板高度均為 4.2 公尺。・週邊有許多餐廳，從清晨營業到深夜。・不提供早餐，請諒解。
stays.descriptionEn: ・The first floor is a shared space and can be used for meals, etc. All rooms are on the second floor (there is no elevator), and there is one 4-person room, one 2-person room with shower, two 2-person rooms with bathtubs, and one 6-person room. Up to 16 people can stay without extra beds.・This facility is not a hotel, but a private lodging where the owner& #39;s home is partially open to the public. If you are expecting hotel-like facilities and services, please make a reservation with this in mind.・The owner lives on the 3rd floor. If you would like to rent the entire facility, you can use the 1st and 2nd floors (the kitchen cannot be used).・All rooms have an open space with a ceiling height of 4.2 meters.・There are many restaurants in the surrounding area that are open from early morning to late at night.・Please note that breakfast is not provided.

stays.name: 簡單小日子民宿
stays.description: 簡單小日子民宿坐落於臺東火車站旁，不論是搭乘火車、公車或是租汽、機車都相當快速、便利。是為台東旅遊行程安排的絕佳住宿點。5 km之外是台東市區最繁榮之處，緊鄰交通要道，不論前往遠近的台東觀光景點都極為便利。 簡單小日子民宿提供優質舒適的住宿空間，豐富的導覽解說和專業的咖啡飲品等服務，希望讓每個旅人在此獲得最貼心的休息。配備了早餐、付費交通接駁、租車、公用交誼廳/視聽空間、寄放行李等服務。這裡設有6間精美的客房，所有房型都配有遮光窗簾，變頻冷暖空調、盥洗用品、液晶電視。除此之外，民宿更有客人專屬吧檯，可以一邊享受飲品一邊與其他旅人交流。而其他娛樂設施一定會讓您在留宿期間享受更多樂趣。溫馨的裝潢設施與得天獨厚的地理位置，讓簡單小日子成為台東旅遊時的最佳留宿飯店。
stays.descriptionEn: "Ciao!Life" is just hundreds of meters away from Taitung Train Station, it provides easy access to train, bus as well as auto or motorbike renting. It's the best place to stay for anyone exploring Taitung! Taitung Downtown is 5 km away and accessible by highway, which also leads to other destinations. "Ciao!Life" provides quality accommodation, travel advice and expertly brewed coffee drinks, and last but not least, a place to fully restore energy. It offers breakfast, paid transportation, vehicle rental, public social area/video room, luggage keeping and more. Each of the six guest rooms are provided with curtains, variable-frequency air conditioner, toiletries and LCD TV. It has a bar for visitors to have drinks and meet other guests, as well as other recreational facilities to keep your happy during your stay. With its warm theme and very good location, "Ciao!Life" is a great place to stay the night!

stays.name: 米卡撒民宿
stays.description: 「米卡撒」是西班牙文我家(mi casa)的意思，也是數年前女主人獨赴南美旅行深刻的一段故事。旅途中，偶然相遇的人事物，往往可能成為我們對於那個地方、那段旅行、那些日子的美好回憶。這也是我們對於米卡撒的期待。米卡撒的四間客房，各有其主題，代表家中的四位成員—男主人(海藍色)、女主人(愛旅行)、大寶(搖搖馬)、小寶(數數羊)。誠摯歡迎您的到來~~
stays.descriptionEn: MI CASA, or My Home in Spanish, embodies a reminiscent story experienced by the hostess on her journey through South America. People and things we have met and in touch with during a trip, usually are the key that made the place, a journey, and those days, so mesmerize. And this is what we have expected of at MI CASA.MI CASA is presenting to you warm hospitality and 4 accommodations, each embodies the character of a family member - your host is a fisherman who pursues in the “Sea Blue” for his whole life; the hostess, a “Travel Aficionado” who just can’t quit travelling; the baby girl is at the age knows to have fun on her “Rocking Horse”; and the newborn, who needs mommy “Counting Sheep” with her/him to fall asleep.

stays.name: 綠舍睡到民宿
stays.nameEn: Green House sleeps to the homestay
stays.description: 位於台台東豐富的風景與文化，是最原始、自然的風貌，簡單又引人嚮往，綠舍睡到民宿坐落於市中心，漫步即可體驗到最在地的人事物，遇到豁然的風景、歡欣鼓舞的心情，交織出的每一個悸動時刻，踏踏實實留存在您的記憶之中。綠舍睡到知曉旅行休息的重要，我們將喧囂留在外頭，充滿台東風情的舒適空間帶給您如同在家的享受，讓您沉浸在台東的寧靜裡放鬆休息，期待明天冒險來臨。綠舍睡到民宿位在台東縣的台東市，靠近東海運動公園和台東縣體育場，提供免費私人停車位。 所有房型附空調，均設有私人衛浴、平面電視、設備齊全的廚房和陽台。 且提供露台供住客使用。距離 Taitung Night Market 2.7 公里距離武安宮 2.1 公里。最近的機場是台東機場，距離綠舍睡到民宿 3 公里。東縣的民宿
stays.descriptionEn: Taitung& #39;s rich scenery and culture are the most primitive and natural features, simple and attractive. Green House Bed and Breakfast is located in the city center. You can experience the most local people and things by taking a stroll. You will encounter the sudden scenery and the joyful mood. Every throbbing moment intertwined will be firmly retained in your memory. Green House knows the importance of rest during travel. We leave the hustle and bustle outside and provide a comfortable space full of Taitung style to make you feel at home. You can relax and rest in the tranquility of Taitung and look forward to tomorrow& #39;s adventure.Located in Taitung City in the Taitung County region, Green House Bed and Breakfast is close to Donghai Sports Park and Taitung County Stadium. It offers free private parking. All accommodation types are air-conditioned and feature a private bathroom, flat-screen TV, fully equipped kitchen and balcony. A terrace is available for guests to use.2.7 km from Taitung Night MarketWu& #39;an Palace is 2.1 km away.The nearest airport is Taitung Airport, 3 km from Green House Bed and Breakfast.

stays.descriptionEn: We are located in the suburbs of Taitung City, offering a standalone "courtyard vacation house" with private access and easy parking. Just 10 minutes from the city center, Tiehua Village, Zhonghua Road shopping district, Showtime Cinemas, PX Mart flagship store, Blue Dragonfly Fried Chicken, Banyan Tree Rice Noodles, and Zhengqi Tourist Night Market. Enjoy fresh air and a comfortable resting space. Please allow us to introduce you to the beauty of Taitung and let’s enjoy the blue skies of Taitung together.The owner personally designed the space with gentle, understated tones—nothing flashy. The high ceilings create a relaxing atmosphere. In the living room, there is a massage chair (sanitized regularly) as a thoughtful little service for those driving or riding motorcycles. We provide oversized beds to ensure travelers can rest comfortably—small details but very important. We look forward to welcoming travelers to experience the happiness of Taitung.Our green-themed guesthouse is located in Taitung City but without the crowding of the urban area. Just 10 minutes to the golden city center. We are a standalone courtyard house with neighbors nearby. There’s a FamilyMart convenience store close by, and the airport is only 1.3 kilometers away. Perfect for vacationers, small families, and motorcycle enthusiasts (safe parking for your beloved bikes). Renting the entire house for weddings or banquets is also a great option.The guesthouse is spotless inside and out because the owner loves cleanliness. We hope you come here to feel the simplicity, warmth, and relaxed lifestyle of Taitung. Most importantly, the owner warmly welcomes guests to share this space and invites you to chat whenever you have time. We welcome you to visit and share your travel experiences with us.Green rice fields and blue skies await you!

stays.name: 臨風閣民宿
stays.description: 佇立於臺東市區寧靜的泰安街上，「臨風閣」以簡約現代的設計，為旅人打造一處遠離塵囂、沉澱心靈的棲所。我們將臺東的純粹與美好融入每個角落，讓您在旅程中，不僅僅是歇腳，更是深度體驗這片土地的溫暖與閒適。民宿位置鬧中取靜，步行即可輕鬆抵達市區繁華，夜市小吃、文創商店、特色咖啡館皆近在咫尺。回到「臨風閣」，則能享受靜謐舒適的休憩時光。在這裡，您可以倚靠在窗邊，讓涼爽的微風拂過臉龐，感受臺東獨有的悠閒氛圍。我們精心挑選舒適的寢具與高品質的沐浴用品，為您洗去一身疲憊。明亮寬敞的公共空間，是旅人交流故事、分享心情的絕佳場所。我們也樂於提供私房景點與美食推薦，讓您的臺東之旅更添深度與驚喜。
stays.descriptionEn: Nestled on the tranquil Tai& #39;an Street in downtown Taitung, Linfeng Pavilion, with its minimalist, modern design, offers travelers a haven of tranquility and tranquility. We incorporate the purity and beauty of Taitung into every corner, allowing you to not only rest your feet but also deeply experience the warmth and tranquility of this land during your journey.The B&B& #39;s tranquil location amidst the bustling city center is within easy walking distance, with night market snacks, cultural and creative shops, and unique cafes all within easy reach. Return to Linfeng Pavilion for a peaceful and comfortable rest. Here, lean against the window, let the cool breeze caress your face, and soak in Taitung& #39;s uniquely relaxed atmosphere.We carefully select comfortable bedding and high-quality bath products to help you soothe your tiredness. Bright and spacious common areas are perfect for travelers to exchange stories and share their experiences. We also happily offer hidden gems and food recommendations to add depth and excitement to your Taitung experience.

stays.description: ＝自己來+小旅宿By Yourself Hostel＝ 我們沒有精緻高級的家具，也沒有豪華享受的設備，在這裡只會看到我們一草一木慢慢堆疊出的家居模樣；老木頭、老傢俱打造一個質樸而溫暖的空間。家中老大是七隻有點胖又異常親人的貓咪，歡迎來台東體驗旅行的樂趣與自在！ 在這裡希望讓你/妳緩下步調,開啟知覺,自然而然發掘心中的慢靈魂｡
stays.descriptionEn: = Come by yourself + Small Hostel By Yourself Hostel =We don’t have exquisite and high-end furniture, nor do we have luxurious equipment. The eldest in the family is a slightly fat and extremely friendly cat. Welcome to Taitung to experience the fun and freedom of travel!Here I hope to let you slow down, open your perception, and naturally discover the slow soul in your heart.

stays.name: 自由風民宿
stays.description: 山風海風自由風，天藍海藍自由行 漫步市區老街，享受美食小吃、巡弋蔚藍山海，呼吸新鮮空氣，洗滌一身疲憊，領悟自由身心靈。 來趟自由自在的輕旅行，入住市區老街全新民宿，領會卅年前台東繁華，隨性漫步市區，品嚐各種小吃美食。民宿設計融入自由風元素，搭配寬敞舒適的空間，柔和溫暖的氛圍及配置五星級的床墊，使人不知覺置身於天藍海藍的自由風氣息中，放鬆一覺到天亮。 另外可諮詢民宿精心建議的旅遊行程，遊覽花東縱谷的山藍及東海岸的海藍，探索祕境，呼吸新鮮的空氣，洗滌一身的疲憊，領悟自由的身心靈，重新再出發。 鬧中取靜全新落成民宿，距夜市、榕樹下米苔目、臭豆腐、藍蜻蜓炸雞、寶桑湯圓及豆花等知名小吃僅五分鐘路程。平日出差出示證件公務價，可刷國旅卡。
stays.descriptionEn: Mountain breeze, sea breeze, free wind, blue sky and blue sea, free travelWalk in the old streets of the city, enjoy delicious snacks, cruise the blue mountains and seas, breathe fresh air, wash away fatigue, and understand the freedom of body, mind and soul.Take a free and easy trip, stay in a brand new homestay in the old streets of the city, experience the prosperity of Taitung 30 years ago, stroll in the city at will, and taste various snacks and delicacies. The design of the homestay incorporates free style elements, with spacious and comfortable space, soft and warm atmosphere and equipped with five-star mattresses, so that people can unconsciously be in the free wind of sky blue and sea blue, and relax until dawn.In addition, you can consult the carefully recommended travel itinerary of the homestay, visit the mountain blue of the Hualien Valley and the sea blue of the East Coast, explore the secrets, breathe fresh air, wash away fatigue, understand the freedom of body, mind and soul, and start again.The newly completed homestay is quiet in the bustling city, only five minutes away from the night market, banyan tree rice tatami, stinky tofu, blue dragonfly fried chicken, Baosang glutinous rice balls and tofu pudding and other famous snacks. On weekdays, you can pay the official price by showing your ID and using the National Travel Card.

images.name: 201六十石山四人房
images.description: 六十石山位於花蓮縣富里鄉竹田村東側海拔約800公尺的海岸山脈上，這兒有一片廣達300公頃的金針田，與赤柯山同為花蓮縣內兩大金針栽植區。為什麼會被叫做六十石山呢？據當地人說，早在日據時期，一般水田每甲地的穀子收成大約只有四、五十石，而這一帶的稻田每一甲卻可生產60石縠子，因此被稱做六十石（ㄉㄢˋ）山。此外，還有另一種說法：早在日據時期，這片山區本是一片繁茂的樟樹林，為了煉製樟腦而被砍伐一空。結果發現在空曠的山坡上，散佈著60塊巨大的石頭，所以這裡被命名為六十石（ㄕˊ）山。

images.description: 伯朗咖啡曾經在這裡取景多次，讓這條路被稱為「翠綠的天堂路」，也命名為伯朗大道 也因金城武的廣告也在這裡拍攝，頓時讓這裡成為超級熱門的旅遊景點 季節限定的金黃地毯在台東縱谷中緩緩蔓延澄黃的色調將稻梗染上了色彩搭配層次分明且高度緩和的海岸山脈讓眼底的風景更加精采層層疊疊的山景如夢似幻地在背景後堆疊海岸山脈以及中央山脈守護了台東縱谷這片富饒的土地農作無憂慮地生長更擁有著得天獨厚的天然資源及環境讓台東縱谷有了台灣米鄉的美名蜿蜒的柏油路

stays.description: 自小於台東後山生長的姐妹，因求學和就業之故必須遠離家鄉，來到人生地不熟的台北大都會，終日汲汲營營的生活著...卻始終感念台東生活的緩慢與優雅，於是決定毅然而然回鄉打拼，將慢步調的生活態度和溫暖的人情味一同分享給您~「台東民宿‧艾希兒民宿」為獨棟透天建築，外觀由多種變化萬千的幾何圖形組合而成，展現時尚且新奇的特殊造型，內部空間則以強烈且繽紛的牆面色彩，搭配主題各異的造型佈景和精巧雅緻的造型裝潢，揮灑台東後山的幽靜氣息，是您造訪台東的極佳休憩地。「台東民宿‧艾希兒民宿」座落於台東火車站周邊，步行僅需5分鐘即可輕鬆抵達；前往卑南文化公園、台東森林公園、馬卡巴嗨公園等旅人必訪的熱門景點也便利易抵，不論是自由自在的背包客群，或是駕車遨遊寶島的自駕族，都能在此享受毫無拘束的優雅閒適。
stays.descriptionEn: The sisters who grew up in the back mountains of Taitung had to leave their hometown for study and employment, and came to the unfamiliar metropolis of Taipei. They lived a busy life all day long...but they always appreciated the slow and elegant life in Taitung, so they decided to return to their hometown to work hard and share the slow-paced life attitude and warm human touch with you~"Taitung B&B‧Ai Xier B&B" is a single-family building. The exterior is composed of a variety of ever-changing geometric shapes, showing a fashionable and novel special shape. The interior space is strong and colorful wall colors, with different themed styling scenes and exquisite and elegant styling decorations, exuding the quiet atmosphere of Taitung& #39;s back mountains. It is an excellent place for you to relax when visiting Taitung."Taitung Bed and Breakfast - Ashley Bed and Breakfast" is located near Taitung Railway Station, and can be easily reached in just 5 minutes on foot. It is also conveniently accessible to popular attractions that travelers must visit, such as Beinan Cultural Park, Taitung Forest Park, and Makabahai Park. Whether you are a free-spirited backpacker or a self-driving traveler, you can enjoy the unrestrained elegance and leisure here.

stays.name: 花緣民宿
stays.description: 花緣民宿落座於台東糖廠旁，近火車站、台東觀光夜市、鐵花村、森林公園、琵琶湖、海濱公園⋯⋯等。花緣民宿是由疼愛老婆的老公深受老婆的愛戴，就算長年在外工作，老婆一直默默在背後支持與陪伴，為這樣的老婆而感動所送給老婆的禮物，卻也是老婆一直以來的夢想～名所創為“花”，是因老婆深愛美麗的花朵彷彿著大自然的氣息漂浮在空間內，因而民宿內多處可見老婆對花與手工藝的熱愛與執著～名所創為“緣”，是因非常感謝這緣份讓彼此相遇，也因為緣份造就了美好幸福的家庭，所在此創出“花緣民宿”，滿懷著幸福的送給老婆最愛的禮物～
stays.descriptionEn: Huayuan B&B is located next to Taitung Sugar Factory, close to the train station, Taitung Tourist Night Market, Tiehua Village, Forest Park, Lake Biwa, Seaside Park, etc.Huayuan B&B is owned by a husband who loves his wife and is deeply loved by his wife.Even though he has been working away from home for many years, his wife has always been silently supporting and accompanying him.The gift he gave to his wife because he was moved by such a wife is also his wife& #39;s dream~The name was created as "Flower" because my wife loves beautiful flowers, which seem to float in the space with the breath of nature.Therefore, my wife& #39;s love and persistence for flowers and handicrafts can be seen in many places in the B&B~The name was created as "Fate" because I am very grateful for this fate that allowed us to meet each other.And because fate has created a beautiful and happy family,so I created "Huayuan B&B" here, and gave my wife my favorite gift with happiness~

stays.name: 菓薌民宿
stays.description: 座落於鄉野田園間，清晨可觀賞日出的燦爛，而夜晚星光與燈光交織出的美麗景緻，站在景觀窗和小陽台前遠眺一望無的田園景觀，每到夏天一畝畝綠油油的稻田隨風搖拽，秋天來臨時，綠油油的稻田轉為一串串飽滿的稻穗，冬天則變成一畦畦的小水池，映著藍色天空。「菓薌民宿」一年四季都有不同的景觀變化等您來探索，有著舒適寧靜的居家環境，美好的旅程從這裡開始一同遊賞台東美麗景色，樂享台東的慢遊悠活。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the countryside, you can watch the brilliant sunrise in the morning, and the beautiful scenery intertwined with stars and lights at night. Stand in front of the landscape windows and small balconies and overlook the endless pastoral landscape. Every summer, acres and acres of green. The rice fields sway in the wind. When autumn comes, the green rice fields turn into bunches of plump ears of rice. In winter, they turn into borders of small pools, reflecting the blue sky."Guoxiang B&B" has different landscape changes throughout the year waiting for you to explore. It has a comfortable and peaceful home environment. A wonderful journey starts here. Let& #39;s enjoy the beautiful scenery of Taitung together and enjoy the leisurely life of Taitung. .

stays.name: 萊灣民宿
stays.description: 萊灣民宿位於台東市，擁有有6個不同的台灣原住民傳統元素裝飾，設有免費WiFi以及免費內部私人停車場。 萊灣民宿距離鐵花曲村4.2公里，距離台東鐵道藝術村5公里，距離台東火車站3.5公里。 沒見客房均設有空調和硬木地板，擁有不同台灣原住民的裝飾，如阿美族、布農族、排灣族和邵族。民宿還額外配備電熱水壺、冰箱、平板有線電視。私人浴室配有淋浴設施、免費洗浴用品和吹風機。部分房型配有浴缸和私人陽台。 萊灣民宿根據顧客的要求提供1瓶免費水以及交通服務。工作人員很樂意提供旅遊訊息。顧客可使用共用休息室放鬆休息，並交流各自的旅行經驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Laiwan B&B is located in Taitung City. It features 6 different traditional elements of Taiwan& #39;s aboriginal people. Free WiFi is available and free private parking is available on site. Laiwan B&B is 4.2 km from Tiehua Music Village and 5 km from Taitung Railway Art Village. Taitung Railway Station is 3.5 km away. All rooms are air-conditioned and feature hardwood floors. They are decorated with different aboriginal peoples of Taiwan, such as Amis, Bunun, Paiwan and Thao. Extras include an electric kettle, a refrigerator and a flat-screen cable TV. The private bathroom comes with shower facilities, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Some room types have a bathtub and a private balcony. Laiwan B&B provides a free bottle of water and transportation services upon request. Staff are happy to provide tourist information. Guests can use the shared lounge to relax and exchange their travel experiences.

stays.name: 蔓漫民宿
stays.description: 蔓漫民宿是一間位於台東知本的精品民宿，擁有五間獨立設計的客房，為旅客打造舒適且充滿溫馨的住宿體驗。蔓漫民宿秉持「放慢腳步，享受當下」的理念，結合台東在地特色與優美自然景觀，為來自各地的旅客提供身心放鬆的理想居所。民宿內部採用簡約而不失優雅的設計風格，每個房間都帶有獨特的風情，從大窗戶望出去可以欣賞知本的山海美景。民宿周邊環境幽靜，距離知本溫泉區、當地夜市及多處自然景點都十分便利。無論是想體驗泡湯放鬆，還是深入探索台東文化，蔓漫民宿都能滿足您的需求。讓我們帶您遠離都市喧囂，在這裡慢下來，感受蔓延在心中的平靜與美好。
stays.descriptionEn: Manman B&B is a boutique B&B located in Zhiben, Taitung. It has five individually designed guest rooms, creating a comfortable and warm accommodation experience for travelers. Manman B&B adheres to the concept of "slow down and enjoy the moment" and combines Taitung& #39;s local characteristics and beautiful natural landscape to provide travelers from all over the world with an ideal place to relax physically and mentally.The interior of the B&B adopts a simple yet elegant design style. Each room has a unique style. Looking out from the large windows, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Zhiben& #39;s mountains and sea. The surrounding environment of the B&B is quiet and it is very convenient to Zhiben Hot Spring Area, local night market and many natural attractions. Whether you want to relax in a hot spring or explore Taitung culture in depth, Manman B&B can meet your needs.Let us take you away from the hustle and bustle of the city, slow down here and feel the peace and beauty spreading in your heart.

stays.name: 蕃茄咖啡民宿
stays.description: 「台東民宿‧蕃茄咖啡民宿」位於台東地區，距離台東火車站約4分鐘車程，前往卑南文化公園、台東森林公園、史前博物館等地皆鄰近易抵；前往市區品嘗道地的美味小吃更是方便鄰近。旅人們可以欣賞壯闊海岸帶來的視覺震撼，讚嘆台東後山的人文遺跡，更可以大啖豬血湯、卑南包子、米苔目等口味獨特、讓人吮指回味的地小吃。 「台東民宿‧蕃茄咖啡民宿」為編號717的合法台東民宿，佈置精美的綠意中庭，融合灰色系為主的獨棟日式透天建築，展現低調奢華的典雅風味。客房空間則以繽紛的亮眼色彩，營造出輕甜淡雅的活潑調性，帶給旅人溫馨愜意的閒適空間，帶給您極為放鬆的舒適品質。
stays.descriptionEn: "Tatung B&B‧Tomato Coffee B&B" sits in Taitung. It takes about 4 minutes to drive to the Taitung Station. It is also convenient to go to Beinan Cultural Park, Taitung Forest Park, and National Museum of Prehistory, or taste delicious local dishes in the downtown. Visitors can feel the visual impact of the magnificent coast, and praise the cultural relics in Tatung. They can also taste unique and delicious local dishes, pork blood soups, Pinuyumayan buns, and silver needle noodles. "Tatung B&B‧Tomato Coffee B&B" is a legal B&B in Tatung with registration number 717. The beautifully furnished green courtyard complements the single gray Japanese-style building which shows a low-key luxurious and elegant style. The gust rooms create a sweet yet simple and elegant style with bright colors, which gives a warm and comfortable space for visitors to relax in.

stays.name: 蘭舍民宿
stays.description: 取名「蘭舍」，蘭花為台東縣花，且為民宿女主人芳名中的末字，民宿男主人貼心巧思，甚為動人，其得天獨厚的地理環境，可觀山．觀海．觀日出，而民宿內部更是舒適乾淨的休憩環境，入住此地的旅人啊，必能消除旅程中的疲憊。泡杯咖啡，坐在二樓觀景台，遠望湛藍的大海，呼吸著台東純淨的空氣，享受著台東溫暖的陽光，讓自己好好的放鬆一下！蘭舍位於台東市，鄰近小野柳、森林公園、琵琶湖、海濱公園、鯉魚山、卑南文化公園、史前博物館、新園社區等景點。如果不知該往哪玩，不妨問問老闆與老闆娘，他們會以專業的資訊，親切的態度為您解說哦！！
stays.descriptionEn: Named "Lanshe", orchid is the flower of Taitung County and the last character in the name of the hostess of the B&B. The host is thoughtful and ingenious, which is very touching. Its unique geographical environment allows you to see the mountains, the sea, and the sunrise. The interior of the B&B is a comfortable and clean resting environment. Travelers staying here will be able to eliminate the fatigue of the journey.Make a cup of coffee, sit on the second-floor observation deck, look at the blue sea in the distance, breathe the pure air of Taitung, enjoy the warm sunshine of Taitung, and relax yourself!Lanshe is located in Taitung City, close to Xiaoyeliu, Forest Park, Lake Biwa, Seaside Park, Liyushan, Beinan Cultural Park, Prehistoric Museum, Xinyuan Community and other attractions. If you don& #39;t know where to go, you might as well ask the boss and the boss lady, they will explain to you with professional information and a friendly attitude! !

stays.name: 諾園民宿
stays.description: 擁有海浪波瀾壯闊、山峰綠意綿延的台灣東部海岸線，總是隱藏著許多迷人特別的景色，背山望海的獨特景致，一起來台東渡個假吧！！位於台東火車站附近的「台東民宿～諾園民宿」，為一棟登記合法的台東民宿，別具特色的白色地中海風格建築民宿，擁有廣闊草坪與空間，造型簡單卻有著得天獨厚的景觀，展現民宿獨有的異國風情。將民宿取為「諾園」是因把重然諾，講信用；秉真誠，踏實地為服務每位到此住宿旅客的信念，也如同聖經裡記載的「諾許之地」，希望來這裡帶回的是健康快樂、回味無窮的回憶。置身於鄉野間，無特色招牌的「台東民宿～諾園民宿」，卻有著迷人的在地風情，於藍天白雲下與獨特的地中海建築，和民宿主人精心種植的椰林、花園，讓你體會猶如身處熱帶國度氛圍，體會美麗的異國度假風情。室內裝潢寬敞舒適，提供優雅別緻的蜜月、雙人、四人和六人之房型，讓您有更多住宿的選擇；此外喜歡享受一個人旅行的您，「台東民宿～諾園民宿」也提供單人住宿哦！來到「台東民宿～諾園民宿」您可以享受到台東人的親切、熱情與純樸，另有滿滿溫馨如同家的感覺，回歸心靈深處的故鄉～「諾園民宿」是您到台東渡假的最佳住宿選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: The coastline in eastern Taiwan has magnificent waves and stretching green mountains, and always hides much unique fascinating scenery with back to the mountains. Come to Taitung to have a good vacation. Located near the Taitung Station, "Taitung B&B--Promised Land" is a registered legal Taitung B&B, has a distinctive white Mediterranean-style building, a vast lawns and space, though simple in appearance, has a unique landscape, showing the B&B's unique exotic mien. We named the B&B Promised Land, because we uphold our promises and trust, and with sincerity, we are practical to serve guests, as this belief is also recorded in the Bible as "the promised land." I hope the staying guests can leave with happiness and health enjoyed and lingering memories. Promised Land, though located in the countryside with a featureless sign, offers a charming local style, under the blue sky, it is a unique Mediterranean architecture, and innkeepers carefully plant coconut trees, manage gardens, to make you staying in an atmosphere of tropical country and experience the beautiful mien of exotic vacation. Spacious and comfortable interior offers elegant chic room types, including honeymoon, double, four-person, and six-person, providing more choice of accommodation. We also offer single accommodation for people who likes to enjoy a trip alone. Welcome you to "Promised Land," you can enjoy Taitung people's warmth, passion, and simplicity, and a stay full of warm and homely feeling. Return to the home of soul ~ "Promised Land" It is your best choice for vacation accommodation in Taitung.

stays.name: 貓追熊民宿
stays.nameEn: The cat chased the Bear Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: 【台東旅宿】貓追熊‧熊追貓親子民宿：幸福陪伴，一起填滿最歡樂的兒時記憶。面向太平溪的獨棟透天住宅中，有一棟特別可愛的房子，門口掛上「凱特熊樂園」布條，入口坡道是充滿童趣的熊大、貓兒音樂世界，民宿主人用滿滿的熱情，迎接準備入住「貓追熊‧民宿」的大朋友小朋友們。一推開門的那刻，歡笑聲即刻響起。「當自己有了孩子後，更能體會快樂玩耍對於成長的重要！」_彷彿拿到了打開孩子夢想樂園的那把鑰匙，打開大門，寬闊的庭院變身繽紛的兒童賽車場，驚呼了你對親子民宿的歡快想像。主人熊大將遊戲的體驗發揮到極致，賽車場、沙坑、扮家家酒、生存遊戲、小火車、故事書、Tomica創意軌道…數不盡的遊戲種類，若不是當了爸爸後的心境使然，那必是因為自己依然是個童心未泯的大孩子！
stays.descriptionEn: [Taitung accommodation] Cat Chasing Bear‧Bear Chasing Cat Family B&B: Happy companionship, filling the happiest childhood memories together.Among the single-family houses facing Taiping River, there is a particularly cute house with a banner of "Kate Bear Paradise" hanging at the door. The entrance ramp is a music world full of childlike fun for bears and cats. The owner of the B&B welcomes adults and children who are ready to stay at "Cat Chasing Bear‧B&B" with full enthusiasm.The moment the door is opened, laughter immediately rang out."When you have children, you can better understand the importance of happy play for growth!"_It& #39;s like getting the key to open the child& #39;s dream paradise. Open the door, and the wide courtyard turns into a colorful children& #39;s racing track, exclaiming your cheerful imagination of parent-child B&Bs. The owner, Big Bear, brings the gaming experience to the extreme, including racing tracks, sand pits, playing house, survival games, trains, storybooks, Tomica creative tracks... countless types of games. If it wasn& #39;t because of his mood after becoming a father, it must be because he is still a big kid with a childlike innocence!

stays.searchText: 貓追熊民宿 貓追熊民宿 臺東縣民宿720號 臺東縣 臺東市 豐榮路90巷38號 【台東旅宿】貓追熊‧熊追貓親子民宿：幸福陪伴，一起填滿最歡樂的兒時記憶。面向太平溪的獨棟透天住宅中，有一棟特別可愛的房子，門口掛上「凱特熊樂園」布條，入口坡道是充滿童趣的熊大、貓兒音樂世界，民宿主人用滿滿的熱情，迎接準備入住「貓追熊‧民宿」的大朋友小朋友們。一推開門的那刻，歡笑聲即刻響起。「當自己有了孩子後，更能體會快樂玩耍對於成長的重要！」_彷彿拿到了打開孩子夢想樂園的那把鑰匙，打開大門，寬闊的庭院變身繽紛的兒童賽車場，驚呼了你對親子民宿的歡快想像。主人熊大將遊戲的體驗發揮到極致，賽車場、沙坑、扮家家酒、生存遊戲、小火車、故事書、Tomica創意軌道…數不盡的遊戲種類，若不是當了爸爸後的心境使然，那必是因為自己依然是個童心未泯的大孩子！

stays.name: 路得行旅
stays.description: 50年前這裡曾是風華一時的台東寶桑「省都旅社」，在一趟旅行的探索，發現這棟已被塵封20年的老旅社，過去中庭的天井被覆蓋著，陽光只能在殘留的縫隙中顯露，於是我們開啟了天井，讓自然的能量完全釋放。分享路得行旅的意念就此展開！「路得行旅國際青年旅館-台東館」前身是寶桑地區的「省都大旅社」，在建築結構上依舊屬於老建築，我們保持了原本的主體結構，打開了天井，讓建築自然呼吸、中庭陽光流轉，擁有天井後，館內空間易產生共鳴的緣故，聲音傳達會比較明顯，館內活動請聲音放低，靜靜地欣賞天井中庭的景色，與其他旅人一同共享空間。還有，台東市區鄰近志航基地，每天都會有不同型號的飛機，從天空呼嘯而過，隆隆的聲響，早已成了台東日常之一，有時低、有時高，偶爾幸運的話，還能看見天井框住了飛機。
stays.descriptionEn: This building used to be a famous hotel in a busy neighborhood back in 50 years ago. After hidden for 20 years, it was rediscovered by us. We kept the original building and gave it a new look. After the cover was taken away, the central courtyard was no longer in the dark. Sunlight, sky, and fresh air of Taitung are invited into the building. We hope you feel inspired to explore and embrace the beauty in Taitung.

stays.name: 輕安漫旅電梯民宿
stays.description: 台東輕安漫旅——展開一段輕鬆愜意的奢華之旅隱藏在台東這片靜謐而迷人的土地上，輕安漫旅民宿是您放鬆心靈、尋求內心平靜的理想之地。這座充滿詩意的民宿，凝聚了現任主人對園藝與生活美學的深刻理解和熱愛。當年，這裡是由一位旅居日本的屋主精心設計並居住的宅邸，現今的主人延續了這份東方情懷，在庭院中栽種了象徵情誼與雅致生活的七里香。這芬芳的花香，彷彿時光的印記，帶領著您走進這座充滿故事的日式庭園。民宿的每一個角落都經過精心布置，結合了日式風格與法式的精緻點綴，將東西方美學完美融合。所有客房皆採用日式榻榻米設計，帶您感受日式旅宿的溫馨與靜謐。踏入這裡，您將置身於如詩如畫的氛圍中，享受細膩而沉靜的片刻時光。房間的每一處細節都流露著溫暖與優雅，讓您仿佛遠離塵囂，找到一方心靈的淨土。在這裡，您不僅能體驗到與眾不同的住宿環境，還能享受到無比便利的交通服務。民宿距離火車站僅需步行5分鐘或開車2分鐘，距離台東機場也僅有15分鐘的車程。無論是迎著晨曦漫步於庭園，還是乘車前往下一個目的地，輕安漫旅都能為您提供最貼心的服務，讓您的每一次出行都變得如此輕鬆愉快。在台東輕安漫旅，讓花香與微風伴隨著您，享受一場徹底放鬆、充滿詩意的奢華之旅。這裡的一切，都在等待著與您共度那段獨一無二的美好時光。
stays.descriptionEn: Taitung Qing'an Travel - embark on a relaxing and luxurious journeyHidden in the quiet and charming land of Taitung, Qing'an Manlv B&B is an ideal place for you to relax your mind and find inner peace. This poetic B&B embodies the current owner’s deep understanding and love for gardening and life aesthetics. At that time, this was a mansion carefully designed and lived in by an owner living in Japan. The current owner has continued this oriental sentiment and planted Qilixiang, a symbol of friendship and elegant life, in the courtyard. This fragrant floral fragrance, like a mark of time, leads you into this Japanese garden full of stories.Every corner of the B&B has been carefully decorated, combining Japanese style with French exquisite embellishments, perfectly integrating Eastern and Western aesthetics. All rooms are designed with Japanese tatami mats, allowing you to feel the warmth and tranquility of a Japanese-style hotel. Stepping here, you will be immersed in a picturesque atmosphere and enjoy a delicate and quiet moment. Every detail of the room exudes warmth and elegance, making you feel as if you are far away from the hustle and bustle and find a pure land of your soul.Here, you can not only experience a unique accommodation environment, but also enjoy extremely convenient transportation services. stays.description: 這裡沒有為了賺錢而弄了一堆像鳥籠的雙人房，房型可分為4人、6人、8人，格局方正且內部空間寬敞，小朋友真的可以在裡面奔跑、打滾！此外，這裡在七月才剛完成裝潢重新營業，不只內裝及床組等等設備都是全新的(有間特別房的床價格高達6萬喔-生技醫療用床)，就連主人也是新的，不過價格卻相當平民，真的不是一般飯店或民宿所能比擬！在舒適的環境住上一晚，是抒解旅途勞累的最佳方法，這裡真可以稱得上是呼朋引伴出遊或家庭旅遊的絕佳住宿選擇！！
stays.descriptionEn: There are no birdcage-like double rooms here just to make money. The rooms can be divided into 4-person, 6-person, and 8-person rooms. The layout is square and the interior space is spacious. Children can really run and roll around in it! In addition, this place has just been renovated and reopened in July. Not only are the interior decoration and bed sets and other equipment brand new (there is a special room with a bed that costs up to 60,000 - a biotech medical bed), but even the owner is new. However, the price is quite affordable, which is really not comparable to ordinary hotels or B&Bs! Staying in a comfortable environment for a night is the best way to relieve the fatigue of the journey. This can really be called a great accommodation choice for friends or family travel! !

It is also convenient to visit famous attractions such as Beinan Cultural Park, Seaside Park, Tiehua Village Music Village, Taitung Forest Park, etc.Let& #39;s go now! Let& #39;s experience the simplicity and tranquility of the back mountain and feel the carefree and leisurely pleasure~ "Taitung B&B‧Meet Happiness" focuses on providing parent-child accommodation. The spacious and brightly lit comfortable guest rooms use bright colors and integrate modern decorations full of creative childlike fun, as well as children& #39;s favorite slides, swings, runway landscaping... and other amusement equipment to create a happy atmosphere for the whole family. Children can have fun and adults can rest comfortably without worries. Both adults and children can spend a relaxing and happy holiday.

It is an ideal place to stay during your trip to Taitung. It will bring you a pleasant accommodation experience and allow you to have a wonderful stay with you. Start an unforgettable journey!

stays.name: 鄉居。拼布亭民宿
stays.description: 這是一個充滿溫馨與創意的鄉村風格民宿，坐落在美麗而純樸的知本；遠離都市的喧囂，提供給旅人一處寧靜的鄉居休憩場所。基於民宿主人對拼布藝術的熱衷，我們將客房命名為【花‧田‧厝】，結合了傳統拼布藝術與鄉村田園風情，每一處細膩的裝飾佈置都透露著來自於傳統拼布創意的巧思與對美好生活的追求。除了獨特溫馨的住宿環境，周圍環抱著田園鄉野景色，隨處皆能感受到大自然天籟的寧靜。無論您是尋求放鬆身心或是找尋創作靈感，鄉居。拼布亭都是您的理想選擇。期待您的到來，讓我們一起在這個充滿愛與藝術的空間中，體驗純粹的鄉村生活，留下一頁美好的鄉居回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: This is a country-style B&B full of warmth and creativity, located in the beautiful and simple Zhiben; we are far away from the hustle and bustle of the city and provide you with a peaceful country retreat. Based on the B&B owner’s passion for patchwork art, we specially named the guest room [Flower. Tian•cuo]• combines traditional patchwork art with rural pastoral style. Every layout reveals the ingenuity of patchwork creativity and the pursuit of a better life. In addition to the warm accommodation environment, the B&B is surrounded by natural countryside scenery, so you can feel the tranquility of nature at any time. Whether you're looking for relaxation or creative inspiration, Countryside. Patchwork booths are your ideal choice. We look forward to your arrival, let us experience pure rural life together in this space full of love and art, and leave a page of beautiful rural memories.

stays.name: 鐵支路民宿
stays.description: 位於台東縣火車站附近有全家及7-11便利商店的鐵支路民宿，是一個鐵路退休員工的民宿夢，民宿布置有著鐵道及文物風格及台東風景畫作的明亮舒適的空間。不僅有著民宿的故事及溫度，更有著旅店的自在與服務。~~~歡迎您來~~~橘黃外觀顯眼而醒目，一樓公共空間以鐵路意象的裝置藝術為主軸；客房則以顏色區分，省去過多繁複裝飾，呈現典雅簡約的風格，讓疲憊的旅人能獲得一夜好眠。鄰近景點：史前文化公園、利吉水利公園、利吉惡地、美術館、親子蛋糕公園、森林海濱公園、四格山。
stays.descriptionEn: Located near Taitung County Train Station, near FamilyMart and 7-Eleven convenience stores, Tiezhilu B&B is a retired railway employee& #39;s dream homestay. The bright and comfortable space is decorated with railway-themed elements, reminiscent of Taitung& #39;s landscapes. It not only embodies the story and warmth of a B&B, but also offers the comfort and service of a hotel.~~~Welcome~~~The striking orange exterior features a first-floor public space centered around a railway-themed installation. Guest rooms are color-coded, eschewing overly elaborate decorations for an elegant, minimalist style, ensuring a restful night& #39;s sleep for weary travelers.Nearby attractions: Prehistoric Cultural Park, Liji Water Conservancy Park, Liji Badlands, Art Museum, Family Cake Park, Forest Seaside Park, and Sige Mountain.
