stays.name: 杰克山莊大飯店
stays.description: 東大門夜市走路3分鐘全新設計裝潢/房型多樣附自助式早餐/提供車站接送歡迎闔家大小一起來杰克山莊親近花蓮喔~全館均有wifi設備讓您能夠快速飆網。本店設有精緻雙人房、尊爵雙人房、家庭三人房、典雅四人房、杰克六人房等各式套房一應俱全。「杰克山莊渡假大飯店」位於花蓮市舊火車站起點，前抱美崙山、左鄰花蓮舊市區、右俯東大門夜市，週邊美食、古蹟、生活機能一應俱全，此地是花蓮的發跡地。見證了昔日花東發展的流金歲月。「杰克山莊」的前身為鴻山別莊，是花蓮知名的懷舊旅館，內有全台僅存的花綾磚古蹟建築極具文化鑑賞價值。2015年本店敦聘名師重新整裝設計，讓老幹新枝重新發芽，前棟為原始自然的原住民風、後棟保有紀念價值的懷舊風，是老、中、青三代一起出遊渡假的場所。
stays.descriptionEn: Jack House Hotel located center of Hwa Lien city. Close to all the tourist attractions. The famous local eateries,historic buildings or night market are within walking distance. The hotel itself was a historical building. In 2015 the hotel was fully refurbished and to keeping its unique architecture.The hotel provides high speed WiFi all round the building. Breakfast buffet has various choice for everybody including vegetarian foods. We also provide the transfer service on customers request.Rooms are available in Double, Twin, Single and Family rooms.Hualien County

stays.description: 2008年12月盛大開幕，隱身花蓮市區寧靜一禺，""鬧中取靜,轉角即達繁華市中心""，各大 美食小吃，名產琳瑯滿目。一進到大廰，大紅色的迎賓琉璃牆面，古樸典雅吊燈 ，花蓮特有山水玫瑰石，古色古香東方風情油然而生。東城秉持親切服務態度，讓旅人賓至如歸。厭倦都會快速繁忙的節奏，準備來段輕鬆的假期嗎？帶著家人及朋友、或一本好書，來品味東城悠閒步調，為自己的旅行增加新的註記。
stays.descriptionEn: Easttown 26 opened in December 2008, is located in a secluded and quiet corner of downtown Hualien, just blocks away from the bustling city center, major gourmet snack shops, and specialty boutiques. When entering the lobby, you are greeted with one big red welcome glazed wall, simple and elegant chandeliers, unique rose landscape stone of Hualien specialty, presenting an oriental style of antique beauty spontaneously. We uphold our commitment to offer services with a friendly attitude to make travelers feel at home. Tired of the fast paced busy city, are you ready to have a relaxing holiday? Bring your family or friends, or a good book to savor the leisurely pace of Easttown 26, and write a new note in your personal travel journal.

stays.name: 東大門民宿
stays.description: 花蓮，作為台灣最大的縣市，擁有寬廣的腹地，還是欣賞晨曦最迷人的地方之一。日出東方，旭日升起的美麗總是令人期待，特別是在旅途中。而位於花蓮市的【東大門民宿】，正好坐落於此晨曦綻放之地。從民宿出發，僅需幾分鐘即可步入無限的陽光與蔚藍的太平洋，遠眺壯麗的【中央山脈】，如巨龍般雄偉地聳立在眼前。此外，往南眺望，還能欣賞到【東海岸山脈】的小龍身影，映襯著海天一色的壯美。到了夜晚，【東大門民宿】更是理想的下榻之所。僅一步之遙，便可抵達熱鬧非凡的【東大門夜市】，或【漫步在市區街道】及【巷弄間】，尋找別具風味的美食與隱藏的藝術之美。【東大門民宿】提供舒適的住宿環境，更是您旅行花蓮城市風光的起點，讓每一刻都充滿未知的旅程與感動。

stays.description: 東大門精緻旅店位於花蓮市，距離北濱公園 2.9 公里，提供公共休息區、免費私人停車位和花園。館內提供免費 WiFi，距離松園別館約 3.8 公里，距離慈濟文化園區 1.2 公里。此旅館提供 24 小時接待櫃台與客房服務，並可協助安排觀光行程。所有客房均配備空調、平面有線電視、冰箱、熱水壺、沖洗座、吹風機和書桌。此飯店的客房皆享有園景，房內的私人衛浴附淋浴設施與免費盥洗用品。東大門精品旅館的每間客房均設有一個休息區。此旅館距離花蓮天惠堂 1.6 公里，距離花蓮縣立體育館 2 公里。最近的機場是花蓮機場，距離 4 公里。此區為花蓮市的人氣推薦區域（依據真實住客評語）
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Hualien City, 2.9 km from Beibin Park, Dongdaemun Inn offers a shared lounge area, free private parking spaces and a garden. Free WiFi is available in the hotel. It is about 3.8 km from Pine Garden and 1.2 km from Tzu Chi Cultural Park. The hotel provides a 24-hour front desk and room service, and can assist with sightseeing arrangements.All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, flat-screen cable TV, refrigerator, kettle, flushing station, hairdryer and desk. The rooms in this hotel all have garden views, private bathrooms with shower facilities and free toiletries. Each room in Dongdaemun Boutique Hotel has a seating area.This hotel is 1.6 km from Hualien Tianhui Hall and 2 km from Hualien County Stadium. The nearest airport is Hualien Airport, 4 km away.This area is a popular recommended area in Hualien City (based on real guest reviews)

stays.name: 泊壹民宿
stays.description: 位於花蓮縣的民宿Boy apartment 提供質感住宿環境與生活入住體驗,築起一個文化居家空間。所有產品都經由我們設計製作及精心挑選,房客能了解其出處，安心去感受房內每個細節。房源內家具皆為實木而成且附合格檢驗報告，匠人手工精心製作。生活居家用品採用當地或海外獨立工作室設計品牌，結合美感與巧思為期更換。Boy apartment與客人間是相互尊重，我們不提供多餘服務與強迫推銷，在這空間的彼此是獨立個體且能有善溝通。如需幫忙，我們會盡可能協助。房客能自在不受打擾舒服得到休息，需要你我的配合。Boy apartment位處於舊時溝仔尾的小巷弄間，今日規劃成香榭大道。緊鄰花蓮觀光夜市東大門與傳統市場，步行皆在三分鐘內。附近有許多知名文創咖啡店及各式餐廳。花蓮市中心鬧區皆能步行抵達，往太平洋公園海邊一公里。適合每個想悠閒漫遊花蓮旅客。Boy apartment是甫完工的新屋附有電梯，電器居家設備新穎且經一再測試調整。我們以房客為出發點著想，盡心完成。
stays.descriptionEn: Homestay located in HualienBoy Apartment creates not just a place to rest your head at night but a home where you can reset and renew. Our amenities and spaces support relaxation and rejuvenation of the mind, body and spirit. With fragrances and scents in every guest room, each space is meticulously crafted to enchant the senses. Put down the pressure in the real world, listen to the sounds of nature, feel the warmth of Taiwan's people, slow down the pace of life and leisurely experience a simple slow life.

stays.name: 法朵民宿
stays.description: 「Fardo」從最初的設計到夢想實現的過程，民宿主人都親自參與實施。民宿內外都呈現出主人精緻的設計風格。大廳營造出優雅豪華的氛圍，客房則為旅客提供舒適、整潔的休息空間。民宿內外都融入了民宿主人對Fardo的愛與期許。我們的客房設施包括：每間客房均設有陽台、高檔獨立彈簧床墊、一床兩床被子、大金空調、台灣寬頻高清電視、乾濕分離衛生間。寄宿家庭設施包括：微波爐和冰箱。另外，距離民宿200公尺處有民宿專用停車場。以上設施均免費供房客使用。
stays.descriptionEn: From the initial design of "Fardo" to the process of dream realization, the owner of the homestay was personally involved in the implementation. The homestay presents the owner's exquisite design style inside and out. The lobby creates an elegant and luxurious atmosphere, while the rooms provide travelers with a comfortable and clean resting space. Both inside and outside the homestay are infused with the homestay owner's passion and expectations for Fardo.Our room facilities include: each room has a balcony, high-end independent spring mattress, one bed with two quilts, Daikin air conditioning, Taiwan Broadband high-definition TV, and dry and wet separated bathroom. homestay facilities include: microwave and refrigerator. In addition, there is a dedicated parking lot for the homestay 200 meters away from the homestay. The above facilities are free for guests to use.

stays.name: 洄瀾窩青年旅舍
stays.description: 洄瀾窩不僅是一個住宿空間，更是集結旅人的交流空間。旅舍主人運用旅行與生活中熱愛自然的一種態度，打造出「環保、貼心、有溫度」的窩，從公共交誼空間至房間設計概念皆採用環保與復古工業風。相信喜歡設計感強烈的旅人們，一定會愛上這裡！我們相信，旅人絕不是因為洄瀾窩而來，他們是因為花蓮的好山好水而來；於是，我們也謙卑地引入花蓮由北到南的七個無價大景在每一層樓的梯間，成為我們最美的裝潢。洄瀾窩希望給入住的旅人們WOW的感覺，走進洄瀾窩即是走進花蓮，希望旅人們在旅途中能因為洄瀾窩而有美好的回憶！最後，我們也希望將台灣自然環境之特色及在地風土文化之熱情帶給來自世界各地的旅人，使其了解台灣之美，再介紹更多人來看見台灣、體驗台灣，並將WOW「清新、分享、環境友善」的精神傳遞到世界各個角落。
stays.descriptionEn: Hualien Wow Hostel provides not only accommodation but also a communication space. The hotel owner executes travel experience and love the nature in life who create a place with "Green, Thoughtful, and Temperature”.From public space to the room design are environmentally and vintage industrial concepts. Travelers who love heavily design will fall in love with Hualien Wow Hostel. We believe travelers come to Hualien are main for good scenery. However, we have 7 priceless endowed scenes in Hualien at every staircase corner which is our fantastic decoration. Hualien Wow Hostel expects to provide travelers with the “WOW” spirit which means when visit Hualien Wow Hostel that is visiting Hualien. As long as Hualien Wow Hostel that provide the travelers with a good travel memory. At last, we also hope to bring features of Taiwan’s nature environment and traditional enthusiasm culture to travelers in the world. Travelers can be acquainted with beauty of Taiwan, recommend Taiwan and convey the “WOW” spirit—“fresh, sharing, eco-friendly” to everywhere in the world.

stays.searchText: 洄瀾窩青年旅舍 洄瀾窩青年旅舍股份有限公司 花蓮縣旅館156號 花蓮縣 花蓮市 國聯里24鄰國聯一路83號(2至9樓) 洄瀾窩不僅是一個住宿空間，更是集結旅人的交流空間。旅舍主人運用旅行與生活中熱愛自然的一種態度，打造出「環保、貼心、有溫度」的窩，從公共交誼空間至房間設計概念皆採用環保與復古工業風。相信喜歡設計感強烈的旅人們，一定會愛上這裡！我們相信，旅人絕不是因為洄瀾窩而來，他們是因為花蓮的好山好水而來；於是，我們也謙卑地引入花蓮由北到南的七個無價大景在每一層樓的梯間，成為我們最美的裝潢。洄瀾窩希望給入住的旅人們WOW的感覺，走進洄瀾窩即是走進花蓮，希望旅人們在旅途中能因為洄瀾窩而有美好的回憶！最後，我們也希望將台灣自然環境之特色及在地風土文化之熱情帶給來自世界各地的旅人，使其了解台灣之美，再介紹更多人來看見台灣、體驗台灣，並將WOW「清新、分享、環境友善」的精神傳遞到世界各個角落。

stays.descriptionEn: View Ocean Bed and Breakfast links the Pacific Ocean and Central Mountain Range, with a prominent city location that features Nanbin Park on the left and Beibin Ecological Park on the right. The city’s only garden scenic bed and breakfast covering over 660 square meters, it affords incredibly beautiful views of the sunrise, sunset, moon, stars, and ships at night, as well as the design of the Yu Yu Yang Art Museum, Taroko Line and snake pattern stone ladder, native trees of Hualien, flocks of swallows in the spring, changing clouds in the summer, rainbows following an afternoon rain, and migratory birds gathering around the ocean in fall and winter. There’s an abundance of natural beauty that varies by season and climate.

stays.name: 漁家樂民宿
stays.description: 位於市中心花蓮市市公所旁，生活機能便利，附近有炸彈蔥油餅街與時光二手書店，以及可登山健行的美崙山，路程只要五分鐘就可到達美崙山路口，可看見整個花蓮市與海邊，晚上可逛著名的南濱夜市與自強夜市，可代客安排夜間抓蝦、釣魚、坐船夜釣，以及二天一夜套裝行程。4月-5月間鯉魚潭是賞鳥、賞螢、賞蝶及觀察植物的生態之旅，8月-9月是富里六十石山金針花季，7月-8月是花蓮原住民豐年祭，10月是花蓮國際石雕藝術節，11月是太魯閣峽谷馬拉松與峽谷音樂會。花蓮餐飲特色有三國一餐廳、月盧、櫻田野養生館、花本家〈賀川〉、立川魚池以及順富裕小吃、公正包子、鵝肉先生、來成排骨、大陸麵店、第一家烤肉店、蔣家花蓮式棺材板等都是好吃的美食。本人喜歡釣魚活動，在花蓮經營釣具業已經有二十年以上，這是父親在花蓮經營的店所傳承下來，已經有四十年了，由我接手，我愛好釣魚，常常與朋友去溪邊或海邊磯釣、灘釣、船釣，去享受大自然新鮮空氣與大海吹來涼爽的海風。花蓮是個好山好水美麗的地方。
stays.descriptionEn: Fish Fun is situated next to Hualien City Office. Everything needed for convenient living is easily available . Nearby there are a bomb scallion pancake street and second hand bookstore, and Mei Lun Mountain where you can go trekking. Mei Lun Mountain is only 5 minutes away by car. You can see the entire Hualien City and the beach from the mountain. At night, you can go to the famous Nan Bing (Nanbin) and Tzu Chiang (Ziqiang) Night markets. We can arrange nighttime shrimp catching, fishing, night fishing, and a 2 day, 1 night package trip. April to May is the best time to go bird, firefly, and butterfly watching, and observe plants in Liyutan (Liyu Lake). August to September is the Lioushidan (Liushishi) Mountain daylily flower season. July to August is the Hualien Aboriginal Harvest Festival. October has the Hualien International Stone Sculpture Art Festival. November has the Taroko Gorge Marathon and Valley Music Concert. As for good food in Hualien: There are the Sankokuighi Drink & Foods Restaurant, Yue Lu (Moon House), Ying Tien Yeh, Health and Wellness House, Hua Ben House (Kagawa), Lichuan Fish Pond, Shuen Fu Yu Snack Stand, Gong Cheng Steamed Buns, Mr. Goose Meat, Lai Cheng Pork Chop, China Noodle Shop, First Barbecue Shop, Chiang Family Hualien Style Coffin Boards, all serving up delicious delicacies at a reasonable price. I like fishing. In Hualien, I have been in the fishing equipment business for over 20 years. I inherited the 40 year old store from my father. I love fishing, and often go rock fishing, beach fishing, and boat fishing on the river or the sea, enjoying the fresh air of Mother Nature and cool sea breeze. Hualien is a beautiful place.

With an unbeatable vacation vibe, this ocean-view guesthouse is the perfect escape for all sea lovers!

Lakeshore will accompany travelers to discover the meaning of travel and to freely enjoy and experience Hualien.

stays.description: 位於花蓮縣的民宿 - 花蓮爸爸萬歲民宿 (Hualien PA PA Banzai B&B)《爸爸萬歲》民宿的名稱；取名源自於一本 -《狐狸爸爸萬歲 》Fantastic Mr Fox由風靡全世界的兒童文學英國作家-羅德•達爾（Ronald Dahl)在1968年春天所寫出來的童書故事。我們距離花蓮火車站僅約970meter，民宿位在花蓮熱鬧的市中心，生活機能超方便，地點鬧中取靜，在靜謐巷弄內，擁有最寧靜的住宿夜晚，我們也有旅客專屬停車場。花蓮市區美味的美食店家都在民宿附近，步行2-3分鐘即可有多種選擇，到太平洋海邊也只有1.9kilometer遠。爸爸萬歲民宿，提供舒適休憩空間，讓來花蓮遊玩的您有回家的感覺。Hualien PA PA B&B
stays.descriptionEn: B&B in Hualien County - Hualien PA PA Banzai B&B"Long Live Dad" B&BThe name; the name comes from a book - "Long Live Mr. Fox"A children's book story written in the spring of 1968 by Ronald Dahl, a British writer of children's literature that is popular all over the world.We are only about 970 meters away from Hualien Railway Station. The B&B is located in the bustling city center of Hualien. It is very convenient for living functions. The location is quiet in the middle of the bustle. It is in a quiet alley, giving you the most peaceful night to stay. We also have an exclusive parking lot for tourists.The delicious food shops in Hualien City are all nearby the B&B. There are many choices within a 2-3 minute walk, and the Pacific Ocean is only 1.9 kilometers away.Long Live Dad B&B provides comfortable relaxing space, making you feel like you are at home when visiting Hualien.Hualien PA PA B&B

stays.name: 璽賓行旅
stays.description: 「Kadda Hotel璽賓行旅」位在面對太平洋的花蓮港旁，是一間以運動為主題的飯店。不僅是台灣東部第一間以單車為主題的運動飯店，全館更積極提倡單車環保低碳旅行，不僅館內設有單車維修站，所有房間單車都可進房且皆設置有機無毒的高級義大利進口盥洗用品。一進入Kadda的迎賓大廳，首先印入眼簾的是一整面花蓮單車地圖與標誌，牆上更呈列許多已60~80年代的古董手工鋼管單車，單車主題風味十足的大廳，是許多旅客及路過的民眾打卡勝地。「Kadda Hotel璽賓行旅」擁有50間客房，每一間都擁有全台最美日出的太平洋海景，遠眺還可看到青翠山巒，並緊鄰花蓮知名的「兩潭自行車道」，旅客在房內就可欣賞太平洋美景。
stays.descriptionEn: The "Kadda Hotel" is located next to the Hualien Harbour facing the Pacific Ocean. It is a sports-themed hotel. It is not only the first bicycle-themed sports hotel in eastern Taiwan. The whole building is more active in promoting cycling and low-carbon travel. All rooms are equipped with organic non-toxic premium Italian imported toiletries. As soon as you enter the welcome hall of Kadda, the first thing that comes to your attention is a full-faced Hualien bicycle map and logo. On the wall, there are many antique handmade steel bicycles from the 60s and 80s. The bicycle-style hall is full of flavors and is a lot of passengers. Passing people hit the card resort."Kadda Hotel" has 50 rooms, each with the most beautiful sunrise in the Pacific Ocean, overlooking the green hills and close to the famous "Bicycle Path" in Hualien.

stays.searchText: 璽賓行旅 璽賓實業股份有限公司 花蓮縣旅館162號 花蓮縣 花蓮市 民德里12鄰民權路2之6號 「Kadda Hotel璽賓行旅」位在面對太平洋的花蓮港旁，是一間以運動為主題的飯店。不僅是台灣東部第一間以單車為主題的運動飯店，全館更積極提倡單車環保低碳旅行，不僅館內設有單車維修站，所有房間單車都可進房且皆設置有機無毒的高級義大利進口盥洗用品。一進入Kadda的迎賓大廳，首先印入眼簾的是一整面花蓮單車地圖與標誌，牆上更呈列許多已60~80年代的古董手工鋼管單車，單車主題風味十足的大廳，是許多旅客及路過的民眾打卡勝地。「Kadda Hotel璽賓行旅」擁有50間客房，每一間都擁有全台最美日出的太平洋海景，遠眺還可看到青翠山巒，並緊鄰花蓮知名的「兩潭自行車道」，旅客在房內就可欣賞太平洋美景。

stays.name: 眠月樓民宿
stays.description: 眠月樓—浪漫肆意與月共眠…偷得浮生半日閒‧浪漫肆意月共眠，每個人都希望遠離喧囂與煩惱在花蓮--我們已經為您準備好渡假別墅，這裡的每一分設計，都是民宿主人的用心，用精緻的進口寢俱、原木傢俱來妝點樓房，安靜、乾淨、舒適的居家環境，是這裡的特色之一搭配浪漫水晶吊燈，隨處擺飾的藝品凸顯藝術氣息。更重要的是—親切溫馨為您服務的民宿主人想跟您作朋友~才是我們邀請您來的主要原因。眠月樓位在花蓮美崙山麓，環境清幽、路邊停車，至市區10分鐘車程，全棟樓房提供【早餐現作服務】，家電傢俱齊全包括客房內【32吋液晶電視、音響、冰箱、咖啡機、免費上網…等】。 眠月樓非常注重環境清潔，入住前每間客房均經過專業人員整理打掃；遇續住房客提供備品補充，但被品不更換，保持飯店等級的睡眠環境...進口原木家具浪漫設計，舒適的住宿環境外提供的是心靈層次的民宿體驗... 讓居住民宿成為一種～享受…
stays.descriptionEn: Moon House B&B - Where you sleep with the moon... Everyone wants to get away from the hustle and bustle of daily life. In Hualien, we have prepared this holiday house for you. Every bit of it is designed by the owner. It is quiet, clean, and comfortable. And it is refined with imported wooden furniture, the chandeliers and the artworks. What& #39;s more - the warm and welcoming hosts that wish to make friends with everyone is the main feature of the place. Moon House B&B is on Meilun Mountain, Hualien. It is secluded and has plenty of space to park by the road. It is a 10-minute drive to downtown Hualien. A Freshly cooked breakfast is provided for every room. Rooms are equipped with a 32-inch LCD TV, household speakers, a refrigerator, a coffee machine, and free Internet. Moon House B&B makes sure every room is professionally cleaned before every check-in. Room amenities are replaced regularly. We provide a supreme environment with imported wooden furniture. This is where you can rest your mind and soul and enjoy every bit of your stay.

stays.name: 知了居民宿
stays.description: 發現知了居知了，是蟬的別名。知了居位於花蓮市的美崙山上，旁有松園別館，在這優美的環境中，時時聽到蟬兒唧唧的叫聲，彷彿催促著我們趕快步入這片優美的環境。因此，我們以「知了」命名為—「知了居」。在這裡，您可以俯瞰花蓮市，右有中央山脈，左有海岸山脈，在這自然景觀中，讓您的視覺與聽覺擺脫城市的紛擾，享受大自然最隆重而簡單的洗禮。當您步進「知了居」，門前的二葉松以及繁星正在與您打招呼，庭院裡紫色飛舞的海豚花、粉色浪漫的歐牽、薰衣草，也在熱烈歡迎您的到來。在我們用心下有最親切的服務，最舒服的設備與享受，讓您卸下平日沈重的壓力，沐浴在花蓮的山、海、陽光、空氣中，知了居歡迎有品味及愛好自然的您。花蓮的日與夜早晨 — 陽光灑落在剛剛甦醒的花蓮市，光線穿過，照亮雄偉的中央山脈，也照耀著美麗的太平洋。黃昏 — 一抹晚霞劃過天邊，微風徐徐吹來，星光、街燈若隱若現。夜晚 — 俯視花蓮夜景，萬家燈火閃爍，月光微微落在大地，星星閃閃掛在天邊。蛙鳴、蟬叫，如同一場大地的音樂會正熱鬧展開。手工精緻早餐早餐由管家親自製作，美味的漢堡搭配新鮮爽口的生菜沙拉以及當季盛產的水果，客人還可以挑選果汁、熱可可、熱咖啡，吃完美味早餐，一天的營養以及活力都具備囉!
stays.descriptionEn: Discovering Zileju(Cicada-Home). Zile is another name for Cicada. Zileju is situated on Mei Lun Mountain in Hualien City. There is a Pine Garden next to it. In this beautiful environment, you can often hear the chirping sound of cicada that seems to be urging us to quickly step into this beautiful environment; therefore, we called our home stay “cicada.” Here, you can enjoy a great view of Hualien City. To the right, there is the Central Mountain Range, and, to the left, is the Coastal Mountain Range. In this natural scenery, you are far from the disturbance of the noisy city, and enjoy the most grand and simple baptism of Mother Nature. When you step into Zileju, Taiwan red pines and an array of stars greet you. The purple-dancing Cape Primrose, pink and romantic morning glory, and lavender also welcome you. We provide the most friendly service, the most comfortable facilities and enjoyment, allowing you to unwind and forget the stress of work by bathing in the mountains, sea, sunlight, and air of Hualien. Zileju welcomes guests who have taste and a love for nature. The day and night of Hualien: Morning- Sunlight shines on the newly awakened Hualien City. The sunlight shines through, and lights up the grand Central Mountain Range, and also shines on the beautiful Pacific Ocean. Sunset- Afterglow sweeps across the sky, a breeze gently blows, starlight and street lights are faintly discernible. Night- Looking over Hualien night scene, you see glittering lights, as moon light gently shines on the ground and stars twinkle on the sky. The croaking of frogs and chirping sounds of cicadas is like a natural symphony. We serve a delicious breakfast, personally made by the inn keeper, consisting of a tasty hamburger, together with fresh and tasty lettuce salad and seasonal fruits; as for drinks, guests can choose juice, hot cocoa, or hot coffee. After eating breakfast, you will have all the nourishment and energy you need for the day !

stays.name: 碧夏民宿
stays.description: 「花蓮的空氣特新鮮」，這是來過的人都說的第一句話，第一印象。那是因為美麗雄偉的中央山脈近在咫尺，寬廣碧綠的太平洋就近在眼前並觸手可及。全新落成開幕的「碧夏民宿」，坐落於花蓮市金三角鬧區的巷道內，動靜皆宜的環境，整棟建築物採最原始﹑自然的清水模牆壁，簡單紋理猶如潑墨畫般﹐無太多化學漆料﹐加上民宿主人獨一無二的設計感﹐loft風﹑工業風﹑復古﹑懷舊﹑簡約﹑時尚均一一融入室內設計﹐就連「碧夏民宿」的外觀建築更是突出醒目﹐整棟建築洋溢著年輕活力的朝氣。退而不休的民宿主人﹐秉持傳統理念，『家』才是幸福的來源，守著碧夏，也守著你。
stays.descriptionEn: "The air in Hulaien is particularly fresh." Everyone who paid a visit to Hualien said this first. This was their impression as well. That is because the Central Mountain Range is not far away and the vast and blue Pacific is reachable and in sight. The newly-opened "Be Sunny B & B" sits in an alley of the Golden Triangle in Hualien. With an environment suitable for both static and dynamic activities, the entire building has the most primitive and natural architectural concrete walls with simple texture looking like splash-ink paintings. There is no too much chemical paint. The B&B owner has a unique sense of design, integrating the loft, industrial, retro, simplicity, and fashionable style with the interior design. The building appearance of the "Be Sunny B & B" is so striking that the entire building is filled with young and vibrant vitality. The B&B owner retired from his previous job upholds the traditional concept and believes that "home" is the source of happiness. Thus he guards Be Sunny B & B and you.

stays.searchText: 碧夏民宿 碧夏民宿 花蓮縣民宿1372號 花蓮縣 花蓮市 自由街110巷7號 「花蓮的空氣特新鮮」，這是來過的人都說的第一句話，第一印象。那是因為美麗雄偉的中央山脈近在咫尺，寬廣碧綠的太平洋就近在眼前並觸手可及。全新落成開幕的「碧夏民宿」，坐落於花蓮市金三角鬧區的巷道內，動靜皆宜的環境，整棟建築物採最原始﹑自然的清水模牆壁，簡單紋理猶如潑墨畫般﹐無太多化學漆料﹐加上民宿主人獨一無二的設計感﹐loft風﹑工業風﹑復古﹑懷舊﹑簡約﹑時尚均一一融入室內設計﹐就連「碧夏民宿」的外觀建築更是突出醒目﹐整棟建築洋溢著年輕活力的朝氣。退而不休的民宿主人﹐秉持傳統理念，『家』才是幸福的來源，守著碧夏，也守著你。

stays.nameEn: Fairy Tale Motel Co., Ltd. Metropolitan Branch
stays.description: 童話都會館隱身於花蓮市區寧靜的巷弄內，步行約十分鐘隨即進入市中心精華逛街徒步區，東大門夜市(彩虹夜市)廟口紅茶、公正街包子、液香扁食、海埔蚵仔煎，經典美食近在咫尺。您亦可騎乘童話都會館提供的自行車，伴隨和煦陽光及徐徐海風， 沿著北濱公園、曙光橋、七星潭自行車步道，悠閒自在地欣賞花蓮之美。童話都會館精心設計的主題房間，帶給您最優質、最舒服的住房感受。房內更備有豪華按摩浴缸，為每位風塵僕僕的旅人，洗去一身疲憊。旅行不是趕行程的賽跑，遠離都市塵囂，徹底放鬆身心，盡情徜徉在後山愜意的漫活步調當中，童話都會館將陪伴您度過一個精彩又難忘的美好旅程。
stays.descriptionEn: The Fairy Tale Hotel is hidden in the quiet alleys of Hualien City, just a ten-minute walk to the vibrant shopping area in the city center. The Dongdamen Night Market (Rainbow Night Market) offers delicious treats like temple entrance red tea, steamed buns from Gongzheng Street, and oyster omelets from Haipu, all within easy reach. You can also ride the bicycles provided by the Fairy Tale Hotel, enjoying the warm sunshine and gentle sea breeze as you leisurely explore the beauty of Hualien along the Beibin Park, Shuguang Bridge, and Qixingtan bike paths. The themed rooms at the Fairy Tale Hotel are meticulously designed to provide you with the highest quality and most comfortable accommodation experience. Each room is equipped with a luxurious massage bathtub to help weary travelers wash away their fatigue. Travel is not a race against the schedule; it is about escaping the hustle and bustle of the city, completely relaxing your body and mind, and enjoying the leisurely pace of life in the back mountains. The Fairy Tale Hotel will accompany you on a wonderful and unforgettable journey.

stays.description: 「米可司MIX民宿」位於花蓮火車站前，搭乘火車可往前站出口處後，往前直走5分鐘即可抵達；火車站前有汽、機車出租公司可供選擇，民宿周遭有7-11、八方雲集、咖啡館、連鎖早餐店、飲料鋪、電影城、保齡球遊樂館各式店家林立；可沿美崙溪畔騎單車、散步至太平洋海岸。白天、夜晚生活機能無虞。步行十分鐘即抵達花蓮市中心，交通極其便利。「米可司MIX民宿」可提供旅遊資訊及規畫套裝行程，讓您初訪花蓮也可玩得盡興；套房以原住民文化為設計中心，融合現代摩登的風格，舒適木質地板和精彩燈具，優質的傢俱及高級寢具設備和備品，營造雅緻、舒適穹蒼的空間及視覺享受，讓您在繁忙的一日旅遊後，能夠迅速而輕鬆的入眠，並達到極佳的舒眠品質。「米可司MIX民宿」住宿需經過感應門鎖，且每晚有大批警力維持附近治安，安全有保障。公有停車位PM10:00～AM10:00，免費停車。交通方便的區段、絕佳的生活機能、高檔的住宿品質、舒適的睡眠環境，是您旅遊或背包客自由行最物超所值的住宿選擇
stays.descriptionEn: Mix hostel is located in front of Hualien train station. Only takes 5 minitues by walking. Each suite is decorated with western and aboriginal details. The fusion of varied cultural themes makes each room a surprising expression of aesthetics, simple and classical. The location of the hostel is very convenient for leisure or business with super market (7-11), dining, coffee shop, cinema, bars, and bowling store around the hostel. About 10 minutes, you can visit the Hualien downtown and the night fair. Spacious room, wooden floor, and comfort bed cheer up the visitors and release their fatigue. Every visitor uses the key with senor to entry the hostel. High security increases the quality of rest and sleep for visitors.Mix B&B plans a trip for 2 or 3 days to visit the Taroko National Park (northern Hualien) or rift valley or seascape (southern Hualien). With our utmost sincerity, we welcome you to be our honorable guests and serve you a pleasant time at Mix hostel.

stays.descriptionEn: For those who don't visit Hualien that often, Hualien is a pure land enclosed by the Central Mountain Raneg and the Pacific Ocean. Hualien is a harbor of refuge and home to Uncle De and Grandma Yun who moved to Eastern Taiwan from Western Taiwan, and have lived here for nearly 40 years. Green Window House is the dream of this elderly couple who are more than sixty years old. This House does not have magnificent decorations or fancy trappings. It only has clean white walls, big beds, and large windows for you.

stays.name: 繆斯民宿
stays.description: 「繆斯」創始之初的設計到夢想實踐的過程，皆是民宿主人親身投入施作。民宿裡外呈現主人極具講究的設計風格，大廳部分營造出高雅奢華的氛圍，房間部分則提供旅客舒適潔淨的休憩空間，不論市民宿的裡外，全都注入了民宿主人對繆斯的熱情與期盼。我們房間設施包括：每房皆有陽台、高級獨立筒床墊、一床附兩被，大金冷暖空調、台灣大寬頻高畫質電視、乾濕分離衛浴。民宿設施包括：微波爐、冰箱。另外，附設民宿專用停車場在民宿旁200公尺處。以上設施皆免費提供住客使用。
stays.descriptionEn: From the initial design of "Muse" to the process of dream realization, the owner of the homestay was personally involved in the implementation. The homestay presents the owner's exquisite design style inside and out. The lobby creates an elegant and luxurious atmosphere, while the rooms provide travelers with a comfortable and clean resting space. Both inside and outside the homestay are infused with the homestay owner's passion and expectations for Muse.Our room facilities include: each room has a balcony, high-end independent spring mattress, one bed with two quilts, Daikin air conditioning, Taiwan Broadband high-definition TV, and dry and wet separated bathroom. homestay facilities include: microwave and refrigerator. In addition, there is a dedicated parking lot for the homestay 200 meters away from the homestay. The above facilities are free for guests to use.

stays.name: 美侖大飯店
stays.description: 1993年，美侖飯店伴隨著花蓮的心跳誕生。身為花蓮第一家國際型度假飯店，美侖始終與花蓮一起呼吸律動，坐落於湛藍海洋與蓊鬱群山環抱中的美侖，是通往花蓮山水美景的鎖鑰，無論是景致明媚的太魯閣、風景宜人的七星潭、或是集合美食與絕佳伴手禮的花蓮市區… 美侖，絕對是您花蓮之旅的最佳起點～ 不只如此，無限寬廣的藍與綠垂手可得，更讓美侖不但是一都市的度假休閒飯店，更成為花蓮最跳躍鮮明的印記！ 不但是地理上的美景中心，更是花蓮歷史的、人文的、感官的中心。 以自然美景為本，用在地文化提味，美侖灌溉了身心的感官需求。 現在，就開始享受美侖，開始你在花蓮心的起點※ 花蓮美侖為響應環保愛護地球, 自2022/6/1不主動提供一次性備品, 客房內僅提供沐浴乳、洗髮乳及潤髮乳, 入住期間如有需求請以客房電話與房務部聯絡, 謝謝。
stays.descriptionEn: In 1993, Parkview Hotel Hualien was born accompanying the heartbeat of Hualien. As the first international resort hotel in Hualien, Parkview Hotel always breathes with the rhythm of Hualien, is located in and surrounded by deep blue ocean and lush mountains, is the gateway to Hualien splendid views, whether it is the bright scenery of Taroko, scenic Qixingtan, or downtown Hualien where a collection of gourmet foods and great souvenirs ... Parkview Hotel is definitely your best starting point for the trip to Hualien ~ Not only that, the infinitely broad blue and green just at your fingertips, and more, Parkview Hotel is not only a leisure hotel in the city, but also become the most jumping distinctive mark of Hualien. It is not only the geographical center of beautiful scenic, but also the center of Hualien's history, humanities, and sensory. Based on natural beauty views, enhance it the flavor with local culture, Parkview Hotel has been infused. Now, you begin to enjoy the Parkview Hotel. Start your starting point in the heart of Hualien. ※ GOING GREEN!!! To support the government policy with the goal environmental protection and reduce plastic wastes, guests are encouraged to bring their own amenities. We will only provide shampoo & shower gel and hair conditioner in the guest room from Jun 1st 2022. Other disposable amenities will no longer be deployed. Amenities are available by request to [Housekeeping], please dial 7 from the house phone.

stays.searchText: 美侖大飯店 宜津企業股份有限公司 交觀宿字第1600號 花蓮縣 花蓮市 林園1之1號 1993年，美侖飯店伴隨著花蓮的心跳誕生。身為花蓮第一家國際型度假飯店，美侖始終與花蓮一起呼吸律動，坐落於湛藍海洋與蓊鬱群山環抱中的美侖，是通往花蓮山水美景的鎖鑰，無論是景致明媚的太魯閣、風景宜人的七星潭、或是集合美食與絕佳伴手禮的花蓮市區… 美侖，絕對是您花蓮之旅的最佳起點～ 不只如此，無限寬廣的藍與綠垂手可得，更讓美侖不但是一都市的度假休閒飯店，更成為花蓮最跳躍鮮明的印記！ 不但是地理上的美景中心，更是花蓮歷史的、人文的、感官的中心。 以自然美景為本，用在地文化提味，美侖灌溉了身心的感官需求。 現在，就開始享受美侖，開始你在花蓮心的起點※ 花蓮美侖為響應環保愛護地球, 自2022/6/1不主動提供一次性備品, 客房內僅提供沐浴乳、洗髮乳及潤髮乳, 入住期間如有需求請以客房電話與房務部聯絡, 謝謝。

stays.description: 市區首選優質民宿，提供旅人一個溫馨舒適的歇腳處。艾米CASA位于花蓮市台九線旁，距離市區金三角五分鐘車程、距離東大門夜市六分鐘車程。鬧中取靜生活機能便利，附近有24小時營業便利商店及洗衣店。所有客房均配有平面有線電視、熱水壺、小冰箱和吹風機。提供免費無線網絡連接。​艾米CASA希望把花蓮的文化和熱情帶給每一個旅客，我們會提供附近的生活訊息，歡迎來親自體驗在地生活。讓更多來花蓮遊玩的旅人，能夠在飯店之外有一個更不一樣的選擇，我們會以最熱情的心歡迎每個來我們這兒的旅人，期待您的光臨！​
stays.descriptionEn: The premium B&B, the best choice in downtown. We offer you a comfortable place for rest. ""AMICASA GUESTHOUSE"" is near Provincial Highway 9 in Hualien City, and is only 5 minutes away from downtown and 6 minutes away from Tungtamen Night Market by car. With all the convenience, we are away from the noise of the city but with a24-hour convenience store and a laundromat nearby. Every room has a TV, a water kettle, a mini-bar and a hairdryer . We offer free WiFi. ​AMICASA GUESTHOUSE wants to bring the culture and passion of Hualien to every traveler, and we are happy to give you practical directions. Welcome to A MI CASA to experience the local life. We hope to offer a different option in addition to the hotels for travelers who come to Hualien. We treat our guests with the greatest passion ever. We look forward to seeing you soon! ​

stays.name: 花漾蓮芯民宿
stays.description: 花蓮是台灣的最後一塊淨土，好山、好水、好樂活，是都市忙碌人、是親子同遊、是年輕人、是浪漫情人…的旅遊最佳選擇。我們提供的服務1.「花漾蓮芯」位於花蓮市正中央，鄰近花蓮火車站、客運站及慈濟園區的絕佳 位置(步行僅 3分鐘)，享交通便捷之利，生活機能24小時不打烊。有著鬧中取靜的獨有特色，讓您無論到哪裡都不是問題，這兒有著家的溫暖、家的方便、家的貼心。2.民宿主人曾經從事旅遊相關工作多年，對花蓮觀光旅遊事務嫻熟，擅於針對季節的不同，整合上中下游垂直式產業或水平式異業以合作型態並與花蓮各鄉鎮推出的活動相連結，幫各種需求的客人規畫符合需要的行程。如文化型、體驗型、樂活型、探索型…等。3.民宿主人喜歡用大自然素材再造新生命，是民宿擺設重要元素之一，提供五種不同風格的客房，客人從進入民宿開始，眼睛看的，鼻子聞的、觸摸到的…等，都是一種享受，而且所有的擺飾品都可以買回去。4.每天早上提供以花蓮當季有機新鮮蔬果、由民宿主人親手現做的幸福早餐，開始一天健康樂活的花蓮行。5.提供花蓮機場、火車站免費溫馨接送服務。(需事前先預約)6.特別印製衛星定位之花蓮縣(市)交通、景點、美食精美地圖，一圖在手，暢行花蓮無阻，且值得收藏或傳送親朋好友。7.免費提供拼貼藝術DIY課程給住宿旅客參與，但需自付製作材料費(需事前先預約)。
stays.descriptionEn: Dear friends:Hualien is the last pure land in Taiwan with the beautiful natural scenery, clean water and leisure life style and is the best travel choice for family, young people and couple.The services which we provide:1. Hua Yang Lian Xin Homestay is located in the center of Hualien city. It’s a perfect location which provides you the convenient traffic and living function near the train station, bus station and Tzu Chi area (only 3 minutes by walking).2. Help you to arrange your trip plan well! We will consider your require and the different seasons to help you to plan the suitable trip for you, also introduce you tourist attractions and variety of local activities. Let you have the impressive and memorable Hualien journey!3. Provide the transport service! We will pick up and drop off from the train station and airport to Hua Yang Lian Xin Homestay.(Make the reservation first!)4. Provide the rooms with five different styles! You can enjoy the design and also buy any decoration which you like.5. Provide breakfast which is handmade by us. The ingredients we used are all came from local fresh food including organic vegetable, ham, a boiled egg, toast, pumpkin soup and so on. Whole meal consists of the varied nutrition and is healthy!Owner’s specialties and hobbies:1. I am good at making some decorations and stuff such as slippers, a mail box, tissue paper boxes and so on. Moreover, you can have a free Decoupage lesson, by the way you have to pay the material cost.(Make the reservation first!)2. I engaged in tourism for many years, so I am well-experienced and familiar with travel activities in Hualien. I believe that I can give you the best travel advice and help you to arrange your Hualien trip well.

stays.descriptionEn: Hualien 5FM Homestay - Xinyi Branch is located in Hualien. It is a 5-minute walk from the nearest night market and a 7-minute drive from Hualien Railway Station. Guest can use free bicycles to cycle around. Free WiFi access is available.Rooms here will provide a flat-screen TV, a work desk and air conditioning. Complete with a microwave, the dining area also has a refrigerator. Private bathroom comes with a bathtub or shower facilities. Free toiletries are included.At Hualien 5FM Homestay - Xinyi Branch you will find a shared kitchen and a games room. Staff at tour desk will gladly help with tickets booking and trip arrangements to Taroko National Park, Huatung Valley, East Coast National Scenic Area and Kenting. Car hire and luggage storage are possible as well. There is also a lift at the property.

stays.name: 花蓮富野渡假酒店
stays.description: 2013年夏天，「富野飯店集團」將飯店版圖拓展至休閒旅遊重鎮花蓮，打造市區裡的寧靜渡假旅宿──「花蓮富野渡假酒店」，共有189間舒適客房，以當代簡約設計呼應後山質樸風情，加上精緻美食與便捷交通，絕對是您輕鬆渡假的首選。「花蓮富野渡假酒店」坐落在花蓮市區，距離火車站不過10分鐘車程，為富野集團旗下首家休閒型商務飯店，大手筆買下老旅館，再斥資3億重新改造為時尚飯店，摩登的黑色建築透出低調氣質，有如城市裡的隱士，客房設計採簡約居家風，空間舒適且溫馨，總計有189間房，有標準、豪華、家庭與貴賓等不同房型，滿足不同度假需求。
stays.descriptionEn: Hoya Resort Hotel Group expended its domain to Hualien in 2013 summer and established a resort hotel in its downtown area. Hualien Hoya Resort Hotel has 189 comfy rooms which were designed to be simple to reflect the local nature. The resort hotel also has perfect location and delicate dinning. You won’t regret if you are looking for a relaxing vacation. Choose Hualien Hoya Resort Hotel!Hualien Hoya Resort Hotel locates in Hualien downtown, which is only 10 mins away from the train station by car. The resort hotel is the first leisure-oriented business hotel under Hoya Resort Hotel Group. Hoya Resort Hotel Group purchased an old hotel and turned it into a stage-of-the-art hotel with 300 million dollars. The exterior of the hotel is black, keeping its cutting-edge temperament in a low-profile as if a hermit in the city. There are 189 rooms in the hotel all of which are comfortable and sweet. The rooms includes different types to meet the customers’ demends.

stays.descriptionEn: Small Whale House, located next to the beautiful Meilun Mountain, features a comfortable, elegant living environment and is near the Qixingtan Bike Trail, providing full views of the Pacific Ocean. Hualien Harbor is a tourist destination for whale watching in the summer. Other places to visit in Hualien include Taroko, Huadong Valley, Hualien East Coast, and Mugumuki,. At Small Whale House, you’ll enjoy a level of friendliness and laid-back atmosphere not found in hotels. We offer soft beds and a good night of sleep, clean bathrooms to wash away your fatigue, and a warm, comfortable living room that’s a great place to chat and drink tea with a group of friends. If you like warm, laid-back bed and breakfasts, come to Small Whale House, where you’re sure to create great memories!

stays.name: 花蓮樂活亞綠亞民宿
stays.description: 火車站附近電梯民宿，宛如博物館的一樓大廳，異國風格的各式房型，位於巷弄異國風格的花蓮樂活亞綠亞精緻民宿，附近各種餐廳商家林立，離花蓮火車站只需步行10分鐘的路程，也備有私人免費停車場。民宿提供您截然不同的住宿體驗，從宛如博物館的一樓大廳、風格迥異的異國房型，全都有我們精心收集而來的各種典藏品及進口家具。民宿每日都會一早為住客準備現煮豐富營養的早餐，多住幾天的住客早餐絕不重複，讓您可每日享用不同的早餐。且為因應遊客方便性，除了信用卡可支付，也可使用國旅卡及銀聯、支付寶、微信付款，同時我們有配合的出租車，出門都可享有折扣，也可代訂賞鯨、泛舟、溯溪、獨木舟、SUP立槳、獵人學校、沙灘車、夜間抓蝦＋BBQ、包車一日遊（花東縱谷線、花東海岸線、六石石山、清境農場、墾丁），內容精彩可期，入住花蓮樂活亞綠亞精緻民宿絕對讓您賓至如歸。身為媒體工作者的我，20年前就規劃20年後的退休生活，花蓮的好山好水一直是我嚮往居住的城市，於是在2016年3月我買下花蓮火車站附近的電梯別墅，每間房間每個角落都是我花了一年的時間精心設計，我成就了我的夢想，也想將這份成就分享給喜歡來花蓮的旅客～
stays.descriptionEn: Set in Hualien City, 10 minutes' walk from Hualien Railway Station, Aria 2 Home offers cozy guest rooms. The homestay has a sun terrace with views of the mountain. Free parking is also available with advance reservation.Each guest room is designed in different style and is fitted with a flat-screen TV and a quiet refrigerator. Certain units include a seating area, balcony or terrace. The private bathroom comes with slippers, free toiletries and a hairdryer.Free use of bicycles is available at this homestay and the area is popular for cycling. Guests can enjoy free WiFi throughout the property.Guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant.

stays.name: 花蓮海悅酒店
stays.description: 花蓮海悅座落於太平洋畔，全館採用當地原石建材搭配手工原木家俱，兼具現代時尚極簡約風格，面海景觀套房，採用落地賞景玻璃帷幕，朝觀日出、暮賞夕陽，太平洋美麗海景一覽無遺。海悅距離市區、火車站、南濱夜市僅5分鐘車程，花蓮國際機場10分鐘車程；酒店前方為北濱公園親海戲水園區、環海景觀休閒步道、自行車專用道，右臨美崙溪畔、北（南）濱公園，左往七星潭、花蓮港賞鯨碼頭，後有美崙山及國家級古蹟松園別館。酒店提供入住貴賓，中西自助式早餐、迎賓飲品及火車站、機場、市區免費接駁等，各項貼心服務及旅遊行程諮詢，絕佳的地理位置，兼具休閒、商務、觀光旅遊與運動生活機能，為您造訪花蓮時，住宿最佳首選。
stays.descriptionEn: Ocean Hotel Hualien is located on the seashore of the Pacific Ocean. The hotel is built with local raw stones and furnished with handmade log furniture, and with a modern minimalist style. The suites facing the sea view employ ceiling-to-floor scenery glass curtain, and you can watch the sunrise in the morning and the sunset in the evening, providing you a vantage point to see the sweep of beautiful Pacific sea view. Ocean Hotel Hualien is just 5 minutes' drive from downtown, Train Station, and Nanbin Night Market, and 10 minutes from the Hualien Airport by car. In front of the Hotel, you can find a sea water swimming zone of the Beibin Park, sea landscape trails, and bike lanes. To the right, the Hotel neighbors on Meilun River, Beibin and Nanbin Parks, to the left, connects to Qixingtan, the whale-watching recreation pier of Hualien Harbor, and Mt. Meilun and the Pine Garden of National Monuments are behind the Hotel. The hotel offers staying guests Western buffet breakfast, welcome drinks, free shuttles to and from the Train Station, airport, urban area, etc., and attentive services and travel advice. A great location and functions for leisure, business, tourism, and sport life. It is your best choice for accommodation when you visit Hualien.

stays.name: 花蓮香城大飯店
stays.description: 花蓮香城大飯店位於花蓮市國興二街座擁花蓮市區繁華熱鬧處，是鄰近花蓮火車站的飯店，步行5分鐘即可抵達花蓮火車站，絕佳地理位置讓您方便到花蓮市中心吃喝玩樂更盡興；也可盡情到各大景點樂活一番，鄰近還有美侖山運動公園、螢火蟲生態館、中山運動公園、七星潭、松園別館等熱門花蓮景點，徹底悠遊花蓮清靜的自然風情，徜徉於浩瀚的太平洋海岸，讓您的旅遊與出差皆能身心舒暢並盡興得怡，客房雅緻高貴，價格卻不貴，飯店內有120坪的育樂中心結合所有娛樂元素，給您最歡愉的回憶，花蓮香城大飯店用心真心貼心款待最重要的您，鄰近花蓮火車站得天獨厚的地理位置，滿足您是休閒度假的優質住宿飯店。花蓮香城大飯店全新完工之餐廳，設有西式餐廳[歡聚屋]及中式宴會廳[盡歡苑]，給您舒適新穎的用餐空間，並使用當地食材，挑動您的味蕾，讓您享受到花蓮當地的特有風味！每日並推出主廚推薦風味套餐，適合需要洽公及聚餐的您。亦有合菜及自助式風味饗宴供您選擇，歡迎前來細細品嚐，體驗香城美味！
stays.descriptionEn: The hotel is 5 minutes walk from Hualien Train Station. The clean and delicate guest rooms all come with a view, and guests can fully enjoy the sceneries of Hualien. The hotel offers various rooms, a free parking lot with a capacity of 10 tour buses and 30 compact cars, entertainment center, KTV, conference room for business and outdoor area for event holding. The western restaurant and Chinese restaurant are newly refurbished and provides modern and comfortable dining atmosphere. The restaurants use fresh local foodstuffs and provide Chinese set course and buffet for you to choose. We welcome you to visit us and enjoy the gourmet in Charming City Hotel Hualien!

stays.name: 葛洛莉亞的城堡
stays.description: Gloria House 葛洛莉亞的城堡是Tom國王和Mira皇后及小公主Gloria 和拉拉犬ㄋㄟ ㄋㄟ的小小城堡!! 我們沒有富麗豪華的外衣，但是擁有誠懇、熱情的心~提供您一個乾淨、安全、溫馨、舒適,有別於一般飯店旅館，有家的感覺的住宿環境~ 葛洛莉亞的城堡 距離火車站 300公尺，交通方便!!是您出差、旅遊、休閒之餘,落腳休息的好選擇~您有多久沒到戶外走走、呼吸一下新鮮的空氣、品嚐道地的地方小吃了呢? 誠摯的歡迎您攜家帶眷、呼朋引伴一起到花蓮來體驗、親澤花蓮的好山、好水、好人情味!!
stays.descriptionEn: Gloria House is a little castle of King Tom, Queen Mira, Princess Gloria, and Labrador Retriever Neinei. This house doesn& #39;t have fabulous, luxury outwear, but does have the sincere enthusiasm to provide you with a clean, safe, warm, comfortable, and homely accommodation that set us apart from general hotels. Gloria House is 300 meters from train station. With this convenient transportation, it is very good choice for your business travel, tour, or leisure stay. Step away from the man cave. It& #39;s time for an adventure, walking outdoor, breathing fresh air, enjoying authentic local cuisines. We sincerely welcome you bringing your whole family, or your friends together to experience personally the beautiful landscape and the milk of people of Hualien.

stays.description: 藍天麗池飯店位於花蓮正市中心，對面即有24小時速食店與便利商店，許多知名小吃也都在附近，距離東大門夜市步行10分鐘，距離車站車程6分鐘，周遭機能相當便利，位處商圈周邊，鬧中取靜，並提供多種不同房型供旅人選擇。 藍天麗池飯店為東台灣第一間全蔬食飯店，提供無肉、無海鮮的蔬食料理，優先選用在地食材，以美味與創新顛覆人們對蔬食的既有想像，無論是蔬食愛好者還是首次接觸蔬食的人，都能在藍天麗池飯店找到滿足味蕾與心靈的幸福滋味。為響應環保，藍天麗池飯店不提供一次性備品(包含牙膏、牙刷、梳子、拖鞋、刮鬍刀、浴帽、香皂、棉花棒、牙線棒)，客房僅提供壁掛式瓶裝洗沐產品與毛巾。建議可自行攜帶備品，若仍有需求可至櫃檯選購，其備品銷售金額將部分捐贈公益團體，讓我們透過自身的力量以實際行動關心與實現環保永續，換取未來更美好的生活環境。

stays.name: 衝浪海豚民宿
stays.description: 我們在花蓮 這是一個開始 來到這裡 可以走入享譽國際的太魯閣 用慢跑42KM的步伐前進 或者騎著單車迎風擁抱妳可以划著Kayak海洋獨木舟從太平洋的水平面仰望清水之美 跨越那道孕育生命的黑潮 與鯨魚海豚對話 走訪溪澗 溯流而上尋找那傳說中的黃金峽谷 華燈初上 離開繁鬧市區 跟著點點螢光 回憶兒時記趣 夜晚靜默 我們可以很熱血 穿越中橫到武嶺張開雙臂 仰望無垠的星空 晨曦初照 頂著衝浪板 打開氣象收音機 Jack Johnson 傑克·強森 陪你一起跳入海中catch wave 甚至 妳可以甚麼都不做 做一個叛逆的都市小孩 與SEVEN INN來場邂逅般的小戀愛 。
stays.descriptionEn: We are in Hualien. This is a beginning, one may enter the internationally famous Taroko Gorge when visiting here, and embrace the wind through jogging 42Km or riding a bicycle; you may row a kayak to admire the beauty of the crystal clear water from the surface of the Pacific Ocean; have conversation with whales and dolphins by crossing over the black tide that cultivates life; visit the stream by going upwards to search for the legendary Golden Valley. When the evening lights are lit, get away from the bustling city and follow the dots of lights to reminisce the childhood fun. In the silence of the night, we can go passionately across the Central Cross-Island Highway to arrive at Wuling, open arms wide to look up at the endless starry sky; when the first ray of morning sun shines, grab your surfboard and switch on the weather radio, where Jack Johnson accompanies you to dive in the sea to catch the waves. stays.descriptionEn: Homestay located in Hualien Nottingham Ocean Castle Bed and Breakfast is full of British elegance and is located in the first row of the sea view in Hualien City. With the most excellent ocean view, gorgeous decoration and furnishings, as well as top-quality bedding and amenities, it will create the best accommodation for your vacation in Hualien.Nottingham Ocean Castle B&B has an elegant shape, and its bright yellow exterior complements the blue sea. The six-story villa has an unobstructed view, allowing you to watch the sunrise comfortably while lying in bed.The B&B is right opposite the Pacific Park. You can stroll along the beach at dawn and dusk or sit on the exclusive sea view balcony and enjoy the cool breeze from the Pacific Ocean. This is daily life at Nottingham Ocean Castle.You are welcome to visit Nottingham and experience our care and consideration.

stays.name: 象東青旅民宿
stays.description: Dumbo Hostel象東青旅“Dumbo”是什麼？讓我們來解釋一下象青旅舍所珍視的價值觀。每一位造訪象東的旅客都被視為客人和家人。“作為客人來，作為朋友離開”是我們的口號。我們保證通過令人滿意的友好服務，讓所有來象東的客人擁有一段難忘的旅程。在這裡，你可以輕鬆結識新朋友，還可以交流文化和旅行小貼士！我們經常舉辦活動，為您提供與彼此聯繫的好機會，當然也包括我們！我們的所有員工都非常友善，隨時樂意幫助您，使您的旅程更加精彩！象東旅舍是一家溫馨、乾淨且價格實惠的住宿，距離花蓮火車站僅需三分鐘步行路程。無論您在花蓮停留多久，我們都是理想的住宿選擇。為提醒您一些住宿注意事項，您需要自備牙膏、牙刷和浴巾；僅可在一樓大廳內飲食，廚房和冰箱可供使用。客房樓層禁止攜帶食物和飲料；晚上10點後，請降低聲音，不要打擾其他客人休息。建築物內禁止吸煙。我們希望能夠一起維持住宿的品質。此外，我們還提供免費無線網絡、安全儲物櫃、閱讀燈、公共廚房、洗衣設施等豐富設施！每天早上8:00至10:00，我們還提供美味的早餐，讓您開始美好的一天。象東旅舍提倡綠色和有意識的生活方式，鼓勵分享和日常生活中的慎重選擇，旨在追求更可持續的世界。在預訂前請閱讀我們的條款和條件，以免有任何意外！我們提供的免費服務包括：*WiFi *空調 *沐浴露、洗髮水、吹風機 *廚房設施（飲用水、微波爐和電磁爐）*免費咖啡/茶包 *免費早餐我們提供的收費服務包括：*毛巾租借（NT$30）*大毛巾（NT$50）*牙刷套裝（NT$10）和投幣式洗衣機。期待在美麗的花蓮見到您
stays.descriptionEn: Dumbo Hostel is a cozy, affordable spot just 3 mins from Hualien Station! Enjoy free Wi-Fi, lockers, and breakfast. We provide kitchen access, laundry services, and privacy with functional beds. Please bring your own toothpaste, toothbrush, and towel, or rent from us. No food/drinks on guest floors, and keep quiet after 10 PM. Come enjoy green living, a comfy stay, and no curfew!❤️ Reception business hour: 15:00 ~ 22:00 ❤️ Check in time : 15:00 ~ 22:00 ❤️ Check out time : ~ 11:00front gate, backyard, and lobbyDumbo HostelWhat's a 'DUMBO' ? Let us explain the value Dumbo Guesthouse cherish. Every person visiting DUMBO is considered as a Guest and a Family. “Come as a guest. Leave as a friend” is our catch phrase. We guarantee a trip that you will never forget through our satisfying friendly service to all the guests visiting DUMBO. It’s easy to make new friends here, also you can exchange cultures and tips for trip! We do hold parties and give you great chances to be connected each other, including us! All we are so friendly and always happy to help you to make your trip greater! Dumbo Hostel is a homely, clean, affordable accommodation located just a three minutes’ walk from Hualien Railway Station. We are the perfect hostel to accommodate you during your stay in Hualien.To remind you of some accommodation notices, you need to prepare your own toothpaste, toothbrush and bath towel; you can eat and drink ONLY in the lobby on the first floor, and the kitchen and the refrigerator can be used. Food and beverages are NOT allowed on the guest floor; after 10 PM in the evening, please keep your voice down, do not disturb the rest of other guests. No smoking inside the building. We wish we can maintain the quality of accommodation together.Additionally, we provide complimentary amenities such as free Wi-Fi, secure lockers, reading lights, a guest kitchen, laundry facilities, and much more! Start your day with a delicious breakfast offered every morning 8:00 to 10:00AM. Dumbo promotes green and conscious living by encouraging sharing and mindful choices in daily life, aiming for a more sustainable world. Please read our T&Cs below before booking, so there are no surprises! What we provide is FREE: *Internet access. *AC. shower gel, shampoo, hair dryer *Kitchen (drinking water, microwave, and induction stove) Free coffee/tea bags /Free Breakfast What we provide is CHARGE: * Towel rental (NT$30) *big towel(NT $50) *toothbrush set(NT$10) and coin laundry machine.See you in beautiful Hualien.===Best Choice For Your Stay In Hualien===*3 mins walk from Hualien Railway Station Exit “West”. *No Curfew!! *Free Wi-Fi *Shower rooms and Living room are available. *Fully equipped kitchen. *Laundry service with free detergent. *Functional beds with reading light, outlet for power, sub cushion and curtain/slide door keeps your privacy. ==== BUSINESS HOURS ==== * Reception business hour: 08:00 ~ 10:00 15:00 ~ 22:00 * Check in time : 15:00 ~ 22:00 * Check out time : ~ 11:00 + If you need an arrangements for late check-in, please inform us in advance via e-mail. ==== LOCATION ==== *3 mins walk from Hualien Railway Station Exit West. We are located in the heart of Hualien. (for sightseeing, eating, shopping, and everything!)

stays.description: 鍾愛義大利的民宿主人住在好山、好水、好空氣的花蓮， 在花蓮市區將100餘坪的土地別墅整理為民宿並取名為Bellalia貝拉利亞(義大利文美麗的空氣)。寧靜優雅的歐式鄉村風格別墅內有花園、停車位，位於鬧中取靜的美崙文教區，旁有公園、7-11便利商店、文化中心、港口景觀橋、高爾夫球場以及雙教堂。不管是市區逛街、花蓮港賞鯨或七星潭踏浪都只需要五分鐘左右的車程。結婚包棟、親子出遊或約會度假，貝拉利亞歐市民宿貼心的服務絕對是您旅行花蓮的最佳選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: The host loves Italy and lives in Hualien, a prosperous land of natural wonders. He turned his 350 sqm villa and land into a hostel and named it Bellaria ("pleasing air" in Italian). This quiet, elegant European rural villa is designed with garden and parking spaces. It sits at Meilun Cultural and Educational Area, with easy access to park, 7-11 convenience store, culture center, port scenic bridge, golf course, and two churches. It takes about 5 minutes of driving to shop in downtown, go for whale-watching from Hualien Port, or take a walk at Qixingtan Bay. European bed and breakfast "Bellalia" is your best accommodation partner in Hualien!

stays.name: 路境行旅－花蓮文化館
stays.description: 放下成長的包袱，一起展開奇幻旅程還記得，小時候的夢想嗎？現在聽來可能有點傻氣、有點天真、有點荒謬、有點可愛。上一次很偶爾很偶爾，從記憶裡取出擦亮的時刻，是什麼時候了呢？歡迎來到現實之外的祕密空間，作夢的應許之地，隱匿的夢想鄉。在這裡，沒有時鐘的滴答聲，停留在最想留住的一瞬。城市與花蓮、現狀與最初，路境行旅花蓮文化館是一座精神的永無島，等待每一個卸下繁瑣、起飛的你。
stays.descriptionEn: Set down the burdens of growing up, and embark on a magical journey together.Do you still remember your childhood dreams? They might seem a little silly, a little naïve, a little absurd, yet undeniably cute now.When was the last time you gently dusted off a moment from those memories?Welcome to a secret space beyond reality, a promised land for dreamers, a hidden utopia for your dreams.Here, the ticking of the clock fades away, leaving only the moment you most wish to hold on to.In this place, between the city and Hualien, between the present and the beginning, Roaders Hualien Cultural Center is an island of spirit that waits for you—each one who sheds the weight of the mundane and soars.

stays.name: 輕井澤民宿
stays.description: 你期盼的是拋開煩惱， 來一趟悠遊的旅行。我說我能給你的不僅是眼前所見，而是一種人們所期待的感受。在一個風和日麗的午後，用一種怡然自得的心境看這世界，你會發現，處處都被幸福所包圍。大口的呼吸空氣芬芳，在陽光的照耀下擁抱大地。一趟旅程迷人、浪漫，不再只是奢求；用輕井澤的完美來詮譯這趟旅行的心情是再適合不過的。不需遠渡至日本才能品味休閒，不需詞藻形容才能體會的美，只需來趟花蓮便能感受讚嘆，用品味格調，融合視覺及觸覺的頂級享受， 就等您親自體驗！
stays.descriptionEn: You anticipate casting aside all worries, come and have a leisurable journey. I say that I can offer you more than what can be seen, which is rather a feeling anticipated by people. Look at this world with a contented state of mind on a sunny afternoon, and you will discover that happiness is everywhere. Take a deep breath of the fragrant air; embrace the earth under the sunshine. A charming and romantic journey is no longer a luxury; it is the most appropriate to interpret the mood for this journey using the perfection of Qing Jing Ze. There is no need to go all the way to Japan in order to experience leisure, it is the beauty that does not need verbal deions in order to understand, as you will sense the astonishment simply through a visit to Hualien; the premium visual and sensual enjoyment fused using a high-end style is waiting for you to experience!

stays.name: 重飛/Go Around民宿
stays.description: 「重飛」是軍中飛行術語，英譯為”Go Around”，原譯指飛行員因某種因素不降落，呼叫聯絡塔台 Go Around，重新配置馬力，完成所需要的飛行姿態。民宿主人是陸航服役24年飛行教官，「 重飛/ Go Around 」寓意民宿主人自退役後，「重」新整裝再出發，再次「飛」向新視野，新挑戰，拒絕降落退休的選擇。Go Around同時也代表「四處走走」的含義，歡迎您到花蓮好山好水的觀光城市，享受漫遊花蓮的風景及人文。讓重飛/ Go Around民宿主人，為您解說花蓮故鄉的美。

stays.description: 我是訓易，花蓮在地長大的青年，為了成就最平凡的幸福，想有更多時間陪伴摯愛的媽媽，屆滿32歲生日前，轉換跑道踏入民宿服務業。【開心民宿】，是花蓮市中心合法優質民宿，寬敞‧舒適‧簡約‧大方，每個房間皆有窗戶設置與獨立HCG乾溼分離衛浴，誠摯歡迎您的蒞臨。開心民宿座落於花蓮市中心，交通非常便利，離車站與花蓮各特殊美食景點包括：炸彈蔥油餅、時光書店、自強夜市、遠東百貨、慈濟園區、賀川壽司、公正包子、廟口紅茶、南濱夜市、松園別館、七星潭……等僅需3~10分鐘車程。民宿的地點非常顯眼易尋(花蓮農校對面)，更難得能在花蓮市區眺望校園的樹海美景。
stays.descriptionEn: My names is Xunyi, and I was raised here in Hualien. In order to realize a simple dream and have more time to spend with my beloved mother, I decided, before the age of 32, to switch professions and enter the bed and breakfast business. The grand opening of Happy Hostel was held in 2012; now it is a legally-certified establishment in downtown Hualien, featuring a spacious area, comfortable atmosphere, and simple, tasteful style. Rooms come with windows and stand-alone HCG separate wet/dry area bathrooms. Welcome to Happy Hostel! Happy Hostel is located in the city center with convenient transportation, close to the train station and a variety of local delicacy attractions, including exploding onion pancake with egg, Time Book House, Ziqiang Night Market, Far Eastern Department Store, Tzu Chi Campus, Kagawa Sushi House, Gongzheng Street Buns, Miaokou Black Tea, Nanbin Night Market, Pine Garden, and Qixingtan, all a 3-10 minute drive away. Our building is very easy to find (next door to Settour and across the street from Hualien Vocational High School of Agriculture, a rare place in the city with views of the school campus, trees, and ocean.

stays.name: 阿思瑪麗景大飯店
stays.description: 阿思瑪 麗景大飯店定位走向以” 城市渡假飯店” (CITY RESORT) 為設計主軸，提供給所有旅客最舒適、最便利的住宿空間與設備。全館設計風格以新古典歐風鋪陳，寬敞的大廳搭配華麗的水晶燈飾，溫暖又明亮的燈光效果，我們期待每一位前來的旅客都能享有貴族般的服務與享受。飯店共有客房 126 間，各類房型兼具滿足各類型旅客之需求，客房內從燈光的投影到精心設計的家具，呈現在所有旅客面前的，將是另一種不同的氛圍與視覺感動，高樓層的客房擁有絕佳的美景視野，西邊遠眺中央山脈，東邊親近太平洋海岸，一年四季的自然景觀盡收眼簾，體驗不同於以往城市飯店的地理景觀。
stays.descriptionEn: The Arsma Hotel is a landmark urban resort that provides elegant and convenient accommodations and services. The hotel is proud of its neo-classic ornaments and a spacious lobby with a gorgeous chandelier that beautifully lit the entire place. We are confident that our elite customers will savor luxurious and attentive services when experiencing Arsma with us.Our hotel has 126 well-appointed guest rooms that provide the utmost comfort to the satisfaction of our distinguished guests. With stylish lighting and exquisite furniture, the rooms are all characterized by uniquely splendid ambience that carries you away. Upper-level rooms feature marvelous views from the Central Mountains in the West, to the Pacific Ocean in the East. You will have the opportunity to indulge yourself in the magnificence of natural beauty just by staying in your room. We hope to make and share memories with you while your stay at Arsma.

stays.description: 花蓮力麗華美達安可酒店為溫德姆酒店集團在台灣的第一家酒店。對於人文休憩觀念的新訴求，亦或在飯店的服務設施上，皆擷取商旅及休閒會館經營之服務精華，以其細膩精緻、客製化為服務導向，結合週邊景點，在地活動之旅，「立足東海岸、望眼全台灣 」，再開啟東部另一頁新休憩旅遊史！花蓮力麗華美達安可酒店位於市中心林森路上，地理環境絕佳，距離花蓮航空站、臺鐵花蓮車站約十多分鐘車程，交通十足便利，方便貴賓前往各個著名旅遊景點遊玩賞心。飯店擁有地上8層地下2層的建築規模，館內設計名師打造之各型客房，皆適用於商務洽公及闔家旅遊之貴賓，館內設施新穎多元，十分適合身心靈欲放鬆之旅遊貴賓及洽公開會人士！本館經星級旅館評鑑為「三星級」旅館
stays.descriptionEn: Presented to you as a new Ramada Encore By Wyndham Hualien, not only has the advantages of national hotels under out group, an architectural scope of eight floors and two underground levels, it is also the initial step taken by our group toward operation of large scale resort hotels.Ramada Encore By Wyndham Hualien is located on Linsen Road, Hualien downtown. It has excellent geography advantage that only takes you 15 minutes to and from the airport or the train station. The traffic transportation is convenient. Whether it is about the new appeal of humane recreational concept or the hotel service facilities, we extract the essence of business travel and recreational tour that combine with the surrounding attractions. Our service focuses on fine, exquisite, customized local tour

Elegant House Homestay welcomes you in Hualien.

stays.name: 香氛居家
stays.description: 一進入香氛居家馬上就聞到撲鼻的香氣，原來身為芳療師的女主人，喜歡用香氣迎接每一位客人。室內的佈置擺設是南法鄉村風，感覺舒服又溫馨。設計都是民宿一家人所完成，因曾居住於國外所以特別重視佈置與氣氛營造。香氛居家每一個房間都經過精心的設計，有的有獨立的歐式小花園，有的可以看到美麗的山景也有適合親子出遊入住的家庭房。香氛居家很重視每天的早餐，有機現做的早餐配上多種水果與飲料的選擇，絕對是一天最棒的開始。
stays.descriptionEn: Fun House is run by a hospitable family who have opened up their house to guests from all over the word, they love decorating and making friends. The rooms are comfortable and cozy with great view of the mountains. Every morning, organic healthy breakfast is served with love, guest always look forward to the meal. There is also a SPA in Fun House so that guest can totally enjoy and relax during the stay, please book in advance. There& #39;s so much love poured into Fun House, you won& #39;t want to leave. Fun House is located in a quiet high-class neighborhood with a short walk to shops and amenities, it is also a short 5-10min drive from Hualien train station.

stays.description: 花蓮的麗格休閒飯店，矗立在花蓮市市中心（商校街），火車站、商務金融中心皆可步行到達。五星級的裝潢，超大空間加上溫馨、悠閒的環境，在當地建立非常好的口碑。曾經為花蓮和平電廠高級工程師慎選為最好的長期住宿飯店，就是因為這裡的採光、空氣、結構安全度、舒適…等，讓這些來自英、法、美、德的工程師們有如回到“甜蜜歸屬的家”。麗格休閒飯店以“御飯糰”的心來接待每一位到訪的旅客，口碑好、設備佳、價錢平價，五星級的獨立SPA衛浴、ADSL寬頻無限上網、自助咖啡吧、KTV、空中花園…等，如果有空到花蓮走走，麗格休閒飯店會是您甜蜜歸屬的家喔！館內規劃有125間豪華套房，提供多樣化作息空間與無微不至的服務，讓您感受 舒適自在。來到麗格就像回到家。 您可以在繁忙緊張的都市中得享一個安寧、隱密、具地中海風情的生活空間。
stays.descriptionEn: Designed for both business and leisure travel, Liga Hotel is ideally situated in Hualien, one of the city's most popular locales. From here, guests can enjoy easy access to all that the lively city has to offer. A haven of rest and relaxation, the hotel will offer total renewal just steps away from the city's numerous attractions such as Hualien Train Station, Meiluen Shan Nature Park, and Pine Garden.The facilities and services provided by ensure a pleasant stay for guests. The hotel provides 24-hour room service, a family room, casino, safety deposit boxes, and a business center to ensure guests the greatest comfort. Experience high quality room facilities, including internet access, air conditioning, a refrigerator, and an LCD/plasma screen television, to help you recharge after a long day. The hotel's garden is ideal relax and unwind in after a busy day. Superb facilities and an excellent location make the Liga Hotel the perfect base from which to enjoy your stay in Hualien.

stays.name: 麗軒國際飯店
stays.description: 花蓮麗軒國際飯店位於花蓮市最幽靜風景最優美的至高點美侖區中美路上，距離花蓮機場車程只要10分鐘，松園別館與賞鯨碼頭緊鄰在側，火車站 、市區、七星潭風景區、慈濟園區、台九線也只要10分鐘車程，交通之便讓您節省許多寶貴時間。美侖地區亦為花蓮縣行政文教之所在地,實為您洽公開會選擇住宿之處。走進花蓮麗軒國際飯店您可享受到依山面海的自然美景，高樓層的客房透過景觀窗太平洋美麗海景一覽無遺,遠眺海岸山脈的秀麗景色,身處於天然景色的環繞之中,有助於您紓解身心的疲憊，全館採高度設計空間讓您身處其中毫無壓迫感。建築物外觀設計簡潔典雅有如豪宅般的磅礡氣勢，是位居花蓮都市當中最具有古典優雅的現代風格建築。除了提供您優雅舒適的用餐地點之外,麗軒國際飯店為滿足商務人士的需求,於一樓大廳備有商務中心,地下室一樓的會議廳，適合30-80人的會議場所，專業的會議器材明亮的燈光設計提供給您腦力激盪知識前進的絕佳場所，麗悅KTV備有音效絕佳的點唱系統適合小型團體聚會，此外”麗軒健康運動中心”備有專業健身器材,讓您在出差及旅遊的同時也能兼顧到保持運動的良好習慣。 為了將飯店與在地藝術文化做結合,麗軒國際飯店提供了全館的空間,與本地大學藝術系的學生一同妝點飯店內部留白的空間,館內所有的油畫皆為學生的創作,獨到且別緻,在這裡您放眼望去看到的畫作皆是獨一無二的真跡,樸實且優雅。展出之餘也希望能獲得中外旅客青睞,將在地文創作品也能推廣至國際上。
stays.descriptionEn: Lishiuan Hotel is the perfect choice. The excitement of the city center is only 2.3 Km away. A haven of rest and relaxation, the hotel will offer total renewal just steps away from the city's numerous attractions such as Hualien County Stone Sculpture Museum, Meiluen Shan Nature Park, Meilunxi Riverside Park.Take advantage of a wealth of unrivaled services and amenities at this Hualien hotel. A selection of top-class facilities such as free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, 24-hour room service, facilities for disabled guests, luggage storage can be enjoyed at the hotel. Hotel accommodations have been carefully appointed to the highest degree of comfort and convenience. In some of the rooms, guests can find locker, wooden/parqueted flooring, slippers, complimentary instant coffee, separate living room. Throughout the day you can enjoy the relaxing atmosphere of the fitness center, golf course (within 3 km), spa, garden, karaoke. stays.searchText: 麗軒國際飯店 麗軒國際飯店有限公司花蓮分公司 花蓮縣旅館124號 花蓮縣 花蓮市 民勤里15鄰中美路99之1號 花蓮麗軒國際飯店位於花蓮市最幽靜風景最優美的至高點美侖區中美路上，距離花蓮機場車程只要10分鐘，松園別館與賞鯨碼頭緊鄰在側，火車站 、市區、七星潭風景區、慈濟園區、台九線也只要10分鐘車程，交通之便讓您節省許多寶貴時間。美侖地區亦為花蓮縣行政文教之所在地,實為您洽公開會選擇住宿之處。走進花蓮麗軒國際飯店您可享受到依山面海的自然美景，高樓層的客房透過景觀窗太平洋美麗海景一覽無遺,遠眺海岸山脈的秀麗景色,身處於天然景色的環繞之中,有助於您紓解身心的疲憊，全館採高度設計空間讓您身處其中毫無壓迫感。建築物外觀設計簡潔典雅有如豪宅般的磅礡氣勢，是位居花蓮都市當中最具有古典優雅的現代風格建築。除了提供您優雅舒適的用餐地點之外,麗軒國際飯店為滿足商務人士的需求,於一樓大廳備有商務中心,地下室一樓的會議廳，適合30-80人的會議場所，專業的會議器材明亮的燈光設計提供給您腦力激盪知識前進的絕佳場所，麗悅KTV備有音效絕佳的點唱系統適合小型團體聚會，此外”麗軒健康運動中心”備有專業健身器材,讓您在出差及旅遊的同時也能兼顧到保持運動的良好習慣。 為了將飯店與在地藝術文化做結合,麗軒國際飯店提供了全館的空間,與本地大學藝術系的學生一同妝點飯店內部留白的空間,館內所有的油畫皆為學生的創作,獨到且別緻,在這裡您放眼望去看到的畫作皆是獨一無二的真跡,樸實且優雅。展出之餘也希望能獲得中外旅客青睞,將在地文創作品也能推廣至國際上。

stays.description: 齊愔居民宿：用色彩迎接每一位旅人距離花蓮火車站僅約1公里，齊愔居民宿位於鬧中取靜的市區巷弄中，交通便利，生活機能完善，是旅人探索花蓮的絕佳落腳點。獨棟電梯建築，貼心設計減輕行李負擔，讓入住更輕鬆。雖無過度包裝的奢華服務，卻以用心的細節與繽紛明亮的空間設計，帶來純粹的居住體驗。每一間客房都擁有獨特主題配色，從自然清新的綠與藍，到充滿活力的橘與紫，搭配幾何圖形與簡潔線條，營造出現代、年輕又溫馨的住宿氛圍。乾淨衛浴、充足採光、寬敞舒適的床鋪，讓每位旅人都能在此放鬆、沉澱、補充能量。齊愔居，是為了追求高性價比、乾淨舒適、設計感與自在氛圍的旅人而存在。
stays.descriptionEn: Located just about 1 kilometer from Hualien Train Station, KeyInn Space sits quietly in a lively yet peaceful alley of the city. With convenient transportation and excellent amenities, it’s the perfect base for travelers exploring Hualien.This standalone building with an elevator is thoughtfully designed to ease the burden of carrying luggage, making check-in a breeze. While it may not offer luxurious, over-the-top services, it delivers a sincere and pure stay through attention to detail and bright, cheerful interior design.Each room features a unique color theme—from refreshing greens and blues inspired by nature, to vibrant oranges and purples full of energy. Paired with geometric patterns and clean lines, the atmosphere is modern, youthful, and warm. Clean bathrooms, ample natural light, and spacious, comfortable beds ensure that every guest can unwind, recharge, and feel at home.KeyInn Space is made for travelers seeking great value, cleanliness, design, and a relaxed ambiance.

stays.name: 天地海民宿
stays.description: 七年多前，兩位熱愛旅行的音樂家，在台灣東海岸的中點找到一塊荒廢許久的地，就在這塊易主多人毫不起眼的荒地，築起退隱山林的夢想。不只熱愛音樂，他們也深愛建築設計，博覽相關書籍與建築設計的節目影片，花了三年的時間跟優秀的趙建築師溝通，兩年多的時間與很有才華的李設計師研究，從遼闊的太平洋尋找蓋房子的靈感。這個房子很有趣，將一般方正的房子，橫拉開來變成一道「牆」，就變成現在這個七個方塊「DO-RE-MI-FA-SOL-LA-SI」七聲音階階梯狀的長屋。空間設計採主客分離，主客互有私密空間，又可以在正中間的大廳交集聯誼。每個房間都可以看海，都可以保有極不錯的私密領域，都有能耐強颱的五加五膠合強化玻璃隔音氣密窗，都可以敞開門窗與大海與海岸山脈直接接觸，建築師以堅固耐震的結構加強建築物本體，加上堅固高貴的大門，讓您安心放心享受東海岸的海景、星空、海風與山風。
stays.descriptionEn: "Two travel lovers and musicians found and acquired a piece of uncared land in the middle of Eastern Taiwan seven years ago to make their dream of peaceful life. Besides music, they also have a passion for architecture. With fundamentals from related publications and shows, three years of discussion with engineer Mr. Chao, and two years of planning with gifted designer Mr. Li, they built up their dream with the idea taken from Pacific. The house is playful with the long wall resembling seven paino keys from do-re-mi to fa-so-la-si. The guests have their independent space, while they can make friends in the lobby. Each room provides sea view, secures privacy, and is equipped with sound-proof, air-right laminated glass window to provide unobscured view of sea and the Coastal Mountain Range. With its earthquake-resistant structure and stylish yet durable doors, you can feel at ease when enjoying the sea view, starry sky and wind."

stays.name: 海岸行館民宿
stays.description: 「NOOSA」是我們曾經去過的澳大利亞最美麗的海灘之一。當我們參觀花蓮的磯崎海灘時，發現這裡有著自然的環境和廣闊的海景，我們開始想像建造一個像NOOSA海灘一樣令人驚嘆的地方。我們給自己取名為NOOSA海岸行館民宿。這裡地理位置優越，坐落在山邊，面朝太陽升起的地方是——遼闊美麗的太平洋。步行1分鐘即可到達私人海灘，海灘上覆蓋著柔軟的沙子和小卵石．我們歡迎廣大遊客在東海岸享受海風與美麗的海景。室內設計以loft風格為主，每間房型均為豪華海濱套房。每個房間面積在40-50平方米左右，大片的落地窗面向大海，在這裡，躺在床上就可以看到日出。
stays.descriptionEn: Noosa is one of the most beautiful beach in Australia which we used to visit. When we visit jiqi beach in Hualien which present natural environment and vast ocean view. We start to imagine to build an amazing place which just like Noosa beach. We named our self is Noosa coast B&B which is privileged being situated by a mountain and facing where the sun rises-the Pacific Ocean.Walking 1 minute to private beach and the beach's covered with soft sands and small pebbles. Welcomes our visitors to enjoy ocean breeze and great ocean view in East Coast.Interior design is based on loft style and each guest room type is deluxe oceanfront suite. Every room size is around 40-50 square metersand windows facing the ocean. You can just watch the sun-rise lying in bed.

stays.name: 石梯灣118民宿
stays.description: 石梯灣118，佇立在港口部落的滄海桑田，遺世靜定這間充滿謎樣的部屋，由藝術家主人與新銳建築師陳冠華共同打造設計概念始於「簡單生活」，傳達少即是多，空即是滿的哲學拋棄過多的修飾與包裝，真正回歸一個房子的本質與原貌堅持與所在地景自然融合，把主角全留給大自然的流動。如果房子像人，石梯灣118很像一個孤獨堅毅的男子漢桀傲不馴的橫向線條，粗獷原始的模板牆面，豪邁景色的大塊露出風雨、歲月洗鍊出那深沉的灰，默默以生命實踐，它所相信的意義讓旅人能夠真正安靜下來，感受一種簡樸無華的旅行方式重新發掘自我，重新看見世界，重新體會生命。

stays.name: 石梯緣民宿
stays.description: 「石梯緣」民宿位於花東海岸線上的石梯坪遊憩區， 是一棟三層樓高的灰色洗石子建築，面向太平洋，背對 海岸山脈，無論四季晨昏，乘船賞鯨，海邊散步沈思，皆有不同感受。晴空萬里時，海邊的陽光耀眼 眩目，將海水的藍裝點的更加迷人；陰雲籠罩時，山海 狀闊，宛如山水國畫，潑墨揮灑。庭園種植海岸特有植物，與石梯坪遊憩區相連， 清晨或午後可漫步於石梯岩岸，賞玩海蝕地形及珊瑚礁 ，或登上單面山看漁人海釣，或至石梯漁港觀看漁人叫賣。本民宿一樓設有光復糖廠冰品及冷飲、食品販售；二樓為咖啡廳，提供咖啡、果汁、花茶等飲品，並備有國台語經典老歌唱片，三樓為客房，提供旅客留宿。歡迎來石梯緣 ~ 隨緣自在 ~。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Shitiping Recreation Area in the East Coast Scenic Area, Sea Fan Bed and Breakfast is a 3-story grey washed-pebble building backed against the Coastal Mountain Range and facing the Pacific Ocean, providing a variety of experiences including mornings and evenings throughout the seasons, whale-watching, and quiet contemplation during walks along the beach. On clear days, the bright and dazzling sunlight of the beach makes the blue decoration of the sea even more charming, while cloudy days bring the sea and mountains a more majestic atmosphere, resembling a masteful Chinese scenic painting. The courtyard is filled with special coastal plants and borders the Shitiping Recreation Area. Visitors can take a morning or afternoon stroll along Shiti Coast, observing the coastal erosion and coral reef, watching fishermen from the one-sided mountain, or watching them sell their goods at Shiti Harbor. The first floor offers Hualien Sugar Factory ice cream and treats, as well as food and drinks. The second floor has a coffee shop, providing coffee, juice, and flower tea, as well as classic Mandarin and Taiwanese albums. Rooms are on the third floor, providing accommodation. Welcome to Shiti Yuan - release your worries and follow your destiny.

stays.name: 緩慢石梯坪民宿
stays.description: 花蓮｜ 緩慢・石梯坪．悠緩舒適的山海慢旅行沿著台11線海濱公路，風很快速，海很激昂，藍天正湛藍，但你的心卻隨著山脈的延伸越趨舒緩。自台東長濱接到花蓮豐濱，64公里處，湛藍晴空放慢了時空，轉進石梯坪海景遊憩區，來到今天的目的地——緩慢．石梯坪，以悠緩而輕快的步調，迎接專屬於你的旅行，輕盈音樂正流瀉在大廳前的草地，反射風景的大片落地窗裡也滿室愜意。。山海姿態，共好的迷人風韻越過草原走過石階，蔚藍的太平洋就近在眼前，推開大門後迎接你的是淡淡木造香氣與親切的管家們，在櫃台check-in後，於旁邊的琴房稍作休息，悠微琴聲伴著窗外海景，讓身心逐漸放鬆安定。放下行李，來到一樓大廳享用下午自助茶點，新鮮當季水果、原住民的手作點心……，最後搭著幾片香脆餅乾，啜口咖啡，坐在落地窗旁，望著怎麼也望不膩的山海風景，像浪輕拍岸上、雲霧溫柔飄散那般舒緩著靈魂。逛逛大廳裡的在地原民藝術家作品，將生根於自然的藝術帶回旅店成為旅人的另一片風景，緩慢系列企業堅持與社區共好的理念，將在地藝術與大自然以情感及旅宿串連，在山海的姿態裡獨展自我風情。貼心寵愛，七幅獨享的悠閒海景業化的管理卻不冰冷，親切專業的管家們笑容真摯，彷彿染上海面陽光般，貼心的選鑰匙與選香服務也增添了旅程裡的驚喜，每串別緻且帶有原民風味的鑰匙圈代表著不同的浪漫故事與文化，輕抹特地準備的草本香味身體乳，選一個最令你放鬆的氣味，管家將會為你把沐浴用品都換成此種香味，讓洗澡時也能尋著這香氣回到最舒適的自己。脫下鞋子，步上木頭階梯，居家舒適感也隨之展開。寬敞的交誼客廳空間，幾本雜誌、兩張木桌及偌大的沙發，倚著綿延的山海景色度過悠閒的假期，即便不用步出旅宿，也能坐擁山海、讓心享受緩慢愉悅的假期。
stays.descriptionEn: Hualian｜ Adagio ShihtipingA Slow Travel Journey Between Mountains and SeaTime seems to slow down beneath clear blue skies as you follow the Hualian-Taitung Coastal Highway (Provincial Highway 11) from Changbin township northward to Fengbin. Pulling off into the Shitiping ocean-lookout rest area, you arrive at today’s destination: Adagio Shihtiping. At a slow, relaxed pace, you set off on your exclusive journey.The enchanting elegance of mountain and seaCrossing grassy fields and ascending stone steps with the Pacific Ocean spread out right before your eyes, you push open the front doors and are greeted by the faint smell of solid wood and the smiles of your cordial hosts. Gentle piano music plays in the background as you take in the ocean vista beyond the windows and any tension you’ve brought with you slowly fades away. Laying your luggage to one side, you enter the main hall and enjoy the afternoon array of self-serve refreshments consisting of fresh seasonal fruit, handmade indigenous desserts, and fresh coffee. Sitting beside floor-to-ceiling windows and gazing at the captivating coastal vistas, your spirits feel soothed by the waves gently lapping the shore and the clouds drifting carefree through the sky.You peruse the local indigenous artwork in the main hall. With their roots in the natural world, these works of art create yet another fascinating landscape for the delight of travelers. With their insistence upon a win-win community philosophy, all Adagio Inn branches are making connections between local art and the natural environment.Enjoy pampered intimacy in any of seven private ocean-view roomsService personnel considerately help you choose the room key and the aromas best suited to your tastes, adding to the pleasure of the travel experience. Each keychain is unique, with indigenous markings that represent different romantic stories and cultural elements. Once you choose your favorite relaxing aroma from several unique herbal bath creams, the housekeeper will swap the shower products in your room for your preferred fragrance so that bath time may become a journey back to your most comfortable self.As you take off your shoes and walk up the wooden stairs, the coziness of this house reveals itself. Lounging in the spacious common room, with its assortment of magazines, two hardwood tables and roomy sofa, you can enjoy a slow-paced, cheerful mountain holiday by the seaside even without leaving the comforts of the B&B.The 330-square meter space allows each of the seven rooms to have its own special ocean view and independent open balcony. Whether you find your own comfy corner to laze around in or head out of Shitiping for a stroll, there is no need to add the stress and haste of a travel plan to your vacation. Just find your favorite spot and stay put and let the clouds and mist of the mountains drift slowly through your state of mind.Diverse breakfast dishes, slow travel with beautiful sceneryIn the brilliant morning sunlight, you stroll into the main hall to enjoy a delicious breakfast of warm congee accompanied by an array of tidy side dishes made from healthy local ingredients and served on a three-by-three square of nine small porcelain plates a la Chinese calligraphy paper and a bowl of refreshing fish soup, leaving both body and soul feeling nourished and satisfied. Before leaving, you bid farewell to the gorgeous scenery outside the floor-to-ceiling windows. Your heart suddenly softens as your body unconsciously unloads some of its usual burden. As the stress of the usual struggle for survival is cast aside, you become aware that the thing you needed to warm your heart, after all, was a date with the mountains and sea at Adagio Shihtiping.

stays.descriptionEn: The home stay is situated in Feng Lin Township which is at the northern end of the East Rift Valley, in the vicinity of the north side of Chao Feng Ranch & Resort. The European style farm, orchid style attic home stay and colorful garden cover approximately 1,100 square meters. Here, one can view the Central Mountain Range, Coastal Mountain Range, and the clouds, mountains, and water of the valley from a far. It will make you feel relaxed and happy, and allow you to leave the stress of ordinary life behind you for a while.

stays.description: 位於花蓮縣的民宿＊民宿有鄉下特有的噪音,即夜晚有可能出現蟲鳴,農夫家的狗叫,壁虎叫,牛哇等聲音,這些動物們不會聽民宿老闆指揮,有做隔音窗能降低音量, 但淺眠者一定會被影響到. ＊房間有壁虎出沒,沒有電梯 ＊續住沒有折扣 ＊室內公共空間牽繩 ＊入住時間下午”15:30後”,沒有限制多晚到 ＊退房是早上11:00前離開民宿＊不接受訪客參觀 ＊自備牙膏牙刷及室內拖鞋(視自己需求)＊附近沒有路燈,民宿沒有招牌, 離花蓮市區車程約30-40分鐘 ＊附人類早餐 ＊毛孩餐食自備＊不接受主人外出時把毛孩單獨留在民宿空間(包含房間,公共空間,草皮) ＊房間內能輕食(餅乾,飲料),但無法吃重口味食物(如泡麵,魯味,臭豆腐,炸物類)民宿有公共空間有長桌,有大吧台可以用餐

stays.searchText: 毛球公爵寵物民宿 毛球公爵寵物民宿 花蓮縣民宿2138號 花蓮縣 鳳林鎮 林榮里榮開路62號 位於花蓮縣的民宿＊民宿有鄉下特有的噪音,即夜晚有可能出現蟲鳴,農夫家的狗叫,壁虎叫,牛哇等聲音,這些動物們不會聽民宿老闆指揮,有做隔音窗能降低音量, 但淺眠者一定會被影響到. ＊房間有壁虎出沒,沒有電梯 ＊續住沒有折扣 ＊室內公共空間牽繩 ＊入住時間下午”15:30後”,沒有限制多晚到 ＊退房是早上11:00前離開民宿＊不接受訪客參觀 ＊自備牙膏牙刷及室內拖鞋(視自己需求)＊附近沒有路燈,民宿沒有招牌, 離花蓮市區車程約30-40分鐘 ＊附人類早餐 ＊毛孩餐食自備＊不接受主人外出時把毛孩單獨留在民宿空間(包含房間,公共空間,草皮) ＊房間內能輕食(餅乾,飲料),但無法吃重口味食物(如泡麵,魯味,臭豆腐,炸物類)民宿有公共空間有長桌,有大吧台可以用餐

stays.name: 江水田園民宿
stays.description: 一、簡介：體驗大自然享受鄉村生活:1.中國式鄉村建築，大自然零距離。2.可賞螢火蟲、花、鳥、蛙、溪蝦及魚。3.引領遊客體驗60年代兒時遊戲生活。二、江水民宿特色：清新翠綠的山巒點綴著古樸的建築，讓民宿更加顯現出台灣人純樸踏實的精神。只要來到這裡，就能忘卻所有煩憂，遠離平時上班的忙碌與庸擾，親近大自然就是現代人最需要的舒壓調劑，在這裡沉浸於優美風景，自然而然可以薰陶身心，放慢腳步放鬆新心情，隨意探索大自然的奧妙。走一小段路就能看到一望無際的深藍大海，看著一片片美麗的浪花打上沙灘，無論工作中有多少不愉快，無論生活中有多少不如意，面對大海盡情地吶喊吧！海的深沉將包容我們，讓你消除壓力，釋放笑容，整裝再出發！三、餐飲特色：古樸風味甕仔雞，鹽烤現炸特大台灣鯛魚，健康放山白斬雞，溫補聖品麻油雞，時令季節蔬果，有機原汁濃郁果汁，各式餐飲等……需先預約烹煮

stays.name: 隱花民宿
stays.description: 隱花民宿坐落在花蓮縣鳳林鎮美麗的花東縱谷上.主人夫婦倆年輕時久居於台北， 深圳, 上海等各大城市,逐漸厭倦大都會的五光十色. 一心嚮往田園生活。 終於在孩子們都離開身邊上大學去了之後，決定回歸自然，用心打造一棟日式環保鋼構陶板屋， 從房屋外觀設計到內部裝潢, 主人夫婦都參與其中, 處處有他們的巧思及對人生的態度. 民宿主人對民宿的定義是分享個人對生活的想法給有緣的投宿者. 實踐真正意義上的B&B (Bed & Breakfast)而不是單單住一晚的功能. 就因如此, 每一位有緣的住宿者, 都可享用到女主人環保/天然/手工 早餐. 所有食材90-%取材於當地天然食材. 就連雞蛋也是自養母雞貢獻的喔.
stays.descriptionEn: Celines B&B sits between the beautiful mountains of the famous East Rift Valley. The owner is a couple that grew tired of the dazzling and busy lifestyle in cities like Taipei, Shenzhen and Shanghai, where they spent most of their time living in, and had always pictured a serene lifestyle at a tranquil countryside far from the crowded cities. To fulfill their longed-for dream,they spent a year to build their own house in Hualien and got deeply involved in both the outer and interior design.The owner's view of B&B (Bed & Breakfast) is not a place just for sharing rooms, but a place to share interesting stories and views on life.Thus, every guest can enjoy natural, home made breakfast that uses fresh, homegrown ingredients. We even produce our own eggs!

stays.name: 雲淡風清民宿
stays.description: 2015年底全新完工獨棟歐式鄉村風格別墅、溫馨、親切就像你家的雲淡風清民宿，座落在中央山脈與海岸山脈間縱谷，距離鳳林鎮中正路的鬧區與火車站約800公尺，交通及生活機能便利，是名符其實的離塵不離城。地理位置正處花東縱谷中區偏北，南下北上各大景點如太魯閣國公園、鯉魚潭、雲山水、林田山、賞螢與花的大農大富園區、甚至瑞穗泛舟與玉里賞金針花皆適合，是定點旅遊的最佳留宿之處。在陽台或院子裡坐會兒，用美景佐茶，人聲渺然，前有潺潺水聲，後有雲霧多變的山，無聲的搬演著巨大的風景劇。我們沒有汲汲營營的商業氣息，我們有的是讓你來不及看清楚的鳥兒，總是在田野中漫步或盤旋在上空的白鷺鷥，翩翩飛舞的蝴蝶，忙忙碌碌的蜜蜂，自然農法的果菜……等等花、鳥、樹、草、鄉村生態。這裡可以朝攬晨霧、午眺雲嵐、夕攏流霞、夜賞星晨。三五好友或至愛親人齊來聽雨、觀雲、賞花、評酒、品茶、說笑、觀瀑、戲水，人生至此，夫復何求？

stays.name: 青川果舍民宿
stays.description: 沒有都市的吵雜聲，聽！！是蟲鳴、是蛙叫聲、是鳥叫聲、還有鴨鵝的聲音；你心動了嗎？那麼就馬上行動吧！果香味撲鼻而來，享受在果園裡奔跑、品嚐有機水果、回味小時候光著腳丫與泥土親近的幸福，極富懷舊的鄉村生活，優美的住宿環境與絕佳服務品質，是旅遊休憩的最佳選擇。山明水秀的青山綠野盡在眼底；騎著鐵馬在鄉間小徑穿梭悠閒無比，沿途聞著迎面撲鼻而來的芬多精，清香的味道使得精神舒暢。結合休閒農業型態的住宿環境，親身體驗採果樂、烤桶子鴨，放鬆心情與家人一起享受無拘無束的鄉村生活。夜深了，眼前呈現閃爍著熠熠光芒的小星星！不，是螢火蟲呢！看著它們跳著迎賓舞，吃著現採無毒有機的網式水果，口中喝著香濃的茶，不外乎有如人間天堂。飽足精神，迎接燦爛的明天，周邊的人文、景色等著你去探索呀！
stays.descriptionEn: Listen, the noise of the city is gone! It’s the sound of birds, frogs, insects, ducks, and geese. Are you moved? Then do something about it! As the smell of fresh fruit wafts over you, enjoy running in the orchard, taste organic fruit, and recall the happiness of playing barefoot in the mud as a child. Featuring richly nostalgic countryside living, a beautiful living environment, and outstanding service, this is your perfect choice for accommodations. Here you’re surrounded by beautiful scenic green mountains and plains, experiencing the ultimate leisure of biking the little paths of the countryside fields and breathing in the phytoncides, lifting and refreshing your spirits. Combining a recreational farm, this bed and breakfast allows guests to experience the fun of picking fruit, roasting duck, and relaxing with family to enjoy an unrestrained countryside life. After night falls, twinkling stars appear before your eyes! No, they’re fireflies! Watch them perform a welcoming dance, feast on freshly picked organic, pesticide-free fruit, and sip fragrant tea…this must be paradise. When you’re fully rested and ready, welcome the bright new day and get ready to explore the nearby culture and scenery!

stays.searchText: 青川果舍民宿 青川果舍民宿 花蓮縣民宿478號 花蓮縣 鳳林鎮 北林里平康路5號 沒有都市的吵雜聲，聽！！是蟲鳴、是蛙叫聲、是鳥叫聲、還有鴨鵝的聲音；你心動了嗎？那麼就馬上行動吧！果香味撲鼻而來，享受在果園裡奔跑、品嚐有機水果、回味小時候光著腳丫與泥土親近的幸福，極富懷舊的鄉村生活，優美的住宿環境與絕佳服務品質，是旅遊休憩的最佳選擇。山明水秀的青山綠野盡在眼底；騎著鐵馬在鄉間小徑穿梭悠閒無比，沿途聞著迎面撲鼻而來的芬多精，清香的味道使得精神舒暢。結合休閒農業型態的住宿環境，親身體驗採果樂、烤桶子鴨，放鬆心情與家人一起享受無拘無束的鄉村生活。夜深了，眼前呈現閃爍著熠熠光芒的小星星！不，是螢火蟲呢！看著它們跳著迎賓舞，吃著現採無毒有機的網式水果，口中喝著香濃的茶，不外乎有如人間天堂。飽足精神，迎接燦爛的明天，周邊的人文、景色等著你去探索呀！

stays.name: 靜園池畔民宿
stays.description: 靜園池畔民宿除了擁有廣闊的園區，最難能可貴的是一個連“視覺污染”都没有的境地。民宿的主屋是一棟百坪的綠建築，外觀的風格色調與園區景緻完美契合；內部裝潢精緻而典雅，所有的空間均出自民宿主人的精心規劃，是一個百分百以“家”為主軸的設計；是故，僅能挪出三處面積不大的房間，佈置成經典客房分享給同樣想築夢田園或體驗田園生活的客人。經營特色－是以民宿的基本精神經營民宿，所以與客人同住，是顧客最佳的在地解說員；因民宿是主人的副業，沒有業績的壓力，故每日只接待一組視為“老朋友”的客人。為讓入住的朋友能吃住舒適安心，所有環境的清潔與飲食的提供，女主人均堅持親自打理及巧心準備。園區的景觀與生態，自然而多樣化，按時節或氣候，會呈獻出不同的景相與驚豔，這是讓常客最為津津樂道之處，没有親自來幾趟，恐怕難以窺見全貌。
stays.descriptionEn: In addition to expansive grounds, Jingyuan Chipan Bed and Breakfast’s most remarkable feature is its visual pollution-free environment. The building covers 330 square meters and was designed with green features as well as a color and style that perfectly matches the grounds, while the interior decoration is exquisite and elegant, with the owner’s careful planning evident in every area. This is a 100% “home” design and therefore only includes 3 rooms of modest size, featuring classic design, to offer guests who share our countryside dream or wish to experience such a life. Features of our business – Operated based on the spirit of a bed and breakfast, with the owner living in the same building with guests and serving as their best local guides. Since this is the owner’s side business, it’s a low pressure environment that hosts no more than one party of “good friends” per day. In order to provide guests with a safe and secure eating and accommodation experience, we maintain cleanliness and offer food and drink, which the wife of the owner insists on carefully preparing and handling herself. The surrounding landscape and ecology is natural and diverse, offering new sights and surprises based on the season or climate. A favorite among old customers, this is a place that can’t be fully appreciated without seeing it in person.

stays.descriptionEn: F Hotel Sanyi stands in Sanyi Township, where the simple and natural Hakka’s customs make it a utopia-like travel destination. Located within three-minute distance of the train station and fifteen-minute distance of the Sanyi Interchange (Sun Yat-sen Freeway), F Hotel Sanyi offers convenient access not only to the well-known wood carving area, Shengxing Train Station, and Remains of Longten Bridge, but also to the symbolic Hakka Compound and Tung Blossom Festival, one of the must-go events in Taiwan. The simple Hakka town awaits you to explore its beauty…

stays.name: 向陽田園
stays.description: 來到苗栗三義的舊山線鐵道區，由勝興車站往龍騰斷橋方向，您會發現一處充滿悠閒氣息，綠意與花卉滿佈的向陽田園。是的，這正是我們為您準備的森林饗宴。 一直有個夢想，可以整理一片屬於自已的園區，保留森林、生態，並與出遊的旅人們一同分享。於是在2000年，向陽田園從整地、規劃動線、房屋建設與樹木栽種，一點一滴地打造屬於向陽的生態民宿。2002年春節，正式開始民宿之旅。 一整排的桂花林、茶花、碩大的迦苳樹與楓樹…等樹種圍繞著向陽，更為田園增添幾分綠意，當年為打造生態環境所保留的樹木，如今彷彿向陽的世外桃源。經過這麼多年，三義民宿-向陽田園仍究不斷地改變著，並加入了第二代年輕人的獨特想法，將許多手作木工、彩繪與空間設計融合，為向陽田園增添不少色彩與氛圍。 親切與熱情是我們唯一不變的堅持，並希望介紹更多三義的在地文化給所有人知道。
stays.descriptionEn: Coming into the zone of the historic Mountain Route of Railroad, Sanyi, Miaoli, at Shengxing Station look towards the direction of Longteng Broken Bridge, you will find Sun Green Holiday, a place filled with relaxed atmosphere and covered with greenery and flowers. Yes, this is exactly the forest feast we have prepared for you. We always have a dream that we can develop a park belonging to us to reserve the forests and ecological lands, and to share with the traveling people. Therefore, in 2000, we started to work on Sun Green Holiday& #39;s soil preparation, planning of lines of motion, housing construction, and planting trees, bit by bit, to create an ecological Bed & Breakfast. In the 2002 Spring Festival, the operation of the B&B was officially started. Rows of sweet-scented Osmanthus forest, camellias, huge Buddha cutters with maple trees, and other trees surround around the Sun Green Holiday, adding a bit more pastoral green to it. The retained trees to build the ecological environment in those days now seem to create a paradise for Sun Green Holiday. After so many years, Sun Green Holiday, a B&B in Sanyi, has continured changing and developing, and the young second generation has joined in with unique ideas that blending a lot of hand woodworking, painting, with spatial design, creating more colorful atmosphere to the B&B. Cordial and passionate services are our only constant adherence, and we hope to introduce a more local culture of Sanyi to everyone.

stays.name: 喆娟夢田
stays.description: 喆娟夢田距離三義交流道約20分鐘的車程，交通便利，沿途經過著小村莊，充滿著農村樸實的風情，因此開車、騎車、坐車都是一種趣味，可以沿途欣賞傳統風情的美麗。這裡青山綠野，這裡無憂無慮，從停車場走進喆娟夢田的那一扇門後，您看見的是兩道綠意盎然的植栽位於兩側歡迎您的來訪，踏著您愉快的步伐再往前走，轉個小彎，是小橋流水花園綠地，而小亭則在陽光普照時，為您留下一處賞景休憩的最佳位置，再往上走可看見喆娟夢田的美食餐廳，週邊是精心佈置的綠美化植物花朵，搭配著餐廳內的片片落地窗景，您的用餐、下午茶就是再這樣怡然自得的環境中慢慢品嘗佳肴，而戶外還有雅座供您自由選擇。喆娟夢田是位於苗栗三義的一間美食民宿，鄰近勝興車站與龍騰斷橋，高級的住宿品質，大膽的採用與五星級飯店同等級的寢具，客房內的擺設也是採用高雅又有質感的家具陳設，另外在喆娟夢田的餐廳，美麗的排盤搭配著得獎金牌的美味，絕對令您意想不到的味道。
stays.descriptionEn: Lita& #39;s Paradise is about 20 minutes by car from Sanyi Interchange, and has convenient transportation. Along the way to here, you pass through a small village full of simple rural style. Therefore, it is just a kind of fun that you can along the way to appreciate the traditional style of beauty by driving, cycling, or taking a bus. Here has verdurous mountains, and here you have freedom from care. Walking from the parking lot into the door of Lita& #39;s Paradise, you find the two green plantings located on both sides welcoming your visit. March your pleasant pace and move forward, make a turn, there lies a green garden with a bridge. The pivallion offers you a good place viewing landscape in the sunshine. Further advance, you see the gourmet restaurant of the Lita& #39;s Paradise. The gourmet restaurant is surrounded by green landscaping plants and carefully arranged flowers, and with pieces of French windows inside the restaurant, your dining and afternoon tea are set in such an environment you will feel comfortable to enjoy your cuisine, and there are lounges outdoor for you to choose. Lita& #39;s Paradise is a gourmet B&B located in Miaoli, close to Shengxing Station and Longteng Broken Bridge, featuring sophisticated accommodation quality, bedding of five-star hotel level, and in-room furnishings also uses elegant and textured furniture. In addition, the Lita& #39;s Paradise restaurant displays beautiful rows of plates with gold medal winning delicacies, which absolutely makes you enjoy unexpected flavors.

stays.searchText: 喆娟夢田 喆娟夢田 苗栗縣民宿198號 苗栗縣 三義鄉 龍騰村1鄰龍騰9-1號 喆娟夢田距離三義交流道約20分鐘的車程，交通便利，沿途經過著小村莊，充滿著農村樸實的風情，因此開車、騎車、坐車都是一種趣味，可以沿途欣賞傳統風情的美麗。這裡青山綠野，這裡無憂無慮，從停車場走進喆娟夢田的那一扇門後，您看見的是兩道綠意盎然的植栽位於兩側歡迎您的來訪，踏著您愉快的步伐再往前走，轉個小彎，是小橋流水花園綠地，而小亭則在陽光普照時，為您留下一處賞景休憩的最佳位置，再往上走可看見喆娟夢田的美食餐廳，週邊是精心佈置的綠美化植物花朵，搭配著餐廳內的片片落地窗景，您的用餐、下午茶就是再這樣怡然自得的環境中慢慢品嘗佳肴，而戶外還有雅座供您自由選擇。喆娟夢田是位於苗栗三義的一間美食民宿，鄰近勝興車站與龍騰斷橋，高級的住宿品質，大膽的採用與五星級飯店同等級的寢具，客房內的擺設也是採用高雅又有質感的家具陳設，另外在喆娟夢田的餐廳，美麗的排盤搭配著得獎金牌的美味，絕對令您意想不到的味道。

stays.name: 峯州小木屋
stays.description: 峯州的天然環境維護的非常好，春初來臨時生命悄悄的在此躍動著，就像是伸手可觸的星光般閃動著；油桐花季時.樹輕輕的將雪白純潔的花朵，由樹梢間舞動於大地之上，這樣的景象就像是天空中飄落著片片的雪花，四月雪便因此而聲名遠播。秋末，園區內卻有人因寒冷而展現出它火紅熱情的一面，似乎是要告知大家冬天已經來臨了…的夜隨著冬天的到來特別的冷，溼氣似乎也更加重了，而此刻的條件即是三義最特別的氣象條件之一，清晨時分（霧）壟罩著大地，緊接著而來的山景之中鋪滿著層層的雲海，清新的空氣伴隨著眼前的美景，真的很棒！歡迎到三叉河.十六份來撩喔!
stays.descriptionEn: The natural environment of Fong Chou Cabins is well maintained. When spring comes, lives are quietly enlivened, as palpable starry flickering. In Tung blossom season, pure and white flowers dance on the treetops above the earth; the scene is like patches of snow falling from the sky, and therefore the April Snow becomes famous. In late fall, some people in the park want to demonstrate the fiery passion side of them because of the cool weather, and it seems to announce the winter has arrived. With the arrival of the winter, it feels particularly cold and the moisture seems to become building up, and the condition at the moment is one of the most unique meteorological conditions in Sanyi. In the early morning, fogs cover the earth and the mountain view is followed by the coming of layers of clouds covering over the mountains, and the fresh air accompanies the beauty before your eyes. It is really great. Welcome to visit us.
