stays.name: 愛面子民宿
stays.description: 臉譜文化生活館前身本為一成立十餘年之木雕工作室，在民國 88 年轉型為以木雕創作教學為旨的農場，因館主林文源與彭妃玉夫婦，對京劇臉譜藝術情有獨鍾，並多年潛心研究與描繪；遂將原為木雕初學者必學的雕刻技巧，轉化為適合大眾、親子即興彩繪，簡單有趣的創作教學活動；從臉譜彩繪、相思藍衫情掛飾彩繪創作至接受訂作個人化陶土塑像和各類媒材畫像、木匾都有；以提高大家對於木雕多元藝術的興趣。 結合園區原有木雕及臉譜文化元素，便促成"愛面子民宿"由來!~這是具有濃厚在地特色之民宿，讓來訪賓客感受不同的旅遊住宿體驗!! 除此之外，山板樵農場內大量復育各類生態動植物，偌大的農場充滿田園風光；使來訪的朋友，盡情享受山野自然之美；並可嘗試騏雞蛋捲DIY下午茶，一個舒爽的下午茶時光便於焉展開 ... 山板樵休閒農場不僅提供藝術文化體驗、食農教育相關課程，還可在農場內露營、體驗農家生活、觀察生態 … 等活動，是一個擁有多元文化生活體驗感受的農場。更期待來自世界各國的好友一起來相聚!!
stays.descriptionEn: The museum started off with a humble beginning as a woodcarving workshop. Later in 1988, it functioned as a woodcarving school that mainly conducted classes for young children between ages 10 and 12. The overwhelming responses for classes inspired the establishment of the current Face Painting Cultural Museum, which combines the art of wood carving and the art of Chinese Opera face painting together. More than a thousand traditional Chinese Opera face paintings are displayed in the museum, each exquisitely designed by the owner's family of 4 during the SARS period from 1992 to 1995. The SARS crisis was a blessing in disguise that provided the family with an opportunity to transform the site into the current Face Painting Cultural Museum. The gallery of face painting art pieces not only enhances the beauty of the place, but also represents the fruits of their hard work.

stays.name: 慕哲哈比屋
stays.description: 一間貓頭鷹造型的現代建築，卻有著像歐洲古教堂一樣的大廳，充滿異國情調的哲學家套房，想與您分享不同的生活美感!這是一間充滿藝文哲學的民宿，多久沒有跟自已對話？多久沒有跟老友對談？忙碌的步調讓我們連休閒旅遊也行程滿滿。休閒一定要一攤吃過一攤嗎?旅遊一定要東趕西趕嗎?假日一定要呼朋引伴嗎?羨慕法國人可以一本書一杯咖啡消磨一個下午。如果你只有一個人--希望你來哈比屋跟自已對話。一瓶紅酒、幾片起司非常適合跟老友秉燭夜談。如果你有許久不見的老友--希望你們來哈比屋聊想法、聊哲學。一張毛毯、一片草地也可以悠閒的躺一下午。如果您是一對戀人—歡迎您來哈比屋渡過閒逸的兩人世界。這就是慕哲哈比屋的渡假哲學—“渡假的時候，無所事事就是最大的美德。
stays.descriptionEn: Maison Philo is an owl shaped modern architecture, but it has a hall similar to a hall of the old European church, an exotic philosopher suites, which we want to share with you a different aesthetic perception of life. This is a B&B full of literature and philosophy. How long did you not have a dialogue with yourself? How long did you not talk with an old friend? Hectic pace even makes a leisure tour a full busy itinerary. Is a leisure activity meant to eat one meal after another? Is a travel meant to be rushed? Must a holiday be banded together? Envy a Frenchman can while away a long afternoon with just a book and a cup of coffee. If you have only one person - I hope you come to Maison Philo to have a dialogue with yourself. A bottle of red wine, a few slices of cheese, it seems suitable enough for having night chats with old friends with candles in hand. If you have some long lost friends, we hope you come to Maison Philo to have a chat about ideas, or philosophy with them. A blanket and a lawn, we can also lay a leisurely afternoon. If you are lovers--you are welcome to spend a leisurely life of two at Maison Philo. This is Maison Philo's vacation philosophy--"during a vacation, doing nothing is the greatest virtue of all.

stays.searchText: 慕哲哈比屋 慕哲哈比屋 苗栗縣民宿172號 苗栗縣 三義鄉 廣盛村34鄰重河路324之12號 一間貓頭鷹造型的現代建築，卻有著像歐洲古教堂一樣的大廳，充滿異國情調的哲學家套房，想與您分享不同的生活美感!這是一間充滿藝文哲學的民宿，多久沒有跟自已對話？多久沒有跟老友對談？忙碌的步調讓我們連休閒旅遊也行程滿滿。休閒一定要一攤吃過一攤嗎?旅遊一定要東趕西趕嗎?假日一定要呼朋引伴嗎?羨慕法國人可以一本書一杯咖啡消磨一個下午。如果你只有一個人--希望你來哈比屋跟自已對話。一瓶紅酒、幾片起司非常適合跟老友秉燭夜談。如果你有許久不見的老友--希望你們來哈比屋聊想法、聊哲學。一張毛毯、一片草地也可以悠閒的躺一下午。如果您是一對戀人—歡迎您來哈比屋渡過閒逸的兩人世界。這就是慕哲哈比屋的渡假哲學—“渡假的時候，無所事事就是最大的美德。

stays.name: 樹也民宿
stays.description: 苗栗｜樹也Villa．與自然一起呼吸，回到樹林懷抱中的安靜碧綠池水輕輕搖晃，在腦海中反射出美麗的樹影——閉上眼，山風吹拂身體，途經龍騰斷橋，往苗栗三義的山路裡開，當車駛進樹也Villa，花草香味飄來，一隻大斑鳩飛翔於天空，隱密木門後迎接屬於你們的專屬假期，在這裡，大自然伴你們一同呼吸，讓你住進山林懷抱中的美好。與自然共享山林中的渡假愜意鳶尾花天臺下，錯落且爬滿藤葉的樹也Villa，像一幢幢有品味的樹屋，在山谷裡與大自然共築秘境，走入大廳落地窗門後，先喝一杯咖啡休憩，坐進玻璃窗邊的沙發椅，翻閱雜誌書籍，觀看風景、享受愜意。步下戶外階梯，茂盛的樟樹林在戲水池上頭為你們遮蔭，風一吹、樹一搖、山泉水面上的影子跟著搖晃，你坐上躺椅，愛人仰浮於水面，鳥鳴跟著你自在的心情歌唱著。日、樹、川、月，種出四間舒眠空間依山勢而建、與樹林共生的四間雙人房，每間都有簡約的質感——走進「樹泉」雙人房，時光好像變慢，三棵向光攀上的樟樹就種在房裡，以透明樹窗相隔，再走近一些，窗外的竹林與小溪譜出讓人放鬆的旋律，脫掉衣裳，走過凹字型走廊、綠野陽台，另頭便是寬敞的景致湯屋；「晴川」房可以看見斷橋的痕跡，傾聽流水的聲音，享受寧靜；「初日」房的落地透明紗簾穿透日光，紗幔蓋住的床給你溫柔假期，還能走上映著藍空的玻璃通道往衛浴空間；在「醉月」房中，則可以欣賞迷人的星空及綠意風景。創意饗宴，品嚐台灣在地美味一泊二食的舌尖饗宴，以在地食材融合創意料理手法，在夜裡展開，走上二樓的餐廳，開放式廚房分享主廚如何用心地料理。有清爽的開胃小菜，豐盛的沙拉、及各種帶著藝術感的創意料理，最後以香煎牛小排、澎湖紅鰷的海陸雙主菜，為今晚畫下句點。早晨，一碗溫熱的蔬菜粥與在地小農購買的食材所做的小菜，以簡單調味讓你吃下最天然的滋味。ˇ樹也，Chooart，將樹以台語發音，紀念著土地與在地人情味。
stays.descriptionEn: Miaoli｜ChooArt VillaBreathe with Nature and Return to the Tranquility Embraced by the ForestThe ripples of the green pool water reflect the beautiful shadows of trees in your mind. Close your eyes and let the mountain breeze brush against your body. Passing by the Longteng Broken Bridge, you are driving on the mountain road to Sanyi, Miaoli County. When the car enters ChooArt Villa, the fragrance of flowers and plants floats in the air and a large striped-dove flies in the sky. Behind the hidden wooden door, your exclusive holiday is expecting your arrival. Here, you breathe with nature, while the mountain and woods embrace you with their beauty.Share with Nature the Leisurely Vacation in Mountain Woods Under the rooftop garden of irises, the vine-covered buildings of ChooArt Villa in the valley are beautifully arranged in a haphazard way like stylish tree houses, while staying close to nature. You enter the lobby with the floor-to-ceiling windows and doors, have a cup of coffee and rest for a bit. Sit in the sofa chair by the glass window, browse through some magazines or books, take in the scenery and just enjoy the leisurely time.Step down the outdoor stairs, and you find yourself at the pool, where the verdant camphor woods above provide you with shade. When the wind blows, the tree branches and leaves flutter, and the shadows on the spring water sway to a natural rhythm. You sit on the deck chair as your lover floats relaxingly in the water. Your cheerful mood is accompanied by the chirping of the birds. Everything is just so delightful and at ease.Sun, Tree, River, and Moon; Planting Four Relaxing Sleep SpacesBeing built along the contour of the hill, four double rooms of ChooArt share a simple character, and they breathe and live with the woods. Walking into the “Tree Spring” double room, time seems to slow down here. In the bedroom space, three camphor trees stretching up toward the light are surrounded by the glass windows. Get closer to the window, and you’d enjoy the relaxing melody composed by the bamboo forest and the creek outside. Take off your clothes and get through the U-shaped corridor by the greenery balcony, you’ll arrive at the spacious bathroom with the forest view. The “Sunny River” room offers the view of the ruins of the Broken Bridge. You may listen to the sound of running water and enjoy the quiet peace here. The sunlight penetrates the transparent floor-to-ceiling gauze curtains of the “First Sun” room, while the bed with the gauze canopy brings you a sense of the romantic holiday. You can also walk through the glass passage with the reflection of the blue sky to the bathroom. In the “Tipsy Moon” room, you can admire the enchanting starry sky and the lush scenery.Taste the Authentic Taiwanese Flavor in the Creative CuisineAs your stay at ChooArt includes two meals, you can enjoy the culinary delights that incorporate creative ideas with local ingredients. In the evening, you step into the dining room on the second floor, where the chef will demonstrate how the food is carefully prepared in the open kitchen. There are refreshing appetizers, hearty salads, and creative dishes with a variety of artistic senses. Of course, the highlight would be the surf and turf meal combined with the seared short beef rib and coral hind from Penghu, bringing the perfect ending to the evening. In the morning, the breakfast contains a bowl of warm vegetable porridge and small dishes made with the ingredients purchased from the local farmers, all with simple seasoning for you to savor the most natural flavors.The name of the villa, ChooArt, is the Taiwanese word for trees, representing a tribute to the land and local hospitality. The team is dedicated to the coexistence of the ecologically sustainable architecture and nature. This dedication also leads ChooArt Villa to be the Gold Winner of the 2017 FIABCI World Prix d’Excellence Environmental Award (as “Oscars Award” of the real estate industry). The team believes that a good balance can be achieved by planting trees while building houses. Just like Brian, the amicable CEO, said: “A lot of things should not be taken for granted, we must learn how to adapt to nature.” His respect for the earth also deeply affects the employees of ChooArt. Working as a staff here, not only one’s capability is a must, but the attitude one bears would be the key. The staff here learn from nature while serving each traveler wholeheartedly.Before you leave, come to the lobby and enjoy some Chinese tea and a good chat with the tea master. With a cup of fine tea, reserve some quiet time for yourself. The aroma drifting in the air just reminds you of the thoughtfulness of ChooArt and the wonderfulness of being embraced by the forest.

stays.searchText: 樹也民宿 樹也民宿 苗栗縣民宿209號 苗栗縣 三義鄉 龍騰村5鄰外庄27-1號 苗栗｜樹也Villa．與自然一起呼吸，回到樹林懷抱中的安靜碧綠池水輕輕搖晃，在腦海中反射出美麗的樹影——閉上眼，山風吹拂身體，途經龍騰斷橋，往苗栗三義的山路裡開，當車駛進樹也Villa，花草香味飄來，一隻大斑鳩飛翔於天空，隱密木門後迎接屬於你們的專屬假期，在這裡，大自然伴你們一同呼吸，讓你住進山林懷抱中的美好。與自然共享山林中的渡假愜意鳶尾花天臺下，錯落且爬滿藤葉的樹也Villa，像一幢幢有品味的樹屋，在山谷裡與大自然共築秘境，走入大廳落地窗門後，先喝一杯咖啡休憩，坐進玻璃窗邊的沙發椅，翻閱雜誌書籍，觀看風景、享受愜意。步下戶外階梯，茂盛的樟樹林在戲水池上頭為你們遮蔭，風一吹、樹一搖、山泉水面上的影子跟著搖晃，你坐上躺椅，愛人仰浮於水面，鳥鳴跟著你自在的心情歌唱著。日、樹、川、月，種出四間舒眠空間依山勢而建、與樹林共生的四間雙人房，每間都有簡約的質感——走進「樹泉」雙人房，時光好像變慢，三棵向光攀上的樟樹就種在房裡，以透明樹窗相隔，再走近一些，窗外的竹林與小溪譜出讓人放鬆的旋律，脫掉衣裳，走過凹字型走廊、綠野陽台，另頭便是寬敞的景致湯屋；「晴川」房可以看見斷橋的痕跡，傾聽流水的聲音，享受寧靜；「初日」房的落地透明紗簾穿透日光，紗幔蓋住的床給你溫柔假期，還能走上映著藍空的玻璃通道往衛浴空間；在「醉月」房中，則可以欣賞迷人的星空及綠意風景。創意饗宴，品嚐台灣在地美味一泊二食的舌尖饗宴，以在地食材融合創意料理手法，在夜裡展開，走上二樓的餐廳，開放式廚房分享主廚如何用心地料理。有清爽的開胃小菜，豐盛的沙拉、及各種帶著藝術感的創意料理，最後以香煎牛小排、澎湖紅鰷的海陸雙主菜，為今晚畫下句點。早晨，一碗溫熱的蔬菜粥與在地小農購買的食材所做的小菜，以簡單調味讓你吃下最天然的滋味。ˇ樹也，Chooart，將樹以台語發音，紀念著土地與在地人情味。

stays.name: 福田瓦舍
stays.description: 福田瓦舍民宿座落在三義鄉舊山線休閒農業區，位在聯繫勝興火車站與龍騰斷橋之苗 49-1 線上，在勝興舊鐵道旁的蓊鬱樹林間，隱藏著一座獨立的紅磚式樓房「福田瓦舍」，在山林中顯得格外醒目。胼手胝足開墾了福田瓦舍，民宿內的一草一木都是由主人夫婦親手培育，希望能提供一個自然的環境給下ㄧ代；完全呈現出福田瓦舍的有機生態面給大眾。尤其每到桐花季，福田瓦舍的林區天然屏障，顯現白藹藹的四月雪花海，美得令人屏息。瓦舍園區佔地2公頃，以回歸原始林相為環境營造的重點，腹地廣闊的生態園區，包括有機果園、生態淨化池以及遍植九芎、楓樹、大頭茶等的森林綠地，自然的環境常吸引台灣藍鵲、五色鳥、繡眼畫眉在園區築巢，每一個到訪的遊客可以體驗山居的樂趣、慢活的休閒方式、享受鄉村田園風光、欣賞客庄藝術創作、敞佯於藍天綠地。來福田瓦舍聽主人為您細說三義文化 / 古蹟 / 藝術 / 自然，貼心的為您客製套裝遊程，民宿提供 5000 坪自然腹地，任親子遨遊、三五好友品茗茶敘、情侶漫步、銀髮養生，享受心靈的沉靜空間。 全區除了獨具的寬敞套房、森林景觀木屋、優雅咖啡廳、室外涼亭雅座、生態荷花池、果園、戲鵝池、咖啡樹徑….. 等。入秋後咖啡豆轉紅，遊客還可以親嘗採咖啡豆的樂趣，所有園區設施與活動都可以親身體驗，也因為如此用心經營的態度，深得旅人的一致好評。主人們就是堅持著讓福田瓦舍成為到三義旅遊者不能錯過的幸福旅宿。
stays.descriptionEn: Futen-house Villa B&B is located in the Leisure Agriculture Area of the historic Mountain Route of Railroad, Sanyi Township, at Miaoli Highway 49-1 where connects Longteng Broken Bridge and Shengxing Station. Amid luxuriant woods next to Shengxing old railroad, you can find an independent red brick building, "Futen-house Villa," hides in the woods and appears particularly eye-catching. Toiling over to reclaim the land of Futen-house Villa and cultivating every tree and flower personally, the host couple hope to provide a natural environment for future generations and to present completely the organic and ecological perspectives of the Fulton- house Villa to the public. In particular, in every season of Tung Blossom, the natural forest barrier of Futen-house Villa presents a hazy sea of snow white flowers of the April. It is breathtakingly beautiful. Futen-house Villa covers an area of ​​two hectares, which focuses on environmental constructions of returning to the original forests. In the vast hinterland of the eco-park, the green land of forest includes organic orchards, ecological purification ponds, and has planted Lagerstroemia subcostata, maples, Taiwan Gordonia, etc., throughout. The natural environment often attracts the nesting of Taiwan Blue Magpies, Taiwan Barbets, Gray-cheeked Fulvetta, among others, in the park of Futen-house Villa. Every visiting visitor is able to experience the fun of living in the mountains and the leisure of recreational mode, to enjoy the idyllic countryside, and artistic creations of Hakka village, and to stroll in an open paradise of blue sky and green land. Come to Futen-house Villa, allow the hosts to elaborate the Sanyi culture / Monuments / Art / Nature, and to make carefully a custom journey package for you, featuring a natural hinterland of 16,500 square-meters for the parent-child ramble, tea party for a few friends, lovers' stroll, health programs for the seniors, and enjoying the calm space of the mind. Feature forest landscape log cabins, elegant coffee house, outdoor pavilion lounges, ecological lotus ponds, orchards, goose pond, and coffee tree trails, in addition to exclusive spacious suites. In Autumn, coffee beans turn ripe; visitors may also enjoy the pleasure of picking coffee beans. Visitors can experience all park facilities and activities, and because of this attitude of careful management, the Villa won consistently high praises from travelers. The innkeepers adhere to make Futen-house Villa a happy accommodation that the tourists to Sanyi cannot miss.

stays.name: 觀心農舍
stays.description: 觀心農舍於 2023 年 3 月 7 日成立並獲得苗栗縣政府認證許可經營。這是全新的農舍，只有提供清新與乾淨, 室內環境非常乾淨，戶外呼吸活動，空氣非常新鮮。獨立的農舍提供舒適的環境，沒有汽油味和喇叭聲。三義鄉位於苗栗縣的南部, 也是台中市偏北的山城，平均海拔300多米。 這是一個青山綠水環抱的小鎮。除此之外, 這裡還是台灣著名的木雕之鄉。 數百上千木雕藝術家在這裡，充滿木香的藝術家工作室藏身於庭院巷弄，木頭香氣不僅衝擊著你的嗅覺，精雕細鑿的工藝也衝擊著你的心靈。如果您有興趣了解更多小鎮深層文化和特有生活方式，請將您的空閒時間留在這裡，讓我們安排您的旅程,這將會是一個令人難忘的旅程。
stays.descriptionEn: The Ageless Farmhouse was established on March 7, 2023 and has been certified and licensed by the Miaoli County Government.This is a brand new farmhouse that only offers freshness and cleanliness, the indoor environment is very clean, the outdoors is breathable and the air is very fresh.The detached farmhouse offers comfort without the smell of petrol and the sound of horns.Sanyi Township is located in the south of Miaoli County, and is also a mountain town north of Taichung City, with an average altitude of more than 300 meters. This is a small town surrounded by green mountains and green waters.In addition, it is also a famous hometown of woodcarving in Taiwan. Hundreds of wood carving artists are here, and the artist studios full of wood fragrance are hidden in courtyard lanes. The fragrance of wood not only impacts your sense of smell, but also impacts your heart with exquisite craftsmanship.If you are interested in learning more about the deep culture and unique lifestyle of the town, please leave your free time here and let us arrange your journey, which will be an unforgettable journey.

stays.name: 喫茶居民宿
stays.description: 喫茶居 位於苗栗公館黃金小鎮 一樓設計為古意雅致風格分享主人收藏古董、古玩、老物件的【老茶會客廳】 一樓同時也設計了一處幸福陽光令人嚮往擁有的【開放式蔬食廚房和飯廳】 二樓則設計現代簡約風格的【旅宿空間和大廳】 門口大院子有顆超過20年的櫸木樹，是從老家山上移植到此，也象徵【傳承和守護】 波光綠意，清風徐來 棗園、稻田、芋田、小溪流和腳踏車步道等........ 旅友們在這裡感受田園美好，心靈放鬆的靜謐時光 附近還有在地知名餐廳【棗莊】也可品嘗到以紅棗為主題的客家風味餐
stays.descriptionEn: Chi Cha Ju is located in the Golden Town of Gongguan, Miaoli. The first floor is designed in an ancient and elegant style. It is the [Old Tea Room] where the owner’s collection of antiques, curios, and old objects are shared. The first floor is also designed with a happy and sunny [open vegetarian kitchen and dining room] that makes people yearn for it. The second floor is designed with a modern and simple style [accommodation space and lobby]. There is a beech tree over 20 years old in the large yard at the entrance. It was transplanted here from the mountain of my hometown, and it also symbolizes [inheritance and protection]. The waves are green and the breeze is blowing. The jujube garden, rice fields, taro fields, small streams and bicycle trails, etc........ Travelers here feel the beauty of the countryside and the quiet time of spiritual relaxation. There is also a well-known local restaurant [Zaozhuang] nearby, where you can also taste Hakka-style meals with red dates as the theme.

stays.description: 『松鶴民宿』座落苗栗縣公館鄉景色優美寬廣的陶色公路，沿山道仁安活動中心旁，緊鄰天泉宮，後有翠綠山峰、登山步道、運動公園，登峰頂可鳥瞰公館鄉全貌及美麗夜間全鄉燈光景色；四周綠意盎然，鳥語花香、蟲鳴蝶舞，螢火蟲閃爍、農田溝渠縱橫，水聲潺潺、魚群悠游充滿田野風味，讓醉心於繁華都市生活中的人，憶起兒時抓蚱蜢、泥鰍、釣魚的歲月。 鄰近景點南有苗栗客家大院、客家文物館、勝興車站、騰龍斷橋、台灣油礦陳列館、苗栗陶瓷博物館、大湖草莓酒莊、汶水老街、清安豆腐街、泰安溫泉區、五穀文化村、西湖渡假村、三義木雕博物館、三義木雕街等。往北有獅潭仙草街、仙山、南庄老街、獅頭山等等名勝旅遊區。百聞不如一見…松鶴民宿全體同仁歡迎您來苗栗盡情享受好山好水。
stays.descriptionEn: Songhe B&B is located along the scenic and wide Taose Highway in Gongguan Township, Miaoli County. It& #39;s next to Ren& #39;an Community Center along Mountain Road, with Tianquan Temple nearby. Behind the B&B are lush green mountains, hiking trail and Exercise Park. A hike up the mountain offers a birds-eye-view of Gongguan Township and the beautiful night scene of the entire Gongguan Town. This area is surrounded by greenery and flowers, sounds of birds chirping, insects buzzing, butterflies fluttering about and fireflies flickering at night. The soothing sounds of water running in the farm field ditches and fish swimming in the pond remind visitors from the busy city of the carefree country lifestyle and childhood games, such as catching grasshoppers and fishing for loach. Nearby attractions in the southern part of Miaoli include Miaoli Hakka Mansion, Hakka Cultural Museum, Shengxing Station, Tenglong Bridge Ruins, Taiwan Oil Field Exhibition Hall, Miaoli Pottery Museum, Da Hu Wineland Resort, Wenshui Old Street, Qing& #39;an Tofu Street, Tai& #39;an Hot Spring Area, Wugu Cutural Village, Westlake Village Resortopia, Sanyi Wood Sculpture Museum and Sanyi Wood Sculpture Street. Scenic attractions in the northern part of Miaoli are Shitan Xiancao Street, Mt. Xianshan, Nanzhuang Old Street and Mt. Shitou. Seeing is believing. All of us at Songhe B&B welcome you to Miaoli to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

stays.name: 桐莊
stays.description: 苗栗｜油桐花坊．山林中的白雪，幸福的桐花之境循台六線一路向山前行，呼吸苗栗清甜的空氣；轉入彎曲山路，如點點白雪般的桐花，輕輕飄下五月雪，經過被綠意包圍的路，遇見山間的美麗境地──油桐花坊，在優雅的大自然與美味餐點之間，品嚐幸福時光。桐花樹下，被山環繞的午茶時光有層次的綠意風景在眼前展開，一株高大的油桐樹佇立在油桐花坊園區正中央，安靜伸展著樹枝，在暖陽中沐浴。踏上佈滿油桐花、仿若一片雪地的木棧道，繞過一棵棵桐花樹、鵝掌木、楠木、苦茶樹……，山風拍打著葉子的樂音，蟲鳴鳥叫傳入耳裡，共譜一首輕快的森林協奏曲。午後，走進四面透光的玻璃小屋，滿櫃新竹知名的RT蛋糕、奶酪、新鮮水果任你無限享用，配上熱茶咖啡，愜意坐在屋裡或戶外座位，不只桐花季，也能欣賞隨四季變換的風景——春天草木有新生的翠綠，夏日有油桐花的雪白，秋季楓紅乾爽，冬季雲霧包圍山林。在木香中休息，品嚐客家創意無菜單料理 踏進三層樓的獨棟木屋，滿室的香杉氣味，放鬆了疲憊的心。油桐花坊每間房的家具皆以厚實原木為底，與各式精緻古董燈具搭配，也都備有膠囊咖啡機與RT手作餅乾。室內空間有和式榻榻米設計及木搖椅，可以看到青山與樹林的開闊窗景，旅人更能踏出陽台坐上吊椅，呼吸芬多精，或浸入浴缸，徹底放鬆。這裡適合與家人、好友一次包下整棟木屋，最多可容納二十人，一樓交誼廳有卡拉OK可以歡唱，三樓小客廳還能讓一家人窩在沙發悠閒地下棋、聊天。一泊三食的油桐花坊，最令人期待的，是夜晚結合在地食材與客家風味的無菜單料理！以紅棗醋飲的酸甜拉開序幕，蓮藕包裹著客家仙草的甘甜，與竹籠清蒸的鮮甜時蔬搭配特製桔醬，色香味俱佳；而味道獨特的客家豆乾雞湯，佐以酥脆麵包相裹義大利米麵，散發獨特義式香氣；更有香煎香魚的新鮮海味，以及最不能錯過的炙燒高級日本和牛！
stays.descriptionEn: Miaoli｜House of Tung FlowersWhite snow in a mountain forest; the delight of Tung flower landFollowing Provincial Highway Six up into the mountains, you breathe the sweet, clear air of Miaoli County. Turning down a winding mountain road, you see a flurry of snow-like Tung flowers - the so-called May Snows. Trees encompass the road from both sides as you approach your beautiful mountain destination - House of Tung Flowers. Between the elegance of nature and the deliciousness of exquisitely prepared meals, you savor the taste of happiness.Afternoon tea in the mountains beneath the Tung treesThe layered green landscape of House of Tung Flowers unfolds before your eyes, with a lofty tung tree standing directly in the middle of the gardens, quietly extending its branches to bathe in the warm sunlight. You set out across a wooden pathway strewn with Tung flowers and resembling snow-covered ground, and stroll between the Tung, Phoebe zhennan, umbrella, and camellia assamica trees. The mountain breeze rustles the tree leaves as the sounds of insects and birds enters your ears, uniting into a lively forest concerto.In the afternoon, you enter the glass-walled tea room, with light spilling in from all sides. To one side sits a dessert cabinet full of sweets from the famous RT Bakery House. Have as much as you like, along with hot tea and coffee. Seated indoors or out, the scenery is beautiful any season of the year, not just during the Tung flower season. In spring, fresh emerald-green leaves sprout all around. In summer, the tung trees produce a snow of white flowers. In autumn, the maples shine red in the forest. And in winter, the mountain forests are shrouded in clouds and mist.Resting between fragrant trees, taste a creative, menu-free Hakka-style mealStepping into the three-story building, the scent of Chinese fir filling the entire space relieves your exhausted mind. At House of Tung Flowers, the furnishings in each room are made of solid wood, accentuated with exquisite antique lamps, and include a capsule coffee machine and complementary RT Bakery House cookies. The interior design includes Japanese tatami mats as well as wooden rocking chairs, with large windows that afford beautiful views of the mountain forests. You can sit on the balcony and breathe phytoncides from the comfort of hanging chairs, or soak in the bathtub to completely relax. With a maximum capacity of 20 people, House of Tung Flowers is well-suited for a family or a group of friends to reserve the entire wooden structure. With karaoke in the first floor common room and a small living room on the third floor where family and friends can play chess or chat with each other.A one night stay includes three meals, yet the thing most anticipated by visitors to House of Tung Flowers is the menu-free fusion dinner incorporating local ingredients and traditional Hakka flavors. Red date vinegar is used to start the meal off, followed by lotus root wrapped in the sweetness of Hakka-style grass jelly made of Chinese mesona. A bamboo steamer full of fresh seasonal vegetables with homemade kumquat sauce satisfies all the senses. A uniquely flavored bean curd chicken soup, served with crisp bread stuffed with Italian rice-flour noodles emits distinct Italian aroma. The sweet fish imparts the fresh sweetness of the sea, while the broiled Japanese beef (wagyu) simply cannot be missed. Finally, enjoy a bite of delicate almond tofu and a glass from host James’s private wine collection to bring your beautiful evening to a close. In contrast with one’s impression of the usual fixed villa menu, the food at House of Tung Flowers employs meticulous western-style techniques and the ingenious fusion of Hakka cuisine and Taiwanese ingredients to bring to each traveler an elegant and refined dining experience. James - promoting Taiwan’s tung flower season for the appreciation of the entire worldIn the morning, the mountain breeze urges you toward the breakfast table, where yet another sumptuous meal is laid out. Many summers ago, James decided to open his family home up to the public, to share the beautiful scenery with travelers by opening a guesthouse. The Hakka Affairs Council seized the opportunity to promote the Hakka tung flower season to attract large quantities of tourists, during which time House of Tung Flowers operates at full capacity every single day. Today, James has a full head of gray hair, yet in those first days, he truly was a pioneer, leading the way in the tung flower tourist market. With his endless Hakka passion and hospitality, he has been a great advocate of tung flower tourism during the month of May. Who would guess that he grew up in the Ximending neighborhood in Taipei! Yet he had always hoped to one day live in the tranquility of nature. Upon entering society, he continued his father’s construction business. At the turn of the millennium, in a time when many people could not even recognize a tung tree, he had come to admire the largest tung tree in Taiwan, right here beside House of Tung Flowers. He built his guesthouse and launched his one night, three meals slow living holiday package so that travelers can live in the mountains, and enjoy the tung flowers and delicious food. “Taiwan has many qualifications which surpass those of other countries, so we need to look at things from a new perspective, drawing in a tide of tourists from abroad, in order for Taiwan to build confidence!” With his warmth and sincerity, James invites travelers from around the world to come to this tranquil forest, to enjoy the tung flowers fluttering on the May breeze, like beautiful snow swirling in the air, and savor the taste of a truly happy vacation.

stays.searchText: 桐莊 桐莊 苗栗縣民宿046號 苗栗縣 公館鄉 福德村4鄰福德35-12號 苗栗｜油桐花坊．山林中的白雪，幸福的桐花之境循台六線一路向山前行，呼吸苗栗清甜的空氣；轉入彎曲山路，如點點白雪般的桐花，輕輕飄下五月雪，經過被綠意包圍的路，遇見山間的美麗境地──油桐花坊，在優雅的大自然與美味餐點之間，品嚐幸福時光。桐花樹下，被山環繞的午茶時光有層次的綠意風景在眼前展開，一株高大的油桐樹佇立在油桐花坊園區正中央，安靜伸展著樹枝，在暖陽中沐浴。踏上佈滿油桐花、仿若一片雪地的木棧道，繞過一棵棵桐花樹、鵝掌木、楠木、苦茶樹……，山風拍打著葉子的樂音，蟲鳴鳥叫傳入耳裡，共譜一首輕快的森林協奏曲。午後，走進四面透光的玻璃小屋，滿櫃新竹知名的RT蛋糕、奶酪、新鮮水果任你無限享用，配上熱茶咖啡，愜意坐在屋裡或戶外座位，不只桐花季，也能欣賞隨四季變換的風景——春天草木有新生的翠綠，夏日有油桐花的雪白，秋季楓紅乾爽，冬季雲霧包圍山林。在木香中休息，品嚐客家創意無菜單料理 踏進三層樓的獨棟木屋，滿室的香杉氣味，放鬆了疲憊的心。油桐花坊每間房的家具皆以厚實原木為底，與各式精緻古董燈具搭配，也都備有膠囊咖啡機與RT手作餅乾。室內空間有和式榻榻米設計及木搖椅，可以看到青山與樹林的開闊窗景，旅人更能踏出陽台坐上吊椅，呼吸芬多精，或浸入浴缸，徹底放鬆。這裡適合與家人、好友一次包下整棟木屋，最多可容納二十人，一樓交誼廳有卡拉OK可以歡唱，三樓小客廳還能讓一家人窩在沙發悠閒地下棋、聊天。一泊三食的油桐花坊，最令人期待的，是夜晚結合在地食材與客家風味的無菜單料理！以紅棗醋飲的酸甜拉開序幕，蓮藕包裹著客家仙草的甘甜，與竹籠清蒸的鮮甜時蔬搭配特製桔醬，色香味俱佳；而味道獨特的客家豆乾雞湯，佐以酥脆麵包相裹義大利米麵，散發獨特義式香氣；更有香煎香魚的新鮮海味，以及最不能錯過的炙燒高級日本和牛！

stays.description: 『松鶴民宿』座落苗栗縣公館鄉景色優美寬廣的陶色公路，沿山道仁安活動中心旁，緊鄰天泉宮，後有翠綠山峰、登山步道、運動公園，登峰頂可鳥瞰公館鄉全貌及美麗夜間全鄉燈光景色；四周綠意盎然，鳥語花香、蟲鳴蝶舞，螢火蟲閃爍、農田溝渠縱橫，水聲潺潺、魚群悠游充滿田野風味，讓醉心於繁華都市生活中的人，憶起兒時抓蚱蜢、泥鰍、釣魚的歲月。 鄰近景點南有苗栗客家大院、客家文物館、勝興車站、騰龍斷橋、台灣油礦陳列館、苗栗陶瓷博物館、大湖草莓酒莊、汶水老街、清安豆腐街、泰安溫泉區、五穀文化村、西湖渡假村、三義木雕博物館、三義木雕街等。往北有獅潭仙草街、仙山、南庄老街、獅頭山等等名勝旅遊區。百聞不如一見…松鶴民宿全體同仁歡迎您來苗栗盡情享受好山好水。 在全鄉最美之自行車步道沿山旁休閒行，(本民宿提供自行車供房客使用)，前往鄰近地區交通便捷，公館市區、客家大院或北側錫隘隧道、出磺坑油礦場等，放鬆心情走進客家風味鄉村，有各種時令農作物(竽頭、草莓、紅棗)散佈在廣大原野鄉間，花開時節、色彩繽紛的各式花朵，引來蝶飛蜂舞，好不熱鬧。 民宿庭園造景、綠樹花草、充滿客家鄉土風味，並備有烤肉設施及場地可供使用(可代訂BBQ食材)；廚房炊具一應俱全，可自行至市場或超市採購健康蔬果，品嚐最新鮮鄉土滋味。提供多元化週到服務，高級房間設備，一般民宿收費，讓您渡過田野間的知性旅宿美感。客廳提供咖啡、茶葉供住宿者免費盡情使用，三五好友泡茶聊天忘卻塵囂回歸自然好不心曠神怡。走吧！松鶴民宿期待您的光臨！
stays.descriptionEn: Songhe B&B is located along the scenic and wide Taose Highway in Gongguan Township, Miaoli County. It& #39;s next to Ren& #39;an Community Center along Mountain Road with Tianquan Temple nearby. Behind the B&B are lush green mountains, hiking trail and Exercise Park. A hike up the mountain offers a birds-eye-view of Gongguan Township and the beautiful night scene of the entire Gongguan Town. This area is surrounded by greenery and flowers, sounds of birds chirping, insects buzzing, butterflies fluttering about and fireflies flickering at night. The soothing sounds of water running in the farm field ditches and fish swimming in the pond remind visitors from the busy city of the carefree country lifestyle and childhood games, such as catching grasshoppers and fishing for loachThe town& #39;s most beautiful bikeway and hiking trail is along the mountain. The B&B has bikes available for guests to use. It& #39;s very convenient to get to nearby neighborhoods, such as downtown Gongguan, Hakka Mansion and Oil Mine. Take a walk to the Hakka Village and see a variety of seasonal fresh vegetables growing in the farm fields - taros, strawberries and red dates. When flowers bloom, the colorful blossoms attract many butterflies to the area.The beautifully landscaped B&B courtyard evokes the local Hakka flavor and is equipped with barbeque facilities and kitchen utensils. The B&B can order BBQ food items for guests, and guests can also go to the supermarket or vegetable market to select the freshest vegetables and fruits. Our price is average, but our service is thoughtful and extensive, and our equipment and accessories in the guestrooms are very high quality. You will be guaranteed to have a fulfilled country style vacation. The living room has complimentary coffee and tea for guests to enjoy. This is a great place for a few friends to gather and catch up on each other& #39;s lives and forget all their troubles.

stays.searchText: 苗栗松鶴陶然居民宿 苗栗松鶴陶然居民宿 苗栗縣民宿221號 苗栗縣 公館鄉 仁安村9鄰仁安118-7號 『松鶴民宿』座落苗栗縣公館鄉景色優美寬廣的陶色公路，沿山道仁安活動中心旁，緊鄰天泉宮，後有翠綠山峰、登山步道、運動公園，登峰頂可鳥瞰公館鄉全貌及美麗夜間全鄉燈光景色；四周綠意盎然，鳥語花香、蟲鳴蝶舞，螢火蟲閃爍、農田溝渠縱橫，水聲潺潺、魚群悠游充滿田野風味，讓醉心於繁華都市生活中的人，憶起兒時抓蚱蜢、泥鰍、釣魚的歲月。 鄰近景點南有苗栗客家大院、客家文物館、勝興車站、騰龍斷橋、台灣油礦陳列館、苗栗陶瓷博物館、大湖草莓酒莊、汶水老街、清安豆腐街、泰安溫泉區、五穀文化村、西湖渡假村、三義木雕博物館、三義木雕街等。往北有獅潭仙草街、仙山、南庄老街、獅頭山等等名勝旅遊區。百聞不如一見…松鶴民宿全體同仁歡迎您來苗栗盡情享受好山好水。 在全鄉最美之自行車步道沿山旁休閒行，(本民宿提供自行車供房客使用)，前往鄰近地區交通便捷，公館市區、客家大院或北側錫隘隧道、出磺坑油礦場等，放鬆心情走進客家風味鄉村，有各種時令農作物(竽頭、草莓、紅棗)散佈在廣大原野鄉間，花開時節、色彩繽紛的各式花朵，引來蝶飛蜂舞，好不熱鬧。 民宿庭園造景、綠樹花草、充滿客家鄉土風味，並備有烤肉設施及場地可供使用(可代訂BBQ食材)；廚房炊具一應俱全，可自行至市場或超市採購健康蔬果，品嚐最新鮮鄉土滋味。提供多元化週到服務，高級房間設備，一般民宿收費，讓您渡過田野間的知性旅宿美感。客廳提供咖啡、茶葉供住宿者免費盡情使用，三五好友泡茶聊天忘卻塵囂回歸自然好不心曠神怡。走吧！松鶴民宿期待您的光臨！

stays.name: 21杉林別墅
stays.description: 一位在台灣醫界服務40餘年迄今的醫師，因為非常喜愛大自然，20年前一次因緣際會買下這片有山有水的美麗土地，原想希望未來能蓋來當自己退休後度假及招待朋友之用的會館，後來希望能有更多人可以一起來享受這片寧靜、美麗大自然的環境，因此開始有了想蓋起這民宿的想法，也因親手種植了從小小樹苗的這21棵南洋杉木迄今已20餘年，這些21棵南洋杉木已高聳矗立有五、六層樓之高，圍繞著民宿四周圍，所以將民宿命名為「21杉林Villa」不管您置身在民宿哪個地方，都能享受著這些21棵壯碩又美麗、隨時散發著南洋杉芬多精的氣息。一杯Araucaria精品咖啡，一本好書，坐在窗邊，沉浸、享受這片有鳥語、花香、山泉水沿著石階流下及溪畔邊的潺潺水流聲， 如果您是夏天來此，有來自蟬、青蛙的叫聲，望著天邊的山嵐徐徐飄過，誏人沈澱心靈、可得到心情最放鬆的舒壓，一草一木、只要您用心去欣賞這些大自然的美，其實這些生活中看似平凡且易得的花草樹木，卻都是大自然中送給人類最珍貴的禮物; 在此，春天可欣賞有如少女般的粉紅色櫻花，夏天有活潑熱情綻放的風鈴木及紫薇花，5月更有佈滿整片南庄山頭最美的五月雪油桐花，走到猶如片片雪花般落下的油桐花，那有多美呢？秋冬季則有金黃、橘紅的楓葉⋯⋯​這些春夏秋冬的美，也就是民宿醫師主人希望可以跟大家分享的，希望大家都能有機會一起來欣賞這美麗的南庄美景。
stays.descriptionEn: we have the best quality on accommodation and landscaping in here .we also very attach importance to each customers feelings and needs.hope you can enjoy in here...we have 21 Araucaria tress around our villa. its very beautiful and tall. its also very quiet and comfortable.

stays.name: 加州莊園民宿
stays.description: 合法民宿登記證號：274 位在苗栗南庄山中的加州莊園民宿，是個有著陽光活力的橘色加州風建築，伴隨著24小時千變萬化的南庄山中美景，前一刻山嵐籠罩猶如夢中仙境，下一秒則撥雲見日群山乍現，美景盡收眼底，彷彿置身世外桃源。 春天的櫻花、五月的油桐花及夜晚的火金姑更是美不勝收。 由加州莊園民宿可直接前往南庄老街、南庄護魚步道、南庄向天湖、南庄神仙谷、八卦力部落、仙山、泰安溫泉.....等景點，更讓這趟旅程增添了不少回憶。 （各住宿客房的玩具視當天可提供以清潔之玩具為主，無法讓您自行挑選，若您先行告知小朋友的喜好，我們會儘量地提供孩子喜歡的玩具。）
stays.descriptionEn: Legal B&B registration number: 274. California Golden Villa is located in Nanzhuang, Miaoli Country. It is a building with orange Californian style, and you can see the amazing scenery in the mountains of Nanzhuang. You just see the clouds and mists in the mountains as if in the fairyland, but soon the sun comes out and shines over the mountains, which make you feel like you& #39;re in Xanadu. Cherry blossoms in spring, tung blossoms in May and fireflies at night are out of this world. From the B&B, you can head to tourist spots like Nanzhuang Old Street, Penglai River Ecology Park, Xiangtian Lake, Shenxiangu Waterfall, Baguali Tribal Village, Xian Mountain, Taian hot springs, which will surely enrich your trip. (We will prepare cleaned toys in every room. While guests cannot select toys, if you notify us in advance of your children& #39;s preferences, we will try to provide the most suitable toys we have.)

stays.name: 南江璞園
stays.description: 南江璞園座落於南庄通往東河青翠秀麗的田園間，距南庄老街約一公里，是一家交通便利視野廣闊的優質民宿。本園建築外型為北美式歐風格調，設計融入民宿主人的品味與用心，整體呈現高雅、精緻的感覺，而時空光影的流動，以及窗窗美景如詩畫，令人心曠神怡，有如置身於夢想家一般。到這裡，您可以欣賞到主人的藝術收藏品，也可以在叢山河谷間，悠閒地享受山澗、溪水聲圍繞的咖啡談心；對於喜愛大自然的人來說，可以沐浴在森林芬多精中，享受綠仙子在身上婆娑起舞；還可發揮一下運動神經，來趟古道登山健行；如果，想來趟南庄自然與人文生態之旅，除了體驗到純樸的客家風情與美食外，也可瞭解賽夏族和泰雅族部落歷史遺跡與部落文化，或是走訪你絕不可錯過的蓬萊溪護魚步道；夜宿南江璞園，可以欣賞到山水環繞的街道夜景，及滿天繁星的閃閃夜空。南江璞園不但通過SGS認證之民宿，同時也榮穫交通部觀光局評定為好客民宿，及苗栗縣政府評定之四星級民宿。總之，精心雕琢而成的南江璞園，是一個值得您信賴及探訪的地方，預約您的到來，一同分享山居閑適的生活！
stays.descriptionEn: Nan Chian Jade Garden is located in Nanzhuang, amid beautiful verdant countryside beside the road leading to Donghe, about 1 km from the Nanzhuang Old Street. It is a high quality Bed and Breakfast with convenient transportation and vast field of view. The appearance of Nan Chian Jade Garden is a European style of North America with a design reflecting the innkeeper& #39;s taste and intention, the overall feeling is elegant, sophisticated, and the presentation of the flow of light and shadow in the space varying with time, as well as the poetic beauties of the scenery changing window by window, makes you feel refreshing like being in a home of your earnest wish. Here, you can enjoy the owner& #39;s art collection, and also the music of creeks, while leisurely strolling in the mountains and valleys, or sip a cup of coffee while chatting with friends, accompanying by the natural sounds of surrounding brook. For people like you who love nature, you can bathe yourself in the forest Phytoncide to feel the green fairy dancing in your body. Or, take a hike on old trails to flex your motor nerve. If, an exciting journey to Nanzhuang natural and cultural eco-tour is what you have expected, in addition to experiencing the simplicity of Hakka mien and cuisine, you can study the historical relics and tribal cultures of Saisiyat and Atayal tribes, or visit the Penglai River (Creek) fish conservation trails that you can not miss. Overnight Nen Chian Jade Garden, you can enjoy the night view of the landscape surrounding streets and the sparkling starry sky. Nan Chian Jade Garden is a B&B certified by SGS, a certified Taiwan Host by the Tourism Bureau, MOTC, and a four-star B&B assessed by the Miaoli County Government. In short, the well-crafted Nan Chian Jade Garden is a name you can trust and a place to visit. Please make an appointment for your arrival to share the mountain quiet life together.

stays.name: 問樵山居
stays.description: 位於苗栗縣南庄鄉的民宿2004年底邂逅南庄，就愛上這個山水秀麗，民風淳樸的客家庄。2008年愛樹的我們將層層的梯田遍植台灣原生樹種，如肖楠、豬腳楠、香楠、大葉楠、赤楠、青剛櫟、台灣油杉、榔榆、櫸木、光臘樹、茄苳、楊梅；還有隨季節變換色彩的青楓、楓香、三角楓，無患子；以及適應當地自然環境的各種花卉，如櫻花、梅花、李花、鳶尾花、杜鵑花、芙蓉花、荷花、野薑花及油桐花。生態池裡水生植物生趣盎然，小魚小蝦悠遊其中。山林裡生態豐富，偶與野兔、山羌，大冠鳩與藍鵲不期而遇，增添了山居的樂趣。2011年「問樵山居」落成，除了讓自己寄情於山水之中，也願將此情此景分享給有緣人。
stays.descriptionEn: Bed and Breakfast in Miaoli CountyWen Qiao Villa is situated at a mountainside in Nan Zhuang, a Hakka village in Miao Li County. At the upper end of a valley, Wen Qiao is an acre-sized paddy embraced by a forest and alongside a mountain stream.We found this gorgeous place in 2004, and decided to keep its original look by minimizing the changes to the landscapes and vegetation. We have also planted a number of indigenous trees and aquatic plants with a view to maintain an environment where human and all other creatures live in harmony.We built this cottage in 2011, and have since spent most of our holidays in Wen Qiao enjoying the unparalleled country experiences. Now, we are ready to share it with people who would appreciate such a life style.Service in English is available here. Come and see Wen Qiao a home during your stay in Taiwan.

stays.name: 普羅旺斯鄉村民宿
stays.description: 從一樹一景的堅持開始，我們堅持要最好，堅持以時間來成就夢想，過程雖然辛苦，但從無到有的喜悅，從擁有到完成夢想的用心與決心，讓我深刻的體會到堅持絕對可以成就經典。這裡有和諧的大地表情，美好的天空線，活化山林，創造山中休憩角落，環境無價，這裡的一草一木，都是用心與堅持的呈現。在這裡發現:原來山有很多不同的表情，就如同人的情緒，面對不同的人事物，自然有不同的面具，當身心靈合諧流動時，你會發現不同的自己。在這裡生活在自然裡，住在風景裡，山的大陽台，這裡的晚餐，就在陽台開動。山的美，讓身體五感喜悅充沛，山不語，靜默的力量讓身體沉靜，釋放能力。南庄普羅旺斯民宿，鄰近南庄老街、向天湖、南江老街、油桐花、神仙谷、夏季螢火蟲、春季賞櫻、客家美食、蓬萊溪護魚步道、42份冷泉步道、南庄矮靈祭，開車或搭車至南庄老街也很方便，我們擁有南庄最好的環境以及最棒的視野，讓您瀏覽南庄壯闊的山景與美麗的景色，有這麼多好玩的南庄，希望您也能來體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Paying attention to every detail, we insist on making dreams come true regardless of time. It was never easy, but the joy of starting something from scratch and seeing it finished is beyond words. I realized that it does not matter how slow you go as long as you don't stop. Here you will feel the harmony of the land and the sky. The place to rest in the mountains is priceless. Every detail is the result of hard work. Here you will find the many faces of the mountains just like what you find in people. Different people see different things when they have different emotions as you see a different self when you reach a harmonious state. Come here and live in nature. The mountain is like a massive balcony. And during the night you feast on it. The beauty of the mountain brings joy to your body. Let the power of the silent mountains calm you and bring out your energy. Provence Villa in Nanchaung, Moali, is close to Nanchaung Old Street, Xiangtien Lake, Penglai river, and Fairy Valley. In summer there are fireflies. In spring there are cherry blossoms and tung flowers. You can enjoy the cold spring trail and Pas-ta'ai, the Ritual to the Short People. We have the finest environment and the best view in Nanchaung that we hope to share with you.

stays.descriptionEn: Situated just 3.6 km from Nanzhuang Old Street, Nanchuang Sung Yun features accommodation in Nanzhuang with access to a shared lounge, a garden, as well as a shared kitchen. With garden views, this accommodation offers a balcony.Featuring a patio and river views, the chalet includes 4 bedrooms, a living room, cable flat-screen TV, an equipped kitchen, and 2 bathrooms with a bidet and a shower.The chalet provides a terrace.Museum of Saisiat Folklore is 16 km from Nanchuang Sung Yun, while Xiangtian Lake is 16 km from the property. The nearest airport is Taichung International, 79 km from the accommodation, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

stays.name: 水岸明珠
stays.description: 水岸明珠位處苗栗南庄山巒之頂，宛如明珠一顆，巍然獨立稀有，前有中港溪、蓬萊溪匯集，可總攬南庄老街全景，行看吊橋流水之姿、坐賞層層山巒之美，絕對值得您駐足、細細品味變化萬千之大自然美景。明珠背擁神桌山天然山林，左抱咫尺百丈之天然石壁美景、古道蜿蜒其間，沿途更有礦坑口、情人谷、啞瑪頂古道等景點為明珠獨有，林相優美、生態豐富，抬頭仰望，或有成群藍色小精靈(台灣藍鵲)飛舞其間，漫步林間，或與穿山甲不期而遇，夏晚更可於鄰近小溪夜觀螢火蟲，螢光點點，歡迎您來玩味其中。明珠為南庄歐風特色民宿，為您精心布置典雅舒適客房，採光優雅的Lobby更是您與家人朋友話家常的好地方，2樓玻璃屋陽台亦是觀星、發呆、賞景的閒適空間。園區內更有小花園及杉林後花園，漫步其中可領略杉林搖曳、四季花卉之美，更可於拉蓓蕾咖啡屋來杯香濃咖啡，坐觀美景一邊聆聽蟲鳴鳥叫的大自然交響樂，讓本民宿陪您度過悠閒、舒適的美好假期。

stays.description: 訂房電話:037-825822Email:lilyvillage50@yahoo.com百合山莊位於苗栗南庄，我們突破傳統民宿，以精緻的飯店管理，提供庭園式的渡假休閒民宿與美食饗宴。百合山莊緣起於一位成功室內設計師之夢想，歷經近千個晨昏的漫長規劃與建設，以退伍後自住的超高標準來要求每一個微小細節，更以遠高於鄰近地區同業之內控管理流程，將山莊內每一項軟硬體設施與服務大幅的提升至星級旅館層次，為南庄民宿品質奠立新的里程碑 。 百合山莊位於苗栗縣南庄鄉，為國家級觀光旅遊休閒勝地，人稱「好山好水在南庄」，又有客家歌曲形容「南庄細妹將過旦」(客家發音)，百聞不如親歷其境親身體驗，百合山莊是以歐式風車為造型之頂級麗緻民宿，除了造景考究，客房陳設雅致外，另設有高爾夫球推桿果嶺，可供房客免費練習使用，頂樓另設有大型觀景台，攬視南庄獨特之壯觀儷景。設有咖啡花茶、套餐點心專區，您可選擇於室內外享用，同時欣賞光舞噴泉，入夜後山莊內燈光照明繽紛燦爛，可謂燈光美氣氛佳，清晨日出前可至裸足健康步道運動散步，同時觀賞蓮花、錦鯉，伴隨著晨曦享受這難得的清悠時光。
stays.descriptionEn: Reservation Tel: 037-825822 Email:lilyvillage50@yahoo.com Lily Village is located in Nanzhuang, Miaoli. We break through the B&B traditions and offer garden-style B&B and gourmet feasts and sophisticated hotel Management. Lily Village originated from a dream of a successful interior designer. He set standards to build an ideal residential house for himself after completing his military service and carried out the standards to every tiny detail and the internal control management processes that are more restricted than that of the B&Bs in neighboring areas. After nearly a thousand days and nights for planning and constructions, each hardware and software facilities and services in the Lily Village has been elevated dramatically to the level of star-rated hotels, laid a new milestone for the quality of B&Bs in Nanzhuang. Lily village is located in Nanzhuang Township, Miaoli County. As a national tourist resort, Nanzhuang is known that "beautiful waters and beautiful mountains are all in Nanzhuang" and, as another Hakka song puts it, "Nanzhuang girls are more beautiful than Dan (female character in an opera)" (Hakka pronunciation). Experiencing in person is believing. Lily Village is a top class fine B&B built with European windmill shape and features a golf putting green available for guests& #39; practice free of charge, a large viewing deck on the top floor for embracing the unique spectacular view of Nanzhuang, in addition to the exquisite landscaping and elegantly and tastefully furnished rooms. Also features a refreshment area for offering coffee, scented teas, and repasts, available for you to enjoy them indoors or outdoors, while enjoying the light dancing fountain. After dark, bright colorful lighting light up the Lily Village, creating both beautiful ambience and lighting, and in the morning before sunrise, you can walk barefoot on the health trail for exercising or just for strolling, meanwhile enjoy the sight of lotuses, fancy carps, along with the dawn to appreciate this rare leisurely time.

stays.searchText: 百合山莊 百合山莊 苗栗縣民宿093號 苗栗縣 南庄鄉 南江村17鄰福南50號 訂房電話:037-825822Email:lilyvillage50@yahoo.com百合山莊位於苗栗南庄，我們突破傳統民宿，以精緻的飯店管理，提供庭園式的渡假休閒民宿與美食饗宴。百合山莊緣起於一位成功室內設計師之夢想，歷經近千個晨昏的漫長規劃與建設，以退伍後自住的超高標準來要求每一個微小細節，更以遠高於鄰近地區同業之內控管理流程，將山莊內每一項軟硬體設施與服務大幅的提升至星級旅館層次，為南庄民宿品質奠立新的里程碑 。 百合山莊位於苗栗縣南庄鄉，為國家級觀光旅遊休閒勝地，人稱「好山好水在南庄」，又有客家歌曲形容「南庄細妹將過旦」(客家發音)，百聞不如親歷其境親身體驗，百合山莊是以歐式風車為造型之頂級麗緻民宿，除了造景考究，客房陳設雅致外，另設有高爾夫球推桿果嶺，可供房客免費練習使用，頂樓另設有大型觀景台，攬視南庄獨特之壯觀儷景。設有咖啡花茶、套餐點心專區，您可選擇於室內外享用，同時欣賞光舞噴泉，入夜後山莊內燈光照明繽紛燦爛，可謂燈光美氣氛佳，清晨日出前可至裸足健康步道運動散步，同時觀賞蓮花、錦鯉，伴隨著晨曦享受這難得的清悠時光。

stays.name: 眉山居
stays.nameEn: Mei Shan Ju．Your Home In Taiwan
stays.description: 眉山居，是南庄鄉的第一家合法民宿，位於田美村，距離南庄老街車程三分鐘，屬於南庄的中心地點，往來南庄各景區，非常方便且適中。山居庭園，景色清幽，是一處心靈交流的好所在。眉山居經營項目為：民宿、咖啡、簡餐，除了有客式三合院、紅樓、三餘咖啡屋、觀景平台外，尚有一溪清流、一方荷塘、以及華麗的觀賞雞。至於庭中，則綠草如茵，繁花錦簇，可以讓訪客汲淂一身的清朗。這裡自然生態良好，不但小溪中有石蟹、溪蝦、青蛙，庭院中更是蜂蝶飛舞；而各種鳥類更多，不但在樟樹上，即使矮叢的桂花樹，亦常見到鳥巢進駐，人鳥相處和諧，變成是山居來去自如的訪客。
stays.descriptionEn: (May Shan Jhui) is located in the peaceful area of Nan-Jhuang township at the northeast corner of Miao-Li county and provides calming views of valleys and mountains. The guesthouse is composed of traditional Taiwan-Hakka style compound with a spacious courtyard and landscaped lush flowery garden with lotus pond. Along with the verdant hills and crystal streams, we create a homey guesthouse serve with mom& #39;& #39;s daily dishes and guests enjoy a feeling of refreshment with a cup of coffee or tea in our library café either outdoor garden seat. We surrounded in a well-balanced environment where wild creations are easily been found. Bees and butterflies decorate the flowery garden in spring and summer, then harmony songs of frogs always be the companion in your sweet dream at night. Colorful wild birds often reside and everything is welcoming your visit.

stays.name: 紅磚屋特色民宿
stays.description: 紅磚屋經過苗栗縣政府特色民宿評鑑委員會審查，認為它具有生態或景觀、建築、配合地方政府發展觀光產業（活動）及經營者等四項特色，是苗栗縣政府核准設立的第一家特色民宿。 紅磚屋特色民宿位於南庄鄉南江村里金館，是一個與眾不同的別墅型特色民宿。房屋由清水紅磚砌成，紅牆銀瓦與大自然渾成一體，山莊視野寬廣，園內花木扶疏，庭院綠草如茵，親子戲水池清澈見底，屋內廚房設備齊全，可自行煮炊烤肉，最適合家庭親子聚會。山莊四周民風淳樸，住宿紅磚屋，盡享台灣鄉村風情。
stays.descriptionEn: Red Brick Villa has been recognized as an outstanding B&B with the characteristics of an ecological or landscape architecture, coordinating with the local government to develop the tourism industry (activities), approved by the Characteristic B&B Review Committee of the Miaoli County Government, and thus is the first Miaoli County Government certified Characteristic Bed and Breakfast. Red Brick Villa, located in Lijin Hall, Nanjiang Village, Nanzhuang Township, is a distinctive characteristic villa style Bed and Breakfast. Built with red Shimizu brick masonry, Red Brick Villa's red walls and silver tiles were blended with nature, and the villa features a wide field of vision, luxuriant and well-spaced flowers and trees, lush grass courtyard, crystal clear family paddling pool, fully equipped kitchen and dining facilities for self cooking or barbecue, which is the most suitable for family gatherings. Embraced by simple, unadorned, honest people and folk custom, your stay at Red Brick Villa offers you the chance to enjoy the rustic charm of Taiwan.

stays.name: 老寮民宿
stays.description: 取名老寮，典故來自這片山林。客家人耕山，在山上有許多產業，台三線上，樟腦、香茅、火炭、造紙…好不熱鬧，上山工作往往十天半月，因此搭有寮社（腦寮、紙寮等）。 老，紀念著過去的風華；寮，則是暫時居所的意思，英文名字作Mountain Lodge。 More information 我們希望老寮可以是認識這片山林的入口，’讓人們透過旅行的方式一個不小心便熱烈地愛上土地。從這裡出發，老寮還有好多好多想做想去完成的事情，想重新熱鬧這片曾經繁盛的山林。

stays.descriptionEn: Two dogs, three wishes, five friends become the dream where human and dogs commonly enjoy. When Onor and Ohara introduced naivety and trust, the five friends jointly made the wishes to work hard together. Wish No.1: to find a LOHAS place for retired guide dogs who have worked hard through half of their lives; Wish No.2: Take the dogs for outings to enjoy the scenery, return with full happy memories; Wish No.3: a place where people can be at ease, dogs can be joyful and be happy together. Lush prosperous mountain woods, open grassland, golden sunshine, warm breeze and murmuring stream, this is where Dog Howls is.

stays.nameEn: Shang Shan Hui Jia Min Su
stays.description: 上山回家旅宿期望您能一起來身臨一個歷經超過五年的討論，不輕易妥協的與自然共生，與國內知名的建築事務所竹工凡木設計研究室合作，一座與原始山林共生息的建築。結合著台灣原生山林、四季美味果實山丘的旅人之宿！這裡是一間為了親近自然的旅人們而準備的旅宿。我們有一張夠大的床，讓全家人可以依偎彼此、共同聆聽一個安穩的睡前故事。在餐桌上，認識在地好蔬食，愛上真滋味、認同土地；在田園裡，看見了大自然多樣性的生態，愛惜環境，學習謙卑。

stays.name: 巧克力雲莊
stays.description: 關於巧克力雲莊2002年底,巧克力雲莊開始出現在地圖上 位在於溫泉、草莓聞名的大湖泰安鄉入口 擁有雪霸山群360度完全圍繞 從一片四公頃的原始林地逐步開墾 巧克力雲莊是夢想最初的起點 原本取名為大湖雲莊 就因一個夢想 興建一棟"巧克力專屬"的建物比百貨櫃位更精美的展示櫥窗 外觀採用歐洲斜頂與拱門造形 內裝為溫暖的歐式鄉村風 復古紅磚勾著白色花邊 原木廚櫃展示粉色壁畫和熊公仔 屋外青草如茵、綠樹農蔭、夢幻的像是座歐式莊園 2009年正式落成後 更名為 "巧克力雲莊" 巧克力雲莊集結了主人的許多夢想 美好生活的模樣 花花草草的愛好 美食享樂的主張 一個個單一的理念 變成了一朵一朵的雲彩 變成了滋味豐富的餡料 匯集成雲莊這顆層次分明的巧克力 歡迎您來雲莊 歡迎您進入我們的夢想的夢想
stays.descriptionEn: Schokolake was established in the end of 2002. It's located by the hot spring at the entrance of Dahu, Tai'an Township, which is known for their strawberries. Schokolake was built on a piece of undeveloped land covering an area of 4 hectares, completely surrounded by mountains. Originally named Dahu Yunzhuang, Schokolake was born out of a dream. The dream was to create a store exclusively for chocolate. The owner displays the chocolate confections in display cases that are more exquisite than any display cases you see at department stores. The store's exterior is a European style architecture with slanted roof tops and arched windows. The interior is a warm retro European country decor with red brick walls and white trims. Flanked by wooden cabinets, a large painting depicting cute little bears in a pastel pink background takes center stage in the Chocolate Dream Room. The lush green lawn and trees in front of the store evoke the feel of an European manor. Since the store was formally renamed Schokolake in 2009, it has been a dream come true for the owner. Everything she has created - plants, flowers and exquisite product - was a result of her vision, which was to turn fine ingredients into exquisite and delicious pieces of chocolate. We welcome you to Schokolake to share our dream.

stays.searchText: 巧克力雲莊 巧克力雲莊 苗栗縣民宿165號 苗栗縣 大湖鄉 富興村4鄰水尾坪82號 關於巧克力雲莊2002年底,巧克力雲莊開始出現在地圖上 位在於溫泉、草莓聞名的大湖泰安鄉入口 擁有雪霸山群360度完全圍繞 從一片四公頃的原始林地逐步開墾 巧克力雲莊是夢想最初的起點 原本取名為大湖雲莊 就因一個夢想 興建一棟"巧克力專屬"的建物比百貨櫃位更精美的展示櫥窗 外觀採用歐洲斜頂與拱門造形 內裝為溫暖的歐式鄉村風 復古紅磚勾著白色花邊 原木廚櫃展示粉色壁畫和熊公仔 屋外青草如茵、綠樹農蔭、夢幻的像是座歐式莊園 2009年正式落成後 更名為 "巧克力雲莊" 巧克力雲莊集結了主人的許多夢想 美好生活的模樣 花花草草的愛好 美食享樂的主張 一個個單一的理念 變成了一朵一朵的雲彩 變成了滋味豐富的餡料 匯集成雲莊這顆層次分明的巧克力 歡迎您來雲莊 歡迎您進入我們的夢想的夢想

stays.name: 日光森林
stays.description: 位在苗栗縣草莓故鄉-大湖鄉的「苗栗大湖民宿‧日光森林」，擁有寬廣的戶外庭園，無遮蔽的視野讓四周群山環繞的景色盡收眼裡，這裡的空氣清新，氣候宜人，清幽的氛圍使人忘卻了都市的塵囂與煩悶，盡情地沉浸在此，度過難忘假期！ 在「苗栗大湖民宿‧日光森林」這裡，你能擁有與大自然最親近的接觸，每個季節都能夠感受到不一樣的美麗特色，不論是年初的草莓季、春天的螢火蟲、油桐花或是夏天避暑、冬天泡湯等都能夠滿足您的心，讓您放鬆身心徜徉於此！而您也千萬不能錯過這裡最迷人的夜景唷！這可是民宿的一大特色呢！「苗栗大湖民宿‧日光森林」內提供二至四人套房，房間布置高尚，以不同色系與主題呼應，房內規劃有觀景窗戶與陽台，讓戶外綠意與陽光能夠穿透牆圍直至您身邊，房內選用木質建材來裝潢使空間帶著溫暖氣息，柔軟舒適的床褥帶您進入甜蜜的夢鄉，而齊全優質的備品細細呵護著您，如此細心的準備只為讓您在「苗栗大湖民宿‧日光森林」內能夠留下美好的難忘回憶，帶著幸福的笑容回家！倘若您對旅途或行程有任何疑問，歡迎直接電洽【0927-940227、0931-616832】「苗栗大湖民宿‧日光森林」

stays.name: 楓葉地圖民宿
stays.description: 遺世獨立般的渡假仙境一個人的假期．是悠哉二個人的世界．是浪漫三個人以上的旅行．是滿滿的幸福與歡笑循著小徑前行．楓葉地圖實現您夢想中的生活方式 . . . . . .大湖楓葉地圖民宿位於苗栗「海拔1406公尺馬拉邦山」半山腰754公尺登山入口處，是一棟充滿詩情畫意的浪漫民宿，民宿四周青山連綿，隨著季節的變化交替，時而嵐霧、雲海，每每楓紅，靜謐的山林氛圍，更悄悄地攫獲心靈。佔地十分寬廣的楓葉地圖，是馬拉邦山地區極為頂級的渡假民宿，主人家大量採用落地玻璃，讓您在屋內，細細品嚐佳餚之餘，也能無時刻地迎覽窗外的絕色景觀，輕輕啜口咖啡，美麗的假期才正要開始. . . . . .。來到楓葉地圖，只要您多看看，就會發現從建材到室內的佈置，處處是主人家巧思下獨俱創意的傑作，這裡不但提供精緻的餐飲服務外，二樓以上還規劃為住宿區，雖然這兒的房間數不多，但間間明亮清麗，傢俱的選用及擺設也相當講究，房內舒適自在的程度，肯定讓您卸下疲憊的身心一夜好眠。除了登山、賞景外，楓葉地圖相當適合全家大小及情人們來此渡假出遊，民宿的前方擁有大片的高山草莓園，提供玩家們享受採果的樂趣，倘若您對行程上有任何疑問，也歡迎洽詢店家，楓葉地圖歡迎您的蒞臨。
stays.descriptionEn: A holiday wonderland in which you can cast aside worldly cares and live independently. Spending a holiday alone is for leisure. Sharing the world with another person is romantic. Traveling with more than two people is brimming with happiness and belly-laughs. Follow the path forward, and at Maple Map Café, you may achieve your dream lifestyle. Maple Map Café B&B is located in the "Mt. Manapan of 1,406 meters in elevation" in Miaoli, and at the waist of the mountain of 754 meters in elevation, lies the idyllic romantic B&B at the start of mountaineering. The B&B is surrounded by green rolling hills with views alternating with the change of seasons, sometimes mist and fog, sometimes sea of clouds, and when the maples turn red, the tranquil ambience of the mountains quietly grabs your soul. Maple Map Café covers an extensive area, is one of highest rated resort B&Bs in Mt. Manapan. The host makes extensive use of floor to ceiling glasses, allowing you to be greeted by the stunning views of landscapes outside the windows, while savoring the delicacies in the room. Sip a cup of coffee, your beautiful holiday just starts. In the Maple Map Café, if you pay more attention to detail, you will find the host's ingenuities in everywhere from selecting building materials to the interior layouts. The B&B offers a fine dining service, and on 2nd floor accommodations, though just a few rooms, each bright and elegant room is furnished with selected furniture and sophisticated decorations. Every room is prepared particularly comfortable to make sure you have a good night's sleep after receding from the tired body and mind. Maple Map Café is quite suitable for vacation trips of a whole family or lovers. In the front part of the B&B, there is a large garden of alpine strawberries for you to enjoy the fun of picking fruit, in addition to hiking and sightseeing. If you have any questions about your trip, please contact the B&B, Maple Map Café welcomes your visit.

stays.description: 溫馨幽靜的第二個家，位於卓蘭、大湖交接的村莊-新開村，正處鯉魚潭水庫明媚風光第一排，盡覽湖光山色。民宿前方即是花之島環湖公園，無論是清晨的漫步，或是日落時分萬紫千紅的夕陽畫布，大自然多變美景的魔幻時刻，洗滌放鬆都市塵囂所帶來的緊繃壓力。房間數不多，室內挑高且寬敞舒適，每個房間各具風格，民宿的創建過程，從裡而外的設計規劃，庭院景觀的塑造、草木花卉的植栽，乃至木工、油漆、傢俱選配與陳設佈置皆由一家人親力親為協力打造，孕育出今日的樣貌，喜愛木工手作的女兒、女婿巧思巧手不曾停過，讓民宿經營數年下來，維護良好如新及不斷增添風格的手作民宿，適合小眾團體8-26人的聯誼聚會，專屬使用寬敞舒適的公共空間，烤肉聚餐、晚間飯後的小酌暢談、露臺星空電影、主人私房秘境探遊等，在LakeLily的小確幸，等你來體驗!
stays.descriptionEn: Welcome to our Bed and Breakfast in Miaoli County Dahu Township. we are located right next to the lake of the Liyutan Reservoir. you can enjoy the nice scenery by taking a stroll in the park around the lake just in front of our house. Our clean and cozy rooms are decorated in different styles. We love woodworking and handicrafts, and try to make our B&B unique and with its characters. This place is perfect for small group gathering around 8-16 people. Our BBQ grill、outdoor movie projector and spacious living room can make your gathering much more fun and enjoyable. We can take you to see beautiful sunset or if you enjoy hiking in the woods like we do, hiking in the Miaoli area is also an awesome experience. We wecome you to stay in Lake Lily and have a nice relaxing stay with us.

stays.name: 湖畔花時間
stays.description: 苗栗｜湖畔花時間．在湖畔花時間泡湯享受自然午後的山色溫柔地在眼前展開，沿著山路一路往上開，湖畔花時間，就座落在苗栗大湖山間，依山傍湖，和周圍的景色融合成一幅畫，寧靜而安詳。享受大自然真誠的歡迎下了車，沿著花草樹木及石子路走去，你會驚喜地發現主屋沿著湖畔而立，山環水繞，四周花木林立。迎面而來是清新的風和飛舞的蝴蝶，繞著木屋散個步，花香總是迎面而來，在這裡，大自然也已經為你安排了完整的行程，讓你可以好好地「花時間」享受。入住湖畔花時間，不同的套房也帶來不同氛圍，湖畔雙人溫泉房有一座面湖的景觀陽台，在有淡淡香氣的小木屋裡，與愛人及美麗的大自然對坐相望，沉靜心情，而新館的粉紅公主雙人房及四人溫泉套房，讓你感受甜蜜的假期滋味。白日，在晨光下與水畔漫步，看著湖面上母鴨帶小鴨的溫馨畫面，心情彷彿也跟著溫暖而悠閒，在這美好的湖畔邊，隨著季節轉換，時間與大自然也為你們準備了賞心悅目的禮物——可以在初春賞紫藤、櫻花，春末看油桐，深秋望楓紅，晚上在溫泉池中仰望滿天星斗，夏夜還可能巧遇螢火蟲，推開房間陽台的門，就能望見波光粼粼的湖景，湖畔花時間一年四季、白天夜晚皆給你不同的迷人景致。美景美食美人溫泉湖畔花時間不僅將大自然的美好不藏私地分享，還提供多種結合道地食材的美味食物與自釀美酒。烤草莓啤酒雞、德國豬腳，是推薦必點菜色；早餐面湖享用滿桌的中式早餐，饅頭牛奶味十足，十分可口。這裡的管家與服務人員都熱情好客，不要害羞與他們聊天，說不定還有機會被招待品嚐獨特的自釀葡萄甜酒、金桔酒呢！而俗稱「美人湯」的碳酸氫納泉也是這裡一大特色，湖畔花時間堅持提供不參雜任何一滴水或化學添加物的純淨原湯，房裡連沖澡的平日用水都是滑嫩的溫泉。不同於只有大池的大眾池，湖畔花時間的大眾溫泉館有各種不同大小、不同材質的溫泉池，有些甚至連水溫都可以控制，重新為旅人放滿一池新鮮的溫泉。
stays.descriptionEn: Miaoli｜Spend TimeSpend time soaking in hot springs and enjoying nature by the lakesideThe afternoon scenery unfolds before your eyes as you drive up into the mountains in Dahu Township, Miaoli County. There, you find Spend Time guesthouse which melds into the landscape between mountains and lakes, resembling a picturesque painting.Enjoy Mother Nature’s genuine welcomeAs you walk down the stone path from your car to the guesthouse, you are surprised to discover that the main building sits right beside the lake. Water and mountains wrap around on all sides. Vivid flowers and trees abound. You are met by a delicious breeze and dancing butterflies. As you stroll around the wooden guesthouse, you can sense that nature has already prepared a full itinerary for you.Wandering by the flowing brooks on a bright sunny day, you can observe wisteria and sakura flowers in early spring and tung oil tree blossoms toward the end of the season. In the golden autumn, the sycamores turn red and you can behold the starry sky while steeping in hot-spring pools at night. During summer evenings, you open the balcony doors and the fireflies make their debut as the lake shimmers before your eyes. Spend Time guesthouse is always ready to serve you something spectacular whenever you swing by.Beauty in the scenery, the cuisine, the people, and the hot springsAt Spend Time, not only can you enjoy all the beauty that nature unselfishly provides; various kinds of local delicacies and homemade wines are also on offer. The roasted strawberry beer chicken and German-style pig’s trotters are must-try dishes. A Chinese-style breakfast with mouthwatering steamed breads is served lake-side every morning. The housekeeper and all the staff are exceedingly hospitable. You might even have the opportunity to taste unique, homemade grape and kumquat wines.Commonly referred to as “beauty springs”, the sodium bicarbonate hot-springs are one of the distinguishing features here. Spend Time guesthouse insists on providing an authentic hot-spring experience with no extra water or chemical additives whatsoever. Even the bath in your room runs with delicate spring water. The public pools at Spend Time are made from various materials in a number of shapes and sizes, some of them with controllable water temperature, and provide travelers with a uniquely refreshing hot spring experience.Building a dreamlike garden paradiseSpend Time guesthouse is the realization of a common ideal held by two mutually supportive friends. Mr. Lin loves creative work and is captivated by art. Ms. Cai adores working in the kitchen and is also fond of gardening. After a bout of serious illness several years ago, Mr. Lin accelerated his plans to retire and open a guesthouse, inviting Ms. Cai to help him realize his dream. One of the partners took charge of designing the space, and the other took responsibility for the gardens and the creative cuisine. In this way, the seemingly parallel lives of an artist and a housewife came to intersect in the planning and implementation of a beautiful dream.Why not find a day to come “Spend Time” here? Come enjoy this dreamlike garden paradise, relax in the pure, fresh hot spring, savor the gentle surroundings, and delight in the simple pleasures of nature.

stays.descriptionEn: A quiet privacy accommodation that allows you to stay away from the hubbub of cities, free you from complicated chores, and you can listen to the mysteries of natural daybreak and nightfall. We offer open-air baths, including hot bathtubs, room temperature pools, SPA hot & cool tubs, steams, ovens and other facilities. Located on the high point of the park with excellent views, you can enjoy taking a bath, while watching mountains, trees, clouds, to be contented by free and at leisure.

stays.name: 土牧驛健康農莊
stays.description: 出生在世居務農的原住民小部落的三兄弟（老大黃見德、老二黃見初、老三黃見龍），憶起小時候的環境，沒有電燈、稻田玩耍、赤腳上學、養豬澆菜、放陷井、拉竹子、野溪射魚及幫忙家事煮飯等熱情天真的童年生活，懷念不已。轉眼間，50年過去了，生命已走了大半的旅程，現在所追求的是回饋與寧靜，期望在有限的生命裡，努力追求健康、平安、感恩與簡單的日子。於是乎，三兄弟激起了「落葉歸根」的想法，期望祖先的榮耀能降臨給我，並與部落的族人一起營造健康的生活環境。 為了貼近自然，接近山水，營造健康的目的，心中燃起一個夢想就是擁有一個屬於自己的健康農莊，以簡單、自然、樸實的方式呈現，讓庸懶悠閒的人生陪伴著大自然，並分享給所有喜歡這裡的好朋友。三兄弟於20年前積極購地，97年4月開始回到部落規劃，緊接著設計，於同年11月22日施工，最後於98年10月3日正式完工啟用，我們三兄弟以2年餘的時間，將這健康的農莊建造完成。這裡的山水非常優美，氣候宜人，是一個未經開發的人間仙境，處處可以發現很多讓人驚奇的地方，希望讓來到此地的遊客，都能像遨遊瑞士般的美好感受。「土牧驛－Tumuyi」是我父親的原住民名字，過去務農，生活清苦，因一時疏忽，在38歲那年突然高血壓離開了我們，為了感念及懷念父親養育之恩，勤奮刻苦與助人為樂的大愛精神，並喚醒我們後代子孫都能重視自己的健康，本農莊才以「土牧驛－Tumuyi健康農莊」為命名。
stays.descriptionEn: The three brothers (Huang Jiande, the eldest, Huang Jianchu, the second, and Huang Jianlong, the youngest), born in a family in farming for generations of Aboriginal small tribe, cherish the memory of the living environment of their innocent, passionate childhood of without lights, playing in the rice fields, going to school barefooted, feeding pigs, watering vegetables, setting up traps, pulling bamboo, shooting fish in streams, cooking and helping with housework. Suddenly, 50 years later, our journeys of life have mostly gone, and now what we are looking for is feedback and serenity, and wish to pursue a healthy, peaceful, and simple life in their remaining years. Ever since, we have been thinking of "a falling leaf returns to the roots" and hoped that ancestral glory can come to us to help us creating a healthy living environment with the tribesmen together. To be closer to nature, closer to the waters and mountains, and closer to creating a healthy cause, we have a dream to own a health farm, render it in a simple, natural, earthy way to allow us to have a lazy laid-back life accompanied by nature and share it with all good friends who like here. Three brothers then actively brought the land 20 years ago. Beginning in April 2008, they have returned to tribe planning, followed by designing, in the same year on November 22 they started the construction, and officially completed the building and opened for business on October 3, 2009. We, three brothers, spent more than 2 years to complete the construction of this healthy farm. Here has very beautiful landscapes, pleasant climate, and is an unexplored paradise on earth, where you can find a lot of amazing things in every corner. We hope the staying tourists can have the beautiful feelings comparable to traveling to the Swiss. "Tumuyi" is my father's indigenous name. In the past, he was a farmer battling through hardship to live, inadvertently, at 38 years old, he died of hypertension and suddenly left us. To recall fondly and cherish the memory of father's kindness of bringing up us, hardworking, and helpful spirit of great love, and to awaken our descendants to attach importance to their health, the farm villa is therefore named "Tumuyi Healthy Resort."

stays.name: 日出溫泉渡假飯店
stays.description: 山路的蜿蜒崎嶇正是旅程中最好的心情醞釀，直到看到"日出"的驚豔，才能體會實現的欣喜。苗62線盡頭，躍動的溫泉生命與人文意涵正躲藏在山坳後的印象峇里中。來到這片綠意盎然的世外桃源，盡情享受大地之母孕育出富含大地元素的生命之泉，以及在那和煦陽光與潔淨空氣的洗滌下，心靈再次獲得能量。此時，在旭日東昇的那一刻，生命的悸動油然而生，源源不息!! 森林精靈隱身在夜空下，深邃的黑暗中是一盞盞的童趣驚喜。對於這些「驚喜」，剎那，我們給他一個代名詞－「日出」。新朋友們都會問起的同一個話題「為何叫做日出，那陰天呢？…下雨天呢？…」，我總好整以暇的說道：「日出不一定在天上，他在我們所有同仁的心中、也在我們所有同仁的臉上；更希望透過日出溫泉渡假飯店，這樣的陽光燦爛也能都在你的臉上、你的心中」。而你……是客人、亦是家人。
stays.descriptionEn: Wiggling on the mountain roads is the best brewing for the trip, until you see the SUNRISE, you would experience the amazing so you could experience the happiness you long for has came true. At the end of Miaoli No. 62, the enlivened spa life and cultural implications is hiding at the mountain cols as if the expression of Bali.Come to this green Arcadia, enjoy Mother of Nature which gives the birth of ground element of life and under the genial sunshine and washed by the clean air, your sprit would gain the energy again. At the moment, the time that Sun comes up from the east, feels the life is throbbing, endless!! Forest fairy hides under the night sky, in the deep darkness, there are surprises from the memory of child. About these “surprises,” right at the moment, we named “SUNRISE.”New friends always ask why “SUNRISE” what about cloudy days, what about raining days? I always reply leisurely: SUNRISE may not only in the sky, it’s also on our staff’s minds, on our staff’s faces; We also hope by visiting Sunrise Hot Spring Hotel, such sunshine would reflect on your faces and minds. And you are……customers, also families.

stays.searchText: 日出溫泉渡假飯店 日出峇里溫泉飯店股份有限公司 苗栗縣旅館046號 苗栗縣 泰安鄉 錦水村橫龍山34號 山路的蜿蜒崎嶇正是旅程中最好的心情醞釀，直到看到"日出"的驚豔，才能體會實現的欣喜。苗62線盡頭，躍動的溫泉生命與人文意涵正躲藏在山坳後的印象峇里中。來到這片綠意盎然的世外桃源，盡情享受大地之母孕育出富含大地元素的生命之泉，以及在那和煦陽光與潔淨空氣的洗滌下，心靈再次獲得能量。此時，在旭日東昇的那一刻，生命的悸動油然而生，源源不息!! 森林精靈隱身在夜空下，深邃的黑暗中是一盞盞的童趣驚喜。對於這些「驚喜」，剎那，我們給他一個代名詞－「日出」。新朋友們都會問起的同一個話題「為何叫做日出，那陰天呢？…下雨天呢？…」，我總好整以暇的說道：「日出不一定在天上，他在我們所有同仁的心中、也在我們所有同仁的臉上；更希望透過日出溫泉渡假飯店，這樣的陽光燦爛也能都在你的臉上、你的心中」。而你……是客人、亦是家人。

stays.searchText: 虎山溫泉會館 山泰開發事業股份有限公司 苗栗縣旅館057號 苗栗縣 泰安鄉 錦水村圓墩73-1號 虎山溫泉會館舊稱「圓墩仔」，因汶水溪中留有一座蝕餘小島而得名，方圓約1.8公頃由無數堅硬砂岩構成，周圍谷身清流，景色清幽，原是無人居住之荒島。民國六十三年，旅日范姓華僑路經該地，見景色秀麗，立即許願投資開發，設置綠園館(今虎山溫泉會館)；民國七十八年易手於山泰開發事業股份有限公司李泰裕董事長，是唯一於苗栗縣泰安鄉鄊誌具有官方文獻資料記載，泰安溫泉觀光區第一家具有指標性特色，也是全台灣絕無僅有小島營運之旅館，溪水環繞四周，有吊橋與汶水溪南岸相連，島上花木扶疏，環境清幽，營運至今近三十二年光景。

stays.name: 觀霧山莊
stays.description: 觀霧山莊位於觀霧國家森林遊樂區及雪霸國家公園範圍內，四季景觀分明，是夏季避暑的好去處，。自從大鹿林道開闢之後，美麗的景緻吸引了許多遊客慕名前來。為提供來到觀霧的遊客能有更完善的旅遊服務，設有住宿、餐廳及販賣部。此外，觀霧山莊除了可以遠眺著名的聖稜線外，觀霧國寶之霧社櫻，每年3月開著秀麗的白色花朵，是台灣本土最美的白色櫻花，讓觀霧山莊更增添幾分美感。然而最重要的，是在地泰雅族及賽夏族豐富的人文資源。

stays.name: 八角居所民宿
stays.description: -----------自然純淨的生活探索----------- 歡迎您到訪民宿八角居所 樹守護著地球；樹爺爺們守護著八角居所！二百多歲的茄苳爺爺，領著老樟、赤桐、山櫻、青楓、貝殼杉、櫸木、真柏、蒲葵、五葉松、二葉松、赤松、落羽松和黒松，以及楊梅、杏桃、油柑、綠竹林，山茶花、杜鵑、桂花、流蘇、樹蘭、紫薇、麒麟花、鷄蛋花…,，群居在山巒環抱的三千坪林園，演繹著生生不息的大自然傳奇。「Aroundthetree 」-八角居所的英文名字。的確，走到哪兒樹總圍繞著你，你也總繞著樹。在樹的婆娑光影中，吮吸清新甜美的空氣，送往迎來凌晨的夜鷺、入夜的樹蛙，和飄忽不定的鳥雀蝶蛾，偶遇松鼠探頭問訊，莞爾對望，不覺心花燦放。八角居所一樓有一間洋溢地中海風的餐廳「白廳」[ Grand White Hall ]及莊園酒吧、一間也扮演包廂餐廳的水畔閱讀室「小白廳」[ Le Petit White Hall ]、以及另一間備有80吋寬螢幕電視和發燒音響的「黑白辣歌劇院」[ The Opera Hall ]。二樓有寬敞舒適的客房，都擁有望山親樹的私密陽台。 夏綠蒂•勃朗特名著「簡愛」筆下的「曼菲爾德山莊」重現八角，以純白之姿，巍峨矗立在廣茅的綠映中。這??，自然與奢華共浴； 美食與健康相戀！ 山野靈氣洗滌身心； 藝文音樂愉悅性??！八角居所…不來可惜、來了驚喜！Michael & Lisa 邀您 心適來作夥，歡喜來作陣！ 「八角」你我共同的「居所」
stays.descriptionEn: ----------- Discover the natural and pure life ----------- Welcome to Aroundthetree Manor The trees protect the Earth, while the aged trees protect Aroundthetree Manor! The red cedar tree of over 200 years old is the king among the old camphor trees, India coral trees, Taiwan cherries, green maples, dammar pines, Taiwan zelkova, Chinese Juniper, fan palms, Taiwan white pines, Taiwan red pines, Japanese red pines, bald cypresses, and Japanese black pines, as well as Chinese bayberry trees, apricot trees, Indian gooseberry trees, green bamboo forest, camellia, azalea, sweet olives, Chinese fringe-trees, orchid trees, common crepe myrtle, Bojers Spurge, plumeria, etc. to grow and multiply without end in the forest. "Aroundthetree," that is our name. Indeed, wherever you go, the trees are around you.

stays.description: 位於苗栗縣獅潭鄉的桂橘園民宿，矗立在台三線上，灰白相間的的嶄新建築，成為顯著的地標，這裡可遠眺獅潭青山綠水美景，寬廣的活動空間，是中秋賞月的絕佳選擇！民宿主人黃榮宗先生退休後和家人一同回到家鄉獅潭，期望打造一個優質的居家空間，在屋舍興建過程中興起經營民宿的念頭。 民宿緊鄰群山環繞的台三線，與藍天只有一個仰頭的距離，面對群山萬壑，望遠印入眼簾的是整山谷的翠綠；大吸一口氣，滿山林的清新立即竄入鼻間；日出晨曦之景可比清境，幸運的話，還可看見鷹翱翔天空的霸氣之姿。日頭落山，夜幕低垂，浩瀚蒼穹滿掛繁星點點。蛙鳴、鳥叫、桂花香、砌上一壺好茶，在最自然的環境，享受都市沒有的生活，如此難得、難得愜意…。一處讓人感受家的溫暖、豐厚人情味、回味古早童玩、客家味早點、讓旅人再三流連的真正民宿。 桂橘園民宿有寬敞的草坪、賞月陽台、專用室內停車位，提供寧靜舒適的環境與悠閒的鄉間情調，無論是全家或團體出遊，都可以盡情享受庭園樂趣，桂橘園歡迎您的蒞臨！
stays.descriptionEn: Gui Ju Yuan B&B, located in Shihtan (Shitan) , Miaoli, stands in beside Highway No. 3, is a new building with gray and white and a significant landmark. From here you can overlook the pleasant country scene of Shihtan mountains, and having a spacious space; it is an excellent choice of place for enjoying the Mid-Autumn Festival. Mr. Huang Rongzong, the innkeeper, brought his family together back to hometown Shihtan after retirement, and decided to build a high-quality living space for home, During building the house, he had an idea to ​​operate a B&B. The B&B is located close to Taiwan Highway No. 3 surrounded by mountains. To close the distance between you and the sky is only to raise your head, and when facing the myriad of mountains, you catch the view of the greeting emerald green of the whole valley. Take a deep breath, you then inhale the freshness of the mountains immediately. The dawn of sunrise at here is comparable to that of Cingjing (Qingjing) Farm. If lucky enough, you are able to watch the domineering posture of an eagle soaring in the sky. When the sun goes down, night falls, and the vast starry sky is hanging over. While frogs croak, birds chirp, sweet Osmanthuses give off a fragrance, you brew a pot of tea and enjoy the life unavailable in the city but available in the most natural environment. A place you feel the warmth of home with rich real human interest, where you can have fun of playing the toys of old days, and breakfast of Hakka flavor. A real B&B the travelers have frequented repeatedly. Gui Ju Yuan offers spacious lawns, moon watching balcony, private indoor parking spaces, featuring a quiet and comfortable environment and relaxing countryside ambience. Whether it is family or group outings, you can enjoy the pleasure of a pleasance. Welcome to Gui Ju Yuan.

stays.description: 苗栗芝柏山商務汽車旅館位於竹南鎮火車站前，光復路右轉1公里處，鄰近竹南工業區、廣源科學園區及竹南科學園區，距中山高、北二高及西濱交通相當便利，環境優雅，寧靜雅緻，是商務洽公、旅遊休閒-苗栗竹南住宿的最佳選擇。 芝柏山商務汽車旅館內整體RC結構建造，消防安檢合格，房內設施多元完善、雙人按摩浴缸，冷暖氣設備，免費提供寬頻網路，服務親切，清潔度高，歡迎親臨鑑賞。 竹南芝柏山MOTEL周邊景點相當豐富，如：大湖採草莓、明德水庫、泰安溫泉、薰衣草森林、香格里拉、南庄風景區、獅頭山、台灣啤酒廠、慈裕宮、龍鳳宮、五穀王宮等眾多廟宇、通霄海洋園區、飛牛牧場、四方牧場、崎頂海水浴場、西濱風力發電、新竹南寮漁港等等，再到龍鳳漁港看日落吃新鮮海產。
stays.descriptionEn: Zhi Baishan Motel is right in front of the Zhunan Station, Miaoli. If you turn right on the Guangfu Rd. and keep going for approx. 1km, you can see our motel. The location of Zhi Baishan Motel is in the vicinity of the Zhunan Industrial Park, Guangyuan Science Park and Zhunan Science Park and conveniently connects to the Sun Yat-sen Freeway, Formosa Freeway and West Coast Expressway. The graceful and peaceful environment is your best choice for traveling and going on business trip to Zhunan, Miaoli. Zhi Baishan Motel is built with reinforced concrete construction and meets every possible fire safety standard. The rooms are well-equipped, including whirlpool tubs for two, heating/cooling air conditioning and free WiFi. Welcome you to experience our kind services and clean environment by yourself. There are numerous scenic spots around Zhi Baishan Motel , such as Dahu strawberry garden, Mingte Dam, Tai'an Hot Spring, Lavender CottAge, Shangrila Paradise, Nanjhuang Scenic Area, Shitou Mountain, Taiwan Beer Factory, Cihyu Temple, Longfeng Temple, Wugu Temple, Tung-Hsiao West-Educational Sea World, Flying Cow Ranch, Sihfang Ranch, Qiding Haishui Yuchang, West Coast Wind Farm, Nanliao Harbor, etc. You can taste fresh sea food and admire sunset at Longfeng Harbor at the end of the day.

stays.name: 馥藝金鬱金香酒店
stays.description: 飯店概要:苗栗馥藝金鬱金香酒店為苗栗縣唯一國際品牌之星級國際觀光飯店，巴洛克式的建築矗立於苗栗縣竹南鎮。191間客房的設計均以旅客的需求為導向，每間客房面積均超過12坪以上。緊鄰萬坪運動公園及苗北藝文中心，加上戶外歐式中庭花園，散發歐洲貴族居所的大器，低調的奢華為旅客停留苗栗的首選。品牌介紹:金鬱金香集團於1962年誕生於荷蘭，同年也是荷蘭最大的旅館集團。1975年，集團與荷蘭皇家航空公司策略聯盟。1993年，集團推出三星級飯店品牌Tulip Inn (鬱金香旅店)。2006年，集團推出五星級飯店品牌Royal Tulip (皇家金鬱金香)。2009年，集團被喜達屋資本集團收購，並與羅浮宮酒店集團簽署戰略聯盟。此時，金鬱金香酒店集團已成為歐洲第2大的連鎖飯店旅館集團，在全球超過54個國家管理經營超過1,554家旅館，總計客房數超過120,000間。預計在2022年達到全球超過2,000家旅館之規模。地理位置飯店位於竹南、頭份市區交接，轄屬炙手可熱的重劃區商業用地區段，正公園路旁，面對萬坪運動公園，緊傍演藝廳機關用地地標顯著，進出30米永貞路與50米中央路條條大道，鄰近中山高速公路、第二高速公路、台ㄧ線、台十三線等道路以及鐵路系統，交通網路完善便利。來此區域洽公的國內外專業人士只需透過大眾運輸工具即可解決交通問題，往來竹南科學園區車程只要5-10分鐘，無論是商務洽公或是竹苗地區景點觀光休閒住宿都具備交通的便利與指標性。

It is situated opposite a 33,000 square meters of scenery park and walking distance to Northern Miaoli Art Center. Golden Tulip becomes No. 2 hotel group in Europe by scale, operates 1,554 hotels in 54 countries, and number of rooms has exceeds 120,000 rooms. Located at the intersection of Jhunan and Toufen urban, in a hottest commercial sections of re-zoned land, beside Gongyuan Road, facing Wan Ping Sports Park, right beside the Auditorium organ land, a notable landmark, access to 30 m Yongjhen Road and 50 m Zhongyang Road, and others, close to National Highway 1, National Highway 3, Taiwan Highway No 1, and No. 13 and other roads and rail systems, has a perfect convenient transportation network. Business travelers, domestic or international, can simply use public transportation to solve transportation problems. Shuttle between Chunan Science Park and the Hotel takes only 5-10 minutes drive. Whether for business trip or stay for leisure activities in attractions of Hsinchu and Miaoli areas, the Hotel has the convenience of transportation.

stays.name: 享沐時光
stays.description: 蘊育種種傳統文化、處處皆有歷史痕跡的苗栗苑裡小鎮，素有「苗栗穀倉」、「藺草原鄉」等美譽，這些藝文歷史在一群返鄉青年努力下復興發揚，綿延不絕傳承世世代代。一間滿足旅人休閒的渡假莊園酒店在這經典小鎮揭開序幕，扎根於此，它座落於火炎山山腳下，它飽覽一望無際沖積扇平原，它，名為「享沐時光」。前往「享沐時光」的路途，行駛寬敞鄉道間，兩旁圍繞田野風光，春季秧苗嫩綠，生機勃勃；夏天綠油油稻田隨風擺盪，綠色波浪起起伏伏；秋天飽滿黃金稻穗，飄散陣陣稻香；冬季休耕為來年做準備，栽種花卉形成別樣花海風光，抬頭仰望蒼穹更是能將廣闊蔚藍全數盡收眼底，這是城市沒有的風景，這是鄉村獨有的悠閒寧靜．享沐時光備有90間客房，共有11種房型，每間寬敞舒適的客房都擁有獨立溫泉湯池，供旅人在房內就能享受泡湯樂趣。． 設有10間湯屋、裸湯風呂、露天風呂及戶外游泳池，旅人可以自由隨心選擇想要的泡湯方式。．「享宴」宴會廳、「沐食」餐廳、「時漫」咖啡廳、「光苑」戶外露臺、遊戲及閱讀區、KTV、室內觀景台等多樣區域的規劃，將帶給賓客極致享受。
stays.descriptionEn: Miaoli Yuanli is a small town with traditional breeding culture and historical traces everywhere. It is known as "Miaoli Barn" and "Lin Grassland Township".These artistic and cultural history are revitalized and carried forward under the efforts of a group of returning youths. Passed on from generation to generation.A vacation manor hotel that satisfies travellers' leisure kicked off in this classic town. It is rooted here. It is located at the foot of the Huoyan Mountain. It overlooks the endless alluvial fan plain. It is called "Enjoy the Time".On the way to "enjoy the time", drive through the spacious country roads, surrounded by field scenery, spring seedlings are green and vibrant; summer green rice fields swing with the wind, green waves ups and downs; autumn full of golden rice ears, floating bursts of rice Fragrant; fallow in winter to prepare for the coming year, planting flowers to form a unique scenery of the sea of ​​flowers, looking up at the sky will give you a panoramic view of the vast blue sky. This is a landscape that the city does not have. This is the unique leisure and tranquility of the countryside. There are 90 rooms, 11 types of rooms, each spacious and comfortable room has its own hot spring bath, so that travelers can enjoy the fun of bathing in the room.. There are 10 hot spring baths, naked hot spring baths, open-air baths and outdoor swimming pools. Travelers can freely choose the bathing method they want.. The planning of various areas such as "Xianyan" banquet hall, "Music" restaurant, "Time Man" coffee shop, "Guangyuan" outdoor terrace, game and reading area, KTV, indoor observation deck, etc. will bring guests the ultimate enjoyment .

stays.searchText: 享沐時光 揚悅旅館股份有限公司 苗栗縣旅館086號 苗栗縣 苑裡鎮 石鎮里錦山8-1、8-2號 蘊育種種傳統文化、處處皆有歷史痕跡的苗栗苑裡小鎮，素有「苗栗穀倉」、「藺草原鄉」等美譽，這些藝文歷史在一群返鄉青年努力下復興發揚，綿延不絕傳承世世代代。一間滿足旅人休閒的渡假莊園酒店在這經典小鎮揭開序幕，扎根於此，它座落於火炎山山腳下，它飽覽一望無際沖積扇平原，它，名為「享沐時光」。前往「享沐時光」的路途，行駛寬敞鄉道間，兩旁圍繞田野風光，春季秧苗嫩綠，生機勃勃；夏天綠油油稻田隨風擺盪，綠色波浪起起伏伏；秋天飽滿黃金稻穗，飄散陣陣稻香；冬季休耕為來年做準備，栽種花卉形成別樣花海風光，抬頭仰望蒼穹更是能將廣闊蔚藍全數盡收眼底，這是城市沒有的風景，這是鄉村獨有的悠閒寧靜．享沐時光備有90間客房，共有11種房型，每間寬敞舒適的客房都擁有獨立溫泉湯池，供旅人在房內就能享受泡湯樂趣。． 設有10間湯屋、裸湯風呂、露天風呂及戶外游泳池，旅人可以自由隨心選擇想要的泡湯方式。．「享宴」宴會廳、「沐食」餐廳、「時漫」咖啡廳、「光苑」戶外露臺、遊戲及閱讀區、KTV、室內觀景台等多樣區域的規劃，將帶給賓客極致享受。

stays.name: 任意宿民宿
stays.description: N-Square hostel任意。宿位於台灣環島海線必經路線上，離苑裡火車站走路只要5分鐘，無論是徒步、騎車、開車、坐火車皆可輕易抵達，客棧位於鎮中心，附近就有便利商店、生活百貨、超級市場、餐廳小吃店，採買、覓食都非常方便喔!!簡約舒適的環境提供背包客及環島的旅人一個休息放鬆、分享交流的空間，雖沒有華麗的裝潢，但溫暖的人情味，將為你的旅途充電並帶來滿滿正能量。
stays.descriptionEn: N-square is a Hostel in Yuanli, a small town between Hsinchuand Taichung. There isn’t really touristy. So if you want to get an impression of local Taiwanese life, N-square is the perfect place to stay at. We really appreciate to welcome and host any of you guys out there.

stays.name: 綠意山莊民宿
stays.description: 綠意山莊民宿位於苗栗的苑裡鎮。苑裡是富有深厚文化的小鎮，除了是苗栗穀倉外，還有著藺草原鄉的美名。除此之外，更被喻為紅磚的故鄉，小鎮也保留許多相當豐富的歷史文化。民宿主人希望藉由成立揚昊民宿，讓旅人沉浸於大自然懷抱中，享受山間美好時光。綠意山莊民宿提供獨一無二的山林生活與自然景觀，藉此讓入住的旅人，感受當地的文化、生活與食物，一起走進苑裡小鎮探索人文歷史、美景美食及深度體驗。

stays.description: 伽芝萊民宿就是「自己來」民宿，為合法民宿及國民旅遊卡特約店，園內有1200顆桂花，盛開時散發濃郁桂花香，生態池、綠茵如畫的庭園適合親子遊玩與員工旅遊。海洋、峇里島等多樣特色套房，讓您住上一晚永生難忘，獨特通風的天井設計，空氣能對流，陽光更可灑落在大廳裡。遊古道、賞桐花、賞螢、抓蝦、採果，享受到放鬆舒適的優質住宿。
stays.descriptionEn: Come 2 Here B&B is pronounced "Jiā Zhī Lái" B&B, a legal B&B and a merchant of the National Travel Card. The park has planted 1,200 Osmanthus, distributing rich fragrance when in bloom, an ecological pond, green picturesque garden, and is suitable for family outings or staff travels. Offers diverse specialty suites, including Ocean, Bali, and others, to make your stay a night unforgettable. Uniquely designed airy patio with air convection allows the sunshine spills in the hall. Take a trip to historic trails, tour Tung blossom, watch fireflies, catch shrimp, pick fruits; you can enjoy the relaxed and comfortable quality accommodation.

stays.name: 欣達休閒旅館 (在飛牛牧場內)
stays.description: 位於苗栗縣的旅館【全國第一家】經行政院農委會專案輔導成功且取得【許可登記證】之【綜合型休閒農場】。以“自然、健康、歡樂”為創園宗旨；稟持“品質創新、親切和諧、永續環保”為經營理念；期許提供【優質的自然休憩空間及三生合一的農村休閒體驗生活】；希望能藉由“親近大自然”的生活體驗中，學習“尊重大自然”，並力行“愛護大自然”！園區內有“乳牛生態教學活動區、自然步道蝴蝶園區、羊ㄇㄟㄇㄟ親子體驗園區、可愛動物生活園區、DIY教學歡樂體驗園區、水循環生態教育園區”等【六大歡樂體驗主題園區】。每日定時定點安排免費的“牛媽媽擠牛奶教學體驗、餵小牛喝ㄋㄟㄋㄟ、鴨BB大遊行”親子同樂體驗等活動外；也讓您親自體驗“擁抱可愛小動物”、“餵羊吃草”的樂趣；漫步在酚多精的自然步道中與蝶共舞、徜徉在牧野草原的知性懷抱裡。除此之外，牧場主人更精心的將“鮮奶”生活化在“歡樂DIY體驗園區”裡；提供“冰淇淋搖搖樂、搖滾瓶中信、牛奶雞蛋糕、及彩繪肥牛”等多元DIY體驗活動，讓大家可以歡樂學手藝帶回家；在滿足的喜悅驚奇中，擁有一座屬於自己的自然牧場。【美食～五大特色餐飲】有提供牧場風味合菜、義式麵食套餐、可口特色鍋品、美式速食套餐、野趣BBQ烤肉，五大主題餐飲服務；不僅是多元的選擇，更讓您可以儘情“饗”受。【住宿～溫馨氛圍風格】提供【牧場原憩】40間之住宿服務。【牧場原憩】以簡樸休閒風格設計；提供兩層樓～1F、2F各20間閤家套房。牧場裡生產多種自製乳製品～有特濃牛奶糖、冰淇淋、牛軋糖、牛奶蛋捲、優格、奶酪、濃郁鮮奶、新鮮起司、鮮奶麵包、牛奶饅頭；更引進日本北海道獨一配方及精湛生產技術，共同研製出極具特色可口白布丁，滿載而歸是必然的。此外，鮮乳保養品系列、牧場特色紀念品…等近千種獨家商品，更可讓您夯心享購；將豐盛多采的感受體驗分享予親朋好友！
stays.descriptionEn: Hotel located in Miaoli County【Flying Cow Ranch~ The Best Natural Farm in Taiwan】We are the most successful complex leisure farm which is the first one to get a qualified license from Council of Agriculture, Executive Yuan. Our purposes are “ Natural、healthy、Joyous”; the operation principles are “ quality innovation、gracious、harmonious and environmental protection.” We would like to provide the high quality leisure farm which can experience the Natural life, then hope everyone can learn how to esteem, cherish the Natural and to safeguard it by getting closely to Natural.There are six topic joyous areas in our our farm. They are “Dairy Cattle Learning Activity Area”、 “Butterfly Area with natural footpath”、“Lamb Family Experience Area”、“Pretty Animals Area” “DIY Area”、“Water Circles Ecology Education Area” and so on. We have the free shows like “milking the cows”、“feeding the calves” and “walking the ducks” that the parents can make fun with their children. Walking in the natural world with lots of butterflies that just like in mother’s arms. Moreover, the master of farm puts many activities of milk for service customers in DIY Area. There are making ice creams、baking cookies、rocking 、bottle letter、tossing butter、making cakes and painting the cows potter’s clay. All the finished goods can carry to home with tourists.【Delicacies~ The Five Trait Food & Dining】We offer the multiple delicious foods . The Taiwanese Table d’hote、Spaghetti Meals、Hot Pot、Fast Food and Barbecues. You can choose and enjoy all of them by yourself. 【Taste & Shopping】 A lot of dairy products are made by ourselves, Milk Candies、Ice Cream、Nougat with Peanut、 Milk Egg Rolls、Yogurt、Milk Curd、Milk、Fresh Cheese、Milk Bread and Steamed Milk Bun. We introduce a new recipe and technology to come up with special white pudding. Furthermore, you can go shopping in our farm with the thousand of goods for your family or friends, like Milk Cosmetics and Local Souvenirs.

Here, chickens, ducks, and geese are free-range, vegetables are grown using eco-friendly, toxin-free farming methods, and multiple natural springs can be found. The goal is to create a habitat suitable for butterflies, dragonflies, birds, and various wildlife.

stays.name: 翠松苑民宿
stays.description: 飛牛牧場旁園藝民宿『翠松苑盆栽民宿』位於苗栗通霄，鄰近飛牛牧場，沿途風景秀麗，四季多變(柚子花、木棉花、油桐花、波斯菊、向日葵、油菜花)。『翠松苑』園中種滿數百棵五葉松，空氣自然清新；百年茄苳樹下享用早餐，還可享受花草樹木環繞的大自然饗宴。鄉村風情休閒體驗園區活動有烤肉、泡茶、賞星及螢火蟲、抓溪蝦、焢窯、米食DIY、季節性採果及當地農產業風味健康餐，另可安排通霄深度一～二日遊行程，深刻體驗藝文鄉村風情休閒體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: A Horticultural B&B next to the Flying Cow Ranch. "Cui Song Yuan Bonsai Bed and Breakfast" is located in Tongsiao (Tongxiao), Miaoli, close to the Flying Cow Ranch. Beautiful scenery along the way to the B&B varies with changing seasons (grapefruit flowers, cotton trees, Tung flowers, cosmos, sunflowers, canola flowers)." Over hundreds of Taiwan White Pines has been planted in the garden of "Cui Song Yuan," providing natural, fresh air. Have your breakfast under century-old Autumn maple tree, while enjoy the nature& #39;s feast of surrounding flowers and trees. Rustic Leisure Experience Activities featured in the park of Cui Song Yuan include barbecue, tea parties, stargazing and firefly tours, creek shrimp catching, kiln smothered cooking, rice diet DIY, seasonal fruit picking, and healthy meals of local agricultural flavors. In addition, a 1-day or 2-day Depth Tongsiao (Tongxiao) Journey can be arranged to experience profoundly the rustic art and leisure.

stays.name: 飛螢農莊
stays.description: 飛螢農莊 座落在通宵鎮福興里南勢溪上游與保安林交界的半山腰上，三面環抱著翠綠的山巒，潺潺小溪穿過幽谷，緩緩流經屋前，奇花異卉佈滿庭院，是一棟環境清幽典型的農家三合院。飛螢農莊提供遊客賞螢火蟲、聽鳥、泡茶聊天、游泳戲水、安排渡假民宿品嚐鄉野小吃的最佳去處。園區周為佈滿溼地，每年的春秋時節，本地盛產火金姑。每到夜晚山澗水邊，屋前屋後，飛螢點點最為迷人，所以命名為『飛螢農莊』。位於半山腰，環境純淨，極少污染，因此每年的3~11月可以看到黃緣螢、台灣窗螢、大端黑螢在山間飛舞，點點亮光，是大自然最美麗的畫面。飛螢農莊是一個融合自然、健康與永續理念的綜合性民宿，位於螢火蟲生態復育區，提供多元的服務項目，旨在讓每位遊客能在親近大自然的同時，體驗放鬆、學習與自我療癒的過程。農莊的服務包括住宿、餐飲、DIY體驗、生態導覽、環境教育，以及專業的森林療癒活動，無論是追求休閒的旅客，還是渴望身心放鬆的朋友，都能在這裡找到屬於自己的放鬆之道。
stays.descriptionEn: Firefly Farm is located on the hillside at the junction of the protected forest and the upstream of Nanshi River in Fuxing Village, Tongsiao Township, surrounded by the green hills in three directions. A babbling brook flows across the valley and slowly passes through the front of the house. A courtyard covered with floral. It is a typical quiet Sanhe Yuan farmhouse. Firefly Farm offers visitors the activities including watching fireflies, listening to birds, tea and chat, swimming and playing with water. It is the best place to enjoy the countryside snacks in an arranged vacation. Covered with wetlands around the park, the place is rich in fireflies during the annual spring season. At night, mountains and waters, in front of the house and behind the house, are dotted with charming flickering fireflies; therefore the name "Firefly Farm." Located halfway up the mountain, it is a clean environment with minimal pollution, so every year from March to November you can enjoy Luciola ficta Olivier, Pyrocoelia analis, and Luciola anceyi flying in the mountains dotting the lights. It is one of nature's most beautiful pictures. Firefly Farm is a comprehensive B&B that integrates the concepts of nature, health and sustainability. It is located in the Firefly Ecological Restoration Area and provides a variety of services. It aims to allow every visitor to experience the process of relaxation, learning and self-healing while getting close to nature. The farm's services include accommodation, catering, DIY experiences, ecological tours, environmental education, and professional forest healing activities. Whether you are a traveler pursuing leisure or a friend who desires to relax physically and mentally, you can find your own way to relax here.
