stays.name: 泓揚精緻商旅
stays.description: 土木、建築系所畢業，註定了漂泊的工作方式。從高雄到台北、台灣到大陸、遠赴世界各地有工作、有事業、有辛酸也有歡樂；穿梭無數的城市，落腳各式旅店；繁華抑或純樸的街景有著同樣的銀色月光，街燈下五星酒店有著奢華的裝潢、舒適的名床，商務旅館設備一般、侷促的空間裡只能擺放著長度略嫌不足又有點硬的床。它們給我唯一的共同感觸是-有點冰冷沒有家的溫暖，枕頭聞不到自己的味道；夜深了湧上絲絲落寞鄉愁….想家。 我們有一身好本領可以幫人們規劃、設計、建造、裝潢一個美麗、舒適、溫暖又安全的家。而因全球村高度發展下以四海為家各地駐泊的族群們，內心渴望所停泊的旅店「像家」。於是，「泓揚精緻商旅-竹」誕生了，就在我們的家鄉-陽光、美麗的海港城-南台灣-高雄市。七賢二路上一棟不起眼的舊大樓，用我們的專業、用心與執著賦予它新生命；冀盼因商務、工作、旅遊而離家，因緣分而落腳泓揚精緻商旅的你都有-回家的感覺、居家的舒適、在家的放鬆。來吧！成為我們的家人，第一次入住就像搬新家，以後就像回家一樣，只要來到高雄市就想回「泓揚精緻商旅」這個家。現在我們的「泓揚精緻商旅」開始營運了，希望我們的用心、理念、傻勁曾經感動每一個住過的你。而你也會想念在高雄「泓揚精緻商旅」這個家。
stays.descriptionEn: A drifting work style is the destiny for those who graduated from the department of civil engineering and the graduate school of architecture. From Kaohsiung to Taipei, and from Taiwan to the Mainland to every corner around the world, either for work or business, with bitterness and happiness, I am a wanderer between cities, staying at different hotels at night. The silver moonlight, however, is the one thing that never changes no matter whether the streets are booming or quiet. Shone by the streetlight, those extravagantly adorned 5-star hotels provide the comfort of brand-name beds, whereas in the ordinarily equipped, confined room of business hotels, only beds of slightly insufficient length and roughness to be had. These only make me feel the lack of warmth being away from home. The pillows without my own smell arouse the homesickness deep inside of me in the depth of night. I miss home. We all have what it takes to plan, design, build and decorate a beautiful, comfortable, warm and safe house of our own. Those who travel anywhere owing to the highly developed global village without their own permanent residence want a hotel to be "like home" for their time staying there. It is with such idea that "Hoyang Business Hotel - Chu" was born in our home town, the gorgeous harbor city in southern Taiwan where the sun always shines - Kaohsiung. An inconspicuous old building on the Qixian 2nd Rd. was thus given a new life by our expertise, dedication and persistence. It is hoped, whether it is because of business, work or travel, those who are far away from home and destined to spend a night at out place will find it like home with all its comfort and relief. Come visit us! Be a part of this big family. You will find it just like moving into a new house upon your stay first time. From then on, end every time you happen to be in Kaohsiung, you will have an impulse to go back to your home at "Hoyang Business Hotel." Now that our "Hoyang Business Hotel" is open for business, we hope our dedication, business philosophy and passion touch deep down inside all of you who ever spent a night here. And you will miss your home of Kaohsiung - "Hoyang Business Hotel."

stays.descriptionEn: Located on Jhongsiao 1st Rd., Sinsing District, the hotel is well within the boundary of the Kaohsiung station commercial district. We are only 2 blocks away from the famous scenic spot of Lio Ho Night Market and a 15-minute walk away from the Kaohsiung train station, and the metro stations Kaohsiung Main Station and Formosa Boulevard. The High Speed Railway station of Zuoying and Kaohsiung International Airport can be reached by a 20-minute ride. With bustling surroundings and convenient transportation, we are the top choice for your business travel and casual trip to Kaohsiung.

stays.descriptionEn: Located in the vicinity of Kaohsiung Railway Station and Kaohsiung Metrostation as well as Lio Ho Night Market and Ruifeng Night Market where people flock to their small eats, "Mei Wang Hotel" offers you the taste and comfort of a simple trip with our elegant and stylish room design. On a par with 5-star hotels, the sheets and covers, including mattresses, down comforters and down pillows, in our rooms are used "one time only" for your sleeping quality and comfort. We also provide morning and evening newspapers, current magazines and dedicated parking space. Guests can enjoy the benefit of our free bicycle rental service for a carefree ride around the harbor city. Following the service philosophy of "Utmost and True Care", we provide you with an accommodation service of the highest value. Your No.1 choice for travelr, leisure, and business accommodation.

stays.description: 英迪格酒店，洲際酒店集團(IHG)旗下精品酒店品牌，每一家酒店都有著與眾不同的個性，並致力為賓客提供耳目一新，猶如鄰間般親切自然的服務。高雄中央公園英迪格酒店座落於高雄市中心，鄰近中央公園捷運站，距離高雄國際機場20分鐘車程，至高雄火車站僅7分鐘車程；步行可到達五福商圈，漫步挖掘風格小店、文創咖啡館、潮牌店家。搭乘捷運可前往左營高鐵站、光之穹頂、西子灣、愛河、高雄展覽館等著名旅遊景點，方便您探索港都魅力。閒暇之餘，您還可到城市光廊體會白天或夜晚不同的美，在都市綠洲中釋放身心活力。
stays.descriptionEn: Located at the center of the city’s entertainment district, on Zhongshan 1st Road next to the MRT Central Park Station, Hotel Indigo Kaohsiung Central Park features easy access to plenty of attractions and activities. You also have fast access to Kaohsiung International Airport (only a 20-minute drive), Kaohsiung Train Station (7-minute drive), and THSR Zuoying Station (15 minutes by MRT). The Shinkuchan Shopping District, filled with shophouses and restaurants, is just a short stroll away, so you can get great local gifts and cuisine just around the corner. So many influences have contributed to the wealth of culture in this historic neighbourhood, which is alive and thriving for you to experience!

With 167 guest rooms, a business entertainment center, conference room, restaurant and other facilities, our five-star international hotel provides the finest quality and superior service to both our business travelers and tourists from around the world. Our attentive and caring hospitality makes you feel right at home.

stays.name: 高雄福華大飯店
stays.description: 座落於高雄市七賢一路與復興路口金融財經商圈的五星級國際觀光大飯店~30層樓高設計，可俯瞰大高雄全景，臨近市區商業中心、火車站、美麗島捷運站及信義國小捷運站、高速公路，交通便利，機場、高鐵站亦只是二十分鐘車程，至高雄著名觀光景點，如愛河、六合夜市..等，僅需數分車程，讓來高雄洽公、觀光的客人享盡地利之便。館內擁有溫馨典雅客房、尊爵商務中心、中外美饌餐廳酒吧、多功能宴會廳及專業會議室、國際名品專櫃街、隨處可見的版畫,藝術精品..等，結合美食、休閒、娛樂、藝術等功能的商務觀光飯店，更是商務人士與觀光旅客下榻的城市渡假天堂。 溫馨典雅豪華客房高雄福華大飯店提供精緻典雅客房，也有為行動不方便的客人所設置之無障礙客房，為滿足不同旅客的需求，更精心規劃設計商務樓層，旅客可針對自己的需求預先做訂房選擇。 典雅客房位於11樓至29樓間，所有客房空間寬敞，均搭配尊貴傢俱與藝術精品。南台灣美食之最 盡在高雄福華 高雄福華飯店有中西式美饌餐廳、酒吧，提供各式佳餚，滿足色香味俱全的最佳享受。以西式套餐與午茶著稱的麗香苑，廣式點心的珍珠坊，以及高雅道地江浙料理的江南春..等，皆讓前來高雄福華的賓客回味無窮。

Also,with the Liuho Tourist Night Market and other shopping areas nearby, plus convenient transportation,your business trips and traveling plans are all within reach.283 cozy and classic guest rooms are matched with prestigious wooden furniture and artworks bearing intense Chinese classical tone and reflecting the extraordinary taste of distinguished guests.Providing six fine restaurants, our professional chefs together prepare delicious Chinese and Western cuisine with each being an inspiring enjoyment of the taste and texture.

stays.descriptionEn: Fish Hotel Kaohsiung is located on Bade Road in front of the Kaohsiung Train Station, in which diversified transportations gather, and coach numbers are high concentrated. Moreover, it takes only 15 minutes to the airport and 10 minutes to the Zuoying High Speed Rail Station by car, and the MRT is also within feet, so you can easily reach any famous scenic spots in Kaohsiung, such as the World Games Plaza, the Hanshin Arena Shopping Plaza,the Juifeng Night Market, the Lotus Pond, the Chiaotou Sugar Refinery, eating lamb in Kangshan, the Yencheng District, the Cijin Ferry Pier, and the Love River. The well-known Liuhe Night Market is even within 5 minutes by walk, and so are the computer street and the mobile phone street in Kaohsiung. There are 98 guest rooms in our hotel. Various room types are available. The decoration is classic and in good taste, and all the guest rooms are quiet and clean. In addition, the emergency facilities have passed safety inspections, and our guards patrol at night for security.

stays.name: 鶴宮寓
stays.description: 「鶴宮寓 HOK HOUSE」的前身是「鶴宮大旅社The Crane Palace Hotel」。1960年代，它是台灣少數擁有現代設備的旅館。經營者後來移民美國，1996年歇業成為火鍋店。2016年因緣際會下發現這幢美麗的房子。我們順著它的氣質，改建了內部，在「鶴宮」後頭加一個「寓」字。希望它能成為一部時光機，讓旅人安心的待上一陣時日後，稍稍喚起大港埔（美麗島）那段有點浪漫、荒唐妄想、生猛朝氣的過往。
stays.descriptionEn: Built in 1958 as a townhouse owned by a local big family, opened in 1965 as the former Grand Crane Palace Hotel , and again renovated with one and half year effort since 2016, a bright new life-style hotel Hok House was finally born in 2017 winter.The vision of Hok House is becoming a cultural-centric neighborhood venue where people can live and meet and set minds peace and free together. All of the space are designed to craft you a perfect day to rhyme with the locals.

This property is 700 meters from the city center and 1.5 km from MRT Formosa Boulevard Station.Lilong Hotel offers air-conditioned rooms to its guests. Kaohsiung International Airport is 7 km from the property.

stays.name: 旗山三合院民宿
stays.description: 旗山三合院民宿是棟很有特色的古早鄉村三合院建築，位於高雄市旗山區廣福里中興街6號，旗山位居高雄縣中央，歷來為旗山區九鄉鎮對外的交通樞紐，自行開車走高速公路往旗山十分方便，行經中山高速公路，可在楠梓交流道下，接旗楠公路直達旗山；或於中山高速公路接國道十號東向行駛，到國道底右轉往里港方向路上有民宿指標。 本提供度假休閒小憩，讓人們暫時遠離都市喧囂，擁抱大自然享受安靜休閒愜意生活，民宿四周種有許多花花草草供欣賞，還有開心農場(真實版)體驗農村生活，由老闆娘教你種蔬菜、水果...，適合全家大小休閒的好地方，可以攜帶寵物住宿，晚間可在河堤散步看夕陽、並設有烤肉區。《攜帶寵物、使用烤肉區、請事先以電話通知》。 本店提供免費早餐給住宿客，中式(稀飯)和咖啡，吃素食請提早告知。 另外有販賣泡麵、飲料、啤酒...#泡茶(每組茶具500元、含茶具、茶葉、茶水)、簡易型泡茶 150元，另售茶葉1包500元。#免費提供烤肉場地及烤肉架，另外食材、木炭(請自備)。（使用烤肉區請來電告知）
stays.descriptionEn: Qishan Sanheyuan B&B is a very distinctive ancient rural Sanheyuan building. It is located at No. 6, Zhongxing Street, Guangfuli, Qishan District, Kaohsiung City. Qishan is located in the center of Kaohsiung County and has always been the external transportation hub of Jiuxiang Town, Qishan District. You can drive there by yourself. It is very convenient to get to Qishan from the expressway. When passing the Zhongshan Expressway, you can get off at the Nanzi Interchange and take Qinan Highway directly to Qishan; or take the Zhongshan Expressway and connect to National Highway No. 10 and drive eastward, and turn right at the end of the national highway toward Ligang. stays.name: 花鄉渡假會館
stays.description: 花鄉集團旅館連鎖『花鄉休閒渡假會館』位於旗山糖廠內，它保有大自然的美景、鄉村的寧靜，舒適、整潔的住宿環境，寬廣的活動空間，最重要的是這裡充滿了深厚的老街文化與客家文化的人文特色、臨近美麗的客家小鎮－美濃來大高雄旗美區遊玩感受休閒渡假樂趣，我們會用最溫馨及熱情的招待，讓您渡過完美愉快的假期。花鄉休閒渡假會館內分五大主題休閒渡假系列、都會時尚系列、夢幻兒童系列、時尚奢華系列、北約簡約風系列。計有21間汽車休閒館VILLA客房及60間休閒商務館共81間客房，全館備有迎賓大廳、商務會議廳、商務中心、中西式餐廳、卡拉OK、聯誼廳、棋藝室、戶外SPA湯區、兒童閱讀室、戶外遊戲區、大型停車場等設備，適合公司、社團、旅遊團體來此渡假，無論住宿旅遊會議，都能擁有最精緻的歡樂驚喜。102年全新開幕，以配合國人精緻旅遊之需求。期待尊榮的您能有一趟溫馨又舒適的渡假之旅建築外觀高雅大方，會館提供二人及四人住宿房型，空間寬敞舒適、設備齊全。本渡假會館的鄰近有各休閒名勝去處，例如「內門紫竹寺」「佛光山佛陀紀念會館」「美濃客家文物館」「旗山老街」等。其行車時間約均在十分鐘內到達，可謂相當便捷。期待我們「賓至如歸」的優質服務，能與您共渡美好的假期！您的到來，更促進了旗美地區觀光勝地的繁榮，我們誠摯歡迎您！
stays.descriptionEn: Hua-Xiang Resort is located within the Cishan Sugar Factory. The resort offers natural scenery, suburban peacefulness and quietness, clean and comfortable living quarters, broad space, the culture of old-time streets and Meinong, the famous home of Hakka culture. We provide visitors with the best comfort to help them have a perfect holiday.Hau-Xiang Resort is divided into five different themes: the Recreational Theme, the Metropolitan theme, the Fantasy Children theme, the Fashion Luxurious Theme, and the Simplicity Theme. The resort has a total of 81 rooms including 21 motel villa guest rooms and 60 commercial rooms to meet your traveling needs. We also provide duo and quad rooms that are spacious and fully equipped. Around the resort there are a lot of famous tourism spots such as Neimen Zizhu Temple, Fo Guang Shan Budda Memorial Center, Meinong Hakka Museum, Cishan old-street and many more, all of within ten minutes of car ride. We thrive to make our guest feel at home and help you enjoy the wonderful vacation you deserve!Your visit will contribute to the prosperity of tourism in Cimei area, We sincerely welcome you!

stays.name: 月光山林
stays.description: 自然是最適合居住的環境，一個最接近自然、減壓的地方。月光山林外觀仿造古老的三合院建築，與屋外的自然環境相互輝映，呈現出最原始的鄉村氣息。我們的建築是一座現代化的三合院，屋內訪小木屋裝置，原木芬多精洗滌一身的疲勞。地理位置居高臨下，展望視野極佳，清晨迎接朝陽乍現時可感受芬多精的洗禮，聽蟲鳴鳥叫，天晴時可欣賞夕陽晚霞，陰雨時可靜看山嵐雲朵的變化萬千，夜晚時這裡沒有光害，以致月亮、星星特別明亮，加上山下燈光的閃爍，猶如一幅活動的美畫，境收眼前。
stays.descriptionEn: This is a great place to get close to nature and far from stress. We use natural farming methods to grow our own vegetables, as well as working to develop our own vanilla-based recipes that truly showcase the essential flavor of the herb. The guesthouse itself is a modern sanheyuan (traditional three-section Chinese homestead with courtyard), and being a wooden structure, thus creating a phytoncide-rich way to ease the stresses of modern life.

stays.name: 亞力民宿
stays.description: 位在高雄六龜鄉南橫線要進入寶來溫泉區前有一間充滿布農族風味的民宿『亞力民宿』，這裡四面環山，四季氣候涼爽，是一處休閒渡假放鬆心情的世外桃源。一進入『亞力民宿』您會彷彿是來到自己家般的自在，前院的大花園、大大的活動客廳、大大的和式通舖，這是上帝賜的家…女主人總是這樣分享著…這裡有一顆熱誠的心讓您感受主人的熱情，來到這裡絕對不是只有住宿…皮雕ＤＩＹ、珠串ＤＩＹ、布農部落文化巡禮、夜遊生態、山訓活動、溫泉ＳＰＡ…等；亞力民宿都能給您滿滿的美好回憶。
stays.descriptionEn: There is a Bunun style B&B near Baolai Hot Spring Area, YaLi B&B. The weather is cool all the year here, and, surrounded by mountains, it is a Xanadu for you to relax. Entering YaLi B&B, you will feel that you have arrived home. The big garden in the front courtyard, a spacious parlor and Japanese style rooms compose a warm place to live. For God's sake... The hostess always shares what she has with others. Besides the passionate people and the warm house, you can also learn to do leather carving and beadwork, visit Bunun tribal villages, visit the ecological area at night, take part in mountain training, go to hot springs, etc. YaLi enriches your trip during your stay.

stays.name: 花季度假飯店
stays.description: 大崗山北麓天然湧泉，遠離塵囂，浸潤身、心、靈的泡湯好地方～花季度假飯店整體占地近7000餘坪，涵蓋有養生、藝術與文化等三大主題推動泡湯觀光，休閒設施包括出雲風呂大眾裸湯、玉蘭軒湯屋、賞花建康步道、KTV歡唱廳、書坊、童心室等..；飯店秉持提倡慢活住宿概念，不論是客房湯池與大眾風呂都能享受自然湧泉的原湯滋潤。餐飲方面，食堂中餐廳使用台南、阿蓮、田寮週邊地區特色季節性食材，搭配主廚創意料理手法，以精緻中式套餐型式，提供味蕾完美的享受。覓堂餐廳是一處結合陽光、水流聲、花香綠意、輕瀑的風味茶屋。輔以各式優質茶品、咖啡與100%鮮果汁搭配輕食，是恬靜午後時光與享受美食的聖地。飯店內還有可容納約110人的食堂大廳，優質會議首選的百合廳，先進齊全的設備，配合主題會議茶點，依不同的開會型態，都能滿足需求。全館30間精緻客房，平均16坪以上的客房空間均備有獨立泡湯池，乾、濕分離的衛浴設計，將泡湯、賞景作最完美的結合的，住房的每一口深呼吸都是健康的氣息。此外，飯店週邊擁有聞名全台的「月世界」聖地、歷史悠久超過三百年的超峰寺、二寮美景日出、朝元寺一線天與旗山老街，豐富的旅遊景點，是全齡層皆適合的歡樂所在。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in the northern foothills of Mt. Dagang and with natural cold springs, Spring Hill Resort is an oasis from the rat race for the body, mind, and soul. Sitting on over 23,000 square meters of land, it is focused three themes: health, art, and culture. We pride ourselves on our promotion of cold-springs tourism, along with flower-filled walking trails, karaoke, a study, a children’s room, nude bathing pools,and springs cabins, . The hotel is focused on promoting a slower pace of life, and the pools, whether private ones in the rooms or large public ones, offer natural, nourishing springs bathing. In terms of dining, our Chinese-style meals use seasonal ingredients sourced from the surrounding Tainan, Alian, and Tianliao areas, prepared by our creative chefs. We also offer elegant Chinese-style set meals and Western food including handmade Italian food, along with high-quality teas, coffees, and fruit juices to help you while away a relaxing afternoon. The main dining hall can accommodate 110 people and our conference room is of the highest quality, providing all the necessities, along with snacks that can be tailored to your conference’s needs. Our 30 high-class guest rooms average around 50 square meters, and include private baths and dry/wet segregated bathroom areas, offering a perfect mix of springs bathing and spectacular scenery. Additionally, we are near well-known tourist destinations like “Moon World,” the three-century-old Chaofeng Temple, Erliao (a great place to catch the sunrise), Chaoyuan Temple, and Qishan Old Street, providing a wonderful travel experience for guests of all ages.

stays.description: 中正湖民宿為美聲民宿，緊鄰中正湖，從屋內窗向外望去，竟是一片青蔥翠綠的人字山，湖光山色，美景天成，由男女主人李文欽、蘇櫻菊共同親手打造的園區花園，花草豐富，健康步道，小橋流水，到了晚上在黃昏的燈光擴大下，更讓中正湖民宿的視野更加浪漫撩人。位於高雄市的美濃小鎮，值得依偎在群巒綿延的[人字山]山腳下。腳步細細去習慣。 。主人蘇女士，不只是一位專業導覽，更有一位熱情開朗的志願者，有關美濃客家的風土人情，她有若直指掌如數家珍，在最短的時間認識美濃的猝死遊客。傳統的客家八音，即以鑼鼓樂為基礎加產類鼓吹樂器為主，有時會即興來段【迎賓曲】以迎接遠道到來的貴客。中正湖民宿位於全國模範社區獲獎者的中樞社區中，這裡的居民對於環境的綠美化重視，高度重視其他社區居民。美濃的旅遊道德與推廣美濃地區的客家文化，同時也期盼為您提供一個難忘的節日，誠摯邀請您光臨。1.位於曾窪模範社區，緊鄰中正湖、客家文物館，由屋外望到湖光山色美景天成。2.免費提供單車路線圖，讓您暢遊美濃7條單車路線。3.電視旅遊應援團，曾美譽為美聲民宿，為喜好音樂者，了解客家古樂、八音及山歌。4.異業結盟[餐飲以客為尊]，能應顧客需求承載[辦桌]總鋪師方式為您打造不一樣的餐飲(須電話預約)5.房間房型寬敞，乾淨整潔，有家的感覺，是本民宿最重要的訴求。
stays.descriptionEn: Zhongzheng Lake B&B is a Belvedere B&B, close to Zhongzheng Lake. Looking out the window of the house, you can see a lush green herringbone mountain, with lakes and mountains, a natural beauty. The male and female owners Li Wenqin and Su Yingju personally built a park garden with rich flowers and plants, and healthy trails. , small bridges and flowing water, and at night, under the beautiful lights, the Zhongzheng Lake B&B looks even more romantic and alluring.The small town of Meinong is located in Kaohsiung City, nestled at the foot of the rolling [Herringbone Mountain] mountains. In this Hakka settlement, there are historical sites, old houses and water towns, as well as simple and kind-hearted humanistic customs. It is worth slowing down and savoring it. In winter, you can see the small, white and tender white jade radishes; in summer, you can come here and see green in different shades, admire the lingering mountains after the rain, or ride a bicycle and let the warm south wind blow on your face.The host, Ms. Su, is not only a professional tour guide, but also an enthusiastic and cheerful volunteer. She knows the customs and customs of Meinong Hakkas like the back of her hand, and can help tourists get to know Meinong in the shortest possible time. He is committed to promoting the traditional Hakka music, which is based on gongs and drums and mainly suona-like drum instruments. Sometimes he will improvise a "welcome song" to welcome guests from afar.Zhongzheng Lake B&B is located in Zhongzhen Community, which won the National Model Community Competition. The residents here attach more importance to the greening and beautification of the environment than residents of other communities. Zhongzheng Lake B&B is a cozy little building carefully built by the owner. In addition to using it to promote the quality of Meinong's tourism and promote the Hakka culture in Meinong, we also hope to give you an unforgettable holiday life. We sincerely invite you. 's visit.1. It is located in a model community that has been awarded, close to Zhongzheng Lake and the Hakka Cultural Relics Museum. From outside the house, you can see the beautiful scenery of lakes and mountains.2. Free bicycle route maps are provided, allowing you to enjoy the 7 bicycle roaming routes in Meinong.3. The TV travel support group, once known as the Bel Canto B&B, is for music lovers to learn about Hakka ancient music, music and folk songs.4. Catering through cross-industry alliances [customer-oriented], can present different catering services according to guest needs [desk] chef-style approach to create different catering for you (reservation required by phone)5. Diversified room types, clean and tidy, and a home-like feel are the most important demands of this B&B.

stays.name: 人字山莊
stays.description: 從事兒童美術教學20多年，原本成立藝術廣場就是為了教導兒童學習藝術創作，美術教學戶外場所及自已藝術創作的空間之用，２００３年響應政府推廣觀光民宿且能廣交朋友的心態，開放給遊客度假住宿之用，申請登記通過合法民宿。 本山莊佔地500多坪近臨風景優美的中正湖、後倚人字山、翠綠山嵐、魔術方塊的涼亭及蓮花池中香水蓮隨風搖曳，子午蓮也在晚上綻放媲美，到處都可以看到男女主人創作猶如進入藝術館般，男主人水彩創作及女主人作品種類樣式多/葫蘆雕刻/棉紙撕畫/立體創作/藍染/…….不勝枚舉歡迎來享受一下藝術的饗宴。營運特色：1.免費為客人量身訂做安排行程，深度、藝術、知性、認識古蹟之旅2.提供腳踏車景點路線圖，規畫旅遊路線圖，建議單車遊美濃作深度知性之旅3.藝術DIY不同的生活體驗
stays.descriptionEn: The owner of Ren Zji Village is a children’s art teacher with over 20 years’ experience, and has set up a plaza here to help teach children art and creativity. It’s also a perfect space for grown-ups to exercise their creative muscles as well! In 2003, as the government began promoting bed-and-breakfasts, as well as being motivated by a desire to make new friends, they got a license from the government and began operating their own bed-and-breakfast. Sitting on just over 1,650 square meters of land, Ren Zji Village is located near the spectacular Lake Zhongzheng and Mt. Renzi. The lush mountain greenery, Rubik’s-cube-like pagoda, and fragrant lotus lake create an atmosphere of serene beauty, particularly in the evenings, and the grounds are decorated with the artworks of the owners, one of whom specializes in watercolors, the other in a variety of art forms, including gourd carving, paper art, and dyework. Special features include: 1) Free personalized itineraries for guests, offering tours that are in-depth, artistic, and informative. 2) Maps of bicycle paths around the local scenic spots, a particularly recommended way to enjoy the beauty of the Meinong area. 3) DIY art sessions, which offer a chance to experience something a little different.

stays.description: 對很多自助旅遊的人而言，「交通」往往是一個旅程安排上很重要的因素。一但沒有自行開車前往，恐怕有很多景點到不了。峰園民宿，距離車站約五分鐘路程，民宿本身提供導覽服務，非常適合自由行背包客住宿！民宿主人陳啟中先生，本身是高雄市民宿發展協會總幹事，擁有專業導覽導遊證照，對於推廣美濃觀光導覽與民宿發展更是不餘遺力。峰園民宿提供的導覽，分半天、一日的行程，並依照客人喜好與背景，規劃行程，並有交通車接送，可以輕鬆地飽覽客家文化的精華。聽主人陳啟中娓娓道著每一個美濃鄉間的故事和點點滴滴，既有趣且溫馨。隨著民宿主人導覽解說的腳步，遊走在田園鄉間的田埂上，彷彿遠方菸樓升起的白霧裊裊茫茫令人忘卻凡塵如在仙境。峰園民宿竭誠的邀請您的蒞臨。
stays.descriptionEn: For the independent traveler, transportation can be a vital concern; without a car, it can be hard to get to many of the most scenic areas. Fengyuan Bed & Breakfast is just five minutes from the train station and offers its own guided tours, making it a great choice for backpackers and independent travelers. Owner Chen Qizhong is also secretary general of the Kaohsiung Minsu (Bed & Breakfast) Development Association and a licensed tour guide, so he spares no effort in promoting the beauty of Meinong through tourism and accommodation. Fengyuan Bed & Breakfast offers half-day and full-day tours tailored to guests’ preferences and backgrounds, as well as providing transportation, all helping guests get a full experience of the local Hakka culture. Fengyuan Bed & Breakfast cordially invites you to experience the fantastical rural scenery and local culture!

stays.description: 坐落於風光明媚的美濃，「有間客棧-旅橙」於2024年8月正式開幕，是一間融合當地文化與現代舒適的特色民宿。我們以「旅程」與「橙」為設計靈感，希望為每位旅客帶來溫暖而難忘的住宿體驗。在這裡，您可以：體驗傳統美濃文化的獨特魅力。沉浸於大自然的懷抱，感受四季的變換。享受我們精心設計的舒適客房與貼心服務。無論您是來美濃旅遊、休閒，或是尋求一段靜謐的時光，「有間客棧-旅橙」都會是您理想的下榻之所。歡迎您與我們一同創造美好的回憶，開始一段難忘的美濃之旅。
stays.descriptionEn: Orange JourneyNestled in the picturesque region of Meinong, Youjian Guesthouse - Orange Journey officially opened its doors in August 2024. Our guesthouse beautifully blends local culture with modern comfort, offering a unique and warm accommodation experience inspired by the concepts of "journey" and "orange."Here at Orange Journey, you can:Experience the unique charm of traditional Meinong culture.Immerse yourself in nature’s embrace and enjoy the changing seasons.Relax in our thoughtfully designed comfortable rooms with personalized service.Whether you’re visiting Meinong for travel, leisure, or simply seeking a peaceful retreat, Youjian Guesthouse - Orange Journey is your perfect destination. We warmly invite you to create unforgettable memories with us as you embark on an extraordinary journey in Meinong.

stays.searchText: 有間客棧-旅．橙 有間客棧-旅．橙 高雄市民宿194號 高雄市 美濃區 自強街一段165巷13號 坐落於風光明媚的美濃，「有間客棧-旅橙」於2024年8月正式開幕，是一間融合當地文化與現代舒適的特色民宿。我們以「旅程」與「橙」為設計靈感，希望為每位旅客帶來溫暖而難忘的住宿體驗。在這裡，您可以：體驗傳統美濃文化的獨特魅力。沉浸於大自然的懷抱，感受四季的變換。享受我們精心設計的舒適客房與貼心服務。無論您是來美濃旅遊、休閒，或是尋求一段靜謐的時光，「有間客棧-旅橙」都會是您理想的下榻之所。歡迎您與我們一同創造美好的回憶，開始一段難忘的美濃之旅。

stays.name: 望峰息心民宿
stays.description: 忘峰息心民宿，緣起為家人建造的現代温馨舒適的家，可照顧長輩、自過退休生活及家人返家有獨立生活起居空間，衛浴開窗、乾濕分離、免治馬桶座，每層樓有休閒小客廳，空中花園休閒觀景區，觀景台等。另顧及全年齡生活設施、無障礙行動坡道，電梯等是必備的設施，也有特斯拉TPC充電樁提供房客充電。另選擇美濃自地自建，因母親客家人，而美濃係客家莊，客家人約佔93%。美濃三面環山，風景秀麗，全區水文系統豐富，有荖濃溪與其支流美濃溪貫穿，距離高雄市區約35公里。來美濃玩，住望峰息心民宿不需自己開車，可以自左營高鐵站搭旗美國道快捷45分到達美濃客運站，中間停留旗山站，美濃客運站斜對面雙峰公園有UBiKe可租借，該站距離民宿400公尺，走路10分鐘可達民宿。民宿附近景奌美濃湖及美濃客家文物館、三合院紙傘、敬字亭、東門樓、水圳、林家菸樓、永安老街等，走路約20分鐘。距離民宿約400公尺有傳統粄條店、各式美食、早餐店、未來農會、全聯，全聯对面有私人經營的摩托車、腳踏車租借。美濃米特殊的芋頭香，全國95%的水蓮來自美濃，冬季有白玉蘿蔔、橙蜜小番茄等特産，大受旅人鍾愛。美濃靈山、雙峰山、月光山受登山客喜愛，距離民宿1公里。

stays.name: 林家民宿
stays.description: 林家民宿位於田園之中，建築物是客家三合院。本民宿提供早餐、鐵馬。另有陶藝工作室，客人亦可自費陶藝DIY。美濃的客家文化、人文、環境優美，是可讓旅人適時的放鬆，過著慢活樂活的自在。是個不錯的優質之旅。
stays.descriptionEn: A traditional Hakka sanheyuan (traditional three-section Chinese homestead with courtyard) nestled amongst the fields, this bed & breakfast provides guests with breakfast and bicycles. It also boasts a pottery workshop where guests can try their hands at making their own pottery. The beautiful natural environment, artistic air, and friendly Hakka culture of Meinong will have guests quickly at easy and enjoying the slower, simpler pace of life, making for a quality stay.

stays.description: 中正湖歐式山莊又名中正湖民宿為美聲民宿，緊鄰中正湖，從屋內窗外望去，竟是一片青蔥翠綠的人字山，湖光山色，美景天成，由男女主人李文欽、蘇櫻菊一起親手打造的園區花園，花草豐富，健康步道，小橋流水，到了夜晚在唯美的燈光點綴下，更讓中正湖民宿顯得更加浪漫撩人。位於高雄市的美濃小鎮，依偎在群巒綿延的[人字山]山腳下。在這個客家聚落裡有古蹟有老厝有水圳，更有純樸善良的人文風情，值得您放慢腳步細細去品味。冬天的時候，小巧白嫩的白玉蘿蔔；夏天的時候來到這裡則可以滿眼深淺不一的綠，欣賞雨後繚繞的山嵐或騎腳踏車任暖洋洋的南風吹彿在臉上。主人蘇女士，不但是一位專業導覽，更是一位熱情開朗的志工，有關美濃客家的風土人情，她瞭若直指掌如數家珍，能為遊客在最短時間認識美濃。他致力於推廣傳統的客家八音，即以鑼鼓樂為基礎加嗩吶類鼓吹樂器為主，有時會即興來段 [迎賓曲]以迎接遠道而來的貴客。中正湖民宿位於全國模範社區比賽獲獎的中圳社區中，此地的里民對於環境的綠美化重視，高過於其他社區居民。中正湖民宿是主人精心打造的溫馨小筑，除了希望能藉著它來帶動美濃的觀光品質與推廣美濃地區的客家文化，同時也期盼能給您一個難忘的假日生活，誠摯邀請您的光臨。1.地處曾榮獲模範社區，緊鄰中正湖、客家文物館，由屋外望去湖光山色美景天成。2.免費提供單車路線圖，讓您暢遊美濃7條單車漫遊路線。3.電視旅遊應援團，曾美譽為美聲民宿，為喜好音樂者，了解客家古樂、八音及山歌。4.異業結盟餐飲[以客為尊]，能應客人需求呈現 [辦桌]總鋪師方式為您打造不一樣餐飲(須電話預約)5.房間房型多樣化，乾淨整潔，有家的感覺，是本民宿最重要訴求。
stays.descriptionEn: Zhongzheng Lake European-style Villa, also known as Zhongzheng Lake B&B, is a Bel Canto B&B. It is close to Zhongzheng Lake. When you look out the window of the house, you can actually see a lush green herringbone mountain with lakes and mountains. The scenery is natural. The park garden was built by the host and hostess Li Wenqin and Su Yingju. , rich in flowers and plants, healthy trails, small bridges and flowing water. At night, under the beautiful lights, the Zhongzheng Lake B&B looks more romantic and alluring.The small town of Meinong is located in Kaohsiung City, nestled at the foot of the rolling [Herringbone Mountain] mountains. In this Hakka settlement, there are historical sites, old houses and water towns, as well as simple and kind-hearted humanistic customs. It is worth slowing down and savoring it. In winter, you can see the small, white and tender white jade radishes; in summer, you can come here and see green in different shades, admire the lingering mountains after the rain, or ride a bicycle and let the warm south wind blow on your face.The host, Ms. Su, is not only a professional tour guide, but also an enthusiastic and cheerful volunteer. She knows the customs and customs of Meinong Hakkas like the back of her hand, and can help tourists get to know Meinong in the shortest possible time. He is committed to promoting the traditional Hakka music, which is based on gongs and drums and mainly suona-like drum instruments. Sometimes he will improvise a "welcome song" to welcome guests from afar.Zhongzheng Lake B&B is located in Zhongzhen Community, which won the National Model Community Competition. The residents here attach more importance to the greening and beautification of the environment than residents of other communities. Zhongzheng Lake B&B is a cozy little building carefully built by the owner. In addition to using it to promote the quality of Meinong's tourism and promote the Hakka culture in Meinong, we also hope to give you an unforgettable holiday life. We sincerely invite you. 's visit.1. It is located in a model community that has been awarded, close to Zhongzheng Lake and the Hakka Cultural Relics Museum. From outside the house, you can see the beautiful scenery of lakes and mountains.2. Free bicycle route maps are provided, allowing you to enjoy the 7 bicycle roaming routes in Meinong.3. The TV travel support group, once known as the Bel Canto B&B, is for music lovers to learn about Hakka ancient music, music and folk songs.4. Catering through cross-industry alliances [customer-oriented], can present different catering services according to guest needs [desk] chef-style approach to create different catering for you (reservation required by phone)5. Diversified room types, clean and tidy, and a home-like feel are the most important demands of this B&B.

stays.searchText: 美濃湖民宿 美濃湖民宿 高雄市民宿045號 高雄市 美濃區 福美路28號 中正湖歐式山莊又名中正湖民宿為美聲民宿，緊鄰中正湖，從屋內窗外望去，竟是一片青蔥翠綠的人字山，湖光山色，美景天成，由男女主人李文欽、蘇櫻菊一起親手打造的園區花園，花草豐富，健康步道，小橋流水，到了夜晚在唯美的燈光點綴下，更讓中正湖民宿顯得更加浪漫撩人。位於高雄市的美濃小鎮，依偎在群巒綿延的[人字山]山腳下。在這個客家聚落裡有古蹟有老厝有水圳，更有純樸善良的人文風情，值得您放慢腳步細細去品味。冬天的時候，小巧白嫩的白玉蘿蔔；夏天的時候來到這裡則可以滿眼深淺不一的綠，欣賞雨後繚繞的山嵐或騎腳踏車任暖洋洋的南風吹彿在臉上。主人蘇女士，不但是一位專業導覽，更是一位熱情開朗的志工，有關美濃客家的風土人情，她瞭若直指掌如數家珍，能為遊客在最短時間認識美濃。他致力於推廣傳統的客家八音，即以鑼鼓樂為基礎加嗩吶類鼓吹樂器為主，有時會即興來段 [迎賓曲]以迎接遠道而來的貴客。中正湖民宿位於全國模範社區比賽獲獎的中圳社區中，此地的里民對於環境的綠美化重視，高過於其他社區居民。中正湖民宿是主人精心打造的溫馨小筑，除了希望能藉著它來帶動美濃的觀光品質與推廣美濃地區的客家文化，同時也期盼能給您一個難忘的假日生活，誠摯邀請您的光臨。1.地處曾榮獲模範社區，緊鄰中正湖、客家文物館，由屋外望去湖光山色美景天成。2.免費提供單車路線圖，讓您暢遊美濃7條單車漫遊路線。3.電視旅遊應援團，曾美譽為美聲民宿，為喜好音樂者，了解客家古樂、八音及山歌。4.異業結盟餐飲[以客為尊]，能應客人需求呈現 [辦桌]總鋪師方式為您打造不一樣餐飲(須電話預約)5.房間房型多樣化，乾淨整潔，有家的感覺，是本民宿最重要訴求。

stays.name: 美濃雲山居民宿
stays.description: 一個花發而幽香，佳木秀而繁陰的地方，主人取名為雲山居。鑿池其西，引流種樹，以為休憩之所，三十餘年來，在主人刻意的經營下，已頗具規模，環抱之樹比比皆是，碧綠庭芳，更是稚子最佳嬉戲之所。 主人是為音樂人，有著老莊的超然。凡人如能有心靈的餘裕，自然就會回饋到自己本身，有此餘裕之心，也才能誠摯地款待他人。而主人在庭院藝術的發揮，卻說明了此點。 「美濃雲山居民宿」東望中央山脈〈大武山〉，有清流測奔，朝暉夕陰，氣象萬千，懶懶地偷個浮生半日，目視西沉金鳥，如桂林的奇峰，掩蔽日輝，自是一番暢快、、、、、、 以前都是些騷人墨客齊聚之所，常不知不覺已時過子夜，時而雨霏日斜，時而微風穿樹，時而春和景明，時而皓月晴空，時而漣漪入池，時而水石相博，又時而鳥鳴枝間、、、、、 身為音樂人的主人，自然和藝術脫離不了關係。同為藝術的盆栽或為直幹，或為垂崖，或為文人，或為飄逸，無不是主人精心之作。樹與石自然也分不開，庭石或景石錯置院中，別是一番情趣。池中白鵝競游，綠鴨逐波，自成風情！雲山居的秘密等你一一揭開！
stays.descriptionEn: A place with flourishing flowers and floral fragrances, as well as lush prosperous woods, and the owner named it Yun Shanju. With a pond drilled on its west side to guide the stream for cultivating trees to become a recreational venue, which has already become quite a large scale under the owner’s intended management for over the past more than 30 years, such that it is surrounded by trees, and is further the ideal playground for children. The owner who is also a musician has an aloof quality of Taosim. Anyone who has wealthy spirit will naturally feedback to oneself, and only those with a wealthy heart will be capable pf hosting others sincerely. The owner’s exertion towards gardening art explains this point. “Meinong Yun Shanju Homestay” faces the Central Mountain Range “Dawushan” on the east, with crystal clear running stream, morning sunlight and evening shade, as well as ever-changing sceneries. Take a half day off to admire the golden sunset, just as refreshing as watching the odd mountains in Guilin sheltering the sunlight. It used to be the gathering venue for writers and poets in the past, where time often gets past midnight with being noticed; with the rain through sunlight, the breeze through trees, the magnificent sceneries, the bright moon in the clear sky, the ripples in the pool, the splashes between water and stones, as well as the birds chirpings amongst the woods… the owner with background as a musician is thus naturally related to art. Whether straight stem or hanging down, literati or graceful are all artistic bonsais created meticulously by the owner. Trees and stones are naturally inseparable, offering an alternative sentiment with garden stones or scene stones placed in the yard. The image of white geese swimming in the pool and green ducks chasing after the waves form an interesting scenery as well! Wait for you to uncover the secrets of Meinong Yun Shanju Homestay!

stays.descriptionEn: Meinong was previously renowned as a tobacco-growing location, earning the nickname of “tobacco town.” Tobacco City gives guests the chance to experience everything Meinong has to offer in a bed & breakfast adorned in every nook and cranny by the creative works and design efforts of the owner. As soon as you come through the gate, you’re greeted by the scent of herbs and flowers, and in the spacious central courtyard you’ll find all manner of opportunities to relax and unwind. Whether it’s under clear blue skies or twinkling, starry nights, you’re sure to find Tobacco City a relaxing stay.

stays.description: 寒軒國際大飯店矗立於高雄市政府對面，四維林蔭大道上，是南台灣最具規模的五星觀光飯店。42樓美觀建築設計、挑高明亮的景觀玻璃，風格獨具。完善硬體設備與無微不至的溫馨服務，滿足商務人士及渡假旅客的多重需求。 寒軒國際大飯店擁有311 間設計一流的典雅客房與套房，所有房間均大面採光，景觀視野極佳，能將高雄全景一覽無遺， 美食餐廳提供中外美食，另有大型宴會廳及典雅貴賓包廂，位居交通四通八達的市中心，機場、購物、娛樂、古蹟名勝近在比鄰，是您在南台灣最舒適便利的家。
stays.descriptionEn: Located on Sihwei Road across from the Kaohsiung City Hall, the five-star Han-Hsien International Hotel offers 42-stories of accommodation where even the most seasoned traveler will encounter a harmonious blend of luxury and personal charm without a hint of ostentation. It is conveniently located just 15 minutes from the Kaohsiung International Airport. The magnificent ambience of the hotel''''s rooms and state-of-the-art facilities, together with the warmest of service will ensure the comfort of your stay. This popular hotel will entice you in a way no other can and will be your first destination whenever you visit this promising city of tomorrow. All of the Han-Hsien International Hotel''''s 311 guest rooms and suites are having a beautiful architectural design and bright and transparent glass, which make the hotel look magnificent and elegant.

images.description: 位於最高客房樓層39樓的總統套房，佔地60坪(198平方公尺)，內部裝潢設計以古典高雅歐美風格為主，整間套房主要分為3個區域：客廳、餐廳及主臥室而房內所有線型飾版以24K金粉漆描繪佈置而成。 客廳：歐洲宮廷風格的客廳挑高6米，自天花板懸掛著4盞氣派非凡的水晶燈，入口處手工嵌入式花紋地板亦增添幾許優雅的風格；客廳除了有50吋寬螢幕電視及錄放影機設備外，並有供貴賓高歌幾曲的卡拉ＯＫ設備與客廳設有立體聲環繞音響，觀賞影碟時有如置身電影院般臨場感受。 餐廳：面向三面大落地窗的餐廳，除了有大型木製圓桌可同時招待10多人用餐外，並附有化妝室供客人使用，以保有主人私密的空間，備餐區亦設有周全的設備，餐廳窗簾可遙控升降，可一邊用餐一邊觀賞高雄市的美麗港景。 書房：上等仿古家具配合擺飾裝點成古意典雅氣質，所有實心原木家具皆以紅檜訂製家具為主，並有手工彩繪花紋，設計色調採以莊嚴磚紅為主調搭配淺色進口緹花椅布呈現典雅中有新意的設計表現，並附有化妝室供客人使用，書房中備有個人雪茄盒(含點煙設備)供來賓休閒使用。 主臥室：主臥室設計以溫馨的米色系為主，備有King Size規格(190㎝×200㎝)的大型雙人床及豪華床具，房內家具皆為手工製品，房內窗簾可遙控升降，客人可隨時由三面大落地景窗鳥瞰高雄市景。 衛浴設備：包括按摩浴缸、蒸氣室及淋浴間設備，房客在沖完澡後，進入蒸氣室內享受三溫暖，再於按摩浴缸內放鬆，充份享受貴賓級的服務。 其他貴賓專屬服務：(視貴賓需求狀況彈性提供) 24小時專屬管家服務、特別準備之個人燙金文具、名片組、個人繡名浴袍及毛巾組等等。 隨扈或同行侍從連通臥室。 ‧房價：NT$120,000+10% ‧面積：60坪(198平方公尺) ‧床型尺寸：King Size標準床(190cm×200cm)

stays.searchText: 寒軒國際大飯店 寒軒國際大飯店股份有限公司 交觀業字第1163號 高雄市 苓雅區 四維三路33號 寒軒國際大飯店矗立於高雄市政府對面，四維林蔭大道上，是南台灣最具規模的五星觀光飯店。42樓美觀建築設計、挑高明亮的景觀玻璃，風格獨具。完善硬體設備與無微不至的溫馨服務，滿足商務人士及渡假旅客的多重需求。 寒軒國際大飯店擁有311 間設計一流的典雅客房與套房，所有房間均大面採光，景觀視野極佳，能將高雄全景一覽無遺， 美食餐廳提供中外美食，另有大型宴會廳及典雅貴賓包廂，位居交通四通八達的市中心，機場、購物、娛樂、古蹟名勝近在比鄰，是您在南台灣最舒適便利的家。

stays.name: 寓旅宿
stays.description: 「寓‧旅宿 Apato Home」以乾淨整潔做為基本訴求，溫馨舒適的套房皆由主人精心佈置，運用不同的裝潢及擺設給您從未有過的精緻住宿體驗。每間客房更採用了大片落地窗及小陽台，將窗外的光線引領入室。「寓‧旅宿 Apato Home」緊鄰熱鬧的三多百貨商圈、夢時代、愛河與城市光廊。周邊擁有在地小吃自強夜市及知名美食、高雄圖書總館、展覽館和輕軌站更比鄰而居,步行約7分鐘到R8捷運站將可前往駁二、旗津、六合夜市、西子灣等地區。寓‧旅宿 Apato Home的細心和用心，全都是要讓您能在充滿溫馨與獨具風格的環境空間裡親自蒞臨感受，同時感受家與旅居生活的新鮮感。除了要讓您感受到與眾不同的「溫馨感」，其平易近人的價位設定，也將會讓您更心動滿意。

stays.description: ※房價已含營業稅及服務費，並免費提供精緻美味的早餐。※為了保證您的訂房需收取訂金，訂金為單筆訂房總房價之30%。國外訂房僅接受信用卡支付訂金（無接受國外匯款）；國內訂房接受信用卡、ATM轉帳、匯款等方式支付訂金，入住時您可以使用信用卡（VISA, MasterCard, American Express, JCB, 銀聯卡）或現金支付餘額。※住宿/退房時間：下午三時/中午十二時，您可以寄放行李於大廳。※房價若有變動恕不另行通知。※全館全面禁煙。※全館房型皆不提供指定，僅有部分房型為彩繪房，如有任何需求請提前告知服務人員並記錄於訂單中，房間安排仍是以入住當天狀況安排，恕無法保證。※禁止攜帶寵物入住。※交通部99年1月13日交路字第0990000402號函頒，旅客完成訂房並支付訂金後，亦可取消訂房，但應負擔下列費用：1. 旅客於入住日期前14日取消訂房時，將不收取取消訂房手續費。2. 旅客於入住日期前10至13日取消訂房時，應負擔訂金之30%為訂房取消費用。3. 旅客於入住日期前7至9日取消訂房時，應負擔訂金之50%為訂房取消費用。4. 旅客於入住日期前4至6日取消訂房時，應負擔訂金之60%為訂房取消費用。5. 旅客於入住日期前2至3日取消訂房時，應負擔訂金之70%為訂房取消費用。6. 旅客於入住日期前1日取消訂房時，應負擔訂金之80%為訂房取消費用。7. 旅客於入住日期當天取消訂房或怠於通知者，應負擔訂金之100%為訂房取消費用。
stays.descriptionEn: Cancellation and Refund policies are as below:5% tax is included in the room rates. To ensure your booking, we will request 30% deposit of your entire stay. Overseas bookings are only accepted if paid by credit card; bank transfer is not accepted. Guests who make bookings in Taiwan can use credit cards, ATM and bank transfer to pay deposit. All remaining cost has to be paid off by credit cards (VISA, MasterCard, American Express, JCB, China Unionpay) or cash on arrival.We reserve the right to changes room rates without prior notice.Check-in/ Check-out Time: 15:00/12:00, baggage storage is available at lobby.All areas are smoking prohibited due to the Smoking Law of Taiwan.Design rooms are available upon request, please contact Reception for reservations. Please note that offer is valid while supplies last and may be revoked without prior notice.Pets are not allowed.The cancellation policy is listed as follows:1. No cancellation fees will be charged if cancellations are made 14 days prior to your stay.2. 30% of the deposit will be charged if cancellations are made 10 to 13 days prior to your stay.3. 50% of the deposit will be charged if cancellations are made 7 to 9 days prior to your stay.4. 60% of the deposit will be charged if cancellations are made 4 to 6 days prior to your stay.5. 70% of the deposit will be charged if cancellations are made 2 to 3 days prior to your stay.6. 80% of the deposit will be charged if cancellations are made 1 day prior to your stay.7. All deposit will be charged if cancellations are made on the day of your stay or without prior notice.

stays.name: 陽光大飯店
stays.description: 陽光大飯店創立於1995年，隆重開幕於中華四路上，結合優雅的中式古典，全館以名貴花梨木傢俱融合雅緻的東方文華精萃，匠心獨具以獨有的中華文化融入創新的當代設計，是您不可錯過體驗的東方美學深度之旅，給顧客每一次的住宿，都像一種品味……陽光大飯店座落於高雄市中心，位居中華路金融商圈與三多商圈之精華地段，與85大樓比鄰而居，緊鄰高雄軟體科學園區與高雄加工出口區，距高雄車站及小港國際機場僅十分鐘車程，離大魯閣草衙道和夢時代等熱門購物中心車程約十分鐘，鄰近高雄捷運紅線三多商圈站，步行僅需五分鐘是洽商出差與渡假觀光的最佳地理位置。陽光大飯店不斷追求創新與優質服務，於2011年擴大營運，為具備五星級設備水準之精緻飯店，全館擁有150間舒適豪華客房，3個中西式餐廳及日式餐廳、功能完備之專業會議室場地、專業健身中心……等多樣休閒設施，充分滿足顧客多樣需求。全體員工秉持「創新服務，以客為尊」之服務理念，提供顧客最賓至如歸的尊榮享受。陽光大飯店薈萃東方文化的典藏風華，散發高雄海港城市的活力，以精緻的品味、貼心的服務，成為造訪高雄最佳的選擇!誠如飯店所名，陽光歡迎您的蒞臨………
stays.descriptionEn: Hotel Sunshine was established in 1995 and opened at Jhonghua 4th Road. With elegant Chinese classic, the hotel uses valuable and rare rosewood furniture to blend with refined oriental culture and make innovative contemporary designs by unique Chinese culture. It is a trip to experience oriental aesthetics and you shall not miss it. We’d like to make each stay an unforgettable taste for our customers. Hotel Sunshine is located at the center of Kaohsiung City, the finest section of Financial Districts at Jhonghua Road and Sanduo Shopping District. It is next to The 85 Sky Tower. Also, it’s close to Kaohsiung Science Park and Kaohsiung Export Processing Zone and it takes only 10 minutes to Kaohsiung Main Station and Siaogang International Airport by car. It takes only 10 minutes to TAROKO Park and Dream Mall by car. It is in the vicinity of the Red Line of Sanduo Shopping District of Kaohsiung MRT and it takes only 5 minutes by walk. It is the best location for business affairs, business trips, tours and vacations. Hotel Sunshine keeps pursuing innovative and best services and enlarges the operations in 2011. In order to have the standards of Five Star hotel, there are various leisure facilities such as 150 comfortable and luxurious guest rooms, three Chinese ,Western and Japanese restaurants, venues for professional conferences with complete functions, professional fitness center, in the hotel to satisfy different needs from the customers. The whole staff hold the service principles of “Innovative Service, Customer First” to provide top service for the customers to make them feel at home. Hotel Sunshine gathers classic grace of oriental culture and gives out the vitality of Harbor City, Kaohsiung. Because we provide exquisite tastes and close services, our hotel is your best choice when you visit Kaohsiung. The hotel is worthy of the name and welcome to Hotel Sunshine.

stays.name: 麗尊大酒店
stays.description: 關於麗尊創辦人精神創辦人李總裁登木博士的藝術文化堅持與公司治理理念為企業核心文化紮根。擁藝術、建築與商業背景，自始融貫與生俱來對於企業經營的敏銳度與藝文的見地，建立人文、服務、美學、設備兼具的五星級飯店，目的即是以客為尊，並打造充滿藝術文化氣息的生活空間，賓客們皆可與古董、名畫等藝術品邂逅於大廳、客房廊道或意想不到的地點。 建築美學麗尊酒店外觀以「尊」（古字同『鐏』）為設計靈感，即為古代帝王飲酒器具，取其外型做樓頂造型，以示企業尊客及尊才精神。建材使用花崗石古堡城牆丁掛工法，突顯尊榮大方，主牆以義大利工藝風格，使用四種色調之日本進口珍珠粉光馬賽克磚貼砌，隨一天的光源角度變化色澤。 空間美學酒店大廳主要以簡雅內斂的現代新古典與裝飾藝術風格呈現，整體空間使用大理石地舖、楓木並融合間接燈源，搭配眾多館藏藝術品點綴。十米挑高中庭利用鐵件與玻璃設計出充滿現代感之大型吊掛裝置藝術，與二樓餐廳區隔卻而光影間相呼應；大廳牆面，掛有創辦人李總裁登木博士親手操筆的巨幅畫作「心相」及「俯瞰大地」抽象油畫，更加襯托寬敞氣派的大廳空間。榮耀麗尊2009 世運會首選飯店、JAL 日本航空指定飯店、2008 環保旅館優選、UTELL 品味精選飯店、文化局認證之行動美術館、榮獲觀光局5星評定、2014榮獲Agoda金環獎、2015TripAdvisor前25大豪華飯店、2016 TripAdvisor 旅行者之選(Travellers' CHOICE Award)。
stays.descriptionEn: About TLHThe Lees Hotel The company’s core culture is based on the artistic persistence and the corporate governance of the founder Dr. Lee Deng Mu; with a background in arts, architecture and business, Dr. Lee uses his natural acuity for business management and arts and culture and established a five star hotel complete with humanities, services, aesthetics, and facilities. The aim of the hotel is to treat the guests with honor. Also, by creating a living space full of aesthetic and cultural ambience, guests can easily encounter antiques, paintings and other art works in the lobby, hallways, or other unexpected places. The aesthetic of the building The design of the building is based on the Chinese character “zun”, which in ancient times refers to the utensil the emperor uses to drink wine. By using the shape of the word as an exterior design expresses the company’s respect towards guests and staffs. The building material uses granite panels to express a sense of honor, glory and generosity. The main wall is Italian styled with four different colors of imported pearl mosaic panels and shifts color under different angles of sunlight. The aesthetic of the spacesThe lobby is presented with the simple and modest modern new classical and decoration art styles. The overall design uses marble floors and maple wood integrated with indirect lightings along with a collection of many art works. The ten meter high ceiling atrium uses metal and glass to design a large modernistic overhead art piece, echoing with the restaurants on the second floor. The abstract paintings painted by the founder Dr. Lee Deng Mu are hanged on the lobby walls, adding a spacious and imposing ambience to the lobby.

stays.name: 高雄圓山大飯店
stays.description: 高雄圓山莊園渡假飯店位於澄清湖畔。特有的宮殿式建築是集西方建築的雄偉與東方建築的古典於一體，七彩畫棟、丹朱圓柱等建築特色，東方傳統的藝術色彩，匠心獨運。 107間客房，舒適寬敞的空間，結合中西合併，古典婉約的風格，從景觀陽台，坐望燈火輝煌的夜色，澄清湖碧波蕩漾四季如畫之美景，盡收眼底，讓您身心完全放鬆的莊園渡假飯店。 飯店餐廳匯集了中、西式傳統道地的經典名菜，宮廷般的尊貴氣派，讓您在喧鬧的城市中，享受一個靜謐的餐飲環境。 飯店多項休閒設施，花園游泳池、池畔坐望林、健身中心、撞球、桌球、景觀木棧道等，讓您除了徜徉於澄清湖的湖光山色之間，又能鬆弛筋骨，享受輕鬆自在又健康的美好假期。
stays.descriptionEn: Kaohsiung is an important city in southern Taiwan, both economy and tourism-wise. The Grand Hotel, situated by the Cheng Ching Lake in Kaohsiung, is a renowned palatial recluse from the bustles and hustles of the Kaohsiung City. It is approximately 30 minutes by car from the Kaohsiung International Airport, and 20 minutes from the Kaohsiung Train Station and the Zhuoying Station of Taiwan High Speed Rail. The convenient location makes the hotel a great place to spend vacation time, stay for business trips, or hold banquets.The Grand Hotel is a combination of the grandeur of Western architecture and classic Easter architecture. Exquisite craftsmanship is evident in the colorful painted rafters and red columns in traditional Chinese styles. The Ming-dynasty style decor and redwood furniture in the rooms all bring back thoughts of ages past. The hotel used to be a high society entertainment and diplomatic reception venue for the nation in the past, and it has stood witness to countless historical events.

stays.description: 綠蔭盎然的三棵老樹，襯托佈滿水泥屋瓦的日式獨棟雙拼磚木混造架高屋舍，磚造圍牆上方防盜的四吋大釘與紅白相間的眷村紅門，全屋運用榫接結構修復大木樑柱，補強架高木地板，打開破損竿緣天花，讓屋頂野地版防水與屋瓦工程修復一目了然，展示修復工法與在地材料的新舊融合，此屋舍便是誠正國小第一任校長王景佑校長與孫菊人(孫立人堂妹)老師的住所。期待大家都能跟我們一樣體驗沉浸式眷村日常，除了可以穿梭村子巷弄串門子外，還可了解眷舍修復過程，在獨特超過一甲子的三棵大樹下感受絲絲清風拂面，愜意流連，泡上一壺清香茗茶，配上眷村小點，享受眷村食聊的午後時光，大小孩們也可體驗製作早期手工眷村童玩。夜幕降臨時騎著單車至鳳山大街採買在地美食回眷舍享用，也可在保留了５０年代白色方形磁磚的炊事場簡單體驗製作眷村家鄉菜。用膳休息後在湯屋內注滿熱水放入一塊泡澡錠，解除壓力。夜闌人靜換上睡袍窩在充滿眷村味的主臥或是日式地舖，耳邊傳來陸軍官校悠悠晚安曲酣然入夢，隔日院子樹上各種鳥鳴旋律譜成大自然美麗的樂章，拌入軍校起床號，體驗眷村獨特的早安進行曲。換洗後，沖杯熱牛奶或手沖咖啡，拿起蒸籠內熱騰騰的窗花饅頭搭配清粥小菜，便是眷村家常醍醐味。打開緣側格柵拉門延伸室內至庭院互為表裡相輔相成，在角落隨意翻開一本書，坐上搖椅，時而放空時而回味，享受這眷村演化獨特的ＳＯＨＯ工房。
stays.descriptionEn: Three old trees with lush greenery set off the Japanese-style single-family two-story brick and wood elevated house covered with cement roof tiles. The four-inch anti-theft nails above the brick fence and the red and white red gate of the military community. The whole house uses mortise and tenon structure to repair large wooden beams and columns, reinforce the elevated wooden floor, and open the damaged pole edge ceiling, so that the roof waterproofing and roof tile repair work can be seen at a glance, showing the restoration method and the integration of old and new local materials. This house is It is the residence of Principal Wang Jingyou, the first principal of Chengzheng Elementary School, and teacher Sun Juren (cousin of Sun Liren).We hope that everyone can experience the immersive daily life of the military dependents' village like us. In addition to walking through the village alleys and visiting the houses, you can also learn about the restoration process of the military dependents' houses and feel the gentle breeze blowing on your face under the three big trees that are unique for more than a month. You can linger comfortably, make a pot of fragrant tea, and enjoy the afternoon snacks of the Military Village. Children, both adults and children, can also experience making early handcrafted Children's Village toys. When night falls, you can ride your bicycle to Fengshan Street to buy local delicacies and return to the family home to enjoy. You can also simply experience making home-cooked food from the military family in the cooking area that retains the white square tiles from the 1950s. After a meal and a break, fill the bathhouse with hot water and put a bath tablet in it to relieve stress. At the end of the night, people quietly put on their pajamas and nestled in the master bedroom full of military village atmosphere or on the Japanese-style floor. Listening to the long good night song of the Army Academy, they fell asleep soundly. The next day, the melodies of various birds singing on the trees in the yard composed the beautiful movement of nature. Mix in the military academy’s reveille and experience the unique morning march of the military military village. After washing, make a cup of hot milk or hand-brewed coffee, pick up the steaming steamed buns in the steamer, and pair them with porridge and side dishes, which is the delicious taste of home in the military community. Open the edge grille sliding door and extend the interior to the courtyard. The inside and outside complement each other. Open a book in the corner, sit on a rocking chair, sometimes relax and sometimes reflect, and enjoy the unique SOHO studio that has evolved in this military village.​

stays.description: 位於高雄鳳山黃埔新村的眷村民宿，推開門的同時，也回到美麗富有的輝煌時代，這裡不只是民宿，更像是電影內的場景，宿囍想帶給你復舊卻保有嶄新氣息的住宿環境，客房均備有電熱水壺、淋浴設施、吹風機,免費盥洗用品(沐浴用品皆使用歐萊德產品)。享受現代便利設施的同時也投入懷舊氛圍，每個角落都能拍下獨特美照，並能享有室外空間，快來嘗試飯店和其他民宿無法提供的精緻與美好。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Huangpu New Village, Fengshan, Kaohsiung, when you open the door, you will be transported back to the glorious era of beauty and wealth. This place is not just a B&B, but more like a scene from a movie. The hotel wants to bring you a retro look but with a brand new atmosphere. The accommodation environment is excellent, and the guest rooms are equipped with electric kettles, shower facilities, hairdryers, and free toiletries (the bath products are all made of O'Laide products). Enjoy modern conveniences while also immersing yourself in a nostalgic atmosphere. You can take unique photos in every corner and enjoy outdoor space. Come and try the sophistication and beauty that hotels and other B&Bs cannot provide.

stays.name: 日出單車小棧民宿
stays.description: 日出單車小棧民宿位於高雄鳳山，城市與郊區的交會點。由日式空間改造而成，空間裡面充斥著主人們的生活日常，單車生活、海洋運動，老屋子的活力從未因為年紀而遞減，反而因為不同時間不同生命的入住持續澎湃，這也是眷村的意義，不同時期、不同的人群。這是我們家，我們分享空間提供休憩、歇息，80 年的日式空間無所謂豪華氣派，單純的修整，保有屋子的靈魂和過往生活的痕跡。如果你正在旅途中或是單車旅行的過程，日出可以讓你輕鬆待著；也許你會聽到一些吵鬧、也許會有單車的聲音，那就是我們的生活樣貌。
stays.descriptionEn: .Sunrise Bike Inn is located in Fengshan, Kaohsiung, at the intersection of the city and suburb. Transformed from a Japanese-style space, it’s filled with the daily lives of its hosts—cycling, Surfing, and the vibrant energy of an old house that never fades with age. Instead, it continues to thrive with the arrival of different lives at different times. This is the essence of a military dependents’ village: a blend of various eras and diverse people.This is our home, and we share this space to offer rest and respite. The 80-year-old Japanese-style building isn’t about luxury or grandeur—it’s been simply restored to preserve the soul of the house and traces of past lives. If you’re on a journey or a cycling trip, Sunrise offers a laid-back place to stay. You might hear some noise, perhaps the sound of bicycles—that’s just the rhythm of our life here.

stays.name: 春天藝術飯店
stays.description: 春天藝術飯店本館位於高雄市鳳山區，臨近衛武營公園、鳳山體育館、中正預校與陸軍官校、距離高速公路交流道只須５分鐘車程；火車站、客運站、高雄國際機場與高雄市中心只有１０分鐘車程、而且開車至有號稱高雄國際觀光六合夜市的鳳山青年觀光夜市也只須１０分鐘車程。附近環境相當熱鬧且交通便利，是一個來高雄出差、自由行旅遊、住宿的絕佳選擇。春天藝術飯店館內附設高級餐廳並提供免費的中西式自助早餐，房間內支援無線上網，讓您於洽公在外時能時刻掌握商機；春天藝術飯店並設有旅遊商務中心、運動休閒區、會議室，讓您於住宿本飯店時能拋開世俗的煩惱，帶著愉快的心情回家。
stays.descriptionEn: Spring Art Hotel is located in Kaohsiung's Fengshan District, close to Weiwuying Park, Fengshan Stadium, Chung Cheng Armed Forces Preparatory School and Republic of China Military Academy. It's about a 5 minute drive from the highway interchange. Other transportation stations, such as train station, bus terminal, Kaohsiung International Airport and downtown Kaohsiung are all about a 10 minute drive away. In addition, it only takes a 10 minute ride to get to the famous Kaohsiung International Tourism Liuhe Night Market and the Fengshan Youth Tourist Night Market. With a lively surrounding and convenient transportation, Spring Art Hotel is definitely an ideal hotel for business and pleasure. Spring Art Hotel has a very nice restaurant that serves complimentary Chinese and western buffet breakfast to the hotel guests. The wireless connection available in all the guestrooms provides easy access to business clients to stay connected to their work. The hotel also has a business center, sports and leisure area and meeting rooms. You will be able to take care of all your businesses and relax when you stay at Spring Art Hotel, and we promise you will return home feeling happy and satisfied.

stays.name: 月光寶盒旅店
stays.description: ｜藏在月光寶盒中的光陰故事｜月光寶盒旅店融合了濃厚的日式氣息與過往眷村的懷舊風貌，每個住宿空間都有自己獨特的故事。在這裡，我們秉持著「以住代護」的理念，保留了傳統的建築風貌和日式工藝，讓您感受到過去人們生活的痕跡。不僅延續了眷村的初始樣貌，更讓您能親身體驗昔日的眷村生活，仿佛穿越回那個時光。屋內的木質建築古樸典雅，原始的格局沒有過多改動，經過精心修繕後，還原了當年的日式空間。房間內鋪上榻榻米，根據旅客人數擺放床墊，營造出溫暖且富有懷舊氛圍的居住環境。這裡的每個細節都在講述著過去的故事，讓您在現代與歷史之間找到一個獨特的連結。
stays.descriptionEn: ｜Where Stories of the Past Gently Welcome You｜At Moonlight Hostel, we’ve blended cozy Japanese charm with the warm memories of Taiwan’s military villages. Every room tells a little story—of families, traditions, and the simple joys of everyday life.We’ve preserved the original wood structure and layout with care, adding soft tatami floors and comfortable futons arranged to fit your group. It’s a place where modern comfort meets heartfelt history, where you’re invited to slow down, settle in, and feel at home—past and present, side by side.

stays.descriptionEn: Located in Fengshan District, Kaohsiung, Royal Gold Hotel is the best hotel for tourists enjoying luxurious European architecture. A chandelier in the form of a jade Ruyi is hung in the spacious lobby on the 1st floor. With the wooden furniture, the Hotel integrates Chinese and western aesthetics. The rooms on the 6th floor are for those with children. You can ride the slide directly to the outdoor playground on the 5th floor. The children will definitely love it. Next to the Hotel is Fengshan Stream Bike Route. It takes about 5 minutes by bike to go to Kaohsiung City Dadong Arts Center and 5 minutes to Wei Wu Ying Center for the Arts. Focusing on the new traveling aesthetics and customer-centered service, Royal Gold Hotel hopes to bring the unique aspects of Southern Taiwan to the visitors.

A 5 star service with affordable pricing, all of the equipments and decors are dedicated from the needs of our guests. The bright but comfortable lightings inside our hotel, and elegant designs will make our business traveling guests lighten up right away. There is no need to pack around a heavy luggage, let our best hospitality welcome you and make your stay the best experience ever.

In addition, there are steam shower bathrooms, whirlpool tubs and far infrared lounges inside the rooms. It’s a quiet and peaceful place that you can relax yourself after a busy day. We offer complimentary buffet breakfast for the guests who stay overnight, giving you massive amount of energy at the beginning of the day. We also hope that we can see you again soon.

stays.description: GO HOME民宿是個透棟的透天房子，由鹽埕埔捷運站1號出口，走路3分鐘可以到民宿，距離輕軌也是走路3分鐘，民宿走路3分鐘可到駁二特區，非常適合輕旅遊兩天一夜或三天兩夜慢慢遊。我們位於鹽埕區交通便利的地點，鹽埕區有非常多好吃的小吃美食，甜點蛋糕，異國創意料理，非常值得大家來探索，管家會提供在地美食口帶名單給大家參考.民宿裡面特別以海洋為主，請藝術家在牆壁面做了3D彩繪壁畫，每個角度都有不一樣的感覺，搭配歐洲希臘白色建築，每個樓層都有不一樣的風格及壁畫，另外，我們有安裝全戶軟水淨水設備，讓大家洗澡時可以很放心的沐浴，沒有氯氣刺激皮膚，洗澡比較久也不會有過敏的問題產生，希望大家可以輕鬆自在的入住，一夜好眠，讓旅遊可以有不一樣的體驗。早餐時刻由管家親自下廚手做愛心早餐，住2天以上，每天都是不一樣的早餐。讓大家有回家的感覺，歡迎回家^0^
stays.descriptionEn: GO HOME is a townhouse located just a 3-minute walk from Yanchengpu MRT Station Exit 1. It& #39;s also a 3-minute walk to the light rail and the Pier-2 Art Center, making it an ideal spot for a leisurely 2-day or 3-day trip.We are situated in the convenient location of Yancheng District, where there are many delicious snacks, desserts, and exotic creative cuisines worth exploring. The manager will provide a local food guide list for your reference.The interior of the guesthouse features an ocean theme, with 3D mural paintings by artists on the walls, giving each angle a different feel. Combined with European-style Greek white architecture, each floor has its unique style and murals.Additionally, we have installed a whole-house soft water filtration system, allowing guests to bathe without the irritation of chlorine, which can cause skin issues. This ensures a relaxing and comfortable stay, offering a unique travel experience.Breakfast is personally prepared by the housekeeper MELODY with love, and if you stay for more than two days, the breakfast will be different each day, giving you a homey feeling. Welcome home! ^0^

stays.searchText: 回家 回家 高雄市民宿140號 高雄市 鹽埕區 公園二路139之3號 GO HOME民宿是個透棟的透天房子，由鹽埕埔捷運站1號出口，走路3分鐘可以到民宿，距離輕軌也是走路3分鐘，民宿走路3分鐘可到駁二特區，非常適合輕旅遊兩天一夜或三天兩夜慢慢遊。我們位於鹽埕區交通便利的地點，鹽埕區有非常多好吃的小吃美食，甜點蛋糕，異國創意料理，非常值得大家來探索，管家會提供在地美食口帶名單給大家參考.民宿裡面特別以海洋為主，請藝術家在牆壁面做了3D彩繪壁畫，每個角度都有不一樣的感覺，搭配歐洲希臘白色建築，每個樓層都有不一樣的風格及壁畫，另外，我們有安裝全戶軟水淨水設備，讓大家洗澡時可以很放心的沐浴，沒有氯氣刺激皮膚，洗澡比較久也不會有過敏的問題產生，希望大家可以輕鬆自在的入住，一夜好眠，讓旅遊可以有不一樣的體驗。早餐時刻由管家親自下廚手做愛心早餐，住2天以上，每天都是不一樣的早餐。讓大家有回家的感覺，歡迎回家^0^

stays.name: 城市商旅高雄真愛館
stays.description: 海霸王集團繼台北南西館、台北南東館、桃園航空館後，另一鉅獻再度於高雄鹽埕區，推出城市商旅高雄真愛館。以海洋元素為主要設計風格，秉持著現代、簡潔、時尚優雅風，讓您旅行時能找到生活裡單純的美好，體驗極簡的生活美學與住房享受。在真愛館可欣賞大樓林立的現代都市風貌，也可眺望海灣體驗大船入港的震撼，絕佳的視野讓您感受白天與夜晚不同的風貌，享受於港都城市中特別的住房體驗。全館共8個樓層、298間尊榮客房，每間約10坪舒適空間，低調且奢華的設計風格，絕佳的視野盡享海與山的視覺饗宴，海上郵輪的海景，日出日落的山景，寧靜低調的市景，所有景色一覽無遺。『高雄真愛館』讓住多了點藝文味，讓住多了點風格。讓休閒的旅客及商務人士們，體驗時尚又有人情味的住房服務。『高雄真愛館』藉由波浪的外牆，突顯了海的奧秘，五彩的繽紛，表現了住的精彩，從大廳明亮又樸實的設計到悠閒隨性的寬敞休憩空間，低調又舒適的客房燈廊。
stays.descriptionEn: Following the successful launches of its Taipei Nansi, Taipei Nandong, and Taoyuan Airport branches, the HPW Group proudly presents another landmark property in Yancheng District, Kaohsiung — City Suites Kaohsiung Chenai.Designed with ocean-inspired elements as its core theme, the hotel embraces a modern, minimalist, and elegantly stylish aesthetic. It offers travelers a chance to rediscover the simple beauty of everyday life while experiencing the refined comfort of minimalist living.At City Suites Kaohsiung Chenai, guests can admire the striking modern city skyline or gaze across the harbor to witness the awe-inspiring sight of massive ships arriving at port. With exceptional views that transform from day to night, the hotel delivers a truly distinctive accommodation experience in the heart of the harbor city.The hotel features a total of 8 floors and 298 premium guest rooms, each offering approximately 33 square meters of comfortable space. With a design that is understated yet luxurious, guests are treated to panoramic views of sea and mountains — from ocean liners cruising across the water, to sunrise and sunset over the hills, to serene cityscapes. Every view unfolds at a glance.City Suites Kaohsiung Chenai adds a touch of art and style to every stay, offering both leisure travelers and business guests a fashionable yet warm and personable hospitality experience.The hotel’s wave-inspired exterior façade highlights the mystery and depth of the sea, while vibrant colors express the joy of living. From the bright and unpretentious lobby, to the relaxed and spacious lounge areas, and the softly lit, tranquil guestroom corridors, every detail reflects a balance of understated elegance and comfort.

stays.searchText: 城市商旅高雄真愛館 城市商旅股份有限公司 高雄市旅館453號 高雄市 鹽埕區 大義街1號 海霸王集團繼台北南西館、台北南東館、桃園航空館後，另一鉅獻再度於高雄鹽埕區，推出城市商旅高雄真愛館。以海洋元素為主要設計風格，秉持著現代、簡潔、時尚優雅風，讓您旅行時能找到生活裡單純的美好，體驗極簡的生活美學與住房享受。在真愛館可欣賞大樓林立的現代都市風貌，也可眺望海灣體驗大船入港的震撼，絕佳的視野讓您感受白天與夜晚不同的風貌，享受於港都城市中特別的住房體驗。全館共8個樓層、298間尊榮客房，每間約10坪舒適空間，低調且奢華的設計風格，絕佳的視野盡享海與山的視覺饗宴，海上郵輪的海景，日出日落的山景，寧靜低調的市景，所有景色一覽無遺。『高雄真愛館』讓住多了點藝文味，讓住多了點風格。讓休閒的旅客及商務人士們，體驗時尚又有人情味的住房服務。『高雄真愛館』藉由波浪的外牆，突顯了海的奧秘，五彩的繽紛，表現了住的精彩，從大廳明亮又樸實的設計到悠閒隨性的寬敞休憩空間，低調又舒適的客房燈廊。

stays.name: 塩˙泊思行旅
stays.description: HOTEL LAGOM 以中庸之道為自在生活的精神，不求極簡或奢華，追求剛剛好的平衡點，擁有飯店應有的規格，同時又有B&B般的親切服務。住進HOTEL LAGOM的生活探險家們(Explorer)，可在公共空間找到剛好屬於自己的角落，享受一個人的時光抑或是展開與他人的交流。HOTEL YAM 塩旅社，可追溯於過去鹽埕區的歷史，於1908年高雄港落成後，成為當時高雄最繁榮的地方，隨時代的演進物換星移，現今可轉為高雄市的老城區，無論文化或在地老店可依舊屹立不搖，連在地高雄人都愛這鹽埕味。因此採「塩」的台語讀音來命名，也恰是「蕃薯」的英文，象徵台灣這塊土地，歡迎無論來自台灣或國外的人們，落腳於此一起探索高雄鹽埕。2020年10月，HOTEL YAM正式與泊思品牌合作，以HOTEL YAM LAGOM 塩．泊思旅宿展開新的旅程，不變的是渴望分享老鹽埕的初衷，但以更舒適自在的服務來款待每位生活探險家們。

stays.name: 愛河日央
stays.description: 歡迎光臨愛河日央!我們位於高雄鹽埕區愛河邊的黃金地段，離愛河僅需一分鐘步行，十分鐘內即可步行到捷運橘線鹽埕埔站，高雄歷史博物館，浪漫的愛河愛之船，皆近在咫尺。愛河日央是您探索高雄熱門景點的最佳據點： 人潮薈集的駁二藝術特區、真愛碼頭、充滿歷史文化的鹽埕老街、繁華的六合觀光夜市、日落動人的西子灣、最適合一日遊的旗津、壽山國家自然公園與南台灣最大的壽山動物園等等，不勝枚舉。我們緊鄰高雄熱門的健行和自行車路線，您可以沿著愛河漫步與乘風踩踏，北至愛河之心，南到光榮碼頭，享受親水港都的宜人景色與夕陽。愛河日央採用便捷的自助入住，每間客房均有匠心獨具的裝飾，也有獨立浴室與免費的高速無限網路。浴缸房型多是寬敞的日式石砌浴缸，泡澡紓壓分外愜意，療癒旅客疲累的身心。部分房型提供網路電視，Youtube及Netflix免費觀看，旅客可以隨時掌握世界大小事，旅遊商務洽公皆相宜。旅客在入住期間可以免費享用我們的自助吧，咖啡、茶、熱可可、點心與麥片，二十四小時無限時供應。另外我們也提供家庭房和團體住宿，12到18人團體包層享有獨立出入，親子出遊、家族旅遊、好友揪團，愛河日央皆可以滿足您。愛河日央是全面禁菸合法登記的旅宿( 高雄市旅館532號 )，確保旅客的安全與舒適。無論是享受美好假期，還是犒賞忙碌工作的休憩，讓我們為您打造一段獨特的入住體驗。立即預訂，開啟您的舒適之旅！
stays.descriptionEn: Welcome to Love River Inn!We are located in the prime area of Yancheng District, Kaohsiung, right by the Love River. It takes only one minute on foot to reach the riverbank, and within a 10-minute walk you can reach the MRT Orange Line Yanchengpu Station, the Kaohsiung Museum of History, and the romantic Love Boat cruise on the Love River.Love River Inn is your best starting point to explore Kaohsiung’s most popular attractions: the bustling Pier-2 Art Center, True Love Pier, the historic Yancheng Old Street, the lively Liuhe Night Market, the breathtaking sunset at Sizihwan, the perfect day-trip destination Cijin, Shoushan National Nature Park, and the largest zoo in southern Taiwan, Shoushan Zoo—the list goes on.We are also right next to Kaohsiung& #39;s popular walking and cycling routes. You can stroll or bike along the Love River, heading north to the Heart of Love River or south to Glory Pier, all while enjoying the waterfront city& #39;s pleasant scenery and sunsets.Love River Inn offers convenient self check-in. Each guest room is uniquely decorated, with a private bathroom and free high-speed unlimited Wi-Fi. Many of our bathtub rooms feature spacious Japanese-style stone baths—perfect for a soothing soak to relax both body and mind. Selected rooms are equipped with smart TVs with YouTube and Netflix for free viewing, allowing you to stay connected with the world at any time. Whether for leisure or business, we& #39;ve got you covered. Guests may also enjoy our complimentary self-service bar with coffee, tea, hot cocoa, snacks, and cereals, available 24 hours a day.We also provide family rooms and group accommodations. Groups of 12 to 18 people can book an entire floor with private access—ideal for family trips, reunions, or friends traveling together.Love River Inn is a fully non-smoking, legally registered hotel (Kaohsiung City Hotel License No. 532), ensuring safety and comfort for all our guests.Whether you& #39;re here for a delightful holiday or a well-deserved break from work, let us create a unique and comfortable stay for you. Book now and begin your journey of relaxation!

stays.name: 福容大飯店 高雄
stays.description: 福容大飯店高雄位於鹽埕區五福四路、大成街口，地理環境極佳且交通便利。緊鄰知名景點愛河旁，定位為國際觀光飯店，提供250間客房，設施包括游泳池、三溫暖、健身中心等，並提供全館WIFI無線上網服務，備極貼心；專為頂級消費者設計的尊榮樓層，提供氣派奢華的舒適環境，從制高點一覽海洋之都，凡塵喧囂瞬間落盡，是專屬的私密景點，輕啜著一杯紅酒，一天奔波幻化為心中的滿足。周邊景點多元，潺潺清流的愛河，多元的休閒藝文活動，值得在此度過悠閒時光；氛圍優雅的和平公園，吸引雙雙儷人來此拍攝婚紗；如意橋在夜裡恍若發著光的河流，浪漫美麗。真愛碼頭以雙座風帆的特殊造型，分別對著高雄市區及旗津渡輪碼頭，來到福容可欣賞高雄摩天大樓林立的現代都市風貌，也可眺望高雄海港體驗大船入港的震撼，白天、夜晚各具不同的風貌。
stays.descriptionEn: Fullon Hotel (Kaohsiung) is located in Yancheng District, at Wǔfú 4th Rd and Dacheng Street, and has an excellent geographical environment and convenient transportation. Near famous attractions Love River, the hotel, positioned as an international tourist hotel, offers 250 rooms, and its facilities include a swimming pool, a sauna, a gym. Provides also wireless Internet access available for whole hotel, a very considerate plan; specifically designed premier floors for high-end consumers with luxurious style of comfort, allowing for an elevated view of the cityscape, which is the exclusive personal attraction. Sipping a glass of red wine, the hustle and bustle world instantly falls away, ends a busy day in satisfaction. Nearby Attraction Diversities: Gurgling clean flows of Love River is worth spending leisure time; Peace Park with elegant atmosphere attracts wedding couples to take pictures; Ruyi Bridge romantically glowing in the night; Love Pier& #39;s twin sails stand opposite to Kaohsiung District and Cijin (Qijin) ferry terminal, respectively. Arriving Fullon, you can enjoy Kaohsiung& #39;s urban style of modern skyscrapers, or overlook and experience the shock of huge ships entering Port of Kaohsiung, during the day or the night, each with a different style.

stays.searchText: 福容大飯店 高雄 福容大飯店股份有限公司高雄分公司 交觀業字第1340號 高雄市 鹽埕區 五福四路45號 福容大飯店高雄位於鹽埕區五福四路、大成街口，地理環境極佳且交通便利。緊鄰知名景點愛河旁，定位為國際觀光飯店，提供250間客房，設施包括游泳池、三溫暖、健身中心等，並提供全館WIFI無線上網服務，備極貼心；專為頂級消費者設計的尊榮樓層，提供氣派奢華的舒適環境，從制高點一覽海洋之都，凡塵喧囂瞬間落盡，是專屬的私密景點，輕啜著一杯紅酒，一天奔波幻化為心中的滿足。周邊景點多元，潺潺清流的愛河，多元的休閒藝文活動，值得在此度過悠閒時光；氛圍優雅的和平公園，吸引雙雙儷人來此拍攝婚紗；如意橋在夜裡恍若發著光的河流，浪漫美麗。真愛碼頭以雙座風帆的特殊造型，分別對著高雄市區及旗津渡輪碼頭，來到福容可欣賞高雄摩天大樓林立的現代都市風貌，也可眺望高雄海港體驗大船入港的震撼，白天、夜晚各具不同的風貌。

stays.description: 翰品酒店高雄是台灣第一連鎖旅館品牌「雲朗觀光」專為商務人士打造的國際級精品酒店。座落於鹽埕區，鄰近愛河、駁二藝術特區、歷史博物館、電影館，搭捷運從鹽埕埔站2號出口步行只要兩、三分鐘即可抵達飯店。飯店位居市中心，交通便捷，不論是連結到高鐵左營站、小港國際機場、火車站或高速公路交流道都相當快速便利。 全新開幕的翰品酒店高雄，集結眾多菁英設計師，分別以不同創意、特色風格及專業技術，打造外觀、公共區及客房。152間全新時尚精緻客房與套房，以兩種不同氛圍設計呈現獨特風格，展現全新現代都會及摩登高貴氣質。 酒店提供各式美食，三樓「港都茶樓」以道地港式飲茶聞名，深獲饕客喜愛。一樓「品」日式料理集結握壽司、壽喜燒與涮涮鍋於一廳，二樓貴賓廂房供應各式精緻中式料理，以及風格時尚，提供各式點心與飲品的七樓VIP Lounge讓您在旅途中獲得舒適的小憩空間。另有功能齊全的商務中心及氣勢宏偉的會議空間，提供您商務、觀光住宿、美食更多元的選擇。
stays.descriptionEn: Chateau de Chine (Kaohsiung) is an international-class business hotel built by L’Hotel de Chine Hotel Group, Taiwan’s first franchise hotel brand. Located in Yancheng District near the Love River, Pier 2 Art center, Kaohsiung Museum of History, and Kaohsiung Film Archive, and a 2-3 minute walk from from Yanchengpu MRT Station Exit 2 , it is situated downtown with convenient transportation, including the Taiwan high speed rail Zuoying Station, Kaohsiung International Airport, train station, and highway entrance. The new opening of the hotel gathered together several top-class designers who contributed their own creativity, styles, and skills toward construction of the building, common areas, and guest rooms. 152 brand-new fashionable and exquisite rooms and suites feature two distinct styles, modern urban fashion and aristocratic class. We provide a variety of fine foods, with the highly popular Cantonese Tea House on the third floor being famous for its dim sum. The Pin Japanese cuisine restaurant on the first floor offers sushi, sukiyaki, and shabu-shabu, the 2nd floor VIP wing a variety of exquisite Chinese cuisine, and the 7th floor VIP Lounge a variety of deserts and beverages, providing you with a comfortable resting place during your journey. Additional facilities include a fully functional business center, variety of fine foods, and impressive conference room for all your business, tourism, and accommodation needs.

stays.description: 賀喔文旅來自台灣最熱情的高雄愛河畔, 以豪邁的”台式精神”出發, 結合西式精緻旅店風格, 打造摩登的飯店體驗, 故飯店名稱以充滿趣味的方式, 取自”好喔”的台語”賀喔”, 英文為Hooray=萬歲, 充滿輕快自在的氛圍, 期望每一位選擇賀喔文旅的旅人, 都能用如此怡然歡樂的心情, 遊玩港都高雄。座落於美食小吃雲集的鹽埕商圈，緊臨視野絕佳的浪漫愛河畔。距離捷運鹽埕埔站五分鐘車程，交通便捷，地理位置優越。鄰近駁二藝術特區、歷史博物館、電影圖書館、真愛碼頭…等熱門景點只要五至十分鐘車程。充滿現代感的大廳空間，以新銳藝術家作品佈置，樓層迴廊富饒主題趣味，全館客房在簡約摩登設計概念中，注入創意、時尚的氛圍。全館免費提供無線上網、自行車租借、自助洗衣烘衣間、等貼心服務，讓旅客感受物超所值的全新住宿體驗，猶如回家般舒適自在。位在R樓的早餐餐廳特別採用大扇景觀窗，讓旅客在愛河美景伴隨下，享用中西式自助早餐，多元化菜色依季節不同嚴選當令食材，每日變換各式元氣料理，提供旅客一天滿滿的活力。
stays.descriptionEn: Located in Kaohsiung District Love River, neighboring The Pier-2 Art Center and the famous Yencheng wharf. A 270-degree viewing restaurant on the top of the roof allows you to enjoy perfect view of Love River. Free internet access, self-service coin laundry and bicycle rental is available for all our guests.

stays.name: 高雄愛河智選假日酒店
stays.nameEn: Holiday Inn Express Kaohsiung Love River
stays.description: 高雄愛河智選假日酒店，毗鄰高雄愛河，可同時眺望港灣美景及愛河河畔，陽光明媚、熱情多元的「高雄」，整座城市由港灣區興起發展，沿著愛河蔓延出今日的興盛景象，讓我們在此感受到獨有的美好與活力。酒店地理位置優越、交通便利，步行3分鐘即可搭乘捷運及輕軌，距高雄火車站僅15分鐘車程，高雄國際機場及左營高鐵站約車程30分鐘。可輕鬆穿梭於港都體驗城市之美，鄰近多處更是高雄必遊景點，步行10分鐘可達愛河及駁二藝術特區，距達六合夜市、西子灣、旗津老街僅3公里，亞洲新灣區、高雄軟體科技園區及前鎮加工出口區車程約8分鐘，無論是重點傳統產業區域或新興商業密集區皆可輕鬆抵達。挑高舒適的接待大廳及多功能空間—「智•空間」，為往來旅客打造一處最自在的休憩選擇，簡約時尚的客房設計、寬敞明亮的室內空間，夜幕將臨之際，可於客房內欣賞高雄港灣的迷人景致。每日提供中西式自助早餐來開啟活力的一天，遍佈全館的高速網路，打造高效便捷、輕鬆舒適的住宿體驗，無論是商務差旅或休閒旅遊，高雄愛河智選假日酒店都是您的明智之選。
stays.descriptionEn: Kaohsiung, a harbor city. It is full of sunshine all year round and the weather is delightful. Along the love river, rich historic culture and the enthusiasm of people make the city genuine and vigorous. Hotel is located in Yancheng district adjacent to the famous tourist attractions with easily accessible location. Able to reach metro in 3 minutes on foot and to arrive railway station in 10 minutes by car. Only 10 kilometres to Kaohsiung International airport or Zuoying highspeed railway station. Easy to travel over the city and to experience the local. In walking distance, the love river side and Peir 2 Art Centre are must go of visiting Kaohsiung. In 10 minutes by car, hot destination as Liuhe Night Market, Siziwan and Cijin scenic area could be easily approached. In 15 minutes by car, there are central business district and major industry park, Kaohsiung Software Park, export processing zone and port zone. European style exterior and high ceiling lobby provides a relaxing and comfortable space for all traveller. Simple, trendy and spacious guest room comprises smart design concept and the awesome view. On the high floor, the evening harbor view. In the morning, complimentary Express Buffet Breakfast includes various Western and Eastern choices. Chic style and fully equipped smart space provides multifunction travel solution. Highspeed Wi-Fi covers everywhere in hotel. To make a simple, smart and comfortable accommodation experience.

stays.description: 巨蛋旅店Hotel R14，以所在地鄰近高雄巨蛋以及位於捷運紅線第14站作為命名，一目了然。秉持「自然」、「真實」、「環保」、「簡單」的理念，巨蛋旅店從外觀到內部裝修的風格可以被歸類為日式現代風，打造出一棟兼具現代感、樸實、內斂、低調奢華卻又令人無法轉睛的旅店。旅店門口步行1分鐘路程即是R14巨蛋捷運站二號出口，步行至瑞豐夜市只需約5分鐘的路程，距離漢神巨蛋百貨也是5分鐘的路程，距離左營高鐵站約10-15分鐘的車程或5分鐘捷運旅程，距離知名景點蓮池潭約10分鐘以內的車程。便捷的交通、卓越的地點，是您旅遊的最佳選擇！每間客房均配有線電視、高效能旅館專用冰箱、衣櫃和書桌。床組是美國知名品牌蕾絲 (Restonic)，私人浴室則配備了Panasonic負離子吹風機、義大利進口高級洗浴用品和拖鞋。超過一半的房間面對著綠樹成蔭的明誠公園，坐在房間就可以寧靜地欣賞印度黃檀、雨豆樹等美麗高大的樹木以及高雄市最精華地段博愛二路的城市景觀。旅店全館提供免費的wi-fi服務，服務中心提供行李寄存服務、旅遊諮詢服務及代客叫車的服務，前台的工作人員則可幫助有需要的客人安排旅遊行程，也可應要求提供收費的班車服務。旅店早餐提供蛋奶五辛健康素，讓客人的早晨能夠健康清爽沒有負擔。
stays.descriptionEn: Hotel R14, named after its location near Kaohsiung MRT Red Line Stop 14, and next to Kaohsiung Arena, was designed by Mr. Lin Po-Yu, an architecture student of the renowned Japanese architect, Kengo Kuma. Hotel R14 is a green building, upholding “natural”, “authentic”, “green”, and “simple” concepts. Its style can be considered modern Japanese, combining a sense of modernity, simplicity and low-key luxury.Outwardly, the hotel’s appearance is an impressive symmetrical black and white bar code design conveying a strong sense of the future. The interior design is constructed using exquisite woodwork, noble titanium plated metal, elegant exposed concrete, and bamboo materials from Bamboola, Taiwan. The color theme is black, white, wood, and gray- all earth tones which exude tranquility to make guests feel relaxed.

stays.name: 帕可麗酒店
stays.description: 帕可麗(PARK LEES)地理位置絕佳，坐落鬧中取靜的公園旁，我們所描畫的不僅是公園的表象，而是以此內涵探索原生自然的態度和休憩心靈的需求，在忙碌與城市中創造一個旅人們能自在步足，又可重拾能量的空間。希望透過她所展現的簡約時尚主義與服務上的細膩專業、及我們的設計理念，賦予漫步至這個城市的旅人，不管是商務或休閒都能像在公園中短暫尋得所需的舒適平靜與能量。 以「旅人自主空間」為主軸，以同調性的色溫與線條光影串聯每個環境，大面積落地窗呼應戶外陽光綠意、浴室的透光灰色玻璃與鏡面、簡約舒爽的白色桌面、不經意的細部巧思，營造出時尚舒適又完備的精巧空間，以木、鐵、岩、光與影及精品的元素融入感官設計。 P-A-R-K Personal and Peaceful 雅靜休憩與個人，專屬旅人的精品簡奢之家 Artistic and Astounding 生活美學與時尚，探索建築空間與深度設計 Refined and Resourceful 精緻服務與專業，便捷的環境與貼心的接待 Kaohsiung Originated 城市高雄與品味，都會融合的獨特風範 建築設計 ARCHITECTURE樓層說明 B1~B3：地下停車場 Parking (車位有限)LB（文信路）：酒店接待大廳 Hotel Lobby 1F~2F（篤敬路）：艾可廚坊CERCLE de Cercle 5F~16F：客房Guestroom 建築外觀酒店以簡潔的黑白灰色調及線條，和諧搭配出精品感十足的建築外衣，頂冠採用不規則間距粗細的黑色鐵件保留陽光與天際的穿透感，公園前烙印明亮的集團標誌，如高雄海港之都中旅人歸屬的燈塔，並於酒店大門外角落地坪崁入銅板蝕雕，標記了所在地的經緯度與方位。 環保綠化 建築表層晶石塗料內具隔熱層，全面採用灰階強化膠合玻璃，有效阻隔部分熱能。頂樓鋪設隔熱地磚與綠化，設置太陽能板可自主蓄電提供夜間外牆照明電力。全館空調與熱水採用熱泵與冰水主機熱回收串聯，有效降低能源之耗損。建築內外燈光皆使用高效能LED燈具，並利用KNX系統及軟體，分區分段分時調節光源。 室內空間設計 INTERIOR DESIGN 抽象港都延伸外觀高雅簡約的風格，室內大量使用雕刻白大理石為主建材，大廳的復古不規則拼貼地坪表現出海水折射晶化的抽象感，並搭配接待櫃台的不規則船型意象與皮革框、大船入港。沙發區立面同樣採用不規則拼貼大面積的粗曠石材，櫃台後方壁面墨藍色橡木，加上天花的鍍鈦黑與金色波浪藝術造型，以抽象而時尚的設計手法，渲染這城市的天、海、山、河的港都意境，華奢但精緻內斂。 客房廊道映入眼簾的是藍灰白潑墨式的羊毛地毯，流水般的引導至客房門口，墨藍色與木色壁面及微醺暈光的大框，厚實門扇隔絕干擾舒適入眠。 個性化舒活空間 客房內49吋電視主牆墨藍框型與簡潔的白色長桌面，色調對換的呼應大廳白皮革框與櫃檯，銜接房口的矮坐墊，貼心給予旅客方便卸去鞋子讓腳呼吸的一處。芥末綠與金色曲線造型的書桌椅與矮凳，簡約時尚的品味恰與公園景致延伸一氣，全落地式的十字窗，讓充足的溫暖南台灣光線穿透房內至浴室空間。全館衛浴皆配置日本INAX免治馬桶，並使用德國百年精品V&B與GROHE。濕式備品更選用歐盟認證的環保產品，草本芬芳溫和舒適。而房內的畫作皆是跟高雄在地藝術家配合創作，讓源自這個城市萌芽的作品有機會被更多國內外的旅人欣賞。 PARK C ROOM墨藍色的客房、或PARK LEES SUITE墨綠色的套房，大膽但沉穩放鬆的格調，再開啟YAMAHA音響連接手機撥放自己喜愛的音樂，泡個澡同時喝杯紅酒，沉溺陶醉。 帕可麗酒店 PARK LEES HOTEL高雄市鼓山區文信路192號電話: 07-962-8800傳真: 07-962-9600 訂房 Reservation電話：07-229-6030 分機 3510 / 3511 或 07-962-8800
stays.descriptionEn: Sitting across from a park amid the bustling city, PARK LEES does not simply borrow from the serenity of the park but rather uses this asset to explore our natural disposition and the soul’s longing for repose. Our hotel offers travelers an abode to be themselves and rejuvenate, close to yet separate from the urban hubbub. We hope that business travelers and tourists alike enjoy our minimalist design and attentive service and derive a sense of quiet peace and renewed energy from the park across the street.Architectural appearanceThe hotel is decorated with a simple color palette of black and white paired with gray hues, and fluid lines that dress the hotel in an elegant architectural cloak, while a crown of irregular black iron sculptural forms around the roof create a playful transition between the building and the sky above. The lanterns in the park make the hotel’s logo light up, like a beacon beckoning the travelers home to their haven in the harbor city of Kaohsiung. In the pavement outside the lobby doors, etched copper plates mark the latitude and longitude of the location. A green building The building’s exterior surface is coated with a thermal insulation layer, while gray-scale reinforced glass is applied throughout to block part of the heat. The rooftop is laid with insulation tiles, green plants, and solar panels that power the hotel’s exterior lighting at night. The building’s air conditioning and hot water use a heat pump and ice water heat recovery system, which reduces energy consumption. Inside and outside, high-performance LED lighting is used under a KNX (smart building) system and software which manages the light sources for different zones and times.Taking the "traveler's autonomous space" as the main axis, connecting each environment with coherent color temperature and line light and shadow, large-area floor-to-ceiling windows echo the outdoor sunshine and green, transparent gray glass and mirrors in the bathroom, simple and comfortable white desktop, casual details Ingenuity creates a stylish, comfortable and complete sophisticated space, with wood, iron, rock, light and shadow, and fine-quality elements integrated into the sensory design.

stays.searchText: 帕可麗酒店 麗尊開發股份有限公司 高雄市旅館517號 高雄市 鼓山區 文信路192號 帕可麗(PARK LEES)地理位置絕佳，坐落鬧中取靜的公園旁，我們所描畫的不僅是公園的表象，而是以此內涵探索原生自然的態度和休憩心靈的需求，在忙碌與城市中創造一個旅人們能自在步足，又可重拾能量的空間。希望透過她所展現的簡約時尚主義與服務上的細膩專業、及我們的設計理念，賦予漫步至這個城市的旅人，不管是商務或休閒都能像在公園中短暫尋得所需的舒適平靜與能量。 以「旅人自主空間」為主軸，以同調性的色溫與線條光影串聯每個環境，大面積落地窗呼應戶外陽光綠意、浴室的透光灰色玻璃與鏡面、簡約舒爽的白色桌面、不經意的細部巧思，營造出時尚舒適又完備的精巧空間，以木、鐵、岩、光與影及精品的元素融入感官設計。 P-A-R-K Personal and Peaceful 雅靜休憩與個人，專屬旅人的精品簡奢之家 Artistic and Astounding 生活美學與時尚，探索建築空間與深度設計 Refined and Resourceful 精緻服務與專業，便捷的環境與貼心的接待 Kaohsiung Originated 城市高雄與品味，都會融合的獨特風範 建築設計 ARCHITECTURE樓層說明 B1~B3：地下停車場 Parking (車位有限)LB（文信路）：酒店接待大廳 Hotel Lobby 1F~2F（篤敬路）：艾可廚坊CERCLE de Cercle 5F~16F：客房Guestroom 建築外觀酒店以簡潔的黑白灰色調及線條，和諧搭配出精品感十足的建築外衣，頂冠採用不規則間距粗細的黑色鐵件保留陽光與天際的穿透感，公園前烙印明亮的集團標誌，如高雄海港之都中旅人歸屬的燈塔，並於酒店大門外角落地坪崁入銅板蝕雕，標記了所在地的經緯度與方位。 環保綠化 建築表層晶石塗料內具隔熱層，全面採用灰階強化膠合玻璃，有效阻隔部分熱能。頂樓鋪設隔熱地磚與綠化，設置太陽能板可自主蓄電提供夜間外牆照明電力。全館空調與熱水採用熱泵與冰水主機熱回收串聯，有效降低能源之耗損。建築內外燈光皆使用高效能LED燈具，並利用KNX系統及軟體，分區分段分時調節光源。 室內空間設計 INTERIOR DESIGN 抽象港都延伸外觀高雅簡約的風格，室內大量使用雕刻白大理石為主建材，大廳的復古不規則拼貼地坪表現出海水折射晶化的抽象感，並搭配接待櫃台的不規則船型意象與皮革框、大船入港。沙發區立面同樣採用不規則拼貼大面積的粗曠石材，櫃台後方壁面墨藍色橡木，加上天花的鍍鈦黑與金色波浪藝術造型，以抽象而時尚的設計手法，渲染這城市的天、海、山、河的港都意境，華奢但精緻內斂。 客房廊道映入眼簾的是藍灰白潑墨式的羊毛地毯，流水般的引導至客房門口，墨藍色與木色壁面及微醺暈光的大框，厚實門扇隔絕干擾舒適入眠。 個性化舒活空間 客房內49吋電視主牆墨藍框型與簡潔的白色長桌面，色調對換的呼應大廳白皮革框與櫃檯，銜接房口的矮坐墊，貼心給予旅客方便卸去鞋子讓腳呼吸的一處。芥末綠與金色曲線造型的書桌椅與矮凳，簡約時尚的品味恰與公園景致延伸一氣，全落地式的十字窗，讓充足的溫暖南台灣光線穿透房內至浴室空間。全館衛浴皆配置日本INAX免治馬桶，並使用德國百年精品V&B與GROHE。濕式備品更選用歐盟認證的環保產品，草本芬芳溫和舒適。而房內的畫作皆是跟高雄在地藝術家配合創作，讓源自這個城市萌芽的作品有機會被更多國內外的旅人欣賞。 PARK C ROOM墨藍色的客房、或PARK LEES SUITE墨綠色的套房，大膽但沉穩放鬆的格調，再開啟YAMAHA音響連接手機撥放自己喜愛的音樂，泡個澡同時喝杯紅酒，沉溺陶醉。 帕可麗酒店 PARK LEES HOTEL高雄市鼓山區文信路192號電話: 07-962-8800傳真: 07-962-9600 訂房 Reservation電話：07-229-6030 分機 3510 / 3511 或 07-962-8800

stays.description: 碧港良居海景精品旅店坐落於西子灣風景區，2013年11月全新落成開幕，現代感與極簡時尚的建築融合於山海美景之中。全館共規劃十四間房，空間充滿 人文優雅與俐落清爽的都會氣息，房間皆有賞景陽台，海景房型更直接臨高雄港美景。旅店內更設置了早餐咖啡廳、10人型及20人型會議室、可賞景BBQ的頂樓花園瞭望台，無論是情侶愛之旅、家族旅遊或企業會議假期，皆能在此歡 度假期，加倍浪漫歡愉。 碧港良居地理位置得天獨厚，背倚層巒疊翠的柴山，開門即見高雄港和遊艇碼頭海天一色的絕佳景致，晚上則可眺望燈光璀璨的市景、高雄地標八五大樓及夢時代摩天輪，周邊更有名勝古蹟、知名景點和美食小吃，如西子灣、哨船頭公園、英國領事館、駁二藝術特區、真愛碼頭、旗津海岸公園等，既能散步閒逛，也可以單車旅遊，直接住在名勝景點就是這麼便利。 悠遊海洋城市，一定要住在海闊天高的風景裡才不枉此行，我們將竭誠提供您 賓至如歸的服務，以及最舒適的住宿品質，讓您的高雄之旅更添美好回憶，碧港良居在此全心全意迎接您。
stays.descriptionEn: The “Watermark Hotel”, located in Sizihwan, is surrounded by the prosperous Kaohsiung Harbor and Chai Shan which is peaks and ridges and a whole slice of green. Feel the phytoncidere in the mountain and wash tiredness of body and soul early in the morning. The fading light of sunset spilled here, glistening yellow, sparkling like a jewel when sunset. And it can overlook the city view with bright lights of Kaohsiung Harbor and the landmark of Kaohsiung of 85 building and Ferris Wheel of Dream Mall can be a panoramic view. The sea and the sky merge into one, the ship goes into the territory and the verdant mountain and sea views can be got easily at anywhere and anytime. In addition to the stunning scenery, the convenient transportation is a big advantage here. It is near Sizihwan MRT station and Gushan Ferry Station; it is very convenient to go to the urban area of Kaohsiung and Cijin. The nearby attractions are too numerous to enumerate, there are Sizihwan Beach, Shaochuantou Park, British Consulate, Martyrs’ Shrine, Pier-2 Art Center, Banana Pier, Love Pier, Cijin Seaside Park, Cihou Lighthouse and so on. It combines the convenience and prosperity of city and the quiet and beauty of suburb; it can be said to be the most beautiful back garden in Kaohsiung. Would you like to get away temporarily from the hubbub and make a relax tour for you that tired of crowded urban life? Here is absolutely your best choice.

stays.name: 高雄港區-棧貳沐居
stays.description: 2018年由高雄港區土地開發股份有限公司接手整建的「棧貳庫 KW2」不僅以高雄港二號碼頭緣由命名，更盡可能保留百餘年來倉庫所遺留下來的元素，如磚牆、搖擺窗、力霸鋼筋屋架，原貌呈現老建築富含時代底藴與歲月痕跡的簡約美感。棧貳庫五周年，攜手MUJI RENOVATION空間改造企劃團隊，打造臺灣首座歷史建築倉庫旅宿「棧貳沐居KW2 HOSTEL」，以「大人的秘密基地」為發想概念，透過空間改造活化提升「三感一力」歷史感、國際感、價值感與創造力，帶動高雄港區觀光文創複合式體驗。在歷史建築內賦予「住宿」的新意義，眺望高雄港海景沐光而眠，享受慢活旅行步調，以「不只是旅宿」的企劃方向，創造內容趣味性與話題性。

stays.name: 高雄萬豪酒店
stays.description: 高雄萬豪酒店為全台最大萬豪酒店，座落於於愛河地區，鄰近凹仔底森林公園。酒店距高雄國際機場僅25分鐘車程，距高鐵站15分鐘，距捷運凹仔底站步行5分鐘，交通便利性極佳。酒店會議及宴會空間分佈於 8 樓、10 樓及 11 樓，總面積達2,518 坪，稱霸南台灣；面積最大的萬享大宴會廳空間挑高、氣派華麗，面積約 847 坪可容納約 2,000 人；首創兩座戶外禮堂，滿足不同場合及宴會型態。從13到33樓共700間客房，12種不同房型，設計經典兼具現代風格〪12 樓健身中心設有室內溫水游泳池、水療池以及維琪浴，幫助紓壓煥發身心。酒店提供多樣精緻美食，包括歐陸餐廳、頂級中、西、日式佳餚美饌，為賓客締造賓至如歸奢華體驗。
stays.descriptionEn: Kaohsiung Marriott Hotel is located within the area of Love River and Aozihdi Forest Park. Welcome you to explore the city from the convenient location of hotel. Encompassing 8318 square meters of flexible space, the hotel is an inspiring event venue. Spreading over 2800 square meters the Grand Ballroom accommodating as many as 2000 guests. A range of versatile spaces to choose from including Apollo and Diana, two splendid sky gardens. Total 700 guestrooms, offering 12 room types in modern and spacious design. Take a dip in swimming pool, soothe your muscles with a hydro massage or enjoy a relaxing Vichy shower at the Fitness Center. Embark on a gastronomic journey to discover a wide array of gourmet offerings. Enjoy a marvelous experience and Let Your Mind Travel.

stays.searchText: 高雄萬豪酒店 朕豪大酒店股份有限公司 交觀宿字第1523號 高雄市 鼓山區 龍德新路222號 高雄萬豪酒店為全台最大萬豪酒店，座落於於愛河地區，鄰近凹仔底森林公園。酒店距高雄國際機場僅25分鐘車程，距高鐵站15分鐘，距捷運凹仔底站步行5分鐘，交通便利性極佳。酒店會議及宴會空間分佈於 8 樓、10 樓及 11 樓，總面積達2,518 坪，稱霸南台灣；面積最大的萬享大宴會廳空間挑高、氣派華麗，面積約 847 坪可容納約 2,000 人；首創兩座戶外禮堂，滿足不同場合及宴會型態。從13到33樓共700間客房，12種不同房型，設計經典兼具現代風格〪12 樓健身中心設有室內溫水游泳池、水療池以及維琪浴，幫助紓壓煥發身心。酒店提供多樣精緻美食，包括歐陸餐廳、頂級中、西、日式佳餚美饌，為賓客締造賓至如歸奢華體驗。
